_meta.note: 任務對話。這個檔案是產生物——請改 quest/ 底下對應任務的檔案，再跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。直接改這裡下次會被蓋掉。

A Grave Mistake#000.src: I have nothing more to say. Take these.
A Grave Mistake#000.dst: Je n'ai rien d'autre à dire. Prenez ceci.

similar.text: I have nothing more to say.

A Grave Mistake#001.src: Thank you again for all of your help!
A Grave Mistake#001.dst: Merci encore pour toute votre aide!

A Grave Mistake#003.src: But since you have made it thus far, I suppose I shall show you the truth...
A Grave Mistake#003.dst: Mais puisque vous êtes venu jusqu'ici, je vais vous montrer la vérité...

A Grave Mistake#004.src: Then leave, and forget the horrors you have witnessed here today...
A Grave Mistake#004.dst: Alors partez, et oubliez les horreurs que vous avez vues ici aujourd'hui...
A Grave Mistake#004.speaker: Mael

A Grave Mistake#005.src: Keep in mind what you have learned.
A Grave Mistake#005.dst: Retenez bien ce que vous avez appris.

A Grave Mistake#007.src: There is nothing in this graveyard.
A Grave Mistake#007.dst: Il n'y a rien dans ce cimetière.
A Grave Mistake#007.speaker: Alem

A Grave Mistake#011.dst: Oh, mon bras.. Il est rev...
A Grave Mistake#011.speaker: XXXXXXX

A Grave Mistake#012.src: Where di.. my arm.? I need my a... I had it somewh... upstairs?
A Grave Mistake#012.dst: Où est.. mon bras.? Il me faut mon b... Je l'avais quelque p... en haut?
A Grave Mistake#012.speaker: XXXXXXX

A Grave Mistake#013.src: You were warned not to enter this forsaken place.
A Grave Mistake#013.dst: On vous avait dit de ne pas entrer dans ce lieu maudit.

A Grave Mistake#015.dst: Ils sont plus en sécurité ici.
A Grave Mistake#015.speaker: Mael

A Grave Mistake#017.src: Ooh.. oh... another victim... Welcome... there is no need for a quick introduction... ... you will have just time enough now...
A Grave Mistake#017.dst: Ooh.. oh... une autre victime... Bienvenue... nul besoin de vous présenter... ... vous aurez juste assez de temps...
A Grave Mistake#017.speaker: Skull

A Grave Mistake#018.src: After all... you just fell into a grave... but, let us make it a little comfortable... where shall I bite first?!
A Grave Mistake#018.dst: Après tout... vous venez de tomber dans une tombe... mais installons-nous confortablement... où vais-je mordre d'abord?!
A Grave Mistake#018.speaker: Skull

A Headless History#000.src: These crates contain equipment made for exploring, but nothing suspicious.
A Headless History#000.dst: Ces caisses contiennent du matériel d'exploration, mais rien de suspect.

A Headless History#001.src: Oi, what are you still doing here?
A Headless History#001.dst: Hé, qu'est-ce que tu fais encore là?

A Headless History#002.src: You should check your content book to see what to do next.
A Headless History#002.dst: Consulte ton livre de contenu pour savoir quoi faire ensuite.

A Headless History#003.src: I left {p} behind, to aid in her "battle" against the darkness. What a fool I was.
A Headless History#003.dst: J'ai quitté {p} pour l'aider dans sa "bataille" contre les ténèbres. Quel sot j'étais.

A Headless History#004.src: Six hundred years of searching finally brought us to what we so foolishly sought... And we were unprepared.
A Headless History#004.dst: Six cents ans de recherche nous ont enfin menés à ce que nous cherchions si sottement... Et nous n'étions pas prêts.

A Headless History#005.src: That sparkle of light seems to lead down the side path. It feels somehow desperate...?
A Headless History#005.dst: Cette lueur semble mener vers le chemin de côté. Elle paraît presque... désespérée?

A Headless History#006.src: It almost seems like he wants to say something, even though his expression is blank.
A Headless History#006.dst: On dirait presque qu'il veut dire quelque chose, malgré son visage inexpressif.

A Headless History#007.src: Despite this, he isn't responding to you. He looks almost soulless...
A Headless History#007.dst: Pourtant, il ne vous répond pas. Il semble presque sans âme...

A Headless History#011.src: You are NOT dying on me! I won't allow it! You will LIVE, you hear me? !
A Headless History#011.dst: Tu NE vas PAS mourir! Je ne le permettrai pas! Tu vas VIVRE, tu m'entends?!
A Headless History#011.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#012.src: At this moment...I believed that I could protect her. I believed that I could aid her.
A Headless History#012.dst: A ce moment... je croyais pouvoir la protéger. Je croyais pouvoir l'aider.

A Headless History#013.src: You've been trying to find "another way" for two centuries. Don't you think it's high-time we took my route, before things get worse?
A Headless History#013.dst: Ça fait deux siècles que tu cherches "un autre moyen". Tu ne crois pas qu'il est grand temps de faire à ma façon, avant que ça empire?
A Headless History#013.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#014.src: As the darkness slowly seeped into the land, her stubbornness halted any progress we might have made.
A Headless History#014.dst: Tandis que les ténèbres s'infiltraient lentement dans la terre, son entêtement a bloqué tout progrès possible.

A Headless History#015.src: Years of searching to no avail- A strong enough attack would have ended it, but her foolish pacifism doomed us.
A Headless History#015.dst: Des années de recherches en vain- Une attaque assez forte y aurait mis fin, mais son pacifisme insensé nous a condamnés.

A Headless History#016.src: The creature was found hibernating underground... It had been storing power, and we found ourselves utterly outmatched.
A Headless History#016.dst: La créature hibernait sous terre... Elle accumulait du pouvoir, et nous étions totalement dépassés.

A Headless History#017.src: The sacrifices I made for her can never be measured. Despite that... once I had outlived my usefulness, I was tossed away like old clothing and left to collect dust.
A Headless History#017.dst: Les sacrifices que j'ai faits pour elle sont incommensurables. Pourtant... une fois devenu inutile, elle m'a jeté comme un vieux vêtement, abandonné à la poussière.

A Headless History#018.src: Instead, it will free you from your very life. I have had enough of your meddling.
A Headless History#018.dst: Au lieu de cela, elle vous délivrera de la vie même. J'en ai assez de votre ingérence.

A Headless History#019.src: She had the power and the opportunity to kill it ten times over, but clung to her morals. She could not recognize necessity, and refused to heed my offers and warnings.
A Headless History#019.dst: Elle avait le pouvoir et l'occasion de la tuer dix fois, mais s'accrochait à sa morale. Elle ne voyait pas la nécessité, et ignorait mes offres et mes avertissements.

A Headless History#020.src: And so, my dark agony began. The light began to siphon away from me. I found myself paranoid and addled, fearful that my disfigurement would be seen.
A Headless History#020.dst: C'est ainsi qu'a commencé ma sombre agonie. La lumière s'est mise à me fuir. Je suis devenu paranoïaque et confus, craignant qu'on voie ma difformité.

A Headless History#021.src: Even still I held some misplaced faith in her. With that dark seed in my mind... It grew to an obsession, almost- I had to hide it. I had to hide my curse. But it was found...
A Headless History#021.dst: Malgré tout, je gardais en elle une foi mal placée. Avec cette graine noire dans l'esprit... C'est devenu une obsession, presque- Je devais le cacher. Cacher ma malédiction. Mais on l'a découverte...

A Headless History#022.src: All of you, welcome! Today will be the day we save our fair land. Today's the day of light!
A Headless History#022.dst: Bienvenue à tous! Aujourd'hui, nous sauverons notre belle terre. Aujourd'hui est le jour de la lumière!
A Headless History#022.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#023.src: The people of {p} saw my cursed visage... They saw me near the dark scars. They assumed without thought, and turned me into a perfect scapegoat.
A Headless History#023.dst: Les gens de {p} ont vu mon visage maudit... Ils m'ont vu près des cicatrices sombres. Ils ont conclu sans réfléchir, et ont fait de moi le bouc émissaire idéal.

A Headless History#024.src: Not even death saw the end of my misfortunes. Not even a final release such as this could save me from Lari's stubbornness and endless mistakes.
A Headless History#024.dst: Même la mort n'a pas mis fin à mes malheurs. Même une délivrance ultime comme celle-ci n'a pu me sauver de l'entêtement de Lari et de ses erreurs sans fin.

A Headless History#025.src: She brought me back...but the dark infection had eroded away my mind, my soul, my magic, and it continued to ravage my body. Every part of me, the dark touched.
A Headless History#025.dst: Elle m'a ramené... mais l'infection noire avait rongé mon esprit, mon âme, ma magie, et continuait de ravager mon corps. Les ténèbres ont touché chaque parcelle de moi.

A Headless History#026.src: Her soft light burned in me, as the darkness quashed it and filled in the emptiness that it had created. I was there...but you could not say I was the same person.
A Headless History#026.dst: Sa douce lumière brûlait en moi, tandis que les ténèbres l'étouffaient et comblaient le vide qu'elle avait laissé. J'étais là... mais je n'étais plus le même.

A Headless History#027.src: I could feel nothing. She still made me feel...but only annoyance. Rage. Sorrow. I could not bear to be with her a moment longer.
A Headless History#027.dst: Je ne ressentais rien. Elle m'inspirait encore... mais seulement de l'agacement. De la rage. Du chagrin. Je ne la supportais plus.

A Headless History#028.src: There is no fixing this. Her actions are doomed to failure, just as I saw. She has not returned since this time... And so she did not realize that her actions have done little.
A Headless History#028.dst: Ce n'est pas réparable. Ses actes sont voués à l'échec, comme je l'ai vu. Elle n'est jamais revenue depuis... Elle ignore donc combien ses actes ont peu servi.

A Headless History#029.src: The very powers she bestowed me with, knowingly or not...allow me to command spirits as I wish. To have those who doomed me to this purgatory feel the same aches as I have.
A Headless History#029.dst: Les pouvoirs mêmes qu'elle m'a conférés, sciemment ou non... me permettent de commander les esprits à ma guise. Que ceux qui m'ont condamné à ce purgatoire souffrent comme moi.

A Headless History#030.src: To have their minds, bodies, and souls wracked. To have their magic outlawed and wither in disuse.
A Headless History#030.dst: Que leur esprit, leur corps et leur âme soient tourmentés. Que leur magie soit proscrite et dépérisse, inutilisée.

A Headless History#031.src: Each soul I consume fills me with new strength. And none can reach me- Lari herself saw to that. Would she have taken action, had she known?
A Headless History#031.dst: Chaque âme que je consume me remplit d'une force nouvelle. Et nul ne peut m'atteindre- Lari elle-même y a veillé. Aurait-elle agi, si elle avait su?

A Headless History#032.src: There is truly, finally, nothing more for you here. The spell can not be broken, as of now. You have seen my life laid bare in front of you. There is nothing more for you to see.
A Headless History#032.dst: Il n'y a vraiment, enfin, plus rien pour vous ici. Le sort ne peut être brisé, pour l'instant. Vous avez vu ma vie mise à nu devant vous. Il n'y a plus rien à voir.

A Headless History#034.src: Talk to Hans in the {p} outskirts at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
A Headless History#034.dst: Parlez à Hans aux abords de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Headless History#035.src: Oi, you there! With the small nose and whatnot! I got somethin' to ask you. Got a minute?
A Headless History#035.dst: Hé, toi là! Avec le petit nez et tout! J'ai une question pour toi. T'as une minute?
A Headless History#035.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#036.src: Good, you're good people. It's about our neighbor, Referick. He's a bit of a conspiracy nut. You know the type, villager illuminati, Wybels are evil, all that?
A Headless History#036.dst: Bien, t'es quelqu'un de bien. C'est à propos de notre voisin, Referick. Il est un peu complotiste. Tu vois le genre: illuminati villageois, les Wybels sont maléfiques, tout ça?
A Headless History#036.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#037.src: He's acting proper strange though, the past few days. Thinkin' a lord of time's draggin' creatures from other dimensions doesn't make ya stop eatin' or drinkin'.
A Headless History#037.dst: Mais il est vraiment bizarre depuis quelques jours. Croire qu'un seigneur du temps ramène des bestioles d'autres dimensions, ça empêche pas de manger ou de boire.
A Headless History#037.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#038.src: He'll talk your ear off about it if you give him half a chance, but he ain't sayin' a word to me, even when I tried askin' about his theories.
A Headless History#038.dst: Il te rebat les oreilles avec ça à la moindre occasion, mais à moi il dit pas un mot, même quand j'ai voulu l'interroger sur ses théories.
A Headless History#038.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#039.src: Somethin's definitely wrong about him, that much's for sure. Could ya take a look for me, see whatcha can figure out and all?
A Headless History#039.dst: Il a un truc qui va pas, ça c'est sûr. Tu pourrais jeter un oeil pour moi, voir ce que tu trouves et tout?
A Headless History#039.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#040.src: He lives in the house next to the pile of rocks. He's got screws loose but I don't want 'im dyin' on me, yeah?
A Headless History#040.dst: Il vit dans la maison à côté du tas de rochers. Il lui manque une case, mais je veux pas qu'il me claque entre les doigts, hein?
A Headless History#040.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#041.src: Talk to Referick in his house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
A Headless History#041.dst: Parlez à Referick chez lui en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Headless History#043.src: Oi! Any luck with ol' Rick there?
A Headless History#043.dst: Hé! Du nouveau avec ce vieux Rick?
A Headless History#043.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#044.src: ...hm. Dang it...y'know, maybe there's somethin' here that'll tell us what in heck happened.
A Headless History#044.dst: ...hm. Zut... tu sais, y a peut-être un truc ici qui nous dira ce qui s'est passé, bon sang.
A Headless History#044.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#045.src: Let's look around the house for anythin' he mighta been workin' on. Maybe he finally fiddled with somethin' he shouldn'ta fiddled with?
A Headless History#045.dst: Fouillons la maison, voir sur quoi il bossait. Il a peut-être enfin bidouillé un truc qu'il aurait pas dû bidouiller?
A Headless History#045.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#046.src: Investigate his house for clues as to what could have happened.
A Headless History#046.dst: Fouillez sa maison en quête d'indices sur ce qui a pu se passer.

A Headless History#047.src: Whassat you're lookin' at there? The castle? Don't see why he'd be pointin' this ol' telescope that way.
A Headless History#047.dst: Qu'est-ce que tu regardes, là? Le château? Je vois pas pourquoi il pointerait ce vieux télescope par là.
A Headless History#047.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#048.src: You're human, so you wouldn't know, but somethin' like two hundred years ago, an elf of all people lived in that castle. Called 'imself Dullahan, wore a helmet a lot, I think.
A Headless History#048.dst: T'es humain, donc tu peux pas savoir, mais il y a genre deux cents ans, un elfe, figure-toi, vivait dans ce château. Il se faisait appeler Dullahan, portait souvent un casque, je crois.
A Headless History#048.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#049.src: People thought he was the reason for the Decay- can't imagine why, personally, and obviously they weren't right.
A Headless History#049.dst: Les gens pensaient qu'il causait la Décadence- je vois pas pourquoi, perso, et ils avaient tort, évidemment.
A Headless History#049.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#050.src: ...hm. Y'know, there's some ghost stories about Dullahan still livin' in that castle... Come to think of it, I think Referick mentioned a theory about it.
A Headless History#050.dst: ...hm. Tu sais, y a des histoires de fantômes qui disent que Dullahan vit encore dans ce château... Maintenant que j'y pense, Referick a parlé d'une théorie là-dessus.
A Headless History#050.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#051.src: Barely remember what it was about cause of how many crackpots he's stuck his head into, but it's somethin' about a ghost. 's the only lead I can think of, anyways...
A Headless History#051.dst: Je me souviens à peine de quoi ça parlait, vu toutes les lubies où il a mis le nez, mais c'est un truc de fantôme. C'est la seule piste que j'ai, en tout cas...
A Headless History#051.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#052.src: The castle door's locked, but you can access the basement. Think you could try lookin' over there? That's all I got.
A Headless History#052.dst: La porte du château est fermée, mais on peut entrer dans la cave. Tu pourrais aller voir par là? C'est tout ce que j'ai.
A Headless History#052.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#053.src: Travel to the castle in the north at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
A Headless History#053.dst: Rendez-vous au château au nord en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Headless History#055.src: ...an unfamiliar soul? Strange. I have not brought you here. I do not know of you.
A Headless History#055.dst: ...une âme inconnue? Étrange. Je ne vous ai pas amené ici. Je ne vous connais pas.

A Headless History#056.src: What an odd feeling... I haven't felt confusion in a long time. How refreshing...still, I shall ask you to leave.
A Headless History#056.dst: Étrange sensation... Je n'avais plus été perplexe depuis longtemps. Rafraîchissant... partez tout de même.

A Headless History#057.src: Excuse you. I asked you to leave, strange person. You would ignore my request?
A Headless History#057.dst: Je vous demande pardon? Je vous ai prié de partir, étranger. Vous ignoreriez ma requête?

A Headless History#058.src: Such an action is rather insolent, not to mention...interesting. Still, interfering with my business is inexcusable.
A Headless History#058.dst: Un tel acte est bien insolent, pour ne pas dire... intéressant. Mais vous mêler de mes affaires est inexcusable.

A Headless History#059.src: Demons of the Prison Guard, I compel you to execute this interloper. Trap their soul for my perusal later.
A Headless History#059.dst: Démons du Geôlier, je vous somme d'exécuter cet intrus. Piégez son âme, que je l'examine plus tard.

A Headless History#060.src: Return to Referick with his soul at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
A Headless History#060.dst: Retournez voir Referick avec son âme en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Headless History#061.src: Return to Referick with his soul at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Headless History#061.dst: Retournez voir Referick avec son âme en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Headless History#062.src: OI! Referick!! Wait for me! Ain'tcha need some food and drink first?!
A Headless History#062.dst: HÉ! Referick!! Attends-moi! T'as pas besoin de manger et boire un coup d'abord?!
A Headless History#062.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#063.src: The heck did you do?! Referick just bolted out the door like he forgot his wallet or somethin'!
A Headless History#063.dst: Bon sang, t'as fait quoi?! Referick vient de filer dehors comme s'il avait oublié son portefeuille!
A Headless History#063.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#064.src: C'mon mate, you got up and moved for the first time in days and now you're clammin' up again? Speak to me!
A Headless History#064.dst: Allez, mon vieux, tu te lèves pour la première fois depuis des jours et tu te refermes encore? Parle-moi!
A Headless History#064.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#066.src: YIPE! Never heard 'im scream like that before! Never heard anyone scream like that before! I'd like to never hear anyone scream like that again!
A Headless History#066.dst: AÏE! Je l'avais jamais entendu crier comme ça! Ni personne d'autre! Et j'aimerais plus jamais entendre personne crier comme ça!
A Headless History#066.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#067.src: Oh, shut UP Hans! I nearly had my soul devoured, don't DARE give me any chaff when I was RIGHT all along!!
A Headless History#067.dst: Oh, la FERME, Hans! J'ai failli me faire dévorer l'âme, OSE pas me chercher alors que j'avais RAISON depuis le début!!
A Headless History#067.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#068.src: Agh, alright, alright! Quiet, my ears are ringin'! I'll listen, I'll listen, just quiet!
A Headless History#068.dst: Aïe, d'accord, d'accord! Moins fort, mes oreilles sifflent! J'écoute, j'écoute, mais moins fort!
A Headless History#068.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#069.src: I knew the disappearances in {p} weren't just because of the risen bodies. People were being left catatonic!! That doesn't happen randomly!
A Headless History#069.dst: Je savais que les disparitions à {p} n'étaient pas dues qu'aux morts relevés. Les gens restaient catatoniques!! Ça arrive pas par hasard!
A Headless History#069.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#070.src: It's Dullahan, I swear on my life! I figured him out and he came after me! He's devouring peoples' souls and siphoning their energy for himself!
A Headless History#070.dst: C'est Dullahan, je le jure sur ma vie! Je l'ai démasqué et il s'en est pris à moi! Il dévore l'âme des gens et aspire leur énergie!
A Headless History#070.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#071.src: He's acting from within the castle somehow- Ghostly hands and servants, I'll bet! And that means there's a chance to stop him, if he has to act indirectly!
A Headless History#071.dst: Il agit depuis le château, d'une façon ou d'une autre- Des mains et des serviteurs fantômes, je parie! Et s'il doit agir indirectement, on a une chance de l'arrêter!
A Headless History#071.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#072.src: We need to round up the townsfolk, the guards, the military, EVERYONE! We have to storm the castle and stop him before he's able to escape!
A Headless History#072.dst: Il faut rassembler les villageois, les gardes, l'armée, TOUT LE MONDE! On doit prendre le château d'assaut et l'arrêter avant qu'il puisse s'enfuir!
A Headless History#072.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#073.src: ...criminy, you really bit the big one, didn'tcha...look, if he's tryin' to eat people's souls, wouldn't it be smarter to NOT have a huge mob?
A Headless History#073.dst: ...bon sang, t'as vraiment pris cher, hein... écoute, s'il veut manger des âmes, ce serait pas plus malin de PAS amener une foule énorme?
A Headless History#073.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#074.src: Wait, wh-what do you mean?! Shouldn't everyone be on high alert? Won't we have a better chance of swarming him all at once?
A Headless History#074.dst: Attends, q-quoi?! Tout le monde devrait pas être en alerte? On aurait pas plus de chances en l'assaillant tous ensemble?
A Headless History#074.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#075.src: He'd have a whole mob of people ready to take from in that case. Sending in one, heavily-armed person, or a small group'd be better.
A Headless History#075.dst: Il aurait toute une foule où se servir, dans ce cas. Mieux vaut envoyer une seule personne bien armée, ou un petit groupe.
A Headless History#075.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#076.src: And, well...a heavily-armed human just rescued ya, Ricky. I think we leave this to 'em. How about it, human? Head up to the castle and look into this for us?
A Headless History#076.dst: Et, bah... un humain bien armé vient de te sauver, Ricky. On lui laisse ça, je pense. Qu'en dis-tu, l'humain? Tu montes au château enquêter pour nous?
A Headless History#076.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#077.dst: Entrez dans le château de Dullahan.

A Headless History#078.dst: Entrez dans le château de Dullahan.

A Headless History#079.src: The interesting soul arrives once more. Why is it you valued the life of that villager? You risked yourself for his soul.
A Headless History#079.dst: L'âme intéressante revient. Pourquoi teniez-vous tant à la vie de ce villageois? Vous avez risqué la vôtre pour son âme.

A Headless History#080.src: It will not make a difference one way or the other, and so I am doubly confused. The feeling has already grown tiresome.
A Headless History#080.dst: Cela ne changera rien, dans un sens ou dans l'autre, ce qui me rend doublement perplexe. La sensation m'ennuie déjà.

A Headless History#081.src: What purpose have you in this place? Turn over your soul so I may examine it and find out. I am genuinely curious to know...
A Headless History#081.dst: Quel est votre but en ce lieu? Livrez-moi votre âme, que je l'examine pour le découvrir. Je suis sincèrement curieux...

A Headless History#083.src: Be done! I bind you with Orphion's light!
A Headless History#083.dst: C'est fini! Je te lie par la lumière d'Orphion!
A Headless History#083.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#084.dst: Attends... ça... ça ne t-tient pas?!
A Headless History#084.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#085.src: LARIII! Where are you?! I can help!!
A Headless History#085.dst: LARIII! Où es-tu?! Je peux aider!!
A Headless History#085.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#086.src: Ugh, I saw her with that...THING, but...
A Headless History#086.dst: Ugh, je l'ai vue avec cette... CHOSE, mais...
A Headless History#086.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#087.src: My visions didn't show an exact enough spot... LARIII?
A Headless History#087.dst: Mes visions ne montraient pas l'endroit exact... LARIII?
A Headless History#087.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#088.src: I...what is... What left the land scarred like this?!
A Headless History#088.dst: Je... qu'est-ce... Qu'est-ce qui a meurtri la terre ainsi?!
A Headless History#088.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#089.src: Was...was this their clash...? L-LARI! LARIIII! WHERE ARE YOU?!
A Headless History#089.dst: Était-ce... était-ce leur affrontement...? L-LARI! LARIIII! OÙ ES-TU?!
A Headless History#089.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#091.src: Sit as still as you can, I have healing spells prepared.
A Headless History#091.dst: Ne bouge surtout pas, j'ai préparé des sorts de soin.
A Headless History#091.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#092.src: I ask the land for its life to save another. Grant me this!
A Headless History#092.dst: Je demande à la terre sa vie pour en sauver une autre. Exauce-moi!
A Headless History#092.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#094.src: Oh, what am I going to do with you...
A Headless History#094.dst: Oh, qu'est-ce que je vais faire de toi...
A Headless History#094.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#096.src: Once again you ignore my demands...? And not only that, you invade the memories I have locked away?
A Headless History#096.dst: Vous ignorez encore mes ordres...? Et plus encore, vous envahissez les souvenirs que j'ai enfermés?
A Headless History#096.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#097.src: I must ask again, what is your goal? Why have you come here, and why do you seek my most private thoughts, that not even I wish to think?
A Headless History#097.dst: Je dois le redemander: quel est votre but? Pourquoi êtes-vous venu, et pourquoi fouillez-vous mes pensées les plus intimes, que moi-même je refuse de penser?
A Headless History#097.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#098.src: Look, Dulla, I really do appreciate your help, but you know I can't do what you're asking of me! There's another way, I just need to find it!
A Headless History#098.dst: Écoute, Dulla, j'apprécie vraiment ton aide, mais tu sais que je ne peux pas faire ce que tu me demandes! Il y a un autre moyen, je dois juste le trouver!
A Headless History#098.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#099.src: Lari, you remember that I have my visions, right? I've seen what will happen if you don't step up- and I can help stop it!
A Headless History#099.dst: Lari, tu te souviens que j'ai mes visions, hein? J'ai vu ce qui arrivera si tu n'agis pas- et je peux aider à l'empêcher!
A Headless History#099.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#100.src: NO! I am not going to kill it! YOU are not going to kill it! I'll find a way! I will, I have these powers for a reason!
A Headless History#100.dst: NON! Je ne vais pas la tuer! Et TOI non plus! Je trouverai un moyen! Oui, j'ai ces pouvoirs pour une raison!
A Headless History#100.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#101.src: You talk a big game, and you show one too, but the creature wasn't fazed. I'm not fazed. Drop the intimidating act, please.
A Headless History#101.dst: Tu parles beaucoup, et tu joues les dures, mais la créature n'a pas bronché. Moi non plus. Arrête de vouloir m'intimider, s'il te plaît.
A Headless History#101.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#102.src: I...there...there has to be a way. I...I-I'm terrified that I've...already ruined everything, just by following my heart, like I was told...
A Headless History#102.dst: Je... il... il doit y avoir un moyen. J'ai... j-j'ai peur d'avoir... déjà tout gâché, rien qu'en suivant mon coeur, comme on me l'a dit...
A Headless History#102.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#103.src: I know you're frustrated, but I am too. I left a lot behind to try and help you. I hate to say these things, I wish it could be your way.
A Headless History#103.dst: Je sais que tu es frustrée, mais moi aussi. J'ai laissé beaucoup derrière moi pour t'aider. Je déteste dire ça, j'aimerais que ce soit à ta façon.
A Headless History#103.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#104.src: I'm terrified too, that if we don't take more drastic action, things will get worse. Can't you see that, too?
A Headless History#104.dst: J'ai peur aussi que si on ne prend pas de mesures radicales, tout empire. Tu ne le vois pas, toi aussi?
A Headless History#104.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#105.src: I...I just... I don't know what to do!
A Headless History#105.dst: Je... c'est juste que... Je ne sais pas quoi faire!
A Headless History#105.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#106.src: He showed me all these things and gave me all these choices and asked how my heart beat!
A Headless History#106.dst: Il m'a montré toutes ces choses, donné tous ces choix, et m'a demandé comment battait mon coeur!
A Headless History#106.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#107.src: He gave me these powers but they don't work or I don't know HOW they work!
A Headless History#107.dst: Il m'a donné ces pouvoirs, mais ils ne marchent pas ou j'ignore COMMENT!
A Headless History#107.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#108.src: I want to do the right thing but I don't know what it is and I don't know how to ask what it is and...a-and...
A Headless History#108.dst: Je veux faire ce qui est juste, mais je ne sais pas ce que c'est, ni comment le demander, et... e-et...
A Headless History#108.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#109.src: You have become infuriating instead of interesting. Why do you violate my memories? Why do you force me to relive them?
A Headless History#109.dst: Vous êtes passé d'intéressant à exaspérant. Pourquoi violez-vous mes souvenirs? Pourquoi me forcez-vous à les revivre?
A Headless History#109.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#110.src: Spirit of the Keeper of Keys, rid me of this thing that befouls my place. It incites a rage akin to HER.
A Headless History#110.dst: Esprit du Gardien des Clés, débarrasse-moi de cette chose qui souille ces lieux. Elle m'enrage comme ELLE le faisait.
A Headless History#110.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#111.src: You...are a fool. More than I was. You knowingly walk to your death.
A Headless History#111.dst: Vous... êtes un sot. Plus que moi. Vous marchez sciemment vers la mort.
A Headless History#111.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#112.src: It is convenient for me, certainly, but I admit that it is equal parts enraging and bewildering.
A Headless History#112.dst: Cela m'arrange, certes, mais j'avoue que c'est autant exaspérant que déroutant.
A Headless History#112.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#113.src: Leave the room and continue exploring the castle.
A Headless History#113.dst: Quittez la pièce et continuez d'explorer le château.

A Headless History#114.src: I told you, Lari! I saw it in my visions, this is our last chance! Hurry!
A Headless History#114.dst: Je te l'avais dit, Lari! Je l'ai vu en vision, c'est notre dernière chance! Vite!
A Headless History#114.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#115.src: Look at this spot, Lari. It has to be here. The land is being scarred, just like after your fight. The light is being drained!
A Headless History#115.dst: Regarde cet endroit, Lari. C'est forcément ici. La terre est meurtrie, comme après ton combat. La lumière est aspirée!
A Headless History#115.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#116.src: This must be where the parasite burrowed down... You're... You're right. We have to...to do something.
A Headless History#116.dst: C'est sûrement là que le parasite s'est enfoui... Tu... Tu as raison. Il faut... faire quelque chose.
A Headless History#116.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#117.src: I... I'm not sure if I'm ready, but you're right. We need to do this...
A Headless History#117.dst: Je... je ne sais pas si je suis prête, mais tu as raison. Il faut le faire...
A Headless History#117.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#118.src: ...Remember what I said. You HAVE to take action. There's only two outcomes here.
A Headless History#118.dst: ...Souviens-toi de ce que je t'ai dit. Tu DOIS agir. Il n'y a que deux issues possibles.
A Headless History#118.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#120.src: We'll need to dig... Do you think you could help with that, Dulla?
A Headless History#120.dst: Il va falloir creuser... Tu pourrais m'aider, Dulla?
A Headless History#120.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#121.src: Of course, Lari. We'll need everything we can get if we're going to kill that horrendous thing.
A Headless History#121.dst: Bien sûr, Lari. Il nous faudra tout ce qu'on peut si on veut tuer cette horreur.
A Headless History#121.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#123.src: I see it! Lari, it's time!
A Headless History#123.dst: Je la vois! Lari, c'est le moment!
A Headless History#123.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#124.src: ...I will show you an exit, interloper. It would be...wise of you to take it.
A Headless History#124.dst: ...Je vais vous montrer une sortie, intrus. Il serait... sage de la prendre.
A Headless History#124.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#125.src: You are a damned fool, interloper. Dredging my memories as you have... I have never felt such rage, not in a long time.
A Headless History#125.dst: Vous êtes un fichu sot, intrus. A fouiller ainsi mes souvenirs... Je n'ai pas ressenti pareille rage depuis bien longtemps.
A Headless History#125.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#126.src: As such, it shall end now. The exit I spoke of will not free you from the castle, as you can see.
A Headless History#126.dst: Cela va donc finir maintenant. La sortie dont je parlais ne vous libérera pas du château, comme vous le voyez.
A Headless History#126.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#127.src: Warden of Wisdom! I compel you- Rid me of this miscreant! Erase every trace of it from this existence...
A Headless History#127.dst: Gardien de la Sagesse! Je te l'ordonne- Débarrasse-moi de ce scélérat! Efface toute trace de lui de cette existence...
A Headless History#127.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#128.src: ...save for a corpse, for me to toss at Lari's feet.
A Headless History#128.dst: ...hormis un cadavre, que je jetterai aux pieds de Lari.
A Headless History#128.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#129.src: GAH! It was never able to do this before...! W-What happened to it?!
A Headless History#129.dst: GAH! Elle n'avait jamais pu faire ça...! Q-Qu'est-ce qui lui arrive?!
A Headless History#129.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#130.src: AWAY! You keep away from us!!
A Headless History#130.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#131.src: Lari, you need to get up, now! We can't waste this chance!
A Headless History#131.dst: Lari, relève-toi, tout de suite! On ne peut pas gâcher cette chance!
A Headless History#131.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#132.src: It...it threw me aside like nothing! How is it overpowering Orphion's light...?
A Headless History#132.dst: Elle... elle m'a balayée comme rien! Comment peut-elle surpasser la lumière d'Orphion...?
A Headless History#132.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#133.src: It's overpowering you because you're not attacking! Remember what I said? You have to-
A Headless History#133.dst: Elle te surpasse parce que tu n'attaques pas! Tu te souviens? Tu dois-
A Headless History#133.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#134.src: ...wait, where did it...did we lose it already?!
A Headless History#134.dst: ...attends, où est-elle... on l'a déjà perdue?!
A Headless History#134.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#136.src: It's shrugging my attacks off, Lari! Come on, do SOMETHING!
A Headless History#136.dst: Elle ignore mes attaques, Lari! Allez, fais QUELQUE CHOSE!
A Headless History#136.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#138.src: I...No! It's happening just like I saw! She's...
A Headless History#138.dst: Je... Non! Tout se passe comme je l'ai vu! Elle...
A Headless History#138.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#139.src: I need to get to her, push her to the killing blow...
A Headless History#139.dst: Je dois la rejoindre, la pousser à porter le coup fatal...
A Headless History#139.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#140.src: Be still, creature! I compel you with Orphion's light!
A Headless History#140.dst: Immobile, créature! Je te l'ordonne par la lumière d'Orphion!
A Headless History#140.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#141.src: LARIIII! THIS IS THE LAST CHANCE YOU HAVE! DON'T TRAP IT, KILL IT!
A Headless History#141.dst: LARIIII! C'EST TA DERNIÈRE CHANCE! NE LA PIÈGE PAS, TUE-LA!
A Headless History#141.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#142.src: I-I'm...Dulla, I'm- I can't! I know I can keep it held this time!!
A Headless History#142.dst: J-Je... Dulla, je- je ne peux pas! Je sais que je peux la retenir cette fois!!
A Headless History#142.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#144.src: I...I-I...th-the light is...I c-can't hold onto it...i-is it...it's t-taking...g-guh...
A Headless History#144.dst: Je... j-je... l-la lumière... je n-ne peux la tenir... e-est-ce... elle la p-prend... g-guh...
A Headless History#144.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#145.src: Lari! You can't reason with it! You can't hold it! You have to put Gavel first! US first!!
A Headless History#145.dst: Lari! On ne raisonne pas cette chose! Tu ne peux pas la retenir! Gavel d'abord! NOUS d'abord!!
A Headless History#145.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#146.src: I won't let what you predicted happen! I know I can change fate!!
A Headless History#146.dst: Ta prédiction ne se réalisera pas! Je sais que je peux changer le destin!!
A Headless History#146.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#147.src: Please work, please work! D-Don't break, I can't-
A Headless History#147.dst: Marche, pitié, marche! N-Ne casse pas, je ne peux pas-
A Headless History#147.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#148.src: Lari, no! If it bites you we're doomed! GET UP!
A Headless History#148.dst: Lari, non! Si elle te mord, on est perdus! RELÈVE-TOI!
A Headless History#148.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#151.src: L-Lari...we...e-everything happened like I s-said...you...you didn't...l-listen...
A Headless History#151.dst: L-Lari... tout... t-tout s'est passé comme j-je l'avais dit... tu... tu n'as pas... é-écouté...
A Headless History#151.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#152.src: No! No it didn't happen like you said! I-I can fix this! Y-You'll be alright! You'll be alright, you hear me?! I'll make sure of it!
A Headless History#152.dst: Non! Ça ne s'est pas passé comme tu l'as dit! J-Je peux arranger ça! T-Tu vas t'en sortir! Tu vas t'en sortir, tu m'entends?! J'y veillerai!
A Headless History#152.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#153.src: ...so I am cursed to bear witness to my most painful memories due to your idiocy. It is almost a fitting penance... Almost, but not quite.
A Headless History#153.dst: ...me voilà condamné à revoir mes pires souvenirs à cause de votre idiotie. C'est presque une juste pénitence... Presque, mais pas tout à fait.
A Headless History#153.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#154.src: My rage... My memories... Your presence stirs them in kind. You must disappear, I no longer care to see your soul.
A Headless History#154.dst: Ma rage... Mes souvenirs... Votre présence les ravive tous deux. Vous devez disparaître, je ne veux plus voir votre âme.
A Headless History#154.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#155.src: Sit still and allow yourself to be engulfed. It will save me further pain.
A Headless History#155.dst: Restez immobile et laissez-vous engloutir. Cela m'épargnera d'autres souffrances.
A Headless History#155.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#156.src: Lari...? Where are you? I...I need you... Why are you gone? Why do you ignore me?
A Headless History#156.dst: Lari...? Où es-tu? Je... j'ai besoin de toi... Pourquoi es-tu partie? Pourquoi m'ignores-tu?
A Headless History#156.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#157.src: My magic is fading, I can't see my visions... They're clearer around you... Please, come back...
A Headless History#157.dst: Ma magie faiblit, mes visions s'effacent... Elles sont plus claires près de toi... Je t'en prie, reviens...
A Headless History#157.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#158.src: That elf girl's off in the forest. Don't know what she's doing but this is our shot!
A Headless History#158.dst: La petite elfe est partie dans la forêt. Je sais pas ce qu'elle fait, mais c'est notre chance!
A Headless History#158.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#159.src: We can finally execute the person causing the decay in the forest! {p} will be saved!
A Headless History#159.dst: On va enfin pouvoir exécuter celui qui cause la Décadence dans la forêt! On sauvera {p}!
A Headless History#159.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#160.src: You prepared the sleeping spell, right? Who knows if we'll get a chance like this again.
A Headless History#160.dst: Tu as préparé le sort de sommeil, hein? Qui sait si on aura encore une telle occasion.
A Headless History#160.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#163.src: L-Lari? Is...is that you? Did you finally come back...?
A Headless History#163.dst: L-Lari? C'est... c'est toi? Tu es enfin revenue...?
A Headless History#163.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#164.src: Nah, not quite. Say, why don't you go to sleep 'til she comes back? Dream sweet dreams...
A Headless History#164.dst: Non, pas vraiment. Dis, pourquoi tu ne dormirais pas jusqu'à son retour? Fais de beaux rêves...
A Headless History#164.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#165.src: ...they'll be the last ones you ever have, grimy demon. To the guillotine with you... Everyone! I got him!
A Headless History#165.dst: ...ce seront tes derniers, démon crasseux. A la guillotine... Tout le monde! Je le tiens!
A Headless History#165.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#166.src: Dullahan has been captured! We have the cursed progenitor of the decay in our grip- to be executed, once and for all!
A Headless History#166.dst: Dullahan a été capturé! Nous tenons le maudit responsable de la Décadence- il sera exécuté, une bonne fois pour toutes!
A Headless History#166.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#167.src: Haha, yeah! Shoulda thought twice before cursing OUR homes! Three cheers for our wizards!!
A Headless History#167.dst: Haha, ouais! Fallait réfléchir avant de maudire NOS foyers! Trois hourras pour nos mages!!
A Headless History#167.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#168.src: The decay will clear up- We'll spill his blood, chop off his head, and the curse will be lifted!!
A Headless History#168.dst: La Décadence va disparaître- On va verser son sang, lui couper la tête, et la malédiction sera levée!!
A Headless History#168.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#169.src: Ladies and gentlemen, folks of all shapes and sizes, it's time to take our lives back!
A Headless History#169.dst: Mesdames et messieurs, gens de toutes formes et tailles, il est temps de reprendre nos vies en main!
A Headless History#169.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#171.src: Dullahan? I'm...I'm back. I didn't leave you for long, I just was trying to find the cu-
A Headless History#171.dst: Dullahan? Je... je suis rentrée. Je ne suis pas partie longtemps, j'essayais juste de trouver le remè-
A Headless History#171.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#172.src: ...uh? Dullahan? He's...he's been right here to greet me almost every day for the past twenty years...
A Headless History#172.dst: ...hein? Dullahan? Il... il est là pour m'accueillir presque chaque jour depuis vingt ans...
A Headless History#172.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#173.src: Footprints...? Dullaaaa? Where'd you go? Is everything alright, did something happen?
A Headless History#173.dst: Des empreintes...? Dullaaaa? Où es-tu passé? Tout va bien, il s'est passé quelque chose?
A Headless History#173.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#175.dst: Je... C-comment ont-ils pu... f-faire ça...?
A Headless History#175.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#176.src: I...I l-left for...an hour, a-and...and they... Why?
A Headless History#176.dst: Je... je suis p-partie une heure, e-et... ils... Pourquoi?
A Headless History#176.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#177.src: Why did they do this to you...? I...h-how can I possibly fix this?!
A Headless History#177.dst: Pourquoi ils t'ont fait ça...? Je... c-comment pourrais-je réparer ça?!
A Headless History#177.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#178.src: I cannot understand why you continue to defile me with these horrid memories. What do you hope to find?
A Headless History#178.dst: Je ne comprends pas pourquoi vous continuez à me souiller avec ces horribles souvenirs. Qu'espérez-vous trouver?
A Headless History#178.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#179.src: I am once more curious. If only to know what I could possibly do or say to cease this horrid quest you've given yourself.
A Headless History#179.dst: Me voilà de nouveau curieux. Ne serait-ce que pour savoir quoi faire ou dire pour stopper cette horrible quête que vous vous êtes donnée.
A Headless History#179.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#180.src: Th-this has to work. It WILL work! I know it will! I...I d-don't know if it will... I have to fix this, I have to...
A Headless History#180.dst: Ç-ça doit marcher. Ça VA marcher! Je le sais! Je... je n-ne sais pas si ça marchera... Je dois réparer ça, je dois...
A Headless History#180.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#181.src: The waters from the Lazarus Pit are fabled for bringing back the dead... If this doesn't work, I...
A Headless History#181.dst: On dit que les eaux du Puits de Lazarus ramènent les morts... Si ça ne marche pas, je...
A Headless History#181.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#182.src: I can't think about that. This...this WILL work. I promise. I found a way to fix it... It has to.
A Headless History#182.dst: Je ne dois pas y penser. Ça... ça VA marcher. Promis. J'ai trouvé comment réparer ça... Il le faut.
A Headless History#182.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#183.src: P-Please...w-whatever gods are out there, whoever is listening, hear me...bring Dullahan back to me, I'm begging you...
A Headless History#183.dst: P-Pitié... q-quels que soient les dieux là-haut, qui que ce soit qui m'écoute, entendez-moi... rendez-moi Dullahan, je vous en supplie...
A Headless History#183.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#184.src: It's... I-Is it reacting? It... It looks like it is, but...h-he's not mending...
A Headless History#184.dst: Est-ce... e-est-ce que ça réagit? On... On dirait que oui, mais... i-il ne guérit pas...
A Headless History#184.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#185.src: N-No, this...i-it isn't...NO! It... It HAS to work! I...I can m-make this work!
A Headless History#185.dst: N-Non, ça... ç-ça ne... NON! Ça... Ça DOIT marcher! Je... je peux le f-faire marcher!
A Headless History#185.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#186.dst: D-Dullahan! Ça... ça a marché! Tu es revenu!
A Headless History#186.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#187.src: I...I t-told you... I knew I could change fate... I'm so glad you're here...
A Headless History#187.dst: Je... j-je te l'avais dit... Je pouvais changer le destin... Quel bonheur que tu sois là...
A Headless History#187.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#188.src: It's odd. If it were not for her, I would not be here. I would not have my power. Yet even thinking her name enrages me.
A Headless History#188.dst: C'est étrange. Sans elle, je ne serais pas là. Je n'aurais pas mon pouvoir. Pourtant, penser seulement à son nom me met en rage.
A Headless History#188.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#189.src: Enter the last door in the dining hall.
A Headless History#189.dst: Franchissez la dernière porte de la salle à manger.

A Headless History#191.src: H...h-hrk...g-gah, what is...wh-what... You...you didn't really...?
A Headless History#191.dst: H...h-hrk...g-gah, qu'est-ce... q-quoi... Tu... tu n'as pas vraiment...?
A Headless History#191.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#192.src: Th-there's so much death... The...the air smells like b-blood...
A Headless History#192.dst: Il y a t-tant de morts... L'air... l'air sent le s-sang...
A Headless History#192.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#193.src: This isn't... There has to be s-some other reason, I... I can't have b-brought back a...a...
A Headless History#193.dst: Ce n'est pas... Il doit y avoir u-une autre raison, je... Je ne peux pas avoir r-ramené un... un...
A Headless History#193.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#194.src: P-Please, we can't afford to lose more people! There's hardly any farmers in the fields anymore, I-I'm needed elsewhere!
A Headless History#194.dst: P-Pitié, on ne peut pas perdre plus de monde! Il n'y a presque plus de fermiers dans les champs, o-on a besoin de moi ailleurs!
A Headless History#194.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#195.src: The last few said similar things. Someone else I knew said similar things. Frankly, I do not care. Present your soul to me, now.
A Headless History#195.dst: Les derniers ont dit à peu près la même chose. Quelqu'un que je connaissais aussi. Franchement, peu m'importe. Présentez-moi votre âme, maintenant.
A Headless History#195.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#196.src: DULLAHAN! What...w-what are you doing?! I... I can't believe my eyes...
A Headless History#196.dst: DULLAHAN! Que... q-que fais-tu?! Je... je n'en crois pas mes yeux...
A Headless History#196.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#197.src: I... I tried to help you! I t-tried so hard at everything we did together... How could you do this to them?! To...to me?
A Headless History#197.dst: Je... j'ai essayé de t'aider! J'ai t-tant donné dans tout ce qu'on a fait ensemble... Comment as-tu pu leur faire ça?! A... à moi?
A Headless History#197.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#198.src: Odd. I recall you explicitly denying the only option that would have prevented this. I warned you quite thoroughly.
A Headless History#198.dst: Étrange. Je me souviens que tu as rejeté explicitement la seule option qui aurait évité ceci. Je t'avais pourtant bien prévenue.
A Headless History#198.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#199.src: You have had many chances to end this, Lari. Do you expect me to feel sympathy, when your own actions have made me feel nothing?
A Headless History#199.dst: Tu as eu bien des occasions d'en finir, Lari. Tu t'attends à ce que j'aie de la compassion, alors que tes propres actes m'ont rendu insensible?
A Headless History#199.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#200.src: This...this isn't like you... You would never have done this before! You dedicated your life to trying to help...so w-why are you...m...m-m... I-I'm leaving!!
A Headless History#200.dst: Ce... ce n'est pas toi... Tu n'aurais jamais fait ça avant! Tu as consacré ta vie à aider... alors p-pourquoi tu... m...m-m... J-Je m'en vais!!
A Headless History#200.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#201.src: What have I done...? This...he's... He's not th-the same anymore... What changed? Is this my fault...? I c-can't understand it...
A Headless History#201.dst: Qu'ai-je fait...? Ça... il... Il n'est plus l-le même... Qu'est-ce qui a changé? Est-ce ma faute...? J-Je ne comprends pas...
A Headless History#201.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#202.src: ...but...I'll... I'll protect them. I'll protect him... I...there has to be a way. But...until I find it...
A Headless History#202.dst: ...mais... je... je les protégerai. Je le protégerai... Je... il doit y avoir un moyen. Mais... en attendant de le trouver...
A Headless History#202.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#203.src: ...goodbye. Goodbye until the day comes when I can fill you with light once more. Goodbye until you learn... Goodbye, until I can fix you...
A Headless History#203.dst: ...adieu. Adieu jusqu'au jour où je pourrai de nouveau te remplir de lumière. Adieu jusqu'à ce que tu comprennes... Adieu, jusqu'à ce que je puisse te guérir...
A Headless History#203.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#204.dst: Adieu, Dullahan... Tu vas me manquer.
A Headless History#204.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#205.src: Investigate the dark door at the end of the castle.
A Headless History#205.dst: Examinez la porte sombre au fond du château.

A Headless History#207.src: lion an corp seo leis an saol aris!!
A Headless History#207.dst: lion an corp seo leis an saol aris!!
A Headless History#207.speaker: Lari

A Hunter's Calling#000.src: With so much of the active army dead, dying, and corrupted, {p} fell within the day.
A Hunter's Calling#000.dst: Avec une si grande part de l'armée morte, mourante ou corrompue, {p} a succombé en une journée.

A Hunter's Calling#001.src: After the two soldiers were slain in battle, {p} crumbled.
A Hunter's Calling#001.dst: Après la mort des deux soldats au combat, {p} n'a pas tenu.

A Hunter's Calling#002.src: You have been made for a single purpose, peon. The wizard, Theorick, is endangering our cause.
A Hunter's Calling#002.dst: Tu as été créé dans un seul but, pion. Le mage Theorick met notre cause en péril.

A Hunter's Calling#003.src: The corruptive influence will spread. I will see this place desolate.
A Hunter's Calling#003.dst: L'influence corruptrice va se répandre. Je ferai de ce lieu un désert.

A Hunter's Calling#004.src: I will demolish this town. Their army will fall before us.
A Hunter's Calling#004.dst: Je vais raser cette ville. Leur armée tombera devant nous.

A Hunter's Calling#005.src: ...Fool. Run while you have the chance.
A Hunter's Calling#005.dst: ...Imbécile. Fuis tant que tu le peux.

A Hunter's Calling#006.src: Move faster. It will notice your presence soon.
A Hunter's Calling#006.dst: Plus vite. Il va bientôt te remarquer.

A Hunter's Calling#007.src: You need to catch Maxie before he reaches the war scene.
A Hunter's Calling#007.dst: Rattrape Maxie avant qu'il n'atteigne la bataille.

A Hunter's Calling#009.src: ...and the Corkians, blindsided by the Factory's reactivation, were purged by metal and electricity.
A Hunter's Calling#009.dst: ...et les Corkians, pris de court par la réactivation de l'Usine, ont été purgés par le métal et l'électricité.

A Hunter's Calling#010.src: Explore the deepest part of the Silent Expanse
A Hunter's Calling#010.dst: Explorez la partie la plus profonde du Silent Expanse

A Hunter's Calling#012.src: ...you arrive. You search... To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#012.dst: ...tu arrives. Tu cherches... Dans quel but?

A Hunter's Calling#013.src: You wonder. What do we speak of? To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#013.dst: Tu te demandes. De quoi parlons-nous? Dans quel but?

A Hunter's Calling#014.src: You panic. We know you. How? We can provide no answer.
A Hunter's Calling#014.dst: Tu paniques. Nous te connaissons. Comment? Nous ne savons pas.

A Hunter's Calling#015.src: For answers... You search. To an end you seek. May we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#015.dst: Des réponses... Tu cherches. Une fin, tu poursuis. Pouvons-nous t'offrir une fin?

A Hunter's Calling#016.src: The besieged origin. To end, one must begin.
A Hunter's Calling#016.dst: L'origine assiégée. Pour finir, il faut commencer.

A Hunter's Calling#017.src: You anger. Viewing needless destruction. To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#017.dst: Tu t'emportes. Devant une destruction inutile. Dans quel but?

A Hunter's Calling#018.src: You distrust. We are dark. Are we? You believe it so.
A Hunter's Calling#018.dst: Tu te méfies. Nous sommes ténèbres. Le sommes-nous? Tu le crois.

A Hunter's Calling#019.src: You prepare. You would attack us. To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#019.dst: Tu te prépares. Tu nous attaquerais. Dans quel but?

A Hunter's Calling#020.src: There is no end. Of what you wish, there is none. But may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#020.dst: Il n'y a pas de fin. De ce que tu veux, rien. Mais pouvons-nous t'offrir une fin?

A Hunter's Calling#021.src: ???: The unrighteous sought it. The noble hid it. The one seeking answers found more questions. Another beginning...to a new end.
A Hunter's Calling#021.dst: ???: L'injuste l'a cherché. Le noble l'a caché. Qui cherchait des réponses a trouvé plus de questions. Un autre commencement... vers une nouvelle fin.

A Hunter's Calling#022.src: The unrighteous sought it. The noble hid it. The one seeking answers found more questions. Another beginning... to a new end.
A Hunter's Calling#022.dst: L'injuste l'a cherché. Le noble l'a caché. Qui cherchait des réponses a trouvé plus de questions. Un autre commencement... vers une nouvelle fin.

A Hunter's Calling#023.src: Hey, little miss. Don't go spacing out on me like that.
A Hunter's Calling#023.dst: Hé, ma petite. Ne pars pas dans la lune comme ça.
A Hunter's Calling#023.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#024.src: Now that you're acquainted with the new laws we'll want to introduce, I've got a job for you to do.
A Hunter's Calling#024.dst: Maintenant que tu connais les nouvelles lois qu'on veut introduire, j'ai un travail pour toi.
A Hunter's Calling#024.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#025.src: The current mayor is human. He'll inevitably veto the laws. The deputy on the other hand, is a villager, and on our side. See what I'm getting at.
A Hunter's Calling#025.dst: Le maire actuel est humain. Il mettra forcément son veto. L'adjoint, lui, est un villageois, et il est de notre côté. Tu vois où je veux en venir.
A Hunter's Calling#025.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#026.src: Another employee has already been sent out to get things started. He'll know what you need to do, so meet up with him, would you?
A Hunter's Calling#026.dst: On a déjà envoyé un autre employé pour lancer les choses. Il saura ce que tu dois faire, alors va le retrouver, d'accord?
A Hunter's Calling#026.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#027.src: Head to town and get further information from the employee at {~}, {~}.
A Hunter's Calling#027.dst: Allez en ville et obtenez plus d'informations auprès de l'employé en {~}, {~}.

A Hunter's Calling#028.src: Oh, yeah I saw the mayor not too long ago.
A Hunter's Calling#028.dst: Ah, oui, j'ai vu le maire il n'y a pas longtemps.
A Hunter's Calling#028.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#029.src: He was headed towards the bank. Why're you wondering, miss Villager?
A Hunter's Calling#029.dst: Il allait vers la banque. Pourquoi cette question, mademoiselle la villageoise?
A Hunter's Calling#029.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#030.src: You are here for the job, aren't you? I have to apologize. It's going to be trickier than I'd wanted for you.
A Hunter's Calling#030.dst: Tu viens pour le travail, hein? Désolé, ça va être plus compliqué que je ne l'aurais voulu.
A Hunter's Calling#030.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#031.src: So our mission is to assassinate the mayor. Amadel told you about the laws. We have a puppet in the running who'll rubberstamp them.
A Hunter's Calling#031.dst: Notre mission est donc d'assassiner le maire. Amadel t'a parlé des lois. On a une marionnette en lice qui les approuvera les yeux fermés.
A Hunter's Calling#031.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#032.src: I've got a trap set up inside the bank. It was entirely too tricky, but it worked out. Your job is to trigger the trap.
A Hunter's Calling#032.dst: J'ai installé un piège dans la banque. C'était bien trop compliqué, mais ça a marché. Ton boulot, c'est de déclencher le piège.
A Hunter's Calling#032.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#033.src: I've got the trap set up inside the bank. It was entirely too tricky, but it worked out. Your job is to trigger the trap.
A Hunter's Calling#033.dst: Le piège est installé dans la banque. C'était bien trop compliqué, mais ça a marché. Ton boulot, c'est de le déclencher.
A Hunter's Calling#033.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#034.src: Climb up the tree behind me and look through the window, you should be able to see it from there.
A Hunter's Calling#034.dst: Grimpe à l'arbre derrière moi et regarde par la fenêtre, tu devrais le voir de là.
A Hunter's Calling#034.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#035.src: Climb up the tree and look through the window.
A Hunter's Calling#035.dst: Grimpez à l'arbre et regardez par la fenêtre.

A Hunter's Calling#036.src: Can you see the mayor? I had to stay totally out of sight while setting this all up, so...
A Hunter's Calling#036.dst: Tu vois le maire? J'ai dû rester complètement caché pour tout installer, alors...
A Hunter's Calling#036.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#037.src: ...the only way to get to the trap is to jump across the hanging lamps in the ceiling.
A Hunter's Calling#037.dst: ...le seul moyen d'atteindre le piège, c'est de sauter sur les lampes suspendues au plafond.
A Hunter's Calling#037.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#038.src: You can absolutely not be spotted. The way up to the ceiling is on the opposite side of the bank. Just keep on walking past the guards, play it cool.
A Hunter's Calling#038.dst: Tu ne dois surtout pas être repérée. L'accès au plafond est de l'autre côté de la banque. Passe devant les gardes, l'air de rien.
A Hunter's Calling#038.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#039.src: No one enters when the mayor is doing his errands, sorry. You'll have to wait for your transaction.
A Hunter's Calling#039.dst: Personne n'entre pendant que le maire fait ses affaires, désolé. Vous devrez attendre pour votre transaction.
A Hunter's Calling#039.speaker: Bodyguard

A Hunter's Calling#040.src: Head back to the excavation camp.

A Hunter's Calling#041.src: Quickly, back to the camp. Before we're noticed.
A Hunter's Calling#041.dst: Vite, retour au camp. Avant qu'on nous remarque.
A Hunter's Calling#041.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#042.dst: Ah, vous voilà de retour, tous les deux.
A Hunter's Calling#042.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#044.src: Yes sir, everything went smoothly, {u} did a great thing for the company.
A Hunter's Calling#044.dst: Oui, monsieur, tout s'est bien passé, {u} a rendu un grand service à l'entreprise.
A Hunter's Calling#044.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#045.src: We can send in Miss Wuna at any time now, and she'll give us the clearance to start the excavation in a snap.
A Hunter's Calling#045.dst: On peut envoyer Mlle Wuna quand on veut, et elle nous donnera le feu vert pour les fouilles en un clin d'oeil.
A Hunter's Calling#045.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#046.src: ...you rage. Aided the ignoble. To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#046.dst: ...tu enrages. Tu as aidé l'ignoble. Dans quel but?

A Hunter's Calling#047.src: You misinterpret. What you see... Is it true? How?
A Hunter's Calling#047.dst: Tu te méprends. Ce que tu vois... Est-ce vrai? Comment?

A Hunter's Calling#048.src: The answer... It will not bring you the end.
A Hunter's Calling#048.dst: La réponse... Elle ne t'apportera pas la fin.

A Hunter's Calling#049.src: You see. Yet you do not understand. So, may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#049.dst: Tu vois. Mais tu ne comprends pas. Alors, pouvons-nous t'offrir une fin?

A Hunter's Calling#050.src: The cruel. The kind. The selfish. The just. He who traveled life with confliction. Who faced eternity served cold. To his end.
A Hunter's Calling#050.dst: Le cruel. Le bon. L'égoïste. Le juste. Celui qui traversa la vie dans le conflit. Qui affronta une éternité servie froide. Jusqu'à sa fin.

A Hunter's Calling#052.src: Listen, I understand the discontent, but we must start rationing! The corruption is consuming our arable fields.
A Hunter's Calling#052.dst: Écoutez, je comprends le mécontentement, mais nous devons rationner! La corruption dévore nos terres arables.
A Hunter's Calling#052.speaker: Kotham

A Hunter's Calling#053.src: Who knows if we'll even have water soon? We need to save up as much as we can!
A Hunter's Calling#053.dst: Qui sait si on aura encore de l'eau bientôt? Il faut économiser autant qu'on peut!
A Hunter's Calling#053.speaker: Kotham

A Hunter's Calling#054.src: Yeah, and what does Theorick have to say on the topic? How will he think of that?
A Hunter's Calling#054.dst: Ouais, et qu'en dit Theorick? Qu'est-ce qu'il en pensera?
A Hunter's Calling#054.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#055.src: He will be here shortly to discuss this problem in more detai-
A Hunter's Calling#055.dst: Il sera bientôt là pour discuter de ce problème plus en détai-
A Hunter's Calling#055.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#056.src: Everyone, hush and listen to what Kotham is saying!
A Hunter's Calling#056.dst: Silence, tout le monde, écoutez ce que dit Kotham!
A Hunter's Calling#056.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#057.src: As the mayor said, all of you need to start rationing what you eat and drink. I cannot be here every waking moment!
A Hunter's Calling#057.dst: Comme l'a dit le maire, vous devez tous rationner ce que vous mangez et buvez. Je ne peux pas être là à chaque instant!
A Hunter's Calling#057.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#058.src: In addition, I've figured something very important out. I'm developing a way to cease the spread of corruption. So I need to concentrate on that.
A Hunter's Calling#058.dst: De plus, j'ai découvert une chose très importante. Je mets au point un moyen de stopper la corruption. Je dois donc m'y consacrer.
A Hunter's Calling#058.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#060.src: ...someone among you... I can feel a horrendous strength...
A Hunter's Calling#060.dst: ...quelqu'un parmi vous... Je sens une force terrible...
A Hunter's Calling#060.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#061.src: Kotham! Get everyone to safety! NOW! MOVE, GO!
A Hunter's Calling#061.dst: Kotham! Mets-les tous à l'abri! VITE! ALLEZ!
A Hunter's Calling#061.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#062.src: You! Sent by Bak'al, I assume? What, is he too much of a coward to face me himself?
A Hunter's Calling#062.dst: Toi! Envoyé par Bak'al, je suppose? Quoi, il est trop lâche pour m'affronter lui-même?
A Hunter's Calling#062.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#063.src: What purpose do you have for doing this? This destruction is needless! {p} and all of Wynn have suffered enough!
A Hunter's Calling#063.dst: Pourquoi fais-tu ça? Cette destruction est inutile! {p} et tout Wynn ont assez souffert!
A Hunter's Calling#063.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#064.src: I'll freeze you solid, just like the rest of the corruption, you foul THING!
A Hunter's Calling#064.dst: Je vais te geler sur place, comme le reste de la corruption, immonde CHOSE!
A Hunter's Calling#064.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#066.src: This way, no one else gets hurt. Only one will leave from here alive.
A Hunter's Calling#066.dst: Comme ça, personne d'autre ne sera blessé. Un seul sortira d'ici vivant.
A Hunter's Calling#066.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#067.src: ...you fear. Does the dark become you?
A Hunter's Calling#067.dst: ...tu as peur. Les ténèbres te prennent-elles?

A Hunter's Calling#069.src: No. You remain whole. You do not change.
A Hunter's Calling#069.dst: Non. Tu restes intact. Tu ne changes pas.

A Hunter's Calling#070.src: So, you wonder. To what end? The question brings dread.
A Hunter's Calling#070.dst: Alors, tu te demandes. Dans quel but? La question inspire l'effroi.

A Hunter's Calling#071.src: Yet, an end is what you seek. So, may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#071.dst: Pourtant, tu cherches une fin. Alors, pouvons-nous t'offrir une fin?

A Hunter's Calling#072.src: An end, ousted by further action. An end, brought to six. An end, to the surety of the haughty. An end, of the world... in some fashion.
A Hunter's Calling#072.dst: Une fin, chassée par d'autres actes. Une fin, portée à six. Une fin, à la certitude de l'orgueilleux. Une fin, du monde... d'une certaine façon.

A Hunter's Calling#073.src: Enter the Corrupter of World Cave
A Hunter's Calling#073.dst: Entrez dans la Corrupter of World Cave

A Hunter's Calling#074.src: Make your way to the end of the cave.
A Hunter's Calling#074.dst: Rendez-vous au fond de la grotte.

A Hunter's Calling#075.src: Return back up the cave and fix a way out.
A Hunter's Calling#075.dst: Remontez la grotte et ouvrez-vous une sortie.

A Hunter's Calling#076.src: ...you disbelieve. It was an end. But you are here once more.
A Hunter's Calling#076.dst: ...tu n'y crois pas. C'était une fin. Mais te revoilà.

A Hunter's Calling#077.src: How much more? Where next? To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#077.dst: Combien encore? Où ensuite? Dans quel but?

A Hunter's Calling#078.src: Aiding terrible forces... But is it true? To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#078.dst: Aider des forces terribles... Mais est-ce vrai? Dans quel but?

A Hunter's Calling#079.src: No. You see possibility. You do not see certainty.
A Hunter's Calling#079.dst: Non. Tu vois une possibilité. Tu ne vois pas une certitude.

A Hunter's Calling#080.src: You question. To what end, then, and so may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#080.dst: Tu t'interroges. Dans quel but, alors, et pouvons-nous t'offrir une fin?

A Hunter's Calling#081.src: Metal. Preventing an end. Life. Ends, prevented. Does metal taking life, bringing an end, truly prevent more?
A Hunter's Calling#081.dst: Métal. Empêcher une fin. Vie. Fins, empêchées. Le métal qui ôte la vie et donne une fin en empêche-t-il vraiment d'autres?

A Hunter's Calling#082.src: Ah, here for the job opportunity then, I see. The waiver didn't turn you away, good!
A Hunter's Calling#082.dst: Ah, vous venez pour l'offre d'emploi, je vois. La décharge ne vous a pas fait fuir, parfait!
A Hunter's Calling#082.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#083.src: Now, to business. Times are tough, as you know, and our Iron Golems are in high demand. However, we've, ah...
A Hunter's Calling#083.dst: Bon, aux affaires. Les temps sont durs, vous le savez, et nos Iron Golems sont très demandés. Mais nous avons, euh...
A Hunter's Calling#083.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#084.src: ...experienced a draught of 'volunteers.' Your job is decently simple; just- *ahem* convince some people to join the cause.
A Hunter's Calling#084.dst: ...connu une sécheresse de 'volontaires'. Votre travail est assez simple: juste- *hum* convaincre quelques personnes de rejoindre la cause.
A Hunter's Calling#084.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#085.src: ...experienced a drought of 'volunteers.' Your job is decently simple; just- *ahem* convince some people to join the cause.
A Hunter's Calling#085.dst: ...connu une sécheresse de 'volontaires'. Votre travail est assez simple: juste- *hum* convaincre quelques personnes de rejoindre la cause.
A Hunter's Calling#085.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#086.src: The King of {p} sought help from {p}, the most secure fortress in the province. But help was too late.
A Hunter's Calling#086.dst: Le roi de {p} a demandé l'aide de {p}, la forteresse la plus sûre de la province. Mais l'aide est arrivée trop tard.

A Hunter's Calling#087.src: Your attention should be drawn to my peon. Now fall.
A Hunter's Calling#087.dst: C'est mon pion que tu devrais surveiller. Maintenant, tombe.

A Hunter's Calling#088.src: After a villager took over, new laws were put in place. This was the spark Wynnexcavation needed to start their work.
A Hunter's Calling#088.dst: Un villageois a pris le pouvoir et fait passer de nouvelles lois. L'étincelle qu'attendait Wynnexcavation pour commencer.

A Hunter's Calling#089.src: He is capable of halting our advance with his damnable ice. Kill him.
A Hunter's Calling#089.dst: Il peut stopper notre avancée avec sa glace maudite. Tue-le.

A Hunter's Calling#090.src: Three people should be enough for the moment. Look around the swamp for some folks, and lure them over here.
A Hunter's Calling#090.dst: Trois personnes suffiront pour le moment. Cherchez du monde dans le marais et attirez-les ici.
A Hunter's Calling#090.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#091.src: I'll stay in here and take care of them when you bring me them. It will absolutely be worth your while, I assure you.
A Hunter's Calling#091.dst: Je reste ici et je m'en occupe quand vous me les amenez. Ça en vaudra vraiment la peine, je vous l'assure.
A Hunter's Calling#091.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#092.src: Trick {~} people to follow you into the iron golem factory.
A Hunter's Calling#092.dst: Attirez par la ruse {~} personnes dans l'usine d'Iron Golems.

A Hunter's Calling#093.src: Agh, dang it dang it dang it!! You over there, help me out, would ya??
A Hunter's Calling#093.dst: Argh, zut zut zut!! Hé, vous là-bas, aidez-moi, vous voulez bien??
A Hunter's Calling#093.speaker: Anast

A Hunter's Calling#094.src: I tripped and fell in this stupid hole, and now there's mud in my eyes that I can't get out!
A Hunter's Calling#094.dst: J'ai trébuché dans ce trou stupide, et maintenant j'ai de la boue dans les yeux, impossible de l'enlever!
A Hunter's Calling#094.speaker: Anast

A Hunter's Calling#095.src: I need to get home or to some kind of a doctor so I can wash my eyes out with actual clean water.
A Hunter's Calling#095.dst: Je dois rentrer chez moi ou voir un médecin pour me rincer les yeux à l'eau vraiment propre.
A Hunter's Calling#095.speaker: Anast

A Hunter's Calling#096.src: Get me to {p} or a doctor or even just a sink!
A Hunter's Calling#096.dst: Emmenez-moi à {p}, chez un médecin, ou juste à un lavabo!
A Hunter's Calling#096.speaker: Anast

A Hunter's Calling#097.src: Good job! We'll get you taken care of nicely.
A Hunter's Calling#097.dst: Beau travail! On va bien s'occuper de vous.
A Hunter's Calling#097.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#098.src: Well done! We'll get you taken care of nicely.
A Hunter's Calling#098.dst: Bien joué! On va bien s'occuper de vous.
A Hunter's Calling#098.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#099.src: Oh, ah...heehee, heya cutie.. Whatcha doin' all the way out here?
A Hunter's Calling#099.dst: Oh, ah... hihi, coucou mon chou.. Qu'est-ce que tu fais si loin d'ici?
A Hunter's Calling#099.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#100.src: Just exploring, huh? I bet someone like you could use someone to...y'know, spend some time with...
A Hunter's Calling#100.dst: Tu explores, hein? Je parie qu'il te faudrait quelqu'un pour... tu sais, passer un peu de temps...
A Hunter's Calling#100.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#101.src: ...guess you're not interested? Oh...sorry if I came off as creepy. I'm just...really lonely, is all.
A Hunter's Calling#101.dst: ...ça ne t'intéresse pas? Oh... pardon si j'ai eu l'air glauque. C'est juste que... la solitude me pèse, voilà tout.
A Hunter's Calling#101.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#102.src: W-wait, those are...for me? Oh, you shouldn't have, I'm so happy!
A Hunter's Calling#102.dst: A-attends, c'est... pour moi? Oh, il ne fallait pas, quel bonheur!
A Hunter's Calling#102.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#103.src: You want to take me out on a date? R-Really? You'll give me a chance? Yes, of course!
A Hunter's Calling#103.dst: Tu veux m'inviter à un rendez-vous? C-c'est vrai? Tu me laisses une chance? Oui, bien sûr!
A Hunter's Calling#103.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#104.src: Lead the way, please! I can't wait to see where we're headed!
A Hunter's Calling#104.dst: Passe devant, s'il te plaît! J'ai hâte de voir où on va!
A Hunter's Calling#104.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#105.src: A bit of spare change, for an old man out of work?
A Hunter's Calling#105.dst: Une petite pièce pour un vieil homme sans travail?
A Hunter's Calling#105.speaker: Leni

A Hunter's Calling#106.src: This decay's made me terribly sick. I still have a family to feed... Any amount will help.
A Hunter's Calling#106.dst: Cette Décadence m'a rendu bien malade. J'ai encore une famille à nourrir... Tout peut aider.
A Hunter's Calling#106.speaker: Leni

A Hunter's Calling#107.src: I'll take care of this homeless old man.
A Hunter's Calling#107.dst: Je m'occupe de ce vieux sans-abri.
A Hunter's Calling#107.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#108.src: Good job, let us get down to my lab.
A Hunter's Calling#108.dst: Bon travail, descendons à mon labo.
A Hunter's Calling#108.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#109.src: Make your way through the factory.

A Hunter's Calling#110.src: Flawless work! I daresay these are some of our best work yet, and it's thanks to you.
A Hunter's Calling#110.dst: Du travail impeccable! J'ose dire que ce sont nos plus belles pièces, et c'est grâce à vous.
A Hunter's Calling#110.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#111.src: Go on, step closer! You've done a wonderful service here. Examine the fruits of your labor!
A Hunter's Calling#111.dst: Allez, approchez! Vous avez rendu un fier service. Admirez les fruits de votre labeur!
A Hunter's Calling#111.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#112.src: Look into their eyes, it's almost like you can see the person they once were. Intriguing, isn't-
A Hunter's Calling#112.dst: Regardez-les dans les yeux, on croirait voir la personne qu'ils étaient. Fascinant, n'est-ce p-
A Hunter's Calling#112.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#113.src: Hah! This one seems quite fond of you! Want to take it home as a bonus to your payment?
A Hunter's Calling#113.dst: Ha! Celui-ci semble vous apprécier! Vous voulez l'emporter, en prime de votre paie?
A Hunter's Calling#113.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#114.src: ...you resign yourself. You believe you will never find the answers you seek.
A Hunter's Calling#114.dst: ...tu te résignes. Tu crois que tu ne trouveras jamais les réponses que tu cherches.

A Hunter's Calling#115.src: You see the ends... To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#115.dst: Tu vois les fins... Dans quel but?

A Hunter's Calling#116.src: They are not yours. What is their purpose?
A Hunter's Calling#116.dst: Elles ne sont pas les tiennes. Quel est leur but?

A Hunter's Calling#117.src: You do not understand. But you must see. So, may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#117.dst: Tu ne comprends pas. Mais tu dois voir. Alors, pouvons-nous t'offrir une fin?

A Hunter's Calling#118.src: A home, invaded. A society, crumbling. The people, starving. The concerned, helpless. The flames, rising. An end you will not expect.
A Hunter's Calling#118.dst: Un foyer, envahi. Une société, qui s'effondre. Le peuple, affamé. Les inquiets, impuissants. Les flammes, qui montent. Une fin inattendue.

A Hunter's Calling#119.src: Our king has requested the removal of the slum folk.
