A New Beginning#352.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#353.src: Can't save 'em all. Especially not from themselves. I've learned that many times over, over my years.
A New Beginning#353.dst: On peut pas tous les sauver. Surtout pas d'eux-mêmes. Je l'ai appris plus d'une fois, au fil des années.
A New Beginning#353.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#354.src: So he got caught. Heard a cursed one got involved... was a whole damn mess. Sovereign really wasn't happy with Synny when he heard, let me tell you. Ain't seen her that shellshocked in years.
A New Beginning#354.dst: Alors il s'est fait prendre. Paraît qu'un Maudit s'en est mêlé... une sacrée pagaille. Le Souverain était vraiment pas content de Synny quand il l'a su, crois-moi. Je l'avais pas vue aussi secouée depuis des années.
A New Beginning#354.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#355.src: ...but you're sayin' he lived? How's that all work out?
A New Beginning#355.dst: ...mais tu dis qu'il a survécu? Comment ça s'est fait?
A New Beginning#355.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#357.src: Well... tell me this, then. Was he happy, you think? Out there in the wider world? Did he live a good life?
A New Beginning#357.dst: Bon... dis-moi une chose, alors. Il était heureux, à ton avis? Là-bas, dans le vaste monde? Il a eu une belle vie?
A New Beginning#357.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#358.src: ...alright. Alrighty. Good. That- that's good, y'hear. I... I'm glad for that much.
A New Beginning#358.dst: ...bon. D'accord. Bien. C'est- c'est bien, t'entends. Je... j'suis content au moins pour ça.
A New Beginning#358.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#359.src: Thank you for... for tellin' me all that. S'not a tale that ends in happiness, but I reckon so long as he made the most of it... that's all you can really hope for.
A New Beginning#359.dst: Merci de... de m'avoir raconté tout ça. C'est pas une histoire qui finit bien, mais tant qu'il en a profité au mieux... c'est tout ce qu'on peut espérer, j'imagine.
A New Beginning#359.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#360.src: Y'may as well leave me be a while, now. Got some thinkin' to get through.
A New Beginning#360.dst: Tu peux me laisser un moment, maintenant. J'ai besoin de réfléchir.
A New Beginning#360.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#362.src: I'll let you get back to it.

A New Beginning#366.src: It's a headstone. Carved into the stone, you see a name and a year.
A New Beginning#366.dst: C'est une pierre tombale. Vous y voyez gravés un nom et une année.

A New Beginning#369.src: He got sent to Wynn. We... m
A New Beginning#369.dst: On l'a envoyé à Wynn. On s'est... rencontrés là-bas.
A New Beginning#369.full: He got sent to Wynn. We... met there.

A Sandy Scandal#000.src: You look like a hardy one! {p} army, is it? Would you be willing to help {p} a bit?
A Sandy Scandal#000.dst: Vous avez l'air robuste! L'armée de {p}, c'est ça? Seriez-vous prêt à aider un peu {p}?
A Sandy Scandal#000.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#001.src: We're looking into some witness reports to try to gain information on the bandits' plan.
A Sandy Scandal#001.dst: Nous examinons des témoignages pour tenter d'en savoir plus sur le plan des bandits.
A Sandy Scandal#001.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#002.src: You read the report and visualize its words.
A Sandy Scandal#002.dst: Vous lisez le témoignage et imaginez la scène.

A Sandy Scandal#003.src: WITNESS REPORT I - TOLD BY ODIN GIBBS, SHOP OWNER - GIBBS' MINING SUPPLY STORE CO.
A Sandy Scandal#003.dst: TÉMOIGNAGE I - RAPPORTÉ PAR ODIN GIBBS, COMMERÇANT - GIBBS' MINING SUPPLY STORE CO.

A Sandy Scandal#004.src: Business was slow that day, until two rugged, oddly-dressed men stormed into my shop, with a lot of nerve.
A Sandy Scandal#004.dst: Peu de clients ce jour-là, jusqu'à ce que deux brutes mal fagotées entrent dans ma boutique avec un sacré culot.

A Sandy Scandal#005.src: Before I could close any deal with them, the man with a dagger started threatening me!
A Sandy Scandal#005.dst: Avant que je puisse conclure quoi que ce soit, l'homme à la dague s'est mis à me menacer!

A Sandy Scandal#006.src: I tried to make peace with the crooks.
A Sandy Scandal#006.dst: J'ai tenté de calmer les escrocs.

A Sandy Scandal#007.src: The bandit put the knife closer to me and started demanding the code to the TNT vault downstairs!
A Sandy Scandal#007.dst: Le bandit a approché son couteau et a exigé le code de la chambre forte de TNT du sous-sol!

A Sandy Scandal#008.src: The bandits grew agitated and resorted to violence to obtain the combination.
A Sandy Scandal#008.dst: Les bandits se sont énervés et ont usé de violence pour obtenir la combinaison.

A Sandy Scandal#009.src: They swiped their knife at me, leaving a sizeable wound on my arm.
A Sandy Scandal#009.dst: Ils m'ont donné un coup de couteau, me laissant une belle entaille au bras.

A Sandy Scandal#010.src: I had no choice but to give up the combination, which was {~}.
A Sandy Scandal#010.dst: Je n'ai pas eu d'autre choix que de donner la combinaison: {~}.

A Sandy Scandal#011.src: After I gave up the combination, they knocked me out!

A Sandy Scandal#012.src: I had no idea what the criminals did after that, I haven't been back to my shop since the incident.
A Sandy Scandal#012.dst: J'ignore ce que les criminels ont fait ensuite, je ne suis pas retourné à ma boutique depuis l'incident.

A Sandy Scandal#013.src: The bandits must've taken the explosives! You should investigate.
A Sandy Scandal#013.dst: Les bandits ont dû prendre les explosifs! Vous devriez enquêter.

A Sandy Scandal#014.src: Looks like the bandit's took almost all of the TNT from the shopkeeper's vault.
A Sandy Scandal#014.dst: On dirait que les bandits ont pris presque toute la TNT de la chambre forte du marchand.

A Sandy Scandal#015.src: They seem to have dropped their knife during all the looting...
A Sandy Scandal#015.dst: Ils semblent avoir laissé tomber leur couteau pendant le pillage...

A Sandy Scandal#016.src: You should return to the {p} Bank Guard with your information.
A Sandy Scandal#016.dst: Retournez voir le garde de la banque de {p} avec ces informations.

A Sandy Scandal#017.src: WITNESS REPORT II - TOLD BY SCROLL MERCHANT, SHOP OWNER - ALMUJ SCROLL SHOP
A Sandy Scandal#017.dst: TÉMOIGNAGE II - RAPPORTÉ PAR LE MARCHAND DE PARCHEMINS, COMMERÇANT - ALMUJ SCROLL SHOP

A Sandy Scandal#018.src: I was having a fine time tending to my rooftop garden after a lengthy day of selling scrolls.
A Sandy Scandal#018.dst: Je profitais tranquillement de mon jardin sur le toit après une longue journée à vendre des parchemins.

A Sandy Scandal#019.src: While looking down on the street, I saw two unsavory men, one with TNT in hand, marching down the path.
A Sandy Scandal#019.dst: En regardant la rue, j'ai vu deux hommes louches, dont un avec de la TNT à la main, descendre le chemin.

A Sandy Scandal#020.src: I was suspicious, so I tried to get their attention, but they ignored me.
A Sandy Scandal#020.dst: Méfiant, j'ai essayé d'attirer leur attention, mais ils m'ont ignoré.

A Sandy Scandal#021.src: I tried to yell for the attention of a guard or official, but nobody could hear me.
A Sandy Scandal#021.dst: J'ai crié pour alerter un garde ou un fonctionnaire, mais personne ne m'entendait.

A Sandy Scandal#022.src: I wasn't sure what to do at this point... I didn't try to confront them, that'd have been way too risky!
A Sandy Scandal#022.dst: Je ne savais plus quoi faire... Je n'ai pas tenté de les affronter, c'était bien trop risqué!

A Sandy Scandal#023.src: I have no idea where they went off to afterwards.
A Sandy Scandal#023.dst: Je n'ai aucune idée d'où ils sont allés ensuite.

A Sandy Scandal#024.src: You should check out the house that the explosion came from!
A Sandy Scandal#024.dst: Vous devriez inspecter la maison d'où est partie l'explosion!

A Sandy Scandal#025.src: Two weapons are missing from the wealthy estate owner's weapon rack!
A Sandy Scandal#025.dst: Il manque deux armes au râtelier du riche propriétaire!

A Sandy Scandal#026.src: With such powerful weapons the bandits could easily break through the bank's defenses.
A Sandy Scandal#026.dst: Avec des armes aussi puissantes, les bandits pourraient facilement percer les défenses de la banque.

A Sandy Scandal#027.src: The whole thing'll go up in a few seconds, and any evidence will be buried in the sand. Good luck getting out of here!
A Sandy Scandal#027.dst: Tout va sauter dans quelques secondes, et les preuves seront enterrées sous le sable. Bonne chance pour sortir d'ici!
A Sandy Scandal#027.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#028.src: Looks like the bandits have started their heist! You should follow them into the bank and stop them.
A Sandy Scandal#028.dst: On dirait que les bandits ont commencé leur casse! Vous devriez les suivre dans la banque et les arrêter.

A Sandy Scandal#029.src: It's too late to stop us now! We're about to bust out of here with the grand prize - the contents of the emerald vault!
A Sandy Scandal#029.dst: Trop tard pour nous arrêter! On est sur le point de filer avec le gros lot - le contenu de la chambre forte aux émeraudes!
A Sandy Scandal#029.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#030.src: We think the bandits might have made the first move in their heist, we're mobilising a troop to-
A Sandy Scandal#030.dst: Nous pensons que les bandits ont peut-être lancé leur casse, nous mobilisons une troupe pour-
A Sandy Scandal#030.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#031.src: Before anybody could hear me, a large explosion occurred inside of the house the bandits intruded.
A Sandy Scandal#031.dst: Avant que quiconque m'entende, une grosse explosion a retenti dans la maison où les bandits étaient entrés.

A Sandy Scandal#032.src: Talk to the {p} Bank Guard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
A Sandy Scandal#032.dst: Parlez au garde de la banque de {p} à [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Sandy Scandal#034.src: {p} bank tends to be a prime target for bandits, and there's been a string of incidents that have made us suspicious.
A Sandy Scandal#034.dst: La banque de {p} est souvent une cible de choix pour les bandits, et une série d'incidents a éveillé nos soupçons.
A Sandy Scandal#034.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#036.src: If I give you some of the reports, will you help check them out for clues?
A Sandy Scandal#036.dst: Si je vous donne quelques témoignages, nous aiderez-vous à y chercher des indices?
A Sandy Scandal#036.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#037.src: Great! The store from the first witness report is straight down the stairs, just past this building right behind me.
A Sandy Scandal#037.dst: Parfait! La boutique du premier témoignage est droit en bas des escaliers, juste après ce bâtiment derrière moi.
A Sandy Scandal#037.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#038.src: It's called "Gibbs' Mining Supply Store", and the owner reported a robbery a few days ago.
A Sandy Scandal#038.dst: Elle s'appelle "Gibbs' Mining Supply Store", et le propriétaire a signalé un vol il y a quelques jours.
A Sandy Scandal#038.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#039.src: Good luck! Report back to me if you find any information.
A Sandy Scandal#039.dst: Bonne chance! Revenez me voir si vous trouvez quelque chose.
A Sandy Scandal#039.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#040.src: Go to the witness report location at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Sandy Scandal#040.dst: Rendez-vous sur le lieu du témoignage à [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#041.src: Hello gentlemen! What can I interest you in today? Some industrial torches? Pickaxes?
A Sandy Scandal#041.dst: Bonjour, messieurs! Que puis-je vous proposer aujourd'hui? Des torches industrielles? Des pioches?
A Sandy Scandal#041.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#042.src: Shut yer’ trap, old man. We came for a different kind of business.
A Sandy Scandal#042.dst: Ferme-la, le vieux. On est venus pour une autre sorte d’affaire.
A Sandy Scandal#042.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#043.src: Wha-? Look, fellows. Just step out of my store, and nobody gets hurt. I don't want any trouble.
A Sandy Scandal#043.dst: Qu-? Écoutez, les gars. Sortez de ma boutique, et personne ne sera blessé. Je ne veux pas d'ennuis.
A Sandy Scandal#043.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#044.src: Listen up old man, tell us the code to the TNT vault in the basement, or I decorate my necklace with your fingers!
A Sandy Scandal#044.dst: Écoute bien, le vieux, donne-nous le code de la chambre forte de TNT au sous-sol, ou je décore mon collier avec tes doigts!
A Sandy Scandal#044.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#045.src: Certainly not! That TNT is for licensed mining companies only, not your average amateur miner.
A Sandy Scandal#045.dst: Certainement pas! Cette TNT est réservée aux compagnies minières agréées, pas au premier mineur amateur venu.
A Sandy Scandal#045.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#046.src: Well then! I guess you'll still be able to grasp a pick with four fingers, eh?
A Sandy Scandal#046.dst: Eh bien soit! Tu pourras toujours tenir une pioche avec quatre doigts, hein?
A Sandy Scandal#046.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#047.src: Gaaah! Alright, alright! No more violence, please!
A Sandy Scandal#047.dst: Aaaah! D'accord, d'accord! Plus de violence, je vous en prie!
A Sandy Scandal#047.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#048.src: The code is {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}... please don't hurt me!
A Sandy Scandal#048.dst: Le code est {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}... ne me faites pas de mal!
A Sandy Scandal#048.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#049.src: {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}... thanks! We won't be needing you anymore... now go to sleep!
A Sandy Scandal#049.dst: {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}... merci! On n'a plus besoin de toi... maintenant, dodo!
A Sandy Scandal#049.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#050.src: Open the vault in the basement [Code: {~}].
A Sandy Scandal#050.dst: Ouvrez la chambre forte du sous-sol [Code: {~}].

A Sandy Scandal#054.src: Ah, you're back! Did you find anything interesting in the report?
A Sandy Scandal#054.dst: Ah, vous revoilà! Du nouveau dans le témoignage?
A Sandy Scandal#054.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#055.src: Missing TNT in the shop's vault? Looks like the shopkeeper was telling the truth.
A Sandy Scandal#055.dst: De la TNT manquante dans la chambre forte de la boutique? Le marchand disait donc la vérité.
A Sandy Scandal#055.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#056.src: We need to catch these criminals quickly if they have access to that amount of TNT - they could blow a hole right into the bank's vault!
A Sandy Scandal#056.dst: Il faut vite attraper ces criminels s'ils ont accès à autant de TNT - ils pourraient percer un trou droit dans la chambre forte de la banque!
A Sandy Scandal#056.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#057.src: You should check out another witness report, from after the attack on the shopkeeper.
A Sandy Scandal#057.dst: Vous devriez consulter un autre témoignage, recueilli après l'attaque contre le marchand.
A Sandy Scandal#057.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#058.src: It was taken from the rooftop garden of the Scroll Merchant's residence, you should take a look.
A Sandy Scandal#058.dst: Il a été recueilli dans le jardin sur le toit de la résidence du Marchand de parchemins, jetez-y un oeil.
A Sandy Scandal#058.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#059.src: Be quick! We don't have much time if we want to stop these bandits.
A Sandy Scandal#059.dst: Vite! Le temps presse si nous voulons arrêter ces bandits.
A Sandy Scandal#059.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#062.src: Ey', what do you two blighters think you're doing with those dangerous explosives in the city?
A Sandy Scandal#062.dst: Hé, qu'est-ce que vous fabriquez, bande de vauriens, avec ces explosifs dangereux en pleine ville?
A Sandy Scandal#062.speaker: Scroll Merchant

A Sandy Scandal#063.src: Guards! Guards! Robber! Come quick! Urgently!
A Sandy Scandal#063.dst: Gardes! Gardes! Au voleur! Venez vite! C'est urgent!
A Sandy Scandal#063.speaker: Scroll Merchant

A Sandy Scandal#065.src: Find the source of the detonation at [{~}, {~}, {~}].
A Sandy Scandal#065.dst: Trouvez l'origine de la détonation à [{~}, {~}, {~}].

A Sandy Scandal#068.src: Were you able to uncover any new information regarding the status of the criminals?
A Sandy Scandal#068.dst: Avez-vous découvert quelque chose de nouveau sur la situation des criminels?
A Sandy Scandal#068.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#069.src: Ah... that's troubling. The criminals plundered two very powerful weapons.
A Sandy Scandal#069.dst: Ah... c'est inquiétant. Les criminels ont dérobé deux armes très puissantes.
A Sandy Scandal#069.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#070.src: It won't be easy facing those criminals if they decide to raid the bank with those weapons.
A Sandy Scandal#070.dst: Il ne sera pas facile d'affronter ces criminels s'ils décident d'attaquer la banque avec ces armes.
A Sandy Scandal#070.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#071.src: I'm not certain how to proceed from here, we didn't receive any more witness reports, and-
A Sandy Scandal#071.dst: Je ne sais pas trop comment procéder, nous n'avons reçu aucun autre témoignage, et-
A Sandy Scandal#071.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#072.src: Boss, I just received urgent reports of a robbery underway in the left residential area of {p}!
A Sandy Scandal#072.dst: Chef, on signale d'urgence un vol en cours dans le quartier résidentiel gauche de {p}!
A Sandy Scandal#072.speaker: Almuj Sentry

A Sandy Scandal#073.src: Oh my… you! Soldier! Quick! The robbery is taking place across the bridge, next to the first house you visited today! It may be the bandits we're looking for.
A Sandy Scandal#073.dst: Oh là là… vous! Soldat! Vite! Le vol a lieu de l'autre côté du pont, à côté de la première maison que vous avez visitée! Ce sont peut-être nos bandits.
A Sandy Scandal#073.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#074.src: There will be somebody waiting for you outside of the house once you get to the residential area!
A Sandy Scandal#074.dst: Quelqu'un vous attendra devant la maison quand vous arriverez dans le quartier résidentiel!
A Sandy Scandal#074.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#075.src: If you still can't find it, I've written the coordinates in your content book. Now quickly, get to the house!
A Sandy Scandal#075.dst: Si vous ne la trouvez toujours pas, j'ai noté les coordonnées dans votre livre de contenu. Maintenant, vite, allez à la maison!
A Sandy Scandal#075.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#076.src: Quickly! Go to the house at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Sandy Scandal#076.dst: Vite! Rendez-vous à la maison à [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#077.src: Hello? Are you with the guards? Good! Hurry! Some bandits just ransacked my house, and left with lots of emeralds!
A Sandy Scandal#077.dst: Hé! Vous êtes de la garde? Bien! Vite! Des bandits viennent de saccager ma maison, et sont partis avec plein d'émeraudes!
A Sandy Scandal#077.speaker: Almuj Citizen

A Sandy Scandal#078.src: Follow me to my house, hopefully you can find the bandits! They stole lots of my precious gems!
A Sandy Scandal#078.dst: Suivez-moi jusque chez moi, j'espère que vous trouverez les bandits! Ils m'ont volé tant de pierres précieuses!
A Sandy Scandal#078.speaker: Almuj Citizen

A Sandy Scandal#079.src: Look for signs of the bandits' whereabouts.
A Sandy Scandal#079.dst: Cherchez des indices sur l'endroit où se trouvent les bandits.

A Sandy Scandal#081.src: Ready, boys? We've got the TNT, weapons, and the fastest horses those emeralds could buy. Now we just-
A Sandy Scandal#081.dst: Prêts, les gars? On a la TNT, les armes et les chevaux les plus rapides qu'on pouvait s'offrir. Plus qu'à-
A Sandy Scandal#081.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#082.src: Ahah. I had a feeling we had a guard on our tail.
A Sandy Scandal#082.dst: Ahah. Je sentais bien qu'on avait un garde aux trousses.
A Sandy Scandal#082.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#083.src: No point wasting these brand-new weapons on you... since we're blowing up this hideout anyway!
A Sandy Scandal#083.dst: Inutile de gâcher ces armes neuves sur toi... on fait sauter cette planque de toute façon!
A Sandy Scandal#083.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#086.src: Find where the bandits blasted a hole to get into the bank at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Sandy Scandal#086.dst: Trouvez l'endroit où les bandits ont percé un trou pour entrer dans la banque à [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#088.src: Follow the criminals into the other room.
A Sandy Scandal#088.dst: Suivez les criminels dans l'autre pièce.

A Sandy Scandal#089.src: Look here, the soldier decided they wanted to follow us. Dumb move.
A Sandy Scandal#089.dst: Tiens, regardez, le soldat a voulu nous suivre. Mauvaise idée.
A Sandy Scandal#089.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#090.src: I guess we can kill two birds with one stone: escaping the bank, and killing this pest.
A Sandy Scandal#090.dst: On peut faire d'une pierre deux coups: s'échapper de la banque, et tuer ce nuisible.
A Sandy Scandal#090.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#092.dst: Ne laissez pas les bandits s'échapper!

A Sandy Scandal#093.src: Report back to the {p} Bank Guard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Sandy Scandal#093.dst: Faites votre rapport au garde de la banque de {p} à [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#094.src: Soldier! Where did you disappear to? Did you hear those explosions, below the bank?
A Sandy Scandal#094.dst: Soldat! Où étiez-vous passé? Avez-vous entendu ces explosions, sous la banque?
A Sandy Scandal#094.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#096.src: You've already stopped them? And reclaimed the stolen weapons and explosives..?
A Sandy Scandal#096.dst: Vous les avez déjà arrêtés? Et récupéré les armes et explosifs volés..?
A Sandy Scandal#096.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#097.src: Wow. Excellent work, soldier. {p} is in your debt. Please accept these from our vault, as a token of our thanks.
A Sandy Scandal#097.dst: Ouah. Excellent travail, soldat. {p} a une dette envers vous. Acceptez ceci de notre chambre forte, en gage de notre gratitude.
A Sandy Scandal#097.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#098.src: I then realized that they had no innocent itinerary, they were heading straight for my wealthy neighbor's house!
A Sandy Scandal#098.dst: J'ai alors compris que leur itinéraire n'avait rien d'innocent, ils filaient droit chez mon riche voisin!

A Sandy Scandal#099.src: The bandits came sprinting out of my wealthy neighbor's house with some of his most prized possessions: two weapons from his collection.
A Sandy Scandal#099.dst: Les bandits sont sortis en courant de chez mon riche voisin avec certains de ses biens les plus précieux: deux armes de sa collection.

Acquiring Credentials#000.src: Oh, an egg! I'll pay you {~} emeralds for it, of course!
Acquiring Credentials#000.dst: Oh, un oeuf! Je t'en donne {~} émeraudes, évidemment!
Acquiring Credentials#000.speaker: Black Market Merchant

Acquiring Credentials#001.dst: Obtenez un passeport de Gavel à [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Acquiring Credentials#002.src: I'm sorry sir, but I can't just give you a new passport... You'd need approval from-...
Acquiring Credentials#002.dst: Désolé, monsieur, je ne peux pas vous donner un passeport comme ça... Il faut l'accord de-...
Acquiring Credentials#002.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#003.src: But sir, my passport was stolen! I have a flight to {p} in under {~} minutes. I really need one, quick...
Acquiring Credentials#003.dst: Mais monsieur, on m'a volé mon passeport! Mon vol pour {p} part dans moins de {~} minutes. Il m'en faut un, vite...
Acquiring Credentials#003.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#004.src: I've already told you where you need to go to get a new one. Next in line, please!
Acquiring Credentials#004.dst: Je vous ai déjà dit où aller pour en obtenir un nouveau. Au suivant, s'il vous plaît!
Acquiring Credentials#004.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#005.src: Hmmm... {u}, is it? Unfortunately, humans are required to get their passports in Wynn.
Acquiring Credentials#005.dst: Hmmm... {u}, c'est bien ça? Malheureusement, les humains doivent obtenir leur passeport à Wynn.
Acquiring Credentials#005.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#006.src: I'm afraid I can't help you. Next in line, please!
Acquiring Credentials#006.dst: Je crains de ne pas pouvoir vous aider. Au suivant, s'il vous plaît!
Acquiring Credentials#006.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#007.src: Hey, you! Yes, you! Come outside, would you? I think we can help each other.
Acquiring Credentials#007.dst: Hé, toi! Oui, toi! Tu peux sortir un instant? Je crois qu'on peut s'entraider.
Acquiring Credentials#007.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#008.src: So, I overheard your conversation with the Officer... You're also looking for a passport, right?
Acquiring Credentials#008.dst: Alors, j'ai surpris ta conversation avec l'agent... Toi aussi, tu cherches un passeport, hein?
Acquiring Credentials#008.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#009.src: Well...so, I've heard rumours of a secret Black Market that hides in the airbase.
Acquiring Credentials#009.dst: Eh bien... il paraît qu'un Marché noir secret se cache dans la base aérienne.
Acquiring Credentials#009.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#010.src: Let's explore the airbase, then! We need to look for clues, lead the way.
Acquiring Credentials#010.dst: Alors explorons la base aérienne! Il faut chercher des indices, passe devant.
Acquiring Credentials#010.speaker: Cinfras Citizen

Acquiring Credentials#011.src: Apparently they trade illegal products... There has to be a way of buying passports, I'm sure of it!
Acquiring Credentials#011.dst: Il paraît qu'ils vendent des produits illégaux... Il doit y avoir moyen d'acheter des passeports, j'en suis sûr!
Acquiring Credentials#011.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#012.src: If we work together, we might be able to find a way in. What do you think?
Acquiring Credentials#012.dst: Si on fait équipe, on pourra peut-être trouver l'entrée. Qu'en dis-tu?
Acquiring Credentials#012.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#013.src: Explore the Airbase looking for clues about the Black Market.
Acquiring Credentials#013.dst: Explorez la base aérienne à la recherche d'indices sur le Marché noir.

Acquiring Credentials#014.src: Oh, you brought us to the Inn! Hmmm, the Barman's been working here for a long time...
Acquiring Credentials#014.dst: Oh, tu nous as menés à l'auberge! Hmmm, le barman travaille ici depuis longtemps...
Acquiring Credentials#014.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#015.src: Maybe he knows something about the Black Market! I'll try and ask, y'know...all, uh...sneaky-like.
Acquiring Credentials#015.dst: Il sait peut-être quelque chose sur le Marché noir! Je vais lui demander, tu sais... euh... l'air de rien.
Acquiring Credentials#015.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#016.src: I can't believe this place! They only have some rancid wheat stored here, what am I supposed to do with that? I'll take a carrot any day over... wheat.
Acquiring Credentials#016.dst: Je n'en reviens pas! Ils n'ont que du blé rance ici, qu'est-ce que je suis censé en faire? Je préfère cent fois une carotte à... du blé.

Acquiring Credentials#017.src: All those other airship men carry around those vile face fruits, but I have to say, I've always had a soft spot for potatoes.
Acquiring Credentials#017.dst: Tous les autres aéronautes trimballent ces infâmes fruits à visage, mais je dois dire que j'ai toujours eu un faible pour les pommes de terre.
Acquiring Credentials#017.speaker: Airship Commander

Acquiring Credentials#018.src: I wish my airship was black, I can't say I'm a fan of that white palette...
Acquiring Credentials#018.dst: J'aimerais que mon dirigeable soit noir, je ne suis pas fan de cette palette blanche...

Acquiring Credentials#020.src: You know, maybe white isn't so bad after all.
Acquiring Credentials#020.dst: Vous savez, le blanc n'est peut-être pas si mal, finalement.
Acquiring Credentials#020.speaker: Airship Commander

Acquiring Credentials#021.src: It turns out, white's actually quite a nice colour.
Acquiring Credentials#021.dst: En fait, le blanc est une assez jolie couleur.
Acquiring Credentials#021.speaker: Airship Commander

Acquiring Credentials#022.src: ... Oh, fine, wheat's not bad. I'll take some, I guess.
Acquiring Credentials#022.dst: ... Oh, bon, le blé, c'est pas mal. J'en prendrai un peu, j'imagine.
Acquiring Credentials#022.speaker: Airship Commander

Acquiring Credentials#024.src: Though, really, the face doesn't mean it has to be evil, does it? It could be a nice face, after all.
Acquiring Credentials#024.dst: Cela dit, un visage n'est pas forcément maléfique, non? Ça pourrait être un visage gentil, après tout.

Acquiring Credentials#025.src: Excuse me, sir... You, uh...wouldn't happen to know any really cheap stores around here, would you?
Acquiring Credentials#025.dst: Excusez-moi, monsieur... Vous ne connaîtriez pas, euh... des boutiques vraiment pas chères par ici?
Acquiring Credentials#025.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#026.src: The table's been set for the great feast, have stout or beer, what will it be?
Acquiring Credentials#026.dst: La table est mise pour le grand festin, brune ou blonde, qu'est-ce qu'on prend?
Acquiring Credentials#026.speaker: Barman

Acquiring Credentials#027.src: Is that a secret code...? Beer?
Acquiring Credentials#027.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#028.src: Did that work? Is he gonna let us in?
Acquiring Credentials#028.dst: Ça a marché? Il va nous laisser entrer?
Acquiring Credentials#028.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#029.src: I guess it wouldn't be that easy to find a way in... Where do you think we can go with that lead, {u}?
Acquiring Credentials#029.dst: J'imagine que ce ne serait pas si facile de trouver l'entrée... Où penses-tu que cette piste peut nous mener, {u}?
Acquiring Credentials#029.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#030.src: Let's just keep exploring. Lead the way.
Acquiring Credentials#030.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#031.src: Keep exploring the Airbase looking for clues about the Black Market.
Acquiring Credentials#031.dst: Continuez d'explorer la base aérienne à la recherche d'indices sur le Marché noir.

Acquiring Credentials#033.src: Hey, uh...do these people look suspicious to you, too?
Acquiring Credentials#033.dst: Dis, euh... tu trouves ces gens louches, toi aussi?
Acquiring Credentials#033.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#034.src: The airship commanders love what they hate.
Acquiring Credentials#034.dst: Les commandants de dirigeable aiment ce qu'ils détestent.
Acquiring Credentials#034.speaker: Waiter

Acquiring Credentials#035.src: I think we're getting onto something! Let's keep going.
Acquiring Credentials#035.dst: Je crois qu'on tient quelque chose! Continuons.
Acquiring Credentials#035.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#036.src: Follow the clue: The airship commanders love what they hate.
Acquiring Credentials#036.dst: Suivez l'indice: Les commandants de dirigeable aiment ce qu'ils détestent.

Acquiring Credentials#037.src: Hmmm... These crates are full of items. Maybe we could give some of them to the commanders?
Acquiring Credentials#037.dst: Hmmm... Ces caisses sont pleines d'objets. On pourrait peut-être en donner aux commandants?
Acquiring Credentials#037.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#038.src: Once torn, forever broken beyond repair.
Acquiring Credentials#038.dst: Déchiré une fois, brisé à jamais.
Acquiring Credentials#038.speaker: Commander

Acquiring Credentials#039.src: Oh, let's keep going! Where can we go with that lead?
Acquiring Credentials#039.dst: Oh, continuons! Où cette piste peut-elle nous mener?
Acquiring Credentials#039.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#040.src: Follow the clue: Once torn, forever broken beyond repair.
Acquiring Credentials#040.dst: Suivez l'indice: Déchiré une fois, brisé à jamais.

Acquiring Credentials#041.src: Who's that on top of that platform?!
Acquiring Credentials#041.dst: Qui est-ce, là-haut sur cette plateforme?!
Acquiring Credentials#041.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#042.src: The two of you have come real far for this, huh?
Acquiring Credentials#042.dst: Vous êtes venus de loin pour ça, hein?
Acquiring Credentials#042.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#043.src: Well, I can give you the answer to the stout and beer question! But you won't enter the Market just with that.
Acquiring Credentials#043.dst: Eh bien, je peux vous donner la réponse à la question de la brune et de la blonde! Mais ça ne suffira pas pour entrer au Marché.
Acquiring Credentials#043.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#044.src: You see, to enter the Market you'll need something to sell! And it won't be something you can exactly buy around here, if you get what I mean.
Acquiring Credentials#044.dst: Voyez-vous, pour entrer au Marché, il vous faut quelque chose à vendre! Et pas quelque chose qu'on peut vraiment acheter par ici, si vous voyez ce que je veux dire.
Acquiring Credentials#044.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#045.dst: Il nous faut quelque chose... d'illégal, c'est ça?
Acquiring Credentials#045.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#046.src: Exactly! Luckily for you, I'm in a good mood. There's an airship docked close by. We'll be able to take it and I can help you get an item.
Acquiring Credentials#046.dst: Exactement! Par chance pour vous, je suis de bonne humeur. Un dirigeable est amarré tout près. On pourra le prendre et je vous aiderai à obtenir un objet.
Acquiring Credentials#046.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#047.src: Uh... What do you think, {u}? I really need that passport, and well...you could get something out of this too, right?
Acquiring Credentials#047.dst: Euh... Qu'en penses-tu, {u}? J'ai vraiment besoin de ce passeport, et bon... tu pourrais y gagner quelque chose aussi, non?
Acquiring Credentials#047.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#048.src: Protect me while I harvest the egg, soldier!
Acquiring Credentials#048.dst: Protégez-moi pendant que je récupère l'oeuf, soldat!
Acquiring Credentials#048.speaker: Mechanic

similar.text: Protect me while I harvest the egg, human!

Acquiring Credentials#050.src: Great! Follow me, it's not far.
Acquiring Credentials#050.dst: Parfait! Suivez-moi, ce n'est pas loin.
Acquiring Credentials#050.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#052.src: Wait! There are guards protecting the airship. Don't let them see you!
Acquiring Credentials#052.dst: Attendez! Des gardes protègent le dirigeable. Qu'ils ne vous voient pas!
Acquiring Credentials#052.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#053.src: They're near the edge... Push them off.
Acquiring Credentials#053.dst: Ils sont près du bord... Poussez-les.
Acquiring Credentials#053.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#054.src: Uhh... I'm sure they're fine, I'm sure that fall wasn't too big...
Acquiring Credentials#054.dst: Euh... Je suis sûr qu'ils vont bien, la chute n'était sûrement pas si haute...
Acquiring Credentials#054.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#055.src: Well, that's your only way inside! There are more guards up ahead. Take care of them without being seen, and we'll be in the clear!
Acquiring Credentials#055.dst: Bon, c'est le seul moyen d'entrer! Il y a d'autres gardes plus loin. Occupez-vous d'eux sans être vus, et la voie sera libre!
Acquiring Credentials#055.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#056.src: Well done! Let's get on the airship.
Acquiring Credentials#056.dst: Bien joué! Montons à bord du dirigeable.
Acquiring Credentials#056.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#057.src: Did you just... Push them all...?
Acquiring Credentials#057.dst: Tu viens de... les pousser tous...?
Acquiring Credentials#057.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#058.src: Buckle up! We're heading to the {p}, there we'll be able to collect some dragonling eggs for you to sell at the Black Market!
Acquiring Credentials#058.dst: Attachez vos ceintures! Cap sur {p}, où on pourra récolter des oeufs de dragonnet à vendre au Marché noir!
Acquiring Credentials#058.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#059.src: Travel with the Mechanic and Doan to the {p} to get the Dragonling Egg.
Acquiring Credentials#059.dst: Voyagez avec le Mécanicien et Doan jusqu'à {p} pour obtenir l'oeuf de dragonnet.

Acquiring Credentials#060.src: The island we're heading to is home to a Dragonling nest! They use it to lay their eggs, as it's quite a difficult place to access.
Acquiring Credentials#060.dst: L'île où nous allons abrite un nid de dragonnets! Ils y pondent leurs oeufs, car c'est un endroit très difficile d'accès.
Acquiring Credentials#060.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#061.src: And those'll be worth a lot in the Black Market, right...?
Acquiring Credentials#061.dst: Et ils vaudront cher au Marché noir, hein...?
Acquiring Credentials#061.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#062.src: They sure will! Dragonling eggs are rare, and this island can only be accessed by airship... They're worth a fortune back at Letvus.
Acquiring Credentials#062.dst: Et comment! Les oeufs de dragonnet sont rares, et on ne peut atteindre cette île qu'en dirigeable... Ils valent une fortune à Letvus.
Acquiring Credentials#062.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#063.src: Oh, there it is! I can see the island from here, buckle up. We've got some eggs to steal!
Acquiring Credentials#063.dst: Oh, la voilà! Je vois l'île d'ici, accrochez-vous. On a des oeufs à voler!
Acquiring Credentials#063.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#064.src: What's that?! Oh... It looks like we've got company...
Acquiring Credentials#064.dst: C'est quoi, ça?! Oh... On dirait qu'on a de la compagnie...
Acquiring Credentials#064.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#065.src: Drat, the skyraiders are here! We can't let them get away with those eggs...
Acquiring Credentials#065.dst: Zut, les Skyraiders sont là! On ne peut pas les laisser filer avec ces oeufs...
Acquiring Credentials#065.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#066.src: Well, if that's the case, then there's only one thing to do! Come on, follow me!
Acquiring Credentials#066.dst: Eh bien, dans ce cas, il n'y a qu'une chose à faire! Allez, suivez-moi!
Acquiring Credentials#066.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#067.src: We can't get to the nest with so many pirates on the way, kill them!
Acquiring Credentials#067.dst: On ne pourra pas atteindre le nid avec autant de pirates en travers, tuez-les!
Acquiring Credentials#067.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#068.src: Alright, follow me! Let's go harvest that egg!
Acquiring Credentials#068.dst: Bien, suivez-moi! Allons récolter cet oeuf!
Acquiring Credentials#068.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#069.src: Protect me while I harvest the egg, human!
Acquiring Credentials#069.dst: Protégez-moi pendant que je récupère l'oeuf, humain!
Acquiring Credentials#069.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#070.src: We're halfway there, just keep defending me!
Acquiring Credentials#070.dst: On est à mi-chemin, continuez à me défendre!
Acquiring Credentials#070.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#071.src: There we go! Let's get back to the airship, run!
Acquiring Credentials#071.dst: Et voilà! Retournons au dirigeable, courez!
Acquiring Credentials#071.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#072.src: Don't let them get away! Fire the cannons!!
Acquiring Credentials#072.dst: Ne les laissez pas filer! Feu à volonté!!
Acquiring Credentials#072.speaker: Skyraider

Acquiring Credentials#073.src: Soldier, don't let them hit us! Attack the cannonballs using your weapon before they hit our airship to deflect them!
Acquiring Credentials#073.dst: Soldat, qu'ils ne nous touchent pas! Frappez les boulets avec votre arme pour les dévier avant qu'ils touchent le dirigeable!
Acquiring Credentials#073.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#074.src: We can't take more cannon shots... We're wasting our time, let's get going! We got bigger fish to fry!
Acquiring Credentials#074.dst: On ne tiendra pas d'autres tirs... On perd notre temps, filons! On a d'autres chats à fouetter!
Acquiring Credentials#074.speaker: Skyraider

Acquiring Credentials#075.src: That was close... Well then, let's head back to the airbase!
Acquiring Credentials#075.dst: C'était juste... Bon, retournons à la base aérienne!
Acquiring Credentials#075.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#076.src: Go back to the bar at the Blackbird Inn with Doan.
Acquiring Credentials#076.dst: Retournez au bar de la Blackbird Inn avec Doan.

Acquiring Credentials#077.src: The two of you have certainly proven yourselves today!
Acquiring Credentials#077.dst: Vous avez fait vos preuves aujourd'hui, tous les deux!
Acquiring Credentials#077.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#078.src: So, I'll give you the password to enter the Black Market.
Acquiring Credentials#078.dst: Je vais donc vous donner le mot de passe pour entrer au Marché noir.
Acquiring Credentials#078.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#079.src: Go back to the Barman at the Inn and tell him 'I'm not thirsty, I always carry a bottle.'
Acquiring Credentials#079.dst: Allez dire au barman de l'auberge: 'Je n'ai pas soif, j'ai toujours une bouteille.'
Acquiring Credentials#079.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#080.src: That might just give you the chance you need to get in. Good luck!
Acquiring Credentials#080.dst: Ça pourrait bien vous ouvrir la porte. Bonne chance!
Acquiring Credentials#080.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#081.src: Thank you for your help, sir... Let's go back to the bar, then.
Acquiring Credentials#081.dst: Merci pour votre aide, monsieur... Retournons au bar, alors.
Acquiring Credentials#081.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#082.src: Here we are again. Let's talk to the Barman.
Acquiring Credentials#082.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#083.src: Um, sir? I'm not thirsty, I always carry a bottle.
Acquiring Credentials#083.dst: Euh, monsieur? Je n'ai pas soif, j'ai toujours une bouteille.
Acquiring Credentials#083.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#084.src: ...Well, hey there... Would you like to buy some... potions?
Acquiring Credentials#084.dst: ...Eh bien, salut... Ça te dirait d'acheter quelques... potions?

Acquiring Credentials#085.src: Well, hello there! You like you could use some of my fine wares, yes!
Acquiring Credentials#085.dst: Eh bien, bonjour! Mes excellentes marchandises te seraient bien utiles, oui!

Acquiring Credentials#086.src: A dragonling egg? I'd pay {~} emeralds for it.
Acquiring Credentials#086.dst: Un oeuf de dragonnet? Je t'en donnerais {~} émeraudes.
Acquiring Credentials#086.speaker: Black Market Merchant

Acquiring Credentials#087.src: So that's our initial bid. Now we need to ask for a higher bid, remember? We can't always talk to the same merchant or they'll lose interest...
Acquiring Credentials#087.dst: Voilà notre offre de départ. Il faut maintenant obtenir mieux, tu te souviens? On ne peut pas toujours voir le même marchand, sinon il se lassera...

Acquiring Credentials#088.src: And we can't talk to more than {~} people for a raise or they might get angry.
Acquiring Credentials#088.dst: Et on ne peut demander une hausse qu'à {~} personnes au plus, sinon elles s'énerveront.

Acquiring Credentials#089.src: Well! We really don't see many dragonling eggs around here, not at all!! I'll give you {~} emeralds for it, how does that sound?!
Acquiring Credentials#089.dst: Eh bien! On ne voit vraiment pas beaucoup d'oeufs de dragonnet par ici, pas du tout!! Je t'en donne {~} émeraudes, qu'en dis-tu?!
Acquiring Credentials#089.speaker: Black Market Merchant

Acquiring Credentials#090.src: Fine! I'll raise my price to {~} emeralds. But if this egg isn't mine now? Don't bother coming back.
Acquiring Credentials#090.dst: Soit! Je monte à {~} émeraudes. Mais si cet oeuf n'est pas à moi tout de suite? Inutile de revenir.
Acquiring Credentials#090.speaker: Black Market Merchant

Acquiring Credentials#091.src: Remember what the passport seller said? We shouldn't always talk to the same merchant... I think this one won't like another price raise. We should talk to the others.
Acquiring Credentials#091.dst: Tu te souviens de ce qu'a dit le vendeur de passeports? On ne devrait pas toujours parler au même marchand... Je crois que celui-ci n'appréciera pas une nouvelle hausse. Parlons aux autres.

Acquiring Credentials#092.src: An egg, eh... I'd pay you... {~} emeralds, for it.
Acquiring Credentials#092.dst: Un oeuf, hein... Je t'en donnerais... {~} émeraudes.

Acquiring Credentials#093.src: Another price hike?! I'm not interested anymore. Scram.
Acquiring Credentials#093.dst: Encore une hausse?! Ça ne m'intéresse plus. Dégage.

Acquiring Credentials#094.src: Is that a dragonling egg I spot? For a rare item such as that, I would of course be willing to pay {~} emeralds for it!
Acquiring Credentials#094.dst: Est-ce un oeuf de dragonnet que j'aperçois? Pour un objet aussi rare, je serais bien sûr prêt à en payer {~} émeraudes!
Acquiring Credentials#094.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#096.src: He appears to be rummaging through his documents.
Acquiring Credentials#096.dst: Il semble fouiller dans ses documents.

Acquiring Credentials#097.src: We have to get to {~} emeralds in {~} bid increases. Let's try again!
Acquiring Credentials#097.dst: Il faut atteindre {~} émeraudes en {~} hausses. Réessayons!

Acquiring Credentials#098.src: You should try to increase the price with another merchant before going back to your previous one.
Acquiring Credentials#098.dst: Vous devriez essayer de faire monter le prix avec un autre marchand avant de revenir au précédent.

Acquiring Credentials#099.src: Oh, you're bold, I'll give you that! Asking for another price increase?! Fine!! I'll raise my price to {~} emeralds!
Acquiring Credentials#099.dst: Oh, tu as du culot, je te l'accorde! Encore une hausse?! Soit!! Je monte à {~} émeraudes!

Acquiring Credentials#100.src: I'll raise that price to... {~} emeralds.
Acquiring Credentials#100.dst: Je monte ce prix à... {~} émeraudes.

Acquiring Credentials#102.src: ...might not be my business to ask, but what's a human got business at a villager airship customs office for?
Acquiring Credentials#102.dst: ...c'est peut-être pas mes oignons, mais qu'est-ce qu'un humain vient faire dans un bureau de douane de dirigeables villageois?

Acquiring Credentials#103.src: Talk only to the Black Market member in the end of the hallway and do not talk to anyone else.
Acquiring Credentials#103.dst: Parlez uniquement au membre du Marché noir au bout du couloir, et à personne d'autre.
Acquiring Credentials#103.speaker: Barman

Acquiring Credentials#105.src: Enter the Black Market and talk to the Member at the end of the hallway.
Acquiring Credentials#105.dst: Entrez dans le Marché noir et parlez au membre au bout du couloir.

Acquiring Credentials#106.src: I've heard you've stolen some eggs from the Skyraiders. That's a bold move!
Acquiring Credentials#106.dst: Il paraît que vous avez volé des oeufs aux Skyraiders. C'est audacieux!
Acquiring Credentials#106.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#108.src: Two passports? I'd say that's around {~} emeralds. You can get that selling this egg on the market.
Acquiring Credentials#108.dst: Deux passeports? Je dirais dans les {~} émeraudes. Vous pouvez les obtenir en vendant cet oeuf au marché.
Acquiring Credentials#108.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#109.src: Let me fill you in how the market works. You'll get a low starting price for your egg, and then you'll have to go around the merchants asking for a higher bid.
Acquiring Credentials#109.dst: Je vous explique comment fonctionne le marché. Votre oeuf aura un prix de départ bas, et vous devrez faire le tour des marchands pour obtenir une meilleure offre.
Acquiring Credentials#109.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#110.src: Be careful, though, as you can only ask for {~} price increases.
Acquiring Credentials#110.dst: Mais attention, vous ne pouvez demander que {~} hausses de prix.
Acquiring Credentials#110.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#111.src: You can try talking to different merchants, and see how much each increases the price of the egg.
Acquiring Credentials#111.dst: Vous pouvez parler à différents marchands, et voir de combien chacun augmente le prix de l'oeuf.
Acquiring Credentials#111.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#112.src: Good luck, and do try not to get killed.
Acquiring Credentials#112.dst: Bonne chance, et tâchez de ne pas vous faire tuer.
Acquiring Credentials#112.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#113.src: Talk to the Merchants and try to get {~} emeralds to buy a passport.
Acquiring Credentials#113.dst: Parlez aux marchands et essayez d'obtenir {~} émeraudes pour acheter un passeport.

Acquiring Credentials#114.src: That's what we need, {u}. Sold! The egg is yours.
Acquiring Credentials#114.dst: C'est ce qu'il nous faut, {u}. Vendu! L'oeuf est à vous.
Acquiring Credentials#114.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#115.src: Here, you can have your emeralds.
Acquiring Credentials#115.speaker: Merchant

Acquiring Credentials#117.src: Talk to the Black Market Member again.
Acquiring Credentials#117.dst: Parlez de nouveau au membre du Marché noir.

Acquiring Credentials#118.src: So do you have the emeralds?
Acquiring Credentials#118.speaker: Black Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#119.src: Hmm... This will do it. Here, your passports.
Acquiring Credentials#119.dst: Hmm... Ça fera l'affaire. Tenez, vos passeports.
Acquiring Credentials#119.speaker: Black Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#120.src: Uhh.. {u}, I think you dropped your passport. Let me get it for yo-...
Acquiring Credentials#120.dst: Euh.. {u}, je crois que t'as fait tomber ton passeport. Attends, je te le ramass-...
Acquiring Credentials#120.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#121.src: Wait... That's MY passport?! It was in my pocket all along...
Acquiring Credentials#121.dst: Attends... C'est MON passeport?! Il était dans ma poche depuis le début...
Acquiring Credentials#121.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#122.src: Well, uhhh... I guess you can have some of these emeralds, then...
Acquiring Credentials#122.dst: Eh bien, euhhh... Tu peux garder une partie de ces émeraudes, alors...
Acquiring Credentials#122.speaker: Doan

Aldorei's Secret Part I#000.src: For the safety of the citizens, these doors shall remain shut until the criminal is captured.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#000.dst: Pour la sécurité des citoyens, ces portes resteront fermées jusqu'à la capture du criminel.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#000.speaker: Elf Guard

similar.text: [+{~} Rusted Rake]

Aldorei's Secret Part I#002.src: This is utterly inane. A full lockdown, over a petty theft... Are we not to help one another? To thieve is unnecessary.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#002.dst: C'est d'une absurdité totale. Un confinement complet, pour un vulgaire larcin... Ne devons-nous pas nous entraider? Voler est inutile.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#002.speaker: Vaenr

Aldorei's Secret Part I#003.src: The plant has been disturbed- Looks like it was knocked over.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#003.dst: La plante a été dérangée- On dirait qu'on l'a renversée.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#004.src: It's missing a few leaves- Many of them are scattered around the area.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#004.dst: Il lui manque quelques feuilles- Beaucoup sont éparpillées alentour.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#005.src: There seem to be some footprints leading away... It would probably be best to ask about the plant.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#005.dst: On dirait que des empreintes s'éloignent... Le mieux serait sans doute de se renseigner sur la plante.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#006.src: I pray to the Light that you are able to help before the situation degrades further.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#006.dst: Je prie la Lumière que vous puissiez aider avant que la situation n'empire.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#007.src: This book describes a potion of enhanced vision.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#007.dst: Ce livre décrit une potion de vision améliorée.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#008.src: ...why are so many of the pages ripped out?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#008.dst: ...pourquoi tant de pages ont-elles été arrachées?

Aldorei's Secret Part I#009.src: See me as I truly am- My name is Korben, and I mustn't be delayed further!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#009.dst: Voyez-moi tel que je suis- Je m'appelle Korben, et je ne dois plus perdre de temps!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#009.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#010.src: Maybe there's another way to the window...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#010.dst: Il y a peut-être un autre moyen d'atteindre la fenêtre...

Aldorei's Secret Part I#011.src: You should probably investigate the collapsed bridge to see where Korben went.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#011.dst: Vous devriez sans doute examiner le pont effondré pour voir où est allé Korben.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#012.src: You may come and go as you wish to {p} Town. We shall open the doors for you.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#012.dst: Vous pouvez aller et venir au village de {p} librement. Nous vous ouvrirons les portes.

similar.text: This being the case... You may come and go as you wish to {p} Town. We shall re-open the doors.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#013.src: Hey! Please come talk to me.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#013.dst: Hé! Venez me parler, s'il vous plaît.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#013.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part I#014.src: Have you ever heard the saying "Elves never die"- well it's true, or so I thought.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#014.dst: Connaissez-vous le dicton "Les elfes ne meurent jamais"- c'est vrai, du moins je le croyais.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#014.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part I#015.src: Talk to the Elf Guard at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part I#016.src: Halt, traveler! Entry to {p} Town is forbidden at present.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#016.dst: Halte, voyageur! L'accès au village de {p} est interdit pour l'instant.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#016.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#017.src: There is a dangerous criminal on the loose in this valley.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#017.dst: Un dangereux criminel rôde dans cette vallée.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#017.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#018.src: These doors shall remain closed until the criminal is captured.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#018.dst: Ces portes resteront fermées jusqu'à la capture du criminel.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#018.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#019.src: See if anyone in {p} Valley knows what happened
Aldorei's Secret Part I#019.dst: Demandez dans la vallée de {p} si quelqu'un sait ce qui s'est passé

Aldorei's Secret Part I#020.src: An outsider in our midst? Exciting to see. I have wished to share our magic with new people for a long while.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#020.dst: Un étranger parmi nous? Quelle joie. Cela fait longtemps que je souhaite partager notre magie avec de nouvelles personnes.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#020.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#021.src: However, I am...well, rather hungry. And I must tend to my garden here for the time being.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#021.dst: Cependant, j'ai... ma foi, plutôt faim. Et je dois m'occuper de mon jardin pour le moment.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#021.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#022.src: Have you heard the saying “You scratch my ears, I scratch yours”? People must help one another.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#022.dst: Connaissez-vous le dicton “Gratte-moi les oreilles, je gratterai les tiennes”? Il faut s'entraider.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#022.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#023.src: If you would be so kind as to bring me a loaf of fresh bread you may take my enchanted bucket.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#023.dst: Si vous aviez l'amabilité de m'apporter une miche de pain frais, vous pourrez prendre mon seau enchanté.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#023.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#024.src: I saw you toil to bake this yourself. Frankly, that is above and beyond what I expected, so here is your exchange.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#024.dst: Je vous ai vu peiner à le cuire vous-même. Franchement, c'est bien plus que je n'espérais, alors voici votre récompense.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#024.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#025.src: If you require help in the future with anything, do not be afraid to ask. If you put such effort for me, I shall give you the same.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#025.dst: Si vous avez besoin d'aide un jour, n'hésitez pas à demander. Si vous vous donnez tant de peine pour moi, je ferai de même pour vous.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#025.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#026.src: Find a use for Damys' Bucket
Aldorei's Secret Part I#026.dst: Trouvez une utilité au seau de Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#027.src: The thieving is not the reason, from what I have heard. It is that the grove was jealously hidden due to the potency of the plants there.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#027.dst: D'après ce que j'ai entendu, le vol n'est pas la raison. Le bosquet était jalousement caché à cause de la puissance de ses plantes.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#027.speaker: Sylvar

Aldorei's Secret Part I#028.src: Tattytale, Iridesca, Subtraxerim... The Light only knows what else. It is impossible to reach without unusual means- And that is cause for grave concern.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#028.dst: Tattytale, Iridesca, Subtraxerim... La Lumière seule sait quoi d'autre. Impossible d'y accéder sans moyens insolites- Et c'est un motif de grave inquiétude.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#028.speaker: Sylvar

Aldorei's Secret Part I#029.src: Find a way to grow the plant by the waterfall
Aldorei's Secret Part I#029.dst: Trouvez un moyen de faire pousser la plante près de la cascade

Aldorei's Secret Part I#031.src: Halt! This area is strictly off limits, especially for an outsider. Turn back now!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#031.dst: Halte! Cette zone est strictement interdite, surtout aux étrangers. Faites demi-tour!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#031.speaker: Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#033.src: Aha, the outsider returns. Is there something troubling you?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#033.dst: Ah, l'étranger est de retour. Quelque chose vous tracasse?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#033.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#034.src: ...mmm. Unfortunate, that. I cannot help with this.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#034.dst: ...mmm. Fâcheux, cela. Je ne peux pas vous aider.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#034.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#035.src: It is not a matter of secrecy or morals- I simply do not know what that leaf is from or what it may be capable of.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#035.dst: Ce n'est ni une question de secret ni de morale- J'ignore d'où vient cette feuille et de quoi elle est capable.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#035.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#036.src: I am no botanist- Simply a gardener. The mistake is understandable, if regrettable.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#036.dst: Je ne suis pas botaniste- Simple jardinier. L'erreur est compréhensible, quoique regrettable.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#036.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#037.src: However, I was taught under a much more storied botanist who may have the answers you seek.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#037.dst: Mais j'ai été formé par une botaniste bien plus illustre, qui aura peut-être vos réponses.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#037.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#038.src: Her name is Fiona- Her home is across the valley from here. Take the bridge across. She often stays inside studying.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#038.dst: Elle s'appelle Fiona- Elle vit de l'autre côté de la vallée. Prenez le pont. Elle reste souvent chez elle à étudier.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#038.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#039.src: She has forgotten more than I will ever hope to know about plants. If she cannot help you, I fear none can.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#039.dst: Elle a oublié plus que je n'en saurai jamais sur les plantes. Si elle ne peut vous aider, personne ne le pourra.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#039.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#040.src: Go to the botanist's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Aldorei's Secret Part I#040.dst: Allez à la maison de la botaniste en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Aldorei's Secret Part I#041.src: This is outrageous! To think one of our own would stoop to such thievery and destruction!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#041.dst: C'est scandaleux! Dire que l'un des nôtres s'abaisserait à voler et à détruire!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#041.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#042.src: Outsider, this is not the time to be asking me anything. My home has been ransacked!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#042.dst: Étranger, ce n'est pas le moment de me poser des questions. Ma maison a été saccagée!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#042.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#043.src: Mm? Damys sent you... You have leaves of Iridesca? Hm... Then perhaps we may be able to help one another.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#043.dst: Mm? Damys vous envoie... Vous avez des feuilles d'Iridesca? Hm... Alors nous pourrons peut-être nous entraider.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#043.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#044.src: They tore through my shelves and furniture searching, and scanned the pages as fervently once they found it.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#044.dst: Le voleur a fouillé mes étagères et mes meubles, puis, le livre trouvé, en a parcouru les pages avec avidité.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#044.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#045.src: Afterwards, they threw the book into the back garden, and forced a carnivorous plant to grow and consume my notes!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#045.dst: Ensuite, il a jeté le livre au jardin et forcé une plante carnivore à pousser pour dévorer mes notes!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#045.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#046.src: I assume when the desired information was found, they went into my garden, threw the book into the carnivorous plant and stormed off towards the lab.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#046.dst: Je suppose qu'une fois l'information trouvée, il est allé au jardin, a jeté le livre à la plante carnivore et est parti en trombe vers le labo.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#046.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#047.src: I have researched the Iridesca bloom, and many other plants, for a long time. All my knowledge is stored in that book!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#047.dst: J'étudie la fleur d'Iridesca, et bien d'autres plantes, depuis longtemps. Tout mon savoir est dans ce livre!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#047.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#048.src: Retrieve it for me, and I will share my knowledge with you.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#048.dst: Rapportez-le-moi, et je partagerai mon savoir avec vous.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#048.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#049.src: Kill the carnivorous plant and loot the book
Aldorei's Secret Part I#049.dst: Tuez la plante carnivore et récupérez le livre

Aldorei's Secret Part I#050.src: ...disgusting. I will have to hang the pages to dry later, but first, our exchange.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#050.dst: ...répugnant. Je ferai sécher les pages plus tard, mais d'abord, notre marché.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#050.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#051.src: Hmm... Herbstzeitlose... Death Whistle, no...where is Iridesca, again...?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#051.dst: Hmm... Herbstzeitlose... Death Whistle, non... où est donc Iridesca...?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#051.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#052.src: Aha, there it is. The pages were sticking together. Iridesca leaves are potent in various ways and are very versatile in their use.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#052.dst: Ah, la voilà. Les pages étaient collées. Les feuilles d'Iridesca sont puissantes à bien des égards et d'un usage très polyvalent.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#052.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#053.src: They have an incredibly broad range of usage, from soothing joint pain or curing sickness to emetic effect and lethal poison, depending on what it is brewed with.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#053.dst: Leurs usages sont incroyablement variés: apaiser les articulations, guérir la maladie, faire vomir ou tuer net, selon ce avec quoi on les infuse.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#053.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#054.src: Mm? The book thief also possesses Iridesca...? This... This is very troubling. There are few notes aside from mine on how to heal Iridesca poisoning.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#054.dst: Mm? Le voleur a lui aussi de l'Iridesca...? Voilà... voilà qui est très inquiétant. Hormis les miennes, peu de notes expliquent comment soigner ce poison.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#054.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#055.src: They were headed in the direction of the potionmaker's guild. If they intend something wicked...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#055.dst: Il se dirigeait vers la guilde des fabricants de potions. S'il prépare un mauvais coup...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#055.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#056.dst: Examinez la boutique de l'alchimiste en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Aldorei's Secret Part I#057.src: ..you! You have been seeking me! I have seen you tracing my footsteps...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#057.dst: ..vous! Vous me cherchiez! Je vous ai vu suivre mes traces...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#057.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#058.src: I apologize for this... But what I do is a necessity!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#058.dst: Pardonnez-moi... Mais ce que je fais est une nécessité!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#058.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#059.src: I beg you, do not pursue me any further!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#059.dst: Je vous en supplie, cessez de me poursuivre!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#059.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#061.src: Outsider, I realize the circumstances appear damning, but you must stop!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#061.dst: Étranger, je sais que les apparences m'accablent, mais vous devez arrêter!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#061.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#062.src: What I have done is needed, and if there were another path I would have taken it over this.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#062.dst: Ce que j'ai fait était nécessaire, et s'il y avait eu une autre voie, je l'aurais prise.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#062.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#063.src: I must take my concoction to where it is needed!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#063.dst: Je dois apporter ma préparation là où l'on en a besoin!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#063.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#064.src: G R O W! (In High Gavellian)
Aldorei's Secret Part I#064.dst: P O U S S E! (En haut gavellien)
Aldorei's Secret Part I#064.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#065.src: A damnable pace you have... I cannot let you stop me for a moment longer!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#065.dst: Quelle allure infernale... Je ne vous laisserai pas m'arrêter un instant de plus!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#065.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#066.src: It will be done soon, but I must reach my destination first!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#066.dst: Ce sera bientôt fait, mais je dois d'abord atteindre ma destination!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#066.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#067.src: Finally... I apologize for the delay. I needed to take strong measures to get this to you.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#067.dst: Enfin... Pardonnez ce retard. J'ai dû employer les grands moyens pour vous apporter ceci.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#067.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#068.src: Here, here... Drink, father. It will clear your throat.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#068.dst: Tenez, tenez... Buvez, père. Cela apaisera votre gorge.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#068.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#069.src: ...there. It is done. Now... Outsider... Hear me, please.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#069.dst: ...voilà. C'est fait. Maintenant... Étranger... Écoutez-moi, je vous prie.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#069.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#070.src: I am aware of exactly what I have done. Shredded Fiona’s research, disturbed the forbidden gardens, unsettled the hearts of many...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#070.dst: Je sais exactement ce que j'ai fait. Déchiré les recherches de Fiona, troublé les jardins interdits, inquiété bien des coeurs...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#070.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#071.src: My father fell ill. A trek to {p}’s borders left him stricken with Kerasot poisoning. He was near death...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#071.dst: Mon père est tombé malade. Un voyage aux frontières de {p} l'a empoisonné au Kerasot. Il était près de mourir...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#071.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#072.src: {p}’s village is one of outcasts- to visit is, stupidly, forbidden. He would have been exiled, and that would have ensured his death with his affliction.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#072.dst: Le village de {p} est un village de parias- Y aller est, stupidement, interdit. Il aurait été exilé, et avec son mal, cela l'aurait tué.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#072.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#073.src: Desperation causes one to do strange things. I thought only of his safety- I cared little about anything else.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#073.dst: Le désespoir pousse à d'étranges actes. Je ne pensais qu'à sa sécurité- Le reste m'importait peu.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#073.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#074.src: Even now I am simply relieved for his safety. If you must turn me in, I understand- I have already done what I set out to do.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#074.dst: Même maintenant, je suis juste soulagé qu'il soit sauf. Si vous devez me livrer, je comprends- J'ai accompli ce que je voulais.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#074.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#075.src: Though I wish to remain free, whether you choose to report my activities or not does not matter to me now.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#075.dst: Je souhaite rester libre, mais que vous dénonciez mes actes ou non ne m'importe plus.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#075.speaker: Korben

Aldorei's Secret Part I#077.src: Traveler, I must remind you- The doors shall remain shut until the criminal has been found.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#077.dst: Voyageur, je dois vous le rappeler- Les portes resteront closes tant que le criminel ne sera pas trouvé.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#077.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#078.src: ...ah. You have found him, then. The name is Korben... Understood. We shall interrogate him for his actions.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#078.dst: ...ah. Vous l'avez donc trouvé. Il s'appelle Korben... Compris. Nous l'interrogerons sur ses actes.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#078.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#079.src: This being the case... You may come and go as you wish to {p} Town. We shall re-open the doors.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#123.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#124.src: I don't care if you have defeated all the monsters in the world, never ask a woman like me of her age.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#124.dst: Peu m'importe que vous ayez vaincu tous les monstres du monde, on ne demande jamais son âge à une femme comme moi.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#124.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#125.src: I'm glad I could be of help
Aldorei's Secret Part II#125.dst: Ça me fait plaisir d'avoir pu aider Aldorei.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#127.src: You seem like such a kind adventurer, you humans aren't all so bad.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#127.dst: Vous semblez être un aventurier si gentil, vous les humains n'êtes pas si mauvais.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#127.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#128.src: I'm so sorry to hear that.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#128.dst: Je suis vraiment navrée de l'apprendre.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#128.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#129.src: I don't really see how that is connected to {p} though.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#129.dst: Mais je ne vois pas bien le rapport avec {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#129.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#131.src: You never ask a woman her age. Did you not know that?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#131.dst: On ne demande jamais son âge à une femme. Vous ne le saviez pas?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#131.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#132.src: All I can say is that I am old enough.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#132.dst: Disons simplement que je suis assez âgée.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#132.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#133.dst: Amber au rapport! Prête pour le service.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#133.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#134.src: Worry not, the great Amber is here to help you find your way!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#134.dst: Pas d'inquiétude, la grande Amber est là pour t'aider à trouver ton chemin!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#134.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#137.src: My name is Amber of the Sol Embassy Royal Task Force!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#137.dst: Je m'appelle Amber, de la Brigade royale de l'ambassade de Sol!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#137.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#138.src: It is my duty to protect the city from wrongdoers!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#138.dst: Mon devoir est de protéger la ville des malfaiteurs!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#138.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#139.src: You AREN'T A THIEF ARE YOU? OR A ROBBER? OR MURDERER!? ARSONIST!?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#139.dst: Tu N'ES PAS UN VOLEUR, HEIN? OU UN BRIGAND? OU UN ASSASSIN!? UN PYROMANE!?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#139.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#140.src: I let my imagination get the best of me!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#140.dst: Je me suis laissé emporter par mon imagination!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#140.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#141.src: My main job is patrolling the grounds and making sure no one is doing anything they shouldn't.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#141.dst: Mon travail, c'est surtout de patrouiller et de veiller à ce que personne ne fasse ce qu'il ne doit pas.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#141.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#142.src: Maybe I shouldn't have said all of that...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#142.dst: Je n'aurais peut-être pas dû dire tout ça...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#142.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#143.src: Can I help you with anything else?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#143.dst: Je peux t'aider pour autre chose?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#143.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#146.src: I report who comes and leaves the town. Who sells what, who buys what and who talks with who.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#146.dst: Je signale qui entre et sort du village. Qui vend quoi, qui achète quoi et qui parle avec qui.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#146.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#147.src: The list goes on and on and on and on and on... and on... and on.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#147.dst: La liste continue encore et encore et encore et encore... et encore... et encore.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#147.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#148.src: They like keeping track of what happens inside the town!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#148.dst: Ils aiment savoir ce qui se passe dans le village!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#148.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#150.src: The Sol Embassy and its elders.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#150.dst: A l'ambassade de Sol et à ses anciens.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#150.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#152.src: Enjoy this wonderful town. Don't hesitate to ask me for help!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#152.dst: Profite bien de ce merveilleux village. N'hésite pas à me demander de l'aide!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#152.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#157.src: I... I... No! Bullies don't affect me... *sniffles*
Aldorei's Secret Part II#157.dst: Je... je... Non! Les brutes ne m'atteignent pas... *renifle*
Aldorei's Secret Part II#157.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#158.src: Oh it's you. I can't believe we let a human into this place.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#158.dst: Ah, c'est toi. Je n'arrive pas à croire qu'on ait laissé entrer un humain ici.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#158.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#161.src: You dare speak to me like that?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#161.dst: Tu oses me parler sur ce ton?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#161.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#162.src: I will get you deported if it's the last thing I do, mark my words!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#162.dst: Je te ferai expulser, même si c'est la dernière chose que je fais, crois-moi!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#162.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#163.src: So what is it you need?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#163.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#164.dst: Alors, qu'est-ce que tu veux savoir?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#164.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#166.src: If you don't mind me asking... Is your friend from {p}?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#166.dst: Sans indiscrétion... Ton ami vient de {p}?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#166.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#168.src: Farewell. Make sure to let everyone know I'm the smartest!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#168.dst: Adieu. Et dis bien à tout le monde que je suis le plus malin!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#168.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#173.src: You humans are really stupid I have to say... zzz......
Aldorei's Secret Part II#173.dst: Vous, les humains, vous êtes vraiment bêtes, je dois dire... zzz......
Aldorei's Secret Part II#173.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#175.src: I'm younger than most here, you see. I'm just about a hundred years old.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#175.dst: Je suis plus jeune que la plupart des gens ici, voyez-vous. J'ai à peine cent ans.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#175.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#176.dst: Il y en a beaucoup de votre âge?

Aldorei's Secret Part II#177.src: No. Do you not know of the child regulations here?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#177.dst: Non. Vous ne connaissez pas les règles sur les enfants, ici?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#177.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#178.src: There are very strict restrictions on who or when someone can have children here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#178.dst: Il y a des restrictions très strictes sur qui peut avoir des enfants, et quand.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#178.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#179.src: The main reason elves have moved to {p}, to start families.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#179.dst: C'est la raison principale du départ des elfes pour {p}: fonder une famille.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#179.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#180.dst: Où n'avez-vous pas le droit d'aller?

Aldorei's Secret Part II#181.src: I can't really say... You really don't want to break the rules here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#181.dst: Je ne peux pas le dire... Ici, mieux vaut ne pas enfreindre les règles.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#181.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#182.src: I can give you some information but you need to leave me alone after.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#182.dst: Je peux vous donner quelques informations, mais après, laissez-moi tranquille.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#182.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#185.src: I'm not that much for... image and status.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#185.dst: Je ne tiens pas trop à... l'image et au statut.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#185.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#186.src: Return to Olon with the information at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#186.dst: Retournez voir Olon avec les informations en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#190.src: Good idea! I overheard some elves talking about an underground river running under the town.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#190.dst: Bonne idée! J'ai entendu des elfes parler d'une rivière souterraine qui coule sous le village.
