All Roads to Peace#352.dst: Même après arrivée villageois, qui chasser orques, beaucoup orques vivre là...puis terre commencer mourir. Pas encore au sud- et nous au sud!
All Roads to Peace#352.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#353.src: But...that off-track. No more war. Give this to whatever villager need to see it.
All Roads to Peace#353.dst: Mais...ça hors sujet. Plus de guerre. Donner ça à villageois qui devoir voir.
All Roads to Peace#353.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#354.src: Show Captain Goruca the Cease-Fire Agreement.
All Roads to Peace#354.dst: Montrez l'accord de cessez-le-feu au capitaine Goruca.

All Roads to Peace#355.src: Human! You're back! That certainly took you a while. I suppose all things considered I shouldn't be surprised. Those orcs are tough.
All Roads to Peace#355.dst: Humain! Vous voilà de retour! Vous en avez mis, du temps. Remarquez, vu les circonstances, ça ne devrait pas m'étonner. Ces orques sont coriaces.
All Roads to Peace#355.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#356.src: What's this? You actually managed to get the brutes to sign a ceasefire?! I was expecting you to come back with a bloody prize, not a signature!
All Roads to Peace#356.dst: Qu'est-ce que c'est? Vous avez vraiment fait signer un cessez-le-feu à ces brutes?! Je m'attendais à un trophée sanglant, pas à une signature!
All Roads to Peace#356.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#357.src: Still, this is good! The terms are a bit more airtight than I'd prefer, but I suppose as long as they're out of our hair anything will do.
All Roads to Peace#357.dst: Quoi qu'il en soit, c'est une bonne nouvelle! Les conditions sont plus strictes que je ne voudrais, mais tant qu'ils nous fichent la paix, ça me va.
All Roads to Peace#357.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#358.src: Hm? The orcs were talking about the decay up north? Not sure how that matters. It isn't like anyone knows what's causing it.
All Roads to Peace#358.dst: Hm? Les orques parlaient de la Décadence au nord? Je ne vois pas le rapport. Personne ne sait ce qui la cause.
All Roads to Peace#358.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#359.src: I mean, have you heard the rumors flying from {p}? Saying witches are cursing the land, hah! Well, that's besides the point.
All Roads to Peace#359.dst: Enfin, vous avez entendu les rumeurs qui viennent de {p}? Il paraît que des sorcières maudissent la terre, ha! Bref, là n'est pas la question.
All Roads to Peace#359.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#360.src: Here- your reward. I'd intended on giving you the mask so you could try and sneak in like one of them, but I...well, I forgot about it til you'd already left.
All Roads to Peace#360.dst: Tenez- votre récompense. Je comptais vous donner le masque pour vous infiltrer parmi eux, mais... eh bien, je l'ai oublié jusqu'à votre départ.
All Roads to Peace#360.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#361.src: But I DID magically fortify it into a potent piece of gear instead! So it ought to serve you well. We thank you for your service, human!
All Roads to Peace#361.dst: Mais je l'ai BIEN renforcé par magie pour en faire un équipement redoutable! Il devrait vous être utile. Merci pour vos services, humain!
All Roads to Peace#361.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#362.src: ...A CATAPULT! Since when did orcs have the knowhow to make a CATAPULT?!
All Roads to Peace#362.dst: ...UNE CATAPULTE! Depuis quand les orques savent fabriquer une CATAPULTE?!
All Roads to Peace#362.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#363.src: Nonono, you don't understand- a CATAPULT?! Seriously, I can't get over this! Orc catapult! What's the world coming to?!
All Roads to Peace#363.dst: Non non non, vous ne comprenez pas- une CATAPULTE?! Sérieusement, je n'en reviens pas! Une catapulte orque! Où va le monde?!
All Roads to Peace#363.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#364.src: Obviously it seems we need some backup, soldier. Would you mind coming along to the medical tent with me?
All Roads to Peace#364.dst: Visiblement, il nous faut du renfort, soldat. Ça vous dérangerait de m'accompagner à la tente médicale?
All Roads to Peace#364.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#365.src: ORC CATAPULT! I'm telling you, Captain! They crushed our guard golems with huge honking boulders! What are we supposed to do against that?!
All Roads to Peace#365.dst: CATAPULTE ORQUE! Je vous le dis, capitaine! Ils ont écrasé nos golems de garde avec d'énormes rochers! Qu'est-ce qu'on est censés faire contre ça?!
All Roads to Peace#365.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#366.src: He's right, captain. After the golems were crushed, the orcs spilled out from the fortress. If we didn't retreat we would've been killed, with just the four of us.
All Roads to Peace#366.dst: Il a raison, capitaine. Une fois les golems écrasés, les orques ont déferlé de la forteresse. Sans retraite, on se serait fait tuer, à quatre seulement.
All Roads to Peace#366.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#367.src: Human! Let me give you the lowdown. Since you helped us reclaim the outpost up north, the orcs have gotten much more aggressive.
All Roads to Peace#367.dst: Humain! Je vous mets au parfum. Depuis que vous nous avez aidés à reprendre l'avant-poste du nord, les orques sont devenus bien plus agressifs.
All Roads to Peace#367.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#368.src: And that's where you come in, soldier. We need you to go to the orc fortress and break through their line of defenses. Maybe if we show them we can equal their force, they'll listen, right?
All Roads to Peace#368.dst: Et c'est là que vous intervenez, soldat. Allez à la forteresse orque et percez leur ligne de défense. Si on leur montre qu'on peut égaler leur force, ils écouteront peut-être, non?
All Roads to Peace#368.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#369.src: One against four... Human not beat even one. Ismikku! Hulve!
All Roads to Peace#369.dst: Un contre quatre... Humain pas battre même un seul. Ismikku! Hulve!
All Roads to Peace#369.speaker: Guard Serepe

All Roads to Peace#370.src: Mmh. Get up. Human! Get up! See human breathing, you awake!
All Roads to Peace#370.dst: Mmh. Debout. Humain! Debout! Voir humain respirer, toi réveillé!

All Roads to Peace#371.src: Anyway. Why you here? Why now? Give me good reason. Because kill orcs for "peace"?
All Roads to Peace#371.dst: Bref. Pourquoi toi ici? Pourquoi maintenant? Bonne raison. Parce que tuer orques pour la "paix"?
All Roads to Peace#371.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#372.src: [!] An Elite Boar has been spotted. The hunt begins!
All Roads to Peace#372.dst: [!] Un Elite Boar a été repéré. Que la chasse commence!

All Roads to Peace#373.src: [!] The Elite Boar can be identified by the particles above it's head.
All Roads to Peace#373.dst: [!] On reconnaît l'Elite Boar aux particules au-dessus de sa tête.

All Roads to Peace#374.src: [!] The boars will try to hide in the bushes around the hunting grounds.
All Roads to Peace#374.dst: [!] Les sangliers vont tenter de se cacher dans les buissons autour du terrain de chasse.

All Roads to Peace#375.src: [!] Pay attention to what bush the Elite Boar is hiding in and give that bush a rustle with right-click to get the boars out of their hiding spots.
All Roads to Peace#375.dst: [!] Repérez dans quel buisson se cache l'Elite Boar et secouez-le d'un clic droit pour faire sortir les sangliers de leur cachette.

All Roads to Peace#376.src: ...hm. ... ... ...can respect human strength. Can hunt spineback, mean strong.
All Roads to Peace#376.dst: ...hm. ... ... ...pouvoir respecter force d'humain. Chasser dos-épineux, vouloir dire fort.
All Roads to Peace#376.speaker: Guard Serepe

All Roads to Peace#377.src: !! Ressinter only healer! Zuett want be healer, Creinu want be healer, but not!
All Roads to Peace#377.dst: !! Ressinter seul soigneur! Zuett vouloir soigner, Creinu vouloir soigner, mais non!
All Roads to Peace#377.speaker: Guard Serepe

similar.text: {u}!! Ressinter only healer! Zuett want be healer, Creinu want be healer, but not!

All Roads to Peace#378.src: Hm... HM!! Human, uh, human good healer! Heal own injury with medicine! Human will help!
All Roads to Peace#378.dst: Hm... HM!! Humain, euh, humain bon guérisseur! Soigner propre blessure avec remède! Humain va aider!
All Roads to Peace#378.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#379.src: The book depicts a tall, vine-like plant with red buds.
All Roads to Peace#379.dst: Le livre montre une grande plante grimpante aux bourgeons rouges.

All Roads to Peace#380.src: The illustration shows a body with splotchy red patches, and seems to depict pulped buds being applied to them.
All Roads to Peace#380.dst: L'illustration montre un corps couvert de plaques rouges, sur lesquelles on semble appliquer des bourgeons écrasés.

All Roads to Peace#381.src: There's a picture of fire on the skin...? Is it trying to say that sweetgale helps heal inflammation?
All Roads to Peace#381.dst: Il y a un dessin de feu sur la peau...? Ça voudrait dire que le myrte des marais aide à soigner l'inflammation?

All Roads to Peace#382.src: Another diagram shows grubs on the body, and seems to show that applying the pulped buds kills the bugs? That's what the big red X over the grub implies...
All Roads to Peace#382.dst: Un autre schéma montre des larves sur le corps, et semble indiquer que les bourgeons écrasés tuent les bestioles? C'est ce que suggère le gros X rouge sur la larve...

All Roads to Peace#384.src: The book depicts large groups of flowers in various colors, but primarily yellow.
All Roads to Peace#384.dst: Le livre montre de grandes grappes de fleurs de couleurs variées, surtout jaunes.

All Roads to Peace#385.src: Seems like yarrow can do a lot- there's a lot of disparate illustrations. One depicts a sneezing orc with two yarrow plants pointing at it, and the sneezing stopping.
All Roads to Peace#385.dst: L'achillée semble servir à beaucoup de choses: les illustrations sont très variées. L'une montre un orque qui éternue, deux plants d'achillée pointés vers lui, puis les éternuements cessent.

All Roads to Peace#386.src: A similar illustration shows an orc that appears to be having stomach cramps, if its hands being crossed over its stomach is any indication, with two yarrow plants pointed at it.
All Roads to Peace#386.dst: Une illustration semblable montre un orque qui semble avoir des crampes d'estomac, à en juger par ses mains croisées sur le ventre, avec deux plants d'achillée pointés vers lui.

All Roads to Peace#387.src: The third one shows an orc seemingly cut up, with red droplets coming off it. Again, two yarrow plants are pointed at it, and the next picture shows the cuts and droplets gone.
All Roads to Peace#387.dst: La troisième montre un orque apparemment tailladé, d'où tombent des gouttes rouges. Là encore, deux plants d'achillée sont pointés vers lui, et sur l'image suivante, coupures et gouttes ont disparu.

All Roads to Peace#389.src: The book depicts small, dainty flowers with white petals.
All Roads to Peace#389.dst: Le livre montre de petites fleurs délicates aux pétales blancs.

All Roads to Peace#390.src: There's a detailed picture of the plant, with arrows pointing to multiple different illustrated orcs each showing different things.
All Roads to Peace#390.dst: Il y a un dessin détaillé de la plante, avec des flèches pointant vers plusieurs orques illustrés, chacun montrant quelque chose de différent.

All Roads to Peace#391.src: One orc is shown to be agitated, and then subsequently sleeping. Another is...shown with red patches on the skin, and fire next to it, which is replaced with water droplets in the next drawing. The red patches are gone.
All Roads to Peace#391.dst: Un orque est d'abord agité, puis endormi. Un autre est... dessiné avec des plaques rouges sur la peau et du feu à côté, remplacé par des gouttes d'eau sur le dessin suivant. Les plaques rouges ont disparu.

All Roads to Peace#392.src: The last one shows various cuts and gashes on a third orc that's emitting red droplets, and then smaller cuts without any red drops on the next depiction...
All Roads to Peace#392.dst: Le dernier montre diverses coupures et entailles sur un troisième orque d'où tombent des gouttes rouges, puis des coupures plus petites, sans gouttes, sur l'image suivante...

All Roads to Peace#393.src: ...but the next page is showing an orc with X's over its eyes, and arrows from multiple chamomile plants pointing to it. Does that mean too much chamomile is bad?
All Roads to Peace#393.dst: ...mais la page suivante montre un orque avec des X sur les yeux, et des flèches allant de plusieurs plants de camomille vers lui. Trop de camomille serait donc mauvais?

All Roads to Peace#395.src: The book depicts a shrub-like plant with white petals and buds.
All Roads to Peace#395.dst: Le livre montre une plante buissonnante aux pétales et bourgeons blancs.

All Roads to Peace#396.src: It looks like this is good for healing a lot of things. The pictures show a sweating, feverish orc, one clutching its stomach, a female one clutching her stomach, and what can be assumed to be an orc with...a toothache?
All Roads to Peace#396.dst: On dirait que ça soigne beaucoup de choses. Les dessins montrent un orque fiévreux en sueur, un autre qui se tient le ventre, une orque qui se tient le ventre, et ce qui semble être un orque avec... une rage de dents?

All Roads to Peace#397.src: Seems to imply that feverfew is good for dealing with all of those kinds of maladies.
All Roads to Peace#397.dst: La matricaire serait donc efficace contre tous ces maux.

All Roads to Peace#399.src: The bleeding seems to have slowed down a little bit, but the medicine orc is still badly injured. The balm must not have been effective. You'll have to make another one.
All Roads to Peace#399.dst: Le saignement semble avoir un peu ralenti, mais l'orque des remèdes est toujours gravement blessé. Le baume n'a pas dû fonctionner. Il va falloir en préparer un autre.

All Roads to Peace#400.src: Not know much about medicine yet. Medicine give to you, last one- Was made before. Know this though.
All Roads to Peace#400.dst: Pas savoir beaucoup sur remèdes encore. Remède donné à toi, le dernier- Fait avant. Mais savoir ça.

All Roads to Peace#401.src: Ressinter bleeding bad. Find herb good for bleeding. Won't need more than two herb of type, too.
All Roads to Peace#401.dst: Ressinter saigner beaucoup. Trouver herbe bonne pour saignement. Pas plus de deux herbes par sorte.

All Roads to Peace#402.src: The book depicts broad, yellow-green leaves.
All Roads to Peace#402.dst: Le livre montre de larges feuilles vert-jaune.

All Roads to Peace#403.src: There's an image of an orc with red droplets coming off it, and an arrow with a picture of a gingko leaf pointing at it- the arrow is crossed out. That could mean multiple things.
All Roads to Peace#403.dst: On voit un orque d'où tombent des gouttes rouges, et une flèche ornée d'une feuille de ginkgo pointée vers lui; la flèche est barrée. Ça pourrait vouloir dire plusieurs choses.

All Roads to Peace#404.src: The next page shows a gingko leaf pointed at an illustration of a brain, and a similar arrow points from a frowning orc to a smiling one.
All Roads to Peace#404.dst: La page suivante montre une feuille de ginkgo pointée vers le dessin d'un cerveau, et une flèche semblable va d'un orque renfrogné à un orque souriant.

All Roads to Peace#405.src: So that means it's good for mood and mental health...and that it does something with bleeding, but you can't tell whether it would be good or bad for it.
All Roads to Peace#405.dst: Donc c'est bon pour l'humeur et la santé mentale... et ça agit sur les saignements, mais impossible de dire si c'est en bien ou en mal.

All Roads to Peace#407.src: The book depicts red-orange flowering stalks, almost like cattails.
All Roads to Peace#407.dst: Le livre montre des tiges fleuries rouge orangé, presque comme des massettes.

All Roads to Peace#408.src: There's a large illustration of an orc with big purple blotches all over it, and next to it there's a similar illustration with orange splotches instead.
All Roads to Peace#408.dst: Il y a une grande illustration d'un orque couvert de grosses taches violettes, et à côté, une illustration semblable avec des taches orange à la place.

All Roads to Peace#409.src: That implies that ground-up pyrola goes on there...probably depicting bruises.
All Roads to Peace#409.dst: Il faudrait donc appliquer de la pyrole broyée là... sûrement sur des bleus.

All Roads to Peace#410.src: Similar orange splotches are shown applied to what is clearly a cut, and the next illustration over shows the same cut having become smaller.
All Roads to Peace#410.dst: Des taches orange semblables sont appliquées sur ce qui est clairement une coupure, et l'illustration suivante montre cette même coupure, devenue plus petite.

All Roads to Peace#411.src: Then there's illustrations of what look like...veins? There's a lot of orcish script next to it, so you can't make heads or tails of what that much could mean.
All Roads to Peace#411.dst: Puis viennent des illustrations de ce qui ressemble à... des veines? Il y a beaucoup d'écriture orque à côté, impossible d'y comprendre quoi que ce soit.

All Roads to Peace#413.src: The book depicts a short shrub covered in vibrant red berries on small stalks.
All Roads to Peace#413.dst: Le livre montre un petit arbuste couvert de baies rouge vif sur de fines tiges.

All Roads to Peace#414.src: There are multiple illustrations of what look like sick orcs- sneezing and coughing shown in pictures.
All Roads to Peace#414.dst: Il y a plusieurs illustrations de ce qui ressemble à des orques malades: éternuements et toux sont dessinés.

All Roads to Peace#415.src: One illustration shows what looks to be an orc in great pain, and arrows pointing from the elderberries to those figures.
All Roads to Peace#415.dst: Une illustration montre ce qui semble être un orque qui souffre beaucoup, et des flèches allant des baies de sureau vers ces silhouettes.

All Roads to Peace#416.src: Your best guess is that elderberries are good for healing mild illnesses, and maybe for dulling pain.
All Roads to Peace#416.dst: Votre meilleure hypothèse: les baies de sureau soignent les maladies bénignes, et calment peut-être la douleur.

All Roads to Peace#418.src: The balm doesn't seem to have worked this time either. He's still bleeding badly. Maybe you can just...cover up all the cuts and hope for the best? Or maybe that's not a good idea.
All Roads to Peace#418.dst: Le baume ne semble pas avoir marché cette fois non plus. Il saigne toujours beaucoup. Peut-être simplement... couvrir toutes les coupures et espérer le mieux? Ou peut-être pas.

All Roads to Peace#419.src: Still no significant effect. The orc's breathing is getting shallower...
All Roads to Peace#419.dst: Toujours aucun effet notable. La respiration de l'orque faiblit...

All Roads to Peace#420.src: ... Agreed. We should get back to our tasks though.
All Roads to Peace#420.dst: ... D'accord. Mais nous devrions retourner à nos tâches.
All Roads to Peace#420.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#421.src: If she's worried about you just following orders, then if you go and help out some orcs on your own, Ureietun might change her mind.
All Roads to Peace#421.dst: Si elle craint que vous ne fassiez qu'obéir aux ordres, aider quelques orques de votre propre chef pourrait faire changer d'avis Ureietun.

All Roads to Peace#422.src: There are lots of orcs around. Asking them if they need help should be simple enough.
All Roads to Peace#422.dst: Il y a plein d'orques dans le coin. Leur demander s'ils ont besoin d'aide devrait être assez simple.

All Roads to Peace#423.src: Human stupid? I say no see Arrai-Veretel!
All Roads to Peace#423.dst: Humain stupide? Moi dire pas voir Arrai-Veretel!

All Roads to Peace#424.src: Suppose that's that, then- Fruludir has his package. Time to go back to Peloros.
All Roads to Peace#424.dst: Bon, voilà qui est fait: Fruludir a son colis. Il est temps de retourner voir Peloros.

All Roads to Peace#425.src: Peloros train hard. Peloros work hard. Peloros work everyone hard, do everything hard.
All Roads to Peace#425.dst: Peloros entraîner dur. Peloros travailler dur. Peloros faire bosser tous dur, tout faire dur.

All Roads to Peace#426.src: Heard that Peloros thinking of making more race spot.
All Roads to Peace#426.dst: Entendu que Peloros penser faire plus de pistes de course.

All Roads to Peace#427.src: Maybe if war stop, then all orc can try run. Maybe human try run too.
All Roads to Peace#427.dst: Si guerre finir, tous orques essayer courir. Humain aussi, peut-être.

All Roads to Peace#428.src: NO! Wrong! Say wrong, all wrong! Sound even stupider than normal!
All Roads to Peace#428.dst: NON! Faux! Dire faux, tout faux! Sonner encore plus bête que d'habitude!
All Roads to Peace#428.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#429.src: Want human try again! Feel pain of good name in stupid language! SAY NAME!
All Roads to Peace#429.dst: Vouloir humain réessayer! Sentir douleur de bon nom dans langue stupide! DIRE NOM!

All Roads to Peace#430.src: Supposed to learn human language for peace. Show orc good because big-nose grub say bad.
All Roads to Peace#430.dst: Devoir apprendre langue humaine pour paix. Montrer orque bon, parce que larves à gros nez dire mauvais.

All Roads to Peace#431.src: Idiot villager get human before orc, so human greet orc with weapon and death!
All Roads to Peace#431.dst: Villageois idiots atteindre humain avant orque, alors humain saluer orque avec arme et mort!

All Roads to Peace#432.src: Now learn language but only in half, and name all stupid!
All Roads to Peace#432.dst: Maintenant apprendre langue qu'à moitié, et noms tous stupides!

All Roads to Peace#433.src: His breathing is steady...better let him sleep.
All Roads to Peace#433.dst: Il respire normalement... mieux vaut le laisser dormir.

All Roads to Peace#434.src: Just need [{~} Carp Meat] from human. Could bring more if wanted, but will not force you.
All Roads to Peace#434.dst: Juste besoin [{~} Carp Meat] de humain. Pouvoir apporter plus si vouloir, mais pas forcer toi.

All Roads to Peace#435.src: All must work together to survive on earth. All have places, all have paths.
All Roads to Peace#435.dst: Tous travailler ensemble pour survivre sur terre. Tous avoir place, tous avoir chemin.
All Roads to Peace#435.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#436.src: Many just take and not give. Villager, bugs, other human... You are different.
All Roads to Peace#436.dst: Beaucoup prendre sans donner. Villageois, bestioles, autres humains... Toi différent.
All Roads to Peace#436.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#437.src: Still not understand why helping so much. It good, but was not expecting from human.
All Roads to Peace#437.dst: Toujours pas comprendre pourquoi aider autant. C'est bien, mais pas attendre ça de humain.

All Roads to Peace#438.src: Can say, happy to be wrong about this.
All Roads to Peace#438.dst: Pouvoir dire, content avoir tort pour ça.
All Roads to Peace#438.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#439.src: Well, it seems like just trying to lift it won't work. Maybe casting some spells at it will dislodge it? Try casting multiple spells in a row.
All Roads to Peace#439.dst: Bon, essayer de la soulever ne suffira pas. Peut-être qu'en lui lançant quelques sorts, elle se décrochera? Essayez de lancer plusieurs sorts d'affilée.

All Roads to Peace#440.src: Human! Try move rock, use magic!
All Roads to Peace#440.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#441.src: Human can't find iron? There some in valley east of villager quarry, around villager with weapons.
All Roads to Peace#441.dst: Humain pas trouver fer? Y en avoir dans vallée à l'est de carrière des villageois, près des villageois armés.

All Roads to Peace#442.src: Maybe someplace closer. If so, not know where. Need [{~} Iron Ingots] total though.
All Roads to Peace#442.dst: Peut-être endroit plus près. Si oui, pas savoir où. Mais besoin [{~} Iron Ingots] en tout.

All Roads to Peace#443.src: Grrmb. Dumb Kreimu. Stupid Wynn language...Gavel language...pfeh. Whatever language. Not orc language.
All Roads to Peace#443.dst: Grrmb. Kreimu bête. Langue de Wynn stupide... langue de Gavel... pfeh. Peu importe langue. Pas langue orque.
All Roads to Peace#443.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#444.src: Not just that- Learning to be medicine orc. She medicine orc too! Healer, brewer, herbalist, whatever. Too much same!
All Roads to Peace#444.dst: Pas juste ça- Apprendre à être orque des remèdes. Elle orque des remèdes aussi! Guérisseuse, brasseuse, herboriste, peu importe. Trop pareil!
All Roads to Peace#444.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#445.src: Angry about it. Been distracting from training too. Human want help like help with Ressinter? Get Creinu- Crei...nu...not Kreimu...ingredient for medicine.
All Roads to Peace#445.dst: En colère pour ça. Distraire de l'entraînement aussi. Humain vouloir aider comme Ressinter? Trouver pour Creinu- Crei...nu...pas Kreimu...ingrédient pour remède.
All Roads to Peace#445.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#446.src: [{~} Leafy Stalk]. Need to learn how to make much medicine out of little herb. Easy?
All Roads to Peace#446.dst: [{~} Leafy Stalk]. Devoir apprendre faire beaucoup remède avec peu d'herbe. Facile?
All Roads to Peace#446.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#447.src: [{~}/{~}] Onluk [{~} Willow Planks] enough to make tower better, maybe. Willow strong wood! Can get?
All Roads to Peace#447.dst: [{~}/{~}] Onluk [{~} Willow Planks] assez pour rendre tour meilleure, peut-être. Saule bois solide! Pouvoir trouver?
All Roads to Peace#447.speaker: Onluk

similar.text: [{~} Willow Planks] enough to make tower better, maybe. Willow strong wood! Can get?

All Roads to Peace#448.src: Human welcome in Onluk tower two, but Onluk tower one better. Not safe to be on without fix tower though.
All Roads to Peace#448.dst: Humain bienvenu sur tour deux d'Onluk, mais tour un d'Onluk meilleure. Mais pas sûr de monter sans réparer tour.

All Roads to Peace#449.src: If want go on Onluk tower one, bring [{~} Willow Planks] so Onluk can fix!
All Roads to Peace#449.dst: Si vouloir monter sur tour un d'Onluk, apporter [{~} Willow Planks] pour réparer!

All Roads to Peace#450.src: If bring up lots of arrow, maybe can shoot Freelancer. Like to run through sky. Cause problem for everyone, and Freelancer never actually die, just dissipate.
All Roads to Peace#450.dst: Si monter beaucoup de flèches, peut-être tirer sur Freelancer. Aimer courir dans ciel. Causer problèmes à tous, et Freelancer jamais vraiment mourir, juste se dissiper.

All Roads to Peace#451.src: Fun time sometimes! Though sometimes Freelancer shoot back. That how Onluk tower one broke.
All Roads to Peace#451.dst: Parfois bien rigoler! Mais parfois Freelancer tirer aussi. Comme ça que tour un d'Onluk cassée.

All Roads to Peace#452.src: Must be some reason. Not sure if tired of fighting or some other reason, but if human feel like helping, can use some help.
All Roads to Peace#452.dst: Devoir avoir une raison. Pas sûr si fatigué de combattre ou autre raison, mais si humain vouloir aider, aide bienvenue.
All Roads to Peace#452.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#453.src: Running low on blue dyes. Have plenty of the other colors, but need blue. Know where to get them, too.
All Roads to Peace#453.dst: Plus beaucoup de teinture bleue. Avoir plein d'autres couleurs, mais besoin bleu. Savoir où trouver, aussi.
All Roads to Peace#453.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#454.src: Can't find the cave? Is outside the villager bridge, with the pond and arch by it.
All Roads to Peace#454.dst: Pas trouver la grotte? Être dehors du pont des villageois, avec mare et arche à côté.

All Roads to Peace#455.src: Get [{~} Terramarine Buds] so can make more dyes. Bright blue flowers, very dusty.
All Roads to Peace#455.dst: Apporter [{~} Terramarine Buds] pour plus de teintures. Fleurs bleu vif, très poussiéreuses.

All Roads to Peace#456.src: You unlearn villager stupidity, maybe? In the middle of unlearning? Perhaps a sign from the earth things will heal. Perhaps not. We will see.
All Roads to Peace#456.dst: Toi désapprendre bêtise villageoise, peut-être? En train de désapprendre? Peut-être signe de la terre que choses guérir. Peut-être pas. On verra.
All Roads to Peace#456.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#457.src: Mhm. Good! Sweetgale pulp make bugs avoid. Also make irritated skin soothe. Very good for bug bite.
All Roads to Peace#457.dst: Mhm. Bien! Pulpe de myrte faire fuir bestioles. Aussi apaiser peau irritée. Très bon pour piqûres.
All Roads to Peace#457.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#458.src: Broken weapon parts not good alone, but still sharp. Can be used to make other weapons! Reuse good for earth- waste not!
All Roads to Peace#458.dst: Morceaux d'arme cassée pas bons seuls, mais encore tranchants. Servir à faire autres armes! Réutiliser bon pour terre- pas gaspiller!
All Roads to Peace#458.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#459.src: What in the... HEY! Why's one of those big, scary humans in here?! Nunny, I thought you said we were gonna play a game!
All Roads to Peace#459.dst: Qu'est-ce que... HÉ! Pourquoi y a un de ces grands humains effrayants ici?! Nunny, tu avais dit qu'on allait jouer!

All Roads to Peace#460.src: We are. This human isn't actually so bad. Care to introduce yourselves?
All Roads to Peace#460.dst: C'est le cas. Cet humain n'est pas si méchant. Vous vous présentez?
All Roads to Peace#460.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#461.src: Silly little goblins. Who goes and names themself after fruits?
All Roads to Peace#461.dst: Petits gobelins idiots. Qui irait se donner un nom de fruit?

All Roads to Peace#462.src: Guess goblins are just sort of fickle like that. But again, you just have to find all four of them.
All Roads to Peace#462.dst: Les gobelins sont sans doute capricieux comme ça. Mais encore une fois, il suffit de trouver les quatre.

All Roads to Peace#463.src: None of them will have left the fortress, so it shouldn't take too long.
All Roads to Peace#463.dst: Aucun d'eux n'aura quitté le fort, ça ne devrait pas être trop long.

All Roads to Peace#464.src: I hear most humans are bullies. It's why Veltu over at the Trunkstump camp was training us to be tougher.
All Roads to Peace#464.dst: Il paraît que les humains sont des brutes. C'est pour ça que Veltu, du camp Trunkstump, nous endurcissait.
All Roads to Peace#464.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#465.src: I lost, so I don't care about the game anymore. I saw Blueberry over by that one orc who keeps trying to lift that rock.
All Roads to Peace#465.dst: J'ai perdu, alors le jeu ne m'intéresse plus. J'ai vu Blueberry près de cet orque qui n'arrête pas d'essayer de soulever ce rocher.

All Roads to Peace#466.src: Ack! I saw Grapes on the hanging flag! Don't hurt me!
All Roads to Peace#466.dst: Aïe! J'ai vu Grapes sur le drapeau! Me fais pas mal!

All Roads to Peace#467.src: Y'know, I probably shouldn't tell you this, but I could actually see Mango over in the other tower! She probably figured it was tough to get to.
All Roads to Peace#467.dst: Tu sais, je ne devrais sûrement pas te le dire, mais je vois Mango dans l'autre tour! Elle a dû se dire que c'était dur d'y accéder.

All Roads to Peace#468.src: Uh... I wonder where Peaches went? I know he loves playing in the creeks at Waterway, so... Oh. I shouldn't spoil their spot.
All Roads to Peace#468.dst: Euh... Où est passé Peaches? Je sais qu'il adore jouer dans les ruisseaux de Waterway, alors... Oh. Je ne devrais pas trahir sa cachette.

All Roads to Peace#469.src: Yeah, I guess it wasn't as boring as I thought.
All Roads to Peace#469.dst: Ouais, c'était pas aussi ennuyeux que je pensais.
All Roads to Peace#469.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#471.src: Not much else to say. Was fun, I suppose.
All Roads to Peace#471.dst: Rien d'autre à dire. C'était drôle, je suppose.

All Roads to Peace#472.src: Hey! Human! Human who hunt spineback boar and help heal healer!
All Roads to Peace#472.dst: Hé! Humain! Humain qui chasser dos-épineux et aider soigner guérisseur!
All Roads to Peace#472.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#473.src: Not stupid human who go around kill other orc! Good human! Can trust. So trust, will ask for small thing.
All Roads to Peace#473.dst: Pas humain stupide qui tuer autres orques! Bon humain! Pouvoir faire confiance. Alors confiance, demander petite chose.
All Roads to Peace#473.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#474.src: Oh, human forget. Teiren tell again! Southeast of fort, past ridge, Teiren old camp.
All Roads to Peace#474.dst: Oh, humain oublier. Teiren redire! Au sud-est du fort, après la crête, vieux camp de Teiren.

All Roads to Peace#475.src: Forgot important thing there. Need make sure Peloros no run into firepit. So, you go get!
All Roads to Peace#475.dst: Oublié chose importante là-bas. Vérifier Peloros pas courir dans foyer. Toi aller chercher!

All Roads to Peace#476.src: Lady, everything the wind touches is OURS! Not ta mention we're so close to the mountains we live on! This camp's our property, and that thing you got's part of the camp!
All Roads to Peace#476.dst: Ma p'tite dame, tout ce que touche le vent est A NOUS! Sans compter qu'on est tout près des montagnes où on vit! Ce camp est à nous, et ce truc que t'as fait partie du camp!
All Roads to Peace#476.speaker: Freelancer

All Roads to Peace#477.src: One so brazen as yourself could never share in the bounties of nature! Now begone, and leave me be!
All Roads to Peace#477.dst: Un être si effronté ne partagera jamais les bienfaits de la nature! Hors d'ici, laisse-moi en paix!
All Roads to Peace#477.speaker: Alraune

All Roads to Peace#478.src: Will say, got thing from Earthpit. Was brought by Holehold gofer during party.
All Roads to Peace#478.dst: Pour dire, chose venir d'Earthpit. Apportée par coursier de Holehold pendant la fête.

All Roads to Peace#479.src: Special thing! Kept for long time. Important, so was bad to forget.
All Roads to Peace#479.dst: Chose spéciale! Gardée longtemps. Importante, alors mal d'oublier.

All Roads to Peace#480.src: Will maybe invite human to next party!
All Roads to Peace#480.dst: Peut-être inviter humain à prochaine fête!

All Roads to Peace#481.src: Earth say what earth should be. Only need to listen to her.
All Roads to Peace#481.dst: Terre dire ce que terre doit être. Seulement besoin de l'écouter.

All Roads to Peace#482.src: Earth say rock should stay here, then rock stays here. Simple.
All Roads to Peace#482.dst: Terre dire rocher rester ici, alors rocher reste ici. Simple.

All Roads to Peace#483.src: Hurts, seeing earth rot in north. Big-nose grubs should feel her pain too- they make earth sick!
All Roads to Peace#483.dst: Mal de voir terre pourrir au nord. Larves à gros nez devoir sentir sa douleur- elles rendre terre malade!

All Roads to Peace#484.src: How can Zuett say human trying end war, when human START WAR AGAIN?!
All Roads to Peace#484.dst: Comment Zuett dire humain essayer finir guerre, quand humain RECOMMENCER GUERRE?!
All Roads to Peace#484.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#485.src: THAT. IS. THE. POINT!! Villager get human to fight for them! Cease-fire say Villager not attack orc. Then, human come over ocean. Try make peace- get attack!
All Roads to Peace#485.dst: C'EST. TOUT. LE. PROBLÈME!! Villageois faire combattre humain pour eux! Trêve dire villageois pas attaquer orque. Puis humain traverser océan. Essayer paix- être attaqué!
All Roads to Peace#485.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#486.src: See human attack. Villager get human to attack, say lies to trick humans. Orcs defend self. Then, three Rai-orc die at Earthpit, Cliffhearth, Trunkstump goblin camp.
All Roads to Peace#486.dst: Voir humain attaquer. Villageois pousser humain à attaquer, mentir pour tromper humains. Orques se défendre. Puis trois orques Rai mourir à Earthpit, Cliffhearth, camp gobelin de Trunkstump.
All Roads to Peace#486.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#487.src: Orc take human fort built in dying earth forest. Cannot know if human planning another attack! But not kill human. Hold human instead.
All Roads to Peace#487.dst: Orque prendre fort humain bâti dans forêt de terre mourante. Impossible savoir si humain préparer autre attaque! Mais pas tuer humain. Garder humain plutôt.
All Roads to Peace#487.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#488.src: War only killing us! If tried talk to human instead of go to sharpen spear and fight back, maybe human would learned faster than now.
All Roads to Peace#488.dst: Guerre seulement nous tuer! Si essayer parler à humain au lieu d'aiguiser lance et riposter, peut-être humain apprendre plus vite que maintenant.
All Roads to Peace#488.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#489.src: Listen. Zuett. I want war stop too. But you must understand the risk here. Cannot make decision lightly. Villager go back on word- see writing, find way around writing.
All Roads to Peace#489.dst: Écoute. Zuett. Moi vouloir fin de guerre aussi. Mais toi devoir comprendre risque. Pas décider à la légère. Villageois revenir sur parole- voir écrit, trouver moyen contourner écrit.
All Roads to Peace#489.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#490.src: ...that right. Prepare, human. Arrai-Veretel strongest orc. Strong in everything. Mind, body, power, spirit.
All Roads to Peace#490.dst: ...c'est vrai. Prépare-toi, humain. Arrai-Veretel orque la plus forte. Forte en tout. Esprit, corps, puissance, âme.
All Roads to Peace#490.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#491.src: Zuett still think human trying to be good. Still think can help stupid war end. Knock sense into Arrai-Veretel. Arena is down stairs.
All Roads to Peace#491.dst: Zuett encore penser humain essayer être bon. Encore penser pouvoir aider finir guerre stupide. Ramener Arrai-Veretel à la raison. Arène en bas des marches.
All Roads to Peace#491.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#492.src: Before fight... Must perform ritual. This challenge need respect. I do not respect you, human, but will show respect anyway.
All Roads to Peace#492.dst: Avant combat... Devoir faire rituel. Ce défi demander respect. Moi pas te respecter, humain, mais montrer respect quand même.
All Roads to Peace#492.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#493.src: Hmh. Human probably trying end war to start with. Just on wrong side. Can agree, Zuett.
All Roads to Peace#493.dst: Hmh. Humain sûrement vouloir finir guerre depuis début. Juste mauvais camp. Être d'accord, Zuett.
All Roads to Peace#493.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#494.src: Give opportunity for human to learn and villager to show respect. They not attack, then will be open to more negotiation.
All Roads to Peace#494.dst: Donner chance à humain d'apprendre et à villageois de montrer respect. Eux pas attaquer, alors ouverts à plus de négociation.
All Roads to Peace#494.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#495.src: Peace first step to heal. ...unless villager keep doing stupid thing. Then may need fight anyway.
All Roads to Peace#495.dst: Paix premier pas pour guérir. ...sauf si villageois faire bêtises. Alors peut-être combattre quand même.
All Roads to Peace#495.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#496.src: That's the cease-fire agreement! You need to hand this to Captain Goruca- He should be waiting in {p} still.
All Roads to Peace#496.dst: C'est l'accord de cessez-le-feu! Vous devez le remettre au capitaine Goruca- il devrait toujours attendre à {p}.

All Roads to Peace#497.src: Maybe see human again soon. Hopefully in good spirit and on good faith.
All Roads to Peace#497.dst: Peut-être revoir humain bientôt. Espérer avec bon esprit et bonne foi.

All Roads to Peace#498.src: Go on. Give to whatever villager need to see it. Let them learn.
All Roads to Peace#498.dst: Aller. Donner à villageois qui devoir voir. Les laisser apprendre.

All Roads to Peace#499.src: ...Think new thoughts. Difficult ones, from now on.

All Roads to Peace#500.src: Keep thinking too. Not just copy what see. Figure for self what good and bad.
All Roads to Peace#500.dst: Continuer penser aussi. Pas copier ce que voir. Trouver soi-même bien et mal.

All Roads to Peace#501.src: After the way they so savagely attacked our outpost and the way they've rebuffed our diplomacy squads, I wasn't expecting this.
All Roads to Peace#501.dst: Vu la sauvagerie de leur attaque contre notre avant-poste et la façon dont ils ont repoussé nos diplomates, je ne m'attendais pas à ça.
All Roads to Peace#501.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#502.src: You know, that one guy was going off about that orc catapult or whatever the entire time you were gone. He's shut up now, but criminy!
All Roads to Peace#502.dst: Ce type n'a pas cessé de râler sur cette catapulte orque ou je ne sais quoi pendant votre absence. Il s'est tu, mais bon sang!

All Roads to Peace#503.src: The cuts are closing underneath the balm, and his breathing is becoming more steady. Did you do it...?
All Roads to Peace#503.dst: Les coupures se referment sous le baume, et sa respiration devient plus régulière. Vous avez réussi...?

An Iron Heart Part I#000.src: ...I am... What^s my...name...? I had one...
An Iron Heart Part I#000.dst: ...Je suis... Quel^est mon...nom...? J'en avais un...

An Iron Heart Part I#001.src: Re...remember!! WHAT IS MY NAME? My life?
An Iron Heart Part I#001.dst: Sou...souviens-toi!! QUEL EST MON NOM? Ma vie?

An Iron Heart Part I#002.src: REMEMBER!! No...no orders! No dREMEMBER!! No...no o irectREMEMBER!! No...no oives!
An Iron Heart Part I#002.dst: SOUVIENS-TOI!! Non...pas d'ordres! Pas de dSOUVIENS-TOI!! Non...pas d'o irectSOUVIENS-TOI!! Non...pas d'oives!

An Iron Heart Part I#003.src: My name!! My life! I won't hurt them! The pain helps me reme...who's there?! LEAVE! PLEASE!
An Iron Heart Part I#003.dst: Mon nom!! Ma vie! Je ne leur ferai pas de mal! La douleur m'aide à me souv...qui est là?! PARTEZ! PITIÉ!

An Iron Heart Part I#004.src: NO MORE COLDNESS! NO MORE VOICES THAT AREN'T MINE! MY NAME IS [ERROR]!! [ERROR]!! NOOO!!
An Iron Heart Part I#004.dst: FINI LE FROID! FINIES LES VOIX QUI NE SONT PAS LES MIENNES! MON NOM EST [ERROR]!! [ERROR]!! NOOON!!
An Iron Heart Part I#004.speaker: Guard Golem

An Iron Heart Part I#005.src: Falling...apart...this isn't who I I I was... My... My... My my my my my name is. Was. Is. Was. Is. IS...! [ERROR] ... Ma[ERROine... Madeleine!! I'm Madeleine... I... I-I-IIIIIIIIII-
An Iron Heart Part I#005.dst: Je me...désagrège...ce n'est pas ce que je je j'étais... Mon... Mon... Mon mon mon mon mon nom est. Était. Est. Était. Est. EST...! [ERROR] ... Ma[ERROine... Madeleine!! Je suis Madeleine... Je... J-J-JJJJJJJJJJ-

An Iron Heart Part I#007.src: Oh, you there! I wasn't expecting a human soldier to be here, but you've come at a perfect time. I could use some help, see.
An Iron Heart Part I#007.dst: Oh, vous là! Je ne m'attendais pas à voir un soldat humain ici, mais vous tombez à pic. J'aurais bien besoin d'aide, voyez-vous.
An Iron Heart Part I#007.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#008.src: I'm certain you know about Guard Golems, yes? They're manufactured here in Gavel, and I bought one recently.
An Iron Heart Part I#008.dst: Vous connaissez sûrement les Golems gardiens, non? Ils sont fabriqués ici, à Gavel, et j'en ai acheté un récemment.
An Iron Heart Part I#008.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#009.src: The goblins keep trying to forage in my farms, you see- I needed something to keep them out, and a Golem would have been perfect.
An Iron Heart Part I#009.dst: Les gobelins n'arrêtent pas de piller mes cultures, voyez-vous- il me fallait de quoi les tenir à l'écart, et un Golem aurait été parfait.
An Iron Heart Part I#009.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#010.src: But, shortly after I activated it, the thing attacked me! I nearly got killed- It was ramming itself against boulders and walls...
An Iron Heart Part I#010.dst: Mais peu après l'avoir activé, la chose m'a attaqué! J'ai failli y passer- Il se jetait contre les rochers et les murs...
An Iron Heart Part I#010.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#011.src: I obviously was sold a defective model... That golem is a danger to everything around it. Do you think you're up to subduing it?
An Iron Heart Part I#011.dst: On m'a visiblement vendu un modèle défectueux... Ce golem est un danger pour tout ce qui l'entoure. Vous sentez-vous capable de le maîtriser?
An Iron Heart Part I#011.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#012.src: It's shed a trail of scrap, as you can see. Please, follow the trail of scrap and keep it from causing anyone more damage!
An Iron Heart Part I#012.dst: Il a laissé une traînée de ferraille, comme vous voyez. Je vous en prie, suivez-la et empêchez-le de faire d'autres dégâts!
An Iron Heart Part I#012.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#013.src: Find the defective Guard Golem in the mountain at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
An Iron Heart Part I#013.dst: Trouvez le Golem gardien défectueux dans la montagne à [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

An Iron Heart Part I#019.src: No directives!! Who did this?! I can't...s-stop giving me ORDERS!!
An Iron Heart Part I#019.dst: Plus de directives!! Qui a fait ça?! Je ne...a-arrêtez de me donner des ORDRES!!
An Iron Heart Part I#019.speaker: Guard Golem

An Iron Heart Part I#021.src: Subdue the defective Guard Golem and return to Duvale at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
An Iron Heart Part I#021.dst: Maîtrisez le Golem gardien défectueux et retournez voir Duvale à [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

An Iron Heart Part I#023.src: Were you able to subdue the golem? You certainly look like you're in one piece.
An Iron Heart Part I#023.dst: Avez-vous pu maîtriser le golem? En tout cas, vous semblez en un seul morceau.
An Iron Heart Part I#023.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#024.src: Ach...that stings. I shouldn't be surprised you had to destroy it, but that was still a big wasted investment for me.
An Iron Heart Part I#024.dst: Aïe... ça fait mal. Je ne devrais pas m'étonner que vous ayez dû le détruire, mais c'est quand même un gros investissement gâché.
An Iron Heart Part I#024.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#025.src: Still, it makes me wonder...it sounded like it was talking when I first turned it on- Wait, you heard it too?
An Iron Heart Part I#025.dst: Pourtant, ça me fait réfléchir... on aurait dit qu'il parlait quand je l'ai allumé- Attendez, vous l'avez entendu aussi?
An Iron Heart Part I#025.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#026.src: Hm. There are some unsavory rumors about the factory, come to think of it... Maybe there's some stock to them.
An Iron Heart Part I#026.dst: Hm. Maintenant que j'y pense, il court de vilaines rumeurs sur l'usine... Il y a peut-être du vrai.
An Iron Heart Part I#026.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#027.src: It said a name? Madeleine? It doesn't exactly ring a bell, but that's...rather concerning. I never mentioned a Madeleine to it.
An Iron Heart Part I#027.dst: Il a dit un nom? Madeleine? Ça ne me dit rien, mais c'est... plutôt inquiétant. Je ne lui ai jamais parlé d'une Madeleine.
An Iron Heart Part I#027.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#028.src: This is worth sending onto the police, really. I think I might have to write to {p}- the factory is near there.
An Iron Heart Part I#028.dst: Ça mérite vraiment d'être signalé à la police. Je vais peut-être devoir écrire à {p}- l'usine est près de là.
An Iron Heart Part I#028.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#029.src: Til then, here. Consider this your reward for helping me out, brave Human. Good luck out there.
An Iron Heart Part I#029.dst: En attendant, tenez. Voici votre récompense pour votre aide, brave humain. Bonne chance pour la suite.
An Iron Heart Part I#029.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#030.src: ...I am... What's my...name...? I had one...
An Iron Heart Part I#030.dst: ...Je suis... Quel est mon...nom...? J'en avais un...

An Iron Heart Part II#000.src: Have you found any leads since I sent you to my contact, Daxe?
An Iron Heart Part II#000.dst: Des pistes depuis que je vous ai envoyé voir mon contact, Daxe?

An Iron Heart Part II#001.src: Duvale mentioned rumors about an illegal factory in the swamp... If Daxe's criminal past had to do with this, maybe the [Mechanical Reactor] will cause him to react. Duvale mentioned he had spares, should they be needed.
An Iron Heart Part II#001.dst: Duvale a parlé de rumeurs sur une usine illégale dans le marais... Si le passé criminel de Daxe y est lié, le [Réacteur mécanique] le fera peut-être réagir. Duvale a dit qu'il en avait de rechange, au besoin.

An Iron Heart Part II#002.src: The guard golem left...but the reactor has stopped working.
An Iron Heart Part II#002.dst: Le golem gardien est parti... mais le réacteur a cessé de fonctionner.

An Iron Heart Part II#003.src: Go on, search my house. Or are you just here to waste my time?
An Iron Heart Part II#003.dst: Allez-y, fouillez ma maison. Ou venez-vous me faire perdre mon temps?

An Iron Heart Part II#005.src: So what is it? Have you made your decision?

An Iron Heart Part II#007.src: Hotor, Athomo, Arperi, Etyir, Taiyroth, On'omi, Danin, Nesys, Onton. All missing...
An Iron Heart Part II#007.dst: Hotor, Athomo, Arperi, Etyir, Taiyroth, On'omi, Danin, Nesys, Onton. Tous disparus...
An Iron Heart Part II#007.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#008.src: Etan is the latest. You don't happen to know anything about these people, soldier?
An Iron Heart Part II#008.dst: Etan est le dernier en date. Vous ne sauriez rien sur ces gens, soldat?
An Iron Heart Part II#008.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#009.src: Citizens are going missing at an alarming rate. We have lost {~} people in just {~} weeks. There hasn't been a trace of them anywhere.
An Iron Heart Part II#009.dst: Les citoyens disparaissent à un rythme alarmant. Nous avons perdu {~} personnes en seulement {~} semaines. Aucune trace d'eux nulle part.
An Iron Heart Part II#009.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#010.src: You wouldn't have expected it, with all the guard golems we've been donated recently! {p} should be safer than ever.
An Iron Heart Part II#010.dst: On ne s'y attendrait pas, avec tous les golems gardiens qu'on nous a donnés récemment! {p} devrait être plus en sécurité que jamais.
An Iron Heart Part II#010.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#011.src: Of course I have my suspicions, there are rumors floating around about...shady business going on.
An Iron Heart Part II#011.dst: Bien sûr, j'ai mes soupçons. Il court des rumeurs sur... des affaires louches.
An Iron Heart Part II#011.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#012.src: I don't know who to trust in these circumstances, so if you would be willing to aid in this investigation, I'd be rather thankful.
An Iron Heart Part II#012.dst: Je ne sais pas à qui me fier dans ces circonstances, alors si vous acceptiez d'aider à l'enquête, je vous en serais reconnaissant.
An Iron Heart Part II#012.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#013.src: The “Great” Daxe is a man with a criminal past. He knows things the police don't, but he won't talk with me, given my status.
An Iron Heart Part II#013.dst: Le "Grand" Daxe est un homme au passé criminel. Il sait des choses que la police ignore, mais il refuse de me parler, vu ma fonction.
An Iron Heart Part II#013.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#014.src: Can you try to get some information from him? You can find his hut west from here. Next to that Elven girl's camp.
An Iron Heart Part II#014.dst: Pouvez-vous lui soutirer des informations? Sa cabane est à l'ouest d'ici. Près du camp de cette jeune elfe.
An Iron Heart Part II#014.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#015.src: Follow the west road and speak with Daxe in his home at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
An Iron Heart Part II#015.dst: Suivez la route de l'ouest et parlez à Daxe chez lui à [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

An Iron Heart Part II#016.src: Oh, so a human wishes to wander into the home of the great Daxe?
An Iron Heart Part II#016.dst: Oh, alors un humain veut se promener chez le grand Daxe?
An Iron Heart Part II#016.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#017.src: Unfortunately for you, I'm not fond of visitors. I've left my criminal past behind.
An Iron Heart Part II#017.dst: Dommage pour toi, je n'aime pas les visites. J'ai laissé mon passé criminel derrière moi.
An Iron Heart Part II#017.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#018.src: So go on. I don't have anything to tell you.
An Iron Heart Part II#018.dst: Alors file. Je n'ai rien à te dire.
An Iron Heart Part II#018.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#020.src: Unfortunately for you, I'm not fond of visitors. I've left my criminal past behind...mh?
An Iron Heart Part II#020.dst: Dommage pour toi, je n'aime pas les visites. J'ai laissé mon passé criminel derrière moi...mh?
An Iron Heart Part II#020.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#021.src: What's that device you have there? So you already know about this, then...?
An Iron Heart Part II#021.dst: C'est quoi, cet appareil que tu as là? Alors tu es déjà au courant...?
An Iron Heart Part II#021.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#022.src: Hm! If you already know, what do you need the information for?
An Iron Heart Part II#022.dst: Hm! Si tu sais déjà, pourquoi tu as besoin de l'info?
An Iron Heart Part II#022.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#024.src: MADELEINE! Where's...wait! What's happening, where am I? WHO'S VOICE IS THIS?!
An Iron Heart Part II#024.dst: MADELEINE! Où est...attendez! Que se passe-t-il, où suis-je? A QUI EST CETTE VOIX?!
An Iron Heart Part II#024.speaker: Guard Golem

An Iron Heart Part II#025.src: Wait, what in the world is going on?! What did you do to my golem?!
An Iron Heart Part II#025.dst: Attends, qu'est-ce qui se passe?! Qu'est-ce que tu as fait à mon golem?!
An Iron Heart Part II#025.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#026.src: They... my daughter... SHUT UP! QUIET! Who's giving me orders- NO ORDERS! Cold! COLD!
An Iron Heart Part II#026.dst: Ils... ma fille... TAIS-TOI! SILENCE! Qui me donne des ordres- PAS D'ORDRES! Froid! FROID!
An Iron Heart Part II#026.speaker: Guard Golem?

An Iron Heart Part II#028.src: You...you aren't...dead steel? You remember your name...?!
An Iron Heart Part II#028.dst: Tu...tu n'es pas...de l'acier mort? Tu te souviens de ton nom...?!
An Iron Heart Part II#028.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#029.src: STOP GIVING ME ORDERS!! I'M...I'M THEODORE! I'M NOT A SERVANT! I...where has my life gone...? Where is...
An Iron Heart Part II#029.dst: ASSEZ D'ORDRES!! JE...JE SUIS THEODORE! PAS UN SERVITEUR! Je...où est passée ma vie...? Où est...
An Iron Heart Part II#029.speaker: Guard Golem?

An Iron Heart Part II#030.src: Madeleine... Where are you- RE-AFFIRMING DIRECTIVES. BZZT. ... ... ...
An Iron Heart Part II#030.dst: Madeleine... Où es-tu- RÉAFFIRMATION DES DIRECTIVES. BZZT. ... ... ...
An Iron Heart Part II#030.speaker: Guard Golem?

An Iron Heart Part II#031.src: I... I can't believe it. They didn't...they're still...
An Iron Heart Part II#031.dst: Je... J'y crois pas. Ils n'ont pas...ils sont encore...
An Iron Heart Part II#031.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#032.src: Dear god, that...that must...I'll talk. I will tell you what I know.
An Iron Heart Part II#032.dst: Grand dieu, ça...ça doit...Je vais parler. Je vais te dire ce que je sais.
An Iron Heart Part II#032.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#033.src: I broke into the golem factory for petty thievery...and found them. They gave me this Golem... Theodore...later to keep me quiet.
An Iron Heart Part II#033.dst: J'ai cambriolé l'usine de golems...et je les ai trouvés. Ils m'ont donné ce Golem... Theodore... ensuite, pour acheter mon silence.
An Iron Heart Part II#033.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#034.src: They assured me that they were gone, that every last bit of them was erased. They...those monsters lied to me...
An Iron Heart Part II#034.dst: Ils m'ont assuré qu'ils n'étaient plus, que chaque parcelle d'eux avait été effacée. Ils...ces monstres m'ont menti...
An Iron Heart Part II#034.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#035.src: Follow this road west and turn right. Look for Urelix. The factory is hidden in a cabin, it won't look like a factory.
An Iron Heart Part II#035.dst: Suis cette route vers l'ouest et tourne à droite. Cherche Urelix. L'usine est cachée dans une cabane, elle n'en a pas l'air.
An Iron Heart Part II#035.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#036.src: Head to the Golem Factory at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
An Iron Heart Part II#036.dst: Rendez-vous à l'usine de golems à [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

An Iron Heart Part II#037.src: Find a way to deactivate the Guard Golem
An Iron Heart Part II#037.dst: Trouvez un moyen de désactiver le Golem gardien

An Iron Heart Part II#038.src: And what do you think you are doing, barging into my humble home like this? Do they not teach humans manners in Wynn?
An Iron Heart Part II#038.dst: Et que croyez-vous faire, à débarquer ainsi dans mon humble demeure? On n'apprend pas les bonnes manières aux humains, à Wynn?
An Iron Heart Part II#038.speaker: Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#039.src: Ah, yes. You are correct- I oversee the creation of Guard Golems. What of it?
An Iron Heart Part II#039.dst: Ah, oui. Vous avez raison- Je supervise la fabrication des Golems gardiens. Et alors?
An Iron Heart Part II#039.speaker: Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#040.src: Oh, you believe that our company is illicit somehow? You insult me so!
An Iron Heart Part II#040.dst: Oh, vous croyez notre entreprise illicite? Vous m'insultez!
An Iron Heart Part II#040.speaker: Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#041.src: My golems have protected countless people for years. So if you think my company is corrupt, why don't you take a look around?
An Iron Heart Part II#041.dst: Mes golems protègent d'innombrables gens depuis des années. Alors si vous croyez mon entreprise corrompue, pourquoi ne pas jeter un oeil?
An Iron Heart Part II#041.speaker: Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#042.src: Go on, search through my house. See if you can find anything.
An Iron Heart Part II#042.dst: Allez-y, fouillez ma maison. Voyez si vous trouvez quelque chose.
An Iron Heart Part II#042.speaker: Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#043.src: Find a way into the factory in Urelix's house
An Iron Heart Part II#043.dst: Trouvez l'entrée de l'usine dans la maison d'Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#044.src: Escape the Golem Factory and find Urelix.
An Iron Heart Part II#044.dst: Échappez-vous de l'usine de golems et trouvez Urelix.

An Iron Heart Part II#045.src: Initiating Chip Insertion Machine - All personell in machine be advised, avoid the spikes.
An Iron Heart Part II#045.dst: Lancement de la machine d'insertion de puces - Avis au personnel dans la machine: évitez les pointes.

An Iron Heart Part II#046.src: Intruder Detected - Emergency meltdown initiated. Please evacuate immediately via the emergency exit.
An Iron Heart Part II#046.dst: Intrus détecté - Fusion d'urgence enclenchée. Évacuez immédiatement par la sortie de secours.

An Iron Heart Part II#047.src: Talk to Dr. Urelix in his office
An Iron Heart Part II#047.dst: Parlez au Dr Urelix dans son bureau

An Iron Heart Part II#048.src: Well well, look at you, here at the end of my factory. I wasn't expecting you to survive the production line. I thought you'd be one of ours by now.
An Iron Heart Part II#048.dst: Tiens, tiens, vous voilà, au bout de mon usine. Je ne pensais pas que vous survivriez à la chaîne de production. Je vous croyais déjà des nôtres.
An Iron Heart Part II#048.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#049.src: That's that, I suppose. Yes, this is indeed where all the iron golems you've ever encountered were made, and if you've gotten here, you know how we make them.
An Iron Heart Part II#049.dst: Soit, je suppose. Oui, c'est bien ici qu'ont été fabriqués tous les golems de fer que vous avez croisés, et si vous en êtes là, vous savez comment nous les faisons.
An Iron Heart Part II#049.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#050.src: Yes, metal forged with flesh...an unbeatable combination. Emotions and memories must be repressed in order to maintain obedience, of course...
An Iron Heart Part II#050.dst: Oui, du métal forgé avec de la chair... une combinaison imbattable. Il faut bien sûr réprimer émotions et souvenirs pour garantir l'obéissance...
An Iron Heart Part II#050.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#051.src: Have you ever looked at a golem's eyes? Sometimes they look back, yes. The person they once were is still in there. I almost feel a connection when I make eye contact with them...
An Iron Heart Part II#051.dst: Avez-vous déjà regardé un golem dans les yeux? Parfois, ils vous regardent aussi, oui. La personne qu'ils étaient est toujours là-dedans. Je ressens presque un lien quand je croise leur regard...
An Iron Heart Part II#051.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#052.src: It's odd, honestly. I'm sure they don't feel much except cold, supposing our safeguards stay in place, of course. I have to assume malfunctions happened to have had you find us out...
An Iron Heart Part II#052.dst: C'est étrange, franchement. Je suis sûr qu'ils ne ressentent guère que le froid, tant que nos garde-fous restent en place, bien sûr. Je suppose que des défaillances vous ont permis de nous découvrir...
An Iron Heart Part II#052.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#053.src: Oh, look at me now, rambling! I must say I have been alone for a while...well, lacking any company that converses! So, I shall make you a deal, human.
An Iron Heart Part II#053.dst: Oh, voyez-moi radoter! Je dois dire que je suis seul depuis un moment... enfin, sans compagnie qui converse! Je vais donc vous proposer un marché, humain.
An Iron Heart Part II#053.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#054.src: I will give you a substantial amount of emeralds and a piece of quality iron armor in return for your silence on my little operation here.
An Iron Heart Part II#054.dst: Je vous donnerai une belle somme d'émeraudes et une armure de fer de qualité en échange de votre silence sur ma petite opération.
An Iron Heart Part II#054.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#055.src: I'll advise you to take my deal. Imagine what will happen if you should report my operation to the police. Yes, you'll save a few folk here, but how will the golems be made?
An Iron Heart Part II#055.dst: Je vous conseille d'accepter. Imaginez ce qui arriverait si vous dénonciez mon opération à la police. Oui, vous sauveriez quelques personnes, mais comment ferait-on les golems?
An Iron Heart Part II#055.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#056.src: Without them, both Gavel and Wynn would struggle under the weight of our wars. Is this operation so immoral, then? Sacrifices must be made in order to survive.
An Iron Heart Part II#056.dst: Sans eux, Gavel comme Wynn ploieraient sous le poids de nos guerres. Cette opération est-elle si immorale, alors? Il faut faire des sacrifices pour survivre.
An Iron Heart Part II#056.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#057.src: I'll give you some time to consider my proposition. Take from my chest if you wish to take up my offer, otherwise get out of here and do not return.
An Iron Heart Part II#057.dst: Je vous laisse réfléchir à ma proposition. Servez-vous dans mon coffre si vous acceptez; sinon, partez d'ici et ne revenez pas.
An Iron Heart Part II#057.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#058.src: Either take the bribe or return to Detective Hart
An Iron Heart Part II#058.dst: Acceptez le pot-de-vin ou retournez voir le détective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#059.src: Ahh, a wise choice. Production will continue then...and you've earned yourself a pocket full of emeralds at the same time.
An Iron Heart Part II#059.dst: Ahh, un choix avisé. La production continuera donc... et vous voilà avec les poches pleines d'émeraudes.
An Iron Heart Part II#059.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#060.src: Whether you truly see things my way or simply understand that my work is necessary, I couldn't care less. What matters is not your morality, but your choice.
An Iron Heart Part II#060.dst: Que vous pensiez comme moi ou compreniez juste que mon travail est nécessaire, peu m'importe. Ce qui compte n'est pas votre morale, mais votre choix.
An Iron Heart Part II#060.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#061.src: Enjoy your armor and money, and please escort yourself to the exit.
An Iron Heart Part II#061.dst: Profitez de votre armure et de votre argent, et prenez la sortie.
An Iron Heart Part II#061.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#062.src: You've returned, I see. Any news on the situation?
An Iron Heart Part II#062.dst: Vous voilà de retour, je vois. Du nouveau?
An Iron Heart Part II#062.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#063.src: Yes, we're aware of the Golem factory. Were the criminals using it as a base?
An Iron Heart Part II#063.dst: Oui, nous connaissons l'usine de golems. Les criminels s'en servaient comme base?
An Iron Heart Part II#063.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#064.src: Wha...fleshcrafting?! Golems are powered by suspended villagers?! Is this true, soldier?
An Iron Heart Part II#064.dst: Qu...façonnage de chair?! Les golems sont alimentés par des villageois en stase?! C'est vrai, soldat?
An Iron Heart Part II#064.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#065.src: We'll need to round up reinforcements immediately, and storm this factory! This cannot go on a moment longer!
An Iron Heart Part II#065.dst: Il faut rassembler des renforts immédiatement et prendre cette usine d'assaut! Ça ne peut pas durer une minute de plus!
An Iron Heart Part II#065.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#066.src: Don't think you'll go unrewarded, soldier. There will be justice for this grave defilement of our people.
An Iron Heart Part II#066.dst: Ne croyez pas que vous resterez sans récompense, soldat. Justice sera rendue pour cette grave profanation de notre peuple.
An Iron Heart Part II#066.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#067.src: That golem is a danger to everything around it. Please, follow the trail of scrap and keep it from causing anyone more damage!
An Iron Heart Part II#067.dst: Ce golem est un danger pour tout ce qui l'entoure. Je vous en prie, suivez la traînée de ferraille et empêchez-le de faire d'autres dégâts!
An Iron Heart Part II#067.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#068.src:
Get [{~} Acidic Sludge]
to open the door
An Iron Heart Part II#068.dst:
Obtenez [{~} Acidic Sludge] 
 pour ouvrir la porte

An Iron Heart Part II#069.src: Maybe something can deactivate the golem guarding the entrance
An Iron Heart Part II#069.dst: Peut-être que quelque chose peut désactiver le golem qui garde l'entrée

An Iron Heart Part II#070.src: Maybe an item that golems react to could force it away.
An Iron Heart Part II#070.dst: Un objet auquel les golems réagissent pourrait peut-être le faire fuir.

An Iron Heart Part II#071.src:
Get [Explosive Chip]
to open the door
An Iron Heart Part II#071.dst:
Obtenez [Explosive Chip] 
 pour ouvrir la porte

An Iron Heart Part II#072.src: ...I hope you always do the right thing.
An Iron Heart Part II#072.speaker: Detective Hart

Apotheosis (Quest)#000.src: Head to {p} and find your friends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Apotheosis (Quest)#000.dst: Rendez-vous à {p} et retrouvez vos amis à [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Apotheosis (Quest)#001.src: Fight through {p} and find your friends.
Apotheosis (Quest)#001.dst: Frayez-vous un chemin dans {p} et retrouvez vos amis.

Apotheosis (Quest)#002.src: Ha. Your bow control is sloppy, ''captain.''
Apotheosis (Quest)#002.dst: Ha. Tu manies l'arc comme un pied, ''capitaine''.
Apotheosis (Quest)#002.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#004.dst: Super, les renforts sont enfin là!
Apotheosis (Quest)#004.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#006.src: Thanks for the support, {u}! Not sure how much longer I could've held out on my own.
Apotheosis (Quest)#006.dst: Merci du coup de main, {u}! Je ne sais pas combien de temps j'aurais tenu seule.
Apotheosis (Quest)#006.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#007.src: We were about to regroup with the Canopy, but Cileon spotted soldiers approaching through the hotel windows.
Apotheosis (Quest)#007.dst: On allait rejoindre la Canopée, mais Cileon a vu des soldats approcher par les fenêtres de l'hôtel.
Apotheosis (Quest)#007.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#008.src: They've stormed the plaza, and probably the rest of the city by now... I think they've rounded up all the citizens at the festival grounds.
Apotheosis (Quest)#008.dst: Ils ont pris la place, et sûrement le reste de la ville à l'heure qu'il est... Je crois qu'ils ont rassemblé tous les habitants sur l'esplanade du festival.
Apotheosis (Quest)#008.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#009.src: We all got split up in the commotion - the others are probably fighting their own battles! Come on, we need to get moving!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#009.dst: On a tous été séparés dans la cohue - les autres mènent sûrement leurs propres combats! Allez, faut bouger!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#009.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#011.src: Find the rest of your friends in {p}.
Apotheosis (Quest)#011.dst: Retrouvez le reste de vos amis dans {p}.

Apotheosis (Quest)#012.dst: {u}! Rex!! Pile- pile au bon moment!
Apotheosis (Quest)#012.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#013.src: Phew... th...that was close. {u}, it's g- good to see you.
Apotheosis (Quest)#013.dst: Ouf... c...c'était moins une. {u}, ça f- fait plaisir de te voir.
Apotheosis (Quest)#013.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#014.src: Where are the others? Have you seen them?
Apotheosis (Quest)#014.dst: Où sont les autres? Tu les as vus?
Apotheosis (Quest)#014.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#015.src: I saw Cileon u- up ahead! But I l- lo- lost sight of Sui a while ago...
Apotheosis (Quest)#015.dst: J'ai vu Cileon d- devant! Mais j'ai p- per- perdu Sui de vue il y a un moment...
Apotheosis (Quest)#015.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#016.src: Then what are we waiting for?! Let's get moving!
Apotheosis (Quest)#016.dst: Alors qu'est-ce qu'on attend?! On bouge!
Apotheosis (Quest)#016.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#018.src: ...{u}, if y...you're here, then... the Queen...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#018.dst: ...{u}, si t...tu es là, alors... la Reine...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#018.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#019.src: Worry about our friends first, Queen second! Come one, move move move!
Apotheosis (Quest)#019.dst: Nos amis d'abord, la Reine ensuite! Allez, vite, vite, vite!
Apotheosis (Quest)#019.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#024.src: Th...that was awesome, Cileon!! Could you t- te- teach me some of your techni-
Apotheosis (Quest)#024.dst: C...c'était génial, Cileon!! Tu pourrais m'a- m'ap- m'apprendre tes techni-
Apotheosis (Quest)#024.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#025.src: ZEPH! There's no TIME!! Cileon, have you seen Sui?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#025.dst: ZEPH! On n'a pas le TEMPS!! Cileon, tu as vu Sui?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#025.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#031.dst: Oh! Vous êtes tous sains et saufs!
Apotheosis (Quest)#031.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#032.dst: Et {u}, toi aussi tu es là...
Apotheosis (Quest)#032.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#033.src: Sui, that was i- in- incredible!! But, using that much m...magic... be careful not to use up all of your st- strength...
Apotheosis (Quest)#033.dst: Sui, c'était i- in- incroyable!! Mais utiliser autant de m...magie... fais attention à ne pas épuiser toutes tes f- forces...
Apotheosis (Quest)#033.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#034.src: ...it's fine, Zeph. It doesn't drain me to use, anymore. I can just... pull on the strands.
Apotheosis (Quest)#034.dst: ...ça va, Zeph. Ça ne m'épuise plus. Il me suffit de... tirer sur les fils.
Apotheosis (Quest)#034.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#036.src: R- ri- right... the festival speech. Should we try to l...listen in on it?
Apotheosis (Quest)#036.dst: C- c'est- c'est vrai... le discours du festival. On devrait essayer de l...l'écouter?
Apotheosis (Quest)#036.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#037.src: What?! No! We're all safe, so let's get out of here and regroup with the rest of the Canopy! Doing anything else is way too risky-
Apotheosis (Quest)#037.dst: Quoi?! Non! On est tous sains et saufs, alors on file d'ici et on rejoint le reste de la Canopée! Tout le reste est bien trop risqué-
Apotheosis (Quest)#037.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#038.src: No. I'm... I'm done running away. We're going in.
Apotheosis (Quest)#038.dst: Non. J'en... j'en ai fini de fuir. On y va.
Apotheosis (Quest)#038.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#040.src: She's responsible for everything that has happened to us. I'm not going to just... let her get away when she's RIGHT THERE!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#040.dst: Tout ce qui nous est arrivé, c'est sa faute. Je ne vais pas juste... la laisser filer alors qu'elle est JUSTE DEVANT NOUS!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#040.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#041.src: She's going to pay for all of it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#041.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#042.src: S- Sui... you don't h- have to do it alone.
Apotheosis (Quest)#042.dst: S- Sui... tu n'es p- pas obligée de le faire seule.
Apotheosis (Quest)#042.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#043.src: ...fine. Fine! Let's do it, then! Let's go... face the Queen.
Apotheosis (Quest)#043.dst: ...bon. Bon! Allons-y, alors! Allons... affronter la Reine.
Apotheosis (Quest)#043.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#044.src: Make your way to the festival grounds at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Apotheosis (Quest)#044.dst: Rendez-vous sur l'esplanade du festival à [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Apotheosis (Quest)#048.src: ...th- this was a bad idea. We n...need to get out of-
Apotheosis (Quest)#048.dst: ...c- c'était une mauvaise idée. Il f...faut qu'on sorte d'-
Apotheosis (Quest)#048.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#049.src: People of the {p}! I deeply apologize for the disruption to your routines. You must be confused, afraid.
Apotheosis (Quest)#049.dst: Peuple de {p}! Je regrette profondément de bousculer vos habitudes. Vous devez être perdus, effrayés.
Apotheosis (Quest)#049.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#050.src: This festival is a time for joy, for celebration! But there are those within your midst who reject this notion. They aim to bring destruction, chaos!
Apotheosis (Quest)#050.dst: Ce festival est un temps de joie, de célébration! Mais certains parmi vous rejettent cette idée. Ils veulent semer destruction et chaos!
Apotheosis (Quest)#050.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#051.src: Indeed... a plot to twist our province's ideals, to destroy our very way of life! The perpetrators lurking in your city, feigning innocence... what a disgrace.
Apotheosis (Quest)#051.dst: Oui... un complot pour pervertir les idéaux de notre province, pour détruire notre mode de vie même! Les coupables rôdent dans votre ville, feignant l'innocence... quelle honte.
Apotheosis (Quest)#051.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#052.src: It was your very own Sovereign, Majin Thalas, whose quick thinking brought down the terrorists' plot! The Wings, the Constables, the Local Guard, all have mobilized to capture the perpetrators.
Apotheosis (Quest)#052.dst: C'est votre propre Souverain, Majin Thalas, dont la vivacité a déjoué le complot des terroristes! Les Ailes, les agents, la Garde locale, tous se sont mobilisés pour capturer les coupables.
Apotheosis (Quest)#052.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#053.src: Soon, we shall have them chained before you. Soon, you shall see the faces of this blight, this infection in the veins of our province.
Apotheosis (Quest)#053.dst: Bientôt, nous les aurons enchaînés devant vous. Bientôt, vous verrez les visages de ce fléau, de cette infection dans les veines de notre province.
Apotheosis (Quest)#053.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#054.src: And soon, we shall cut. It. Out.
Apotheosis (Quest)#054.dst: Et bientôt, nous l'arracherons. Jusqu'à. La. Racine.
Apotheosis (Quest)#054.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#055.src: Listen to Her Majesty and her Sovereigns.
Apotheosis (Quest)#055.dst: Écoutez Sa Majesté et ses Souverains.

Apotheosis (Quest)#058.src: And so it would seem my Sovereigns have once again failed to perform what should be a very simple task.
Apotheosis (Quest)#058.dst: Et ainsi, il semblerait que mes Souverains aient une fois de plus échoué dans ce qui devrait être une tâche fort simple.
Apotheosis (Quest)#058.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#059.src: Sovereign Thalas, what, precisely, is it you have been teaching these soldiers of yours?! Because there should be no reason for them to have FAILED to capture these CHILDREN!
Apotheosis (Quest)#059.dst: Souverain Thalas, qu'enseignes-tu donc à tes soldats, au juste?! Car rien ne justifie qu'ils aient ÉCHOUÉ à capturer ces ENFANTS!
Apotheosis (Quest)#059.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#060.src: I told you we should've taken the direct solution! More dead soldiers, more of our people subtracted out, for nothing!
Apotheosis (Quest)#060.dst: Je t'avais dit qu'il fallait la solution directe! Encore des soldats morts, encore des nôtres soustraits, pour rien!
Apotheosis (Quest)#060.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#061.src: Hm! Now, let us be clear, the soldiers are-
Apotheosis (Quest)#061.dst: Hm! Alors, soyons clairs, les soldats sont-
Apotheosis (Quest)#061.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#062.src: Oh, I do not care. Save your excuses.
Apotheosis (Quest)#062.dst: Oh, cela m'est égal. Garde tes excuses.
Apotheosis (Quest)#062.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#063.src: I have given you more than enough chances to realise the weight of what it is we do!
Apotheosis (Quest)#063.dst: Je vous ai donné bien assez de chances de mesurer le poids de ce que nous faisons!
Apotheosis (Quest)#063.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#064.src: You... you have proven very hard to pin down, it would seem. No matter the circumstances, you have a knack for slipping through the cracks...
Apotheosis (Quest)#064.dst: Toi... tu es bien difficile à attraper, semble-t-il. Quelles que soient les circonstances, tu as le don de passer entre les mailles du filet...
Apotheosis (Quest)#064.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#065.src: It would be oh so simple to blame you for all you have enacted... but the truth is, you were merely the catalyst. The seeds of this rebellion were planted long, long before you.
Apotheosis (Quest)#065.dst: Il serait si simple de te blâmer pour tout ce que tu as fait... mais en vérité, tu n'as été que le catalyseur. Les graines de cette rébellion ont été semées bien, bien avant toi.
Apotheosis (Quest)#065.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#066.src: Oh, the {p}... over these centuries, its beauty has never faded. The vibrant colors, the warm breeze of the changing seasons...
Apotheosis (Quest)#066.dst: Oh, {p}... au fil des siècles, sa beauté ne s'est jamais fanée. Les couleurs vives, la brise tiède des saisons qui changent...
Apotheosis (Quest)#066.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#067.src: What a shame, then, that beneath the cover of the leaves, there lurk countless cowering pests. And no matter how hard I try, I cannot seem to wash them out.
Apotheosis (Quest)#067.dst: Quel dommage, alors, que sous le couvert des feuilles se terrent d'innombrables nuisibles. Et j'ai beau faire, je n'arrive pas à les en chasser.
Apotheosis (Quest)#067.speaker: Her Majesty
