Dearly Departed#008.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#009.src: Well, you see the situation I'm in? Help a poor fellow out, just go and grab that [Muddy Shovel] over there, and then come back to me.
Dearly Departed#009.dst: Bref, vous voyez dans quelle situation je suis? Aidez un pauvre homme: allez prendre cette [Muddy Shovel] là-bas, puis revenez me voir.
Dearly Departed#009.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#011.src: The [Muddy Shovel] is just over there. I'd really appreciate the help, recruit.
Dearly Departed#011.dst: La [Muddy Shovel] est juste là-bas. Votre aide serait très appréciée, recrue.
Dearly Departed#011.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#012.dst: Retournez voir le fermier Cevalus en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Dearly Departed#013.src: You've got the shovel? Great! You've got some sturdy armour and a weapon too, I presume?
Dearly Departed#013.dst: Vous avez la pelle? Parfait! Vous avez aussi une armure solide et une arme, je présume?
Dearly Departed#013.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#014.src: Good, good. Better safe than sorry... As I always say! Always, ha ha...
Dearly Departed#014.dst: Bien, bien. Prudence est mère de sûreté... Je le dis toujours! Toujours, ha ha...
Dearly Departed#014.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#015.src: Oh, no reason really! Just making sure, ha ha... Should be perfectly safe back there, perfectly safe.
Dearly Departed#015.dst: Oh, pour rien, vraiment! Je vérifie, c'est tout, ha ha... Aucun danger là-derrière, aucun.
Dearly Departed#015.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#017.src: Well, they're Skill Points! You gain them as you level up, then you can assign them to get bonuses in combat. Look, I'm no soldier, but even I know you really should be using them...
Dearly Departed#017.dst: Eh bien, ce sont les points d'attribut! Vous en gagnez en montant de niveau, et vous les assignez pour des bonus en combat. Je ne suis pas soldat, mais même moi je sais qu'il faut les utiliser...
Dearly Departed#017.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#019.src: You get it, or do you want me to tell you what they are?
Dearly Departed#019.dst: Compris, ou vous voulez que je vous explique ce que c'est?
Dearly Departed#019.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#023.src: {#} Defence is your best bet if you're struggling with staying alive. Decreases the damage you take, 's about all.
Dearly Departed#023.dst: {#} La Défense, c'est votre meilleur atout si vous peinez à survivre. Elle réduit les dégâts subis, c'est à peu près tout.
Dearly Departed#023.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#024.src: {#} Agility, now that one is for the risktakers. The more you have, the likelier you are to dodge incoming attacks, negating most of their damage.
Dearly Departed#024.dst: {#} L'Agilité, elle, c'est pour les casse-cou. Plus vous en avez, plus vous avez de chances d'esquiver les attaques et d'en annuler presque tous les dégâts.
Dearly Departed#024.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#025.src: Best part is, you can combine them however you want, no matter your class or style of fighting.
Dearly Departed#025.dst: Le mieux, c'est que vous les combinez à volonté, quels que soient votre classe ou votre style.
Dearly Departed#025.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#026.src: Just open your compass to assign your Skill Points. Then, when you're ready, head in there and get my ring.
Dearly Departed#026.dst: Ouvrez votre boussole pour assigner vos points d'attribut. Puis, une fois prêt, entrez là-dedans et rapportez mon alliance.
Dearly Departed#026.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#028.src: Go on then, soldier! Show us the might of {p}'s army! Uh, I mean... get me that ring!
Dearly Departed#028.dst: Allez, soldat! Montrez la puissance de l'armée de {p}! Euh, enfin... rapportez-moi cette alliance!
Dearly Departed#028.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#029.src: What's going on in there, soldier? Have you found the ring yet?
Dearly Departed#029.dst: Que se passe-t-il là-dedans, soldat? Vous avez trouvé l'alliance?
Dearly Departed#029.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#030.src: You really should hurry, before... nevermind! Just find the ring and get out of there!
Dearly Departed#030.dst: Dépêchez-vous, avant que... laissez tomber! Trouvez l'alliance et sortez de là!
Dearly Departed#030.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#031.src: Holy Bovine! It's... It's... He's back! Kill it, quickly!
Dearly Departed#031.dst: Sainte Vache! C'est... C'est... Il est revenu! Tuez-le, vite!
Dearly Departed#031.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#033.src: You did it! Come back here now, so I can finally get my ring back.
Dearly Departed#033.dst: Vous avez réussi! Revenez ici, que je récupère enfin mon alliance.
Dearly Departed#033.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#035.src: Goodness, that was a little more exciting than I anticipated, hmph. Still, good work! I'm glad we were able to get rid of that monster...
Dearly Departed#035.dst: Bonté divine, c'était un peu plus palpitant que prévu, hmph. Enfin, beau travail! Je suis content qu'on se soit débarrassés de ce monstre...
Dearly Departed#035.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#036.src: I mean... poor father-in-law! I don't know how I'll explain this to the wife...
Dearly Departed#036.dst: Enfin... pauvre beau-père! Comment je vais expliquer ça à ma femme...
Dearly Departed#036.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#037.src: I'll take the ring now, it's rather precious to me...
Dearly Departed#037.dst: Je prends l'alliance, maintenant, j'y tiens beaucoup...
Dearly Departed#037.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#038.src: Anyhow, take this well-deserved reward for the, well, actions you took today. Perhaps, if you keep it up, you could even become a hero like Ragnar one day.
Dearly Departed#038.dst: Bref, prenez cette récompense bien méritée pour, eh bien, vos actes d'aujourd'hui. Qui sait, si vous continuez ainsi, vous deviendrez peut-être un jour un héros comme Ragnar.
Dearly Departed#038.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#039.src: Hello there, stranger. Was there something you wanted to speak to me about?
Dearly Departed#039.dst: Bonjour, voyageur. Vous vouliez me parler de quelque chose?
Dearly Departed#039.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#040.src: I should be angry but... I can't pretend to be surprised. He's always been such a forgetful oaf.
Dearly Departed#040.dst: Je devrais être en colère, mais... je ne peux pas feindre la surprise. Il a toujours été un balourd étourdi.
Dearly Departed#040.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#041.src: But, it explains a lot... He's been acting weird lately, ever since dad passed. That must've been what happened, so thank you for telling me.
Dearly Departed#041.dst: Mais ça explique bien des choses... Il est bizarre depuis que papa est parti. C'est sûrement ce qui s'est passé, alors merci de me l'avoir dit.
Dearly Departed#041.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#042.src: That's right. The one and only, ha ha...
Dearly Departed#042.dst: C'est ça. La seule et unique, ha ha...
Dearly Departed#042.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#043.src: We're just simple farmers, trying to get by. We were taking care of my dad until... well... yeah...
Dearly Departed#043.dst: On est de simples fermiers qui se débrouillent. On s'occupait de mon père jusqu'à ce que... enfin... voilà...
Dearly Departed#043.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#044.src: Thank you... It all happened so suddenly. On the day I left for {p}, dad was as healthy as ever, but when I came back he was already buried. The sickness must have come so fast...
Dearly Departed#044.dst: Merci... Tout s'est passé si vite. Le jour où je suis partie pour {p}, papa était en pleine forme, mais à mon retour, il était déjà enterré. La maladie a dû frapper si vite...
Dearly Departed#044.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#045.src: But at his age, I'm not surprised... It's just regrettable that we couldn't get a priest out here in time, dad was such a pious man.
Dearly Departed#045.dst: Mais à son âge, ça ne m'étonne pas... C'est juste regrettable qu'on n'ait pas pu faire venir un prêtre à temps, papa était si pieux.
Dearly Departed#045.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#046.src: Dad... Above all, he was kind and always generous. He left us this entire farm. And very pious too, a true believer. Maybe that's why he lived so long...
Dearly Departed#046.dst: Papa... Avant tout, il était bon et généreux. Il nous a laissé toute la ferme. Très pieux aussi, un vrai croyant. C'est peut-être pour ça qu'il a vécu si vieux...
Dearly Departed#046.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#047.src: Oh, dear... If I don't stop, I'm gonna start crying again.
Dearly Departed#047.dst: Oh, là là... Si je ne m'arrête pas, je vais encore pleurer.
Dearly Departed#047.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#048.src: You've used your Skill Points too, right? They could come in handy, should something happen.
Dearly Departed#048.dst: Vous avez utilisé vos points d'attribut aussi, n'est-ce pas? Ils pourraient être utiles, au cas où.
Dearly Departed#048.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#049.src: There's five of them. {#} Strength, {#} Dexterity, {#} Intelligence, {#} Defence, and {#} Agility, each with different bonuses.
Dearly Departed#049.dst: Il y en a cinq. {#} Force, {#} Dextérité, {#} Intelligence, {#} Défense et {#} Agilité, chacun avec ses propres bonus.

Dearly Departed#050.src: Why are you asking me that?

Dearly Departed#059.src: Now to see if you can find that ring Cevalus mentioned...
Dearly Departed#059.dst: Reste à trouver l'alliance dont parlait Cevalus...

Dearly Departed#060.src: You manage to pry the ring off the monster's finger...
Dearly Departed#060.dst: Vous parvenez à arracher l'alliance du doigt du monstre...

Dearly Departed#063.src: {#} Strength is handy if you're having a tough time taking down enemies. It makes your attacks hit harder, simple as.
Dearly Departed#063.dst: {#} La Force, c'est pratique si vous avez du mal à abattre vos ennemis. Elle rend vos attaques plus puissantes, tout simplement.
Dearly Departed#063.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#064.src: Thank you dearly for your help, soldier. You really saved me... Don't know what I would have told the wife, ha ha...
Dearly Departed#064.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Death Whistle (Quest)#001.src: Hello! Hmm, armour, weapon, look of grim despair... You must be from the Wynn province!
Death Whistle (Quest)#001.dst: Bonjour! Hmm, armure, arme, air de sombre désespoir... Vous venez sûrement de la province de Wynn!
Death Whistle (Quest)#001.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#002.src: My name is Voer, and I'm an exotic plant merchant. I sell all kinds of, uh, perfectly legal goods to the magicians of Gavel.
Death Whistle (Quest)#002.dst: Je m'appelle Voer, marchand de plantes exotiques. Je vends toutes sortes de marchandises, euh, parfaitement légales aux magiciens de Gavel.
Death Whistle (Quest)#002.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#003.src: Lately, this Decay has been making business rather tough. The magical plants that used to grow here are dying.
Death Whistle (Quest)#003.dst: Ces temps-ci, la Décadence complique les affaires. Les plantes magiques qui poussaient ici meurent.
Death Whistle (Quest)#003.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#004.src: The need for magic has never been as big as it is now, and without supplies, the magicians of the swamp simply cannot operate!
Death Whistle (Quest)#004.dst: On n'a jamais eu autant besoin de magie qu'aujourd'hui, et sans fournitures, les magiciens du marais ne peuvent tout simplement pas travailler!
Death Whistle (Quest)#004.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#005.src: It is a rather rare plant with all sorts of mystical properties, so much so that it can animate objects around it!
Death Whistle (Quest)#005.dst: C'est une plante assez rare aux propriétés mystiques de toutes sortes, au point qu'elle peut animer les objets autour d'elle!
Death Whistle (Quest)#005.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#006.src: Look for the highest mountain in the swamp south-east from here. The Decay hasn't reached the peaks yet, you see!
Death Whistle (Quest)#006.dst: Cherchez la plus haute montagne du marais, au sud-est d'ici. La Décadence n'a pas encore atteint les sommets, voyez-vous!
Death Whistle (Quest)#006.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#007.src: Find the mountain at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and a way up on it.
Death Whistle (Quest)#007.dst: Trouvez la montagne en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] et un moyen d'y grimper.

Death Whistle (Quest)#008.src: Go to the top of the mountain and get {~} Black Whistle Leaf.
Death Whistle (Quest)#008.dst: Montez au sommet de la montagne et obtenez {~} Black Whistle Leaf.

Death Whistle (Quest)#009.src: Return to Voer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with [{~} Death Whistle Leaf].
Death Whistle (Quest)#009.dst: Retournez voir Voer en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] avec [{~} Death Whistle Leaf].

Death Whistle (Quest)#011.src: You've no idea what you even have done, do you? Your thoughtless actions will cost lives!
Death Whistle (Quest)#011.dst: Tu n'as même pas idée de ce que tu as fait, n'est-ce pas? Ton insouciance coûtera des vies!
Death Whistle (Quest)#011.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#012.src: Uhm... Excuse me? What do you want, elf girl? We're in the middle of a deal here?
Death Whistle (Quest)#012.dst: Euh... Pardon? Qu'est-ce que tu veux, la petite elfe? On est en pleine affaire, là?
Death Whistle (Quest)#012.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#013.src: You sold Pink Pelulite! Have you forgotten its enraging properties? Or shall I read from that herbology book you "found" in my camp?
Death Whistle (Quest)#013.dst: Tu as vendu de la Pink Pelulite! As-tu oublié ses propriétés enrageantes? Ou dois-je te lire ce livre d'herboristerie que tu as "trouvé" dans mon camp?
Death Whistle (Quest)#013.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#014.src: You can't even say for certain. This kind of carelessness has no place! If you refuse to exercise the proper thought and caution, then those around you suffer.
Death Whistle (Quest)#014.dst: Tu n'en es même pas certain. Une telle négligence n'a pas lieu d'être! Si tu refuses de faire preuve de réflexion et de prudence, ce sont ceux qui t'entourent qui en souffrent.
Death Whistle (Quest)#014.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#015.src: Aaah, this is a disaster! Human, please, Pink Pelulite acts quickly and intensely... Follow the pink trail on the ground, the flowers shed their petals. Get it back before something bad happens!
Death Whistle (Quest)#015.dst: Aaah, c'est une catastrophe! Humain, je vous en prie, la Pink Pelulite agit vite et fort... Suivez la traînée rose au sol, les fleurs perdent leurs pétales. Récupérez-la avant qu'un malheur arrive!
Death Whistle (Quest)#015.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#016.src: Follow the path of residue to the buyer’s cave.
Death Whistle (Quest)#016.dst: Suivez la traînée de résidus jusqu'à la grotte de l'acheteuse.

Death Whistle (Quest)#017.src: Ah, um, come back later please! Something strange is happening!
Death Whistle (Quest)#017.dst: Ah, euh, revenez plus tard! Il se passe un truc bizarre!
Death Whistle (Quest)#017.speaker: Witch

Death Whistle (Quest)#018.src: My body is a bit, um, not-in-my-control right now! I'd rather not hurt anyone!
Death Whistle (Quest)#018.dst: Mon corps est un peu, euh, hors de contrôle en ce moment! Je préfère ne blesser personne!
Death Whistle (Quest)#018.speaker: Witch

Death Whistle (Quest)#019.src: Remove the flower from the woman in the cave.
Death Whistle (Quest)#019.dst: Retirez la fleur à la femme de la grotte.

Death Whistle (Quest)#020.src: And what of the woman who bought it? Was she...?
Death Whistle (Quest)#020.dst: Et la femme qui l'a achetée? Est-ce qu'elle...?
Death Whistle (Quest)#020.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#021.src: I need Death Whistle in particular. It's not as deadly as it sounds, I promise- the name's just archaic, if I recall right from that- er, my book.
Death Whistle (Quest)#021.dst: Il me faut du Death Whistle précisément. C'est moins mortel que ça en a l'air, promis- le nom est archaïque, si je me souviens bien de ce- euh, mon livre.
Death Whistle (Quest)#021.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#022.src: Wait, wh-what? A Pink PELULITE!? I sold that woman a Pink PELUTE for her luck charms! How dare- wait...wait, Pink Pelute has rounder petals... Oh no.
Death Whistle (Quest)#022.dst: Hein, qu-quoi? Une Pink PELULITE!? J'ai vendu une Pink PELUTE à cette femme pour ses porte-bonheur! Comment oses- attends...attends, la Pink Pelute a des pétales ronds... Oh non.

Death Whistle (Quest)#023.src: I must...make a difficult choice, and leave this job to you. I've other things to tend to, though it pains me to leave a life in another's hands. Remember this, villager!
Death Whistle (Quest)#023.dst: Je dois...faire un choix difficile, et vous laisser cette tâche. J'ai d'autres affaires à régler, même s'il m'en coûte de laisser une vie entre d'autres mains. Souvenez-vous-en, villageois!

Death Whistle (Quest)#024.src: You're back, I see...and you're shedding petals! You got the Pink Pelulite back?
Death Whistle (Quest)#024.dst: De retour, je vois...et vous semez des pétales! Vous avez la Pink Pelulite?

Death Whistle (Quest)#025.src: Oh, thank goodness! You got there in time. She's a regular of mine- and a bit of a looker, too. That Lari was right, to some extent, at least...
Death Whistle (Quest)#025.dst: Oh, Dieu merci! Vous êtes arrivé à temps. C'est une habituée- et plutôt jolie, en plus. Cette Lari avait raison, du moins en partie...
Death Whistle (Quest)#025.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#026.src: I did take her book, and I should be more careful in the future, regarding this...but I can't just quit selling these herbs.
Death Whistle (Quest)#026.dst: J'ai bien pris son livre, et je devrais être plus prudent à l'avenir, sur ce point...mais je ne peux pas arrêter de vendre ces herbes.
Death Whistle (Quest)#026.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#027.src: I need an income, and the swamp isn't exactly the most resource rich region here! Especially not any more.
Death Whistle (Quest)#027.dst: Il me faut un revenu, et le marais n'est pas vraiment la région la plus riche en ressources! Surtout plus maintenant.
Death Whistle (Quest)#027.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#028.src: And how dare she just walk away like that! It's a good thing you were around, human, otherwise...well, I'd rather not think about it.
Death Whistle (Quest)#028.dst: Et quel culot de partir comme ça! Heureusement que vous étiez là, humain, sinon...bref, je préfère ne pas y penser.
Death Whistle (Quest)#028.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#029.src: Regardless, you've helped me greatly. Got me my supplies and saved the life of a regular of mine, so I've got a gift for you!
Death Whistle (Quest)#029.dst: Quoi qu'il en soit, vous m'avez beaucoup aidé: mes fournitures, et la vie sauve d'une habituée. Alors j'ai un cadeau pour vous!
Death Whistle (Quest)#029.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#030.src: I'll offer you a sampler of my stock. Everything in here is pre-primed to be safe for brewing, so there won't be any mishaps like today!
Death Whistle (Quest)#030.dst: Je vous offre un échantillon de mon stock. Tout est déjà préparé pour être infusé sans risque, donc pas d'incident comme aujourd'hui!
Death Whistle (Quest)#030.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#031.src: I've got to sharpen up these old eyes of mine. Can't make a mistake like that again.
Death Whistle (Quest)#031.dst: Il faut que j'aiguise ces vieux yeux. Je ne peux plus faire une erreur pareille.

Death Whistle (Quest)#032.src: Still, that Lari girl... I have to wonder what her problem is.
Death Whistle (Quest)#032.dst: Quand même, cette Lari... Je me demande bien quel est son problème.

Death Whistle (Quest)#033.src: I know humans aren't renowned for their memory, but do hurry, yes? What you need is written down in your content book!
Death Whistle (Quest)#033.dst: Les humains n'ont pas une mémoire légendaire, je sais, mais faites vite, hein? Tout est noté dans votre livre de contenu!
Death Whistle (Quest)#033.speaker: Voer

Deja Vu#001.src: Whatever that odd feeling was, it's over now. And there's Asher's shovel! Better return this to him.
Deja Vu#001.dst: Quelle que soit cette étrange sensation, elle est passée. Et voilà la pelle d'Asher! Mieux vaut la lui rendre.

Deja Vu#002.src: Whenever you're ready to save Asher, step through the rift.
Deja Vu#002.dst: Quand vous serez prêt à sauver Asher, traversez la faille.

Deja Vu#004.dst: Parlez à Asher près de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Deja Vu#005.src: Well well well, look who decided to come back with their tail between their legs.
Deja Vu#005.dst: Tiens, tiens, tiens, regardez qui revient la queue entre les jambes.
Deja Vu#005.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#006.src: Two weeks now and you still haven't found it? Ugh, I can't believe I ever trusted you with such a simple task.
Deja Vu#006.dst: Deux semaines et tu ne l'as toujours pas trouvée? Pff, dire que je t'ai confié une tâche aussi simple.
Deja Vu#006.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#007.src: Who am I? WHAT DO YOU MEAN WHO AM I? You offered to help find my shovel, and I've been waiting two weeks!
Deja Vu#007.dst: Qui je suis? COMMENT ÇA, QUI JE SUIS? Tu as proposé de retrouver ma pelle, et ça fait deux semaines que j'attends!
Deja Vu#007.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#008.src: Forget about your payment. Unless you either pay me back or get my shovel right now!
Deja Vu#008.dst: Oublie ton paiement. A moins que tu me rembourses ou que tu me rapportes ma pelle tout de suite!
Deja Vu#008.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#009.src: My shovel? That's why I sent you out in the first place! It's somewhere in {p}. I lost it while following a trail of flowers.
Deja Vu#009.dst: Ma pelle? C'est pour ça que je t'ai envoyé, à la base! Elle est quelque part dans {p}. Je l'ai perdue en suivant une piste de fleurs.
Deja Vu#009.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#010.src: I think it was south west of the large ruined gate. Now go get it!
Deja Vu#010.dst: Au sud-ouest de la grande porte en ruine, je crois. Allez, va la chercher!
Deja Vu#010.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#011.dst: Trouvez la pelle d'Asher près de [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Deja Vu#013.src: Well hello there, stranger! Welcome to {p}! Always nice to see a new face around here.
Deja Vu#013.dst: Bonjour, l'étranger! Bienvenue dans {p}! Toujours un plaisir de voir une nouvelle tête ici.
Deja Vu#013.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#014.src: Mad at you? Why would I be mad at you? We've never met.
Deja Vu#014.dst: Fâché contre toi? Et pourquoi donc? On ne se connaît pas.
Deja Vu#014.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#015.src: I know this a bit forward, but I need to ask for your help with-
Deja Vu#015.dst: Je sais que c'est un peu direct, mais j'ai besoin de ton aide pour-
Deja Vu#015.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#016.src: Wait, is that-? It is! You've found my shovel! I recognize those markings anywhere.
Deja Vu#016.dst: Attends, c'est-? Mais oui! Tu as trouvé ma pelle! Je reconnaîtrais ces marques entre mille.
Deja Vu#016.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#017.src: But why is it so rusty? Ah, no matter. Give that to me and I'll head inside to get you a nice reward.
Deja Vu#017.dst: Mais pourquoi est-elle si rouillée? Bah, peu importe. Donne, je vais te chercher une belle récompense.
Deja Vu#017.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#018.src: Thank you. Now, about that reward-
Deja Vu#018.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#020.src: Oh dear, there he goes again. Poor fool ignored my warnings and touched that shovel.
Deja Vu#020.dst: Oh là là, ça recommence. Le pauvre fou a ignoré mes avertissements et touché cette pelle.
Deja Vu#020.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#021.src: He's gone and got himself stuck in a loop.
Deja Vu#021.dst: Il s'est retrouvé coincé dans une boucle.
Deja Vu#021.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#022.src: Head inside, soldier, and I'll explain what's happening here.
Deja Vu#022.dst: Entrez, soldat, et je vous expliquerai ce qui se passe ici.
Deja Vu#022.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#024.src: Without Asher, his house has vanished from time.
Deja Vu#024.dst: Sans Asher, sa maison a disparu du temps.
Deja Vu#024.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#026.src: Let me explain why Asher disappeared...
Deja Vu#026.dst: Je vais vous expliquer la disparition d'Asher...
Deja Vu#026.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#027.src: {p} was built many years ago by a long-lost civilization.
Deja Vu#027.dst: Une civilisation disparue a bâti {p} il y a bien longtemps.
Deja Vu#027.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#028.src: They had odd powers. They ended up distorting time itself.
Deja Vu#028.dst: Elle avait d'étranges pouvoirs, qui ont fini par déformer le temps.
Deja Vu#028.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#029.src: The tools they used to make these structures are imbued with their power.
Deja Vu#029.dst: Les outils qui ont servi à bâtir ces structures sont imprégnés de son pouvoir.
Deja Vu#029.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#030.src: Asher found one of these tools: the shovel.
Deja Vu#030.dst: Asher a trouvé l'un de ces outils: la pelle.
Deja Vu#030.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#031.src: The shovel is tethering its time of influence to today. It keeps sending Asher back.
Deja Vu#031.dst: La pelle rattache son temps d'influence à aujourd'hui. Elle renvoie sans cesse Asher en arrière.
Deja Vu#031.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#032.src: The issue is, Asher died in the past. This creates a paradox.
Deja Vu#032.dst: Or, Asher est mort dans le passé. D'où un paradoxe.
Deja Vu#032.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#033.src: We can save him if I send you back to prevent his death. Go through this rift to join him in the past.
Deja Vu#033.dst: Nous pouvons le sauver si je vous renvoie empêcher sa mort. Traversez cette faille pour le rejoindre dans le passé.
Deja Vu#033.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#034.src: Find a way to save Asher from his death.
Deja Vu#034.dst: Trouvez un moyen d'empêcher la mort d'Asher.

Deja Vu#036.src: Usually this place is filled with workers.
Deja Vu#036.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#037.src: But no one's here. And this place is clearly not done.
Deja Vu#037.dst: Mais il n'y a personne. Et tout est inachevé.
Deja Vu#037.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#038.src: Whatever the case, I should probably find my shovel.
Deja Vu#038.dst: Quoi qu'il en soit, je ferais mieux de retrouver ma pelle.
Deja Vu#038.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#039.src: If I were a shovel, where would I be?
Deja Vu#039.dst: Si j'étais une pelle, où est-ce que je serais?
Deja Vu#039.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#041.src: This place... There's so much going on but no one here.
Deja Vu#041.dst: Cet endroit... Il s'y passe tant de choses, mais personne.
Deja Vu#041.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#042.src: What I don't understand, though, is why this place looks brand new.
Deja Vu#042.dst: Ce que je ne comprends pas, c'est pourquoi tout a l'air neuf.
Deja Vu#042.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#043.src: This place looks like it's just being built!
Deja Vu#043.dst: On dirait que c'est en pleine construction!
Deja Vu#043.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#044.src: This must be something to do with the valley's magic. Wouldn't be the first time.
Deja Vu#044.dst: Ça doit avoir un rapport avec la magie de la vallée. Ce ne serait pas la première fois.
Deja Vu#044.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#046.src: In fact, whenever I hold that shovel, this kind of stuff seems to happen.
Deja Vu#046.dst: En fait, chaque fois que je tiens cette pelle, ce genre de truc arrive.
Deja Vu#046.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#047.src: Maybe it's sent me way back. Back to the construction of this place.
Deja Vu#047.dst: Elle m'a peut-être renvoyé très loin. A l'époque de la construction.
Deja Vu#047.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#048.src: Then why is no one here?
Deja Vu#048.dst: Alors pourquoi il n'y a personne?
Deja Vu#048.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#049.src: Woah, that tree looks like it might fall over!
Deja Vu#049.dst: Ouah, cet arbre a l'air sur le point de tomber!
Deja Vu#049.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#051.src: Uhf! How do they have a cannon? These guys must be super advanced.
Deja Vu#051.dst: Ouf! Comment ils ont un canon? Ces gens doivent être super avancés.
Deja Vu#051.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#052.src: I think I'm close now. I can just feel that shovel close by.
Deja Vu#052.dst: Je crois que j'y suis presque. Je sens la pelle toute proche.
Deja Vu#052.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#054.src: My my, a crushing defeat to be sure. You'll have to find a way to stop that.
Deja Vu#054.dst: Eh bien, une défaite écrasante, à n'en pas douter. Il faudra empêcher ça.
Deja Vu#054.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#055.src: Go back through the rift and make sure Asher doesn't become a pancake this time.
Deja Vu#055.dst: Retraversez la faille et faites en sorte qu'Asher ne finisse pas en crêpe cette fois.
Deja Vu#055.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#057.src: Well that was quite the explosive end to our friend there. There must be a way to prevent that.
Deja Vu#057.dst: Eh bien, notre ami a connu une fin des plus explosives. Il doit y avoir un moyen d'éviter ça.
Deja Vu#057.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#058.src: Head back in there. This time with less explosions.
Deja Vu#058.dst: Retournez-y. Cette fois avec moins d'explosions.
Deja Vu#058.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#059.src: Oh, so close on that try. Who could've guessed that was how our friend met his end?
Deja Vu#059.dst: Oh, presque, cette fois. Qui aurait cru que notre ami finirait ainsi?
Deja Vu#059.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#060.src: I'm sure you'll nail it this time. Not sure how you will stop a cosmic event, though.
Deja Vu#060.dst: Cette fois sera la bonne. Reste à savoir comment arrêter un événement cosmique.
Deja Vu#060.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#061.src: Oh there it is! My shovel!
Deja Vu#061.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#062.src: I'm surprised it took me back this far this time.
Deja Vu#062.dst: Étonnant qu'elle m'ait ramené si loin cette fois.
Deja Vu#062.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#063.src: Well, time to head on back-
Deja Vu#063.dst: Bon, il est temps de rentrer-
Deja Vu#063.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#066.src: Asher, you remember when I allowed you to live in the valley, I told you not to touch any odd objects.
Deja Vu#066.dst: Asher, souviens-toi: quand je t'ai permis de vivre dans la vallée, je t'ai dit de ne toucher à aucun objet étrange.
Deja Vu#066.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#068.src: You got yourself stuck hundreds of years ago. If it wasn't for this guard, you'd be removed from existence.
Deja Vu#068.dst: Tu t'es retrouvé coincé il y a des centaines d'années. Sans ce garde, tu aurais été effacé de l'existence.
Deja Vu#068.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#069.src: Oh... So that's where I am. I am so sorry Martyn. Please don't kick me out of the valley.
Deja Vu#069.dst: Oh... Alors c'est là que je suis. Pardon, Martyn. Je t'en prie, ne me chasse pas de la vallée.
Deja Vu#069.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#070.src: I know time travel can be tempting. But it's far more dangerous than you can ever understand.
Deja Vu#070.dst: Je sais que voyager dans le temps est tentant. Mais c'est bien plus dangereux que tu ne l'imagines.
Deja Vu#070.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#071.src: The valley is banned for most citizens. I watch over this timeline because of poor souls like Asher.
Deja Vu#071.dst: La vallée est interdite à presque tous. Je veille sur cette ligne temporelle pour de pauvres âmes comme Asher.
Deja Vu#071.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#075.src: How did you get these powers? Are you even human?
Deja Vu#075.dst: Comment tu as eu ces pouvoirs? Tu es seulement humain?
Deja Vu#075.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#076.src: Oh you know. I've read a book or two in my time.
Deja Vu#076.dst: Oh, tu sais. J'ai lu un livre ou deux dans ma vie.
Deja Vu#076.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#077.src: {u}, I'm sorry I got you dragged into this. I wish I could have done it myself.
Deja Vu#077.dst: {u}, désolé de vous avoir entraîné là-dedans. J'aurais aimé m'en charger moi-même.
Deja Vu#077.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#078.src: I probably could have gotten myself out...
Deja Vu#078.dst: J'aurais sûrement pu m'en sortir tout seul...
Deja Vu#078.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#079.src: You died in the past. Multiple times.
Deja Vu#079.dst: Tu es mort dans le passé. Plusieurs fois.
Deja Vu#079.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#081.src: Yes. In some surprising ways too.
Deja Vu#081.dst: Oui. Et de façons assez surprenantes.
Deja Vu#081.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#082.src: {u}, I'm sure we will meet again... in time.
Deja Vu#082.dst: {u}, nous nous reverrons... avec le temps.
Deja Vu#082.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#086.src: I don't understand Martyn. He seems to know everything about the past. Here, come closer, I want to whisper something.
Deja Vu#086.dst: Je ne comprends pas Martyn. Il a l'air de tout savoir du passé. Tiens, approche, je veux te glisser un mot à l'oreille.
Deja Vu#086.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#088.src: I think he might have known Bob. I saw some letters in his house.
Deja Vu#088.dst: Je crois qu'il a peut-être connu Bob. J'ai vu des lettres chez lui.
Deja Vu#088.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#089.src: Weird, right? Bob was a hard guy to know.
Deja Vu#089.dst: Bizarre, non? Bob n'était pas facile à connaître.
Deja Vu#089.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#090.src: Anyway, take this. It's the least I can do to pay you for saving me.
Deja Vu#090.dst: Bref, tiens. C'est bien le moins pour m'avoir sauvé.
Deja Vu#090.speaker: Asher

Desperate Metal#003.src: A bunch of stupid mechs came here and just started ransacking!
Desperate Metal#003.dst: Une bande de mechs stupides est venue tout saccager!
Desperate Metal#003.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#004.src: Looks like a bunch of despermechs. That's what we call junk mechs, trying to survive.
Desperate Metal#004.dst: On dirait des despermechs. On appelle comme ça les mechs de récup qui tentent de survivre.
Desperate Metal#004.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#005.src: I count three different mech marks. Looks like they split up once they got their parts.
Desperate Metal#005.dst: Je compte trois marques de mech. Ils ont dû se séparer une fois leurs pièces en poche.
Desperate Metal#005.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#006.src: You got to help me here, I'm no warrior. Look they've dropped crates on their escape. Follow them and bring me back evidence that you destroyed them and I shall reward you.
Desperate Metal#006.dst: Aidez-moi, je ne suis pas un guerrier. Regardez, ils ont semé des caisses en fuyant. Suivez-les, rapportez-moi la preuve que vous les avez détruits, et vous serez récompensé.
Desperate Metal#006.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#007.src: Three trails, three thieving despermechs. Be careful, they aren't to be underestimated.
Desperate Metal#007.dst: Trois pistes, trois despermechs voleurs. Prudence, il ne faut pas les sous-estimer.
Desperate Metal#007.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#008.src: Locate the {~} mechs by following the trails of tools, return to Phinas with evidence that you destroyed the mechs.
Desperate Metal#008.dst: Trouvez les {~} mechs en suivant les traînées d'outils, puis retournez voir Phinas avec la preuve que vous les avez détruits.

Desperate Metal#009.src: You Wynn folk sure know your fights.
Desperate Metal#009.dst: Vous, les gens de Wynn, savez vous battre.
Desperate Metal#009.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#010.src: You found all three? Let's take a look. Hmm....
Desperate Metal#010.dst: Vous les avez trouvés tous les trois? Voyons ça. Hmm....
Desperate Metal#010.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#011.src: Wait. These aren't Despermechs.. The factory fell over two years ago. These are brand new. Handmade.
Desperate Metal#011.dst: Attendez. Ce ne sont pas des despermechs.. L'usine est tombée il y a plus de deux ans. Ceux-là sont neufs. Faits main.
Desperate Metal#011.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#013.src: Would you look at that! Their code!
Desperate Metal#013.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#014.src: Here, have them back. Take a close look at the names of these parts.
Desperate Metal#014.dst: Tenez, reprenez-les. Regardez bien les noms de ces pièces.
Desperate Metal#014.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#015.src: Find out where to go by looking at the pieces of junk.
Desperate Metal#015.dst: Trouvez où aller en examinant les morceaux de ferraille.

Desperate Metal#016.src: What are these? I have nothing to do with them!
Desperate Metal#016.dst: C'est quoi, ça? Je n'ai rien à voir avec ça!
Desperate Metal#016.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#017.src: Ahh.. Well, now that I think of it, writing my location on these parts was a bit stupid.
Desperate Metal#017.dst: Ahh.. Bon, maintenant que j'y pense, graver mon adresse sur ces pièces, c'était un peu bête.
Desperate Metal#017.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#018.src: Those mechs were my creation. Corkus can still live with machines.
Desperate Metal#018.dst: Ces mechs sont mes créations. Corkus peut encore vivre avec les machines.
Desperate Metal#018.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#019.src: The factory was a disaster. That's what happens when a machine controls a machine.
Desperate Metal#019.dst: L'usine a été un désastre. Voilà ce qui arrive quand une machine en contrôle une autre.
Desperate Metal#019.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#020.src: I am living proof that humans can control them. Make use of them.
Desperate Metal#020.dst: Je suis la preuve vivante que les humains peuvent les contrôler. Les utiliser.
Desperate Metal#020.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#021.src: The metal shortage has made it difficult to make my machines... Not to mention the new laws..
Desperate Metal#021.dst: La pénurie de métal complique la fabrication de mes machines... Sans parler des nouvelles lois..
Desperate Metal#021.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#022.src: If you want to turn me in, fine. You'll find all the evidence you need under my pillow.
Desperate Metal#022.dst: Si vous voulez me dénoncer, soit. Vous trouverez toutes les preuves nécessaires sous mon oreiller.
Desperate Metal#022.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#024.dst: Étranger détecté. Système de sécurité: activé.

Desperate Metal#027.src: I'm sorry it ended up like this, you should've just ignored that old man.
Desperate Metal#027.dst: Désolée que ça finisse comme ça, vous auriez dû ignorer ce vieil homme.
Desperate Metal#027.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#029.src: I was made to be angry. I can't stop myself...
Desperate Metal#029.dst: On m'a fait pour être en colère. Je ne peux pas m'arrêter...
Desperate Metal#029.speaker: Big Boss Mech-DM666

Desperate Metal#031.src: Did you find the source of those odd handmade mechs?
Desperate Metal#031.dst: Vous avez trouvé l'origine de ces étranges mechs faits main?
Desperate Metal#031.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#032.src: Nettik? The Light House owner? It's not overly surprising.
Desperate Metal#032.dst: Nettik? La propriétaire du phare? Ça ne m'étonne pas trop.
Desperate Metal#032.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#033.src: She always did complain about the mech ban.
Desperate Metal#033.dst: Elle s'est toujours plainte de l'interdiction des mechs.
Desperate Metal#033.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#034.src: You see, many of the Corkian people rely on their machines. Have done for years.
Desperate Metal#034.dst: Voyez-vous, beaucoup de Corkians dépendent de leurs machines. Depuis des années.
Desperate Metal#034.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#035.src: So when the factory fell and the new laws were introduced, people's lives changed..
Desperate Metal#035.dst: Alors, quand l'usine est tombée et que les nouvelles lois sont venues, tout a changé..
Desperate Metal#035.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#036.src: People don't like change. Anyway, I can't thank you enough. Have this for your troubles.
Desperate Metal#036.dst: Les gens n'aiment pas le changement. Bref, merci mille fois. Prenez ceci pour votre peine.
Desperate Metal#036.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#038.src: Request additional orders from L.H. Defend.
Desperate Metal#038.dst: Demande d'ordres supplémentaires à L.H. Défendre.
Desperate Metal#038.speaker: Steam Mech-DM1

Desperate Metal#039.src: Tools acquired, delivered to L.H. Additional orders received.
Desperate Metal#039.dst: Outils acquis, livrés à L.H. Ordres supplémentaires reçus.
Desperate Metal#039.speaker: Fiery Mech-DM2

Desperate Metal#041.src: Strategic mission accomplished. Mechanical parts: procured.
Desperate Metal#041.dst: Mission stratégique accomplie. Pièces mécaniques: obtenues.
Desperate Metal#041.speaker: Intelligence Mech-DM3

Desperate Metal#042.src: Look in the content book if you forgot what to do.
Desperate Metal#042.dst: Consultez le livre de contenu si vous avez oublié quoi faire.
Desperate Metal#042.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#043.src: I wrote down your task there.
Desperate Metal#043.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#044.src: What in the world are you doing here!? Get out immediately.
Desperate Metal#044.dst: Mais qu'est-ce que vous faites ici!? Sortez immédiatement.
Desperate Metal#044.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#045.src: I mean, welcome! Nothing suspicious here at all.
Desperate Metal#045.dst: Je veux dire, bienvenue! Rien de suspect ici, vraiment rien.
Desperate Metal#045.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#046.dst: Activation de la trappe de sécurité. {~}... {~}...

Desperate Metal#047.src: Report back to Phinas after destroying the mech
Desperate Metal#047.dst: Retournez voir Phinas après avoir détruit le mech

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#001.dst: Série de quêtes commencée: Dwarves et Doguns

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#002.src: The report suggests that the two species would compete for space.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#002.dst: Le rapport suggère que les deux espèces se disputeraient l'espace.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#003.src: "Public opinion is firmly against removal of the natives..."
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#003.dst: "L'opinion publique est fermement opposée à l'expulsion des autochtones..."

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#005.src: Find out what's happening at the theatre.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#005.dst: Découvrez ce qui se passe au théâtre.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#006.src: Interesting to see a Human wanting to see a Dwarven play!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#006.dst: Intéressant, un Humain qui veut voir une pièce naine!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#006.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#007.src: The only play we're performing is the annual Victory Festival.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#007.dst: La seule pièce que nous jouons, c'est le Festival de la Victoire annuel.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#007.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#008.src: The entry cost is [{~} Emerald Block]
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#008.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#010.src: Just take a seat and enjoy the show.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#010.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#011.src: Wait, is that- Hey, {u}! It's so good to see you!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#011.dst: Attends, c'est- Hé, {u}! Ça me fait tellement plaisir de te voir!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#011.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#012.src: Hello, to the people of Gavel, glad to see so many here!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#012.dst: Bonjour, peuple de Gavel, ravi de vous voir si nombreux!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#012.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#013.src: I hope you'll enjoy the play and that it'll be very educational too. I will be tonight's narrator.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#013.dst: J'espère que la pièce vous plaira et qu'elle sera aussi très instructive. Je serai le narrateur de ce soir.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#013.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#014.src: I hope you'll enjoy the play, and that it'll be very educational too. I will be tonight's narrator.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#014.dst: J'espère que la pièce vous plaira, et qu'elle sera aussi très instructive. Je serai le narrateur de ce soir.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#014.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#016.src: Pheeeew. I think we outran the villagers.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#016.dst: Ouuuuf. Je crois qu'on a semé les villageois.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#016.speaker: Babbi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#017.src: I think we are safe here in the mountains. Oh look. Shiny ores. This is like a gold mine.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#017.dst: On est en sécurité ici, dans les montagnes. Oh, regarde. Des minerais brillants. Une vraie mine d'or.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#017.speaker: Dwarfi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#018.src: These nice minerals are very nice, let us start digging.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#018.dst: Ces jolis minéraux sont très jolis, commençons à creuser.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#018.speaker: Dwarfi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#020.src: I am a dangerous monster and I will not let you mine these diamonds. We are the Doguns, and we will kill you!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#020.dst: Je suis un monstre dangereux et je ne vous laisserai pas miner ces diamants. Nous sommes les Doguns, et nous allons vous tuer!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#020.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#021.src: Graoaoro. I will eat you all for my afternoon demon luncheon.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#021.dst: Graoaoro. Je vais tous vous manger pour mon goûter démoniaque de l'après-midi.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#021.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#025.src: MOAHAHAHA. WE WILL KILL ALL OF YOU.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#025.dst: MOUAHAHAHA. NOUS ALLONS TOUS VOUS TUER.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#025.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#026.src: We need to forge better weapons so we can fight back.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#026.dst: Il faut forger de meilleures armes pour riposter.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#026.speaker: Babbi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#027.src: Good idea! We will use our intelligence to slay the demons.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#027.dst: Bonne idée! Nous utiliserons notre intelligence pour terrasser les démons.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#027.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#028.src: YOU CANNOT BEAT US, WE CAN SUMMON DRAGONS WITH OUR MAGIC.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#028.dst: VOUS NE POUVEZ PAS NOUS BATTRE, NOTRE MAGIE INVOQUE DES DRAGONS.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#028.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#029.src: Dragons are no match for us?? CHARGE!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#029.dst: Les dragons ne font pas le poids face à nous?? CHARGEZ!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#029.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#030.src: We have won. Hooray. And now we have established a great citadel, {p}!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#030.dst: Nous avons gagné. Hourra. Et maintenant, nous avons fondé une grande citadelle, {p}!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#030.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#031.src: The dwarven intellect beat the sheer power of the demons magic.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#031.dst: L'intellect nain a vaincu la puissance brute de la magie des démons.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#031.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#033.src: I hope you enjoyed the show, and learned something new today!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#033.dst: J'espère que le spectacle vous a plu et que vous avez appris quelque chose!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#033.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#034.src: We are continuing the celebration at the old Demon City. Follow the red banners outside {p} to get there.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#034.dst: La fête continue dans l'ancienne Cité des démons. Suivez les bannières rouges hors de {p} pour vous y rendre.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#034.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#036.src: Ugh, that was awful. Don't believe anything you see here, human. History is written by the victors.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#036.dst: Pff, c'était affreux. Ne crois rien de ce que tu vois ici, humain. L'histoire est écrite par les vainqueurs.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#036.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#038.src: Welcome one and all! Dwarven brothers and sisters, guests and visitors!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#038.dst: Bienvenue à tous! Frères et soeurs nains, invités et visiteurs!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#038.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#039.src: Welcome, one and all! Dwarven brothers and sisters, guests and visitors!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#039.dst: Bienvenue, à tous! Frères et soeurs nains, invités et visiteurs!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#039.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#040.src: Axelus! You are under arrest for high treason!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#040.dst: Axelus! Vous êtes en état d'arrestation pour haute trahison!

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#041.src: The cover crumbles a touch at your grip when you open it up. How old is this?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#041.dst: La couverture s'effrite un peu quand vous l'ouvrez. Quel âge peut-il avoir?

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#042.src: If I could draw your attention to the wooden stage in the north, we can begin.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#042.dst: Si je puis attirer votre attention sur la scène en bois au nord, nous pouvons commencer.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#042.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#043.src: Welcome to the annual festival where we celebrate victory over the foul demons...The Doguns!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#043.dst: Bienvenue au festival annuel où nous célébrons la victoire sur les immondes démons...les Doguns!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#043.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#044.src: Now, if I can get you to turn around to face the bonfire, we've prepared a lovely firecasting show for you all while we prepare!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#044.dst: Et maintenant, tournez-vous vers le feu de joie: un superbe spectacle de feu vous attend pendant nos préparatifs!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#044.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#045.src: Wow, I didn't know Dwarves could learn such magic! Beats the heck out of firecrackers!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#045.dst: Ouah, j'ignorais que les Nains maîtrisaient une telle magie! Bien mieux que des pétards!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#045.speaker: Mahou

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#046.src: Magnificent! Thank you very much to our fire casters. Now, ladies and gents, your attention to the main stage please!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#046.dst: Magnifique! Merci à nos lanceurs de feu. Et maintenant, mesdames et messieurs, votre attention sur la scène principale!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#046.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#047.src: For the last {~} years we have captured renegade Doguns that escaped the war, and this year is no exception!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#047.dst: Depuis {~} ans, nous capturons les Doguns renégats qui ont fui la guerre, et cette année ne fait pas exception!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#047.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#048.src: We shall now entomb the foul demon to join the ranks of the other Doguns on display.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#048.dst: Nous allons maintenant emmurer l'immonde démon, qui rejoindra les autres Doguns exposés.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#048.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#050.src: Note its magical might, its aggressive nature, its intense heat, and its fierce appearance.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#050.dst: Remarquez sa puissance magique, sa nature agressive, sa chaleur intense et son aspect féroce.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#050.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#051.src: All no match for the ingenuity and comeradery of the Dwarven nations!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#051.dst: Rien de tout cela ne vaut l'ingéniosité et la camaraderie des nations naines!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#051.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#052.src: M-Monsters... You all...are the demons here...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#052.speaker: Dogun

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#053.src: Every year, every year, every single YEAR you do this. You all need to open your god-blessed eyes for once!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#053.dst: Chaque année, chaque année, chaque fichue ANNÉE, vous faites ça. Ouvrez donc vos satanés yeux, pour une fois!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#053.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#054.src: Do you all really believe everything they tell you? Do you all just lap it up like dogs?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#054.dst: Vous croyez vraiment tout ce qu'on vous raconte? Vous lapez tout comme des chiens?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#054.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#055.src: Our side won the war, but does that really mean we were in the right? I'll tell you right now, it doesn't!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#055.dst: Notre camp a gagné la guerre, mais ça veut dire qu'on avait raison? Je vous le dis tout de suite: non!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#055.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#056.src: We all see it- The Doguns have feelings, family and thoughts, just like anyone else here!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#056.dst: On le voit tous- Les Doguns ont des sentiments, une famille et des pensées, comme n'importe qui ici!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#056.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#057.src: You are encasing live Doguns for entertainment. Public execution! This twisted display is more demonic than they ever could dream to be!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#057.dst: Vous emmurez des Doguns vivants pour le spectacle. Une exécution publique! Ce numéro tordu est plus démoniaque qu'eux ne pourraient jamais l'être!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#057.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#058.src: Guards! Get this propaganda spewing half pint to the Molten Core Prison, north side.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#058.dst: Gardes! Emmenez ce nabot propagandiste à la Molten Core Prison, côté nord.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#058.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#059.src: Come along, sir. Let's not make more of a scene.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#059.dst: Suivez-nous, monsieur. Ne faisons pas davantage de scandale.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#059.speaker: Dwarven Guard

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#060.src: Why would Axelus say something so blatantly wrong?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#060.dst: Pourquoi Axelus dirait-il quelque chose d'aussi faux?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#060.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#061.src: What was he talking about? That was all nonsense!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#061.dst: De quoi il parlait? C'était n'importe quoi!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#061.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#062.src: Are they really taking him to the Molten Core? You've heard the horror stories about there, right?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#062.dst: Ils l'emmènent vraiment au Molten Core? T'as entendu les histoires horribles sur cet endroit, non?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#062.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#063.src: Well, the expression 'no hope blows from the north' came from there, since it's on the north side...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#063.dst: Eh bien, l'expression 'du nord ne souffle nul espoir' vient de là, puisque c'est côté nord...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#063.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#064.src: Apologies, all. I shall provide us all with a quick way back to {p} on the floor here. We hope you enjoyed the show, despite the interruption!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#064.dst: Toutes mes excuses. Je vais ouvrir ici, au sol, un raccourci vers {p}. Nous espérons que le spectacle vous a plu, malgré l'interruption!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#064.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#065.src: Find out more about the hysterical dwarf in {p}'s prison.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#065.dst: Renseignez-vous sur le nain hystérique de la prison de {p}.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#066.src: I see I got your attention. Interested in the truth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#066.dst: Je vois que j'ai attiré ton attention. La vérité t'intéresse.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#066.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#067.src: I'm no conspiracy nut. The Dwarves have been lied to for hundreds of years about the war.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#067.dst: Je ne suis pas un conspirationniste. On ment aux Nains sur la guerre depuis des siècles.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#067.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#068.src: I have seen the truth. But my word isn't enough, is it? Seeing is believing, after all.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#068.dst: J'ai vu la vérité. Mais ma parole ne suffit pas, hein? Il faut le voir pour le croire, après tout.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#068.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#069.src: Hopefully I will see you soon, {u}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#069.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#070.src: Pick up Axelus' note and head to the location at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#070.dst: Ramassez la note d'Axelus et rendez-vous à l'endroit en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#073.src: Well, now you have read what I read. The truth...or the lie.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#073.dst: Bon, maintenant tu as lu ce que j'ai lu. La vérité...ou le mensonge.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#073.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#074.src: My people are tyrants and conquerors...but they are also good. The people have been brainwashed.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#074.dst: Mon peuple est fait de tyrans et de conquérants...mais il est aussi bon. On lui a lavé le cerveau.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#074.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#075.src: Many things are about to happen. If you want to know more, come to house number {~} in {p}. I'll be waiting.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#075.dst: Beaucoup de choses vont se passer. Si tu veux en savoir plus, viens à la maison numéro {~} à {p}. Je t'attendrai.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#075.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#077.src: Talk to Axelus in the Coalition Base.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#077.dst: Parlez à Axelus dans la base de la coalition.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#078.src: Ah, you made it. Come and meet Korzim
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#078.dst: Ah, te voilà. Viens rencontrer Korzim
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#078.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#080.src: We...are those who...want peace. I am son...of the Dogun Chief... I have...been banished.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#080.dst: Nous...sommes ceux qui...veulent la paix. Je suis fils...du chef des Doguns... J'ai...été banni.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#080.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#081.src: The coalition is a small group of believers in the truth. The Doguns aren't demons, and the Dwarves aren't all brainwashed.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#081.dst: La coalition est un petit groupe qui croit en la vérité. Les Doguns ne sont pas des démons, et tous les Nains ne sont pas endoctrinés.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#081.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#082.src: But of course, we have to live in hiding. The Doguns won’t tolerate Dwarves and the Dwarves hunt traitors and "Demons".
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#082.dst: Mais bien sûr, nous devons vivre cachés. Les Doguns ne tolèrent pas les Nains, et les Nains traquent les traîtres et les "démons".
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#082.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#083.src: But of course, we have to live in hiding. The Doguns won't tolerate Dwarves and the Dwarves hunt traitors and "Demons".
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#083.dst: Mais bien sûr, nous devons vivre cachés. Les Doguns ne tolèrent pas les Nains, et les Nains traquent les traîtres et les "démons".
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#083.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#084.src: We would...melt the beds...they sleep in... After all...we are...molten rock.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#084.dst: Nous ferions...fondre leurs lits...sous eux... Après tout...nous sommes...roche en fusion.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#085.src: This hideout was created by the Doguns in minutes, when it would have taken us days!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#085.dst: Les Doguns ont créé cette cachette en quelques minutes, alors qu'il nous aurait fallu des jours!

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#086.src: It's a control panel. It's futile to figure out how it works, perhaps brute force is necessary.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#086.dst: C'est un panneau de contrôle. Inutile de chercher à le comprendre, la force brute s'impose peut-être.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#087.src: Right now, we're trying to convince the public. But it's proving difficult, if not impossible.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#087.dst: Pour l'instant, on essaie de convaincre le public. Mais ça s'avère difficile, voire impossible.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#087.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#088.src: It isn't {~} years ago. We have the technology and supply chains to live here peacefully, but they just won't listen!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#088.dst: On n'est plus il y a {~} ans. On a la technologie et l'approvisionnement pour vivre ici en paix, mais ils ne veulent rien entendre!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#088.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#089.src: We have...a plan... To win over...my people...that is.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#089.dst: Nous avons...un plan... Pour gagner...mon peuple...à notre cause.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#089.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#090.src: Korzim has told us that dragon bone is sacred to his people. We had to make some connections, but we have a way to get it now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#090.dst: Korzim nous a dit que l'os de dragon est sacré pour son peuple. On a dû faire jouer nos relations, mais on a enfin un moyen d'en obtenir.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#090.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#091.src: If you want, you could come with us. We can explain more of the situation later. Exit's through the back.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#091.dst: Si tu veux, tu peux venir avec nous. On t'expliquera mieux la situation plus tard. La sortie est à l'arrière.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#091.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#092.src: Follow the group on the mission.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#094.src: The others...are just up ahead. I'll let you through...our tunnel.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#094.dst: Les autres...sont juste devant. Je te laisse passer...par notre tunnel.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#094.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#095.src: We use.. earth and.. fire.. elements. It is slow... like us.. but powerful.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#095.dst: Nous utilisons.. les éléments.. terre et.. feu. C'est lent... comme nous.. mais puissant.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#095.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#096.src: We use...earth and...fire...elements. It is slow...like us...but powerful.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#096.dst: Nous utilisons...les éléments...terre et...feu. C'est lent...comme nous...mais puissant.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#096.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#097.src: We don't forbid...you humans to be here, but please leave... We don't want any...unwanted dwarves here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#097.dst: Nous n'interdisons pas...aux humains d'être ici, mais partez... Nous ne voulons pas...de Nains indésirables.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#099.src: We got this drill all the way from Corkus. Axelus had to pay a king's ransom to buy it, but this ought to work!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#099.dst: On a fait venir cette foreuse de Corkus. Axelus l'a payée une fortune, mais ça devrait marcher!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#099.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#101.src: AAAAGH! Idiot Corkus swindlers! Damn it all! How many emeralds did we waste?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#101.dst: AAAAGH! Ces escrocs idiots de Corkus! Bon sang! Combien d'émeraudes on a gaspillées?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#101.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#102.src: Ugh, do you have any experience with machines? You might have some idea of how in the hell to fix this hunk of junk.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#102.dst: Pff, tu t'y connais en machines? Tu sauras peut-être comment diable réparer ce tas de ferraille.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#102.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#103.src: Fantastic, {u}! We got the bone! Couldn't have done it without you.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#103.dst: Fantastique, {u}! On a l'os! On n'y serait pas arrivés sans toi.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#103.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#104.src: You can take it back to the coalition base. Barden and I will need to pack up before we join you.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#104.dst: Tu peux le rapporter à la base de la coalition. Barden et moi devons remballer avant de te rejoindre.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#104.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#105.src: Just knock on the black block in front of the cave we arrived in.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#105.dst: Frappe simplement au bloc noir devant la grotte par laquelle on est arrivés.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#105.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#106.src: Head back to the Coalition Base through the tunnel.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#106.dst: Retournez à la base de la coalition par le tunnel.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#109.src: Dragon bone is one of the hardest substances in all the provinces. It's extremely rare.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#109.dst: L'os de dragon est l'une des matières les plus dures des provinces. Il est extrêmement rare.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#109.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#110.src: We're going to present this to the Dogun chief as tribute. We need to tidy it up.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#110.dst: On va l'offrir en tribut au chef des Doguns. Il faut le remettre en état.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#110.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#111.src: Could you get [{~} Repair Kit] from the eastern part of the base?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#111.dst: Tu pourrais aller chercher [{~} Repair Kit] dans la partie est de la base?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#111.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#112.src: Retrieve the [Repair Kit] in the eastern part of the base.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#112.dst: Récupérez le [Repair Kit] dans la partie est de la base.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#114.src: There are voices behind this wall, and the trail ends here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#114.dst: Il y a des voix derrière ce mur, et la piste s'arrête ici.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#115.src: We have no vaults here. Must be traitors... The King really wants to see Axelus.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#115.dst: Pas de chambre forte ici. Ce sont des traîtres... Le roi tient vraiment à voir Axelus.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#116.src: Stand back! I'll ready the charges...

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#118.src: No, no, ignore the repair kit! There's no time to worry about that!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#118.dst: Non, non, oublie le kit de réparation! On n'a pas le temps pour ça!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#118.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#119.src: Our position has been compromised, they blew our doors wide open! We have to evacuate immediately.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#119.dst: Notre position est compromise, ils ont fait sauter nos portes! Il faut évacuer immédiatement.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#119.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#120.src: We've never been caught like this before, they never knew we really had Doguns on our side.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#120.dst: On ne s'était jamais fait prendre comme ça, ils ignoraient qu'on avait vraiment des Doguns de notre côté.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#120.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#121.src: We need to get to safety right now! The least explored area is the Upper Heights.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#121.dst: Il faut se mettre à l'abri tout de suite! La zone la moins explorée, c'est Upper Heights.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#121.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#122.src: Everyone, out! Now! They won't follow through the rough terrain!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#122.dst: Tout le monde dehors! Vite! Ils ne nous suivront pas sur ce terrain accidenté!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#122.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#123.src: Find your way up to the Dogun Village through the tunnel.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#123.dst: Montez jusqu'au village dogun par le tunnel.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#124.src: We'll stay around here, we aren't welcome in the village.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#124.dst: On reste dans le coin, on n'est pas les bienvenus au village.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#124.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#126.src: You are free to enter the village but we will stay back and wait until the coast is clear. Keep going.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#126.dst: Tu peux entrer dans le village, mais on reste en retrait jusqu'à ce que la voie soit libre. Continue.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#126.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#127.src: What is...that on the...cliff to the south?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#127.dst: Qu'est-ce que...c'est que ça sur la...falaise au sud?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#127.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#128.src: What is... that on the... cliff to the south?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#128.dst: Qu'est-ce que... c'est que ça sur la... falaise au sud?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#128.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#129.src: Hey, aren't those...Doguns?! A whole settlement...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#129.dst: Hé, ce ne sont pas...des Doguns?! Tout un village...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#129.speaker: Dwarven Scout

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#130.src: They've been gathering forces! We must inform {p} immediately!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#130.dst: Ils rassemblent des forces! Il faut prévenir {p} immédiatement!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#130.speaker: Dwarven Scout

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#131.src: Human. Come talk to me... Now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#131.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#133.src: Human... That Dwarf, he saw us...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#133.dst: Humain... Ce Nain, il nous a vus...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#133.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#134.src: They will... destroy us... If he reports... back to {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#134.dst: Ils vont... nous détruire... S'il fait son rapport... à {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#134.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#135.src: We need to...prepare our defenses. We need all the...help we can get.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#135.dst: Nous devons...préparer nos défenses. Nous avons besoin de toute...l'aide possible.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#135.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#136.src: If you want a ticket you'll have to pay me [{~} Emerald Block].
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#136.dst: Pour un billet, vous devrez me payer [{~} bloc d'émeraude].

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#137.src: ...oh Lord, this must be why! D-Doguns?!

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#138.src: Several rumours are suggested to be propagated amongst the population.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#138.dst: Il est suggéré de propager plusieurs rumeurs au sein de la population.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#139.src: He is consorting with the enemy! Axelus, they've tainted your soul!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#139.dst: Il pactise avec l'ennemi! Axelus, ils ont souillé ton âme!

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#140.src: They will...destroy us... If he reports...back to {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#140.dst: Ils vont...nous détruire... S'il fait son rapport...à {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#140.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#141.src: "Any war could result in rioting in {p} and other established colonies."
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#141.dst: "Toute guerre pourrait provoquer des émeutes à {p} et dans d'autres colonies établies."

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#144.src: We need to... prepare our defenses. We need all the... help we can get.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#144.dst: Nous devons... préparer nos défenses. Nous avons besoin de toute... l'aide possible.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#144.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#145.src: Wait... What are...you holding? Dragon bone...? Just what we need...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#145.dst: Attends... Que tiens-tu...là? De l'os de dragon...? Ce qu'il nous faut...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#145.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#146.src: Human...if you promise to help us...I will grant you access to...our secret elevators... You can get up and...down the heights with those.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#146.dst: Humain...si tu promets de nous aider...je t'ouvrirai l'accès à...nos ascenseurs secrets... Avec eux, tu pourras monter et...descendre les Heights.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#146.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#147.src: Please return to...us when you reach level {~}. Take this...badge so the...others recognize you...as an ally. One of the elevators is...to the south.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#147.dst: Reviens nous voir...quand tu atteindras le niveau {~}. Prends cet...insigne pour que les...autres te reconnaissent...comme un allié. L'un des ascenseurs se trouve...au sud.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#147.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#148.src: Ugh, that was horrible.. Like I said before, this war was a genocide. Don't believe any of the lies they try and feed you.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#148.dst: Pff, c'était horrible.. Je te l'ai dit, cette guerre était un génocide. Ne crois aucun des mensonges qu'on essaie de te faire avaler.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#148.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#149.src: Make your way to the Dogun festival at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] by following the red banners outside {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#149.dst: Rejoignez la fête dogun en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] en suivant les bannières rouges hors de {p}.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#150.src: Looks like Axelus dropped a note...? Doesn't seem like anyone else noticed.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#150.dst: On dirait qu'Axelus a laissé tomber une note...? Personne d'autre ne semble l'avoir remarqué.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#151.src: Seems like Axelus had more to say. Since no one else picked up the note, you may as well seek him out.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#151.dst: Axelus avait apparemment plus à dire. Puisque personne d'autre n'a ramassé la note, autant aller le trouver.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#152.src: Find out more about the hysterical dwarf in {p}'s prison at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#152.dst: Renseignez-vous sur le nain hystérique de la prison de {p}, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#153.src: You came at the right time, {u}. It's good to see you're still interested in what's really going on here..
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#153.dst: Tu arrives au bon moment, {u}. Ça fait plaisir de voir que ce qui se passe vraiment ici t'intéresse toujours..
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#153.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#154.src: I've told you this already, but you have to know that it really is true. The Dwarves have been lied to for so long about the war.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#154.dst: Je te l'ai déjà dit, mais sache que c'est vraiment vrai. On ment aux Nains sur la guerre depuis si longtemps.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#154.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#155.src: ..But I think it's best if you see it for yourself. Relying on my word alone won't be enough to grasp the full extent of this dilemma.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#155.dst: ..Mais je pense que le mieux, c'est que tu le voies par toi-même. Ma parole seule ne suffira pas à saisir toute l'ampleur de ce dilemme.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#155.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#156.src: It seems like Axelus slipped another note into your pocket.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#156.dst: Axelus semble vous avoir glissé une autre note dans la poche.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#156.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#157.src: That gate must be the entrance to the Library that Axelus mentioned, but it looks locked tight. Could anything in the area open it up?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#157.dst: Cette grille doit être l'entrée de la Bibliothèque dont parlait Axelus, mais elle est bien verrouillée. Quelque chose ici pourrait-il l'ouvrir?

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#158.src: It's an extremely old book. The pages are torn, yellowed, and dusty.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#158.dst: Un livre extrêmement ancien. Les pages sont déchirées, jaunies et poussiéreuses.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#159.src: "Top Secret"? The words are faded and hard to make out.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#159.dst: "Top secret"? Les mots sont effacés et difficiles à déchiffrer.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#160.src: It seems to be a report written at the start of the Dogun war.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#160.dst: On dirait un rapport rédigé au début de la guerre contre les Doguns.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#161.src: "The natives occupy {~} of the habitable land in the heights..."
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#161.dst: "Les autochtones occupent {~} des terres habitables des hauteurs..."

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#162.src: Several pages are dedicated to the Doguns personalities, traits and powers.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#162.dst: Plusieurs pages sont consacrées à la personnalité, aux traits et aux pouvoirs des Doguns.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#165.src: "Clearance is needed if Dwarves are going to form a colony..."
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#165.dst: "Un nettoyage est nécessaire si les Nains veulent fonder une colonie..."

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#166.src: According to the report, the land was once rich with minerals and materials.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#166.dst: Selon le rapport, la terre était autrefois riche en minerais et en matériaux.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#167.src: This page appears to have been ripped out and crudely reattached.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#167.dst: Cette page semble avoir été arrachée puis grossièrement recollée.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#168.src: "A program of public profiling of the natives is recommended..."
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#168.dst: "Un programme de profilage public des autochtones est recommandé..."

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#169.src: There are detailed instructions on producing propaganda against the Doguns.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#169.dst: On y trouve des instructions détaillées pour produire de la propagande contre les Doguns.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#170.src: "...recommend they are referred to as demons, as inherent fear will take hold..."
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#170.dst: "...recommandé de les appeler démons, car la peur innée prendra le dessus..."

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#171.src: The report details propaganda at all levels of society, particularly at educational centers.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#171.dst: Le rapport détaille la propagande à tous les niveaux de la société, surtout dans les écoles.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#172.src: "Once public opinion is sufficiently hostile, establishment of colonies will be achievable..."
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#172.dst: "Une fois l'opinion publique suffisamment hostile, l'établissement de colonies sera réalisable..."

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#173.src: The report goes on to detail the total dominance of {p} and the importance of propaganda continuation.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#173.dst: Le rapport détaille ensuite la domination totale de {p} et l'importance de poursuivre la propagande.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#174.src: Now do you see? Everything that I told you about when we rescued those flerisi was indeed true...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#174.dst: Tu vois, maintenant? Tout ce que je t'ai raconté quand on a secouru ces Flerisi était bien vrai...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#174.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#175.src: Search for house number {~} in {p} like Axelus said.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#175.dst: Cherchez la maison numéro {~} à {p}, comme l'a dit Axelus.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#179.src: To repair the mechanical core, select a colour and connect the clay with the same coloured glass block by clicking the iron blocks with the Rewiring Tool.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#179.dst: Pour réparer le noyau mécanique, choisissez une couleur et reliez l'argile au bloc de verre de la même couleur en cliquant sur les blocs de fer avec le Rewiring Tool.
