Dwarves and Doguns Part I#180.src: Head back to the coalition through the tunnel at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#180.dst: Retournez voir la coalition par le tunnel en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#181.src: The king has sent for you personally.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#181.dst: Le roi vous fait mander en personne.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#181.speaker: Pens'r

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#182.src: If you don't come with us we wi-
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#182.dst: Si vous ne venez pas avec nous, nous al-
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#182.speaker: Pens'r

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#183.src: Entomb these Doguns, and slay their Dwarven thralls!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#183.dst: Emmurez ces Doguns, et tuez leurs esclaves nains!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#183.speaker: Pens'r

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#184.src: But...bring them...the dragon bone...as a gift. If they accept it...they might accept us.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#184.dst: Mais...apportons-leur...l'os de dragon...en cadeau. S'ils l'acceptent...ils nous accepteront peut-être.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#184.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#185.src: We need to solve...this conflict somehow. Please...help us.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#185.dst: Il faut résoudre...ce conflit, coûte que coûte. Aide-nous...je t'en prie.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#185.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#000.src: The Royal Guards escort you and Axelus out of the palace.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#000.dst: Les gardes royaux vous escortent, Axelus et vous, hors du palais.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#001.src: Aval...would have us...leave the Heights... But we...would not survive...in large numbers.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#001.dst: Aval...voudrait que nous...quittions les Heights... Mais nous...ne survivrions pas...en grand nombre.

similar.text: Aval... would have us... leave the Heights... But we... would not survive.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#002.src: Return to the Dogun village with a Dogun Badge of Trust and talk to the leader of the town
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#002.dst: Retournez au village dogun avec un Dogun Badge of Trust et parlez au chef du village

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#003.src: You are so young...to be fighting...a war so old. Still...it is appreciated.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#003.dst: Tu es si jeune...pour mener...une guerre si ancienne. Pourtant...c'est apprécié.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#003.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#004.src: Why...would we trust... Why...would we trust... you...of all Dwarves?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#004.dst: Pourquoi...croire... Pourquoi...croire... en toi...entre tous les Nains?

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#005.dst: Nous avons appris ce qui s'est passé, {u}.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#006.src: The war...to you, it would be...ages ago. But...when one has lived for...{~} years...
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#006.dst: La guerre...pour toi, ce serait...il y a une éternité. Mais...quand on a vécu...{~} ans...
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#006.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#007.src: We have...few options. We need to discuss...the few we have...available.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#007.dst: Nous avons...peu d'options. Nous devons discuter...des rares qui nous...restent.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#007.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#009.src: I am sorry...to welcome you all...in such troubled times.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#009.dst: Je suis désolé...de vous accueillir...en des temps si troublés.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#009.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#010.src: We thought...we could hide in safety... But there is...no place left to hide.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#010.dst: Nous pensions...pouvoir nous cacher... Mais il n'y a plus...aucune cachette.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#010.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#011.src: Aval... would have us... leave the Heights... But we... would not survive.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#011.dst: Aval... voudrait que nous... quittions les Heights... Mais nous... ne survivrions pas.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#011.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#012.src: We must...evacuate the settlement...immediately. They...are coming...again.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#012.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#013.src: [New Quest Started: Dwarves and Doguns Part II]
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#013.dst: [Nouvelle quête commencée: Dwarves et Doguns, partie II]

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#015.src: Please! You all know me, I'm not with the side of the government. Hear me out, we can fix this!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#015.dst: Je vous en prie! Vous me connaissez, je ne suis pas avec le gouvernement. Écoutez-moi, on peut arranger ça!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#015.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#017.src: Stop! I have been hiding from the Dwarves just as much as anyone here, they've been after me too!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#017.dst: Arrêtez! Je me cache des Nains autant que n'importe qui ici, ils me traquent moi aussi!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#017.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#018.src: Why... would we... trust you... of all Dwarves?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#018.dst: Pourquoi... croire... en toi... entre tous les Nains?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#018.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#019.src: How...could you even help? They...won't listen to you.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#019.dst: Comment...pourrais-tu seulement aider? Ils...ne t'écouteront pas.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#019.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#020.src: I know all the war strategies and weapon cache locations.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#020.dst: Je connais toutes les stratégies et les caches d'armes.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#020.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#021.src: Treason...against your own kind...? How will you...manage this?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#021.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#022.src: The human and I will sneak into the armoury and sabotage their equipment. Korzim will help you Doguns evacuate someplace safer.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#022.dst: L'humain et moi, on va s'infiltrer dans l'armurerie et saboter leur matériel. Korzim aidera les Doguns à évacuer en lieu sûr.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#022.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#023.src: I am...yet wary of you...but we will...follow your plan...Dwarf. Korzim...lead us...to safety.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#023.dst: Je me méfie...encore de toi...mais nous suivrons...ton plan...Nain. Korzim...conduis-nous...en lieu sûr.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#023.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#024.src: {u}, follow the southern road from {p}, towards the {p} entrance. I'll be waiting there for you near the armoury.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#024.dst: {u}, suis la route du sud depuis {p}, vers l'entrée de {p}. Je t'attendrai là-bas, près de l'armurerie.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#024.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#026.src: Shh! Get behind here, and look towards the armoury doors.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#026.dst: Chut! Mets-toi derrière ici, et regarde vers les portes de l'armurerie.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#026.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#027.src: We need to sneak in when they aren't looking, got it? But we need to be fast.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#027.dst: Il faut entrer quand ils ne regardent pas, compris? Mais vite.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#027.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#028.src: If they close that door, we'll only have one option left, and it's a huge risk. Those Dwarven gates are almost unbreakable.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#028.dst: S'ils ferment cette porte, il ne nous restera qu'une option, et elle est très risquée. Ces portails nains sont presque indestructibles.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#028.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#029.src: Alright boys, let's close this up and head to base B.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#029.dst: Bon, les gars, on ferme ici et on file à la base B.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#029.speaker: Rodoroc Commander

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#030.src: Aaah! Charge them! HEY, STOP RIGHT THERE, SOLDIERS!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#030.dst: Aaah! A l'attaque! HÉ, PAS UN GESTE, SOLDATS!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#030.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#031.src: Defeat the {p} Guards outside the armory.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#031.dst: Battez les gardes de {p} devant l'armurerie.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#032.src: It's the traitor! Capture them, now! There's only one reason they would be near the armoury!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#032.dst: C'est le traître! Capturez-les! Ils ne peuvent être près de l'armurerie que pour une raison!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#032.speaker: Commander

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#033.src: Is that all of them? We're out of danger, at least, but they still shut the door, damn it!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#033.dst: C'est tout? On est hors de danger, au moins, mais ils ont quand même fermé la porte, bon sang!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#033.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#034.src: Gah, all that for nothing! You're not too banged up, are you?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#034.dst: Bah, tout ça pour rien! Tu n'es pas trop amoché, hein?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#034.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#035.src: Well, I said there's another way, but it's not a guarantee. Hurry, follow me.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#035.dst: Bon, j'ai dit qu'il y avait un autre moyen, mais rien n'est garanti. Vite, suis-moi.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#035.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#036.src: Urgh, damn it. They almost never bother to close this door, and now of all times...
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#036.dst: Argh, bon sang. Ils ne ferment presque jamais cette porte, et il faut que ce soit maintenant...
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#036.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#037.src: There's nothing for it. They'll be sending reinforcements soon, we need a way through here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#037.dst: Pas le choix. Ils vont bientôt envoyer des renforts, il nous faut un moyen de passer.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#037.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#038.src: Those black bricks look breakable...but that won't solve the door, will it?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#038.dst: Ces briques noires ont l'air fragiles...mais ça n'ouvre pas la porte, si?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#038.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#039.src: Find a way to break through the black bricks outside the wooden door.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#039.dst: Trouvez un moyen de percer les briques noires près de la porte en bois.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#041.src: Alright, let's destroy these machines! You see the two cannons?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#041.dst: Bon, détruisons ces machines! Tu vois les deux canons?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#041.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#042.src: If you use rocks as ammo, you'll destroy the machine it's aiming at, but if you use tnt, it'll selfdestruct. Good luck
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#042.dst: Avec des pierres comme munitions, tu détruiras la machine visée, mais avec de la tnt, il s'autodétruira. Bonne chance
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#042.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#043.src: Follow Axelus deeper into {p} and destroy the power source of the city, the {p} Power Core.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#043.dst: Suivez Axelus au coeur de {p} et détruisez la source d'énergie de la ville, le noyau d'énergie de {p}.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#044.src: Nice work! That will slow them down. We're not done yet, we need to pay the king a visit. Let's head further into {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#044.dst: Beau travail! Ça va les ralentir. On n'a pas fini, il faut rendre visite au roi. Enfonçons-nous dans {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#044.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#045.src: Hurry! Through here, to the power core!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#045.dst: Vite! Par ici, vers le noyau d'énergie!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#045.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#046.src: This is a geothermal power core. If we can disrupt it, it should slow them down.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#046.dst: C'est un noyau d'énergie géothermique. Si on le perturbe, ça devrait les ralentir.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#046.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#047.src: The hypocrites used Dogun magic to make this... It's lucky, honestly. I know how to work it.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#047.dst: Ces hypocrites ont fait ça avec la magie dogun... Une chance, franchement. Je sais m'en servir.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#047.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#048.src: ...hell, they already rallied?! That's the army!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#048.dst: ...bon sang, ils se sont déjà rassemblés?! C'est l'armée!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#048.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#049.src: That sounds like an entire battalion!! How did they know I was going after this?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#049.dst: On dirait tout un bataillon!! Comment savaient-ils que je visais ça?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#049.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#050.src: Dogun magic is slow! Keep me defended, this'll take awhile!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#050.dst: La magie dogun est lente! Protège-moi, ça va prendre un moment!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#050.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#051.src: Grr, this is harder than I thought!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#051.dst: Grr, c'est plus dur que prévu!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#051.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#052.src: Ah! Don't let them get too close!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#052.dst: Ah! Ne les laisse pas trop approcher!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#052.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#054.src: I hate that you're having to fight my people, but I wouldn't be asking for help if it weren't needed.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#054.dst: Je déteste te forcer à combattre mon peuple, mais je ne demanderais pas d'aide si ce n'était pas nécessaire.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#054.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#055.src: Hm...the slums should be behind this wall here. We'll lose them there.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#055.dst: Hm...les bas quartiers devraient être derrière ce mur. On les sèmera là-bas.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#055.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#056.src: The power's down, but...that cannon should do to get us through. You know how to operate it, right?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#056.dst: Plus de courant, mais...ce canon devrait nous ouvrir la voie. Tu sais t'en servir, hein?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#056.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#057.src: Dwarvern society isn't as great as they make it out to be. The poorest are hidden away.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#057.dst: La société naine n'est pas aussi merveilleuse qu'on le prétend. Les plus pauvres sont cachés.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#057.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#058.src: The coalition has helped these people through some hard times, we can trust them.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#058.dst: La coalition a aidé ces gens dans des moments difficiles, on peut leur faire confiance.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#058.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#059.src: There's a reason I brought us here. The sewer system is connected to the royal palace. All the way to the kings bathroom.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#059.dst: Je nous ai amenés ici pour une raison. Les égouts sont reliés au palais royal. Jusqu'à la salle de bains du roi.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#059.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#060.src: We need to find a way to ignite this explosive. Can you take a look around?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#060.dst: Il faut trouver un moyen d'allumer cet explosif. Tu peux jeter un oeil autour?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#060.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#061.src: Find a way to enter the sewer system.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#061.dst: Trouvez un moyen d'entrer dans les égouts.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#062.src: If we can convince the king that it’s not worth the fight, he may back down.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#062.dst: Si on convainc le roi que ce combat n'en vaut pas la peine, il reculera peut-être.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#062.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#063.src: I'm a little ashamed to admit I know my way round the sewers by now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#063.dst: J'ai un peu honte de l'avouer, mais je connais les égouts par coeur maintenant.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#063.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#064.src: You have to understand.. The people truly think the Doguns are evil incarnate. But the king knows better.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#064.dst: Comprends bien.. Le peuple croit vraiment que les Doguns sont le mal incarné. Mais le roi, lui, sait.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#064.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#065.src: Enter the Royal Palace through the sewer pipe and find the king.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#065.dst: Entrez dans le palais royal par le tuyau des égouts et trouvez le roi.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#066.src: Don't let the guards catch you. Stay out of sight, got it?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#066.dst: Ne te fais pas attraper par les gardes. Reste hors de vue, compris?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#066.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#067.src: Sneak past the guards and talk to the Dwarven King.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#067.dst: Faufilez-vous entre les gardes et parlez au roi des Nains.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#068.src: I can't say I'm surprised, Axelus. Guards, let them be.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#068.dst: Je ne peux pas dire que je sois surpris, Axelus. Gardes, laissez-les.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#068.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#069.src: You know why I'm here, father. We haven't got any more chances to stop this.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#069.dst: Tu sais pourquoi je suis là, père. On n'aura pas d'autre chance d'arrêter ça.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#069.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#070.src: Axelus, you know why we have to maintain the lie. Think about the people, how they would react.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#070.dst: Axelus, tu sais pourquoi nous devons entretenir le mensonge. Pense au peuple, à sa réaction.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#070.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#071.src: We can not be responsible for the lies of our ancestors! This is ridiculous and you know it!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#071.dst: On ne peut pas porter les mensonges de nos ancêtres! C'est ridicule, et tu le sais!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#071.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#072.src: Axelus, if the people found out, everything would descend to chaos. There would be riots, revolutions!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#072.dst: Axelus, si le peuple l'apprenait, tout sombrerait dans le chaos. Il y aurait des émeutes, des révolutions!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#072.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#073.src: If you hadn't turned traitor and gone gallivanting off with the Doguns, you would be in a better position to convince me.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#073.dst: Si tu n'étais pas devenu un traître parti batifoler avec les Doguns, tu serais mieux placé pour me convaincre.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#073.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#074.src: As it is now, you are too little and too late. The war has already begun.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#074.dst: En l'état, c'est trop peu, trop tard. La guerre a déjà commencé.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#074.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#075.src: The armoury that a certain someone decided to sabotage won't make any difference.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#075.dst: L'armurerie que quelqu'un a décidé de saboter n'y changera rien.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#075.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#076.src: You will commit genocide so you don't have to face the consequences of your lies?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#076.dst: Tu vas commettre un génocide pour ne pas avoir à assumer tes mensonges?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#076.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#077.src: I will be the hero of our nation, and my name will forever be remembered as the King who brought peace.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#077.dst: Je serai le héros de notre nation, et mon nom restera à jamais celui du roi qui a apporté la paix.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#077.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#078.src: I have nothing left to say to you. See yourselves out behind the throne. I'll let you use the trading tunnel to {p} in the southern caves, if you just step back and let me handle things.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#078.dst: Je n'ai plus rien à te dire. Sortez par derrière le trône. Je vous laisserai emprunter le tunnel commercial vers {p} dans les grottes du sud, si tu te retires et me laisses gérer.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#078.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#080.src: I'm not giving up on this. I'm going back in, I know he can be reasoned with!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#080.dst: Je n'abandonne pas. J'y retourne, je sais qu'on peut le raisonner!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#080.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#081.src: Give this letter to Korzim in the Dogun village when you reach level {~}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#081.dst: Donne cette lettre à Korzim au village dogun quand tu atteindras le niveau {~}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#081.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#082.src: I'm going to have one last talk with my father.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#082.dst: Je vais avoir une dernière conversation avec mon père.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#082.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#083.src: You shouldn't enter this place yet!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#083.dst: Vous ne devriez pas encore entrer ici!

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#084.src: The {p} Power Core has been disrupted!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#084.dst: Le noyau d'énergie de {p} a été perturbé!

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#085.src: Follow Axelus deeper into {p} and destroy the power source of the city.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#085.dst: Suivez Axelus au coeur de {p} et détruisez la source d'énergie de la ville.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#087.src: Leave the Royal Palace at the end of the palace.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#087.dst: Quittez le palais royal par le fond du palais.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#089.src: Leave now and I won't send the Dwarven army on you. You don't want to get hunted like the Doguns, do you?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#089.dst: Partez maintenant, et je ne lancerai pas l'armée naine à vos trousses. Vous ne voulez pas être traqué comme les Doguns?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#089.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#090.src: And Axelus, leave the city. You are no longer my son.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#090.dst: Et toi, Axelus, quitte la ville. Tu n'es plus mon fils.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#090.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#000.src: {u}...I take back my statement. They have already begun... There cannot be reasoning.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#000.dst: {u}...je retire ce que j'ai dit. Ils ont déjà commencé... On ne peut plus raisonner.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#001.src: A door slamming open is heard in the distance...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#001.dst: On entend au loin une porte s'ouvrir violemment...

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#002.src: Return to the Dogun Village with the letter and speak to Korzim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#002.dst: Retournez au village dogun avec la lettre et parlez à Korzim.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#003.src: We...have an issue. A dire one... Where is...Axelus at a time...like this?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#003.dst: Nous...avons un problème. Un problème grave... Où est...Axelus dans un moment...pareil?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#003.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#005.src: Oh... From Axelus, then...? He could not find...a stone? That...does not bode well.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#005.dst: Oh... D'Axelus, alors...? Il n'a pas trouvé...de pierre? Mauvais...présage.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#005.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#006.src: He is trying to...reason with the Dwarven King? There is...no one else...then. You... You will have to...help.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#006.dst: Il essaie de...raisonner le roi des Nains? Alors...il n'y a...personne d'autre. Toi... Tu vas devoir...aider.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#006.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#007.src: The chieftain is...desperate. He has enacted a...terrible plan. They are planning on summoning Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#007.dst: Le chef est...désespéré. Il a lancé un...plan terrible. Ils prévoient d'invoquer Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#007.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#008.src: If they succeed...we all die. Dwarves... Doguns... Possibly even Villagers...and then... Humans as well.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#008.dst: S'ils réussissent...nous mourrons tous. Nains... Doguns... Peut-être même les villageois...puis... les humains.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#008.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#009.src: Garaheth is a...horrible demon. We used to worship him...thousands of years ago.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#009.dst: Garaheth est un...démon horrible. Nous le vénérions...il y a des milliers d'années.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#009.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#010.src: I only overheard parts... But enough to be certain. They are preparing...to the south. At a disused...ritual site.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#010.dst: Je n'ai entendu que des bribes... Mais assez pour en être sûr. Ils se préparent...au sud. Sur un ancien...site rituel.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#010.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#011.src: Meet me there... Do not just attack. We may be able to...resolve it peacefully. I will wait...by the staircase.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#011.dst: Retrouve-moi là-bas... N'attaque pas. Nous pourrons peut-être...régler ça en paix. Je t'attendrai...à l'escalier.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#011.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#012.src: Investigate the structure to the south.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#013.src: We shall take the east tower... Hide there...and watch.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#013.dst: Nous prendrons la tour est... Cache-toi là...et observe.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#013.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#014.src: Interrupting...at this point will have...disastrous consequences. We must let them continue...and pray they fail.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#014.dst: Les interrompre...maintenant aurait...des conséquences désastreuses. Laissons-les continuer...et prions pour qu'ils échouent.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#014.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#015.src: Reach into the darkness...and grasp the hand of Garaheth to purge the intruders...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#015.dst: Plongez dans les ténèbres...et saisissez la main de Garaheth pour purger les intrus...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#015.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#016.src: This is a worst-case scenario... Meet me in {p}. We will talk more there...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#016.dst: C'est le pire des scénarios... Retrouve-moi à {p}. Nous en reparlerons là-bas...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#016.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#018.src: Hoho...! Over here...fine traveler! Join me at the gates!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#018.dst: Hoho...! Par ici...noble voyageur! Rejoins-moi aux portes!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#018.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#019.src: This dwarf voice is...horrible on my throat...but it is an effective disguise...is it not?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#019.dst: Cette voix de nain est...horrible pour ma gorge...mais le déguisement est efficace...n'est-ce pas?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#019.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#020.src: We are headed to...a blacksmith in town. Follow me...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#020.dst: Nous allons voir...un forgeron en ville. Suis-moi...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#020.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#022.src: ...Korzim...what in the name of all that is holy is that disguise?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#022.dst: ...Korzim...par tout ce qui est sacré, c'est quoi ce déguisement?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#022.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#023.src: I'm flabbergasted you fooled anyone with that thing! How did you stop the beard from burning?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#023.dst: Je suis sidérée que tu aies dupé qui que ce soit avec ce truc! Comment ta barbe n'a pas brûlé?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#023.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#024.src: But, erm...more importantly, who's the bucko in the fancy armour there?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#024.dst: Mais, euh...surtout, c'est qui, le gaillard dans sa belle armure?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#024.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#025.src: An ally...of the coalition. No time...Edula. Doguns... summoning... Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#025.dst: Un allié...de la coalition. Pas le temps...Edula. Doguns... invoquent... Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#025.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#026.src: So...so it's really down to that low, then. Burning your own house down to kill the rats.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#026.dst: Alors...alors on en est vraiment là. Brûler sa propre maison pour tuer les rats.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#026.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#027.src: Good thing we've got this prepared. One fallout will prevent the next. Soldier, I've got a list of materials we need!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#027.dst: Heureusement qu'on a préparé ça. Une catastrophe en évitera une autre. Soldat, j'ai une liste de matériaux!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#027.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#028.src: You will need [{~} Fire Webs] . The Heatscar Spiders under the town make them, there's a cave right by the entrance arch.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#028.dst: Il te faudra [{~} Fire Webs] . Les Heatscar Spiders sous la ville les tissent, il y a une grotte juste à côté de l'arche d'entrée.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#028.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#029.src: Then, [{~} Magmatic Crystals] from the {p} mines. I'd get them myself, but...I'm banned from there since the rubber mallet incident.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#029.dst: Ensuite, [{~} Magmatic Crystals] des mines de {p}. J'irais bien moi-même, mais...j'y suis bannie depuis l'incident du maillet en caoutchouc.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#029.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#030.src: Lastly, [{~} Crystallized Lava]. The closest source is in the lava lake just outside {p}. There's a protruding crater in the lake.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#030.dst: Enfin, [{~} Crystallized Lava]. La source la plus proche est le lac de lave juste à côté de {p}. Un cratère dépasse dans le lac.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#030.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#031.src: Bring back [{~} Fire Webs], [{~} Magmatic Crystals], and [{~} Crystallized lava].
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#031.dst: Rapportez [{~} Fire Webs], [{~} Magmatic Crystals] et [{~} Crystallized lava].

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#032.src: The crystal formation... It is definitely here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#032.dst: La formation de cristal... Elle est bien ici.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#032.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#033.src: I will clear the lava... On my signal, move. And do not stop.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#033.dst: Je vais dégager la lave... A mon signal, cours. Et ne t'arrête pas.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#033.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#035.src: Mhm, looks like everything's in order. Now, for a short explanation.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#035.dst: Mhm, on dirait que tout est en ordre. Maintenant, une petite explication.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#035.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#036.src: These materials go into crafting a special charm. It will allow you to resist demon fire.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#036.dst: Ces matériaux servent à fabriquer une amulette spéciale, qui te protégera du feu démoniaque.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#036.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#037.src: We need to account for if they finish the summoning, so this'll help keep you safe if you end up having to square off with Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#037.dst: Il faut prévoir le cas où ils achèveraient l'invocation, alors ceci te protégera si tu dois affronter Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#037.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#038.src: You will need to craft it yourself, so its magic will bond to you. I've got a station just for it.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#038.dst: Tu devras la fabriquer toi-même, pour que sa magie se lie à toi. J'ai un poste prévu pour ça.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#038.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#039.src: Right-click the crafting table in the back and put it together.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#039.dst: Fais un clic droit sur l'établi du fond et assemble-la.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#039.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#040.src: Craft the amulet in the crafting table.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#041.src: We must... visit... Sanba... the enchanter.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#041.dst: Nous devons... rendre visite... à Sanba... l'enchanteresse.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#041.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#042.src: Go to the enchanter and enchant the amulet.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#042.dst: Allez voir l'enchanteresse et enchantez l'amulette.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#043.src: Erm...Korzim, what on earth are you doing here? It's not safe for you!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#043.dst: Euh...Korzim, qu'est-ce que tu fiches ici? Ce n'est pas sûr pour toi!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#043.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#044.src: Wait, that amulet...oh no, really? Okay, I know what's going on.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#044.dst: Attends, cette amulette...oh non, sérieux? Bon, je sais ce qui se passe.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#044.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#045.src: We're going to need to give this a little extra kick if you're going to use this for what I think you are.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#045.dst: Il va falloir lui donner un petit coup de pouce si tu comptes l'utiliser pour ce que je crois.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#045.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#046.src: A pinch of fire scarab tail, splash of sulphur, exactly three ounces of old brimstone...!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#046.dst: Une pincée de queue de scarabée de feu, un trait de soufre, trois onces pile de vieux soufre natif...!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#046.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#047.src: Infunde hoc monile, alta intra monte. Magia!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#047.dst: Infunde hoc monile, alta intra monte. Magia!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#047.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#048.src: Meet me in the back, we can't talk out here. You never know who's listening...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#048.dst: Viens dans l'arrière-boutique, on ne peut pas parler ici. On ne sait jamais qui écoute...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#048.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#049.src: Enter the storage room in the enchanter's house.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#049.dst: Entrez dans la réserve de la maison de l'enchanteresse.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#050.src: Supposing you're here to help, Soldier. Garaheth's being summoned if you're getting this...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#050.dst: Tu viens aider, j'imagine, soldat. Si tu as ça, c'est qu'on invoque Garaheth...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#050.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#051.src: Axelus prepped a contingency plan for this, but having to put it in action is surreal. Let me fill you in.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#051.dst: Axelus avait préparé un plan de secours pour ça, mais devoir l'appliquer, c'est surréaliste. Je t'explique.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#051.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#052.src: That dragon skeleton lying in the Heights belonged to an Ice Drake. Centuries ago, it was used in the Dogun wars.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#052.dst: Ce squelette de dragon dans les Heights était celui d'un Ice Drake. Il y a des siècles, il a servi contre les Doguns.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#052.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#053.src: It had incredibly potent magic, particularly in its icy breath. The area it hit is still frozen to this day, and shows no signs of thaw.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#053.dst: Sa magie était incroyablement puissante, surtout son souffle glacé. La zone qu'il a frappée est encore gelée aujourd'hui, sans signe de dégel.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#053.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#054.src: According to Axelus' stories, its breath travelled through the tunnels and coalesced someplace deep within...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#054.dst: D'après les histoires d'Axelus, son souffle a traversé les tunnels et s'est condensé quelque part dans les profondeurs...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#054.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#055.src: ...becoming True Ice, a potent mixture of sheer cold and magic energy. That's what we will need to combat Garaheth.'
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#055.dst: ...devenant le True Ice, un puissant mélange de froid pur et d'énergie magique. C'est ce qu'il nous faut contre Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#055.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#056.src: If you bring me [{~} True Ice] I can make a staff capable of harnessing it...and we can freeze Garaheth in its tracks.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#056.dst: Si tu m'apportes [{~} True Ice], je peux fabriquer un bâton capable de le canaliser...et on pourra figer Garaheth sur place.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#056.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#057.src: If you bring me [{~} True Ice] I can make a staff capable of harnessing it...and we can freeze Garahath in its tracks.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#057.dst: Si tu m'apportes [{~} True Ice], je peux fabriquer un bâton capable de le canaliser...et on pourra figer Garaheth sur place.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#057.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#058.src: Me and my husband will support the coalition as long as we live.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#058.dst: Mon mari et moi soutiendrons la coalition tant que nous vivrons.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#058.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#059.src: Head north to the Freezing Heights and make your way to the top, now! We've got no time at all!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#059.dst: Va au nord, vers les Freezing Heights, et grimpe jusqu'au sommet, maintenant! On n'a plus une minute!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#059.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#060.src: Travel to the frozen heights and find {~} True Ice.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#060.dst: Rendez-vous dans les hauteurs gelées et trouvez {~} True Ice.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#061.src: {u}... This... This used to be...a Dogun town. The Dwarves rendered it barren.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#061.dst: {u}... Ceci... Ceci était...une ville dogun. Les Nains en ont fait un désert.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#061.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#062.src: They used the Drake... They chained it up and...forced it to attack. We had to kill it...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#062.dst: Ils ont utilisé le Drake... Ils l'ont enchaîné et...forcé à attaquer. Nous avons dû le tuer...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#062.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#063.src: It...froze my town...as it died. I was there...{~} years ago.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#063.dst: Il a...gelé ma ville...en mourant. J'y étais...il y a {~} ans.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#063.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#064.src: I know the way... into the caves.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#064.dst: Je connais le chemin... vers les grottes.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#064.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#065.src: The True Ice...is deep inside. I will struggle to...stay warm here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#065.dst: Le True Ice...est tout au fond. J'aurai du mal à...garder ma chaleur ici.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#065.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#066.src: I will try to run through...as quickly as possible. The ice is...painful.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#066.dst: Je vais essayer de traverser...le plus vite possible. La glace est...douloureuse.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#066.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#067.src: We must... move fast... or... we will both.... freeze.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#067.dst: Nous devons... faire vite... ou... nous allons tous deux.... geler.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#067.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#068.src: Maybe... I am... hotter than... I thought... do you.. Hear that?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#068.dst: Peut-être... suis-je... plus chaud que... je ne pensais... tu.. Entends ça?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#068.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#069.src: Oh no... I think... It's... COLLAPSING.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#069.dst: Oh non... Je crois... que ça... S'EFFONDRE.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#069.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#070.src: My... feet are... solid... Keep... running.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#070.dst: Mes... pieds sont... gelés... Continue... à courir.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#070.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#071.src: This is it... The thing that... Killed my families... [{~} True Ice].
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#071.dst: C'est ça... La chose qui a... Tué les miens... [{~} True Ice].
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#071.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#072.src: Return to the enchanter with the True Ice.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#072.dst: Rapportez le True Ice à l'enchanteresse.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#073.src: Impressive, you two. Must've been tough to get that...doubly so for Korzim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#073.dst: Impressionnant, vous deux. Ça a dû être dur à obtenir...et deux fois plus pour Korzim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#073.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#074.src: Impressive, you two. Must have been tough to get that...doubly so for Korzim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#074.dst: Impressionnant, vous deux. Ça a dû être dur à obtenir...doublement pour Korzim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#074.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#075.src: Here is the staff, {u}. Keep it safe, and don't you go dying on us.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#075.dst: Voici le bâton, {u}. Prends-en soin, et ne va pas mourir, hein.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#075.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#076.src: My husband and I will round up the coalition and get them to act now. We need to get going before-
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#076.dst: Mon mari et moi allons rassembler la coalition et la faire agir maintenant. On doit partir avant que-
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#076.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#077.src: ...that's the barracks door. That's the barracks door!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#077.dst: ...c'est la porte de la caserne. C'est la porte de la caserne!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#077.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#078.src: Men! We have to meet for briefing on the surface, the war is due any hour now! Move faster!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#078.dst: Soldats! Briefing à la surface, la guerre peut éclater d'une heure à l'autre! Plus vite!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#078.speaker: Maex Soldier

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#079.src: They're already going?! We're out of time! Korzim is waiting for you just upstairs when you reach level {~}. Go train! NOW!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#079.dst: Ils partent déjà?! On n'a plus le temps! Korzim t'attend juste en haut quand tu auras le niveau {~}. Va t'entraîner! TOUT DE SUITE!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#079.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#080.src: Return to the Dogun village with the letter and speak to Korzim at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#080.dst: Retournez au village dogun avec la lettre et parlez à Korzim en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#081.src: Korzim reads the message on the tablet silently. His expression is inscrutable.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#081.dst: Korzim lit en silence le message de la tablette. Son expression est indéchiffrable.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#082.src: Travel to {p} and meet Korzim at the entrance at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#082.dst: Rendez-vous à {p} et retrouvez Korzim à l'entrée, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#084.src: Good job collecting the tools needed to destroy the demon.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#084.dst: Bien joué, tu as réuni les outils nécessaires pour détruire le démon.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#084.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#085.src: Go to the enchanter and enchant the amulet at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#085.dst: Allez voir l'enchanteresse et enchantez l'amulette en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#086.src: Travel through the Freezing Heights and get [{~} True Ice].
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#086.dst: Traversez les Freezing Heights et obtenez [{~} True Ice].

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#087.src: The ice has trapped you. Try again.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#087.dst: La glace vous a piégé. Réessayez.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#088.src: If you're having trouble finding the crater, look for the reddest rocks in amongst the others in the lake. They should lead you to it.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#088.dst: Si tu as du mal à trouver le cratère, cherche les roches les plus rouges parmi celles du lac. Elles t'y mèneront.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#088.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#000.src: Quiet. Dwarven whelp...you have failed... We will not go quietly. AWAKEN.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#000.dst: Silence. Avorton nain...tu as échoué... Nous ne céderons pas. ÉVEILLE-TOI.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#000.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#001.src: {u}... Do you have...the staff? And the amulet...?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#001.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#003.src: Return to Korzim on the second floor of the enchanter in {p} with the Amulet of Fire Resistance and the Staff of True Ice.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#003.dst: Retournez voir Korzim au premier étage de la maison de l'enchanteresse à {p} avec l'Amulet of Fire Resistance et le Staff of True Ice.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#005.src: The war is starting... and Axelus... He has not returned.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#005.dst: La guerre commence... et Axelus... Il n'est pas revenu.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#005.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#006.src: We can not go... Not without him. Find him... And bring him to the... Dogun village.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#006.dst: Nous ne pouvons pas partir... Pas sans lui. Trouve-le... Et ramène-le au... village dogun.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#006.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#007.src: I can not leave. The guard...it is on high alert. He was last at {p}...yes?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#007.dst: Je ne peux pas sortir. La garde...est en alerte. Il était à {p}...n'est-ce pas?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#007.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#008.src: Head to {p} and look for Axelus.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#009.src: The first group has already started their climb, let's hurry.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#009.dst: Le premier groupe a déjà commencé l'ascension, dépêchons-nous.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#009.speaker: Soldier

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#010.src: Hey! Everyone, the king has someone in the cage! It's been years since we used it!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#010.dst: Hé! Venez voir, le roi a mis quelqu'un dans la cage! Elle n'avait pas servi depuis des années!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#010.speaker: Rodoroc Citizen

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#011.src: Wait, that's Axelus up there!! The king locked up his son?! What in the world?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#011.dst: Attendez, c'est Axelus, là-haut!! Le roi a enfermé son fils?! Mais qu'est-ce qui se passe?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#011.speaker: Rodoroc Citizen

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#012.src: I heard he was consorting with demons, but that can't possibly be true, can it?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#012.dst: J'ai entendu dire qu'il pactisait avec les démons, mais ça ne peut pas être vrai, si?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#012.speaker: Rodoroc Citizen

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#013.src: For the last time, they are not demons!! Gods, I've been telling you this whole time! Not even my father will listen to reason!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#013.dst: Pour la dernière fois, ce ne sont pas des démons!! Par les dieux, je vous le répète depuis le début! Même mon père refuse d'entendre raison!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#013.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#014.src: If I don't get freed we're doomed, you hear me?! We won't survive another war! As your prince I demand to be freed!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#014.dst: Libérez-moi ou on est perdus, vous m'entendez?! On ne survivra pas à une autre guerre! Je suis votre prince, j'exige d'être libéré!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#014.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#015.src: Listen, the statues are climbable and there's a control panel for the lava siphons near them! Now help me so we all don't die!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#015.dst: Écoute, les statues s'escaladent, et il y a un panneau de contrôle des siphons de lave à côté! Aide-moi, ou on va tous mourir!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#015.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#016.src: Free Axelus and escape the city.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#016.dst: Libérez Axelus et fuyez la ville.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#017.src: Wait, that human just defaced the hero's monument!! Are they working with the demons too?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#017.dst: Attendez, cet humain vient de dégrader le monument du héros!! Il travaille aussi avec les démons?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#017.speaker: Rodoroc Citizen

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#018.src: {u}! I didn't think you'd be back, but we need to leave, now! Meet me outside!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#018.dst: {u}! Je ne pensais pas te revoir, mais il faut partir, tout de suite! Rejoins-moi dehors!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#018.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#019.src: {u}! Over here, to the right! By the cannon! I'm commandeering this thing.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#019.dst: {u}! Par ici, à droite! Près du canon! Je réquisitionne ce truc.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#019.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#020.src: We need to get up to the Doguns before the Dwarves begin their assault, or before the Doguns take their last resort.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#020.dst: Il faut rejoindre les Doguns avant l'assaut des Nains, ou avant que les Doguns n'usent de leur dernier recours.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#020.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#021.src: Get in the cannon, now! You've got your armour, you might end up charred and covered in soot but you'll be fine!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#021.dst: Dans le canon, vite! Tu as ton armure: tu finiras sans doute carbonisé et couvert de suie, mais ça ira!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#021.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#022.src: Don't tell anyone we shot ourselves out of a cannon, I'll never live it down. Now come on, to the Dogun village, hurry!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#022.dst: Ne dis à personne qu'on s'est tirés au canon, je ne m'en remettrais jamais. Allez, au village dogun, vite!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#022.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#023.src: If the Doguns are taking their last resort and summoning Garaheth, then we've got two sides to stop at once...basically, the odds are astronomically against us.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#023.dst: Si les Doguns usent de leur dernier recours et invoquent Garaheth, on a deux camps à arrêter à la fois... bref, nos chances sont astronomiquement faibles.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#023.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#024.src: That means you do what you need to do, no matter what. Understood? If we can stop this madness then the casualties won't have died for nothing! Now move!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#024.dst: Donc tu fais ce qu'il faut, quoi qu'il arrive. Compris? Si on arrête cette folie, les victimes ne seront pas mortes pour rien! Allez, bouge!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#024.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#025.src: Reach the portal and stop Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#025.dst: Atteignez le portail et arrêtez Garaheth.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#028.src: I can't believe this... That bone was part of the ritual?! Agh, how could we have been so STUPID! You're all lucky we prepared for this!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#028.dst: Je n'y crois pas... Cet os faisait partie du rituel?! Argh, comment a-t-on pu être aussi STUPIDES! Vous avez de la chance qu'on s'y soit préparés!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#028.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#029.src: You need to get inside him. He's still chained! The amulet will protect you from the heat! Freeze him from the inside out!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#029.dst: Il faut que tu entres en lui. Il est encore enchaîné! L'amulette te protégera de la chaleur! Gèle-le de l'intérieur!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#029.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#030.dst: Entrez dans le corps de Garaheth.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#031.src: Find all {~} organs and destroy them.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#032.src: Leave Garaheth and exit his realm.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#032.dst: Quittez Garaheth et sortez de son royaume.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#033.src: EVERYONE, STOP THIS! RIGHT NOW!! IT'S OVER!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#033.dst: TOUT LE MONDE, ARRÊTEZ ÇA! TOUT DE SUITE!! C'EST FINI!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#033.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#034.src: Open your eyes for once in your lives!! You see that?! Behind me! THAT was going to be the end result!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#034.dst: Ouvrez les yeux pour une fois dans votre vie!! Vous voyez ça?! Derrière moi! C'EST ÇA qui allait arriver!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#034.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#035.src: Garaheth would have killed every one of us, damn it! Are you that short-sighted that you can't see this?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#035.dst: Garaheth nous aurait tous tués, bon sang! Êtes-vous bornés au point de ne pas le voir?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#035.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#036.src: Everyone here is to blame, except the human who helped stop this! The Doguns were already exiled, they wouldn't have hurt anyone!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#036.dst: Tout le monde ici est coupable, sauf l'humain qui a aidé à l'empêcher! Les Doguns étaient déjà exilés, ils n'auraient fait de mal à personne!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#036.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#037.src: But we couldn't just let ANYTHING be! You always need more glory, more, more, MORE! Don't you, Draani? I'm ashamed to be your lineage!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#037.dst: Mais il fallait qu'on ne laisse RIEN en paix! Toujours plus de gloire, plus, plus, PLUS! N'est-ce pas, Draani? J'ai honte d'être de ton sang!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#037.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#038.src: And you, Doguns! I...I pitied you. You were wronged, but you resort to this? You'd doom the world over to spite the Dwarves? Is that it?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#038.dst: Et vous, les Doguns! Je... j'avais pitié de vous. On vous a fait du tort, mais vous en venez à ça? Condamner le monde pour vous venger des Nains? C'est ça?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#038.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#039.src: Whelp. You do not understand. To be persecuted...and see your people tortured...hunted.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#039.dst: Gamin. Tu ne comprends pas. Être persécutés... voir son peuple torturé... chassé.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#039.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#040.src: You all deserve it! You attacked our ancestors for sport! Eye for an eye, have you heard of it? It's only fair!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#040.dst: Vous le méritez! Vous avez attaqué nos ancêtres pour le plaisir! Oeil pour oeil, vous connaissez? C'est de bonne guerre!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#040.speaker: Dwarven Commander

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#041.src: Imbeciles...your stories are not true. We... We lived through the war. You took everything...and suffered none.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#041.dst: Imbéciles... vos histoires sont fausses. Nous... nous avons vécu la guerre. Vous avez tout pris... sans rien subir.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#041.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#042.src: I've been trying to tell BOTH of you that the monarchy has been spreading lies for centuries! One bad king doesn't mean the whole species is a loss!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#042.dst: J'essaie de vous dire à TOUS LES DEUX que la monarchie répand des mensonges depuis des siècles! Un mauvais roi ne condamne pas toute une espèce!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#042.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#043.src: Shut your mouth. Even now...you trample on the bones of our god... You have taken everything from us...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#043.dst: Tais-toi. Même maintenant... vous piétinez les os de notre dieu... Vous nous avez tout pris...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#043.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#044.src: This earth is stained by you. We...we shall burn you...and scatter your ash to the wind.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#044.dst: Cette terre est souillée par vous. Nous... nous vous brûlerons... et disperserons vos cendres au vent.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#044.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#045.src: DON'T YOU DARE! STOP, RIGHT NOW!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#045.dst: N'Y PENSEZ MÊME PAS! ARRÊTEZ, TOUT DE SUITE!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#045.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#048.src: You would... You would kill a savior...?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#048.dst: Vous tueriez... Vous tueriez un sauveur...?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#048.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#049.src: No, no! No no no, this can't be happening! H-Hang on, we'll save you, I...I'll do something, I...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#049.dst: Non, non! Non non non, c'est impossible! T-Tiens bon, on va te sauver, je... je vais agir, je...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#049.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#050.src: Y-You DEMONS! MONSTERS! I'll avenge you, Axelus, j-just give me time-
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#050.dst: E-Espèces de DÉMONS! MONSTRES! Je te vengerai, Axelus, d-donne-moi du temps-
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#050.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#051.src: AGH, SHUT UP! SHUT...ack... Q-Quiet. Listen to one damn word from my mouth, Draani... For once in your miserable life
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#051.dst: ARGH, TAIS-TOI! TAIS... ack... S-Silence. Écoute un seul foutu mot de ma bouche, Draani... Pour une fois dans ta misérable vie
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#051.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#052.src: Tell. The. TRUTH!! G-gaagh...you know that's th...the only way to stop this. Swallow your pride, you...old fool...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#052.dst: Dis. La. VÉRITÉ!! G-gaagh... tu sais que c'est le... le seul moyen d'arrêter ça. Ravale ta fierté, vieux... fou...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#052.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#053.src: I...I... Axelus... He...he called me Draani...why did...?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#053.dst: Je... je... Axelus... Il... il m'a appelé Draani... pourquoi...?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#053.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#054.src: Men, stand down. This... This war is over! I will not have one more life lost! Touch the Doguns and I'll personally behead you!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#054.dst: Soldats, baissez les armes. Cette... Cette guerre est finie! Plus une seule vie ne sera perdue! Touchez aux Doguns et je vous décapite moi-même!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#054.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#055.src: Chief, I...I ask of you but an hour of your time. If you are willing to negotiate...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#055.dst: Chef, je... je ne vous demande qu'une heure de votre temps. Si vous êtes prêt à négocier...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#055.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#056.src: Speak with the King of {p} and the Dogun Chieftain.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#056.dst: Parlez au roi de {p} et au chef dogun.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#057.src: Ah, you've arrived. I...actually remember you from earlier. So you and...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#057.dst: Ah, vous voilà. Je... me souviens de vous, en fait. Donc vous et...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#057.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#059.src: ...you knew my son. Were helping him try to put an end to this, before everything was too far gone. Heh...apologies, for that.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#059.dst: ...vous connaissiez mon fils. Vous l'aidiez à mettre fin à tout ça, avant qu'il ne soit trop tard. Heh... pardon pour cela.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#059.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#060.src: Paku and I have had a long discussion about the wisdom of youth over the old. You all were right. I needed to swallow my pride.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#060.dst: Paku et moi avons longuement parlé de la sagesse des jeunes face aux anciens. Vous aviez tous raison. Je devais ravaler ma fierté.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#060.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#061.src: We agreed upon a peace treaty... A new city... The Dwarves will aid us in building it.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#061.dst: Nous avons conclu un traité de paix... Une nouvelle cité... Les Nains nous aideront à la bâtir.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#061.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#062.src: All hostilities...will end. My people will...be free to roam the caverns. It has been...too long.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#062.dst: Toute hostilité... cessera. Mon peuple pourra... parcourir librement les cavernes. Cela fait... trop longtemps.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#062.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#063.src: And the entombed Doguns at Courag will be reconstituted, as well, supposing that is a possibility.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#063.dst: Et les Doguns ensevelis à Courag seront restaurés eux aussi, si toutefois c'est possible.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#063.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#064.src: Every king, since my so-far-great grandfather, Draani Thunderwill, has battled with their morality over the lies told to my people.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#064.dst: Tous les rois, depuis mon lointain aïeul Draani Thunderwill, ont lutté avec leur conscience au sujet des mensonges faits à mon peuple.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#064.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#065.src: It ends here, with the name Draani VIII. It will take time, but the bloodshed has proven things must begin to change now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#065.dst: Cela s'arrête ici, avec le nom de Draani VIII. Il faudra du temps, mais tout ce sang prouve que les choses doivent changer dès maintenant.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#065.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#066.src: You and the coalition have saved the Heights, and Gavel. In {p}, you will find a stall to trade valuable minerals. You will be granted special Dwarven privileges to purchase it now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#066.dst: Vous et la coalition avez sauvé les Heights, et Gavel. Dans {p}, un étal vend des minerais précieux: vous bénéficiez désormais de privilèges nains spéciaux pour y acheter.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#066.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#067.src: Though that is...almost certainly not enough a reward for everything you have done...sincerely. Thank you, Wynn soldier.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#067.dst: Même si c'est... sans doute bien peu pour tout ce que vous avez fait... sincèrement. Merci, soldat de Wynn.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#067.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#068.src: Return to Korzim at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] on the second floor of the enchanter in {p} with the Amulet of Fire and the Staff of Ice.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#068.dst: Retournez voir Korzim en [{~}, {~}, -{~}], au premier étage de chez l'enchanteresse de {p}, avec l'Amulet of Fire et le Staff of Ice.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#069.src: Reach the ritual colosseum and prevent Garaheth from being summoned
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#069.dst: Atteignez le colisée rituel et empêchez l'invocation de Garaheth

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#070.src: Freeze any vital point of Garaheth you can find!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#070.dst: Gelez tous les points vitaux de Garaheth que vous trouvez!

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#072.src: We...we have nothing left... We could have...taken them with us... Now they will...will... You...!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#072.dst: Nous... n'avons plus rien... Nous aurions pu... les emporter avec nous... Maintenant ils vont... vont... Toi...!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#072.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwelling Walls#000.src: I left a very precious journal inside of this mansion, a hell within walls. It was my great grandfather's!
Dwelling Walls#000.dst: J'ai laissé un journal très précieux dans ce manoir, un enfer entre quatre murs. Il appartenait à mon arrière-grand-père!
Dwelling Walls#000.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#002.src: Let's see here... mother's old vase... check!
Dwelling Walls#002.dst: Voyons voir... le vieux vase de maman... fait!
Dwelling Walls#002.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#003.src: Dining room table... got it here, check!
Dwelling Walls#003.dst: La table de la salle à manger... je l'ai, fait!
Dwelling Walls#003.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#004.src: Finally, the journal. It's out here somewhere, I assume. I'll look around.
Dwelling Walls#004.dst: Enfin, le journal. Il doit être par ici, je suppose. Je vais chercher.
Dwelling Walls#004.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#006.src: Hold on, what? The journal! I must have forgotten it inside the mansion!
Dwelling Walls#006.dst: Une minute, quoi? Le journal! J'ai dû l'oublier dans le manoir!
Dwelling Walls#006.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#007.src: You there! Would you mind doing me a deed?
Dwelling Walls#007.dst: Vous, là! Pourriez-vous me rendre un service?
Dwelling Walls#007.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#008.src: The mansion was designed by a Corkian architect, and I was scammed into buying it.
Dwelling Walls#008.dst: Le manoir a été conçu par un architecte corkian, et on m'a arnaqué pour que je l'achète.
Dwelling Walls#008.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#009.src: If you step inside the mansion just for a few moments, you'll understand why the sellers had to trick someone into investing in their god forsaken real estate!
Dwelling Walls#009.dst: Si vous entrez dans le manoir ne serait-ce qu'un instant, vous comprendrez pourquoi les vendeurs ont dû duper quelqu'un pour refourguer leur maudite propriété!
Dwelling Walls#009.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#010.src: Navigating from room to room is nearly impossible, the rooms move around. I've only been in the mansion for a week and I'm already packing my bags and moving to {p}.
Dwelling Walls#010.dst: Passer d'une pièce à l'autre est presque impossible, les pièces bougent. Je ne vis ici que depuis une semaine et je fais déjà mes valises pour {p}.
Dwelling Walls#010.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#012.src: Navigate the mansion to the room holding the journal
Dwelling Walls#012.dst: Traversez le manoir jusqu'à la pièce où se trouve le journal

Dwelling Walls#014.src: The journal! You outsmarted the mansion!
Dwelling Walls#014.dst: Le journal! Vous avez déjoué le manoir!
Dwelling Walls#014.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#015.src: I must thank you, that journal was priceless to my family.
Dwelling Walls#015.dst: Merci infiniment, ce journal n'avait pas de prix pour ma famille.
Dwelling Walls#015.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#016.src: Let this be a life lesson to you. Never buy a house from a Corkian architect.
Dwelling Walls#016.dst: Que cela vous serve de leçon. N'achetez jamais une maison à un architecte corkian.
Dwelling Walls#016.speaker: Leucsaa

Echoes of Change#000.src: Third Division - Guarding Sovereign Soosu's mansion.
Echoes of Change#000.dst: Troisième division - Garde du manoir de la Souveraine Soosu.

Echoes of Change#002.dst: Vous ne pouvez pas encore partir!

Echoes of Change#003.src: The painting has a note attached to it.
Echoes of Change#003.dst: Une note est attachée au tableau.

Echoes of Change#004.src: Attend the meeting to prepare for the plan in the Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#004.dst: Assistez à la réunion de préparation du plan à la Plume d'acier en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#006.src: I trust everyone has taken the time to process last night's announcement? I will let Syndra take over shortly, but first, I would like to thank each and every one of you.
Echoes of Change#006.dst: J'espère que chacun a pu digérer l'annonce d'hier soir? Je laisserai bientôt la parole à Syndra, mais d'abord, je tiens à remercier chacun d'entre vous.
Echoes of Change#006.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#007.src: I won't mince words. This is dangerous work. What we are planning puts us at great risk. But this is what it takes to change Fruma, to put an end to the crown's oppression!
Echoes of Change#007.dst: Je ne mâcherai pas mes mots. C'est dangereux. Ce que nous préparons nous expose à de grands risques. Mais c'est le prix pour changer Fruma, pour en finir avec l'oppression de la Couronne!
Echoes of Change#007.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#008.src: We will kill a God! And we will all be free. Now, Syndra?
Echoes of Change#008.dst: Nous allons tuer un dieu! Et nous serons tous libres. Syndra, à toi?
Echoes of Change#008.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#009.src: Thank you, Quill. To begin, allow me to give each group their assignment.
Echoes of Change#009.dst: Merci, Quill. Pour commencer, laissez-moi donner sa mission à chaque groupe.
Echoes of Change#009.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#010.src: Mora and Yuman, you will be infiltrating the guards' outpost in {p} to retrieve their schedules. Get in, note down the formations, and get out.
Echoes of Change#010.dst: Mora et Yuman, vous infiltrerez le poste de garde de {p} pour récupérer leurs plannings. Entrez, notez les formations, et ressortez.
Echoes of Change#010.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#011.src: Mora, you're familiar with military structure, and Yuman knows his way around {p}. I expect you two should be able to make it work.
Echoes of Change#011.dst: Mora, tu connais la structure militaire, et Yuman connaît bien {p}. Je pense qu'à vous deux, vous y arriverez.
Echoes of Change#011.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#013.src: Understood. However, I have a few concerns with the overall plans... I'll speak with you later.
Echoes of Change#013.dst: Compris. Cela dit, j'ai quelques réserves sur le plan dans son ensemble... Je vous en parlerai plus tard.
Echoes of Change#013.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#014.src: Yusanu and Sui, you'll be constructing explosives that we can use as distractions during the festival to draw guards away from the main stage.
Echoes of Change#014.dst: Yusanu et Sui, vous fabriquerez des explosifs qui serviront de diversion pendant le festival pour éloigner les gardes de la scène principale.
Echoes of Change#014.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#015.src: I trust Yusanu knows what he's doing, so Sui, you'll be acting as an assistant.
Echoes of Change#015.dst: Yusanu sait ce qu'il fait, alors Sui, tu seras son assistante.
Echoes of Change#015.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#017.src: Works for me. I might already have some blueprints lying around somewhere...
Echoes of Change#017.dst: Ça me va. J'ai peut-être déjà des plans qui traînent quelque part...
Echoes of Change#017.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#018.src: Zeph and Rex, I want you to scout the city rooftops for potential spots where Rex and Yulie can provide aerial support... in case it's necessary.
Echoes of Change#018.dst: Zeph et Rex, repérez sur les toits de la ville des postes d'où Rex et Yulie pourront offrir un appui aérien... au cas où.
Echoes of Change#018.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#019.src: Yeah, I c- c- can do that.
Echoes of Change#019.dst: Oui, j- j- je peux faire ça.
Echoes of Change#019.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#021.src: Quill and Yulie, you two know your way around the city. I'll need you to scout out potential escape routes from the city... again, in case things go badly.
Echoes of Change#021.dst: Quill et Yulie, vous connaissez bien la ville. Il me faut des itinéraires de fuite possibles... encore une fois, au cas où ça tournerait mal.
Echoes of Change#021.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#022.src: Ah, that should be a breeze.
Echoes of Change#022.dst: Ah, ce sera un jeu d'enfant.
Echoes of Change#022.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#023.src: ...yes. I think I have a few places in mind already.
Echoes of Change#023.dst: ...oui. J'ai déjà quelques endroits en tête.
Echoes of Change#023.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#024.src: Finally. {u}, I want you to be adaptable. Help out wherever it's needed - I'm sure your skills will come in handy.
Echoes of Change#024.dst: Enfin. {u}, je veux que tu t'adaptes. Aide là où on a besoin de toi - je suis sûre que tes talents serviront.
Echoes of Change#024.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#025.src: Hey, if you're helping out wherever, you should come with me and Mora! Guard positions would be handy to know before finding escape routes.
Echoes of Change#025.dst: Hé, si tu aides un peu partout, viens avec Mora et moi! Ça aiderait de savoir où sont les gardes avant de chercher des itinéraires de fuite.
Echoes of Change#025.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#026.src: I was about to suggest the same thing. Then let us adjourn this meeting. Good luck, everyone.
Echoes of Change#026.dst: J'allais proposer la même chose. Alors levons la séance. Bonne chance à tous.
Echoes of Change#026.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#027.src: Hum. {u} and Yuman, let us go discuss our plans then.
Echoes of Change#027.dst: Hum. {u} et Yuman, allons donc discuter de notre plan.
Echoes of Change#027.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#028.src: Meet up with Mora and Yuman at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#029.src: Alright, guys! So, any plans? What're we cooking with here?
Echoes of Change#029.dst: Bon, les gars! Alors, un plan? On a quoi sous la main?
Echoes of Change#029.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#030.dst: Hm... je ne suis... pas sûr.
Echoes of Change#030.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#031.src: Hey, man, everything good? I'm uh, not that horrible to work with, am I? Haha.
Echoes of Change#031.dst: Hé, mec, tout va bien? Je suis pas si horrible comme coéquipier, si? Haha.
Echoes of Change#031.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#032.src: Ah! My apologies. No, it is not you... I simply do not like Syndra's plan.
Echoes of Change#032.dst: Ah! Pardonne-moi. Non, ce n'est pas toi... Je n'aime simplement pas le plan de Syndra.
Echoes of Change#032.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#033.src: You must understand, I would trust her with my life... but that is precisely the issue. She will do anything to avoid putting us in danger.
Echoes of Change#033.dst: Comprends-moi, je lui confierais ma vie... mais c'est précisément le problème. Elle fera tout pour éviter de nous mettre en danger.
Echoes of Change#033.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#034.src: She treats us as her own children, but she is only a decade older than I am! She would put herself through all the suffering in the world, if only to avoid letting us help where it is most needed!
Echoes of Change#034.dst: Elle nous traite comme ses propres enfants, mais elle n'a que dix ans de plus que moi! Elle endurerait toute la souffrance du monde, rien que pour nous empêcher d'aider là où c'est le plus utile!
Echoes of Change#034.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#035.src: She is willing to take the fall if the plan goes awry. But, this time... this time, I will not back off. I am not allowing her to put herself through that danger alone.
Echoes of Change#035.dst: Elle est prête à tout endosser si le plan tourne mal. Mais cette fois... cette fois, je ne reculerai pas. Je ne la laisserai pas affronter ce danger seule.
Echoes of Change#035.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#036.src: Yeesh. Didn't think you guys were that messy! I think I get it though.
Echoes of Change#036.dst: Ouh là. C'était si compliqué entre vous? Mais je crois que je comprends.
Echoes of Change#036.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#037.src: My bros... they mean well, yeah, but they never ask for help. They're always trying to do everything themselves, and... and it drives me nuts!
Echoes of Change#037.dst: Mes frangins... ils veulent bien faire, ouais, mais ils demandent jamais d'aide. Ils veulent toujours tout faire eux-mêmes, et... ça me rend dingue!
Echoes of Change#037.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#038.src: Like, man, just let me do something!! Anything!! It's so frustrating.
Echoes of Change#038.dst: Genre, laissez-moi faire un truc!! N'importe quoi!! C'est trop frustrant.
Echoes of Change#038.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#039.src: Ha! I did not think we had this in common. Well then... perhaps we can both prove ourselves to our families, eh?
Echoes of Change#039.dst: Ha! Nous avons donc cela en commun. Eh bien... peut-être ferons-nous tous deux nos preuves auprès des nôtres, hein?
Echoes of Change#039.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#040.src: Yeah!! I like the sound of that!!
Echoes of Change#040.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#041.src: Okay, well, I know where the guards' outpost is in {p}. Let's just go to it and take it from there!
Echoes of Change#041.dst: Ok, bon, je sais où est le poste de garde de {p}. On y va et on avise!
Echoes of Change#041.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#042.src: Ha, settle down a little. I think we need to be a bit more prepared than that. But, yes, time is of the essence, so let us head there first. I will attempt to think of a plan on the way.
Echoes of Change#042.dst: Ha, calme-toi un peu. Je pense qu'il faut être un peu mieux préparés que ça. Mais oui, le temps presse, alors allons-y d'abord. J'essaierai de trouver un plan en chemin.
Echoes of Change#042.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#043.src: Whatever, man! Too much planning often spoils the results... but, sure! Let's meet outside the tallest building in {p}. First tunnel to the right leads there!
Echoes of Change#043.dst: Comme tu veux, mec! Trop planifier gâche souvent tout... mais d'accord! Retrouvons-nous devant le plus haut bâtiment de {p}. Le premier tunnel à droite y mène!
Echoes of Change#043.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#044.src: Meet up with Yuman and Mora in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#044.dst: Retrouvez Yuman et Mora à {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
