Elemental Exercise#018.dst: ... Pourvu que ce ne soit rien de grave. Il avait l'air d'apprécier nos talents au combat, mais-... Laisse tomber. On devrait y aller.

Elemental Exercise#019.src: Ahem. Before you return to your business, I have something for the two of you. Payment for your work today, and a special piece of equipment. Make good use of it.
Elemental Exercise#019.dst: Hum. Avant que vous retourniez à vos affaires, j'ai quelque chose pour vous deux. Votre paie pour aujourd'hui, et une pièce d'équipement spéciale. Faites-en bon usage.
Elemental Exercise#019.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#020.src: Talk to Captain Ragon in the {p} Barracks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Elemental Exercise#020.dst: Parlez au capitaine Ragon à la caserne de {p} en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Elemental Exercise#021.src: Ah! You must be one of the new recruits the Admiral told me to look out for! What was it... {u}, yes?
Elemental Exercise#021.dst: Ah! Vous devez être l'une des nouvelles recrues que l'amiral m'a demandé d'attendre! Comment était-ce... {u}, c'est ça?
Elemental Exercise#021.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#022.src: You've done well to reach this city as quickly as you have, which must have required a great deal of fighting the undead.
Elemental Exercise#022.dst: Vous avez bien fait d'atteindre cette ville aussi vite, ce qui a dû exiger beaucoup de combats contre les morts-vivants.
Elemental Exercise#022.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#023.src: Now, I've heard from Sergeant Van of your aid in his assault on our overtaken fort- which, good work, very well done...
Elemental Exercise#023.dst: Le sergent Van m'a parlé de votre aide lors de son assaut sur notre fort tombé aux mains de l'ennemi- bon travail, vraiment bien joué...
Elemental Exercise#023.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#024.src: But the fact still stands that you lack experience. You can certainly fight, yes, but can you fight well?
Elemental Exercise#024.dst: Mais vous manquez toujours d'expérience. Vous savez vous battre, certes, mais savez-vous bien vous battre?
Elemental Exercise#024.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#025.src: Lucky for you, that's where I come in. You're just in time for today's training session! Come here, follow me.
Elemental Exercise#025.dst: Par chance, c'est là que j'interviens. Vous arrivez juste à temps pour l'entraînement du jour! Venez, suivez-moi.
Elemental Exercise#025.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#026.src: Follow Captain Ragon to the Training Room at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Elemental Exercise#026.dst: Suivez le capitaine Ragon jusqu'à la salle d'entraînement en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Elemental Exercise#027.src: ...Oh! {u}, hello. Are you here for training as well?
Elemental Exercise#027.dst: ...Oh! {u}, bonjour. Tu viens t'entraîner, toi aussi?
Elemental Exercise#027.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#028.src: Ahem. Now, in front of you, you'll see five special training dummies. Each one finely imbued with elemental magic. You are aware of the elements, yes? There's five of them in total.
Elemental Exercise#028.dst: Hum. Devant vous se trouvent cinq mannequins d'entraînement spéciaux, chacun finement imprégné de magie élémentaire. Vous connaissez les éléments, n'est-ce pas? Il y en a cinq au total.
Elemental Exercise#028.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#029.src: I am! The elements are... Fire, Air, Earth, Thunder, and... Water?
Elemental Exercise#029.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#030.src: That's right. And generally speaking, they're strong against each other in that order- Fire beats Air, Air beats Earth, and so on.
Elemental Exercise#030.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#031.src: Elemental weaknesses may vary based on the enemy, but that order holds true in most cases.
Elemental Exercise#031.dst: Les faiblesses élémentaires varient selon l'ennemi, mais cet ordre est valable dans la plupart des cas.
Elemental Exercise#031.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#032.src: Enemies will take more damage from elements they're weak to, and take less damage from elements they resist. This change to your damage is always a flat value, and it varies from enemy to enemy.
Elemental Exercise#032.dst: Les ennemis subissent plus de dégâts des éléments auxquels ils sont faibles, et moins de ceux auxquels ils résistent. Cette variation est toujours une valeur fixe, propre à chaque ennemi.
Elemental Exercise#032.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#033.src: Now. For training purposes, you'll be given an elemental weapon to try out on these training dummies. Take note of how each elemental defense and weakness affects your damage dealt. Speak to me once you feel you understand the concept.
Elemental Exercise#033.dst: Bien. Pour l'entraînement, vous recevrez une arme élémentaire à essayer sur ces mannequins. Observez comment chaque défense et faiblesse élémentaire influe sur vos dégâts. Parlez-moi quand vous aurez compris le principe.
Elemental Exercise#033.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#034.src: Test out the elemental training weapons on the dummies, then speak to Captain Ragon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Elemental Exercise#034.dst: Testez les armes d'entraînement élémentaires sur les mannequins, puis parlez au capitaine Ragon en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Elemental Exercise#035.src: Well? Have you noted the effect of elemental defenses and weaknesses on your damage?
Elemental Exercise#035.dst: Alors? Avez-vous remarqué l'effet des défenses et faiblesses élémentaires sur vos dégâts?
Elemental Exercise#035.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#036.src: Excellent. I'll take those training weapons back from the two of you. Any questions?
Elemental Exercise#036.dst: Excellent. Je vais vous reprendre ces armes d'entraînement à tous les deux. Des questions?
Elemental Exercise#036.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#037.src: One final note before we move on from the elements- your weapon may not always be as effective against an enemy as you would like.
Elemental Exercise#037.dst: Une dernière remarque avant d'en finir avec les éléments- votre arme ne sera pas toujours aussi efficace que vous le voudriez contre un ennemi.
Elemental Exercise#037.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#038.src: That sounds good to me! {u}, we've been traveling together for some time now... I can't say I haven't been curious to see how you fight. Let's see who comes out on top, shall we?
Elemental Exercise#038.dst: Ça me va! {u}, ça fait un moment qu'on voyage ensemble... J'avoue que j'étais curieux de te voir te battre. Voyons qui l'emporte, d'accord?
Elemental Exercise#038.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#040.src: Alright. I'll be waiting here when you're ready!
Elemental Exercise#040.dst: D'accord. Je t'attends ici quand tu seras prêt!
Elemental Exercise#040.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#041.src: I'd like to try out this wea
Elemental Exercise#041.dst: J'aimerais essayer cette arme encore un peu.

Elemental Exercise#042.src: Go on, then. Just speak to me when you're ready to move on.
Elemental Exercise#042.dst: Allez-y, alors. Parlez-moi quand vous serez prêt à continuer.
Elemental Exercise#042.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#043.src: Return to Tasim at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] for a duel.
Elemental Exercise#043.dst: Retournez voir Tasim en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] pour un duel.

Elemental Exercise#044.src: There you are! Are you ready for our duel?
Elemental Exercise#044.dst: Te voilà! Prêt pour notre duel?
Elemental Exercise#044.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#045.src: Alright! Let's see which of us is the better fighter!
Elemental Exercise#045.dst: Parfait! Voyons lequel de nous deux se bat le mieux!
Elemental Exercise#045.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#047.src: Fight Tasim in a friendly duel.
Elemental Exercise#047.dst: Affrontez Tasim dans un duel amical.

Elemental Exercise#049.src: Phew! That was a good fight. You did well, {u}. We'll have to do this again- and maybe we can get Aledar to join!
Elemental Exercise#049.dst: Ouf! C'était un beau combat. Bien joué, {u}. Il faudra remettre ça- et peut-être convaincre Aledar de se joindre à nous!
Elemental Exercise#049.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#050.src: Woo! You fought well, {u}, but it looks like I'm still better! Wait until Aledar hears about this...
Elemental Exercise#050.dst: Youhou! Tu t'es bien battu, {u}, mais on dirait que je suis encore le meilleur! Attends qu'Aledar apprenne ça...
Elemental Exercise#050.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#051.src: Yes, yes, fine work, the two of you. Now-
Elemental Exercise#051.dst: Oui, oui, beau travail, tous les deux. Maintenant-
Elemental Exercise#051.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#052.src: Captain! Captain Ragon! There's- there's corrupted forces! Advancing from {p}!
Elemental Exercise#052.dst: Capitaine! Capitaine Ragon! Il y a- il y a des forces corrompues! Elles arrivent de {p}!
Elemental Exercise#052.speaker: Scout Evelyn

Elemental Exercise#053.src: Hm. And the Admiral is away... Very well. Mobilize the troops! We meet the forces at the north gate!
Elemental Exercise#053.dst: Hm. Et l'amiral est absent... Très bien. Mobilisez les troupes! Nous les affronterons à la porte nord!
Elemental Exercise#053.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#055.src: Captain- we're capable fighters too. Let us come along and help fight off these undead!
Elemental Exercise#055.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#056.src: Hm... As I see it, this is a fine opportunity for you to gain some firsthand experience! Very well. Prepare yourselves, and come to {p}' north gate when you're ready.
Elemental Exercise#056.dst: Hm... A mon avis, c'est une belle occasion d'acquérir de l'expérience sur le terrain! Très bien. Préparez-vous, et rejoignez la porte nord de {p} quand vous serez prêts.
Elemental Exercise#056.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#057.src: This is exciting! But... I'm a little bit nervous, still.
Elemental Exercise#057.dst: C'est excitant! Mais... je suis quand même un peu nerveux.
Elemental Exercise#057.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#058.src: ... We'll be alright. Come on, let's go follow the captain.
Elemental Exercise#058.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#059.src: Follow Captain Ragon to {p}' north gate at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to face the undead forces.
Elemental Exercise#059.dst: Suivez le capitaine Ragon jusqu'à la porte nord de {p} en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] pour affronter les forces morts-vivantes.

Elemental Exercise#060.src: There you are! Ready for battle?
Elemental Exercise#060.dst: Vous voilà! Prêts pour la bataille?
Elemental Exercise#060.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#061.src: I'm prepared as well. These corrupted won't stand a chance against us!
Elemental Exercise#061.dst: Je suis prêt, moi aussi. Ces corrompus n'ont aucune chance contre nous!
Elemental Exercise#061.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#062.src: Yes, yes, very good. Now, it shouldn't be long until-
Elemental Exercise#062.dst: Oui, oui, très bien. Bon, ça ne devrait plus tarder avant que-
Elemental Exercise#062.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#064.src: Hm... Take note of the leader. I expect if we can defeat it, the rest of the forces will disperse.
Elemental Exercise#064.dst: Hm... Repérez leur chef. Si nous le vainquons, je pense que le reste des forces se dispersera.
Elemental Exercise#064.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#065.src: Stronger foes such as this one will cast spells one after the other, in a specific order. These spell combos can be dangerous, so make sure to take note of them.
Elemental Exercise#065.dst: Les ennemis puissants comme celui-ci lancent des sorts les uns après les autres, dans un ordre précis. Ces combos de sorts peuvent être dangereux, alors retenez-les bien.
Elemental Exercise#065.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#066.src: We'll be fighting all around you, so shout if you're in need of aid. Alright, soldiers, let's defend our city!
Elemental Exercise#066.dst: Nous combattrons tout autour de vous, alors criez si vous avez besoin d'aide. Allez, soldats, défendons notre ville!
Elemental Exercise#066.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#068.src: I need to get ready first.

Elemental Exercise#069.src: I understand. We have time until the corrupted forces arrive, so go prepare. Don't take too long, though.
Elemental Exercise#069.dst: Je comprends. Nous avons le temps avant l'arrivée des corrompus, allez vous préparer. Mais ne tardez pas trop.
Elemental Exercise#069.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#070.src: Defeat the Corrupted Captain and the force threatening {p}.
Elemental Exercise#070.dst: Vainquez le Capitaine corrompu et les forces qui menacent {p}.

Elemental Exercise#071.src: Return to the {p} Barracks and talk to Captain Ragon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Elemental Exercise#071.dst: Retournez à la caserne de {p} et parlez au capitaine Ragon en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Elemental Exercise#072.src: Ah, there you two are. Come here.
Elemental Exercise#072.dst: Ah, vous voilà tous les deux. Approchez.
Elemental Exercise#072.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#073.dst: Oh, amiral! Vous êtes déjà de retour?
Elemental Exercise#073.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#074.src: Yes, my absence was never meant to take long. I was paying a visit to the desert city of {p}, for a meeting with an Admiral Amerigo...
Elemental Exercise#074.dst: Oui, mon absence ne devait jamais durer longtemps. Je rendais visite à la cité désertique de {p}, pour une réunion avec un certain amiral Amerigo...
Elemental Exercise#074.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#075.src: But I digress. I've been told the two of you were essential in the defense of our city! Excellent work.
Elemental Exercise#075.dst: Mais je m'égare. On m'a dit que vous aviez tous deux été essentiels à la défense de la ville! Excellent travail.
Elemental Exercise#075.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#076.src: Our preparations for the assault on {p}' spider den are nearing completion. I'd like the two of you to join that mission.
Elemental Exercise#076.dst: Nos préparatifs pour l'assaut du nid d'araignées de {p} touchent à leur fin. J'aimerais que vous participiez tous les deux à cette mission.
Elemental Exercise#076.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#077.src: Sir- are you certain? I mean, we'd be happy to join, but surely there are many others more worthy of such a task.
Elemental Exercise#077.dst: Amiral- vous êtes sûr? Enfin, nous serions ravis, mais il y en a sûrement bien d'autres plus dignes d'une telle tâche.
Elemental Exercise#077.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#078.src: Nonsense! Captain Ragon has assessed your skills, and has deemed them sufficient. And I trust the Captain's judgement.
Elemental Exercise#078.dst: Balivernes! Le capitaine Ragon a évalué vos compétences et les a jugées suffisantes. Et j'ai confiance en son jugement.
Elemental Exercise#078.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#079.src: Now, I must be off. I'll see the two of you when it's time for the mission.
Elemental Exercise#079.dst: Bon, je dois partir. Je vous reverrai tous les deux à l'heure de la mission.
Elemental Exercise#079.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#080.src: A big mission to take out the spiders, huh... You know, even though I'm a little worried, I think I'm excited.
Elemental Exercise#080.dst: Une grande mission pour éliminer les araignées, hein... Tu sais, même si je suis un peu inquiet, je crois que j'ai hâte.
Elemental Exercise#080.speaker: Tasim

Ensemble of Hope#000.src: Meet up with your friends in room number {~} in hotel {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Ensemble of Hope#000.dst: Retrouvez vos amis dans la chambre numéro {~} de l'hôtel {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Ensemble of Hope#003.src: {u}'s here? Good, that means we can-
Ensemble of Hope#003.dst: {u} est là? Bien, ça veut dire qu'on peut-
Ensemble of Hope#003.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#007.src: Ugh. ZEPH! Get out of there already!
Ensemble of Hope#007.dst: Pff. ZEPH! Sors de là, enfin!
Ensemble of Hope#007.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#008.src: C...coming! Jeez, Rex, g...give a man his p- pr- privacy...
Ensemble of Hope#008.dst: J...j'arrive! Bon sang, Rex, l...laisse un peu d'i- int- intimité à un homme...
Ensemble of Hope#008.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#010.src: Rex. I'm f...fine. St- stop asking me that.
Ensemble of Hope#010.dst: Rex. Je vais b...bien. Ar- arrête de me demander ça.
Ensemble of Hope#010.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#011.src: Okay! Okay. Gods forbid I worry about you for even a second...
Ensemble of Hope#011.dst: D'accord! D'accord. Que les dieux me pardonnent de m'inquiéter pour toi une seule seconde...
Ensemble of Hope#011.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#012.src: Rex. You had something to tell us.
Ensemble of Hope#012.dst: Rex. Tu avais quelque chose à nous dire.
Ensemble of Hope#012.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#013.src: Right, okay, I'll get to it. These past few days, I have been plotting. I have something... serviceable, I think.
Ensemble of Hope#013.dst: Oui, d'accord, j'y viens. Ces derniers jours, j'ai comploté. J'ai quelque chose... d'exploitable, je crois.
Ensemble of Hope#013.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#014.src: So, to start with, let's lay out our goal - the destruction of the Crown, the Queen and her Sovereigns included.
Ensemble of Hope#014.dst: Alors, pour commencer, posons notre objectif - la destruction de la Couronne, Reine et Souverains compris.
Ensemble of Hope#014.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#015.src: We won't be able to do it ourselves - we're only four people. And we definitely won't be able to do it if their eyes are on us the whole time!
Ensemble of Hope#015.dst: On n'y arrivera pas seuls - on n'est que quatre. Et sûrement pas s'ils ont les yeux rivés sur nous en permanence!
Ensemble of Hope#015.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#016.src: Sui and {u}, you two worked with the Canopy while you were in the {p}. Do you think they have the people and resources to help us?
Ensemble of Hope#016.dst: Sui et {u}, vous avez travaillé avec la Canopée quand vous étiez dans {p}. Vous pensez qu'ils ont le monde et les ressources pour nous aider?
Ensemble of Hope#016.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#017.src: They do. They've... been fighting openly against the crown for years and haven't been caught. So... they know what they're doing.
Ensemble of Hope#017.dst: Oui. Ils... combattent ouvertement la Couronne depuis des années sans se faire prendre. Donc... ils savent ce qu'ils font.
Ensemble of Hope#017.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#018.src: Good, we'll want to get in contact then. And Yusanu is with them, anyway... it'll be good to see him again.
Ensemble of Hope#018.dst: Bien, il faudra prendre contact, alors. Et puis Yusanu est avec eux... ça fera du bien de le revoir.
Ensemble of Hope#018.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#020.src: But, uh, moving on. Zeph, you went out earlier and gathered some information on the {p}, right?
Ensemble of Hope#020.dst: Mais, euh, passons. Zeph, tu es sorti tout à l'heure te renseigner sur {p}, non?
Ensemble of Hope#020.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#021.src: Y- yeah! P...people around here seem v- v- very excited for th...the festival. The C- Cr- Crown is gonna be b...busy with preparations for a wh...while.
Ensemble of Hope#021.dst: O- ouais! Les g...gens d'ici ont l'air t- t- très excités par l...le festival. La C- Cou- Couronne va être o...occupée par les préparatifs un b...bon moment.
Ensemble of Hope#021.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#022.src: B- but, uh, Rex, y...you wanted me to- to ch...check out the Dam E- Elevator, right?
Ensemble of Hope#022.dst: M- mais, euh, Rex, t...tu voulais que j'a- aille v...voir l'ascenseur du b- barrage, non?
Ensemble of Hope#022.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#023.src: I did, yep. What's the guards situation like? Heavily guarded, lightly guarded... somewhere in between?
Ensemble of Hope#023.dst: Oui, c'est ça. Et côté gardes? Très surveillé, peu surveillé... entre les deux?
Ensemble of Hope#023.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#024.src: S...somewhere in be- between, I think. Cl...closer to lightly guarded. I don't th- think they're ex- exp- expecting an... a- an attack.
Ensemble of Hope#024.dst: E...entre les d- deux, je crois. P...plutôt peu surveillé. Je ne c- crois pas qu'ils s'at- s'att- s'attendent à une... u- une attaque.
Ensemble of Hope#024.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#025.src: Perfect. Perfect, perfect, perfect... so! How do we all feel about committing some light terrorism today?
Ensemble of Hope#025.dst: Parfait. Parfait, parfait, parfait... alors! Qu'est-ce que vous diriez d'un petit acte de terrorisme aujourd'hui?
Ensemble of Hope#025.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#026.src: Okay, curb the enthusiasm a little. Let me explain why, first.
Ensemble of Hope#026.dst: Bon, modérez un peu votre enthousiasme. Laissez-moi d'abord vous expliquer pourquoi.
Ensemble of Hope#026.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#027.src: Ev- ever the optimist... R- Rex, why do you w...want to take the e- el-... the elevator?
Ensemble of Hope#027.dst: T- toujours aussi optimiste... R- Rex, pourquoi tu v...veux prendre l'a- as-... l'ascenseur?
Ensemble of Hope#027.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#028.src: Like we haven't done worse already... um, why the elevator, Rex?
Ensemble of Hope#028.dst: Comme si on n'avait pas déjà fait pire... euh, pourquoi l'ascenseur, Rex?
Ensemble of Hope#028.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#029.src: We need to get the Crown's eyes off of us. They won't expect us to try to return to the {p} - why would we? The enemy is right here.
Ensemble of Hope#029.dst: Il faut détourner l'attention de la Couronne. Ils ne s'attendront pas à ce qu'on retourne dans {p} - pourquoi le ferait-on? L'ennemi est ici.
Ensemble of Hope#029.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#030.src: So what happens when we do? They'll start thinking. Why are we doing it? What do we have to gain?
Ensemble of Hope#030.dst: Et que se passe-t-il quand on le fait? Ils vont réfléchir. Pourquoi on fait ça? Qu'a-t-on à y gagner?
Ensemble of Hope#030.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#031.src: They'll start to pay attention to that elevator. And, if we're lucky, less attention on what we're actually doing.
Ensemble of Hope#031.dst: Ils vont commencer à surveiller cet ascenseur. Et, avec un peu de chance, moins ce qu'on fait vraiment.
Ensemble of Hope#031.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#032.src: ...and, well, maybe if we're fast, we could bring some friends up from Auburn to us. We could use all the help we can get.
Ensemble of Hope#032.dst: ...et puis, si on fait vite, on pourrait peut-être faire monter quelques amis d'Auburn. Toute l'aide possible sera la bienvenue.
Ensemble of Hope#032.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#033.src: Th...that- that sounds nice... it- it's been s...so long already...
Ensemble of Hope#033.dst: Ç...ça- ça serait bien... ç- ça fait d...déjà si longtemps...
Ensemble of Hope#033.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#035.src: Sui... do you think you and Zeph could handle getting the rest of the Leaves up here? Zeph'll need someone who knows how to find the Canopy, and I need {u} with me.
Ensemble of Hope#035.dst: Sui... tu penses que Zeph et toi pourriez vous charger de faire monter le reste des Feuilles? Zeph aura besoin de quelqu'un qui sait trouver la Canopée, et j'ai besoin de {u} avec moi.
Ensemble of Hope#035.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#038.src: Well, we'll all be going to take control of the elevator anyway. We can... talk more there.
Ensemble of Hope#038.dst: Bon, de toute façon on va tous prendre le contrôle de l'ascenseur. On pourra... en reparler là-bas.
Ensemble of Hope#038.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#039.src: {u}, after we've done that, I'll need you to take me to the Canopy. I want to familiarize myself with their leadership, and start working on an actual plan.
Ensemble of Hope#039.dst: {u}, après ça, j'aurai besoin que tu m'emmènes à la Canopée. Je veux faire connaissance avec leurs chefs et commencer à bâtir un vrai plan.
Ensemble of Hope#039.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#040.src: Okay! I think that's everything. Let's all get ready, then head to that elevator on the southern side of the dam!
Ensemble of Hope#040.dst: Bon! Je crois que c'est tout. Préparons-nous, puis direction l'ascenseur du côté sud du barrage!
Ensemble of Hope#040.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#043.src: Hi, {u}. Ready to fight more of the crown's soldiers?
Ensemble of Hope#043.dst: Salut, {u}. Prêt à affronter d'autres soldats de la Couronne?
Ensemble of Hope#043.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#047.src: We... have Rex and Zeph back. We're going to reunite with the people we left behind in Auburn. We're going to meet back with the Canopy.
Ensemble of Hope#047.dst: On a... retrouvé Rex et Zeph. On va revoir ceux qu'on a laissés à Auburn. On va retrouver la Canopée.
Ensemble of Hope#047.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#049.src: Really? And why would that be?!
Ensemble of Hope#049.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#050.src: It's not like- n-not like someone's MISSING! OR ANYTHING!!
Ensemble of Hope#050.dst: C'est pas comme si- c-comme si quelqu'un MANQUAIT! OU QUOI QUE CE SOIT!!
Ensemble of Hope#050.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#051.src: So- s-so maybe I'm not. But it doesn't matter. We have things we need to get done, {u}! I don't have time to- to feel not fine!!
Ensemble of Hope#051.dst: Alors- a-alors peut-être que non. Mais ça n'a pas d'importance. On a des choses à faire, {u}! J'ai pas le temps de- d'aller mal!!
Ensemble of Hope#051.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#053.src: Don't push this... please? Just... let's follow Rex's plan.
Ensemble of Hope#053.dst: N'insiste pas... s'il te plaît? Suivons... juste le plan de Rex.
Ensemble of Hope#053.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#054.src: It's... fine. Solid plan, I guess.
Ensemble of Hope#054.dst: Il est... bien. Un plan solide, j'imagine.
Ensemble of Hope#054.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#055.src: I couldn't think of anything better at least, so...
Ensemble of Hope#055.dst: En tout cas, je n'ai rien trouvé de mieux, donc...
Ensemble of Hope#055.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#056.src: And, um, I'm not the- the tactician, anyway. I'm... glad I don't have to worry about that anymore.
Ensemble of Hope#056.dst: Et, euh, je ne suis pas la- la tacticienne, de toute façon. Je suis... contente de ne plus avoir à m'en soucier.
Ensemble of Hope#056.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#059.src: I... don't really want to face Yusanu again. After... um. You know.
Ensemble of Hope#059.dst: Je n'ai... pas trop envie de revoir Yusanu. Après... euh. Tu sais.
Ensemble of Hope#059.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#060.src: But... I have to do it eventually. So.
Ensemble of Hope#060.dst: Mais... il faudra bien que je le fasse un jour. Donc.
Ensemble of Hope#060.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#061.src: Yeah. Let's... get a move on.
Ensemble of Hope#061.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#062.src: ...ready for phase one of the plan, {u}? Let's pack up quickly and head out.
Ensemble of Hope#062.dst: ...prêt pour la phase un du plan, {u}? Remballons vite et partons.
Ensemble of Hope#062.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#063.dst: A moins que tu aies des questions?
Ensemble of Hope#063.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#064.src: You know... still awful. But, uh... better, I guess.
Ensemble of Hope#064.dst: Tu sais... toujours affreux. Mais, euh... mieux, j'imagine.
Ensemble of Hope#064.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#065.src: I haven't left the hotel these past few days... but even just getting real food has felt like... like a gourmet meal!
Ensemble of Hope#065.dst: Je ne suis pas sortie de l'hôtel ces jours-ci... mais rien qu'un vrai repas, ça m'a paru... un festin de roi!
Ensemble of Hope#065.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#066.src: It's... hm. I've tried to not really... think about it too much. I'll have time for that when we're not still in danger.
Ensemble of Hope#066.dst: C'est... hm. J'ai essayé de ne pas trop... y penser. J'aurai le temps pour ça quand on ne sera plus en danger.
Ensemble of Hope#066.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#067.src: But, Zeph... he's been isolating himself. Him and Sui both!
Ensemble of Hope#067.dst: Mais Zeph... il s'isole. Lui et Sui, tous les deux!
Ensemble of Hope#067.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#068.src: Sigh... it's hard. Whenever I talk to him, he tries to put on his regular happy persona, but...
Ensemble of Hope#068.dst: Soupir... c'est dur. Chaque fois que je lui parle, il joue son rôle de joyeux luron habituel, mais...
Ensemble of Hope#068.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#069.src: I don't know. Obviously things have changed - I don't think you get out of - ha, what was it, weeks? - of imprisonment unaffected.
Ensemble of Hope#069.dst: Je ne sais pas. Évidemment, les choses ont changé - je ne crois pas qu'on sorte indemne de - ha, combien, des semaines? - d'emprisonnement.
Ensemble of Hope#069.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#070.src: ...he's resilient. Sui too. We'll be able to work past this. It's just... going to take time.
Ensemble of Hope#070.dst: ...il est solide. Sui aussi. On arrivera à surmonter ça. Ça va juste... prendre du temps.
Ensemble of Hope#070.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#071.src: Still workshopping it! I have a couple of different ideas, but...
Ensemble of Hope#071.dst: Je le peaufine encore! J'ai deux ou trois idées différentes, mais...
Ensemble of Hope#071.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#072.src: Well, it's hard to know which will work without knowing what the Canopy has. Too many different things to consider.
Ensemble of Hope#072.dst: Bon, difficile de savoir laquelle marchera sans savoir de quoi dispose la Canopée. Trop de choses à prendre en compte.
Ensemble of Hope#072.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#073.src: When we join up with them, I'm hoping I can fill in the gaps. And... I guess, get their opinions on it, too.
Ensemble of Hope#073.dst: Quand on les aura rejoints, j'espère combler les trous. Et... avoir leur avis là-dessus, aussi, j'imagine.
Ensemble of Hope#073.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#074.src: So- all that to say, I've got nothing for you! For now. I'll tell you later, okay?
Ensemble of Hope#074.dst: Bref- tout ça pour dire: rien pour toi! Pour l'instant. Je te raconterai plus tard, d'accord?
Ensemble of Hope#074.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#076.src: I... don't know what to do. I really, really don't.
Ensemble of Hope#076.dst: Je... ne sais pas quoi faire. Vraiment, vraiment pas.
Ensemble of Hope#076.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#077.src: We've... ugh, we've all lost people. Lots of Leaves got arrested for... this or that, over the years. It sucked, but... it happened.
Ensemble of Hope#077.dst: On a... pff, on a tous perdu des gens. Beaucoup de Feuilles ont été arrêtées pour... ceci ou cela, au fil des ans. C'était nul, mais... c'est arrivé.
Ensemble of Hope#077.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#078.src: ...it's never been this bad before. Never anyone this close. I mean... sigh. Syndra and Mora. Gods.
Ensemble of Hope#078.dst: ...ça n'a jamais été aussi grave. Jamais quelqu'un d'aussi proche. Enfin... soupir. Syndra et Mora. Dieux.
Ensemble of Hope#078.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#079.src: I want to help her get through this, but... she's closing herself off. And... we're still not home free just yet.
Ensemble of Hope#079.dst: Je veux l'aider à traverser ça, mais... elle se renferme. Et... on n'est pas encore tirés d'affaire.
Ensemble of Hope#079.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#080.src: ...when it's over. When it's over. Everything will be okay when it's over.
Ensemble of Hope#080.dst: ...quand ce sera fini. Quand ce sera fini. Tout ira bien quand ce sera fini.
Ensemble of Hope#080.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#083.src: I'm r-ready to see my old friends again... I miss Kaio.
Ensemble of Hope#083.dst: Je suis p-prêt à revoir mes vieux amis... Kaio me manque.
Ensemble of Hope#083.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#084.src: Was there s-something on your mind?
Ensemble of Hope#084.dst: Tu avais q-quelque chose en tête?
Ensemble of Hope#084.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#085.src: Ah... I... I don't want to lie to you.
Ensemble of Hope#085.dst: Ah... je... je ne veux pas te mentir.
Ensemble of Hope#085.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#086.src: So... I'm not d-doing great. Everytime I... I close my eyes I s-see that... face. The S-sovereign...
Ensemble of Hope#086.dst: Bon... ça ne va pas t-très bien. Dès que je... je ferme les yeux, je v-vois ce... visage. Le S-souverain...
Ensemble of Hope#086.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#087.src: Everytime I close my e-eyes I feel all that pain. All of it! All the m-memories!
Ensemble of Hope#087.dst: Dès que je ferme les y-yeux, je ressens toute cette douleur. Toute! Tous les s-souvenirs!
Ensemble of Hope#087.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#088.src: I was... okay with it all e-ending there.
Ensemble of Hope#088.dst: J'étais... prêt à ce que tout s-s'arrête là.
Ensemble of Hope#088.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#089.src: I know that i-it's over. I know Gikyo is dead but... their ghost still h-haunts me.
Ensemble of Hope#089.dst: Je sais que c'est f-fini. Je sais que Gikyo n'est plus, mais... son fantôme me h-hante encore.
Ensemble of Hope#089.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#090.src: I think it's a s-solid plan.
Ensemble of Hope#090.dst: Je trouve que c'est un plan s-solide.
Ensemble of Hope#090.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#091.src: I j-just wonder how many from the Leaves in the Wind are willing to a-actually come all the way here.
Ensemble of Hope#091.dst: Je me d-demande juste combien, chez les Feuilles au vent, voudront v-vraiment venir jusqu'ici.
Ensemble of Hope#091.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#094.src: Well, here we are. The dam really is something to behold, isn't it...
Ensemble of Hope#094.dst: Bon, nous y voilà. Le barrage vaut vraiment le coup d'oeil, hein...
Ensemble of Hope#094.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#095.src: I- I always d..did wonder what it'd b- b- be like to... to t...take this elevator...
Ensemble of Hope#095.dst: J- je me suis toujours d..demandé ce que ça f- f- ferait de... de p...prendre cet ascenseur...
Ensemble of Hope#095.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#096.src: Well, you'll finally get your chance. Come on, let's just fight already.
Ensemble of Hope#096.dst: Eh bien, tu vas enfin le savoir. Allez, battons-nous, qu'on en finisse.
Ensemble of Hope#096.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#097.dst: Sui. On ne peut pas juste-
Ensemble of Hope#097.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#098.src: What? We can't rush this? The longer we wait, the more suspicious they'll get.
Ensemble of Hope#098.dst: Quoi? Il ne faut pas se précipiter? Plus on attend, plus ils vont se méfier.
Ensemble of Hope#098.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#102.src: Defeat the soldiers defending the elevator at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Ensemble of Hope#102.dst: Vainquez les soldats qui défendent l'ascenseur en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Ensemble of Hope#104.src: Careful! Looks like they've got backup!
Ensemble of Hope#104.dst: Attention! On dirait qu'ils ont des renforts!
Ensemble of Hope#104.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#106.src: H...how many p- people can they fit in th- th- that elevator?!
Ensemble of Hope#106.dst: C...combien de p- personnes ils peuvent faire tenir dans c- c- cet ascenseur?!
Ensemble of Hope#106.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#108.src: You're the insurgents everyone is on the lookout for! MEN, TO ARMS! CAPTURE THEM!
Ensemble of Hope#108.dst: Vous êtes les insurgés que tout le monde recherche! HOMMES, AUX ARMES! CAPTUREZ-LES!
Ensemble of Hope#108.speaker: Wings Commander Kaezu

Ensemble of Hope#109.src: Talk to the group again at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Ensemble of Hope#109.dst: Parlez de nouveau au groupe en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Ensemble of Hope#111.src: Sigh. Whatever. Let's go... get our people.
Ensemble of Hope#111.dst: Soupir. Peu importe. Allons... chercher les nôtres.
Ensemble of Hope#111.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#114.src: Sui, are you INSANE?! You almost got SHOT!
Ensemble of Hope#114.dst: Sui, t'es FOLLE?! Tu as failli te faire TIRER DESSUS!
Ensemble of Hope#114.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#116.src: You turned your back when there were enemies still around!! What do you think would have happened if we weren't here?
Ensemble of Hope#116.dst: Tu as tourné le dos alors qu'il restait des ennemis!! Qu'est-ce qui se serait passé, à ton avis, si on n'avait pas été là?
Ensemble of Hope#116.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#118.src: Shot. If you were lucky, somewhere that wouldn't have killed - but after what they saw, would they have really taken that risk?!
Ensemble of Hope#118.dst: On t'aurait tiré dessus. Avec de la chance, pas à un endroit mortel - mais après ce qu'ils ont vu, ils auraient vraiment pris ce risque?!
Ensemble of Hope#118.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#120.src: Sui, stop being so reckless. You're... you're strong, I get that, but... that doesn't mean you're invincible.
Ensemble of Hope#120.dst: Sui, arrête d'être aussi imprudente. Tu es... tu es forte, je sais, mais... ça ne veut pas dire que tu es invincible.
Ensemble of Hope#120.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#121.src: S...Sui, we dont w- want to l- lo- lose you too...
Ensemble of Hope#121.dst: S...Sui, on ne v- veut pas te p- per- perdre toi aussi...
Ensemble of Hope#121.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#122.src: But if I'm not good enough, if I'm not f-fast enough, then- then- then I'll lose you, and- and I can't, I can't do that again, I-
Ensemble of Hope#122.dst: Mais si je ne suis pas assez forte, pas assez r-rapide, alors- alors- alors je vous perdrai, et- et je ne peux pas, je ne peux pas revivre ça, je-
Ensemble of Hope#122.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#125.src: You don't need to prove yourself. You've always been good enough for us.
Ensemble of Hope#125.dst: Tu n'as rien à prouver. Tu as toujours été à la hauteur pour nous.
Ensemble of Hope#125.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#126.src: Whatever that- that Sovereign said to you, to make you think everything's that's happened to us is your fault? It's not true!
Ensemble of Hope#126.dst: Ce que ce- ce Souverain t'a dit pour te faire croire que tout ce qui nous est arrivé est de ta faute? C'est faux!
Ensemble of Hope#126.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#127.src: Sui. Sui. Mora's death is not your fault!! We can blame the crown, blame the Sovereigns- hell, blame me for leaving him there!!!
Ensemble of Hope#127.dst: Sui. Sui. La mort de Mora n'est pas de ta faute!! Accuse la Couronne, les Souverains- bon sang, accuse-moi de l'avoir laissé là-bas!!!
Ensemble of Hope#127.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#128.src: But it wasn't your responsibility to protect him. To protect us. We're a team - a family, and... and I don't want to see you burn yourself to ash like Syndra did.
Ensemble of Hope#128.dst: Mais ce n'était pas à toi de le protéger. De nous protéger. On est une équipe - une famille, et... et je ne veux pas te voir te consumer jusqu'aux cendres comme Syndra.
Ensemble of Hope#128.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#130.src: R...Rex is r- right, Sui. We can... f- fi- fight together, sh...shore up each o- oth... each other's w...weaknesses.
Ensemble of Hope#130.dst: R...Rex a r- raison, Sui. On peut... c- com- combattre ensemble, c...combler les f- fai... les faiblesses de l'a...autre.
Ensemble of Hope#130.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#132.src: ...b- but we should pr...probably get going, Sui, b- before more backup sh...shows up.
Ensemble of Hope#132.dst: ...m- mais on devrait sans d...doute y aller, Sui, a- avant que d'autres renforts n'a...arrivent.
Ensemble of Hope#132.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#133.src: Sigh. Zeph's right. You guys hurry to the Leaves, while we have the chance. {u} and I will prepare for your return.
Ensemble of Hope#133.dst: Soupir. Zeph a raison. Filez rejoindre les Feuilles tant qu'on en a l'occasion. {u} et moi, on préparera votre retour.
Ensemble of Hope#133.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#135.src: Y... yeah. You're right, we should go too. Come on, let's meet at the Canopy's cave.
Ensemble of Hope#135.dst: O... ouais. Tu as raison, on y va aussi. Allez, rendez-vous à la grotte de la Canopée.
Ensemble of Hope#135.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#136.src: A little. But... I don't know how else to get through to her.
Ensemble of Hope#136.dst: Un peu. Mais... je ne sais pas comment l'atteindre autrement.
Ensemble of Hope#136.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#137.src: It's so... frustrating! Seeing her taking on all of Syndra's worst traits! I- I know what to look out for, this time, but...
Ensemble of Hope#137.dst: C'est tellement... frustrant! La voir adopter tous les pires travers de Syndra! Je- je sais quoi surveiller, cette fois, mais...
Ensemble of Hope#137.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#138.src: ...but I still don't know what to do.
Ensemble of Hope#138.dst: ...mais je ne sais toujours pas quoi faire.
Ensemble of Hope#138.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#139.src: Ha. Maybe I should apply my own advice to myself...
Ensemble of Hope#139.dst: Ha. Je devrais peut-être suivre mes propres conseils...
Ensemble of Hope#139.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#140.src: We should get moving too. Come on, let's meet at the Canopy's cave.
Ensemble of Hope#140.dst: On devrait y aller aussi. Allez, rendez-vous à la grotte de la Canopée.
Ensemble of Hope#140.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#141.src: Travel to the {p} and find the Canopy in their new hideout at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Ensemble of Hope#141.dst: Rendez-vous dans {p} et trouvez la Canopée dans sa nouvelle cachette en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Ensemble of Hope#145.src: Oh, good grief. Look more closely, foxes - these are familiar faces! Or rather, familiar face, I should say - welcome back to the Canopy, {u}! And who might this be?
Ensemble of Hope#145.dst: Oh, juste ciel. Regardez mieux, renards - ce sont des visages familiers! Ou plutôt, un visage familier, devrais-je dire - bon retour à la Canopée, {u}! Et qui est-ce donc?
Ensemble of Hope#145.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#146.src: ...you're Captain Rurie, right? Sui told us about you.
Ensemble of Hope#146.dst: ...vous êtes le capitaine Rurie, c'est ça? Sui nous a parlé de vous.
Ensemble of Hope#146.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#147.src: Did she! Then that must mean you are one of the dear captured friends - no no, don't tell me, I can figure it out... Rex, I assume?
Ensemble of Hope#147.dst: Vraiment! Alors tu dois faire partie de ces chers amis capturés - non non, ne dis rien, je vais deviner... Rex, je présume?
Ensemble of Hope#147.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#148.src: Hm... now, I would bring you in, but then Fuhue might have my head for not following her many numerous protocols... and we certainly can't have that...
Ensemble of Hope#148.dst: Hm... je vous ferais bien entrer, mais Fuhue risquerait de me couper la tête pour non-respect de ses innombrables protocoles... et ça, il ne faudrait surtout pas...
Ensemble of Hope#148.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#149.src: Ugh, just let them in, Rurie. We've been breaking initiation protocols left and right already, I can't be bothered enforcing them anymore.
Ensemble of Hope#149.dst: Pff, fais-les entrer, Rurie. On enfreint déjà les protocoles d'admission à tout bout de champ, je n'ai plus la force de les faire respecter.
Ensemble of Hope#149.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#150.src: Well, would you look at that! Lucky you! Come on in, come on in. Our numbers have grown since last you were here, {u} - many more friendly faces hanging about!
Ensemble of Hope#150.dst: Eh bien, regardez-moi ça! Quelle chance! Entrez, entrez. Nous sommes plus nombreux depuis ta dernière visite, {u} - bien d'autres visages amicaux traînent par ici!
Ensemble of Hope#150.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#151.src: {u}, Rex!! Man, it's good to see you guys!!
Ensemble of Hope#151.dst: {u}, Rex!! Bon sang, ça fait plaisir de vous voir!!
Ensemble of Hope#151.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#152.src: Yuman?! What're you doing here? I thought they had you locked up in-
Ensemble of Hope#152.dst: Yuman?! Qu'est-ce que tu fais là? Je croyais qu'ils t'avaient enfermé à-
Ensemble of Hope#152.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#153.src: In Deraj Prison, yup. Everything they say about it is true- and, and more! They get you workin' in the mines, if you're not... eh, y'know. Disappeared.
Ensemble of Hope#153.dst: A la prison de Deraj, ouais. Tout ce qu'on en dit est vrai- et, et même pire! Ils te font bosser dans les mines, si t'as pas... euh, tu vois. Disparu.
Ensemble of Hope#153.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#154.src: Lucky us, these Canopy guys showed up and broke us out! There were explosions, and growing plants, and crashing waves, and- and-
Ensemble of Hope#154.dst: Par chance, la Canopée est venue nous faire évader! Y avait des explosions, des plantes qui poussaient, des vagues qui déferlaient, et- et-
Ensemble of Hope#154.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#155.src: And then the feathery birds showed up outta nowhere, like- nothing there, then poof, cloud of smoke, and there they are- and they got us outta there!
Ensemble of Hope#155.dst: Et puis les oiseaux à plumes sont sortis de nulle part, genre- rien, puis pouf, nuage de fumée, et les voilà- et ils nous ont sortis de là!
Ensemble of Hope#155.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#156.src: I'm sorry... Rurie. You all... successfully broke into Gravity's Monolith?! And got people out?!
Ensemble of Hope#156.dst: Pardon... Rurie. Vous avez... réussi à entrer dans le Monolithe de la Gravité?! Et à libérer des gens?!
Ensemble of Hope#156.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#157.src: Ah, it wasn't so tough once we had the plans of their inner workings! Floorplans, guard rotations... the works.
Ensemble of Hope#157.dst: Ah, ce n'était pas si dur une fois qu'on avait les plans de son fonctionnement! Plans des étages, tours de garde... tout!
Ensemble of Hope#157.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#158.src: That Warden's a deadly foe, but he sticks to an incredibly firm schedule - out like a light once it turns {~} PM! Of course, the prison goes into lockdown, but we've got our ways around it.
Ensemble of Hope#158.dst: Le directeur de la prison est un ennemi redoutable, mais il suit un horaire d'une rigueur incroyable - il dort comme une masse dès {~} h du soir! Bien sûr, la prison est alors verrouillée, mais nous avons nos astuces.
Ensemble of Hope#158.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#160.src: Right you are Cileon, right you are... well, we'll have time to discuss the details later! I must return to my owls, there's much left to do!
Ensemble of Hope#160.dst: Exactement, Cileon, exactement... enfin, nous aurons le temps d'en discuter plus tard! Je dois retourner auprès de mes hiboux, il reste tant à faire!
Ensemble of Hope#160.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#162.src: Is, uh... is Zeph alright? I overheard a couple of things about what you two went through, so...
Ensemble of Hope#162.dst: Est-ce que, euh... Zeph va bien? J'ai entendu deux-trois trucs sur ce que vous avez vécu tous les deux...
Ensemble of Hope#162.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#164.dst: Hein? Pff, nan, bien sûr que non.
Ensemble of Hope#164.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#166.src: He's alright. He and Sui will be here later, so you can ask him about it yourself.
Ensemble of Hope#166.dst: Il va bien. Sui et lui arriveront plus tard, tu pourras lui demander toi-même.
Ensemble of Hope#166.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#167.src: Oh! Oh, ha, uh, alright- sure, that sounds good, yep.
Ensemble of Hope#167.dst: Oh! Oh, ha, euh, d'accord- bien sûr, ça me va, ouais.
Ensemble of Hope#167.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#168.src: I'm gonna... get back to my bro up there. Talk to ya more later!
Ensemble of Hope#168.dst: Je vais... retourner voir mon frangin là-haut. On se reparle plus tard!
Ensemble of Hope#168.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#170.src: I should go talk to the Canopy's leader, get started on some planning. Come by when you're done talking with everyone, okay?
Ensemble of Hope#170.dst: Je devrais aller parler au chef de la Canopée, commencer à planifier. Passe me voir quand tu auras fini de parler à tout le monde, d'accord?
Ensemble of Hope#170.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#172.src: Your friend has entered the hideout already, please make yourself at home.
Ensemble of Hope#172.dst: Votre amie est déjà entrée dans la cachette, faites comme chez vous.
Ensemble of Hope#172.speaker: Canopy Fox

Ensemble of Hope#176.src: Ah, {u}. I'm glad to see you are well.
Ensemble of Hope#176.dst: Ah, {u}. Je suis heureux de te voir en forme.
Ensemble of Hope#176.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#177.src: These have been... a difficult few weeks. For all of us, I gather. We have... been informed of our losses.
Ensemble of Hope#177.dst: Ces dernières semaines ont été... difficiles. Pour nous tous, j'imagine. On nous a... informés de nos pertes.
Ensemble of Hope#177.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#178.src: I still can't believe we let her talk us into... into all of that!
Ensemble of Hope#178.dst: Je n'arrive toujours pas à croire qu'on l'ait laissée nous convaincre de... de tout ça!
Ensemble of Hope#178.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#179.src: Yulie, let's not speak ill of the dead. We cannot change the past. We can only move forward.
Ensemble of Hope#179.dst: Yulie, ne disons pas de mal des morts. On ne peut pas changer le passé. On ne peut qu'aller de l'avant.
Ensemble of Hope#179.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#180.src: ...I, too, regret not standing my ground. For her sake, if nothing else.
Ensemble of Hope#180.dst: ...moi aussi, je regrette de ne pas avoir tenu bon. Pour elle, au moins.
Ensemble of Hope#180.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#181.src: Sigh... her grief and rage consumed her, in the end, and I did little to stop it. I- ahh- my back...
Ensemble of Hope#181.dst: Soupir... le chagrin et la rage l'ont consumée, et je n'ai guère tenté de l'en empêcher. Je- ahh- mon dos...
Ensemble of Hope#181.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#182.src: Quill, you need to rest. Sit down for a while, please.
Ensemble of Hope#182.dst: Quill, tu dois te reposer. Assieds-toi un moment, s'il te plaît.
Ensemble of Hope#182.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#183.src: No, no... I'm fine, Yulie. We have work to do, after all.
Ensemble of Hope#183.dst: Non, non... ça va, Yulie. Nous avons du travail, après tout.
Ensemble of Hope#183.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#184.src: Well, the guards at the prison didn't really care much about who was physically fit to work or not. They just... work you 'till you're dead, I guess!
Ensemble of Hope#184.dst: Bon, les gardes de la prison se fichaient pas mal de savoir qui était en état de travailler. Ils te font... bosser jusqu'à la mort, j'imagine!
Ensemble of Hope#184.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#185.src: Harsh treatment, certainly... but I suppose it is no different than the Roughworks, at its core. Only... less obscured.
Ensemble of Hope#185.dst: Un traitement dur, certes... mais je suppose qu'au fond, ce n'est pas si différent de Roughworks. Juste... moins dissimulé.
Ensemble of Hope#185.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#187.src: {u}, Yusanu told us that he only made it through because of you and Sui. So... thank you. For protecting my little brother when I couldn't.
Ensemble of Hope#187.dst: {u}, Yusanu nous a dit qu'il ne s'en est sorti que grâce à toi et à Sui. Alors... merci. D'avoir protégé mon petit frère quand je ne pouvais pas.
Ensemble of Hope#187.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#188.src: Yes... thanks to yours and Sui's magic, I hear...
Ensemble of Hope#188.dst: Oui... grâce à ta magie et à celle de Sui, à ce qu'on m'a dit...
Ensemble of Hope#188.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#189.src: From the Steel Feather? The Canopy has quarters built deeper in these caverns. Anyone uninterested in fighting is staying there, for the time being.
Ensemble of Hope#189.dst: Ceux de la Plume d'acier? La Canopée a aménagé des quartiers plus loin dans ces cavernes. Ceux qui ne veulent pas se battre y restent, pour le moment.
Ensemble of Hope#189.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#190.src: ...those we could find, at least. There are many we are still missing, unfortunately. I pray they are still alive.
Ensemble of Hope#190.dst: ...ceux que nous avons pu retrouver, du moins. Beaucoup manquent encore à l'appel, hélas. Je prie pour qu'ils soient encore en vie.
Ensemble of Hope#190.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#191.src: Perhaps when this is all over, we will be able to locate the rest... I can only hope so.
Ensemble of Hope#191.dst: Quand tout ça sera fini, nous pourrons peut-être retrouver les autres... Je ne peux que l'espérer.
Ensemble of Hope#191.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#192.src: ...so, look, if we try to charge these in this specific order-
Ensemble of Hope#192.dst: ...donc, regarde, si on essaie de les charger dans cet ordre précis-
Ensemble of Hope#192.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#193.src: No, wait. Your sequence is charging Thunder twice in a row here, when it should only do it once. Too much of a charge, and-
Ensemble of Hope#193.dst: Non, attends. Ta séquence charge Foudre deux fois de suite ici, alors qu'elle ne devrait le faire qu'une fois. Trop de charge, et-
Ensemble of Hope#193.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#194.src: -and it'll destabilize, right. Thanks for double checking my work, Fuhue.
Ensemble of Hope#194.dst: -et ça se déstabilise, c'est vrai. Merci d'avoir revérifié, Fuhue.
Ensemble of Hope#194.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#195.src: ...oh, {u}??? I- I completely didn't... notice you were here...
Ensemble of Hope#195.dst: ...oh, {u}??? Je- je n'avais pas du tout... remarqué que tu étais là...
Ensemble of Hope#195.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#196.src: Yeesh. You've gotta fix your lack of awareness, bro. Anyone could sneak up on you while you're hyper focused in on something!
Ensemble of Hope#196.dst: Ouh là. Faut que tu travailles ta vigilance, frangin. N'importe qui pourrait te surprendre quand t'es hyper concentré sur un truc!
Ensemble of Hope#196.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#197.src: Ugh, yeah, yeah, you keep telling me- if you're not going to be helpful, stop hovering!
Ensemble of Hope#197.dst: Pff, oui, oui, tu me le répètes sans cesse- si tu ne m'aides pas, arrête de me tourner autour!
Ensemble of Hope#197.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#198.src: Nah. I wanna see the cool stuff happen when you get it working! Don't want to miss the fireworks or any-
Ensemble of Hope#198.dst: Nan. Je veux voir les trucs cool qui se passent quand tu le fais marcher! J'veux pas rater le feu d'artifice ou-
Ensemble of Hope#198.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#199.src: To answer your question, {u}, Yusanu believes he has a working theory on the Resonance Weaver's functionality.
Ensemble of Hope#199.dst: Pour répondre à ta question, {u}, Yusanu pense avoir une théorie viable sur le fonctionnement du Tisseur de résonance.
Ensemble of Hope#199.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#200.src: Yeah, but a working theory doesn't mean a whole lot if I can't get results...
Ensemble of Hope#200.dst: Ouais, mais une théorie viable ne vaut pas grand-chose sans résultats...
Ensemble of Hope#200.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#201.src: Look, these five glyphs - they correspond almost exactly to the ones the Canopy's talismans use. Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Thunder.
Ensemble of Hope#201.dst: Regarde, ces cinq glyphes - ils correspondent presque exactement à ceux des talismans de la Canopée. Feu, Eau, Terre, Air, Foudre.
Ensemble of Hope#201.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#202.src: They can be charged to activate them - a simple burst on its own, maybe, but if chained together... you get something more complex.
Ensemble of Hope#202.dst: On peut les charger pour les activer - seul, ça fait juste une décharge, peut-être, mais enchaînés... on obtient quelque chose de plus complexe.
Ensemble of Hope#202.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#203.src: Resonance... resonance, resonance, resonance... Soosu was always saying there was something she could not see with her blessing. Intangible, not of the elements...
Ensemble of Hope#203.dst: Résonance... résonance, résonance, résonance... Soosu disait toujours qu'il y avait quelque chose que sa bénédiction ne lui laissait pas voir. Intangible, étranger aux éléments...
Ensemble of Hope#203.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#204.src: Maybe... if we could find it, we could use the Weaver to... to visualize it. Bind it in place, so we can see it...
Ensemble of Hope#204.dst: Peut-être... si on le trouvait, le Tisseur pourrait... le rendre visible. Le fixer sur place, pour qu'on puisse le voir...
Ensemble of Hope#204.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#205.src: ...yeah, none of that made any sense to me. Explain it with easier words?
Ensemble of Hope#205.dst: ...ouais, j'ai rien compris. Tu peux expliquer avec des mots plus simples?
Ensemble of Hope#205.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#206.src: Okay, sure, just for you. Invisible thing in the air. With device, we make it visible.
Ensemble of Hope#206.dst: D'accord, rien que pour toi. Chose invisible dans l'air. Avec appareil, on la rend visible.
Ensemble of Hope#206.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#207.src: Oh! Why didn't ya start with that!
Ensemble of Hope#207.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#209.src: Ahem. Will we try the updated chain?
Ensemble of Hope#209.dst: Hum. On essaie la chaîne mise à jour?
Ensemble of Hope#209.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#210.src: Right, right... got distracted. Thanks, Yuman.
Ensemble of Hope#210.dst: Oui, oui... je me suis laissé distraire. Merci, Yuman.
Ensemble of Hope#210.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#214.src: I... I don't know, but... I think it's working! Fuhue, we did it!
Ensemble of Hope#214.dst: Je... je ne sais pas, mais... je crois que ça marche! Fuhue, on a réussi!
Ensemble of Hope#214.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#215.src: Maybe if I touch it, something will...
Ensemble of Hope#215.dst: Si je le touche, peut-être que quelque chose va...
Ensemble of Hope#215.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#216.dst: Qu- quoi?! Qu'est-ce qui ne va pas?!
Ensemble of Hope#216.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#218.src: And what, exactly, is this doing here? A blight that permeates the air... concerning. I'll have to speak to Master Azael.
Ensemble of Hope#218.dst: Et que fait ceci ici, exactement? Un fléau qui imprègne l'air... inquiétant. Je vais devoir en parler à maître Azael.
Ensemble of Hope#218.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#219.src: Well, uh... now that it is here, can we do anything with it? Like... charge the glyphs to manipulate it?
Ensemble of Hope#219.dst: Bon, euh... maintenant qu'il est là, on peut en faire quelque chose? Genre... charger les glyphes pour le manipuler?
Ensemble of Hope#219.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#220.src: M... maybe. I'll have to do some thinking. But for now, it'd probably be best to... get rid of it. If I hit all five at once, it should...
Ensemble of Hope#220.dst: P... peut-être. Je vais devoir réfléchir. Mais pour l'instant, mieux vaut sans doute... s'en débarrasser. Si je frappe les cinq à la fois, ça devrait...
Ensemble of Hope#220.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#221.src: ...there. Gods. Why did the Queen need this thing in the first place...?
Ensemble of Hope#221.dst: ...voilà. Par les dieux. Pourquoi la Reine avait-elle besoin de ce truc...?
Ensemble of Hope#221.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#222.src: ...yeah, sure, why not. Later. I guess I've got to clean up here anyway.
Ensemble of Hope#222.dst: ...ouais, bien sûr, pourquoi pas. Plus tard. De toute façon, je dois ranger ici.
Ensemble of Hope#222.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#223.src: Seeing as... is that Rex over there? Oh, good. Well, seeing as she's plotting with Azael, I should get ready for that.
Ensemble of Hope#223.dst: Vu que... c'est Rex, là-bas? Oh, bien. Bon, vu qu'elle complote avec Azael, je devrais me préparer.
Ensemble of Hope#223.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#224.src: Yuman, could you help me out? Since you've been annoying me all day.
Ensemble of Hope#224.dst: Yuman, tu peux m'aider? Vu que tu m'as embêté toute la journée.
Ensemble of Hope#224.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#229.src: I've been looking forward to seeing you again, {u}. That is your real name, right?
Ensemble of Hope#229.dst: J'avais hâte de te revoir, {u}. C'est bien ton vrai nom, n'est-ce pas?
Ensemble of Hope#229.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#230.src: It feels like it's been ages since we last spoke. As you can probably guess, a lot has changed for me since then.
Ensemble of Hope#230.dst: Ça me semble faire une éternité qu'on ne s'est pas parlé. Tu t'en doutes, beaucoup de choses ont changé pour moi depuis.
Ensemble of Hope#230.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#231.src: After we took out Commander Ferreo, there was nowhere for me to go, but I knew I needed to leave the {p} and head somewhere I wouldn't be recognized.
Ensemble of Hope#231.dst: Après avoir éliminé le commandant Ferreo, je n'avais nulle part où aller, mais je savais que je devais quitter {p} pour un endroit où personne ne me reconnaîtrait.
Ensemble of Hope#231.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#232.src: I couldn't risk taking the train, so sneaking into the {p} at night was my only option. I had no idea what could be waiting for me there, but I had to go quickly, before they would start looking for me.
Ensemble of Hope#232.dst: Je ne pouvais pas risquer de prendre le train, alors me faufiler dans {p} de nuit était ma seule option. J'ignorais ce qui m'attendait là-bas, mais je devais faire vite, avant qu'ils ne commencent à me chercher.
Ensemble of Hope#232.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#233.src: I took the easternmost exit out of the {p}, and by some miracle, snuck through to the {p} after quietly taking out a guard.
Ensemble of Hope#233.dst: J'ai pris la sortie la plus à l'est de {p} et, par miracle, je me suis faufilé jusqu'à {p} après avoir discrètement neutralisé un garde.
Ensemble of Hope#233.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#234.src: From there, I blindly stumbled across the region, terrified of what would find me. I was eventually knocked out by a Canopy scout, who took me into their hideout to be questioned.
Ensemble of Hope#234.dst: De là, j'ai erré à l'aveugle dans la région, terrifié par ce qui pourrait me tomber dessus. J'ai fini assommé par un éclaireur de la Canopée, qui m'a emmené dans leur cachette pour m'interroger.
Ensemble of Hope#234.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#235.src: I told them the truth, about who I was, where I came from, and what I had done... They didn't believe me until I described you, and what you had done for me.
Ensemble of Hope#235.dst: Je leur ai dit la vérité, qui j'étais, d'où je venais et ce que j'avais fait... Ils ne m'ont cru qu'une fois que je t'ai décrit, toi et ce que tu avais fait pour moi.
Ensemble of Hope#235.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#236.src: Even after we split ways, you were still there to look out for me!
Ensemble of Hope#236.dst: Même après nous être séparés, tu veillais encore sur moi!
Ensemble of Hope#236.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#237.src: Of course, they didn't trust me immediately, I still had to prove myself. I've learned more here than I would have ever had at {p}.
Ensemble of Hope#237.dst: Bien sûr, ils ne m'ont pas fait confiance tout de suite, j'ai dû faire mes preuves. J'ai appris plus ici que je ne l'aurais jamais fait à {p}.
Ensemble of Hope#237.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#238.src: And now, I can call myself a resistance member, same as you. I've thought a lot about my goals since we were recruits. I want Fruma to be rid of corruption, like what we saw with Commander Ferreo.
Ensemble of Hope#238.dst: Et maintenant, je peux me dire membre de la résistance, comme toi. J'ai beaucoup réfléchi à mes objectifs depuis qu'on était recrues. Je veux débarrasser Fruma de la corruption, comme celle du commandant Ferreo.
Ensemble of Hope#238.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#239.src: The resistance is the best chance we have at achieving this goal, I'm sure you've realised this too. I am ready to risk my life fighting for a better future for Fruma!
Ensemble of Hope#239.dst: La résistance est notre meilleure chance d'y arriver, tu l'as sûrement compris toi aussi. Je suis prêt à risquer ma vie pour un meilleur avenir pour Fruma!
Ensemble of Hope#239.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#240.src: I could be saying the same thing, but the people here have told me that you can handle yourself just fine.
Ensemble of Hope#240.dst: Je pourrais te dire la même chose, mais les gens d'ici m'ont dit que tu savais très bien te débrouiller.
Ensemble of Hope#240.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#241.src: I must admit, my time with the resistance has been very difficult. But I can finally say I am fighting for a cause I truly believe in.
Ensemble of Hope#241.dst: Je dois l'avouer, mon temps dans la résistance a été très difficile. Mais je peux enfin dire que je me bats pour une cause en laquelle je crois vraiment.
Ensemble of Hope#241.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#242.src: Deep down in my heart, I've always known I could never live up to the expectations my family had for me. Here, I no longer have to worry about that.
Ensemble of Hope#242.dst: Au fond de moi, j'ai toujours su que je ne serais jamais à la hauteur des attentes de ma famille. Ici, je n'ai plus à m'en soucier.
Ensemble of Hope#242.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#243.src: I was so alone, {u}, I truly can't thank you enough for being there for me...
Ensemble of Hope#243.dst: J'étais si seul, {u}, je ne te remercierai jamais assez d'avoir été là pour moi...
Ensemble of Hope#243.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#244.src: You have nothing to be sorry for, I completely understand why you couldn't tell me the truth.
Ensemble of Hope#244.dst: Tu n'as pas à t'excuser, je comprends parfaitement pourquoi tu ne pouvais pas me dire la vérité.
Ensemble of Hope#244.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#245.src: What matters the most is that you helped me escape {p} when you found out that I was in danger.
Ensemble of Hope#245.dst: Ce qui compte le plus, c'est que tu m'as aidé à fuir {p} quand tu as découvert que j'étais en danger.
Ensemble of Hope#245.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#246.src: ...and if we route through the tunnels - we have a couple options for city sectors...
Ensemble of Hope#246.dst: ...et si on passe par les tunnels - on a deux ou trois options de secteurs de la ville...
Ensemble of Hope#246.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#247.src: Yes, I see. It would be worth your while to compare notes with Captain Fuhue, she can help narrow it down.
Ensemble of Hope#247.dst: Oui, je vois. Tu aurais intérêt à comparer tes notes avec la capitaine Fuhue, elle peut t'aider à affiner.
Ensemble of Hope#247.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#248.src: ...ah, {u}. Young Rex and I were just speaking on our options moving forward. Would you like to join us for this discussion?
Ensemble of Hope#248.dst: ...ah, {u}. La jeune Rex et moi parlions justement de nos options pour la suite. Veux-tu te joindre à nous?
Ensemble of Hope#248.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#249.src: Well... go, then! Go talk to people, you have time.
Ensemble of Hope#249.dst: Bon... vas-y, alors! Va parler aux gens, tu as le temps.
Ensemble of Hope#249.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#250.src: Alright! So, {u}, here's the deal. If we want to take out the crown, we'll need to hit it at its root - the Queen, the Citadel, and her Royal Palace.
Ensemble of Hope#250.dst: Bien! Alors, {u}, voilà le topo. Si on veut abattre la Couronne, il faut la frapper à la racine - la Reine, la Citadelle et son Palais royal.
Ensemble of Hope#250.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#251.src: We're not getting through the front gates, obviously... they're too defended. But we don't need to take the gates - we can come in from below.
Ensemble of Hope#251.dst: On ne passera pas par les portes principales, évidemment... trop bien défendues. Mais pas besoin de prendre les portes - on peut entrer par en dessous.
Ensemble of Hope#251.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#252.src: The caverns and catacombs beneath the Citadel are quite expansive. Captain Rurie has-
Ensemble of Hope#252.dst: Les cavernes et catacombes sous la Citadelle sont très étendues. Le capitaine Rurie a-
Ensemble of Hope#252.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#253.src: Ah, was that my name I just overheard! We're speaking about the tunnels, are we? If you're hoping to traverse them, I'm the man for the job!
Ensemble of Hope#253.dst: Ah, est-ce mon nom que je viens d'entendre? On parle des tunnels, n'est-ce pas? Si vous comptez les parcourir, je suis l'homme de la situation!
Ensemble of Hope#253.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#254.src: It's quite an extensive network, really... the owls and I have spent years mapping each and every inch of it - and we still haven't seen it all! It's all very interesting - and that's not to mention-
Ensemble of Hope#254.dst: C'est un réseau très étendu, vraiment... les hiboux et moi avons passé des années à en cartographier chaque recoin - et nous n'avons toujours pas tout vu! C'est passionnant - sans parler de-
Ensemble of Hope#254.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#255.src: Get to the point already, Rurie. They want to reach the Citadel through the tunnels. Is that possible?
Ensemble of Hope#255.dst: Viens-en au fait, Rurie. Ils veulent atteindre la Citadelle par les tunnels. C'est possible?
Ensemble of Hope#255.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#256.src: Hmph. Possible, it certainly is... though results may vary. Looking for something in particular?
Ensemble of Hope#256.dst: Hmph. Possible, ça l'est assurément... mais les résultats varient. Vous cherchez quelque chose de précis?
Ensemble of Hope#256.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#257.src: Something easy to take, and easily defensible. University is out of the question... too large. The barracks are out of the question... maybe the Industrial Zone? Someone get me a map-
Ensemble of Hope#257.dst: Quelque chose de facile à prendre et à défendre. L'Université est exclue... trop grande. La caserne est exclue... la Zone industrielle, peut-être? Qu'on m'apporte une carte-
Ensemble of Hope#257.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#258.src: If I- ahh- if I may interrupt... I believe the {p} should fit the criteria you are looking for.
Ensemble of Hope#258.dst: Si je- ahh- si je puis me permettre... je pense que {p} devrait correspondre à vos critères.
Ensemble of Hope#258.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#259.src: It is closed off, and only lightly guarded in comparison to the rest of the Citadel... or, at least, it was in my time.
Ensemble of Hope#259.dst: C'est un lieu fermé, et peu gardé comparé au reste de la Citadelle... ou du moins, ça l'était à mon époque.
Ensemble of Hope#259.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#261.src: The {p}, you say? Yes... yes, I believe it could work! The path is long and winding, but should be plenty large enough to fit a strike team.
Ensemble of Hope#261.dst: {p}, dis-tu? Oui... oui, je crois que ça pourrait marcher! Le chemin est long et sinueux, mais bien assez large pour une équipe d'assaut.
Ensemble of Hope#261.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#262.src: Good! Captain Rurie, would you be able to map out that route so we can-
Ensemble of Hope#262.dst: Bien! Capitaine Rurie, pourriez-vous tracer cet itinéraire pour qu'on puisse-
Ensemble of Hope#262.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#264.dst: Oh... tout le monde est, euh, là.
Ensemble of Hope#264.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#266.src: Y...Yuman?! Y- you- you're here? Y...you're okay?
Ensemble of Hope#266.dst: Y...Yuman?! T- tu- tu es là? T...tu vas bien?
Ensemble of Hope#266.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#267.src: 'Course I am, princess! What, were you worried?
Ensemble of Hope#267.dst: Bien sûr, princesse! Quoi, tu t'inquiétais?
Ensemble of Hope#267.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#268.src: Are you done? Weren't we here to plan our next moves?
Ensemble of Hope#268.dst: Vous avez fini? On n'était pas là pour planifier la suite?
Ensemble of Hope#268.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#270.src: So we're attacking the Citadel through the tunnels?
Ensemble of Hope#270.dst: Donc on attaque la Citadelle par les tunnels?
Ensemble of Hope#270.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#271.src: Indeed, we are. It seems we have decided on the {p}? We will take control of the sector to serve as a launching point for future operations.
Ensemble of Hope#271.dst: En effet. Il semble que nous ayons choisi {p}? Nous prendrons le contrôle du secteur pour en faire une base de départ pour nos futures opérations.
Ensemble of Hope#271.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#272.src: If that's the only thing we attack, won't the crown immediately realize what we're doing?
Ensemble of Hope#272.dst: Si c'est la seule chose qu'on attaque, la Couronne ne va pas tout de suite comprendre ce qu'on fait?
Ensemble of Hope#272.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#273.src: Hm... yeah, I guess you're right. We'll want to stage a few more attacks elsewhere, divert their attention...
Ensemble of Hope#273.dst: Hm... ouais, tu as sans doute raison. Il faudra monter quelques attaques ailleurs, détourner leur attention...
Ensemble of Hope#273.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#274.src: We could launch an attack at the gates?
Ensemble of Hope#274.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#275.src: Wh- wh- what?! Sui, y...you can't just th- throw yourself at-
Ensemble of Hope#275.dst: Qu- qu- quoi?! Sui, t...tu ne peux pas te j- jeter comme ça sur-
Ensemble of Hope#275.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#276.src: Just enough to draw their attention! N-not to try and break through, obviously. We kill a few soldiers, then retreat.
Ensemble of Hope#276.dst: Juste assez pour attirer leur attention! P-pas pour essayer de percer, évidemment. On tue quelques soldats, puis on se replie.
Ensemble of Hope#276.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#277.src: If... if we can make them think we're trying the gates, then they won't see the group coming through the tunnels.
Ensemble of Hope#277.dst: Si... si on leur fait croire qu'on vise les portes, ils ne verront pas le groupe passer par les tunnels.
Ensemble of Hope#277.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#278.src: Clever, indeed... I suppose we could spare some of our best fighters for such a task. Cileon, perhaps you might be interested?
Ensemble of Hope#278.dst: Astucieux, en effet... nous pourrions prêter quelques-uns de nos meilleurs combattants pour cette tâche. Cileon, ça t'intéresserait?
Ensemble of Hope#278.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#280.src: Wonderful! Then I suppose it's settled? One team to the gates, one team through the tunnels- and, naturally, a team to handle communication-
Ensemble of Hope#280.dst: Merveilleux! Alors c'est décidé? Une équipe aux portes, une équipe par les tunnels- et, naturellement, une équipe pour les communications-
Ensemble of Hope#280.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#281.src: Ahem- a moment of your time? Now, admittedly, I may be a tad outta my depth here- but y'all are talkin' a whole lot 'bout fighting?
Ensemble of Hope#281.dst: Hum- je peux vous prendre un instant? Bon, j'avoue, j'suis p'têt un peu dépassé- mais vous parlez drôlement beaucoup de vous battre, non?
Ensemble of Hope#281.speaker: Kaio

Ensemble of Hope#282.src: And it seems to me you're disregarding somethin' quite vital. The crown sure ain't lacking in strength... it can always train up new folks to replace the lost. S'done it time n' time again.
Ensemble of Hope#282.dst: Et m'est avis que vous négligez un truc vital. La Couronne manque pas de force, ça non... elle peut toujours former du monde pour remplacer les pertes. L'a fait encore et encore.
Ensemble of Hope#282.speaker: Kaio

Ensemble of Hope#283.src: But where the crown really lives and dies is the public opinion. Y'know, the whole... ehm, "ordeal" at the Roughworks Festival - it's caused a real stir in the people.
Ensemble of Hope#283.dst: Mais là où la Couronne vit et meurt vraiment, c'est l'opinion publique. Vous savez, toute cette... hum, "affaire" au festival de Roughworks - ça a vraiment remué les gens.
Ensemble of Hope#283.speaker: Kaio

Ensemble of Hope#284.src: Sovereigns turnin', public exe-... sigh. Public executions. The people ain't happy. Wouldn't take much to... push 'em over the edge.
Ensemble of Hope#284.dst: Souverains qui trahissent, exé-... soupir. Exécutions publiques. Les gens sont pas contents. Faudrait pas grand-chose pour... qu'ils craquent.
Ensemble of Hope#284.speaker: Kaio

Ensemble of Hope#285.src: Now, the crown's got the tools to deal with violence. What it don't got is the tools to deal with civil unrest, 'least not quickly. So it might do well to give that a go as well.
Ensemble of Hope#285.dst: Bon, la Couronne a de quoi gérer la violence. Ce qu'elle a pas, c'est de quoi gérer la grogne populaire, du moins pas vite. Alors ça vaudrait p'têt le coup d'essayer ça aussi.
Ensemble of Hope#285.speaker: Kaio

Ensemble of Hope#286.src: That... makes sense. Though, I'm not sure we have the means for something like that...
Ensemble of Hope#286.dst: Ça... se tient. Mais je ne suis pas sûre qu'on ait les moyens pour un truc pareil...
Ensemble of Hope#286.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#287.src: We could ask the Blossom of Blades.
Ensemble of Hope#287.dst: On pourrait demander à la Fleur des Lames.
Ensemble of Hope#287.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#288.src: What?! Ugh, no, they're useless. It was a miracle you got anything out of them the first time, Sui! Trying again is just gonna be a waste of effort.
Ensemble of Hope#288.dst: Quoi?! Pff, non, ils sont inutiles. C'était un miracle que tu en tires quoi que ce soit la première fois, Sui! Réessayer, ce sera juste du temps perdu.
Ensemble of Hope#288.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#289.src: No, it won't. Because it'll work. {u} and I, we can talk to them, we can... we can work something out.
Ensemble of Hope#289.dst: Non, pas du tout. Parce que ça va marcher. {u} et moi, on peut leur parler, on peut... trouver un arrangement.
Ensemble of Hope#289.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#290.src: ...fine. If you want to try, fine. But when it doesn't work - which it won't - remember that I told you so.
Ensemble of Hope#290.dst: ...bon. Si tu veux essayer, d'accord. Mais quand ça échouera - et ça échouera - souviens-toi que je t'avais prévenue.
Ensemble of Hope#290.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#291.src: Okay. So you've got two distractions. But you're forgetting the most important problem - there is a GOD to worry about. If she catches on, you're done for.
Ensemble of Hope#291.dst: D'accord. Vous avez donc deux diversions. Mais vous oubliez le problème le plus important - il y a une DÉESSE à surveiller. Si elle s'en rend compte, vous êtes fichus.
Ensemble of Hope#291.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#292.src: Y...yeah... We- we need a way t...to make sure she d- does- doesn't show up...
Ensemble of Hope#292.dst: O...ouais... Il- il nous faut un moyen d'ê...être sûrs qu'elle ne- ne- ne vienne pas...
Ensemble of Hope#292.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#295.src: A move with great risk, certainly. But one that solves our remaining problems if successful.
Ensemble of Hope#295.dst: Une manoeuvre très risquée, certes. Mais qui, si elle réussit, résout nos derniers problèmes.
Ensemble of Hope#295.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#296.src: {u}, a...are you s- sure about this?
Ensemble of Hope#296.dst: {u}, t...tu es s- sûr de toi?
Ensemble of Hope#296.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#297.src: Well, then it's settled! To divert the crown's attention - a strike team at the gates, unrest from the gossip group, and {u} turning themself in!
Ensemble of Hope#297.dst: Eh bien, c'est décidé! Pour détourner l'attention de la Couronne - une équipe d'assaut aux portes, des troubles semés par le groupe de commères, et {u} qui se rend!
Ensemble of Hope#297.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#298.src: There are still several days to go before the {p} Festival... perhaps it could be wise to detail our- aah- our plans further in that time?
