Fantastic Voyage#250.src: Allow me to borrow your map for a second. We'll have to find him somewhere else, I reckon.
Fantastic Voyage#250.dst: Prête-moi ta carte une seconde, veux-tu. Il faudra le chercher ailleurs, j'ai bien vu.
Fantastic Voyage#250.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#251.src: I know we can come up with a solution using our wits. Perhaps we can craft an explosive to blow that big rock to bits!
Fantastic Voyage#251.dst: Avec de l'astuce, on trouvera bien la solution. Un explosif pourrait pulvériser ce rocher, voilà mon opinion!
Fantastic Voyage#251.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#252.src: Let's think of some materials we can get here. There isn't much on this island, I fear...
Fantastic Voyage#252.dst: Voyons quels matériaux on peut trouver ici. Il n'y a pas grand-chose sur cette île, tant pis...
Fantastic Voyage#252.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#253.src: First we're going to need [{~} Gritty Sand]. Where to get it? Try the beach at the back of the island.
Fantastic Voyage#253.dst: D'abord, il nous faudra [{~} Gritty Sand]. Où en trouver? Essaie la plage au fond de l'île.
Fantastic Voyage#253.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#254.src: Next up is [Sawdust], you'll need three. I think the best place to search would be the largest tree.
Fantastic Voyage#254.dst: Ensuite, [Sawdust], il t'en faudra trois. Le mieux serait de chercher dans le plus grand arbre, je crois.
Fantastic Voyage#254.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#255.src: Finally, [{~} Black Powder], found in a place that is very unique. You'll have to brave your way to the volcano's peak.
Fantastic Voyage#255.dst: Enfin, [{~} Black Powder], dans un lieu bien particulier. Il te faudra braver le volcan jusqu'au sommet!
Fantastic Voyage#255.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#256.src: You'll need those items to craft the bomb, I just told you where to look. If you forget what you need to find, check your content book.
Fantastic Voyage#256.dst: Il te faut ces objets pour fabriquer la bombe, je t'ai dit où chercher. Si tu oublies quoi trouver, ton livre de contenu est là pour t'aider.
Fantastic Voyage#256.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#257.src: Bring [{~} Gritty Sand], [{~} Saw Dust], and [{~} Black Powder] to the Crafting Table
Fantastic Voyage#257.dst: Apportez [{~} Gritty Sand], [{~} Saw Dust] et [{~} Black Powder] à l'établi

Fantastic Voyage#258.src: Use the explosive on the boulder.

Fantastic Voyage#259.src: Incredible, The explosive blew right through the stone!
Fantastic Voyage#259.dst: Incroyable, l'explosif a traversé la pierre d'un coup!
Fantastic Voyage#259.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#260.src: Let us progress into this mysterious zone.
Fantastic Voyage#260.dst: Avançons dans cette zone mystérieuse, jusqu'au bout.
Fantastic Voyage#260.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#262.dst: Enfoncez-vous plus loin dans la grotte.

Fantastic Voyage#263.src: For adventurers like us, an incredible cave, perfect to explore.
Fantastic Voyage#263.dst: Pour des aventuriers comme nous, une grotte incroyable à explorer.
Fantastic Voyage#263.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#264.src: Surely where my old friend ventured - just as I swore!
Fantastic Voyage#264.dst: C'est sûrement là que mon vieil ami est allé - je l'avais juré!
Fantastic Voyage#264.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#265.src: Long ago, a strong adventurer like yourself reached out to me for a wonderful sail. It truly is a gripping tale!
Fantastic Voyage#265.dst: Jadis, un fort aventurier comme toi me proposa une belle traversée. Une histoire vraiment palpitante, crois-moi, à raconter!
Fantastic Voyage#265.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#266.src: We became the best of friends on our quest. But then he vanished, oh how he was the best.
Fantastic Voyage#266.dst: Nous sommes devenus grands amis pendant notre quête. Puis il a disparu, lui, le meilleur, quelle perte!
Fantastic Voyage#266.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#267.src: And we've finally made it to where he'd been. I can't wait to see him again, I don't know where to begin!
Fantastic Voyage#267.dst: Et nous voici enfin là où il était allé. J'ai hâte de le revoir, je ne sais plus par où commencer!
Fantastic Voyage#267.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#268.src: A mystical portal! This must be where my old friend got lost!
Fantastic Voyage#268.dst: Un portail mystique! C'est ici qu'il a disparu, mon ami, c'est sûr!
Fantastic Voyage#268.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#269.src: We must go through and find him, whatever the cost.
Fantastic Voyage#269.dst: Il faut le franchir et le trouver, quelle que soit l'aventure!
Fantastic Voyage#269.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#270.src: I can't believe it! I simply can't speak!
Fantastic Voyage#270.dst: Incroyable! J'en perds la voix, tout à coup!
Fantastic Voyage#270.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#271.src: I always told the others I wasn't a freak. Old friend, I'll look for you until the bitter end!
Fantastic Voyage#271.dst: J'ai toujours dit aux autres que je n'étais pas fou. Vieil ami, je te chercherai jusqu'au bout!
Fantastic Voyage#271.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#272.src: Find Relend in the strange place
Fantastic Voyage#272.dst: Trouvez Relend dans le lieu étrange

Fantastic Voyage#273.src: A foreign land filled with danger, to the brim...
Fantastic Voyage#273.dst: Une terre étrangère, emplie de danger jusqu'au bord...
Fantastic Voyage#273.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#274.src: It must be where he vanished to, regardless of how grim.
Fantastic Voyage#274.dst: C'est là qu'il a dû disparaître, aussi sinistre que soit le décor.
Fantastic Voyage#274.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#275.src: My friend... Where do you think we are?
Fantastic Voyage#275.dst: Mon ami... Où sommes-nous, à ton avis?
Fantastic Voyage#275.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#276.src: Wherever it is, I feel that we're being overseen from afar.
Fantastic Voyage#276.dst: Où que ce soit, je sens qu'on nous observe, de loin, d'ici.
Fantastic Voyage#276.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#277.src: With all this danger, I do hope my good friend is still okay.
Fantastic Voyage#277.dst: Avec tous ces dangers, j'espère que mon bon ami va bien.
Fantastic Voyage#277.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#278.src: My goodness! Keep your wits about, we may be in for a fray!
Fantastic Voyage#278.dst: Ciel! Garde la tête froide, la bagarre n'est pas loin!
Fantastic Voyage#278.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#279.src: Aagh... New friend... are you there?
Fantastic Voyage#279.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#280.src: Don't...give up... we must find him, I swear...
Fantastic Voyage#280.dst: Ne... renonce pas... il faut le trouver, crois-moi...
Fantastic Voyage#280.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#281.src: I promise I'll find him, I'll do it, without a single scar!
Fantastic Voyage#281.dst: Je promets de le trouver, j'y arriverai, sans une égratignure!
Fantastic Voyage#281.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#283.src: Get on it then, no time for a nap! That thieving parrot has our map!
Fantastic Voyage#283.dst: Vite, pas le temps de traîner! Notre carte, ce perroquet l'a chipée!
Fantastic Voyage#283.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#284.src: Perhaps these citizens may help us out, ask them about the parrot's route!
Fantastic Voyage#284.dst: Ces habitants pourront peut-être aider, demande-leur où le perroquet est allé!
Fantastic Voyage#284.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#285.src: He seems distracted, best to walk away while you can.
Fantastic Voyage#285.dst: Il semble distrait, mieux vaut partir tant que vous le pouvez.

Fantastic Voyage#286.src: He begins to list off a seemingly endless amount of examples.
Fantastic Voyage#286.dst: Il se met à énumérer une liste d'exemples apparemment sans fin.

Fantastic Voyage#287.src: It looks like he's nearly finished.
Fantastic Voyage#287.dst: On dirait qu'il a presque fini.

Fantastic Voyage#288.src: It seems like he's lost in reminiscence.
Fantastic Voyage#288.dst: Il semble perdu dans ses souvenirs.

Fantastic Voyage#289.src: He doesn't seem to be stopping any time soon.
Fantastic Voyage#289.dst: Il ne semble pas près de s'arrêter.

Fantastic Voyage#290.src: It seems like he's waiting expectantly.

Fantastic Voyage#291.src: He's thoughtfully rubbing his jaw. Best to leave him be
Fantastic Voyage#291.dst: Il se frotte la mâchoire, pensif. Mieux vaut le laisser tranquille

Fantastic Voyage#293.src: It seems like he's deep in thought.
Fantastic Voyage#293.dst: Il semble plongé dans ses pensées.

Fantastic Voyage#294.src: He proceeds to rattle off several grievances about pastry making.
Fantastic Voyage#294.dst: Il se met à débiter une série de griefs sur la pâtisserie.

Fantastic Voyage#296.src: You don't have the time for this.
Fantastic Voyage#296.dst: Vous n'avez pas le temps pour ça.

Fantastic Voyage#297.src: He seems pretty comfortable, best not to disturb him.
Fantastic Voyage#297.dst: Il a l'air bien installé, mieux vaut ne pas le déranger.

Fantastic Voyage#298.src: Heh, have fun, mate. Lot'sa treasure out there, eh?
Fantastic Voyage#298.dst: Hé, amuse-toi bien, l'ami. Plein de trésors là-bas, hein?
Fantastic Voyage#298.text: You know he's nuts, right mate? Y'not gonna find any treasure or anythin'.

Fantastic Voyage#299.src: Looks like the parrot dropped the map! You should get this back to Relend.
Fantastic Voyage#299.dst: On dirait que le perroquet a lâché la carte! Vous devriez la rapporter à Relend.

Fantastic Voyage#300.src: You have no use for this yet, you should speak with Relend up near the steering wheel.
Fantastic Voyage#300.dst: Ça ne vous sert à rien pour l'instant, vous devriez parler à Relend, en haut près du gouvernail.

Fantastic Voyage#301.src: You'll need a [Wooden Board], a [Center Piece], and a [String] to craft a Steering Wheel.
Fantastic Voyage#301.dst: Il vous faudra une [planche de bois], une [pièce centrale] et une [corde] pour fabriquer un gouvernail.

Fantastic Voyage#302.src: This will probably work... You should show Relend.
Fantastic Voyage#302.dst: Ça devrait marcher... Montrez-le à Relend.

Fantastic Voyage#303.src: You have nothing to load... You should continue through the wreckage.
Fantastic Voyage#303.dst: Vous n'avez rien à charger... Vous devriez continuer à travers les débris.

Fantastic Voyage#304.src: Bring [{~} Raw Mutton], [{~} Edible Mushrooms], [{~} Coconut], and [{~} Berries] to the Cooking Pot
Fantastic Voyage#304.dst: Apportez [{~} Raw Mutton], [{~} Edible Mushrooms], [{~} Coconut] et [{~} Berries] à la marmite

Fantastic Voyage#305.src: You'll need [{~} Raw Mutton], [{~} Edible Mushrooms], [{~} Coconut], and [{~} Berries] to make a stew.
Fantastic Voyage#305.dst: Il vous faudra [{~} Raw Mutton], [{~} Edible Mushrooms], [{~} Coconut] et [{~} Berries] pour faire un ragoût.

Fantastic Voyage#306.src: Take a look at your content book if you forgot your project, this island has supplies we ought to collect!
Fantastic Voyage#306.dst: Si tu as oublié ta mission, ton livre de contenu te le dira! Cette île regorge de provisions, ramasse-les, toi!
Fantastic Voyage#306.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#309.src: This looks dangerous! You should go blow open that boulder now.
Fantastic Voyage#309.dst: Ça a l'air dangereux! Allez vite faire sauter ce rocher.

Fantastic Voyage#310.src: I've been looking for my old friend all this time. Sailing with every young adventurer in their prime!
Fantastic Voyage#310.dst: Tout ce temps, j'ai cherché mon vieil ami sans répit. En naviguant avec chaque jeune aventurier, plein d'énergie!

Fantastic Voyage#311.src: ...Oh, you're goin' out with Relend, hey? You sure?
Fantastic Voyage#311.dst: ...Oh, tu pars en mer avec Relend, hein? T'es sûr?
Fantastic Voyage#311.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#312.src: This looks... edible. You should see what Relend thinks.
Fantastic Voyage#312.dst: Ça a l'air... comestible. Voyez ce qu'en pense Relend.

Fate of the Fallen#000.src: Ah, a member of the {p} army. We're trying to learn more of this frozen barrow. We could use your aid.
Fate of the Fallen#000.dst: Ah, un membre de l'armée de {p}. Nous essayons d'en savoir plus sur ce tertre gelé. Votre aide serait la bienvenue.
Fate of the Fallen#000.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#002.src: If you don't remember what I said, I remember you writing something in your book. Try looking there.
Fate of the Fallen#002.dst: Si vous avez oublié ce que j'ai dit, je me souviens que vous avez noté quelque chose dans votre livre. Regardez-y.

Fate of the Fallen#003.src: You should head back to the mage with the wand.
Fate of the Fallen#003.dst: Vous devriez retourner voir le mage au bâton.

Fate of the Fallen#004.src: This is the Temple of Time...

Fate of the Fallen#005.src: Here you can visit the memories of this land...
Fate of the Fallen#005.dst: Ici, vous pouvez visiter les souvenirs de cette terre...

Fate of the Fallen#006.src: The altar requires an item from the time you desire to access...
Fate of the Fallen#006.dst: L'autel requiert un objet de l'époque à laquelle vous désirez accéder...

Fate of the Fallen#007.src: You will access a memory as if you were present, but when you return it will be as if you were never there.
Fate of the Fallen#007.dst: Vous accéderez à un souvenir comme si vous y étiez, mais à votre retour, ce sera comme si vous n'y étiez jamais allé.

Fate of the Fallen#008.src: You should stick around to find out how to reverse the spell.
Fate of the Fallen#008.dst: Vous devriez rester pour découvrir comment inverser le sort.

Fate of the Fallen#009.src: Gaaah... Tell...everyone. I will freeze this place. I...t-too far gone. It needs time to heal...and my powers m-must be dampened...frozen...
Fate of the Fallen#009.dst: Gaaah... Dis-le... à tous. Je vais geler ce lieu. Je... s-suis trop atteint. La terre doit guérir... et mes pouvoirs d-doivent être étouffés... gelés...
Fate of the Fallen#009.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#010.src: If I have learned anything from that insufferable f- ...from Mael...deaths without reason lets spirits linger. I would...prefer against giving him a harder time.
Fate of the Fallen#010.dst: Si j'ai appris une chose de cet insupportable c- ...de Mael... les morts sans raison font s'attarder les esprits. Je... préférerais ne pas lui compliquer la tâche.
Fate of the Fallen#010.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#011.src: Wha... so many revelations... ice magic staves off corruption...? It is true that this place has seen less corrupted threats than other places in the province...
Fate of the Fallen#011.dst: Qu... tant de révélations... la magie de glace repousse la Corruption...? C'est vrai que cet endroit a connu moins de menaces corrompues que le reste de la province...
Fate of the Fallen#011.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#012.src: Dear gods... We've had it all wrong this whole time... It was to protect everyone... but surely he would have told someone his intentions if he was of that sound a mind!
Fate of the Fallen#012.dst: Par les dieux... Nous nous sommes trompés depuis le début... C'était pour protéger tout le monde... mais s'il était si sain d'esprit, il aurait sûrement confié ses intentions à quelqu'un!
Fate of the Fallen#012.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#013.src: I froze this land to allow it to heal.. People did not understand.. They came for me here, seeking revenge.
Fate of the Fallen#013.dst: J'ai gelé cette terre pour qu'elle guérisse.. On n'a pas compris.. Ils sont venus me chercher ici, pour se venger.

Fate of the Fallen#014.src: Of course, just like you.. They can not leave. Their souls are stuck here. For the spell must not be broken.
Fate of the Fallen#014.dst: Bien sûr, tout comme toi.. Ils ne peuvent pas partir. Leurs âmes sont prisonnières ici. Car le sort ne doit pas être rompu.

Fate of the Fallen#015.src: Even if you think you can cure me.. I can not allow you to try for if it were to fail my corrupted body would wreak havoc on the world!
Fate of the Fallen#015.dst: Même si tu crois pouvoir me guérir.. Je ne peux te laisser essayer, car en cas d'échec, mon corps corrompu ravagerait le monde!

Fate of the Fallen#016.src: It will be dangerous...perhaps your toughest fight yet...but it must be done. If you need time to prepare, do so. But you must end Theorick's pain.
Fate of the Fallen#016.dst: Ce sera dangereux... peut-être votre pire combat... mais il le faut. Préparez-vous si besoin. Mais vous devez mettre fin aux souffrances de Theorick.

Fate of the Fallen#017.src: Don't you just love fishing? The little waves in the river, the wind and the rewarding feeling when you catch something, those are my favorite things about it.
Fate of the Fallen#017.dst: Vous n'adorez pas la pêche? Les petites vagues de la rivière, le vent, la satisfaction quand ça mord: c'est ce que je préfère.

Fate of the Fallen#018.src: You can not return until your goal is fulfilled...
Fate of the Fallen#018.dst: Pas de retour avant d'avoir atteint votre but...

Fate of the Fallen#019.src: Talk to Telvu the mage at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Fate of the Fallen#020.src: Are you familiar with the story of Theorick and {p}?
Fate of the Fallen#020.dst: Connaissez-vous l'histoire de Theorick et de {p}?
Fate of the Fallen#020.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#021.src: Probably not. Well, you see, {p} was not always frozen.
Fate of the Fallen#021.dst: Sans doute pas. Voyez-vous, {p} n'a pas toujours été gelé.
Fate of the Fallen#021.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#022.src: During Theorick's time, this place was like the Wynn plains, warm and arable.
Fate of the Fallen#022.dst: A l'époque de Theorick, l'endroit était comme les plaines de Wynn, chaud et fertile.
Fate of the Fallen#022.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#023.src: For some reason, Theorick Twain used his immense power to freeze the land before exiling himself here.
Fate of the Fallen#023.dst: Pour une raison inconnue, Theorick Twain a usé de son immense pouvoir pour geler la terre avant de s'exiler ici.
Fate of the Fallen#023.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#024.src: We need to find out why so we can reverse this spell. Presumably, the source of that spell's magic would lie within the barrow... but we don't want to go in empty-handed.
Fate of the Fallen#024.dst: Nous devons découvrir pourquoi afin d'inverser ce sort. La source de sa magie se trouve sans doute dans le tertre... mais nous ne voulons pas y entrer les mains vides.
Fate of the Fallen#024.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#025.src: As such...have you heard of a place called {p}? We could use it to go back in time, to try to learn more about Theorick's actions.
Fate of the Fallen#025.dst: Ainsi... connaissez-vous un lieu appelé {p}? Il nous permettrait de remonter le temps, pour mieux comprendre les actes de Theorick.
Fate of the Fallen#025.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#026.src: Well...in a way, at least. There are laws to this sort of magic. For one, you need an item from the specific time we want to see. Second, you can witness the past, not change it.
Fate of the Fallen#026.dst: Enfin... d'une certaine manière, du moins. Ce genre de magie a ses lois. D'abord, il faut un objet de l'époque précise que nous voulons voir. Ensuite, on peut observer le passé, pas le changer.
Fate of the Fallen#026.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#027.src: One of Theorick's staves is on display in the {p} bank. Presumably, it should work for what we need. Could you retrieve it somehow?
Fate of the Fallen#027.dst: L'un des bâtons de Theorick est exposé à la banque de {p}. Il devrait faire l'affaire. Pourriez-vous le récupérer, d'une manière ou d'une autre?
Fate of the Fallen#027.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#028.dst: Trouvez le bâton de Theorick à la banque de {p}.

Fate of the Fallen#029.src: Aha, quick job. I see you've got the wand. Must've needed a sharp tongue to get the bankers to give it up.
Fate of the Fallen#029.dst: Aha, rapide. Je vois que vous avez le bâton. Il vous a fallu une sacrée éloquence pour que les banquiers s'en séparent.
Fate of the Fallen#029.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#030.src: Now, it is a long walk to {p}. Needn't take that walk, though, as I can teleport you there. Hopefully.
Fate of the Fallen#030.dst: Bon, la route est longue jusqu'à {p}. Inutile de la faire à pied, je peux vous y téléporter. En principe.
Fate of the Fallen#030.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#031.src: Once you're there, enter the Temple of Time. You should know what to do once you are there. Careful dealing with time travel, friend... No idea what you might find.
Fate of the Fallen#031.dst: Une fois là-bas, entrez dans le Temple of Time. Vous saurez quoi faire. Prudence avec les voyages dans le temps, l'ami... Impossible de savoir ce que vous y trouverez.
Fate of the Fallen#031.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#033.src: Should anything go wrong, I'll stay here to teleport you back to the temple.
Fate of the Fallen#033.dst: Si quelque chose tourne mal, je resterai ici pour vous ramener au temple.
Fate of the Fallen#033.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#034.src: Enter the portal the mage made.
Fate of the Fallen#034.dst: Entrez dans le portail créé par le mage.

Fate of the Fallen#035.src: Enter the Gate of Time at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and travel back in time.
Fate of the Fallen#035.dst: Franchissez la Gate of Time en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] et remontez le temps.

Fate of the Fallen#038.src: Woah, your weaponry and armour is so advanced!
Fate of the Fallen#038.dst: Waouh, tes armes et ton armure sont si avancées!
Fate of the Fallen#038.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#039.src: Are you another Twain? Only the Twains know magic like that.
Fate of the Fallen#039.dst: Tu es un autre Twain? Seuls les Twain connaissent ce genre de magie.
Fate of the Fallen#039.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#041.src: He's busy fighting in the war, shouldn't you be doing the same?
Fate of the Fallen#041.dst: Il est à la guerre, tu ne devrais pas y être aussi?
Fate of the Fallen#041.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#042.src: He went west. There was some kind of emergency.
Fate of the Fallen#042.dst: Il est parti vers l'ouest. Une sorte d'urgence.
Fate of the Fallen#042.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#043.src: We've been fighting the corruption for years, it seems like it might finally engulf {p}.
Fate of the Fallen#043.dst: On combat la Corruption depuis des années, on dirait qu'elle va finir par engloutir {p}.
Fate of the Fallen#043.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#044.src: Find Theorick in the forest west of {p} [{~}, {~}, {~}].
Fate of the Fallen#044.dst: Trouvez Theorick dans la forêt à l'ouest de {p} [{~}, {~}, {~}].

Fate of the Fallen#045.src: I could've sworn she had gone this way... Oh, what now, more imbeciles? This forest isn't safe to travel!
Fate of the Fallen#045.dst: J'aurais juré qu'elle était passée par là... Oh, quoi encore, d'autres imbéciles? Cette forêt n'est pas sûre!
Fate of the Fallen#045.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#046.src: If you need help, lodge a complaint with the guards. I'm busy and I can't exactly break away from saving this god-blessed province to chill your milk!!
Fate of the Fallen#046.dst: Si tu as besoin d'aide, plains-toi aux gardes. Je suis occupé et je ne peux pas arrêter de sauver cette fichue province pour te rafraîchir ton lait!!
Fate of the Fallen#046.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#047.src: Are your ears full of wax?! I said-
Fate of the Fallen#047.dst: Tu as de la cire dans les oreilles?! J'ai dit-
Fate of the Fallen#047.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#048.src: Urgh, the things followed you! See what happens?! STAND ASIDE.
Fate of the Fallen#048.dst: Argh, ces choses t'ont suivi! Tu vois ce qui arrive?! RECULE.
Fate of the Fallen#048.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#049.src: As though I needed TWO people to save! Now get out of here, I have to find that woman who went missing!
Fate of the Fallen#049.dst: Comme si j'avais besoin de sauver DEUX personnes! Maintenant, file d'ici, je dois retrouver cette femme disparue!
Fate of the Fallen#049.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#050.src: HEEEELP! I can't outrun them!!! Guards! Someone!!
Fate of the Fallen#050.dst: AU SECOUUURS! Ils me rattrapent!!! Gardes! Quelqu'un!!

Fate of the Fallen#051.src: Whuh! That's her voice! Where is she?! I just cleared this area!
Fate of the Fallen#051.dst: Hein! C'est sa voix! Où est-elle?! Je viens de nettoyer cette zone!
Fate of the Fallen#051.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#052.dst: Th-Theorick!! Il y a des corrompus!!
Fate of the Fallen#052.speaker: Girl

Fate of the Fallen#053.src: Ugh, is she dragging them over from the west?! You there, If you don't want to end up frozen, GET BEHIND ME, NOW!!
Fate of the Fallen#053.dst: Argh, elle les ramène de l'ouest?! Toi, là, si tu ne veux pas finir gelé, DERRIÈRE MOI, TOUT DE SUITE!!
Fate of the Fallen#053.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#054.src: Phew... You're out of danger now. If you hadn't left town, though, you wouldn't have been IN any danger at all!
Fate of the Fallen#054.dst: Ouf... Tu es hors de danger. Mais si tu n'avais pas quitté la ville, tu n'aurais JAMAIS été en danger!
Fate of the Fallen#054.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#055.src: Don't bother apologizing to me, just get back to town. Now.
Fate of the Fallen#055.dst: Inutile de t'excuser, retourne en ville. Maintenant.
Fate of the Fallen#055.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#056.src: Next time you feel like picking flowers in the forest or whatever you were doing, remember you have a life to live, hm?!
Fate of the Fallen#056.dst: La prochaine fois que tu voudras cueillir des fleurs en forêt ou je ne sais quoi, souviens-toi que tu n'as qu'une vie, hm?!
Fate of the Fallen#056.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#057.src: Every day, more corrupteds, more deaths... There is only one thing for it. I have to tackle it myself. Cut the roots...and kill this hellish weed.
Fate of the Fallen#057.dst: Chaque jour, plus de corrompus, plus de morts... Il n'y a qu'une solution. Je dois m'en charger moi-même. Couper les racines... et tuer cette herbe infernale.
Fate of the Fallen#057.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#058.src: Still here? Well, listen up. Myself and a few others are planning something risky. Damned be it if our minds are lost, I need to go through that portal.
Fate of the Fallen#058.dst: Encore là? Bon, écoute bien. Quelques autres et moi préparons un coup risqué. Tant pis si nous y perdons la raison, je dois franchir ce portail.
Fate of the Fallen#058.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#059.src: You look heavily geared, so I'm conscripting you. Meet us at our base, immediately. Follow the river south and you'll see a house on the right side.
Fate of the Fallen#059.dst: Tu as l'air bien équipé, alors je te réquisitionne. Rejoins-nous à notre base, immédiatement. Suis la rivière vers le sud, tu verras une maison sur ta droite.
Fate of the Fallen#059.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#060.src: Head to the base of the operation south of {p} [{~}, {~}, {~}].
Fate of the Fallen#060.dst: Rendez-vous à la base de l'opération au sud de {p} [{~}, {~}, {~}].

Fate of the Fallen#061.src: Well, I'll give you this. You're prompt to listen to orders, at least. We're headed to the {p}.
Fate of the Fallen#061.dst: Bon, je te l'accorde. Tu obéis vite aux ordres, au moins. Nous partons pour {p}.
Fate of the Fallen#061.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#062.src: The last man that entered the portal and returned became Bak’al... But if there is even a fraction of a chance this could work, we must take it at this point.
Fate of the Fallen#062.dst: Le dernier homme entré dans le portail et revenu est devenu Bak’al... Mais s'il y a la moindre chance que ça marche, nous devons la saisir, à ce stade.
Fate of the Fallen#062.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#063.src: Let's get moving. We'll be taking no breaks on the trip, so I hope you were prepared.
Fate of the Fallen#063.dst: En route. Pas de pause pendant le trajet, alors j'espère que tu es prêt.
Fate of the Fallen#063.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#064.src: Now. The sheer cold I command can stave off corruption itself. Somehow I doubt any of you can say the same. I'll go in alone.
Fate of the Fallen#064.dst: Bien. Le froid absolu que je commande peut repousser la Corruption elle-même. Je doute qu'aucun de vous puisse en dire autant. J'irai seul.
Fate of the Fallen#064.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#065.src: When I enter... If I had to make an assumption, corrupteds will swarm the portal after me. Your job? Slay them. I can't have distractions in there.
Fate of the Fallen#065.dst: Quand j'entrerai... A mon avis, les corrompus vont envahir le portail derrière moi. Votre travail? Les tuer. Je ne peux pas me permettre de distractions là-dedans.
Fate of the Fallen#065.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#066.src: You will not be leaving your post here until I exit that portal. Understood?
Fate of the Fallen#066.dst: Tu ne quitteras pas ton poste avant que je ressorte de ce portail. Compris?
Fate of the Fallen#066.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#069.src: ...no, no, no no no NO!! DAMN IT ALL!!
Fate of the Fallen#069.dst: ...non, non, non non non NON!! MAUDIT SOIT TOUT ÇA!!
Fate of the Fallen#069.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#070.src: You know what happened?! I lost!! I will destroy the province if I turn completely! GET AWAY, NOW! DO YOU HEAR ME?! RUN!!
Fate of the Fallen#070.dst: Tu sais ce qui s'est passé?! J'ai perdu!! Si je me transforme, je détruirai la province! VA-T'EN! TU M'ENTENDS?! COURS!!
Fate of the Fallen#070.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#071.src: I... C-calm yourself, Theorick...don't...don't lose yourself to it...there's...yet a solution...one way...
Fate of the Fallen#071.dst: Je... C-calme-toi, Theorick... ne... ne te laisse pas dévorer... il y a... encore une solution... un moyen...
Fate of the Fallen#071.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#072.src: Oh...you again...the others...dead? Run off? Cowards...urgh...
Fate of the Fallen#072.dst: Oh... encore toi... les autres... morts? Enfuis? Lâches... argh...
Fate of the Fallen#072.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#073.src: You live...so...eyes up. Listen to me. If I turn...w-when...when I turn...n-no, can't...gaaah, I'll destr- Nggh...
Fate of the Fallen#073.dst: Tu vis... donc... écoute-moi. Si je me transforme... q-quand... quand je... n-non, impossible... gaaah, je vais détru- Nggh...
Fate of the Fallen#073.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#074.src: I won't last, you can tell... Right now...killing me is an impossibility, you idiotic weakl- Agh, GET OUT OF MY MIND!!
Fate of the Fallen#074.dst: Je ne tiendrai pas, tu le vois bien... Pour l'instant... me tuer est impossible, espèce d'idiot de faibl- Agh, SORS DE MON ESPRIT!!
Fate of the Fallen#074.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#075.src: All worthless... Urgh, no...they yet deserve life...and this spell...it will surely claim some. Please, let them know why...
Fate of the Fallen#075.dst: Tous des bons à rien... Argh, non... ils méritent de vivre... et ce sort... en emportera sûrement. Je t'en prie, dis-leur pourquoi...
Fate of the Fallen#075.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#076.src: K-keep advancing. Your things, if everyone was as strong as you...we may stand a chance. This could end me, in time, once I am weaker.
Fate of the Fallen#076.dst: C-continue. Tes affaires... si tous étaient aussi forts que toi... on aurait une chance. Ceci pourrait m'achever, avec le temps, une fois affaibli.
Fate of the Fallen#076.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#077.src: Let it be known...Theorick Twain is not dead. He cannot be killed...all will burn...until future days. Here, in this accursed place. Find me...and end it all.
Fate of the Fallen#077.dst: Que l'on sache... Theorick Twain n'est pas mort. Il ne peut être tué... tout brûlera... jusqu'aux jours futurs. Ici, dans ce lieu maudit. Retrouve-moi... et mets fin à tout ça.
Fate of the Fallen#077.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#078.src: Tell Telvu the mage what happened.
Fate of the Fallen#078.dst: Racontez au mage Telvu ce qui s'est passé.

Fate of the Fallen#079.src: You must have succeeded, or you would be yet in the memory of the past. I can feel some potent magic on you.
Fate of the Fallen#079.dst: Vous avez dû réussir, sinon vous seriez encore dans le souvenir du passé. Je sens une magie puissante sur vous.
Fate of the Fallen#079.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#080.src: So, you met Theorick? He was always said to have fallen from heroism after the great freezing.
Fate of the Fallen#080.dst: Alors, vous avez rencontré Theorick? On a toujours dit qu'il avait renié l'héroïsme après le grand gel.
Fate of the Fallen#080.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#081.src: Were you able to figure out why it was he froze this place, at least?
Fate of the Fallen#081.dst: Avez-vous au moins découvert pourquoi il a gelé cet endroit?
Fate of the Fallen#081.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#082.src: All this time, spent buried alive, wrestling with the corruption. The thought horrifies you, as well, judging by your face. Killing him would be a mercy.
Fate of the Fallen#082.dst: Tout ce temps, enterré vivant, à lutter contre la Corruption. A voir votre visage, l'idée vous horrifie aussi. Le tuer serait un acte de pitié.
Fate of the Fallen#082.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#083.src: Here. Use this. It may help protect you within the Ice Barrows... Please, soldier. Be Theorick's guardian angel. Free him from this torment.
Fate of the Fallen#083.dst: Tenez. Utilisez ceci. Ça pourra vous protéger dans les Tertres de glace... Je vous en prie, soldat. Soyez l'ange gardien de Theorick. Libérez-le de ce tourment.
Fate of the Fallen#083.speaker: Telvu

Finding the Light#000.src: Most of the pages are filled with religious verses. At the very end of the book, there's a card separate from the rest of the pages.
Finding the Light#000.dst: La plupart des pages sont remplies de versets religieux. A la toute fin du livre, il y a une fiche à part du reste des pages.

Finding the Light#001.src: I covered over the way down to that giant archive like you asked. It shouldn't be reachable now.
Finding the Light#001.dst: J'ai recouvert l'accès à cette immense archive comme vous l'aviez demandé. Elle ne devrait plus être accessible.

Finding the Light#002.src: It'd take something really heavy to crack open the foundation- Frankly, that gold church bell might do it if it's not maintained.
Finding the Light#002.dst: Il faudrait un objet très lourd pour fendre les fondations - Franchement, cette cloche d'église en or suffirait si elle n'est pas entretenue.

Finding the Light#003.src: I left ladders and platforms as access to the bell tower- Make sure you keep it in good condition! I don't want to have to do that kind of work again.
Finding the Light#003.dst: J'ai laissé des échelles et des plateformes pour accéder au clocher - Veillez à le garder en bon état! Je ne veux pas avoir à refaire ce genre de travail.

Finding the Light#004.src: What, are you thinking "oh, let's follow the funny elf girl and see her FAIL, OVER and OVER AGAIN!?" IS THAT IT?!
Finding the Light#004.dst: Quoi, tu te dis "oh, suivons la drôle de petite elfe et regardons-la ÉCHOUER, ENCORE et ENCORE!?" C'EST ÇA?!

Finding the Light#005.src: This is enough, Lari. I waken. And thus, your task is complete, {u}. You have done as Orphion asked.
Finding the Light#005.dst: Ça suffit, Lari. Je m'éveille. Et ainsi, ta tâche est accomplie, {u}. Tu as fait ce qu'Orphion demandait.

Finding the Light#006.src: What connection does a primordial force have with the moral leanings of mortals- or even immortals?
Finding the Light#006.dst: Quel lien une force primordiale a-t-elle avec les penchants moraux des mortels - ou même des immortels?

Finding the Light#007.src: For now, {u} must learn what you have learned, of the nature of realms. They must know what you know if they are to aid you fully.
Finding the Light#007.dst: Pour l'instant, {u} doit apprendre ce que tu sais de la nature des royaumes. Sans ce savoir, impossible de t'aider pleinement.

Finding the Light#008.src: Allow me to show you our reality, {u}. It is difficult to properly present its scale... So here is an approximation.
Finding the Light#008.dst: Permets-moi de te montrer notre réalité, {u}. Il est difficile d'en rendre l'échelle... Voici donc une approximation.

Finding the Light#009.src: The balance shifts, and Orphion grows weary. Angered, desperate. He called to you as a last plea- and you have done admirably, for what he has asked of you.
Finding the Light#009.dst: L'équilibre bascule, et Orphion s'épuise. En colère, désespéré. Il t'a appelé en dernier recours - et tu as agi admirablement, au vu de ce qu'il t'a demandé.

Finding the Light#010.src: Enter the portal, {u}. I shall show you the Gateway to Light... And I shall wish you luck.
Finding the Light#010.dst: Entre dans le portail, {u}. Je vais te montrer la Porte de la Lumière... Et je te souhaite bonne chance.

Finding the Light#011.src: What you have done may not have been the right thing, by anyone's account. However, it was necessary. You have thrown off your bonds, in a sense.
Finding the Light#011.dst: Ce que tu as fait n'était peut-être pas juste, aux yeux de quiconque. Mais c'était nécessaire. Tu t'es libéré de tes chaînes, en un sens.

Finding the Light#012.src: New Quest Started: Realm of Light IV - Finding the Light
Finding the Light#012.dst: Nouvelle quête commencée: Royaume de la Lumière IV - En quête de lumière

Finding the Light#013.src: That should have cracked open the foundation! You should check to see if you can reach the archive mentioned by the note card.
Finding the Light#013.dst: Ça devrait avoir fendu les fondations! Voyez si vous pouvez atteindre l'archive mentionnée par la fiche.

Finding the Light#014.src: The door down below should open, now that you've activated the mechanisms.
Finding the Light#014.dst: La porte en bas devrait s'ouvrir, maintenant que vous avez activé les mécanismes.

Finding the Light#015.src: Some of the few pages are ripped out. It seems to be describing an event occurring with the Guardian of the Forest until the first missing page.
Finding the Light#015.dst: Quelques pages ont été arrachées. Jusqu'à la première page manquante, le texte semble décrire un événement survenu au Gardien de la forêt.

Finding the Light#016.src: The rest of the book is in perfect condition- Who could've done this if the archives were locked away? Did someone enter before you?
Finding the Light#016.dst: Le reste du livre est intact - Qui a pu faire ça si les archives étaient sous clé? Quelqu'un est-il entré avant vous?

Finding the Light#017.src: ...so it returned, asleep and unwakeable. The light has spoken of a time when the Guardian shall grace us with its presence once more...
Finding the Light#017.dst: ...ainsi il est revenu, endormi, impossible à réveiller. La lumière a parlé d'un temps où le Gardien nous honorera de nouveau de sa présence...

Finding the Light#018.src: ...but such a time is centuries off, and will require great effort. The spell included is vital to the process.
Finding the Light#018.dst: ...mais ce temps est à des siècles d'ici, et exigera de grands efforts. Le sort joint est essentiel au processus.

Finding the Light#019.src: The light also warns- If the darkness should encroach and reach the Guardian's roots, it shall never wake... But it seems we will not have to worry of that.
Finding the Light#019.dst: La lumière avertit aussi - Si les ténèbres gagnaient les racines du Gardien, il ne se réveillerait jamais... Mais il semble que nous n'ayons pas à nous en soucier.

Finding the Light#020.src: There's another loose page here, with more High Gavellian text on it. Lari should be able to translate this.
Finding the Light#020.dst: Il y a une autre page volante ici, avec d'autres textes en haut gavellien. Lari devrait pouvoir la traduire.

Finding the Light#021.src: ...go on, then, do it. I'm just needed here to be a translator for you thus far, it seems.
Finding the Light#021.dst: ...vas-y, alors, fais-le. On dirait que je ne suis là que pour te servir de traductrice, jusqu'ici.
Finding the Light#021.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#023.src: The voice of the Light told you to pursue her. You shouldn't stop now, should you?
Finding the Light#023.dst: La voix de la Lumière vous a dit de la suivre. Pas question de s'arrêter maintenant, si?

Finding the Light#024.src: The building looks climbable... You can probably eavesdrop on the conversation if you climb up the walls.
Finding the Light#024.dst: Le bâtiment semble escaladable... En grimpant aux murs, vous pourriez sans doute écouter la conversation.

Finding the Light#026.src: You got the plant! You should return by the Guardian of the Forest to proceed.
Finding the Light#026.dst: Vous avez la plante! Retournez auprès du Gardien de la forêt pour continuer.

Finding the Light#027.src: I DON'T CARE ANYMORE! STOP STEALING MY LIFE LIKE THIS!!!
Finding the Light#027.dst: JE M'EN FICHE MAINTENANT! ARRÊTE DE ME VOLER MA VIE COMME ÇA!!!

Finding the Light#029.src: ...GRAAAAAUGH!! TELL ME HOW THIS IS "ENOUGH!" TELL ME, NOW!
Finding the Light#029.dst: ...GRAAAAAUGH!! DIS-MOI EN QUOI "ÇA SUFFIT"! DIS-LE-MOI, MAINTENANT!
Finding the Light#029.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#030.src: To do something "dark," you are about to say, and to that I say you have not.
Finding the Light#030.dst: D'avoir fait quelque chose de "sombre", allais-tu dire, et à cela je réponds que non.

Finding the Light#031.src: For a thousand years or more of your own thoughts, I understand that you are conflicted.
Finding the Light#031.dst: Après mille ans ou plus seule avec tes pensées, je comprends que tu sois déchirée.

Finding the Light#032.src: However... You have, in that time, made a grave error. You have grown to realize an incorrect assumption.
Finding the Light#032.dst: Cependant... Tu as, en ce temps, commis une grave erreur. Tu en es venue à tenir pour vraie une supposition erronée.

Finding the Light#033.src: Dark and Light... They oppose. They clash. They create a cloying pox. But, allow me to ask.
Finding the Light#033.dst: Ténèbres et Lumière... S'opposent. S'affrontent. Engendrent un fléau étouffant. Mais permets-moi une question.

Finding the Light#034.src: Is the axe evil for chopping the tree? Is the wood evil for resisting the metal?
Finding the Light#034.dst: La hache est-elle maléfique d'abattre l'arbre? Le bois est-il maléfique de résister au métal?

Finding the Light#035.src: Are the flames evil for burning up the leaves? Is the water evil for dousing the fire?
Finding the Light#035.dst: Les flammes sont-elles maléfiques de brûler les feuilles? L'eau est-elle maléfique d'éteindre le feu?

Finding the Light#036.src: Is a victim evil for striking back against those that have struck them?
Finding the Light#036.dst: Une victime est-elle maléfique de rendre les coups à ceux qui l'ont frappée?

Finding the Light#037.src: And most importantly... Are any of these things light, or dark?
Finding the Light#037.dst: Et surtout... L'une de ces choses est-elle lumière, ou ténèbres?

Finding the Light#038.src: I will not ask you to. You must understand that Orphion has no moral bearings- He simply needs action.
Finding the Light#038.dst: Je ne te le demanderai pas. Comprends qu'Orphion n'a aucune boussole morale - Il lui faut seulement qu'on agisse.

Finding the Light#039.src: I admit, such a thing is a conundrum. I agree that it is a tragedy to kill, in many instances.
Finding the Light#039.dst: Je l'admets, c'est un dilemme. Je conviens que tuer est une tragédie, bien souvent.

Finding the Light#040.src: Yet when such an action could save the lives of others, it becomes a conundrum with no answer. An impossible value to weigh.
Finding the Light#040.dst: Pourtant, quand un tel acte pourrait sauver d'autres vies, cela devient un dilemme sans réponse. Une valeur impossible à peser.

Finding the Light#041.src: Despite the circumstances, you have done the best you could. I cannot fault you for your thoughts and morals.
Finding the Light#041.dst: Malgré les circonstances, tu as fait de ton mieux. Je ne peux te reprocher tes pensées ni ta morale.

Finding the Light#042.src: And so... As you are now proven, as I am awoken, the gateway to the Light shall reveal itself to you. Lari... You must prepare for your journey to the Realm of Light.
Finding the Light#042.dst: Ainsi... Toi qui as fait tes preuves, moi qui suis éveillé, la porte de la Lumière se révélera à toi. Lari... Prépare-toi au voyage vers le Royaume de la Lumière.

Finding the Light#043.src: I do not blame you for it. By the time you have composed yourself, your ally will be ready. Understand that they are as necessary as you are.
Finding the Light#043.dst: Je ne t'en blâme pas. Le temps que tu te ressaisisses, ton allié sera prêt. Comprends qu'il est aussi nécessaire que toi.

Finding the Light#044.src: I must ask you to pay close attention. I shall present it simply- though the enormity of this cannot be understated.
Finding the Light#044.dst: Je te demande toute ton attention. Je vais l'exposer simplement - bien que l'ampleur de la chose soit immense.

Finding the Light#045.src: This is our world, the world we stand in right now. The physical plane of existence.
Finding the Light#045.dst: Voici notre monde, celui où nous nous tenons en ce moment. Le plan physique de l'existence.

Finding the Light#046.src: Only a select few are aware that there is more of the world than this. Even the astronomers and those who view the enormity of the sky cannot understand.
Finding the Light#046.dst: Seuls quelques élus savent que le monde ne se limite pas à cela. Même les astronomes, qui contemplent l'immensité du ciel, ne peuvent le comprendre.

Finding the Light#047.src: For, you see, this realm, this plane- It is mirrored upon a second plane, as the embodiments of Realms clash.
Finding the Light#047.dst: Car, vois-tu, ce royaume, ce plan - Il se reflète sur un second plan, là où s'affrontent les incarnations des Royaumes.

Finding the Light#048.src: This is the Plane of Influence, comprised of many realms. There are three you must know- But only one you must pay attention to.
Finding the Light#048.dst: Voici le Plan d'Influence, fait de nombreux royaumes. Il en est trois que tu dois connaître- mais un seul mérite ton attention.

Finding the Light#049.src: The Realms of Influence are connected to the physical plane, tied inexorably so to it. This is why even those gazing at the cosmos cannot grasp the enormity of it.
Finding the Light#049.dst: Les Royaumes d'Influence sont liés au plan physique, inexorablement. C'est pourquoi même ceux qui contemplent le cosmos ne peuvent en saisir l'immensité.

Finding the Light#050.src: These realms are in a constant push and pull- Battles that could not be seen by those of this world, waged constantly.
Finding the Light#050.dst: Ces royaumes se livrent un perpétuel bras de fer- des batailles invisibles pour ce monde, menées sans relâche.

Finding the Light#051.src: However, they can be felt. Wide-scale changes to the balance of one realm or another are reflected on the physical plane.
Finding the Light#051.dst: Mais on peut les ressentir. Tout grand changement dans l'équilibre d'un royaume se reflète sur le plan physique.

Finding the Light#052.src: The Realms of Influence are, themselves, reflections of a Beast- They themselves, a physical manifestation of their realm, as their realm is a manifestation of them.
Finding the Light#052.dst: Les Royaumes d'Influence sont eux-mêmes le reflet d'une Bête- manifestation physique de son royaume, tout comme ce royaume est sa manifestation.

Finding the Light#053.src: So surely, you must know- As Gavel has decayed, it must mean that the Realm of Light is in peril, and thus that Orphion is, as well.
Finding the Light#053.dst: Tu dois donc le savoir- si Gavel a dépéri, c'est que le Royaume de la Lumière est en péril, et Orphion avec lui.

Finding the Light#054.src: The Light is infected- That abominable parasite has breached the Realm of Light, and sought Orphion to leech away his light.
Finding the Light#054.dst: La Lumière est infectée- cet abominable parasite a forcé le Royaume de la Lumière et s'en est pris à Orphion pour aspirer sa lumière.

Finding the Light#055.src: And so, as the sun is forced to set, the land of Gavel grows dark. As the dark parasites spread and devour the minds of those here, so too is Orphion subject to this torture.
Finding the Light#055.dst: Ainsi, le soleil forcé de se coucher, la terre de Gavel s'assombrit. Tandis que les parasites sombres dévorent l'esprit des gens d'ici, Orphion subit la même torture.

Finding the Light#056.src: Now, you must enter the Realm of Light, and aid Lari in purging the parasite, before its work is finished and Orphion's mind is consumed.
Finding the Light#056.dst: Tu dois maintenant entrer dans le Royaume de la Lumière et aider Lari à purger le parasite, avant qu'il n'achève son oeuvre et ne consume l'esprit d'Orphion.

Finding the Light#057.src: You must ready yourself before this, of course. To venture to another realm is a lofty task.
Finding the Light#057.dst: Tu dois d'abord te préparer, bien sûr. S'aventurer dans un autre royaume est une rude entreprise.

Finding the Light#058.src: I will bestow upon you two things that will surely aid you in this, however. First, I shall provide you the way to the Gateway to Light.
Finding the Light#058.dst: Je t'accorderai toutefois deux choses qui t'y aideront. D'abord, je te montrerai le chemin de la Porte de la Lumière.

Finding the Light#059.src: Once you have reached it, I shall bestow upon you a personal blessing of mine, in the hopes that your path will become clear.
Finding the Light#059.dst: Une fois là-bas, je t'accorderai ma bénédiction personnelle, dans l'espoir que ton chemin s'éclaire.

Finding the Light#062.src: ...ah. {u}. So you are needed here too, then?
Finding the Light#062.dst: ...ah. {u}. On a besoin de toi ici aussi, alors?
Finding the Light#062.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#063.src: I am... TRYING... To awaken the Guardian of the Forest to receive its guidance, but it refuses to budge! Even the voice of Orphion provides no reaction.
Finding the Light#063.dst: Je... J'ESSAIE... de réveiller le Gardien de la forêt pour qu'il nous guide, mais il refuse de bouger! Même la voix d'Orphion ne provoque rien.
Finding the Light#063.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#064.src: I beg once more of you, awaken! Us two... Us two seek your wisdom!
Finding the Light#064.dst: Je t'en prie encore, éveille-toi! Nous deux... Nous deux voulons ta sagesse!
Finding the Light#064.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#065.src: I present you Orphion's barest light- Please, respond!
Finding the Light#065.dst: Voici un éclat d'Orphion- Je t'en prie, réponds!
Finding the Light#065.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#066.src: Urgh... See? Nothing is happening. I'm at a loss of what to do. Maybe you can effect some change, considering what you've done before.
Finding the Light#066.dst: Urgh... Tu vois? Rien ne se passe. Je ne sais plus quoi faire. Toi, tu pourrais peut-être changer les choses, vu tout ce que tu as déjà fait.
Finding the Light#066.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#067.src: Urgh... See? Nothing is happening. I'm at a loss of what to do. Maybe you can affect some change, considering what you've done before.
Finding the Light#067.dst: Urgh... Tu vois? Rien ne se passe. Je ne sais plus quoi faire. Toi, tu pourrais peut-être changer les choses, vu tout ce que tu as déjà fait.
Finding the Light#067.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#068.src: My pulse, it is time. I shall shine my light upon the roots of the Guardian. You and she must learn now.
Finding the Light#068.dst: Mon pouls, il est temps. Ma lumière va briller sur les racines du Gardien. Elle et toi devez apprendre.

Finding the Light#069.src: Read the inscription at the bottom of the big tree.
Finding the Light#069.dst: Lisez l'inscription au pied du grand arbre.

Finding the Light#070.src: An inscription! That wasn't there before! It was... That was completely instant. How did you even...?
Finding the Light#070.dst: Une inscription! Elle n'y était pas avant! C'était... C'est apparu instantanément. Comment as-tu...?
Finding the Light#070.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#071.src: But, still! I knew I could be useful, let me translate this for you! As a stranger to Gavel you wouldn't know High Gavellian...
Finding the Light#071.dst: Mais quand même! Je savais que je servirais à quelque chose, laisse-moi traduire! Tu n'es pas d'ici, tu ne connais pas le haut gavellien...
Finding the Light#071.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#072.src: It says... Secrets uncovered in the oldest of libraries in {p}.
Finding the Light#072.dst: Ça dit... Secrets dévoilés dans la plus vieille bibliothèque de {p}.
Finding the Light#072.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#073.src: ...of course. A place that Elves aren't allowed, but humans are. {u}, you'll have to find this library on your own, it seems.
Finding the Light#073.dst: ...évidemment. Un lieu interdit aux elfes, mais pas aux humains. {u}, tu vas devoir trouver cette bibliothèque par toi-même, on dirait.
Finding the Light#073.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#074.src: Find the Church Library in the city of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Finding the Light#074.dst: Trouvez la bibliothèque de l'église dans la ville de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Finding the Light#075.src: Find the Church Library in the city of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Finding the Light#075.dst: Trouvez la bibliothèque de l'église de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Finding the Light#076.src: Find a way up to the church bell at the top of the church.
Finding the Light#076.dst: Trouvez un moyen de monter jusqu'à la cloche, au sommet de l'église.

Finding the Light#077.src: Explore the secret library and find a way to wake up the tree.
Finding the Light#077.dst: Explorez la bibliothèque secrète et trouvez un moyen de réveiller l'arbre.

Finding the Light#079.src: Do you reject the light of Orphion? Waken, please!
Finding the Light#079.dst: Rejettes-tu la lumière d'Orphion? Éveille-toi, pitié!
Finding the Light#079.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#080.src: Urgh... {u}, please tell me you were able to make some progress. The Guardian still refuses... To... WAKE!
Finding the Light#080.dst: Urgh... {u}, dis-moi que tu as avancé, je t'en prie. Le Gardien refuse toujours... de... SE RÉVEILLER!
Finding the Light#080.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#081.src: What is this? A spell scroll- Of the Waking Forest?! In {p}, of all places? Where it would have been... Impossible for me to go...
Finding the Light#081.dst: Qu'est-ce que c'est? Un parchemin de sort- de la Forêt de l'Éveil?! Et à {p}, en plus? Là où il m'aurait été... impossible d'aller...
Finding the Light#081.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#082.src: So I am Orphion's chosen, yet I would not have been able to do what was asked of me. That... No, I can't dwell on that, let me see the scroll.
Finding the Light#082.dst: Je suis l'élue d'Orphion, et pourtant je n'aurais pas pu faire ce qu'on me demandait. Ça... Non, je ne dois pas m'y attarder, montre-moi le parchemin.
Finding the Light#082.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#083.src: ...hm. It says, The seeker must rest these words upon those of the Guardian.
Finding the Light#083.dst: ...hm. C'est écrit: Le chercheur doit poser ces mots sur ceux du Gardien.
Finding the Light#083.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#084.src: I suppose that means you need to place it by the inscription. So yet another task that you must finish...
Finding the Light#084.dst: Je suppose que tu dois le poser près de l'inscription. Encore une tâche que c'est toi qui dois accomplir...
Finding the Light#084.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#085.src: Use the spell on the inscription under the tree.
Finding the Light#085.dst: Utilisez le sort sur l'inscription sous l'arbre.

Finding the Light#086.src: Let me go ahead and read this, too. This will be tedious, I fear...
Finding the Light#086.dst: Laisse-moi lire ça aussi. Ce sera fastidieux, je le crains...
Finding the Light#086.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#087.src: It says... Awakening the Guardian of the Forest requires more than just magic. The home of the elves will house the answers and revelations...?
Finding the Light#087.dst: Ça dit... Éveiller le Gardien de la forêt exige plus que de la magie. La demeure des elfes abritera les réponses et les révélations...?
Finding the Light#087.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#088.src: That... This is finally my time! I still have a hand in this!! Finally, I can do something more than just holding stasis here!
Finding the Light#088.dst: Ça... Enfin, mon heure est venue! J'ai encore un rôle à jouer!! Enfin, je peux faire plus que maintenir l'équilibre ici!
Finding the Light#088.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#089.src: Listen, {u}. Achara... This is my time. I can finally help you more directly. I know the elders of {p}- They're sure to have answers!
Finding the Light#089.dst: Écoute, {u}. Achara... C'est mon heure. Je peux enfin t'aider plus directement. Je connais les anciens de {p}- ils auront forcément des réponses!
Finding the Light#089.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#090.src: You truly have been helpful, even through my own worries. I must thank you, but you can relax now! I will be the one this time!
Finding the Light#090.dst: Tu m'as vraiment aidée, malgré mes doutes. Merci, mais tu peux souffler maintenant! Cette fois, c'est mon tour!
Finding the Light#090.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#091.src: You can continue doing...whatever else it is you need doing. I have seen you helping in various places- Concern yourself with those for now. I can handle this.
Finding the Light#091.dst: Tu peux continuer à faire... tout ce que tu as à faire. Je t'ai vu aider un peu partout- occupe-toi de ça pour l'instant. Je m'en charge.
Finding the Light#091.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#092.src: Pursue her, my pulse. She must take dire action- Alone, her light shall illuminate nothing. You must provide her direction.
Finding the Light#092.dst: Suis-la, mon pouls. Elle doit prendre des mesures extrêmes- seule, sa lumière n'éclairera rien. Tu dois lui montrer la voie.

Finding the Light#093.src: Enter the portal Lari left behind
Finding the Light#093.dst: Entrez dans le portail laissé par Lari

Finding the Light#094.src: Go to the hut Lari entered.
Finding the Light#094.dst: Allez à la hutte où Lari est entrée.

Finding the Light#095.src: W-What? You- Why did you follow me? I can handle this! I can finally be useful again! Do you...not trust me?
Finding the Light#095.dst: Q-Quoi? Toi- Pourquoi m'as-tu suivie? Je m'en charge! Je peux enfin être utile de nouveau! Tu... ne me fais pas confiance?
Finding the Light#095.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#096.src: Please, just respect my wishes! If I need your help, I'll go find you- For now, just leave! You don't need to worry about this!
Finding the Light#096.dst: Je t'en prie, respecte ma volonté! Si j'ai besoin d'aide, je viendrai te chercher- pour l'instant, pars! Tu n'as pas à t'en soucier!
Finding the Light#096.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#097.src: Find a way to sneak into the hut.
Finding the Light#097.dst: Trouvez un moyen de vous faufiler dans la hutte.

Finding the Light#098.src: ...if this human has truly done what you have said, then why do you spurn their aid? It is unlike you.
Finding the Light#098.dst: ...si cet humain a vraiment fait ce que tu dis, pourquoi repousses-tu son aide? Ça ne te ressemble pas.
Finding the Light#098.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#099.src: I know, I know. I just am in disbelief. They've been contacted by Orphion himself, allowed into the Taproot, they have a symbol of Orphion's blessing!!
Finding the Light#099.dst: Je sais, je sais. Je n'arrive pas à y croire. Orphion lui-même l'a contacté, on l'a admis dans le Taproot, il porte un symbole de sa bénédiction!!
Finding the Light#099.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#100.src: They just...walked up, after a thousand years of my putting my entire life into trying to save this province, and do everything I couldn't, in the span of weeks at most!
Finding the Light#100.dst: Il est juste... arrivé, après mille ans passés à consacrer ma vie à sauver cette province, et il a fait tout ce que je n'ai pas pu, en quelques semaines tout au plus!
Finding the Light#100.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#101.src: Do you understand how infuriating this is? Can you comprehend such a thing, not having been in my position yourself?
Finding the Light#101.dst: Comprenez-vous à quel point c'est exaspérant? Pouvez-vous seulement le concevoir, sans avoir été à ma place?
Finding the Light#101.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#102.src: No. I cannot understand. But I also cannot understand how you are not grateful for this aid.
Finding the Light#102.dst: Non, je ne peux pas. Mais je ne comprends pas non plus ton ingratitude envers cette aide.
Finding the Light#102.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#103.src: I know I should be! It's all I've been able to think about. I should be ecstatic! The light will be saved, it should be everything I've dreamed of...
Finding the Light#103.dst: Je sais que je devrais l'être! Je ne pense qu'à ça. Je devrais être aux anges! La lumière sera sauvée, c'est tout ce dont j'ai rêvé...
Finding the Light#103.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#104.src: But it makes me feel like a complete failure. Like everything I have done has been for naught, that I have somehow been doing everything wrong!
Finding the Light#104.dst: Mais ça me donne l'impression d'être un échec total. Comme si tout ce que j'ai fait avait été vain, comme si j'avais tout fait de travers!
Finding the Light#104.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#105.src: I know I have made mistakes. Dullahan would still be... Still be himself, if I had taken faster action, but I can't have done nothing right. I can't accept that.
Finding the Light#105.dst: Je sais que j'ai fait des erreurs. Dullahan serait encore... encore lui-même si j'avais agi plus vite, mais je n'ai pas pu tout rater. Je refuse de l'accepter.
Finding the Light#105.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#106.src: This is my chance to prove I can still be useful- that Orphion choosing me wasn't a fluke! Please, the inscription said you would know where to go!
Finding the Light#106.dst: C'est ma chance de prouver que je sers encore à quelque chose- qu'Orphion ne m'a pas choisie par hasard! Je vous en prie, l'inscription disait que vous sauriez où aller!
Finding the Light#106.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#108.src: ...even after a millennium, there is so very much for us all to learn. Fine then.
Finding the Light#108.dst: ...même après un millénaire, nous avons tous tant à apprendre. Soit.
Finding the Light#108.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#109.src: But promise me to accept the aid you receive. This opportunity cannot be wasted, Lari.
Finding the Light#109.dst: Mais promets-moi d'accepter l'aide qu'on t'offrira. Cette occasion ne doit pas être gâchée, Lari.
Finding the Light#109.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#110.src: ...I have to do at least one thing right. I can't just keep up this holding pattern. I'll do whatever is necessary!
Finding the Light#110.dst: ...Je dois réussir au moins une chose. Je ne peux pas continuer à tourner en rond. Je ferai tout ce qu'il faudra!
Finding the Light#110.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#111.src: You must seek the Canned Abis plant, then. It rests within a cavern shaded by giant fern leaves.
Finding the Light#111.dst: Alors cherche la plante Canned Abis. Elle pousse dans une caverne ombragée de feuilles de fougère géantes.
Finding the Light#111.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#112.src: Thank you. I can finally do what I was meant to do! I won't let anything stop me this time!!
Finding the Light#112.dst: Merci. Je peux enfin accomplir ma destinée! Cette fois, rien ne m'arrêtera!!
Finding the Light#112.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#113.src: ...Human, I can see you. Consider yourself lucky that she did not. Come talk to me.
Finding the Light#113.dst: ...Humain, je vous vois. Estimez-vous heureux qu'elle ne vous ait pas vu. Venez me parler.
Finding the Light#113.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#115.src: So you are Orphion's new chosen, then. It is both surprising and not- Humans have an interesting reputation.
Finding the Light#115.dst: Vous êtes donc le nouvel élu d'Orphion. C'est surprenant sans l'être- les humains ont une réputation intéressante.
Finding the Light#115.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#116.src: Often said as being able to get anything done, without limits, be it completing impossible tasks or breaking moral tenets.
Finding the Light#116.dst: On les dit capables de tout accomplir, sans limites, qu'il s'agisse de tâches impossibles ou d'enfreindre des principes moraux.
Finding the Light#116.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#117.src: In this instance, however, you've both to do. Orphion has commanded it, has he not? And so you must, and for that I apologize.
Finding the Light#117.dst: Mais ici, vous devrez faire les deux. Orphion l'a ordonné, n'est-ce pas? Vous le devez donc, et pour cela, je m'excuse.
Finding the Light#117.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#118.src: I have seen Lari's work- And she has done this land a priceless service. Alone, she has kept the Decay from creeping south, and thus the Guardian remains with us.
Finding the Light#118.dst: J'ai vu l'oeuvre de Lari- elle a rendu à cette terre un service inestimable. Seule, elle a empêché la Décadence de gagner le sud, et le Gardien est toujours parmi nous.
Finding the Light#118.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#119.src: However, her own morals prevent the situation from progressing. She cannot kill- And the source must be exterminated for light to once again fill the land.
Finding the Light#119.dst: Mais sa propre morale empêche la situation d'évoluer. Elle ne peut pas tuer- or il faut exterminer la source pour que la lumière emplisse de nouveau la terre.
Finding the Light#119.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#120.src: Orphion's circumstances are dire- And so you must come to understand something. He is above us, in terms of morals. Such concepts do not apply to him.
Finding the Light#120.dst: La situation d'Orphion est critique- vous devez donc comprendre une chose. En matière de morale, il nous dépasse. Ces notions ne s'appliquent pas à lui.
Finding the Light#120.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#121.src: As the embodiment of Light itself, he has no sense of morals- Merely survival and stasis. What he asks of us, many will balk at.
Finding the Light#121.dst: Incarnation de la Lumière elle-même, il n'a aucun sens moral- seulement la survie et l'équilibre. Beaucoup reculeront devant ce qu'il nous demande.
Finding the Light#121.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#122.src: It is a matter where morals must be set aside... And such a thing is one that Lari cannot abide by, for she has stubbornly clung to them for a thousand years.
Finding the Light#122.dst: C'est une affaire où la morale doit être mise de côté... Et cela, Lari ne peut s'y résoudre, car elle s'y accroche obstinément depuis mille ans.
Finding the Light#122.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#123.src: To break them... I will admit, I believe there to be some other way to solve these problems, but the fact of the matter is there simply is no time left.
Finding the Light#123.dst: La transgresser... Je l'admets, je crois qu'il existe un autre moyen de régler ces problèmes, mais le fait est qu'il ne reste plus de temps.
Finding the Light#123.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#124.src: She must use the extent of her powers, and while she retains her pacifism that will not happen. I must ask you to follow her, as Orphion would wish.
Finding the Light#124.dst: Elle doit user de tout son pouvoir, et tant qu'elle restera pacifiste, ça n'arrivera pas. Je dois vous demander de la suivre, comme Orphion le voudrait.
Finding the Light#124.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#125.src: There is, unfortunately, no right to this. There is simply necessity- And there, you must push her to her limits. Seek the cave of the Canned Abis.
Finding the Light#125.dst: Hélas, rien de tout cela n'est juste. Il n'y a que la nécessité- et là-bas, vous devrez la pousser à bout. Cherchez la grotte de la Canned Abis.
Finding the Light#125.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#126.src: It is north-east from here. The entrance is shaded by giant fern leaves. I only pray that this will be enough.
Finding the Light#126.dst: Elle est au nord-est d'ici. L'entrée est ombragée de feuilles de fougère géantes. Je prie pour que cela suffise.
Finding the Light#126.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#127.src: Find the Canned Abis cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Finding the Light#127.dst: Trouvez la grotte de la Canned Abis en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Finding the Light#128.src: Find the plant inside the cave.
Finding the Light#128.dst: Trouvez la plante dans la grotte.

Finding the Light#131.src: ...I can't believe this. What am I doing wrong? What is it? There has to be some reason, what IS it?!
Finding the Light#131.dst: ...Je n'y crois pas. Qu'est-ce que je fais de travers? Qu'est-ce que c'est? Il doit y avoir une raison, LAQUELLE?!
Finding the Light#131.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#132.src: There's not another inscription...it's just the same words! What does it mean by "dire actions?!" I've done everything I can think of!
Finding the Light#132.dst: Il n'y a pas de nouvelle inscription... ce sont les mêmes mots! Que veut dire "mesures extrêmes"?! J'ai fait tout ce qui me venait à l'esprit!
Finding the Light#132.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#133.src: ...{u}. I. I have to know. What did Orphion tell you, exactly? I can't stand not knowing any longer. Did he really replace me?
Finding the Light#133.dst: ...{u}. Je. Je dois savoir. Que t'a dit Orphion, exactement? Je ne supporte plus de ne pas savoir. M'a-t-il vraiment remplacée?
Finding the Light#133.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#134.src: Is- Is this not dire enough? Is poring over you and putting aside my role and pride to someone else not EXTREME enough?!
Finding the Light#134.dst: Ce- Ce n'est pas assez extrême? Te scruter, céder mon rôle et ma fierté à quelqu'un d'autre, ce n'est pas assez EXTRÊME?!
Finding the Light#134.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#135.src: I can't think of any other reason why everything for me has just...stopped working. Did he? Please, tell me-
Finding the Light#135.dst: Je ne vois pas d'autre raison pour que tout ait... cessé de marcher pour moi. C'est ça? Je t'en prie, dis-le-moi-
Finding the Light#135.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#136.src: ...wait... You... You have Canned Abis on you!! Where did you get that?!
Finding the Light#136.dst: ...attends... Tu... Tu as de la Canned Abis sur toi!! Où l'as-tu trouvée?!
Finding the Light#136.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#137.src: You... There's no way you would've known that unless you... YOU! You eavesdropped on me!!
Finding the Light#137.dst: Toi... Tu n'aurais jamais pu le savoir, à moins de... TOI! Tu m'as espionnée!!
Finding the Light#137.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#138.src: You FOLLOWED ME into the cave even after I asked not to! You... After everything I said!! After you heard all those private thoughts!
Finding the Light#138.dst: Tu M'AS SUIVIE dans la grotte alors que je t'avais dit non! Toi... Après tout ce que j'ai dit!! Après avoir entendu mes pensées intimes!
Finding the Light#138.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#139.src: You STILL decided it was a good idea to come after me! What are you planning to accomplish like this?!
Finding the Light#139.dst: Et tu as QUAND MÊME jugé bon de me suivre! Qu'espères-tu accomplir comme ça?!
Finding the Light#139.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#140.src: You heard me then!! It's ALL out in the open! I can't succeed! You're there! You're doing everything I couldn't!
Finding the Light#140.dst: Tu m'as entendue!! TOUT est étalé au grand jour! Je ne peux pas réussir! Toi, tu es là! Tu fais tout ce que je n'ai pas pu!
Finding the Light#140.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#141.src: I'm NOT a failure! I'm not! I won't be! I refuse to be! You don't GET to watch me flounder and flail!!
Finding the Light#141.dst: Je ne suis PAS un échec! Non! Je ne le serai pas! Je refuse! Tu n'as PAS LE DROIT de me regarder me débattre!!
Finding the Light#141.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#144.src: Wha- I... What just... What did I...?
Finding the Light#144.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#146.src: I-I NEARLY KILLED THEM! I JUST BROKE AND DEFILED EVERYTHING I'VE EVER STOOD FOR!!
Finding the Light#146.dst: J-J'AI FAILLI LE TUER! J'AI TRAHI ET SOUILLÉ TOUT CE QUE J'AI TOUJOURS DÉFENDU!!
Finding the Light#146.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#147.src: TELL ME!! HOW COULD THIS POSSIBLY BE THE ANSWER?! HOW COULD THIS BE WHAT NEEDED TO HAPPEN?!
Finding the Light#147.dst: DIS-LE-MOI!! COMMENT ÇA POURRAIT ÊTRE LA RÉPONSE?! COMMENT ÇA POURRAIT ÊTRE CE QUI DEVAIT ARRIVER?!
Finding the Light#147.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#148.src: WHY WOULD I BE NEEDED TO... To...
Finding the Light#148.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#149.src: T-Trying to murder them because they did what I couldn't isn't dark? How can you possibly think that?!
Finding the Light#149.dst: V-Vouloir le tuer parce qu'il a fait ce que je n'ai pas pu, ce n'est pas sombre? Comment peux-tu penser ça?!
Finding the Light#149.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#150.src: What kind of guardian are you, permissing this kind of violence? How is anything I just did alright?
Finding the Light#150.dst: Quel gardien es-tu, pour tolérer une telle violence? Comment ce que je viens de faire pourrait-il être acceptable?
Finding the Light#150.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#151.src: ...you. You can't possibly be saying that what I did was the right thing to do. I refuse to accept that.
Finding the Light#151.dst: ...toi. Tu ne peux pas dire que ce que j'ai fait était juste. Je refuse de l'accepter.
Finding the Light#151.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#152.src: ...then... Shouldn't I feel... I don't know. Shouldn't I feel less restrained? Less afraid? More... More free?
Finding the Light#152.dst: ...alors... Ne devrais-je pas me sentir... Je ne sais pas. Moins entravée? Moins effrayée? Plus... Plus libre?
Finding the Light#152.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#153.src: If what I've done was what needed to happen, why do I feel like the scum of the earth? Why do I feel so terrible?!
Finding the Light#153.dst: Si ce que j'ai fait devait arriver, pourquoi je me sens comme la pire des ordures? Pourquoi je me sens si mal?!
Finding the Light#153.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#154.src: ...I... I need time to process this. I... Do you understand how difficult this is to hear? To bear?
Finding the Light#154.dst: ...Je... J'ai besoin de temps pour digérer ça. Je... Tu comprends à quel point c'est dur à entendre? A supporter?
Finding the Light#154.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#155.src: My pulse, your light is brilliant... It has shone upon Lari, and soon her light will shine my way...
Finding the Light#155.dst: Mon pouls, ta lumière est éclatante... Elle a brillé sur Lari, et bientôt sa lumière brillera vers moi...

Finding the Light#156.src: Enter the roots, and witness the path to my realm. And then, prepare yourself. Muster your most blinding light...
Finding the Light#156.dst: Entre dans les racines et contemple le chemin de mon royaume. Puis prépare-toi. Rassemble ta lumière la plus aveuglante...

Finding the Light#157.src: secrets uncovered in the oldest of libraries in cinfras
Finding the Light#157.dst: secrets dévoilés dans la plus vieille bibliothèque de cinfras
Finding the Light#157.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#158.src: awakening the guardian of the forest requires more than just magic
Finding the Light#158.dst: éveiller le gardien de la forêt exige plus que de la magie
Finding the Light#158.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#159.src: the home of the elves will house the answers and revelations
Finding the Light#159.dst: la demeure des elfes abritera les réponses et les révélations
Finding the Light#159.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#160.src: dire actions in the presence of the guardian will waken many things
Finding the Light#160.dst: des mesures extrêmes devant le gardien éveilleront bien des choses

Flight in Distress#000.src: Bring your Gavellian Passport to the Airship Clerk at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Flight in Distress#000.dst: Apportez votre passeport gavellien à l'employé du dirigeable en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Flight in Distress#001.src: Good day, soldier! Will you be flying with us today?
Flight in Distress#001.dst: Bonjour, soldat! Vous volez avec nous aujourd'hui?
Flight in Distress#001.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#002.src: May I see your passport please?
Flight in Distress#002.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#003.src: It's a bit dusty! It looks very old, but the picture looks like you.
Flight in Distress#003.dst: Un peu poussiéreux! Il a l'air très ancien, mais la photo vous ressemble.
Flight in Distress#003.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#004.src: Well everything seems to be in order, climb aboard and I hope you have a pleasant journey.
Flight in Distress#004.dst: Bien, tout semble en ordre. Montez à bord, et je vous souhaite un agréable voyage.
Flight in Distress#004.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#006.src: Please remain seated, passengers. We'll be taking off in a moment!
Flight in Distress#006.dst: Restez assis, chers passagers. Nous décollons dans un instant!
Flight in Distress#006.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#007.src: Speak to Captain Ackbar regarding the missing child.
Flight in Distress#007.dst: Parlez au capitaine Ackbar de l'enfant disparu.

Flight in Distress#008.src: Attention passengers. There has been a missing person reported aboard. If there are any volunteers to help search for them, please report to the bridge and speak to the captain.
Flight in Distress#008.dst: Avis aux passagers. Une personne a été signalée disparue à bord. Tout volontaire pour aider aux recherches est prié de se rendre sur la passerelle et de parler au capitaine.
Flight in Distress#008.speaker: Broadcast

Flight in Distress#009.src: This area is off limits to passengers during take off. Climb up to the passenger decks, there will be an attendee at your cabin.
Flight in Distress#009.dst: Cette zone est interdite aux passagers pendant le décollage. Montez aux ponts passagers, un steward vous attend à votre cabine.
Flight in Distress#009.speaker: Ship Crew

Flight in Distress#011.src: The bear really liked the cod!

Flight in Distress#012.src: I hope I don't get nauseous...
Flight in Distress#012.speaker: Passenger Jeremy

Flight in Distress#013.src: Greetings, young adventurer. You haven't seen my glasses, have you?
Flight in Distress#013.dst: Salutations, jeune aventurier. Vous n'auriez pas vu mes lunettes?
Flight in Distress#013.speaker: Baron Axol

Flight in Distress#014.src: The interior of this ship is beautiful!
Flight in Distress#014.dst: L'intérieur de ce dirigeable est superbe!
Flight in Distress#014.speaker: Passenger John

Flight in Distress#015.src: Good day to you, soldier! This will be your quarters for the flight. I wish you a pleasant trip with us!
Flight in Distress#015.dst: Bonjour, soldat! Voici votre cabine pour le vol. Je vous souhaite un agréable voyage parmi nous!
Flight in Distress#015.speaker: Attendant

Flight in Distress#016.src: You can sleep through your journey here if you have nothing else to do!
Flight in Distress#016.dst: Vous pouvez dormir ici tout le voyage si vous n'avez rien d'autre à faire!
Flight in Distress#016.speaker: Attendant
