Hunger of the Gerts Part I#020.dst: Je savais que c'était une erreur d'acheter si près des frontières des Gerts. Voyez-vous, les Gerts ne sont pas les 'brutes' qu'on dit, mais...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#020.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#020.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.src: Well, they'll eat anything! Animals, fish, monsters, villagers, even humans! Biologically, they're just constantly hungry.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.dst: Bon, ils mangent n'importe quoi! Animaux, poissons, monstres, villageois, même des humains! Biologiquement, ils ont faim en permanence.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.src: The watch is meant to keep them behind their borders...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.dst: La Garde est censée les garder derrière leurs frontières...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.src: I even bought a golem to watch over them - Got it for a good price because of some incident down at the {p} factory.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.dst: J'ai même acheté un golem pour les surveiller - Je l'ai eu à bon prix à cause d'un incident à l'usine de {p}.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#024.src: But somehow the gerts are managing to avoid it! Look, if you're here from the watch, could you help me out?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#024.dst: Mais les Gerts arrivent à l'éviter, je ne sais comment! Écoutez, si vous venez de la part de la Garde, vous pourriez m'aider?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#024.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#024.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#025.src: Go to the gert camp west of here and find out how they are doing all of this!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#025.dst: Allez au camp des Gerts à l'ouest d'ici et découvrez comment ils s'y prennent!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#025.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#025.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#026.src: Inspect the Gerten Forwarding Camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#026.dst: Inspectez le camp avancé des Gerts en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#026.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#027.src: Investigate the cave in the back of the camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#027.dst: Examinez la grotte au fond du camp en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#027.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#028.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#029.src: Looks like the Gerten chiefs are having a meeting, you shouldn't get too close... maybe there's somewhere nearby you can eavesdrop from?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#029.dst: On dirait que les chefs des Gerts sont en réunion, mieux vaut ne pas trop s'approcher... il y a peut-être un endroit tout près d'où écouter?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#029.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.src: -Good job to all of you! I am proud to say we made the cave road very well.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.dst: -Bon travail à tous! Moi fier de dire que nous avoir très bien fait la route de grotte.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#031.src: The town folk at Gylia steal the stuff meant for us for their party, and leave us high and dry!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#031.dst: Les gens de ville à Gylia volent les choses pour nous pour leur fête, et nous laisser sans rien!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#031.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#031.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#032.src: But those dumb over fed town folk did not catch us when we dug our cave road right under their watch house.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#032.dst: Mais ces gens de ville bêtes et trop gros pas nous voir creuser route de grotte juste sous leur maison de garde.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#032.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#032.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#033.src: With our new way to get to Gylia land we have more stuff than ever!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#033.dst: Avec nouveau chemin vers Gylia, nous avoir plus de choses que jamais!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#033.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#033.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#034.dst: Sortez de la grotte des Gerts.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#034.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#035.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.src: Human! You're back... and haven't been eaten by a Gert!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.dst: Humain! Vous voilà... et aucun Gert ne vous a mangé!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.src: What did you discover in the camp?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.src: A tunnel?! Past Gerten borders? That must be how they're managing to get in and steal my livestock.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.dst: Un tunnel?! Qui passe sous la frontière des Gerts? C'est sûrement comme ça qu'ils entrent pour voler mon bétail.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.src: Look, human. The Watch aren't gonna do anything about this. Please... maybe you can help me.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.dst: Écoutez, humain. La Garde ne va rien faire. Je vous en prie... vous pourriez peut-être m'aider.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#040.src: If you can disguise yourself as a Gert maybe you could sneak into their main camp and check out this tunnel?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#040.dst: Si vous vous déguisez en Gert, vous pourriez peut-être vous faufiler dans leur camp principal et examiner ce tunnel?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#040.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#040.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#041.src: Okay! As you can see, all Gerts wear a carved pumpkin on their head - something to do with their culture.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#041.dst: D'accord! Comme vous voyez, tous les Gerts portent une citrouille sculptée sur la tête - une histoire de culture.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#041.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#041.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#042.src: There's a pumpkin farm near here at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]... maybe you could get one from there?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#042.dst: Il y a un champ de citrouilles près d'ici en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]... vous pourriez en prendre une?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#042.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#042.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#043.src: There's a pumpkin farm near here at [-{~},-{~}]... maybe you could get one from there?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#043.dst: Il y a un champ de citrouilles près d'ici en [-{~},-{~}]... vous pourriez en prendre une?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#043.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#044.src: Go to the gerten pumpkin farm at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#044.dst: Allez au champ de citrouilles des Gerts en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#044.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#045.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#045.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#046.src: Oh good, were you sent here to be my lunch?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#046.dst: Oh, bien, on t'a envoyé ici pour être mon déjeuner?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#046.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#046.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#047.src: The gert is looking at you hungrily... it might be best to leave the conversation?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#047.dst: Le Gert vous regarde avec appétit... mieux vaudrait peut-être quitter la conversation?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#047.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#048.src: Are you here to be my lunch?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#048.dst: Tu viens pour être mon repas?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#048.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#048.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#049.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#049.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.src: Oh. What are you then, some kind of snack?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.dst: Oh. Alors tu es quoi, un genre d'en-cas?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#051.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.src: ... Is that a joke? What are you, some kind of snack?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.dst: ... C'est une blague? Tu es quoi, un en-cas?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.src: A who.. man? Oh, you mean new folk! All the way here in gerten lands? I have not seen one of you here.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.dst: Un hu.. main? Ah, un nouveau-venu! Jusqu'ici, en terre gerten? Jamais vu un des tiens par ici.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#054.src: I do want to know how you taste...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#054.dst: J'ai bien envie de savoir quel goût tu as...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#054.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#054.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#055.src: The gert has a strange look in his eyes and is inching towards you suspiciously...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#055.dst: Le gert a un drôle de regard et se rapproche de vous l'air louche...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#055.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.src: Doing? I am here to guard the orange gourd farm, of course!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.dst: Ce que je fais? Je garde le champ de courges orange, bien sûr!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#057.src: This farm right here is where all the gerts get their day mask from!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#057.dst: C'est dans ce champ que tous les gerts prennent leur masque du jour!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#057.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#057.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#058.dst: Pourquoi les gerts portent des citrouilles?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#058.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#059.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.src: No, new folk. Gerts only in this farm.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.dst: Non, nouveau-venu. Champ réservé aux gerts.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.src: That is why I am put here. To make sure no one gets in.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.dst: C'est pour ça qu'on m'a mis là. Pour que personne n'entre.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#062.src: But but I get so bored... and I really want to eat...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#062.dst: Mais mais je m'ennuie tant... et j'ai si faim...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#062.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#062.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#063.src: I'll pay you to let me take
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#063.dst: Je te paie pour en prendre une
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#063.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#064.src: Like, with the clear green rocks?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#064.dst: Genre, avec les cailloux verts clairs?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#064.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#064.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#065.src: No new folk, gerts do not have any need for green rocks. But...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#065.dst: Non, nouveau-venu, les gerts n'ont pas besoin de cailloux verts. Mais...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#065.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#065.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#066.src: How about this - I will just eat you!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#066.dst: J'ai mieux: je vais te manger!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#066.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#066.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#067.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#069.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#070.src: Well, I think I will still eat you. Just how it is!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#070.dst: Bon, je crois que je te mange quand même. C'est comme ça!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#070.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#070.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#071.src: Oh, it is a thing gerts have been doing for as long as we know.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#071.dst: Oh, les gerts font ça depuis toujours.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#071.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#071.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#072.src: At wake time each day a gert takes an orange gourd and eats into it a shape that shows their mood!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#072.dst: Chaque jour au réveil, un gert prend une courge orange et y croque une forme qui montre son humeur!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#072.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#072.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#073.src: It is really nice, is it not?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#073.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#073.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#074.src: The gert is very close to you now and you can see saliva dripping from its teeth...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#074.dst: Le gert est tout près de vous et vous voyez la bave couler de ses dents...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#074.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#075.src: We all want to eat all the time!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#075.dst: On veut tous manger tout le temps!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#075.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#075.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#076.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#076.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#077.src: Oh... good bye. Come back soon? With some food?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#077.dst: Oh... au revoir. Tu reviens vite? Avec à manger?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#077.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#077.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#078.src: Looks like the guard is pretty distracted waiting for apples to fall out of the sky... you should be able to sneak into the farm now.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#078.dst: Le garde semble occupé à attendre que des pommes tombent du ciel... vous devriez pouvoir vous faufiler dans le champ.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#078.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#079.src: This pumpkin looks perfect to carve a face into...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#079.dst: Une citrouille parfaite pour y sculpter un visage...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#079.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#080.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#081.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#082.src: You should report back to Jitak with your new mask and information about the tunnel.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#082.dst: Retournez voir Jitak avec votre masque et ce que vous savez du tunnel.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#082.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#084.dst: Oh, un fruit rouge d'arbre! Je ne dois pas quitter mon poste... mais j'ai faim...

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#086.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#087.src: That tastes so good! What a good red tree fruit.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#087.dst: Que c'est bon! Quel bon fruit rouge d'arbre.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#087.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#087.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#088.src: ... If I wait here, more might fall from the sky!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#088.dst: ... Si j'attends ici, il en tombera peut-être d'autres!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#088.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#088.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#089.dst: Entrez dans le champ de citrouilles en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#089.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#090.src: Find a pumpkin to use as a gert mask.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#090.dst: Trouvez une citrouille à porter comme masque de gert.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#090.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#091.dst: Hé! Tu fais quoi dans le champ de citrouilles à cette heure?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#091.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#091.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#094.dst: Tu n'es pas un gert! Tu es un humain! Un gert a toujours faim!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#094.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#094.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#095.dst: Désolé, humain, c'est une terre gerten privée. Et puis... un gert doit manger!

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#053.dst: Bon... même si je doute que les Gerts grimpent...
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#053.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#053.speaker: Bory

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#054.src: The details aren't that important. I am doing my job, anyway.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#054.dst: Les détails importent peu. Je fais mon travail, de toute façon.

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#060.dst: Notre devoir est de protéger les gens des Gerts!
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#060.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#060.speaker: Bory

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#061.src: If what you are saying is true, we need to stay here!
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#061.dst: Si tu dis vrai, nous devons rester ici!
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#061.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#061.speaker: Bory

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#062.src: Do you want to go have a sna
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#062.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#063.src: I don't even think anyone would miss the Gerts if they were to die, hah!
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#063.dst: Je doute que les Gerts manquent à qui que ce soit s'ils mouraient, ha!
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#063.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#063.speaker: Bory

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#064.src: You successfully got Bory out of the watch!
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#064.dst: Vous avez fait sortir Bory de la Garde!
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#064.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#065.src: Maybe it's time to save the people in the basement.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#065.dst: Il est peut-être temps de sauver ceux du sous-sol.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#065.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#066.src: It seems that they locked up the basement...
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#066.dst: On dirait qu'ils ont fermé le sous-sol à clé...
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#066.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#067.dst: Il s'est passé quelque chose dehors!
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#067.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#068.src: This must be a freshly dug tunnel...
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#068.dst: Ce tunnel doit être fraîchement creusé...

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#069.src: It seems the Gerts have gone on the offence.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#069.dst: On dirait que les Gerts sont passés à l'offensive.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#069.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#070.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#071.src: At least for now. Maybe it's time to check on the Gylia watch again.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#071.dst: Pour l'instant du moins. Il est peut-être temps de revoir la Garde de Gylia.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#071.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#072.src: I can never say no to a snack!
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#072.dst: Je ne dis jamais non à un en-cas!
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#072.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#072.speaker: Bory

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#074.src: Ooh! It sounds like you've prepared a whole feast out there!
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#074.dst: Ooh! On dirait que tu as préparé un vrai festin dehors!

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#074.speaker: Bory

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#084.speaker: Winie

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#085.src: Good job on emptying the tower. I explained the situation to the {p} Military and they followed me here.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#085.dst: Bravo d'avoir vidé la tour. J'ai expliqué la situation à l'armée de {p} et ils m'ont suivi.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#085.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#085.speaker: Winie

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#086.src: Good thing you came to us. There is something wrong with this place because I swear... everyone seems to go coockoo.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#086.dst: Heureusement que tu es venu nous voir. Il y a un problème ici, parce que je te jure... tout le monde devient zinzin.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#086.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#086.speaker: Cinfras Military

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#087.src: Either way. Due to the workers breaking the treaty we have no choice but to charge them for their crimes and fire them on the spot.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#087.dst: Quoi qu'il en soit. Les employés ayant rompu le traité, nous devons les inculper pour leurs crimes et les renvoyer sur-le-champ.

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#088.src: Us three have been put in place as a replacement until further notice.

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#088.speaker: Winie

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#089.src: We will also return the stolen food to the Gerts, and hopefully they can calm them down.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#089.dst: Nous rendrons aussi la nourriture volée aux Gerts, en espérant que ça les calme.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#089.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#089.speaker: Winie

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#090.dst: Ton travail ici est terminé, Wynnien. Merci au nom de {p}.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#090.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#090.speaker: Winie

Hunt Woolly Rhinos#001.src: Request from the Customs Clerk: To whomever it may concern, there has recently been an increase in damaged goods from outside the Capital. When questioned, various artisans admit having been attacked by ferocious beasts.
Hunt Woolly Rhinos#001.dst: Requête du douanier: A qui de droit, les marchandises abîmées venant de l'extérieur de la capitale se multiplient. Interrogés, plusieurs artisans admettent avoir été attaqués par des bêtes féroces.

Hunt Woolly Rhinos#002.src: Woolly Rhinos seem to match the description, and they are indeed creatures not to be tempered with. I am unsure what causes them such unrest. Perhaps they feel a change in the environment, but it matters not.
Hunt Woolly Rhinos#002.dst: Les rhinocéros laineux semblent correspondre, et ce sont des créatures à ne pas provoquer. J'ignore ce qui les agite autant. Peut-être sentent-ils un changement dans leur milieu, mais peu importe.

Hunt Woolly Rhinos#003.src: What matters is that more and more goods are being damaged, causing delays in the monitoring of what goes in and out of the Capital. If someone could hunt at least {~} Woolly Rhinos, it would be of assistance to us all.
Hunt Woolly Rhinos#003.dst: Ce qui importe, c'est que de plus en plus de marchandises sont abîmées, ce qui retarde le contrôle des entrées et sorties de la capitale. Si quelqu'un pouvait chasser au moins {~} rhinocéros laineux, cela nous aiderait tous.

Hunt Woolly Rhinos#004.src: There are reports of two of them having been spotted nearby House Thalas and House Nasin. I have set up a carriage next to this board if you wish to go there.
Hunt Woolly Rhinos#004.dst: Deux auraient été aperçus près de la Maison Thalas et de la Maison Nasin. J'ai mis une calèche à côté de ce tableau si vous voulez vous y rendre.

Hunt Woolly Rhinos#005.src: Additionally, a friend of mine has also seen one to the north of {p}, quite close to the town itself. Please return to this post once you are done. As mentioned, they are very resilient. Be sure to brace yourself.
Hunt Woolly Rhinos#005.dst: Un ami en a aussi vu un au nord de {p}, tout près de la ville. Revenez à ce tableau une fois terminé. Comme dit, ils sont très résistants. Préparez-vous bien.

Hunt Woolly Rhinos#006.src: You've hunted enough of those beasts. You should return to the Slaying Post to collect your reward.
Hunt Woolly Rhinos#006.dst: Vous avez chassé assez de ces bêtes. Retournez au tableau de chasse chercher votre récompense.

Hunt Woolly Rhinos#007.src: Return to the Slaying Post at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to collect your reward.
Hunt Woolly Rhinos#007.dst: Retournez au tableau de chasse en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] pour récupérer votre récompense.

Ice Nations#000.src: Thank you again for bringing peace upon our islands.
Ice Nations#000.dst: Merci encore d'avoir ramené la paix sur nos îles.
Ice Nations#000.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#002.src: It's useless to come back to me if you do not have the treasure.
Ice Nations#002.dst: Inutile de revenir me voir sans le trésor.

Ice Nations#003.src: ...You see, the reason why we became shipwrecked wasn't natural cause. We were attacked...
Ice Nations#003.dst: ...Voyez-vous, notre naufrage n'avait rien de naturel. On nous a attaqués...
Ice Nations#003.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#005.src: Talk to Adigard on the {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Ice Nations#006.src: Welcome traveler, to our humble island...
Ice Nations#006.dst: Bienvenue sur notre humble île, voyageur...
Ice Nations#006.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#007.src: My people and I landed here many years ago. Unfortunately, our ship didn't make it...
Ice Nations#007.dst: Mon peuple et moi avons accosté ici il y a longtemps. Hélas, notre navire n'a pas survécu...
Ice Nations#007.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#008.src: We tried to build a nation on these islands but became divided through the years.
Ice Nations#008.dst: Nous avons voulu bâtir une nation sur ces îles, mais nous nous sommes divisés au fil des ans.
Ice Nations#008.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#009.src: Because of this, we are fighting a useless war with our neighbours.
Ice Nations#009.dst: Résultat, nous menons une guerre inutile contre nos voisins.
Ice Nations#009.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#010.src: I believe we should try to pass a peace treaty, but I am afraid of getting killed if I leave the island...
Ice Nations#010.dst: Il faudrait signer un traité de paix, mais j'ai peur d'être tué si je quitte l'île...
Ice Nations#010.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#011.src: Would you mind helping us? Talk to Hallfred about this treaty. He lives on another ice island nearby.
Ice Nations#011.dst: Pourriez-vous nous aider? Parlez de ce traité à Hallfred. Il vit sur une île de glace voisine.
Ice Nations#011.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#012.src: Talk to Hallfred about the peace treaty
Ice Nations#012.dst: Parlez du traité de paix à Hallfred

Ice Nations#013.src: Welcome traveler! What brings you to our island?
Ice Nations#013.dst: Bienvenue, voyageur! Qu'est-ce qui vous amène ici?
Ice Nations#013.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#014.src: Oh, I see that Adigard now sends strangers through his cowardice! Worried he'll get killed?
Ice Nations#014.dst: Oh, je vois qu'Adigard envoie des inconnus par lâcheté! Il a peur de se faire tuer?
Ice Nations#014.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#015.src: This is the last time I'll repeat it: We will sign the peace treaty the day Adigard and his nation will return to us... the treasure.
Ice Nations#015.dst: Je le répète une dernière fois: nous signerons la paix le jour où Adigard et sa nation nous rendront... le trésor.
Ice Nations#015.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#016.src: The one that they kept and hid from us after the shipwreck.
Ice Nations#016.dst: Celui qu'ils ont gardé et nous ont caché après le naufrage.
Ice Nations#016.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#017.src: Pure gold, very valuable and rare! Tell him I'll be waiting for it. And none of that silly story again.
Ice Nations#017.dst: De l'or pur, rare et précieux! Dites-lui que je l'attends. Et plus de cette histoire ridicule.
Ice Nations#017.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#018.src: Talk back to Adigard about Hallfred's response
Ice Nations#018.dst: Rapportez la réponse de Hallfred à Adigard

Ice Nations#019.src: I should have expected that. Hallfred was always very greedy...
Ice Nations#019.dst: J'aurais dû m'en douter. Hallfred a toujours été très avide...
Ice Nations#019.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#020.src: We tried to make him understand that we do not have the treasure, without much success.
Ice Nations#020.dst: Nous avons tenté de lui faire comprendre que nous n'avons pas le trésor, sans grand succès.
Ice Nations#020.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#021.src: By whom? The undead. Ghosts and demons navigating a monstrous ship. They got us by surprise.
Ice Nations#021.dst: Par qui? Les morts-vivants. Fantômes et démons sur un navire monstrueux. Ils nous ont surpris.
Ice Nations#021.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#022.src: I believe they also stole our treasure during the attack.
Ice Nations#022.dst: Je crois qu'ils ont aussi volé notre trésor pendant l'attaque.
Ice Nations#022.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#023.src: Would you help our nation come back together? Find this ship, and bring the treasure back to Hallfred so we can finally live in peace.
Ice Nations#023.dst: Aideriez-vous notre nation à se réunir? Trouvez ce navire et rapportez le trésor à Hallfred pour qu'enfin vienne la paix.
Ice Nations#023.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#024.src: Sail north. That is where they attacked us many years ago. It should be easy to find, I'm sure they are anchored there in glory... Thank you.
Ice Nations#024.dst: Naviguez vers le nord. C'est là qu'ils nous ont attaqués jadis. Facile à trouver, ils doivent y être ancrés en vainqueurs... Merci.
Ice Nations#024.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#025.src: Find the ghost ship and bring back [Ancient Treasure] to Hallfred
Ice Nations#025.dst: Trouvez le navire fantôme et rapportez l'[Ancient Treasure] à Hallfred

Ice Nations#026.src: Incredible! He actually delivered the treasure!
Ice Nations#026.dst: Incroyable! Il a vraiment rendu le trésor!
Ice Nations#026.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#027.src: I suppose that means the end of the war between our nations!
Ice Nations#027.dst: J'imagine que c'est la fin de la guerre entre nos nations!
Ice Nations#027.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#028.src: This is a great day! Here, take this as a reward for helping our nation.
Ice Nations#028.dst: Quel grand jour! Tenez, voici une récompense pour avoir aidé notre nation.
Ice Nations#028.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#029.src: I'm sure you'll find a use for this helmet one day!
Ice Nations#029.dst: Ce casque vous servira sûrement un jour!
Ice Nations#029.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#030.src: Find the ghost ship by heading north of the {p} and bring back [Ancient Treasure] to Hallfred at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Ice Nations#030.dst: Trouvez le navire fantôme au nord de {p} et rapportez l'[Ancient Treasure] à Hallfred en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Infested Pit#001.src: Oh, it seems I have some guests. You're just in time for dinner... hehe..
Infested Pit#001.dst: Oh, on dirait que j'ai des invités. Vous arrivez juste à temps pour le dîner... héhé..

Infested Pit#002.src: My poor babies are starving. But what shall they feast on? How about... you?
Infested Pit#002.dst: Mes pauvres petits meurent de faim. Mais de quoi vont-ils se régaler? Pourquoi pas... de vous?

Infested Pit#003.src: Alright, we're in. Keep your guards up, you two. Don't want to get picked off by the spiders!
Infested Pit#003.dst: Bon, on est dedans. Restez sur vos gardes, tous les deux. Pas question de se faire cueillir par les araignées!
Infested Pit#003.speaker: Aledar

Infested Pit#004.src: Ha. No, we wouldn't want that... we'll proceed with caution.
Infested Pit#004.dst: Ha. Non, on ne voudrait pas ça... on avancera prudemment.
Infested Pit#004.speaker: Tasim

Infested Pit#005.src: There's more spiders here than I expected... Nothing we can't handle, of course, but- still.
Infested Pit#005.dst: Il y a plus d'araignées ici que je ne pensais... Rien qu'on ne puisse gérer, bien sûr, mais- quand même.
Infested Pit#005.speaker: Tasim

Infested Pit#006.src: Oh, hey- watch your step! Don't want to fall and get stuck in those webs down there, yeah?
Infested Pit#006.speaker: Aledar

Infested Pit#007.src: So you freed the Mushroom Man... no matter. My babies think you three look just as delicious... You will make a fine replacement, hehehe...
Infested Pit#007.dst: Alors vous avez libéré l'homme-champignon... peu importe. Mes petits vous trouvent tout aussi appétissants, tous les trois... Vous ferez un excellent remplacement, héhéhé...
Infested Pit#007.speaker: Arakadicus

Infested Pit#008.src: I can't imagine it's much further from here. Just a few more jumps to make, a few more spiders to fight through, and we'll be there.
Infested Pit#008.dst: Ça ne doit plus être très loin. Encore quelques sauts, quelques araignées à traverser, et on y sera.
Infested Pit#008.speaker: Tasim

Infested Pit#009.src: Here we are, then. The spider queen must be through here.
Infested Pit#009.dst: Nous y voilà. La reine araignée doit être par là.
Infested Pit#009.speaker: Tasim

Infested Pit#010.src: Alright. Let's rest a moment, then head on in and take her out. If we work together, these spiders won't stand a chance!
Infested Pit#010.dst: Bien. Reposons-nous un instant, puis on entre pour l'éliminer. Si on travaille ensemble, ces araignées n'auront aucune chance!
Infested Pit#010.speaker: Aledar

Infested Pit#011.src: Ah, the main course has arrived. You look so good, I think I'll have a taste of you myself!
Infested Pit#011.dst: Ah, le plat de résistance est arrivé. Tu as l'air si appétissant que je crois que je vais te goûter moi-même!
Infested Pit#011.speaker: Arakadicus

Infested Pit#012.src: Well, we're not going to make it easy for you! We'll take you down!
Infested Pit#012.dst: Eh bien, on ne va pas te faciliter la tâche! On va t'abattre!
Infested Pit#012.speaker: Aledar

Infested Pit#013.src: The people living in the forest are more than just food for you spiders! We won't let you attack them anymore!
Infested Pit#013.speaker: Tasim

Infested Pit#014.src: Oh, it seems I have a guest. You're just in time for dinner... hehe..
Infested Pit#014.dst: Oh, on dirait que j'ai un invité. Tu arrives juste à temps pour le dîner... héhé..

Infested Pit#015.src: You've come so far, haven't you? And my babies are just so hungry... You'll make a fine meal for them... hehehe...
Infested Pit#015.dst: Tu es venu de si loin, n'est-ce pas? Et mes petits ont tellement faim... Tu leur feras un excellent repas... héhéhé...
Infested Pit#015.speaker: Arakadicus

Infested Plants#000.src: I'm going to go on ahead. Just follow the coordinates in your content book to find that cave!
Infested Plants#000.dst: Je pars devant. Suis les coordonnées de ton livre de contenu pour trouver la grotte!

Infested Plants#001.src: ...mm, cutting it a little close, but... oh! You're, uh, still here...! Right. Right- you have to go into that cave, remember?
Infested Plants#001.dst: ...mm, c'est un peu juste, mais... oh! Tu es, euh, encore là...! D'accord. D'accord- tu dois entrer dans cette grotte, tu te souviens?

Infested Plants#004.src: Meet up with Tasim at the entrance to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Infested Plants#004.dst: Retrouvez Tasim à l'entrée de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#005.src: Oh, {u}! There you are. It's good to see you. Are you ready to continue on towards {p}?
Infested Plants#005.dst: Oh, {u}! Te voilà. Content de te voir. Prêt à continuer vers {p}?
Infested Plants#005.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#006.src: H-hey! You two! You're soldiers, right? I can tell from your weird fashion sense. You folk are supposed to help people! So. Help!
Infested Plants#006.dst: H-hé! Vous deux! Vous êtes soldats, non? Ça se voit à vos drôles de tenues. Vous êtes censés aider les gens! Alors. Aidez-moi!

Infested Plants#007.src: Huh? Oh- yes, of course! What's your name? What do you need help with?
Infested Plants#007.dst: Hein? Oh- oui, bien sûr! Comment t'appelles-tu? De quoi as-tu besoin?
Infested Plants#007.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#008.src: I'm Ope! I was recently... uh... bit by a spider! And now I need your help to get a rare medicinal herb to heal me!
Infested Plants#008.dst: Je suis Ope! Je me suis... euh... fait mordre par une araignée! Il me faut une herbe médicinale rare pour guérir!
Infested Plants#008.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#009.src: It only grows in an infested cave filled with creepy crawlies. And I'm clearly in no condition to go get it myself!
Infested Plants#009.dst: Elle ne pousse que dans une grotte infestée de bestioles. Et je ne suis pas en état d'y aller moi-même!
Infested Plants#009.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#010.src: Well, alright! We're here to help, after all, so... We'll get you that herb!
Infested Plants#010.dst: Bon, d'accord! On est là pour aider, après tout... On va te trouver cette herbe!
Infested Plants#010.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#011.src: Follow Ope to the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Infested Plants#011.dst: Suivez Ope jusqu'à la grotte en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#012.src: Hm... There's two of you. Good! One of your can climb up into that cave, and the other can protect me from the crawly spiders down here!
Infested Plants#012.dst: Hm... Vous êtes deux. Parfait! L'un grimpe dans la grotte, l'autre me protège des araignées ici en bas!
Infested Plants#012.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#013.src: Alright! {u}, you can go into the cave, and I can defend Ope here while you do that.
Infested Plants#013.dst: D'accord! {u}, va dans la grotte, et je protège Ope ici en attendant.
Infested Plants#013.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#014.src: Locate the medicine in the spider cave behind Ope at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Infested Plants#014.dst: Trouvez le remède dans la grotte aux araignées derrière Ope en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#015.src: Exit the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with the medicinal herb.
Infested Plants#015.dst: Sortez de la grotte en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] avec l'herbe médicinale.

Infested Plants#016.src: There you are! It feels like we've been waiting for hours.
Infested Plants#016.dst: Te voilà! On a l'impression d'avoir attendu des heures.
Infested Plants#016.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#017.src: It... really hasn't been that long. Maybe ten minutes at most.
Infested Plants#017.dst: Ça... n'a pas été si long. Dix minutes tout au plus.
Infested Plants#017.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#018.src: Well-... Anyway! Do you have the herb? It's very- uh, important! To cure me. Yep.
Infested Plants#018.dst: Bon-... Bref! Vous avez l'herbe? C'est très- euh, important! Pour me guérir. Voilà.
Infested Plants#018.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#021.src: That's... frustrating. He seemed shady from the start, I should have-... Well. What's done is done. Let's go speak to that mayor.
Infested Plants#021.dst: C'est... frustrant. Il avait l'air louche dès le début, j'aurais dû-... Bon. Ce qui est fait est fait. Allons voir ce maire.
Infested Plants#021.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#022.src: Speak to Mayor Alvin in Alekin Village at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Infested Plants#022.dst: Parlez au maire Alvin à Alekin Village en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#023.src: Speak to Mayor Alvin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Infested Plants#023.dst: Parlez au maire Alvin à {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#024.src: Ah, travelers... welcome to our humble forest town. Have you come to stay, or are you simply passing through?
Infested Plants#024.dst: Ah, voyageurs... bienvenue dans notre humble village forestier. Venez-vous rester, ou êtes-vous de passage?
Infested Plants#024.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#025.src: Probably the latter. Though, we ran into a man named Ope, who directed us to speak with you.
Infested Plants#025.dst: Plutôt de passage. Mais nous avons croisé un certain Ope, qui nous a dit de venir vous voir.
Infested Plants#025.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#026.src: Here, I may offer you a small sum of emeralds as an apology. I hope he has not soured your opinion of our small town, here...
Infested Plants#026.dst: Tenez, permettez-moi de vous offrir quelques émeraudes en guise d'excuses. J'espère qu'il ne vous a pas dégoûtés de notre petit village...
Infested Plants#026.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#027.src: Oh... Thank you. That's very kind of you. We'll probably stay for a while, before we continue towards {p}.
Infested Plants#027.dst: Oh... Merci. C'est très aimable. Nous resterons sans doute un peu avant de repartir vers {p}.
Infested Plants#027.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#028.src: Oh, {u}! There you are. It's good to see you. I'd say we should keep heading towards {p}, but...
Infested Plants#028.dst: Oh, {u}! Te voilà. Content de te voir. On devrait continuer vers {p}, mais...

Infested Plants#029.src: It looks like we'll need to pass through the {p} first. I've heard the forest is crawling with spiders... and the undead are a danger, as always... but between you and me, we should be-
Infested Plants#029.dst: On dirait qu'il faut d'abord traverser {p}. Il paraît que la forêt grouille d'araignées... et les morts-vivants sont dangereux, comme toujours... mais entre nous, on devrait-

Infested Plants#030.src: H-hey! You two! You're soldiers, right?
Infested Plants#030.dst: H-hé! Vous deux! Vous êtes soldats, non?

Infested Plants#032.src: Yep, I could tell from your weird fashion sense! You folk are supposed to help people, right? So. Help!
Infested Plants#032.dst: Oui, ça se voit à vos drôles de tenues! Vous êtes censés aider les gens, non? Alors. Aidez-moi!

Infested Plants#033.src: Well, sure- but who are you? Why are you out on your own, isn't it dangerous? Aren't the undead...
Infested Plants#033.dst: Bien sûr- mais qui es-tu? Pourquoi es-tu seul ici, ce n'est pas dangereux? Les morts-vivants...

Infested Plants#034.src: I'm Ope! And the undead... eh, there's not as many of them around here. The spiders aren't picky 'bout who they go for.
Infested Plants#034.dst: Je suis Ope! Et les morts-vivants... bah, y en a pas tant que ça par ici. Les araignées, elles, s'en prennent à tout le monde.

Infested Plants#035.src: Right... okay. That makes sense. What did you need help with?
Infested Plants#035.dst: D'accord... bon. Ça se tient. De quoi avais-tu besoin?

Infested Plants#036.src: I... uh... so, there's this rare medicinal herb that grows in these woods, right? And it's important. But the only place I know to find it is an infested cave, filled with creepy crawly spiders.
Infested Plants#036.dst: Je... euh... bon, il y a une herbe médicinale rare qui pousse dans ces bois, d'accord? Et c'est important. Mais le seul endroit que je connais, c'est une grotte infestée d'araignées répugnantes.

Infested Plants#037.src: And, y'know, I- I'm no soldier! Can't just go in there and get it myself! So, I was hoping you could help me out.
Infested Plants#037.dst: Et, vous savez, je- je suis pas soldat, moi! Je peux pas aller la chercher moi-même! Alors j'espérais que vous m'aideriez.

Infested Plants#038.src: Well... we came to Wynn to help out, after all. So... we can get you that herb!
Infested Plants#038.dst: Bon... on est venus à Wynn pour aider. Alors... on va te trouver cette herbe!

Infested Plants#039.src: Great. Great! I'll bring you to the cave, and you can do the rest from there. Follow me!
Infested Plants#039.dst: Super. Super! Je vous mène à la grotte, vous ferez le reste. Suivez-moi!

Infested Plants#040.src: Well, here we are! That's the cave right over there- just climb up the rocks and jump into it. It's safe! Uh, probably.
Infested Plants#040.dst: Bon, nous y voilà! La grotte est juste là- grimpez sur les rochers et sautez dedans. C'est sans danger! Euh, sans doute.

Infested Plants#041.src: ...eek. There's a lot of spiders even up here... hey, since there's two of you- one of you can go get the herb, and the other can, uh... protect me from the crawly spiders?
Infested Plants#041.dst: ...hiii. Il y a plein d'araignées même ici... dites, vous êtes deux- l'un va chercher l'herbe, et l'autre, euh... me protège des araignées?

Infested Plants#042.src: That works for me. {u}, you go into the cave, and I'll defend Ope up here while you do that.
Infested Plants#042.dst: Ça me va. {u}, va dans la grotte, et je protège Ope ici en attendant.

Infested Plants#043.src: Yep... good! Good, good! Good, uh, luck up there! Try not to get bitten too much by the spiders!
Infested Plants#043.dst: Oui... bien! Bien, bien! Bonne, euh, chance là-haut! Tâche de pas trop te faire mordre!

Infested Plants#044.src: ...ah- there you are!! What took you so long, it feels like we've been waiting for hours!
Infested Plants#044.dst: ...ah- te voilà!! Pourquoi c'était si long, on a l'impression d'avoir attendu des heures!

Infested Plants#045.src: It-... mm. A-anyway! Do you have the herb? It's very important, yep.
Infested Plants#045.dst: C'est-... mm. B-bref! Tu as l'herbe? C'est très important, voilà.

Infested Plants#046.src: Come to think of it... I don't think you ever mentioned what you needed it for.
Infested Plants#046.dst: J'y pense... tu ne nous as jamais dit à quoi elle te servait.

Infested Plants#047.src: Oh, I- eheh, it... I... uh, it's n-none of your business, actually.
Infested Plants#047.dst: Oh, je- héhé, c'est... je... euh, ça v-vous regarde pas, en fait.

Infested Plants#048.src: I- I thank you kindly for your work, soldiers! Now, about your payment... let's see, what do I have...
Infested Plants#048.dst: J- je vous remercie bien pour votre travail, soldats! Bon, pour votre paie... voyons ce que j'ai...

Infested Plants#049.src: Oh. I seem to be out of emeralds. Well- then, I- I can offer some advice! There's lots to find in this forest. Plenty of other caves with valuables to explore! Might be worth your time!
Infested Plants#049.dst: Oh. On dirait que je n'ai plus d'émeraudes. Eh bien- alors, je- je peux vous donner un conseil! Cette forêt regorge de choses. Plein d'autres grottes à trésors à explorer! Ça vaut peut-être le coup!

Infested Plants#050.src: Wait, what? Hey, are you seriously not going to-
Infested Plants#050.dst: Attends, quoi? Hé, tu ne vas sérieusement pas-

Infested Plants#051.src: It has been a time soldiers, but I- I truly must be going! Important things to get to! We're near {p}, you should stop on by! Just keep going east down the main road!
Infested Plants#051.dst: C'était un plaisir, soldats, mais je- je dois vraiment filer! Des choses importantes m'attendent! On est près de {p}, passez donc! Suivez la route principale vers l'est!

Infested Plants#052.src: You can, uh, go speak to the mayor! He can cover my expenses!
Infested Plants#052.dst: Vous pouvez, euh, aller voir le maire! Il couvrira mes frais!

Infested Plants#054.src: That's... frustrating. I really did just want to know... well. What's done is done. Let's just go talk to that mayor he mentioned.
Infested Plants#054.dst: C'est... frustrant. Je voulais juste savoir... bon. Ce qui est fait est fait. Allons voir ce maire dont il parlait.

Infested Plants#055.src: I'm going to go on ahead. I'll meet you in {p}, it's just down the main road to the east.
Infested Plants#055.dst: Je pars devant. On se retrouve à {p}, c'est tout droit sur la route principale vers l'est.

Infested Plants#056.src: Ah, recruits... welcome to our humble forest town. Have you come to stay, or are you simply passing through?
Infested Plants#056.dst: Ah, des recrues... bienvenue dans notre humble village forestier. Venez-vous rester, ou êtes-vous de passage?

Infested Plants#057.src: Just passing through, our destination is {p}. Though... we ran into a man named Ope, who directed us to speak with you.
Infested Plants#057.dst: De passage, nous allons à {p}. Mais... nous avons croisé un certain Ope, qui nous a dit de venir vous voir.

Infested Plants#058.src: Oh, Ope... I take it your meeting with him went poorly? I must apologize for him, he is... a tough man to deal with sometimes.
Infested Plants#058.dst: Oh, Ope... La rencontre s'est mal passée, je suppose? Je vous présente mes excuses, il est... difficile à vivre parfois.

Infested Plants#059.src: Oh... thank you. That's very kind of you. We'll probably stay a while, before we continue towards {p}.
Infested Plants#059.dst: Oh... merci. C'est très aimable. Nous resterons sans doute un peu avant de repartir vers {p}.

Infested Plants#060.src: Then feel free to make yourselves at home! We welcome all travelers here, no matter how long their stay.
Infested Plants#060.dst: Alors faites comme chez vous! Tous les voyageurs sont les bienvenus ici, quelle que soit la durée de leur séjour.

Infested Plants#061.src: I'm going to go rest up a little. I'll be ready for more adventures soon though, don't worry!
Infested Plants#061.dst: Je vais me reposer un peu. Mais je serai vite prêt pour d'autres aventures, t'en fais pas!
Infested Plants#061.speaker: Tasim

Jungle Fever#000.src: The only cure to this fever is to drink Liquid Emeralds! Yes, exactly! *cough*
Jungle Fever#000.dst: Seul remède contre cette fièvre: boire des émeraudes liquides! Oui, exactement! *tousse*
Jungle Fever#000.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#001.src: Break into *cough* the emerald storage, but don't take anything... come back to me immediately after, if you make it out alive, heheh...
Jungle Fever#001.dst: Introduis-toi *tousse* dans la réserve d'émeraudes, mais ne prends rien... reviens me voir aussitôt, si tu t'en sors vivant, héhé...
Jungle Fever#001.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#002.src: We'll have to change our strategy, we don't ask for permission. It's to help me after all.
Jungle Fever#002.dst: Changeons de stratégie: on ne demande pas la permission. C'est pour m'aider, après tout.
Jungle Fever#002.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#003.src: I needed to make sure you could easily break into a bank. So i came here by myself to see if you could do it.
Jungle Fever#003.dst: Je devais m'assurer que tu pouvais entrer facilement dans une banque. Alors je suis venu seul ici voir si tu y arrivais.

Jungle Fever#004.src: You've proven your ability of stealth and strength by breaking into this storage, we can start the real thing now.
Jungle Fever#004.dst: En entrant dans cette réserve, tu as prouvé ta discrétion et ta force, on peut passer aux choses sérieuses.

Jungle Fever#005.src: It is guarded with tons of well trained Guard Golems, who can kill anyone in one hit.
Jungle Fever#005.dst: Elle est gardée par des tas de golems gardiens entraînés, qui tuent n'importe qui d'un coup.

similar.text: It is guarded with tons of well trained Guard Golem, who can easily kill any adventurer.

Jungle Fever#006.src: ..I mean *cough*.. I was too sick so i came back here.. *cough*
Jungle Fever#006.dst: ..enfin *tousse*.. J'étais trop malade, alors je suis revenu.. *tousse*

Jungle Fever#007.src: I feel so much better now, thank you for the cure!
Jungle Fever#007.dst: Je me sens beaucoup mieux, merci pour le remède!

Jungle Fever#008.src: Talk to Worid in the jungle village at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Jungle Fever#008.dst: Parlez à Worid dans le village de la jungle en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Jungle Fever#009.src: Oh, I am so happy to see you! *cough*, I caught a very bad fever, and I really need help! *cough*
Jungle Fever#009.dst: Oh, que je suis content de te voir! *tousse*, j'ai une fièvre terrible, il me faut de l'aide! *tousse*
Jungle Fever#009.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#011.src: Do you think you could ask the Banker at {p} if he could give me, oh I don't know, [{~} Liquified Emeralds]?
Jungle Fever#011.dst: Tu pourrais demander au Banquier de {p} de me donner, oh je ne sais pas, [{~} émeraudes liquides]?
Jungle Fever#011.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#012.src: If he has the audacity to *cough* say no... you will have to use brute force...
Jungle Fever#012.dst: S'il a l'audace de *tousse* refuser... tu devras employer la force...
Jungle Fever#012.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#015.src: Talk to {p}'s Banker about the cure for Worid at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Jungle Fever#015.dst: Parlez au Banquier de {p} du remède pour Worid en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Jungle Fever#016.src: [{~} Liquified Emeralds]? He is crazy! Liquified Emeralds cannot cure anyone from anything, except being poor!
Jungle Fever#016.dst: [{~} émeraudes liquides]? Il est fou! Les émeraudes liquides ne guérissent de rien, sauf de la pauvreté!
Jungle Fever#016.speaker: The Banker

Jungle Fever#017.src: I will not participate in this pathetic fraud attempt!
Jungle Fever#017.dst: Je refuse de participer à cette pitoyable escroquerie!
Jungle Fever#017.speaker: The Banker

Jungle Fever#018.dst: Entrez dans la réserve d'émeraudes de {p} en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Jungle Fever#019.src: Oh no! How will I ever cure my sickness without any Liquified Emeralds?... *cough*
Jungle Fever#019.dst: Oh non! Comment guérir de ma maladie sans émeraudes liquides?... *tousse*
Jungle Fever#019.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#021.src: First, I need to make sure you can easily break into a bank. Try to enter {p}' Secret Stash.
Jungle Fever#021.dst: D'abord, vérifions que tu sais entrer dans une banque. Essaie la réserve secrète de {p}.
Jungle Fever#021.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#022.src: When you're done, talk to me again. Be careful too, they might have some Guards.
Jungle Fever#022.dst: Quand tu auras fini, reviens me voir. Et prudence, il y a peut-être des gardes.
Jungle Fever#022.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#024.src: What? You're here already. I thought you would take too long so I just went myself.
Jungle Fever#024.dst: Quoi? Déjà là? Je pensais que tu mettrais trop de temps, alors j'y suis allé moi-même.
Jungle Fever#024.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#025.src: My sickness? RIGHT. *cough* You should feel bad for forcing a sick man to do your job.
Jungle Fever#025.dst: Ma maladie? AH OUI. *tousse* Tu devrais avoir honte de forcer un malade à faire ton travail.
Jungle Fever#025.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#026.src: Anyway I see you proved yourself, we can start the real thing now.
Jungle Fever#026.dst: Bref, tu as fait tes preuves, on peut passer aux choses sérieuses.
Jungle Fever#026.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#027.src: You see, {p} has a very well guarded emerald vault named "The Emerald Labyrinth".
Jungle Fever#027.dst: Vois-tu, {p} a une chambre forte très gardée appelée "Le Labyrinthe d'émeraude".
Jungle Fever#027.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#028.src: It is guarded with tons of well trained Guard Golem, who can easily kill any adventurer.
Jungle Fever#028.dst: Elle est gardée par une foule de golems gardiens bien entraînés, qui tuent sans mal tout aventurier.
Jungle Fever#028.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#029.src: The Banker in the secret vault must be completely bored out of his mind, and won't mind if you find him.
Jungle Fever#029.dst: Le Banquier de la chambre secrète doit s'ennuyer à mourir, il ne t'en voudra pas de le trouver.
Jungle Fever#029.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#030.src: Good luck with that. Haha.. I mean, *cough*.
Jungle Fever#030.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#031.src: Infiltrate {p}'s Secret Emerald Labyrinth at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] underground and find the Banker in the Emerald Room
Jungle Fever#031.dst: Infiltrez le Labyrinthe d'émeraude secret de {p}, sous terre en [{~}, {~}, -{~}], et trouvez le Banquier dans la salle des émeraudes

Jungle Fever#032.src: Oh, uh! Somebody! It has been so long since I've seen someone!
Jungle Fever#032.dst: Oh, euh! Quelqu'un! Ça fait si longtemps que je n'ai vu personne!
Jungle Fever#032.speaker: Almuj Banker

Jungle Fever#033.src: Liquified Emeralds? Of course, of course! I've got tons! Here, take them.
Jungle Fever#033.dst: Des émeraudes liquides? Bien sûr, bien sûr! J'en ai des tas! Tiens, prends-les.
Jungle Fever#033.speaker: Almuj Banker

Jungle Fever#036.src: That is a lot of money, thank you very much, I will finally be able to... *cough* to cure myself!
Jungle Fever#036.dst: C'est beaucoup d'argent, merci infiniment, je vais enfin pouvoir... *tousse* me soigner!
Jungle Fever#036.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#037.src: Here, take this part, you deserve it. I have to use most of the... *cough* money so I can heal, so I've instead paid you with a key.
Jungle Fever#037.dst: Tiens, cette part est pour toi. L'essentiel de l'... *tousse* argent ira à ma guérison, alors je te paie avec une clé.
Jungle Fever#037.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#038.src: I stole- *cough* I mean, borrowed it, from our tribe's leader. Apparently it was used to lock up a great evil.
Jungle Fever#038.dst: Je l'ai volée- *tousse* enfin, empruntée au chef de notre tribu. Elle aurait servi à enfermer un grand mal.
Jungle Fever#038.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#039.src: Good ridda- *cough* Er... luck. Yes, good luck, adventurer!
Jungle Fever#039.dst: Bon débarr- *tousse* Euh... courage. Oui, bon courage, aventurier!
Jungle Fever#039.speaker: Worid

King's Recruit#001.src: {#}Cast your Arrow Bomb Spell by clicking  LEFT -  RIGHT -  RIGHT  while holding your Bow
King's Recruit#001.dst: {#}Lancez votre sort Arrow Bomb en cliquant  GAUCHE -  DROIT -  DROIT  avec votre arc en main

similar.text: {#}Cast your Arrow Storm Spell by clicking  RIGHT -  LEFT -  RIGHT  while holding your Bow

King's Recruit#002.src: You three are going to make fine soldiers. Now, go on to {p}, the King is awaiting your arrival.
King's Recruit#002.dst: Vous trois ferez de bons soldats. Maintenant, allez à {p}, le Roi attend votre arrivée.

King's Recruit#003.src: Well, what are we waiting for?

King's Recruit#006.src: Hey, {u}! You alright in there? Looks like we hit something.
King's Recruit#006.dst: Hé, {u}! Ça va là-dedans? On dirait qu'on a heurté un truc.

King's Recruit#007.src: Hey, {u}! Are you alright in there? It looks like we've hit something.
King's Recruit#007.dst: Hé, {u}! Tout va bien là-dedans? On dirait qu'on a heurté quelque chose.

King's Recruit#008.src: Exit the caravan and talk to the Caravan Driver at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#008.dst: Sortez de la caravane et parlez au cocher de la caravane en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#009.src: Exit the caravan and talk to the Caravan Driver at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
King's Recruit#009.dst: Sortez de la caravane et parlez au cocher de la caravane en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

King's Recruit#010.src: Hm... I swear I hit this same darn boulder every time I make this trip. Sorry folks.
King's Recruit#010.dst: Hm... Je jure que je heurte ce fichu rocher à chaque trajet. Désolé, les amis.
King's Recruit#010.speaker: Caravan Driver

King's Recruit#011.src: Ah. Does this mean we have to walk all the way to {p} from here?
King's Recruit#011.dst: Ah. Ça veut dire qu'on doit marcher jusqu'à {p} d'ici?
King's Recruit#011.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#012.src: Unfortunately so. Luckily, it's not that far from here. Just a straight path forward.
King's Recruit#012.dst: Hélas oui. Heureusement, ce n'est pas loin. Tout droit sur le chemin.
King's Recruit#012.speaker: Caravan Driver

King's Recruit#013.src: Well, nothing to do but keep moving! Tasim, {u}, I'll race you to the gate!
King's Recruit#013.dst: Bon, rien d'autre à faire qu'avancer! Tasim, {u}, le premier à la porte!
King's Recruit#013.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#015.src: ... He's already gone. We'll have to catch up to him. {u}, lead the way.
King's Recruit#015.dst: ... Il est déjà parti. Il faut le rattraper. {u}, passe devant.
King's Recruit#015.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#016.src: Walk down the path towards the gate to the Wynn Province at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#016.dst: Suivez le chemin jusqu'à la porte de la province de Wynn en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#017.src: Walk down the path towards the gate to the Wynn Province at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
King's Recruit#017.dst: Suivez le chemin jusqu'à la porte de la province de Wynn en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

King's Recruit#018.src: I don't suppose you know much about Wynn either, do you?
King's Recruit#018.dst: Tu n'en sais pas beaucoup plus sur Wynn, je suppose?
King's Recruit#018.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#019.src: Of course, the King of {p}'s been recruiting Fruma soldiers, but...
King's Recruit#019.dst: Bien sûr, le Roi de {p} recrute des soldats de Fruma, mais...
King's Recruit#019.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#020.src: That war of theirs must be getting pretty bad if they need this much support.
King's Recruit#020.dst: Leur guerre doit bien mal tourner s'ils ont besoin d'autant d'aide.
King's Recruit#020.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#021.src: Oh, there's Aledar! And the gate, by the looks of it.
King's Recruit#021.dst: Oh, voilà Aledar! Et la porte, on dirait.
King's Recruit#021.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#022.src: There you two are! You'll have to be faster than that if you want to stand a chance against the undead.
King's Recruit#022.dst: Vous voilà! Il faudra être plus rapides si vous voulez tenir tête aux morts-vivants.
King's Recruit#022.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#023.src: Yes, yes, we'll be faster next time.
King's Recruit#023.dst: Oui, oui, on ira plus vite la prochaine fois.
King's Recruit#023.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#024.src: Yes, yes, we'll be faster next time. So, is this the gate marking the border between Wynn and Fruma?
King's Recruit#024.dst: Oui, oui, on ira plus vite la prochaine fois. Alors, c'est la porte qui marque la frontière entre Wynn et Fruma?
King's Recruit#024.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#160.src: There's this handy item we were all given on our way here, the Content Book. It displays most things you can do in this world; Quests, Caves, and much, much more.
King's Recruit#160.dst: On nous a tous donné un objet bien pratique en venant: le Livre de contenu. Il montre presque tout ce qu'on peut faire ici: quêtes, grottes et bien plus encore.
King's Recruit#160.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#161.src: It also lets you track any content you want, which will create beacons for you to follow.
King's Recruit#161.dst: Il permet aussi de suivre le contenu de ton choix, avec des balises à suivre.
King's Recruit#161.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#162.src: Here, why don't you try it out? Use your Content Book and click on the highlighted quest.
King's Recruit#162.dst: Tiens, essaie donc! Ouvre ton Livre de contenu et clique sur la quête en surbrillance.
King's Recruit#162.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#163.src: There you go! I'm going to head towards {p}, at the end of the {p}.
King's Recruit#163.dst: Voilà! Je pars vers {p}, au bout de {p}.
King's Recruit#163.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#164.src: You should meet me there once you've gotten a little stronger. Well, see you around, {u}.
King's Recruit#164.dst: Rejoins-moi là-bas quand tu seras un peu plus fort. Allez, à plus, {u}.
King's Recruit#164.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#165.src: There you go! I'm going to head towards {p}, at the end of the {p}. You should meet me there once you've gotten a little stronger.
King's Recruit#165.dst: Voilà! Je pars vers {p}, au bout de {p}. Rejoins-moi là-bas quand tu seras un peu plus fort.
King's Recruit#165.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#167.src: What are you waiting for recruits? Go identify your helmet at the  Item Identifier and then equip it in your helmet slot!
King's Recruit#167.dst: Qu'attendez-vous, recrues? Allez identifier votre casque à l' Identificateur d'objets, puis équipez-le!

King's Recruit#168.src: Unless you'd rather stand around here all day, that's fine by me too.
King's Recruit#168.dst: A moins que vous préfériez rester plantés là toute la journée, ça me va aussi.

King's Recruit#169.src: Well, what are you waiting for?

King's Recruit#170.src: Good luck in there, recruits. You're gonna need it...
King's Recruit#170.dst: Bonne chance là-dedans, les recrues. Vous en aurez besoin...
King's Recruit#170.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#171.src: We did it! Let's continue through the underpass.
King's Recruit#171.dst: On a réussi! Continuons dans le passage souterrain.
King's Recruit#171.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#172.src: Well? Let's go see what this province is really like.
King's Recruit#172.dst: Alors? Allons voir à quoi ressemble vraiment cette province.
King's Recruit#172.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#173.src: It's beautiful... It's pretty exciting to finally be here, don't you think?
King's Recruit#173.dst: C'est magnifique... C'est excitant d'y être enfin, tu ne trouves pas?
King's Recruit#173.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#174.src: There's no use standing around here waiting for adventure to come to us! I'm getting out there and helping some people!
King's Recruit#174.dst: Inutile d'attendre ici que l'aventure vienne à nous! Je file aider les gens!
King's Recruit#174.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#175.src: Oh! I almost forgot to tell you, {u}. There's this handy item we were given, the Content Book. It displays most things you can do in this world and lets you track them, creating beacons for you to follow.
King's Recruit#175.dst: Oh! J'allais oublier, {u}. On nous a donné un objet bien pratique, le Livre de contenu. Il montre presque tout ce qu'on peut faire ici et permet de le suivre, avec des balises.
King's Recruit#175.speaker: Tasim

Kingdom of Sand#000.src: Ah! Good to see you. Of all the sites we've explored so far... this tomb is the most exciting.
Kingdom of Sand#000.dst: Ah! Ravie de vous voir. De tous les sites explorés jusqu'ici... cette tombe est le plus passionnant.

Kingdom of Sand#001.src: ... Until now. I believe I've managed to trace its possession to a nearby group of bandits. They probably have no idea what they're sitting on.
Kingdom of Sand#001.dst: ... Jusqu'à maintenant. Je crois l'avoir retracé jusqu'à une bande de bandits voisine. Ils ne savent sans doute pas ce qu'ils ont.
Kingdom of Sand#001.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#002.src: Oi! Remember, yer need to nab that journal from the big mansion in {p}, if yer want to get in with us.
Kingdom of Sand#002.dst: Hé! Oublie pas, faut que tu piques ce journal dans le grand manoir de {p} si tu veux être des nôtres.

Kingdom of Sand#004.src: Looks like this is the room the journal is kept in...
Kingdom of Sand#004.dst: On dirait que c'est la pièce où il garde le journal...

Kingdom of Sand#005.src: What yer waiting for, get in here!

Kingdom of Sand#006.src: Seems like there's a meeting going on...
Kingdom of Sand#006.dst: On dirait qu'une réunion a lieu...

Kingdom of Sand#007.src: Seems like that broken cart by the river might be worth checking out...
Kingdom of Sand#007.dst: Ce chariot cassé près de la rivière vaut peut-être le coup d'oeil...

Kingdom of Sand#009.src: Seems like that note might give you a clue...
Kingdom of Sand#009.dst: Cette note pourrait vous donner un indice...

Kingdom of Sand#010.src: The sceptre hums with unmeasurable power, filled with a thousand years of Desert history.
Kingdom of Sand#010.dst: Le sceptre vibre d'une puissance incommensurable, chargé de mille ans d'histoire du Désert.

Kingdom of Sand#011.src: You should get this back to Junes as soon as possible.
Kingdom of Sand#011.dst: Rapportez-le à Junes au plus vite.

Kingdom of Sand#013.src: I should get it to {p} right away. Thank you, {u}. You have my eternal gratitude.
Kingdom of Sand#013.dst: Je dois l'apporter à {p} sans tarder. Merci, {u}. Je vous suis éternellement reconnaissante.
Kingdom of Sand#013.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#014.src: Are you thinking of exploring the tomb? I'm sure you could learn so much about the Empire... but you best be careful.
Kingdom of Sand#014.dst: Vous comptez explorer la tombe? Vous apprendriez tant sur l'Empire... mais soyez prudent.
Kingdom of Sand#014.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#015.src: I have little to offer you for your help, but please accept these emeralds, and this lesser treasure I found nearby.
Kingdom of Sand#015.dst: J'ai peu à vous offrir, mais acceptez ces émeraudes et ce modeste trésor trouvé dans les environs.

Kingdom of Sand#017.src: A {p} soldier! I imagine you're here to investigate the tomb up the hill?
Kingdom of Sand#017.dst: Un soldat de {p}! Vous venez sans doute enquêter sur la tombe de la colline?
Kingdom of Sand#017.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#018.src: It's believed to house the remains of Prince Hashr, the son of the old Desert Emperor, but it's far too dangerous for me to explore personally.
Kingdom of Sand#018.dst: Elle abriterait les restes du prince Hashr, fils du vieil Empereur du Désert, mais elle est bien trop dangereuse pour que je l'explore moi-même.
Kingdom of Sand#018.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#019.src: Instead I've been looking into a related legend - the Emperor's Sceptre.
Kingdom of Sand#019.dst: Je me suis donc penchée sur une légende liée: le sceptre de l'Empereur.
Kingdom of Sand#019.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#020.src: It was the source of his power, and potentially one of the most important artifacts in history.
Kingdom of Sand#020.dst: C'était la source de son pouvoir, et peut-être l'un des artefacts les plus importants de l'histoire.
Kingdom of Sand#020.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#021.src: When the Emperor was slain by his son, Hashr, it is said that the sceptre was lost amongst the raging sandstorm that followed.
Kingdom of Sand#021.dst: Quand l'Empereur fut tué par son fils, Hashr, le sceptre se serait perdu dans la tempête de sable qui suivit.
Kingdom of Sand#021.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#022.src: I'm not prepared to confront them myself, but... this artifact belongs in a museum, in the hands of careful and respectful researchers.
Kingdom of Sand#022.dst: Je ne suis pas prête à les affronter moi-même, mais... cet artefact a sa place dans un musée, entre des mains prudentes et respectueuses.
Kingdom of Sand#022.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#023.src: I would be in your debt if you could try to retrieve it, for the sake of history.
Kingdom of Sand#023.dst: Je vous serais redevable si vous tentiez de le récupérer, pour l'histoire.
Kingdom of Sand#023.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#024.src: Attempt to enter the bandit hideout at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Kingdom of Sand#024.dst: Essayez d'entrer dans la planque des bandits en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Kingdom of Sand#025.dst: Quoi, tu veux entrer dans la planque?
Kingdom of Sand#025.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#026.src: Even if yer a crooked soldier, we can't jus let yer in.
Kingdom of Sand#026.dst: Même si t'es un soldat véreux, on te laisse pas entrer comme ça.
Kingdom of Sand#026.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#027.src: That is, unless yer got the password?
Kingdom of Sand#027.dst: A moins que t'aies le mot de passe?
Kingdom of Sand#027.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#028.src: Didn’t think so. Now get lost, wasted enough of my t-
Kingdom of Sand#028.dst: Je m'en doutais. Dégage, tu m'as assez fait perdre mon t-
Kingdom of Sand#028.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#029.src: Now would you look at that... Even soldiers think they can waltz in ere.
Kingdom of Sand#029.dst: Eh ben, regardez-moi ça... Même les soldats croient pouvoir entrer ici.
Kingdom of Sand#029.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#030.src: Having fun thinking of a password? Sorry to spoil your lunch, but there isn’t one!
Kingdom of Sand#030.dst: Tu t'amuses à chercher un mot de passe? Désolé de casser l'ambiance, mais y en a pas!
Kingdom of Sand#030.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#031.src: We could use a few more officials on the roster.
Kingdom of Sand#031.dst: Il nous faudrait quelques fonctionnaires de plus sur la liste.
Kingdom of Sand#031.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#032.src: If yer are on the liberal side of the law, talk to us outside.
Kingdom of Sand#032.dst: Si t'es du genre souple avec la loi, on en parle dehors.
Kingdom of Sand#032.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#034.src: Looks like yer in. Look, there ain't a password cause we're meant to be the best thieves in the land, right?
Kingdom of Sand#034.dst: On dirait que t'es partant. Écoute, y a pas de mot de passe, vu qu'on est censés être les meilleurs voleurs du pays, hein?
Kingdom of Sand#034.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#035.src: So what good are words? Yer gotta give the guard somethin' stolen, aintcha!
Kingdom of Sand#035.dst: Alors à quoi bon des mots? Faut filer au garde un truc volé, pas vrai!
Kingdom of Sand#035.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#036.src: And we just so happen to have the opportunity of a lifetime for you. {p} has gone soft see, a new Mayor is cleaning things up.
Kingdom of Sand#036.dst: Et justement, on a l'occasion de ta vie pour toi. {p} s'est ramolli, vois-tu, un nouveau maire fait le ménage.
Kingdom of Sand#036.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#037.src: Well, we can't have government not under our control. {p} will always be bandit capital.
Kingdom of Sand#037.dst: Bah, on peut pas laisser le pouvoir nous échapper. {p} sera toujours la capitale des bandits.
Kingdom of Sand#037.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#038.src: So how about we give him a taste of his own medicine, and get hold of that journal he keeps? I'm sure that’ll dig up some dirt on him.
Kingdom of Sand#038.dst: Et si on lui rendait la monnaie de sa pièce en piquant son journal? Ça doit déterrer des saletés sur lui.
Kingdom of Sand#038.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#039.src: And by "we", we mean you. You'll have to sneak through the mansion and avoid guards.
Kingdom of Sand#039.dst: Et par "on", on veut dire toi. Faudra te faufiler dans le manoir sans te faire voir des gardes.
Kingdom of Sand#039.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#040.src: He keeps his journal in the highest room. Might need to distract some guards too. It's the biggest mansion in {p}, can't miss it.
Kingdom of Sand#040.dst: Il garde son journal dans la pièce la plus haute. Faudra peut-être distraire des gardes. C'est le plus grand manoir de {p}, tu peux pas le rater.
Kingdom of Sand#040.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#041.src: Sneak into the highest room of the {p} Mansion at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Kingdom of Sand#041.dst: Faufilez-vous dans la pièce la plus haute du {p} Mansion en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Kingdom of Sand#042.src: Arh, there's the thief I saw a-sneakin' round the Mansion! Get them!
Kingdom of Sand#042.dst: Arh, voilà le voleur que j'ai vu rôder autour du manoir! Attrapez-le!
Kingdom of Sand#042.speaker: Mansion Guard

Kingdom of Sand#043.src: Yer know you could get kicked out of the army fer this.
Kingdom of Sand#043.dst: Tu sais qu'on pourrait te virer de l'armée pour ça.
Kingdom of Sand#043.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#044.src: Heh, guess yer the real thing. Hop in, lets get out of ‘ere.
Kingdom of Sand#044.dst: Hé, on dirait que t'es un vrai de vrai. Monte, on file d'ici.
Kingdom of Sand#044.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#045.src: That journal is more valuable than any gem, you'll be able to get in fer sure.
Kingdom of Sand#045.dst: Ce journal vaut plus que n'importe quelle gemme, tu vas entrer à coup sûr.
Kingdom of Sand#045.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#046.src: Bring the journal from the {p} Mansion to the Vault Guard to enter the hideout.
Kingdom of Sand#046.dst: Apportez le journal du {p} Mansion au garde de la chambre forte pour entrer dans la planque.

Kingdom of Sand#049.src: Oh, this is quite the password, "soldier". I think this will do nicely, on you go.
Kingdom of Sand#049.dst: Oh, ça c'est un sacré mot de passe, "soldat". Ça fera l'affaire, entre.
Kingdom of Sand#049.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#050.src: Look for the sceptre within the bandit hideout at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Kingdom of Sand#050.dst: Cherchez le sceptre dans la planque des bandits en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Kingdom of Sand#051.src: Right, then, you lot. Give me your reports.
Kingdom of Sand#051.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#052.src: Gold relieved from Mesa travellers last week counted just over {~} bars.
Kingdom of Sand#052.dst: L'or pris aux voyageurs de Mesa la semaine passée: un peu plus de {~} lingots.
Kingdom of Sand#052.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#054.src: We're working on exposing that blasted {p} Mayor with a stolen journal. {p} should be back under Creden Tibus control within the week.
Kingdom of Sand#054.dst: On fait tomber ce fichu maire de {p} avec un journal volé. {p} repassera sous la coupe de Creden Tibus d'ici la semaine.
Kingdom of Sand#054.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#056.src: Well... someone's been hanging around the old tomb. An archaeologist, looks like. I reckon she's lookin' for the sceptre.
Kingdom of Sand#056.dst: Ben... quelqu'un traîne autour de la vieille tombe. Une archéologue, on dirait. M'est avis qu'elle cherche le sceptre.
Kingdom of Sand#056.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#057.src: Ah... that sceptre's too valuable for us to lose. Maybe we pay 'er a visit, persuade her to... stop lookin'.
Kingdom of Sand#057.dst: Ah... ce sceptre vaut trop cher pour qu'on le perde. On va p'têt lui rendre visite, la convaincre... d'arrêter de chercher.
Kingdom of Sand#057.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#058.src: Right you are, boss. Good thing no one will think to look for it in that broken cart by the river, ey?!
Kingdom of Sand#058.dst: Bien vu, chef. Heureusement que personne pensera à le chercher dans le chariot cassé près de la rivière, hein?!
Kingdom of Sand#058.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#059.src: Shut it, you fool! What did I just say? Anyway, I'll decide what to do with this archaeologist. Dismissed!
Kingdom of Sand#059.dst: La ferme, imbécile! Qu'est-ce que je viens de dire? Bref, je déciderai quoi faire de cette archéologue. Rompez!
Kingdom of Sand#059.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#062.src: We might be bandits, but we’re not stupid. That sceptre is left better off alone.
Kingdom of Sand#062.dst: On est peut-être des bandits, mais pas des idiots. Ce sceptre, mieux vaut ne pas y toucher.
Kingdom of Sand#062.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#064.src: Return to the tomb and give Junes the sceptre at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Kingdom of Sand#064.dst: Retournez à la tombe et donnez le sceptre à Junes en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Kingdom of Sand#065.src: Ah, {u}. I couldn't help myself - I simply had to see the tomb up close.
Kingdom of Sand#065.dst: Ah, {u}. Je n'ai pas pu résister - il fallait que je voie la tombe de près.
Kingdom of Sand#065.speaker: Junes
