Lost Soles#045.dst: Moi, je regarderais dans le trou, puis je chercherais au-dessus des drapeaux bleus!
Lost Soles#045.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#046.src: But if that's the way up to the second floor, what does the diary mean by this?
Lost Soles#046.dst: Mais si c'est le chemin vers le deuxième étage, que veut dire le journal par là?
Lost Soles#046.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#047.src: "Throw something behind the map on the wall to uncover a piece of the code"? Wait, that probably means the code to the basement! Come back to me at once when you've done that, I have more to tell you!
Lost Soles#047.dst: "Lancez quelque chose derrière la carte murale pour découvrir une partie du code"? Attendez, ça doit être le code du sous-sol! Revenez me voir dès que c'est fait, j'ai autre chose à vous dire!
Lost Soles#047.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#048.src: "Throw something behind the map on the wall to uncover a piece of the code"
Lost Soles#048.dst: "Lancez quelque chose derrière la carte murale pour découvrir une partie du code"

Lost Soles#049.src: You found a piece of the code!? Hahah, excellent! I must say, you've made more progress in a few minutes than I have in a few years! You humans really are something!
Lost Soles#049.dst: Vous avez trouvé une partie du code!? Haha, excellent! Vous avez plus avancé en quelques minutes que moi en des années! Quels gens, ces humains!
Lost Soles#049.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#050.src: Now, the diary now says you must make your way to the second floor to find the other {~} digits of the code.
Lost Soles#050.dst: Le journal dit maintenant que vous devez monter au deuxième étage pour trouver les {~} autres chiffres du code.
Lost Soles#050.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#051.src: Remember, to get up to the second floor you need to use the button in the rat hole to open the passage above the blue flags hanging from the ceiling.
Lost Soles#051.dst: Rappelez-vous: pour monter au deuxième étage, utilisez le bouton du trou à rats, qui ouvre le passage au-dessus des drapeaux bleus du plafond.
Lost Soles#051.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#052.src: It doesn't say where they are, just that they're well hidden and that there are additional clues around the house. The other {~} digits should all be up there on the second floor! Maybe Leacen has seen something about them while she's been up there, as well.
Lost Soles#052.dst: Il ne dit pas où ils sont, seulement qu'ils sont bien cachés et qu'il y a d'autres indices dans la maison. Les {~} autres chiffres devraient tous être au deuxième étage! Leacen en a peut-être vu quelque chose pendant qu'elle était là-haut.
Lost Soles#052.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#053.src: Once you've found the whole code, head to the basement. Just follow the path and signs outside the manor once you have it.
Lost Soles#053.dst: Une fois le code complet en main, allez au sous-sol. Suivez simplement le chemin et les panneaux devant le manoir.
Lost Soles#053.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#054.src: Open the secret passage above the flags by reaching into the unwanted hole
Lost Soles#054.dst: Ouvrez le passage secret au-dessus des drapeaux en fouillant le trou dont personne ne voulait

Lost Soles#055.src: Bring back [{~} Boot Container] and [Abysso Galoshes] to Ferndor
Lost Soles#055.dst: Rapportez [{~} Boot Container] et [Abysso Galoshes] à Ferndor

Lost Soles#056.src: Darn, I thought for sure one of these books would open a secret shelf...oh, heya Humie. Did you manage to climb up the stairs too?
Lost Soles#056.dst: Zut, j'étais sûre qu'un de ces livres ouvrirait une étagère secrète... oh, salut p'tit humain. Toi aussi, t'as réussi à monter l'escalier?
Lost Soles#056.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#057.src: Oh wow, a secret passage! Not as impressive as gettin' to climb the way up, but still nice job! I'm guessing that you're looking for the code hints?
Lost Soles#057.dst: Ouah, un passage secret! Moins drôle que de grimper jusqu'en haut, mais bien joué quand même! Je parie que tu cherches les indices du code?
Lost Soles#057.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#058.src: Tell you what, Humie. You help us out, and I'll give you some information you might be interested in hearing. Sound good to you?
Lost Soles#058.dst: Écoute, p'tit humain. Tu nous aides, et je te donne une info qui pourrait t'intéresser. Ça te va?
Lost Soles#058.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#059.src: On the upper floor are some bedrooms, and a spiral staircase that starts at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. Head to the top of the staircase, which will take you to the roof of the manor. The sign can be found at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], at the edge of the roof, and says "{~} is the first".
Lost Soles#059.dst: L'étage du haut abrite des chambres et un escalier en colimaçon qui part de [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. Montez tout en haut de l'escalier, qui mène au toit du manoir. Le panneau se trouve en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], au bord du toit, et dit "{~} is the first".
Lost Soles#059.speaker: First Digit

Lost Soles#060.src: The second digit's sign is the one you find in stage {~}, revealing that the second digit is {~} when you throw any item into the map near Grandon.
Lost Soles#060.dst: Le panneau du deuxième chiffre est celui de l'étape {~}: lancez n'importe quel objet sur la carte près de Grandon et il révèle que le deuxième chiffre est {~}.
Lost Soles#060.speaker: Second Digit

Lost Soles#061.src: On the second floor, at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], there is an iron door with a button next to it. Press the button to open the door and enter the small room; you should find a sign which reads "He told us that the blue flowers are special...". Back in the area outside the iron door, there is one blue flower on a high shelf next to a button at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. The button opens up a ladder leading to a bedroom in the corner of the room, at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. The third sign is on the wall of the room the ladder leads to, at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], and says "{~} is the third".
Lost Soles#061.dst: Au deuxième étage, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], se trouve une porte en fer avec un bouton à côté. Appuyez sur le bouton pour ouvrir la porte et entrez dans la petite pièce; vous devriez trouver un panneau qui dit "He told us that the blue flowers are special...". De retour devant la porte en fer, il y a une fleur bleue sur une haute étagère, à côté d'un bouton en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. Le bouton fait apparaître une échelle menant à une chambre dans le coin de la pièce, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. Le troisième panneau est sur le mur de la pièce où mène l'échelle, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], et dit "{~} is the third".
Lost Soles#061.speaker: Third Digit

Lost Soles#062.src: On the third floor is a staircase that starts at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and leads to a walkway crossing over a hallway. Jumping off the walkway through a gap in the railings on the north side, you can get into a small hole with a sign saying "He always hid something underneath his pillow...". Drop back down to the Master Bedroom at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], and, as the clue suggests, throw an emerald on the pillow. This opens up a small room behind a high shelf, at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], leading to the final sign, which says "{~} is the fourth". Note that if you aren't quick enough to get into the room, you can throw an emerald over to the pillow while standing on top of the shelf.
Lost Soles#062.dst: Au troisième étage, un escalier part de [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] et mène à une passerelle qui enjambe un couloir. En sautant de la passerelle par une brèche dans la rambarde côté nord, vous pouvez entrer dans un petit trou où un panneau dit "He always hid something underneath his pillow...". Redescendez dans la chambre principale en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] et, comme le suggère l'indice, lancez une émeraude sur l'oreiller. Cela ouvre une petite pièce derrière une haute étagère, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], qui mène au dernier panneau, qui dit "{~} is the fourth". Si vous n'êtes pas assez rapide pour entrer dans la pièce, vous pouvez lancer une émeraude sur l'oreiller depuis le haut de l'étagère.
Lost Soles#062.speaker: Fourth Digit

Lost Soles#063.src: You found the container? I wish I would have gone with you...
Lost Soles#063.dst: Vous avez trouvé le conteneur? J'aurais aimé vous accompagner...
Lost Soles#063.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#064.src: At least we can stop the manor's slow decay! Let me just put the boots into the container...
Lost Soles#064.dst: Au moins, on peut arrêter la lente décrépitude du manoir! Laissez-moi mettre les bottes dans le conteneur...
Lost Soles#064.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#065.src: That was easy. I still can not believe that such a small thing can cause so much trouble.
Lost Soles#065.dst: C'était facile. Je n'arrive toujours pas à croire qu'une si petite chose cause tant d'ennuis.
Lost Soles#065.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#066.src: Well, I can not just let you stand there without a reward, right?
Lost Soles#066.dst: Bon, je ne peux pas vous laisser là sans récompense, n'est-ce pas?
Lost Soles#066.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#067.src: Here, how about some emeralds, and these boots? They're heirlooms given to my family by the Sodeta Guild who once owned this mansion. I promise they aren’t evil! Feel free to visit us at any time!
Lost Soles#067.dst: Tenez, des émeraudes et ces bottes! Ce sont des héritages offerts à ma famille par la guilde Sodeta, jadis propriétaire du manoir. Promis, elles ne sont pas maléfiques! Revenez quand vous voulez!
Lost Soles#067.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#068.src: I wonder where those boots have gone... It's been such a long time. Do you know about the [Abysso Galoshes]?
Lost Soles#068.dst: Je me demande où sont passées ces bottes... Ça fait si longtemps. Vous connaissez les [Abysso Galoshes]?
Lost Soles#068.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#069.src: A pirate stole them from us years ago! I could reward you if you could bring me the [Abysso Galoshes] and help us!
Lost Soles#069.dst: Un pirate nous les a volées il y a des années! Rapportez-moi les [Abysso Galoshes] et je vous récompenserai!
Lost Soles#069.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#070.src: Bring back [{~} Boot Container] and [Abysso Galoshes] to Ferndor at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lost Soles#070.dst: Rapportez [{~} Boot Container] et [Abysso Galoshes] à Ferndor en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lost Soles#071.src: It hasn't been accessible for a fairly long while, not since the stairs collapsed. Except for Leacen, but she's a bit crazy...
Lost Soles#071.dst: On n'y accède plus depuis un bon moment, depuis que l'escalier s'est effondré. Sauf Leacen, mais elle est un peu folle...
Lost Soles#071.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#072.src: The other {~} digits should all be up there on the second floor! Maybe Leacen has seen something about them while she's been up there, as well.
Lost Soles#072.dst: Les {~} autres chiffres devraient tous être au deuxième étage! Leacen en a peut-être vu quelque chose pendant qu'elle était là-haut.
Lost Soles#072.speaker: Grandon

Lost Tower#000.src: Hey, adventurer! Would you mind helping me for a second? I have a bit of a problem on my hands.
Lost Tower#000.dst: Hé, aventurier! Ça vous dérangerait de m'aider un instant? J'ai un petit souci sur les bras.
Lost Tower#000.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#001.src: A long time ago, before {p} was destroyed, my family used to own quite an interesting book, that held knowledge of places and beings of great power.
Lost Tower#001.dst: Il y a longtemps, avant la destruction de {p}, ma famille possédait un livre fascinant, qui renfermait le savoir de lieux et d'êtres très puissants.
Lost Tower#001.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#005.src: Unfortunately, a creature stole it from them during the attack that led to the destruction of {p}, and no one has seen it since.
Lost Tower#005.dst: Hélas, une créature le leur a volé pendant l'attaque qui a mené à la destruction de {p}, et personne ne l'a revu depuis.
Lost Tower#005.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#006.src: If you are willing to help, bring me [{~} Book of the Bones], I believe this book is now between the hands of skeletons, in an old tower in {p}.
Lost Tower#006.dst: Si vous voulez m'aider, rapportez-moi [{~} Book of the Bones]; je crois que le livre est aux mains de squelettes, dans une vieille tour de {p}.
Lost Tower#006.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#007.src: See if you can find this tower, one of the skeletons probably has the book somewhere in there.
Lost Tower#007.dst: Essayez de trouver cette tour; un des squelettes doit avoir le livre quelque part là-dedans.
Lost Tower#007.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#008.src: Find the lost tower in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lost Tower#008.dst: Trouvez la tour perdue à {p}, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Lost Tower#009.src: Find the book in the tower, and bring it back to Laen.
Lost Tower#009.dst: Trouvez le livre dans la tour et rapportez-le à Laen.

Lost Tower#010.src: Bring back the book to Laen.

Lost Tower#011.src: Great! This will be very interesting to read, thank you!
Lost Tower#011.dst: Génial! Ce sera passionnant à lire, merci!
Lost Tower#011.speaker: Laen

Maltic's Well#000.src: Please do something! I know {p} isn't of much importance to you humans, being a villager settlement, but...my son!
Maltic's Well#000.dst: Faites quelque chose, pitié! Je sais que {p}, simple village de villageois, compte peu pour vous, humains, mais... mon fils!
Maltic's Well#000.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#001.dst: Nouvelle quête commencée: Le puits de {p}

similar.text: New Quest Started: {p} Trouble

Maltic's Well#002.src: I don't know why they call me a witch. This one's father made fun of my looks, so I'll turn his son into a Grook!
Maltic's Well#002.dst: Pourquoi me traite-t-on de sorcière? Son père s'est moqué de mon physique, alors je vais changer son fils en Grook!
Maltic's Well#002.speaker: Witch

similar.text: I don't know why they call me a witch. Magic is everywhere, you know. This one's father made fun of my looks, so I'll turn his son into a Grook!

Maltic's Well#003.src: ...for if you choose the wrong door, you'll be sent to a beast, a beast most foul! The... the Beast-That-Eats-{p}-Guards-For-Brunch!!
Maltic's Well#003.dst: ...car si tu choisis la mauvaise porte, tu seras livré à une bête, une bête des plus immondes! La... la Bête-Qui-Mange-Des-Gardes-De-{p}-Au-Brunch!!
Maltic's Well#003.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#004.src: Oh...didn't think that'd fool you. You know, I'm really not all that good at magic. I just like wearing this cowl, and have warts.
Maltic's Well#004.dst: Oh... je me doutais que ça ne prendrait pas. Tu sais, je ne suis pas très douée en magie. J'aime juste porter cette capuche, et j'ai des verrues.
Maltic's Well#004.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#005.src: I cannot thank you enough for your help!
Maltic's Well#005.dst: Merci mille fois pour votre aide!
Maltic's Well#005.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#006.src: Talk to Rynend located in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Maltic's Well#007.src: Please help us! We called for a {p} guard days ago, but Humans tend to forget this little village.
Maltic's Well#007.dst: Aidez-nous, pitié! On a appelé un garde de {p} il y a des jours, mais les humains oublient ce petit village.
Maltic's Well#007.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#008.src: Last week, an evil witch found refuge in our old well. Normally this wouldn't be a problem...
Maltic's Well#008.dst: La semaine dernière, une méchante sorcière s'est cachée dans notre vieux puits. Normalement, ça irait...
Maltic's Well#008.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#009.src: But she's lured my child into the well! My only child! He was born in Wynn, that makes him a Wynn citizen!
Maltic's Well#009.dst: Mais elle a attiré mon enfant dans le puits! Mon unique enfant! Il est né à Wynn, ça fait de lui un citoyen de Wynn!
Maltic's Well#009.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#010.src: Investigate the old {p} well at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring [{~} Witch's Empty Bottle] to Rynend
Maltic's Well#010.dst: Fouillez le vieux puits de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] et rapportez [{~} Witch's Empty Bottle] à Rynend

Maltic's Well#011.src: Help me! Someone! The witch is being mean!!
Maltic's Well#011.dst: A l'aide! Quelqu'un! La sorcière est méchante!!
Maltic's Well#011.speaker: Child

Maltic's Well#012.src: I wondered when they'd send the famous {p} guards. You'll never get me!
Maltic's Well#012.dst: Je me demandais quand ils enverraient les fameux gardes de {p}. Tu ne m'auras jamais!
Maltic's Well#012.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#013.src: Treat me like a witch, I'll act like one, darn it! You'll have to pass through my dastardly magical defenses to find me!
Maltic's Well#013.dst: On me traite de sorcière? Alors j'agirai en sorcière, zut! Il te faudra franchir mes perfides défenses magiques pour me trouver!
Maltic's Well#013.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#014.src: Oh...drat. I never could get that spell right. Well, now you'll have to guess the way, um, you fool! Turn back now, for, uh...
Maltic's Well#014.dst: Oh... flûte. Je n'ai jamais réussi ce sort. Bon, il va falloir deviner le chemin, euh, pauvre fou! Fais demi-tour, car, euh...
Maltic's Well#014.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#015.src: Maybe if the people of this village weren't so mean to me, I wouldn't have been forced to live here.
Maltic's Well#015.dst: Si les gens de ce village n'étaient pas si méchants avec moi, je n'aurais pas été forcée de vivre ici.
Maltic's Well#015.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#016.src: I know it's a crime, but his father and the rest of the villagers here hunt me like I'm a rabid dog!
Maltic's Well#016.dst: Je sais que c'est un crime, mais son père et les autres villageois me traquent comme une chienne enragée!
Maltic's Well#016.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#017.src: I wasn't really going to turn this boy into a Grook. I doubt I could even make him grow one feather. I mean, watch...
Maltic's Well#017.dst: Je n'allais pas vraiment changer ce garçon en Grook. Je doute même de pouvoir lui faire pousser une plume. Tiens, regarde...
Maltic's Well#017.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#019.src: ...oh my gosh it worked???? It worked, I did a spell for once in my miserable life!!
Maltic's Well#019.dst: ...oh là là, ça a marché???? Ça a marché, j'ai réussi un sort pour une fois dans ma misérable vie!!
Maltic's Well#019.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#020.src: W-Wait, that's not good at all, you're gonna... No! You won't take me out of here alive!
Maltic's Well#020.dst: A-Attends, c'est pas bon du tout, tu vas... Non! Tu ne me sortiras pas d'ici vivante!
Maltic's Well#020.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#021.src: Thank you for saving me from the witch... She was nice at first and made me cookies, but I want to go home now.
Maltic's Well#021.dst: Merci de m'avoir sauvé de la sorcière... Au début elle était gentille et me faisait des biscuits, mais je veux rentrer maintenant.
Maltic's Well#021.speaker: Child

Maltic's Well#022.src: Oh my son! What happened down there? Erh, not a witch, you say?
Maltic's Well#022.dst: Mon fils! Que s'est-il passé en bas? Euh, pas une sorcière, vous dites?
Maltic's Well#022.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#023.src: Preposterous! She wore a hat and had warts! I guess it's too late now... Thank you so much for your help.
Maltic's Well#023.dst: Absurde! Elle portait un chapeau et avait des verrues! Je suppose qu'il est trop tard... Merci infiniment pour votre aide.
Maltic's Well#023.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#024.src: I have very little to offer you as reward... I hope my appreciation will be more than enough!
Maltic's Well#024.dst: J'ai bien peu à vous offrir en récompense... J'espère que ma gratitude vous suffira amplement!
Maltic's Well#024.speaker: Rynend

Master Piece#000.src: Look in your content book! I wrote the locations of the legendary creatures.
Master Piece#000.dst: Regardez dans votre livre de contenu! J'y ai noté où se trouvent les créatures légendaires.

Master Piece#001.src: This is...just a normal cow. This is supposed to be legendary?
Master Piece#001.dst: C'est... juste une vache normale. C'est censé être légendaire?

Master Piece#002.src: ...Caissop seemed to be looking forward to this painting a lot...
Master Piece#002.dst: ...Caissop semblait vraiment attendre ce tableau avec impatience...

Master Piece#003.src: ...well, if he's blind, maybe you can fudge the details to give him something better.
Master Piece#003.dst: ...bon, s'il est aveugle, vous pourriez arranger les détails pour lui offrir mieux.

Master Piece#006.src: That sounds like a villager to you.
Master Piece#006.dst: Ça vous évoque plutôt un villageois.

Master Piece#007.src: Time to head back to Caissop. Hopefully he'll buy it.
Master Piece#007.dst: Retour chez Caissop. Pourvu qu'il y croie.

Master Piece#008.src: This is just a normal sheep! Are none of these supposed creatures really legendary?
Master Piece#008.dst: C'est juste un mouton normal! Aucune de ces créatures n'est vraiment légendaire?

Master Piece#009.src: You'll need to lie about something to make a mundane sheep seem special...
Master Piece#009.dst: Il va falloir mentir un peu pour qu'un banal mouton paraisse spécial...

Master Piece#010.src: It has large horns- no, say it's just one.
Master Piece#010.dst: Il a de grandes cornes- non, disons une seule.

Master Piece#011.src: Clean white wool, instead of black...
Master Piece#011.dst: Laine blanche et propre, pas noire...

Master Piece#012.src: A pure white sheep with one horn...?
Master Piece#012.dst: Un mouton tout blanc avec une seule corne...?

Master Piece#013.src: Time to head back to Caissop. Hopefully that's good enough for him.
Master Piece#013.dst: Retour chez Caissop. Pourvu que ça lui suffise.

Master Piece#014.src: Snowy white, a large horn... A Unicorn Sheep, you say?!
Master Piece#014.dst: Blanc comme neige, une grande corne... Un Mouton licorne?!
Master Piece#014.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#015.src: ...OH, NO, NO. YES! MORE COLOUR, MORE PAINT! I'M OUT OF RED!
Master Piece#015.dst: ...OH, NON, NON. OUI! PLUS DE COULEUR, PLUS DE PEINTURE! PLUS DE ROUGE!

Master Piece#016.src: The creatures guarding these animals seem more legendary to you.
Master Piece#016.dst: Les créatures qui gardent ces animaux vous semblent plus légendaires.

Master Piece#017.src: No way you can describe a pig fantastically. You'll have to outright make something up...
Master Piece#017.dst: Impossible de décrire un cochon de façon fantastique. Il faudra tout inventer...

Master Piece#018.src: Pink is fine, it's a rare color...
Master Piece#018.dst: Le rose, ça va, c'est une couleur rare...

Master Piece#019.src: ...what if you say it has wings?
Master Piece#019.dst: ...et si vous disiez qu'il a des ailes?

Master Piece#020.src: Will he believe a flying pig?

Master Piece#021.src: Time to head back to Caissop. Hopefully he won't be able to tell something's amiss.
Master Piece#021.dst: Retour chez Caissop. Pourvu qu'il ne remarque rien de louche.

Master Piece#022.src: Talk to Caissop the artist, in his tent at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Master Piece#022.dst: Parlez à Caissop l'artiste, dans sa tente en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Master Piece#024.src: Oh sorry, I didn't notice you. Did you want an autograph?
Master Piece#024.dst: Oh, pardon, je ne vous avais pas vu. Vous vouliez un autographe?
Master Piece#024.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#025.src: Wait, no? Don't you know who I am?! It seems like you have no taste in art... I am Caissop, the legendary artist!
Master Piece#025.dst: Comment ça, non? Vous ne savez pas qui je suis?! Vous n'avez aucun goût en art... Je suis Caissop, l'artiste légendaire!
Master Piece#025.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#026.src: Though, since you are not a fan... Perhaps you can help me? I am looking for a new assistant.
Master Piece#026.dst: Cela dit, puisque vous n'êtes pas un fan... Pourriez-vous m'aider? Je cherche un nouvel assistant.
Master Piece#026.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#027.src: Excellent... I need your help to find three legendary creatures that are hiding in caves around the swamp.
Master Piece#027.dst: Excellent... J'ai besoin de vous pour trouver trois créatures légendaires cachées dans des grottes du marais.
Master Piece#027.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#028.src: I actually know their location, but unfortunately, I am...blind.
Master Piece#028.dst: Je sais où elles sont, mais hélas, je suis... aveugle.
Master Piece#028.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#029.src: For me to do my work I need to imagine them! That's where you come in. I need you to find them and describe them to me!
Master Piece#029.dst: Pour travailler, je dois les imaginer! C'est là que vous intervenez. Trouvez-les et décrivez-les-moi!
Master Piece#029.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#030.src: Would you turn your back on a blind man?! I need you to give me an accurate description of them! Once you have found one, come back and describe it to me exactly!
Master Piece#030.dst: Vous tourneriez le dos à un aveugle?! Il me faut une description exacte! Dès que vous en trouvez une, revenez me la décrire à la lettre!
Master Piece#030.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#031.src: The first cave is up a hill with tall, thin-leafed flowers. They smell pink to me, and of this I am certain.
Master Piece#031.dst: La première grotte est sur une colline aux hautes fleurs à feuilles fines. Elles sentent le rose, j'en suis certain.
Master Piece#031.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#032.src: Search for the first mythical creature in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Master Piece#032.dst: Cherchez la première créature mythique dans la grotte en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Master Piece#033.src: Report back with the description of the brown, large-snouted creature to Caissop
Master Piece#033.dst: Retournez décrire à Caissop la créature brune au gros museau

Master Piece#034.src: Quick! Describe it to me! Go on!
Master Piece#034.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#035.src: Brown...big-nosed... A Villager Cow, you say!?
Master Piece#035.dst: Brune... gros nez... Une Vache villageoise, dites-vous!?
Master Piece#035.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#037.src: ...MH, NO, A LITTLE MORE RED!..... YES!
Master Piece#037.dst: ...MH, NON, UN PEU PLUS DE ROUGE!..... OUI!
Master Piece#037.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#038.src: Haha! This is WONDERFUL! I'm not going to show it to you before it is finished!
Master Piece#038.dst: Haha! C'est MERVEILLEUX! Je ne vous le montrerai pas avant qu'il soit fini!
Master Piece#038.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#039.src: Savor the ideas! So now, I need you to go to the second cave...
Master Piece#039.dst: Savourez les idées! Maintenant, allez à la deuxième grotte...
Master Piece#039.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#040.src: It is down a road, with short, round-cupped flowers. Those ones smell orange to me!
Master Piece#040.dst: Elle est au bord d'une route, avec des fleurs basses en coupe. Celles-là sentent l'orange!
Master Piece#040.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#041.src: Hurry! I'll finish this animal while you are gone. OH, YES. MUY MACHO.
Master Piece#041.dst: Vite! Je finis cet animal pendant votre absence. OH, OUI. MUY MACHO.
Master Piece#041.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#042.src: Search for the second mythical beast in the cave at [-{~},-{~}]
Master Piece#042.dst: Cherchez la deuxième bête mythique dans la grotte en [-{~},-{~}]

Master Piece#043.src: Report back with the description of the white, big-horned creature to Caissop
Master Piece#043.dst: Retournez décrire à Caissop la créature blanche à la grande corne

Master Piece#044.src: You're here! Quick! Don't look at me, describe it!
Master Piece#044.dst: Vous voilà! Vite! Ne me regardez pas, décrivez-la!
Master Piece#044.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#046.src: ...OH YES, THE WOOL IS REAL... MORE SWIPING... OH YES, BIEN!
Master Piece#046.dst: ...OH OUI, LA LAINE EST RÉELLE... ENCORE DES TRAITS... OH OUI, BIEN!
Master Piece#046.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#047.src: ... THIS IS UNIQUE, REMARKABLE, YES. SUPERNATURAL!
Master Piece#047.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#048.src: The last creature! Red-smelling flowers, prickly thorns, hurry, mucho inspired!
Master Piece#048.dst: La dernière créature! Fleurs qui sentent le rouge, épines, vite, mucho inspiré!
Master Piece#048.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#050.src: I'LL JUST USE MY BLOOD! OH! YES! ...INSPIRED! REMARKABLE! Huh? Why are you still here? Go! I need that last description!
Master Piece#050.dst: J'UTILISERAI MON SANG! OH! OUI! ...INSPIRÉ! REMARQUABLE! Hein? Encore là? Allez! Il me faut cette dernière description!
Master Piece#050.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#051.src: Search for the third and last mythical animal in the cave at [-{~},-{~}]
Master Piece#051.dst: Cherchez le troisième et dernier animal mythique dans la grotte en [-{~},-{~}]

Master Piece#052.src: Report back with the description of the pink, flying creature to Caissop
Master Piece#052.dst: Retournez décrire à Caissop la créature rose volante

Master Piece#053.src: You're finally back! I just finished the last one. Go! Describe it!
Master Piece#053.dst: Enfin de retour! Je viens de finir le dernier. Allez! Décrivez-la!
Master Piece#053.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#056.src: ...OH YES, WINGS! EYES FROM HEAVEN! OH, YES.
Master Piece#056.dst: ...OH OUI, DES AILES! DES YEUX CÉLESTES! OH, OUI.
Master Piece#056.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#057.src: Och, Perfect. The final touch and, done! You were so inspiring that I made two! One for you, and one for me!
Master Piece#057.dst: Och, parfait. La touche finale et, terminé! Vous m'avez tant inspiré que j'en ai fait deux! Un pour vous, un pour moi!
Master Piece#057.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#058.src: You might want to hold onto that, big-town upper class Villagers pay through the roof for Caissop's work!
Master Piece#058.dst: Gardez-le bien: les riches villageois des grandes villes paient une fortune pour une oeuvre de Caissop!
Master Piece#058.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#059.src: Thank you for your assistance, what a rush! Good luck on your Gavel adventure!
Master Piece#059.dst: Merci de votre aide, quelle montée d'adrénaline! Bonne chance dans votre aventure à Gavel!
Master Piece#059.speaker: Caissop

Meaningful Holiday#000.src: So, how is it going? Did you find Nick in the slum?
Meaningful Holiday#000.dst: Alors? Vous avez trouvé Nick dans les bas quartiers?

Meaningful Holiday#001.src: You should follow Nick and hop in the portal right there!
Meaningful Holiday#001.dst: Suivez Nick et sautez dans le portail juste là!

Meaningful Holiday#002.src: I can't wait for the feast to be served. It's always magnificent.
Meaningful Holiday#002.dst: J'ai hâte qu'on serve le festin. Il est toujours magnifique.

Meaningful Holiday#003.src: You want me to donate food? I'm just a guest here.
Meaningful Holiday#003.dst: Donner de la nourriture? Je ne suis qu'un invité ici.

Meaningful Holiday#004.src: You want food for the poor? They should get jobs and help themselves!
Meaningful Holiday#004.dst: De la nourriture pour les pauvres? Qu'ils trouvent du travail et se débrouillent!

Meaningful Holiday#005.src: Why should I help them if they don't help themselves?
Meaningful Holiday#005.dst: Pourquoi les aiderais-je s'ils ne s'aident pas eux-mêmes?

Meaningful Holiday#006.src: I can't give away free food! This is the biggest feast of the year!
Meaningful Holiday#006.dst: Je ne peux pas donner de nourriture! C'est le plus grand festin de l'année!

Meaningful Holiday#007.src: You should go and ask charities for that.
Meaningful Holiday#007.dst: Demandez plutôt aux oeuvres de charité.

Meaningful Holiday#008.src: If you want to help someone else this year, our boss Nick is already out in the thick of it.
Meaningful Holiday#008.dst: Si vous voulez aider quelqu'un cette année, notre patron Nick est déjà sur le terrain.
Meaningful Holiday#008.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#010.src: I'm sorry but everyfin is sold out, everyone is preparing for Craftmas.
Meaningful Holiday#010.dst: Désolé, mais tout est vendu, tout l'monde prépare Craftmas.
Meaningful Holiday#010.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#011.src: I might have something on the attic, if you find anyfin, you can 'ave it. I know how difficult it gets.
Meaningful Holiday#011.dst: J'ai p't-êt' quelque chose au grenier, si tu trouves un truc, c'est pour toi. J'sais c'que c'est, la galère.
Meaningful Holiday#011.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#012.src: Did ye find anyfin in the attic?
Meaningful Holiday#012.dst: T'as trouvé un truc au grenier?

Meaningful Holiday#013.src: Looks like I'm fresh outta food. Barely got enough to feed meself.
Meaningful Holiday#013.dst: On dirait qu'j'ai plus rien à manger. J'en ai à peine pour moi.
Meaningful Holiday#013.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#014.src: Oh, also, can you give this blanket to Margaret while you're down in the tunnel? Just follow the road behind me.
Meaningful Holiday#014.dst: Oh, et pourriez-vous donner cette couverture à Margaret en passant au tunnel? Suivez la route derrière moi.
Meaningful Holiday#014.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#015.dst: Vous avez trouvé de la nourriture?

Meaningful Holiday#016.src: Oh, please don't move me along. I have no where else to go!
Meaningful Holiday#016.dst: Oh, je vous en prie, ne me chassez pas. Je n'ai nulle part où aller!
Meaningful Holiday#016.speaker: Margaret

Meaningful Holiday#017.src: Heya! I just finished decorating this craftmas tree!
Meaningful Holiday#017.dst: Coucou! Je viens de finir de décorer ce sapin de Craftmas!
Meaningful Holiday#017.speaker: Elvura

Meaningful Holiday#019.src: Get out before I call the guards!

Meaningful Holiday#020.src: Stealing is not in the Craftmas spirit... But I think I can make this work.
Meaningful Holiday#020.dst: Voler n'est pas dans l'esprit de Craftmas... Mais je crois que je peux en tirer parti.
Meaningful Holiday#020.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#021.src: My siblings and I take care of people at Craftmas. My area is the {p} desert. I guess you could call me Sanda Claus, heh.
Meaningful Holiday#021.dst: Mes frères et soeurs et moi veillons sur les gens à Craftmas. Mon secteur, c'est le désert de {p}. Appelez-moi le Père Sable, hé.
Meaningful Holiday#021.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#023.src: Hello, dear. My name is Haily. Nice to meet you.
Meaningful Holiday#023.dst: Bonjour, mon chou. Je m'appelle Haily. Enchantée.
Meaningful Holiday#023.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#024.src: This is the {p} Charity center. We're looking for volunteers to help the homeless this year.
Meaningful Holiday#024.dst: Voici le centre caritatif de {p}. Nous cherchons des bénévoles pour aider les sans-abri cette année.
Meaningful Holiday#024.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#025.src: He's a really special man. I'll write his location down for you in your book. Oh, remember this is charity work, so hopefully gratitude is a good enough reward for you.
Meaningful Holiday#025.dst: C'est un homme très spécial. Je note où le trouver dans votre livre. Oh, c'est du bénévolat; j'espère que la gratitude vous suffira comme récompense.
Meaningful Holiday#025.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#026.src: Go talk to Haily's friend Nick at the poor area.
Meaningful Holiday#026.dst: Allez parler à Nick, l'ami de Haily, dans le quartier pauvre.

Meaningful Holiday#027.src: Oh. Oh... Oh dear. There's more people here than ever.
Meaningful Holiday#027.dst: Oh. Oh... Oh là là. Il y a plus de monde que jamais.
Meaningful Holiday#027.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#028.src: Hm, are you just passing through? Oh! A volunteer!
Meaningful Holiday#028.dst: Hm, vous êtes de passage? Oh! Un bénévole!
Meaningful Holiday#028.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#029.src: You're the only one this year. Things have really changed. We used to have hundreds of volunteers this time of year.
Meaningful Holiday#029.dst: Vous êtes le seul cette année. Les choses ont bien changé. Avant, on avait des centaines de bénévoles à cette époque.
Meaningful Holiday#029.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#030.src: The people here are starving. There's no two ways about it.
Meaningful Holiday#030.dst: Les gens ici meurent de faim. Inutile de tourner autour du pot.
Meaningful Holiday#030.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#031.src: I don't know how we're going to feed everyone this year.
Meaningful Holiday#031.dst: Je ne sais pas comment on va nourrir tout le monde cette année.
Meaningful Holiday#031.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#032.src: The man who runs the budget store used to be homeless... He knows the struggles they face.
Meaningful Holiday#032.dst: L'homme qui tient la boutique bon marché était sans-abri... Il sait ce qu'ils endurent.
Meaningful Holiday#032.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#033.src: I'll look after things here. Can you go to the budget store? It's really close. Any food is gratefully received.
Meaningful Holiday#033.dst: Je m'occupe de tout ici. Pouvez-vous aller à la boutique bon marché? C'est tout près. Toute nourriture est bienvenue.
Meaningful Holiday#033.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#034.src: Go to the budget store and ask for food.
Meaningful Holiday#034.dst: Allez à la boutique bon marché et demandez de la nourriture.

Meaningful Holiday#036.src: What can I do fer ye?
Meaningful Holiday#036.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#038.src: Look for food on the second floor.
Meaningful Holiday#038.dst: Cherchez de la nourriture au deuxième étage.

Meaningful Holiday#039.src: Hm... This apple has seen betta days...
Meaningful Holiday#039.dst: Hm... Cette pomme a connu des jours meilleurs...
Meaningful Holiday#039.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#040.src: I wish I had something to give this year. I guess people are having a feast in the city.
Meaningful Holiday#040.dst: J'aimerais bien avoir quelque chose à donner cette année. J'suppose qu'en ville, ils font un festin.
Meaningful Holiday#040.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#041.src: Return to Nick and tell him the bad news.
Meaningful Holiday#041.dst: Retournez voir Nick et annoncez-lui la mauvaise nouvelle.

Meaningful Holiday#043.src: I see. I was counting on him.
Meaningful Holiday#043.dst: Je vois. Je comptais sur lui.
Meaningful Holiday#043.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#044.src: I can't be too upset. He donates so much the rest of the year.
Meaningful Holiday#044.dst: Je ne peux pas trop lui en vouloir. Il donne tellement le reste de l'année.
Meaningful Holiday#044.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#045.src: We may have to ask the farmers directly...
Meaningful Holiday#045.dst: Il faudra peut-être aller voir les fermiers...
Meaningful Holiday#045.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#046.src: I know someone in {p} with a kind heart.
Meaningful Holiday#046.dst: Je connais quelqu'un au grand coeur à {p}.
Meaningful Holiday#046.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#047.src: We've fallen out before, seems he didn't understand what a donation was.
Meaningful Holiday#047.dst: On s'est déjà brouillés; il ne comprenait pas ce qu'était un don.
Meaningful Holiday#047.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#048.src: There is a shortcut south from here, in a cave. Go through there.
Meaningful Holiday#048.dst: Il y a un raccourci au sud d'ici, dans une grotte. Passez par là.
Meaningful Holiday#048.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#049.src: Bring the blanket to the woman in the tunnel south of Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#049.dst: Apportez la couverture à la femme du tunnel, au sud de Nick.

Meaningful Holiday#050.src: Oh, a blanket for me? How sweet... From Nick, you say? He's always so kind... Thank you, as well.
Meaningful Holiday#050.dst: Oh, une couverture pour moi? C'est adorable... De la part de Nick? Il est toujours si gentil... Merci à vous aussi.
Meaningful Holiday#050.speaker: Margaret

Meaningful Holiday#051.src: If you want to get to {p} quickly, just keep going through this tunnel. Some unfriendly homeless folks live around here too, so be careful. It's so sad, their state.
Meaningful Holiday#051.dst: Pour aller vite à {p}, continuez dans ce tunnel. Des sans-abri peu amicaux vivent aussi par ici, alors prudence. Ça fait si mal de les voir ainsi.
Meaningful Holiday#051.speaker: Margaret

Meaningful Holiday#052.src: Continue the tunnel and find Nick's friend.
Meaningful Holiday#052.dst: Continuez dans le tunnel et trouvez l'ami de Nick.

Meaningful Holiday#053.src: Welcome to my farm! Looking to buy some of my fresh crops?
Meaningful Holiday#053.dst: Bienvenue à ma ferme! Vous voulez m'acheter des récoltes fraîches?
Meaningful Holiday#053.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#054.src: Well, it seems you're out of luck. I've just sold the last of them from this harvest.
Meaningful Holiday#054.dst: Eh bien, pas de chance. Je viens de vendre le reste de cette récolte.
Meaningful Holiday#054.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#055.src: It was all for that big Craftmas feast happening in {p}. Wish I could help you out, but I'm fresh out of food to sell you.
Meaningful Holiday#055.dst: Tout est parti pour ce grand festin de Craftmas à {p}. J'aimerais vous aider, mais je n'ai plus rien à vous vendre.
Meaningful Holiday#055.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#056.src: Wait, I bet Nick sent you, didn't he? Well, he's coming up on your left. Remind him that this isn't a charity.
Meaningful Holiday#056.dst: Attendez, je parie que c'est Nick qui vous envoie? Tenez, il arrive sur votre gauche. Rappelez-lui que je ne fais pas la charité.
Meaningful Holiday#056.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#058.src: We can't get any food? We're running out of options here...
Meaningful Holiday#058.dst: Aucune nourriture? On est à court de solutions...
Meaningful Holiday#058.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#059.src: Well, there's only one person left that we can appeal to at this time of year.
Meaningful Holiday#059.dst: Bon, il ne reste qu'une personne à qui s'adresser à cette période de l'année.
Meaningful Holiday#059.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#061.src: Explore the area and look for Santa.
Meaningful Holiday#061.dst: Explorez les environs et cherchez Santa.

Meaningful Holiday#063.src: He is right down the stairs to the right.
Meaningful Holiday#063.dst: Il est en bas de l'escalier, à droite.
Meaningful Holiday#063.speaker: Elvura

Meaningful Holiday#064.src: Enter Santa's home and speak to him.

Meaningful Holiday#066.src: The council all have their areas to care for. Yours is {p}. How you care for it is your responsibility.
Meaningful Holiday#066.dst: Chaque membre du conseil a sa zone. La tienne, c'est {p}. A toi de voir comment t'en occuper.
Meaningful Holiday#066.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#067.src: There's five times more homeless and hungry than last year!
Meaningful Holiday#067.dst: Il y a cinq fois plus de sans-abri et d'affamés que l'an dernier!
Meaningful Holiday#067.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#068.src: Nick, I know times are tough there, but-
Meaningful Holiday#068.dst: Nick, je sais que c'est dur là-bas, mais-
Meaningful Holiday#068.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#069.src: Tough?! It's impossible! What happened to people's good will? I had one volunteer this year! ONE!
Meaningful Holiday#069.dst: Dur?! C'est impossible! Où est passée la bonne volonté des gens? J'ai eu un bénévole cette année! UN SEUL!
Meaningful Holiday#069.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#070.src: I'm sorry Nick. You could go to {p} and ask there, they have a feast big enough to feed an army!
Meaningful Holiday#070.dst: Désolé, Nick. Tu pourrais aller demander à {p}, ils ont un festin à nourrir une armée!
Meaningful Holiday#070.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#071.src: Hmmm... Oh, sorry. I miscalculated your journey here. Good to see you.
Meaningful Holiday#071.dst: Hmmm... Oh, pardon. J'ai mal calculé votre trajet. Content de vous voir.
Meaningful Holiday#071.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#072.src: I suppose you heard Santa and I. Our next location is {p}.
Meaningful Holiday#072.dst: Vous nous avez entendus, Santa et moi. Notre prochaine étape: {p}.
Meaningful Holiday#072.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#073.src: Alright, that's settled then. Leave through the fireplace behind me, it will bring you directly to {p}. Good luck, Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#073.dst: Bien, c'est réglé. Sors par la cheminée derrière moi, elle te mènera droit à {p}. Bonne chance, Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#073.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#074.src: Leave through the portal behind Santa.
Meaningful Holiday#074.dst: Sortez par le portail derrière Santa.

Meaningful Holiday#075.dst: Entrez dans la salle de bal.

Meaningful Holiday#076.src: Wow. The people here live in such grandure. I wonder if they know people are starving to the east.
Meaningful Holiday#076.dst: Ouah. Ces gens vivent dans un tel faste. Savent-ils que des gens meurent de faim à l'est?
Meaningful Holiday#076.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#077.src: Let's ask around for some donations.
Meaningful Holiday#077.dst: Demandons des dons à la ronde.
Meaningful Holiday#077.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#078.src: More importantly, let's hope they'll share a trifle of food.
Meaningful Holiday#078.dst: Surtout, espérons qu'ils partagent un peu de nourriture.
Meaningful Holiday#078.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#079.dst: Demandez de la nourriture aux invités.

Meaningful Holiday#082.src: You aren't even in a formal dress.
Meaningful Holiday#082.dst: Vous n'êtes même pas en tenue.
Meaningful Holiday#082.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#084.src: Food? You want food? Does this look like a charity to you?
Meaningful Holiday#084.dst: Manger? Vous voulez manger? On a l'air d'une oeuvre de charité?
Meaningful Holiday#084.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#085.src: Of course not! We have an obligation to feed our partygoers, not some poor scraps of men in the desert!
Meaningful Holiday#085.dst: Bien sûr que non! On doit nourrir nos invités, pas quelques pauvres loques du désert!
Meaningful Holiday#085.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#086.src: Now get out of here before I call the security golems. And don't even think of stealing from the kitchen!
Meaningful Holiday#086.dst: Maintenant, dehors avant que j'appelle les golems de sécurité. Et n'essayez même pas de voler en cuisine!
Meaningful Holiday#086.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#087.src: Steal the food from the kitchen and talk to Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#087.dst: Volez la nourriture en cuisine et parlez à Nick.

Meaningful Holiday#088.src: Were you able to get any food?
Meaningful Holiday#088.dst: Vous avez pu avoir de la nourriture?
Meaningful Holiday#088.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#089.src: You do?! I didn't expect them to be so generous, a whole crate?
Meaningful Holiday#089.dst: Oui?! Je ne les pensais pas si généreux, une caisse entière?
Meaningful Holiday#089.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#092.src: Go on ahead. I have a plan. Don't worry, I'll return all this food.
Meaningful Holiday#092.dst: Partez devant. J'ai un plan. Pas d'inquiétude, je rendrai tout.
Meaningful Holiday#092.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#095.src: I know you are hungry. Because I am too.
Meaningful Holiday#095.dst: Je sais que vous avez faim. Moi aussi.
Meaningful Holiday#095.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#096.src: But your dinner will not be served tonight.
Meaningful Holiday#096.dst: Mais votre dîner ne sera pas servi ce soir.
Meaningful Holiday#096.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#097.src: There will be no Craftmas feast this year!
Meaningful Holiday#097.dst: Il n'y aura pas de festin de Craftmas cette année!
Meaningful Holiday#097.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#099.src: The food on the table isn't enough to feed everyone here!
Meaningful Holiday#099.dst: La nourriture sur la table ne suffit pas pour tout le monde ici!
Meaningful Holiday#099.speaker: Guest

Meaningful Holiday#100.src: This one night, this one missed meal.
Meaningful Holiday#100.dst: Une seule nuit, un seul repas manqué.
Meaningful Holiday#100.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#101.src: This is how thousands of people live every day.
Meaningful Holiday#101.dst: C'est ainsi que des milliers de gens vivent chaque jour.
Meaningful Holiday#101.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#102.src: Hungry, wondering when the food will be available.
Meaningful Holiday#102.dst: Affamés, se demandant quand il y aura à manger.
Meaningful Holiday#102.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#103.src: And while you sit there with empty stomachs be thankful for what you have. Spare a thought for those who have not.
Meaningful Holiday#103.dst: Et pendant que vous êtes là, le ventre vide, soyez reconnaissants de ce que vous avez. Pensez à ceux qui n'ont rien.
Meaningful Holiday#103.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#104.src: Hundreds of men, women and children, just like you, will not eat tonight, at all.
Meaningful Holiday#104.dst: Des centaines d'hommes, de femmes et d'enfants, comme vous, ne mangeront rien du tout ce soir.
Meaningful Holiday#104.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#105.src: All because this enormous feast was not enough. {p} bought all the food, cheap or expensive.
Meaningful Holiday#105.dst: Tout ça parce que ce festin énorme ne suffisait pas. {p} a acheté toute la nourriture, bon marché ou chère.
Meaningful Holiday#105.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#106.src: I'm here to remind you the real meaning of this day. To think of others..
Meaningful Holiday#106.dst: Je suis là pour vous rappeler le vrai sens de ce jour. Penser aux autres..
Meaningful Holiday#106.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#107.src: I will return your meal tonight, but while you eat it... I want you to remember every empty mouth it could have fed.
Meaningful Holiday#107.dst: Je vous rendrai votre repas ce soir, mais en le mangeant... souvenez-vous de chaque bouche vide qu'il aurait pu nourrir.
Meaningful Holiday#107.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#108.src: Share what you have, be thankful for what you are given.
Meaningful Holiday#108.dst: Partagez ce que vous avez, appréciez ce qu'on vous donne.
Meaningful Holiday#108.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#109.src: Well, looks like you came through yet again Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#109.dst: Eh bien, on dirait que tu as encore réussi, Nick.

Meaningful Holiday#110.src: I came to see if I could help out. But it looks like you've done it.
Meaningful Holiday#110.dst: Je venais voir si je pouvais aider. Mais on dirait que c'est fait.
Meaningful Holiday#110.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#111.src: Well, I guess there is only one thing left to do to complete this scene.
Meaningful Holiday#111.dst: Bon, il ne reste qu'une chose à faire pour parfaire ce tableau.
Meaningful Holiday#111.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#112.src: Hope you all have a merry craftmas. Ho-ho!
Meaningful Holiday#112.dst: Joyeux Craftmas à tous. Ho ho!
Meaningful Holiday#112.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#114.src: It looks like my little speech brought the rich back down to earth.
Meaningful Holiday#114.dst: On dirait que mon petit discours a ramené les riches sur terre.
Meaningful Holiday#114.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#115.src: They gave us half of their feast. Can you believe they still had leftovers?
Meaningful Holiday#115.dst: Ils ont donné la moitié du festin. Et il en restait encore, vous imaginez?
Meaningful Holiday#115.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#116.src: All of that food, going straight to waste.
Meaningful Holiday#116.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#117.src: They have no idea what they have, compared to these poor folks.
Meaningful Holiday#117.dst: Ils ne savent pas ce qu'ils ont, comparés à ces pauvres gens.
Meaningful Holiday#117.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#118.src: You might be wondering why I know Santa. Well, he's my brother.
Meaningful Holiday#118.dst: Vous vous demandez pourquoi je connais Santa? C'est mon frère.
Meaningful Holiday#118.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#119.src: It's people like you that keep the real meaning of this holiday alive. It gets harder every year as the meaning is distorted. Here is a personal gift from me. Thank you.
Meaningful Holiday#119.dst: Ce sont des gens comme vous qui gardent vivant le vrai sens de ces fêtes. C'est plus dur chaque année, car ce sens se déforme. Voici un cadeau personnel de ma part. Merci.
Meaningful Holiday#119.speaker: Nick

Memory Paranoia#000.src: You can't quite make out the messy scribbles in the journal, but it looks very intense.
Memory Paranoia#000.dst: Vous ne déchiffrez pas vraiment les gribouillis du journal, mais ils semblent très fébriles.

Memory Paranoia#001.src: The check is made out to a charity for a rather large amount of emeralds.
Memory Paranoia#001.dst: Un chèque pour une oeuvre de charité, d'un montant élevé en émeraudes.

similar.text: This check is made out to a charity for a lot of emeralds.

Memory Paranoia#003.src: Oh, a human? If I could beg your pardon a moment... could I talk to you about the mansion here?
Memory Paranoia#003.dst: Oh, un humain? Si vous permettez un instant... puis-je vous parler du manoir ici?
Memory Paranoia#003.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#004.src: But... Eventually... Erm, we're not entirely sure what happened, only rumours have surfaced over the years, but... things took a turn, shall we say.
Memory Paranoia#004.dst: Mais... Avec le temps... Euh, on ne sait pas trop ce qui s'est passé, seules des rumeurs ont circulé au fil des ans, mais... les choses ont mal tourné, disons.
Memory Paranoia#004.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#005.src: Because, aah... How shall I put this... One day they were all... discovered dead. Murdered. By each other.
Memory Paranoia#005.dst: Parce que, aah... Comment dire... Un jour, on les a tous... retrouvés morts. Assassinés. Les uns par les autres.
Memory Paranoia#005.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#006.src: Since, erm... Since there was no one alive to report the incident, it wasn't discovered until days later when a traveller passing by took notice of the mansion.
Memory Paranoia#006.dst: Comme, euh... Comme personne n'avait survécu pour signaler l'incident, on ne l'a découvert que des jours plus tard, quand un voyageur a remarqué le manoir.
Memory Paranoia#006.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#007.src: Yet, I am... scared of this place. It is the ruins of the life I should have had. The spirits of the dead are still there... Cursed. I need someone else to uncover my heritage.
Memory Paranoia#007.dst: Et pourtant, j'ai... peur de cet endroit. Ce sont les ruines de la vie que j'aurais dû avoir. Les esprits des morts y sont encore... Maudits. Il me faut quelqu'un d'autre pour découvrir mes origines.
Memory Paranoia#007.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#008.src: It's so kind of the Caritats to donate these supplies to the struggling people in the forest.
Memory Paranoia#008.dst: C'est si gentil de la part des Caritat de donner ces provisions aux gens en difficulté dans la forêt.

similar.text: It's so nice that the Caritats are donating all of these supplies to the struggling people in the forest.

Memory Paranoia#009.src: Mr. Caritat is always writing so intensely in that book... I do wonder what he could be saying.
Memory Paranoia#009.dst: M. Caritat écrit toujours avec tant d'ardeur dans ce livre... Je me demande bien ce qu'il raconte.

Memory Paranoia#010.src: I'll bet he's writing insults about us or something. He can't be as nice as he appears, no one is!
Memory Paranoia#010.dst: Je parie qu'il écrit des insultes sur nous. Personne n'est aussi gentil qu'il en a l'air!
Memory Paranoia#010.speaker: Maid

similar.text: I'll bet he's writing insults about us. He can't be as nice as he appears.

Memory Paranoia#011.src: Come on, Timmy. Mr. Caritat is crazily sweet. I doubt he'd be upset, even if you'd thrown it down there on purpose.
Memory Paranoia#011.dst: Allons, Timmy. M. Caritat est d'une gentillesse folle. Je doute qu'il se fâche, même si tu l'avais jetée là-dedans exprès.

Memory Paranoia#013.src: Mr. Caritat looks very engrossed in his writing... you best not disturb him.
Memory Paranoia#013.dst: M. Caritat semble très absorbé par son écriture... mieux vaut ne pas le déranger.

Memory Paranoia#014.src: I've forgotten, where should I look for my Library Key?
Memory Paranoia#014.dst: J'ai oublié, où dois-je chercher ma Library Key?

Memory Paranoia#015.src: The drainage pipes have probably taken the key to the basement in the southeast corner of the mansion by now, you should check there.
Memory Paranoia#015.dst: Les tuyaux ont sans doute emporté la clé jusqu'au sous-sol, dans l'angle sud-est du manoir; va voir là-bas.

similar.text: Well, the drainage pipes have probably taken the key to the basement in the southeast corner of the mansion by now, that's most likely where it is.

Memory Paranoia#016.src: Page {~}: The Caritats are as nice as people say. They're some of the kindest people I've ever met, let alone work for.
Memory Paranoia#016.dst: Page {~}: Les Caritat sont aussi gentils qu'on le dit. Les gens les plus bons que j'aie connus, et de loin les meilleurs patrons.

Memory Paranoia#017.src: Page {~}: That Timmy boy has been acting rather unusual lately... Uncharacteristically hostile. I wonder what's come over him.
Memory Paranoia#017.dst: Page {~}: Le petit Timmy se comporte bizarrement ces temps-ci... Hostile, ça ne lui ressemble pas. Je me demande ce qui lui prend.

Memory Paranoia#018.src: Page {~}: I've been hearing strange noises at night. Scratching, and sometimes yelling... I do hope nothing bad is going on.
Memory Paranoia#018.dst: Page {~}: J'entends des bruits étranges la nuit. Des grattements, et parfois des cris... J'espère qu'il ne se passe rien de grave.

Memory Paranoia#019.src: Page {~}: I don't even know how this happened, but Timmy performed dark magic. He shot a fireball! The north wall of the library was wrecked!
Memory Paranoia#019.dst: Page {~}: Je ne sais même pas comment c'est arrivé, mais Timmy a pratiqué la magie noire. Il a lancé une boule de feu! Le mur nord de la bibliothèque est détruit!

Memory Paranoia#020.src: It appears that all of the pages have been torn out...
Memory Paranoia#020.dst: On dirait que toutes les pages ont été arrachées...

Memory Paranoia#021.src: Aw man, I can't believe I'm not allowed to sit with the adults. I'm nearly twelve!
Memory Paranoia#021.dst: Pff, on m'interdit de m'asseoir avec les adultes. J'ai presque douze ans!

Memory Paranoia#022.src: They appear to be chatting about local politics.
Memory Paranoia#022.dst: Ils semblent discuter de politique locale.

Memory Paranoia#024.src: It's been depleted of its magic. How disappointing.
Memory Paranoia#024.dst: Elle a perdu sa magie. Quelle déception.

Memory Paranoia#025.src: Thank you very much, Father, and everyone here. Here's to more years of health-
Memory Paranoia#025.dst: Merci beaucoup, père, et vous tous. Je bois à de longues années de santé-
Memory Paranoia#025.speaker: Timothy

Memory Paranoia#026.src: My god... What is wrong with this place? No matter what I do, what I try...
Memory Paranoia#026.dst: Mon dieu... Qu'est-ce qui cloche ici? Quoi que je fasse, quoi que je tente...
Memory Paranoia#026.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#027.src: ...Timothy, I'm going to ask you something, and I need you to answer me honestly. Were you... Were you responsible for this?
Memory Paranoia#027.dst: ...Timothy, je vais te poser une question, et réponds-moi honnêtement. Est-ce que... Est-ce que c'est toi qui as fait ça?
Memory Paranoia#027.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#028.src: Never, never!! That study is off-limits to everyone, even your mother! If I had known back then, I'd... I'd have... urgh...
Memory Paranoia#028.dst: Jamais, jamais!! Ce bureau est interdit à tous, même à ta mère! Si j'avais su à l'époque, j'aurais... j'aurais... argh...

Memory Paranoia#029.src: Page {~}: DEATH DEATH DEATH DEATH DEATH DEATH DEATH DEATH DEATH DEATH DEATH.
Memory Paranoia#029.dst: Page {~}: MORT MORT MORT MORT MORT MORT MORT MORT MORT MORT MORT.

Memory Paranoia#030.src: Page {~}: There is a dark power beyond our control within this mansion. There is no use trying to fight it.
Memory Paranoia#030.dst: Page {~}: Il y a dans ce manoir une puissance obscure qui nous dépasse. Inutile d'essayer de la combattre.

Memory Paranoia#031.src: Page {~}: I felt like all of the skulls were watching me. I have had to turn them all towards the fireplace.
Memory Paranoia#031.dst: Page {~}: J'avais l'impression que tous les crânes me regardaient. J'ai dû tous les tourner vers la cheminée.

Memory Paranoia#032.src: THAT WHICH STARTED THIS WAR SHALL RISE ONCE MORE. FROM THE REALM OF SHADOWS, DECEIT AND PAIN.
Memory Paranoia#032.dst: CE QUI A DÉCLENCHÉ CETTE GUERRE SE RELÈVERA. DEPUIS LE ROYAUME DES OMBRES, DE LA TROMPERIE ET DE LA DOULEUR.
Memory Paranoia#032.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#033.src: FOREVER TRAPPED, FROM WHENCE IT CAME. THROUGH THE WEAK POINT BETWEEN REALMS IT. SHALL. RISE. AGAIN!
Memory Paranoia#033.dst: PRISONNIER POUR TOUJOURS DE SON ROYAUME D'ORIGINE. PAR LE POINT FAIBLE ENTRE LES ROYAUMES IL. SE. RELÈVERA!
Memory Paranoia#033.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#034.src: Dear Anton, the chandelier fell in the main hall. Please fix it as soon as possible.
Memory Paranoia#034.dst: Cher Anton, le lustre du grand hall est tombé. Merci de le réparer au plus vite.

Memory Paranoia#035.src: FROM SOILS OF DOOM THE SERVANT LAID
Memory Paranoia#035.dst: DES TERRES FUNESTES QUE LE SERVITEUR SEMA
Memory Paranoia#035.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#036.src: All you have to do, is go in there and find answers. I'm sure the past won't haunt us both. Something happened here all those years ago... I want to know what.
Memory Paranoia#036.dst: Il vous suffit d'entrer et de trouver des réponses. Le passé ne nous hantera pas, j'en suis sûr. Il s'est passé quelque chose ici, il y a des années... Je veux savoir quoi.

Memory Paranoia#037.src: I don't think it's wise you enter the mansion ever again...
Memory Paranoia#037.dst: Je ne crois pas sage que vous retourniez un jour dans ce manoir...

Memory Paranoia#039.src: It was not always so dilapidated. It once stood tall, a monument to the family of Caritat, who constructed it from the ground up.
Memory Paranoia#039.dst: Il n'a pas toujours été aussi délabré. Il se dressait jadis fièrement, monument à la famille Caritat, qui l'avait bâti de ses mains.
Memory Paranoia#039.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#040.src: The Caritats were unlike any other. Uncharacteristically selfless and helpful. Their wealth was everyone’s wealth as far as they were concerned.
Memory Paranoia#040.dst: Les Caritat n'étaient pas comme les autres. D'une générosité et d'une serviabilité rares. Pour eux, leur richesse était celle de tous.
Memory Paranoia#040.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#041.src: I am the last remaining descendant, Atisun Caritat. I was the only survivor of the... incident. I was only an infant when I was found by a passerby.
Memory Paranoia#041.dst: Je suis le dernier descendant, Atisun Caritat. Le seul survivant de... l'incident. Je n'étais qu'un nourrisson quand un passant m'a trouvé.
Memory Paranoia#041.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#042.src: I do not believe that my family simply went mad, but I do not know what happened. I want to know the truth. I think this mansion still holds the answers I'm looking for.
Memory Paranoia#042.dst: Je ne crois pas que ma famille soit simplement devenue folle, mais j'ignore ce qui s'est passé. Je veux la vérité. Je pense que ce manoir détient encore les réponses que je cherche.
Memory Paranoia#042.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#043.src: Don't you worry, like my ancestors, I'm a generous man. If you help me, I will reward you handsomely. All you have to do, is go in there and find answers. I'm sure the past won't haunt us both.
Memory Paranoia#043.dst: Ne vous en faites pas, comme mes ancêtres, je suis généreux. Si vous m'aidez, je vous récompenserai bien. Il vous suffit d'entrer et de trouver des réponses. Le passé ne nous hantera pas, j'en suis sûr.
Memory Paranoia#043.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#045.src: Learn the story of the Caritat Family.
Memory Paranoia#045.dst: Découvrez l'histoire de la famille Caritat.

Memory Paranoia#046.src: This check is made out to a charity for a lot of emeralds.
Memory Paranoia#046.dst: Un chèque pour une oeuvre de charité, de beaucoup d'émeraudes.
Memory Paranoia#046.speaker: Check

Memory Paranoia#047.src: It's so nice that the Caritats are donating all of these supplies to the struggling people in the forest.
Memory Paranoia#047.dst: C'est si gentil que les Caritat donnent toutes ces provisions aux gens en difficulté dans la forêt.
Memory Paranoia#047.speaker: Maid

Memory Paranoia#048.src: He seems to be very engrossed in his writing.
Memory Paranoia#048.dst: Il semble très absorbé par son écriture.
Memory Paranoia#048.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#049.src: I've heard about weird things happening around the house. People are saying the mansion might be haunted!
Memory Paranoia#049.dst: Il paraît qu'il se passe des choses bizarres dans la maison. On dit que le manoir serait hanté!
Memory Paranoia#049.speaker: Maid

Memory Paranoia#050.src: Ghosts? Preposterous! This mansion isn't haunted, don't believe those silly rumors!
Memory Paranoia#050.dst: Des fantômes? Absurde! Ce manoir n'est pas hanté, ne croyez pas ces rumeurs idiotes!
Memory Paranoia#050.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#051.src: Mister Caritat is always writing in that book, always so intensely. I wonder what he is writing.
Memory Paranoia#051.dst: M. Caritat écrit sans cesse dans ce livre, et avec tant d'ardeur. Je me demande ce qu'il écrit.
Memory Paranoia#051.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#052.src: He won't even tell me what he's writing.
Memory Paranoia#052.dst: Il ne veut même pas me dire ce qu'il écrit.
Memory Paranoia#052.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#053.src: I accidentally dropped my Library Key down the drain, do you think my dad will be angry?
Memory Paranoia#053.dst: J'ai fait tomber ma Library Key dans l'égout sans faire exprès, tu crois que mon père va se fâcher?
Memory Paranoia#053.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#054.src: No, Mister Caritat is very forgiving. I doubt he'd be upset, especially if it was an accident.
Memory Paranoia#054.dst: Non, M. Caritat est très indulgent. Je doute qu'il se fâche, surtout si c'était un accident.
Memory Paranoia#054.speaker: Maid

Memory Paranoia#055.src: I still want to find the key though, do you know where I should look?
Memory Paranoia#055.dst: Je veux quand même retrouver la clé, tu sais où chercher?
Memory Paranoia#055.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#056.src: Well, the drainage pipes have probably taken the key to the basement in the southeast corner of the mansion by now, that's most likely where it is.
Memory Paranoia#056.dst: Eh bien, les tuyaux ont sans doute emporté la clé jusqu'au sous-sol, dans l'angle sud-est du manoir; elle doit être là.
Memory Paranoia#056.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#057.src: Enter the basement and recover the Library Key.
Memory Paranoia#057.dst: Entrez dans le sous-sol et récupérez la Library Key.

Memory Paranoia#059.src: Enter the hole in the wall.
Memory Paranoia#059.dst: Entrez dans le trou du mur.

Memory Paranoia#060.src: Timmy, is something bothering you? You have been acting so weird lately.
Memory Paranoia#060.dst: Timmy, quelque chose te tracasse? Tu es si bizarre ces temps-ci.
Memory Paranoia#060.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#061.src: You cannot command me, mortal! You and all of your inferior species will bow to the darkness!
Memory Paranoia#061.dst: Tu ne peux pas me commander, mortel! Toi et ton espèce inférieure plierez devant les ténèbres!
Memory Paranoia#061.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#062.src: I don't know what game you are playing, Timmy. But I will not stand for it any longer, snap out of it!
Memory Paranoia#062.dst: Je ne sais pas à quoi tu joues, Timmy. Mais je ne le tolérerai plus, reprends-toi!
Memory Paranoia#062.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#063.src: You shall pay for your insolence, mortal!
Memory Paranoia#063.dst: Tu paieras pour ton insolence, mortel!
Memory Paranoia#063.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#064.src: Dark magic? What foul books have you been reading? And what's that in your hand?
Memory Paranoia#064.dst: La magie noire? Quels livres immondes as-tu lus? Et qu'as-tu dans la main?
Memory Paranoia#064.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#065.src: Casting spells with a black spoon? I'm going to get rid of this foul thing!
Memory Paranoia#065.dst: Lancer des sorts avec une cuillère noire? Je vais me débarrasser de cette horreur!
Memory Paranoia#065.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#066.src: That is an item beyond you, mortal. Give it back to me this instant!
Memory Paranoia#066.dst: Cet objet te dépasse, mortel. Rends-le-moi sur-le-champ!
Memory Paranoia#066.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#067.src: Return the spoon to the Kitchen.
Memory Paranoia#067.dst: Rapportez la cuillère à la cuisine.

Memory Paranoia#069.src: Attention, attention everyone! I have an announcement I'd like to make!
Memory Paranoia#069.dst: Votre attention, s'il vous plaît! J'ai une annonce à faire!
Memory Paranoia#069.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#070.src: My son, Timothy, has just turned eighteen today.
Memory Paranoia#070.dst: Mon fils, Timothy, a dix-huit ans aujourd'hui.
Memory Paranoia#070.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#071.src: Now, there have been a few slight hiccups over the years, but we've made it through mostly in one piece.
Memory Paranoia#071.dst: Il y a eu quelques petits accrocs au fil des ans, mais nous nous en sommes sortis presque intacts.
Memory Paranoia#071.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#072.src: And I'd like to say, I'm very proud of him. To Timothy, a new man!
Memory Paranoia#072.dst: Et je tiens à le dire, je suis très fier de lui. A Timothy, un homme nouveau!
Memory Paranoia#072.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#073.src: Please, everyone stay calm. I'm sure it's just the cooks spilling something...
Memory Paranoia#073.dst: Du calme, tout le monde. Les cuisiniers ont sûrement renversé quelque chose...
Memory Paranoia#073.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#075.src: Oh my god... what is that thing?!
Memory Paranoia#075.dst: Mon dieu... C'est quoi, cette chose?!
Memory Paranoia#075.speaker: Baker

Memory Paranoia#076.src: Everyone out, now! We can't fight these things!
Memory Paranoia#076.dst: Tout le monde dehors, vite! On ne peut pas les combattre!
Memory Paranoia#076.speaker: Chef

Memory Paranoia#078.src: Speak to people who haven't fled from the disaster.
Memory Paranoia#078.dst: Parlez aux gens qui n'ont pas fui la catastrophe.

Memory Paranoia#079.src: How was any of that even possible? What are we going to tell their families?
Memory Paranoia#079.dst: Comment tout ça a-t-il pu arriver? Que va-t-on dire à leurs familles?
Memory Paranoia#079.speaker: Timothy

Memory Paranoia#080.src: No, of course not! I overcame that years ago, you know that, I can't believe you still suspect me of-
Memory Paranoia#080.dst: Non, bien sûr que non! J'ai surmonté ça il y a des années, tu le sais, et tu me soupçonnes encore de-
Memory Paranoia#080.speaker: Timothy

Memory Paranoia#081.src: Ah, sir, we did find something rather unusual in the kitchen that might interest you? Maybe?
Memory Paranoia#081.dst: Ah, monsieur, nous avons trouvé quelque chose d'insolite en cuisine, qui pourrait vous intéresser? Peut-être?
Memory Paranoia#081.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#082.src: What- Out with it! What did you find?! Please, please tell me I'm wrong!!
Memory Paranoia#082.dst: Quoi- Parlez! Qu'avez-vous trouvé?! Pitié, dites-moi que je me trompe!!
Memory Paranoia#082.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#083.src: We found this charred-looking black spoon. I've worked here for years, and I've never seen any spoons of this style in the mansion.
Memory Paranoia#083.dst: Nous avons trouvé cette cuillère noire, comme calcinée. Je travaille ici depuis des années, et je n'en ai jamais vu de ce style au manoir.
Memory Paranoia#083.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#084.src: Wait, that spoon? I remember sneaking into your study that one time to get it, but how did it survive the fire?
Memory Paranoia#084.dst: Attends, cette cuillère? Je me souviens m'être faufilé dans ton bureau pour la prendre, mais comment a-t-elle survécu au feu?
Memory Paranoia#084.speaker: Timothy

Memory Paranoia#088.src: Speak with the Possessed Mr. Caritat.

Memory Paranoia#089.src: Bring the key to Timmy's bedroom.
Memory Paranoia#089.dst: Apportez la clé dans la chambre de Timmy.

Memory Paranoia#090.dst: Entrez dans la chambre de Timmy.

Memory Paranoia#092.src: Bring the key to the Master Bedroom.
Memory Paranoia#092.dst: Apportez la clé dans la chambre principale.

Memory Paranoia#097.src: BREAK THROUGH THE REALMS TO THE LAND OF TRADE.
Memory Paranoia#097.dst: FRANCHIS LES ROYAUMES VERS LA TERRE DU COMMERCE.
Memory Paranoia#097.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#098.src: CORRUPT THE WORLD WITH SEEDS OF PAIN
Memory Paranoia#098.dst: CORROMPS LE MONDE DE GRAINES DE DOULEUR
Memory Paranoia#098.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#101.src: Escape the flaming mansion through the back door.
Memory Paranoia#101.dst: Fuyez le manoir en flammes par la porte de derrière.

Memory Paranoia#104.src: No, no! I said three feet left, you absolute...
Memory Paranoia#104.dst: Non, non! J'ai dit un mètre à gauche, espèce de...
Memory Paranoia#104.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#105.src: Mr. Caritat! What are you doing?!
Memory Paranoia#105.speaker: Lari

Memory Paranoia#106.src: What are you doing here, Elf? You need proper equipment to be on this site-
Memory Paranoia#106.dst: Que faites-vous ici, l'elfe? Il faut un équipement adapté sur ce chantier-
Memory Paranoia#106.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#107.src: Mr Caritat, you can't build a house here!
Memory Paranoia#107.dst: M. Caritat, vous ne pouvez pas bâtir ici!
Memory Paranoia#107.speaker: Lari

Memory Paranoia#108.src: I can do whatever I like here, I bought the land.
Memory Paranoia#108.dst: Je fais ce que je veux ici, j'ai acheté le terrain.
Memory Paranoia#108.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#109.src: You don't understand! This is where it came... this is where the darkness invaded!
Memory Paranoia#109.dst: Vous ne comprenez pas! C'est par ici qu'elle est venue... c'est ici que les ténèbres ont surgi!
Memory Paranoia#109.speaker: Lari

Memory Paranoia#110.src: Don't be preposterous. I'm building here to show the people that there's simply nothing to worry about!
Memory Paranoia#110.dst: Ne dites pas d'absurdités. Je bâtis ici pour montrer aux gens qu'il n'y a tout simplement rien à craindre!
Memory Paranoia#110.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#111.src: Besides, even if there was something, now that Dullahan's gone, it'll go too.
Memory Paranoia#111.dst: Et même s'il y avait quelque chose, Dullahan parti, ça partira aussi.
Memory Paranoia#111.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#112.src: What?! He wasn't the one causing all this, it was-
Memory Paranoia#112.dst: Quoi?! Ce n'était pas lui qui causait tout ça, c'était-
Memory Paranoia#112.speaker: Lari

Memory Paranoia#113.src: Well of course you would think that. You and him had some... history, didn't you?
Memory Paranoia#113.dst: Évidemment que vous pensez ça. Vous et lui aviez une certaine... histoire, non?
Memory Paranoia#113.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#114.src: I... Please, Mr Caritat. You don't understand what you're doing...
Memory Paranoia#114.dst: Je... Je vous en prie, M. Caritat. Vous ne savez pas ce que vous faites...
Memory Paranoia#114.speaker: Lari

Memory Paranoia#115.src: I am securing some prime real-estate right here. Oh... Perhaps that is why you're here?
Memory Paranoia#115.dst: Je m'assure un terrain de premier choix, ici même. Oh... C'est peut-être pour ça que vous êtes là?
Memory Paranoia#115.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#117.src: Trying to expand elven territories, are you?! Well, I'll be having none of that! Leave, before I have my men escort you!
Memory Paranoia#117.dst: Vous voulez étendre les territoires elfiques, hein?! Hors de question! Partez, ou mes hommes vous raccompagneront!
Memory Paranoia#117.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#118.src: Hey! Human! Are you alright?! Please, calm down, quit flailing around, you're safe!
Memory Paranoia#118.dst: Hé! Humain! Ça va?! Calmez-vous, arrêtez de vous débattre, vous êtes en sécurité!
Memory Paranoia#118.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#119.src: Oh thank goodness, you're back to us. I was so worried... er, you might not recall. Let me explain...
Memory Paranoia#119.dst: Oh, Dieu merci, vous revoilà. J'étais si inquiet... euh, vous ne vous souvenez peut-être pas. Je vous explique...
Memory Paranoia#119.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#120.src: It... it seemed like you were possessed. You stood in the hall for... I don't know how long. I couldn't snap you out of it, no matter what I tried.
Memory Paranoia#120.dst: On... on aurait dit que vous étiez possédé. Vous êtes resté dans le hall... je ne sais combien de temps. Impossible de vous en tirer, quoi que je tente.
Memory Paranoia#120.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#121.src: Voices that weren't yours, you spoke out their moments and thoughts. The maids, my father... everyone. I... you said what I needed to hear.
Memory Paranoia#121.dst: D'autres voix que la vôtre racontaient leurs instants, leurs pensées. Les servantes, mon père... tous. Je... vous avez dit ce que j'avais besoin d'entendre.
Memory Paranoia#121.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#122.src: My great grandfather, wanting to prove to everyone that the forest was still good, built his mansion atop the very spot that was acclaimed to be the cause of the Decay.
Memory Paranoia#122.dst: Mon arrière-grand-père, voulant prouver à tous que la forêt restait saine, a bâti son manoir sur le lieu même qu'on disait à l'origine de la Décadence.
Memory Paranoia#122.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#123.src: My father tried to continue the traditions... but all of it was burned to ashes. I must consider myself lucky that I did not fall with them.
Memory Paranoia#123.dst: Mon père a tenté de perpétuer les traditions... mais tout a été réduit en cendres. J'ai de la chance de ne pas avoir péri avec eux.
Memory Paranoia#123.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#124.src: And what emerged from that spot? Who knows... but, whatever it was... the darkness must have lingered, and drove them all to madness.
Memory Paranoia#124.dst: Et qu'est-il sorti de cet endroit? Qui sait... mais quoi que ce fût... les ténèbres ont dû s'attarder, et les ont tous rendus fous.
Memory Paranoia#124.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#125.src: I'm sorry you went through that ordeal... I would suggest seeing a healer as soon as possible.
Memory Paranoia#125.dst: Désolé que vous ayez subi cette épreuve... Je vous conseille de voir un guérisseur au plus vite.
Memory Paranoia#125.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#126.src: I will make sure no one enters this house again. It is cursed. Thank you for helping me.
Memory Paranoia#126.dst: Je veillerai à ce que personne n'entre plus dans cette maison. Elle est maudite. Merci de m'avoir aidé.
Memory Paranoia#126.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#127.src: Look around the chandelier at the stairs.
Memory Paranoia#127.dst: Examinez les abords du lustre, près de l'escalier.

Misadventure on the Sea#000.src: As you touch the obelisk, it ignites with an otherworldly blue light...
Misadventure on the Sea#000.dst: Quand vous touchez l'obélisque, il s'embrase d'une lumière bleue surnaturelle...

Misadventure on the Sea#001.src: So... I've seen ya around town. You've got the soul of an adventurer, don't ya?
Misadventure on the Sea#001.dst: Alors... Je t'ai vu en ville. T'as une âme d'aventurier, pas vrai?

Misadventure on the Sea#003.src: Don't think we'll be done with ya once you clean all of this!
Misadventure on the Sea#003.dst: Crois pas qu'on en aura fini avec toi quand t'auras tout nettoyé!

Misadventure on the Sea#005.src: Sitting on this stool will start Misadventure on the Sea.
