Misadventure on the Sea#005.dst: S'asseoir sur ce tabouret lancera Mésaventure en mer.

Misadventure on the Sea#006.src: I'll take two {p} Whiskeys. One for me, one for this chap.
Misadventure on the Sea#006.dst: Deux whiskys de {p}. Un pour moi, un pour ce gars-là.
Misadventure on the Sea#006.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#008.src: I'll wait for ya at the docks. Don't worry, ya can't miss the boat!
Misadventure on the Sea#008.dst: Je t'attends aux quais. T'inquiète, tu peux pas rater le bateau!
Misadventure on the Sea#008.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#009.src: They're a bit too head on, don't you think?
Misadventure on the Sea#009.dst: Ils foncent un peu trop droit, tu trouves pas?
Misadventure on the Sea#009.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#010.src: I'm tryin' to steer the ship but it's not budging...
Misadventure on the Sea#010.dst: J'essaie de virer, mais le navire veut pas bouger...
Misadventure on the Sea#010.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#011.src: Sounds like you're being dragged around...
Misadventure on the Sea#011.dst: On dirait qu'on vous traîne de tous côtés...

Misadventure on the Sea#012.src: You pick up a small sign...

Misadventure on the Sea#014.src: So, there's quite a few bodies in there, and we never bothered throwin' em out!
Misadventure on the Sea#014.dst: Bon, y a pas mal de cadavres là-dedans, et on s'est jamais embêtés à les jeter!
Misadventure on the Sea#014.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#015.src: Go ahead, here's a sponge for the dried blood as well. Just wack the bodies with it!
Misadventure on the Sea#015.dst: Vas-y, voilà aussi une éponge pour le sang séché. Frotte les cadavres avec!
Misadventure on the Sea#015.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#017.src: You take a look inside the furnaces...
Misadventure on the Sea#017.dst: Vous jetez un oeil dans les fourneaux...

Misadventure on the Sea#019.src: An absurd amount of wood shavings, for some reason.
Misadventure on the Sea#019.dst: Une absurde quantité de copeaux, allez savoir pourquoi.

Misadventure on the Sea#020.src: Looks like the door that leads to the hold...
Misadventure on the Sea#020.dst: On dirait la porte qui mène à la cale...

Misadventure on the Sea#021.src: It's locked. Probably because of the rat issue. Honip must have the key.
Misadventure on the Sea#021.dst: Elle est verrouillée. Sûrement à cause des rats. Honip doit avoir la clé.

Misadventure on the Sea#022.src: You find some notes on the table.
Misadventure on the Sea#022.dst: Vous trouvez des notes sur la table.

Misadventure on the Sea#023.src: There's mentions of... A human cannon? How does that make sense?
Misadventure on the Sea#023.dst: Il est question... d'un canon humain? Ça rime à quoi?

Misadventure on the Sea#024.src: Apparently, only gunpowder is needed, as well as a fuse.
Misadventure on the Sea#024.dst: Apparemment, il ne faut que de la poudre et une mèche.

Misadventure on the Sea#025.src: This cannon is aiming slightly upwards, and it seems less powerful than the others.
Misadventure on the Sea#025.dst: Ce canon vise légèrement vers le haut, et il semble moins puissant que les autres.

Misadventure on the Sea#026.src: According to the notes you saw, it's probably the "human" cannon. This must be your escape route!
Misadventure on the Sea#026.dst: D'après les notes que vous avez vues, c'est sûrement le canon "humain". Voilà votre issue de secours!

Misadventure on the Sea#028.src: There are mentions of a hidden key in the hold...
Misadventure on the Sea#028.dst: Il est question d'une clé cachée dans la cale...

Misadventure on the Sea#029.src: You should probably search the hold later, when possible.
Misadventure on the Sea#029.dst: Vous devriez fouiller la cale plus tard, si possible.

Misadventure on the Sea#030.src: You cleaned the bodies! You should talk to Honip on the deck.
Misadventure on the Sea#030.dst: Vous avez nettoyé les cadavres! Allez parler à Honip sur le pont.

Misadventure on the Sea#031.src: 'ey! How's the cleaning? Don't forget to check everywhere, ya never know what you might find!
Misadventure on the Sea#031.dst: Hé! Ça avance, le ménage? Oublie pas de regarder partout, on sait jamais c'que tu peux trouver!

Misadventure on the Sea#032.src: You're done? Well good job! Honip's next to the helm if you're lookin' for him.
Misadventure on the Sea#032.dst: T'as fini? Bien joué! Honip est près de la barre si tu le cherches.

Misadventure on the Sea#033.src: You've been running around the boat for a while now!
Misadventure on the Sea#033.dst: Ça fait un moment que tu cours partout sur le bateau!

Misadventure on the Sea#035.src: Honip's probably waitin' for ya by now! Take these ladders next to me, he's up there.
Misadventure on the Sea#035.dst: Honip doit t'attendre, maintenant! Prends les échelles à côté de moi, il est là-haut.

Misadventure on the Sea#036.src: If you lose your sponge, Honip can give you a new one on the deck.
Misadventure on the Sea#036.dst: Si vous perdez l'éponge, Honip peut vous en donner une autre sur le pont.

Misadventure on the Sea#037.src: The only boat that will take ye directly to {p}.
Misadventure on the Sea#037.dst: Le seul navire qui vous mène droit à {p}.

Misadventure on the Sea#038.src: Hey! You aren't allowed on my ship!
Misadventure on the Sea#038.dst: Hé! T'as rien à faire sur mon navire!

Misadventure on the Sea#039.src: This hologram will teleport you back on the island to continue the quest or Reset your quest.
Misadventure on the Sea#039.dst: Cet hologramme vous ramène sur l'île pour continuer la quête, ou réinitialise votre quête.

Misadventure on the Sea#040.src: Are you sure you wish to Reset your quest?

Misadventure on the Sea#041.src: Misadventure On The Sea has been reset!
Misadventure on the Sea#041.dst: Mésaventure en mer a été réinitialisée!

Misadventure on the Sea#042.src: Maybe you could somehow use it..? There's no way to tell how dangerous it is. Probably very.
Misadventure on the Sea#042.dst: Vous pourriez peut-être vous en servir..? Impossible de savoir s'il est dangereux. Sûrement très.

Misadventure on the Sea#043.src: It must be the one up you saw up there! That's got to be the way to escape!
Misadventure on the Sea#043.dst: Ce doit être celui que vous avez vu là-haut! Ce doit être le moyen de s'enfuir!

Misadventure on the Sea#044.src: Who knows, maybe there's gunpowder in there?
Misadventure on the Sea#044.dst: Qui sait, il y a peut-être de la poudre là-dedans?

Misadventure on the Sea#045.src: Seems like it likes you now!

Misadventure on the Sea#046.src: Not done yet? Well, take your time!
Misadventure on the Sea#046.dst: Pas encore fini? Bon, prends ton temps!

Misadventure on the Sea#047.src: We sometimes hear unusually loud footsteps, along with some really eerie squeaking...
Misadventure on the Sea#047.dst: On entend parfois des pas très bruyants, et des couinements vraiment sinistres...
Misadventure on the Sea#047.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#048.src: Looks like this crate is filled with rat hair, with some eaten carrots.
Misadventure on the Sea#048.dst: Cette caisse semble pleine de poils de rat, avec quelques carottes grignotées.

Misadventure on the Sea#049.src: You defeated the rats! You should grab the gunpowder and the fuse before leaving.
Misadventure on the Sea#049.dst: Vous avez vaincu les rats! Prenez la poudre et la mèche avant de partir.

Misadventure on the Sea#052.dst: Vous avez déjà assez de poudre.

Misadventure on the Sea#053.src: Looks like this crate is filled with even more rat hair!
Misadventure on the Sea#053.dst: Cette caisse semble pleine d'encore plus de poils de rat!

Misadventure on the Sea#054.src: You picked up a dusty key!

Misadventure on the Sea#056.src: You got the fuse as well as the gunpowder. Looks like you can use that cannon now!
Misadventure on the Sea#056.dst: Vous avez la mèche et la poudre. Vous pouvez utiliser ce canon, maintenant!

Misadventure on the Sea#057.src: You put the gunpowder in the cannon and attach the fuse...
Misadventure on the Sea#057.dst: Vous mettez la poudre dans le canon et fixez la mèche...

Misadventure on the Sea#058.src: Looks like it's fully functional. Make sure the pirates don't see you! Once you leave, you won't be able to come back.
Misadventure on the Sea#058.dst: Il semble parfaitement fonctionnel. Que les pirates ne vous voient pas! Une fois parti, impossible de revenir.

Misadventure on the Sea#059.dst: Vous vous glissez dans le canon...

Misadventure on the Sea#064.src: Huh? Something's approaching off in the distance...
Misadventure on the Sea#064.dst: Hein? Quelque chose approche au loin...

Misadventure on the Sea#065.src: Looks like they're headed toward the island! Is that..?
Misadventure on the Sea#065.dst: On dirait qu'ils viennent vers l'île! Est-ce que..?

Misadventure on the Sea#066.src: Ah... Trust. Say, why don't I make it so you can travel to {p} for free? That way, if ya ever think o' doin' somethin' foolish like that again, ya can jus' take a trip on my ol' ship!
Misadventure on the Sea#066.dst: Ah... La confiance. Dis, et si je te laissais voyager gratis jusqu'à {p}? Comme ça, si un jour tu penses à refaire une bêtise pareille, t'auras qu'à faire un tour sur mon vieux rafiot!

Misadventure on the Sea#068.src: Hello there soldier! What can I get you?
Misadventure on the Sea#068.dst: Bonjour, soldat! Qu'est-ce que je vous sers?
Misadventure on the Sea#068.speaker: Barman

Misadventure on the Sea#070.src: So... I've seen ya around town. I saw how happy that guy was when you brought him some journal.
Misadventure on the Sea#070.dst: Alors... Je t'ai vu en ville. J'ai vu comme ce gars était content quand tu lui as apporté un journal.
Misadventure on the Sea#070.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#072.src: So... Soldier. Are ya up for sailin' the ocean with me? I got a fancier boat than that seaskipper!
Misadventure on the Sea#072.dst: Alors... Soldat. Partant pour voguer sur l'océan avec moi? J'ai un bateau bien plus classe que ce Seaskipper!
Misadventure on the Sea#072.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#073.src: I figured you'd be interested in explorin' the waters!
Misadventure on the Sea#073.dst: Je me doutais que t'aurais envie d'explorer les flots!
Misadventure on the Sea#073.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#075.src: There you are! Ready? Follow me, the boat's over here!
Misadventure on the Sea#075.dst: Te voilà! Prêt? Suis-moi, le bateau est par ici!
Misadventure on the Sea#075.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#076.src: Look at this.. Magnificent! Much better than whatever the Seaskipper is using!
Misadventure on the Sea#076.dst: Regarde-moi ça.. Magnifique! Bien mieux que ce qu'utilise le Seaskipper!
Misadventure on the Sea#076.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#077.src: Well, what are you waiting for? Hop aboard!
Misadventure on the Sea#077.dst: Eh bien, t'attends quoi? Monte à bord!
Misadventure on the Sea#077.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#078.src: Then it's settled, we're goin' on an adventure!
Misadventure on the Sea#078.dst: Alors c'est décidé, on part à l'aventure!
Misadventure on the Sea#078.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#079.src: Buckle up, we got waves to catch.
Misadventure on the Sea#079.dst: Accroche-toi, y a des vagues à prendre.
Misadventure on the Sea#079.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#080.src: So... I should warn ya', this is actually my first time sailing...
Misadventure on the Sea#080.dst: Alors... Faut que j'te prévienne, c'est ma première fois à la barre...
Misadventure on the Sea#080.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#081.src: It doesn't seem too difficult though, a little to the left...
Misadventure on the Sea#081.dst: Ça n'a pas l'air si dur, cela dit, un peu à gauche...
Misadventure on the Sea#081.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#082.src: Hmm, looks like we're not the only ones out on the water today.
Misadventure on the Sea#082.dst: Hmm, on dirait qu'on n'est pas seuls en mer aujourd'hui.
Misadventure on the Sea#082.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#086.src: I honestly, truly can't believe you fell for that. Let me sum it up for you...
Misadventure on the Sea#086.dst: Franchement, j'arrive pas à croire que t'aies mordu à l'hameçon. Je te résume...
Misadventure on the Sea#086.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#087.src: Some extremely suspicious pirate comes up, offers you a drink, and leads you to his suspicious boat.
Misadventure on the Sea#087.dst: Un pirate ultra louche s'approche, t'offre un verre, et t'emmène sur son bateau louche.
Misadventure on the Sea#087.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#088.src: Any normal person would've turned back by then. But what do you do? You hop on! Well, now you're stuck with us.
Misadventure on the Sea#088.dst: N'importe qui de normal aurait fait demi-tour. Mais toi? Tu montes! Bon, maintenant, t'es coincé avec nous.
Misadventure on the Sea#088.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#089.src: Let me make this quick. This boat needs renovation, and we want you to do it.
Misadventure on the Sea#089.dst: Je fais vite. Ce bateau a besoin d'être retapé, et c'est toi qui t'y colles.
Misadventure on the Sea#089.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#090.src: Why? You're a soldier! All you do is take orders! Anyway, we'll need you to clean our stuff. Here, get out.
Misadventure on the Sea#090.dst: Pourquoi? T'es un soldat! Tu ne fais qu'obéir aux ordres! Bref, tu vas nettoyer nos affaires. Allez, dehors.
Misadventure on the Sea#090.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#092.src: I told you to stay back!
Misadventure on the Sea#092.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#094.src: If you need me, I'll be on the deck. And, uh, don't go in the hold. We've got a BIG rat problem.
Misadventure on the Sea#094.dst: Si t'as besoin de moi, je serai sur le pont. Et, euh, va pas dans la cale. On a un GROS problème de rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#094.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#095.src: Also, for the sake of my crew, could you be more cooperative? I don't have an unlimited amount of these potions.
Misadventure on the Sea#095.dst: Aussi, pour le bien de mon équipage, tu pourrais coopérer? J'ai pas une réserve infinie de ces potions.
Misadventure on the Sea#095.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#096.src: Clean the bodies in the boat. Look for clues on how to escape at the same time. -Bodies cleaned: #/{~}
Misadventure on the Sea#096.dst: Nettoyez les cadavres du bateau. Cherchez en même temps des indices pour vous échapper. -Cadavres nettoyés: #/{~}

Misadventure on the Sea#097.src: Hey, so you're our personal guard, huh?
Misadventure on the Sea#097.dst: Hé, alors c'est toi notre garde perso, hein?
Misadventure on the Sea#097.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#099.src: That ladder leads to the hold, but right now it's locked... We've got a severe case of rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#099.dst: Cette échelle mène à la cale, mais elle est verrouillée pour l'instant... On a un sérieux cas de rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#099.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#100.src: Pep is just a treasure, ain't I right? I'm glad you're taking care of him too!
Misadventure on the Sea#100.dst: Pep est un vrai trésor, pas vrai? Content que tu t'en occupes aussi!
Misadventure on the Sea#100.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#101.src: Honip has a pet chicken, weird right?
Misadventure on the Sea#101.dst: Honip a un poulet de compagnie, bizarre, non?
Misadventure on the Sea#101.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#102.src: I bet he got inspiration from that weird guy on his island...
Misadventure on the Sea#102.dst: Je parie qu'il s'est inspiré de ce type bizarre sur son île...
Misadventure on the Sea#102.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#103.src: What? You murdered that guy's most prized chicken? You're an odd one, soldier.
Misadventure on the Sea#103.dst: Quoi? T'as tué le poulet préféré de ce type? T'es un drôle de numéro, soldat.
Misadventure on the Sea#103.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#104.src: Oh, uh... Don't worry about that, 'ay?
Misadventure on the Sea#104.dst: Oh, euh... T'occupe pas de ça, hein?
Misadventure on the Sea#104.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#106.src: Oh, that's my cannon! Pretty cool, right? I made it using a bunch of arm- Nevermind...
Misadventure on the Sea#106.dst: Oh, c'est mon canon! Plutôt cool, hein? Je l'ai fait avec un tas de bra- Laisse tomber...
Misadventure on the Sea#106.speaker: Seth

Misadventure on the Sea#108.src: He's a strong chicken alright, trust me on that one.
Misadventure on the Sea#108.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#110.src: I'm just goin' to... Wait here... With my cannons...
Misadventure on the Sea#110.dst: Je vais juste... Attendre ici... Avec mes canons...
Misadventure on the Sea#110.speaker: Seth

Misadventure on the Sea#111.src: Talk to Honip on the deck to get your next task
Misadventure on the Sea#111.dst: Parlez à Honip sur le pont pour votre prochaine tâche

Misadventure on the Sea#112.src: Hey! The boat's lookin' real nice now!
Misadventure on the Sea#112.dst: Hé! Le bateau a fière allure, maintenant!
Misadventure on the Sea#112.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#113.src: I'll probably let you rest so- hold on.
Misadventure on the Sea#113.dst: J'vais te laisser souffler, al- attends.
Misadventure on the Sea#113.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#114.src: Ho-Honip! One of the guys said he saw something really weird coming right for us!
Misadventure on the Sea#114.dst: Ho-Honip! Un des gars dit qu'il a vu un truc super bizarre foncer droit sur nous!
Misadventure on the Sea#114.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#117.src: We-we don't know! We can't exactly see it, but it seems huge!
Misadventure on the Sea#117.dst: On-on sait pas! On le voit pas bien, mais ça a l'air énorme!
Misadventure on the Sea#117.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#119.src: Uh... Where am I supposed to be looking at, exactly?
Misadventure on the Sea#119.dst: Euh... Je suis censé regarder où, exactement?
Misadventure on the Sea#119.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#120.src: I swear, it felt like the whole ocean was getting crazy a second ago!
Misadventure on the Sea#120.dst: Je te jure, on aurait dit que l'océan devenait fou il y a une seconde!
Misadventure on the Sea#120.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#121.src: If this is another one of your jokes...
Misadventure on the Sea#121.dst: Si c'est encore une de vos blagues...
Misadventure on the Sea#121.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#124.src: I don't know, this wasn't planned!
Misadventure on the Sea#124.dst: J'en sais rien, c'était pas prévu!
Misadventure on the Sea#124.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#125.src: Soldier, now's your time to shine! Scare it off with one of your spells or somethin'!
Misadventure on the Sea#125.dst: Soldat, à toi de briller! Fais-le fuir avec un de tes sorts ou un truc du genre!
Misadventure on the Sea#125.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#130.src: I knew you had it in ya, haha!
Misadventure on the Sea#130.dst: Je savais que t'en étais capable, haha!
Misadventure on the Sea#130.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#131.src: What a show! Come, I've got some things to tell ya!
Misadventure on the Sea#131.dst: Quel spectacle! Viens, j'ai des choses à te dire!
Misadventure on the Sea#131.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#132.src: I don't know where that creature came from, but thanks to you it's gone.
Misadventure on the Sea#132.dst: J'sais pas d'où sortait cette créature, mais grâce à toi, elle est partie.
Misadventure on the Sea#132.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#133.src: I've got somethin' else for you to tackle. It's about... the rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#133.dst: J'ai autre chose pour toi. Ça concerne... les rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#133.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#134.src: Come to the hold, I'll explain on the way.
Misadventure on the Sea#134.dst: Viens à la cale, je t'explique en chemin.
Misadventure on the Sea#134.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#135.src: I think we have quite a hellish problem on our hands.
Misadventure on the Sea#135.dst: Je crois qu'on a un problème infernal sur les bras.
Misadventure on the Sea#135.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#136.src: I'm not sure what ya'll find there, but these are NOT normal rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#136.dst: J'sais pas ce que tu vas trouver là-bas, mais c'est PAS des rats normaux.
Misadventure on the Sea#136.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#137.src: So please, get in there... and kill everything, alright?
Misadventure on the Sea#137.dst: Alors s'il te plaît, entre là-dedans... et tue tout, d'accord?
Misadventure on the Sea#137.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#138.src: I've got faith in ya. Here goes nothin'!
Misadventure on the Sea#138.dst: J'ai confiance en toi. Allez, on y va!
Misadventure on the Sea#138.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#139.src: Just cast one of your fancy spells!
Misadventure on the Sea#139.dst: Lance un de tes sorts tape-à-l'oeil!
Misadventure on the Sea#139.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#140.src: That was... Phew... That was something.
Misadventure on the Sea#140.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#141.src: Now, for an even bigger surprise...
Misadventure on the Sea#141.dst: Et maintenant, une surprise plus grosse...
Misadventure on the Sea#141.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#142.src: What the hell, soldier?? What don't you get in the "soldier" part of your job?
Misadventure on the Sea#142.dst: C'est quoi ce bazar, soldat?? T'as pas compris le mot "soldat"?
Misadventure on the Sea#142.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#143.src: Come, let's figure some things out.
Misadventure on the Sea#143.dst: Viens, on a des choses à mettre au clair.
Misadventure on the Sea#143.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#144.src: You've been a massive disappointment, y'know?
Misadventure on the Sea#144.dst: T'as été une énorme déception, tu sais?
Misadventure on the Sea#144.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#145.src: But you can still redeem yourself.
Misadventure on the Sea#145.dst: Mais tu peux encore te racheter.
Misadventure on the Sea#145.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#146.src: Follow me, I'll explain on the way.
Misadventure on the Sea#146.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#147.src: I mentioned a rat problem earlier... It's, uh, not a small one.
Misadventure on the Sea#147.dst: J'ai parlé d'un problème de rats tout à l'heure... Il est, euh, pas petit.
Misadventure on the Sea#147.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#148.src: We've got gunpowder to retrieve, so you're the one who's gonna clear the hold.
Misadventure on the Sea#148.dst: On doit récupérer de la poudre, alors c'est toi qui vas nettoyer la cale.
Misadventure on the Sea#148.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#149.src: So get in there... and try to kill everything, alright?
Misadventure on the Sea#149.dst: Alors entre là-dedans... et essaie de tout tuer, d'accord?
Misadventure on the Sea#149.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#150.src: Don't be as bad as earlier. You're a soldier.
Misadventure on the Sea#150.dst: Fais pas aussi mal que tout à l'heure. T'es un soldat.
Misadventure on the Sea#150.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#153.src: I expected you to do somethin', soldier, not him!
Misadventure on the Sea#153.dst: J'attendais que TOI tu agisses, soldat, pas lui!
Misadventure on the Sea#153.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#155.src: I have another task for you. It's about... the rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#155.dst: J'ai une autre tâche pour toi. Ça concerne... les rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#155.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#156.src: See, I really don't think we have your usual type of problem.
Misadventure on the Sea#156.dst: Vois-tu, je crois pas qu'on ait un problème ordinaire.
Misadventure on the Sea#156.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#157.src: That's why we're not too fond of goin' in... But our gunpowder there! We need it, as pirates!
Misadventure on the Sea#157.dst: C'est pour ça qu'on tient pas trop à y aller... Mais notre poudre est là! On en a besoin, on est pirates!
Misadventure on the Sea#157.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#158.src: So, I need you to get in... and kill everything, alright?
Misadventure on the Sea#158.dst: Alors, faut que t'entres là-dedans... et que tu tues tout, d'accord?
Misadventure on the Sea#158.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#159.src: Here goes nothing. Snoo, ya stay there!
Misadventure on the Sea#159.dst: Allez, on y va. Snoo, toi, tu restes là!
Misadventure on the Sea#159.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#160.src: Explore the hold and kill the rats
Misadventure on the Sea#160.dst: Explorez la cale et tuez les rats

Misadventure on the Sea#161.src: Defeat the Colossal Rat in the hold
Misadventure on the Sea#161.dst: Vainquez le Rat colossal dans la cale

Misadventure on the Sea#162.src: Use the gunpowder and the fuse to activate the cannon and escape
Misadventure on the Sea#162.dst: Utilisez la poudre et la mèche pour activer le canon et fuir

Misadventure on the Sea#163.src: Hey there! Ya bringin' me good news?
Misadventure on the Sea#163.dst: Hé, toi! Tu m'apportes de bonnes nouvelles?
Misadventure on the Sea#163.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#164.src: You took care of these damn thieving rodents? A... colossal rat you say?
Misadventure on the Sea#164.dst: Tu t'es occupé de ces fichus rongeurs voleurs? Un... rat colossal, tu dis?
Misadventure on the Sea#164.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#165.src: Nicely done, I knew I could count on ya! C'mere, take these!
Misadventure on the Sea#165.dst: Bien joué, je savais que je pouvais compter sur toi! Viens là, prends ça!
Misadventure on the Sea#165.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#166.src: Anyway, for now, you can go rest and do whatever you want!
Misadventure on the Sea#166.dst: Bref, pour l'instant, va te reposer et fais ce que tu veux!
Misadventure on the Sea#166.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#167.src: Well, shiver me timbers! You did redeem yourself, soldier!
Misadventure on the Sea#167.dst: Mille sabords! Tu t'es racheté, soldat!
Misadventure on the Sea#167.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#168.dst: Hé, soldat. La balade te plaît?

Misadventure on the Sea#169.src: Huh? It looks like there's a hidden lock in this bookshelf!
Misadventure on the Sea#169.dst: Hein? On dirait qu'il y a une serrure cachée dans cette bibliothèque!

Misadventure on the Sea#170.src: Where could the key be? Does the crew know about this?
Misadventure on the Sea#170.dst: Où peut bien être la clé? L'équipage est-il au courant?

Misadventure on the Sea#171.src: It's barely visible, it's probably not going to help on escaping.
Misadventure on the Sea#171.dst: Elle est à peine visible, elle ne vous aidera sûrement pas à fuir.

Misadventure on the Sea#172.src: That's definitely not a place to store gunpowder, nor a fuse.
Misadventure on the Sea#172.dst: Ce n'est clairement pas un endroit où ranger de la poudre, ni une mèche.

similar.text: You don't have to come.

Misadventure on the Sea#174.src: Huh? What did you do?? Oh well, whatever...
Misadventure on the Sea#174.dst: Hein? T'as fait quoi?? Bah, peu importe...

similar.text: {~} x Fake Tooth

Misadventure on the Sea#178.dst: C'est tout ce qu'il y avait.

Misadventure on the Sea#179.src: Mo'in, traveller, have you heard of Corkus? The new province filled with machines!
Misadventure on the Sea#179.dst: Mo'in, voyageur, vous connaissez Corkus? La nouvelle province pleine de machines!

Misadventure on the Sea#180.src: If you were level {~} I'd let you enter Corkus for free. Come back to me then!
Misadventure on the Sea#180.dst: Au niveau {~}, je vous laisserai entrer à Corkus gratis. Revenez me voir!

Misadventure on the Sea#181.src: That sounds absolutely terrifying! And ya did that alone! You know what, her', take these.
Misadventure on the Sea#181.dst: Ça a l'air terrifiant! Et t'as fait ça tout seul! Tu sais quoi, tiens, prends ça.
Misadventure on the Sea#181.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#182.src: Hey! What do you think you're doin'?!
Misadventure on the Sea#182.dst: Hé! Qu'est-ce que tu crois faire?!
Misadventure on the Sea#182.speaker: Pirate Guard

Misadventure on the Sea#184.src: No, but they did a great job in the hold! Some gunpowder went missing though.
Misadventure on the Sea#184.dst: Non, mais il a fait du bon boulot dans la cale! Il manque un peu de poudre, cela dit.
Misadventure on the Sea#184.speaker: Seth

Misadventure on the Sea#187.src: Find out where you are and a way to flee the island
Misadventure on the Sea#187.dst: Découvrez où vous êtes et trouvez un moyen de fuir l'île

Misadventure on the Sea#188.src: 'ey there soldier! Looks like ya're in a bit of a pickle! How 'bout ya hop on?'
Misadventure on the Sea#188.dst: Hé, soldat! On dirait que t'es dans le pétrin! Et si tu montais à bord?
Misadventure on the Sea#188.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#189.src: Well... We're headed for {p}, the heart of the ocean! Which is safer than wherever you were, heh!
Misadventure on the Sea#189.dst: Eh bien... On met le cap sur {p}, le coeur de l'océan! Plus sûr que là où t'étais, hé!
Misadventure on the Sea#189.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#190.src: I was casually takin' a scenic detour when I saw you and your shiny equipment on that island.
Misadventure on the Sea#190.dst: Je faisais tranquillement un détour panoramique quand je t'ai vu sur cette île, avec ton équipement brillant.
Misadventure on the Sea#190.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#191.src: So, ya gotta tell me what happened!
Misadventure on the Sea#191.dst: Alors, raconte-moi ce qui s'est passé!
Misadventure on the Sea#191.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#192.src: Oh, kidnapped by pirates I see! How unfortunate...
Misadventure on the Sea#192.dst: Oh, enlevé par des pirates, je vois! Pas de chance...
Misadventure on the Sea#192.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#193.src: I guess that'll show ya, tryin' to avoid using good ol' seaskipper! I'm the only trustworthy one 'round here.
Misadventure on the Sea#193.dst: Ça t'apprendra à éviter ce bon vieux Seaskipper! Je suis le seul digne de confiance par ici.
Misadventure on the Sea#193.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#194.src: Well, I hope they weren't too bad with ya! Here, I'll make you travel to {p} for free as compensation.
Misadventure on the Sea#194.dst: J'espère qu'ils t'ont pas trop malmené! Tiens, je t'emmène à {p} gratis, en dédommagement.
Misadventure on the Sea#194.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#195.src: Anyway, I can see the shore off in the distance! Hang tight, we're almost there!
Misadventure on the Sea#195.dst: Bref, je vois la côte au loin! Tiens bon, on y est presque!
Misadventure on the Sea#195.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Mixed Feelings#000.src: Speak to Javen at the Corkus Docks.
Mixed Feelings#000.dst: Parlez à Javen sur les quais de Corkus.

Mixed Feelings#001.src: Mo’in lad! We don’t get many Wynn folks round ‘ere.
Mixed Feelings#001.dst: Mo'in, mon gars! On voit pas beaucoup d'gens de Wynn par ici.
Mixed Feelings#001.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#002.src: Welcome to old Javen’s tavern, what can I do yer for?
Mixed Feelings#002.dst: Bienvenue à la taverne du vieux Javen, qu'est-ce que j'te sers?
Mixed Feelings#002.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#003.src: Let’s see... I can give ya some of the islands “Old Cork” Brew..
Mixed Feelings#003.dst: Voyons... J'peux te servir de la bière "Old Cork" de l'île..
Mixed Feelings#003.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#004.src: Seems like you are in luck today, adventurer.
Mixed Feelings#004.dst: On dirait que c'est votre jour de chance, aventurier.

Mixed Feelings#005.src: My day's been long, and you also look like you could do with a drink or two.
Mixed Feelings#005.dst: Ma journée a été longue, et vous m'avez l'air d'avoir besoin d'un verre ou deux.

Mixed Feelings#006.src: There's no need to pay by yourself. Javen, we'll have two cups of the seasonal brew.
Mixed Feelings#006.dst: Inutile de payer vous-même. Javen, deux chopes de la bière de saison.

Mixed Feelings#008.src: Everything alright, lad? Looking a bit pale...
Mixed Feelings#008.dst: Tout va bien, mon gars? T'es un peu pâle...
Mixed Feelings#008.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#010.src: Oh by the mighty founders, everything is ruined!
Mixed Feelings#010.dst: Oh, par les puissants fondateurs, tout est saccagé!
Mixed Feelings#010.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#012.src: You did this! Yer mad in the head! Possessed or summet!
Mixed Feelings#012.dst: C'est toi qu'as fait ça! T'es fou! Possédé ou j'sais pas quoi!
Mixed Feelings#012.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#013.src: Yer seem fine now though. What got inter ye lad? You went berserk like!
Mixed Feelings#013.dst: T'as l'air normal, là. Qu'est-ce qui t'a pris, mon gars? T'étais déchaîné!
Mixed Feelings#013.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#014.src: It weren’t just here neither. You ran outta here and wrecked all sorts! You better go find the people you affected and apologise
Mixed Feelings#014.dst: Et c'était pas qu'ici. T'es sorti en courant et t'as tout cassé! Tu ferais bien d'aller trouver les gens que t'as lésés et t'excuser
Mixed Feelings#014.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#015.src: Talk to the citizens around the docks.
Mixed Feelings#015.dst: Parlez aux habitants autour des quais.

Mixed Feelings#016.src: The whole aqueduct is ruined! The city's fresh water is just draining into the ocean...
Mixed Feelings#016.dst: Tout l'aqueduc est détruit! L'eau potable de la ville se déverse dans l'océan...
Mixed Feelings#016.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#017.src: Ah! It's you! Back to wreck the rest of the city's infrastructure?! You're meant to be a tourist!
Mixed Feelings#017.dst: Ah! C'est vous! Revenu détruire le reste des infrastructures?! Vous êtes censé être un touriste!
Mixed Feelings#017.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#018.src: Wait... Weren't your eyes red before? Were you ill? It was a bit scary.
Mixed Feelings#018.dst: Attendez... Vous n'aviez pas les yeux rouges? Vous étiez malade? Ça faisait peur.
Mixed Feelings#018.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#019.src: Oh.. You don't even remember? Well.. If you want to help, I need it right now.
Mixed Feelings#019.dst: Oh.. Vous ne vous en souvenez même pas? Bon.. Si vous voulez aider, c'est maintenant.
Mixed Feelings#019.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#020.src: The system needs to be rebooted, which can only be done down in the sewers.
Mixed Feelings#020.dst: Il faut redémarrer le système, et ça ne se fait que dans les égouts.
Mixed Feelings#020.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#021.src: Kind of a design flaw if you ask me.. But if you go down that trap door, you will find it in the sewers!
Mixed Feelings#021.dst: Un défaut de conception, si vous voulez mon avis.. Mais descendez par cette trappe, c'est dans les égouts!
Mixed Feelings#021.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#022.src: You fixed it? Everything you broke? That's one hell of a twisted personality.
Mixed Feelings#022.dst: Vous l'avez réparé? Tout ce que vous avez cassé? Quelle personnalité tordue.
Mixed Feelings#022.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#023.src: Corkus has been urging tourists and envoys from the other provinces to gain recognition.
Mixed Feelings#023.dst: Corkus incite les touristes et les envoyés des autres provinces à venir, pour se faire reconnaître.
Mixed Feelings#023.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#024.src: There are others that blame any outsiders for the problems of the islands.. They say they are patriots.. but honestly...
Mixed Feelings#024.dst: D'autres accusent les étrangers de tous les maux des îles.. Ils se disent patriotes.. mais franchement...
Mixed Feelings#024.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#025.src: They are just awful people. They want to do anything to make non Corkians look bad.
Mixed Feelings#025.dst: Ce sont juste des gens horribles. Ils feraient tout pour discréditer les non-Corkians.
Mixed Feelings#025.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#026.src: If I were you, I'd better start asking around to find out more about that!
Mixed Feelings#026.dst: Si j'étais vous, je me renseignerais là-dessus!
Mixed Feelings#026.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#027.src: Speak to the other citizens around the docks.
Mixed Feelings#027.dst: Parlez aux autres habitants autour des quais.

Mixed Feelings#028.src: It’s THEM! Someone call the authorities! It’s the one who set my house on fire.
Mixed Feelings#028.dst: C'est l'INCENDIAIRE! Qu'on appelle les autorités! C'est lui qui a brûlé ma maison.
Mixed Feelings#028.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#029.src: How could you do this and just come back all calm like? You were screaming your head off!
Mixed Feelings#029.dst: Comment pouvez-vous faire ça et revenir tout calme? Vous hurliez comme un fou!
Mixed Feelings#029.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#030.src: My house is still burning! Wait… You say you don’t have any memory of any of this?
Mixed Feelings#030.dst: Ma maison brûle encore! Attendez... Vous dites que vous ne vous souvenez de rien?
Mixed Feelings#030.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#031.src: Look, if you’re serious, you have a chance to help make it better.
Mixed Feelings#031.dst: Écoutez, si vous êtes sincère, vous pouvez arranger les choses.
Mixed Feelings#031.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#032.src: There are valuables in a chest in there you must save before the whole place burns to the ground, get going!
Mixed Feelings#032.dst: Il y a un coffre d'objets de valeur là-dedans à sauver avant que tout brûle, allez-y!
Mixed Feelings#032.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#033.src: You did it! So you weren't lying? Ugh, I guess you might just be trustworthy.
Mixed Feelings#033.dst: Vous avez réussi! Vous ne mentiez pas? Pff, vous êtes peut-être digne de confiance.
Mixed Feelings#033.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#034.src: You know about the 'patriots' of Corkus?
Mixed Feelings#034.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#035.src: Well this kind of maneuver is right up their alley.. It certainly made you look bad!
Mixed Feelings#035.dst: Ce genre de manoeuvre, c'est tout eux.. Ça vous a bien fait passer pour le méchant!
Mixed Feelings#035.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#036.src: Now that you bring it up, I did hear a group of Corkians quietly discussing something about framing tourists.
Mixed Feelings#036.dst: Maintenant que vous le dites, j'ai entendu des Corkians parler à voix basse de piéger des touristes.
Mixed Feelings#036.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#037.src: I have no idea how they would make you do something against your will though...
Mixed Feelings#037.dst: Mais je ne sais pas comment ils vous feraient agir contre votre volonté...
Mixed Feelings#037.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#038.src: Talk to the final victim of your rampage.
Mixed Feelings#038.dst: Parlez à la dernière victime de votre saccage.

Mixed Feelings#039.src: Came back to wreck the rest of my work have you? Why aren't you all insane looking?
Mixed Feelings#039.dst: Revenu saccager le reste de mon travail? Pourquoi vous n'avez plus l'air dément?
Mixed Feelings#039.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#040.src: So now your story is you were not in control? It's easy to believe. You were mad!
Mixed Feelings#040.dst: Alors maintenant, vous dites que vous ne contrôliez rien? Facile à croire. Vous étiez fou!
Mixed Feelings#040.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#041.src: I don't know if you have some kind of condition.. but if you want to help, I need it to clean up the mess you made.
Mixed Feelings#041.dst: Je ne sais pas si vous avez une maladie.. mais si vous voulez aider, réparez le gâchis que vous avez causé.
Mixed Feelings#041.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#042.src: I need to replace all the cargo you destroyed.
Mixed Feelings#042.dst: Je dois remplacer toute la cargaison détruite.
Mixed Feelings#042.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#043.src: All you gotta do is get those crates here and put them back on the boats. The limit is {~} for each boat, not more not less!
Mixed Feelings#043.dst: Il suffit d'apporter ces caisses ici et de les remettre sur les bateaux. La limite est de {~} par bateau, ni plus ni moins!
Mixed Feelings#043.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#044.src: Some weights might not be needed, but be careful, I don't wanna go diving after you.
Mixed Feelings#044.dst: Certains poids sont peut-être en trop, mais attention, j'ai pas envie de plonger.
Mixed Feelings#044.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#045.src: You did it? ... -I mean, at last. Eh... I guess I was too fast with my judgement for once.
Mixed Feelings#045.dst: Vous avez réussi? ... -Je veux dire, enfin. Euh... J'ai jugé trop vite, pour une fois.
Mixed Feelings#045.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#046.src: Hmm… As it happens I have seen some strange things around here.
Mixed Feelings#046.dst: Hmm... Justement, j'ai vu des choses étranges par ici.
Mixed Feelings#046.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#047.src: During the night I saw something moving across the cliffs.. Looked like a personal balloon.
Mixed Feelings#047.dst: La nuit, j'ai vu quelque chose bouger le long des falaises.. On aurait dit un ballon individuel.
Mixed Feelings#047.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#048.src: It wouldn't have been out of the ordinary except there are occasional blood trails leading from the balloon...
Mixed Feelings#048.dst: Rien d'extraordinaire, sauf qu'il y a parfois des traînées de sang qui partent du ballon...
Mixed Feelings#048.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#049.src: If you really want to approach these people… I guess all you would need to do is follow the trail of blood.
Mixed Feelings#049.dst: Si vous voulez vraiment approcher ces gens... il suffit de suivre la traînée de sang.
Mixed Feelings#049.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#050.src: Can't say I recommend it but the trail starts near the aqueduct.
Mixed Feelings#050.dst: Je ne vous le conseille pas, mais la traînée part près de l'aqueduc.
Mixed Feelings#050.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#051.src: Follow the trail of blood and board the airship.
Mixed Feelings#051.dst: Suivez la traînée de sang et montez dans le dirigeable.

Mixed Feelings#052.dst: Explorez le pied de la falaise.

Mixed Feelings#053.src: Why are you here? I don't mean here and now, I mean why are you on our island?
Mixed Feelings#053.dst: Pourquoi es-tu là? Pas ici et maintenant, je veux dire: pourquoi es-tu sur notre île?
Mixed Feelings#053.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#054.src: You have of course found yourself in front of me because you were a pawn in our attempts to save this nation.
Mixed Feelings#054.dst: Si tu te retrouves devant moi, c'est bien sûr parce que tu as été un pion dans nos efforts pour sauver cette nation.
Mixed Feelings#054.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#055.src: I suppose I should apologize, but truth is you are the reason for this movement. Not you personally... but your people.
Mixed Feelings#055.dst: Je devrais m'excuser, mais en vérité, tu es la raison de ce mouvement. Pas toi en personne... mais ton peuple.
Mixed Feelings#055.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#056.src: You... Look at yourself. You fight in a war you did not cause. You come from a land you don't even remember.
Mixed Feelings#056.dst: Toi... Regarde-toi. Tu mènes une guerre que tu n'as pas causée. Tu viens d'une terre dont tu ne te souviens même pas.
Mixed Feelings#056.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#057.src: We ask ourselves why would we invite people from two lands of sin. Invite a nation of warring travellers and a nation of greedy merchants to our doors?
Mixed Feelings#057.dst: Nous nous demandons pourquoi inviter les gens de deux terres de péché. Ouvrir nos portes à une nation de voyageurs belliqueux et à une nation de marchands cupides?
Mixed Feelings#057.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#058.src: The Corkian people are above such mundane capitalism and brutality. We work as a nation to better all.
Mixed Feelings#058.dst: Le peuple corkian est au-dessus de ce vil capitalisme et de cette brutalité. Unis, nous oeuvrons pour tous.
Mixed Feelings#058.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#059.src: You have been a pawn your entire existence on this world. The worst part is you don't even know it.
Mixed Feelings#059.dst: Tu as été un pion toute ton existence en ce monde. Le pire, c'est que tu ne le sais même pas.
Mixed Feelings#059.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#060.src: Do you, for example - Know the name of your ultimate enemy? The reason for the war on your land?
Mixed Feelings#060.dst: Connais-tu, par exemple, le nom de ton ennemi ultime? La raison de la guerre sur tes terres?
Mixed Feelings#060.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#061.src: No? Didn't think so. I have no time for this. You served your purpose, even if you did try and redeem your barbaric behaviour... Kill them!
Mixed Feelings#061.dst: Non? Je m'en doutais. Je n'ai pas de temps pour ça. Tu as servi, même si tu as tenté de racheter ta conduite barbare... Tuez-le!
Mixed Feelings#061.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#062.src: Fight and evade the waves of mobs until the timer runs out.
Mixed Feelings#062.dst: Combattez et esquivez les vagues de monstres jusqu'à la fin du chrono.

Mixed Feelings#063.src: Tougher than I expected. You don’t mind if I interfere a bit, do you?
Mixed Feelings#063.dst: Plus coriace que prévu. Ça ne te dérange pas que j'intervienne un peu?
Mixed Feelings#063.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#065.src: You may have won this fight, but you are still the loser in this situation.
Mixed Feelings#065.dst: Tu as peut-être gagné ce combat, mais tu restes le perdant dans cette histoire.
Mixed Feelings#065.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#066.src: Your eyes are still closed to the greater picture of it all. Corkus is the only place safe from it. I will make sure of it!
Mixed Feelings#066.dst: Tes yeux restent fermés sur l'ensemble du tableau. Corkus est le seul endroit à l'abri. J'y veillerai!
Mixed Feelings#066.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#067.src: There are still greater things in motion as we speak. Plans that will secure this island's safety.
Mixed Feelings#067.dst: De plus grandes choses sont en marche à l'heure où nous parlons. Des plans qui garantiront la sûreté de l'île.
Mixed Feelings#067.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#068.src: Fruma.. Gavel.. Wynn… It’s all a joke. We all sit on the cusp of this reality, fighting only the prelude to the real war.
Mixed Feelings#068.dst: Fruma.. Gavel.. Wynn... Tout ça n'est qu'une farce. Nous sommes au bord de cette réalité, ne livrant que le prélude de la vraie guerre.
Mixed Feelings#068.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#069.src: This is our farewell. I must depart before the short sighted government arrive. Good Luck with your struggle.
Mixed Feelings#069.dst: C'est ici que nos chemins se séparent. Je dois partir avant l'arrivée de ce gouvernement myope. Bonne chance dans ta lutte.
Mixed Feelings#069.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#071.src: Now look who we got over ‘ere! We were all wondering if you'd ever wake up.
Mixed Feelings#071.dst: Tiens, regardez qui voilà! On s'demandait tous si t'allais te réveiller un jour.
Mixed Feelings#071.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#072.src: Sorry we ever doubted ye. Weren't fair of us. What you drank was a rare brew designed to enrage and berserk someone.
Mixed Feelings#072.dst: Désolé d'avoir douté de toi. C'était pas juste. T'as bu un breuvage rare, fait pour rendre fou furieux.
Mixed Feelings#072.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#073.src: Basically, it weren't yer fault lad. We never knew some Corkians were so closed minded.
Mixed Feelings#073.dst: En gros, c'était pas ta faute, mon gars. On savait pas que des Corkians étaient si bornés.
Mixed Feelings#073.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#074.src: Anyways! Look at what we got, thanks to you I acquired this little place!
Mixed Feelings#074.dst: Bref! Regarde un peu, grâce à toi j'ai pu m'offrir ce petit local!
Mixed Feelings#074.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#075.src: By means of reparations have this on me. Yer always welcome round here.
Mixed Feelings#075.dst: En guise de réparation, c'est ma tournée. T'es toujours le bienvenu ici.
Mixed Feelings#075.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#076.src: Go for a drink at the Corkus Docks Inn, [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Mixed Feelings#076.dst: Allez boire un verre à l'auberge des quais de Corkus, [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Mixed Feelings#077.src: Talk to Javen to find out more about what happened.
Mixed Feelings#077.dst: Parlez à Javen pour en savoir plus sur ce qui s'est passé.

Mixed Feelings#078.src: You should ask Javen about what happened.
Mixed Feelings#078.dst: Vous devriez demander à Javen ce qui s'est passé.

Mixed Feelings#079.src: Talk to citizens around the docks to find out more about what happened.
Mixed Feelings#079.dst: Parlez aux habitants autour des quais pour en savoir plus sur ce qui s'est passé.

Mixed Feelings#080.src: You ran outta here and wrecked all sorts! You better go find the people you affected and apologise!
Mixed Feelings#080.dst: T'es sorti en courant et t'as tout cassé! Tu ferais bien d'aller trouver les gens que t'as lésés et t'excuser!
Mixed Feelings#080.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#081.src: Hurry, please! Just head into the big trapdoor by the bushes, the controls are in there.
Mixed Feelings#081.dst: Vite, s'il vous plaît! Descendez par la grande trappe près des buissons, les commandes sont là-dedans.
Mixed Feelings#081.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#082.src: > Thank you for choosingsing CorkTech! Your company for a safe and trustworthy service.
Mixed Feelings#082.dst: > Merci d'avoir choisisisi CorkTech! Votre partenaire pour un service sûr et fiable.

Mixed Feelings#084.src: You can push the button beside the crates to pick them up, and stand on the pressure plate to place them.
Mixed Feelings#084.dst: Appuyez sur le bouton près des caisses pour les prendre, et placez-vous sur la plaque de pression pour les déposer.
Mixed Feelings#084.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#085.src: It seems like all crates are balanced now.
Mixed Feelings#085.dst: On dirait que toutes les caisses sont équilibrées.

Mixed Feelings#086.src: I learned about some rumours involving separatists. I should continue helping locals to find out more.
Mixed Feelings#086.dst: J'ai entendu des rumeurs sur des séparatistes. Je devrais continuer d'aider les habitants pour en savoir plus.

Mixed Feelings#087.src: Someone told you more about the patriots of Corkus. You should continue to find the missing clue.
Mixed Feelings#087.dst: Quelqu'un vous en a dit plus sur les patriotes de Corkus. Continuez à chercher l'indice manquant.

Mixed Feelings#088.src: You manage to reach the chest safely, getting ready to jump through a hole the fire burned.
Mixed Feelings#088.dst: Vous atteignez le coffre sans encombre, et vous vous préparez à sauter par un trou ouvert par le feu.

Mixed Feelings#089.src: Follow the trail of blood close to the castle, [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Mixed Feelings#089.dst: Suivez la traînée de sang près du château, [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Mixed Feelings#090.src: You really don't see a reason to go in there at the moment.
Mixed Feelings#090.dst: Vous ne voyez vraiment aucune raison d'entrer là pour l'instant.

Mixed Feelings#091.src: Use the balloon to enter the suspicious hideout.
Mixed Feelings#091.dst: Utilisez le ballon pour entrer dans la cachette suspecte.

Mixed Feelings#092.src: Survive the fight against the drugged corkian
Mixed Feelings#092.dst: Survivez au combat contre le Corkian drogué

Mixed Feelings#093.src: After witnessing your crash into the cliff, Corkian citizens informed the government.
Mixed Feelings#093.dst: Après vous avoir vu vous écraser contre la falaise, des habitants de Corkus ont prévenu le gouvernement.

Mixed Feelings#094.src: Shortly after your victory security forces found the hideout and arrested the remaining separatists.
Mixed Feelings#094.dst: Peu après votre victoire, les forces de sécurité ont trouvé la cachette et arrêté les derniers séparatistes.

Mixed Feelings#095.src: Their leader was nowhere to be found.

Mixed Feelings#096.src: Always nice to see my favourite customer pay a visit!
Mixed Feelings#096.dst: Toujours un plaisir de voir mon client préféré passer!
Mixed Feelings#096.speaker: Javen

Murder Mystery#000.src: It's some kind of snake symbol, but it's probably not useful to you now.
Murder Mystery#000.dst: Une sorte de symbole de serpent, sans doute inutile pour l'instant.

Murder Mystery#001.src: If you find any more leads remember to come to me - and if you find the murder weapon, make sure to bring it to us immediately!
Murder Mystery#001.dst: Si vous trouvez d'autres pistes, venez me voir, et si vous trouvez l'arme du crime, apportez-la-nous immédiatement!

Murder Mystery#002.src: Have you made any progress? There was a smashed window in there, it might be a good place to start.
Murder Mystery#002.dst: Vous avez avancé? Il y avait une fenêtre brisée là-dedans, ce serait un bon point de départ.

Murder Mystery#003.src: It looks like the victim's head was somehow detatched from his body...
Murder Mystery#003.dst: On dirait que la tête de la victime a été séparée du corps...

Murder Mystery#004.src: The victim's book collection seems to be exclusively made up of dimestore romance novels.
Murder Mystery#004.dst: La bibliothèque de la victime semble uniquement composée de romans à l'eau de rose bon marché.

Murder Mystery#005.src: This painting doesn't seem to have anything to do with the murder, but its a nice landscape of {p}.
Murder Mystery#005.dst: Ce tableau ne semble avoir aucun lien avec le meurtre, mais c'est un joli paysage de {p}.

Murder Mystery#006.src: This half-finished letter seems to be asking for a loan to pay off some kind of debt...
Murder Mystery#006.dst: Cette lettre inachevée semble demander un prêt pour rembourser une sorte de dette...

Murder Mystery#007.src: It looks like the attacker managed to break in through the window.
Murder Mystery#007.dst: On dirait que l'agresseur est entré par la fenêtre.

Murder Mystery#008.src: It's a letter addressed to someone called Rohem in House No. {~} in {p}.
Murder Mystery#008.dst: C'est une lettre adressée à un certain Rohem, maison n° {~}, à {p}.
Murder Mystery#008.speaker: Tattered Letter

Murder Mystery#009.src: If you can find it, it will show you the way to get into the sewers. I'm sorry, I would tell you more if I knew more. But good luck with your investigation.
Murder Mystery#009.dst: Si vous le trouvez, il vous montrera comment entrer dans les égouts. Désolé, je vous en dirais plus si j'en savais plus. Bonne chance pour votre enquête.
Murder Mystery#009.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#010.src: Some of those gamblers had a symbol built into their homes, shaped like a snake. If you find it, it'll show you the way into the sewers. Good luck, officer.
Murder Mystery#010.dst: Certains de ces joueurs avaient un symbole intégré à leur maison, en forme de serpent. Si vous le trouvez, il vous montrera l'entrée des égouts. Bonne chance, agent.
Murder Mystery#010.speaker: Cinfras Citizen

Murder Mystery#011.src: The barkeeper takes the snake symbol and examines it for a moment before nodding and giving it back to you.
Murder Mystery#011.dst: Le tavernier prend le symbole du serpent et l'examine un instant, puis hoche la tête et vous le rend.
Murder Mystery#011.speaker: Barkeeper

Murder Mystery#012.src: The barkeeper gestures down to the open trapdoor.
Murder Mystery#012.dst: Le tavernier vous désigne la trappe ouverte.

Murder Mystery#013.src: But the day he brought Eminar 'round, though, it got ugly fast. Kept borrowing Rohem's emeralds and losing, til neither of em had anythin' left.
Murder Mystery#013.dst: Mais le jour où il a ramené Eminar, ça a vite mal tourné. Il empruntait les émeraudes de Rohem et perdait, jusqu'à c'qu'il leur reste plus rien.
Murder Mystery#013.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#014.src: Now get out of 'ere; there's a back exit in the wall over there. Though, if ya ever fancy a game of 'jack, come back 'n we'll be happy to serve ya!
Murder Mystery#014.dst: Maintenant, dégage; y a une sortie à l'arrière, dans ce mur. Mais si un jour t'as envie d'un blackjack, reviens, on s'ra ravis de t'servir!
Murder Mystery#014.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#015.src: What are ya lingerin' around 'ere for? I've told ya all I know. Now either take a seat or get out.
Murder Mystery#015.dst: Pourquoi tu traînes encore ici? J't'ai dit tout c'que j'sais. Maintenant, soit tu t'assois, soit tu sors.

Murder Mystery#016.src: Ya can then hit and get another card as many times as ya want, or stand and end ya turn. The aim is to get the value of your hand as close to {~} as possible!
Murder Mystery#016.dst: Ensuite, tu peux tirer une carte autant de fois que tu veux, ou rester et finir ton tour. Le but: approcher le plus possible {~} avec ta main!
Murder Mystery#016.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#017.src: It seems like you better go have a chat with Rohem...
Murder Mystery#017.dst: Vous feriez bien d'aller discuter avec Rohem...

Murder Mystery#018.src: You should look around for clues that tie Rohem to the murder.
Murder Mystery#018.dst: Cherchez des indices qui relient Rohem au meurtre.
Murder Mystery#018.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#019.src: Get out of my house, officer, and don't you dare go rooting around in my property!
Murder Mystery#019.dst: Sortez de chez moi, agent, et ne vous avisez pas de fouiner dans mes affaires!
Murder Mystery#019.speaker: Grook

Murder Mystery#020.src: It's a dirty shovel - it must've been used recently to dig something up.
Murder Mystery#020.dst: C'est une pelle sale; elle a dû servir récemment à déterrer quelque chose.

Murder Mystery#021.src: There's a trail of muddy footprints leading back into the house.
Murder Mystery#021.dst: Des traces de pas boueuses ramènent vers l'intérieur de la maison.

Murder Mystery#022.src: Whatever, you pale-faced walking cowlick. You're headed to {p} with a charge of first-class murder. Guards, take him away.
Murder Mystery#022.dst: C'est ça, épi ambulant au teint blafard. Direction {p}, inculpé de meurtre avec préméditation. Gardes, emmenez-le.
Murder Mystery#022.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#023.src: Thank you for your help in catching the perpetrator!
Murder Mystery#023.dst: Merci de votre aide pour arrêter le coupable!
Murder Mystery#023.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#024.src: Looks like the symbol has something carved in on the back...
Murder Mystery#024.dst: On dirait que quelque chose est gravé au dos du symbole...

Murder Mystery#026.src: Stand back, human! This is a crime scene, under my authority. I cannot let you inside.
Murder Mystery#026.dst: Reculez, humain! C'est une scène de crime, sous mon autorité. Je ne peux pas vous laisser entrer.
Murder Mystery#026.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#027.src: Although we are in need of some... assistance... and you are fairly experienced, are you not?
Murder Mystery#027.dst: Cela dit, nous aurions besoin d'un peu... d'aide... et vous avez une certaine expérience, n'est-ce pas?
Murder Mystery#027.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#028.src: Well, straight to the point... do you think I might be able to hire you as a private investigator?
Murder Mystery#028.dst: Bon, droit au but... pourrais-je vous engager comme détective privé?
Murder Mystery#028.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#029.src: To put it bluntly, the owner of this house, Eminar, was murdered a few days ago, and what few leads we had have all gone cold.
Murder Mystery#029.dst: Pour être franc, le propriétaire de cette maison, Eminar, a été assassiné il y a quelques jours, et nos rares pistes n'ont rien donné.
Murder Mystery#029.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#030.src: This is acting outside protocol, of course... but if you manage to catch the killer, I'm sure I could pull some strings and pay you for your work!
Murder Mystery#030.dst: C'est contraire au protocole, bien sûr... mais si vous attrapez le tueur, je pourrai sûrement faire jouer mes relations et vous payer pour votre travail!
Murder Mystery#030.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#031.src: I'll make sure no one stops you inside the crime scene. Head inside the house and see if you can find anything helpful.
Murder Mystery#031.dst: Je veillerai à ce que personne ne vous arrête sur la scène de crime. Entrez dans la maison et cherchez ce qui pourrait nous aider.
Murder Mystery#031.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#032.src: My soldiers and I will keep watch outside the house, and make sure you're not disturbed. Be careful in there!
Murder Mystery#032.dst: Mes soldats et moi surveillerons l'extérieur pour qu'on ne vous dérange pas. Soyez prudent là-dedans!
Murder Mystery#032.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#033.src: Investigate the crime scene at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] for clues.
Murder Mystery#033.dst: Examinez la scène de crime en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] pour trouver des indices.

Murder Mystery#034.src: Ah, a human! A refreshing sight these days. You've come to see me, I presume? What brings you here?
Murder Mystery#034.dst: Ah, un humain! Ça fait plaisir à voir, ces temps-ci. Vous venez me voir, je présume? Qu'est-ce qui vous amène?
Murder Mystery#034.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#035.src: An investigation!? Eminar? That's... that's absurd. I've done nothing wrong.
Murder Mystery#035.dst: Une enquête!? Eminar? C'est... c'est absurde. Je n'ai rien fait de mal.
Murder Mystery#035.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#036.src: Still, the poor man. Eminar and I were good friends, you know. If it could help find his killer, I may have some information for you... strictly off-record, of course...
Murder Mystery#036.dst: Tout de même, le pauvre homme. Eminar et moi étions bons amis, vous savez. Si ça peut aider à trouver son assassin, j'ai peut-être des informations... officieuses, bien sûr...
Murder Mystery#036.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#037.src: Well. You see, there's an underground gambling den hidden in the city's sewers. Only the elite can get in, and Eminar happened to be a frequent visitor.
Murder Mystery#037.dst: Eh bien. Voyez-vous, il y a un tripot clandestin caché dans les égouts de la ville. Seule l'élite peut y entrer, et Eminar y était un habitué.
Murder Mystery#037.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#038.src: Once, he even brought me along with him.
Murder Mystery#038.dst: Une fois, il m'y a même emmené.
Murder Mystery#038.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#039.src: Eminar, though, he often tried to cheat the other gamblers. I suppose it was only a matter of time before they had enough; most do not take cheating lightly.
Murder Mystery#039.dst: Mais Eminar essayait souvent de tricher avec les autres joueurs. Ce n'était qu'une question de temps avant qu'ils en aient assez; la triche, ça ne pardonne pas.
Murder Mystery#039.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#040.src: Back to the point, many of them, including poor Eminar, had a symbol built into the sides of their homes, shaped like a snake. A proof of membership, you could say.
Murder Mystery#040.dst: Bref, beaucoup d'entre eux, dont le pauvre Eminar, avaient un symbole en forme de serpent intégré au mur de leur maison. Une preuve d'adhésion, en quelque sorte.
Murder Mystery#040.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#041.src: Return to the victim's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find a snake symbol.
Murder Mystery#041.dst: Retournez chez la victime en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] pour trouver un symbole de serpent.

Murder Mystery#042.src: Find the gamblers in the {p} sewers.
Murder Mystery#042.dst: Trouvez les joueurs dans les égouts de {p}.

Murder Mystery#043.src: How did ya find us down 'ere? I don't remember you... you're with the police, aren't ya? Here after Eminar, I suppose?
Murder Mystery#043.dst: Comment tu nous as trouvés, en bas? J'te remets pas... t'es de la police, hein? Tu viens pour Eminar, j'parie?
Murder Mystery#043.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#044.src: Yeah, we've 'eard about what happened to him. Murders don't happen every day up there, ya know. And as it happened, I saw Eminar down here, not too long ago...
Murder Mystery#044.dst: Ouais, on a appris c'qui lui est arrivé. Là-haut, on tue pas tous les jours, tu sais. Et justement, j'ai vu Eminar ici, y a pas si longtemps...
Murder Mystery#044.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#045.src: Well... as long as I get a guarantee I won't be shut down, I'll help ya. This is a very profitable place, as I'm sure ya might've guessed.
Murder Mystery#045.dst: Bon... si on m'garantit qu'on m'fermera pas, j'vais t'aider. C'est un endroit très rentable, comme tu t'en doutes sûrement.
Murder Mystery#045.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#046.src: He was brought down here by his friend one day. Rohem, it was. A fine customer, you understand. Never failed to pay his dues...
Murder Mystery#046.dst: Un jour, son ami l'a amené ici. Rohem, qu'il s'appelait. Un bon client, tu vois. Il payait toujours ses dettes...
Murder Mystery#046.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#047.src: It was a good day for me, for obvious reasons, don'cha see! But Rohem was furious. Dead drunk, too, but what else is new!
Murder Mystery#047.dst: Pour moi, c'était une bonne journée, ça s'comprend! Mais Rohem était furieux. Ivre mort, aussi, mais ça, c'est pas nouveau!
Murder Mystery#047.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#048.src: Neither of 'em has been back since, though in Eminar's case, I can see why! And I hope that's enough for ya, 'cause that's all I got.
Murder Mystery#048.dst: Aucun des deux est revenu depuis, mais pour Eminar, ça s'comprend! J'espère que ça t'suffit, parce que j'ai rien d'autre.
Murder Mystery#048.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#049.src: Confront Rohem about the murder at house #{~} in {p}.
Murder Mystery#049.dst: Confrontez Rohem au sujet du meurtre, maison n° {~}, à {p}.

Murder Mystery#050.src: Ah... you again! You're back. I see that. I must admit, I did not expect you to return... so soon...
Murder Mystery#050.dst: Ah... encore vous! Vous êtes revenu. Je vois ça. J'avoue que je ne m'attendais pas à vous revoir... si tôt...
Murder Mystery#050.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#051.src: You really did find your way down there? Oh, that's... excellent... I hope the investigation is going well. Now if you'll just leave me be-
Murder Mystery#051.dst: Vous avez vraiment trouvé le chemin? Oh, c'est... excellent... J'espère que l'enquête avance. Maintenant, si vous voulez bien me laisser-
Murder Mystery#051.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#052.src: Valimare? Bah! Why would you trust anything he says? He's a criminal! A scam artist! I mean, I did direct you to him, but...
Murder Mystery#052.dst: Valimare? Bah! Pourquoi croire ce qu'il dit? C'est un criminel! Un escroc! Bon, c'est moi qui vous ai envoyé à lui, mais...
Murder Mystery#052.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#053.src: He- He's the one you should be arresting. Eminar was a danger to society, got what he deserved, the fool-
Murder Mystery#053.dst: Lui- C'est lui que vous devriez arrêter. Eminar était un danger public, il a eu ce qu'il méritait, l'imbécile-
Murder Mystery#053.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#054.src: Wait! No! Don't turn me in! Can't you let me finish my drink in peace? Get out, get out, you can't prove anything!
Murder Mystery#054.dst: Attendez! Non! Ne me livrez pas! Laissez-moi finir mon verre en paix! Dehors, dehors, vous ne pouvez rien prouver!
Murder Mystery#054.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#055.src: Besides, have you ever heard of a little thing called evidence? You don't have any proof!
Murder Mystery#055.dst: D'ailleurs, vous avez déjà entendu parler d'une petite chose appelée preuves? Vous n'en avez aucune!
Murder Mystery#055.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#056.src: Now, officer, if you don't have a proper warrant, I expect you to vacate my property immediately!
Murder Mystery#056.dst: Maintenant, agent, si vous n'avez pas de mandat en règle, je vous prie de quitter ma propriété sur-le-champ!
Murder Mystery#056.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#057.src: Find the murder weapon around Rohem's house at house #{~} in {p}.
Murder Mystery#057.dst: Cherchez l'arme du crime autour de la maison de Rohem, maison n° {~}, à {p}.

Murder Mystery#058.src: Hi! I'm digging a hole in my garden, just like Mr. Rohem did last night!
Murder Mystery#058.dst: Salut! Je creuse un trou dans mon jardin, comme M. Rohem la nuit dernière!
Murder Mystery#058.speaker: Child

Murder Mystery#059.src: For the last time officer, would you either show me a warrant or get out of my- what are you doing in my garden?!
Murder Mystery#059.dst: Pour la dernière fois, agent, montrez-moi un mandat ou sortez de ma- qu'est-ce que vous faites dans mon jardin?!
Murder Mystery#059.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#060.src: A... a hatchet? I don't know what you mean, I- I've never seen that before in my life!
Murder Mystery#060.dst: Une... une hachette? Je ne vois pas de quoi vous parlez, je- je ne l'ai jamais vue de ma vie!
Murder Mystery#060.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#061.src: Gah! Curse you, human! I might be headed to jail, but I can send you straight to hell!
Murder Mystery#061.dst: Argh! Maudit humain! J'irai peut-être en prison, mais je peux vous envoyer droit en enfer!
Murder Mystery#061.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#062.src: That's enough, Rohem! Stand down, or the guards will attack.
Murder Mystery#062.dst: Ça suffit, Rohem! Rends-toi, ou les gardes attaqueront.
Murder Mystery#062.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#063.src: Augh! Fine, you've got me. But mark my words, this won't be the last you hear of me, human!
Murder Mystery#063.dst: Argh! D'accord, vous m'avez eu. Mais retenez bien: vous entendrez encore parler de moi, humain!
Murder Mystery#063.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#064.src: As for you, human, please accept my immense gratitude. We probably wouldn't have caught that rat without you.
Murder Mystery#064.dst: Quant à vous, humain, acceptez toute ma gratitude. Sans vous, nous n'aurions sans doute jamais attrapé ce rat.
Murder Mystery#064.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#065.src: On behalf of the city of {p}, please accept these emeralds as compensation for your services. You were a fine detective today!
Murder Mystery#065.dst: Au nom de la ville de {p}, acceptez ces émeraudes en paiement de vos services. Vous avez été un fin détective aujourd'hui!
Murder Mystery#065.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#066.src: Heya there! Fancy a quick game of blackjack?
Murder Mystery#066.dst: Salut toi! Ça te dit, une petite partie de blackjack?
Murder Mystery#066.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#068.src: Good stuff! Put ya money in the pot and I'll start the deal.
Murder Mystery#068.dst: Super! Mets ton argent dans le pot, et je distribue.
Murder Mystery#068.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#069.src: Not feelin' up to playin' right now? No worries, just drop by later!
Murder Mystery#069.dst: Pas d'humeur à jouer pour l'instant? Pas de souci, repasse plus tard!
Murder Mystery#069.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#070.src: Not right now? No worries - come back another time!
Murder Mystery#070.dst: Pas maintenant? Pas de souci, reviens une autre fois!
Murder Mystery#070.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#071.src: Ah, new to the game huh? No worries, lemme tell ya all about it!
Murder Mystery#071.dst: Ah, nouveau au jeu, hein? Pas de souci, j'vais tout t'expliquer!
Murder Mystery#071.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#072.src: The rules are simple! I deal two cards face up to ya both face down, and two cards to me, one face up and one face down.
Murder Mystery#072.dst: Les règles sont simples! Je te donne deux cartes face cachée, et deux pour moi, une face visible et une face cachée.
Murder Mystery#072.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#073.src: Number cards are worth what they say, all picture cards are worth {~}, and an ace can be worth either {~} or {~}, whichever works best for ya hand.
Murder Mystery#073.dst: Les cartes à chiffres valent leur nombre, les figures valent {~}, et un as vaut {~} ou {~}, selon ce qui arrange ta main.
Murder Mystery#073.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#074.src: Go over {~} and that's it - you're bust! Stand with your current hand and it's my turn to hit or stand to try and beat your hand.
Murder Mystery#074.dst: Dépasse {~}, et c'est fini: t'as sauté! Si tu restes avec ta main, c'est à moi de tirer ou rester pour essayer de te battre.
Murder Mystery#074.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#075.src: And if ya get a blackjack - that's an ace and a picture card or a ten - ya automatically get double ya money back!
Murder Mystery#075.dst: Et si t'as un blackjack, c'est-à-dire un as et une figure ou un dix, tu récupères automatiquement le double de ta mise!
Murder Mystery#075.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#076.src: Sound fair enough? Alrighty, just right-click me again to play!
Murder Mystery#076.dst: Ça te paraît juste? C'est parti, refais un clic droit sur moi pour jouer!
Murder Mystery#076.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Mushroom Man#000.src: I'm sorry, recruit, but that passage is blocked. We used to use it, but not anymore...
Mushroom Man#000.dst: Désolé, recrue, mais ce passage est bloqué. On l'utilisait avant, mais plus maintenant...

Mushroom Man#001.src: He's... difficult. He's the son of my sister, who we lost to spiders some time ago.
Mushroom Man#001.dst: Il est... difficile. C'est le fils de ma soeur, que les araignées nous ont prise il y a un moment.

similar.text: He's... difficult. He's the son of my sister, who was unfortunately killed by spiders some time ago.

Mushroom Man#002.src: With his father out of the picture, I had to take him in. He's a grown man now, yes, but... I fear the loss has taken its toll on us both.
Mushroom Man#002.dst: Son père n'étant plus là, j'ai dû le recueillir. C'est un adulte maintenant, oui, mais... je crains que cette perte nous ait marqués tous les deux.

Mushroom Man#003.src: I truly hope he will cease with these ridiculous ploys soon... but I can't bring myself to do more than give him a stern talking to.
Mushroom Man#003.dst: J'espère sincèrement qu'il cessera bientôt ces manigances ridicules... mais je n'arrive pas à faire plus que le sermonner sévèrement.

Mushroom Man#004.src: He's a good man, truly. I believe that with my whole heart. I only wish he would show that side of himself to others.
Mushroom Man#004.dst: C'est un brave homme, vraiment. J'en suis convaincu de tout mon coeur. J'aimerais juste qu'il montre ce côté de lui aux autres.

Mushroom Man#005.src: {u}, hello! This place really is nice, isn't it? I'd like to stay a while longer before moving on towards {p}, but I'll be ready soon.
Mushroom Man#005.dst: {u}, salut! Cet endroit est vraiment sympa, hein? J'aimerais rester encore un peu avant de repartir vers {p}, mais je serai bientôt prêt.
Mushroom Man#005.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#006.src: You need to be Woodcutting Lv. {~} to start this Mini-Quest.
Mushroom Man#006.dst: Il faut le niveau {~} en bûcheronnage pour lancer cette mini-quête.

Mushroom Man#007.src: We can kill spiders! Right, {u}? Come on, this is what we're here to do! We became soldiers to help the people of Wynn, didn't we? We'll help you get your mushrooms back, sir.
Mushroom Man#007.dst: Tuer des araignées, on sait faire! Pas vrai, {u}? Allez, c'est pour ça qu'on est là! On s'est engagés pour aider les gens de Wynn, non? On va récupérer vos champignons, monsieur.

Mushroom Man#008.src: H-hm. Good. I can't m-make my soup without... mushrooms. F-follow me, I'll take you to the-... the spiders. B-bad spiders.
Mushroom Man#008.dst: H-hm. Bien. Je peux pas f-faire ma soupe sans... champignons. S-suivez-moi, je vous emmène aux-... aux araignées. M-méchantes araignées.
Mushroom Man#008.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#009.src: Ah, you two must be the the recruits Aledar has been telling us all about. It's good to finally meet you, though I can't help but notice you seem to have arrived in a rush.
Mushroom Man#009.dst: Ah, vous devez être les recrues dont Aledar nous parle tant. Ravi de vous rencontrer enfin, mais je remarque que vous semblez arriver en hâte.
Mushroom Man#009.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#010.src: O-oh! No, t-there's nothing going on. Not a th-thing. My m-m-mushrooms are... they're fine. Why are you a-asking? Ev-... everything is g-great. W-why wouldn't it b-be?
Mushroom Man#010.dst: O-oh! Non, i-il se passe rien. R-rien du tout. Mes ch-ch-champignons sont... ils vont bien. Pourquoi vous d-demandez ça? T-tout va... tout va t-très bien. P-pourquoi ça irait pas?
Mushroom Man#010.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#011.src: Soon... s-soon I will have my m-mushrooms again...
Mushroom Man#011.dst: Bientôt... b-bientôt j'aurai de nouveau mes ch-champignons...

Mushroom Man#012.src: G-gah! D-don't you know it's rude to-... to e-eavesdrop?
Mushroom Man#012.dst: G-gah! C'est mal é-élevé d'é-écouter aux portes, non?

Mushroom Man#013.src: I-... this is bad. This is really bad. We need to tell the Mayor, now.
Mushroom Man#013.dst: Je-... c'est grave. Vraiment grave. Il faut prévenir le maire, tout de suite.
Mushroom Man#013.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#014.src: Right! Right. We've arrived from {p}, with bad news and a request for aid. The spiders of the forest have grown hostile, and threaten the town.
Mushroom Man#014.dst: Oui! Oui. Nous arrivons de {p}, avec de mauvaises nouvelles et une demande d'aide. Les araignées de la forêt sont devenues hostiles et menacent le village.
Mushroom Man#014.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#015.src: And Lieutenant Van is planning a raid on a corrupt stronghold! I'm sure he'd be glad to have more forces with him.
Mushroom Man#015.dst: Et le lieutenant Van prépare un assaut contre une forteresse corrompue! Il serait sûrement content d'avoir des renforts.
Mushroom Man#015.speaker: Aledar

Mushroom Man#017.src: In the meantime, I've been thinking about what we could do to help this place... I've maybe got something.
Mushroom Man#017.dst: En attendant, j'ai réfléchi à ce qu'on pourrait faire pour aider cet endroit... J'ai peut-être une idée.
Mushroom Man#017.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#018.src: Take a look at that villager over there. He's acting a little off, like he's got something going on. I wonder...
Mushroom Man#018.dst: Regarde ce villageois là-bas. Il a l'air un peu bizarre, comme s'il avait un souci. Je me demande...
Mushroom Man#018.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#019.src: Alright, I've decided. I'm feeling a little restless, so let's go over there and see if there's anything we can help with!
Mushroom Man#019.dst: Bon, c'est décidé. Je ne tiens plus en place, alors allons voir là-bas si on peut donner un coup de main!
Mushroom Man#019.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#020.src: Maybe we can leave this place better off than it was when we got here!
Mushroom Man#020.dst: On pourra peut-être laisser cet endroit en meilleur état qu'à notre arrivée!
Mushroom Man#020.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#021.src: Speak to the strange man at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Mushroom Man#022.src: Speak to the strange man at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Mushroom Man#023.src: G-... Hi! H-how can I help you on this... this p-perfectly fine and n-n-normal day!
