Off the Rails#627.dst: Malic est si gentil... Tu sais, quand j'ai visité {p}, j'ai trouvé les habitants... intimidants, pas aimables. Mais Malic? Il est différent.
Off the Rails#627.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#628.src: ...To be honest, I was feeling a little... negative, about the way things were over there. But... I think Malic has given me a new perspective.
Off the Rails#628.dst: ...Pour être honnête, j'avais un regard un peu... négatif sur la façon dont ça se passe là-bas. Mais... je crois que Malic m'a ouvert les yeux.
Off the Rails#628.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#629.src: I'm glad to have met him.
Off the Rails#629.dst: Je suis contente de l'avoir rencontré.
Off the Rails#629.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#630.src: Uhm... I did know her, a bit. Not personally, but I was familiar with her as a person, you know..?
Off the Rails#630.dst: Euh... Je la connaissais, un peu. Pas personnellement, mais je savais qui elle était, tu vois..?
Off the Rails#630.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#631.src: Back home in {p}, they do military parades all the time. I saw her there a lot.
Off the Rails#631.dst: Chez moi, à {p}, il y a tout le temps des défilés militaires. Je l'y ai souvent vue.
Off the Rails#631.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#632.src: She was the leader of the Constables Division, and, and...
Off the Rails#632.dst: C'était la cheffe de la Division des agents, et, et...
Off the Rails#632.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#634.src: MALIC! I think I... No... Uhmmm...
Off the Rails#634.dst: MALIC! Je crois que je... Non... Euhhh...
Off the Rails#634.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#635.src: Ah, the crossword? You got one, finally?
Off the Rails#635.dst: Ah, les mots croisés? Tu as trouvé un mot, enfin?
Off the Rails#635.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#636.src: I... I don't know! I don't know!!!
Off the Rails#636.dst: Je... Je ne sais pas! Je ne sais pas!!!
Off the Rails#636.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#637.src: Maddie here was telling me of her visit to the Roughworks, and her thoughts on our culture, so I thought I'd give her a quiz, see.
Off the Rails#637.dst: Maddie me racontait sa visite à Roughworks et ce qu'elle pense de notre culture, alors j'ai eu l'idée de la tester, tu vois.
Off the Rails#637.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#638.src: It's a crossword from my favourite magazine, Puzzle Factory. Thought it might, y'know, help take her mind off things.
Off the Rails#638.dst: C'est une grille de mon magazine préféré, La Fabrique à énigmes. Je me disais que ça pourrait, tu sais, lui changer les idées.
Off the Rails#638.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#640.src: HEY!!! Well... if it's so easy, SOLVE IT!
Off the Rails#640.dst: HÉ!!! Eh bien... si c'est si facile, RÉSOUS-LA!
Off the Rails#640.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#641.src: You know, I was going to say something else, but now I forgot!!!
Off the Rails#641.dst: Tu sais, j'allais dire autre chose, mais là j'ai oublié!!!
Off the Rails#641.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#643.src: Maybe it'll clear your head if our friend here solves the crossword. Proves it's easy.
Off the Rails#643.dst: Ça t'éclaircira peut-être les idées si la personne ici présente remplit la grille. Ça prouvera que c'est facile.
Off the Rails#643.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#645.src: Alright, fine! Go on! do the crossword!
Off the Rails#645.dst: Bon, d'accord! Vas-y! fais les mots croisés!
Off the Rails#645.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#646.src: Ready to try the crossword? It's not easy!!!
Off the Rails#646.dst: Tu tentes les mots croisés? Ce n'est pas facile!!!
Off the Rails#646.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#648.src: SEE??? It's not easy, they're too intimidated to do it.
Off the Rails#648.dst: TU VOIS??? Ce n'est pas facile, ça l'intimide trop.
Off the Rails#648.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#652.src: As a subscriber to this paper, I'm getting tired of the riddles that just talk about how great the province is... Some variation of this question's in like, every issue.
Off the Rails#652.dst: En tant qu'abonné, j'en ai marre des énigmes qui ne parlent que de la grandeur de la province... Il y a une variante de cette question dans quasiment chaque numéro.
Off the Rails#652.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#654.src: DAMNIT!!! That was so obvious! I had it, I swear!!!!!!
Off the Rails#654.dst: ZUT!!! C'était tellement évident! Je l'avais, je le jure!!!!!!
Off the Rails#654.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#655.src: Wait, that wasn't allowed? I thought it was cool...
Off the Rails#655.dst: Attends, ce n'était pas permis? Je trouvais ça cool...
Off the Rails#655.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#656.src: Hey! That's not how you spell his... oh, whatever, it doesn't actually matter.
Off the Rails#656.dst: Hé! Ce n'est pas comme ça que son nom s'écrit... oh, peu importe, ça n'a pas d'importance.
Off the Rails#656.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#657.src: I've always thought it's, uh, really stupid that they named those trees that. Maddison loves it though?
Off the Rails#657.dst: J'ai toujours trouvé ça, euh, vraiment idiot d'avoir donné ce nom à ces arbres. Maddison adore, par contre?
Off the Rails#657.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#658.src: Yep, and then it takes even more to hold on to it!
Off the Rails#658.dst: Ouais, et ensuite c'est encore plus dur de le garder!
Off the Rails#658.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#659.src: Oh, goodness, crossword... Don't make me think of that again...
Off the Rails#659.dst: Oh là là, les mots croisés... Ne m'y fais pas repenser...
Off the Rails#659.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#660.src: Man... heard that didn't go super well this year...
Off the Rails#660.dst: Mince... il paraît que ça ne s'est pas super bien passé cette année...
Off the Rails#660.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#661.src: SEE??? They couldn't do it. It was too hard!
Off the Rails#661.dst: TU VOIS??? Personne n'y arrive. C'était trop dur!
Off the Rails#661.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#662.src: Have you remembered what you were thinking about?
Off the Rails#662.dst: Tu te rappelles ce à quoi tu pensais?
Off the Rails#662.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#665.src: UGH, what????? Damnit! I guess I didn't pay good enough attention on my trip...
Off the Rails#665.dst: PFF, quoi????? Zut! Je n'ai pas dû faire assez attention pendant mon voyage...
Off the Rails#665.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#666.src: Honestly, don't worry. Given what you've told me about your own home, I can't imagine the Roughworks are really worth knowing about, for someone like you.
Off the Rails#666.dst: Franchement, ne t'en fais pas. Vu ce que tu m'as dit de chez toi, je doute que Roughworks vaille vraiment la peine d'être connu, pour quelqu'un comme toi.
Off the Rails#666.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#668.src: Oh, right! I just remembered what I was going to say.
Off the Rails#668.dst: Ah, c'est vrai! Je viens de me rappeler ce que j'allais dire.
Off the Rails#668.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#669.src: General Levi came from the {p}, specifically a noble house called House Takshah.
Off the Rails#669.dst: La générale Levi venait de {p}, plus précisément d'une maison noble appelée la Maison Takshah.
Off the Rails#669.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#670.src: Apparently, some people have it out for that house in particular... That's all I know though, sorry.
Off the Rails#670.dst: Apparemment, certaines personnes en veulent à cette maison en particulier... C'est tout ce que je sais, désolée.
Off the Rails#670.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#671.src: ...That blasted attendant... He better give me m-
Off the Rails#671.dst: ...Ce maudit contrôleur... Il a intérêt à m'apporter m-
Off the Rails#671.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#672.src: ...Ah, you! You again. They let you go, hm?
Off the Rails#672.dst: ...Ah, vous! Encore vous. Ils vous ont relâché, hm?
Off the Rails#672.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#673.src: Lucky. Those Constables... Majin has them stationed around {p} for our safety, but they're always causing trouble. I don't trust people like them.
Off the Rails#673.dst: Quelle chance. Ces agents... Majin les a postés autour de {p} pour notre sécurité, mais ils causent toujours des ennuis. Je ne me fie pas à ces gens-là.
Off the Rails#673.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#674.src: Still, I suppose Levi would have been different, given her high role. How cruel it is that someone cut her life short...
Off the Rails#674.dst: Cela dit, je suppose que Levi était différente, vu son haut rang. Quelle cruauté que d'avoir abrégé sa vie...
Off the Rails#674.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#675.src: You are looking for the perpetrator, yes? I'll tell you anything you need to know.
Off the Rails#675.dst: Vous cherchez le coupable, n'est-ce pas? Je vous dirai tout ce que vous avez besoin de savoir.
Off the Rails#675.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#677.src: ...Oh, it's you. You from the murder scene. They let you go, hm?
Off the Rails#677.dst: ...Ah, c'est vous. La personne de la scène du crime. Ils vous ont relâché, hm?

Off the Rails#680.src: You are looking for the perpetrator, yes? I'll tell you anything you need to know. I suppose the first thing would be an introduction.
Off the Rails#680.dst: Vous cherchez le coupable, n'est-ce pas? Je vous dirai tout ce qu'il faut. Je suppose qu'il faut d'abord me présenter.

Off the Rails#684.src: But enough about little old me. You are here to ask questions. Go on.
Off the Rails#684.dst: Mais assez parlé de mon humble personne. Vous êtes là pour poser des questions. Allez-y.
Off the Rails#684.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#686.src: What is it now? More questions?
Off the Rails#686.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#687.src: What else have you to ask?
Off the Rails#687.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#688.src: But let us move on from that. Any more questions?
Off the Rails#688.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#690.src: Anywho, thank you for the food. Now, ask me questions if you have any, leave me to my meal otherwise.
Off the Rails#690.dst: Bref, merci pour le repas. Maintenant, posez vos questions si vous en avez, sinon laissez-moi manger.
Off the Rails#690.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#691.src: I didn't see much at all, because I was in the bathroom for much of the time. There's only one thing I saw that could be of note.
Off the Rails#691.dst: Je n'ai pas vu grand-chose, car j'étais aux toilettes une bonne partie du temps. Une seule chose que j'ai vue pourrait être notable.
Off the Rails#691.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#692.src: When I reached the back of the train, where the bathroom is located, I noticed the attendant, Telati.
Off the Rails#692.dst: Quand je suis arrivé à l'arrière du train, là où se trouvent les toilettes, j'ai remarqué le contrôleur, Telati.
Off the Rails#692.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#693.src: He was just stood around, up to... something. When he saw me enter, he seemed to panic and left the carriage. How suspicious.
Off the Rails#693.dst: Il était planté là, à manigancer... quelque chose. En me voyant entrer, il a paru paniquer et a quitté le wagon. Comme c'est suspect.
Off the Rails#693.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#695.src: They're supposedly stronger than the regular divisional soldiers, but at least those divisional soldiers knew respect.
Off the Rails#695.dst: Ils sont censés être plus forts que les soldats de division ordinaires, mais au moins, ces derniers savaient ce qu'est le respect.
Off the Rails#695.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#696.src: The Constables are often from other regions, so they're not part of the local community- they're less friendly. This makes them HORRIBLE town guards.
Off the Rails#696.dst: Les agents viennent souvent d'autres régions, donc ils ne font pas partie de la communauté locale- ils sont moins aimables. Ça en fait d'HORRIBLES gardes municipaux.
Off the Rails#696.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#697.src: I speak from experience. Our Sovereign, Majin, replaced the {p} guard with Constables a few years ago. Supposedly to better protect us.
Off the Rails#697.dst: Je parle d'expérience. Notre Souverain, Majin, a remplacé la garde de {p} par des agents il y a quelques années. Soi-disant pour mieux nous protéger.
Off the Rails#697.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#698.src: Given his lack of improvements to the town besides that, I doubt that's the real reason. He just did it for the praise.
Off the Rails#698.dst: Vu qu'il n'a rien amélioré d'autre en ville, je doute que ce soit la vraie raison. Il l'a fait pour les éloges.
Off the Rails#698.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#699.src: If he REALLY wanted to please us, he should have had some of those spangly Wings guard us. They don't do anything but stand around looking cool, anyway.
Off the Rails#699.dst: S'il voulait VRAIMENT nous faire plaisir, il aurait mis quelques-unes de ces rutilantes Ailes à notre garde. De toute façon, elles ne font que parader.
Off the Rails#699.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#700.src: They're the best of the best, and I'm sure they would serve us better than those unruly Constables. They have the decorum not to scoff in our faces.
Off the Rails#700.dst: Ce sont les meilleurs des meilleurs, et ils nous serviraient sûrement mieux que ces agents indisciplinés. Eux ont la décence de ne pas nous rire au nez.
Off the Rails#700.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#701.src: Yes, that's right- scoff in our faces. That's how little respect these Constables have for the nobility. It's ridiculous.
Off the Rails#701.dst: Oui, vous avez bien entendu- nous rire au nez. Voilà le peu de respect que ces agents ont pour la noblesse. C'est ridicule.
Off the Rails#701.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#702.src: A friend of mine, from House Krisa, was humiliated by a pair of rude Constables in {p} a while back. His handmade clothes were ruined! Covered in dye!
Off the Rails#702.dst: Un ami à moi, de la Maison Krisa, a été humilié par deux agents grossiers à {p} il y a quelque temps. Ses vêtements faits main étaient fichus! Couverts de teinture!
Off the Rails#702.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#703.src: He had one of his friends in House Liftal contact Majin about it, so I'm sure those fools got what they deserved... Heh.
Off the Rails#703.dst: Il a demandé à un ami de la Maison Liftal d'en informer Majin, alors je suis sûr que ces imbéciles ont eu ce qu'ils méritaient... Héhé.
Off the Rails#703.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#704.src: ...Anyway. All of this is to say: Constables are no good. I am not fond of them.
Off the Rails#704.dst: ...Bref. Tout ça pour dire: les agents ne valent rien. Je ne les apprécie guère.
Off the Rails#704.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#705.src: Ugh. It's that attendant, Telati. I asked him for a meal hours ago, and he STILL hasn't even STARTED on it!
Off the Rails#705.dst: Pff. C'est ce contrôleur, Telati. Je lui ai demandé un repas il y a des heures, et il ne l'a TOUJOURS pas COMMENCÉ!
Off the Rails#705.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#706.src: ...Could you do me a favour go and ask him to get a move on? I'm tired of waiting here.
Off the Rails#706.dst: ...Pourriez-vous me rendre le service d'aller lui dire de se dépêcher? J'en ai assez d'attendre ici.
Off the Rails#706.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#707.src: You..? You made it? He really had you do it for him???
Off the Rails#707.dst: Vous..? C'est vous qui l'avez fait? Il vous l'a vraiment fait faire à sa place???
Off the Rails#707.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#708.src: Goodness... I'm going to be leaving a poor review of this train in the paper, and telling my friends of this disappointment...
Off the Rails#708.dst: Mon Dieu... Je vais laisser une mauvaise critique de ce train dans le journal, et raconter cette déception à mes amis...
Off the Rails#708.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#709.src: ...Speaking of gossip, I just thought of something I heard recently that might be useful to you...
Off the Rails#709.dst: ...En parlant de commérages, je viens de penser à une chose entendue récemment qui pourrait vous être utile...
Off the Rails#709.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#710.src: Yes, I heard from some friends that General Levi was being called to {p} by Sovereign Zhiraok.
Off the Rails#710.dst: Oui, des amis m'ont dit que le Souverain Zhiraok avait fait venir la générale Levi à {p}.
Off the Rails#710.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#711.src: Of course, I'm sure you already knew that. My point is this- word was out about what was happening, so I bet whoever killed her had this insider information.
Off the Rails#711.dst: Bien sûr, vous le saviez sûrement déjà. Ce que je veux dire, c'est que la nouvelle circulait, alors je parie que son assassin disposait de cette information de l'intérieur.
Off the Rails#711.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#712.src: Truly curious... Who might know about that?
Off the Rails#712.dst: Vraiment curieux... Qui aurait pu le savoir?
Off the Rails#712.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#714.src: Make an accusation at [-{~}, {~}, {~}], or seek more evidence.
Off the Rails#714.dst: Faites une accusation à [-{~}, {~}, {~}], ou cherchez d'autres preuves.

Off the Rails#716.src: Hm. I suppose it makes enough sense. They were awfully quiet when we found the body.
Off the Rails#716.dst: Hm. Ça se tient, j'imagine. Cette personne était bien silencieuse quand on a trouvé le corps.
Off the Rails#716.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#717.src: I dunno, Maury. Something doesn't seem right about this.
Off the Rails#717.dst: J'sais pas, Maury. Y a un truc qui cloche, là.
Off the Rails#717.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#719.src: ...having seen what other parts of Fruma are like, maybe prison would be... an improvement...
Off the Rails#719.dst: ...vu à quoi ressemble le reste de Fruma, la prison serait peut-être... une amélioration...
Off the Rails#719.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#720.src: Works for us, I guess. Just uh, go along with what we tell 'em, alright?
Off the Rails#720.dst: Ça nous va, j'imagine. Euh, contente-toi de confirmer ce qu'on leur dira, d'accord?
Off the Rails#720.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#721.src: Good timin', too. The train's about to arrive in {p}.
Off the Rails#721.dst: Et pile au bon moment. Le train va arriver à {p}.
Off the Rails#721.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#723.src: Yeah, I suppose a university student could get their hands on the weird substances that were involved here. I see it.
Off the Rails#723.dst: Ouais, j'imagine qu'une étudiante pourrait mettre la main sur les substances bizarres utilisées ici. Ça se tient.
Off the Rails#723.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#724.src: But- but why would I kill a general? I don't want to hurt anyone!
Off the Rails#724.dst: Mais- mais pourquoi je tuerais une générale? Je ne veux faire de mal à personne!
Off the Rails#724.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#725.src: Yeah, Maury, I don't really see a motivation here...
Off the Rails#725.dst: Ouais, Maury, je vois pas trop le mobile, là...
Off the Rails#725.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#726.src: Hm... Well, whatever, we never were goin' off of actual guilt, anyway.
Off the Rails#726.dst: Hm... Bah, peu importe, on a jamais cherché le vrai coupable, de toute façon.
Off the Rails#726.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#727.src: Yeah, true, I guess this works.
Off the Rails#727.dst: Ouais, c'est vrai, j'imagine que ça fera l'affaire.
Off the Rails#727.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#728.src: You're under arrest. We're about to arrive in {p}, and we'll be takin' ya straight to the local guard!
Off the Rails#728.dst: T'es en état d'arrestation. On arrive bientôt à {p}, et on t'emmène direct à la garde locale!
Off the Rails#728.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#729.src: The {p} guy? That's who ya think did it?
Off the Rails#729.dst: Le type de {p}? C'est lui que tu soupçonnes?
Off the Rails#729.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#730.src: Yeah, what the heck? He was in the bathroom the whole time. This doesn't make sense...
Off the Rails#730.dst: Ouais, c'est quoi ce délire? Il était aux toilettes tout le temps. Ça n'a pas de sens...
Off the Rails#730.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#732.src: They are right...! It WAS I, Toxic Thistle of the Blossoming Blades, Fruma's deadliest vindicators!
Off the Rails#732.dst: Ils ont raison...! C'ÉTAIT moi, Chardon toxique de la Fleur des Lames, les justiciers les plus redoutables de Fruma!
Off the Rails#732.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#734.src: Behold, lapdogs, the beginning of our glorious revolution!
Off the Rails#734.dst: Contemplez, larbins, le début de notre glorieuse révolution!
Off the Rails#734.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#735.src: Even in arrest, I have won... My brethren who stand against the Queen shall be mobilized by this glorious act of violence...
Off the Rails#735.dst: Même arrêté, j'ai gagné... Mes frères qui s'opposent à la Reine seront galvanisés par ce glorieux acte de violence...
Off the Rails#735.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#736.src: The troubled people of Fruma shall wake to the fact that their rulers are not infallible gods; they shall at last understand that they alone bear the bridles of their own destiny...!
Off the Rails#736.dst: Le peuple accablé de Fruma comprendra que ses dirigeants ne sont pas des dieux infaillibles; il saura enfin qu'il tient seul les rênes de son destin...!
Off the Rails#736.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#738.src: And executed so poetically, too! Think- a titan of House Takshah, slain by merely the poison of House Efelu- even a small Murex Mollusc takes down the mighty rhinoce-
Off the Rails#738.dst: Et exécuté avec tant de poésie! Imaginez- une titane de la Maison Takshah, terrassée par le simple poison de la Maison Efelu- même un petit Murex Mollusc abat le puissant rhinocé-
Off the Rails#738.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#739.src: Well, actually, Murex Molluscs are noted for being quite large for a sn-
Off the Rails#739.dst: Eh bien, en fait, les Murex Molluscs sont réputés assez gros pour un esc-
Off the Rails#739.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#741.src: Before you take me away, you must admit... my exploits are impressive, no?
Off the Rails#741.dst: Avant de m'emmener, avouez-le... mes exploits sont impressionnants, non?
Off the Rails#741.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#742.src: Er... No. I ain't paid enough to care about whatever revolution thing ya were just talkin' about.
Off the Rails#742.dst: Euh... Non. On me paie pas assez pour m'intéresser à ton truc de révolution, là.
Off the Rails#742.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#743.src: Yeah, do you really think any of this is gonna make a difference? Nobody cares about some general. None of this matters.
Off the Rails#743.dst: Ouais, tu crois vraiment que ça va changer quoi que ce soit? Tout le monde se fiche d'une générale. Rien de tout ça ne compte.
Off the Rails#743.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#745.src: What does matter, though, is that you just made our job REAL easy fer us.
Off the Rails#745.dst: Par contre, ce qui compte, c'est que tu viens de nous mâcher VRAIMENT le travail.
Off the Rails#745.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#746.src: C'mon, punk, the train's arrivin' now. We're takin' you to the slammer.
Off the Rails#746.dst: Allez, voyou, le train arrive. On t'emmène au trou.
Off the Rails#746.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#748.src: I guess a guy like him could grow jaded against the system. He's a Roughworker, after all.
Off the Rails#748.dst: J'imagine qu'un type comme lui peut finir aigri contre le système. C'est un gars de Roughworks, après tout.
Off the Rails#748.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#749.src: Yeah, and he's the only guy who could possibly have unlocked the door to the private cabin, so it makes sense, really.
Off the Rails#749.dst: Ouais, et c'est le seul qui pouvait ouvrir la porte du compartiment privé, alors ça se tient, franchement.
Off the Rails#749.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#750.src: But... I would never kill one of the Queen's servants... Or anyone for that matter! Please! Have mercy!
Off the Rails#750.dst: Mais... Je ne tuerais jamais une servante de la Reine... Ni personne d'autre! Je vous en prie! Pitié!
Off the Rails#750.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#751.src: Heh. I don't think ya did it. But I don't care. We never were specifically lookin' to arrest the actual perpetrator.
Off the Rails#751.dst: Héhé. J'pense pas que c'est toi. Mais je m'en fiche. On a jamais cherché à arrêter le vrai coupable.
Off the Rails#751.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#752.src: Yeah, you're believable enough. We'll go with you.
Off the Rails#752.dst: Ouais, t'es assez crédible. On te prend.
Off the Rails#752.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#753.src: Good timin', too! We're about to arrive in {p}.
Off the Rails#753.dst: Et pile au bon moment! On arrive bientôt à {p}.
Off the Rails#753.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#756.src: Yeah, I uh, don' see the angle on this one, pal..
Off the Rails#756.dst: Ouais, je, euh, vois pas trop le rapport pour celui-là, mon pote..
Off the Rails#756.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#757.src: Eh, Roughworkers are pretty disobedient. I think it makes enough sense.
Off the Rails#757.dst: Bah, les gars de Roughworks sont plutôt désobéissants. Ça se tient assez, je trouve.
Off the Rails#757.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#758.src: True... We never were arrestin' based on real guilt anyway, were we? We'll just go with this.
Off the Rails#758.dst: C'est vrai... On a jamais arrêté les gens pour leur vraie culpabilité, hein? On garde celui-là.
Off the Rails#758.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#760.src: Heh. Tell it to Oru, bub.
Off the Rails#760.dst: Héhé. Va raconter ça à Oru, mon gars.
Off the Rails#760.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#761.src: ...Is that something Oru does? Take questio-
Off the Rails#761.dst: ...Oru fait ça? Il écoute les récla-
Off the Rails#761.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#762.src: I DON'T KNOW, Harvin. It just sounded cool to say. And now you've ruined the moment.
Off the Rails#762.dst: J'EN SAIS RIEN, Harvin. Ça sonnait bien, c'est tout. Et là, t'as gâché le moment.
Off the Rails#762.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#763.src: ...Ech. Whatever. Train's about to arrive in {p}, let's get this guy to the slammer.
Off the Rails#763.dst: ...Pff. Peu importe. Le train va arriver à {p}, emmenons ce type au trou.
Off the Rails#763.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#765.src: What? No! It couldn't have been her!
Off the Rails#765.dst: Quoi? Non! Ça ne peut pas être elle!
Off the Rails#765.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#766.src: Uh... Yeah, I don' see how it could've been her, bud.
Off the Rails#766.dst: Euh... Ouais, je vois pas comment ça pourrait être elle, mon pote.
Off the Rails#766.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#767.src: Do we care? We were going to arrest our detective here without evidence, anyway, Maury.
Off the Rails#767.dst: On s'en fiche, non? De toute façon, on allait arrêter notre détective sans preuves, Maury.
Off the Rails#767.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#768.src: I guess yer right, though it might be hard to spin an Aelumian as guilty... They're pretty well-behaved.
Off the Rails#768.dst: T'as raison, j'imagine, même si ce sera dur de faire passer une Aelumienne pour coupable... Ils sont bien élevés.
Off the Rails#768.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#769.src: ...This is ridiculous! You can't do this!
Off the Rails#769.dst: ...C'est ridicule! Vous ne pouvez pas faire ça!
Off the Rails#769.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#770.src: Must I repeat myself? Do ya want to be put down as an accomplice? Quiet, you.
Off the Rails#770.dst: Faut que je me répète? Tu veux être noté comme complice? Toi, tais-toi.
Off the Rails#770.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#771.src: Hey, Maury... What if we arrested HIM instead. It'd be easier to explain, no?
Off the Rails#771.dst: Hé, Maury... Et si on l'arrêtait LUI, plutôt? Ce serait plus facile à expliquer, non?
Off the Rails#771.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#773.src: ...you know what? Yes. Take me instead.
Off the Rails#773.dst: ...vous savez quoi? Oui. Prenez-moi à sa place.
Off the Rails#773.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#775.src: Hands behind yer back, bub, the train's about to arrive in {p}.
Off the Rails#775.dst: Les mains dans le dos, mon gars, le train va arriver à {p}.
Off the Rails#775.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#776.src: Come on, idiot. We're not going to let you accuse US, obviously.
Off the Rails#776.dst: Allez, idiot. On va pas te laisser NOUS accuser, évidemment.
Off the Rails#776.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#777.src: Even if it WAS me, there'd be nothing ya could do about it. We're the ones with power here. Now go and select one of the passengers, come on.
Off the Rails#777.dst: Même si c'ÉTAIT moi, tu pourrais rien y faire. C'est nous qui avons le pouvoir ici. Maintenant, va choisir un des passagers, allez.
Off the Rails#777.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#778.src: ...You mean to suggest she... No, that's just not possible.
Off the Rails#778.dst: ...Tu insinues qu'elle... Non, c'est tout simplement impossible.
Off the Rails#778.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#779.src: Yeah, why would she? She had important business to do...
Off the Rails#779.dst: Ouais, pourquoi elle l'aurait fait? Elle avait des affaires importantes à régler...
Off the Rails#779.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#780.src: Well, Harvin, maybe she got tired of her job? That Majin bossin' her around all the time's gotta get tirin'...
Off the Rails#780.dst: Ben, Harvin, elle en avait peut-être marre de son boulot? Ce Majin qui la commande tout le temps, ça doit être usant...
Off the Rails#780.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#782.src: You know what? Even if she did do it, I don't care; we need someone to blame. Now COME ON! Accuse someone already, preferably alive this time!
Off the Rails#782.dst: Tu sais quoi? Même si c'est elle, je m'en fiche; il nous faut un coupable. Alors ALLEZ! Accuse quelqu'un, et de vivant cette fois, si possible!
Off the Rails#782.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#784.src: That guy we just arrested? He was STACKED! LOADED! We're gonna be vacationing in the {p} with this kind of money, haha!
Off the Rails#784.dst: Ce type qu'on vient d'arrêter? Il était BLINDÉ! PLEIN AUX AS! Avec tout cet argent, on part en vacances à {p}, haha!
Off the Rails#784.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#785.src: Don't tell Maury, but I felt like you deserved a small cut of the profits. Y'know, for figuring it out, and all.
Off the Rails#785.dst: Le dis pas à Maury, mais je trouvais que tu méritais une petite part du butin. Tu sais, pour avoir trouvé le coupable, tout ça.
Off the Rails#785.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#786.src: HEY! HARVIN! Didn't I tell ya not to go and give 'em anything? Idiot!
Off the Rails#786.dst: HÉ! HARVIN! Je t'avais pas dit de rien lui donner? Idiot!
Off the Rails#786.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#787.src: ...Shoot. Guess that's my cue to leave.
Off the Rails#787.dst: ...Mince. C'est le moment de filer, on dirait.
Off the Rails#787.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#788.src: Got a ticket or train pass?
Off the Rails#788.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#789.src: ...A General's train pass??? But... But you're not-
Off the Rails#789.dst: ...Un pass de général??? Mais... Mais vous n'êtes pas-
Off the Rails#789.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#790.src: Okay, okay... Sorry for questioning you, General. Where would you like to go today?
Off the Rails#790.dst: D'accord, d'accord... Pardon d'avoir douté de vous, mon général. Où souhaitez-vous aller aujourd'hui?
Off the Rails#790.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#791.src: Looks like someone dropped their train ticket... You're sure they wouldn't mind if you kept it.
Off the Rails#791.dst: Quelqu'un a fait tomber son billet de train... Ça ne le dérangera sûrement pas que vous le gardiez.

Off the Rails#792.src: It's for a train to {p}! Might be worth checking out.
Off the Rails#792.dst: C'est un billet de train pour {p}! Ça vaut peut-être le coup d'y jeter un oeil.

Off the Rails#793.src: You should talk to the Ticket Collector first.
Off the Rails#793.dst: Vous devriez d'abord parler au guichetier.

Off the Rails#794.src:
Businessman
I-I swear I had it right here...
Off the Rails#794.dst:
Businessman 
 J-je jure que je l'avais juste là...
Off the Rails#794.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#796.src: You might as well look around while you wait for the train to arrive.
Off the Rails#796.dst: Autant jeter un oeil autour de vous en attendant l'arrivée du train.

Off the Rails#797.src: Alternatively, you could find somewhere to sit to pass the time.
Off the Rails#797.dst: Sinon, vous pouvez trouver un endroit où vous asseoir pour passer le temps.

Off the Rails#798.src: You can check how long is left at the top of the screen.
Off the Rails#798.dst: Le temps restant s'affiche en haut de l'écran.

Off the Rails#799.src: You have a ticket, so don't you know the price? Ah, whatever- it's like, {~} Liquid Emeralds. That's a LOT.
Off the Rails#799.dst: T'as un billet, et tu connais pas le prix? Ah, peu importe- c'est genre {~} émeraudes liquides. C'est ÉNORME.
Off the Rails#799.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#800.src: Saving up's been a real nightmare, I tell ya. What with the price of rent and food, it's hard to hold onto any money at all!
Off the Rails#800.dst: Économiser, ça a été un vrai cauchemar, je te le dis. Avec le prix du loyer et de la nourriture, c'est dur de mettre le moindre sou de côté!
Off the Rails#800.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#801.src: In order to afford this trip, I've been working overtime every day for the past year, and even eating less just to save on food.
Off the Rails#801.dst: Pour me payer ce voyage, j'ai fait des heures sup' tous les jours depuis un an, et j'ai même moins mangé pour économiser.
Off the Rails#801.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#802.src: I'm glad the nightmare's finally over, though. Once I'm back from this trip, I'm never doing anything like that again!
Off the Rails#802.dst: Mais je suis content que le cauchemar soit enfin fini. Une fois rentré de ce voyage, je ne referai plus jamais un truc pareil!
Off the Rails#802.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#803.src: My job? I work at a tool factory up in the north, we make stuff like nice cutlery for export to the other regions.
Off the Rails#803.dst: Mon boulot? Je bosse dans une usine d'outils dans le nord, on fait de beaux couverts pour l'export vers les autres régions.
Off the Rails#803.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#804.src: Really, I don't get why we can't keep some for ourselves... We're the ones who put in all the work, why do THEY get rewarded for- Agh, whatever.
Off the Rails#804.dst: Franchement, pourquoi on ne peut pas en garder un peu pour nous... C'est nous qui faisons tout le boulot, pourquoi c'est EUX qui sont récompensés pour- Agh, peu importe.
Off the Rails#804.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#805.src: ...Anyway. My factory's let us all take a week off. Usually we only get a day off at this time of year, since the Festival's in town, but...
Off the Rails#805.dst: ...Bref. Mon usine nous a tous donné une semaine de congé. D'habitude, on n'a qu'un jour à cette période de l'année, vu que le Festival est en ville, mais...
Off the Rails#805.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#806.src: It turns out the old steelworks next to the station most of us use to commute to work had a slag beetle infestation, so said station had to be closed. Nasty critters, them, they destroy metals.
Off the Rails#806.dst: Il se trouve que la vieille aciérie près de la gare qu'on prend presque tous pour aller au travail était infestée de scarabées de scories, alors la gare a dû fermer. Sales bestioles, elles détruisent le métal.
Off the Rails#806.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#807.src: Ended up working out for me, though- it's the perfect time for me to finally put my holiday plans into action!
Off the Rails#807.dst: Au final, ça m'arrange- c'est le moment parfait pour enfin concrétiser mes projets de vacances!
Off the Rails#807.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#808.src: Yeah... Working overtime every day does that to ya...
Off the Rails#808.dst: Ouais... Faire des heures sup' tous les jours, ça fait ça...
Off the Rails#808.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#809.src: I've also been expending a lot of energy preparing for my trip... Yawn...
Off the Rails#809.dst: J'ai aussi dépensé beaucoup d'énergie à préparer mon voyage... Bâillement...
Off the Rails#809.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#810.src: Say... I could go for an energy drink. There's a vending machine in this station. Wanna come?
Off the Rails#810.dst: Dis... Je prendrais bien une boisson énergisante. Il y a un distributeur dans cette gare. Tu viens?
Off the Rails#810.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#812.src:
Malic
Yeesh.... Do they ever clean this place?
Off the Rails#812.dst:
Malic 
 Beurk.... Ils nettoient jamais cet endroit?
Off the Rails#812.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#813.src: You hear about that new Majin PEACOCK POWER stuff they're selling in these?
Off the Rails#813.dst: T'as entendu parler du nouveau PEACOCK POWER de Majin qu'ils vendent dans ces machines?
Off the Rails#813.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#814.src: Me personally? I'm sticking to Zhirao Sleep. PEACOCK POWER is too... flavorful for my tastes.
Off the Rails#814.dst: Moi, perso? Je reste fidèle au Zhirao Sleep. Le PEACOCK POWER a trop de... goût pour moi.
Off the Rails#814.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#815.src: ...On top of that, I... Honestly, just don't really like Highlanders.
Off the Rails#815.dst: ...En plus, je... Honnêtement, je n'aime pas trop les gens des Hautes-Terres.
Off the Rails#815.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#816.src: ...I mean, seriously! Every time one of them visits the Roughworks, they're always so... inconsiderate. They act like we live in filth... Like they're somehow better than us...
Off the Rails#816.dst: ...Non mais sérieusement! Chaque fois que l'un d'eux visite Roughworks, ils sont toujours si... méprisants. Ils font comme si on vivait dans la crasse... Comme s'ils valaient mieux que nous...
Off the Rails#816.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#817.src: And Majin is the embodiment of that. I mean, he is the Sovereign of the {p}, so, y'know... His drink doesn't really appeal to me.
Off the Rails#817.dst: Et Majin en est l'incarnation. Enfin, c'est le Souverain de {p}, alors, tu vois... Sa boisson ne me tente pas trop.
Off the Rails#817.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#818.src: Oh, yeah. It's ridiculously expensive, too.
Off the Rails#818.dst: Ah, ouais. Et elle est ridiculement chère, en plus.
Off the Rails#818.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#819.src: I have high expectations for {p}. I've heard it's beautiful over there- a couple of my buddies are lucky enough to work at the Auburn Lumbermill.
Off the Rails#819.dst: J'attends beaucoup de {p}. Il paraît que c'est magnifique là-bas- deux de mes potes ont la chance de bosser à la Scierie d'Auburn.
Off the Rails#819.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#820.src: I've never seen what it looks like, personally. The Wall of Xima has made sure of that. But apparently they've got beautiful trees there, trees with golden leaves...
Off the Rails#820.dst: Je n'ai jamais vu à quoi ça ressemble, moi. La Muraille de Xima y a veillé. Mais apparemment, ils ont de beaux arbres là-bas, des arbres aux feuilles dorées...
Off the Rails#820.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#821.src: Sadly, I'm just slightly too late to get to see what the Queen's Festival there is like. I can't imagine it's much different to ours, though.
Off the Rails#821.dst: Malheureusement, j'arrive un poil trop tard pour voir à quoi ressemble leur Festival de la Reine. Je doute qu'il soit très différent du nôtre, cela dit.
Off the Rails#821.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#822.src: I bet the people there are lovely, too, just based on what I've seen from their Sovereign. Although, he is apparently a Highlander... Still! Can't be worse than our bunch.
Off the Rails#822.dst: Je parie que les gens là-bas sont adorables aussi, rien qu'à voir leur Souverain. Bon, apparemment, il vient des Hautes-Terres... Quand même! Il peut pas être pire que les nôtres.
Off the Rails#822.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#823.src: Gosh, I'm so excited to get there. This is gonna be the highlight of my life, for certain.
Off the Rails#823.dst: Ça alors, j'ai tellement hâte d'arriver. Ce sera le grand moment de ma vie, c'est sûr.
Off the Rails#823.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#824.src: Oh yeah, right, those people. I've not talked with them, but maybe I should.
Off the Rails#824.dst: Ah oui, c'est vrai, ces gens-là. Je ne leur ai pas parlé, mais je devrais peut-être.
Off the Rails#824.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#825.src: Just judging from their attire, as well as the odds, they're probably not from around here. Probably tourists.
Off the Rails#825.dst: Rien qu'à leurs tenues, et selon toute probabilité, ils ne sont sûrement pas d'ici. Des touristes, sans doute.
Off the Rails#825.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#826.src: It'd be interesting to hear from them what their regions are like... D'you think one of them might be from Auburn?
Off the Rails#826.dst: Ce serait intéressant qu'ils me racontent à quoi ressemblent leurs régions... Tu crois que l'un d'eux vient d'Auburn?
Off the Rails#826.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#827.src: You want to hear more opinions on the soda from me? Zhirao Sleep's pretty nice, the branding feels tasteful, and just... understanding of us.
Off the Rails#827.dst: Tu veux encore mon avis sur les sodas? Le Zhirao Sleep est plutôt bon, la marque a du goût, et elle... nous comprend, quoi.
Off the Rails#827.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#828.src: Majin's is all about HIM. Just HIM. And the soda itself? It's basically just the same drink as Zhirao Sleep but with a bit more flavour. Too much, in my opinion.
Off the Rails#828.dst: Celui de Majin, c'est LUI. Juste LUI. Et le soda en lui-même? C'est presque la même boisson que le Zhirao Sleep, avec un peu plus de goût. Trop, à mon avis.
Off the Rails#828.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#829.src: Pretty much everyone seems to feel this way about it, too, but its advertising is inescapable... It's tiring.
Off the Rails#829.dst: A peu près tout le monde semble penser pareil, mais sa pub est partout... C'est usant.
Off the Rails#829.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#834.src: It's been fun talking. Come back sometime, won't you?
Off the Rails#834.dst: C'était sympa de discuter. Reviens me voir, d'accord?
Off the Rails#834.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#835.src: Oh, hi! Looking for a chat? My name's Maddison, I'm a tourist from Aelumia.
Off the Rails#835.dst: Oh, salut! Envie de discuter? Je m'appelle Maddison, je suis une touriste d'Aelumia.
Off the Rails#835.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#836.src: The {p} was... Not quite what I expected. There's quite a unique culture there, though! Did you know they cover everything with gorgeous murals?
Off the Rails#836.dst: {p} était... pas tout à fait ce que j'imaginais. Mais il y a une culture vraiment unique là-bas! Tu savais qu'ils couvrent tout de magnifiques fresques?
Off the Rails#836.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#837.src: It's just a shame I didn't schedule this trip properly... I could have seen the Queen's Festival both here AND there, and now I'll miss both... Oh well...
Off the Rails#837.dst: C'est juste dommage que j'aie mal organisé ce voyage... J'aurais pu voir le Festival de la Reine ici ET là-bas, et maintenant je vais rater les deux... Tant pis...
Off the Rails#837.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#838.src: Thank you for the chat. See you later!
Off the Rails#838.dst: Merci pour la discussion. A plus tard!
Off the Rails#838.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#841.src: There's a hastily-scrawn note stuck to this locker, saying "Malic"
Off the Rails#841.dst: Une note griffonnée à la hâte est collée sur ce casier: "Malic"

Off the Rails#842.src: It's locked, but it would be rude to look at his belongings, anyway.
Off the Rails#842.dst: Il est verrouillé, mais de toute façon, ce serait impoli de regarder ses affaires.

Off the Rails#843.src: There's a hastily-scrawn note stuck to this locker, saying "{u}"
Off the Rails#843.dst: Une note griffonnée à la hâte est collée sur ce casier: "{u}"

Off the Rails#844.src: ...Telati did not mention that you had a locker when you were boarding the train, though he seemed in a hurry, so perhaps he forgot.
Off the Rails#844.dst: ...Telati n'a pas mentionné de casier à votre nom à l'embarquement, mais il semblait pressé, alors il a peut-être oublié.

Off the Rails#845.src: ...he also forgot to give you your key, so you couldn't use it even if you wanted to.
Off the Rails#845.dst: ...il a aussi oublié de vous donner votre clé, donc vous ne pourriez pas l'utiliser même si vous le vouliez.

Off the Rails#846.src: It's locked, but it would be rude to look at her belongings, anyway.
Off the Rails#846.dst: Il est verrouillé, mais de toute façon, ce serait impoli de regarder ses affaires.

Off the Rails#847.src: This locker doesn't seem to belong to anyone, but it's locked anyway.
Off the Rails#847.dst: Ce casier ne semble appartenir à personne, mais il est verrouillé quand même.

Off the Rails#848.src: There's a hastily-scrawn note stuck to this locker, saying "Maddison"
Off the Rails#848.dst: Un mot griffonné à la hâte est collé sur ce casier: "Maddison"

Off the Rails#849.src: It's locked, but it would be rude to look at their belongings, anyway.
Off the Rails#849.dst: C'est fermé à clé, et de toute façon, fouiller ses affaires serait impoli.

Off the Rails#852.src: Would you like to take a nap now? If you do this, you may miss some interactions!
Off the Rails#852.dst: Voulez-vous faire une sieste maintenant? Vous risquez de manquer certaines interactions!

Off the Rails#854.src: Once you're done exploring the train, you should take a nap here.
Off the Rails#854.dst: Quand vous aurez fini d'explorer le train, venez faire une sieste ici.

Off the Rails#855.src: The train's pretty comfortable. You could get used to this as a mode of transport.
Off the Rails#855.dst: Le train est plutôt confortable. On pourrait s'habituer à voyager ainsi.

Off the Rails#856.src: And to think, if that businessman back in {p} had not been such a jerk to you, you wouldn't be here now...
Off the Rails#856.dst: Dire que si cet homme d'affaires de {p} n'avait pas été si odieux avec vous, vous ne seriez pas ici...

Off the Rails#857.src: It was all worth it, even if just to see that frustrated look on his face...
Off the Rails#857.dst: Ça en valait la peine, ne serait-ce que pour voir sa mine dépitée...

Off the Rails#860.src: Something's wrong. You should go investigate.
Off the Rails#860.dst: Quelque chose ne va pas. Vous devriez aller voir.

Off the Rails#861.src: It sounded like they were headed towards the back of the train.
Off the Rails#861.dst: On aurait dit qu'ils allaient vers l'arrière du train.

Off the Rails#869.src: Whenever you find potentially relevant info, it will be automatically recorded in the notebook, for you to check later.
Off the Rails#869.dst: Chaque information utile que vous trouverez sera notée automatiquement dans le carnet, à consulter plus tard.

Off the Rails#870.src: {#} You should inspect the crime scene first.

Off the Rails#871.dst: Le texte surligné en jaune indique un élément utile à l'enquête, qui sera noté dans votre carnet.

Off the Rails#872.src: What would you like to inspect first?

Off the Rails#873.src: The knife is lodged deep in her neck. It seems to be the only wound present on her body.
Off the Rails#873.dst: Le couteau est profondément planté dans son cou. Ce semble être la seule blessure sur son corps.

Off the Rails#874.src: You pull out the knife. It seems to be of a high quality.
Off the Rails#874.dst: Vous retirez le couteau. Il semble de très bonne qualité.

Off the Rails#875.src: Some kind of purple goo appears to be slathered on the blade, though not much remains, as it has been washed away by blood.
Off the Rails#875.dst: Une sorte de gelée violette enduit la lame, mais il en reste peu: le sang l'a presque toute lavée.

Off the Rails#876.src: What would you like to inspect next?

Off the Rails#877.src: Though it seems that the victim did not struggle, there is blood all over the room...
Off the Rails#877.dst: La victime ne semble pas s'être débattue, et pourtant il y a du sang partout dans la pièce...

Off the Rails#878.src: Could it be possible the body was moved?

Off the Rails#880.src: From them you pull a card. It reads:
Off the Rails#880.dst: Vous en sortez une carte. On y lit:

Off the Rails#881.src: "TRAIN PASS: GENERAL OF THE PROVINCIAL GUARD"

Off the Rails#882.src: "Possession of this pass entitles its bearer to a train ride anywhere they request, free of charge, by Her Majesty's orders."
Off the Rails#882.dst: "Ce passe donne droit à son porteur de voyager gratuitement en train vers toute destination demandée, par ordre de Sa Majesté."

Off the Rails#884.src: "Rejection of such a request is considered obstruction of the Crown's will, and a serious crime."
Off the Rails#884.dst: "Refuser une telle demande est considéré comme une entrave à la volonté de la Couronne, et un crime grave."

Off the Rails#883.src: Seems you've inspected everything now. Time to speak to the guards.
Off the Rails#883.dst: Il semble que vous ayez tout examiné. Il est temps de parler aux gardes.

Off the Rails#885.src: It seems that these rooms are all connected by vents... It's possible the murderer could have used them to travel between rooms.
Off the Rails#885.dst: Ces pièces semblent toutes reliées par des conduits d'aération... Le meurtrier a pu s'en servir pour passer d'une pièce à l'autre.

Off the Rails#886.src: So our chat's over then? Great, now I have no reason to procrastinate. Ha.
Off the Rails#886.dst: Alors notre discussion est finie? Super, plus d'excuse pour procrastiner. Ha.

Off the Rails#888.src: The door is locked, but you'd better not break the rules, anyway.
Off the Rails#888.dst: La porte est verrouillée, et mieux vaut ne pas enfreindre les règles.

Off the Rails#891.dst: Vous n'aviez pas besoin d'aller aux toilettes.

Off the Rails#893.src: Nothing more to see here. You can check your findings in the notebook.
Off the Rails#893.dst: Plus rien à voir ici. Vous pouvez consulter vos trouvailles dans le carnet.

Off the Rails#894.dst: Le panneau indique "Cuisine, réservé au personnel".

Off the Rails#895.src: The door does not appear to be locked, but it'd be best not to break the rules.
Off the Rails#895.dst: La porte ne semble pas verrouillée, mais mieux vaut ne pas enfreindre les règles.

Off the Rails#896.src: Have a good journey, and good luck.

Off the Rails#921.src: Oh, alright. I wish you luck with the case!
Off the Rails#921.dst: Ah, d'accord. Bonne chance pour l'enquête!
Off the Rails#921.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#924.src: Dang, shame I'll be out of town for that.
Off the Rails#924.dst: Mince, dommage que je ne sois pas en ville à ce moment-là.
Off the Rails#924.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#925.src: Are you sure you want to leave the minigame? If you do, your progress will be lost!
Off the Rails#925.dst: Voulez-vous vraiment quitter le mini-jeu? Votre progression sera perdue!

Off the Rails#926.src: Remarkably, there's a perfectly-prepared platter of whole roast Grookiva on the kitchen counter, still warm, perfect for consumption.
Off the Rails#926.dst: Chose remarquable, un plateau de Grookiva rôti entier, parfaitement préparé et encore chaud, attend sur le comptoir de la cuisine.

Off the Rails#927.src: You accept this wonderful blessing from the gods. This will do nicely. Serve it to Cemor.
Off the Rails#927.dst: Vous acceptez ce merveilleux cadeau des dieux. Ça fera l'affaire. Servez-le à Cemor.

Off the Rails#928.src: The man in the canteen carriage came through here and took a while to come back. Not sure why, though I think it likely he was in the bathroom at the back of the train.
Off the Rails#928.dst: L'homme du wagon-restaurant est passé par ici et a mis du temps à revenir. Je ne sais pas pourquoi, mais il était sans doute aux toilettes au fond du train.
Off the Rails#928.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#931.src: "The Murex Mollusc is a relative of the Gigastropod native to the {p}."
Off the Rails#931.dst: "Le Murex Mollusc est un parent du Gigastropod, originaire de {p}."

Off the Rails#932.src: "Unlike the herbivorous Gigastropod, the Murex Mollusc is a carnivore that hunts for food. From its shell, it can fire toxic darts to aid in this task."
Off the Rails#932.dst: "Contrairement au Gigastropod herbivore, le Murex Mollusc est un carnivore qui chasse. Pour cela, il tire des dards toxiques depuis sa coquille."

Off the Rails#933.src: "Due to the size of some of the {p}' creatures, the toxin in these darts is extremely potent, to the point where it is often lethal to humans."
Off the Rails#933.dst: "Vu la taille de certaines créatures de {p}, la toxine de ces dards est extrêmement puissante, souvent mortelle pour les humains."

Off the Rails#934.src: "This toxin is also known to incapacitate and paralyse those affected by it, a property which has made it desirable to crooks and murderers."
Off the Rails#934.dst: "Cette toxine est aussi connue pour neutraliser et paralyser ses victimes, ce qui la rend prisée des escrocs et des assassins."

Off the Rails#935.src: "However, it has almost never been used in crime, as it is extremely difficult to collect from the Mollusc's fragile darts, which break on impact."
Off the Rails#935.dst: "Elle n'a pourtant presque jamais servi à un crime, car il est très difficile de la recueillir sur les dards fragiles du mollusque, qui se brisent à l'impact."

Off the Rails#936.src: "It is known, however, that the slime trail left behind by Murex Molluscs contains traces of this toxin."
Off the Rails#936.dst: "On sait toutefois que la traînée de bave laissée par les Murex Mollusc contient des traces de cette toxine."

Off the Rails#937.src: "Raids on black markets have found containers of this slime, though the difficulty involved in collecting it has led to a high price."
Off the Rails#937.dst: "Des descentes sur des marchés noirs ont révélé des récipients de cette bave, dont le prix reste élevé tant elle est difficile à récolter."

Off the Rails#938.src: "As such, fortunately, few have chosen to use it to these ends."
Off the Rails#938.dst: "Heureusement, peu de gens ont donc choisi de l'employer à ces fins."

Off the Rails#939.src: There's also an illustration of Murex Mollusc slime. It seems to match what you found on the blade perfectly. This must be it!
Off the Rails#939.dst: Il y a aussi une illustration de bave de Murex Mollusc. Elle correspond parfaitement à ce que vous avez trouvé sur la lame. C'est forcément ça!

Off the Rails#940.src: It's a key. Engraved on it is the word "MASTER". This must be Telati's missing key!
Off the Rails#940.dst: C'est une clé. Le mot "PASSE" y est gravé. Ce doit être la clé perdue de Telati!

Off the Rails#941.src: You slip it into your pocket. You can now access locked rooms.
Off the Rails#941.dst: Vous l'empochez. Vous pouvez désormais ouvrir les pièces verrouillées.

Off the Rails#942.src: You're sure you can break that rule for the sake of the case, though. Open the door?
Off the Rails#942.dst: Cela dit, vous pouvez sûrement enfreindre cette règle pour l'enquête. Ouvrir la porte?

Off the Rails#943.src: It's a book with a knife on the cover, with no title to be seen. You try to read.
Off the Rails#943.dst: C'est un livre avec un couteau sur la couverture, sans titre visible. Vous essayez de le lire.

Off the Rails#944.src: ...Almost all of the pages are glued together, and a knife-shaped compartment is carved into them.
Off the Rails#944.dst: ...Presque toutes les pages sont collées, et un compartiment en forme de couteau y est creusé.

Off the Rails#945.src: This must be how the murderer smuggled the weapon onto the train!
Off the Rails#945.dst: Voilà comment l'assassin a fait entrer l'arme dans le train!

Off the Rails#947.src: I mean, maybe they want to ask us some questions, Maury.
Off the Rails#947.dst: Enfin, peut-être qu'il veut nous poser des questions, Maury.
Off the Rails#947.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#948.dst: Pff. Bon. Qu'est-ce que tu veux?
Off the Rails#948.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#949.src: Your takeaway from that... conversation... is that the General was completely unguarded.
Off the Rails#949.dst: Ce que vous retenez de cette... conversation... c'est que la générale n'était absolument pas protégée.

Off the Rails#952.dst: Le café ne semble pas ouvert pour le moment.

Off the Rails#962.src: Thank goodness he didn't stick around. After all, you wouldn't want him to see what you kept from the crime scene, would you?
Off the Rails#962.dst: Heureusement qu'il n'est pas resté. Vous ne voudriez pas qu'il voie ce que vous avez gardé de la scène du crime, n'est-ce pas?

Off the Rails#964.src: Hey... Could you stop that, please?
Off the Rails#964.dst: Hé... Vous pourriez arrêter, s'il vous plaît?
Off the Rails#964.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#965.src: Ah, alright. Well, do come back if you do want to talk about anything.
Off the Rails#965.dst: Ah, d'accord. Eh bien, reviens si tu veux parler de quoi que ce soit.
Off the Rails#965.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#966.src: There's a hastily-scrawn note stuck to this locker, saying "Demma"
Off the Rails#966.dst: Un mot griffonné à la hâte est collé sur ce casier: "Demma"

Off the Rails#967.src: There's a hastily-scrawn note stuck to this locker, saying "Cemor"

Off the Rails#973.src: Oh, alright then. Good luck catching that murderer.
Off the Rails#973.dst: Ah, très bien. Bonne chance pour attraper cet assassin.
Off the Rails#973.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#975.src: Thank you for the chat, it's helped me take my mind off things. Good luck figuring out the murder!
Off the Rails#975.dst: Merci pour la discussion, ça m'a changé les idées. Bonne chance pour élucider ce meurtre!
Off the Rails#975.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#977.src: "MAJIN PEACOCK POWER Refined Energy Booster: Brand new energy drink hitting vending machines across the {p}!"
Off the Rails#977.dst: "MAJIN PEACOCK POWER Refined Energy Booster: la nouvelle boisson énergisante arrive dans les distributeurs de {p}!"

Off the Rails#978.src: "Have you ever wallowed in the envy that you will never be as great as Sovereign Majin? As graceful? As energetic?"
Off the Rails#978.dst: "Avez-vous déjà ruminé l'envie de ne jamais être aussi grand que le Souverain Majin? Aussi gracieux? Aussi énergique?"

Off the Rails#979.src: "Well, Majin PEACOCK POWER may not make the first two true, but you can equal his liveliness with this fabulous new beverage."
Off the Rails#979.dst: "Majin PEACOCK POWER ne réalisera peut-être pas les deux premiers, mais grâce à cette fabuleuse boisson, vous égalerez sa vitalité."

Off the Rails#980.src: "Six hours of restlessness guaranteed! Perfect for getting through those long shifts. Buy today!"
Off the Rails#980.dst: "Six heures d'éveil garanties! Idéal pour tenir les longues journées de travail. Achetez-la dès aujourd'hui!"

Off the Rails#981.src: "Zhirao Sleep Solution: A beverage for hard workers."
Off the Rails#981.dst: "Zhirao Sleep Solution: la boisson des travailleurs acharnés."

Off the Rails#982.src: "Provides five hours of ambitious wakefulness, so you can stay on your feet."
Off the Rails#982.dst: "Cinq heures d'éveil ambitieux pour rester debout."

Off the Rails#983.src: "Sold now in vending machines across the {p}."
Off the Rails#983.dst: "En vente dans les distributeurs de tout {p}."

Off the Rails#984.src: Thank you for the chat. See you on the train!
Off the Rails#984.dst: Merci pour la discussion. A bientôt dans le train!
Off the Rails#984.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#985.src: This bench looks pretty comfortable. If you sat here, time would almost pass in an instant...
Off the Rails#985.dst: Ce banc a l'air plutôt confortable. Assis ici, le temps passerait presque en un instant...

Off the Rails#986.src: Would you like to sit in the bench? If you do this, it will skip the timer, and you may miss some interactions!
Off the Rails#986.dst: Voulez-vous vous asseoir sur le banc? Cela passera le minuteur, et vous risquez de manquer certaines interactions!

One Thousand Meters Under#000.src: Read the Help Wanted sign in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
One Thousand Meters Under#000.dst: Lisez l'annonce "Cherche de l'aide" à {p}, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

One Thousand Meters Under#004.src: Oh, you're here about the job vacancy? Well, you're a little late.
One Thousand Meters Under#004.dst: Vous venez pour le poste vacant? Eh bien, vous êtes un peu en retard.
One Thousand Meters Under#004.speaker: The Secretary

One Thousand Meters Under#005.src: There might still be time, just sneak in to the conference room behind me.
One Thousand Meters Under#005.dst: Il est peut-être encore temps: glissez-vous dans la salle de réunion derrière moi.
One Thousand Meters Under#005.speaker: The Secretary

One Thousand Meters Under#006.src: Enter the conference room and listen to the scientist.
One Thousand Meters Under#006.dst: Entrez dans la salle de réunion et écoutez le scientifique.

One Thousand Meters Under#008.src: I am Ynnos, one of the leading scientists in Gavel. You're here because... Well you read the help wanted sign.
One Thousand Meters Under#008.dst: Je suis Ynnos, l'un des plus grands scientifiques de Gavel. Vous êtes ici parce que... eh bien, vous avez lu l'annonce.
One Thousand Meters Under#008.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#009.src: Allow me to explain the situation we're in. It's a series of unfortunate events. I study the amazing properties of crystals and other geodes.
One Thousand Meters Under#009.dst: Laissez-moi vous expliquer notre situation. Une série de désastres. J'étudie les étonnantes propriétés des cristaux et autres géodes.
One Thousand Meters Under#009.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#010.src: I am funded by a private organization, however that seems to have stopped. So... We had to make cuts in the budget.
One Thousand Meters Under#010.dst: Une organisation privée me finance, mais cela semble avoir cessé. Alors... nous avons dû réduire le budget.
One Thousand Meters Under#010.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#011.src: One of these, was using cheaper rope. While moving the crystal across {p}, well, it snapped. The crystal fell.
One Thousand Meters Under#011.dst: L'une des économies a été une corde moins chère. En faisant traverser {p} au cristal, elle a cédé. Le cristal est tombé.
One Thousand Meters Under#011.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#012.src: I can not stress the value of that crystal. It had many unique properties that are allowing me to understand why the {p} float the way they do.
One Thousand Meters Under#012.dst: Je ne saurais trop insister sur la valeur de ce cristal. Ses propriétés uniques m'aidaient à comprendre pourquoi les {p} flottent ainsi.
One Thousand Meters Under#012.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#013.src: They hold the very key to restoring this land to being whole once more... But it's gone.
One Thousand Meters Under#013.dst: Il détient la clé pour rendre cette terre entière à nouveau... Mais il a disparu.
One Thousand Meters Under#013.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#014.src: Fortunately, I detected an impact. It's hit something down in the void. We're not sure what, however or how deep.
One Thousand Meters Under#014.dst: Heureusement, j'ai détecté un impact. Il a heurté quelque chose en bas, dans le Vide. Nous ignorons quoi, et à quelle profondeur.
One Thousand Meters Under#014.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#015.src: Your mission will be to retrieve the crystal in a specially designed ship to withstand the void. We barely scraped it out of the budget, so try to bring it back in one piece.
One Thousand Meters Under#015.dst: Votre mission: récupérer le cristal à bord d'un vaisseau conçu pour résister au Vide. Il a à peine tenu dans le budget, alors ramenez-le en un seul morceau.
One Thousand Meters Under#015.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#016.src: If you think you are not up for the challenge, leave now...
One Thousand Meters Under#016.dst: Si vous ne vous sentez pas à la hauteur, partez maintenant...
One Thousand Meters Under#016.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#017.src: When you think you are ready, exit the room behind me and meet me at the dock as soon as possible.
One Thousand Meters Under#017.dst: Quand vous serez prêts, sortez par la porte derrière moi et rejoignez-moi au quai au plus vite.
One Thousand Meters Under#017.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#019.src: Wait for the submarine to arrive at the void islands.
One Thousand Meters Under#019.dst: Attendez que le sous-marin arrive aux îles du Vide.

One Thousand Meters Under#021.src: This is the ship's mechanic. There appears to be a fault on the lower deck. I request urgent assistance.
One Thousand Meters Under#021.dst: Ici le mécanicien. Il semble y avoir une panne au pont inférieur. Je demande de l'aide d'urgence.
One Thousand Meters Under#021.speaker: Kantor

One Thousand Meters Under#022.src: I wonder what the mechanic is doing?
One Thousand Meters Under#022.speaker: Arlene

One Thousand Meters Under#023.src: He has been screaming and crying for a while now. I hope everything is alright down there.
One Thousand Meters Under#023.dst: Ça fait un moment qu'il crie et qu'il pleure. J'espère que tout va bien en bas.
One Thousand Meters Under#023.speaker: Arlene

One Thousand Meters Under#024.src: Ah finally! One of the air pipes has shattered, we need to patch it up ASAP!
One Thousand Meters Under#024.dst: Ah, enfin! Un tuyau d'air a éclaté, il faut le colmater au plus vite!
One Thousand Meters Under#024.speaker: Kantor

One Thousand Meters Under#025.src: Quick, head into the room behind me and line up the white glass with the blue blocks. I'll control things from here!
One Thousand Meters Under#025.dst: Vite, entre dans la salle derrière moi et aligne le verre blanc avec les blocs bleus. Je gère d'ici!
One Thousand Meters Under#025.speaker: Kantor

One Thousand Meters Under#026.src: Take a nap in the resting room.
One Thousand Meters Under#026.dst: Faites une sieste dans la salle de repos.

One Thousand Meters Under#027.src: Oh wow, thanks for the help! You should head up to the resting room and take a nap before we arrive at the first island.
One Thousand Meters Under#027.dst: Oh, merci pour le coup de main! Monte à la salle de repos faire une sieste avant la première île.
One Thousand Meters Under#027.speaker: Kantor

One Thousand Meters Under#028.src: Talk to the captain outside of the submarine.
One Thousand Meters Under#028.dst: Parlez au capitaine à l'extérieur du sous-marin.

One Thousand Meters Under#029.src: We have encountered out first island, {~}m down. Crew members, climb up the ladder and search the island for the crystal.
One Thousand Meters Under#029.dst: Nous avons atteint la première île, à {~} m de fond. Équipage, montez à l'échelle et cherchez le cristal sur l'île.
One Thousand Meters Under#029.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#030.src: We've arrived at the next void island.
One Thousand Meters Under#030.dst: Nous sommes arrivés à l'île du Vide suivante.
One Thousand Meters Under#030.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#031.src: The void islands are really different from Gavel... Or are we still even in Gavel?
One Thousand Meters Under#031.dst: Les îles du Vide ne ressemblent pas du tout à Gavel... Sommes-nous seulement encore à Gavel?
One Thousand Meters Under#031.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#032.src: Anyway, let's explore the island, look for the crystal, and return to {p}!
One Thousand Meters Under#032.dst: Bref, explorons l'île, trouvons le cristal et rentrons à {p}!
One Thousand Meters Under#032.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#033.src: Explore the island and look for the crystal.
One Thousand Meters Under#033.dst: Explorez l'île et cherchez le cristal.

One Thousand Meters Under#034.src: Return to the submarine and continue your journey.
One Thousand Meters Under#034.dst: Retournez au sous-marin et poursuivez votre voyage.

One Thousand Meters Under#036.src: Oh my, what are these creatures!?
One Thousand Meters Under#036.dst: Grands dieux, qu'est-ce que ces créatures!?
One Thousand Meters Under#036.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#037.src: They are attacking the windshield in the front room, it looks like it's about to break any moment!
One Thousand Meters Under#037.dst: Elles attaquent le pare-brise de la salle avant, il va céder d'un instant à l'autre!
One Thousand Meters Under#037.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#038.src: Quick, you! Come to the cockpit and press on the window to scare them off!
One Thousand Meters Under#038.dst: Vite, toi! Viens au poste de pilotage et appuie sur la vitre pour les effrayer!
One Thousand Meters Under#038.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#039.src: This is not good, the creatures destroyed part of the windshield.
One Thousand Meters Under#039.dst: Mauvaise nouvelle, les créatures ont détruit une partie du pare-brise.
One Thousand Meters Under#039.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#040.src: We can't continue much longer with a broken windshield, we'll have to repair it at another island.
One Thousand Meters Under#040.dst: Impossible de continuer longtemps avec un pare-brise cassé, il faudra le réparer sur une autre île.
One Thousand Meters Under#040.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#041.src: Ynnos said the void has pockets of toxic gas... Go take a nap, I'll wake you up when we're there.
One Thousand Meters Under#041.dst: Ynnos a dit que le Vide a des poches de gaz toxique... Va faire une sieste, je te réveille à l'arrivée.
One Thousand Meters Under#041.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#042.dst: Rendez-vous dans la salle de repos.

One Thousand Meters Under#043.src: Meet up with the captain outside the submarine.
One Thousand Meters Under#043.dst: Retrouvez le capitaine à l'extérieur du sous-marin.

One Thousand Meters Under#044.src: Attention crew. We have arrived at the second island, {~}m down. We cannot progress without making some emergency repairs.
One Thousand Meters Under#044.dst: Attention, équipage. Nous sommes à la deuxième île, à {~} m de fond. Impossible d'aller plus loin sans réparations d'urgence.
One Thousand Meters Under#044.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#045.src: Crew, please disembark and search resources to help repair the ship. We need glass and some kind of glue.
One Thousand Meters Under#045.dst: Équipage, débarquez et cherchez de quoi réparer le vaisseau. Il nous faut du verre et une sorte de colle.
One Thousand Meters Under#045.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#046.src: The void creatures did heavy damage to our craft, we need to repair the submarine.
One Thousand Meters Under#046.dst: Les créatures du Vide ont gravement endommagé l'appareil, il faut réparer le sous-marin.
One Thousand Meters Under#046.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#047.src: I'm not sure what we'll find here, but we'll need some glue and glass...
One Thousand Meters Under#047.dst: Je ne sais pas ce qu'on trouvera ici, mais il nous faut de la colle et du verre...
One Thousand Meters Under#047.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#048.src: I doubt we'll find those exact things, so get resourceful!
One Thousand Meters Under#048.dst: Ça m'étonnerait qu'on trouve exactement ça, alors débrouillez-vous!
One Thousand Meters Under#048.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#049.src: Bring me [{~} Sand Substitutes] and [{~} Glue Substitutes], that should be enough.
One Thousand Meters Under#049.dst: Rapportez-moi [{~} Sand Substitutes] et [{~} Glue Substitutes], ça devrait suffire.
One Thousand Meters Under#049.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#050.src: Find [{~} Sand] and [{~} Glue] on the void island.
One Thousand Meters Under#050.dst: Trouvez [{~} Sand] et [{~} Glue] sur l'île du Vide.

One Thousand Meters Under#051.src: Ech! What is this stuff? Well, this should do the trick.
One Thousand Meters Under#051.dst: Beurk! C'est quoi, ce truc? Bon, ça devrait faire l'affaire.
One Thousand Meters Under#051.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#052.src: The mechanic and I will start repairing. It'll take a while, so enter the submarine and rest up.
One Thousand Meters Under#052.dst: Le mécanicien et moi lançons les réparations. Ce sera long, alors rentre dans le sous-marin et repose-toi.
One Thousand Meters Under#052.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#053.src: We'll continue the trip when we've repaired the ship.
One Thousand Meters Under#053.dst: Nous reprendrons le voyage une fois le vaisseau réparé.
One Thousand Meters Under#053.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#055.src: This is the mechanic, requesting urgent assistance in the basement!
One Thousand Meters Under#055.dst: Ici le mécanicien, je demande de l'aide d'urgence au sous-sol!
One Thousand Meters Under#055.speaker: Jesp

One Thousand Meters Under#056.src: Toxic gas has leaked in through the submarine's vents, someone will have to manually close them.
One Thousand Meters Under#056.dst: Du gaz toxique s'est infiltré par les conduits du sous-marin, il faut les fermer à la main.
One Thousand Meters Under#056.speaker: Jesp

One Thousand Meters Under#057.src: I'll control things from here, someone get down to the lowest level and close those vents!
One Thousand Meters Under#057.dst: Je gère d'ici. Que quelqu'un descende au niveau le plus bas et ferme ces conduits!
One Thousand Meters Under#057.speaker: Jesp

One Thousand Meters Under#058.src: Attention crew. We have arrived at the next island {~}m down.
One Thousand Meters Under#058.dst: Attention, équipage. Voici l'île suivante, à {~} m de fond.
One Thousand Meters Under#058.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#059.src: Disembark and start the search for the crystal.
One Thousand Meters Under#059.dst: Débarquez et commencez à chercher le cristal.
One Thousand Meters Under#059.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#060.src: Let's hope it's here... I don't know how much more void my body can handle.
One Thousand Meters Under#060.dst: Pourvu qu'il soit ici... Mon corps ne supportera plus beaucoup de Vide.
One Thousand Meters Under#060.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#061.src: Look out! {u}, we'll build a bridge to the other island whilst you defend us from the mobs!
One Thousand Meters Under#061.dst: Attention! {u}, on construit un pont vers l'autre île pendant que tu nous défends des monstres!
One Thousand Meters Under#061.speaker: Rex

One Thousand Meters Under#063.src: Keep fighting! We're almost halfway to the other side!
One Thousand Meters Under#063.dst: Continue de te battre! On est presque à mi-chemin!
One Thousand Meters Under#063.speaker: Jesp

One Thousand Meters Under#066.src: Return to the submarine and continue the journey.
One Thousand Meters Under#066.dst: Retournez au sous-marin et poursuivez le voyage.

One Thousand Meters Under#067.src: We didn't find the crystal here either. Maybe it just fell in the void?
One Thousand Meters Under#067.dst: Pas de cristal ici non plus. Il est peut-être tombé dans le Vide, tout simplement?
One Thousand Meters Under#067.speaker: Rex

One Thousand Meters Under#068.src: No, it must have hit an island. The scientist said he detected a collision.
One Thousand Meters Under#068.dst: Non, il a dû heurter une île. Le scientifique a détecté une collision.
One Thousand Meters Under#068.speaker: Manny

One Thousand Meters Under#070.src: The ropes are snapping! Quick! Abandon ship!
One Thousand Meters Under#070.dst: Les cordes lâchent! Vite! Abandonnez le navire!
One Thousand Meters Under#070.speaker: Manny

One Thousand Meters Under#074.src: Someone dropped a boooook about you people! Warriors! Workers!
One Thousand Meters Under#074.dst: On a fait tomber un liiiivre sur les tiens! Guerriers! Ouvriers!
One Thousand Meters Under#074.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#075.src: Ah. Yoooou want to know about this place?
One Thousand Meters Under#075.dst: Ah. Tu veux en saaaavoir plus sur cet endroit?
One Thousand Meters Under#075.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#076.src: Well... We were once Villagers. I think we still are, a bit.
One Thousand Meters Under#076.dst: Eh bien... Nous étions villageois. Je crois qu'on l'est encore, un peu.
One Thousand Meters Under#076.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#077.src: For some reason, {~} years agoooo. The sky islands ruptured.
One Thousand Meters Under#077.dst: Allez savoir pourquoi, il y a {~} aaaans, les îles célestes ont éclaté.
One Thousand Meters Under#077.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#078.src: Some stayed. Others fell. We somehow survived the fall into the vooooid.
One Thousand Meters Under#078.dst: Certains sont restés. D'autres sont tombés. On a survécu à la chute dans le Viiiide.
One Thousand Meters Under#078.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#079.src: How we have lived for so long, I doooo not know. But one thing we know for sure. The void provides.
One Thousand Meters Under#079.dst: Comment nous avons vécu si longtemps, je l'iiiignore. Mais une chose est sûre: le Vide pourvoit.
One Thousand Meters Under#079.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#080.src: We are stuck here now. The void has forever changed our physiology.
One Thousand Meters Under#080.dst: Nous voilà coincés ici. Le Vide a changé notre corps pour toujours.
One Thousand Meters Under#080.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#081.src: The crystal yoooou are looking for fell on this island. But...
One Thousand Meters Under#081.dst: Le cristal que tu chercheeeees est tombé sur cette île. Mais...
One Thousand Meters Under#081.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#082.src: We need it. It will aid us for years.
One Thousand Meters Under#082.dst: Nous en avons besoin. Il nous servira des années.
One Thousand Meters Under#082.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#083.src: We have very limited resources here. That's why a power source like this is soooo valuable.
One Thousand Meters Under#083.dst: Nos ressources sont très limitées ici. C'est pour ça qu'une telle source d'énergie est siiii précieuse.
One Thousand Meters Under#083.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#084.src: If you go to the east, you will find Rontaid, our chief scientist. He'll know what to doooo.
One Thousand Meters Under#084.dst: A l'est, tu trouveras Rontaid, notre scientifique en chef. Il saura quoi faiiiire.
One Thousand Meters Under#084.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#085.src: Talk to Rontaid outside the town at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
One Thousand Meters Under#085.dst: Parlez à Rontaid à l'extérieur du village, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

One Thousand Meters Under#086.dst: QUOI... QUI... Des humains dans le Vide!?
One Thousand Meters Under#086.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#087.src: Well, looks like the book we found wasn't fiction after all!
One Thousand Meters Under#087.dst: Tiens, le livre qu'on a trouvé n'était pas une fiction, en fait!
One Thousand Meters Under#087.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#088.src: This crystal is going toooo be our saviour. I was trying to create one of my own, you know.
One Thousand Meters Under#088.dst: Ce cristal vaaaa être notre salut. J'essayais d'en créer un moi-même, tu sais.
One Thousand Meters Under#088.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#089.src: I think I have the formula, but we don't have what we need to make it.
One Thousand Meters Under#089.dst: Je crois avoir la formule, mais nous n'avons pas de quoi le fabriquer.
One Thousand Meters Under#089.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#090.src: Instead of taking this crystal back, why don't I exchange it for the recipe?
