One Thousand Meters Under#090.dst: Au lieu de rapporter ce cristal, pourquoi ne pas l'échanger contre la recette?
One Thousand Meters Under#090.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#091.src: That way, you can make however many crystals youuuu want, and we can keep this one.
One Thousand Meters Under#091.dst: Ainsi, tu pourras fabriquer autant de cristaux que tu veuuuux, et nous gardons celui-ci.
One Thousand Meters Under#091.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#092.src: Here's the recipe, give it to a scientist or someone a bit...smarter than yourself. No offense.
One Thousand Meters Under#092.dst: Voici la recette, donne-la à un scientifique ou à quelqu'un d'un peu... plus malin que toi. Sans vexer.
One Thousand Meters Under#092.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#093.src: A platform was lowered from the surface a while ago at your crash site, as well. If youuuu wish to return, follow this path, I made a shortcut.
One Thousand Meters Under#093.dst: Une plateforme a aussi été descendue de la surface il y a peu, là où vous vous êtes écrasés. Si tu veuuuux remonter, suis ce chemin, j'ai fait un raccourci.
One Thousand Meters Under#093.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#094.src: Return to the crash site by following the road.
One Thousand Meters Under#094.dst: Retournez sur le lieu de l'accident en suivant la route.

One Thousand Meters Under#095.src: Return to the scientist and tell him the news.
One Thousand Meters Under#095.dst: Retournez voir le scientifique pour lui annoncer la nouvelle.

One Thousand Meters Under#096.src: You survived! Where is everyone else?
One Thousand Meters Under#096.dst: Tu as survécu! Où sont les autres?
One Thousand Meters Under#096.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#098.src: I knew some must have died... But all of them?
One Thousand Meters Under#098.dst: Je savais que certains mourraient... Mais tous?
One Thousand Meters Under#098.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#099.src: Well... At least I don't have to pay them! Hah!
One Thousand Meters Under#099.dst: Bah... Au moins, je n'ai pas à les payer! Ha!
One Thousand Meters Under#099.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#100.src: ...That was heartless of me, I'm sorry. The rope we used was too weak to hold you down there.
One Thousand Meters Under#100.dst: ...C'était cruel de ma part, pardon. La corde utilisée était trop faible pour vous retenir là-dessous.
One Thousand Meters Under#100.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#101.src: My calculations didn't account for the void's physics, it seems.
One Thousand Meters Under#101.dst: Mes calculs n'ont pas tenu compte de la physique du Vide, semble-t-il.
One Thousand Meters Under#101.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#102.src: At least we got you back in one piece. You can tell us what happened.
One Thousand Meters Under#102.dst: Au moins, tu es revenu entier. Tu peux nous raconter ce qui s'est passé.
One Thousand Meters Under#102.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#104.src: Well I'll be damned. I'll start sending post down there! We can work together.
One Thousand Meters Under#104.dst: Ça alors, ça me sidère. Je vais envoyer du courrier là-dessous! Nous pourrons collaborer.
One Thousand Meters Under#104.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#105.src: Better to keep everything that happened here a secret. I don't want to lose what little funding I have. This recipe is genius! Here, take this, as well as your money.
One Thousand Meters Under#105.dst: Mieux vaut garder tout ceci secret. Je ne veux pas perdre le peu de financement qui me reste. Cette recette est géniale! Tiens, prends ceci, ainsi que ta paie.
One Thousand Meters Under#105.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#107.src: It looks like everyone already went inside the submarine.
One Thousand Meters Under#107.dst: On dirait que tout le monde est déjà monté dans le sous-marin.

One Thousand Meters Under#109.src: Looks like you managed to fix the pipe! You should tell the mechanic.
One Thousand Meters Under#109.dst: On dirait que vous avez réparé le tuyau! Prévenez le mécanicien.

One Thousand Meters Under#110.src: Who would've thought that the crystal fell that far...
One Thousand Meters Under#110.dst: Qui aurait cru que le cristal était tombé si loin...
One Thousand Meters Under#110.speaker: Manny

One Thousand Meters Under#111.src: But after all, there's still a lot ahead of us!
One Thousand Meters Under#111.dst: Mais après tout, il reste encore de la route!
One Thousand Meters Under#111.speaker: Manny

One Thousand Meters Under#112.src: Have you looked around for the island for the crystal yet?
One Thousand Meters Under#112.dst: Tu as déjà fouillé l'île pour trouver le cristal?
One Thousand Meters Under#112.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#113.src: If you haven't found anything, jump back in the submarine and I'll take us down to the next one.
One Thousand Meters Under#113.dst: Si tu n'as rien trouvé, remonte dans le sous-marin et je nous descends jusqu'à la suivante.
One Thousand Meters Under#113.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#114.src: I've been hearing a lot of strange sounds...
One Thousand Meters Under#114.speaker: Arlene

One Thousand Meters Under#115.src: Pfft. I would've done a better job saving the windshield.
One Thousand Meters Under#115.dst: Pff. J'aurais mieux sauvé le pare-brise, moi.
One Thousand Meters Under#115.speaker: Jesp

One Thousand Meters Under#116.src: Too bad I was in another room.
One Thousand Meters Under#116.dst: Dommage que j'aie été dans une autre salle.
One Thousand Meters Under#116.speaker: Jesp

One Thousand Meters Under#117.src: Oh no, this isn't good. The windshield is destroyed...
One Thousand Meters Under#117.dst: Oh non, ça ne va pas. Le pare-brise est détruit...
One Thousand Meters Under#117.speaker: Kantor

One Thousand Meters Under#118.src: I thought this trip was going to be easy.
One Thousand Meters Under#118.dst: Je croyais que ce voyage serait facile.
One Thousand Meters Under#118.speaker: Kantor

One Thousand Meters Under#120.src: This sand must've fallen from the sky islands, but why is it red?
One Thousand Meters Under#120.dst: Ce sable a dû tomber des îles célestes, mais pourquoi est-il rouge?
One Thousand Meters Under#120.speaker: Manny

One Thousand Meters Under#122.src: It smells really...sterile? Does this mean I have to work...?
One Thousand Meters Under#122.dst: Ça sent vraiment... le stérile? Ça veut dire que je dois travailler...?
One Thousand Meters Under#122.speaker: Kantor

One Thousand Meters Under#123.src: We need this crystal. Go see Rontaid on the eastern part of the island, he can figure something out.
One Thousand Meters Under#123.dst: Il nous faut ce cristal. Va voir Rontaid dans l'est de l'île, il trouvera une solution.
One Thousand Meters Under#123.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#124.src: I hope you make use of our science.
One Thousand Meters Under#124.dst: J'espère que tu sauras tirer parti de notre science.
One Thousand Meters Under#124.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#125.src: We don't want another village to fall down here... I'm not sure we could provide for even more people.
One Thousand Meters Under#125.dst: Nous ne voulons pas qu'un autre village tombe ici... Je doute qu'on puisse nourrir encore plus de monde.
One Thousand Meters Under#125.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#126.src: Looks like the backup team have lowered a crane down to the island, this is your way out!
One Thousand Meters Under#126.dst: L'équipe de secours a descendu une grue jusqu'à l'île, voilà votre sortie!

One Thousand Meters Under#127.src: I'm working on a replacement for the crystal now...
One Thousand Meters Under#127.dst: Je travaille sur un remplaçant pour le cristal...
One Thousand Meters Under#127.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#128.src: These void villagers are rather smart, but their handwriting is utterly atrocious.
One Thousand Meters Under#128.dst: Ces villageois du Vide sont plutôt malins, mais leur écriture est absolument atroce.
One Thousand Meters Under#128.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#129.src: The crystal you're looking for is purple, not blue.
One Thousand Meters Under#129.dst: Le cristal que vous cherchez est violet, pas bleu.

One Thousand Meters Under#130.src: You probably could've seen that from the other side.
One Thousand Meters Under#130.dst: Vous auriez sans doute pu le voir depuis l'autre côté.

Out of my Mind#000.src: Wait Viola, this is our chance! This stranger sure seems like they could tackle anything, even evil hermit crabs! We could just ask them to see if these rumours are true!
Out of my Mind#000.dst: Attends, Viola, c'est notre chance! Cet étranger a l'air de pouvoir tout affronter, même des bernard-l'ermite maléfiques! Demandons-lui de vérifier ces rumeurs!

Out of my Mind#001.src: I don't know, you guys, all these rumours seem a little far-fetched. What next? Will he suddenly turn out to be some mad scientist?
Out of my Mind#001.dst: Je ne sais pas, vous autres, ces rumeurs me semblent un peu tirées par les cheveux. Et quoi encore? Il va se révéler être un savant fou?
Out of my Mind#001.speaker: Viola

Out of my Mind#002.src: Let's go, I'll take you to the exit so that I don't waste your time any longer!
Out of my Mind#002.dst: Allons-y, je te conduis à la sortie pour ne plus te faire perdre de temps!

Out of my Mind#003.src: So you must be thinking, how have you never met a fine fellow such as myself until now? To be quite honest, you must have just been terribly unlucky, I used to travel the world, you know!
Out of my Mind#003.dst: Tu dois te demander comment tu n'as jamais croisé un aussi charmant personnage que moi! Franchement, tu as dû manquer de chance, car je parcourais le monde, tu sais!
Out of my Mind#003.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#004.src: Oh the places I've been were wonderful! From the depths of the jungle to the lesser depths of the jungle to even my back garden, I've done my fair share of exploring, if I do say so myself!
Out of my Mind#004.dst: Ah, les endroits que j'ai vus étaient merveilleux! Des profondeurs de la jungle aux moindres profondeurs de la jungle, jusqu'à mon jardin, j'ai beaucoup exploré, sans vouloir me vanter!

Out of my Mind#005.src: You are the first normal person I've seen recently, {u}. I went out recently and was met with some very rude remarks by some very rude townsfolk!
Out of my Mind#005.dst: Tu es la première personne normale que je vois depuis longtemps, {u}. L'autre jour, des villageois très grossiers m'ont fait des remarques très grossières!

Out of my Mind#006.src: The last time I visited the town it was all empty too, but I could feel people were hiding in their homes, even on such a lovely day as then. There was no one even there to hide from! Strange people.
Out of my Mind#006.dst: La dernière fois, le village était désert aussi, mais je sentais que les gens se cachaient chez eux, par une si belle journée! Et il n'y avait personne de qui se cacher! Drôles de gens.
Out of my Mind#006.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#007.src: Here we are, the library! I could spend years in here, but who has time for that? I could talk about books for hours too! Here's one right now.
Out of my Mind#007.dst: Nous y voilà, la bibliothèque! Je pourrais y passer des années, mais qui a le temps? Et parler de livres pendant des heures! Tiens, en voici un.
Out of my Mind#007.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#008.src: The ground is shaking... I thought that was supposed to happen later! Come back friend, I can't do this alone!
Out of my Mind#008.dst: Le sol tremble... Ça devait arriver plus tard! Reviens, l'ami, je n'y arriverai pas seul!

Out of my Mind#009.src: If you remember, we were talking about keeping the door shut when suddenly something heavy fell off a shelf hitting you square in the head!
Out of my Mind#009.dst: Souviens-toi, on parlait de tenir la porte fermée quand un objet lourd est tombé d'une étagère, pile sur ta tête!
Out of my Mind#009.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#010.src: During the shaking, some of my machines broke apart, but we could use these to build something capable of dropping something heavier on your head for the second time.
Out of my Mind#010.dst: Le tremblement a cassé certaines de mes machines, mais avec les pièces, on peut construire de quoi te faire tomber un truc plus lourd sur la tête une seconde fois.
Out of my Mind#010.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#011.src: Surely by that logic everything has to go well, you know. Now let me explain how we can do this. First, choose what part you want to use to make our machine, then choose were you want it to go and face.
Out of my Mind#011.dst: Avec cette logique, tout doit forcément bien se passer, tu sais. Je t'explique. D'abord, choisis la pièce à utiliser pour notre machine, puis choisis où la placer et dans quel sens.
Out of my Mind#011.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#012.src: Quick, head through the large door and stop the cause of all that shaking!
Out of my Mind#012.dst: Vite, passe la grande porte et arrête ce qui cause ces secousses!
Out of my Mind#012.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#013.src: I don't know about you, Todd, but I feel we should make them our new honorary club member for finding such amazing things!
Out of my Mind#013.dst: Je ne sais pas toi, Todd, mais on devrait le nommer membre d'honneur du club pour avoir trouvé des choses pareilles!
Out of my Mind#013.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#014.src: Ignore Viola, she's acting up today, probably because you've got the spotlight this time. However, I agree with Prentiss.
Out of my Mind#014.dst: Ignore Viola, elle fait des siennes aujourd'hui, sûrement parce que c'est toi la vedette. Mais je suis d'accord avec Prentiss.
Out of my Mind#014.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#015.src: Welcome you to the club, new member! Here is your shiny new badge that you can parade around town to show off how cool you are to others with style.
Out of my Mind#015.dst: Bienvenue au club, nouveau membre! Voici ton badge tout neuf, à exhiber en ville pour montrer avec style à quel point tu es cool.
Out of my Mind#015.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#016.src: You tell the group of kids your experiences of strange creatures, even stranger men as well as a hazy memory about... a coconut?
Out of my Mind#016.dst: Vous racontez aux enfants vos rencontres avec d'étranges créatures, des hommes encore plus étranges et un vague souvenir de... une noix de coco?

Out of my Mind#017.src: Speak with the {p} children in the treehouse.
Out of my Mind#017.dst: Parlez aux enfants de {p} dans la cabane dans l'arbre.

Out of my Mind#018.src: Did ye two hear about some guy wandering around town? I've heard strange rumours about him...
Out of my Mind#018.dst: Vous avez entendu parler d'un type qui rôde en ville? Il paraît qu'on raconte des trucs bizarres sur lui...
Out of my Mind#018.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#019.src: Of course I have, he's the talk of the town! I heard he only brushes his teeth once a day and that he enjoys books about gardening!
Out of my Mind#019.dst: Évidemment, tout le monde en parle! Il paraît qu'il ne se brosse les dents qu'une fois par jour et qu'il aime les livres de jardinage!
Out of my Mind#019.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#020.src: Oh shush you, we're not living inside some storybook! Besides, if he *was* a mad scientist, wouldn't he be trying to take over the city like all mad scientists in stories do?
Out of my Mind#020.dst: Oh, chut, on ne vit pas dans un livre de contes! Et puis, si c'était *vraiment* un savant fou, il essaierait de conquérir la ville, comme tous ceux des histoires, non?
Out of my Mind#020.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#021.src: To me that doesn't sound all that strange compared to these other things I've been hearing, anyway... Something about labs and a "hermit".
Out of my Mind#021.dst: Moi, ça ne me paraît pas si bizarre à côté de tout ce que j'ai entendu... Un truc avec des labos et un "ermite".
Out of my Mind#021.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#022.src: I think that's a type of crab or something. Adults are right old weirdos sometimes.
Out of my Mind#022.dst: Je crois que c'est une sorte de crabe. Les adultes sont de vrais zigotos, parfois.
Out of my Mind#022.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#023.src: Hey, a stranger! How long have you been listening to us? Didn't your mom teach you any manners?
Out of my Mind#023.dst: Hé, un inconnu! Depuis quand tu nous écoutes? Ta mère ne t'a pas appris la politesse?
Out of my Mind#023.speaker: Viola

Out of my Mind#024.src: Ignore my friends over there, they're always like that, but what Prentiss said was true. This might be our only chance to really know who this mystery man really is!
Out of my Mind#024.dst: Ignore mes amis, ils sont toujours comme ça, mais Prentiss a raison. C'est peut-être notre seule chance de savoir qui est vraiment cet homme mystérieux!
Out of my Mind#024.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#025.src: It might be a good idea to look at that weird house next to those spooky ruins south-east of the city. We found this key you could try out, but if you lose it there are some spares in our base.
Out of my Mind#025.dst: Tu pourrais aller voir la maison bizarre près des ruines lugubres, au sud-est de la ville. On a trouvé cette clé, essaie-la; si tu la perds, on en a d'autres à notre base.
Out of my Mind#025.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#026.src: Find the hidden door next to the Undergrowth Ruins outside {p}
Out of my Mind#026.dst: Trouvez la porte cachée près des Ruines des broussailles, à l'extérieur de {p}

Out of my Mind#027.src: Find a way inside the house at [-{~},-{~}]
Out of my Mind#027.dst: Trouvez un moyen d'entrer dans la maison en [-{~},-{~}]

Out of my Mind#028.src: Explore the hidden lab in search of information
Out of my Mind#028.dst: Explorez le laboratoire caché à la recherche d'informations

Out of my Mind#029.src: Hello stranger! Welcome to my humble wooden abode. Comfy, isn't it? I bet you'd like a cup of this coff-
Out of my Mind#029.dst: Bonjour, étranger! Bienvenue dans mon humble demeure de bois. Douillet, non? Je parie que tu veux une tasse de ce caf-
Out of my Mind#029.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#030.src: Oh yes, I am the affable Ariodo, friendly neighbourhood neighbour. What do you need me for?
Out of my Mind#030.dst: Ah oui, je suis l'affable Ariodo, le voisin le plus sympa du quartier. Que puis-je pour toi?
Out of my Mind#030.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#031.src: Kidnappings? Poaching? Not brushing my teeth?! Who is this lowly person you're talking about... they don't seem like a nice fellow such as myself.
Out of my Mind#031.dst: Des enlèvements? Du braconnage? Ne pas se brosser les dents?! Qui est donc cet être si vil dont tu parles... il n'a pas l'air aussi gentil que moi.
Out of my Mind#031.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#032.src: This is the room you came from. I call it the "Vivarium", creative name I came up with, right? It keeps my pets that aren't quite ready.
Out of my Mind#032.dst: Voici la pièce d'où tu viens. Je l'appelle le "Vivarium", créatif, non? J'y garde mes animaux pas tout à fait prêts.
Out of my Mind#032.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#033.src: Ready for what? Well that would ruin the surprise, wouldn't it? Can't have anyone finding out before the big event!
Out of my Mind#033.dst: Prêts pour quoi? Ça gâcherait la surprise, non? Personne ne doit savoir avant le grand jour!
Out of my Mind#033.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#034.src: Let us go now, time is precious.
Out of my Mind#034.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#035.src: I'm just a normal guy, so why can't anyone appreciate me for once? I'm sure you do, right?
Out of my Mind#035.dst: Je suis un type normal, alors pourquoi personne ne m'apprécie, pour une fois? Toi, si, hein?
Out of my Mind#035.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#036.src: This is 'The Long-Winded and Painful Death of Sweeney S. Greenville' and I must say it is a hidden gem among books! One day it just suddenly appeared in here so I couldn't resist reading it. So it starts off with Sweeney S. Greenville...
Out of my Mind#036.dst: Voici "La longue et douloureuse mort de Sweeney S. Greenville", un vrai joyau méconnu! Un jour, il est apparu ici, et je n'ai pas pu résister. Alors, ça commence avec Sweeney S. Greenville...
Out of my Mind#036.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#037.src: We're here now! Take the exit right in front of you, don't mind the corridor to the right, it's only decoration!
Out of my Mind#037.dst: Nous y voilà! Prends la sortie juste devant toi, ignore le couloir de droite, il est purement décoratif!
Out of my Mind#037.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#038.src: Maybe you can come back some day for a tea or coffee and a long talk about books, since I noticed you were very interested in my long-winded review! Have fun out there and don't forget, I'm always here for you!
Out of my Mind#038.dst: Reviens un jour pour un thé ou un café et une longue discussion sur les livres, j'ai vu que ma critique interminable t'a passionné! Amuse-toi bien dehors, et n'oublie pas: je suis toujours là pour toi!
Out of my Mind#038.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#039.src: Build a machine to hit your head and get back to normal
Out of my Mind#039.dst: Construisez une machine pour vous frapper la tête et redevenir normal

Out of my Mind#040.src: Help me keep this door shut, or else my surprise will be ruined!
Out of my Mind#040.dst: Aide-moi à tenir cette porte fermée, sinon ma surprise sera gâchée!
Out of my Mind#040.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#041.src: Just keep to the sides, it's safer that way.
Out of my Mind#041.dst: Reste sur les côtés, c'est plus sûr.
Out of my Mind#041.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#042.src: Just stay here for one more momen...
Out of my Mind#042.dst: Reste ici encore un petit instan...
Out of my Mind#042.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#043.src: Oh my, a ghost? Wait, is this just you, my trusty friend, playing a prank on me? No? Well that certainly is a problem!
Out of my Mind#043.dst: Oh, un fantôme? Attends, c'est toi, mon fidèle ami, qui me fais une farce? Non? Eh bien, voilà un problème!
Out of my Mind#043.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#044.src: I think I heard something about fighting fire with fire, so I think I have a way to get you back! You are a bit too heavy for me, so we need to think of a workaround.
Out of my Mind#044.dst: On dit qu'il faut combattre le feu par le feu, alors je crois savoir comment te faire revenir! Tu es un peu trop lourd pour moi, il faut trouver une autre solution.
Out of my Mind#044.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#045.src: The [Cart] can carry the coconut from one end of the platform to another for a few tiles, while the [Fan] can push the coconut even further.
Out of my Mind#045.dst: Le [Cart] transporte la noix de coco d'un bout à l'autre de la plateforme sur quelques cases, et le [Fan] la pousse encore plus loin.
Out of my Mind#045.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#046.src: The [Hammer] is able to knock the coconut over a one space gap while the [Cannon] can shoot the coconut one grid up diagonally in the direction it is facing.
Out of my Mind#046.dst: Le [Hammer] fait sauter la noix de coco par-dessus un trou d'une case, et le [Cannon] la tire d'une case vers le haut, en diagonale, dans sa direction.
Out of my Mind#046.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#047.src: I think I hit my head too, so I'll need your help deciding where to place each part. You want to get the coconut across to the green tile, remember?
Out of my Mind#047.dst: Je crois que je me suis cogné la tête aussi, aide-moi à placer chaque pièce. Il faut amener la noix de coco jusqu'à la case verte, tu te souviens?
Out of my Mind#047.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#048.src: You're back! To be quite honest, I didn't think that would work, but I'm glad it did!
Out of my Mind#048.dst: Te revoilà! Franchement, je ne pensais pas que ça marcherait, mais tant mieux!
Out of my Mind#048.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#049.src: Find a way to destroy the plant monster, then return to the group in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to report your findings
Out of my Mind#049.dst: Trouvez un moyen de détruire le monstre végétal, puis retournez voir le groupe à {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] pour raconter vos découvertes

Out of my Mind#050.src: Oh no no, this is not good! If I had known that my little pet has grown so much I would have rushed you out sooner. Now it is wilted...
Out of my Mind#050.dst: Oh non, non, ce n'est pas bon! Si j'avais su que mon petit animal avait autant grandi, je t'aurais fait sortir plus tôt. Le voilà flétri...
Out of my Mind#050.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#051.src: You did what you had to, though. I am sorry to say this friend, but I think I'll stay inside a little longer. Sorry, my only friend.
Out of my Mind#051.dst: Mais tu as fait ce qu'il fallait. Désolé de te dire ça, l'ami, mais je vais rester enfermé encore un peu. Pardon, mon seul ami.
Out of my Mind#051.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#052.src: We'll surely meet again in the future, so don't be sad. I'll still be the one and only friendly neighbourhood neighbour when that moment comes, I promise. Goodbye now!
Out of my Mind#052.dst: On se reverra sûrement, alors ne sois pas triste. Je serai toujours le seul et unique voisin sympa du quartier ce jour-là, promis. Au revoir!
Out of my Mind#052.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#053.src: You're back! You were gone for ages too, and what happened to your head? Who did the mystery man turn out to be?
Out of my Mind#053.dst: Te revoilà! Tu en as mis du temps, et qu'est-il arrivé à ta tête? Alors, qui était cet homme mystérieux?
Out of my Mind#053.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#054.src: That sounds ridiculous! Who could ever belie-
Out of my Mind#054.speaker: Viola

Out of my Mind#055.src: Wow that sounded just like in the stories, but it came from you, so it must be true!
Out of my Mind#055.dst: Waouh, on dirait une histoire de livre, mais ça vient de toi, donc c'est forcément vrai!
Out of my Mind#055.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#056.src: Why do I even try... You two would believe anything.
Out of my Mind#056.dst: Pourquoi je me fatigue... Vous gobez n'importe quoi, vous deux.
Out of my Mind#056.speaker: Viola

Out of my Mind#057.src: I'm pretty sure they mentioned something about being hit by coconut crabs, and just look at their head. One... two... two huge bumps!
Out of my Mind#057.dst: Je suis sûr qu'il a parlé de crabes de cocotier qui l'ont frappé, et regarde sa tête. Une... deux... deux énormes bosses!
Out of my Mind#057.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#058.src: Oh fine... whatever you say, Prentiss. I'm sure they'll bring you on some wacky adventures next time around!
Out of my Mind#058.dst: Bon, d'accord... comme tu veux, Prentiss. La prochaine fois, il t'embarquera sûrement dans une aventure loufoque!
Out of my Mind#058.speaker: Viola

Out of my Mind#059.src: Thanks to you, we solved the case of the mystery man as well as the mystery house! For this I'd like to...
Out of my Mind#059.dst: Grâce à toi, on a résolu le mystère de l'homme et celui de la maison! Pour ça, j'aimerais...
Out of my Mind#059.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#060.src: Also since all the adults do it, we'll give you some emeralds that you rightly deserve for such an achievement. We all pitched in!
Out of my Mind#060.dst: Et puisque tous les adultes le font, on te donne des émeraudes, bien méritées pour un tel exploit. On s'est tous cotisés!
Out of my Mind#060.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#061.src: Speak with the {p} children at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] inside the treehouse
Out of my Mind#061.dst: Parlez aux enfants de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], dans la cabane dans l'arbre

Overture to Despair#000.src: - No weaponry or blessed equipment in common areas.
Overture to Despair#000.dst: - Ni armes ni équipement béni dans les espaces communs.

Overture to Despair#004.src: May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change.
Overture to Despair#004.dst: Puissions-nous déterrer la vérité enfouie et faire advenir le changement.
Overture to Despair#004.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

similar.text: May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change. Never forget that.

Overture to Despair#005.src: Different plants require different soils, temperatures and water requirements.
Overture to Despair#005.dst: Chaque plante a ses propres besoins en sol, en température et en eau.

Overture to Despair#006.src: At first, I was afraid of being labeled as cursed. But power does not come without risk. I am willing to risk everything for power.
Overture to Despair#006.dst: Au début, je craignais d'être traité de maudit. Mais il n'y a pas de pouvoir sans risque. Je suis prêt à tout risquer pour le pouvoir.

Overture to Despair#007.dst: Mini-quête lancée: Cueillir des lys blancs

similar.text: Mini-Quest Started: Collect Liff Leaves

Overture to Despair#009.src: Do you want to play a song?

Overture to Despair#010.src: - Late checkout will come with a {~}  fine.
Overture to Despair#010.dst: - Tout départ tardif entraînera une amende de {~}.

Overture to Despair#011.src: You open a page at random...
Overture to Despair#011.dst: Vous ouvrez une page au hasard...

Overture to Despair#013.src: The painting most likely symbolises the destruction of the Auburn of old and the hope of a better time to come.
Overture to Despair#013.dst: Le tableau symbolise sans doute la destruction de l'ancienne Auburn et l'espoir de jours meilleurs.

Overture to Despair#014.src: Painted in {~}NA by Piju Rae. This oil masterpiece embraces revolutionary color techniques using pigments sourced from the highland dye production.
Overture to Despair#014.dst: Peint en {~}NA par Piju Rae. Ce chef-d'oeuvre à l'huile adopte des techniques de couleur révolutionnaires, avec des pigments des teintureries des hautes terres.

Overture to Despair#016.dst: La vie est faite pour la force

Overture to Despair#017.src: Heather is a simple starting plant to grow in the {p}. Any acidic soil from the {p} can be used in the gardening bed or flower pot.
Overture to Despair#017.dst: La bruyère est une plante facile pour débuter dans {p}. Tout sol acide de {p} convient pour la plate-bande ou le pot de fleurs.

Overture to Despair#018.src: To keep it working as intended, the power to issue death sentences should be limited. Giving one trusted official, besides Her Majesty, the right to pass
Overture to Despair#018.dst: Pour bien fonctionner, le droit de prononcer la peine de mort devrait être limité. Donner à un seul haut fonctionnaire de confiance, outre Sa Majesté, le droit de prononcer

Overture to Despair#019.dst: Les pétales tombent sur notre destin

Overture to Despair#020.src: Would you like to keep reading?

Overture to Despair#021.src: Do you want to get some ice?
Overture to Despair#021.dst: Voulez-vous aller chercher de la glace?

Overture to Despair#022.src: Paper published and written by Majin in {~}IA.
Overture to Despair#022.dst: Article écrit et publié par Majin en {~}IA.

Overture to Despair#025.src: New Chapter Started: Blossom of Blades
Overture to Despair#025.dst: Nouveau chapitre: la Fleur des Lames

Overture to Despair#026.src: Meet up with Sui outside {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#026.dst: Retrouvez Sui à l'extérieur de {p}, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#027.src: ...{p}. Ha, the... the tourists really weren't lying when they kept saying it was a work of art.
Overture to Despair#027.dst: ...{p}. Ha, les... les touristes ne mentaient pas quand ils disaient que c'était une oeuvre d'art.
Overture to Despair#027.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#028.src: It must be nice, living here... being able to ignore everything going on everywhere else...
Overture to Despair#028.dst: Ça doit être agréable, de vivre ici... de pouvoir ignorer tout ce qui se passe ailleurs...
Overture to Despair#028.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#029.src: {u}, we need to find that... that so-called "number one" Sovereign! If we can do that, then... ha, then we can save Rex and Zeph.
Overture to Despair#029.dst: {u}, il faut trouver ce... ce soi-disant Souverain "numéro un"! Si on y arrive, alors... ha, on pourra sauver Rex et Zeph.
Overture to Despair#029.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#030.dst: On ne peut pas foncer comme ça.

Overture to Despair#031.src: Why not?! You're the one who wanted to- to rush into Deraj and free everyone without even stopping to think about it!
Overture to Despair#031.dst: Pourquoi pas?! C'est toi qui voulais- foncer dans Deraj et libérer tout le monde sans même réfléchir!
Overture to Despair#031.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#032.src: So why can't I?! The longer we wait, the more chances there are for s-something to happen!! We need to go already!
Overture to Despair#032.dst: Alors pourquoi pas moi?! Plus on attend, plus il risque de se p-passer quelque chose!! Il faut y aller!
Overture to Despair#032.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#033.dst: Il nous faut d'abord un plan!

Overture to Despair#034.src: Yeah, I have one. Find the Sovereign. Free Rex and Zeph. And get out of there!
Overture to Despair#034.dst: Oui, j'en ai un. Trouver le Souverain. Libérer Rex et Zeph. Et filer de là!
Overture to Despair#034.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#035.src: I'll... f-fill in the details as we go. I will! We just need to go already!
Overture to Despair#035.dst: Je... r-réglerai les détails en route. Promis! Il faut juste y aller!
Overture to Despair#035.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#036.dst: ...on n'a pas le temps de se disputer.
Overture to Despair#036.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#039.src: I guess... the Canopy? We can bring them to the Canopy! That... that works...
Overture to Despair#039.dst: Je suppose... à la Canopée? On peut les emmener à la Canopée! Ça... ça marche...
Overture to Despair#039.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#040.src: Um... n-no, I guess not. But- but we can find someone who does, and- and force the information out of them!
Overture to Despair#040.dst: Euh... n-non, je suppose que non. Mais- mais on peut trouver quelqu'un qui sait, et- et lui arracher l'information!
Overture to Despair#040.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#041.src: We can do that. Captain Fuhue, she... told me about some of her methods! I just... need to find someone who... knows...
Overture to Despair#041.dst: On peut le faire. La capitaine Fuhue... m'a parlé de certaines de ses méthodes! Il faut juste... trouver quelqu'un qui... sait...
Overture to Despair#041.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#042.src: If- if that's what it takes!! We were able to k-kill Gikyo, weren't we?
Overture to Despair#042.dst: S'il- s'il le faut!! On a bien réussi à t-tuer Gikyo, non?
Overture to Despair#042.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#043.src: Even if it was hard... and Majin is... probably stronger...
Overture to Despair#043.dst: Même si c'était dur... et Majin est... sûrement plus fort...
Overture to Despair#043.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#044.src: Good. Okay! To start with, we...
Overture to Despair#044.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#047.src: Okay, fine, maybe you're right! Just... ugh!! We have to do something!
Overture to Despair#047.dst: Bon, d'accord, tu as peut-être raison! C'est juste... argh!! Il faut agir!
Overture to Despair#047.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#048.src: ...right. That's... smart. Word's probably spread from, um, {p}, hasn't it...? We'll need to blend in better.
Overture to Despair#048.dst: ...c'est vrai. C'est... malin. La nouvelle a dû partir de, euh, {p}, non...? Il faudra mieux nous fondre dans la masse.
Overture to Despair#048.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#049.src: And... we don't know how long it'll be until we... find the information we need. So... a place to stay, too?
Overture to Despair#049.dst: Et... on ne sait pas combien de temps il faudra pour... trouver ce qu'on cherche. Alors... un endroit où loger, aussi?
Overture to Despair#049.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#050.src: Okay. Find new clothes, and find a place to stay. That's a plan. We can do that.
Overture to Despair#050.dst: D'accord. Trouver des vêtements, et un endroit où loger. Voilà un plan. On peut le faire.
Overture to Despair#050.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#054.src: Indeed, I am. I was raised here in {p}.
Overture to Despair#054.dst: En effet. J'ai grandi ici, à {p}.
Overture to Despair#054.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#055.src: Though, in truth... I've never really left. I'm planning on enlisting in the military once I've completed my provincial tour.
Overture to Despair#055.dst: Mais à vrai dire... je ne suis jamais vraiment parti. Je compte m'engager dans l'armée après mon tour de la province.
Overture to Despair#055.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#056.src: I've been saving up for years for a round-trip ticket throughout the province... I'd like to see all of the less-fortunate regions firsthand.
Overture to Despair#056.dst: J'économise depuis des années pour un aller-retour à travers la province... J'aimerais voir de mes yeux les régions moins fortunées.
Overture to Despair#056.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#057.src: I'm leaving just after the festival. Exciting, isn't it?
Overture to Despair#057.dst: Je pars juste après le festival. C'est excitant, non?
Overture to Despair#057.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#058.src: Hotels... hm. I know of several, though most have probably filled entirely for the upcoming festival.
Overture to Despair#058.dst: Des hôtels... hm. J'en connais plusieurs, mais la plupart doivent être complets pour le festival.
Overture to Despair#058.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#059.src: There is a fancy hotel north of the bank... The Crown Jewel, I believe? It's probably far too expensive for you, however.
Overture to Despair#059.dst: Il y a un hôtel chic au nord de la banque... le Joyau de la Couronne, je crois? Sans doute bien trop cher pour vous, cependant.
Overture to Despair#059.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#060.src: A fine question. I'm not too certain, honestly... growing up here has made me overlook things.
Overture to Despair#060.dst: Bonne question. Je ne suis pas trop sûr, honnêtement... à grandir ici, on finit par ne plus rien remarquer.
Overture to Despair#060.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#061.src: I know tourists typically travel here to look at all our mansions and castles, though. Perhaps you'd be interested?
Overture to Despair#061.dst: Je sais que les touristes viennent surtout voir nos manoirs et nos châteaux. Cela vous intéresserait peut-être?
Overture to Despair#061.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#064.src: How might I help you this fine day?
Overture to Despair#064.dst: Que puis-je faire pour vous en cette belle journée?
Overture to Despair#064.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#065.src: As fine as one may be! Thank you for your inquiry.
Overture to Despair#065.dst: On ne peut mieux! Merci de vous en enquérir.
Overture to Despair#065.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#066.src: I have been graciously afforded an hour off from my work, so I have chosen to take the time and... smell the roses. To admire the beauty of our city.
Overture to Despair#066.dst: On m'a gracieusement accordé une heure de pause, alors j'en profite pour... humer les roses. Admirer la beauté de notre ville.
Overture to Despair#066.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#067.src: Ah... tourists from the lower districts, I take it? A fine use of your travel allotments.
Overture to Despair#067.dst: Ah... des touristes des districts inférieurs, je présume? Bel usage de votre quota de voyage.
Overture to Despair#067.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#068.src: You will want to visit the bustling market on the west side, it would be a shame to miss it!
Overture to Despair#068.dst: Allez voir le marché animé à l'ouest, ce serait dommage de le manquer!
Overture to Despair#068.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#069.src: And if you wish to leave the bounds of the city, I have heard one may find tour guides which will bring you to see the mountains!
Overture to Despair#069.dst: Et si vous voulez sortir de la ville, il paraît que des guides peuvent vous emmener voir les montagnes!
Overture to Despair#069.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#070.src: Yes, {p} is known for its high fashion, isn't it? I'm certain you've heard about it... wherever you come from.
Overture to Despair#070.dst: Oui, {p} est réputée pour sa haute couture, n'est-ce pas? Vous en avez sûrement entendu parler... d'où que vous veniez.
Overture to Despair#070.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#071.src: The famous House Til has placed a pop-up clothes shop to the north, if you're interested.
Overture to Despair#071.dst: La célèbre Maison Til a ouvert une boutique éphémère au nord, si cela vous intéresse.
Overture to Despair#071.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#072.src: I wish you the best on your stay! Praise be to her Majesty!
Overture to Despair#072.dst: Je vous souhaite un excellent séjour! Gloire à Sa Majesté!
Overture to Despair#072.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#074.src: I should have thought about where I'd be staying... I've never taken a train before, so all my thinking went towards making sure that went well!
Overture to Despair#074.dst: J'aurais dû penser à où loger... Je n'avais jamais pris le train, alors toute mon attention était sur le voyage!
Overture to Despair#074.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#075.src: And now all the hotels except the Crown Jewel are fully booked! Will I... will I have to sleep on the street?
Overture to Despair#075.dst: Et maintenant tous les hôtels sauf le Joyau de la Couronne sont complets! Vais-je... vais-je devoir dormir dans la rue?
Overture to Despair#075.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#076.src: Oh, what am I going to do...?
Overture to Despair#076.dst: Oh, qu'est-ce que je vais faire...?
Overture to Despair#076.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#077.src: Oh, thank you, thank you! The Queen herself must have sent you my way!
Overture to Despair#077.dst: Oh, merci, merci! C'est la Reine en personne qui t'a mis sur mon chemin!
Overture to Despair#077.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#078.src: ...short on emeralds too, are you? Maybe we can share a comfy bush together! Ha...
Overture to Despair#078.dst: ...à court d'émeraudes, toi aussi? On pourrait partager un buisson douillet! Ha...
Overture to Despair#078.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#079.src: Oh, I'll remember you forever! You've truly made this festival the best one yet!
Overture to Despair#079.dst: Oh, je ne t'oublierai jamais! Tu as fait de ce festival le meilleur de tous!
Overture to Despair#079.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#080.src: I can't wait to tell my old folk all about it! How the Queen had blessed me with this miracle...
Overture to Despair#080.dst: J'ai hâte de tout raconter aux miens! Comment la Reine m'a bénie de ce miracle...
Overture to Despair#080.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#081.src: But, it wasn't the Queen that... oh, nevermind.
Overture to Despair#081.dst: Mais ce n'est pas la Reine qui... oh, laisse tomber.
Overture to Despair#081.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#082.src: Hello, hello! Care to buy any of our fine papers? Perhaps a magazine is up your alley today- quite the juicy bits of gossip I've heard.
Overture to Despair#082.dst: Bonjour, bonjour! Un de nos excellents journaux? Ou plutôt un magazine aujourd'hui? J'ai entendu des ragots bien juteux.
Overture to Despair#082.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#083.src: Hm... Do I want the Crown of Seraphim collection, or the Peacock Couture...
Overture to Despair#083.dst: Hm... La collection Crown of Seraphim, ou la Peacock Couture...
Overture to Despair#083.speaker: Roughworks Tourist

Overture to Despair#084.src: Oh, this is important... a whole year's paycheck is going towards this!
Overture to Despair#084.dst: Oh, c'est important... j'y mets une année entière de salaire!
Overture to Despair#084.speaker: Roughworks Tourist

Overture to Despair#087.src: Well, it seems you're in luck! Considering this is a pop-up clothes stall, and all.
Overture to Despair#087.dst: Eh bien, vous avez de la chance! Vu que c'est une boutique de vêtements éphémère.
Overture to Despair#087.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#088.src: I'm here representing House Til today. The new fashionable spring line has almost sold out, so shop now if you're interested!
Overture to Despair#088.dst: Je représente la Maison Til aujourd'hui. La nouvelle collection de printemps est presque épuisée, alors achetez vite si ça vous tente!
Overture to Despair#088.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#089.src: Um... is this the fashion around here?
Overture to Despair#089.dst: Euh... c'est la mode, par ici?
Overture to Despair#089.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#090.src: Oh, yes. People from all across the province come to shop at these pop-up events.
Overture to Despair#090.dst: Oh, oui. Les gens viennent de toute la province pour ces ventes éphémères.
Overture to Despair#090.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#091.src: House Til is known for incorporating the designs from peacock feathers into their most extravagant garments!
Overture to Despair#091.dst: La Maison Til est réputée pour intégrer des motifs de plumes de paon à ses tenues les plus extravagantes!
Overture to Despair#091.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#092.src: They come in a wide variety of available colours- all from the district's local dye production!
Overture to Despair#092.dst: Il y en a dans une foule de couleurs, toutes issues de la teinturerie locale du district!
Overture to Despair#092.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#093.src: We don't need anything fancy. Just... show us the cheapest stuff you have, okay?
Overture to Despair#093.dst: On n'a pas besoin de luxe. Montrez-nous juste ce que vous avez de moins cher, d'accord?
Overture to Despair#093.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#094.src: My goodness! You must know fashion does not come cheap, miss! Please, allow me to recommend-
Overture to Despair#094.dst: Grands dieux! La mode n'est pas bon marché, mademoiselle! Permettez-moi de vous conseiller-
Overture to Despair#094.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#095.src: No. Just let us buy the cheapest stuff you have.
Overture to Despair#095.dst: Non. Vendez-nous juste le moins cher que vous avez.
Overture to Despair#095.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#096.src: Uh huh... well, alright. If you insist...
Overture to Despair#096.dst: Hum... bon, très bien. Si vous insistez...
Overture to Despair#096.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#097.src: Here, the cheapest I have available. In total, that will cost you... {~} {#}.
Overture to Despair#097.dst: Voici ce que j'ai de moins cher. Au total, ça vous fera... {~} {#}.
Overture to Despair#097.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#098.src: Where regions meet through lines of burrowed steel.
Overture to Despair#098.dst: Là où les régions se joignent par des lignes d'acier enfoui.

Overture to Despair#099.src: Here, the cheapest I have available. In total, that will cost you... {~} EB.
Overture to Despair#099.dst: Voici ce que j'ai de moins cher. Au total, ça vous fera... {~} EB.
Overture to Despair#099.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#100.src: Very well. Here you are. Now, please leave, your attitude is not good for business!
Overture to Despair#100.dst: Très bien. Voilà. Maintenant, partez, votre attitude est mauvaise pour les affaires!
Overture to Despair#100.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#101.src: Okay... that's the clothes. Now we just... need a place to, um, stay. A hotel, maybe...
Overture to Despair#101.dst: Bon... les vêtements, c'est fait. Reste juste... un endroit où, euh, loger. Un hôtel, peut-être...
Overture to Despair#101.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#102.src: Well! As I said, fashion is not cheap!
Overture to Despair#102.dst: Eh bien! Je vous l'ai dit, la mode n'est pas bon marché!
Overture to Despair#102.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#103.src: Ah, you're back. As I said, the clothes will cost you {~} {#}.
Overture to Despair#103.dst: Ah, vous revoilà. Comme je disais, les vêtements coûtent {~} {#}.
Overture to Despair#103.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#105.src: Ah... Listen, I still need to sell all of my stock, or I won't receive my bonus!
Overture to Despair#105.dst: Ah... Écoutez, je dois encore écouler tout mon stock, sinon pas de prime!
Overture to Despair#105.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#106.src: So, unless you're interested in buying more clothes... please, leave.
Overture to Despair#106.dst: Alors, à moins de vouloir acheter d'autres vêtements... partez, je vous prie.
Overture to Despair#106.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#108.src: Why, hello and welcome to the Crown Jewel! How may I assist you?
Overture to Despair#108.dst: Bonjour, et bienvenue au Joyau de la Couronne! Que puis-je pour vous?
Overture to Despair#108.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#110.src: Well, do you have a booking?
Overture to Despair#110.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#112.src: Hm I see. In that case, allow me to quickly check our listings...
Overture to Despair#112.dst: Hm, je vois. Dans ce cas, laissez-moi vérifier nos disponibilités...
Overture to Despair#112.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#113.src: Aha! You're in luck! It seems we have a spare double room available! But that may not last long- let me tell you, they are selling fast!
Overture to Despair#113.dst: Aha! Vous avez de la chance! Il nous reste une chambre double! Mais ça ne durera pas, croyez-moi, elles partent vite!
Overture to Despair#113.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#114.dst: Il nous faut une chambre plus grande.

Overture to Despair#115.src: A... bigger room? You're certain? From where I stand, I only see the two of you, and-
Overture to Despair#115.dst: Une chambre... plus grande? Vous êtes sûrs? D'ici, je ne vois que vous deux, et-
Overture to Despair#115.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#116.src: We're... going to have friends with us. They just... haven't, um, arrived yet.
Overture to Despair#116.dst: Nous allons... avoir des amis avec nous. Ils ne sont juste... euh, pas encore arrivés.
Overture to Despair#116.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#117.src: I see. I see. That certainly complicates things...
Overture to Despair#117.dst: Je vois. Je vois. Voilà qui complique les choses...
Overture to Despair#117.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#118.src: "Day after day, the voices greet the seekers. Identify the truth, and read the secrets printed."
Overture to Despair#118.dst: "Jour après jour, les voix accueillent les chercheurs. Identifiez la vérité, et lisez les secrets imprimés."

Overture to Despair#119.src: I see. I see That certainly complicates things...
Overture to Despair#119.dst: Je vois. Je vois Voilà qui complique les choses...
Overture to Despair#119.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#120.src: Company? Well, whatever sort? If you're just looking to socialize, the double room should serve your purposes well en-
Overture to Despair#120.dst: De la compagnie? De quel genre? Si c'est juste pour recevoir, la chambre double devrait faire l'aff-
Overture to Despair#120.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#121.src: No, they'll... be staying with us.
Overture to Despair#121.dst: Non, ils vont... loger avec nous.
Overture to Despair#121.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#122.src: Mmn. Yes, that would certainly put a damper on things. Hm...
Overture to Despair#122.dst: Mmh. Oui, voilà qui gâche un peu les choses. Hm...
Overture to Despair#122.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#123.src: Well. I suppose we do also have the luxury suite available. Though, it's quite the hefty price...
Overture to Despair#123.dst: Bon. Je suppose qu'il nous reste aussi la suite de luxe. Mais elle coûte une petite fortune...
Overture to Despair#123.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#124.src: We- we'll take it. I'll pay.
Overture to Despair#124.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#125.src: You're certain? Apologies if I am making assumptions here, but you do not seem the sort who would have-
Overture to Despair#125.dst: Vous êtes sûre? Pardon de présumer, mais vous n'avez pas l'air du genre à avoir-
Overture to Despair#125.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#127.src: ...huh. Well, everything seems in order then. Here are your keys, madame.
Overture to Despair#127.dst: ...tiens. Eh bien, tout semble en ordre. Voici vos clés, madame.
Overture to Despair#127.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#129.src: {u}, I'm... going up to the room.
Overture to Despair#129.dst: {u}, je... je monte dans la chambre.
Overture to Despair#129.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#130.src: No. We're... not here for pleasure, {u}. We're here to... to... to save our friends.
Overture to Despair#130.dst: Non. On n'est pas... ici pour s'amuser, {u}. On est là pour... pour... pour sauver nos amis.
Overture to Despair#130.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#131.src: I'm, um... not hungry. And I'm, ha, definitely not in the mood for a drink.
Overture to Despair#131.dst: Je n'ai, euh... pas faim. Et je n'ai, ha, vraiment pas envie de boire un verre.
Overture to Despair#131.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#132.src: ...you can, um, take a look around though. If- if you want. Just... don't take too long.
Overture to Despair#132.dst: ...toi, tu peux, euh, jeter un oeil. S-si tu veux. Juste... ne traîne pas trop.
Overture to Despair#132.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#133.src: We're in... room {~}, apparently. I'll... leave the door open for you.
Overture to Despair#133.dst: On est dans la... chambre {~}, apparemment. Je... te laisse la porte ouverte.
Overture to Despair#133.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#134.src: Head to your room and discuss what to do next.
Overture to Despair#134.dst: Montez dans votre chambre pour discuter de la suite.

Overture to Despair#135.src: Ah! What can I do for you today?
Overture to Despair#135.dst: Ah! Que puis-je faire pour vous aujourd'hui?
Overture to Despair#135.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#136.src: The {p} are known for their very scenic walks and hikes! I would recommend walking around the lakes or hiking up to the mountains.
Overture to Despair#136.dst: Les {p} offrent des balades et randonnées très pittoresques! Je vous conseille le tour des lacs ou une randonnée dans les montagnes.
Overture to Despair#136.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#137.src: {p} is also known for their very rich alcohol culture. We brew a lot of different beverages that can be enjoyed at our local taverns.
Overture to Despair#137.dst: {p} est aussi réputée pour sa riche culture de l'alcool. Nous brassons quantité de boissons à déguster dans nos tavernes.
Overture to Despair#137.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#138.src: We are not hosting any particular events at this moment because of the upcoming festival.
Overture to Despair#138.dst: Nous n'organisons aucun événement en ce moment, à cause du festival qui approche.
Overture to Despair#138.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#139.src: Usually, we host game nights and quizzes in our bar!
Overture to Despair#139.dst: D'habitude, il y a des soirées jeux et des quiz au bar!
Overture to Despair#139.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#140.src: Oh, are things not up to your standard?
Overture to Despair#140.dst: Oh, quelque chose n'est pas à la hauteur?
Overture to Despair#140.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#141.src: What have you experienced issues with?
Overture to Despair#141.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#142.src: I apologise for that! We will send in a cleaner later to fluff em up for ya!
Overture to Despair#142.dst: Toutes mes excuses! Nous enverrons quelqu'un plus tard pour vous les regonfler!
Overture to Despair#142.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#144.src: Oh I will let our cleaners know to do a better job.
Overture to Despair#144.dst: Oh, je dirai au personnel de ménage de mieux faire.
Overture to Despair#144.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#145.src: Unfortunately there is nothing we can do to help with that.
Overture to Despair#145.dst: Malheureusement, nous ne pouvons rien y faire.
Overture to Despair#145.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#146.src: Let me know if there's anything I can do to make your stay better!
Overture to Despair#146.dst: Dites-moi si je peux faire quoi que ce soit pour améliorer votre séjour!
Overture to Despair#146.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#147.dst: - Pas de bruit après {~} h du soir.
Overture to Despair#147.speaker: Rules of The Crown Jewel

Overture to Despair#148.src: A year of saving... f-finally payed off!
Overture to Despair#148.speaker: Timasca Tourist

Overture to Despair#149.src: A... a giant meal, and a nice hotel... and I have it all to m-myself!! Best! Week!! Ever!!
Overture to Despair#149.dst: Un... un festin géant, et un bel hôtel... et tout ça pour m-moi seul!! Semaine!! De! Rêve!!
Overture to Despair#149.speaker: Timasca Tourist

Overture to Despair#153.src: ...I had heard that about the Auburn Festival!
Overture to Despair#153.dst: ...c'est ce que j'avais entendu du Festival d'Auburn!
Overture to Despair#153.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#154.src: I can't say I expected word to reach {p} from over there. Though, let me say... so far, I am very impressed by how {p} handles festivities.
Overture to Despair#154.dst: Je ne pensais pas que la nouvelle irait jusqu'à {p}. Mais je dois dire... jusqu'ici, la façon dont {p} fait la fête m'impressionne beaucoup.
Overture to Despair#154.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#155.src: Why, the real festivities haven't even begun! You're in for a treat, my friend.
Overture to Despair#155.dst: Mais les vraies festivités n'ont même pas commencé! Vous allez vous régaler, mon amie.
Overture to Despair#155.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#156.src: ...by chance, would you let me show you around when the festival starts in full? I've enjoyed our talks so far.
Overture to Despair#156.dst: ...accepteriez-vous que je vous fasse visiter quand le festival battra son plein? J'ai beaucoup apprécié nos échanges.
Overture to Despair#156.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#157.src: I'd love that. I've never been outside the {p} before... so it would be nice to have someone to guide me, wouldn't it?
Overture to Despair#157.dst: Avec plaisir. Je n'étais jamais sortie de {p}... alors ce serait bien d'avoir un guide, non?
Overture to Despair#157.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#159.src: Ah, I'm so glad we meet again!
Overture to Despair#159.dst: Ah, je suis si contente de te revoir!
Overture to Despair#159.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#160.src: Even though you... barged into my room... er, isn't that against hotel policy?
Overture to Despair#160.dst: Même si tu as... débarqué dans ma chambre... euh, ce n'est pas contraire au règlement?
Overture to Despair#160.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#161.src: ...oh, well, I won't tell them. You did help me pay for the room, after all! I wish you all the best.
Overture to Despair#161.dst: ...bah, je ne dirai rien. Après tout, tu m'as aidée à payer la chambre! Je te souhaite le meilleur.
Overture to Despair#161.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#162.src: Maybe we'll meet again! Perhaps I could buy you a drink at the festival?
Overture to Despair#162.dst: On se reverra peut-être! Je pourrais t'offrir un verre au festival?
Overture to Despair#162.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#163.src: ...oh, you're here. Are you done looking around?
Overture to Despair#163.dst: ...oh, te voilà. Tu as fini de faire le tour?
Overture to Despair#163.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#164.src: So, um. I've been... planning our next steps. Finding a place to stay was... a good idea, I guess. You were right. I shouldn't... rush into it.
Overture to Despair#164.dst: Alors, euh. J'ai... préparé la suite. Trouver où loger, c'était... une bonne idée, je suppose. Tu avais raison. Je ne devrais pas... foncer.
Overture to Despair#164.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#165.src: But this is a good place to regroup once we... once we get Rex and Zeph back. We should, ha, act as early as possible, though.
Overture to Despair#165.dst: Mais c'est un bon endroit pour se regrouper une fois que... qu'on aura récupéré Rex et Zeph. Il faudrait, ha, agir au plus tôt, quand même.
Overture to Despair#165.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#166.dst: Et si on arrivait trop tard?

Overture to Despair#167.src: Stop that. You k-keep doing that, acting as if... a-as if the worst is inevitable! It's not helpful!
Overture to Despair#167.dst: Arrête. Tu n'arrêtes p-pas, tu fais comme si... c-comme si le pire était inévitable! Ça n'aide pas!
Overture to Despair#167.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#168.src: Well... don't!! I know already, I know they might be gone, but I- I can't think like that. I can't. I have to believe they're still... fighting!!
Overture to Despair#168.dst: Eh bien... arrête!! Je sais, je sais qu'ils ne sont peut-être plus là, mais je- je ne peux pas penser comme ça. Je dois croire qu'ils se... battent encore!!
Overture to Despair#168.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#169.src: ...um. Anyway, we should... l-look around the town. To try and figure out where they're being held. If we can figure that out, then...
Overture to Despair#169.dst: ...euh. Bref, on devrait... f-fouiller la ville. Essayer de trouver où ils sont détenus. Si on y arrive, alors...
Overture to Despair#169.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#170.src: Look around the town, I guess... try and figure out where that Sovereign is keeping them. If we can figure that out, then... we can save them.
Overture to Despair#170.dst: Fouiller la ville, je suppose... essayer de trouver où ce Souverain les retient. Si on y arrive, alors... on pourra les sauver.
Overture to Despair#170.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#171.src: We should start right away. Come on.
Overture to Despair#171.dst: On devrait commencer tout de suite. Allez.
Overture to Despair#171.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#173.src: I can't, I can't, I can't. If I stop for... for even a second, I'll... I'll shatter. I have to keep moving. I have to.
Overture to Despair#173.dst: Je ne peux pas, je ne peux pas, je ne peux pas. Si je m'arrête... une seconde, je vais... je vais voler en éclats. Je dois avancer. Il le faut.
Overture to Despair#173.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#174.src: What do you think?! NO, I'm not doing alright!! But I have to do something about it, or... or... I'll shatter.
Overture to Despair#174.dst: A ton avis?! NON, ça ne va pas!! Mais je dois faire quelque chose, ou... ou... je vais voler en éclats.
Overture to Despair#174.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#175.src: You can... stay here and rest if you, um, need to. But I'm going to search the city for clues. By myself if... if I have to.
Overture to Despair#175.dst: Tu peux... rester ici te reposer si, euh, tu en as besoin. Mais moi, je vais chercher des indices en ville. Seule s'il... s'il le faut.
Overture to Despair#175.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#177.src: Meet up with Sui outside the Crown Jewel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#177.dst: Retrouvez Sui devant le Joyau de la Couronne, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#179.src: This... this wind chime. Look at it.
Overture to Despair#179.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#181.src: ...what? No, I'm looking at a wall. What do you think I was looking at?
Overture to Despair#181.dst: ...quoi? Non, je regarde un mur. A ton avis, je regardais quoi?
Overture to Despair#181.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#182.src: These wind chimes. They're... a symbol of resistance in the {p}. S... um, Syndra told us about them.
Overture to Despair#182.dst: Ces carillons à vent. Ils sont... un symbole de résistance dans {p}. S... euh, Syndra nous en a parlé.
Overture to Despair#182.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#183.src: The wind represents... freedom, and free will. But I wouldn't have expected the chimes to have made it all the way here...?
Overture to Despair#183.dst: Le vent représente... la liberté, le libre arbitre. Mais je ne pensais pas que les carillons étaient arrivés jusqu'ici...?
Overture to Despair#183.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#184.src: Could... could this mean what I think it does?
Overture to Despair#184.dst: Est-ce... est-ce que c'est ce que je crois?
Overture to Despair#184.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#185.src: I was right... I was right! It's a symbol of resistance, th-that means {p} must have its own resistance!!
Overture to Despair#185.dst: J'avais raison... j'avais raison! C'est un symbole de résistance, ç-ça veut dire que {p} a sa propre résistance!!
Overture to Despair#185.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#186.src: We... we need to seek them out, {u}!
Overture to Despair#186.dst: Il faut... il faut les trouver, {u}!
Overture to Despair#186.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#187.src: ...oh. Right. Um, sorry. I just... got excited.
Overture to Despair#187.dst: ...oh. Oui. Euh, pardon. Je me suis juste... emballée.
Overture to Despair#187.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#188.src: I think the whole city heard
Overture to Despair#188.dst: Je crois que toute la ville t'a entendue.
Overture to Despair#188.full: I think the whole city heard you.

Overture to Despair#189.src: ...oh. Oops. Let's um, hope I wasn't too loud...
Overture to Despair#189.dst: ...oh. Oups. Pourvu, euh, que je n'aie pas crié...
Overture to Despair#189.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#190.src: A-anyway. I think there's... an inscription on the wind chime.
Overture to Despair#190.dst: B-bref. Je crois qu'il y a... une inscription sur le carillon.
Overture to Despair#190.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#191.src: "The winds of change blow from the west, crashing waves of truth unto our shores."
Overture to Despair#191.dst: "Les vents du changement soufflent de l'ouest, brisant les vagues de vérité sur nos rives."
Overture to Despair#191.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#192.src: ...that must be where the resistance is! Let's- let's find them!
Overture to Despair#192.dst: ...c'est forcément là qu'est la résistance! Allons- allons les trouver!
Overture to Despair#192.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#193.src: Find the location specified on the wind chime in {p}: The winds of change blow from the west, crashing waves of truth unto our shores.
Overture to Despair#193.dst: Trouvez le lieu indiqué sur le carillon de {p}: Les vents du changement soufflent de l'ouest, brisant les vagues de vérité sur nos rives.

Overture to Despair#194.src: ...oh. There... doesn't seem to be a resistance here. Just another wind chime.
Overture to Despair#194.dst: ...oh. Il ne... semble pas y avoir de résistance ici. Juste un autre carillon.
Overture to Despair#194.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#195.src: Does this one also have something written on it?
Overture to Despair#195.dst: Il y a aussi quelque chose d'écrit sur celui-là?
Overture to Despair#195.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#196.src: Find the next location: Rooted deep atop the house of wealth and greed, the branches hear the whispers on the breeze.
Overture to Despair#196.dst: Trouvez le lieu suivant: Enracinées au sommet de la maison de la richesse et de l'avidité, les branches entendent les murmures de la brise.

Overture to Despair#197.src: Find the next location: The whispers speak of unity, called forth where regions meet through lines of burrowed steel.
Overture to Despair#197.dst: Trouvez le lieu suivant: Les murmures parlent d'unité, invoquée là où les régions se rejoignent par des lignes d'acier enfoui.

Overture to Despair#198.src: Find the next location: Day after day, the voices greet the seekers. Identify the truth, and read the secrets printed.
Overture to Despair#198.dst: Trouvez le lieu suivant: Jour après jour, les voix accueillent les chercheurs. Identifiez la vérité, et lisez les secrets imprimés.

Overture to Despair#199.src: What? {u}, what are you doing? That's not...
Overture to Despair#199.dst: Quoi? {u}, qu'est-ce que tu fais? Ce n'est pas...
Overture to Despair#199.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#200.src: ...um. We're very interested in your... um, your wind chimes.
Overture to Despair#200.dst: ...euh. Vos... euh, vos carillons à vent nous intéressent beaucoup.
Overture to Despair#200.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#201.src: Windchimes? I'm sorry? I haven't the foggiest idea what you mean. I've certainly heard of them down in the {p}, but here? What an odd thing to say.
Overture to Despair#201.dst: Des carillons? Pardon? Je n'ai pas la moindre idée de ce que vous voulez dire. J'en ai entendu parler là-bas, dans {p}, mais ici? Quelle drôle d'idée.
Overture to Despair#201.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#202.src: But still, perhaps I can get you a paper. Out of curiosity... where might you two be from? I don't think I've seen you around here before!
Overture to Despair#202.dst: Mais je peux peut-être vous vendre un journal. Par curiosité... d'où venez-vous, tous les deux? Je ne crois pas vous avoir déjà vus par ici!
Overture to Despair#202.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#204.src: Haha, oh dear. I asked where you were from, not the way you got here. So, let's try that one again! Where are you two from?
Overture to Despair#204.dst: Haha, oh là là. Je vous demandais d'où vous venez, pas comment vous êtes arrivés. Alors, on réessaie! D'où venez-vous, tous les deux?
Overture to Despair#204.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#205.src: Ah, yes, and I found a gold bar in my mailbox today! Haha, you'll have to try harder to pull one over on me like that- no one's lived in the {p} for ages! Now, be serious! I was genuine in asking.
Overture to Despair#205.dst: Ah, oui, et moi j'ai trouvé un lingot d'or dans ma boîte aux lettres ce matin! Haha, il faudra faire mieux pour me rouler: plus personne ne vit dans {p} depuis des lustres! Allons, soyez sérieux! Je demandais sincèrement.
Overture to Despair#205.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#206.src: So too we all do- from nothing but milk and love, as I've heard it's said, but if we were to talk about the origins of the universe we'd be here all night. So, where are you really from?
Overture to Despair#206.dst: Comme nous tous: de lait et d'amour, à ce qu'on dit. Mais si on parle des origines de l'univers, on y sera encore cette nuit. Alors, d'où venez-vous vraiment?
Overture to Despair#206.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#207.src: Ahaaa, I see! So you're looking for the people who seek the truth. A noble endeavour, certainly.
Overture to Despair#207.dst: Ahaaa, je vois! Vous cherchez donc ceux qui cherchent la vérité. Une noble entreprise, assurément.
Overture to Despair#207.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#208.src: We'd, um, love to meet some more of these... truth... seekers...?
Overture to Despair#208.dst: Nous aimerions, euh, rencontrer d'autres... chercheurs... de vérité...?
Overture to Despair#208.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#209.src: There's many a like-minded individual if you know where to look. So allow me to catch your eye with the Aelumia Times! It's the best way to keep up with current events.
Overture to Despair#209.dst: Il y a bien des esprits semblables, si l'on sait où regarder. Permettez-moi donc d'attirer votre regard sur l'Aelumia Times! Le meilleur moyen de suivre l'actualité.
Overture to Despair#209.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#210.src: Column {~} will often print the phrase of the day. Read up, and pay close attention! Things will kick off here at midnight.
Overture to Despair#210.dst: La colonne {~} publie souvent la phrase du jour. Lisez-la, et soyez très attentifs! Les choses commencent ici à minuit.
Overture to Despair#210.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#211.src: I wish you two good luck on your endeavours. May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change.
Overture to Despair#211.dst: Bonne chance à vous deux dans vos entreprises. Puissions-nous déterrer la vérité enfouie et faire advenir le changement.
Overture to Despair#211.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#212.src: Th-thank you. Um... may we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change!
Overture to Despair#212.dst: M-merci. Euh... puissions-nous déterrer la vérité enfouie et faire advenir le changement!
Overture to Despair#212.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#213.src: Leave the shop and discuss the next steps.
Overture to Despair#213.dst: Quittez la boutique et discutez de la suite.

Overture to Despair#214.src: Finally! Finally, finally, something good is happening!
Overture to Despair#214.dst: Enfin! Enfin, enfin, quelque chose de bien!
Overture to Despair#214.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#215.src: I didn't even think there'd be a resistance in {p}... it just seems so... idyllic, here. Like... um, like they don't really have... issues.
Overture to Despair#215.dst: Je n'imaginais même pas qu'il y ait une résistance à {p}... tout paraît si... idyllique, ici. Comme si... euh, comme s'ils n'avaient pas vraiment... de problèmes.
Overture to Despair#215.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#216.src: But... I guess we don't know what life is like here... um, either way, if they're a resistance, they have to have intel.
Overture to Despair#216.dst: Mais... on ne sait pas comment on vit ici, je suppose... euh, de toute façon, si c'est une résistance, ils doivent avoir des infos.
Overture to Despair#216.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#217.src: Here, hand me that newspaper. Okay... Column {~}... looks like today's phrase of the day is... "No such thing as a green Squirmle Pot?"
Overture to Despair#217.dst: Tiens, passe-moi ce journal. Bon... Colonne {~}... la phrase du jour serait... "Les Squirmle Pot verts, ça n'existe pas?"
Overture to Despair#217.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#218.src: Weird. But... I guess nobody's going to guess it!
Overture to Despair#218.dst: Bizarre. Mais... personne ne risque de la deviner!
Overture to Despair#218.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#219.src: Okay. Okay... th-this is happening! Majin Thalas, "number one" Sovereign, we're coming for you...
Overture to Despair#219.dst: D'accord. D'accord... ç-ça y est! Majin Thalas, Souverain "numéro un", on arrive...
Overture to Despair#219.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#220.src: I'm... feeling a lot better now. Um... what should we do now, then? While we... wait for midnight.
Overture to Despair#220.dst: Je... me sens beaucoup mieux. Euh... qu'est-ce qu'on fait, alors? En attendant... minuit.
Overture to Despair#220.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#222.src: I long for a worthy opponent, someone I can fully explore the depths of the endless cosmos with. Maybe then my hunger will be satiated.
Overture to Despair#222.dst: J'aspire à un adversaire digne, avec qui explorer pleinement les profondeurs du cosmos infini. Alors peut-être ma faim sera-t-elle assouvie.

Overture to Despair#223.src: I'm feeling a lot better now. Um... what should we do now, then? While we... wait for midnight.
Overture to Despair#223.dst: Je me sens beaucoup mieux. Euh... qu'est-ce qu'on fait, alors? En attendant... minuit.
Overture to Despair#223.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#224.src: Yes... um, thinking about it now, I guess I am kind of starving...
Overture to Despair#224.dst: Oui... euh, maintenant que j'y pense, je meurs un peu de faim...
Overture to Despair#224.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#225.src: I remember seeing a restaurant earlier! Follow me.
Overture to Despair#225.dst: J'ai vu un restaurant tout à l'heure! Suis-moi.
Overture to Despair#225.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#226.src: I... I guess I could use a nap...
Overture to Despair#226.dst: Je... une sieste ne me ferait pas de mal...
Overture to Despair#226.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#227.src: Okay. I'll meet you in our room.
Overture to Despair#227.dst: D'accord. On se retrouve dans la chambre.
Overture to Despair#227.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#228.src: Head to the restaurant and wait at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#228.dst: Rendez-vous au restaurant et attendez en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#229.src: Oh... this is quite cozy, actually. It... it, ha, doesn't really... compare to the Red Fox... but it works.
Overture to Despair#229.dst: Oh... c'est plutôt douillet, en fait. Ça... ha, ça ne vaut pas... le Renard Roux... mais ça ira.
Overture to Despair#229.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#230.src: Maybe it's... better that it, isn't the same. I'm not sure I could...
Overture to Despair#230.dst: C'est peut-être... mieux que ce soit différent. Je ne sais pas si je pourrais...
Overture to Despair#230.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#231.src: Hello, hello! Welcome to the Peacock Inn! What can I get started for you this evening?
Overture to Despair#231.dst: Bonjour, bonjour! Bienvenue à l'Auberge du Paon! Que puis-je vous servir ce soir?
Overture to Despair#231.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#232.src: Today's special dishes are fish tacos, fish miso soup, and yak curry! All locally sourced from our lovely {p}, naturally.
Overture to Despair#232.dst: Les plats du jour: tacos de poisson, soupe miso au poisson et curry de yak! Tout vient de notre cher {p}, bien sûr.
Overture to Despair#232.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#233.src: Um... I'll take the tacos, please.
Overture to Despair#233.dst: Euh... je vais prendre les tacos, s'il vous plaît.
Overture to Despair#233.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#236.src: Coming right up! It'll just be a few minutes.
Overture to Despair#236.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#237.src: ...it's nice here, isn't it? I hadn't... really let myself notice that before. I can see why people talk about the {p} so much...
Overture to Despair#237.dst: ...c'est agréable, ici, non? Je ne... m'étais pas vraiment autorisée à le remarquer. Je comprends pourquoi on parle tant de {p}...
Overture to Despair#237.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#238.src: I'm... ugh. I'm still so angry. At... everything! The crown, the sovereigns, the... the people of {p}, too!! For... for still living their lives, even... even when it feels like the world's ended.
Overture to Despair#238.dst: Je suis... argh. Je suis encore tellement en colère. Contre... tout! La couronne, les souverains, les... les gens de {p} aussi!! De... de continuer à vivre, même... même quand le monde semble fini.
Overture to Despair#238.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#240.src: I'm... ugh. I'm still so angry. At... everything! The crown, the sovereigns, the... the people of {p}, too!! For... for still living their lives, even, even when it feels like the world's ended.
Overture to Despair#240.dst: Je suis... argh. Je suis encore tellement en colère. Contre... tout! La couronne, les souverains, les... les gens de {p} aussi!! De... de continuer à vivre, même, même quand le monde semble fini.
Overture to Despair#240.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#241.src: And... is it weird that I kind of miss the Canopy, too? Even though they were... annoying, and overbearing, and- and kind of... scary?
Overture to Despair#241.dst: Et... c'est bizarre que la Canopée me manque aussi? Même s'ils étaient... pénibles, autoritaires, et- et un peu... effrayants?
