Overture to Despair#241.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#242.src: ...and Yusanu. I hope he's alright. I- I, ha, I really hope he can free his family too. I... I, um, don't want him to lose anyone either.
Overture to Despair#242.dst: ...et Yusanu. J'espère qu'il va bien. J- je, ha, j'espère vraiment qu'il pourra libérer sa famille aussi. Je... je, euh, ne veux pas qu'il perde qui que ce soit.
Overture to Despair#242.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#243.src: ...I hope he doesn't hate me. After what I said to him.
Overture to Despair#243.dst: ...j'espère qu'il ne me déteste pas. Après ce que je lui ai dit.
Overture to Despair#243.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#244.src: Um... while we wait. Is there anything you want to talk about?
Overture to Despair#244.dst: Euh... en attendant. Il y a quelque chose dont tu veux parler?
Overture to Despair#244.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#245.src: ...it's weird. It feels like the ocean is... raging. Thundering storms and crashing waves, and... and still, it doesn't feel like it's at risk of drowning me?
Overture to Despair#245.dst: ...c'est bizarre. L'océan semble... déchaîné. Orages grondants et vagues qui s'écrasent, et... et pourtant, il ne menace pas de me noyer?
Overture to Despair#245.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#246.src: Like... like I could take as much as I want and it wouldn't change a thing. And, ha, it scares me, a little. It's so... different, to how it was before, but...
Overture to Despair#246.dst: Comme... comme si je pouvais en prendre autant que je veux sans que rien ne change. Et, ha, ça me fait un peu peur. C'est si... différent d'avant, mais...
Overture to Despair#246.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#247.src: ...it feels right. Like this is how it always was supposed to be, and I just... didn't realize.
Overture to Despair#247.dst: ...ça semble juste. Comme si ça avait toujours dû être ainsi, et que je... ne m'en rendais pas compte.
Overture to Despair#247.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#248.src: What'll you do when it's all
Overture to Despair#248.dst: Que feras-tu quand tout sera fini?
Overture to Despair#248.full: What'll you do when it's all over?

Overture to Despair#249.src: Once it's... over...? I... I hadn't... let myself think about that...
Overture to Despair#249.dst: Quand tout sera... fini...? Je... je ne m'étais pas... autorisée à y penser...
Overture to Despair#249.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#250.src: I, um. I actually... had a dream last night. But, ha, it was- it was just that. Just a dream.
Overture to Despair#250.dst: Je, euh. En fait... j'ai fait un rêve cette nuit. Mais, ha, ce n'était- ce n'était que ça. Juste un rêve.
Overture to Despair#250.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#251.src: All of us... Rex, Zeph, the- the Roughworks boys... um, Mora, a-and Syndra... we were all laughing and, and having a good time at the Auburn Festival.
Overture to Despair#251.dst: Nous tous... Rex, Zeph, les- les gars de Roughworks... euh, Mora, e-et Syndra... on riait tous et, et on s'amusait au Festival d'Auburn.
Overture to Despair#251.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#252.src: We ate good food... Yuman played music, while Rex and Zeph were b-bickering... Yusanu and Mora were t-talking about his latest invention, and...
Overture to Despair#252.dst: On mangeait bien... Yuman jouait de la musique, Rex et Zeph se c-chamaillaient... Yusanu et Mora p-parlaient de sa dernière invention, et...
Overture to Despair#252.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#254.src: When I... when I woke up, I- ha, I was c-crying. I- I know, I know! It's... stupid. It's stupid.
Overture to Despair#254.dst: Quand je... quand je me suis réveillée, je- ha, je p-pleurais. Je sais, je sais! C'est... idiot. C'est idiot.
Overture to Despair#254.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#255.src: ...it's, um, hard to pick out one moment. She's been like a mother to me ever since I was... {~} years old.
Overture to Despair#255.dst: ...c'est, euh, dur de choisir un seul moment. Elle a été comme une mère pour moi depuis mes... {~} ans.
Overture to Despair#255.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#256.src: M-maybe the first time I really met her. After I discovered my... my gift, I thought my life was over.
Overture to Despair#256.dst: P-peut-être notre vraie première rencontre. Quand j'ai découvert mon... mon don, j'ai cru que ma vie était finie.
Overture to Despair#256.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#257.src: I- I was cursed! And I knew what h-happened to the cursed. Taken away, never to be seen again... or, or killed outright. I had nowhere to go.
Overture to Despair#257.dst: J- j'étais maudite! Et je savais ce qui a-arrivait aux maudits. Emmenés pour ne jamais revenir... ou, ou tués sur-le-champ. Je n'avais nulle part où aller.
Overture to Despair#257.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#258.src: I, um... I'd seen Syndra around before. I... I knew she talked to Mora, before he... l-left our family. So... I, ha, I guess I thought... maybe she'd help me too.
Overture to Despair#258.dst: Je, euh... j'avais déjà croisé Syndra. Je... je savais qu'elle parlait à Mora, avant qu'il... q-quitte la famille. Alors... ha, je me suis dit... qu'elle m'aiderait peut-être aussi.
Overture to Despair#258.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#259.src: A-and she did! She wasn't scared, she didn't report me. She just... embraced me in a hug and welcome me to her home.
Overture to Despair#259.dst: E-et elle l'a fait! Elle n'a pas eu peur, elle ne m'a pas dénoncée. Elle m'a juste... serrée dans ses bras et accueillie chez elle.
Overture to Despair#259.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#260.src: She, um, reunited me with Mora again. After... f-five long years alone. She... she saved me, and now... and now she's...
Overture to Despair#260.dst: Elle, euh, m'a réunie avec Mora. Après... c-cinq longues années seule. Elle... elle m'a sauvée, et maintenant... maintenant elle est...
Overture to Despair#260.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#261.src: ...I never got to tell her how much she meant to me.
Overture to Despair#261.dst: ...je n'ai jamais pu lui dire combien elle comptait pour moi.
Overture to Despair#261.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#262.dst: J'... j'espère que tu as raison.
Overture to Despair#262.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#264.src: And here we are with your orders! Your fish tacos, young lady - sturgeon head packed with tangy cabbage, tossed in rice vinegar, crispy seaweed, and punchy umami sauce.
Overture to Despair#264.dst: Et voici vos commandes! Vos tacos de poisson, mademoiselle: tête d'esturgeon garnie de chou acidulé au vinaigre de riz, d'algues croustillantes et d'une sauce umami relevée.
Overture to Despair#264.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#265.src: And another order of fish tacos for you! Please, enjoy!
Overture to Despair#265.dst: Et une autre portion de tacos de poisson pour vous! Bon appétit!
Overture to Despair#265.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#266.src: And for you, the Bubble Heckel Miso Soup! A hearty broth simmered with today's catch and miso paste that ties all the flavours together! Enjoy!
Overture to Despair#266.dst: Et pour vous, la soupe miso au Bubble Heckel! Un bouillon copieux mijoté avec la pêche du jour et une pâte miso qui lie toutes les saveurs! Bon appétit!
Overture to Despair#266.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#267.src: And for you, the Yak Potato Curry! A rich, aromatic dish seasoned with wild heather. Tender yak meat and new potatoes! You're in for a treat!
Overture to Despair#267.dst: Et pour vous, le curry de yak aux pommes de terre! Un plat riche et parfumé, relevé de bruyère sauvage. Yak tendre et pommes de terre nouvelles! Régalez-vous!
Overture to Despair#267.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#268.src: Um... so this is a taco...?
Overture to Despair#268.dst: Euh... alors c'est ça, un taco...?
Overture to Despair#268.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#269.src: I, I guess I don't know what I expected, but... um. Not this.
Overture to Despair#269.dst: Je, je ne sais pas à quoi je m'attendais, mais... euh. Pas à ça.
Overture to Despair#269.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#271.src: Head back to your hotel room at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and get some rest before the meeting later.
Overture to Despair#271.dst: Retournez dans votre chambre d'hôtel en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] et reposez-vous avant la réunion.

Overture to Despair#272.src: Um... before we go to sleep... Is there anything you want to talk about?
Overture to Despair#272.dst: Euh... avant de dormir... Il y a quelque chose dont tu veux parler?
Overture to Despair#272.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#274.src: Return to the newspaper shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Overture to Despair#274.dst: Retournez à la boutique de journaux en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Overture to Despair#276.src: Oh, is it night time already...? We should get back to the newspaper merchant then.
Overture to Despair#276.dst: Oh, il fait déjà nuit...? Retournons voir le marchand de journaux, alors.
Overture to Despair#276.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#277.src: {u}, before we head in. Let's just... observe, a-and not ask too many questions.
Overture to Despair#277.dst: {u}, avant d'entrer. Contentons-nous... d'observer, e-et ne posons pas trop de questions.
Overture to Despair#277.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#278.src: Ah, terribly sorry! We're just closing out for the day- was on my way out the door. Oh- did you find the paper to be enlightening?
Overture to Despair#278.dst: Ah, navré! Nous fermons pour aujourd'hui, j'étais sur le point de partir. Oh- le journal vous a-t-il éclairés?
Overture to Despair#278.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#279.src: No such thing as a green Squirmle Pot.
Overture to Despair#279.dst: Les Squirmle Pot verts, ça n'existe pas.
Overture to Despair#279.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#280.src: Good, good! Glad to hear you're interested in cutting through the weeds, hearing the stories that matter.
Overture to Despair#280.dst: Bien, bien! Ravi de voir que vous voulez écarter les mauvaises herbes et entendre les histoires qui comptent.
Overture to Despair#280.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#282.src: The meeting will be shortly starting- take the stairs behind me, and head downwards.
Overture to Despair#282.dst: La réunion va bientôt commencer: prenez l'escalier derrière moi, et descendez.
Overture to Despair#282.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#283.src: That ought to be all of us. Let's begin, everyone!
Overture to Despair#283.dst: On doit être au complet. Commençons, tout le monde!
Overture to Despair#283.speaker: Resistance Member

Overture to Despair#284.src: We have some new members joining us today. Please welcome them to our society, The Blossom of Blades.
Overture to Despair#284.dst: Nous accueillons de nouveaux membres aujourd'hui. Souhaitez-leur la bienvenue dans notre société, la Fleur des Lames.
Overture to Despair#284.speaker: Resistance Member

Overture to Despair#285.src: Now, Bleeding Rose. You were so excited to start us off earlier. You've been so quiet normally- how about you share first today?
Overture to Despair#285.dst: Bien, Rose sanglante. Tu avais tellement hâte d'ouvrir la séance. Tu es si discrète d'habitude... et si tu commençais aujourd'hui?
Overture to Despair#285.speaker: Resistance Member

Overture to Despair#286.src: ...thank you, Dusk Garden. I...I think this is pretty alarming, actually... Comparing the prices day to day, bread suddenly spiked. {~} more than just a week ago, with no word of warning.
Overture to Despair#286.dst: ...merci, Jardin du crépuscule. Je... je trouve ça assez alarmant, en fait... En comparant les prix, le pain a soudain flambé. {~} de plus qu'il y a une semaine, sans prévenir.
Overture to Despair#286.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#287.src: I'm not sure what we can...really do about that, but shouldn't we...y-y'know... ... ...do... ...something...?
Overture to Despair#287.dst: Je ne sais pas ce qu'on peut... vraiment y faire, mais on ne devrait pas... t-tu sais... ... ...faire... ...quelque chose...?
Overture to Despair#287.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#288.src: Ugh, again? It isn't an unlivable increase yet, but the poorer among us will definitely be feeling that. Thank you for speaking up, now it's someone else's turn.
Overture to Despair#288.dst: Pff, encore? Ce n'est pas encore invivable, mais les plus pauvres d'entre nous vont le sentir. Merci d'en avoir parlé, au suivant.
Overture to Despair#288.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#290.src: Psst. What the hell is going on here?
Overture to Despair#290.dst: Psst. Qu'est-ce qui se passe ici, bon sang?
Overture to Despair#290.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#292.src: Oh, oh! The news from {p}!! It's- well, I don't know if it's a disaster, or a good thing, really!
Overture to Despair#292.dst: Oh, oh! Les nouvelles de {p}!! C'est- bon, je ne sais pas si c'est une catastrophe ou une bonne chose!
Overture to Despair#292.speaker: Thorn Blade

Overture to Despair#293.src: Well, I barely had time to read the Aelumia Times to get the passcode. Fill me in, would you?
Overture to Despair#293.dst: Bon, j'ai à peine eu le temps de lire l'Aelumia Times pour le mot de passe. Vous me mettez au courant?
Overture to Despair#293.speaker: Crimson Dagger

Overture to Despair#294.src: This wasn't in the Aelumia Times... Anonymous sources have stated that Sovereign Soosu defied Her Majesty, openly!!
Overture to Despair#294.dst: Ce n'était pas dans l'Aelumia Times... Des sources anonymes affirment que la Souveraine Soosu a défié Sa Majesté, ouvertement!!
Overture to Despair#294.speaker: Thorn Blade

Overture to Despair#296.src: What- What do you mean?! Defied, like...went off-script during a speech, or-
Overture to Despair#296.dst: Quoi- Comment ça?! Défié, genre... sorti du texte pendant un discours, ou-
Overture to Despair#296.speaker: Crimson Dagger

Overture to Despair#297.src: She allowed terrorists to escape! At least three of them, according to my sources! Word is, too, that... That she was... Executed!!
Overture to Despair#297.dst: Elle a laissé s'enfuir des terroristes! Au moins trois, selon mes sources! Et on dit aussi... qu'elle aurait été... exécutée!!
Overture to Despair#297.speaker: Thorn Blade

Overture to Despair#298.src: I- You guys! A Sovereign went against the Queen! What...what do you think that means, for us? what do you think we should do? If she can do something that big-
Overture to Despair#298.dst: Je- Vous autres! Une Souveraine s'est opposée à la Reine! Qu'est-ce... qu'est-ce que ça veut dire pour nous? Qu'est-ce qu'on devrait faire? Si elle a pu faire un truc pareil-
Overture to Despair#298.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#299.src: And get executed for it?! Then who would do the work we do? Soosu has always been a bit of a loose cannon anyways. It isn't that surprising.
Overture to Despair#299.dst: Et se faire exécuter?! Et qui ferait notre travail, alors? Soosu a toujours été un peu incontrôlable, de toute façon. Rien d'étonnant.
Overture to Despair#299.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#301.src: In other news! Sovereign Majin was supposedly seen with an unknown man this Saturday. They were out on a walk, but we all know what that really means.
Overture to Despair#301.dst: Autre nouvelle! Le Souverain Majin aurait été vu avec un inconnu ce samedi. Une simple promenade, mais on sait tous ce que ça veut dire.
Overture to Despair#301.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#302.src: -up for you next time, Rose- Ah. That- I heard that was just a new servant. Nothing too important.
Overture to Despair#302.dst: -pour toi la prochaine fois, Rose- Ah. Ça- il paraît que c'était juste un nouveau domestique. Rien d'important.
Overture to Despair#302.speaker: Wilted Camellia

Overture to Despair#303.src: Well, I'll be publishing it in the Majin Monthly anyways. Maybe I could spin a scandal out of this one! ...probably not, but you never know.
Overture to Despair#303.dst: Bon, je le publierai quand même dans le Mensuel de Majin. Je pourrais peut-être en tirer un scandale! ...sûrement pas, mais sait-on jamais.
Overture to Despair#303.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#304.src: Um... I actually had a question about Sovereign Majin.
Overture to Despair#304.dst: Euh... en fait, j'avais une question sur le Souverain Majin.
Overture to Despair#304.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#305.src: Oh, absolutely! I keep tabs on him, so you could consider me an expert on all things Majin, uh...miss...what was your code name again?
Overture to Despair#305.dst: Oh, bien sûr! Je le suis de près, tu peux me considérer experte en tout ce qui touche à Majin, euh... mademoiselle... ton nom de code, déjà?
Overture to Despair#305.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#306.src: Oh, my... code... name... um. Right. It's- Water Grass. That's my name.
Overture to Despair#306.dst: Oh, mon... nom... de code... euh. Oui. C'est- Herbe d'eau. C'est mon nom.
Overture to Despair#306.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#307.src: ...alright. That... That doesn't follow our naming scheme perfectly but- You know, whatever. What's your question?
Overture to Despair#307.dst: ...d'accord. Ça... ça ne colle pas tout à fait à notre logique de noms, mais- Bon, peu importe. Quelle est ta question?
Overture to Despair#307.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#308.src: I... um, I heard a rumor that he'd picked up some prisoners from the {p}.
Overture to Despair#308.dst: J'ai... euh, entendu dire qu'il avait récupéré des prisonniers de {p}.
Overture to Despair#308.speaker: "Water Grass"

Overture to Despair#309.src: Ah! You spoiled my juicy scoop for tomorrow's edition! Yes, the rumour is true.
Overture to Despair#309.dst: Ah! Tu as gâché mon scoop juteux pour l'édition de demain! Oui, la rumeur est vraie.
Overture to Despair#309.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#310.src: Supposedly, he took these prisoners to his castle in the east. There is, according to other rumour, a dungeon underneath it. It'd make sense- why wouldn't a dictator have a dungeon for dissidents?
Overture to Despair#310.dst: Il aurait emmené ces prisonniers dans son château à l'est. Et selon une autre rumeur, il y a un cachot dessous. Logique: quel dictateur n'a pas de cachot pour ses dissidents?
Overture to Despair#310.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#311.src: R-really? What else do you know?
Overture to Despair#311.speaker: "Water Grass"

Overture to Despair#312.src: That there were specifically two prisoners, and, to bring it back around to Thorn Blade's news, that they're part of the {p} Terrorists! Because of that, the guard around House Thalas is particularly tight recently.
Overture to Despair#312.dst: Qu'il y avait précisément deux prisonniers, et, pour revenir à la nouvelle de Lame d'épine, qu'ils font partie des terroristes de {p}! Du coup, la garde autour de la Maison Thalas est très renforcée ces temps-ci.
Overture to Despair#312.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#313.src: Incidentally, I was planning on selling this piece to the Aelumia Times. So, don't any of you go writing in before me.
Overture to Despair#313.dst: D'ailleurs, je comptais vendre cet article à l'Aelumia Times. Alors que personne n'écrive avant moi.
Overture to Despair#313.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#314.src: Well, ah, I heard one of them was that runaway House Athassa girl! Remember the tabloids a few years ago? It was a whole scandal.
Overture to Despair#314.dst: Eh bien, euh, il paraît que l'un d'eux était la fugueuse de la Maison Athassa! Vous vous rappelez les tabloïds d'il y a quelques années? Un scandale.
Overture to Despair#314.speaker: Wilted Camellia

Overture to Despair#315.src: Goodness, Boundless Cherry's sister? I hadn't realized she was involved! Tsk, what a shame that reason doesn't run in the family.
Overture to Despair#315.dst: Ciel, la soeur de Cerise infinie? J'ignorais qu'elle était mêlée à ça! Tss, dommage que la raison ne soit pas de famille.
Overture to Despair#315.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#316.src: What does it matter?! You never shut up about the "one that got away," and- and there's so much more important to b-
Overture to Despair#316.dst: Qu'est-ce que ça peut faire?! Vous ne parlez que de "celle qui s'est échappée", et- et il y a bien plus important à f-
Overture to Despair#316.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#317.src: I do not! Crimson Dagger, please, back me up-
Overture to Despair#317.dst: Faux! Dague cramoisie, s'il te plaît, soutiens-moi-
Overture to Despair#317.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#318.src: What are we going to DO?! We just- I came here because I thought together we-
Overture to Despair#318.dst: Qu'est-ce qu'on va FAIRE?! On- je suis venue parce que je pensais qu'ensemble on-
Overture to Despair#318.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#319.src: Ah! Ah ah!! Did you guys hear that we aren't getting any freebies this festival? This is absolutely appalling.
Overture to Despair#319.dst: Ah! Ah ah!! Vous savez qu'il n'y aura pas de cadeaux gratuits à ce festival? C'est absolument scandaleux.
Overture to Despair#319.speaker: Wilted Camellia

Overture to Despair#321.src: ...shoot! Me and... um, Shadow Bush... forgot to turn off the stove! We'll, um, see you guys at the next meeting! May we reveal secrets buried and bring change!
Overture to Despair#321.dst: ...mince! Moi et... euh, Buisson d'ombre... on a oublié d'éteindre le feu! On, euh, se voit à la prochaine réunion! Puissions-nous révéler les secrets enfouis et apporter le changement!
Overture to Despair#321.speaker: "Water Grass"

Overture to Despair#322.src: Uhm- it's "May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change..." People never get it right-
Overture to Despair#322.dst: Euh- c'est "Puissions-nous déterrer la vérité enfouie et faire advenir le changement..." Personne ne le dit bien-
Overture to Despair#322.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#323.src: She's going to do something! I, I know she's going to- I have to- Guys, can't you see th-
Overture to Despair#323.dst: Elle va faire quelque chose! Je, je sais qu'elle va- je dois- Vous ne voyez pas q-
Overture to Despair#323.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#324.src: You don't know that! And if you try and convince her to, we won't be having you here anymore! Enough about this, do you have any kind of plan?
Overture to Despair#324.dst: Tu n'en sais rien! Et si tu essaies de l'en convaincre, tu ne seras plus la bienvenue ici! Assez, tu as un plan, au moins?
Overture to Despair#324.speaker: Crimson Dagger

Overture to Despair#325.src: Every time I try and think of one, I get shut down! I know I don't have much, but...but, if we work toge-
Overture to Despair#325.dst: Chaque fois que j'essaie d'en trouver un, on me coupe! Je n'ai pas grand-chose, mais... mais si on travaille ensem-
Overture to Despair#325.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#326.src: Enough of that already, Bleeding Rose! We can't reveal the secrets of the monarchy if we're imprisoned! And don't even try to say "what secrets?" This is big news!!
Overture to Despair#326.dst: Ça suffit, Rose sanglante! On ne pourra pas révéler les secrets de la monarchie si on est en prison! Et ne dis surtout pas "quels secrets?" C'est une énorme nouvelle!!
Overture to Despair#326.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#327.src: Speak with Sui outside the Newspaper Shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#327.dst: Parlez à Sui devant la boutique de journaux, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#328.src: I... wanted to stay for the whole meeting. But after that, I... I couldn't.
Overture to Despair#328.dst: Je... voulais rester jusqu'à la fin de la réunion. Mais après ça, je... je n'ai pas pu.
Overture to Despair#328.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#329.src: We know where they are. We know where to find them!
Overture to Despair#329.dst: On sait où ils sont. On sait où les trouver!
Overture to Despair#329.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#330.src: I didn't realize all their names would be so... weird and edgy. I had to come up with something! Just be glad it wasn't something worse, okay?
Overture to Despair#330.dst: Je ne pensais pas que leurs noms seraient tous si... bizarres et dramatiques. Il me fallait un nom! Estime-toi heureux que ce ne soit pas pire, d'accord?
Overture to Despair#330.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#331.src: Look. I had to think on the spot, okay! I just needed a way out.
Overture to Despair#331.dst: Écoute. J'ai dû improviser, d'accord! Il me fallait une porte de sortie.
Overture to Despair#331.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#332.src: ...was that really it? That's the resistance group around here...?
Overture to Despair#332.dst: ...c'était vraiment ça? C'est ça, le groupe de résistance du coin...?
Overture to Despair#332.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#333.src: All they're doing is... is... is sitting around, gossiping about trivial problems! Like... like it's the end of the world!
Overture to Despair#333.dst: Tout ce qu'ils font, c'est... c'est... rester assis à cancaner sur des problèmes futiles! Comme... comme si c'était la fin du monde!
Overture to Despair#333.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#334.src: An increase in bread prices...? No freebies from the festival...? Who cares?! People are... p-people are dying!!
Overture to Despair#334.dst: Le prix du pain qui monte...? Pas de cadeaux au festival...? On s'en fiche!! Des gens... d-des gens meurent!!
Overture to Despair#334.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#335.src: And... and the one person who was trying to do something kept... k-kept getting shut down... ugh! Why did I think something could f-finally go right...
Overture to Despair#335.dst: Et... et la seule qui essayait de faire quelque chose se faisait... se faisait s-sans cesse couper... argh! Pourquoi j'ai cru que quelque chose allait e-enfin bien se passer...
Overture to Despair#335.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#336.src: Whatever. At least their gossip got us some useful leads... we- we know for sure where Rex and Zeph are!
Overture to Despair#336.dst: Peu importe. Au moins, leurs ragots nous ont donné de bonnes pistes... on- on sait où sont Rex et Zeph!
Overture to Despair#336.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#337.src: So... let's head to the castle, and- and take back our friends.
Overture to Despair#337.dst: Alors... allons au château, et- et reprenons nos amis.
Overture to Despair#337.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#338.src: Violent Heather mentioned, um, a dungeon. That's probably where they're being kept... I- I can get them.
Overture to Despair#338.dst: Bruyère violente a parlé, euh, d'un cachot. C'est sûrement là qu'ils sont retenus... Je- je peux les sortir de là.
Overture to Despair#338.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#339.src: But... if we just go in, then... there'll probably be too many guards to take out. We need a distraction.
Overture to Despair#339.dst: Mais... si on entre comme ça... il y aura sûrement trop de gardes. Il nous faut une diversion.
Overture to Despair#339.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#340.src: Could you... draw their attention at the front gates? I, um, I know you're strong enough for it, so... could you do that?
Overture to Despair#340.dst: Tu pourrais... attirer leur attention à l'entrée principale? Je, euh, je sais que tu es assez fort pour ça, alors... tu veux bien?
Overture to Despair#340.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#341.src: A-alright. Good. Good, good, good. Come on, let's save our friends!
Overture to Despair#341.dst: D-d'accord. Bien. Bien, bien, bien. Allez, sauvons nos amis!
Overture to Despair#341.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#342.src: Well... well, too bad. I need you to do it anyway. Come on.
Overture to Despair#342.dst: Eh bien... tant pis. J'ai besoin que tu le fasses quand même. Allez.
Overture to Despair#342.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#343.src: Head the Majin's castle to the east at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#343.dst: Rendez-vous au château de Majin, à l'est, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#344.src: Come on, let's save our friends!
Overture to Despair#344.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#346.src: Oh, what I'd give to just... just... stick him full of spikes... ugh, but I can't.
Overture to Despair#346.dst: Oh, ce que je donnerais pour... pour... le cribler de pics... argh, mais je ne peux pas.
Overture to Despair#346.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#347.src: I'll... search for them in the dungeons while you, um, cause a distraction.
Overture to Despair#347.dst: Je vais... les chercher dans les cachots pendant que tu, euh, crées une diversion.
Overture to Despair#347.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#348.src: However you... um, do that. Storm the castle, or... or whatever. Just... stay safe.
Overture to Despair#348.dst: Fais-le, euh, comme tu veux. Prends le château d'assaut, ou... ou autre. Juste... sois prudent.
Overture to Despair#348.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#349.src: We'll meet back at the Crown Jewel once we're done. If... if either of us don't make it, then...
Overture to Despair#349.dst: On se retrouve au Joyau de la Couronne une fois fini. Si... si l'un de nous ne revient pas, alors...
Overture to Despair#349.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#352.src: Okay... okay. L-let's get them back!
Overture to Despair#352.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#353.src: Okay. Y-yeah. Just... um, hurry back here once you are.
Overture to Despair#353.dst: D'accord. O-oui. Juste... euh, reviens vite quand tu le seras.
Overture to Despair#353.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#354.src: Oh my, but if it isn't the province's most wanted criminal, striding forth into my House entirely of your own volition! Her predictions are as accurate as ever, it would seem.
Overture to Despair#354.dst: Oh, mais ne serait-ce pas le criminel le plus recherché de la province, qui entre dans ma Maison de son plein gré! Ses prédictions sont toujours aussi justes, semble-t-il.
Overture to Despair#354.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#355.src: Quite a foolish thing to do, if you ask me... though I do suppose you have proven yourself something of a wild card these past weeks!
Overture to Despair#355.dst: Bien imprudent, si tu veux mon avis... mais je reconnais que tu t'es montré plutôt imprévisible ces dernières semaines!
Overture to Despair#355.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#357.src: But of course! We do hold the leverage here... you must have come in search of your dear imprisoned friends, haven't you?
Overture to Despair#357.dst: Mais bien sûr! C'est nous qui tenons les cartes... tu es venu chercher tes chers amis emprisonnés, n'est-ce pas?
Overture to Despair#357.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#358.src: What a simple lure... but effective, evidently! It has drawn you in, right where we want you.
Overture to Despair#358.dst: Quel appât grossier... mais efficace, de toute évidence! Il t'a attiré exactement où nous le voulions.
Overture to Despair#358.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#359.src: Oh, really! My my, I would have never guessed - to think, holding them captive might draw you in! What an astonishing revelation.
Overture to Despair#359.dst: Oh, vraiment! Ma foi, je ne l'aurais jamais deviné: dire que les retenir captifs pouvait t'attirer! Quelle révélation stupéfiante.
Overture to Despair#359.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#360.src: They are here, certainly. But you will not be seeing them. There are greater plans in motion, it would seem!
Overture to Despair#360.dst: Ils sont ici, certes. Mais tu ne les verras pas. De plus grands desseins sont en marche, semble-t-il!
Overture to Despair#360.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#361.src: Fight you?! and ruin my decor? Ha! Ahahahaha! Goodness, no, of course not. If I were, you would already be dead.
Overture to Despair#361.dst: Me battre contre toi?! Et abîmer mon décor? Ha! Ahahahaha! Grands dieux, non, bien sûr. Si je le voulais, tu serais déjà mort.
Overture to Despair#361.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#362.src: Perhaps at some later date I might be more amenable to wiping the floor with you! But I'm afraid we have business to attend to.
Overture to Despair#362.dst: Un autre jour, je serai peut-être plus disposé à te réduire en miettes! Mais nous avons à faire, j'en ai peur.
Overture to Despair#362.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#363.src: Oh, take that dour look off your face. Perhaps if all goes well, we might be willing to discuss returning those friends of yours! I certainly have no need to keep them.
Overture to Despair#363.dst: Oh, quitte donc cet air renfrogné. Si tout se passe bien, nous accepterons peut-être de parler de te rendre tes amis! Je n'ai aucune envie de les garder.
Overture to Despair#363.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#364.src: I mean, really, what use could I actually have had for those two? Waste my efforts pulling information out of them that I already know?
Overture to Despair#364.dst: Franchement, à quoi auraient bien pu me servir ces deux-là? Perdre mon temps à leur soutirer ce que je sais déjà?
Overture to Despair#364.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#365.src: You tell her how you finally killed it. How it fought, and fought, and fought, but could not take you down. How the Light was freed from the Shadows.
Overture to Despair#365.dst: Vous lui racontez comment vous l'avez enfin tué. Comment il s'est battu, encore et encore, sans parvenir à vous abattre. Comment la Lumière a été libérée des Ombres.

Overture to Despair#366.src: I mean, really, what use could I actually have had for those two? Waster my efforts pulling information out of them that I already know?
Overture to Despair#366.dst: Franchement, à quoi auraient bien pu me servir ces deux-là? Perdre mon temps à leur soutirer ce que je sais déjà?
Overture to Despair#366.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#367.src: It was pathetic, honestly. The two of them, sitting in front of me, sniveling like little babies...
Overture to Despair#367.dst: C'était pathétique, honnêtement. Ces deux-là, assis devant moi, à pleurnicher comme des bébés...
Overture to Despair#367.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#368.src: "Spare me, great Sovereign! Spare me, great Sovereign!"
Overture to Despair#368.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#369.src: As if that would save them! Ha! Hahahahahaha!
Overture to Despair#369.dst: Comme si ça allait les sauver! Ha! Hahahahahaha!
Overture to Despair#369.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#370.src: Oh, but what does it matter? They are not important, but you... it would seem Her Majesty has taken interest in you, heavens know why.
Overture to Despair#370.dst: Oh, mais qu'importe? Ils n'ont aucune importance, mais toi... Sa Majesté semble s'intéresser à toi, le ciel sait pourquoi.
Overture to Despair#370.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#371.src: But before that, seeing as you are a guest of honour here in House Thalas... allow me to lead you on a tour of the castle!
Overture to Despair#371.dst: Mais avant cela, puisque tu es un invité d'honneur de la Maison Thalas... permets-moi de te faire visiter le château!
Overture to Despair#371.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#372.src: You should feel honoured. Receiving such a personalized tour is quite an uncommon occurrence around here! Do feel free to write about it in your memoirs... if you ever get the chance.
Overture to Despair#372.dst: Tu devrais te sentir honoré. Une visite aussi personnelle est chose rare ici! N'hésite pas à la raconter dans tes mémoires... si tu en as l'occasion.
Overture to Despair#372.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#373.src: Oh no, dear guest, I'm afraid you are not. You do not have a choice in the matter, in fact!
Overture to Despair#373.dst: Oh non, cher invité, j'ai bien peur que non. En fait, tu n'as pas le choix!
Overture to Despair#373.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#375.src: Oh, but I rather do insist! You've come this far, haven't you? And you're a guest of the House- it would be quite rude for you to decline.
Overture to Despair#375.dst: Oh, mais j'insiste! Tu es venu jusqu'ici, n'est-ce pas? Et tu es l'invité de la Maison: refuser serait bien impoli.
Overture to Despair#375.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#376.src: So come along, now. There's much to see, much to do! And we wouldn't want to keep her waiting, would we?
Overture to Despair#376.dst: Alors, suis-moi. Il y a tant à voir, tant à faire! Et nous ne voudrions pas la faire attendre, n'est-ce pas?
Overture to Despair#376.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#377.src: Oh, did I forget to mention? There's someone who would like to meet you! Our Spymaster has finally returned from abroad, and she has much to say to you.
Overture to Despair#377.dst: Oh, ai-je oublié de le préciser? Quelqu'un souhaite te rencontrer! Notre Maîtresse des espions est enfin rentrée de l'étranger, et elle a beaucoup à te dire.
Overture to Despair#377.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#378.src: Follow Majin on the tour of his castle at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#378.dst: Suivez Majin pour la visite de son château, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#379.src: Now. To begin with, to your left you'll see my personal library!
Overture to Despair#379.dst: Bien. Pour commencer, sur ta gauche, ma bibliothèque personnelle!
Overture to Despair#379.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#380.src: I've amassed quite a large collection, you see. Numerous books written by famous writers from all over the province! Some of my personal work is also featured here.
Overture to Despair#380.dst: J'ai amassé une belle collection, vois-tu. De nombreux livres d'auteurs célèbres de toute la province! Certaines de mes oeuvres y figurent aussi.
Overture to Despair#380.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#381.src: And straight ahead, we'll reach my secret, not-so-secret, tower of magical tomes and scrolls.
Overture to Despair#381.dst: Et tout droit, nous arriverons à ma tour secrète, pas si secrète, de grimoires et de parchemins magiques.
Overture to Despair#381.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#382.src: Over the years, I've acquired much... hm, shall we say, "forbidden" literature of that variety. The Cursed simply will not stop trying, no matter how foolish the act!
Overture to Despair#382.dst: Au fil des ans, j'ai acquis bien des... hm, disons, ouvrages "interdits" de ce genre. Les Maudits ne cessent d'essayer, si insensé que ce soit!
Overture to Despair#382.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#383.src: I'd say I have mastered... ah, about half of the spells and rituals featured here? It depends on your definitions- goodness knows the psionics have it rough.
Overture to Despair#383.dst: Je dirais que je maîtrise... ah, environ la moitié des sorts et rituels présentés ici? Tout dépend des définitions: le ciel sait que les psioniques ont la vie dure.
Overture to Despair#383.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#384.src: Oh, good grief, don't play dumb. I know full well that you understand the term. You all out there in Wynn make great use of it, or so I've been told.
Overture to Despair#384.dst: Oh, par pitié, ne fais pas l'idiot. Je sais très bien que tu connais ce terme. Vous autres, là-bas dans Wynn, en faites grand usage, à ce qu'on m'a dit.
Overture to Despair#384.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#385.src: It truly is a wonder you manage to get anything done out there! Where is the control, the coordination?! No, I much prefer how we handle things here in Fruma, thank you.
Overture to Despair#385.dst: C'est un miracle que vous arriviez à faire quoi que ce soit là-bas! Où est le contrôle, la coordination?! Non, je préfère de loin notre façon de faire ici, à Fruma, merci.
Overture to Despair#385.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#386.src: Yes, the Psionics... old history, that is. Sometime during the RA years, I believe? They had been mistaken for the cursed, and were exterminated by the crown for it.
Overture to Despair#386.dst: Oui, les psioniques... de l'histoire ancienne. Pendant les années RA, je crois? On les a pris pour des maudits, et la couronne les a exterminés pour ça.
Overture to Despair#386.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#387.src: A mistake, if you ask me! Psionic abilities certainly should not be considered the same as magic, they're quite different in how they manifest... but alas, it is what it is.
Overture to Despair#387.dst: Une erreur, si tu veux mon avis! Les capacités psioniques ne devraient pas être assimilées à la magie, elles se manifestent tout autrement... mais hélas, c'est ainsi.
Overture to Despair#387.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#389.src: Cursed?! Ha! Oh, no no no, I was not "cursed". I believe you and I both understand the meaninglessness of that terminology, hm?
Overture to Despair#389.dst: Maudit?! Ha! Oh, non, non, non, je n'étais pas "maudit". Je crois que nous comprenons tous deux le vide de ce terme, hm?
Overture to Despair#389.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#390.src: Curses, blessings... a means of controlling the public. A rather useful one, at that - though I never did follow the rules.
Overture to Despair#390.dst: Malédictions, bénédictions... un moyen de contrôler la population. Fort utile, d'ailleurs, même si je n'ai jamais suivi les règles.
Overture to Despair#390.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#391.src: In the end, magic is but another way to obtain power over the weak... is it not natural to seek it out oneself, in order to achieve greatness?
Overture to Despair#391.dst: Au fond, la magie n'est qu'un moyen de plus d'asseoir son pouvoir sur les faibles... n'est-il pas naturel de la rechercher soi-même pour atteindre la grandeur?
Overture to Despair#391.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#392.src: I don't suppose you would understand. You don't seem the type to have ever reached such heights. Regardless, let us press onward!
Overture to Despair#392.dst: Je suppose que tu ne comprendrais pas. Tu n'as pas l'air du genre à avoir atteint de tels sommets. Peu importe, poursuivons!
Overture to Despair#392.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#393.src: Hm... I shall leave you to peruse my collections for the time being. The tour shall continue at the top of these stairs! Don't take too long, would you?
Overture to Despair#393.dst: Hm... Je te laisse parcourir mes collections pour l'instant. La visite reprendra en haut de cet escalier! Ne traîne pas trop, veux-tu?
Overture to Despair#393.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#394.src: Ah... this before you is my planetarium. Quite the marvel, don't you think? On my journey in developing my magical prowess, I developed quite the interest in the cosmos.
Overture to Despair#394.dst: Ah... devant toi, mon planétarium. Une merveille, n'est-ce pas? En développant mes talents magiques, je me suis pris de passion pour le cosmos.
Overture to Despair#394.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#395.src: It was this very room in which I discovered the comet which would be named after me! Majin's Comet... this year will be the third time I see its purple shine fly through the night sky.
Overture to Despair#395.dst: C'est dans cette pièce même que j'ai découvert la comète qui porterait mon nom! La Comète de Majin... cette année, je verrai pour la troisième fois son éclat violet traverser le ciel nocturne.
Overture to Despair#395.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#396.src: In truth, it fascinates me... the power and mystery lying dormant behind each and every star, just waiting to be tapped into!
Overture to Despair#396.dst: A vrai dire, ça me fascine... la puissance et le mystère qui sommeillent derrière chaque étoile, n'attendant que d'être exploités!
Overture to Despair#396.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#397.src: Well, I suppose it wasn't much of a surprise when that was the shape Her Majesty's blessing took on, once I received it on ascension.
Overture to Despair#397.dst: Eh bien, ce ne fut guère une surprise que la bénédiction de Sa Majesté prenne cette forme quand je l'ai reçue, lors de mon ascension.
Overture to Despair#397.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#398.src: Why are you telling me this?
Overture to Despair#398.dst: Pourquoi tu me racontes tout ça?

Overture to Despair#399.src: As I said before, it's quite uncommon for me to personally give a tour of the castle. I take the opportunity to speak on my many accomplishments whenever I can!
Overture to Despair#399.dst: Comme je le disais, il est rare que je fasse moi-même visiter le château. J'en profite pour évoquer mes nombreux exploits dès que possible!
Overture to Despair#399.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#400.src: Oh, and you mean to tell me that if you had a voice like mine, you wouldn't do the very same? Ha! Perhaps someday, you'll understand.
Overture to Despair#400.dst: Oh, et tu vas me dire qu'avec une voix comme la mienne, tu ne ferais pas pareil? Ha! Un jour, peut-être, tu comprendras.
Overture to Despair#400.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#401.src: Ah, the Sovereigns' blessings... they truly are an assorted bunch. Each taking on a distinct shape based on the person receiving it.
Overture to Despair#401.dst: Ah, les bénédictions des Souverains... un ensemble bien hétéroclite. Chacune prend une forme propre selon la personne qui la reçoit.
Overture to Despair#401.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#402.src: I wonder, what could yours have looked like? Anything would be more interesting than that of your friend's... oh yes, "Intention." How passive, how boring.
Overture to Despair#402.dst: Je me demande à quoi la tienne aurait ressemblé. Tout serait plus intéressant que celle de ton ami... ah oui, "Intention". Si passive, si ennuyeuse.
Overture to Despair#402.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#403.src: But I suppose it's just as well, given his... shall we say, transience. Quite the mission he's signed himself up for! What a relief that I have no need to concern myself with it.
Overture to Despair#403.dst: Mais je suppose que c'est aussi bien, vu son... disons, caractère éphémère. Quelle mission il s'est trouvée! Quel soulagement de ne pas avoir à m'en soucier.
Overture to Despair#403.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#404.src: ...oh, yes, this here is my hobby tower! I had it constructed - what was it, {~} years ago? - in order to store all my various projects. I'm a man of many interests, you see.
Overture to Despair#404.dst: ...ah oui, voici ma tour des passe-temps! Je l'ai fait construire, il y a quoi, {~} ans? pour y ranger tous mes projets. Je suis un homme aux multiples intérêts, vois-tu.
Overture to Despair#404.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#405.src: As of late, I've been experimenting with gardening, of all things. Incredibly boring, mind you - a word of advice? Don't bother. It is not worth your time.
Overture to Despair#405.dst: Ces derniers temps, je m'essaie au jardinage, figure-toi. Mortellement ennuyeux, je te préviens. Un conseil? N'essaie même pas. Ça n'en vaut pas la peine.
Overture to Despair#405.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#406.src: Ah... a better view than this is hard to come by. The {p}, in all their glory! Who needs the {p} when you have this!
Overture to Despair#406.dst: Ah... difficile de trouver plus belle vue. Les {p}, dans toute leur splendeur! Qui a besoin des {p} quand on a ceci!
Overture to Despair#406.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#407.dst: Mais nous voici arrivés. Salutations, Maîtresse des espions.
Overture to Despair#407.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#408.src: Sovereign Majin. And {u}. I've been expecting you.
Overture to Despair#408.dst: Souverain Majin. Et {u}. Je vous attendais.

Overture to Despair#409.src: Talk to Sovereign Majin and the Spymaster at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#409.dst: Parlez au Souverain Majin et à la Maîtresse des espions, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#410.src: It's been a while since we've met face to face, hasn't it? And you've been busy.
Overture to Despair#410.dst: Cela faisait longtemps qu'on ne s'était vus face à face, non? Et tu as été occupé.

Overture to Despair#411.src: So in the end you made the choice to search for your answers... bold, I'll admit. You've caused quite the disruption thus far.
Overture to Despair#411.dst: Alors tu as fini par choisir de chercher tes réponses... audacieux, je l'admets. Tu as semé bien du désordre jusqu'ici.

Overture to Despair#412.src: I am the Second, the Spymaster. You may call me Two.
Overture to Despair#412.dst: Je suis la Seconde, Maîtresse des espions. Appelle-moi Two.

Overture to Despair#413.src: You've quite the set of accomplishments, it turns out. Careless work by our inquisitors, perhaps, that we did not know beforehand... with some exceptions, granted.
Overture to Despair#413.dst: Il se trouve que tu as tout un palmarès. Négligence de nos inquisiteurs, peut-être, que nous ne l'ayons pas su plus tôt... à quelques exceptions près, certes.
Overture to Despair#413.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#414.src: To think, the Shade was struck blind by your hand! At no small cost, of course... but a shattered soul means little in the wider stage.
Overture to Despair#414.dst: Dire que l'Ombre a été aveuglée de ta main! Non sans prix, bien sûr... mais une âme brisée compte peu sur la grande scène.
Overture to Despair#414.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#415.src: Had we known, would you have been given greater consideration? Perhaps. Or perhaps not. Each flaw remains as damning as before.
Overture to Despair#415.dst: Si nous avions su, t'aurait-on accordé plus d'égards? Peut-être. Ou peut-être pas. Chaque défaut reste aussi accablant qu'avant.
Overture to Despair#415.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#416.src: Oh, get to the point, would you? I have more important things to attend to than this frivolous attempt at information gathering.
Overture to Despair#416.dst: Oh, viens-en au fait, veux-tu? J'ai plus important à faire que cette frivole collecte d'informations.
Overture to Despair#416.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#418.src: Of all your accomplishments, of all your history, of each point along your storied trail, there is but one we cannot see. A place we cannot go.
Overture to Despair#418.dst: De tous tes exploits, de toute ton histoire, de chaque étape de ton illustre parcours, il n'en est qu'une que nous ne voyons pas. Un lieu où nous ne pouvons aller.
Overture to Despair#418.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#419.src: You and the Light's Scion entered the Realm of Light. At a time pinpointed to have transpired during your stay within, the spread of Gavel's Decay abruptly ceased.
Overture to Despair#419.dst: Toi et l'Héritière de la Lumière êtes entrés dans le Royaume de la Lumière. Au moment précis de votre séjour là-bas, la propagation de la Décadence de Gavel a brusquement cessé.
Overture to Despair#419.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#420.src: You would later return to your numerous adventures, not a sign of ever having traversed the realms at all. She has not been seen since.
Overture to Despair#420.dst: Tu es ensuite retourné à tes nombreuses aventures, sans aucun signe d'avoir jamais franchi les royaumes. Elle, on ne l'a plus revue.
Overture to Despair#420.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#421.src: I do not expect you to share this information freely. That is why we are here. To make an... exchange, of sorts.
Overture to Despair#421.dst: Je ne m'attends pas à ce que tu livres cette information de bon gré. C'est pourquoi nous sommes là. Pour un... échange, disons.
Overture to Despair#421.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#422.src: I should rather like to know the same thing myself! The way I see it, it hardly impacts the wider scope of your schemes.
Overture to Despair#422.dst: J'aimerais bien le savoir moi aussi! A mon sens, cela ne change guère la portée de tes manigances.
Overture to Despair#422.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#423.src: I do like to be meticulous. Each additional defined variable helps with the accuracy of my predictions.
Overture to Despair#423.dst: J'aime être méticuleuse. Chaque variable de plus définie améliore la précision de mes prédictions.
Overture to Despair#423.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#424.src: Regardless - the request comes directly from Her Majesty. It appears she is just as interested in the answer as I am.
Overture to Despair#424.dst: Quoi qu'il en soit, la demande vient directement de Sa Majesté. La réponse semble l'intéresser autant que moi.
Overture to Despair#424.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#425.src: How do you know all this?

Overture to Despair#426.src: My goodness, what a question! How does the Spymaster know these things? What a conundrum - perhaps the title should clue you in?
Overture to Despair#426.dst: Grands dieux, quelle question! Comment la Maîtresse des espions sait-elle ces choses? Quelle énigme... le titre te mettra peut-être sur la piste?
Overture to Despair#426.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#427.src: There is little I do not keep track of in this world. Mostly, my inquisitors work to collect information beyond our gates...
Overture to Despair#427.dst: Peu de choses en ce monde m'échappent. Le plus souvent, mes inquisiteurs recueillent les informations au-delà de nos portes...
Overture to Despair#427.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#428.src: Though, in special circumstances, I have been known to do so myself. Such as the one we find ourselves in now.
Overture to Despair#428.dst: Mais, dans certaines circonstances, il m'arrive de m'en charger moi-même. Comme celle qui nous occupe.
Overture to Despair#428.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#429.src: Entry to their Claims is not such an easy task if uninvited. You've seen the portal that lies at the end of the Expanse, haven't you? Still active, yet... sealed shut.
Overture to Despair#429.dst: Entrer dans leurs Emprises sans y être invité n'est pas chose aisée. Tu as vu le portail au bout de l'Expanse, n'est-ce pas? Toujours actif, et pourtant... scellé.
Overture to Despair#429.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#430.src: It seems the Shade did not take well to losing its Sight. An act of caution, blocking your access to its domain. The Light is much the same.
Overture to Despair#430.dst: L'Ombre n'a pas bien pris la perte de sa Vue, semble-t-il. Te barrer l'accès à son domaine est un acte de prudence. Il en va de même pour la Lumière.
Overture to Despair#430.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#431.src: Awestruck, are we? I do suppose such is the natural consequence of being in the vicinity of the crown's two strongest Sovereigns!
Overture to Despair#431.dst: Impressionné, on dirait? Je suppose que c'est la conséquence naturelle d'être auprès des deux plus puissants Souverains de la couronne!
Overture to Despair#431.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#432.src: But I'm afraid we do need you to speak up, so do get over yourself, would you?
Overture to Despair#432.dst: Mais j'ai bien peur qu'il te faille parler, alors reprends-toi, veux-tu?
Overture to Despair#432.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#433.src: And so, we return to the exchange. If you tell us what we wish to know, I will offer some valuable information in return. I trust it will be of interest to you.
Overture to Despair#433.dst: Revenons-en donc à l'échange. Si tu nous dis ce que nous voulons savoir, je t'offrirai en retour une information précieuse. Elle t'intéressera, j'en suis sûre.
Overture to Despair#433.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#434.src: Well, do we have a deal?
Overture to Despair#434.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#435.src: You always have a choice. But sometimes, there is a right and a wrong choice to make. The decision is yours.
Overture to Despair#435.dst: On a toujours le choix. Mais parfois, il y a un bon et un mauvais choix. La décision t'appartient.
Overture to Despair#435.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#436.src: So tell me. What happened in the Realm of Light? What could we not see?
Overture to Despair#436.dst: Alors dis-moi. Que s'est-il passé au Royaume de la Lumière? Que nous a-t-il échappé?
Overture to Despair#436.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#437.src: How very interesting. To think, the Shade has enough trust in War's lost Scion to send him to defend its trump card...
Overture to Despair#437.dst: Fort intéressant. Dire que l'Ombre a assez confiance en l'Héritier perdu de la Guerre pour l'envoyer défendre son atout maître...
Overture to Despair#437.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#438.src: I had wondered when he might finally show his ugly face again. Heavens know we'd had enough of him already.
Overture to Despair#438.dst: Je me demandais quand il montrerait de nouveau sa vilaine tête. Le ciel sait que nous en avions déjà assez soupé.
Overture to Despair#438.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#439.src: And the Dawn is freed from the Dusk's assault... but its Scion is lost to the Dark's Claim... a step forward, and a step back alike.
Overture to Despair#439.dst: Et l'Aube est libérée de l'assaut du Crépuscule... mais son Héritière est perdue dans l'Emprise des Ténèbres... un pas en avant, et un pas en arrière.
Overture to Despair#439.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#440.src: A step back, perhaps, but it could also be a boon in disguise. She could serve as a potential ally for your... whatever, if you could only locate her.
Overture to Despair#440.dst: Un pas en arrière, peut-être, mais ce pourrait aussi être une aubaine déguisée. Elle pourrait devenir une alliée pour ton... peu importe, si seulement tu la retrouvais.
Overture to Despair#440.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#441.src: Certainly, she could. This will shift the trajectory of certain shards of possibility... I'll have to dive deeper into the consequences.
Overture to Despair#441.dst: Certes, elle le pourrait. Cela va infléchir la trajectoire de certains éclats de possibilité... il me faudra approfondir les conséquences.
Overture to Despair#441.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#442.src: Regardless, this has been enlightening. Her Majesty will certainly be interested in these developments.
Overture to Despair#442.dst: Quoi qu'il en soit, voilà qui était éclairant. Sa Majesté sera certainement intéressée par ces développements.
Overture to Despair#442.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#443.src: Why does she care about all

Overture to Despair#444.src: You refer to the War of the Realms, I presume?
Overture to Despair#444.dst: Tu parles de la Guerre des Royaumes, je présume?
Overture to Despair#444.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#445.src: I suppose it must. Beyond the wider scope, why do we care? Wynn's corruption is at a safe distance, and both Light and Dark are far, far away.
Overture to Despair#445.dst: Je suppose que oui. Au-delà de la vue d'ensemble, que nous importe? La corruption de Wynn est loin, et la Lumière comme les Ténèbres sont bien, bien loin.
Overture to Despair#445.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#446.src: I can answer your question. But first, a tale.
Overture to Despair#446.dst: Je peux te répondre. Mais d'abord, un conte.
Overture to Despair#446.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#447.src: Once, there were two twins orbiting one another, each laying claim to their own piece of the void they were given.
Overture to Despair#447.dst: Il était une fois deux jumeaux en orbite l'un autour de l'autre, chacun revendiquant sa part du vide qui leur avait été donné.
Overture to Despair#447.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#448.src: The first was bright, radiant, overwhelming. The other was dark, shadowed, suffocating. Gazing through the abyss, they saw one another - each a mirror image of the other.
Overture to Despair#448.dst: Le premier était éclatant, radieux, écrasant. L'autre était sombre, ombrageux, étouffant. Par-delà l'abîme, ils se virent l'un l'autre, chacun le reflet de l'autre.
Overture to Despair#448.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#449.src: The twins grew to hate each other. They built forms all their own, denying the truth of their reflections. They tried, and tried, and tried to break their bonds...
Overture to Despair#449.dst: Les jumeaux en vinrent à se haïr. Ils se façonnèrent chacun une forme, niant la vérité de leurs reflets. Ils essayèrent, encore et encore, de briser leurs liens...
Overture to Despair#449.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#450.src: ...but in the end, they could do naught but orbit - holding influence in their own right, but possessing nothing to exert it on.
Overture to Despair#450.dst: ...mais au bout du compte, ils ne purent qu'orbiter, chacun puissant à sa manière, mais sans rien sur quoi exercer cette influence.
Overture to Despair#450.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#451.src: Until... they found it. A miraculous world, of magic and life, and all of a sudden, nothing became something.
Overture to Despair#451.dst: Jusqu'à ce que... ils le trouvent. Un monde miraculeux, de magie et de vie, et soudain, le néant devint quelque chose.
Overture to Despair#451.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#453.src: And in so doing, they came to shatter the mirror which once held their reflections. A building pressure of light and dark and hate, until finally enough was enough...
Overture to Despair#453.dst: Et ce faisant, ils brisèrent le miroir qui portait jadis leurs reflets. Une pression croissante de lumière, de ténèbres et de haine, jusqu'à ce que la coupe déborde...
Overture to Despair#453.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#454.src: And from those uncountable shattered pieces of their battleground, War came to be.
Overture to Despair#454.dst: Et des innombrables éclats de leur champ de bataille naquit la Guerre.
Overture to Despair#454.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#455.src: War, Chaos, Hate, Corruption... call it what you will. It was lesser, holding less control over itself than the twins from which it was birthed.
Overture to Despair#455.dst: Guerre, Chaos, Haine, Corruption... appelle-la comme tu veux. Elle était moindre, moins maîtresse d'elle-même que les jumeaux qui l'avaient engendrée.
Overture to Despair#455.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#456.src: All it knew was the hatred of the twins, directed towards one another, never acknowledging the battlefield they had made. All it knew was the pain of being.
Overture to Despair#456.dst: Elle ne connaissait que la haine des jumeaux l'un pour l'autre, qui jamais ne voyaient le champ de bataille qu'ils avaient créé. Elle ne connaissait que la douleur d'être.
Overture to Despair#456.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#457.src: Until, one day... it all stopped. The twins had lost their connection to their world of influence, and could no longer sustain their endless War.
Overture to Despair#457.dst: Jusqu'au jour où... tout s'arrêta. Les jumeaux avaient perdu le lien avec leur monde d'influence, et ne pouvaient plus entretenir leur Guerre sans fin.
Overture to Despair#457.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#458.src: It was in that silence that War could finally sense beyond itself, could feel the world the twins had taken for granted, the beauty they had discarded in their race for victory.
Overture to Despair#458.dst: C'est dans ce silence que la Guerre put enfin percevoir au-delà d'elle-même, sentir le monde que les jumeaux tenaient pour acquis, la beauté qu'ils avaient rejetée dans leur course à la victoire.
Overture to Despair#458.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#459.src: And so, when the connections emerged once more, it took its chance.
Overture to Despair#459.dst: Alors, quand les liens réapparurent, elle saisit sa chance.
Overture to Despair#459.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#460.src: It broke through the endless void, forcing its own connection unto the world, following in the twins' example.
Overture to Despair#460.dst: Elle perça le vide infini, imposant son propre lien au monde, suivant l'exemple des jumeaux.
Overture to Despair#460.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#461.src: Finally, it saw the world beyond... sprawling plains, forests, seas. Saw towns, cities, farmlands- war, destruction, tainted by the human desperation to live.
Overture to Despair#461.dst: Enfin, elle vit le monde au-delà... vastes plaines, forêts, mers. Vit villages, villes, terres agricoles- guerre, destruction, souillées par le désir désespéré de vivre des humains.
Overture to Despair#461.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#462.src: And it began to dream of that desperation itself.
Overture to Despair#462.dst: Et elle se mit à rêver de ce désespoir même.
Overture to Despair#462.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#464.src: Her Majesty is War - was War. But it is no longer hers - instead, she has chosen to lay claim to this world's protection.
Overture to Despair#464.dst: Sa Majesté est la Guerre, l'était. Mais celle-ci ne lui appartient plus: elle a choisi de revendiquer la protection de ce monde.
Overture to Despair#464.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#465.src: And in the meanwhile, the twins continue to take and take and take. If left unchecked, they will take until there is nothing left to fight over.
Overture to Despair#465.dst: Et pendant ce temps, les jumeaux continuent de prendre, prendre, prendre. Si rien ne les arrête, ils prendront jusqu'à ce qu'il ne reste rien pour quoi se battre.
Overture to Despair#465.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#466.src: ... Will that do for your answer?
Overture to Despair#466.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#467.src: You've a streak for the dramatic, don't you... Was that truly all necessary? We could have always laid it out simply- on that note, why even answer at all?
Overture to Despair#467.dst: Tu as le goût du drame, hein... Tout cela était-il vraiment nécessaire? Nous aurions pu l'exposer simplement- d'ailleurs, pourquoi même répondre?
Overture to Despair#467.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#468.src: I believe the context to be important.
Overture to Despair#468.dst: J'estime que le contexte est important.
Overture to Despair#468.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#469.src: Of course you would... well then, are we finished here?
Overture to Despair#469.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#470.src: I suppose we are. We may consider this interrogation adjourned.
Overture to Despair#470.dst: Je suppose que oui. Considérons cet interrogatoire comme ajourné.
Overture to Despair#470.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#471.src: Ah ah ah! Not so fast. Certainly, neither of us will deign to stop your escape... but the troops lying in wait will have no such reservations.
Overture to Despair#471.dst: Ah ah ah! Pas si vite. Certes, aucun de nous deux ne daignera empêcher ta fuite... mais les troupes postées en embuscade n'auront pas ces scrupules.
Overture to Despair#471.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#472.src: Now, see yourself out, would you? You are dismissed.
Overture to Despair#472.dst: Trouve la sortie tout seul, veux-tu? Tu peux disposer.
Overture to Despair#472.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#473.dst: Fuyez à travers le château, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#474.src: ...oh, would you take your leave already? You're ruining the view.
Overture to Despair#474.dst: ...oh, vas-tu enfin prendre congé? Tu gâches la vue.
Overture to Despair#474.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#475.src: I believe we'll meet once again very soon.
Overture to Despair#475.dst: Je crois que nous nous reverrons très bientôt.
Overture to Despair#475.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#476.src: Regroup at the Crown Jewel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#476.dst: Regroupez-vous au Joyau de la Couronne, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#478.dst: T- tu es en s...sécurité. G...grâce aux dieux...
Overture to Despair#478.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#479.src: We're alive, so... better than nothing, huh?
Overture to Despair#479.dst: On est en vie, alors... c'est mieux que rien, hein?
Overture to Despair#479.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#482.src: ...yeah. Gods, I... I can't believe they're gone.
Overture to Despair#482.dst: ...ouais. Dieux, je... dire qu'elles ne sont plus là.
Overture to Despair#482.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#483.src: S...Syndra, a- and Mora... and we, we c...couldn't do an- any- anything!
Overture to Despair#483.dst: S...Syndra, e- et Mora... et nous, on n'a r...rien pu f- fai- faire!
Overture to Despair#483.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#484.src: Ugh, how stupid could we have been...? Of course they knew what we were planning. A group that big...
Overture to Despair#484.dst: Pff, qu'est-ce qu'on a été bêtes...? Bien sûr qu'ils savaient ce qu'on préparait. Un groupe aussi grand...
Overture to Despair#484.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#485.src: What was Syndra thinking? We should've called it off the minute we knew there would be another Sovereign...
Overture to Despair#485.dst: Qu'est-ce qui lui a pris, à Syndra? On aurait dû tout annuler dès qu'on a su qu'il y aurait un autre Souverain...
Overture to Despair#485.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#486.src: What was so important to her that she'd risk all of our lives like that...?
Overture to Despair#486.dst: Qu'est-ce qui comptait tant pour elle pour risquer nos vies comme ça...?
Overture to Despair#486.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#487.src: I don't... care. It- it doesn't matter now. She's... dead. We don't need to talk about this.
Overture to Despair#487.dst: Je m'en... fiche. Ça- ça n'a plus d'importance. Elle est... morte. Pas besoin d'en parler.
Overture to Despair#487.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#488.src: ...S...Sui, h...how are you ho- holding up? It c- couldn't have b...been easy, on y- your own-
Overture to Despair#488.dst: ...S...Sui, c...comment tu t'en s- sors? Ça n'a pas d- dû être f...facile, t- toute seule-
Overture to Despair#488.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#489.src: I'm fine, Zeph. We've got you two back now, so... so everything's alright. It is.
Overture to Despair#489.dst: Ça va, Zeph. On vous a récupérés tous les deux, alors... alors tout va bien. Vraiment.
Overture to Despair#489.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#490.src: Are you sure? I don't think I've ever seen you this wound up before.
Overture to Despair#490.dst: Tu es sûre? Je ne crois pas t'avoir déjà vue aussi tendue.
Overture to Despair#490.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#491.src: Stop. Stop that. I'm fine, I am, everyone's safe who- who can be, so... so that's it. We can, um, start planning ahead!!!
Overture to Despair#491.dst: Arrête. Arrête ça. Ça va, vraiment, ceux qui- qui pouvaient être sauvés le sont, alors... voilà. On peut, euh, préparer la suite!!!
Overture to Despair#491.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#492.src: ...please stop looking at me like that.
Overture to Despair#492.dst: ...arrête de me regarder comme ça, s'il te plaît.
Overture to Despair#492.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#493.src: ...fine. When Zeph and I were caught at the festival, we were split up from the others.
Overture to Despair#493.dst: ...bon. Quand on s'est fait prendre au festival, Zeph et moi, on nous a séparés des autres.
Overture to Despair#493.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#494.src: I- I o...overheard them t- talking about... a- about D...Deraj Prison.
Overture to Despair#494.dst: J- je les ai e...entendus p- parler de... d- de la p...prison de D...Deraj.
Overture to Despair#494.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#495.src: We, um, heard the same. Yusanu... he- might be working on it. I don't know for sure. We... parted ways in the {p}.
Overture to Despair#495.dst: On a, euh, entendu pareil. Yusanu... il- il s'en occupe peut-être. Je n'en suis pas sûre. On s'est... séparés dans {p}.
Overture to Despair#495.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#497.src: With the Canopy. They're... safe is maybe the wrong word. But, um, he's protected. So... I think he can do it.
Overture to Despair#497.dst: Avec la Canopée. En sécurité, c'est peut-être pas le mot. Mais, euh, il est protégé. Alors... je pense qu'il y arrivera.
Overture to Despair#497.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#498.src: ...s- so you th...think they'll be al- alright...?
Overture to Despair#498.dst: ...a- alors tu p...penses qu'ils vont s'en s- sortir...?
Overture to Despair#498.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#499.src: We don't really have a choice but to trust that they will, since... we're up here, and they're not.
Overture to Despair#499.dst: On n'a pas vraiment d'autre choix que d'y croire, vu que... on est là-haut, et eux non.
Overture to Despair#499.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#500.src: So. So, so, so. I've had a lot of time to think while imprisoned. About the past, the present, the future, all of it.
Overture to Despair#500.dst: Bon. Bon, bon, bon. Enfermée, j'ai eu le temps de réfléchir. Au passé, au présent, à l'avenir, à tout.
Overture to Despair#500.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#501.src: I've come up with lots and lots of possible plans to take down the crown! To, uh, limited success...
Overture to Despair#501.dst: J'ai imaginé des tas et des tas de plans pour renverser la couronne! Avec, euh, un succès limité...
Overture to Despair#501.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#502.src: Lots of pitfalls. There's so many ways things can go wrong. So, so many...
Overture to Despair#502.dst: Plein d'embûches. Il y a tant de façons que ça tourne mal. Tellement...
Overture to Despair#502.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#503.src: ...I think I'll need to sort through them again, with... with our new information. And... and our losses.
Overture to Despair#503.dst: ...je crois que je vais devoir les retrier, avec... avec ce qu'on sait maintenant. Et... et nos pertes.
Overture to Despair#503.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#504.src: I- I'm going to, um, go out for... for a little. I, ha, I need some air, I think.
Overture to Despair#504.dst: J- je vais, euh, sortir un... un petit moment. J'ai, ha, besoin d'air, je crois.
Overture to Despair#504.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#505.dst: Elle est d...différente, pas v- vrai?
Overture to Despair#505.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#506.src: She's definitely not taking Mora's loss well, that's for sure... {u}, how long has she been like this?
Overture to Despair#506.dst: Elle encaisse mal la perte de Mora, ça c'est sûr... {u}, depuis quand elle est comme ça?
Overture to Despair#506.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#508.src: SHE k...killed a S- Sovereign?! She d...didn't tell us that...
Overture to Despair#508.dst: ELLE a t...tué un S- Souverain?! Elle ne n...nous l'a pas dit...
Overture to Despair#508.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#509.src: ...does it have to do with the ice? She's been... kind of cagey about it.
Overture to Despair#509.dst: ...c'est lié à la glace? Elle reste... assez évasive là-dessus.
Overture to Despair#509.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#510.src: H...her magic used t- to be so... s...so beautiful, so s- serene...
Overture to Despair#510.dst: S...sa magie était si... s...si belle, si s- sereine...
Overture to Despair#510.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#511.src: A- and- and n...now it looks... d- dangerous. Lethal.
Overture to Despair#511.dst: E- et- et m...maintenant, elle a l'air... d- dangereuse. Mortelle.
Overture to Despair#511.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#512.src: The p...poet in me can't h- help but see it as a r...reflection of her n- new- newfound coldness...
Overture to Despair#512.dst: Le p...poète en moi ne p- peut s'empêcher d'y voir le r...reflet de sa n- nou- nouvelle froideur...
Overture to Despair#512.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#513.src: Sorry, say that again? The poet in you? What poet?!
Overture to Despair#513.dst: Pardon, tu peux répéter? Le poète en toi? Quel poète?!
Overture to Despair#513.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#514.src: I've ch...changed, Rex... th- there's a, pfft, a- a d...darkness inside me now...
Overture to Despair#514.dst: J'ai ch...changé, Rex... il y a, pfft, d- des t...ténèbres en moi maintenant...
Overture to Despair#514.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#515.src: Oh, get over yourself! I was there too, idiot!
Overture to Despair#515.dst: Oh, redescends sur terre! J'y étais aussi, idiot!
Overture to Despair#515.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#516.src: ...oh, {u}, before I forget. When we got here, there was an envelope left for you on your bed.
Overture to Despair#516.dst: ...ah, {u}, avant que j'oublie. En arrivant, on a trouvé une enveloppe pour toi sur ton lit.
Overture to Despair#516.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#517.src: I haven't read it, but... be careful, okay?
Overture to Despair#517.dst: Je ne l'ai pas lue, mais... fais attention, d'accord?
Overture to Despair#517.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#518.src: We c...can talk to Sui wh- when she gets back.
Overture to Despair#518.dst: On p...pourra parler à Sui q- quand elle reviendra.
Overture to Despair#518.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#519.src: Head to the location mentioned in the letter at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#519.dst: Rendez-vous à l'endroit indiqué dans la lettre, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#520.src: I- I- I st...still can't believe you're r...real. That we're... fr...free.
Overture to Despair#520.dst: J- j- je n'arrive t...toujours pas à croire que tu sois r...réel. Qu'on soit... l...libres.
Overture to Despair#520.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#522.src: I... I th- think so. It was b...bad, but it- it's o...over now.
Overture to Despair#522.dst: Je... je c- crois. C'était d...dur, mais c- c'est f...fini maintenant.
Overture to Despair#522.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#523.src: Seeing S...Sui back there was... i- in- incredible. It was like a m...miracle. It st...still feels... surreal.
Overture to Despair#523.dst: Revoir S...Sui là-bas, c'était... i- in- incroyable. Comme un m...miracle. Ça me semble t...toujours... irréel.
Overture to Despair#523.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#524.src: It's the w...worst thing I've ev- ever been th...through.
Overture to Despair#524.dst: C'est la p...pire chose que j'aie j- jamais t...traversée.
Overture to Despair#524.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#525.src: I- I- I d...don't want to, t...talk about it. I w- want to f- for- forget all the- th- the little details, and- A- AND-
Overture to Despair#525.dst: J- j- je ne v...veux pas en p...parler. Je v- veux ou- oub- oublier tous les- l- les petits détails, et- E- ET-
Overture to Despair#525.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#526.src: I'm glad Gikyo's d...dead. They d- des- deserved it, a- and... worse.
Overture to Despair#526.dst: Je suis content que Gikyo soit m...mort. Il l'a m- mé- mérité, e- et... pire encore.
Overture to Despair#526.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#528.src: Sigh... I can't wait to sleep in a nice bed again.
Overture to Despair#528.dst: Pfff... vivement que je redorme dans un bon lit.
Overture to Despair#528.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#530.src: What's with the stupid questions? No, dumbass, of course not.
Overture to Despair#530.dst: C'est quoi ces questions débiles? Non, crétin, bien sûr que non.
Overture to Despair#530.speaker: Rex
