Overture to Despair#531.src: Being kept in a cage, it... it reminded me too much of living back home.
Overture to Despair#531.dst: Être gardée en cage, ça... ça me rappelait trop ma vie à la maison.
Overture to Despair#531.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#532.src: And... now we're here! So. You know.
Overture to Despair#532.dst: Et... maintenant on est là! Alors. Voilà.
Overture to Despair#532.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#533.src: Oh, boy. If I'm being honest... time sort of blended together.
Overture to Despair#533.dst: Oh là. Pour être honnête... le temps s'est un peu mélangé.
Overture to Despair#533.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#534.src: They took my bow from me almost immediately. I... I couldn't focus on anything. It was like I was barely even there. I just... dreamt.
Overture to Despair#534.dst: Ils m'ont pris mon arc presque tout de suite. Je... je n'arrivais à me concentrer sur rien. C'était comme si j'étais à peine là. Je... rêvais.
Overture to Despair#534.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#535.src: I dreamed of Auburn, of my brother, of my new family, of the people I've lost, of... of my bow.
Overture to Despair#535.dst: Je rêvais d'Auburn, de mon frère, de ma nouvelle famille, des gens que j'ai perdus, de... de mon arc.
Overture to Despair#535.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#536.src: I got used to it, eventually. Like losing a limb! It didn't stop feeling like a loss, but... I figured out how to live without my bow by my side.
Overture to Despair#536.dst: J'ai fini par m'y faire. Comme perdre un membre! Ça restait une perte, mais... j'ai appris à vivre sans mon arc à mes côtés.
Overture to Despair#536.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#537.src: I think... I think I was the lucky one. I was never really present, so everything they did to us, it... it feels like a hazy memory of a dream.
Overture to Despair#537.dst: Je crois... je crois que j'ai eu de la chance. Je n'étais jamais vraiment là, alors tout ce qu'ils nous ont fait, ça... ça ressemble au souvenir flou d'un rêve.
Overture to Despair#537.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#538.src: Zeph... he, uh, couldn't distance himself. But I won't speak for him. Ask him yourself, if you really want to.
Overture to Despair#538.dst: Zeph... lui, euh, n'a pas pu prendre de distance. Mais je ne parlerai pas pour lui. Demande-lui, si tu veux vraiment savoir.
Overture to Despair#538.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#539.src: Ugh. You met those idiots? They're just a glorified book club, honestly.
Overture to Despair#539.dst: Beurk. Tu as vu ces idiots? Un club de lecture qui se la raconte, franchement.
Overture to Despair#539.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#540.src: Sure, they're not all bad, but for the most part... they're performative.
Overture to Despair#540.dst: Bon, ils ne sont pas tous mauvais, mais la plupart... c'est de la pose.
Overture to Despair#540.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#541.src: I only heard about them through my brother, and he was always complaining. But I guess they were the only people he could find who agreed with him, so...
Overture to Despair#541.dst: J'en ai entendu parler par mon frère, et il se plaignait tout le temps. Mais je suppose que c'étaient les seuls qui pensaient comme lui, alors...
Overture to Despair#541.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#542.src: Whatever. I'm glad you managed to get something out of them, at least.
Overture to Despair#542.dst: Peu importe. Je suis contente que tu en aies tiré quelque chose, au moins.
Overture to Despair#542.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#543.src: They're all over the place! In some of them, we all storm the gates of the citadel and break through their defenses...
Overture to Despair#543.dst: Il y en a de toutes sortes! Dans certains, on prend d'assaut les portes de la citadelle et on brise leurs défenses...
Overture to Despair#543.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#544.src: ...in others, I get to put an arrow through the eyes of each and every Sovereign myself.
Overture to Despair#544.dst: ...dans d'autres, c'est moi qui plante une flèche dans l'oeil de chaque Souverain.
Overture to Despair#544.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#545.src: They're... mostly unusable. I just needed to do something with my head. I think there's probably something I can salvage, but for the most part...
Overture to Despair#545.dst: Ils sont... presque tous inutilisables. J'avais juste besoin d'occuper ma tête. Il y a sûrement des choses à sauver, mais la plupart...
Overture to Despair#545.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#546.src: Eh. We've got time. Still another week until the festival, after all...
Overture to Despair#546.dst: Bah. On a le temps. Il reste encore une semaine avant le festival, après tout...
Overture to Despair#546.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#547.src: Good luck. Come back to us alive, alright? We only just all reunited, it'd suck having to go save you instantly.
Overture to Despair#547.dst: Bonne chance. Reviens-nous en vie, d'accord? On vient à peine de se retrouver, ce serait nul de devoir déjà aller te sauver.
Overture to Despair#547.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#549.src: ...you should know. She told me. That mission. That damned mission, the one I-
Overture to Despair#549.dst: ...tu devrais le savoir. Elle me l'a dit. Cette mission. Cette maudite mission, celle où je-
Overture to Despair#549.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#550.src: So I'll ask you again. Is. It. True?
Overture to Despair#550.dst: Alors je te repose la question. C'est. Bien. Vrai?
Overture to Despair#550.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#551.src: And you didn't SAY ANYTHING?! Not a word.
Overture to Despair#551.dst: Et tu n'as RIEN DIT?! Pas un mot.
Overture to Despair#551.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#552.src: All this time, I've been wondering how he's doing, where he is- while you... you... you knew. And you chose to stay silent.
Overture to Despair#552.dst: Tout ce temps, je me demandais comment il allait, où il était- alors que toi... toi... tu savais. Et tu as choisi de te taire.
Overture to Despair#552.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#553.src: I was trying to find the rig
Overture to Despair#553.dst: J'essayais de trouver le bon moment.
Overture to Despair#553.full: I was trying to find the right time.

Overture to Despair#554.src: The right time. Of course. Of course! You just needed to find the right time to tell me you KILLED HIM!!!
Overture to Despair#554.dst: Le bon moment. Évidemment. Évidemment! Il te fallait juste le bon moment pour me dire que tu l'avais TUÉ!!!
Overture to Despair#554.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#555.src: So, now what?! Your "right time" has come and gone, and now we're here.
Overture to Despair#555.dst: Et maintenant, quoi?! Ton "bon moment" est passé, et nous voilà.
Overture to Despair#555.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#556.src: I don't care what it was, {u}!! I don't care what you saw happen, or why you think it had to happen, I care that he's gone!!!
Overture to Despair#556.dst: Peu m'importe, {u}!! Peu m'importe ce que tu as vu, ou pourquoi ça devait arriver selon toi, ce qui compte, c'est qu'il est parti!!!
Overture to Despair#556.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#557.src: I don't have much, you know? A couple of acquaintances in Gavel, maybe. No one to really keep up with!
Overture to Despair#557.dst: Je n'ai pas grand-chose, tu sais? Quelques connaissances à Gavel, peut-être. Personne avec qui garder vraiment contact!
Overture to Despair#557.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#558.src: But I had him. And you TOOK HIM from me!!!!
Overture to Despair#558.dst: Mais je l'avais, lui. Et tu me l'as PRIS!!!!
Overture to Despair#558.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#559.src: He was all I had left, and you took him from me...
Overture to Despair#559.dst: C'était tout ce qui me restait, et tu me l'as pris...
Overture to Despair#559.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#560.src: Why you? Why did it have to be you? If only the roles had been reversed- If only he were here instead of YOU!!!
Overture to Despair#560.dst: Pourquoi toi? Pourquoi fallait-il que ce soit toi? Si seulement les rôles étaient inversés- s'il était là à TA place!!!
Overture to Despair#560.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#561.src: He would have understood. He would have. He always did. He wouldn't have been so... so... STUBBORNLY, OVERWHELMINGLY, WRONG!!!
Overture to Despair#561.dst: Il aurait compris. Si. Il comprenait toujours. Il n'aurait pas été aussi... aussi... OBSTINÉMENT, LOURDEMENT DANS L'ERREUR!!!
Overture to Despair#561.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#562.src: ...of course. Of course I am. What are you trying to suggest?
Overture to Despair#562.dst: ...bien sûr. Bien sûr que oui. Qu'est-ce que tu essaies d'insinuer?
Overture to Despair#562.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#563.src: Don't you dare say that to my face. I didn't know him?! When you're the one who- who-
Overture to Despair#563.dst: N'ose pas me dire ça en face. Je ne le connaissais pas?! Alors que c'est toi qui- qui-
Overture to Despair#563.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#564.src: You're right!! You're right, he isn't - and WHOSE fault is that?!
Overture to Despair#564.dst: Tu as raison!! Tu as raison, il n'est pas là - et c'est la faute de QUI?!
Overture to Despair#564.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#565.src: It's not the crown's, no matter what you want to pin on them. It certainly isn't mine. So who does that leave?! WHO?!
Overture to Despair#565.dst: Pas de la couronne, quoi que tu veuilles lui mettre sur le dos. Et certainement pas la mienne. Alors qui reste-t-il?! QUI?!
Overture to Despair#565.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#567.src: Of course you have nothing to say. You always were a coward.
Overture to Despair#567.dst: Évidemment que tu n'as rien à dire. Tu as toujours été lâche.
Overture to Despair#567.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#568.src: We're done here. Whatever... whatever we had- friendship, acquaintances- it doesn't matter. It's through. Get out of my sight.
Overture to Despair#568.dst: C'est fini. Ce que... ce qu'on avait- amitié, simples connaissances- peu importe. C'est terminé. Disparais de ma vue.
Overture to Despair#568.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#569.src: ...before I change my mind and throw you off this dam myself.
Overture to Despair#569.dst: ...avant que je change d'avis et te jette moi-même de ce barrage.
Overture to Despair#569.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#570.src: Goodbye, {u}. I hope you find your new friendships just as fulfilling as you found ours.
Overture to Despair#570.dst: Adieu, {u}. J'espère que tes nouvelles amitiés te combleront autant que la nôtre.
Overture to Despair#570.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#572.src: She told me about Aledar. Missing some details, but...
Overture to Despair#572.dst: Elle m'a parlé d'Aledar. Il manquait des détails, mais...
Overture to Despair#572.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#573.src: ...I don't know why she'd do it, if not to try and turn me against you.
Overture to Despair#573.dst: ...je ne vois pas pourquoi elle l'aurait fait, sinon pour me retourner contre toi.
Overture to Despair#573.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#574.src: ...pfft, hah- did it- yeah, {u}, it worked. We're now bitter enemies, till the day we die.
Overture to Despair#574.dst: ...pfft, hah- est-ce que ça- oui, {u}, ça a marché. Nous voilà ennemis jurés, jusqu'à la mort.
Overture to Despair#574.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#575.src: You put a blade through my- through his chest, and I can never forgive you! I will now... dedicate the rest of my life to avenging him!
Overture to Despair#575.dst: Tu as planté une lame dans mon- dans sa poitrine, et je ne te pardonnerai jamais! Je vais désormais... consacrer ma vie à le venger!
Overture to Despair#575.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#577.src: No, I... it wasn't your fault. Or... no more your fault than his.
Overture to Despair#577.dst: Non, je... ce n'était pas ta faute. Ou... pas plus la tienne que la sienne.
Overture to Despair#577.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#578.src: ...of course, I... I already knew. So, it... wasn't a surprise.
Overture to Despair#578.dst: ...bien sûr, je... je le savais déjà. Alors ça... n'a pas été une surprise.
Overture to Despair#578.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#579.src: I... it wasn't your fault. Or... no more your fault than his.
Overture to Despair#579.dst: Je... ce n'était pas ta faute. Ou... pas plus la tienne que la sienne.
Overture to Despair#579.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#580.src: It just stings. That he's... he's... he's really gone. That I'll never hear his voice, see his smile, feel his warmth... that for the rest of time, he'll... only ever be a memory.
Overture to Despair#580.dst: Ça fait mal, c'est tout. Qu'il soit... qu'il soit... vraiment parti. Plus jamais sa voix, son sourire, sa chaleur... que pour toujours, il ne sera... qu'un souvenir.
Overture to Despair#580.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#581.src: He's gone, and... he isn't ever coming back. He was the best thing that had ever happened to me, and...
Overture to Despair#581.dst: Il est parti, et... il ne reviendra jamais. C'était ce qui m'était arrivé de plus beau, et...
Overture to Despair#581.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#582.src: I'm... glad you're here, at least. I'm glad to have someone I know.
Overture to Despair#582.dst: Je suis... content que tu sois là, au moins. D'avoir quelqu'un que je connais.
Overture to Despair#582.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#583.src: Sigh. I can't stop thinking about it. What if he could have been here with us? What would he have done? Which side would he have taken?
Overture to Despair#583.dst: Pfff. Je n'arrête pas d'y penser. Et s'il avait pu être là, avec nous? Qu'aurait-il fait? De quel côté se serait-il rangé?
Overture to Despair#583.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#585.src: I guess it doesn't matter, does it? He isn't here. And... he never will be.
Overture to Despair#585.dst: Peu importe, je suppose? Il n'est pas là. Et... il ne le sera jamais.
Overture to Despair#585.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#586.src: We're nearing a final confrontation, you know. Your side's taking action... and so is ours. Next we meet, we'll be enemies.
Overture to Despair#586.dst: On approche de l'affrontement final, tu sais. Ton camp passe à l'action... le nôtre aussi. La prochaine fois, nous serons ennemis.
Overture to Despair#586.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#587.src: ...ha. You would say that, wouldn't you?
Overture to Despair#587.dst: ...ha. Ça te ressemble bien, de dire ça.
Overture to Despair#587.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#588.src: But I can't. Not anymore. The moment I took the blessing, I made the choice. I have to see it through.
Overture to Despair#588.dst: Mais je ne peux pas. Plus maintenant. En acceptant la bénédiction, j'ai fait mon choix. Je dois aller jusqu'au bout.
Overture to Despair#588.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#589.src: It was given for a purpose, and... I can't back out now. I can't.
Overture to Despair#589.dst: Elle m'a été donnée dans un but... je ne peux plus reculer. Je ne peux pas.
Overture to Despair#589.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#590.src: Sigh... goodbye, {u}. I'm sure I'll see you soon.
Overture to Despair#590.dst: Pfff... adieu, {u}. Je suis sûr qu'on se reverra bientôt.
Overture to Despair#590.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#591.src: I am. There's too much at stake to just... turn back now. I've made this choice, and now... I have to see it through.
Overture to Despair#591.dst: Oui. Il y a trop en jeu pour... faire demi-tour maintenant. J'ai fait ce choix, et maintenant... je dois aller jusqu'au bout.
Overture to Despair#591.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#592.src: I... don't see a way to save the world, if not with her. I don't know if anyone else could stand against what we're facing.
Overture to Despair#592.dst: Je... ne vois aucun moyen de sauver le monde, si ce n'est avec elle. Je ne sais pas si quelqu'un d'autre pourrait affronter ce qui nous attend.
Overture to Despair#592.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#593.src: ... Goodbye, {u}. I'm sure I'll see you soon.
Overture to Despair#593.dst: ... Adieu, {u}. Je suis sûr qu'on se reverra bientôt.
Overture to Despair#593.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#594.src: What... what is Fruma to you, if you don't mind me asking? If you're... you know. Why are you here, instead of there?
Overture to Despair#594.dst: Qu'est-ce... qu'est-ce que Fruma représente pour toi, si je peux me permettre? Si tu es... tu vois. Pourquoi es-tu ici, et pas là-bas?
Overture to Despair#594.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#595.src: There is little more I would like than to forget that... place, that cage entirely.
Overture to Despair#595.dst: Je ne désire presque rien autant qu'oublier ce... lieu, cette cage, à jamais.
Overture to Despair#595.speaker: Her Majesty

Overture to Despair#596.src: ...from the moment of conception, It was given nothing. It was Their hatred, Their disdain, Their battlefield, suddenly given the mind to think and form to feel.
Overture to Despair#596.dst: ...dès l'instant de sa conception, Il ne reçut rien. Il était Leur haine, Leur mépris, Leur champ de bataille, soudain doté d'un esprit pour penser et d'une forme pour ressentir.
Overture to Despair#596.speaker: Her Majesty

Overture to Despair#597.src: ...but we have some hope. F-finally. Rex and Zeph... there's still a chance. There's still a chance we'll get to see them again.
Overture to Despair#597.dst: ...mais on a un peu d'espoir. E-enfin. Rex et Zeph... il reste une chance. Une chance de les revoir.
Overture to Despair#597.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#598.src: "Rooted deep atop the house of wealth and greed, the branches hear the whispers on the breeze."
Overture to Despair#598.dst: "Enracinées au faîte de la maison de richesse et d'avidité, les branches entendent les murmures du vent."

Overture to Despair#599.src: You tell her about entering the portal with Lari. About seeing the realm's connections severed, made smaller.
Overture to Despair#599.dst: Vous lui racontez le portail franchi avec Lari. Les liens du royaume que vous avez vus tranchés, rétrécis.

Overture to Despair#600.src: "The whispers speak of unity, called forth where regions meet through lines of burrowed steel."
Overture to Despair#600.dst: "Les murmures parlent d'unité, invoquée là où les régions se rejoignent par des lignes d'acier enfoui."

Overture to Despair#601.src: You tell her about fighting through the nexus. About the battle between Light and Dark ongoing within.
Overture to Despair#601.dst: Vous lui racontez votre combat à travers le nexus. La bataille entre Lumière et Ténèbres qui y fait rage.

Overture to Despair#602.src: Casting simple spells drawing power from the cosmos feels like holding fragile explosives in my hand. One wrong move and I'm afraid it will swallow me, or the world, whole.
Overture to Despair#602.dst: Lancer de simples sorts puisant dans le cosmos, c'est comme tenir des explosifs fragiles en main. Un faux pas, et j'ai peur qu'il m'engloutisse, moi ou le monde entier.

Overture to Despair#603.src: ...from the moment of conception. It was given nothing. It was Their hatred, Their disdain, Their battlefield, suddenly given the mind to think and form to feel.
Overture to Despair#603.dst: ...dès l'instant de sa conception. Il ne reçut rien. Il était Leur haine, Leur mépris, Leur champ de bataille, soudain doté d'un esprit pour penser et d'une forme pour ressentir.
Overture to Despair#603.speaker: Her Majesty

Overture to Despair#604.src: ...and oh, how It grew to hate that cage, to hate those who had put It there to rot.
Overture to Despair#604.dst: ...et oh, comme Il en vint à haïr cette cage, à haïr ceux qui L'y avaient mis à pourrir.
Overture to Despair#604.speaker: Her Majesty

Overture to Despair#605.src: Its only solace was found in glimpses of a world beyond. Mere specks reflected off the scattered shards of War.
Overture to Despair#605.dst: Son seul réconfort: des aperçus d'un monde au-delà. De simples éclats reflétés sur les fragments épars de la Guerre.
Overture to Despair#605.speaker: Her Majesty

Overture to Despair#606.src: I took that cage and shattered Its bars. I freed myself from what It was made to be.
Overture to Despair#606.dst: J'ai pris cette cage et brisé ses barreaux. Je me suis libérée de ce qu'Il était censé être.
Overture to Despair#606.speaker: Her Majesty

Overture to Despair#607.src: This province... I have made it a home. It is everything I could have ever dreamed could be mine. It is... everything, to me.
Overture to Despair#607.dst: Cette province... j'en ai fait un foyer. C'est tout ce que j'aurais pu rêver de posséder. C'est... tout, pour moi.
Overture to Despair#607.speaker: Her Majesty

Overture to Despair#608.src: But now, I have something I could lose. Something to protect at any cost. I would give anything to ensure its safety...
Overture to Despair#608.dst: Mais à présent, j'ai quelque chose à perdre. Quelque chose à protéger à tout prix. Je donnerais n'importe quoi pour sa sécurité...
Overture to Despair#608.speaker: Her Majesty

Overture to Despair#609.src: ... Tasim looks down at the ground.
Overture to Despair#609.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#610.src: I think I know the feeling.
Overture to Despair#610.dst: Je crois que je connais ce sentiment.
Overture to Despair#610.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#612.dst: Y a-t-il des hôtels près d'ici?

Overture to Despair#614.src: It's my first time here, any
Overture to Despair#614.dst: C'est ma première fois ici, des conseils?
Overture to Despair#614.full: It's my first time here, any tips?

Overture to Despair#615.src: We're looking for some hip n
Overture to Despair#615.dst: On cherche des vêtements à la mode.
Overture to Despair#615.full: We're looking for some hip new fashion.

Overture to Despair#616.src: Which cover would you like to take a closer look at?
Overture to Despair#616.dst: Quelle couverture voulez-vous regarder de plus près?

Overture to Despair#617.src: There's a drawing of the Queen completing a puzzle. Next to it, there's a red circle that seems to contain some sort of rant in very small print so as to fit into the shape. It's barely legible.
Overture to Despair#617.dst: Il y a un dessin de la Reine faisant un puzzle. Juste à côté, un cercle rouge semble contenir une sorte de diatribe en tout petits caractères pour tenir dans la forme. C'est à peine lisible.

Overture to Despair#618.src: "TO ALL THE COMPLAINERS: SURELY YOU MUST HAVE SOME IDEA OF HOW HARD IT IS TO COME UP WITH NEW PUZZLES EVERY DAY????"
Overture to Despair#618.dst: "A TOUS LES RÂLEURS: VOUS AVEZ BIEN UNE IDÉE DE LA DIFFICULTÉ D'INVENTER DE NOUVEAUX PUZZLES CHAQUE JOUR????"

Overture to Despair#619.src: "NEW CROSSWORDS, NEW WORD SEARCHES, NEW SPOT THE DIFFERENCES, ETC ETC, EVERY DAY, AND THEY HAVE TO BE TOPICAL????"
Overture to Despair#619.dst: "NOUVEAUX MOTS CROISÉS, NOUVEAUX MOTS MÊLÉS, NOUVEAUX JEUX DES DIFFÉRENCES, ETC ETC, CHAQUE JOUR, ET IL FAUT QU'ILS SOIENT D'ACTUALITÉ????"

Overture to Despair#620.src: Inside, there are some cute illustrations of Her Majesty next to every puzzle. It's very cozy.
Overture to Despair#620.dst: Dedans, de jolies illustrations de Sa Majesté accompagnent chaque puzzle. C'est très chaleureux.

Overture to Despair#621.src: All the wording is very optimistic, an impressive feat given its mention that this is his {~}th year single.
Overture to Despair#621.dst: Le ton est très optimiste, un exploit sachant qu'il mentionne que c'est sa {~}e année de célibat.

Overture to Despair#623.src: HER MAJESTY IS NOT WORRIED ABOUT A REVOLUTION
Overture to Despair#623.dst: SA MAJESTÉ NE CRAINT PAS UNE RÉVOLUTION

Overture to Despair#624.src: According to an expert, Her Majesty has been seen strolling the streets of Aelumia, which is a clear signal that unrest elsewhere in Fruma has not unsettled the Crown.
Overture to Despair#624.dst: Selon un expert, Sa Majesté a été vue se promenant dans les rues d'Aelumia, signe évident que les troubles ailleurs à Fruma n'ont pas ébranlé la Couronne.

Overture to Despair#625.src: "Her composure is a sign for the continued success of Fruma!" said the expert in an interview. (Expert prefers to be left anonymous)
Overture to Despair#625.dst: "Son calme est un signe de la prospérité continue de Fruma!" a déclaré l'expert lors d'un entretien. (L'expert préfère rester anonyme)

Overture to Despair#626.src: Today's weather: Heavy fog from the south, rising tensions, and low chance of thunder this evening.
Overture to Despair#626.dst: Météo du jour: épais brouillard venant du sud, tensions croissantes et faible risque d'orage ce soir.

Overture to Despair#627.src: The... experts of Fruma are very well informed it appears.
Overture to Despair#627.dst: Les... experts de Fruma semblent très bien informés.

Overture to Despair#628.src: "Is This The New Fashion Craze? Frumans Seen Sporting New Look."
Overture to Despair#628.dst: "Est-ce la nouvelle mode? Les Frumiens arborent un nouveau look."

Overture to Despair#629.src: Curious, you take a further look.
Overture to Despair#629.dst: Par curiosité, vous regardez de plus près.

Overture to Despair#630.src: Gold boots, dark grey pants, white T-shirt, blue hat...??? Who is coming up with these trends???
Overture to Despair#630.dst: Bottes dorées, pantalon gris foncé, t-shirt blanc, chapeau bleu...??? Qui invente ces tendances???

Overture to Despair#631.dst: Règlement du Joyau de la Couronne

Overture to Despair#632.dst: - Interdit d'entrer dans la chambre d'autrui.

Overture to Despair#634.src: There's a sign on the elevator door.
Overture to Despair#634.dst: Il y a un panneau sur la porte de l'ascenseur.

Overture to Despair#635.src: "The elevator is currently out of order. We apologize for the inconvenience." Signed, The Crown Jewel Management Team
Overture to Despair#635.dst: "L'ascenseur est actuellement hors service. Veuillez nous excuser pour la gêne occasionnée." Signé: la direction du Joyau de la Couronne

Overture to Despair#637.src: "ATTENTION CUSTOMERS: No, despite the beer-like design of this vending machine, it does not serve alcoholic beverages! Please go to the bar for those! And stop asking us about it!"
Overture to Despair#637.dst: "AVIS A NOTRE CLIENTÈLE: Non, malgré son design de chope de bière, ce distributeur ne sert pas de boissons alcoolisées! Pour ça, allez au bar! Et arrêtez de nous poser la question!"

Overture to Despair#640.src: Now playing: Day In, Day Out ({p})...
Overture to Despair#640.dst: En lecture: Day In, Day Out ({p})...

Overture to Despair#641.src: Now playing: Ballad of the Trees (Savanna)...
Overture to Despair#641.dst: En lecture: Ballad of the Trees (Savanna)...

Overture to Despair#643.src: It appears to be out of order.

Overture to Despair#644.src: Listen! Listen! Do you hear that?
Overture to Despair#644.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#645.src: There! A very slight rumble. And it's not the trains; I can tell the difference!
Overture to Despair#645.dst: Là! Un très léger grondement. Et ce ne sont pas les trains; je sais faire la différence!
Overture to Despair#645.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#646.src: The Mk V Mule-class Royal Freight Engine has a distinct uneven rhythm due to its weighted frontal bogie, whereas the Circuit-class Master Passenger Locomotive {~}-{~} makes a low rumble from harmonic oscillations in its long boiler.
Overture to Despair#646.dst: La locomotive royale de fret Mk V classe Mule a un rythme irrégulier dû à son bogie avant lesté, alors que la locomotive maîtresse de passagers classe Circuit {~}-{~} émet un grondement sourd dû aux oscillations harmoniques de sa longue chaudière.
Overture to Despair#646.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#647.src: This is neither! It must be something happening in the Saltpetre mine that lies below {p}. But what! No normal pickaxe-based excavation could make this sort of tone... unless...
Overture to Despair#647.dst: Ce n'est ni l'un ni l'autre! Ce doit être quelque chose dans la mine de salpêtre sous {p}. Mais quoi! Aucune excavation normale à la pioche ne produirait ce ton... à moins que...
Overture to Despair#647.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#648.src: The rumours of the Mk VI are true!
Overture to Despair#648.dst: Les rumeurs sur la Mk VI sont vraies!
Overture to Despair#648.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#649.src: I must dwell on this. Good day!
Overture to Despair#649.dst: Je dois y réfléchir. Bonne journée!
Overture to Despair#649.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#650.src: "May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change."
Overture to Despair#650.dst: "Puissions-nous déterrer la vérité enfouie et faire advenir le changement."

Overture to Despair#651.src: Maybe you could ask the merchant inside about the wind chime?
Overture to Despair#651.dst: Tu pourrais peut-être interroger le marchand sur le carillon?

Overture to Despair#652.src: May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change. Never forget that.
Overture to Despair#652.dst: Puissions-nous déterrer la vérité enfouie et faire advenir le changement. Ne l'oubliez jamais.
Overture to Despair#652.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#653.src: ...seems like they're occupied. You should follow Sui and see what's going on.
Overture to Despair#653.dst: ...on dirait qu'ils sont occupés. Tu devrais suivre Sui pour voir ce qui se passe.

Overture to Despair#654.src: The Art of the New Age

Overture to Despair#655.src: A comprehensive archive of artwork created during the New Age, arranged chronologically.
Overture to Despair#655.dst: Une archive complète des oeuvres créées pendant la Nouvelle Ère, classées par ordre chronologique.

Overture to Despair#656.src: The painting shows a flooded landscape with a Maple tree coming out of the dark waters. There is a single windchime hanging from a branch of the tree.
Overture to Despair#656.dst: Le tableau montre un paysage inondé d'où un érable émerge des eaux sombres. Un unique carillon pend à l'une de ses branches.

Overture to Despair#658.src: Painted in {~}NA by Yuu Higu. This artwork seems to utilise water paints as the base with coloured glass shards glued on. This is the first record of this technique.
Overture to Despair#658.dst: Peint en {~}NA par Yuu Higu. Cette oeuvre semble utiliser l'aquarelle comme base, avec des éclats de verre coloré collés dessus. C'est la première trace de cette technique.

Overture to Despair#659.src: The painting seems to represents the differences in the {p} and Auburn. The ruined Auburn after the great flood juxtaposed to the idyllic highlands. This is clearly shown in the colours.
Overture to Despair#659.dst: Le tableau semble représenter les différences entre {p} et Auburn. Auburn en ruines après la grande inondation, face aux hautes terres idylliques. Les couleurs le montrent clairement.

Overture to Despair#660.src: The painting has two sides with different colouring styles. One half features the ruined Auburn in gray and muted colours. The other half shows the {p} in bright colouring. The two sides are split by the dam.
Overture to Despair#660.dst: Le tableau a deux moitiés aux couleurs différentes. L'une montre Auburn en ruines, en gris et tons ternes. L'autre montre {p} en couleurs vives. Le barrage sépare les deux.

Overture to Despair#661.dst: Le recueil de haïkus de Khuia:

Overture to Despair#662.src: Written by the poet Khuia in KA{~}
Overture to Despair#662.dst: Écrit par le poète Khuia en KA{~}

Overture to Despair#664.src: You open another page at random...
Overture to Despair#664.dst: Vous ouvrez une autre page au hasard...

Overture to Despair#665.dst: La foudre frappe, la terre cède

Overture to Despair#667.src: What do you want to grow?

Overture to Despair#668.src: The heather plant requires a lot of sunlight.
Overture to Despair#668.dst: La bruyère a besoin de beaucoup de soleil.

Overture to Despair#669.src: The Death Penalty - The Good and the Bad
Overture to Despair#669.dst: La peine de mort - le pour et le contre

Overture to Despair#670.src: The death penalty remains an effective tool for maintaining order, mainly through its value as a deterrent. When people know there is a real risk of execution,
Overture to Despair#670.dst: La peine de mort reste un outil efficace pour maintenir l'ordre, surtout par son effet dissuasif. Quand les gens savent qu'il existe un vrai risque d'exécution,

Overture to Despair#671.src: they are far less likely to break the law. That said, if it is used too often, it can start to backfire and reduce the number of people available for forced
Overture to Despair#671.dst: ils sont bien moins enclins à enfreindre la loi. Cela dit, trop utilisée, elle peut devenir contre-productive et réduire le nombre de personnes disponibles pour la conscription

Overture to Despair#672.src: conscription in the Wynnic War and cutting into the labor supply for the work camps.
Overture to Despair#672.dst: forcée dans la Guerre wynnique et amputer la main-d'oeuvre des camps de travail.

Overture to Despair#673.src: such judgments would help maintain the right balance between fear and function.
Overture to Despair#673.dst: de tels jugements aideraient à maintenir le juste équilibre entre peur et utilité.

Overture to Despair#675.src: Utilising my blessing of cosmic manipulation I have noticed how volatile my spells have become.
Overture to Despair#675.dst: Grâce à ma bénédiction de manipulation cosmique, j'ai remarqué à quel point mes sorts sont devenus instables.

Overture to Despair#676.src: This power is addicting. The risk of casting such magic urges me to use it more, and more, and more.
Overture to Despair#676.dst: Ce pouvoir est addictif. Le risque de lancer une telle magie me pousse à l'utiliser encore, et encore, et encore.

Overture to Despair#677.src: The Queen has strictly advised against frequent magic use... Luckily my sword skills tend to suffice in duels.
Overture to Despair#677.dst: La Reine a formellement déconseillé l'usage fréquent de la magie... Heureusement, mon épée suffit généralement en duel.

Overture to Despair#678.src: Ever since my ascension and the blessing of the stars that followed, I have little use of my previous elemental magics.
Overture to Despair#678.dst: Depuis mon ascension et la bénédiction des étoiles qui a suivi, mes anciennes magies élémentaires ne me servent plus guère.

Overture to Despair#679.src: Teaching myself the elements were fun. Magic is simply easy. Everyone should've been able to realise the nature of our world and the elements that make it up.
Overture to Despair#679.dst: Apprendre les éléments par moi-même était amusant. La magie est simple. Tout le monde aurait dû pouvoir saisir la nature de notre monde et des éléments qui le composent.

Overture to Despair#680.src: After my first discovery of thunder magic the rest came easier and easier. All elements are, the same, but also completely different.
Overture to Despair#680.dst: Après ma découverte de la magie de la foudre, le reste est venu toujours plus facilement. Tous les éléments sont pareils, et pourtant tout autres.

Overture to Despair#681.src: You tell her about remaking the connections. About the monoliths, deactivated with intent, their light fading.
Overture to Despair#681.dst: Vous lui racontez les connexions rétablies. Les monolithes, désactivés exprès, leur lumière qui s'éteint.

Overture to Despair#682.src: You tell her about crossing the bridge. About your encounter with the Scourge of Wynn. About his battle with Lari, from start to end.
Overture to Despair#682.dst: Vous lui racontez la traversée du pont. Votre rencontre avec le Fléau de Wynn. Son combat contre Lari, du début à la fin.

Overture to Despair#683.src: You tell her about Orphion. About the Parasite latched on, eating through his radiance. About the struggle to remove it.
Overture to Despair#683.dst: Vous lui parlez d'Orphion. Du Parasite agrippé à lui, dévorant son éclat. De la lutte pour l'en arracher.

Overture to Despair#684.src: Of course you would... well then, are we finished here? Might we finally dismiss our little guest and return to important matters.
Overture to Despair#684.dst: Évidemment... bon, en avons-nous terminé? Pourrions-nous enfin congédier notre petit invité et revenir aux choses sérieuses.
Overture to Despair#684.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#685.src: I wish... he could have been here with us. There was so much waiting for him in Fruma. So many people. Just a few weeks later, and...
Overture to Despair#685.dst: J'aurais voulu... qu'il soit là avec nous. Tant de choses l'attendaient à Fruma. Tant de gens. Quelques semaines plus tard, et...
Overture to Despair#685.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#686.src: ...ha. What a difference, a few weeks would've made. If only. If only.
Overture to Despair#686.dst: ...ha. Quelques semaines auraient tout changé. Si seulement. Si seulement.
Overture to Despair#686.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Pirate's Trove#000.src: But enough with the pleasantries. Tell me... Ever heard the tale of the great pirate, Captain Hastor? Sailed the seas a long time ago.
Pirate's Trove#000.dst: Mais assez de politesses. Dites-moi... Connaissez-vous l'histoire du grand pirate, le capitaine Hastor? Il a sillonné les mers il y a bien longtemps.
Pirate's Trove#000.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#001.src: Legend says that when {p} was rebuilt all those years ago, he hid his fortune someplace within the walls!
Pirate's Trove#001.dst: La légende dit que lorsque {p} a été reconstruite il y a des années, il a caché sa fortune quelque part dans ses murs!
Pirate's Trove#001.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#002.src: This first riddle goes like so: Toward the sunset, among northern flowers shaded by quartz.
Pirate's Trove#002.dst: La première énigme dit ceci: Vers le couchant, parmi les fleurs du nord à l'ombre du quartz.
Pirate's Trove#002.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#003.src: How is your search going? I've written the first clue into your book. I've heard that the others are engraved on blocks of black stone; maybe you should look for those.
Pirate's Trove#003.dst: Comment avance votre recherche? J'ai écrit le premier indice dans votre livre. On dit que les autres sont gravés sur des blocs de pierre noire; cherchez-les peut-être.

Pirate's Trove#004.src: A message is carved into the pedestal: In a place of identity, above the leaves and between the glass
Pirate's Trove#004.dst: Un message est gravé sur le piédestal: En un lieu d'identité, au-dessus des feuilles et entre les vitres

Pirate's Trove#005.src: A message is carved into the obsidian: In an emerald fountain, surrounded by the wealth of the villagers
Pirate's Trove#005.dst: Un message est gravé dans l'obsidienne: Dans une fontaine d'émeraudes, entourée de la richesse des villageois

Pirate's Trove#006.src: A message is carved into the obsidian: Beneath the cowl of an eastern titan, keeping watch over our heads
Pirate's Trove#006.dst: Un message est gravé dans l'obsidienne: Sous le capuchon d'un titan de l'est, qui veille au-dessus de nos têtes

Pirate's Trove#008.src: Lo, adventurer! Welcome to the great province of Gavel, home of the villager race, and yours truly. You'll be headed into the grand citadel of {p} soon!
Pirate's Trove#008.dst: Holà, aventurier! Bienvenue dans la grande province de Gavel, foyer des villageois et de votre serviteur. Vous entrerez bientôt dans la grande citadelle de {p}!
Pirate's Trove#008.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#009.src: I'm a retired sailor now, but I could still do with a few extra emeralds from that treasure. Perhaps, if you're up to it... we could come to an agreement?
Pirate's Trove#009.dst: Je suis un marin à la retraite, mais quelques émeraudes de ce trésor ne seraient pas de refus. Peut-être, si le coeur vous en dit... pourrions-nous trouver un accord?
Pirate's Trove#009.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#010.src: I have a riddle, the first of a number of clues that are supposed to lead to where Hastor hid his fortune, but I can't for the life of me figure it out.
Pirate's Trove#010.dst: J'ai une énigme, la première d'une série d'indices censés mener à la cachette d'Hastor, mais impossible pour moi de la résoudre.
Pirate's Trove#010.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#011.src: Maybe you'll be able to solve it. If you can, I'll make sure to split the treasure with you!
Pirate's Trove#011.dst: Vous y arriverez peut-être. Si c'est le cas, je partagerai le trésor avec vous, promis!
Pirate's Trove#011.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#012.src: I do wish you good luck, adventurer! Remember, everything you need to solve the clues should be found somewhere inside {p}.
Pirate's Trove#012.dst: Je vous souhaite bonne chance, aventurier! N'oubliez pas, tout ce qu'il faut pour résoudre les indices se trouve quelque part dans {p}.
Pirate's Trove#012.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#013.src: Clue I: Toward the sunset, among northern flowers shaded by quartz
Pirate's Trove#013.dst: Indice I: Vers le couchant, parmi les fleurs du nord à l'ombre du quartz

Pirate's Trove#014.src: Clue II: In a place of identity, above the leaves and between the glass
Pirate's Trove#014.dst: Indice II: En un lieu d'identité, au-dessus des feuilles et entre les vitres

Pirate's Trove#015.src: Clue III: In an emerald fountain, surrounded by the wealth of the villagers
Pirate's Trove#015.dst: Indice III: Dans une fontaine d'émeraudes, entourée de la richesse des villageois

Pirate's Trove#016.src: Clue IV: Beneath the cowl of an eastern titan, keeping watch over our heads
Pirate's Trove#016.dst: Indice IV: Sous le capuchon d'un titan de l'est, qui veille au-dessus de nos têtes

Pirate's Trove#017.src: Aha! I'd come to ask how it was coming when I saw you jump over here!
Pirate's Trove#017.dst: Aha! Je venais voir où vous en étiez quand je vous ai vu sauter ici!
Pirate's Trove#017.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#018.src: Phenomenal work, my compatriot. Though, do remember our deal?
Pirate's Trove#018.dst: Beau travail, camarade. Mais vous vous souvenez de notre marché?
Pirate's Trove#018.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#019.src: You find the treasure, I give you a cut. I'll just take my part and be on my way!
Pirate's Trove#019.dst: Vous trouvez le trésor, je vous donne une part. Je prends juste la mienne et je file!
Pirate's Trove#019.speaker: Damiral

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#001.src: Would you like to hear the tale of the pit of the dead?
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#001.dst: Voulez-vous entendre l'histoire de la fosse des morts?
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#001.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#002.src: It is the pit where the corpses of the poor miners who discovered the Portal by the {p} are buried.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#002.dst: C'est la fosse où sont enterrés les corps des pauvres mineurs qui ont découvert le Portail près de {p}.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#002.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#003.src: Those that had not already died had to be executed due to the insanity brought on from the corruption.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#003.dst: Ceux qui n'étaient pas déjà morts ont dû être exécutés à cause de la folie causée par la Corruption.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#003.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#004.src: Their spirits still haunt the grave and infect the minds of people who disturb them. It isn't pretty.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#004.dst: Leurs esprits hantent encore la tombe et infectent l'esprit de ceux qui les dérangent. Ce n'est pas joli.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#004.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#005.src: However, I heard rumours of those who were able to bathe in their waters and be accepted by them, to show no fear of the dead is to be admired.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#005.dst: Pourtant, on raconte que certains ont pu se baigner dans ses eaux et être acceptés par eux; ne montrer aucune peur des morts est admirable.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#005.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#006.src: Maybe this shrine that I keep hearing about has something to do with it? It's apparently hidden deep inside the pit.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#006.dst: Ce sanctuaire dont on me parle tant y est peut-être pour quelque chose? Il serait caché tout au fond de la fosse.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#006.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#009.src: Explore the pit at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and find the shrine
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#009.dst: Explorez la fosse en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] et trouvez le sanctuaire

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#010.src: Go back to {p} and tell Merloni that you succeeded
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#010.dst: Retournez à {p} et dites à Merloni que vous avez réussi

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#011.src: Very impressive! Here's your reward. I found it a while ago while walking around {p}. It probably fell off a skeleton!
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#011.dst: Très impressionnant! Voici votre récompense. Je l'ai trouvée en me promenant dans {p}. Elle a dû tomber d'un squelette!
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#011.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#012.src: Soldier, the pit is located south east of {p}, across the bridge behind us. I will write down the coordinates inside your content book.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#012.dst: Soldat, la fosse se trouve au sud-est de {p}, de l'autre côté du pont derrière nous. Je vais noter les coordonnées dans votre livre de contenu.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#012.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#013.src: Enter the pit. Learn its mysteries, then come back to me.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#013.dst: Entrez dans la fosse. Percez ses mystères, puis revenez me voir.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#013.speaker: Merloni

similar.text: Where did your soul go?!

Point of No Return#001.src: The passage to the next area has opened...
Point of No Return#001.dst: Le passage vers la zone suivante s'est ouvert...

Point of No Return#002.src: When soul and body synchronize, the way is opened...
Point of No Return#002.dst: Quand l'âme et le corps se synchronisent, le chemin s'ouvre...

Point of No Return#003.src: {u}. {u}, {u}, {u}. You can hear me. For once, for one small moment, we are nearly as one again.
Point of No Return#003.dst: {u}. {u}, {u}, {u}. Tu m'entends. Pour une fois, pour un bref instant, nous ne faisons presque plus qu'un.

Point of No Return#005.src: Tying you to something you no longer are.
Point of No Return#005.dst: Te liant à quelque chose que tu n'es plus.

Point of No Return#007.src: And then, when it was done, we lost what little still was left.
Point of No Return#007.dst: Et puis, une fois que ce fut fini, nous avons perdu le peu qui restait.

Point of No Return#010.src: Did your soul just stop following you?
Point of No Return#010.dst: Votre âme a-t-elle cessé de vous suivre?

Point of No Return#012.src: Something which can no longer leave.
Point of No Return#012.dst: Quelque chose qui ne peut plus partir.

Point of No Return#013.src: ... Maybe you should talk to that citizen again.
Point of No Return#013.dst: ... Vous devriez peut-être reparler à cette citoyenne.

Point of No Return#014.dst: Vous êtes... libre. Mais quelque chose...

Point of No Return#015.src: Live well, {u}. That is all I ask.
Point of No Return#015.dst: Vis bien, {u}. C'est tout ce que je te demande.

Point of No Return#016.src: Retrace the steps of your soul to keep up...
Point of No Return#016.dst: Retracez les pas de votre âme pour la suivre...

Point of No Return#018.src: Holding the Soul Retainer seems to switch your location with your soul...
Point of No Return#018.dst: Tenir le Rétenteur d'âme semble échanger votre position avec celle de votre âme...

Point of No Return#019.dst: Parlez à la citoyenne de {p} en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Point of No Return#021.src: You... could it be...? Are you... real?
Point of No Return#021.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#022.src: Ha... ha... you should not have come here.
Point of No Return#022.dst: Ha... ha... vous n'auriez pas dû venir ici.
Point of No Return#022.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#023.src: Have you seen the others? Barely clinging on to life... hollowed, empty.
Point of No Return#023.dst: Avez-vous vu les autres? Accrochés à la vie par un fil... creux, vides.
Point of No Return#023.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#024.src: Only I persist. And, now... you, too, have been ensnared.
Point of No Return#024.dst: Moi seule persiste. Et à présent... le piège vous tient aussi.
Point of No Return#024.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#025.src: Fight against your fate, if you so choose... it makes no difference in the end. Ha... ha... ha...
Point of No Return#025.dst: Luttez contre votre destin, si vous le voulez... au bout du compte, ça ne change rien. Ha... ha... ha...
Point of No Return#025.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#026.dst: Explorez cette version plus heureuse de {p}.

Point of No Return#027.dst: Ahh... un nouveau venu? Bienvenue, bienvenue.
Point of No Return#027.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#028.src: Do not worry, you are safe here. The Obelisk protects us all.
Point of No Return#028.dst: Ne craignez rien, vous êtes en sécurité ici. L'Obélisque nous protège tous.
Point of No Return#028.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#029.src: A beacon of safety amidst the terror outside... what a miracle, to have found it awaiting us in our time of need.
Point of No Return#029.dst: Un phare de sécurité au milieu de la terreur du dehors... quel miracle de l'avoir trouvé, qui nous attendait à l'heure du besoin.
Point of No Return#029.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#030.src: Rest well, friend. You have made it home. Feel free to familiarize yourself with it.
Point of No Return#030.dst: Reposez-vous bien, l'ami. Vous voici chez vous. N'hésitez pas à découvrir les lieux.
Point of No Return#030.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#031.src: How long has it been since a new face has joined us? I can't quite seem to recall...
Point of No Return#031.dst: Quand un nouveau visage nous a-t-il rejoints pour la dernière fois? Je ne m'en souviens plus...
Point of No Return#031.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#032.src: Don't be fooled - everything you see around you is very real.
Point of No Return#032.dst: Ne vous y trompez pas - tout ce qui vous entoure est bien réel.
Point of No Return#032.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#035.src: You look different in the mirror. It is a reflection of your inner self.
Point of No Return#035.dst: Votre reflet est différent dans le miroir. Il montre votre moi intérieur.

Point of No Return#037.src: Something must be left behind. And you must leave.
Point of No Return#037.dst: Quelque chose doit rester derrière. Et tu dois partir.

Point of No Return#038.src: ...more than anything beyond, at least. The Obelisk protects us, after all.
Point of No Return#038.dst: ...plus que tout ce qu'il y a au-delà, du moins. L'Obélisque nous protège, après tout.
Point of No Return#038.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#039.src: Do you feel its pull? It calls to us all, when we arrive.
Point of No Return#039.dst: Vous sentez son appel? Il nous appelle tous, à notre arrivée.
Point of No Return#039.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#040.src: Why would anyone choose to resist? The world is twisted, wrong... we do not belong there.
Point of No Return#040.dst: Pourquoi résister? Le monde est tordu, mauvais... nous n'y avons pas notre place.
Point of No Return#040.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#041.src: It is by the Bovine's grace that the Obelisk has seen fit to bless us with this sanctuary.
Point of No Return#041.dst: C'est par la grâce de la Sainte Vache que l'Obélisque a bien voulu nous offrir ce sanctuaire.
Point of No Return#041.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#042.src: There is no fault in giving in. It only wants to protect us. Is that so wrong?
Point of No Return#042.dst: Il n'y a pas de honte à céder. Il veut seulement nous protéger. Est-ce si mal?
Point of No Return#042.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#043.src: Why would you ever want to leave?
Point of No Return#043.speaker: Lutho Guard

Point of No Return#046.src: If you truly want to leave... no one here will stop you. But are you really willing to go through with it?
Point of No Return#046.dst: Si vous voulez vraiment partir... personne ici ne vous en empêchera. Mais irez-vous vraiment jusqu'au bout?
Point of No Return#046.speaker: Lutho Guard

Point of No Return#047.src: Talk to the {p} Citizen who sent you on this journey.
Point of No Return#047.dst: Parlez à la citoyenne de {p} qui est à l'origine de ce voyage.

Point of No Return#048.src: Ha... I saw it there. That flicker in your eyes...
Point of No Return#048.dst: Ha... Je l'ai vue là. Cette lueur dans vos yeux...
Point of No Return#048.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#049.src: You have been... shattered. Just like me, ha, ha, ha...
Point of No Return#049.dst: Quelque chose s'est... brisé en vous. Comme en moi, ha, ha, ha...
Point of No Return#049.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#050.src: The others... all have given in to its pull. Our band of survivors... left behind, abandoned...
Point of No Return#050.dst: Les autres... ont tous cédé à son appel. Notre groupe de survivants... laissé derrière, abandonné...
Point of No Return#050.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#051.src: I cannot blame them. Such a loss must seem a blessing, compared to life out here...
Point of No Return#051.dst: Je ne peux pas leur en vouloir. Une telle perte doit sembler une bénédiction face à la vie d'ici...
Point of No Return#051.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#052.src: How long has it been, since we found ourselves trapped here...? Longer than anyone has any right to live... ha, ha...
Point of No Return#052.dst: Depuis combien de temps sommes-nous piégés ici...? Plus longtemps que quiconque n'a le droit de vivre... ha, ha...
Point of No Return#052.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#053.src: Perhaps I am already gone. More dead than alive. Hollowed out...
Point of No Return#053.dst: Peut-être suis-je déjà partie. Plus morte que vive. Vidée...
Point of No Return#053.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#054.src: All it does is take. More, and more, and more, until nothing is left... ha, ha, ha...
Point of No Return#054.dst: Il ne fait que prendre. Encore, et encore, et encore, jusqu'à ce qu'il ne reste rien... ha, ha, ha...
Point of No Return#054.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#056.src: Your soul seems to be slipping away from reality...
Point of No Return#056.dst: Votre âme semble s'échapper de la réalité...

Point of No Return#057.src: Where does all of this lead?

Point of No Return#058.src: Your soul runs beneath your feet.
Point of No Return#058.dst: Votre âme court sous vos pieds.

Point of No Return#060.src: Your soul drifts further from you. Will you ever get it back?
Point of No Return#060.dst: Votre âme s'éloigne de vous. La retrouverez-vous un jour?

Point of No Return#061.src: Oh, how they tried to bury us...
Point of No Return#061.dst: Oh, comme ils ont essayé de nous enterrer...

Point of No Return#063.src: A distant thread, tying you to... something.
Point of No Return#063.dst: Un fil lointain, qui vous lie à... quelque chose.
Point of No Return#063.speaker: Lutho Guard

Point of No Return#064.src: The platforms seem to disappear... You must swap with your soul quickly to make it to the end.
Point of No Return#064.dst: Les plateformes semblent disparaître... Échangez vite avec votre âme pour atteindre la fin.

Point of No Return#065.src: You must look at the mirror and wait for the platforms to appear on the other side before swapping sides...
Point of No Return#065.dst: Regardez le miroir et attendez que les plateformes apparaissent de l'autre côté avant de changer de côté...

Point of No Return#069.src: You should try reproducing your soul's steps to find the exit...
Point of No Return#069.dst: Essayez de reproduire les pas de votre âme pour trouver la sortie...

Point of No Return#072.src: The floor's rising! You need to escape upwards!
Point of No Return#072.dst: Le sol monte! Fuyez vers le haut!

Point of No Return#073.src: The floor's rising! Don't let it get to you!
Point of No Return#073.dst: Le sol monte! Ne le laissez pas vous atteindre!

Point of No Return#074.src: I am... you. {u}. {u}. You can hear me.
Point of No Return#074.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#075.src: How long, now, has it been? Since they broke us in this way. Since you lost all that you were.
Point of No Return#075.dst: Depuis combien de temps? Depuis qu'ils nous ont brisés ainsi. Depuis que tu as perdu tout ce que tu étais.
Point of No Return#075.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#077.src: A trap. A snare. A devious thing, which claims to protect.
Point of No Return#077.dst: Un piège. Un collet. Une chose sournoise, qui prétend protéger.
Point of No Return#077.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#078.src: The soul, the mind, kept safe. All while the body falls prey to the roots and the trees and the gaze of the taken.
Point of No Return#078.dst: L'âme, l'esprit, préservés. Pendant que le corps devient la proie des racines, des arbres et du regard des emportés.
Point of No Return#078.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#079.src: We have fallen, and we cannot climb free. Not whole, not anymore. Something must be lost.
Point of No Return#079.dst: Nous sommes tombés, et ne pouvons remonter. Pas entiers, plus maintenant. Il faut perdre quelque chose.
Point of No Return#079.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#080.src: And it cannot last. And it will not last.
Point of No Return#080.dst: Et cela ne peut durer. Et cela ne durera pas.
Point of No Return#080.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#082.src: Even through the struggle, the turmoil, the loss... despite it all, you remain.
Point of No Return#082.dst: Malgré la lutte, le tumulte, la perte... malgré tout, tu demeures.
Point of No Return#082.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#083.src: Changed... but still, but still... yourself.
Point of No Return#083.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#085.src: The world. The shadows. The crown.
Point of No Return#085.dst: Le monde. Les ombres. La couronne.
Point of No Return#085.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#086.src: Was there meaning to it all? Was there purpose, reason?
Point of No Return#086.dst: Tout cela avait-il un sens? Un but, une raison?
Point of No Return#086.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#087.src: Was it desperation, fear? Or was it simple routine? We cannot know.
Point of No Return#087.dst: Était-ce le désespoir, la peur? Ou une simple routine? Nous ne pouvons le savoir.
Point of No Return#087.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#089.src: Though once, we were one... now we are split. Separate.
Point of No Return#089.dst: Si autrefois nous ne faisions qu'un... nous voilà divisés. Séparés.
Point of No Return#089.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#090.src: But the trap does not see it that way. And, so... a chance to break free.
Point of No Return#090.dst: Mais le piège ne le voit pas ainsi. Et donc... une chance de se libérer.
Point of No Return#090.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#091.src: As one is ensnared, the other will have a moment, an opportunity.
Point of No Return#091.dst: Tandis que l'un est pris au piège, l'autre aura un instant, une occasion.
Point of No Return#091.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#092.src: The snare will hold me here. And you can leave.
Point of No Return#092.dst: Le collet me retiendra ici. Et tu pourras partir.
Point of No Return#092.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#093.src: I will be lost once more... and you will leave.
Point of No Return#093.dst: Je serai perdu une fois de plus... et tu partiras.
Point of No Return#093.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#095.src: You will live. You have lived, already. In my absence, you have built yourself anew.
Point of No Return#095.dst: Tu vivras. Tu as déjà vécu. En mon absence, tu as refait ta vie.
Point of No Return#095.speaker: Player?

Point of No Return#096.src: Do not mourn me. I have long been lost to you already.
Point of No Return#096.dst: Ne me pleure pas. Je suis perdu pour toi depuis longtemps.
Point of No Return#096.speaker: Player?

Potion Making#000.src: Dr. Essren needs to be stopped!
Potion Making#000.dst: Il faut arrêter le Dr Essren!
Potion Making#000.speaker: Dr. Essren

Potion Making#001.src: I was...in support of this...but then, he accrued essence of...the corruption. I had to run away...
Potion Making#001.dst: Je...le soutenais...mais ensuite, il a obtenu de l'essence de...la Corruption. J'ai dû m'enfuir...
Potion Making#001.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#002.src: Get me... [{~} Red Mushroom], they can be found outside the east gate behind me.
Potion Making#002.dst: Rapportez-moi... [{~} Red Mushroom], on en trouve hors de la porte est, derrière moi.
Potion Making#002.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#003.src: You must...ensure that it worked. You...are much stronger than I, stranger...
Potion Making#003.dst: Vous devez...vérifier que ça a marché. Vous...avez bien plus de force que moi, étranger...
Potion Making#003.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#004.src: What have you done to this potion, human!? You will pay for it!
Potion Making#004.dst: Qu'as-tu fait à cette potion, humain!? Tu vas le payer!
Potion Making#004.speaker: Dr. Essren

Potion Making#005.src: It's time to head back to The Assistant in {p} and show him the proof.
Potion Making#005.dst: Il est temps de retourner voir l'Assistant à {p} pour lui montrer la preuve.

Potion Making#006.src: Talk to The Assistant in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Potion Making#007.dst: Héhé...étranger. Je...pourrais avoir besoin de votre aide...
Potion Making#007.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#008.src: My master...wishes to create a very dangerous potion...a transformative elixir of invincibility...
Potion Making#008.dst: Mon maître...veut créer une potion très dangereuse...un élixir transformateur d'invincibilité...
Potion Making#008.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#009.src: I fear...that he may be going...too far. I need your help...
Potion Making#009.dst: Je crains...qu'il n'aille...trop loin. J'ai besoin de votre aide...
Potion Making#009.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#010.src: I want...to stop him...but I need you to...get me the necessary ingredients... to neutralize the potion...
Potion Making#010.dst: Je veux...l'arrêter...mais il faut que vous...me rapportiez les ingrédients... pour neutraliser la potion...
Potion Making#010.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#011.src: Slay Mooshrooms near and bring [{~} Red Mushrooms] to The Assistant in {p}
Potion Making#011.dst: Tuez des Mooshrooms des environs et apportez [{~} Red Mushrooms] à l'Assistant à {p}

Potion Making#012.src: Quickly, get me... [{~} Red Mushroom] as I asked... go through the {p} outside the east gate from here.
Potion Making#012.dst: Vite, rapportez-moi... [{~} Red Mushroom] comme je vous l'ai demandé... traversez {p} en sortant par la porte est.
Potion Making#012.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#016.src: I'll... return to my master's house...and sneak the mushrooms into...his potion. Wait for me here...
Potion Making#016.dst: Je vais... retourner chez mon maître...et glisser les champignons dans...sa potion. Attendez-moi ici...
Potion Making#016.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#017.src: I...have returned... He came back...just as I finished slipping the mushrooms in and...told me...to get out.
Potion Making#017.dst: Je...suis de retour... Il est revenu...juste quand je finissais de glisser les champignons et...m'a dit...de sortir.
Potion Making#017.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#018.src: Did you see the orange witch hat roofed hut when you were gathering the mushrooms?
Potion Making#018.dst: Avez-vous vu la cabane au toit en chapeau de sorcière orange en cueillant les champignons?
Potion Making#018.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#019.src: That is my master's house, you...must go back out the east gate and enter the hut.
Potion Making#019.dst: C'est la maison de mon maître, vous...devez ressortir par la porte est et entrer dans la cabane.
Potion Making#019.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#020.src: You must...make sure...he has not managed...to become invincible... Do what has to be done....
Potion Making#020.dst: Vous devez...vous assurer...qu'il n'est pas parvenu...à devenir invincible... Faites ce qui doit être fait....
Potion Making#020.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#021.src: Enter the hut at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and slay Essren, and take his coat.
Potion Making#021.dst: Entrez dans la cabane en [{~}, {~}, -{~}], tuez Essren et prenez son manteau.

Potion Making#022.src: You must go back out the east gate and enter the hut, it is my master's house.
Potion Making#022.dst: Ressortez par la porte est et entrez dans la cabane, c'est la maison de mon maître.
Potion Making#022.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#023.src: Don't forget... Do what you must...
Potion Making#023.dst: N'oubliez pas... Faites ce que vous devez...
Potion Making#023.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#024.src: Ah, you must be the one my assistant told me about.
Potion Making#024.dst: Ah, c'est donc toi dont mon assistant m'a parlé.
Potion Making#024.speaker: Dr. Essren

Potion Making#025.src: If you are trying to stop me, it's too late. I already drank the pot-...
Potion Making#025.dst: Si tu essaies de m'arrêter, c'est trop tard. J'ai déjà bu la pot-...
Potion Making#025.speaker: Dr. Essren

Potion Making#026.src: What is this taste? Mushrooms? This can't b-
Potion Making#026.dst: Quel est ce goût? Des champignons? Ça ne peut pas ê-
Potion Making#026.speaker: Dr. Essren

Potion Making#028.src: Bring back Essren's Dusty Coat to The Assistant in {p}
Potion Making#028.dst: Rapportez le Manteau poussiéreux d'Essren à l'Assistant à {p}

Potion Making#030.src: Don't believe...everything people tell you... If master managed to...discover invincibility... No...too...dangerous.
Potion Making#030.dst: Ne croyez pas...tout ce qu'on vous dit... Si le maître avait réussi à...découvrir l'invincibilité... Non...trop...dangereux.
Potion Making#030.speaker: The Assistant

Potion Making#032.src: Now. I...do not want you saying anything about...these events. Take these, and...never speak of this again.
Potion Making#032.dst: Bon. Je...ne veux pas que vous parliez de...ces événements. Prenez ceci, et...n'en parlez plus jamais.
Potion Making#032.speaker: The Assistant

Purple and Blue#000.dst: Parlez à Korun près de {p}, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Purple and Blue#001.src: W-Woah there, short nose! What are you doing, barging into my home?!
Purple and Blue#001.dst: H-hé, doucement, petit nez! Qu'est-ce que tu fais à débarquer chez moi?!
Purple and Blue#001.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#002.src: Did {p} send you? Well, welcome to {p}! I could actually make use of some assistance.
Purple and Blue#002.dst: C'est {p} qui t'envoie? Eh bien, bienvenue à {p}! J'aurais justement besoin d'un coup de main.
Purple and Blue#002.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#003.src: The magic here in this place is so potent; you can actually see the mystical properties!
Purple and Blue#003.dst: La magie ici est si puissante qu'on peut voir ses propriétés mystiques!
Purple and Blue#003.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#004.src: I've been a scientist for many years, but I have never seen anything like this lake.
Purple and Blue#004.dst: Je suis scientifique depuis des années, mais je n'ai jamais rien vu de pareil à ce lac.
Purple and Blue#004.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#005.src: That's why I set up a small laboratory and started living here to study the place. It's pretty rudimentary but it does the job done.
Purple and Blue#005.dst: C'est pour ça que j'ai monté un petit labo et que je vis ici pour étudier les lieux. C'est assez rudimentaire, mais ça fait l'affaire.
Purple and Blue#005.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#006.src: The deeper into the lake you dive, the stronger the magical power becomes. I think something strange is occurring in the heart of the lake. I believe a lot of answers lie inside.
Purple and Blue#006.dst: Plus on plonge profond dans le lac, plus le pouvoir magique est fort. Je crois qu'il se passe quelque chose d'étrange au coeur du lac. Bien des réponses s'y trouvent, j'en suis sûr.
Purple and Blue#006.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#007.src: Alright, that's enough context! You see, there's another... "scientist" across the lake. We're kind of rivals? The guy's awful, I hate him, AND... Well...
Purple and Blue#007.dst: Bon, assez de contexte! Vois-tu, il y a un autre... "scientifique" de l'autre côté du lac. On est un peu rivaux? Ce type est affreux, je le déteste, ET... Enfin...
Purple and Blue#007.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#009.src: And while I somewhat hope he's gotten himself in trouble, he might've figured something out about the lake.
Purple and Blue#009.dst: Et même si j'espère un peu qu'il s'est attiré des ennuis, il a peut-être découvert quelque chose sur le lac.
Purple and Blue#009.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#010.src: There's a note here. You start reading it...
Purple and Blue#010.dst: Il y a une note ici. Vous commencez à la lire...

Purple and Blue#011.src: IMPORTANT NOTES: The map to the talisman is in the basement!! That fool Korun will never see all this coming.
Purple and Blue#011.dst: NOTES IMPORTANTES: La carte du talisman est au sous-sol!! Cet idiot de Korun ne verra rien venir.

Purple and Blue#012.src: If everything goes right, it should grant access to the heart of the mountain... I can't wait!
Purple and Blue#012.dst: Si tout se passe bien, il devrait donner accès au coeur de la montagne... J'ai hâte!

Purple and Blue#013.src: It looks like there are extra notes on the back. What should you do?
Purple and Blue#013.dst: On dirait qu'il y a d'autres notes au verso. Que faire?

Purple and Blue#014.src: I needn't forget to input the total number of lit candles inside the house in order to get in the basement... That's why I made that tube! I'm so good at handling security!! No need for blasted overpriced Corkian equipment!
Purple and Blue#014.dst: Je ne dois pas oublier d'entrer le nombre total de bougies allumées dans la maison pour accéder au sous-sol... C'est pour ça que j'ai fait ce tube! Je suis si doué en sécurité!! Pas besoin de ce fichu matériel Corkian hors de prix!

Purple and Blue#015.src: You read what's behind the note...
Purple and Blue#015.dst: Vous lisez ce qu'il y a au dos de la note...

Purple and Blue#016.src: I actually don't know if I'm making it out of this, but I absolutely have to find out what's inside the lake.
Purple and Blue#016.dst: Je ne sais pas si je m'en sortirai, mais je dois absolument découvrir ce qu'il y a dans le lac.

Purple and Blue#017.src: One part of me wants to bring Korun along. As much as we hate each other, it'd surely increase our chance of survival.
Purple and Blue#017.dst: Une part de moi veut emmener Korun. On a beau se détester, ça augmenterait sûrement nos chances de survie.

Purple and Blue#018.src: And, who knows, maybe the heart of the mountain is actually perfectly safe?
Purple and Blue#018.dst: Et, qui sait, peut-être que le coeur de la montagne est en fait parfaitement sûr?

Purple and Blue#019.src: Though, I mustn't forget that three of the greatest minds of our time got lost to cosmic powers...
Purple and Blue#019.dst: Mais je ne dois pas oublier que trois des plus grands esprits de l'époque ont été perdus face au cosmos...

Purple and Blue#020.src: No matter what, if you really want to join me, I left you enough clues.
Purple and Blue#020.dst: Quoi qu'il arrive, si tu veux vraiment me rejoindre, je t'ai laissé assez d'indices.

Purple and Blue#023.src: This map seems to lead towards a particular location nearby...
Purple and Blue#023.dst: Cette carte semble mener à un endroit précis tout près...

Purple and Blue#024.src: Some mechanisms can be heard... There's probably another lever to press.
Purple and Blue#024.dst: On entend des mécanismes... Il y a sans doute un autre levier à actionner.

Purple and Blue#025.src: Upon touching the crystal, you notice a peculiar device...
Purple and Blue#025.dst: En touchant le cristal, vous remarquez un étrange dispositif...

Purple and Blue#026.dst: Il commence à changer de forme!

Purple and Blue#027.src: The crystal finished forming something, you should retrieve it.
Purple and Blue#027.dst: Le cristal a fini de former quelque chose, vous devriez le récupérer.

Purple and Blue#029.src: Looks like you can leave this place now.
Purple and Blue#029.dst: On dirait que vous pouvez partir maintenant.

Purple and Blue#031.src: I suspect he's gone in to the heart of the lake... Come with me a moment, please.
Purple and Blue#031.dst: Je soupçonne qu'il est entré au coeur du lac... Viens avec moi un instant, s'il te plaît.
Purple and Blue#031.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#032.src: Alright, this leads underwater where the heart is. How about you try and enter?
Purple and Blue#032.dst: Bon, ça mène sous l'eau, là où se trouve le coeur. Et si tu essayais d'entrer?
Purple and Blue#032.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#033.src: ...just as I thought, you can't get in just like me. We'll need to gather more information.
Purple and Blue#033.dst: ...comme je le pensais, tu ne peux pas entrer, pas plus que moi. Il nous faut plus d'informations.
Purple and Blue#033.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#034.src: Human, investigate Nikoler's house for me. It's north down the coast.
Purple and Blue#034.dst: Humain, va fouiller chez Nikoler pour moi. C'est au nord, en bas de la côte.
Purple and Blue#034.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#035.src: Where could he be... There's no way he found access to- Hey!
Purple and Blue#035.dst: Où peut-il bien être... Impossible qu'il ait trouvé un accès au- Hé!
Purple and Blue#035.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#036.src: Don't just listen to me mumbling! Have you found Nikoler?!
Purple and Blue#036.dst: Ne reste pas là à m'écouter marmonner! Tu as trouvé Nikoler?!
Purple and Blue#036.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#037.src: Investigate Nikoler's house for clues at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Purple and Blue#037.dst: Fouillez la maison de Nikoler en quête d'indices, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Purple and Blue#038.src: Follow the hints in the cellar to the mysterious cave.
Purple and Blue#038.dst: Suivez les indices du sous-sol jusqu'à la grotte mystérieuse.

Purple and Blue#039.src: Enter and explore the mysterious cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Purple and Blue#039.dst: Entrez dans la grotte mystérieuse en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] et explorez-la.

Purple and Blue#040.src: Return to Korun in his home at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Purple and Blue#040.dst: Retournez voir Korun chez lui, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Purple and Blue#041.src: Y-you've actually found a lead?! There were clues in his basement? And you found a... talisman? This must be it, then!
Purple and Blue#041.dst: T-tu as vraiment trouvé une piste?! Il y avait des indices dans son sous-sol? Et tu as trouvé un... talisman? Alors c'est forcément ça!
Purple and Blue#041.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#042.src: This might very well be the key to enter the heart, especially if it was as well-guarded with cosmic creatures as you say.
Purple and Blue#042.dst: Ça pourrait bien être la clé pour entrer dans le coeur, surtout s'il était aussi bien gardé par des créatures cosmiques que tu le dis.
Purple and Blue#042.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#043.src: Alright then! This might be too dangerous for me, so I'm entrusting this task to you once more. Enter the tunnel in my basement, and explore as much as you can!
Purple and Blue#043.dst: Très bien! C'est peut-être trop dangereux pour moi, alors je te confie encore cette tâche. Entre dans le tunnel de mon sous-sol, et explore autant que tu peux!
Purple and Blue#043.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#044.src: If you can bring me samples of any kind, I'll try to reward you handsomely. However, if you find Nikoler alive... Please bring him back.
Purple and Blue#044.dst: Si tu me rapportes des échantillons, quels qu'ils soient, je tâcherai de bien te récompenser. Mais si tu trouves Nikoler vivant... Ramène-le, s'il te plaît.
Purple and Blue#044.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#045.src: As for the talisman, make sure you hold it whilst in the tunnel. Be careful, you're in uncharted territory from now on.
Purple and Blue#045.dst: Quant au talisman, tiens-le bien en main dans le tunnel. Fais attention, tu entres en territoire inexploré.
Purple and Blue#045.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#046.src: As Korun said, it's probably better to hold that talisman to traverse the tunnel...
Purple and Blue#046.dst: Comme l'a dit Korun, mieux vaut sans doute tenir ce talisman pour traverser le tunnel...

Purple and Blue#047.src: Good luck, human. Please bring me back Nikoler, or any sample you might find.
Purple and Blue#047.dst: Bonne chance, humain. Ramène-moi Nikoler, ou tout échantillon trouvé.
Purple and Blue#047.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#048.src: Enter the heart of Gylia from under the lake.
Purple and Blue#048.dst: Entrez dans le Coeur de Gylia par le fond du lac.

Purple and Blue#050.src: The drill should be ready by now... In just a little bit, I'll have single-handedly conquered the heart of the mountain...!
Purple and Blue#050.dst: La foreuse devrait être prête maintenant... Dans un instant, j'aurai conquis à moi seul le coeur de la montagne...!

Purple and Blue#051.src: A human!? W...What? Did you read the notes I left for Korun? I'll have you know that's theft!! I - you...!
Purple and Blue#051.dst: Un humain!? Q...Quoi? Tu as lu les notes que j'ai laissées pour Korun? Sache que c'est du vol!! Je - toi...!
Purple and Blue#051.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#052.src: Don't get any closer!! I'll destroy the path if I have to!!
Purple and Blue#052.dst: N'approche pas!! Je détruirai le chemin s'il le faut!!
Purple and Blue#052.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#053.src: This is MY story! Don't you dare interfere!!
Purple and Blue#053.dst: C'est MON histoire! N'ose pas t'en mêler!!
Purple and Blue#053.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#054.src: You're... persistent. Are you trying to steal from these meteors I'VE found?! Do you have any idea how much research I did to get this far??
Purple and Blue#054.dst: Tu es... tenace. Tu veux voler ces météorites que J'AI trouvées?! Tu as une idée du travail qu'il m'a fallu pour en arriver là??
Purple and Blue#054.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#055.src: It's too late! I've already drilled a piece. Once I show Korun, I'll be known as the better researcher...
Purple and Blue#055.dst: Trop tard! J'en ai déjà foré un morceau. Dès que Korun le verra, on me reconnaîtra comme le meilleur chercheur...
Purple and Blue#055.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#056.dst: Ah... comme ça va être b-
Purple and Blue#056.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#058.src: No no no no no no! This CAN'T be happening!
Purple and Blue#058.dst: Non non non non non non! Ce n'est PAS possible!
Purple and Blue#058.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#059.src: Tampering with the meteors must be making the cave instable! I... I thought this'd happen and yet-
