Purple and Blue#059.dst: Toucher aux météorites doit rendre la grotte instable! Je... je me doutais que ça arriverait et pourtant-
Purple and Blue#059.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#060.src: This is all YOUR fault! Why'd you have to come and make me panic? We're both DOOMED!
Purple and Blue#060.dst: Tout ça, c'est TA faute! Pourquoi venir me faire paniquer? On est FICHUS tous les deux!
Purple and Blue#060.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#061.src: No... I can't die here, I can't die now, what will he think...
Purple and Blue#061.dst: Non... je ne peux pas mourir ici, pas maintenant, que va-t-il penser...
Purple and Blue#061.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#062.src: I... We might still have a shot at escaping... And then, human, I'll report you to the authorities!!
Purple and Blue#062.dst: Je... On a peut-être encore une chance de s'échapper... Et ensuite, humain, je te dénonce aux autorités!!
Purple and Blue#062.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#063.src: I'm STUCK! Urgh... No... Not like this, please, not like this...
Purple and Blue#063.dst: Je suis COINCÉ! Argh... Non... Pas comme ça, pitié, pas comme ça...
Purple and Blue#063.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#064.src: You... Why? You came to get me? Not the... meteors?
Purple and Blue#064.dst: Toi... Pourquoi? Tu es là pour moi? Pas pour les... météorites?
Purple and Blue#064.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#065.src: I... Fine then. Let's make a run for it, human!
Purple and Blue#065.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#067.src: Rats! That dynamite went and backfired on us! Quick, try to run in to the rubble with me, we need to hurry!
Purple and Blue#067.dst: Zut! Cette dynamite s'est retournée contre nous! Vite, cours avec moi vers les décombres, il faut se dépêcher!
Purple and Blue#067.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#069.src: Welcome back! I see you're completely drenched! How did things go? I assume you've explored the place thoroughly.
Purple and Blue#069.dst: Te revoilà! Tu dégoulines! Comment ça s'est passé? Je suppose que tu as exploré les lieux à fond.
Purple and Blue#069.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#071.src: ...were you worrying about me? What a fool. This mountain could never do so much as scratch me!
Purple and Blue#071.dst: ...tu t'inquiétais pour moi? Quel idiot. Cette montagne ne pourrait même pas m'égratigner!
Purple and Blue#071.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#072.src: This human right here actually saved me, right after endangering me. You don't mean to tell me you sent them for me?
Purple and Blue#072.dst: Cet humain-là m'a sauvé, juste après m'avoir mis en danger. Ne me dis pas que c'est toi qui l'as envoyé me chercher?
Purple and Blue#072.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#073.src: Well, it's very simple. Where's the fun in our rivalry if you just go off and die somewhere?
Purple and Blue#073.dst: Eh bien, c'est très simple. Quel intérêt aurait notre rivalité si tu allais mourir dans un coin?
Purple and Blue#073.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#074.src: That aside, what did you find in there? What happened?
Purple and Blue#074.dst: Mis à part ça, qu'as-tu trouvé là-dedans? Que s'est-il passé?
Purple and Blue#074.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#075.src: I found them, Korun. I found the meteors! They still seemed potent somehow, but the cave collapsed and...
Purple and Blue#075.dst: Je les ai trouvées, Korun. Les météorites! Elles semblaient encore puissantes, mais la grotte s'est effondrée et...
Purple and Blue#075.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#076.src: That's... fine. We can always go back and try clearing the rubble. There's always opportunities to take a hold of. Next time, please don't just go off on your own!
Purple and Blue#076.dst: Ce n'est... pas grave. On peut toujours y retourner et essayer de dégager les décombres. Il y a toujours des occasions à saisir. La prochaine fois, s'il te plaît, ne pars pas tout seul!
Purple and Blue#076.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#077.src: Human, you made the right choice... Without Nikoler, our efforts would have been in vain. I'll try to work with him a bit more, as it seems like the logical course of action now. Thank you.
Purple and Blue#077.dst: Humain, tu as fait le bon choix... Sans Nikoler, nos efforts auraient été vains. Je vais essayer de travailler un peu plus avec lui, ça me semble logique maintenant. Merci.
Purple and Blue#077.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#078.dst: H-hé! Je n'ai jamais accepté de-
Purple and Blue#078.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#079.src: I see you're completely drenched! There's this odd aura around you... What happened?
Purple and Blue#079.dst: Tu dégoulines! Et il y a une aura étrange autour de toi... Que s'est-il passé?
Purple and Blue#079.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#080.src: You... You actually found a meteor shard! That's amazing! That's... that's... um...
Purple and Blue#080.dst: Tu... Tu as vraiment trouvé un éclat de météorite! C'est incroyable! C'est... c'est... euh...
Purple and Blue#080.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#081.src: Uh, what did you say j-just now? The cave collapsed and Nikoler d-died...?
Purple and Blue#081.dst: Euh, tu viens de d-dire quoi? La grotte s'est effondrée et Nikoler est m-mort...?
Purple and Blue#081.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#082.src: That's, um, haha... That doesn't sound right, he can't die, he can't leave like that, he can't-
Purple and Blue#082.dst: C'est, euh, haha... C'est pas possible, il peut pas mourir, il peut pas partir comme ça, il peut pas-
Purple and Blue#082.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#083.src: S-Sorry. I'm just a little shocked is all. I do have to thank you for the shard...
Purple and Blue#083.dst: P-pardon. Je suis juste un peu sous le choc. Je dois te remercier pour l'éclat...
Purple and Blue#083.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#084.src: A-at the very least, you saw this through... I have to commend you for that... I think.
Purple and Blue#084.dst: A-au moins, tu as tenu jusqu'au bout... Je dois te féliciter pour ça... je crois.
Purple and Blue#084.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#085.src: Just take these, and go. I have much to think about.
Purple and Blue#085.dst: Prends ça, et va-t'en. J'ai beaucoup à réfléchir.
Purple and Blue#085.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#086.src: You explored thoroughly, and couldn't find a shard? Well, we still have much to discover I suppose.
Purple and Blue#086.dst: Tu as tout exploré, et tu n'as trouvé aucun éclat? Bon, il nous reste beaucoup à découvrir, je suppose.
Purple and Blue#086.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#087.src: Uh, what did you say j-just now? The cave collapsed and Nikoler d-died..?
Purple and Blue#087.dst: Euh, tu viens de d-dire quoi? La grotte s'est effondrée et Nikoler est m-mort..?
Purple and Blue#087.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#088.src: S-Sorry. I'm just a little shocked is all. And you came back empty-handed... This was just a loss with everyone involved.
Purple and Blue#088.dst: P-pardon. Je suis juste un peu sous le choc. Et tu reviens les mains vides... Tout le monde y a perdu.
Purple and Blue#088.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#089.src: I see you're completely drenched, so I suppose you thoroughly explored the place. How did it go?
Purple and Blue#089.dst: Tu dégoulines, alors je suppose que tu as bien exploré les lieux. Comment ça s'est passé?
Purple and Blue#089.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#090.src: You found... Nothing? Really? And the meteors were too unstable to temper with?
Purple and Blue#090.dst: Tu n'as... rien trouvé? Vraiment? Et les météorites étaient trop instables pour y toucher?
Purple and Blue#090.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#091.src: Actually, how would you know about tempering with the- wait...
Purple and Blue#091.dst: Au fait, comment tu sais qu'on ne peut pas y toucher- attends...
Purple and Blue#091.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#092.src: Did you find him? Please... please tell me you found him, there's no way he'd die just like that. I...
Purple and Blue#092.dst: Tu l'as trouvé? Pitié... dis-moi que tu l'as trouvé, il ne peut pas être mort comme ça. Je...
Purple and Blue#092.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#093.src: W-what? The whole cave COLLAPSED on him? And you couldn't even save him?! N-no, it can't be your fault, I... I'm sorry.
Purple and Blue#093.dst: Q-quoi? La grotte entière s'est EFFONDRÉE sur lui? Et tu n'as même pas pu le sauver?! N-non, ce n'est pas ta faute, je... Je suis désolé.
Purple and Blue#093.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#094.src: This is all way too much to take in for me, but I suppose you've explored and served the purpose I gave you.
Purple and Blue#094.dst: C'est beaucoup trop à encaisser pour moi, mais je suppose que tu as exploré et rempli la mission que je t'avais confiée.
Purple and Blue#094.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#095.src: Here's your reward, then. Now please, just leave me be. There's a lot I have to think about.
Purple and Blue#095.dst: Voici ta récompense, alors. Maintenant, s'il te plaît, laisse-moi seul. J'ai beaucoup à réfléchir.
Purple and Blue#095.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#096.src: It's you! Glad to have crossed paths again!
Purple and Blue#096.dst: C'est toi! Content de te recroiser!
Purple and Blue#096.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#097.src: Since the incident, I've decided to start fishing as a hobby.
Purple and Blue#097.dst: Depuis l'incident, je me suis mis à la pêche.
Purple and Blue#097.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#098.src: Take this- for all I care, you can own this!
Purple and Blue#098.dst: Prends ça- franchement, tu peux le garder!
Purple and Blue#098.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#100.src: Check up on Korun from time to time for me, will you?
Purple and Blue#100.dst: Passe voir Korun de temps en temps pour moi, d'accord?
Purple and Blue#100.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#101.src: I'm still taking a break from all the science stuff... But he definitely hasn't seen the last of me!
Purple and Blue#101.dst: Je fais encore une pause dans tous ces trucs scientifiques... Mais il n'en a pas fini avec moi!
Purple and Blue#101.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#102.src: After all, I'm the one who got to the heart of the mountain! I'm even able to sleep soundly knowing that I've won...
Purple and Blue#102.dst: Après tout, c'est moi qui ai atteint le coeur de la montagne! Je dors même sur mes deux oreilles en sachant que j'ai gagné...
Purple and Blue#102.speaker: Nikoler

Queen's Recruit#000.src: Mel and Lanu, you'll be in E{~}.
Queen's Recruit#000.dst: Mel et Lanu, vous serez en E{~}.
Queen's Recruit#000.speaker: Representative

Queen's Recruit#001.src: Room W{~}... Now get going. I have a lot of rooms to assign...
Queen's Recruit#001.dst: Chambre W{~}... Allez, filez. J'ai encore plein de chambres à attribuer...
Queen's Recruit#001.speaker: Representative

Queen's Recruit#003.dst: Ouais... On a des choses à se raconter.

Queen's Recruit#004.src: I need to tell you s-

Queen's Recruit#005.src: Tasim is looking to catch up in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Queen's Recruit#005.dst: Tasim veut prendre de vos nouvelles à {p}, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Queen's Recruit#006.src: {u}! Hey! It's lucky I managed to catch you here.
Queen's Recruit#006.dst: {u}! Hé! Quelle chance de te trouver ici.
Queen's Recruit#006.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#007.src: It's been a while, hasn't it? We should catch up! You've probably had lots of adventures, right?
Queen's Recruit#007.dst: Ça fait un moment, hein? Il faut qu'on se raconte tout! Tu as sûrement vécu plein d'aventures, non?
Queen's Recruit#007.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#008.src: But before that... I've got to just find...
Queen's Recruit#008.dst: Mais avant ça... il faut juste que je trouve...
Queen's Recruit#008.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#009.src: Huh? What am I- oh, yeah. I'm trying to find Aledar.
Queen's Recruit#009.dst: Hein? Qu'est-ce que je- ah, oui. Je cherche Aledar.
Queen's Recruit#009.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#010.src: He sent me a letter asking me to join him on some... scouting mission. But I haven't been able to find him.
Queen's Recruit#010.dst: Il m'a envoyé une lettre pour que je le rejoigne sur une... mission de reconnaissance. Mais je n'arrive pas à le trouver.
Queen's Recruit#010.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#011.src: It did take me a while to get here... so maybe he's gone somewhere else by now. Aegis did tell me the mission ended up being called off, so...
Queen's Recruit#011.dst: J'ai mis du temps à arriver ici... alors il est peut-être déjà parti ailleurs. Aegis m'a dit que la mission avait finalement été annulée, alors...
Queen's Recruit#011.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#012.src: But if he's not here, then I should probably stop trying to catch him on the streets, huh? I'll just leave a message for him at the barracks.
Queen's Recruit#012.dst: Mais s'il n'est pas là, je devrais sans doute arrêter de le chercher dans les rues, hein? Je vais lui laisser un message à la caserne.
Queen's Recruit#012.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#013.src: We can head to the tavern and catch up! Gods, I've missed the Rusty Recruit's drinks... that barkeeper, he says it's the same as anywhere else, but it really isn't! Nowhere else pours it like he does.
Queen's Recruit#013.dst: On peut aller à la taverne pour se raconter tout ça! Dieux, les boissons du Rusty Recruit m'ont manqué... le barman dit que c'est pareil qu'ailleurs, mais pas du tout! Personne ne sert comme lui.
Queen's Recruit#013.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#014.src: He... doesn't know about Aledar, does he?
Queen's Recruit#014.dst: Il... n'est pas au courant pour Aledar, hein?

Queen's Recruit#015.src: He just got back. You can't... tell him now. You'll do it later, once he's settled in.
Queen's Recruit#015.dst: Il vient de rentrer. Tu ne peux pas... lui dire maintenant. Plus tard, quand il sera installé.

Queen's Recruit#016.src: ...he doesn't know. You have to break the news to him.
Queen's Recruit#016.dst: ...il ne sait pas. Tu dois lui annoncer la nouvelle.

Queen's Recruit#017.src: Pardon me, excuse me- coming through! Coming through! Ah, you two! Just the folks I was looking for.
Queen's Recruit#017.dst: Pardon, excusez-moi- je passe! Je passe! Ah, vous deux! Justement ceux que je cherchais.
Queen's Recruit#017.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#018.src: Pardon me, excuse me coming through! Coming through! Ah, you two! Just the folks I was looking for.
Queen's Recruit#018.dst: Pardon, excusez-moi je passe! Je passe! Ah, vous deux! Justement ceux que je cherchais.
Queen's Recruit#018.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#020.src: Well, perhaps not specifically. I've got a list of folks to try and track down, and the two of you are on it! Tasim and {u}, right?
Queen's Recruit#020.dst: Eh bien, pas précisément. J'ai une liste de gens à retrouver, et vous êtes dessus tous les deux! Tasim et {u}, c'est ça?
Queen's Recruit#020.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#021.src: I've got an important missive from {p}. Direct from the King himself, yep yep!
Queen's Recruit#021.dst: J'ai un message important de {p}. Directement du roi en personne, oui oui!
Queen's Recruit#021.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#022.src: Really? I don't think I've even seen him since... what could he possibly want us for?
Queen's Recruit#022.dst: Vraiment? Je crois que je ne l'ai même pas vu depuis... qu'est-ce qu'il peut bien nous vouloir?
Queen's Recruit#022.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#023.src: I'm not privy to the details, I'm afraid! He's summoning a number of you seasoned adventurers to the castle, for some sort of meeting.
Queen's Recruit#023.dst: Je ne connais pas les détails, j'en ai peur! Il convoque au château plusieurs aventuriers chevronnés comme vous, pour une sorte de réunion.
Queen's Recruit#023.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#024.src: Anyway, I've got more to try and track down, so I'll give you the written letters and be on my way! Best of luck with whatever it is!
Queen's Recruit#024.dst: Bref, j'ai d'autres gens à retrouver, alors je vous donne les lettres et je file! Bonne chance pour ce que c'est!
Queen's Recruit#024.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#026.src: Hm. That is strange, isn't it? I guess we'll have to call off drinks till later... probably for the best. Maybe I'll be able to catch him before...
Queen's Recruit#026.dst: Hm. C'est étrange, non? On va devoir remettre les verres à plus tard... c'est peut-être mieux. Je pourrai peut-être le trouver avant...
Queen's Recruit#026.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#027.src: Oh, uh- you go on ahead. I have to stop by the barracks first. I'll meet you in {p}, then?
Queen's Recruit#027.dst: Oh, euh- vas-y devant. Je dois d'abord passer à la caserne. On se retrouve à {p}, alors?
Queen's Recruit#027.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#028.src: I'll meet you in {p}. I have to deal with some things at the barracks first.
Queen's Recruit#028.dst: On se retrouve à {p}. Je dois d'abord régler deux-trois choses à la caserne.
Queen's Recruit#028.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#029.src: Attend the meeting with the King in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Queen's Recruit#029.dst: Assistez à la réunion avec le roi à {p}, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Queen's Recruit#030.src: ...oh, there you are. Didn't you head out before me?
Queen's Recruit#030.dst: ...ah, te voilà. Tu ne devais pas partir avant moi?
Queen's Recruit#030.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#031.src: I don't know most of the people here, so I'll stick with you for now.
Queen's Recruit#031.dst: Je ne connais presque personne ici, alors je reste avec toi pour l'instant.
Queen's Recruit#031.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#032.src: ...and it's all crashing down, right? So I knock the zombie back, grab the kid, and jump for-
Queen's Recruit#032.dst: ...et tout s'écroule, d'accord? Alors je repousse le zombie, j'attrape le gamin, et je saute vers-
Queen's Recruit#032.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#033.src: Wait, wait wait wait - you're tellin' me there was a kid involved? And you still set off the bombs?!
Queen's Recruit#033.dst: Attends, attends attends attends - tu me dis qu'il y avait un gamin? Et t'as quand même fait sauter les bombes?!
Queen's Recruit#033.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#034.src: Yeah! I said that already, right? That was the whole reason I-
Queen's Recruit#034.dst: Ouais! Je l'ai déjà dit, non? C'était justement pour ça que je-
Queen's Recruit#034.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#035.src: Ahem. Pause the story for a bit, Linton. We have company.
Queen's Recruit#035.dst: Hum. Mets l'histoire en pause un instant, Linton. On a de la compagnie.
Queen's Recruit#035.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#036.src: Well, if it ain't {u}! It's good to see someone else familiar 'round here.
Queen's Recruit#036.dst: Tiens, mais c'est {u}! Ça fait plaisir de voir une autre tête connue par ici.
Queen's Recruit#036.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#037.dst: Quoi, et moi je suis pas une tête connue?
Queen's Recruit#037.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#038.src: I do try to keep my distance.
Queen's Recruit#038.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#039.src: So, you received the summons too? The King has a lot of people here. It's interesting.
Queen's Recruit#039.dst: Alors, vous avez reçu la convocation aussi? Le roi a fait venir beaucoup de monde. C'est intéressant.
Queen's Recruit#039.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#040.src: We did, yes. And it sounded like they had even more people on that list that they were searching for.
Queen's Recruit#040.dst: Oui, en effet. Et apparemment, il y avait encore bien d'autres personnes sur leur liste.
Queen's Recruit#040.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#041.src: Oh, apologies, I hadn't noticed you there. You're a friend of {u}'s, I take it?
Queen's Recruit#041.dst: Oh, pardon, je ne t'avais pas vu. Tu es un ami de {u}, je suppose?
Queen's Recruit#041.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#042.src: I am! We arrived in Wynn on the same caravan. I'm Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#042.dst: Oui! On est arrivés à Wynn dans la même caravane. Je suis Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#042.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#044.src: So you're the one Aledar was always talking about! I thought you were off in Gavel?
Queen's Recruit#044.dst: Alors c'est toi dont Aledar parlait tout le temps! Je te croyais à Gavel?
Queen's Recruit#044.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#045.src: I... was. How do you all know him?
Queen's Recruit#045.dst: J'y... étais. Vous le connaissez d'où, tous?
Queen's Recruit#045.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#046.src: I believe we first met on a mission to reclaim {p}'s barracks from a treasonous commander. We've run into each other a few times since.
Queen's Recruit#046.dst: Je crois qu'on s'est rencontrés lors d'une mission pour reprendre la caserne de {p} à un commandant traître. On s'est recroisés plusieurs fois depuis.
Queen's Recruit#046.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#047.src: Still, it's good to finally get t' meet you! We've heard lots of stories! Including somethin' about not respondin' to letters...?
Queen's Recruit#047.dst: Quand même, ça fait plaisir de t'rencontrer enfin! On a entendu plein d'histoires! Dont un truc sur des lettres restées sans réponse...?
Queen's Recruit#047.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#048.src: Oh... right. We, uh... sorted that out.
Queen's Recruit#048.dst: Oh... oui. On a, euh... réglé ça.
Queen's Recruit#048.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#049.src: But speaking of- have any of you seen him recently?
Queen's Recruit#049.dst: Mais en parlant de lui- l'un de vous l'a vu récemment?
Queen's Recruit#049.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#050.src: 'fraid not. I don't think our paths've crossed since... was it the siege at {p}? Must've been.
Queen's Recruit#050.dst: J'crains que non. J'crois pas qu'on se soit croisés depuis... le siège de {p}? Sûrement.
Queen's Recruit#050.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#051.src: I saw him a month ago in {p}! I asked him what he was working on and if I could help and he just brushed me off. Weird, right?
Queen's Recruit#051.dst: Moi, je l'ai vu il y a un mois à {p}! Je lui ai demandé sur quoi il travaillait et si je pouvais aider, et il m'a envoyé balader. Bizarre, non?
Queen's Recruit#051.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#052.src: Mmn. No, that sounds like him. I think he had enough of your antics last time.
Queen's Recruit#052.dst: Mmn. Non, ça lui ressemble. Je crois qu'il en avait assez de tes frasques la dernière fois.
Queen's Recruit#052.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#053.src: What?! I'm capable. C'mon, Mel, tell her I'm capable.
Queen's Recruit#053.dst: Quoi?! Je suis compétent. Allez, Mel, dis-lui que je suis compétent.
Queen's Recruit#053.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#054.src: Linton, y'were just tellin' us about how you caved in a whole temple by-
Queen's Recruit#054.dst: Linton, tu nous racontais justement comment t'as fait s'écrouler un temple entier en-
Queen's Recruit#054.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#055.src: Okay! Okay, okay okay, let's talk about literally anything else! Tasim, right? What's... uh...
Queen's Recruit#055.dst: Ok! Ok, ok ok, parlons de littéralement autre chose! Tasim, c'est ça? C'est quoi... euh...
Queen's Recruit#055.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#056.src: ...so, your... no, no, give me a moment- you were... and... um... oh, right...
Queen's Recruit#056.dst: ...alors, ton... non, non, attends- tu étais... et... euh... ah, oui...
Queen's Recruit#056.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#059.src: Linton!! Y'can't just ask someone that!!
Queen's Recruit#059.dst: Linton!! T'peux pas demander ça comme ça!!
Queen's Recruit#059.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#061.src: It was nice meeting you, Tasim. I look forward to working with you during this mission.
Queen's Recruit#061.dst: Ravie de t'avoir rencontré, Tasim. J'ai hâte de travailler avec toi pendant cette mission.
Queen's Recruit#061.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#062.src: ...likewise. It's always nice meeting friends of Aledar.
Queen's Recruit#062.dst: ...de même. C'est toujours agréable de rencontrer des amis d'Aledar.
Queen's Recruit#062.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#063.src: Well, look at you! It's been quite a time since we last spoke. Far above the task of cleaning out sewers now, eh?
Queen's Recruit#063.dst: Eh bien, regarde-toi! Ça fait un bail qu'on s'est pas parlé. Bien au-dessus du nettoyage des égouts maintenant, hein?
Queen's Recruit#063.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#064.src: I've heard some tell of your accomplishments. Fine work, fine work.
Queen's Recruit#064.dst: J'ai entendu parler de tes exploits. Beau travail, beau travail.
Queen's Recruit#064.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#065.src: And... hm. Aren't you the one who ran off to Gavel without sayin' a word? Didn't expect you to be one o' the ones picked out for this.
Queen's Recruit#065.dst: Et... hm. C'est pas toi qui as filé à Gavel sans dire un mot? Je pensais pas te voir parmi les élus pour ça.
Queen's Recruit#065.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#066.src: I... didn't expect it either. I didn't even realize the King still remembered me, truth be told.
Queen's Recruit#066.dst: Je... ne m'y attendais pas non plus. Je ne savais même pas que le roi se souvenait encore de moi, à vrai dire.
Queen's Recruit#066.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#067.src: Mmn. Well, whatever the reason, you're here now. Don't suppose it matters much the path you took to get here. We need all the folks we can get- or so Kymer's been sayin'.
Queen's Recruit#067.dst: Mmn. Enfin, quelle que soit la raison, t'es là maintenant. Peu importe le chemin que t'as pris pour venir, j'suppose. On a besoin de tout le monde- c'est du moins ce que répète Kymer.
Queen's Recruit#067.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#068.src: Well well! If my eyes don't deceive me! {u} and Tasim!
Queen's Recruit#068.dst: Tiens, tiens! Si mes yeux ne me trompent pas! {u} et Tasim!
Queen's Recruit#068.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#069.src: I'll say, I didn't quite expect them to track you down! What with your... extended stint off in Gavel.
Queen's Recruit#069.dst: Je dois dire que je ne m'attendais pas à ce qu'on vous retrouve! Vu votre... long séjour à Gavel.
Queen's Recruit#069.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#070.src: I should say the same about you, captain. Did {p} no longer have a use for you once the war ended?
Queen's Recruit#070.dst: Je pourrais en dire autant de vous, capitaine. {p} n'avait plus besoin de vous une fois la guerre finie?
Queen's Recruit#070.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#071.src: Ah... nothing of the sort. You know, I was sent out there initially to serve as more of an envoy from {p}! If the King needs a diplomatic situation sorted, I'm the one he turns to first.
Queen's Recruit#071.dst: Ah... rien de tel. Vous savez, on m'a d'abord envoyé là-bas plutôt comme émissaire de {p}! Quand le roi a besoin de régler une affaire diplomatique, c'est vers moi qu'il se tourne en premier.
Queen's Recruit#071.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#072.src: Which... is indeed why I am here now. I was recalled rather abruptly several weeks ago. It seems we've encountered a tricky situation with our... neighboring province.
Queen's Recruit#072.dst: Ce qui... explique justement ma présence ici. On m'a rappelé assez brusquement il y a plusieurs semaines. Il semble que nous ayons une situation épineuse avec notre... province voisine.
Queen's Recruit#072.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#073.src: But! I shan't say more before the King arrives. He'll tell you all of the problem that hopefully we will be able to resolve.
Queen's Recruit#073.dst: Mais! Je n'en dirai pas plus avant l'arrivée du roi. Il vous exposera le problème que nous pourrons, je l'espère, résoudre.
Queen's Recruit#073.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#074.src: ...I see. We'll leave you to it, then.
Queen's Recruit#074.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#075.src: If we align the manaflow with Water, then nudge it to the side, maybe... ah- Reynauld, pass me my notes on... damn, what was it- oh, yes, the recovery period! Pass me those ones.
Queen's Recruit#075.dst: Si on aligne le flux de mana sur l'Eau, puis qu'on le décale un peu, peut-être... ah- Reynauld, passe-moi mes notes sur... zut, c'était quoi- ah, oui, la période de récupération! Passe-moi celles-là.
Queen's Recruit#075.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#076.src: ...You already have them on your left, doctor.
Queen's Recruit#076.dst: ...Vous les avez déjà à votre gauche, docteur.
Queen's Recruit#076.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#077.src: Do I now! It seems I do... oh, but this is only the first half- where did I leave the rest...
Queen's Recruit#077.dst: Ah bon! On dirait bien... oh, mais ce n'est que la première moitié- où ai-je mis le reste...
Queen's Recruit#077.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#078.src: Sigh... If you'd just allow me to organize for you, maybe you wouldn't-
Queen's Recruit#078.dst: Pfff... Si vous me laissiez ranger pour vous, peut-être que vous ne-
Queen's Recruit#078.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#079.src: And ruin my predefined sorting system?! No, Reynauld, I do think it works perfectly well as it is, thank you very much! Now, where could it have-
Queen's Recruit#079.dst: Et ruiner mon système de classement prédéfini?! Non, Reynauld, il fonctionne parfaitement tel quel, merci bien! Bon, où peut-il bien-
Queen's Recruit#079.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#080.src: Ah! You two! Good, good, you're here- I was worried Reynauld would be the only other one with recovered memories around here!
Queen's Recruit#080.dst: Ah! Vous deux! Bien, bien, vous êtes là- je craignais que Reynauld soit le seul autre ici à avoir retrouvé ses souvenirs!
Queen's Recruit#080.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#081.src: What, you didn't test it on anyone else after we left?
Queen's Recruit#081.dst: Quoi, vous ne l'avez testé sur personne d'autre après notre départ?
Queen's Recruit#081.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#082.src: Test it on- no, of course not! After what I saw? No, no, that would certainly not have been worth the risk. No new test subjects until I am certain it's flawless!
Queen's Recruit#082.dst: Testé sur- non, bien sûr que non! Après ce que j'ai vu? Non, non, ça n'aurait certainement pas valu le risque. Aucun nouveau cobaye tant que je ne serai pas certain que c'est parfait!
Queen's Recruit#082.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#083.src: I've been using it on myself instead! And, let me tell you- the breakthroughs I have made... there is much to be learned.
Queen's Recruit#083.dst: Je l'ai plutôt utilisé sur moi-même! Et laissez-moi vous dire- les percées que j'ai faites... il y a tant à apprendre.
Queen's Recruit#083.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#085.src: Pah! "Safety" - a meaningless term made only to stifle progress. Have there been side effects - certainly! But it has all been worth it.
Queen's Recruit#085.dst: Pah! La "sécurité" - un terme creux inventé pour étouffer le progrès. Y a-t-il eu des effets secondaires - assurément! Mais ça en valait la peine.
Queen's Recruit#085.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#086.src: Now, I must return to the pages... I've some equations I need to perfect before the King arrives...
Queen's Recruit#086.dst: Bon, je dois retourner à mes pages... j'ai des équations à peaufiner avant l'arrivée du roi...
Queen's Recruit#086.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#087.src: Hm. I can't say I would have expected you to be here, Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#087.dst: Hm. Je ne m'attendais pas à te voir ici, Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#087.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#088.src: Well... fate has other plans, I guess. How about you? Did you stay in {p}?
Queen's Recruit#088.dst: Eh bien... le destin en a décidé autrement, je suppose. Et toi? Tu es resté à {p}?
Queen's Recruit#088.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#089.src: Mostly. Moved around for a few assignments here and there, but I kept coming back.
Queen's Recruit#089.dst: Surtout. J'ai bougé pour quelques affectations ici et là, mais je revenais toujours.
Queen's Recruit#089.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#090.src: ...we haven't spoken in a while. Are you... doing well? How have you been managing the memories?
Queen's Recruit#090.dst: ...on ne s'est pas parlé depuis un moment. Tu vas... bien? Comment tu gères les souvenirs?
Queen's Recruit#090.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#091.src: As well as I could be expected to, I guess. It was rough for the first few months. Eventually, I got used to it.
Queen's Recruit#091.dst: Aussi bien qu'on peut s'y attendre, je suppose. Les premiers mois ont été durs. J'ai fini par m'y faire.
Queen's Recruit#091.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#092.src: How about you? I also wouldn't have expected you to show for a mission like this.
Queen's Recruit#092.dst: Et toi? Je ne m'attendais pas non plus à te voir sur une mission comme celle-ci.
Queen's Recruit#092.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#093.src: Same as you. Helped that Caid and I managed to talk it through. We meet every so often, talk about it. He talks about his sister, how he wants to find her one day.
Queen's Recruit#093.dst: Pareil que toi. Ça a aidé que Caid et moi puissions en parler. On se voit de temps en temps, on en discute. Il parle de sa soeur, de son envie de la retrouver un jour.
Queen's Recruit#093.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#094.dst: C'est... bien. Je suis content pour toi.
Queen's Recruit#094.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#095.src: Hm. Nothing stopping you from stopping by, yourself. It might even help you.
Queen's Recruit#095.dst: Hm. Rien ne t'empêche de passer, toi aussi. Ça pourrait même t'aider.
Queen's Recruit#095.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#096.src: I'll... consider it. Good to see you again, Reynauld.
Queen's Recruit#096.dst: J'y... réfléchirai. Content de te revoir, Reynauld.
Queen's Recruit#096.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#097.src: Another soldier? Allow me to see your summons.
Queen's Recruit#097.dst: Encore un soldat? Permettez-moi de voir votre convocation.
Queen's Recruit#097.speaker: Ragni Guard

Queen's Recruit#098.src: ...good. Come on in, {u}. The King will be arriving shortly.
Queen's Recruit#098.dst: ...bien. Entrez, {u}. Le roi va bientôt arriver.
Queen's Recruit#098.speaker: Ragni Guard

Queen's Recruit#100.src: If you insist. Don't take too long.
Queen's Recruit#100.dst: Si vous insistez. Ne tardez pas trop.
Queen's Recruit#100.speaker: Ragni Guard

Queen's Recruit#101.src: Ah... here we are. I thank you all for coming on such short notice. It has been some time since I have seen many of you.
Queen's Recruit#101.dst: Ah... nous y voilà. Je vous remercie tous d'être venus si vite. Cela fait un moment que je n'ai pas vu nombre d'entre vous.
Queen's Recruit#101.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#102.src: ...I'll get right to the point. We find ourselves in a very delicate position when it comes to our relations with our neighboring province, Fruma.
Queen's Recruit#102.dst: ...J'irai droit au but. Nous nous trouvons dans une position très délicate quant à nos relations avec notre province voisine, Fruma.
Queen's Recruit#102.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#105.src: Good. I guess that makes two of us.
Queen's Recruit#105.dst: Bien. Alors nous sommes deux, je suppose.

Queen's Recruit#106.src: It sounds very suspicious. Why the sudden interest? Why now?
Queen's Recruit#106.dst: Ça semble très louche. Pourquoi cet intérêt soudain? Pourquoi maintenant?

Queen's Recruit#107.src: We rely heavily on the flow of new recruits sent to us, but we have no means of contacting their province. Only they may reach out to us, and only once before have they chosen to do so.
Queen's Recruit#107.dst: Nous dépendons beaucoup du flux de nouvelles recrues qu'ils nous envoient, mais nous n'avons aucun moyen de contacter leur province. Eux seuls peuvent nous joindre, et ils ne l'ont fait qu'une seule fois auparavant.
Queen's Recruit#107.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#108.src: ...several weeks ago, we received a cloaked visitor through the outskirts. She claimed to be of Fruma, one of their Sovereigns.
Queen's Recruit#108.dst: ...il y a plusieurs semaines, une visiteuse encapuchonnée est arrivée par la périphérie. Elle disait être de Fruma, l'une de leurs Souveraines.
Queen's Recruit#108.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#109.src: We were extended an invitation, of sorts. Of all the recruits we have ever received, we were to select the greatest, and send them into Fruma for some sort of celebration.
Queen's Recruit#109.dst: On nous a adressé une sorte d'invitation. De toutes les recrues que nous ayons jamais reçues, nous devions choisir les meilleures et les envoyer à Fruma pour une sorte de célébration.
Queen's Recruit#109.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#110.src: Is that who we are? The greatest?
Queen's Recruit#110.dst: C'est ce que nous sommes? Les meilleurs?
Queen's Recruit#110.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#111.src: The ones that could be reached, at the very least! Perhaps some were greater yet, but we all know the roaming habits of your sort, and tracking them down really can prove-
Queen's Recruit#111.dst: Ceux qu'on a pu joindre, du moins! Il y en avait peut-être de meilleurs encore, mais nous connaissons tous les habitudes vagabondes de vos semblables, et les retrouver peut vraiment s'avérer-
Queen's Recruit#111.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#112.src: Ugh, we're not just going along with this, are we?
Queen's Recruit#112.dst: Pff, on va pas se contenter de suivre le mouvement, si?
Queen's Recruit#112.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#114.src: What? They're demanding something weird and obviously suspicious, so why should we just accept it?
Queen's Recruit#114.dst: Quoi? Ils exigent un truc bizarre et clairement louche, alors pourquoi on accepterait sans rien dire?
Queen's Recruit#114.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#115.src: I'm afraid we don't have a choice in the matter. As I mentioned, the recruits we receive make all the difference in our province's continued survival. If we were to reject this invitation...
Queen's Recruit#115.dst: Je crains que nous n'ayons pas le choix. Comme je l'ai dit, les recrues que nous recevons sont décisives pour la survie de notre province. Si nous refusions cette invitation...
Queen's Recruit#115.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#116.src: ...who's to say they wouldn't just stop sendin' 'em, eh? Tough.
Queen's Recruit#116.dst: ...qui dit qu'ils arrêteraient pas d'en envoyer, hein? Dur.
Queen's Recruit#116.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#117.src: Besides all that, think of the opportunity this presents! A true, freely-given view of what lies beyond those walls! We'd be fools not to accept it, no matter the implied threat!
Queen's Recruit#117.dst: Et puis, songez à l'occasion que cela représente! Un vrai regard, librement offert, sur ce qui se cache derrière ces murs! Nous serions fous de refuser, menace implicite ou non!
Queen's Recruit#117.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#118.src: Indeed. I regret that I must request this of you... but there is no other choice. You must accept this invitation.
Queen's Recruit#118.dst: En effet. Je regrette de devoir vous le demander... mais il n'y a pas d'autre choix. Vous devez accepter cette invitation.
Queen's Recruit#118.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#119.src: ...even those of us with bad experiences with the province?
Queen's Recruit#119.dst: ...même ceux qui gardent de mauvais souvenirs de cette province?
Queen's Recruit#119.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#120.src: I apologize... but you must. My hands are tied.
Queen's Recruit#120.dst: Je suis désolé... mais tu le dois. J'ai les mains liées.
Queen's Recruit#120.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#121.src: I take it we are expected to gather as much intelligence on Fruma as we can while we're in there?
Queen's Recruit#121.dst: Je suppose qu'on attend de nous qu'on recueille un maximum de renseignements sur Fruma une fois là-bas?
Queen's Recruit#121.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#122.src: That is the plan, indeed! I'll explain more once we're there, but I believe we're on a time limit, correct?
Queen's Recruit#122.dst: C'est bien le plan! J'en dirai plus une fois sur place, mais je crois que nous avons un temps limité, n'est-ce pas?
Queen's Recruit#122.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#123.src: That's the plan, indeed! I'll explain more once we're there, but I believe we're on a time limit, correct?
Queen's Recruit#123.dst: C'est le plan, en effet! J'en dirai plus une fois sur place, mais nous avons un temps limité, je crois, n'est-ce pas?
Queen's Recruit#123.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#124.src: You are correct, doctor. I have been told that a representative will greet you all at the royal gates of Fruma, situated on the western coast.
Queen's Recruit#124.dst: C'est exact, docteur. On m'a dit qu'un représentant vous accueillera tous aux portes royales de Fruma, sur la côte ouest.
Queen's Recruit#124.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#125.src: I've sent a courier ahead to {p} to inform the local captains of the destination they are to take you to.
Queen's Recruit#125.dst: J'ai envoyé un messager à {p} pour indiquer aux capitaines locaux où ils devront vous conduire.
Queen's Recruit#125.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#126.src: {p}... I know a captain there. {u}, want to join me?
Queen's Recruit#126.dst: {p}... Je connais un capitaine là-bas. {u}, tu viens avec moi?
Queen's Recruit#126.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#127.src: Finally... a glimpse at the province's inner workings... how long have I been seeking these answers?
Queen's Recruit#127.dst: Enfin... un aperçu des rouages de la province... depuis combien de temps je cherche ces réponses?
Queen's Recruit#127.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#128.src: So many theories... how many will be proven right? How many will be wrong? I cannot wait to find out!
Queen's Recruit#128.dst: Tant de théories... combien se révéleront justes? Combien seront fausses? J'ai hâte de le découvrir!
Queen's Recruit#128.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#129.src: Sigh... I did know this was coming. Why else would the doctor have been summoned? But I hoped I was wrong.
Queen's Recruit#129.dst: Pfff... Je savais que ça arriverait. Sinon, pourquoi convoquer le docteur? Mais j'espérais me tromper.
Queen's Recruit#129.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#130.src: Tough situation, isn't it? Lots o' secrecy on part of the Frumans...
Queen's Recruit#130.dst: Situation délicate, hein? Beaucoup de secrets du côté des Frumiens...
Queen's Recruit#130.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#131.src: But we'll handle it. Everyone here's plenty capable, after all.
Queen's Recruit#131.dst: Mais on va s'en sortir. Tout le monde ici est plus que capable, après tout.
Queen's Recruit#131.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#132.src: Hm... what a situation it is we find ourselves in! Diplomacy is my specialty, of course, but my expertise has not prepared me for... this.
Queen's Recruit#132.dst: Hm... quelle situation que la nôtre! La diplomatie est ma spécialité, bien sûr, mais mon expérience ne m'a pas préparé à... ceci.
Queen's Recruit#132.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#133.src: Fruma knows what they want, and know they are strong enough that they can afford not to let up their position.
Queen's Recruit#133.dst: Fruma sait ce qu'elle veut, et se sait assez forte pour se permettre de ne rien céder.
Queen's Recruit#133.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#134.src: Another top secret mission already? And I'm not even allowed to bring my explosives?
Queen's Recruit#134.dst: Encore une mission top secrète? Et j'ai même pas le droit d'apporter mes explosifs?
Queen's Recruit#134.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#135.src: It's interesting, at least! Way better than that last assignment...
Queen's Recruit#135.dst: C'est intéressant, au moins! Bien mieux que la dernière mission...
Queen's Recruit#135.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#136.src: This mission's a big deal, huh? Lots o' strong folks recalled for it, at least.
Queen's Recruit#136.dst: Cette mission, c'est du sérieux, hein? Plein de gens costauds rappelés pour l'occasion.
Queen's Recruit#136.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#137.src: Makes me a bit nervous, honestly!
Queen's Recruit#137.dst: Ça me rend un peu nerveuse, franchement!
Queen's Recruit#137.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#138.src: Fruma... I can't say it's been on my mind much. It's a mystery, yes, but not one with any available answers.
Queen's Recruit#138.dst: Fruma... je ne peux pas dire que j'y pensais beaucoup. C'est un mystère, oui, mais sans réponses à portée de main.
Queen's Recruit#138.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#139.src: Well, until now, I suppose. I'll have to prepare a list of details to look out for...
Queen's Recruit#139.dst: Enfin, jusqu'à maintenant, je suppose. Je vais devoir préparer une liste de détails à surveiller...
Queen's Recruit#139.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#140.src: And yet again, I must send you all into danger... a different sort, this time around, but danger nonetheless.
Queen's Recruit#140.dst: Et une fois de plus, je dois tous vous envoyer au danger... d'un autre genre cette fois, mais un danger tout de même.
Queen's Recruit#140.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#141.src: I remember each face which passes through my castle. I rarely see any of them again.
Queen's Recruit#141.dst: Je me souviens de chaque visage qui passe par mon château. Je revois rarement l'un d'eux.
Queen's Recruit#141.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#142.src: But this time... I have faith we will meet once more. Go on, young hero. Your mission lies ahead of you.
Queen's Recruit#142.dst: Mais cette fois... j'ai bon espoir que nous nous reverrons. Va, jeune héros. Ta mission t'attend.
Queen's Recruit#142.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#143.src: ...back to Fruma. I've only just come back to Wynn, and now...
Queen's Recruit#143.dst: ...retour à Fruma. Je viens à peine de revenir à Wynn, et maintenant...
Queen's Recruit#143.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#144.src: But it had to happen eventually. And I do want answers. So... in we go.
Queen's Recruit#144.dst: Mais ça devait arriver tôt ou tard. Et je veux des réponses. Alors... allons-y.
Queen's Recruit#144.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#145.src: I'll be heading to the {p} Seaskipper, if you want to tag along.
Queen's Recruit#145.dst: Je vais au Seaskipper de {p}, si tu veux m'accompagner.
Queen's Recruit#145.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#146.src: Travel to the Gate of Fruma at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] or meet up with Tasim in {p}.
Queen's Recruit#146.dst: Rendez-vous à la Porte de Fruma en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] ou retrouvez Tasim à {p}.

Queen's Recruit#147.src: ...Oh! You're here! Lost in thought, sorry.
Queen's Recruit#147.dst: ...Oh! Tu es là! Pardon, j'étais perdu dans mes pensées.
Queen's Recruit#147.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#148.src: It's all a little surreal, isn't it? I only just got back to Wynn, and now... Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#148.dst: C'est un peu irréel, non? Je viens à peine de revenir à Wynn, et maintenant... Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#148.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#149.src: Kind of makes me wish we had Aledar here too. The three of us on an adventure again! Going back... home...
Queen's Recruit#149.dst: Ça me donne presque envie qu'Aledar soit là aussi. Nous trois à l'aventure, comme avant! De retour... à la maison...
Queen's Recruit#149.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#150.src: I guess we'll just have to tell him all about it when we get back. He'll be sad he missed it, I bet.
Queen's Recruit#150.dst: Je suppose qu'on lui racontera tout à notre retour. Il sera triste de l'avoir manqué, je parie.
Queen's Recruit#150.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#152.src: Oi, there! Are those my two favorite customers I see?
Queen's Recruit#152.dst: Ohé, vous deux! Ce seraient pas mes deux clients préférés?
Queen's Recruit#152.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#153.src: You call everyone your favorite customer, captain! Don't think I didn't notice!
Queen's Recruit#153.dst: Vous dites ça à tout le monde, capitaine! Ne croyez pas que je ne l'ai pas remarqué!
Queen's Recruit#153.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#154.src: Eheheheh, well, it's true, ain't it? I got lots o' favorites! Ah, anyhow, you're here for a trip, ain't'cha?
Queen's Recruit#154.dst: Héhéhéhé, ben, c'est vrai, non? J'ai plein de préférés! Ah, bref, vous êtes là pour un voyage, pas vrai?
Queen's Recruit#154.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#155.src: We are! You've... probably heard the details already? There should have been something about a new destination.
Queen's Recruit#155.dst: Oui! Vous... connaissez sans doute déjà les détails? On a dû vous parler d'une nouvelle destination.
Queen's Recruit#155.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#156.src: Aye. That I have. Some scrawny {p} courier wooshed past earlier! I barely got a word in before he was off again! Real interesting fellow.
Queen's Recruit#156.dst: Ouais. Pour sûr. Un messager maigrichon de {p} est passé en coup de vent! J'ai à peine pu placer un mot qu'il était reparti! Drôle de bonhomme.
Queen's Recruit#156.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#157.src: ... Not a part o' the sea I like to visit, but I reckon I can make an exception this time.
Queen's Recruit#157.dst: ... C'est pas un coin de la mer que j'aime visiter, mais j'veux bien faire une exception cette fois.
Queen's Recruit#157.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#158.src: Hm... I can pay you extra for the trip, if you'd like.
Queen's Recruit#158.dst: Hm... Je peux vous payer un supplément, si vous voulez.
Queen's Recruit#158.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#159.src: Ha! No, no, there's no need for that. It's free of charge for my two favorite customers, eheh!
Queen's Recruit#159.dst: Ha! Non, non, pas besoin. C'est gratuit pour mes deux clients préférés, héhé!
Queen's Recruit#159.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#160.src: ...and, 'course, s'all paid for from {p}'s royal coffers anyhow. Now, hop aboard 'fore I change my mind and leave without ya!
Queen's Recruit#160.dst: ...et puis, bien sûr, c'est payé par le trésor royal de {p}. Allez, montez à bord avant que je change d'avis et parte sans vous!
Queen's Recruit#160.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#162.src: ...so, Fruma, eh? I'd ask what business ya've got there, but... figure it's top secret.
Queen's Recruit#162.dst: ...alors, Fruma, hein? J'vous demanderais bien ce que vous y faites, mais... c'est top secret, j'imagine.
Queen's Recruit#162.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#163.src: We've been... invited into the province. Supposedly, it's for some sort of celebration, but...
Queen's Recruit#163.dst: On a été... invités dans la province. Soi-disant pour une sorte de célébration, mais...
Queen's Recruit#163.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#164.src: Mmn. Aye, knowin' the rumors... not the kind o' place to just invite folks in, is it?
Queen's Recruit#164.dst: Mmn. Ouais, vu les rumeurs... c'est pas le genre d'endroit à inviter les gens comme ça, hein?
Queen's Recruit#164.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#166.src: Tell me, what's on yer mind then? The both o' you. Speakin' thoughts out tends to make 'em easier to manage, in my experience.
Queen's Recruit#166.dst: Dites-moi, qu'est-ce qui vous tracasse, alors? Tous les deux. D'expérience, dire les choses à voix haute aide à les gérer.
Queen's Recruit#166.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#167.src: Fruma went through all that trouble to erase our memories, to get rid of us... just to ask for us back out of nowhere.
Queen's Recruit#167.dst: Fruma s'est donné tant de mal pour effacer nos souvenirs, se débarrasser de nous... et voilà qu'on nous réclame d'un coup.
Queen's Recruit#167.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#168.src: I don't know why they're doing it, but I'm worried there's more going on.
Queen's Recruit#168.dst: Je ne sais pas pourquoi ils font ça, mais j'ai peur qu'il se trame autre chose.
Queen's Recruit#168.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#169.src: I've not got more of a clue than either o' you, but I reckon that suspicion is warranted.
Queen's Recruit#169.dst: J'en sais pas plus que vous deux, mais j'pense que cette méfiance est justifiée.
Queen's Recruit#169.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#170.src: But don't let it consume you, aye? Some suspicion is healthy, but if it colors everything ya do, it'll hurt ya just as bad as naivety would. Keep an open mind.
Queen's Recruit#170.dst: Mais te laisse pas ronger par elle, hein? Un peu de méfiance, c'est sain, mais si elle teinte tout ce que tu fais, elle te fera autant de mal que la naïveté. Garde l'esprit ouvert.
Queen's Recruit#170.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#171.src: ...it's possible. I hope you're right, and it is all fine, and we are all overthinking it...
Queen's Recruit#171.dst: ...c'est possible. J'espère que vous avez raison, que tout va bien et qu'on se fait trop de souci...
Queen's Recruit#171.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#172.src: But I can't let my guard down. Everything about this situation is screaming that something isn't right, and... I don't know what.
Queen's Recruit#172.dst: Mais je ne peux pas baisser ma garde. Tout dans cette situation hurle que quelque chose cloche, et... je ne sais pas quoi.
Queen's Recruit#172.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#173.src: Nothin' wrong with hopin' for the best. Stayin' positive is all ya can really do, sometimes.
Queen's Recruit#173.dst: Y a pas de mal à espérer le meilleur. Rester positif, c'est parfois tout ce qu'on peut faire.
Queen's Recruit#173.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#174.src: Out here on the sea, we have a saying... go searchin' for the storm, and it'll find ya itself. Don't expect the worst, or it'll find a way to come to pass.
Queen's Recruit#174.dst: Ici, en mer, on a un dicton... pars chercher la tempête, et c'est elle qui te trouvera. Ne t'attends pas au pire, ou il trouvera le moyen d'arriver.
Queen's Recruit#174.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#175.dst: J'ai hâte de rentrer chez moi.

Queen's Recruit#176.src: ...home? Home. I guess. It'll be nice to have more memories of it than just... you know. Curses, and all that.
Queen's Recruit#176.dst: ...chez nous? Chez nous. Je suppose. Ce sera bien d'en avoir d'autres souvenirs que juste... tu sais. Les malédictions, et tout ça.
Queen's Recruit#176.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#177.src: Linton and Kymer are in W{~}.
Queen's Recruit#177.dst: Linton et Kymer sont en W{~}.
Queen's Recruit#177.speaker: Representative

similar.text: Linton and Kymer are in W2.

Queen's Recruit#178.src: Hm. I don’t got much of a home to get back to, either. Had it taken from me by those I trusted, eheh!
Queen's Recruit#178.dst: Hm. Moi non plus, j'ai pas vraiment de foyer où retourner. Ceux en qui j'avais confiance me l'ont pris, héhé!
Queen's Recruit#178.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#179.src: ... But, I made my own home, out here on the sea. Think even if I could go back now, I wouldn’t!
Queen's Recruit#179.dst: ... Mais je me suis fait mon foyer, ici en mer. Même si je pouvais y retourner, j'le ferais pas!
Queen's Recruit#179.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#180.src: So, if y’don’t like what ya find... don’t feel forced to take it, y’hear?
Queen's Recruit#180.dst: Alors, si ce que tu trouves te plaît pas... te sens pas obligé de l'accepter, t'entends?
Queen's Recruit#180.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#181.src: ...I'll keep that in mind. Thank you, captain.
Queen's Recruit#181.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#182.src: Ah, it's what I'm here for, ain't it? Givin' sage advice and sailin' folks around the sea!
Queen's Recruit#182.dst: Ah, c'est pour ça que j'suis là, non? Donner de sages conseils et promener les gens sur la mer!
Queen's Recruit#182.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#183.src: And look at that, on the horizon! Shinin' opulent docks... seems we've arrived.
Queen's Recruit#183.dst: Et regardez, à l'horizon! Des quais opulents et rutilants... on dirait qu'on est arrivés.
Queen's Recruit#183.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#184.src: Dunno what you'll be facin' in there... but good luck anyway, aye?
Queen's Recruit#184.dst: J'sais pas ce qui vous attend là-dedans... mais bonne chance quand même, hein?
Queen's Recruit#184.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#185.src: We'll need it. Thanks for bringing us here, captain.
Queen's Recruit#185.dst: On en aura besoin. Merci de nous avoir amenés, capitaine.
Queen's Recruit#185.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#186.src: It's... impressive. To build something like this for a gate no one ever uses...
Queen's Recruit#186.dst: C'est... impressionnant. Construire un truc pareil pour une porte que personne n'utilise...
Queen's Recruit#186.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#187.src: I guess they have the resources to spare.
Queen's Recruit#187.dst: Je suppose qu'ils ont des ressources à revendre.
Queen's Recruit#187.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#188.src: Meet up with the group at the gate at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Queen's Recruit#188.dst: Rejoignez le groupe à la porte, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Queen's Recruit#189.src: Finally! The stragglers arrive. You certainly took your time, didn't you?
Queen's Recruit#189.dst: Enfin! Voilà les retardataires. Vous avez pris votre temps, hein?
Queen's Recruit#189.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#190.src: Not the time, Kymer. Leave the poor man be for an hour, eh? Got bigger fish to fry, n' all that.
Queen's Recruit#190.dst: C'est pas le moment, Kymer. Laisse le pauvre homme tranquille une heure, hein? On a d'autres chats à fouetter.
Queen's Recruit#190.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#191.src: Yes, yes, fine. We've not been able to get a word out of any of these soldiers! Do we even have the right time and place?
Queen's Recruit#191.dst: Oui, oui, d'accord. Nous n'avons pas pu tirer un mot de ces soldats! Sommes-nous seulement au bon endroit, à la bonne heure?
Queen's Recruit#191.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#192.src: Nah, you just haven't been trying hard enough. Hey, tin can! This is Fruma, right?
Queen's Recruit#192.dst: Mais non, t'as juste pas assez essayé. Hé, boîte de conserve! C'est bien Fruma, ici?
Queen's Recruit#192.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#195.src: It really is an impressive construction, isn't it? All this for a closed-off province.
Queen's Recruit#195.dst: C'est vraiment une construction impressionnante, non? Tout ça pour une province fermée.
Queen's Recruit#195.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#196.src: Impressive or not, we have work to do! On your guard, everyone. We don't know what to expect, so watch your backs.
Queen's Recruit#196.dst: Impressionnant ou non, on a du travail! Tous sur vos gardes. On ne sait pas à quoi s'attendre, surveillez vos arrières.
Queen's Recruit#196.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#197.src: S'anyone's guess when they'll actually let us in...
Queen's Recruit#197.dst: Allez savoir quand ils nous laisseront vraiment entrer...
Queen's Recruit#197.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#200.src: Soldiers of Wynn! Her Majesty welcomes you to the province, as guests of the crown!
Queen's Recruit#200.dst: Soldats de Wynn! Sa Majesté vous accueille dans la province en invités de la couronne!
Queen's Recruit#200.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#201.src: Follow me, and you will be escorted to the royal palace. Let's not keep her waiting- you all are of great importance to her.
Queen's Recruit#201.dst: Suivez-moi, on va vous escorter jusqu'au palais royal. Ne la faisons pas attendre- vous êtes tous d'une grande importance pour elle.
Queen's Recruit#201.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#202.src: Listen to the introduction. Go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to return to the palace.
Queen's Recruit#202.dst: Écoutez la présentation. Allez en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] pour retourner au palais.

Queen's Recruit#203.src: Fruma's... a lot bigger than what I saw in my memories...
Queen's Recruit#203.dst: Fruma est... bien plus grande que dans mes souvenirs...
Queen's Recruit#203.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#204.src: I guess that makes sense. I probably didn't travel much, back then. But... still.
Queen's Recruit#204.dst: Ça se tient. Je ne voyageais sans doute pas beaucoup, à l'époque. Mais... quand même.
Queen's Recruit#204.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#206.src: It... was. I don't know what I expected going in, but... it was stunning.
Queen's Recruit#206.dst: Ça... l'était. Je ne sais pas ce que j'attendais, mais... c'était magnifique.
Queen's Recruit#206.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#208.src: Ha! Yeah, you know, I think you're right. It was impressive, but Gavel also has impressive sights.
Queen's Recruit#208.dst: Ha! Ouais, tu sais, je crois que tu as raison. C'était impressionnant, mais Gavel a aussi de beaux paysages.
Queen's Recruit#208.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#209.src: But let's not get distracted. The tour felt very... controlled. We were never let out of the carriages, and the Sovereign was keeping a watchful eye on us.
Queen's Recruit#209.dst: Mais ne nous laissons pas distraire. La visite semblait très... contrôlée. On ne nous a jamais laissés sortir des calèches, et le Souverain nous surveillait de près.
Queen's Recruit#209.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#210.src: I'm interested in what they're choosing not to show us...
Queen's Recruit#210.dst: Ce qu'ils choisissent de ne pas nous montrer m'intéresse...
Queen's Recruit#210.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#213.src: It is my honor as Queen to facilitate your return to our wonderful province. Though long you have spent away, you will always remain children of Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#213.dst: En tant que Reine, j'ai l'honneur de vous accueillir à nouveau dans notre merveilleuse province. Malgré votre longue absence, vous resterez à jamais enfants de Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#213.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#214.src: Your work to battle against the blight beyond our walls has been of great interest. You have certainly made our province proud.
Queen's Recruit#214.dst: Votre combat contre le fléau au-delà de nos murs a suscité un grand intérêt. Vous avez assurément rendu notre province fière.
Queen's Recruit#214.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#215.src: You must have questions on the nature of your summons. All will be revealed- but first, allow me to introduce two of my wonderful Sovereigns.
Queen's Recruit#215.dst: Vous devez vous interroger sur la raison de votre convocation. Tout vous sera révélé- mais d'abord, permettez-moi de vous présenter deux de mes merveilleux Souverains.
Queen's Recruit#215.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#216.src: You heard my name, but let me introduce myself. I am-
Queen's Recruit#216.dst: Vous avez entendu mon nom, mais laissez-moi me présenter. Je suis-
Queen's Recruit#216.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#217.src: Majin of House Thalas, the Morning Star, Sovereign of our fair {p}. It's a pleasure, dear soldiers, to join our Queen for this ceremony!
Queen's Recruit#217.dst: Majin de la Maison Thalas, l'Étoile du matin, Souverain de {p}. Un plaisir, chers soldats, d'accompagner notre Reine pour cette cérémonie!
Queen's Recruit#217.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#218.src: ...Zhiraok Nasin, Sovereign of the {p}. The value of that title should speak for itself.
Queen's Recruit#218.dst: ...Zhiraok Nasin, Souverain de {p}. La valeur de ce titre parle d'elle-même.
Queen's Recruit#218.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#219.src: Thank you, Sovereigns. These two, and the rest, are my council for ruling over our province. Each Sovereign is given governance over their own district, and works to serve the people there.
Queen's Recruit#219.dst: Merci, Souverains. Ces deux-là, et les autres, forment mon conseil pour gouverner notre province. Chaque Souverain reçoit la charge de son propre district, et oeuvre au service de son peuple.
Queen's Recruit#219.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#220.src: There are others. Though, none could attend this event - they find themselves occupied with various assignments.
Queen's Recruit#220.dst: Il y en a d'autres. Mais aucun n'a pu assister à cet événement - ils sont occupés par diverses missions.
Queen's Recruit#220.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#221.src: Ah, there we are. Tasim and {u}, you'll be in room W{~}... in the western wing.
Queen's Recruit#221.dst: Ah, voilà. Tasim et {u}, vous serez dans la chambre W{~}... dans l'aile ouest.
Queen's Recruit#221.speaker: Representative

Queen's Recruit#222.src: 'Cause I'm fast and stealthy. Gotta run now, I don't want to draw the guards' attention. Remember, room W{~}!
Queen's Recruit#222.dst: Parce que je suis rapide et discret. Faut que je file, je veux pas attirer l'attention des gardes. N'oubliez pas, chambre W{~}!
Queen's Recruit#222.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#224.src: There are others. Though none could attend this event - they find themselves occupied with various assignments.
Queen's Recruit#224.dst: Il y en a d'autres. Aucun n'a toutefois pu assister à cet événement - ils sont occupés par diverses missions.
Queen's Recruit#224.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#225.src: Enough of the boring talk! It is time for the welcoming feast!
Queen's Recruit#225.dst: Assez de discours ennuyeux! Place au festin de bienvenue!
Queen's Recruit#225.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#226.src: We would like to share a taste of what our province has to deliver. Please find your way to the grand dining hall, situated just behind me.
Queen's Recruit#226.dst: Nous aimerions vous faire goûter ce que notre province a de meilleur. Veuillez vous rendre dans la grande salle à manger, juste derrière moi.
Queen's Recruit#226.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#227.src: Head to the royal dining hall at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#227.dst: Rendez-vous à la salle à manger royale en [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#228.src: Make your way to the dining hall, the Queen will be starting her speech soon.
Queen's Recruit#228.dst: Rendez-vous à la salle à manger, la Reine va bientôt commencer son discours.
Queen's Recruit#228.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#229.src: ...you can't even follow the order of operations while Her Majesty is watching?! What kind of expected value must the recruits ha-
Queen's Recruit#229.dst: ...tu n'es même pas capable de respecter l'ordre des opérations sous les yeux de Sa Majesté?! Quelle espérance mathématique doivent avoir les recr-
Queen's Recruit#229.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#230.src: Now, now, Nasin, settle down. We wouldn't want to leave a poor impression on our guest, would we?
Queen's Recruit#230.dst: Allons, allons, Nasin, calme-toi. Ne laissons pas une mauvaise impression à notre invité, veux-tu?
Queen's Recruit#230.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#232.src: Oh, you. You should report to the dining hall with the remainder of your group.
Queen's Recruit#232.dst: Ah, toi. Tu devrais rejoindre la salle à manger avec le reste de ton groupe.
Queen's Recruit#232.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#233.src: Yes, yes, move along. You certainly don't want to keep Her Majesty waiting!
Queen's Recruit#233.dst: Oui, oui, avance. Tu ne voudrais surtout pas faire attendre Sa Majesté!
Queen's Recruit#233.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#234.src: Well, I have put it off long enough. Before the first course is served, I will reveal the purpose of your presence here today.
Queen's Recruit#234.dst: Bien, j'ai assez attendu. Avant que le premier plat soit servi, je vais vous révéler la raison de votre présence ici aujourd'hui.
Queen's Recruit#234.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#235.src: In celebration of your work in the Wynn Province, we shall be hosting a tournament! You will all partake in a set of duels in order to crown the greatest soldier among you.
Queen's Recruit#235.dst: Pour célébrer votre travail dans la province de Wynn, nous organiserons un tournoi! Vous participerez tous à une série de duels afin de couronner le meilleur soldat d'entre vous.
Queen's Recruit#235.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#236.src: You have all grown in your time spent beyond our walls, and what better way to show it?
Queen's Recruit#236.dst: Vous avez tous grandi durant votre séjour au-delà de nos murs, et quelle meilleure façon de le montrer?
Queen's Recruit#236.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#237.src: We will, of course, provide compensation for all participants. A generous monetary reward shall be granted to each of you, no matter your placing in the tournament.
Queen's Recruit#237.dst: Nous dédommagerons bien sûr tous les participants. Chacun de vous recevra une généreuse récompense en argent, quel que soit son classement dans le tournoi.
Queen's Recruit#237.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#238.src: However, for whichever of you finds themselves crowned winner... a greater reward awaits. The specifics shall be revealed once the tournament has concluded.
Queen's Recruit#238.dst: Cependant, pour qui remportera la couronne de vainqueur... une récompense plus grande encore l'attend. Les détails seront révélés à la fin du tournoi.
Queen's Recruit#238.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#239.src: Ah, your majesty- if I may... I am not much of a fighter - my specialty is in research and study of magic.
Queen's Recruit#239.dst: Ah, Votre Majesté- si je puis... je ne suis guère un combattant - ma spécialité, c'est l'étude de la magie.
Queen's Recruit#239.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#240.src: ...very well. Accommodations shall be made. A different request may be made of you later, in exchange.
Queen's Recruit#240.dst: ...très bien. Nous ferons le nécessaire. On pourrait te demander autre chose plus tard, en échange.
Queen's Recruit#240.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#241.src: I thank you for your grace and understanding, your majesty.
Queen's Recruit#241.dst: Je vous remercie de votre grâce et de votre compréhension, Votre Majesté.
Queen's Recruit#241.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#242.src: Yes... now. Once the meal comes to a close, you shall all be assigned a room to stay in for the remainder of your stay in my palace.
Queen's Recruit#242.dst: Oui... bien. Une fois le repas terminé, on vous attribuera à chacun une chambre pour le reste de votre séjour dans mon palais.
Queen's Recruit#242.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#243.src: Ah! It seems the first course has been prepared! Please, enjoy our province's finest cuisine.
Queen's Recruit#243.dst: Ah! Il semble que le premier plat soit prêt! Je vous en prie, savourez la meilleure cuisine de notre province.
Queen's Recruit#243.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#244.src: ...I can't say I was expecting that, of all things.
Queen's Recruit#244.dst: ...je ne m'attendais vraiment pas à ça, entre toutes choses.
Queen's Recruit#244.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#245.src: You'll be joining the tournament, right?
Queen's Recruit#245.dst: Tu vas participer au tournoi, hein?
Queen's Recruit#245.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#246.src: We'd better get going and find our rooms- everyone else headed south.
Queen's Recruit#246.dst: Allons trouver nos chambres- tous les autres sont partis vers le sud.
Queen's Recruit#246.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#247.src: Get your assigned room from the representative at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#247.dst: Demandez votre chambre au représentant en [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#249.src: Your rooms are located on the east and west side of here.
Queen's Recruit#249.dst: Vos chambres se trouvent à l'est et à l'ouest d'ici.
Queen's Recruit#249.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#250.src: Your rooms are on the other side of the castle. Please make your way over there.
Queen's Recruit#250.dst: Vos chambres sont de l'autre côté du château. Veuillez vous y rendre.
Queen's Recruit#250.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#255.src: Talk about a fancy feast, huh?
Queen's Recruit#255.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#256.src: They're really pullin' out all the stops, huh? Don't think I've had anythin' that good in a long while.
Queen's Recruit#256.dst: Ils sortent vraiment le grand jeu, hein? J'crois pas avoir mangé un truc aussi bon depuis longtemps.
Queen's Recruit#256.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#257.src: Yeah, that was probably the best meal I've had in a long time... Really tired me out. Can't wait for a long and good rest.
Queen's Recruit#257.dst: Ouais, c'était sûrement le meilleur repas que j'ai eu depuis longtemps... Ça m'a crevé. Vivement un bon et long repos.
Queen's Recruit#257.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#258.src: How 'bout us? I'm Mel, and this is Linton.
Queen's Recruit#258.dst: Et nous? Moi, c'est Mel, et lui, c'est Linton.
Queen's Recruit#258.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#260.src: Uh- hey, I think you forgot someone! Where am I staying?
Queen's Recruit#260.dst: Euh- hé, je crois que vous avez oublié quelqu'un! Je dors où, moi?
Queen's Recruit#260.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#263.src: Oh... uh, Kymer, huh? That's... hm. Okay.
Queen's Recruit#263.dst: Oh... euh, Kymer, hein? C'est... hm. D'accord.
Queen's Recruit#263.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#265.src: Head to your room, W-{~}, and check it out.
Queen's Recruit#265.dst: Allez dans votre chambre, W-{~}, et jetez-y un oeil.

Queen's Recruit#266.src: I'm just gonna wait here for Lanu.
Queen's Recruit#266.dst: Je vais juste attendre Lanu ici.
Queen's Recruit#266.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#267.src: Hm... {u}? Think you've got the wrong room!
Queen's Recruit#267.dst: Hm... {u}? Je crois que c'est pas ta chambre!
Queen's Recruit#267.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#268.src: Odd that I've got a room all to myself... but eh, I won't complain.
Queen's Recruit#268.dst: Bizarre d'avoir une chambre rien que pour moi... mais bon, je vais pas me plaindre.
Queen's Recruit#268.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#269.src: Kymer. Sure! Cool, cool cool cool... I can stay with the... big biceps... yep. That's... fine. That's fine. Good, even.
Queen's Recruit#269.dst: Kymer. Bien sûr! Cool, cool cool cool... Je peux dormir avec les... gros biceps... ouais. C'est... bien. C'est bien. Génial, même.
Queen's Recruit#269.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#271.src: It seems cozy enough, I guess... hard to relax, though, given... you know. all of it.
Queen's Recruit#271.dst: Assez confortable, je suppose... mais dur de se détendre, vu... tu sais. tout ça.
Queen's Recruit#271.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#272.src: ...it's easier than I thought it would be, being in Fruma. There's enough distance from... the, uh, memories.
Queen's Recruit#272.dst: ...c'est plus facile que je ne le pensais, d'être à Fruma. Il y a assez de distance avec... les, euh, souvenirs.
Queen's Recruit#272.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#273.src: But, okay, we're in private now. So... what do you actually think of the tournament? It's weird, right? Why would we be invited just for this?
Queen's Recruit#273.dst: Mais bon, on est seuls maintenant. Alors... qu'est-ce que tu penses vraiment du tournoi? C'est bizarre, non? Pourquoi nous inviter juste pour ça?
Queen's Recruit#273.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#274.src: Me neither. I don't know what I was expecting when we were entering Fruma, but it wasn't... this.
Queen's Recruit#274.dst: Moi non plus. Je ne sais pas à quoi je m'attendais en entrant dans Fruma, mais pas à... ça.
Queen's Recruit#274.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#275.src: I think we'll have to participate, but keep an eye out. Maybe the secret reward will have some answers..
Queen's Recruit#275.dst: Je crois qu'on devra participer, mais en restant vigilants. Peut-être que la récompense secrète apportera des réponses..
Queen's Recruit#275.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#276.src: Hm... you're probably right, I just don't know what it could possibly be.
Queen's Recruit#276.dst: Hm... tu as sûrement raison, je ne vois juste pas ce que ça pourrait être.
Queen's Recruit#276.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#277.src: Maybe there's something going on with that secret reward for the winner... we'll have to wait and see, I guess.
Queen's Recruit#277.dst: Il y a peut-être quelque chose derrière cette récompense secrète pour le vainqueur... on verra bien, je suppose.
Queen's Recruit#277.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#278.src: Ha! Yeah, alright. I'm a little excited, too. I haven't had any friendly duels for a long time, so maybe it'll be nice to test my strength.
Queen's Recruit#278.dst: Ha! Ouais, d'accord. Moi aussi, j'ai un peu hâte. Ça fait longtemps que je n'ai pas fait de duel amical, alors ce sera peut-être sympa de tester ma force.
Queen's Recruit#278.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#279.src: But don’t forget why we’re here. Keep your guard up. Something about that reward she mentioned... it makes me uneasy.
Queen's Recruit#279.dst: Mais n'oublie pas pourquoi on est là. Reste sur tes gardes. Cette récompense qu'elle a mentionnée... quelque chose me met mal à l'aise.
Queen's Recruit#279.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#280.src: It strikes me as the kind of thing Aledar would enjoy. What better way to prove himself than to win this big tournament?
Queen's Recruit#280.dst: C'est le genre de truc qui plairait à Aledar. Quelle meilleure façon de faire ses preuves que de gagner ce grand tournoi?
Queen's Recruit#280.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#281.src: He'd get to use all his potions and tricks, too! He's always telling me about the horrific creations he's mixed together.
Queen's Recruit#281.dst: Il pourrait utiliser toutes ses potions et ses astuces, en plus! Il me parle toujours des horribles mélanges qu'il a concoctés.
Queen's Recruit#281.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#283.src: But, okay, we're in private now. So.. what do you actually think of the tournament? It's weird, right? Why would we be invited for this?
Queen's Recruit#283.dst: Mais bon, on est seuls maintenant. Alors.. qu'est-ce que tu penses vraiment du tournoi? C'est bizarre, non? Pourquoi nous inviter pour ça?
Queen's Recruit#283.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#284.src: Ha! Yeah, alright. I’m a little excited, too. I haven’t had any friendly duels for a long time, so maybe it’ll be nice to test my strength.
Queen's Recruit#284.dst: Ha! Ouais, d'accord. Moi aussi, j'ai un peu hâte. Ça fait longtemps que je n'ai pas fait de duel amical, alors ce sera sans doute sympa de tester ma force.
Queen's Recruit#284.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#288.src: Oh, uh, nothing much. Just a secret meeting. In Jenprest's room- that's W{~}, at the start of the corridor.
Queen's Recruit#288.dst: Oh, euh, pas grand-chose. Juste une réunion secrète. Dans la chambre de Jenprest- c'est la W{~}, au début du couloir.
Queen's Recruit#288.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#289.src: Picard says we should talk about what we've got so far. He also said to space out people coming to the room so wait a few minutes before stopping by!
Queen's Recruit#289.dst: Picard dit qu'on devrait faire le point sur ce qu'on sait. Il a aussi dit d'arriver dans la chambre en décalé, alors attendez quelques minutes avant de passer!
Queen's Recruit#289.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#290.src: Picard says we should talk about what we've got so far. He also said to space out people coming to the room- so wait a few minutes before stopping by!
Queen's Recruit#290.dst: Picard dit qu'on devrait faire le point sur ce qu'on sait. Il a aussi dit d'arriver dans la chambre en décalé- alors attendez quelques minutes avant de passer!
Queen's Recruit#290.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#291.src: I... guess that makes sense. But why are you here, and not-
Queen's Recruit#291.dst: Je... suppose que ça se tient. Mais pourquoi c'est toi qui viens, et pas-
Queen's Recruit#291.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#292.src: ...he's energetic, huh. Okay, let's head over to the meeting. I wonder what the others have noticed.
