Queen's Recruit#292.dst: ...il a de l'énergie, hein. Bon, allons à la réunion. Je me demande ce que les autres ont remarqué.
Queen's Recruit#292.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#293.src: Meet up with the others in room W-{~} at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#293.dst: Retrouvez les autres dans la chambre W-{~}, en [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#294.src: Ah, good, they're here. Come in, come in. Quickly now.
Queen's Recruit#294.dst: Ah, bien, les voilà. Entrez, entrez. Vite.
Queen's Recruit#294.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#295.src: Are we the last ones in?
Queen's Recruit#295.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#296.src: That y'are. Now, Picard, mind tellin' me what was on your damned mind when you commandeered my room without sayin' a word ?!
Queen's Recruit#296.dst: Eh oui. Bon, Picard, ça t'dérangerait de m'dire ce qui t'est passé par la tête quand t'as réquisitionné ma chambre sans dire un mot?!
Queen's Recruit#296.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#297.src: Ah, eheh, well- I suppose it, er, may have slipped the mind... not important! We're under a time constraint!
Queen's Recruit#297.dst: Ah, héhé, eh bien- je suppose que ça m'est, euh, peut-être sorti de la tête... peu importe! Le temps presse!
Queen's Recruit#297.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#298.src: We've made it this far, but we'll need to plan our next steps. Firstly, however- let us start with what information we have gleaned thus far.
Queen's Recruit#298.dst: Nous sommes arrivés jusqu'ici, mais il va falloir planifier la suite. Mais d'abord- commençons par les informations recueillies jusqu'à présent.
Queen's Recruit#298.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#299.src: Well, the crown certainly has money to spare! What we've seen thus far seems to rival even the richest of the nobility I had the pleasure of working with in {p}.
Queen's Recruit#299.dst: Eh bien, la couronne ne manque certainement pas d'argent! Ce que nous avons vu rivalise même avec la plus riche noblesse avec laquelle j'ai eu le plaisir de travailler à {p}.
Queen's Recruit#299.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#300.src: And the architectural style... it's unique. I haven't seen anything like it before. I suppose it would make sense, if the province has been closed off so long...
Queen's Recruit#300.dst: Et le style architectural... il est unique. Je n'ai jamais rien vu de tel. Ça se comprendrait, si la province est fermée depuis si longtemps...
Queen's Recruit#300.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#301.src: Eh, enough of the unimportant details - any of the rest o' you feelin' strange about the tournament? Seems an odd thing to invite us folks back for.
Queen's Recruit#301.dst: Bah, assez de détails sans importance - y en a d'autres parmi vous que ce tournoi met mal à l'aise? Drôle de raison pour nous faire revenir.
Queen's Recruit#301.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#302.src: I was thinking the same thing. And they're willing to pay all of us for participating, no matter how we do... I don't get why.
Queen's Recruit#302.dst: Je me disais la même chose. Et ils sont prêts à tous nous payer pour participer, quel que soit le résultat... je ne comprends pas pourquoi.
Queen's Recruit#302.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#303.src: Hm, well, in truth I am not overly concerned about it-
Queen's Recruit#303.dst: Hm, eh bien, à vrai dire, ça ne m'inquiète pas outre mesure-
Queen's Recruit#303.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#304.src: Yes, actually, Picard, what was that back there in the dining hall? You're going to draw attention to yourself by opting out of it?
Queen's Recruit#304.dst: Oui, au fait, Picard, c'était quoi, ça, dans la salle à manger? Vous allez attirer l'attention en vous retirant?
Queen's Recruit#304.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#305.src: Oh, what use is there in placing me in such a combat scenario?! I'll be far more useful outside of that structure, free to look around the palace.
Queen's Recruit#305.dst: Oh, à quoi bon me placer dans un tel scénario de combat?! Je serai bien plus utile en dehors de ce cadre, libre d'explorer le palais.
Queen's Recruit#305.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#306.src: And besides, they have me giving them a summary of my research notes, so it's not as though I'm free of it entirely, not to mention-
Queen's Recruit#306.dst: Et puis, ils me demandent un résumé de mes notes de recherche, donc je n'y échappe pas totalement, sans parler de-
Queen's Recruit#306.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#307.src: Alright, settle down y'all! Limited time, remember? We've gone off track. They're rich, fancy, and want us fightin' for some reason. What else?
Queen's Recruit#307.dst: Bon, calmez-vous tous! Temps limité, vous vous rappelez? On s'égare. Ils sont riches, chics, et veulent nous voir nous battre pour une raison ou une autre. Quoi d'autre?
Queen's Recruit#307.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#308.src: ...as I was saying before I was rudely interrupted- I don't believe there is much to be gleaned from the tournament just yet. It's a puzzle piece we'll have to connect later.
Queen's Recruit#308.dst: ...comme je le disais avant d'être grossièrement interrompu- je ne crois pas qu'on puisse tirer grand-chose du tournoi pour l'instant. C'est une pièce du puzzle qu'il faudra relier plus tard.
Queen's Recruit#308.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#309.src: Do we have anything on the Queen and her Sovereigns? It's an interesting governmental structure, but I suppose having a more direct line to the Queen has value for the districts.
Queen's Recruit#309.dst: Avons-nous quelque chose sur la Reine et ses Souverains? C'est une structure de gouvernement intéressante, mais je suppose qu'un lien plus direct avec la Reine a de la valeur pour les districts.
Queen's Recruit#309.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#310.src: Well, they're obviously putting on an act. They're definitely hiding something from us, and I don't think any of them are as happy to see us as they say they are.
Queen's Recruit#310.dst: Bah, ils jouent clairement la comédie. Ils nous cachent forcément quelque chose, et je crois pas qu'aucun d'eux soit aussi content de nous voir qu'il le dit.
Queen's Recruit#310.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#311.src: Yes, indeed... we were sent into Wynn as exiles, not as honored soldiers. So why are they pretending otherwise? They called us back here.
Queen's Recruit#311.dst: Oui, en effet... on nous a envoyés à Wynn comme exilés, pas comme soldats honorés. Alors pourquoi prétendent-ils le contraire? Ce sont eux qui nous ont rappelés.
Queen's Recruit#311.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#312.src: Ah! Perhaps they're unaware that we've cracked that memory spell? For all they know, we still believe their lies.
Queen's Recruit#312.dst: Ah! Peut-être ignorent-ils que nous avons brisé ce sort de mémoire? Pour autant qu'ils sachent, nous croyons encore à leurs mensonges.
Queen's Recruit#312.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#313.src: It'd explain some things, for certain...
Queen's Recruit#313.dst: Ça expliquerait certaines choses, c'est sûr...
Queen's Recruit#313.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#314.src: So, am I the only one confused by the amount of guards around?
Queen's Recruit#314.dst: Alors, je suis le seul que le nombre de gardes laisse perplexe?
Queen's Recruit#314.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#315.src: You'd think that nine strangers entering the royal palace would be under more watchful eyes.
Queen's Recruit#315.dst: On s'attendrait à ce que neuf inconnus entrant dans le palais royal soient plus surveillés.
Queen's Recruit#315.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#316.src: Now that you mention it... the only guards I saw on the way to our rooms were by the courtyard exit. There aren't any outside our rooms.
Queen's Recruit#316.dst: Maintenant que tu le dis... les seuls gardes que j'ai vus en allant aux chambres étaient à la sortie de la cour. Il n'y en a aucun devant nos chambres.
Queen's Recruit#316.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#317.src: ...so we don't need to do the whole stealthy thing?
Queen's Recruit#317.dst: ...alors on avait pas besoin de tout ce cirque discret?
Queen's Recruit#317.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#319.src: Seems likely to me they want us t' feel safe and trusted. They've got to know we'll be talkin' about everything we see, so why not leave a good impression, eh?
Queen's Recruit#319.dst: M'est avis qu'ils veulent qu'on se sente en sécurité et en confiance. Ils savent bien qu'on va parler de tout ce qu'on voit, alors pourquoi pas laisser une bonne impression, hein?
Queen's Recruit#319.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#320.src: A strong spell should get through this wood without a problem.
Queen's Recruit#320.dst: Un sort puissant devrait traverser ce bois sans problème.

Queen's Recruit#321.src: Besides, they've got those two Sovereigns lookin' over us. Pretty strong, aren't they? Figure that's enough incentive not to cause trouble.
Queen's Recruit#321.dst: Et puis, ils ont ces deux Souverains qui nous surveillent. Plutôt costauds, hein? J'imagine que ça suffit pour nous dissuader de faire des histoires.
Queen's Recruit#321.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#322.src: Speakin' of the Sovereigns... and the guards, by extension - anyone else adept at readin' mana? It hardly feels like there's any of it in use at all!
Queen's Recruit#322.dst: En parlant des Souverains... et des gardes, par extension - y a quelqu'un d'autre qui sait lire le mana? On dirait qu'il n'y en a presque pas d'utilisé ici!
Queen's Recruit#322.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#323.src: I was going to bring that up. I haven't seen any mages at all. The closest I've seen is the higher ranked soldiers wielding magical weapons.
Queen's Recruit#323.dst: J'allais en parler. Je n'ai vu aucun mage. Le plus proche, ce sont les soldats haut gradés qui manient des armes magiques.
Queen's Recruit#323.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#324.src: I'm not as good with reading mana, but... there's something with the Sovereigns. They've got an incredibly powerful aura surrounding them. It feels... unnatural.
Queen's Recruit#324.dst: Je ne suis pas aussi doué pour lire le mana, mais... les Souverains ont quelque chose. Une aura incroyablement puissante les entoure. Ça semble... contre nature.
Queen's Recruit#324.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#325.src: Yes, you're right. They, and the Queen, are the only ones I've seen here who possess innate magical abilities. If anything, all three of them seem closely linked in terms of energy...
Queen's Recruit#325.dst: Oui, tu as raison. Eux et la Reine sont les seuls que j'ai vus ici à posséder des capacités magiques innées. Et même, les trois semblent étroitement liés sur le plan énergétique...
Queen's Recruit#325.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#326.src: As interesting as that is, it doesn't leave much for the rest of us to go off of. Doctor, you're the one who organized us here. What are our plans?
Queen's Recruit#326.dst: Aussi intéressant que ce soit, ça ne nous laisse pas grand-chose à exploiter, à nous autres. Docteur, c'est vous qui nous avez réunis ici. Quel est le plan?
Queen's Recruit#326.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#327.src: Yes, that I am... well, it seems our most promising lead is the Sovereigns. We'll want to focus on them- though, do not neglect general information. We still want to know as much about Fruma as possible.
Queen's Recruit#327.dst: Oui, c'est bien moi... eh bien, notre piste la plus prometteuse semble être les Souverains. Concentrons-nous sur eux- sans négliger les informations générales, cependant. Nous voulons toujours en savoir le plus possible sur Fruma.
Queen's Recruit#327.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#328.src: We've been running long enough, let's call it a day. Everyone, get some rest, we must be at our best performance tomorrow.
Queen's Recruit#328.dst: Ça fait assez longtemps, arrêtons-nous là pour aujourd'hui. Reposez-vous tous, nous devons être au meilleur de notre forme demain.
Queen's Recruit#328.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#329.src: Let us gather here again tomorrow evening for another meeting. Goodnight, everyone.
Queen's Recruit#329.dst: Retrouvons-nous ici demain soir pour une autre réunion. Bonne nuit à tous.
Queen's Recruit#329.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#330.src: Make your way back to W-{~} and sleep.
Queen's Recruit#330.dst: Retournez à la W-{~} et dormez.

Queen's Recruit#331.src: Those Sovereigns... they do concern me. If Fruma's leadership holds this much power, then...
Queen's Recruit#331.dst: Ces Souverains... m'inquiètent vraiment. Si les dirigeants de Fruma ont autant de pouvoir, alors...
Queen's Recruit#331.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#332.src: Hm. Perhaps our King is right not to get on their bad side.
Queen's Recruit#332.dst: Hm. Notre roi a peut-être raison de ne pas se les mettre à dos.
Queen's Recruit#332.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#333.src: Ah, great, now all o' you are lingerin'. Get out of my room! Not gonna get a lick o' sleep till you're gone...
Queen's Recruit#333.dst: Ah, génial, maintenant vous traînez tous ici. Dehors, hors de ma chambre! J'fermerai pas l'oeil tant que vous serez là...
Queen's Recruit#333.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#334.src: ...damned Doctor- should'a just used his own room!!
Queen's Recruit#334.dst: ...ce fichu docteur- il aurait dû prendre sa propre chambre!!
Queen's Recruit#334.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#335.src: ...sigh. What am I doing here? I should have stayed back in {p}.
Queen's Recruit#335.dst: ...pfff. Qu'est-ce que je fais ici? J'aurais dû rester à {p}.
Queen's Recruit#335.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#336.src: I just hope nobody here knew me before. I'm not sure I could handle that.
Queen's Recruit#336.dst: J'espère que personne ici ne me connaissait avant. Je ne le supporterais pas, je crois.
Queen's Recruit#336.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#337.src: Hm... a shame I could not fight in the tournament. A monetary reward would be appreciated, given my dwindling research funds...
Queen's Recruit#337.dst: Hm... dommage que je n'aie pas pu combattre au tournoi. Une récompense en argent serait la bienvenue, vu mes fonds de recherche qui s'amenuisent...
Queen's Recruit#337.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#338.src: But, alas, I am no fighter. Perhaps the King would be willing to fund my future research...
Queen's Recruit#338.dst: Mais, hélas, je ne suis pas un combattant. Le roi financerait peut-être mes futures recherches...
Queen's Recruit#338.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#339.src: Gosh, I hope my match tomorrow goes well. I'm a bit nervous... never really dueled anyone before!
Queen's Recruit#339.dst: Ouh là, j'espère que mon match de demain ira bien. J'suis un peu nerveuse... j'ai jamais fait de duel!
Queen's Recruit#339.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#341.src: What? It's been a long day.
Queen's Recruit#341.dst: Quoi? La journée a été longue.
Queen's Recruit#341.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#342.src: That magic... why does it feel familiar? I can't pinpoint what it is, but...
Queen's Recruit#342.dst: Cette magie... pourquoi m'est-elle familière? Je ne saurais dire ce que c'est, mais...
Queen's Recruit#342.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#343.src: Let's just go get some sleep.
Queen's Recruit#343.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#344.src: Goodnight, {u}. I hope you'll sleep better than I will.
Queen's Recruit#344.dst: Bonne nuit, {u}. J'espère que tu dormiras mieux que moi.
Queen's Recruit#344.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#346.src: {u}! We're going to miss the first round if you sleep any longer!
Queen's Recruit#346.dst: {u}! On va rater le premier tour si tu continues à dormir!
Queen's Recruit#346.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#349.src: Well, I feel your pain. I don't think I got more than an hour or two. I kept... I should have expected it'd be worse here. I just hoped... well, it is what it is.
Queen's Recruit#349.dst: Je te comprends. Je n'ai pas dormi plus d'une heure ou deux, je crois. Je n'arrêtais pas de... J'aurais dû me douter que ce serait pire ici. J'espérais juste... enfin, c'est comme ça.
Queen's Recruit#349.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#350.src: But anyway, it's good you're up. A soldier just came by to tell us to head over to the tournament arena.
Queen's Recruit#350.dst: Mais bref, tant mieux que tu sois debout. Un soldat vient de passer nous dire d'aller à l'arène du tournoi.
Queen's Recruit#350.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#351.src: You... no, they just... knocked and slid the notice under the door.
Queen's Recruit#351.dst: Toi... non, ils ont juste... frappé et glissé l'avis sous la porte.
Queen's Recruit#351.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#352.src: Was someone in our room during the night...?
Queen's Recruit#352.dst: Quelqu'un est entré dans notre chambre cette nuit...?
Queen's Recruit#352.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#353.src: I don't... like... that. Not at all.
Queen's Recruit#353.dst: Je n'aime... pas... ça. Pas du tout.
Queen's Recruit#353.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#354.src: Still. We need to head over to the arena. Apparently, it's in the northern part of the palace.
Queen's Recruit#354.dst: Enfin bref. Il faut aller à l'arène. Apparemment, elle est dans la partie nord du palais.
Queen's Recruit#354.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#355.src: Find the location of the tournament in the northern side of the palace at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#355.dst: Trouvez le lieu du tournoi, dans l'aile nord du palais, en [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#356.src: Well, well. Looks like we'll finally get to test which o' us is stronger, eh, captain?
Queen's Recruit#356.dst: Eh bien, eh bien. On va enfin voir lequel d'nous deux est le plus fort, hein, capitaine?
Queen's Recruit#356.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#357.src: Oh, finally? I wasn't aware there was even a question! Lieutenant, do you truly think you stand a chance against me?
Queen's Recruit#357.dst: Oh, enfin? J'ignorais même que la question se posait! Lieutenant, crois-tu vraiment avoir une chance contre moi?
Queen's Recruit#357.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#358.src: Ah, enough o' your posturin', Kymer! You might be all up n' fancy these days, but I still remember when you were but a rookie, all afraid of a lil' old zombie!
Queen's Recruit#358.dst: Ah, arrête tes grands airs, Kymer! T'es p't-être tout chic maintenant, mais j'me souviens quand t'étais qu'un bleu qu'avait peur d'un p'tit zombie de rien du tout!
Queen's Recruit#358.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#359.src: Ha! Ah, good times. Good times. You'll get your recognition too one of these days, you know. Maybe you'll even surpass my rank someday!
Queen's Recruit#359.dst: Ha! Ah, le bon temps. Le bon temps. Toi aussi, tu seras reconnu un de ces jours, tu sais. Tu dépasseras peut-être même mon grade!
Queen's Recruit#359.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#360.src: Eh, you say that every time. Besides, the lower ranks suit me well. Don't think I'd do well with all that "responsibility" the big wigs put on your shoulders.
Queen's Recruit#360.dst: Bah, tu dis ça à chaque fois. Et puis, les p'tits grades me vont bien. J'supporterais pas toute cette "responsabilité" que les huiles vous collent sur le dos.
Queen's Recruit#360.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#361.src: ...all that bein' said, you're still goin' down when it's our go! I got some new tricks since the last time we fought, so don't get too cocky!
Queen's Recruit#361.dst: ...cela dit, tu vas quand même mordre la poussière quand ce s'ra notre tour! J'ai appris d'nouveaux tours depuis not' dernier combat, alors fais pas l'malin!
Queen's Recruit#361.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#362.src: Ha! Then I look forward to seeing them.
Queen's Recruit#362.dst: Ha! Alors j'ai hâte de les voir.
Queen's Recruit#362.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#363.src: If you're looking for the tournament arena, go down this corridor then turn to the left.
Queen's Recruit#363.dst: Si vous cherchez l'arène du tournoi, suivez ce couloir puis tournez à gauche.
Queen's Recruit#363.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#364.src: The tournament arena is further down the corridor.
Queen's Recruit#364.dst: L'arène du tournoi se trouve plus loin dans le couloir.
Queen's Recruit#364.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#365.src: This area is unfortunately not accessible at this moment.
Queen's Recruit#365.dst: Cette zone n'est malheureusement pas accessible pour le moment.
Queen's Recruit#365.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#366.src: This is Her Majesty's own personal quarter.
Queen's Recruit#366.dst: Ce sont les appartements privés de Sa Majesté.
Queen's Recruit#366.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#367.src: I'm afraid I can't let you in just yet. Not until-
Queen's Recruit#367.dst: Je crains de ne pas pouvoir vous laisser entrer pour l'instant. Pas avant-
Queen's Recruit#367.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#368.src: Yes, yes, my research notes, I am aware. It has been sorted already. May I visit the library now?
Queen's Recruit#368.dst: Oui, oui, mes notes de recherche, je sais. C'est déjà réglé. Puis-je aller à la bibliothèque, maintenant?
Queen's Recruit#368.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#369.src: Don't interrupt me. You can't enter until this round of tournament matches concludes. Her Majesty's orders.
Queen's Recruit#369.dst: Ne m'interrompez pas. Vous n'entrerez pas avant la fin de cette série de combats. Ordre de Sa Majesté.
Queen's Recruit#369.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#370.src: Pah. Fine! Fine, yes, I'll wait. Good grief.
Queen's Recruit#370.dst: Pff. Bon! Bon, oui, j'attendrai. Misère.
Queen's Recruit#370.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#371.src: You'd think I would have some level of freedom, but no! What does it matter if I don't need to watch the matches if there's nothing else to do?!
Queen's Recruit#371.dst: On pourrait croire que j'aurais un minimum de liberté, mais non! A quoi bon être dispensé des combats s'il n'y a rien d'autre à faire?!
Queen's Recruit#371.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#372.src: Oh, just go and get your match over with. Quit stalling.
Queen's Recruit#372.dst: Oh, va donc expédier ton combat. Arrête de traîner.
Queen's Recruit#372.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#374.src: Just head down these stairs to find the tournament arena.
Queen's Recruit#374.dst: Descendez ces escaliers pour trouver l'arène du tournoi.
Queen's Recruit#374.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#375.src: The match ups will be announced once everyone is present.
Queen's Recruit#375.dst: Les affrontements seront annoncés quand tout le monde sera présent.
Queen's Recruit#375.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#376.src: Uh. Sovereign... Majin? Sovereign Majin. We're all here.
Queen's Recruit#376.dst: Euh. Souverain... Majin? Souverain Majin. Nous sommes tous là.
Queen's Recruit#376.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#377.src: My, it's about time! As guests of the crown, it would do you well to arrive on time for such things, hm? Tardiness is not a good look.
Queen's Recruit#377.dst: Ma foi, il était temps! En tant qu'invités de la Couronne, vous feriez bien d'arriver à l'heure à ce genre d'événement, hm? Le retard fait mauvais effet.
Queen's Recruit#377.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#378.src: Our apologies, Sovereign. It would seem we were not given the time to be here in advance - a humble mistake, I'm certain.
Queen's Recruit#378.dst: Toutes nos excuses, Souverain. Il semble qu'on ne nous ait pas laissé le temps de venir en avance - une simple erreur, j'en suis certain.
Queen's Recruit#378.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#379.src: Ah, the incompetence of our lessers... it never ceases to amaze! Nevertheless, the duty of arriving on schedule remains on your shoulders. Do better next time, would you?
Queen's Recruit#379.dst: Ah, l'incompétence de nos inférieurs... elle ne cesse de m'étonner! Reste qu'arriver à l'heure est votre devoir. Faites mieux la prochaine fois, voulez-vous?
Queen's Recruit#379.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#380.src: Now, I am a very busy man, so I will keep this brief. As Her Majesty has already explained, this tournament will consist of multiple duels! You are not required to watch each match.
Queen's Recruit#380.dst: Bien, je suis un homme très occupé, je serai donc bref. Comme Sa Majesté l'a expliqué, ce tournoi comptera plusieurs duels! Vous n'êtes pas tenus d'assister à chaque combat.
Queen's Recruit#380.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#381.src: The standard rules apply. No killing, no maiming, no attacking anyone outside the arena - though, do try, I'd find much pleasure in watching you fail!
Queen's Recruit#381.dst: Les règles habituelles s'appliquent. Pas de mise à mort, pas de mutilation, pas d'attaque hors de l'arène - mais essayez donc, j'adorerais vous voir échouer!
Queen's Recruit#381.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#382.src: With that settled, are there any questions? I would certainly hope not, I have much to return to once this is-
Queen's Recruit#382.dst: Cela étant réglé, des questions? J'espère bien que non, j'ai fort à faire une fois que ce sera-
Queen's Recruit#382.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#383.src: Ah, I do - I am not participating in the tournament. I had been told to expect some alternative today.
Queen's Recruit#383.dst: Ah, moi - je ne participe pas au tournoi. On m'avait annoncé une autre option pour aujourd'hui.
Queen's Recruit#383.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#384.src: Oh, yes... you. What did you say you were again, a... researcher?
Queen's Recruit#384.dst: Ah, oui... toi. Tu disais être quoi, déjà, un... chercheur?
Queen's Recruit#384.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#385.src: Ahahaha! Oh, and they selected you as one of your province's greatest? Don't make me laugh! Ahahahahaha!
Queen's Recruit#385.dst: Ahahaha! Et on t'a choisi parmi les meilleurs de ta province? Ne me fais pas rire! Ahahahahaha!
Queen's Recruit#385.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#386.src: Ah, but it's just as well, I suppose. Nine certainly doesn't fit cleanly for such a tournament. Better a researcher than a ninth fighter!
Queen's Recruit#386.dst: Ah, mais c'est aussi bien, je suppose. Neuf, ça ne tombe pas juste pour un tel tournoi. Mieux vaut un chercheur qu'un neuvième combattant!
Queen's Recruit#386.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#387.src: Yes, someone will be with you shortly. Just sit on the sidelines and twiddle your thumbs, or whatever you do- you certainly aren't my problem anymore.
Queen's Recruit#387.dst: Oui, quelqu'un s'occupera de toi sous peu. Assieds-toi sur le côté et tourne-toi les pouces, ou je ne sais quoi- tu n'es plus mon problème.
Queen's Recruit#387.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#392.src: Excellent! The first match up appears to be... {u} and Mel. Step forward, the two of you.
Queen's Recruit#392.dst: Excellent! Le premier affrontement semble être... {u} contre Mel. Avancez, tous les deux.
Queen's Recruit#392.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#395.src: Well, hurry up now, get prepared! Choose a corridor each, north or south, and get to fighting already!
Queen's Recruit#395.dst: Allons, dépêchez-vous, préparez-vous! Choisissez chacun un couloir, nord ou sud, et battez-vous, enfin!
Queen's Recruit#395.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#396.src: As for the rest of you... oh, I can't be bothered. Read your matchups on the board yourselves.
Queen's Recruit#396.dst: Quant aux autres... oh, je n'en ai pas le courage. Lisez vous-mêmes vos affrontements au tableau.
Queen's Recruit#396.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#397.src: Uh... alrighty then. I guess I'll choose this one.
Queen's Recruit#397.dst: Euh... bon, d'accord. Je crois que je prends celui-là.
Queen's Recruit#397.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#398.src: Begin your fight against Mel in the southern waiting room.
Queen's Recruit#398.dst: Commencez votre combat contre Mel dans la salle d'attente sud.

Queen's Recruit#400.src: Just 'cause we've got a mission here, doesn't mean I'll go easy on ya!
Queen's Recruit#400.dst: C'est pas parce qu'on a une mission ici que j'vais y aller mollo avec toi!
Queen's Recruit#400.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#401.src: Ready to go?! Let's show them what we're made of!
Queen's Recruit#401.dst: On y va?! Montrons-leur de quoi on est capables!
Queen's Recruit#401.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#402.src: Phew! What a fight! Got my blood rushin'!
Queen's Recruit#402.dst: Ouf! Quel combat! J'ai le sang qui bouillonne!
Queen's Recruit#402.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#403.src: What'd you think of my trick? Pretty good, right? Makes me less of a sittin' duck in combat!
Queen's Recruit#403.dst: T'as pensé quoi de mon truc? Pas mal, hein? Comme ça, j'suis moins une cible facile en combat!
Queen's Recruit#403.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#404.src: Ah, I didn't think I was gonna be winnin' anything, really. But it was fun givin' it a shot.
Queen's Recruit#404.dst: Ah, j'pensais pas vraiment gagner quoi que ce soit. Mais c'était sympa d'essayer.
Queen's Recruit#404.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#405.src: {u} has bested Mel in the first round, and will progress to the next!
Queen's Recruit#405.dst: {u} a vaincu Mel au premier tour et passe au suivant!
Queen's Recruit#405.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#407.src: You will be permitted to remain in the palace for the duration of the tournament. You will be paid for your participation at the end of your stay.
Queen's Recruit#407.dst: Vous pourrez rester au palais pendant toute la durée du tournoi. Votre participation sera rémunérée à la fin de votre séjour.
Queen's Recruit#407.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#408.src: I figure that makes sense. I wonder when Lanu's match is...
Queen's Recruit#408.dst: Ça me paraît logique. Je me demande quand passe Lanu...
Queen's Recruit#408.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#409.src: {u}, congratulations on your victory. You will be notified when your next match is. In the meantime, feel free to rest.
Queen's Recruit#409.dst: {u}, félicitations pour votre victoire. On vous préviendra de votre prochain combat. En attendant, reposez-vous si vous le souhaitez.
Queen's Recruit#409.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#410.src: Leave the arena waiting room and find Picard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#410.dst: Quittez la salle d'attente de l'arène et trouvez Picard en [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#411.src: It was a good fight! But you'd better win in my honor now, y'hear?
Queen's Recruit#411.dst: Beau combat! Mais maintenant, t'as intérêt à gagner en mon honneur, t'entends?
Queen's Recruit#411.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#412.src: We will announce your next match later. Please feel free to rest or enjoy the palace in the meantime.
Queen's Recruit#412.dst: Nous annoncerons votre prochain combat plus tard. En attendant, reposez-vous ou profitez du palais.
Queen's Recruit#412.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#413.src: Ah, {u}, I saw the match! Very good technique, better than many soldiers I've seen pass through {p} in my time.
Queen's Recruit#413.dst: Ah, {u}, j'ai vu le combat! Excellente technique, meilleure que bien des soldats vus passer par {p} en mon temps.
Queen's Recruit#413.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#414.src: I suppose I'm not surprised! When the tournament was announced, you came to mind as a potential winner. You, and one other person, that is.
Queen's Recruit#414.dst: Je ne suis pas surpris, je suppose! A l'annonce du tournoi, j'ai pensé à toi comme vainqueur possible. Toi, et une autre personne, s'entend.
Queen's Recruit#414.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#415.src: Hm... maybe I could start taking bets on who will win... ah, no, no, I'm far too busy. Stay focused, Picard.
Queen's Recruit#415.dst: Hm... je pourrais prendre des paris sur le vainqueur... ah, non, non, je suis bien trop occupé. Concentre-toi, Picard.
Queen's Recruit#415.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#416.src: Hm? Oh dear, I'd forgotten you were here! Yes, I was going to do something...
Queen's Recruit#416.dst: Hm? Oh, mon Dieu, j'avais oublié que tu étais là! Oui, j'allais faire quelque chose...
Queen's Recruit#416.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#417.src: Oh! The library! Can you believe it, that damnable guard finally stepped away! It's ridiculous, really- who even cares to guard a library of all things?!
Queen's Recruit#417.dst: Oh! La bibliothèque! Tu te rends compte, ce satané garde a enfin quitté son poste! C'est ridicule- qui irait garder une bibliothèque, franchement?!
Queen's Recruit#417.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#418.src: But. But but but. The way is open, and although the tournament round is still ongoing, I'd like to take this opportunity while I can!
Queen's Recruit#418.dst: Mais. Mais mais mais. La voie est libre, et même si la manche du tournoi n'est pas finie, j'aimerais saisir l'occasion tant que je peux!
Queen's Recruit#418.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#419.src: Care to join me? I'm sure there's something you'll find interesting in there. What sorts of knowledge have the Frumans kept hidden in these walls...
Queen's Recruit#419.dst: Tu m'accompagnes? Tu y trouveras sûrement quelque chose d'intéressant. Quels savoirs les Frumiens ont-ils cachés entre ces murs...
Queen's Recruit#419.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#420.src: Well, are you coming? Come now, quickly, before the guard returns!
Queen's Recruit#420.dst: Alors, tu viens? Allez, vite, avant que le garde ne revienne!
Queen's Recruit#420.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#422.src: Goodness, where to even begin? There's so much here...
Queen's Recruit#422.dst: Grands dieux, par où commencer? Il y a tant de choses ici...
Queen's Recruit#422.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#423.src: I hereby introduce to you The Evermoving Zephyr, the ruler of the {p}, the latest in the line of one of Fruma's great noble houses! His lordship, Sovereign Zhiraok Nasin!
Queen's Recruit#423.dst: Je vous présente le Zéphyr perpétuel, souverain de {p}, dernier héritier de l'une des grandes maisons nobles de Fruma! Sa Seigneurie, le Souverain Zhiraok Nasin!

Queen's Recruit#424.src: ...and that we're rifling through the Cursed instead of our own citizens is an incalculable risk!
Queen's Recruit#424.dst: ...et fouiller parmi les Maudits plutôt que parmi nos citoyens est un risque incalculable!

Queen's Recruit#425.src: What was that?! Quickly, quickly now, follow me!
Queen's Recruit#425.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#426.src: Do you have eyes on the speaker? Who is it?
Queen's Recruit#426.dst: Tu vois qui parle? Qui est-ce?
Queen's Recruit#426.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#427.src: I can't find her angle for this hunt.
Queen's Recruit#427.dst: Je n'arrive pas à cerner son angle dans cette chasse.
Queen's Recruit#427.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#428.src: Ah, it's like I'm talking with her again! It's so nostalgic to speak with a clueless Nasin trying their hardest, in spite of their incompe-
Queen's Recruit#428.dst: Ah, on se croirait revenu au temps où je lui parlais! Quelle nostalgie, un Nasin ignorant qui fait de son mieux malgré son incompét-
Queen's Recruit#428.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#429.src: I'M SORRY, YOU IGNORANT INTEGRAND? You really think now is the time for- Rrgh... Why. Do I even bother.
Queen's Recruit#429.dst: PARDON, ESPÈCE D'INTÉGRANDE IGNARE? Tu crois vraiment que c'est le moment de- Rrgh... Pourquoi. Je me fatigue encore.
Queen's Recruit#429.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#430.src: Why, indeed! It truly is a bad habit. Something to work on while your seniors do the important work, hm?
Queen's Recruit#430.dst: Pourquoi, en effet! C'est une bien mauvaise habitude. A corriger pendant que tes aînés font le travail important, hm?
Queen's Recruit#430.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#431.src: Speaking of, I must put forth that I do find this all a bit strange. We most certainly aren't lacking in strength here, so why bother with the exiles?
Queen's Recruit#431.dst: A ce propos, je dois dire que je trouve tout cela un peu étrange. La force ne nous manque pas ici, alors pourquoi s'embêter avec les exilés?
Queen's Recruit#431.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#432.src: ...sigh... The risk factor is much greater than I'd bet on. She has to know more than we do, so maybe we'll get a summation later.
Queen's Recruit#432.dst: ...soupir... Le facteur de risque dépasse mes paris. Elle doit en savoir plus que nous, on aura peut-être la somme totale plus tard.
Queen's Recruit#432.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#433.dst: Vous avez fini, tous les deux?

Queen's Recruit#434.src: Ah, there she is. Fashionably late as always!
Queen's Recruit#434.dst: Ah, la voilà. En retard avec élégance, comme toujours!
Queen's Recruit#434.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#435.src: Hm. If anything, I was early.

Queen's Recruit#436.src: I'd say your timing was golden- if you're here for that summation I mentioned, and this isn't anything else.
Queen's Recruit#436.dst: Je dirais que ton timing vaut de l'or- si tu viens pour la somme dont je parlais, et pas pour autre chose.
Queen's Recruit#436.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#437.src: It's the former. But first, have you been watching the battles? Do any of the contestants stick out to you?
Queen's Recruit#437.dst: Pour ça, oui. Mais d'abord, vous avez suivi les combats? L'un des participants sort-il du lot?

Queen's Recruit#438.src: Stick out? Hardly. Thus far, I have been thoroughly unimpressed.
Queen's Recruit#438.dst: Sortir du lot? Guère. Jusqu'ici, personne ne m'a impressionné.
Queen's Recruit#438.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#439.src: Naturally you would be. I've seen some generally promising things, but I need to know the expected solution to narrow the pool-
Queen's Recruit#439.dst: Évidemment. J'ai vu des choses plutôt prometteuses, mais il me faut la solution attendue pour réduire l'ensemble-
Queen's Recruit#439.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#440.src: Ah, ah! Settle down, Nasin, your betters are speaking. Calculate yourself out of dead last, first.
Queen's Recruit#440.dst: Ah, ah! Du calme, Nasin, tes supérieurs parlent. Commence par calculer comment sortir de la dernière place.
Queen's Recruit#440.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#441.src: Later, then. We have problems. The contestants have been sneaking around. And the doctor has been taking meticulous notes.
Queen's Recruit#441.dst: Plus tard, alors. Nous avons des problèmes. Les participants fouinent partout. Et le docteur prend des notes méticuleuses.

Queen's Recruit#442.src: ...looks like you letting him sit out the problem was a miscalculation, huh?
Queen's Recruit#442.dst: ...on dirait que le sortir de l'équation, c'était une erreur de calcul, hein?
Queen's Recruit#442.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#443.src: For once, we appear to be in agreement. What a pity, what a hassle... it hardly seems worth the effort to me.
Queen's Recruit#443.dst: Pour une fois, nous semblons d'accord. Quel dommage, quelle corvée... ça ne me semble guère valoir l'effort.
Queen's Recruit#443.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#444.src: It will be. But I've spent too much time here already. You'll have to wait for answers.
Queen's Recruit#444.dst: Ça le vaudra. Mais j'ai déjà passé trop de temps ici. Vous devrez attendre vos réponses.

Queen's Recruit#445.src: Of course. How much more irrational can we get, I wonder.
Queen's Recruit#445.dst: Bien sûr. Je me demande jusqu'où on peut encore devenir irrationnels.
Queen's Recruit#445.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#446.src: If you'd like something to look out for, one of the more promising candidates is set to have a match soon. Go watch it.
Queen's Recruit#446.dst: Si vous voulez quelque chose à surveiller, l'un des candidats les plus prometteurs a bientôt un combat. Allez le voir.

Queen's Recruit#447.src: A joy as always. Well, you heard her Nasin! Chop chop, off to the stands we go!
Queen's Recruit#447.dst: Toujours un plaisir. Eh bien, tu l'as entendue, Nasin! Allez, allez, direction les gradins!
Queen's Recruit#447.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#448.src: ...so not even the Sovereigns know what's happening. Fascinating. Very fascinating.
Queen's Recruit#448.dst: ...donc même les Souverains ne savent pas ce qui se passe. Fascinant. Absolument fascinant.
Queen's Recruit#448.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#449.src: And there was a third! Who were they? Another Sovereign...? Damn it, damn it all, how did I not notice?
Queen's Recruit#449.dst: Et il y en avait un troisième! Qui était-ce? Un autre Souverain...? Bon sang, bon sang, comment ne l'ai-je pas vu?
Queen's Recruit#449.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#450.src: Well, they appear to be on to us. No matter. We'll need to be more careful.
Queen's Recruit#450.dst: Bon, ils semblent nous avoir repérés. Peu importe. Il faudra être plus prudents.
Queen's Recruit#450.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#451.src: You'd best get back to the arena. In the meantime, I'll keep searching here... there must be something useful!
Queen's Recruit#451.dst: Tu ferais mieux de retourner à l'arène. En attendant, je continue de chercher ici... il doit bien y avoir quelque chose d'utile!
Queen's Recruit#451.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#453.src: ...hm? Oh, yes, fine, I'll tell the rest about what we heard. After I'm done here, of course.
Queen's Recruit#453.dst: ...hm? Oh, oui, d'accord, je raconterai aux autres ce qu'on a entendu. Quand j'aurai fini ici, bien entendu.
Queen's Recruit#453.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#454.src: The first round of the tournament has concluded!
Queen's Recruit#454.dst: Le premier tour du tournoi est terminé!
Queen's Recruit#454.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#455.src: The names that will proceed to the next round... {u}! Tasim! Reynauld! Kymer!
Queen's Recruit#455.dst: Les noms qui passent au tour suivant... {u}! Tasim! Reynauld! Kymer!
Queen's Recruit#455.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#456.src: {u}, your match will begin shortly. Your opponent is already in the waiting room.
Queen's Recruit#456.dst: {u}, votre combat va bientôt commencer. Votre adversaire est déjà dans la salle d'attente.
Queen's Recruit#456.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#457.src: Make your way to the arena.
Queen's Recruit#457.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#458.src: Begin your next duel in the arena down the stairs.
Queen's Recruit#458.dst: Commencez votre prochain duel dans l'arène, en bas des escaliers.

Queen's Recruit#459.src: Please make your way to the arena by following the stairs down.
Queen's Recruit#459.dst: Veuillez vous rendre à l'arène en descendant les escaliers.
Queen's Recruit#459.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#460.src: Please go to your waiting room and prepare for the battle.
Queen's Recruit#460.dst: Veuillez rejoindre votre salle d'attente et vous préparer au combat.
Queen's Recruit#460.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#462.src: Well, you'll likely prove more of a challenge than Linton, that's for sure.
Queen's Recruit#462.dst: Bon, tu seras sans doute plus coriace que Linton, ça c'est sûr.
Queen's Recruit#462.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#463.src: You've come a long way since {p}, haven't you? Well, so have I! Let's battle.
Queen's Recruit#463.dst: Tu as fait du chemin depuis {p}, pas vrai? Eh bien, moi aussi! Battons-nous.
Queen's Recruit#463.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#464.src: The battle is decided! {u} has come out victorious.
Queen's Recruit#464.dst: Le combat est joué! {u} remporte la victoire.
Queen's Recruit#464.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#465.src: Ah... good fighting, {u}. I even used some of my most powerful arrows.
Queen's Recruit#465.dst: Ah... beau combat, {u}. J'ai même sorti certaines de mes meilleures flèches.
Queen's Recruit#465.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#467.src: I know, I know. You were a worthy opponent, {u}. Now, you'll be winning this whole thing, yes?
Queen's Recruit#467.dst: Je sais, je sais. Tu as été un adversaire digne, {u}. Et maintenant, tu vas tout gagner, hein?
Queen's Recruit#467.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#468.src: {u}, congratulations on reaching the finals. All other opponents have been defeated, except for you and your fellow finalist.
Queen's Recruit#468.dst: {u}, félicitations pour votre place en finale. Tous les autres adversaires ont été vaincus, sauf vous et l'autre finaliste.
Queen's Recruit#468.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#470.src: Hmph. That will be announced shortly. Please make your way to the courtyard and await further instructions.
Queen's Recruit#470.dst: Hmpf. Ce sera annoncé sous peu. Veuillez vous rendre dans la cour et attendre de nouvelles instructions.
Queen's Recruit#470.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#471.src: Return to the courtyard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}] and find other contestants.
Queen's Recruit#471.dst: Retournez dans la cour en [-{~}, {~}, {~}] et retrouvez les autres participants.

Queen's Recruit#472.src: I did well enough, I suppose. I'll be glad for this to all be over, anyway.
Queen's Recruit#472.dst: Je m'en suis bien sorti, je crois. De toute façon, j'ai hâte que tout ça soit fini.
Queen's Recruit#472.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#473.src: Please make your way to the courtyard and await further instructions.
Queen's Recruit#473.dst: Veuillez vous rendre dans la cour et attendre de nouvelles instructions.
Queen's Recruit#473.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#474.src: {u}, you return! Well, how did your match go?
Queen's Recruit#474.dst: {u}, te revoilà! Alors, comment s'est passé ton combat?
Queen's Recruit#474.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#475.src: You? I suppose that would make sense. No offense intended, Reynauld, but I would have bet on {u} if I had the chance.
Queen's Recruit#475.dst: Vous? Je suppose que c'est logique. Sans vouloir vous offenser, Reynauld, j'aurais parié sur {u} si j'en avais eu l'occasion.
Queen's Recruit#475.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#476.src: Ha. For me, certainly! It felt like I could barely make a dent in your stamina.
Queen's Recruit#476.dst: Ha. Pour moi, en tout cas! J'avais l'impression de pouvoir à peine entamer ton endurance.
Queen's Recruit#476.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#477.src: Yes, yes, congratulations are in order, and all that- we have problems.
Queen's Recruit#477.dst: Oui, oui, félicitations, et tout le tralala- nous avons des problèmes.
Queen's Recruit#477.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#478.src: It was problem enough that he was called here in the first place... to think, he could-
Queen's Recruit#478.dst: C'était déjà un problème qu'on l'ait convoqué ici... et dire qu'il pourrait-
Queen's Recruit#478.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#479.src: That is enough about the tournament. I don't want to hear about it anymore. The doctor is right.
Queen's Recruit#479.dst: Assez parlé du tournoi. Je ne veux plus en entendre parler. Le docteur a raison.
Queen's Recruit#479.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#480.src: Yes, well, it's not your honour on the line... but fine, I admit, this third Sovereign is... troubling.
Queen's Recruit#480.dst: Oui, enfin, ce n'est pas votre honneur qui est en jeu... mais soit, je l'admets, ce troisième Souverain est... préoccupant.
Queen's Recruit#480.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#481.src: Hm. Have we been able to find what information we needed?
Queen's Recruit#481.dst: Hm. Avons-nous pu trouver les informations dont nous avions besoin?
Queen's Recruit#481.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#482.src: No! And that is precisely our problem - we are missing something, and we are running out of time! One final match, and then it's done.
Queen's Recruit#482.dst: Non! Et c'est précisément notre problème - il nous manque quelque chose, et le temps presse! Un dernier combat, et ce sera fini.
Queen's Recruit#482.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#483.src: ...truthfully, I'm surprised you were on my side for that match.
Queen's Recruit#483.dst: ...à vrai dire, je suis surpris que tu aies été de mon côté pendant ce combat.
Queen's Recruit#483.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#484.src: Ah, well, someone had t' take him down a peg! Guess that someone was you.
Queen's Recruit#484.dst: Ah, ben, fallait bien qu'quelqu'un lui rabatte le caquet! Faut croire que c'était toi.
Queen's Recruit#484.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#485.src: Oh, give me a break, lieutenant. Him? Of all people to-
Queen's Recruit#485.dst: Oh, lâche-moi, lieutenant. Lui? De tous les gens, il fallait que-
Queen's Recruit#485.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#486.src: Hey, everyone's here! Is... this where they wanted everyone to gather up?
Queen's Recruit#486.dst: Hé, tout le monde est là! C'est... ici qu'ils voulaient qu'on se rassemble?
Queen's Recruit#486.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#487.src: Seems that way. You won your match?
Queen's Recruit#487.dst: On dirait. Tu as gagné ton combat?
Queen's Recruit#487.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#488.src: I did. It seems I'm a finalist now. So, who's the other one?
Queen's Recruit#488.dst: Oui. On dirait que je suis finaliste. Alors, qui est l'autre?
Queen's Recruit#488.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#489.src: Oh! Well, congratulations! Though, I guess we'll be facing each other soon.
Queen's Recruit#489.dst: Oh! Eh bien, félicitations! Mais je suppose qu'on va bientôt s'affronter.
Queen's Recruit#489.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#490.src: Good grief... yes, the tournament has happened, congratulations to the finalists, whatever- where are Mel and Linton? We need to discuss what to do next, before-
Queen's Recruit#490.dst: Misère... oui, le tournoi a eu lieu, bravo aux finalistes, peu importe- où sont Mel et Linton? Il faut discuter de la suite, avant que-
Queen's Recruit#490.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#491.src: ...and so, what, I'm not allowed to take a nap now? I wasn't even fighting!! Mel, back me up, come on!
Queen's Recruit#491.dst: ...et alors quoi, j'ai plus le droit de faire une sieste? Je me battais même pas!! Mel, soutiens-moi, allez!
Queen's Recruit#491.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#492.src: He's right, this hardly seems fair! We were told we could stay in our rooms until the tournament had concluded, so why the change?!
Queen's Recruit#492.dst: Il a raison, c'est pas juste! On nous avait dit qu'on pouvait rester dans nos chambres jusqu'à la fin du tournoi, alors pourquoi ce changement?!
Queen's Recruit#492.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#494.src: Any competitors who have lost in the tournament are to be escorted out of Fruma, effective immediately.
Queen's Recruit#494.dst: Tous les concurrents éliminés du tournoi doivent être escortés hors de Fruma, avec effet immédiat.
Queen's Recruit#494.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#495.src: - what is the meaning of this?!
Queen's Recruit#495.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#496.src: SILENCE! These are new orders from Her Majesty.
Queen's Recruit#496.dst: SILENCE! Ce sont les nouveaux ordres de Sa Majesté.
Queen's Recruit#496.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#497.src: Only {u} and Tasim are permitted to remain in the palace. Any defiance will be seen as an official threat against Fruma from the Wynn province.
Queen's Recruit#497.dst: Seuls {u} et Tasim sont autorisés à rester au palais. Toute résistance sera vue comme une menace officielle de la province de Wynn envers Fruma.
Queen's Recruit#497.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#498.src: Comply, and no one will be hurt. You will still receive your promised reward for participation.
Queen's Recruit#498.dst: Obéissez, et personne ne sera blessé. Vous recevrez tout de même la récompense promise pour votre participation.
Queen's Recruit#498.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#499.dst: ...c'est un scandale. Un tel manque de respect-
Queen's Recruit#499.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#500.src: Enough, Kymer. What's done is done. We have no choice.
Queen's Recruit#500.dst: Assez, Kymer. Ce qui est fait est fait. Nous n'avons pas le choix.
Queen's Recruit#500.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#501.src: You two. Stay safe, and be on guard. I'll report back to the King with this news. If you're not released safely...
Queen's Recruit#501.dst: Vous deux. Soyez prudents, et sur vos gardes. Je rapporterai cette nouvelle au roi. Si vous n'êtes pas relâchés sains et saufs...
Queen's Recruit#501.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#502.src: ...{u}. Tasim. I've gotten what I came here for originally, but... I don't know what they're planning. You'll have to handle it on your own.
Queen's Recruit#502.dst: ...{u}. Tasim. J'ai obtenu ce que j'étais venu chercher, mais... je ne sais pas ce qu'ils préparent. Vous devrez vous débrouiller seuls.
Queen's Recruit#502.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#504.src: Remaining finalists, you are expected in the dining hall shortly. Attend your last meal before the finals.
Queen's Recruit#504.dst: Finalistes restants, on vous attend sous peu dans la salle à manger. Assistez à votre dernier repas avant la finale.
Queen's Recruit#504.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#505.src: What was that? What just happened?
Queen's Recruit#505.dst: C'était quoi, ça? Qu'est-ce qui vient de se passer?
Queen's Recruit#505.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#506.src: They've changed the rules on us, and now... ugh, we have no choice... We need to see it through.
Queen's Recruit#506.dst: Ils ont changé les règles en route, et maintenant... pff, on n'a pas le choix... Il faut aller jusqu'au bout.
Queen's Recruit#506.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#507.src: Well... come on. Let's attend our final dinner here.
Queen's Recruit#507.dst: Bon... viens. Allons à notre dernier dîner ici.
Queen's Recruit#507.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#509.src: What are we supposed to do...?
Queen's Recruit#509.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#510.src: They'll let us out. They have to. It'd be a diplomatic disaster if they didn't.
Queen's Recruit#510.dst: Ils nous laisseront partir. Ils sont obligés. Sinon, ce serait un désastre diplomatique.
Queen's Recruit#510.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#512.src: If you were not already aware, your fellow soldiers have been returned to Wynn. Safely.
Queen's Recruit#512.dst: Si vous l'ignoriez, vos camarades soldats ont été renvoyés à Wynn. Sains et saufs.
Queen's Recruit#512.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#513.src: ...if you don't mind me asking, Your Majesty, I thought we had an agreement? We would all remain here until the tournament concluded with the finals.
Queen's Recruit#513.dst: ...si vous me permettez la question, Votre Majesté, n'avions-nous pas un accord? Nous devions tous rester ici jusqu'à la fin du tournoi.
Queen's Recruit#513.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#514.src: Oh? And would you like to join the rest of them? That could certainly be arranged- we could simply select a victor here and now, and be done with this whole-
Queen's Recruit#514.dst: Oh? Et tu voudrais les rejoindre? Cela peut tout à fait s'arranger- nous pourrions désigner un vainqueur ici et maintenant, et en finir avec tout ce-
Queen's Recruit#514.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#515.src: What is your problem, Thalas?! They're guests of Her Majesty! How irrational are you, trying to subtract them without her appr-
Queen's Recruit#515.dst: C'est quoi ton problème, Thalas?! Ce sont les invités de Sa Majesté! Quelle irrationalité, vouloir les soustraire sans son appro-
Queen's Recruit#515.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#517.src: To answer your question, the circumstances have changed. There is no need for the rest of your group to remain here.
Queen's Recruit#517.dst: Pour répondre à ta question, les circonstances ont changé. Le reste de ton groupe n'avait plus besoin de rester ici.
Queen's Recruit#517.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#518.src: The remainder of the tournament will proceed as expected.
Queen's Recruit#518.dst: La suite du tournoi se déroulera comme prévu.
Queen's Recruit#518.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#520.src: Good. Now, let us enjoy the meal!
Queen's Recruit#520.dst: Bien. A présent, profitons du repas!
Queen's Recruit#520.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#521.src: Another taste of Fruman cuisine... the meat was imported the {p}, and the vegetables came from the royal garden.
Queen's Recruit#521.dst: Encore un goût de la cuisine de Fruma... la viande a été importée de {p}, et les légumes viennent du jardin royal.
Queen's Recruit#521.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#522.src: Another taste of Fruman cuisine... the meat was imported from the {p}, and the vegetables came from our royal garden.
Queen's Recruit#522.dst: Encore un goût de la cuisine de Fruma... la viande a été importée de {p}, et les légumes viennent de notre jardin royal.
Queen's Recruit#522.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#523.src: Now, to business. The final will take place tomorrow morning. But first, I would like to speak to each of you individually.
Queen's Recruit#523.dst: Passons aux choses sérieuses. La finale aura lieu demain matin. Mais d'abord, je voudrais m'entretenir avec chacun de vous en privé.
Queen's Recruit#523.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#524.src: Let us begin with... {u}. Please come to the north-eastern wing when you are ready.
Queen's Recruit#524.dst: Commençons par... {u}. Rejoins l'aile nord-est quand tu le souhaiteras.
Queen's Recruit#524.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#526.src: Talk to Her Majesty in the north-eastern wing of the palace at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#526.dst: Parlez à Sa Majesté dans l'aile nord-est du palais, en [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#527.src: Well. I suppose congratulations are in order, finalist.
Queen's Recruit#527.dst: Bien. Je suppose que des félicitations s'imposent, finaliste.
Queen's Recruit#527.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#528.src: You're curious, surely? For what purpose would I call you soldiers back to our province?
Queen's Recruit#528.dst: Tu te poses la question, n'est-ce pas? Pourquoi rappellerais-je des soldats dans notre province?
Queen's Recruit#528.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#529.src: Certainly not just for a vanity tournament. A meaningless celebration.
Queen's Recruit#529.dst: Certainement pas pour un simple tournoi de vanité. Une célébration vide de sens.
Queen's Recruit#529.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#530.src: I'm... not sure what you mea
Queen's Recruit#530.dst: Je... ne vois pas ce que vous voulez dir

Queen's Recruit#531.src: Oh, let us drop the facade. I know what you have been doing in secret. I am not blind.
Queen's Recruit#531.dst: Oh, laissons tomber les faux-semblants. Je sais ce que vous avez fait en secret. Je ne suis pas aveugle.
Queen's Recruit#531.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#532.src: You chose to take this opportunity to seek out information on our province. What little you have learned, we have deemed an acceptable cost.
Queen's Recruit#532.dst: Vous avez choisi de profiter de l'occasion pour chercher des informations sur notre province. Le peu que vous avez appris, nous l'avons jugé un coût acceptable.
Queen's Recruit#532.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#533.src: Given the circumstances, I would have sacrificed much, much more if necessary.
Queen's Recruit#533.dst: Vu les circonstances, j'aurais sacrifié bien, bien davantage s'il l'avait fallu.
Queen's Recruit#533.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#535.src: The greatest that Wynn has... a broad category. We had to thin the numbers - a contest of strength did the job nicely.
Queen's Recruit#535.dst: Les meilleurs de Wynn... une catégorie bien vaste. Il fallait réduire le nombre - une épreuve de force a parfaitement fait l'affaire.
Queen's Recruit#535.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#536.src: And now... two candidates remain. You have done well to make it this far. I have been watching the duels intently, and you are certainly not unimpressive.
Queen's Recruit#536.dst: Et maintenant... il reste deux candidats. Tu as bien fait d'arriver jusqu'ici. J'ai suivi les duels avec attention, et tu es loin d'être quelconque.
Queen's Recruit#536.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#537.src: Yet of the two of you... you certainly leave a lesser impression than him. You are one amongst hundreds, thousands... indistinguishable.
Queen's Recruit#537.dst: Pourtant, de vous deux... c'est toi qui marques le moins les esprits. Une personne parmi des centaines, des milliers... impossible à distinguer.
Queen's Recruit#537.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#538.src: And still, here you stand. It intrigues me. What is so special about you? What strength has led you here?
Queen's Recruit#538.dst: Et pourtant, te voilà. Cela m'intrigue. Qu'as-tu de si spécial? Quelle force t'a permis d'arriver jusqu'ici?
Queen's Recruit#538.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#539.src: But no matter. Answers will come with time... should you be selected. I can tell you have a question. Speak it.
Queen's Recruit#539.dst: Mais peu importe. Les réponses viendront avec le temps... si l'on te choisit. Je vois que tu as une question. Pose-la.
Queen's Recruit#539.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#540.src: Hm. A blank slate... to be able to see the outside world, for all its splendor and all its faults, to witness firsthand the deep rooted seeds of its inevitable destruction... there is value to that.
Queen's Recruit#540.dst: Hm. Une page blanche... pouvoir voir le monde extérieur, dans sa splendeur comme dans ses défauts, voir de ses propres yeux les germes profonds de sa destruction inévitable... cela a de la valeur.
Queen's Recruit#540.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#541.src: You have seen it, haven't you? Forces beyond any of us vie for control of our world, caring not for what destruction they instill.
Queen's Recruit#541.dst: Tu l'as vu, n'est-ce pas? Des forces qui nous dépassent tous se disputent notre monde, sans se soucier des ravages qu'elles sèment.
Queen's Recruit#541.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#542.src: And it truly is a beautiful world, isn't it? To think, it could all be destroyed, taken for their ceaseless war which holds no meaning, no purpose...
Queen's Recruit#542.dst: Et c'est vraiment un monde magnifique, n'est-ce pas? Dire qu'il pourrait être détruit, sacrifié à leur guerre sans fin, sans but, sans raison...
Queen's Recruit#542.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#543.src: Then you have seen firsthand the benefits. The province is unburdened by those who may cause problems, and Wynn's front in its war is bolstered.
Queen's Recruit#543.dst: Alors tu en as vu les bienfaits de tes propres yeux. La province est délestée de ceux qui pourraient poser problème, et le front de Wynn s'en trouve renforcé.
Queen's Recruit#543.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#544.src: Of course, many will refuse the call. Many more will grow stagnant in their newfound roles. Yet, in a select few... there is potential for much, much more.
Queen's Recruit#544.dst: Bien sûr, beaucoup refuseront l'appel. Bien plus encore stagneront dans leur nouveau rôle. Mais chez quelques élus... il y a le potentiel de bien, bien davantage.
Queen's Recruit#544.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#545.dst: Je me demande... de quel côté es-tu?
Queen's Recruit#545.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#546.src: That will be all. Return to your chambers for the night. I will be sending for the other finalist shortly.
Queen's Recruit#546.dst: Ce sera tout. Retourne dans tes appartements pour la nuit. Je ferai bientôt appeler l'autre finaliste.
Queen's Recruit#546.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#547.src: Return to room W-{~} and talk to Tasim at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#547.dst: Retournez à la chambre W-{~} et parlez à Tasim en [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#549.src: You're back! Still in one piece?
Queen's Recruit#549.dst: Te revoilà! Toujours en un seul morceau?
Queen's Recruit#549.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#550.src: ...I was getting a little worried. You were up there a while.
Queen's Recruit#550.dst: ...je commençais à m'inquiéter un peu. Ça a duré un moment, là-haut.
Queen's Recruit#550.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#554.src: Ha. Well, now I'm a little nervous.
Queen's Recruit#554.dst: Ha. Bon, maintenant, je suis un peu nerveux.
Queen's Recruit#554.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#556.src: I'll... need to ask some follow-up questions.
Queen's Recruit#556.dst: Je vais... devoir lui poser d'autres questions.
Queen's Recruit#556.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#557.src: Oh, this is a disaster. We've been separated, and now we're stuck in here.
Queen's Recruit#557.dst: Oh, c'est un désastre. On nous a séparés, et maintenant on est coincés ici.
Queen's Recruit#557.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#558.src: We need to come up with a plan... is there a way we could-
Queen's Recruit#558.dst: Il nous faut un plan... est-ce qu'on pourrait-
Queen's Recruit#558.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#559.src: Tasim! Her Majesty will speak with you now.
Queen's Recruit#559.dst: Tasim! Sa Majesté va vous recevoir.
Queen's Recruit#559.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#561.src: Okay, wish me luck. I'll be back.
Queen's Recruit#561.dst: Bon, souhaite-moi bonne chance. Je reviens.
Queen's Recruit#561.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#562.src: Don't... stay up waiting for me. You can go rest. I'll be... fine, probably.
Queen's Recruit#562.dst: Ne... m'attends pas. Tu peux aller te reposer. Ça ira... sans doute.
Queen's Recruit#562.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#567.src: It went... fine, I guess. She probably said... most of the same things to you.
Queen's Recruit#567.dst: Ça s'est... bien passé, je crois. Elle t'a sûrement dit... à peu près la même chose.
Queen's Recruit#567.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#569.src: Could I ask you a favor?
Queen's Recruit#569.dst: Je peux te demander un service?
Queen's Recruit#569.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#570.src: Could we spar? A test match, before... before tomorrow. Just like old times.
Queen's Recruit#570.dst: On pourrait s'entraîner? Un combat d'essai, avant... avant demain. Comme au bon vieux temps.
Queen's Recruit#570.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#571.src: Just, get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#571.dst: Prépare-toi et retrouve-moi à l'arène. D'accord?
Queen's Recruit#571.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#572.src: I- yes. I'm okay. Just... could we spar? A test match, before... tomorrow. For old times' sake.
Queen's Recruit#572.dst: Je- oui. Ça va. Juste... on pourrait s'entraîner? Un combat d'essai, avant... demain. Pour le bon vieux temps.
Queen's Recruit#572.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#573.src: Just... get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#573.dst: Juste... prépare-toi et retrouve-moi à l'arène. D'accord?
Queen's Recruit#573.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#574.src: I was going to ask if I could ask you a favor.
Queen's Recruit#574.dst: J'allais te demander si je pouvais te demander un service.
Queen's Recruit#574.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#578.dst: Je... je... je ne comprends pas.
Queen's Recruit#578.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#579.src: He's... what- what happened? How do you know? How- how could you know?
Queen's Recruit#579.dst: Il est... quoi- qu'est-ce qui s'est passé? Comment tu le sais? Comment- comment tu peux le savoir?
Queen's Recruit#579.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#581.src: I-... Gods. And, you- you've been tr-trying to-
Queen's Recruit#581.dst: Je-... Dieux. Et toi- tu as es-essayé de-
Queen's Recruit#581.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#582.src: I- I need to go. I need some space. I'll- I'm going to the arena. I need to... to...
Queen's Recruit#582.dst: Je- je dois y aller. J'ai besoin d'air. Je- je vais à l'arène. J'ai besoin de... de...
Queen's Recruit#582.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#583.src: No. No, d-don't. Don't do that. Not now, not- not now. If... if you need me... you'll- you'll know where I am.
Queen's Recruit#583.dst: Non. Non, n-ne fais pas ça. Pas maintenant, pas- pas maintenant. Si... si tu as besoin de moi... tu- tu sauras où me trouver.
Queen's Recruit#583.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#584.src: Head to the arena for a training match against Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#584.dst: Allez à l'arène pour un combat d'entraînement contre Tasim.

Queen's Recruit#585.src: Get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#585.dst: Prépare-toi et retrouve-moi à l'arène. D'accord?
Queen's Recruit#585.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#586.src: It's... quiet. No guards in sight.
Queen's Recruit#586.dst: C'est... calme. Pas un garde en vue.
Queen's Recruit#586.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#587.src: Sigh. There's no point in trying to get out of here. We have to just see it through to the end.
Queen's Recruit#587.dst: Soupir. Inutile d'essayer de sortir d'ici. On n'a plus qu'à aller jusqu'au bout.
Queen's Recruit#587.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#588.src: What do you think? About what she said? About... forces destroying the world.
Queen's Recruit#588.dst: Tu en penses quoi? De ce qu'elle a dit? Sur... ces forces qui détruisent le monde.
Queen's Recruit#588.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#589.src: She's right. I've seen it- I know you've seen it. It's... getting worse.
Queen's Recruit#589.dst: Elle a raison. Je l'ai vu- je sais que toi aussi. Ça... empire.
Queen's Recruit#589.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#590.src: But... the recruits. The recruits. I can't get over that. It's so...
Queen's Recruit#590.dst: Mais... les recrues. Les recrues. Je n'arrive pas à m'y faire. C'est tellement...
Queen's Recruit#590.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#591.src: Let's just get down there and fight. Usual spots, right?
Queen's Recruit#591.dst: Descendons nous battre, c'est tout. Aux places habituelles, d'accord?
Queen's Recruit#591.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#593.src: No words. Let's fight. Just- just a training battle. To... test our skills.
Queen's Recruit#593.dst: Pas de mots. Battons-nous. Juste- juste un entraînement. Pour... tester nos capacités.
Queen's Recruit#593.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#594.dst: Ha. Tu as pris en force, hein?
Queen's Recruit#594.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#595.dst: Toujours pas capable de te battre, hein...
Queen's Recruit#595.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#596.src: I guess we know how tomorrow will turn out, then.
Queen's Recruit#596.dst: Je suppose qu'on sait comment ça va tourner demain, alors.
Queen's Recruit#596.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#597.src: No don't deny it. We both know I'm right.
Queen's Recruit#597.dst: Non ne le nie pas. On sait tous les deux que j'ai raison.
Queen's Recruit#597.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#598.src: No- don't deny it. We both know I'm right.
Queen's Recruit#598.dst: Non- ne le nie pas. On sait tous les deux que j'ai raison.
Queen's Recruit#598.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#599.src: She gave me a choice, you know?
Queen's Recruit#599.dst: Elle m'a laissé le choix, tu sais?
Queen's Recruit#599.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#600.src: A choice. I don't know what to do with it. And... I'm afraid of taking either option.
Queen's Recruit#600.dst: Un choix. Je ne sais pas quoi en faire. Et... j'ai peur de prendre l'une ou l'autre option.
Queen's Recruit#600.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#601.src: I... I need to think it over some more. And we both need to rest.
Queen's Recruit#601.dst: Je... je dois encore y réfléchir. Et on a besoin de repos, tous les deux.
Queen's Recruit#601.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#602.src: Huh? I... yes. I think I am. I just have a lot on my mind.
Queen's Recruit#602.dst: Hein? Je... oui. Je crois que oui. J'ai juste beaucoup de choses en tête.
Queen's Recruit#602.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#604.src: I'll... tell you in the morning. I just have a lot on my mind.
Queen's Recruit#604.dst: Je te... le dirai demain matin. J'ai juste beaucoup de choses en tête.
Queen's Recruit#604.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#605.src: Ha. You're- you're good. Oof. I'll be feeling that for... for a while.
Queen's Recruit#605.dst: Ha. Tu es- tu es redoutable. Aïe. Je vais le sentir pendant... un bon moment.
Queen's Recruit#605.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#606.src: Why did it have to come to this? Why couldn't- why couldn't we all have just been happy?
Queen's Recruit#606.dst: Pourquoi en arriver là? Pourquoi on n'a pas pu- pourquoi on n'a pas pu tous être heureux, simplement?
Queen's Recruit#606.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#607.src: He- he sent me a letter for that mission, you know. Did I tell you that? It's why I went back to Wynn.
Queen's Recruit#607.dst: Il- il m'avait envoyé une lettre pour cette mission, tu sais. Je te l'ai dit? C'est pour ça que je suis revenu à Wynn.
Queen's Recruit#607.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#608.src: And, it turns out he was already... already gone. And you were there, and I wasn't.
Queen's Recruit#608.dst: Et en fait, il était déjà... déjà parti. Et toi, tu étais là, et pas moi.
Queen's Recruit#608.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#609.src: I want to blame you for it. I want to be able to be mad, to hate you. But... I can't. I just can't.
Queen's Recruit#609.dst: Je veux t'en vouloir. Je veux pouvoir être en colère, te détester. Mais... je ne peux pas. Je n'y arrive pas.
Queen's Recruit#609.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#610.src: I wish I could've been there. I wish I could have done it better. Maybe I could have- or maybe it would've just gone the same way.
Queen's Recruit#610.dst: J'aurais voulu être là. J'aurais voulu faire mieux. Peut-être que j'aurais pu- ou peut-être que ça se serait passé pareil.
Queen's Recruit#610.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#612.src: And now we're both here- in the place we were all exiled from! But he's- he isn't. He's gone, and- and we're still here.
Queen's Recruit#612.dst: Et maintenant on est tous les deux ici- là d'où on a tous été exilés! Mais lui- lui non. Il est parti, et- et nous, on est encore là.
Queen's Recruit#612.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#613.src: ...what am I supposed to do? What are we supposed to do? About all of this?
Queen's Recruit#613.dst: ...qu'est-ce que je suis censé faire? Qu'est-ce qu'on est censés faire? De tout ça?
Queen's Recruit#613.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#615.src: I asked a lot of questions. I didn't like all the answers, but... she left me with a choice.
Queen's Recruit#615.dst: J'ai posé beaucoup de questions. Je n'ai pas aimé toutes les réponses, mais... elle m'a laissé un choix.
Queen's Recruit#615.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#616.src: I don't know what to do. I need to... to... I need to think.
Queen's Recruit#616.dst: Je ne sais pas quoi faire. J'ai besoin de... de... j'ai besoin de réfléchir.
Queen's Recruit#616.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#617.src: Give me some space, please. I'll see you in the morning.
Queen's Recruit#617.dst: Laisse-moi un peu seul, s'il te plaît. On se voit demain matin.
Queen's Recruit#617.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#618.src: Return to your room and sleep for the night.
Queen's Recruit#618.dst: Retournez dans votre chambre et dormez pour la nuit.

Queen's Recruit#619.src: Read the note Tasim left you before heading out.
Queen's Recruit#619.dst: Lisez le mot que Tasim vous a laissé avant de sortir.

Queen's Recruit#620.src: Head to Her Majesty's office for her decision.
Queen's Recruit#620.dst: Allez au bureau de Sa Majesté pour connaître sa décision.

Queen's Recruit#621.src: You've already failed, you know. You did not meet her criteria for selection.
Queen's Recruit#621.dst: Tu as déjà échoué, tu sais. Tu n'as pas rempli ses critères de sélection.

Queen's Recruit#622.src: But is dismissing you outright an error? Certainly, you're powerful. Perhaps even more so than you should be, given the circumstances.
Queen's Recruit#622.dst: Mais t'écarter d'emblée serait-il une erreur? Tu ne manques pas de puissance, certes. Peut-être même plus qu'il ne le faudrait, vu les circonstances.

Queen's Recruit#623.src: Still. You lack the drive, the perspective. The dedication. The understanding.
Queen's Recruit#623.dst: Pourtant. Il te manque l'élan, la perspective. Le dévouement. La compréhension.

Queen's Recruit#624.src: And, most critically - you're unpredictable. And that makes you dangerous.
Queen's Recruit#624.dst: Et, surtout - tu es imprévisible. Et cela fait de toi un danger.

Queen's Recruit#625.src: Ah! It seems Her Majesty and I have come to the same conclusion. Wonderful.
Queen's Recruit#625.dst: Ah! Il semble que Sa Majesté et moi soyons arrivées à la même conclusion. Merveilleux.

Queen's Recruit#626.src: So, where does that leave you? Cast out, discarded?
Queen's Recruit#626.dst: Alors, que te reste-t-il? L'exil? Le rebut?

Queen's Recruit#627.src: All the unanswered questions. Will you choose to let go? Dismiss the possibilities?
Queen's Recruit#627.dst: Toutes ces questions sans réponse. Choisiras-tu de lâcher prise? D'écarter les possibles?

Queen's Recruit#628.src: And if not? What would you do for a glimpse of the truth? For a chance of receiving answers?
Queen's Recruit#628.dst: Et sinon? Que ferais-tu pour entrevoir la vérité? Pour une chance d'obtenir des réponses?

Queen's Recruit#629.src: Hm. Whatever the case, the choice is yours. Perhaps you'll surprise me, after all! Wouldn't that be exciting?
Queen's Recruit#629.dst: Hm. Quoi qu'il en soit, le choix t'appartient. Peut-être me surprendras-tu, après tout! Ce serait palpitant, non?

Queen's Recruit#630.src: {u}, under order of Her Majesty, you are to be escorted out of Fruma, effective immediately.
Queen's Recruit#630.dst: {u}, sur ordre de Sa Majesté, on va vous escorter hors de Fruma, avec effet immédiat.
Queen's Recruit#630.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#631.src: Any defiance will be seen as an official threat against Fruma from the Wynn province. Comply, and no one will be hurt.
Queen's Recruit#631.dst: Toute résistance sera vue comme une menace officielle de la province de Wynn envers Fruma. Obéissez, et personne ne sera blessé.
Queen's Recruit#631.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#632.src: You hold no power here. This choice is not yours. You will follow orders, or face the consequences.
Queen's Recruit#632.dst: Vous n'avez aucun pouvoir ici. Ce choix n'est pas le vôtre. Obéissez aux ordres, ou subissez-en les conséquences.
Queen's Recruit#632.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#634.src: Ah. Please head to the meeting room. I will join shortly.
Queen's Recruit#634.dst: Ah. Veuillez vous rendre dans la salle de réunion. Je vous rejoins sous peu.
Queen's Recruit#634.speaker: Ragni's King

Queen's Recruit#637.src: Before you leave. You need to tell him what happened.
Queen's Recruit#637.dst: Avant que tu partes. Tu dois lui dire ce qui s'est passé.
Queen's Recruit#637.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#640.src: The rest must be waiting up ahead...
Queen's Recruit#640.dst: Les autres doivent attendre plus loin...
Queen's Recruit#640.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#641.src: Hm... that's a good question. Maybe not?
Queen's Recruit#641.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#642.src: But you'll do fine. You're good at fighting! I've seen you out there.
Queen's Recruit#642.dst: Mais tu t'en sortiras. Tu sais te battre! J'ai vu ce que tu sais faire!
Queen's Recruit#642.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#643.src: Either way, it'll be nice to finally spar against you.
Queen's Recruit#643.dst: En tout cas, ce sera sympa de pouvoir enfin t'affronter à l'entraînement.
Queen's Recruit#643.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#645.dst: Je ne sais pas trop à quoi m'attendre.

Queen's Recruit#646.src: It has to be a trick, right?

Queen's Recruit#648.src: Tasim, I really need to te-
Queen's Recruit#648.dst: Tasim, il faut vraiment que je te di-
