Shrouded in Mist#050.dst: Rurie... son histoire pourrait expliquer ce que-
Shrouded in Mist#050.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#051.src: Yes, my friend, I was just thinking the very same thing. Well well, new folk, if what you're saying is true, the Canopy might just be able to assist!
Shrouded in Mist#051.dst: Oui, mon ami, je pensais exactement la même chose. Eh bien, les nouveaux, si vous dites vrai, la Canopée pourrait bien vous aider!
Shrouded in Mist#051.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#052.src: I may have information regarding your allies.
Shrouded in Mist#052.dst: J'ai peut-être des informations sur vos alliés.
Shrouded in Mist#052.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#054.src: Ah- but! But but but, see - trust is a currency here in the {p}. I can't just spill all my secrets at once, can I?
Shrouded in Mist#054.dst: Ah- mais! Mais mais mais - ici, dans {p}, la confiance est une monnaie. Je ne livre pas tous mes secrets d'un coup, si?
Shrouded in Mist#054.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#055.src: And if you'd like to earn our trust... I'll need you to, ah, deal with some things for me.
Shrouded in Mist#055.dst: Et si vous voulez gagner notre confiance... il faudra, ah, vous occuper de quelques affaires pour moi.
Shrouded in Mist#055.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#057.src: Oh, nothing too difficult... I'll tell you on one condition! I'll be taking one of you with me as leverage! Eenie, meenie, money... you, little man!
Shrouded in Mist#057.dst: Oh, rien de bien difficile... Je vous le dirai à une condition! J'emmène l'un de vous en garantie! Am, stram, gram... toi, petit bonhomme!
Shrouded in Mist#057.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#059.src: You, indeed! Worry not, for I'll be sure to keep you safe, but... well, you understand the need, yes?
Shrouded in Mist#059.dst: Toi-même! N'aie crainte, je veillerai sur toi, mais... enfin, vous comprenez la nécessité, oui?
Shrouded in Mist#059.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#060.src: We can't! We can't lose... we can't lose anyone else. Please, there has to be something-
Shrouded in Mist#060.dst: Non! On ne peut perdre... on ne peut perdre personne d'autre. Pitié, il doit y avoir un moyen-
Shrouded in Mist#060.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#061.src: Sui... it's... fine. I don't think we have a choice. Just... do what they ask of you.
Shrouded in Mist#061.dst: Sui... ça... va aller. Je crois qu'on n'a pas le choix. Faites juste... ce qu'ils vous demandent.
Shrouded in Mist#061.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#062.src: Goodness, so melodramatic! Come on, I'm a trustworthy fella! You've got nothing to worry about from me.
Shrouded in Mist#062.dst: Ciel, que de mélodrame! Allons, je suis quelqu'un de fiable! Vous n'avez rien à craindre de moi.
Shrouded in Mist#062.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#064.src: Ah-mazing! I'm glad you chose to be reasonable. In that case - I'll need the remaining two of you to go and sabotage three military structures.
Shrouded in Mist#064.dst: Ma-gnifique! Ravi que vous soyez raisonnables. Dans ce cas - vous deux, vous irez saboter trois installations militaires.
Shrouded in Mist#064.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#065.src: Now, go and say your goodbyes, then come grab the list from me!
Shrouded in Mist#065.dst: Allez, faites vos adieux, puis venez chercher la liste!
Shrouded in Mist#065.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#066.src: Talk to Rurie before heading out at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#066.dst: Parlez à Rurie avant de partir, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#067.src: Hey. You'll be fine. I'll be fine.
Shrouded in Mist#067.dst: Hé. Ça ira pour toi. Ça ira pour moi.
Shrouded in Mist#067.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#068.src: I think we can trust them for now, at least. Not like we have an alternative...
Shrouded in Mist#068.dst: Je crois qu'on peut leur faire confiance, pour l'instant. On n'a pas d'autre choix...
Shrouded in Mist#068.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#069.src: We really... don't have a choice, do we? We, we need their support.
Shrouded in Mist#069.dst: On n'a vraiment... pas le choix, hein? On, on a besoin de leur soutien.
Shrouded in Mist#069.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#070.src: I just... hope Yusanu will be safe.
Shrouded in Mist#070.dst: J'espère juste... que Yusanu ne craindra rien.
Shrouded in Mist#070.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#071.src: Ugh... Captain's being reckless as usual...
Shrouded in Mist#071.dst: Pff... Le capitaine est imprudent, comme toujours...
Shrouded in Mist#071.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#072.src: Have we finished with the heartfelt goodbyes? Excellent. Truly, I am glad you took me up on this generous offer.
Shrouded in Mist#072.dst: Fini, les adieux déchirants? Excellent. Vraiment, je suis ravi que vous ayez accepté ma généreuse offre.
Shrouded in Mist#072.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#073.src: Don't worry about your little friend over there! He'll be safe and sound amongst our Canopy.
Shrouded in Mist#073.dst: Ne vous en faites pas pour votre petit camarade! Il sera sain et sauf parmi la Canopée.
Shrouded in Mist#073.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#074.src: ...and how can we trust you? To not... hurt him?
Shrouded in Mist#074.dst: ...et comment savoir que tu ne... lui feras pas de mal?
Shrouded in Mist#074.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#075.src: Ah, isn't that the issue at the heart of it all? You can't. But as I said, trust is valuable in these woods. That must go both ways!
Shrouded in Mist#075.dst: Ah, n'est-ce pas là le coeur du problème? Vous ne pouvez pas. Mais je l'ai dit, la confiance est précieuse dans ces bois. Dans les deux sens!
Shrouded in Mist#075.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#076.src: Well, newbies! You've a list of the structures I need you to sabotage, so it really should be a simple task.
Shrouded in Mist#076.dst: Bien, les bleus! Vous avez la liste des installations à saboter, ça devrait donc être simple.
Shrouded in Mist#076.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#077.src: Just find a way to... disable them! However you manage it, I can't say I really care - so long as it gets done!
Shrouded in Mist#077.dst: Trouvez un moyen de... les mettre hors service! Comment, ça m'est égal - du moment que c'est fait!
Shrouded in Mist#077.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#078.src: Why are you getting us to do

Shrouded in Mist#080.src: Why, because it's a golden opportunity! The work needs doing, and you need a way to prove yourselves...
Shrouded in Mist#080.dst: Mais parce que c'est une occasion en or! Le travail doit être fait, et vous devez faire vos preuves...
Shrouded in Mist#080.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#081.src: So why not? It's less work for me to do, so I'm not complaining!
Shrouded in Mist#081.dst: Alors pourquoi pas? Ça me fait moins de travail, je ne m'en plains pas!
Shrouded in Mist#081.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#082.src: Newbies! That's what you are, isn't it? New to the woods, new to the world...
Shrouded in Mist#082.dst: Des bleus! C'est bien ça, non? Nouveaux dans ces bois, nouveaux au monde...
Shrouded in Mist#082.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#083.src: ...maybe new to Fruma, even? Ah ah, wipe that expression of shock off your face! I won't tell if you don't either.
Shrouded in Mist#083.dst: ...peut-être même nouveaux à Fruma? Ah ah, efface-moi cet air choqué! Je ne dirai rien si tu te tais aussi.
Shrouded in Mist#083.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#085.src: Once you're done, find me back here! Just don't take too long, eh? Wouldn't want to get bored!
Shrouded in Mist#085.dst: Une fois fini, revenez me voir ici! Mais ne traînez pas, hein? Je m'ennuierais!
Shrouded in Mist#085.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#086.src: Ta ta, newbies! Good luck out there! And just a word of advice - stay on your guard. You never know what the mists may be hiding.
Shrouded in Mist#086.dst: Tchao, les bleus! Bonne chance! Et un petit conseil - restez sur vos gardes. On ne sait jamais ce que cache la brume.
Shrouded in Mist#086.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#087.src: Select the structure to sabotage using the checklist.
Shrouded in Mist#087.dst: Choisissez l'installation à saboter grâce à la liste.

Shrouded in Mist#088.src: Still a bit lost? Just use your taskbook to find the things I need broken!
Shrouded in Mist#088.dst: Encore perdus? Consultez votre carnet de quêtes pour voir ce qu'il faut casser!
Shrouded in Mist#088.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#089.src: Head to the watchtower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and sabotage it using a spell.
Shrouded in Mist#089.dst: Rendez-vous à la tour de guet en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] et sabotez-la avec un sort.

Shrouded in Mist#090.src: So is this... the place? "Military... Watchtower..." I guess so.
Shrouded in Mist#090.dst: C'est donc... ici? "Tour de guet... militaire..." On dirait bien.
Shrouded in Mist#090.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#091.src: Those supports look rather unstable, don't they? I wonder...
Shrouded in Mist#091.dst: Ces supports ont l'air plutôt instables, non? Je me demande...
Shrouded in Mist#091.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#092.src: C-can you deal with them, please?
Shrouded in Mist#092.dst: Tu p-peux t'occuper d'eux, s'il te plaît?
Shrouded in Mist#092.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#093.src: Huh?! We're under attack - it must be the Canopy!
Shrouded in Mist#093.dst: Hein?! On nous attaque - ce doit être la Canopée!
Shrouded in Mist#093.speaker: Watchtower Guard

Shrouded in Mist#095.src: Let's just get this over with.
Shrouded in Mist#095.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#096.src: Check the book, where should we go next?
Shrouded in Mist#096.dst: Regarde le carnet, on va où ensuite?
Shrouded in Mist#096.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#098.src: Head to the water pump at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and sabotage it.
Shrouded in Mist#098.dst: Rendez-vous à la pompe à eau en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] et sabotez-la.

Shrouded in Mist#099.dst: Bon, va pour la pompe à eau...
Shrouded in Mist#099.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#100.src: I think we can work together for this one. Go, um, blast some weak spots on the structure, and I'll... see if I can reverse the water flow.
Shrouded in Mist#100.dst: Je pense qu'on peut s'y mettre à deux. Va, euh, frapper les points faibles de la structure, et moi... je vais tenter d'inverser le flux d'eau.
Shrouded in Mist#100.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#101.src: Let's just... get rid of this hunk of junk.
Shrouded in Mist#101.dst: Débarrassons-nous... de ce tas de ferraille.
Shrouded in Mist#101.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#102.src: You, um, should try to blast some of the weak points with your magic.
Shrouded in Mist#102.dst: Tu devrais, euh, frapper quelques points faibles avec ta magie.
Shrouded in Mist#102.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#103.src: Did you manage to apply some pressure on the pipes?
Shrouded in Mist#103.dst: Tu as réussi à mettre les tuyaux sous pression?
Shrouded in Mist#103.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#104.src: Good, then it's... time for my part, I guess. Um, come talk to me when you're ready.
Shrouded in Mist#104.dst: Bien, alors c'est... mon tour, je suppose. Euh, viens me parler quand tu veux.
Shrouded in Mist#104.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#106.src: Okay... okay. Breathe. I need to... focus.
Shrouded in Mist#106.dst: D'accord... d'accord. Respire. Je dois... me concentrer.
Shrouded in Mist#106.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#107.src: After... after, um, everything that- that's happened, I've been... struggling with my cur-... ugh. You get what I mean.
Shrouded in Mist#107.dst: Après... après, euh, tout ce qui- qui s'est passé, j'ai du mal... à maîtriser ma malé-... pff. Tu vois ce que je veux dire.
Shrouded in Mist#107.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#108.src: It all feels so... so... hopeless! We've lost everyone, and now- now we've lost Yusanu too, and I... I couldn't do anything!
Shrouded in Mist#108.dst: Tout semble si... si... désespéré! On a perdu tout le monde, et maintenant- maintenant Yusanu aussi, et je... je n'ai rien pu faire!
Shrouded in Mist#108.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#109.src: And the last thing we did before was... argue! And now, he's... he's safe, probably, but... I don't know. I wish we hadn't.
Shrouded in Mist#109.dst: Et la dernière chose qu'on a faite, c'est... se disputer! Maintenant, il est... sain et sauf, sûrement, mais... je ne sais pas. Je regrette.
Shrouded in Mist#109.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#110.src: Every time I think about- about any of it, I get so... angry! And the swirling ocean around me starts raging more and more and more, and... and...
Shrouded in Mist#110.dst: Chaque fois que je pense à- à tout ça, je deviens si... furieuse! Et l'océan qui tourbillonne autour de moi se déchaîne de plus en plus, et... et...
Shrouded in Mist#110.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#111.src: I'm scared, {u}. I'm scared for Mora... Syndra... Rex, Zeph, the whole Steel Feather- for all of them! And I... there's nothing I can do...
Shrouded in Mist#111.dst: J'ai peur, {u}. Peur pour Mora... Syndra... Rex, Zeph, toute la Plume d'acier- pour eux tous! Et je... je ne peux rien faire...
Shrouded in Mist#111.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#112.src: What if... what if they're all gone? And, and, and it's just us, forever...?
Shrouded in Mist#112.dst: Et si... s'ils avaient tous disparu? Et, et, et qu'on restait seuls, pour toujours...?
Shrouded in Mist#112.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#113.src: I... I know, {u}, I know! I'm... I'm trying, okay?!
Shrouded in Mist#113.dst: Je... je sais, {u}, je sais! J'essaie... j'essaie, d'accord?!
Shrouded in Mist#113.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#115.src: I don't know if I, ha, have any left. Everything's... moving so fast...
Shrouded in Mist#115.dst: Je ne sais pas s'il m'en, ha, reste encore. Tout va... si vite...
Shrouded in Mist#115.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#116.src: I... I never wanted any of this. I just... I just wanted to live...
Shrouded in Mist#116.dst: Je... je n'ai jamais voulu tout ça. Je voulais... je voulais juste vivre...
Shrouded in Mist#116.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#117.src: Sigh... okay. Sui, focus. You can do this.
Shrouded in Mist#117.dst: Soupir... bon. Sui, concentre-toi. Tu peux le faire.
Shrouded in Mist#117.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#119.src: That's... I don't... how did I...
Shrouded in Mist#119.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#120.src: It... the ocean, it... stopped. I pulled at it, and it... it stopped moving, and...
Shrouded in Mist#120.dst: Il... l'océan, il... s'est arrêté. J'ai tiré dessus, et il... il ne bougeait plus, et...
Shrouded in Mist#120.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#121.src: There's... there's no time to, to think about it. It worked, so... so that's good.
Shrouded in Mist#121.dst: Pas... pas le temps d'y, d'y réfléchir. Ça a marché, alors... alors c'est bien.
Shrouded in Mist#121.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#122.src: Just... check the book, what's our next stop?
Shrouded in Mist#122.dst: Regarde... regarde le carnet, quelle est la prochaine étape?
Shrouded in Mist#122.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#123.src: I... I think that was the last one. Let's go tell Rurie that it's, um, done.
Shrouded in Mist#123.dst: Je... je crois que c'était la dernière. Allons dire à Rurie que c'est, euh, fait.
Shrouded in Mist#123.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#124.src: Head to the mining drill at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#124.dst: Rendez-vous à la foreuse minière en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#126.src: It looks... durable. Like, um, it'll be hard to just... break. We need to find another way...
Shrouded in Mist#126.dst: Elle a l'air... solide. Genre, euh, dure à... casser. Il faut trouver un autre moyen...
Shrouded in Mist#126.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#127.src: There- there isn't any water nearby. So, so if any soldiers show up... please, can you deal with them?
Shrouded in Mist#127.dst: Il- il n'y a pas d'eau près d'ici. Alors, alors si des soldats arrivent... tu peux t'en occuper, s'il te plaît?
Shrouded in Mist#127.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#128.src: Aha, saboteurs! You won't get away with damaging the crown's property, not on my watch!
Shrouded in Mist#128.dst: Ah ah, des saboteurs! On n'abîme pas les biens de la Couronne impunément, pas sous ma garde!
Shrouded in Mist#128.speaker: Mistwoods Captain

Shrouded in Mist#129.src: Um... good job, {u}. I didn't think about breaking the controls...
Shrouded in Mist#129.dst: Euh... bien joué, {u}. Je n'avais pas pensé à casser les commandes...
Shrouded in Mist#129.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#130.src: We should check the book, and find our next stop.
Shrouded in Mist#130.dst: On devrait regarder le carnet pour trouver la prochaine étape.
Shrouded in Mist#130.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#131.src: Was that the last one? Let's head back to Rurie and... and tell him it's done.
Shrouded in Mist#131.dst: C'était la dernière? Retournons voir Rurie et... et disons-lui que c'est fait.
Shrouded in Mist#131.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#132.src: Return to Rurie at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and discuss the next step.
Shrouded in Mist#132.dst: Retournez voir Rurie en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] pour parler de la suite.

Shrouded in Mist#133.src: Well well! So the newbies return! Tell me, how did you find your trial?
Shrouded in Mist#133.dst: Tiens, tiens! Les bleus sont de retour! Dites-moi, comment s'est passée l'épreuve?
Shrouded in Mist#133.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#134.src: We did what you asked, so... so tell us about our friends, already!
Shrouded in Mist#134.dst: On a fait ce que tu voulais, alors... alors parle-nous de nos amis, enfin!
Shrouded in Mist#134.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#135.src: Ah ah ah! Not so fast! I'm afraid you're not done quite yet!
Shrouded in Mist#135.dst: Ah ah ah! Pas si vite! Je crains que vous n'ayez pas encore fini!
Shrouded in Mist#135.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#137.src: Deadly serious, I fear! That, dear friends, was but the first part of your task.
Shrouded in Mist#137.dst: Très sérieux, hélas! Ceci, chers amis, n'était que la première partie de votre tâche.
Shrouded in Mist#137.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#138.src: Oh, but on the contrary! I received word immediately once you had done the deed.
Shrouded in Mist#138.dst: Oh, mais au contraire! J'ai été prévenu dès que vous avez fait le travail.
Shrouded in Mist#138.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#139.src: Ugh... we had an agreement! You can't just-
Shrouded in Mist#139.dst: Pff... on avait un accord! Tu ne peux pas-
Shrouded in Mist#139.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#140.src: But I can. If you want our support, you'll do what we ask. If it is any consolation, this is the last I will ask of you before our deal is concluded.
Shrouded in Mist#140.dst: Oh si, je peux. Si vous voulez notre soutien, vous ferez ce qu'on demande. Si ça peut vous consoler, c'est ma dernière requête avant que notre marché soit conclu.
Shrouded in Mist#140.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#142.src: I would ask of you to kindly... ehm, transport an {p} citizen here. Do make sure you aren't spotted by anyone else! That could cause... issues.
Shrouded in Mist#142.dst: Je vous prierais de bien vouloir... hem, amener ici un citoyen de {p}. Surtout, que personne ne vous voie! Cela pourrait causer... des soucis.
Shrouded in Mist#142.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#144.src: Ah! Allow me to rephrase. You need to kidnap them.
Shrouded in Mist#144.dst: Ah! Permettez-moi de reformuler. Vous devez l'enlever.
Shrouded in Mist#144.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#146.src: Yes, indeed! Kidnap them, bring them here, and we will deal with the rest.
Shrouded in Mist#146.dst: Oui, exactement! Enlevez-le, amenez-le ici, et nous nous chargerons du reste.
Shrouded in Mist#146.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#147.src: You want us to just... just snatch a random citizen from their home? And, and what do you mean "deal with the rest?"
Shrouded in Mist#147.dst: Tu veux qu'on... qu'on arrache un citoyen à sa maison? Et, et ça veut dire quoi, "se charger du reste"?
Shrouded in Mist#147.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#148.src: No questions, young lady! Not if you'd like to ensure the safety of your friend, that is.
Shrouded in Mist#148.dst: Pas de questions, jeune demoiselle! Pas si tu tiens à la sécurité de ton ami, en tout cas.
Shrouded in Mist#148.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#150.src: You didn't even tell us who we're looking for!
Shrouded in Mist#150.dst: Tu ne nous as même pas dit qui chercher!
Shrouded in Mist#150.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#151.src: Ahaha, apologies, my mistake! You'll be looking for the man named Nisen. Bring him here, but don't take too long!
Shrouded in Mist#151.dst: Ahaha, pardon, quel étourdi! Vous cherchez un homme du nom de Nisen. Amenez-le ici, mais ne traînez pas!
Shrouded in Mist#151.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#152.src: Nisen. Fine. {u}, let's... talk about this outside the cave.
Shrouded in Mist#152.dst: Nisen. Bien. {u}, allons... en parler hors de la grotte.
Shrouded in Mist#152.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#153.src: Leave the cave and discuss the plan with Sui at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#153.dst: Sortez de la grotte et parlez du plan avec Sui en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#155.src: This... this is just getting ridiculous.
Shrouded in Mist#155.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#156.src: We, we need to find a way to get Yusanu back, and... and get out of here.
Shrouded in Mist#156.dst: Il, il faut trouver un moyen de récupérer Yusanu, et... et de partir d'ici.
Shrouded in Mist#156.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#157.src: I know, I know, I know! And if we start looking, they'll, they'll notice.
Shrouded in Mist#157.dst: Je sais, je sais, je sais! Et si on se met à chercher, ils, ils le remarqueront.
Shrouded in Mist#157.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#158.src: I'm... sick and tired of following that clown's orders. But you're right...
Shrouded in Mist#158.dst: J'en ai... assez d'obéir à ce clown. Mais tu as raison...
Shrouded in Mist#158.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#159.src: It's just... weird. This last task. I don't get it.
Shrouded in Mist#159.dst: C'est juste... bizarre. Cette dernière tâche. Je ne comprends pas.
Shrouded in Mist#159.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#160.src: Even if Rurie's out of his mind... I don't see him just- just killing an innocent person. Especially if they're, um, a resistance group.
Shrouded in Mist#160.dst: Même si Rurie est complètement fou... je ne le vois pas tuer- tuer un innocent comme ça. Surtout s'ils sont, euh, un groupe de résistance.
Shrouded in Mist#160.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#161.src: Ugh. I don't know. Maybe if we investigate this Nisen person, we'll... figure out Rurie's reasoning.
Shrouded in Mist#161.dst: Pff. Je ne sais pas. Si on enquête sur ce Nisen, on... comprendra peut-être les raisons de Rurie.
Shrouded in Mist#161.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#163.src: Head to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and locate Nisen.
Shrouded in Mist#163.dst: Rendez-vous à {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] et trouvez Nisen.

Shrouded in Mist#165.src: Phew. Getting up here really wasn't the easiest... the Red Fox back in Auburn really, ha, pales in comparison.
Shrouded in Mist#165.dst: Ouf. Monter jusqu'ici n'a pas été simple... le Renard Roux d'Auburn, ha, fait pâle figure à côté.
Shrouded in Mist#165.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#166.src: I've been trying to get information on Nisen, but... people don't seem to like me much.
Shrouded in Mist#166.dst: J'ai essayé d'avoir des infos sur Nisen, mais... les gens n'ont pas l'air de m'aimer.
Shrouded in Mist#166.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#167.src: Maybe you'll have some better luck?
Shrouded in Mist#167.dst: Tu auras peut-être plus de chance?
Shrouded in Mist#167.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#169.dst: Je suis un peu occupé, alors...
Shrouded in Mist#169.speaker: Shu

Shrouded in Mist#172.dst: La brume est un peu épaisse.
Shrouded in Mist#172.speaker: Shu

Shrouded in Mist#180.src: ...I don't...see it. You haven't got one- Er. I. I mean. Nothing. No. Definitely, uh...definitely not.
Shrouded in Mist#180.dst: ...je ne...le vois pas. Tu n'en as pas- Euh. Je. Enfin. Rien. Non. Absolument, euh...absolument pas.
Shrouded in Mist#180.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#181.src: I can't- look, I'm really not supposed to be talking to you at all, and- Wait, that counts as- urgh!
Shrouded in Mist#181.dst: Je ne peux pas- écoute, je ne suis pas du tout censé te parler, et- Attends, ça compte comme- argh!
Shrouded in Mist#181.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#183.src: ...I'm. I. You. ...ugh, I'm no good at this.
Shrouded in Mist#183.dst: ...je suis. Je. Tu. ...pff, je suis nul pour ça.
Shrouded in Mist#183.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#184.src: ...well. ...sorry, Nisen... I. I do know. I shouldn't be telling you, but I do know. Please don't hurt me.
Shrouded in Mist#184.dst: ...bon. ...pardon, Nisen... je. Je sais. Je ne devrais pas te le dire, mais je sais. Ne me fais pas de mal.
Shrouded in Mist#184.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#185.src: You need to take the zipline north-west. Not the one that goes upwards, though.
Shrouded in Mist#185.dst: Il faut prendre la tyrolienne au nord-ouest. Mais pas celle qui monte.
Shrouded in Mist#185.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#190.src: Search Nisen's house for any [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] clues regarding him.
Shrouded in Mist#190.dst: Fouillez la maison de Nisen en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] à la recherche d'indices sur lui.

Shrouded in Mist#191.src: Um, let's hope he's not home...
Shrouded in Mist#191.dst: Euh, espérons qu'il ne soit pas là...
Shrouded in Mist#191.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#192.src: That's odd... the latest entry's dated from weeks ago.
Shrouded in Mist#192.dst: Bizarre... la dernière entrée date d'il y a des semaines.
Shrouded in Mist#192.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#193.src: It's like they stopped writing them abruptly...
Shrouded in Mist#193.dst: Comme si on avait arrêté d'écrire d'un coup...
Shrouded in Mist#193.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#194.dst: Quittez vite la maison de Nisen en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#196.src: Eep! That must be Nisen! We need to think of an excuse...
Shrouded in Mist#196.dst: Hiii! Ça doit être Nisen! Il nous faut une excuse...
Shrouded in Mist#196.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#197.src: Excuse me? What are you doing in my abode?
Shrouded in Mist#197.dst: Pardon? Que faites-vous dans ma demeure?
Shrouded in Mist#197.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#198.src: If I am not mistaken, stumbling into other people's abodes is not a custom.
Shrouded in Mist#198.dst: Sauf erreur de ma part, entrer par mégarde chez autrui n'est pas une coutume.
Shrouded in Mist#198.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#199.src: Oh... I- I'm so sorry! I- I- we- we thought this was the... bakery.
Shrouded in Mist#199.dst: Oh... je- je suis désolée! Je- je- on- on croyait que c'était la... boulangerie.
Shrouded in Mist#199.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#201.src: Oh. Yes, wrong building. The bakery is down at ground level.
Shrouded in Mist#201.dst: Ah. Oui, mauvais bâtiment. La boulangerie est en bas, au niveau du sol.
Shrouded in Mist#201.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#202.src: Oh! Thank you for the directions. We are... so sorry for the misunderstanding.
Shrouded in Mist#202.dst: Oh! Merci pour l'indication. Nous sommes... vraiment désolés du malentendu.
Shrouded in Mist#202.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#203.src: Regroup with Sui at the main square at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#203.dst: Rejoignez Sui sur la place principale en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#204.dst: Je vous prie de partir, maintenant.
Shrouded in Mist#204.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#205.src: That was close... I'm, um, surprised he believed us.
Shrouded in Mist#205.dst: C'était moins une... Je suis, euh, surprise qu'il nous ait crus.
Shrouded in Mist#205.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#207.src: I- I panicked, okay! But it worked, didn't it?
Shrouded in Mist#207.dst: J- j'ai paniqué, d'accord! Mais ça a marché, non?
Shrouded in Mist#207.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#208.src: He was... surprisingly chatty. That's a nice change compared to everyone else.
Shrouded in Mist#208.dst: Il était... étonnamment bavard. Ça change agréablement des autres.
Shrouded in Mist#208.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#209.src: Though, um, he was a bit... odd. He didn't seem too certain about his answers...
Shrouded in Mist#209.dst: Mais, euh, il était un peu... bizarre. Il ne semblait pas très sûr de ses réponses...
Shrouded in Mist#209.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#210.src: I don't know. What are you thinking? Any theories?
Shrouded in Mist#210.dst: Je ne sais pas. Tu en penses quoi? Une théorie?
Shrouded in Mist#210.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#211.dst: On lui a lavé le cerveau.

Shrouded in Mist#212.src: I... was thinking the same thing. It'd explain the diary entries stopping abruptly...
Shrouded in Mist#212.dst: Je... pensais la même chose. Ça expliquerait que le journal s'arrête d'un coup...
Shrouded in Mist#212.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#213.dst: Il est peut-être juste comme ça.

Shrouded in Mist#214.src: Maybe... I guess he could be. I might just be jumping to conclusions.
Shrouded in Mist#214.dst: Peut-être... oui, ça se pourrait. Je tire peut-être des conclusions hâtives.
Shrouded in Mist#214.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#215.src: Uh... let's workshop that one a little.
Shrouded in Mist#215.dst: Euh... creusons un peu cette idée.
Shrouded in Mist#215.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#216.src: Look, I managed to snag a schedule off his bedside table.
Shrouded in Mist#216.dst: Regarde, j'ai pu piquer un emploi du temps sur sa table de chevet.
Shrouded in Mist#216.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#217.src: Listen to this. "Deliver hunting tools from weaponsmith through southern exit at noon."
Shrouded in Mist#217.dst: Écoute ça. "Livrer outils de chasse de l'armurier par la sortie sud à midi."
Shrouded in Mist#217.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#218.src: It's weird, right? Something's definitely off with him... but still, kidnapping him and handing him off to some... some random bird-man! I don't like it.
Shrouded in Mist#218.dst: C'est bizarre, non? Il a clairement un souci... mais quand même, l'enlever et le livrer à un... un homme-oiseau quelconque! Ça ne me plaît pas.
Shrouded in Mist#218.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#219.src: But... we don't have much of a choice. Let's camp out outside the southern gate and wait...
Shrouded in Mist#219.dst: Mais... on n'a pas trop le choix. Postons-nous devant la porte sud et attendons...
Shrouded in Mist#219.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#222.src: Guess we'll just have to wait...
Shrouded in Mist#222.dst: Il n'y a plus qu'à attendre...
Shrouded in Mist#222.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#223.src: I... ha, I've been feeling really out of my depth, here. I've never had to do this much without... um, without their support.
Shrouded in Mist#223.dst: Je... ha, je me sens vraiment dépassée, ici. Je n'ai jamais eu à faire autant sans... euh, sans leur soutien.
Shrouded in Mist#223.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#224.src: But... you're here to help, so. Um. Thanks for- for sticking with me. I... I don't think I'd have made it this far without you.
Shrouded in Mist#224.dst: Mais... tu es là pour m'aider, alors. Euh. Merci de- de rester avec moi. Je... je ne serais pas allée si loin sans toi.
Shrouded in Mist#224.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#227.src: Um... I think it worked, though. Can you help me?
Shrouded in Mist#227.dst: Euh... mais je crois que ça a marché. Tu m'aides?
Shrouded in Mist#227.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#228.src: That was... easier than I expected it to be.
Shrouded in Mist#228.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#229.src: I kind of just, um, landed on top of him? And... and here we are.
Shrouded in Mist#229.dst: Je lui suis, euh, un peu tombée dessus? Et... et voilà.
Shrouded in Mist#229.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#230.src: We should... probably get moving. I don't want anyone to- to see us!
Shrouded in Mist#230.dst: On devrait... sans doute bouger. Je ne veux pas qu'on- qu'on nous voie!
Shrouded in Mist#230.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#231.src: Um! Control is... maybe not the right word. I... ha, I tried to freeze him. So... still working on it. I guess.
Shrouded in Mist#231.dst: Euh! Maîtriser n'est... peut-être pas le mot. J'ai... ha, j'ai essayé de le geler. Donc... je m'entraîne encore. Je crois.
Shrouded in Mist#231.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#232.src: ......how are we going to move him?
Shrouded in Mist#232.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#233.src: So, how do we carry him?

Shrouded in Mist#234.src: Um! I... didn't think about that.
Shrouded in Mist#234.dst: Euh! Je... n'y avais pas pensé.
Shrouded in Mist#234.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#235.src: Well well, newbies! Looks like you could use a hand!
Shrouded in Mist#235.dst: Tiens, tiens, les bleus! Besoin d'un coup de main?
Shrouded in Mist#235.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#236.src: Aah! Wh- where did you come from?!
Shrouded in Mist#236.dst: Aah! D- d'où tu sors, toi?!
Shrouded in Mist#236.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#237.src: Why, from the trees, of course! I see you've managed to subdue the good mister Nisen over here, well done, well done.
Shrouded in Mist#237.dst: Mais des arbres, voyons! Je vois que vous avez maîtrisé ce bon monsieur Nisen, bravo, bravo.
Shrouded in Mist#237.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#238.src: ...we've done everything you've asked for. Now- now tell us what you know!!
Shrouded in Mist#238.dst: ...on a fait tout ce que tu as demandé. Maintenant- maintenant dis-nous ce que tu sais!!
Shrouded in Mist#238.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#239.src: Oh, dear, you thought you two were done? Ha! Ahahaha!
Shrouded in Mist#239.dst: Oh, mes pauvres, vous pensiez avoir fini? Ha! Ahahaha!
Shrouded in Mist#239.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#241.src: Kidding! Kidding, kidding- goodness, the looks on your faces! What's a little practical joke between friends, eh?
Shrouded in Mist#241.dst: Je plaisante! Je plaisante, je plaisante- ciel, vos têtes! Ce n'est qu'une petite farce entre amis, hein?
Shrouded in Mist#241.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#242.src: Fine! Fine, fine, I get it! Jeez, lady...
Shrouded in Mist#242.dst: D'accord! D'accord, d'accord, compris! Ben dis donc, madame...
Shrouded in Mist#242.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#243.src: I'll cut it with the jokes... for now. Good news! You've passed the test!
Shrouded in Mist#243.dst: J'arrête les blagues... pour l'instant. Bonne nouvelle! Vous avez réussi l'épreuve!
Shrouded in Mist#243.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#245.src: Yes, yes, settle down, I will tell you. Give me a moment! Goodness. You're an impatient one, aren't you?
Shrouded in Mist#245.dst: Oui, oui, du calme, je vais vous le dire. Laissez-moi une seconde! Ciel. Tu es bien impatiente, toi, hein?
Shrouded in Mist#245.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#246.src: I'll be bringing you two to the Canopy! But, ah, one little precaution- I'll have to blindfold you till we arrive. Just a security measure!
Shrouded in Mist#246.dst: Je vous emmène tous les deux à la Canopée! Mais, ah, une petite précaution- je dois vous bander les yeux jusqu'à l'arrivée. Simple mesure de sécurité!
Shrouded in Mist#246.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#247.src: Ugh... you know what, I don't even care anymore. Just... bring us to Yusanu.
Shrouded in Mist#247.dst: Pff... tu sais quoi, je m'en fiche, maintenant. Emmène-nous... juste à Yusanu.
Shrouded in Mist#247.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#249.src: Ugh! Fine fine fine! But hurry up.
Shrouded in Mist#249.dst: Pff! D'accord, d'accord! Mais faites vite.
Shrouded in Mist#249.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#250.src: Rurie, care to explain yourself? Why did you bring these outsiders here?
Shrouded in Mist#250.dst: Rurie, tu veux bien t'expliquer? Pourquoi as-tu amené ces étrangers ici?
Shrouded in Mist#250.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#252.src: Ah, you know how it is, Fuhue! I was oh so bored on patrol this morning! You lot aren't exactly the life of the party..
Shrouded in Mist#252.dst: Ah, tu sais ce que c'est, Fuhue! Je m'ennuyais tellement en patrouille ce matin! Vous n'êtes pas vraiment des boute-en-train..
Shrouded in Mist#252.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#253.src: You know Azael has clear rules on recruiting. Did you file the necessary paperwork? Because I didn't see anything on my desk regarding this.
Shrouded in Mist#253.dst: Tu sais qu'Azael a des règles claires sur le recrutement. As-tu rempli les formulaires requis? Parce que je n'ai rien vu passer sur mon bureau.
Shrouded in Mist#253.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#254.src: The... ah, the paperwork was real? I always thought it was something you were making up for the fun of it.
Shrouded in Mist#254.dst: Les... ah, les formulaires existent vraiment? J'ai toujours cru que tu les inventais pour t'amuser.
Shrouded in Mist#254.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#255.src: No. We have the protocols in place for a reason, Captain Rurie. Will you find the time to review them yourself, or must I have Captain Cileon run you through them?
Shrouded in Mist#255.dst: Non. Les protocoles existent pour une raison, capitaine Rurie. Prendras-tu le temps de les revoir toi-même, ou dois-je demander au capitaine Cileon de te les expliquer?
Shrouded in Mist#255.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#256.src: Yes, yes, I understand the importance- though, I believe Cileon shares my views on the protocols. Isn't that right, Cileon?
Shrouded in Mist#256.dst: Oui, oui, j'en comprends l'importance- cela dit, je crois que Cileon partage mon avis sur les protocoles. N'est-ce pas, Cileon?
Shrouded in Mist#256.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#258.src: H- hey! Don't just act like, like we aren't right here!
Shrouded in Mist#258.dst: H- hé! Ne faites pas comme si, comme si on n'était pas là!
Shrouded in Mist#258.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#259.src: Cileon! That is also against our protocols. We wouldn't want to leave a body for the crown to find, we have far simpler forms of disposal.
Shrouded in Mist#259.dst: Cileon! Ça aussi, c'est contraire aux protocoles. Pas question de laisser un corps à la Couronne, nous avons des méthodes bien plus simples.
Shrouded in Mist#259.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#260.src: And of course, we need to torture any necessary information out of them first - I have heard this a dozen times over.
Shrouded in Mist#260.dst: Et bien sûr, il faut d'abord leur arracher les infos nécessaires sous la torture - je l'ai entendu une bonne douzaine de fois.
Shrouded in Mist#260.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#261.src: Ah! You were listening! Good, Captain Rurie. We'll knock some sense into you yet.
Shrouded in Mist#261.dst: Ah! Tu écoutais! Bien, capitaine Rurie. On finira par te mettre du plomb dans la tête.
Shrouded in Mist#261.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#262.src: I did have some deerlings bring Nisen into our processing room earlier. Thank you for your service, Captain.
Shrouded in Mist#262.dst: J'ai déjà fait conduire Nisen en salle de traitement par quelques faons. Merci pour tes services, capitaine.
Shrouded in Mist#262.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#263.src: Ah, no problem! Hardly even broke a sweat!
Shrouded in Mist#263.dst: Ah, pas de souci! J'ai à peine transpiré!
Shrouded in Mist#263.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#264.src: Well, I'll be catching up with you later! I suppose if we're following protocols, I'll need to hand these kids off to Azael.
Shrouded in Mist#264.dst: Bon, on se voit plus tard! Si on suit les protocoles, je suppose que je dois confier ces gamins à Azael.
Shrouded in Mist#264.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#265.src: Hey hey, friends! I'm a bit thirsty, so I'll be leaving you now! Think you'll manage to find Azael yourselves?
Shrouded in Mist#265.dst: Hé hé, mes amis! J'ai un peu soif, je vous laisse! Vous pensez trouver Azael tout seuls?
Shrouded in Mist#265.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#266.src: Find the leader inside the Canopy at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#266.dst: Trouvez le chef au sein de la Canopée en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#267.src: Hm. Rurie told you to find Azael.
Shrouded in Mist#267.dst: Hm. Rurie vous envoie voir Azael.
Shrouded in Mist#267.speaker: Cileon

Shrouded in Mist#275.src: The schedule's always so busy... and now I have even more to deal with.
Shrouded in Mist#275.dst: L'emploi du temps est toujours si chargé... et voilà que j'ai encore plus à gérer.
Shrouded in Mist#275.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#276.src: But I suppose I can squeeze you in for questions.
Shrouded in Mist#276.dst: Mais je peux vous accorder un moment pour vos questions.
Shrouded in Mist#276.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#277.src: I am Fuhue, Team Captain of the Deer clan.
Shrouded in Mist#277.dst: Je suis Fuhue, capitaine du clan des Cerfs.
Shrouded in Mist#277.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#278.src: I also function as the overall manager of the Canopy, not just the Deer operations.
Shrouded in Mist#278.dst: Je gère aussi la Canopée dans son ensemble, pas seulement les opérations des Cerfs.
Shrouded in Mist#278.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#279.src: Master Azael can be found in his hut... it's just to the south-west of here.
Shrouded in Mist#279.dst: Vous trouverez maître Azael dans sa cabane... juste au sud-ouest d'ici.
Shrouded in Mist#279.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#280.src: From what I've heard, your friend is over there as well.
Shrouded in Mist#280.dst: A ce que j'ai entendu, votre ami s'y trouve aussi.
Shrouded in Mist#280.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#281.src: I'm afraid so. Insufferable as always...
Shrouded in Mist#281.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#282.src: But he's incredibly talented at what he does. No one else could run the Owls like he does.
Shrouded in Mist#282.dst: Mais il est incroyablement doué. Personne d'autre ne saurait diriger les Hiboux comme lui.
Shrouded in Mist#282.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#284.src: Or not! It's Master Azael's decision as to whether you stay or not. Just hope you manage to impress him.
Shrouded in Mist#284.dst: Ou pas! C'est maître Azael qui décidera si vous restez. Espérez seulement réussir à l'impressionner.
Shrouded in Mist#284.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#285.src: I have heard about your adventures in the {p} thus far. Very impressive work.
Shrouded in Mist#285.dst: J'ai entendu parler de vos aventures dans {p} jusqu'ici. Un travail très impressionnant.
Shrouded in Mist#285.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#286.src: Not to interrupt you, but we've been running around all day, and I'm tired. Where's Yusanu?
Shrouded in Mist#286.dst: Sans vouloir vous interrompre, on a couru toute la journée, et je suis fatiguée. Où est Yusanu?
Shrouded in Mist#286.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#287.dst: Je suis là! Sain et sauf!
Shrouded in Mist#287.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#289.src: Oh, you're okay... I'm so glad.
Shrouded in Mist#289.dst: Oh, tu vas bien... je suis si contente.
Shrouded in Mist#289.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#290.src: Yes, reunited at last. But now that you are here, it is time for business.
Shrouded in Mist#290.dst: Oui, enfin réunis. Mais maintenant que vous êtes là, passons aux affaires.
Shrouded in Mist#290.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#291.src: I had Yusanu inform me of your adventures in the {p}.
Shrouded in Mist#291.dst: Yusanu m'a fait le récit de vos aventures dans {p}.
Shrouded in Mist#291.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#292.src: And it would appear our causes are in alignment... to dismantle the crown. We here in the Canopy have taken a very active approach to this end.
Shrouded in Mist#292.dst: Et il semble que nos causes convergent... abattre la Couronne. Ici, à la Canopée, nous avons choisi une approche très active.
Shrouded in Mist#292.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#293.src: We had established three teams, each with their own responsibility. Each team attacks the crown on different fronts.
Shrouded in Mist#293.dst: Nous avons formé trois équipes, chacune avec sa propre mission. Chacune attaque la Couronne sur un front différent.
Shrouded in Mist#293.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#294.src: The Owls are our eyes and ears. They are also our most efficient assassins. Captain Rurie, who you have already had the pleasure of meeting, is one of our most lethal members.
Shrouded in Mist#294.dst: Les Hiboux sont nos yeux et nos oreilles, et nos assassins les plus efficaces. Le capitaine Rurie, que vous avez déjà eu le plaisir de rencontrer, est l'un des plus redoutables.
Shrouded in Mist#294.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#295.src: The Foxes are our assault team. They are skilled swordsmen utilizing techniques native to the {p}. They are trained to never lose a duel.
Shrouded in Mist#295.dst: Les Renards sont notre équipe d'assaut. Ce sont d'habiles bretteurs aux techniques propres à {p}. Ils sont entraînés à ne jamais perdre un duel.
Shrouded in Mist#295.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#296.src: The Deers are our command team, the brains behind the operation. They are also responsible for... taking care of spies within {p}.
Shrouded in Mist#296.dst: Les Cerfs sont notre équipe de commandement, le cerveau de l'opération. Ils se chargent aussi de... s'occuper des espions dans {p}.
Shrouded in Mist#296.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#298.src: Spies. That man you brought in, Nisen... I fear that is no longer Nisen. Weeks ago, he had been replaced by one of the crown's elite spies. We know them as Changelings.
Shrouded in Mist#298.dst: Des espions. L'homme que vous avez amené, Nisen... je crains que ce ne soit plus Nisen. Il y a des semaines, un espion d'élite de la Couronne a pris sa place. Nous les appelons changelins.
Shrouded in Mist#298.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#299.src: The {p} have been plagued for years by these masterful creatures of disguise. Whenever one is recognized, we capture them and hold them for questioning.
Shrouded in Mist#299.dst: Depuis des années, {p} subit le fléau de ces maîtres du déguisement. Dès qu'on en repère un, on le capture et on le garde pour l'interroger.
Shrouded in Mist#299.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#300.src: The people of our region have developed a form of identification, the medallions. If you do not possess one, many will refuse to speak with you.
Shrouded in Mist#300.dst: Les gens de notre région ont mis au point un moyen de s'identifier: les médaillons. Sans médaillon, beaucoup refuseront de vous parler.
Shrouded in Mist#300.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#301.src: Um... Azael, sir, I don't mean to come off as rude, but... Rurie told us there were news on our friends from the Roughworks.
Shrouded in Mist#301.dst: Euh... monsieur Azael, sans vouloir être impolie... Rurie nous a dit qu'il y avait des nouvelles de nos amis de Roughworks.
Shrouded in Mist#301.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#302.src: In a sense, there are. However, we still are processing the information the Owls have returned with from the festival. I cannot offer anything just yet.
Shrouded in Mist#302.dst: En un sens, oui. Mais nous traitons encore les informations que les Hiboux ont rapportées du festival. Je ne peux rien vous dire pour l'instant.
Shrouded in Mist#302.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#303.src: Rest assured, we will not withhold anything once we have gone through everything.
Shrouded in Mist#303.dst: Soyez tranquilles, nous ne vous cacherons rien une fois que nous aurons tout examiné.
Shrouded in Mist#303.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#304.src: I give you my word that we will continue searching for any word of your friends.
Shrouded in Mist#304.dst: Je vous donne ma parole que nous continuerons à chercher des nouvelles de vos amis.
Shrouded in Mist#304.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#305.src: It... it finally feels like we have a second to breathe.
Shrouded in Mist#305.dst: On... on a enfin l'impression de pouvoir souffler.
Shrouded in Mist#305.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#306.src: I'll stay with Yusanu and wait for them to sort through the information.
Shrouded in Mist#306.dst: Je vais rester avec Yusanu en attendant qu'ils trient les informations.
Shrouded in Mist#306.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#307.src: I'm going to focus on figuring out what this device is used for.
Shrouded in Mist#307.dst: Moi, je vais tâcher de comprendre à quoi sert cet appareil.
Shrouded in Mist#307.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#308.src: It must have been worth stealing it... somehow.
Shrouded in Mist#308.dst: Il devait bien valoir le coup... quelque part.
Shrouded in Mist#308.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#309.src: It looks like someone's diary. The latest entries are dated {~} IA.
Shrouded in Mist#309.dst: On dirait le journal de quelqu'un. Les dernières entrées sont datées de {~} IA.

Shrouded in Mist#310.src: - Entry {~}: Mother came by today. She is taking their separation quite poorly.
Shrouded in Mist#310.dst: - Entrée {~}: Mère est passée aujourd'hui. Elle vit très mal leur séparation.

Shrouded in Mist#311.src: - Entry {~}: Father tried to bring me fresh produce today. I asked him about mother, and he left.
Shrouded in Mist#311.dst: - Entrée {~}: Père a voulu m'apporter des produits frais aujourd'hui. Je lui ai parlé de mère, et il est parti.

Shrouded in Mist#312.src: - Entry {~}: I stopped talking to Father. Mother came by my work at the market. We went for food after.
Shrouded in Mist#312.dst: - Entrée {~}: Je ne parle plus à Père. Mère est passée me voir au marché, où je travaille. Puis nous sommes allés manger.

Shrouded in Mist#313.src: There's a note with information slipped between the pages: Parents divorced. Working at market.
Shrouded in Mist#313.dst: Une note glissée entre les pages contient des informations: Parents divorcés. Travaille au marché.

Shrouded in Mist#314.src: Seems like no one has slept here in a while.
Shrouded in Mist#314.dst: On dirait que personne n'a dormi ici depuis un moment.

Shrouded in Mist#315.src: - Entry {~}: I had a normal day today. Helped my friend carry some food to their house.
Shrouded in Mist#315.dst: - Entrée {~}: Journée normale aujourd'hui. J'ai aidé un ami à porter de la nourriture chez lui.

Shrouded in Mist#316.src: Find a way to destroy the drill, fast.
Shrouded in Mist#316.dst: Trouve un moyen de détruire la foreuse, vite.
Shrouded in Mist#316.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#318.src: The sweeper did no damage to the monitor...
Shrouded in Mist#318.dst: Le balai n'a pas abîmé le moniteur...

Solidarity of Steel#000.src: I hope the brothers weren't too much of a nuisance. Yuman, especially... he's a good lad, but his enthusiasm gets the best of him sometimes.
Solidarity of Steel#000.dst: J'espère que les frères ne vous ont pas trop embêtés. Yuman, surtout... c'est un bon garçon, mais son enthousiasme l'emporte parfois.
Solidarity of Steel#000.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#001.src: My water's been out for two days now. Last bloke I tried to get on the job refused.
Solidarity of Steel#001.dst: Ça fait deux jours que je n'ai plus d'eau. Le dernier gars que j'ai appelé a refusé le boulot.

Solidarity of Steel#002.src: These boards can last generations, you're sure of it. And this one is covered in notes of all kinds! Even graffiti carvings mean something. There's a carving in one corner that catches your eye...
Solidarity of Steel#002.dst: Ces panneaux peuvent durer des générations, vous n'en doutez pas. Et celui-ci est couvert de notes en tout genre! Même les graffitis gravés veulent dire quelque chose. Une gravure dans un coin attire votre regard...

Solidarity of Steel#003.src: You made it back to Torann.
Solidarity of Steel#003.dst: Te voilà de retour à Torann.

Solidarity of Steel#004.src: That's what we call the {p} sewers and waterworks. Maze of pipes and brickwork, some of it old old. Vagrants and criminals been settling there for years.
Solidarity of Steel#004.dst: On appelle comme ça les égouts et conduites de {p}. Un dédale de tuyaux et de briques, parfois très très vieux. Vagabonds et criminels s'y installent depuis des années.

Solidarity of Steel#006.src: You need to pack something that will help Aihan sleep, something to remind her of home, and something to entertain her at the station.
Solidarity of Steel#006.dst: Vous devez emporter de quoi aider Aihan à dormir, un souvenir de chez elle et de quoi la distraire à la station.

Solidarity of Steel#007.src: Wh-what?! H-how did you fit my whole m-mattress in here? Was... was there not anything smaller?
Solidarity of Steel#007.dst: Q-quoi?! C-comment tu as fait entrer tout mon m-matelas ici? Il n'y avait... il n'y avait rien de plus petit?

Solidarity of Steel#008.src: Regroup with your friends outside {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#008.dst: Rejoignez vos amis à l'extérieur de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#009.src: ...that's everyone, then. Good. Good, you're all safe. I wasn't certain, after...
Solidarity of Steel#009.dst: ...tout le monde est là. Bien. Bien, vous êtes saufs. Je n'en étais pas sûre, après...
Solidarity of Steel#009.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#010.src: Are you just going to ignore what happened back there?
Solidarity of Steel#010.dst: Tu vas faire comme si de rien n'était, après ce qui s'est passé?
Solidarity of Steel#010.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#012.src: Zhiraok's blessing... it gives him the power to revive himself. It takes some time, though.
Solidarity of Steel#012.dst: La bénédiction de Zhiraok... lui permet de ressusciter. Mais cela prend un peu de temps.
Solidarity of Steel#012.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#013.src: If we wanted any chance to get away, I had to- I had to kill him.
Solidarity of Steel#013.dst: Si on voulait avoir une chance de fuir, je devais- je devais le tuer.
Solidarity of Steel#013.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#014.src: Well, in any case, we're all here! We'll be meeting with my contact soon, after which we'll certainly be safe, but...
Solidarity of Steel#014.dst: Enfin, quoi qu'il en soit, nous sommes tous là! Nous verrons bientôt mon contact, et nous serons alors en sécurité, mais...
Solidarity of Steel#014.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#015.src: We have some time to spare. You've had a few days to acclimate to the Roughworks - any thoughts?
Solidarity of Steel#015.dst: Nous avons un peu de temps. Vous avez eu quelques jours pour vous faire à Roughworks - vos impressions?
Solidarity of Steel#015.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#016.src: It is, isn't it? It's much busier, less open, and yet... it carries a certain nostalgia for me.
Solidarity of Steel#016.dst: N'est-ce pas? C'est bien plus animé, moins ouvert, et pourtant... j'y ressens une certaine nostalgie.
Solidarity of Steel#016.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#017.src: Nostalgic? This place, really? What's so nostalgic about loud factories and urban sprawl?
Solidarity of Steel#017.dst: La nostalgie? D'ici, sérieux? Qu'ont de nostalgique des usines bruyantes et une ville sans fin?
Solidarity of Steel#017.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#019.src: Well, I'm with Rex on th- this- this one! I wouldn't want to s- st- stay here for long, it's s- so... smoggy.
Solidarity of Steel#019.dst: Eh bien, je suis avec Rex sur c- ce- ce coup! Je ne voudrais pas r- re- rester ici longtemps, il y a t- tant... de fumée.
Solidarity of Steel#019.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#020.src: Certainly, it is not as... clean, I suppose, as the {p}. The smell of the morning dew shall be sorely missed!
Solidarity of Steel#020.dst: Certes, ce n'est pas aussi... propre, je suppose, que {p}. L'odeur de la rosée matinale va cruellement nous manquer!
Solidarity of Steel#020.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#021.src: Alright, children, get it out of your system. Please refrain from speaking poorly of the Roughworks once we meet with my contact... I'd like to make a good first impression.
Solidarity of Steel#021.dst: Bien, les enfants, videz votre sac. Mais abstenez-vous de dire du mal de Roughworks devant mon contact... j'aimerais faire bonne impression.
Solidarity of Steel#021.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#022.src: Oh, you wouldn't think so if you actually had to live here.
Solidarity of Steel#022.dst: Oh, tu ne dirais pas ça si tu devais vraiment vivre ici.
Solidarity of Steel#022.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#023.dst: Rex, je t'en prie. Sois polie.
Solidarity of Steel#023.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#024.src: What?! Most of them would agree with me!
Solidarity of Steel#024.dst: Quoi?! La plupart d'entre eux seraient d'accord avec moi!
Solidarity of Steel#024.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#025.src: I think I'm with Rex on this- this one! I can't im-imagine- imagine living here, it's s- so... smoggy.
Solidarity of Steel#025.dst: Je crois que je suis avec Rex sur ce- ce coup! Je n'im-imagine- imagine pas vivre ici, il y a t- tant... de fumée.
Solidarity of Steel#025.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#026.src: Alright, children, get it out of your system. Please refrain from speaking poorly of the Roughworks once we meet with my contact... no matter how much they may or may not agree.
Solidarity of Steel#026.dst: Bien, les enfants, videz votre sac. Mais abstenez-vous de dire du mal de Roughworks devant mon contact... qu'il soit d'accord ou non.
Solidarity of Steel#026.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#027.src: In any case, I was told to meet them in the city at noon - {p} is usually empty during the daytime.
Solidarity of Steel#027.dst: Quoi qu'il en soit, le rendez-vous est à midi en ville - {p} est généralement vide en journée.
Solidarity of Steel#027.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#028.src: What? It's empty during the day? Th- that doesn't make a lot of sense.
Solidarity of Steel#028.dst: Quoi? Vide en pleine journée? Ç- ça n'a pas beaucoup de sens.
Solidarity of Steel#028.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#029.src: I'm afraid the lives of the citizens of the Roughworks revolve entirely around their work. The work day starts at sunrise, and ends with sunset. So, let's just wait...
Solidarity of Steel#029.dst: Hélas, la vie des habitants de Roughworks tourne entièrement autour du travail. La journée commence à l'aube et finit au coucher du soleil. Alors, attendons...
Solidarity of Steel#029.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#031.src: Maybe they, um, just read time differently, here...? Or maybe we-
Solidarity of Steel#031.dst: Peut-être qu'ici, euh, ils lisent l'heure autrement...? Ou peut-être qu'on-
Solidarity of Steel#031.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#033.src: Hello, Quill. It's been a while since we've met face to face, hasn't it?
Solidarity of Steel#033.dst: Bonjour, Quill. Ça faisait longtemps qu'on ne s'était pas vus en personne, n'est-ce pas?
Solidarity of Steel#033.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#034.src: Indeed, indeed... I hope your journey to cross to the Roughworks wasn't too difficult.
Solidarity of Steel#034.dst: En effet, en effet... J'espère que la traversée jusqu'à Roughworks n'a pas été trop pénible.
Solidarity of Steel#034.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#035.src: Could have been better, could have been worse. We expected difficulties going in.
Solidarity of Steel#035.dst: Ça aurait pu être mieux, ou pire. On s'attendait à des difficultés.
Solidarity of Steel#035.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#036.src: I see... You'll have to tell me more later. Now, which of you is the cursed one? I'd like a look at you.
Solidarity of Steel#036.dst: Je vois... Tu me raconteras plus tard. Alors, lequel d'entre vous est le Maudit? J'aimerais te voir de plus près.
Solidarity of Steel#036.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#037.src: Mmhm! So you're the one, eh? What I'd heard in correspondence had me thinking you'd be different than us. Seems like I was right!
Solidarity of Steel#037.dst: Mmhm! C'est donc toi, hein? D'après nos lettres, je m'attendais à ce que tu ne sois pas comme nous. On dirait que j'avais raison!
Solidarity of Steel#037.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#038.src: There's a look in your eyes, something to your gait. In all my years I've seen quite a lot, and everything that shouts "promise" is there in you.
Solidarity of Steel#038.dst: Il y a quelque chose dans ton regard, dans ta démarche. J'en ai vu beaucoup au fil des ans, et tout ce qui respire la promesse est là, en toi.
Solidarity of Steel#038.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#039.src: Ha! Yes, yes, I suppose that would be the correct response to that question. You'd do well to stick to that script.
Solidarity of Steel#039.dst: Ha! Oui, oui, je suppose que c'est la bonne réponse à cette question. Tu ferais bien de t'en tenir à ce texte.
Solidarity of Steel#039.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#040.src: But Syndra has already written much about you in our correspondence. No need to be shy.
Solidarity of Steel#040.dst: Mais Syndra m'a déjà beaucoup écrit à ton sujet. Inutile d'être timide.
Solidarity of Steel#040.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#041.src: Blessed, cursed... They're two sides of the same coin, in my eyes. I've seen my fair share of both in my time leading this group, heh heh...
Solidarity of Steel#041.dst: Bénis, maudits... A mes yeux, ce sont les deux faces d'une même pièce. J'en ai vu ma part, des deux, depuis que je mène ce groupe, hé hé...
Solidarity of Steel#041.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#042.src: I see no reason not to celebrate differences, and what better difference could there be?
Solidarity of Steel#042.dst: Pourquoi ne pas célébrer les différences? Et quelle plus belle différence que celle-là?
Solidarity of Steel#042.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#043.src: ... Ah, we'll have more time to speak later. We'd best make our way down to the station, we can sort out arrangements there-
Solidarity of Steel#043.dst: ... Ah, nous aurons le temps de parler plus tard. Mieux vaut descendre à la station, nous pourrons tout organiser là-bas-
Solidarity of Steel#043.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#044.src: Hey, hey! We're leaving before we even get our introductions in? Why'd we even come here then, man?
Solidarity of Steel#044.dst: Hé, hé! On part avant même de se présenter? Alors pourquoi on est venus, mec?
Solidarity of Steel#044.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#045.src: Yes, Yuman, why did we come here? You're the one who dragged us all along.
Solidarity of Steel#045.dst: Oui, Yuman, pourquoi est-on venus? C'est toi qui nous as tous traînés ici.
Solidarity of Steel#045.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#046.src: Well, hey, I just thought this old man could use some help, that's all! Six people's a lot for one guy to greet, you know?
Solidarity of Steel#046.dst: Bah, je me disais que le vieux aurait besoin d'aide, c'est tout! Six personnes, c'est beaucoup à accueillir pour un seul gars, tu vois?
Solidarity of Steel#046.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#047.src: Yes, yes... Well, alright, since you all are here, we may as well handle introductions now.
Solidarity of Steel#047.dst: Oui, oui... Bon, d'accord, puisque vous êtes tous là, autant faire les présentations maintenant.
Solidarity of Steel#047.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#048.src: I'm Yuman! I'm the greatest musician of our age, man! And I'm super muscular and cool, and-
Solidarity of Steel#048.dst: Moi, c'est Yuman! Le plus grand musicien de notre époque, mec! Et je suis super musclé et trop cool, et-
Solidarity of Steel#048.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#049.src: Alright, Yuman, that's enough. I'm Yulie, oldest of three. I work as a detective in {p}.
Solidarity of Steel#049.dst: Bon, Yuman, ça suffit. Je suis Yulie, l'aîné des trois. Je suis détective à {p}.
Solidarity of Steel#049.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#050.src: Booooring! Come on, bro, have some-
Solidarity of Steel#050.dst: Ennuyeeeeux! Allez, frérot, un peu de-
Solidarity of Steel#050.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#051.src: And I'm Yusanu! I'm a mechanic. Quill's told us a lot about you, it's a pleasure to finally meet you.
Solidarity of Steel#051.dst: Et moi, c'est Yusanu! Je suis mécanicien. Quill nous a beaucoup parlé de vous, ravi de vous rencontrer enfin.
Solidarity of Steel#051.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#052.src: Uh... S- same, I guess. This is all s- st- still a bit new.
Solidarity of Steel#052.dst: Euh... P- pareil, je suppose. Tout ça est en- en- encore un peu nouveau.
Solidarity of Steel#052.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#053.src: Eh, you'll get used to it. This place has a way of growing on you.
Solidarity of Steel#053.dst: Bah, tu t'y feras. Cet endroit finit par te plaire.
Solidarity of Steel#053.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#054.src: Ah, if I may - I don't suppose you'd have anything prepared for us to be able to blend in better? I'd imagine we stick out a fair bit right now.
Solidarity of Steel#054.dst: Ah, si je puis me permettre - auriez-vous quelque chose de prévu pour que nous passions inaperçus? J'imagine que nous détonnons quelque peu.
Solidarity of Steel#054.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#055.src: Hm... I hadn't quite considered that. Boys, why don't you handle that while Syndra and I go ahead to sort out living arrangements?
Solidarity of Steel#055.dst: Hm... Je n'y avais pas pensé. Les garçons, vous vous en chargez pendant que Syndra et moi allons régler le logement?
Solidarity of Steel#055.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#057.src: Leaves, why don't you join them? It'll be a good opportunity to get to know each other.
Solidarity of Steel#057.dst: Feuilles, pourquoi ne pas les accompagner? Ce sera l'occasion de faire connaissance.
Solidarity of Steel#057.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#058.src: Um... I think I'd rather go with you. I'd like to rest a bit.
Solidarity of Steel#058.dst: Euh... je crois que je préfère venir avec toi. J'aimerais me reposer un peu.
Solidarity of Steel#058.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#059.src: ... Then I'll tag along as well. Perhaps I could be of use at the station!
Solidarity of Steel#059.dst: ... Alors je vous accompagne aussi. Je pourrais peut-être me rendre utile à la station!
Solidarity of Steel#059.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#060.src: Very well. Follow me, we have an access point this way.
Solidarity of Steel#060.dst: Très bien. Suivez-moi, nous avons un accès par ici.
Solidarity of Steel#060.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#061.src: Well. I'm afraid I can't stay either... the station doesn't exactly run by itself. We'll have to catch up later!
Solidarity of Steel#061.dst: Bon. Je ne peux pas rester non plus, j'en ai peur... la station ne tourne pas toute seule. On se rattrapera plus tard!
Solidarity of Steel#061.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#062.src: Ugh, boring as usual... Oh well! Yulie and I can show you around just fine by ourselves.
Solidarity of Steel#062.dst: Pff, ennuyeux comme d'hab... Tant pis! Yulie et moi, on peut très bien vous faire visiter tout seuls.
Solidarity of Steel#062.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#063.src: We should start with getting you all some new clothes.
Solidarity of Steel#063.dst: Commençons par vous trouver de nouveaux vêtements.
Solidarity of Steel#063.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#064.src: Hey! Wh- what's wrong with our cur- current ones!
Solidarity of Steel#064.dst: Hé! Q- qu'est-ce qu'ils ont, nos vê- vêtements actuels!
Solidarity of Steel#064.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#065.src: They make you look like poor forest people, man!
Solidarity of Steel#065.dst: Vous avez l'air de pauvres gens des bois, mec!
Solidarity of Steel#065.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#066.src: Yuman! Don't be rude to our guests.
Solidarity of Steel#066.dst: Yuman! Ne sois pas grossier avec nos invités.
Solidarity of Steel#066.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#067.src: What, I'm just saying! Am I wrong?
Solidarity of Steel#067.dst: Quoi, je dis ça comme ça! J'ai tort?
Solidarity of Steel#067.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#068.src: Well! At l- lea- at least we don't smell bad!
Solidarity of Steel#068.dst: Eh bien! Au m- moins- au moins, on ne sent pas mauvais!
Solidarity of Steel#068.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#069.src: Alright, boys, settle down, play nice. You're both pretty. So, Yulie, what's the plan?
Solidarity of Steel#069.dst: Bon, les garçons, on se calme. Vous êtes beaux tous les deux. Alors, Yulie, c'est quoi le plan?
Solidarity of Steel#069.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#070.src: I'll have to swing by some shops... Yuman, in the meantime, why don't you see if you can find any clothes around here?
Solidarity of Steel#070.dst: Je vais devoir passer dans quelques boutiques... Yuman, en attendant, tu pourrais voir si tu trouves des vêtements par ici?
Solidarity of Steel#070.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#071.src: Great, I'll join you. I need to get re-acquainted with things around here.
Solidarity of Steel#071.dst: Super, je t'accompagne. Il faut que je me refamiliarise avec le coin.
Solidarity of Steel#071.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#072.src: Sure, that works. Any complaints, Yuman?
Solidarity of Steel#072.dst: D'accord, ça me va. Des objections, Yuman?
Solidarity of Steel#072.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#073.src: If I had 'em, you'd hear it loud and clear. The plan's good, bro.
Solidarity of Steel#073.dst: Si j'en avais, tu les entendrais haut et fort. Le plan est bon, frérot.
Solidarity of Steel#073.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#074.src: Okay, we'll meet back at the Steel Feather once we're done. See you then!
Solidarity of Steel#074.dst: D'accord, on se retrouve à la Plume d'acier quand on a fini. A tout à l'heure!
Solidarity of Steel#074.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#075.src: ...Well! I've got a plan of my own in mind. Not exactly what Yulie had in mind, but... heh, what he doesn't know won't hurt him. Follow me, leaf people!
Solidarity of Steel#075.dst: ...Bon! J'ai mon propre plan. Pas tout à fait ce que Yulie avait en tête, mais... hé, ce qu'il ne sait pas ne lui fera pas de mal. Suivez-moi, les gens des feuilles!
Solidarity of Steel#075.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#076.src: Find clothes in the city by following Yuman at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#076.dst: Trouvez des vêtements en ville en suivant Yuman en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#077.src: Hey! Hold- h- hold up! What's your p- p- plan?
Solidarity of Steel#077.dst: Hé! At- a- attends! C'est quoi ton p- p- plan?
Solidarity of Steel#077.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#078.src: Oh! Right. We're going to steal from the clotheslines, of course.
Solidarity of Steel#078.dst: Ah! C'est vrai. On va piquer du linge sur les cordes, évidemment.
Solidarity of Steel#078.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#079.src: ... I'm no stranger to st- stealing, but... isn't it a bit r- r-... a bit risky to do that in the m- middle of the city?
Solidarity of Steel#079.dst: ... Le v- vol, je connais, mais... ce n'est pas un peu r- r-... un peu risqué de faire ça en p- plein centre-ville?
Solidarity of Steel#079.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#080.src: Man, haven't you noticed how empty {p} is?
Solidarity of Steel#080.dst: Mec, t'as pas remarqué à quel point {p} est vide?
Solidarity of Steel#080.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#081.src: Figures you wouldn't know, since you're not from around here! It's pretty simple.
Solidarity of Steel#081.dst: Normal que tu saches pas, t'es pas d'ici! C'est tout simple.
Solidarity of Steel#081.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#082.src: It's the middle of the workday! People are out at their jobs, they don't have time to stroll around the city! Got to make a living somehow, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#082.dst: C'est le milieu de la journée de travail! Les gens sont au boulot, ils ont pas le temps de se balader en ville! Faut bien gagner sa vie, hein?
Solidarity of Steel#082.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#083.src: A- and since they're out at their jobs, they're n- n- not home... you want us to just walk th- through someone's apartment, then?
Solidarity of Steel#083.dst: E- et comme ils sont au travail, ils ne sont p- p- pas chez eux... tu veux qu'on traverse l'appart de quelqu'un, c- comme ça?
Solidarity of Steel#083.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#084.src: Yep, yep, exaaaactly! You get it. I think you and I are gonna get along great.
Solidarity of Steel#084.dst: Ouais, ouais, exaaactement! Tu piges. Je crois qu'on va super bien s'entendre, toi et moi.
Solidarity of Steel#084.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#086.src: Yeah... sure. L- let- let's get going! I think we can rea- reach the rooftops from this house. We'll find some clothes up there.
Solidarity of Steel#086.dst: Ouais... c'est ça. A- al- allons-y! Je crois qu'on peut at- atteindre les toits depuis cette maison. On trouvera des vêtements là-haut.
Solidarity of Steel#086.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#087.src: Ha! Really? You should... you should pay more attention, man. The moment you stop keeping an eye on things is the moment things go wrong, y'know? Jeez.
Solidarity of Steel#087.dst: Ha! Sérieux? Tu devrais... tu devrais faire plus gaffe, mec. Dès que tu arrêtes de surveiller, c'est là que tout part en vrille, tu vois? La vache.
Solidarity of Steel#087.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#088.src: What I was gonna say is that it's the middle of the workday. People are out at their jobs! No time to stroll around the city, or anything.
Solidarity of Steel#088.dst: Ce que j'allais dire, c'est qu'on est en pleine journée de travail. Les gens sont au boulot! Pas le temps de se balader en ville, ni rien.
Solidarity of Steel#088.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#089.src: A- and since they're out at their jobs, they're n- not home... you want us to just walk th- through someone's apartment, then?
Solidarity of Steel#089.dst: E- et comme ils sont au travail, ils ne sont p- pas chez eux... tu veux qu'on traverse l'appart de quelqu'un, c- comme ça?
Solidarity of Steel#089.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#090.src: Mhm, yep, you get it. They won't mind! Cause they won' know we were there, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#090.dst: Mhm, ouais, tu piges. Ça les dérangera pas! Vu qu'ils sauront même pas qu'on est passés, hein?
Solidarity of Steel#090.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#091.src: I- I- I guess. Okay, let's get going! I think we can rea- reach the rooftops from this house. We'll find some clothes up there.
Solidarity of Steel#091.dst: J- j- je suppose. Bon, allons-y! Je crois qu'on peut at- atteindre les toits depuis cette maison. On trouvera des vêtements là-haut.
Solidarity of Steel#091.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#092.src: Climb up the apartment at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and jump across the roofs.
Solidarity of Steel#092.dst: Grimpez sur l'immeuble en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] et sautez de toit en toit.

Solidarity of Steel#093.src: Try n-not to fall off the roof...
Solidarity of Steel#093.dst: Essaie de n-ne pas tomber du toit...
Solidarity of Steel#093.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#094.src: Jump across the roofs to the first spot at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Solidarity of Steel#094.dst: Sautez de toit en toit jusqu'au premier point en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Solidarity of Steel#095.src: I'll be right be- behind you! Let's get up to the rooftops. I think we can rea- reach them through this building.
Solidarity of Steel#095.dst: Je suis juste der- derrière toi! Montons sur les toits. Je crois qu'on peut les at- atteindre par ce bâtiment.
Solidarity of Steel#095.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#096.src: ...what the hell are you doin' jumpin' around?
Solidarity of Steel#096.dst: ...qu'est-ce que tu fiches à sauter partout?
Solidarity of Steel#096.speaker: Timaca Mason

Solidarity of Steel#097.src: Buzz off, some've us got jobs.
Solidarity of Steel#097.dst: Dégage, y en a qui bossent.
Solidarity of Steel#097.speaker: Timaca Mason

Solidarity of Steel#098.src: Here we are! Best clothes in the entire province, man! Take your pick!
Solidarity of Steel#098.dst: Nous y voilà! Les meilleures fringues de toute la province, mec! Servez-vous!
Solidarity of Steel#098.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#099.src: ... Wait a mi- min- minute. There are only dr- dresses here?
Solidarity of Steel#099.dst: ... At- attends une mi- mi- minute. Il n'y a que des r- robes ici?
Solidarity of Steel#099.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#100.src: Oh, yeah. My bad, man! Bet you could pull it off though, eh?
Solidarity of Steel#100.dst: Ah, ouais. Ma faute, mec! Mais je parie que ça t'irait bien, hein?
Solidarity of Steel#100.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#101.src: I- y- you- wh- wh- what- h- huh? Ev- even- even if I could, Rex and Mora would- w- would never wear- wear these. A- and- and they're n- n- not-
Solidarity of Steel#101.dst: Je- t- tu- q- q- quoi- h- hein? M- même- même si je pouvais, Rex et Mora ne- ne porteraient jamais- jamais ça. E- et- et ce n'est p- p- pas-
Solidarity of Steel#101.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#102.src: Relax, I'm just messing with you, man! We'll find some more. But, hey, grab one if you want, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#102.dst: Relax, je te charrie, mec! On en trouvera d'autres. Mais bon, prends-en une si tu veux, hein?
Solidarity of Steel#102.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#103.src: I'll take one for Sui, just in c- ca- just in case. And let's hurry after him. I'm getting sick a- and-... s- sick and tired of this place already.
Solidarity of Steel#103.dst: J'en prends une pour Sui, au c- ca- au cas où. Et dépêchons-nous de le suivre. J'en ai déjà ma- ma-... ma- marre de cet endroit.
Solidarity of Steel#103.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#104.src: Continue looking for clothes on the rooftops at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#104.dst: Continuez à chercher des vêtements sur les toits en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#105.src: It's g-going to be a long c-couple of days, huh?
Solidarity of Steel#105.dst: Ces j-jours vont être l-longs, hein?
Solidarity of Steel#105.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#106.src: Careful there, princess! Wouldn't want to fall, eh?
Solidarity of Steel#106.dst: Attention, princesse! Faudrait pas tomber, hein?
Solidarity of Steel#106.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#107.dst: Hein? J- j- je ne suis pas-
Solidarity of Steel#107.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#108.src: Anyway, these clothes should work, yeah? Looks like enough for all of you!
Solidarity of Steel#108.dst: Bref, ces fringues devraient faire l'affaire, non? Il y en a assez pour vous tous!
Solidarity of Steel#108.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#109.src: ...yes, this sh- sh- should be fine. Thank you f- for showing us. Let's just grab them a- and go.
Solidarity of Steel#109.dst: ...oui, ça d- d- devrait aller. Merci de nous a- avoir montré. Prenons-les e- et partons.
Solidarity of Steel#109.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#110.src: Sounds good! You saw the big statue in the river when you were entering the city, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#110.dst: Parfait! Vous avez vu la grande statue dans la rivière en entrant en ville, hein?
Solidarity of Steel#110.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#111.src: The one to the s- south- southwest, yes.
Solidarity of Steel#111.dst: Celle au s- sud- sud-ouest, oui.
Solidarity of Steel#111.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#112.src: That's the one! I'll wait for you there, then we can head to the station. And hurry up, would ya?
Solidarity of Steel#112.dst: C'est celle-là! Je vous attends là-bas, puis on ira à la station. Et grouillez-vous, d'accord?
Solidarity of Steel#112.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#113.src: Find the statue in the water at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#113.dst: Trouvez la statue dans l'eau en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#114.src: Ugh... How can one guy be s- s- so annoying?
Solidarity of Steel#114.dst: Pff... Comment un seul type peut-il être a- a- aussi agaçant?
Solidarity of Steel#114.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#115.src: Whatever... Let's just go to that s- st- statue. It's in the river t- to the southwest.
Solidarity of Steel#115.dst: Peu importe... Allons à cette s- st- statue. Elle est dans la rivière a- au sud-ouest.
Solidarity of Steel#115.speaker: Zeph
