Solidarity of Steel#116.src: Ey, there you are! What's with the holdup?
Solidarity of Steel#116.dst: Hé, vous voilà! Pourquoi ce retard?
Solidarity of Steel#116.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#117.src: I was just telling Zeph all about our base of operations! Here, I can start over if you-
Solidarity of Steel#117.dst: Je racontais tout à Zeph sur notre base d'opérations! Tiens, je peux reprendre si tu-
Solidarity of Steel#117.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#118.src: Let's just h- head in! Even if the city's empty, the longer we stay out here, the more we ri- risk getting seen.
Solidarity of Steel#118.dst: E- entrons! Même si la ville est vide, plus on reste dehors, plus on ri- risque d'être vus.
Solidarity of Steel#118.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#119.src: Yeah, yeah, you're right. Okay, follow me! It's just down here.
Solidarity of Steel#119.dst: Ouais, ouais, t'as raison. Bon, suivez-moi! C'est juste en bas.
Solidarity of Steel#119.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#121.src: Sorry if our secret base isn't up to your high standards, princess! We've got to stay hidden somehow, eh?
Solidarity of Steel#121.dst: Désolé si notre base secrète n'est pas à la hauteur de tes exigences, princesse! Faut bien se cacher, hein?
Solidarity of Steel#121.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#123.src: Follow Yuman and Zeph into the sewer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#123.dst: Suivez Yuman et Zeph dans les égouts en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#125.src: Catch up with Zeph and Rex.

Solidarity of Steel#127.src: Welcome to the station, man! There's a bunch of abandoned train lines down here. Dunno how we first found it, but it's where the Steel Feather operates.
Solidarity of Steel#127.dst: Bienvenue à la station, mec! Y a plein de voies ferrées abandonnées là-dessous. Sais pas comment on l'a trouvée, mais c'est là qu'opère la Plume d'acier.
Solidarity of Steel#127.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#129.src: Good to see you've made it down here too. Yuman, you weren't rude to our guests, were you?
Solidarity of Steel#129.dst: Content de vous voir en bas aussi. Yuman, tu n'as pas été grossier avec nos invités, j'espère?
Solidarity of Steel#129.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#130.src: What? Screw you, man, of course I was nice! When have I ever not been nice and kind and awesome?
Solidarity of Steel#130.dst: Quoi? Va te faire voir, mec, bien sûr que j'ai été sympa! Quand est-ce que j'ai pas été sympa, gentil et génial?
Solidarity of Steel#130.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#131.src: Well, either way, I'm sure you've tired them out by now. Let's go on ahead and give them time to catch up, alright?
Solidarity of Steel#131.dst: Bon, dans tous les cas, tu les as sûrement épuisés. Partons devant et laissons-leur le temps de nous rattraper, d'accord?
Solidarity of Steel#131.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#132.dst: Pff, d'accooord. A plus, vous tous!
Solidarity of Steel#132.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#133.src: So... how've you been finding Yuman so far?
Solidarity of Steel#133.dst: Alors... tu le trouves comment, Yuman, pour l'instant?
Solidarity of Steel#133.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#134.src: Ugh. He's... f- fi- fine. We got the clothes, at least.
Solidarity of Steel#134.dst: Pff. Il est... s- sup- supportable. On a les vêtements, au moins.
Solidarity of Steel#134.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#135.src: Hm. You don't sound fine. Spill.
Solidarity of Steel#135.dst: Hm. T'as pas l'air d'aller. Crache le morceau.
Solidarity of Steel#135.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#136.src: Oh, that's it? He's just like that.
Solidarity of Steel#136.dst: Oh, c'est tout? Il est comme ça, c'est tout.
Solidarity of Steel#136.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#137.src: He's just... very p- per- persistent.
Solidarity of Steel#137.dst: Il est juste... très i- ins- insistant.
Solidarity of Steel#137.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#138.src: Well, that says more about you than it does about him. Have you tried making it less easy for him?
Solidarity of Steel#138.dst: Bah, ça en dit plus sur toi que sur lui. T'as essayé de lui rendre la tâche moins facile?
Solidarity of Steel#138.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#139.src: Ha ha. Very hel- hel- helpful, Rex.
Solidarity of Steel#139.dst: Ha ha. Très u- u- utile, Rex.
Solidarity of Steel#139.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#140.src: Makes sense, I guess. It's been a few days since we've been able to relax, hasn't it?
Solidarity of Steel#140.dst: Ça se comprend. Ça fait quelques jours qu'on n'a pas pu se détendre, hein?
Solidarity of Steel#140.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#141.src: Yeah... it'll be n- n- nice to slow down, for a while.
Solidarity of Steel#141.dst: Ouais... ce sera b- b- bien de ralentir, un moment.
Solidarity of Steel#141.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#142.src: Not sure how long we'll be slowed down... but sure. I think Syndra's got some plans in the works, but she hasn't shared them yet.
Solidarity of Steel#142.dst: Je sais pas combien de temps ça durera... mais bon. Je crois que Syndra prépare quelque chose, mais elle n'en a encore rien dit.
Solidarity of Steel#142.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#143.src: She's been getting... more ambitious lately. {u}, I think having you around has had something to do with that.
Solidarity of Steel#143.dst: Elle devient... plus ambitieuse, ces temps-ci. {u}, je crois que ta présence n'y est pas pour rien.
Solidarity of Steel#143.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#144.src: We- we- well, how about you? Is the Roughworks just how you r- remember it?
Solidarity of Steel#144.dst: E- e- et toi, alors? Roughworks est comme dans tes s- souvenirs?
Solidarity of Steel#144.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#145.src: Yeah... pretty much. Things don't tend to change a lot around here, so... it's just like slotting back into place.
Solidarity of Steel#145.dst: Ouais... à peu près. Les choses changent peu, ici, alors... c'est comme reprendre sa place.
Solidarity of Steel#145.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#147.src: Ha. No, it really isn't. The few months I spent here before Quill sent me off to Syndra were... rough.
Solidarity of Steel#147.dst: Ha. Non, pas du tout. Les quelques mois que j'ai passés ici avant que Quill m'envoie chez Syndra ont été... durs.
Solidarity of Steel#147.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#148.src: Oh... h- how come? You've never really talked about the R- R- Rough-... about the R- Roughworks.
Solidarity of Steel#148.dst: Oh... p- pourquoi? Tu n'as jamais vraiment parlé de R- R- Rough-... de R- Roughworks.
Solidarity of Steel#148.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#149.src: Uh... Hey, so about those clothes- let's take a look at what you got!
Solidarity of Steel#149.dst: Euh... Dis, ces vêtements- voyons ce que vous avez trouvé!
Solidarity of Steel#149.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#150.src: R- right... right! Well, here are th- the- the, uh, workers' clothes we got f- for me, Mora, and {u}... And this is a dr- dress for Sui...
Solidarity of Steel#150.dst: O- oui... oui! Alors, voici l- les- les, euh, vêtements d'ouvrier qu'on a pris p- pour moi, Mora et {u}... Et voici une r- robe pour Sui...
Solidarity of Steel#150.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#151.src: And, of- of- of course, a simple dress for you!
Solidarity of Steel#151.dst: Et, bi- bi- bien sûr, une robe toute simple pour toi!
Solidarity of Steel#151.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#152.src: Oh... that's funny, I don't think I've ever worn one of those! Hey, maybe I'll just take your set and you can wear the dress?
Solidarity of Steel#152.dst: Oh... c'est drôle, je crois que je n'en ai jamais porté! Tiens, et si je prenais ta tenue et que tu mettais la robe?
Solidarity of Steel#152.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#153.src: Woah, ha, we- well, let's not g- g- get too hasty, haha- oh, l- look here, an extra set of re- reg- regular workers' clothes! What a c- co- coincidence!
Solidarity of Steel#153.dst: Ouah, ha, b- bon, ne nous p- p- précipitons pas, haha- oh, r- regarde, une tenue d'ouvrier n- nor- normale en plus! Quelle c- co- coïncidence!
Solidarity of Steel#153.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#154.src: ...don't, uh, m- m- make me wear the dress, please?
Solidarity of Steel#154.dst: ...ne me f- f- fais pas, euh, porter la robe, s'il te plaît?
Solidarity of Steel#154.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#155.src: Yeah, yeah. Well, that's enough fooling around - we should find Mora and Sui, see what they've figured out. I'll race you there!
Solidarity of Steel#155.dst: Ouais, ouais. Bon, assez rigolé - on devrait retrouver Mora et Sui, voir ce qu'ils ont trouvé. Le premier arrivé a gagné!
Solidarity of Steel#155.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#156.src: Hey! Oh, you're going d- down!
Solidarity of Steel#156.dst: Hé! Oh, tu vas p- perdre!
Solidarity of Steel#156.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#159.src: Indeed! Tell us, friends, how go the escapades? Has anything of interest transpired up in the city?
Solidarity of Steel#159.dst: En effet! Dites-nous, mes amis, ces escapades? S'est-il passé quelque chose d'intéressant en ville?
Solidarity of Steel#159.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#160.src: No, Mora, nothing very exciting. Yulie and I did a quick supply run in {p} while we were there.
Solidarity of Steel#160.dst: Non, Mora, rien de bien palpitant. Yulie et moi en avons profité pour nous ravitailler à {p}.
Solidarity of Steel#160.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#161.src: And {u} and I found some cl- cl- clothes! They might not fit perfectly, but...
Solidarity of Steel#161.dst: Et {u} et moi, on a trouvé des v- v- vêtements! Ils ne sont peut-être pas pile à la bonne taille, mais...
Solidarity of Steel#161.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#162.src: Ah, well, we'll take what we can get. Besides, I have to imagine they have someone around here who knows their way around modifying clothes!
Solidarity of Steel#162.dst: Ah, ma foi, on fera avec. D'ailleurs, il y a sûrement quelqu'un ici qui sait retoucher des vêtements!
Solidarity of Steel#162.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#163.src: Speaking of, have you had time to explore this place yet? It's far larger than I could have anticipated! So many people with so many skillsets; Syndra wasn't lying when she said they had resources here, hoho!
Solidarity of Steel#163.dst: A ce propos, avez-vous eu le temps d'explorer les lieux? C'est bien plus grand que je ne l'imaginais! Tant de gens aux talents si variés; Syndra ne mentait pas en disant qu'ils avaient des ressources, hoho!
Solidarity of Steel#163.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#164.src: Yes... everyone chips in, too. I got put to work quite fast. Had an opportunity to chat with some of the people here.
Solidarity of Steel#164.dst: Oui... et tout le monde met la main à la pâte. On m'a vite mise au travail. J'ai pu discuter avec certains d'entre eux.
Solidarity of Steel#164.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#165.src: They, um... a lot of them don't have anywhere else to go... so they work hard to keep this place running.
Solidarity of Steel#165.dst: Ils, euh... beaucoup n'ont nulle part où aller... alors ils travaillent dur pour faire tourner cet endroit.
Solidarity of Steel#165.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#167.src: Hey, do you know where Yusanu is? I haven't had the chance to catch up with him yet.
Solidarity of Steel#167.dst: Dis, tu sais où est Yusanu? Je n'ai pas encore eu l'occasion de discuter avec lui.
Solidarity of Steel#167.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#168.src: Oh, he seemed to have disappeared into his study some time ago, though not before I could have a chat with him! Did you know he singlehandedly repaired much of the abandoned infrastructure here?
Solidarity of Steel#168.dst: Oh, il s'est éclipsé dans son atelier il y a un moment, mais pas avant que j'aie pu bavarder avec lui! Saviez-vous qu'il a réparé à lui seul une bonne partie des installations abandonnées?
Solidarity of Steel#168.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#170.src: Apparently, um, the crown was working on building this, central station, but they... abandoned the project, for, some reason. Nobody... really knows why.
Solidarity of Steel#170.dst: Apparemment, euh, la Couronne construisait cette, station centrale, mais elle... a abandonné le projet, pour, une raison ou une autre. Personne... ne sait vraiment pourquoi.
Solidarity of Steel#170.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#171.src: Hm... so what are Syndra and Quill ta- talk- talking about over there?
Solidarity of Steel#171.dst: Hm... et de quoi Syndra et Quill p- par- parlent, là-bas?
Solidarity of Steel#171.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#172.src: An excellent question! Nobody knows! Attempting to interject has only resulted in failure thus far.
Solidarity of Steel#172.dst: Excellente question! Nul ne le sait! Toute tentative d'interruption a échoué jusqu'ici.
Solidarity of Steel#172.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#173.src: I mean... should we even interrupt? I haven't seen her this... happy... in a long time.
Solidarity of Steel#173.dst: Enfin... faut-il vraiment les interrompre? Je ne l'ai pas vue aussi... heureuse... depuis longtemps.
Solidarity of Steel#173.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#174.src: It is a sweet moment, isn't it?
Solidarity of Steel#174.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#175.src: Well, I nominate {u} to go interrupt them. It needs to be done eventually.
Solidarity of Steel#175.dst: Bon, je propose {u} pour aller les interrompre. Il faudra bien que quelqu'un le fasse.
Solidarity of Steel#175.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#176.src: Oh, yes, I second that notion. If it must be anyone, {u} is the one to sacrifice for the cause.
Solidarity of Steel#176.dst: Oh oui, je seconde la proposition. S'il faut quelqu'un, c'est {u} qu'il faut sacrifier pour la cause.
Solidarity of Steel#176.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#177.src: Oh! Uh... sure, I'll... th- third it? That sounds right.
Solidarity of Steel#177.dst: Oh! Euh... d'accord, je la... t- tierce? Ça doit se dire.
Solidarity of Steel#177.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#179.src: Well! Three for, one against. It seems the decision has been made!
Solidarity of Steel#179.dst: Bien! Trois pour, un contre. La décision semble prise!
Solidarity of Steel#179.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#180.dst: Traîtres, tous autant que vous êtes.

Solidarity of Steel#181.src: Yeah, yeah! Come on, what are you waiting for? Go interrupt Syndra and Quill, and find out what they're talking about.
Solidarity of Steel#181.dst: Ouais, ouais! Allez, qu'est-ce que t'attends? Va interrompre Syndra et Quill, et découvre de quoi ils parlent.
Solidarity of Steel#181.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#182.src: Good luck, my friend! You'll certainly need it.
Solidarity of Steel#182.dst: Bonne chance, mon ami! Tu en auras bien besoin.
Solidarity of Steel#182.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#183.src: Your sacrifice will not be in vain.
Solidarity of Steel#183.dst: Ton sacrifice ne sera pas vain.
Solidarity of Steel#183.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#184.src: I had no p- pa- part in this!
Solidarity of Steel#184.dst: Je n'y suis p- p- pour rien!
Solidarity of Steel#184.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#185.src: Don't try to get out of this, Zeph. You're just as complicit in this as the rest of us.
Solidarity of Steel#185.dst: N'essaie pas de te défiler, Zeph. Tu es tout aussi complice que nous.
Solidarity of Steel#185.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#186.src: Wh- I- fine... {u}, just get it o- over with. Go interrupt Syndra and Quill, and find out what th- they- wh- what they're talking about.
Solidarity of Steel#186.dst: Q- je- bon... {u}, finis-en u- une bonne fois. Va interrompre Syndra et Quill, et découvre ce qu'i- ils- d- de quoi ils parlent.
Solidarity of Steel#186.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#187.src: I will remember you fondly, my friend.
Solidarity of Steel#187.dst: Je garderai de toi un tendre souvenir, mon ami.
Solidarity of Steel#187.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#191.src: H-hey! Don't you have a m-mission to do?
Solidarity of Steel#191.dst: H-hé! T'as pas une m-mission à faire?
Solidarity of Steel#191.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#192.src: Ah, {u}! I see you have all returned. Welcome to our home.
Solidarity of Steel#192.dst: Ah, {u}! Je vois que vous êtes tous revenus. Bienvenue chez nous.
Solidarity of Steel#192.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#193.src: Speaking of nuisances... I can't help but notice the rest of our group looking onwards at our conversation with excitement.
Solidarity of Steel#193.dst: En parlant d'importuns... je remarque que le reste du groupe suit notre conversation avec beaucoup d'intérêt.
Solidarity of Steel#193.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#194.src: Ah! Understood. A noble one, at that.
Solidarity of Steel#194.dst: Ah! Compris. Un noble sacrifice, qui plus est.
Solidarity of Steel#194.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#195.src: In any case, Quill and I have been trying to plan out our next moves... but, if I'm being honest, most of that time has been spent catching up.
Solidarity of Steel#195.dst: Quoi qu'il en soit, Quill et moi tentions de planifier la suite... mais, à vrai dire, nous avons surtout échangé des nouvelles.
Solidarity of Steel#195.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#196.src: Don't be fooled. All of these people here are resisting to some extent, but very few are ready to go up against a God.
Solidarity of Steel#196.dst: Ne t'y trompe pas. Tous ici résistent dans une certaine mesure, mais bien peu sont prêts à affronter un dieu.
Solidarity of Steel#196.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#197.src: Hah! Goodness, how long has it been since we met face to face? It must have been... {~} years? Not since before you-
Solidarity of Steel#197.dst: Hah! Ma foi, depuis quand ne s'est-on pas vus en personne? Ça doit faire... {~} ans? Pas depuis avant que tu-
Solidarity of Steel#197.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#199.src: ...Ahem. Yes, of course. As Syndra said, we haven't truly started planning yet... You must be surprised by our numbers, yes? More members in the Steel Feather than you'd have expected.
Solidarity of Steel#199.dst: ...Hum. Oui, bien sûr. Comme l'a dit Syndra, nous n'avons pas encore vraiment commencé... Notre nombre doit te surprendre, non? Plus de membres dans la Plume d'acier que tu ne l'aurais cru.
Solidarity of Steel#199.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#200.src: In truth, looks may be deceiving. Everyone here is resisting in whatever ways they can manage, but few are willing to put as much of themselves into it as your group.
Solidarity of Steel#200.dst: En vérité, les apparences sont trompeuses. Chacun ici résiste comme il peut, mais peu sont prêts à s'investir autant que ton groupe.
Solidarity of Steel#200.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#201.src: Most of them are simply trying to live without the watchful eye of the monarchy. Our safe haven takes in people who are at risk. People who can't work, who have been thrown out of their homes...
Solidarity of Steel#201.dst: La plupart cherchent simplement à vivre loin de l'oeil vigilant de la monarchie. Notre refuge accueille les gens en danger. Ceux qui ne peuvent pas travailler, qu'on a chassés de chez eux...
Solidarity of Steel#201.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#202.src: But we are not helpless. The brothers and I are all ready to help, however we can. And the rest of the Steel Feather will still offer support from the sidelines. We have infrastructure, and we have resources.
Solidarity of Steel#202.dst: Mais nous ne sommes pas démunis. Les frères et moi sommes prêts à aider comme nous le pourrons. Et le reste de la Plume d'acier vous soutiendra en coulisses. Nous avons des installations et des ressources.
Solidarity of Steel#202.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#203.src: I've also suggested that you might offer to teach the basics of magic to those who are interested-
Solidarity of Steel#203.dst: J'ai aussi suggéré que tu pourrais enseigner les bases de la magie à ceux que ça intéresse-
Solidarity of Steel#203.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#204.src: Yes, yes, but I do not believe we need curses or blessings to resist. As I've told you several times before in our correspondences, Syndra!
Solidarity of Steel#204.dst: Oui, oui, mais je ne crois pas qu'il faille des malédictions ou des bénédictions pour résister. Je te l'ai écrit plusieurs fois, Syndra!
Solidarity of Steel#204.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#205.src: And as I've told you in response, I see no reason not to make use of all the tools available!
Solidarity of Steel#205.dst: Et je t'ai répondu que je ne vois aucune raison de se priver des outils à notre disposition!
Solidarity of Steel#205.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#206.src: Syndra, I have been firm on this point for a reason. We have done well for ourselves thus far.
Solidarity of Steel#206.dst: Syndra, si je reste ferme sur ce point, c'est pour une raison. Nous nous en sommes bien sortis jusqu'ici.
Solidarity of Steel#206.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#207.src: As an example- Yusanu has grown quite proficient with machinery. He has constructed weaponry, tools- even my leg is his creation!
Solidarity of Steel#207.dst: Par exemple- Yusanu est devenu très doué en mécanique. Il a fabriqué des armes, des outils- même ma jambe est de lui!
Solidarity of Steel#207.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#208.src: ... I simply think that-... Sigh. Fine. Quill, we should get to discussing the reason we came here.
Solidarity of Steel#208.dst: ... Je pense simplement que-... Soupir. Bien. Quill, parlons plutôt de la raison de notre venue.
Solidarity of Steel#208.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#209.src: Yes, I rather think we should. {u}, in the meantime, why don't you take a look around the station? Familiarize yourself with the area and the people.
Solidarity of Steel#209.dst: Oui, je crois que c'est préférable. {u}, en attendant, pourquoi ne pas faire le tour de la station? Familiarise-toi avec les lieux et les gens.
Solidarity of Steel#209.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#210.src: Explore the Steel Feather train station at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#210.dst: Explorez la station de la Plume d'acier en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#211.src: Take a look around the station! Familiarize yourself with the area and the people.
Solidarity of Steel#211.dst: Fais le tour de la station! Familiarise-toi avec les lieux et les gens.
Solidarity of Steel#211.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#212.src: Hoho! So they return! Tell us, how did it go?
Solidarity of Steel#212.dst: Hoho! Retour du front! Raconte-nous, comment ça s'est passé?
Solidarity of Steel#212.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#214.src: Ah, we all knew the stakes going in! Worry not, friend, your sacrifice will not be forgotten any time soon!
Solidarity of Steel#214.dst: Ah, nous connaissions tous les risques! N'aie crainte, mon ami, ton sacrifice ne sera pas oublié de sitôt!
Solidarity of Steel#214.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#215.src: Hey! E- e- enough with the theatrics!
Solidarity of Steel#215.dst: Hé! A- a- assez de comédie!
Solidarity of Steel#215.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#216.src: Excellent! You have successfully defied the odds, friend!
Solidarity of Steel#216.dst: Excellent! Tu as déjoué tous les pronostics, mon ami!
Solidarity of Steel#216.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#217.src: Zeph didn't believe you'd make it, you know.
Solidarity of Steel#217.dst: Zeph ne croyait pas que tu y arriverais, tu sais.
Solidarity of Steel#217.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#218.src: Wh- what, n- no I- I didn't- Sui!! D- don't- don't believe a word- a word she says, o- okay?
Solidarity of Steel#218.dst: Q- quoi, n- non j- je n'ai pas- Sui!! N- ne- ne crois pas un mot- un mot de ce qu'elle dit, d- d'accord?
Solidarity of Steel#218.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#219.src: Wh- what were they talking about, anyway?
Solidarity of Steel#219.dst: D- de quoi ils parlaient, au fait?
Solidarity of Steel#219.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#220.src: Oh, so it was as boring as I predicted.
Solidarity of Steel#220.dst: Oh, c'était donc aussi ennuyeux que prévu.
Solidarity of Steel#220.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#221.src: Don't call that boring, Rex! It's... nice for her to relax for a little, isn't it?
Solidarity of Steel#221.dst: Ne dis pas que c'est ennuyeux, Rex! C'est... bien qu'elle se détende un peu, non?
Solidarity of Steel#221.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#222.src: It can be both boring and a nice thing, can it not? The nice things often tend towards the boring end of the spectrum, in any case.
Solidarity of Steel#222.dst: Ce peut être à la fois ennuyeux et agréable, non? Les choses agréables tendent souvent vers l'ennui, de toute façon.
Solidarity of Steel#222.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#223.src: So, still n- nothing about the plans... when is she go- go- going to tell us anything?
Solidarity of Steel#223.dst: Donc, toujours r- rien sur les plans... quand est-ce qu'elle va n- n- nous dire quelque chose?
Solidarity of Steel#223.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#224.src: Have patience, young Leaf. She will tell us when it is time! Now, Sui and I have had the opportunity to explore, but you three have not! So, go on! Look around, talk to people.
Solidarity of Steel#224.dst: Patience, jeune Feuille. Elle nous le dira le moment venu! Sui et moi avons pu explorer, mais pas vous trois! Alors, allez! Faites le tour, parlez aux gens.
Solidarity of Steel#224.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#226.src: Ah. You're all back already? Man, I totally lost track of time there... there's so much to do.
Solidarity of Steel#226.dst: Ah. Vous êtes déjà tous revenus? Mince, j'ai complètement perdu la notion du temps... il y a tant à faire.
Solidarity of Steel#226.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#227.src: So, what's up? Sorry I couldn't talk to you more earlier- I'm the one who makes sure everything runs smoothly here.
Solidarity of Steel#227.dst: Alors, quoi de neuf? Désolé de ne pas avoir pu te parler plus tôt- c'est moi qui veille à ce que tout tourne ici.
Solidarity of Steel#227.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#228.src: Most of the infrastructure was here already, but I basically fixed it all up myself... with some help, of course. But now I'm in charge of maintaining all of it!
Solidarity of Steel#228.dst: La plupart des installations étaient déjà là, mais je les ai presque toutes réparées moi-même... avec un peu d'aide, bien sûr. Mais maintenant, c'est moi qui dois tout entretenir!
Solidarity of Steel#228.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#229.src: It's not usually this... hectic. We had some stuff break down recently, and I'm the oooonly one who can deal with it!
Solidarity of Steel#229.dst: D'habitude, ce n'est pas aussi... mouvementé. Des trucs sont tombés en panne récemment, et je suis le seuuuul à pouvoir m'en occuper!
Solidarity of Steel#229.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#231.src: ... Still don't have time to chat, sorry! I'm nearly done, though, I'll be out in a bit.
Solidarity of Steel#231.dst: ... Toujours pas le temps de discuter, désolé! Mais j'ai presque fini, je sors bientôt.
Solidarity of Steel#231.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#232.dst: Yo! Ils sont où, tes potes?
Solidarity of Steel#232.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#234.src: Hah! Yeah, yeah, maybe. I was hoping to tease him some more.
Solidarity of Steel#234.dst: Hah! Ouais, ouais, peut-être. J'espérais le taquiner encore un peu.
Solidarity of Steel#234.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#235.src: He's a fun guy! But the boy's gotta learn how to tease back... it's no fun if it's one-side, y'know?
Solidarity of Steel#235.dst: Il est marrant! Mais le gamin doit apprendre à répondre... c'est pas drôle si ça va que dans un sens, tu vois?
Solidarity of Steel#235.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#236.src: ...what? Ey, don't look at me like that! It's all for fun at the end of the day. If he tells me to quit it, I'll quit it.
Solidarity of Steel#236.dst: ...quoi? Hé, me regarde pas comme ça! Au fond, c'est juste pour rire. S'il me dit d'arrêter, j'arrête.
Solidarity of Steel#236.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#238.src: I'll... go over there later. Eventually! ... Maybe.
Solidarity of Steel#238.dst: J'irai... les voir plus tard. Un jour! ... Peut-être.
Solidarity of Steel#238.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#239.src: Eheh. Wouldn't want to overstay my welcome, y'know? I've got things to do, anyway...
Solidarity of Steel#239.dst: Héhé. Faudrait pas que je m'impose, tu vois? J'ai des trucs à faire, de toute façon...
Solidarity of Steel#239.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#240.src: ...so, you exploring? That's good! I'd show you around, but... eheh, I'm uh, working on a little something right now.
Solidarity of Steel#240.dst: ...alors, tu explores? C'est bien! Je te ferais bien visiter, mais... héhé, je bosse, euh, sur un petit truc, là.
Solidarity of Steel#240.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#241.src: Yo, quit trying to sneak a peak at it! No spoilers! You'll see it tonight, if I get it done.
Solidarity of Steel#241.dst: Yo, arrête d'essayer de jeter un oeil! Pas de spoilers! Tu verras ce soir, si je finis à temps.
Solidarity of Steel#241.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#243.src: Hm. I suppose you're used to invading personal space?
Solidarity of Steel#243.dst: Hm. Tu as l'habitude d'envahir l'espace des autres, je suppose?
Solidarity of Steel#243.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#244.src: Don't worry, I'm not upset. I appreciate the effort in familiarizing yourself with this place.
Solidarity of Steel#244.dst: Rassure-toi, je ne suis pas fâché. J'apprécie que tu fasses l'effort de découvrir les lieux.
Solidarity of Steel#244.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#245.src: Did you have a question, or are you just looking around?
Solidarity of Steel#245.dst: Tu avais une question, ou tu regardes juste?
Solidarity of Steel#245.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#246.src: Oh, has he done something again? Of course he has... I apologize for my brother's actions.
Solidarity of Steel#246.dst: Oh, il a encore fait quelque chose? Évidemment... Je m'excuse pour mon frère.
Solidarity of Steel#246.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#247.src: He's... hard to keep a handle on. Energetic, impulsive... I do love him, but do I ever wish he would cause less trouble.
Solidarity of Steel#247.dst: Il est... difficile à canaliser. Énergique, impulsif... Je l'aime, mais qu'est-ce que j'aimerais qu'il cause moins d'ennuis.
Solidarity of Steel#247.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#248.src: Ah. Then I apologize for my assumption.
Solidarity of Steel#248.dst: Ah. Alors pardonne-moi d'avoir supposé ça.
Solidarity of Steel#248.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#249.src: He's... I might be too hard on him sometimes. He does help out a lot around here, he does- just... like I said. Energetic and impulsive.
Solidarity of Steel#249.dst: Il est... je suis peut-être trop dur avec lui, parfois. Il aide beaucoup ici, vraiment- c'est juste... comme je l'ai dit. Énergique et impulsif.
Solidarity of Steel#249.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#250.src: You'll get used to his personality, with time. Everyone does.
Solidarity of Steel#250.dst: Tu t'habitueras à son caractère, avec le temps. Comme tout le monde.
Solidarity of Steel#250.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#251.src: But in any case, I'll speak with him about it. He should know better than to bother our guests.
Solidarity of Steel#251.dst: Quoi qu'il en soit, je lui en parlerai. Il devrait savoir qu'on n'importune pas nos invités.
Solidarity of Steel#251.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#252.src: I have to get back to work. I'll see you around.
Solidarity of Steel#252.dst: Je dois retourner travailler. A plus tard.
Solidarity of Steel#252.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#253.src: Hm? My role? That's a bit of a complex question, actually. In the Steel Feather... I don't do much.
Solidarity of Steel#253.dst: Hm? Mon rôle? C'est une question un peu compliquée, en fait. Dans la Plume d'acier... je ne fais pas grand-chose.
Solidarity of Steel#253.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#254.src: But I work as a consulting detective for the crown, in the city. I perform investigations for them, but I also gather information for us - keeping tabs on the military, and such.
Solidarity of Steel#254.dst: Mais je suis détective consultant pour la Couronne, en ville. Je mène des enquêtes pour eux, mais je recueille aussi des infos pour nous - je surveille l'armée, ce genre de choses.
Solidarity of Steel#254.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#255.src: Besides, the pay's... decent enough. A few emeralds in my pocket helps all of us down here. Unfortunately, we can't produce everything ourselves.
Solidarity of Steel#255.dst: Et puis, la paie est... correcte. Quelques émeraudes dans ma poche, ça aide tout le monde ici. Hélas, on ne peut pas tout produire nous-mêmes.
Solidarity of Steel#255.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#256.src: But speaking of my work, I... am actually busy preparing for a meeting right now. {p}'s Commander wants us on the lookout for... something, he hasn't told us yet.
Solidarity of Steel#256.dst: Mais en parlant de mon travail, je... prépare justement une réunion. Le commandant de {p} veut qu'on guette... quelque chose, il ne nous a pas encore dit quoi.
Solidarity of Steel#256.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#257.src: But it's my duty to find out, so into the city I will go. If you'll excuse me, I'll get back to preparing now.
Solidarity of Steel#257.dst: Mais c'est mon devoir de le découvrir, alors en ville j'irai. Si tu veux bien m'excuser, je retourne à mes préparatifs.
Solidarity of Steel#257.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#258.src: Return to the main room at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#258.dst: Retournez dans la salle principale en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#260.src: Nothing beyond what I'd written in our letters.
Solidarity of Steel#260.dst: Rien de plus que ce que je t'ai écrit dans mes lettres.
Solidarity of Steel#260.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#261.src: Alright... thank you, Quill. Just a little longer, then I-
Solidarity of Steel#261.dst: D'accord... merci, Quill. Encore un peu, et ensuite je-
Solidarity of Steel#261.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#262.src: Ah, {u}! What do you think of our home? It took a great deal of planning to get the station up and running, but I feel we've done a good-
Solidarity of Steel#262.dst: Ah, {u}! Que penses-tu de notre foyer? Il a fallu beaucoup de préparation pour remettre la station en marche, mais je crois qu'on a fait du bon-
Solidarity of Steel#262.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#265.src: I overheard... an altercation... between a woma-... and a- ...dier...
Solidarity of Steel#265.dst: J'ai entendu... une altercation... entre une fem-... et un- ...dat...
Solidarity of Steel#265.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#266.src: Calm yourself, Jiro. Take a breath, and repeat
Solidarity of Steel#266.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#267.src: A woman is being kicked out... again! I don't know the details, but I think she didn't reach her quota for the month.
Solidarity of Steel#267.dst: On expulse une femme... encore! Je ne connais pas les détails, mais je crois qu'elle n'a pas atteint son quota du mois.
Solidarity of Steel#267.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#269.src: Living Block {~} - through the southwestern tunnel.
Solidarity of Steel#269.dst: Bloc d'habitation {~} - par le tunnel sud-ouest.
Solidarity of Steel#269.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#272.dst: Q- quoi- qu'est-ce qui se passe?
Solidarity of Steel#272.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#273.src: We're heading out. Rescue mission. Yuman, where's Yulie?
Solidarity of Steel#273.dst: On sort. Mission de sauvetage. Yuman, où est Yulie?
Solidarity of Steel#273.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#274.src: He has a meeting in the city today, remember? He told all of us this morning.
Solidarity of Steel#274.dst: Il a une réunion en ville aujourd'hui, tu te souviens? Il nous l'a dit à tous ce matin.
Solidarity of Steel#274.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#275.src: ...Right. Right, he did say- alright. We'll have to go in blind, then. Not ideal, but it can't be helped-
Solidarity of Steel#275.dst: ...C'est vrai. C'est vrai, il l'a dit- bon. On ira à l'aveugle, alors. Pas idéal, mais on n'a pas le choix-
Solidarity of Steel#275.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#276.src: Damn it! Not now, of all times to-
Solidarity of Steel#276.dst: Bon sang! Pas maintenant, pas au moment où-
Solidarity of Steel#276.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#277.src: What's going on? Is something wrong?
Solidarity of Steel#277.dst: Que se passe-t-il? Il y a un problème?
Solidarity of Steel#277.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#278.src: No, no, nothing's- it's nothing bad... I hope. I just need to... check what triggered the alarm. Ugh, can anything go right today...
Solidarity of Steel#278.dst: Non, non, rien- rien de grave... j'espère. Je dois juste... voir ce qui a déclenché l'alarme. Pff, rien ne va aujourd'hui...
Solidarity of Steel#278.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#279.src: Hey, bro, don't worry about it. I'll handle it! You take care of whatever you need to, 'kay?
Solidarity of Steel#279.dst: Hé, frérot, t'inquiète pas. Je m'en charge! Toi, occupe-toi de ce que t'as à faire, OK?
Solidarity of Steel#279.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#280.src: ...Okay. Okay, thanks, Yuman. I owe you one.
Solidarity of Steel#280.dst: ...D'accord. D'accord, merci, Yuman. Je t'en dois une.
Solidarity of Steel#280.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#281.src: Hey, one of these days I'll collect on all those ones you owe me! Don't think you can dodge that just cause you're my bro!
Solidarity of Steel#281.dst: Hé, un de ces jours je vais réclamer toutes celles que tu me dois! Crois pas t'en tirer juste parce que t'es mon frère!
Solidarity of Steel#281.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#282.src: Will you n- ne- need help? {u} and I can join if y- if you need us.
Solidarity of Steel#282.dst: Vous a- a- aurez besoin d'aide? {u} et moi, on peut venir si v- si vous voulez.
Solidarity of Steel#282.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#283.src: Was just about to ask the same thing! Jiro, Zeph, {u}, you all listen to my orders 'till this is sorted! Got it?
Solidarity of Steel#283.dst: J'allais justement demander! Jiro, Zeph, {u}, vous suivez mes ordres jusqu'à ce que ce soit réglé! Compris?
Solidarity of Steel#283.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#285.src: You forgot the "sir" at the end, there! Anyway, let me grab my guitar, and let's head out!
Solidarity of Steel#285.dst: T'as oublié le "chef" à la fin! Bref, je prends ma guitare, et on y va!
Solidarity of Steel#285.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#287.src: Don't ask, you'll find out later. We need to get moving now.
Solidarity of Steel#287.dst: Pose pas de questions, tu verras plus tard. Faut bouger, maintenant.
Solidarity of Steel#287.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#289.src: Follow Yuman to the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#291.src: I hope Yuman doesn't annoy them to death...
Solidarity of Steel#291.dst: J'espère que Yuman ne va pas les rendre fous...
Solidarity of Steel#291.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#292.src: Th- through here! Yuman and Jiro are s- sc- scouting up ahead.
Solidarity of Steel#292.dst: P- par ici! Yuman et Jiro sont en é- é- éclaireurs devant.
Solidarity of Steel#292.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#293.src: Find the woman in trouble at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#293.dst: Trouvez la femme en détresse en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#294.src: I see them up a- a- ahead... Let's join up with them. Fo- follow me!
Solidarity of Steel#294.dst: Je les vois d- d- devant... Rejoignons-les. S- suis-moi!
Solidarity of Steel#294.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#296.src: Alright, lady! Time's up! It's time to get going.
Solidarity of Steel#296.dst: Bon, ma petite dame! C'est l'heure! Faut y aller.
Solidarity of Steel#296.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#297.src: We need to clean up this filthy apartment of yours for whoever's next in line. We've got a tight schedule, so don't make this harder than it needs to be, alright?
Solidarity of Steel#297.dst: On doit nettoyer ton appart crasseux pour le prochain sur la liste. On a un planning serré, alors ne complique pas les choses, compris?
Solidarity of Steel#297.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#298.src: W-w-wait! I still need to pack! You haven't given me enough time!
Solidarity of Steel#298.dst: A-a-attendez! Je dois encore faire mes bagages! Vous ne m'avez pas laissé assez de temps!
Solidarity of Steel#298.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#299.src: You received an eviction notice last night, detailing the protocol, didn't you? You've had plenty of time already, lady.
Solidarity of Steel#299.dst: Tu as reçu un avis d'expulsion hier soir, avec toute la procédure, non? T'as eu largement le temps, ma petite dame.
Solidarity of Steel#299.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#300.src: Unless what you mean to say is you take issue with the system? We've got a formal complaints department, lady, but I don't think you'd enjoy paying them a visit.
Solidarity of Steel#300.dst: A moins que tu veuilles dire que le système te pose problème? On a un service des réclamations, ma petite dame, mais je doute que la visite te plaise.
Solidarity of Steel#300.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#301.src: N-n-no! No, it- it's fine! I-I-I just- I'm just saying th-that- I just need a couple of minutes... Please!
Solidarity of Steel#301.dst: N-n-non! Non, c- c'est bon! J-j-je- je dis juste q-que- j'ai juste besoin de quelques minutes... Pitié!
Solidarity of Steel#301.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#302.src: Sigh. I did warn you, lady. Guess we're doing things the hard way, then.
Solidarity of Steel#302.dst: Soupir. Je t'avais prévenue, ma petite dame. On va faire ça à la dure, alors.
Solidarity of Steel#302.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#304.src: I'm sorry! I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm-
Solidarity of Steel#304.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#305.src: Disrespecting the crown is a serious crime, y'know. Alright, boys, you know what to do.
Solidarity of Steel#305.dst: Manquer de respect à la Couronne, c'est un crime grave, tu sais. Allez, les gars, vous savez quoi faire.
Solidarity of Steel#305.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#306.src: Hey! We n- ne- need to hel- help her!
Solidarity of Steel#306.dst: Hé! Il f- f- faut l'ai- l'aider!
Solidarity of Steel#306.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#307.src: Quiet! It's not protocol, we need to wait until the coast's clear, or else-
Solidarity of Steel#307.dst: Silence! C'est pas le protocole, faut attendre que la voie soit libre, sinon-
Solidarity of Steel#307.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#308.src: But th- they're going to beat her! We c- can- we c- can't just let that-
Solidarity of Steel#308.dst: Mais i- ils vont la frapper! On n- ne p- on ne peut pas laisser-
Solidarity of Steel#308.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#309.src: You're new here, so you get a pass for not knowing, but we cannot draw attention towards us.
Solidarity of Steel#309.dst: T'es nouveau ici, alors on te pardonne de ne pas savoir, mais on ne peut pas attirer l'attention.
Solidarity of Steel#309.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#310.src: Yeah, man! If the guards get a whiff of what we're doing, we're toast! The only reason we have the station is 'cause they don't know about it!
Solidarity of Steel#310.dst: Ouais, mec! Si les gardes flairent ce qu'on fait, on est cuits! Si on a encore la station, c'est parce qu'ils ne savent pas qu'elle existe!
Solidarity of Steel#310.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#311.src: M- m- maybe hiding is enough f- f- for you, but I c- ca- can't just let someone get h- hur- hurt!
Solidarity of Steel#311.dst: P- p- peut-être que vous cacher vous s- suffit, mais moi je n- ne peux pas laisser quelqu'un se faire b- bl- blesser!
Solidarity of Steel#311.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#312.src: S- so-... so sc- screw your cover! She n- n- needs help, so I- I'm going to h- he- help!
Solidarity of Steel#312.dst: A- alors-... au d- diable votre couverture! Elle a b- b- besoin d'aide, et j- je vais l'ai- l'aider!
Solidarity of Steel#312.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#313.src: Hey, don't!-... Damn it. Man, how am I gonna explain this to...
Solidarity of Steel#313.dst: Hé, fais pas ça!-... Bon sang. Mec, comment je vais expliquer ça à...
Solidarity of Steel#313.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#314.src: Defeat the soldiers attacking the woman at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#314.dst: Battez les soldats qui attaquent la femme en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#315.src: Fine, man! Can't just let you fight alone, can we? Let's just get this over with...
Solidarity of Steel#315.dst: Bon, d'accord, mec! On va pas te laisser te battre seul, hein? Finissons-en...
Solidarity of Steel#315.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#317.src: ..Okay. I th- th- I think the coast is clear. She sh- sh- should be-
Solidarity of Steel#317.dst: ..Bon. J- j- je crois que la voie est libre. Elle d- d- devrait être-
Solidarity of Steel#317.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#318.src: What the hell was that? What were you thinking?!
Solidarity of Steel#318.dst: C'était quoi, ça? Tu pensais à quoi?!
Solidarity of Steel#318.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#320.src: No, I really think I should-
Solidarity of Steel#320.dst: Non, je pense vraiment que je devrais-
Solidarity of Steel#320.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#321.src: Jiro. We've got other things to worry about, man. Cool it till we're back at the station, 'kay?
Solidarity of Steel#321.dst: Jiro. On a d'autres soucis, mec. Calme-toi jusqu'à ce qu'on soit rentrés à la station, OK?
Solidarity of Steel#321.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#323.src: Wh-who are you people? What are- what are you doing here?
Solidarity of Steel#323.dst: Q-qui êtes-vous? Qu'est-ce que- qu'est-ce que vous faites ici?
Solidarity of Steel#323.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#324.src: One can learn so much of the community's spirit by surveying the boards. See what they're worried of, see the way they support each other, see their culture...
Solidarity of Steel#324.dst: On apprend tant de l'esprit d'une communauté en parcourant ses panneaux d'affichage. Ce qui l'inquiète, la façon dont les gens s'entraident, leur culture...

Solidarity of Steel#325.src: Donated {~} IA by Sovereign Zhiraok after vandalization of previous noticeboard.
Solidarity of Steel#325.dst: Offert en {~} IA par le Souverain Zhiraok après le vandalisme du panneau précédent.

Solidarity of Steel#326.src: Said it was the Sovereign's problem, but I know the real reason. He just didn't want to go into The Flush.
Solidarity of Steel#326.dst: Il a dit que c'était le problème du Souverain, mais je connais la vraie raison. Il ne voulait juste pas descendre dans le Siphon.

Solidarity of Steel#327.src: You don't know us, and we don't know you. But we're here to help. I'm Yuman, and these are-
Solidarity of Steel#327.dst: Tu ne nous connais pas, et on ne te connaît pas. Mais on est là pour t'aider. Moi, c'est Yuman, et voici-
Solidarity of Steel#327.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#328.src: Why... why would you... help me...?
Solidarity of Steel#328.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#329.src: 'Cause... that's what people like us should do.
Solidarity of Steel#329.dst: Parce que... c'est ce que des gens comme nous devraient faire.
Solidarity of Steel#329.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#330.src: No! N-n-no... people like us should just do as we're told and not get involved in things that aren't ours!
Solidarity of Steel#330.dst: Non! N-n-non... des gens comme nous doivent juste obéir et ne pas se mêler de ce qui ne les regarde pas!
Solidarity of Steel#330.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#332.src: If I just follow orders, at least I'll survive! I might lose my apartment, and maybe everything I've built for myself, and all the things I've managed to keep for myself, but- but- but at least I'll be alive!
Solidarity of Steel#332.dst: Si j'obéis, au moins je survivrai! Je perdrai peut-être mon appartement, et peut-être tout ce que je me suis construit, et tout ce que j'ai réussi à garder, mais- mais- mais au moins je serai vivante!
Solidarity of Steel#332.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#333.src: ...I hear you. Trust me, Aihan, I really do.
Solidarity of Steel#333.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#334.src: Can I tell you a story?
Solidarity of Steel#334.dst: Je peux te raconter une histoire?
Solidarity of Steel#334.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#336.src: Long, long ago, when I was just a little kid, I lost my ma. Dad's out of the picture, so... my bros had to put in the work to take care of me, even though they were just kids too.
Solidarity of Steel#336.dst: Il y a très, très longtemps, quand j'étais tout gamin, j'ai perdu ma mère. Mon père n'était pas là, alors... mes frangins ont dû s'occuper de moi, alors qu'ils n'étaient que des gamins eux aussi.
Solidarity of Steel#336.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#337.src: But, y'know, being kids... they couldn't do enough. Failed to meet their quotas, just like you. Got kicked out, had to live on the streets.
Solidarity of Steel#337.dst: Mais tu sais, des gamins... ils n'y arrivaient pas. Ils n'ont pas atteint leurs quotas, comme toi. On les a expulsés, ils ont dû vivre dans la rue.
Solidarity of Steel#337.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#338.src: You want to know the reason we made it through that? It was 'cause someone reached out a helping hand. Gave us a place to stay, to work without the threat of not meeting expectations. To live, man.
Solidarity of Steel#338.dst: Tu veux savoir pourquoi on s'en est sortis? Parce que quelqu'un nous a tendu la main. Il nous a donné un toit, un endroit où travailler sans la menace des quotas. Où vivre, tu vois.
Solidarity of Steel#338.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#339.src: So... please. Accept the hand that's offered to you, 'kay? You can come with us and talk to the boss, and if what we have isn't enough for you... no one will force you to stay. But give it a try, please?
Solidarity of Steel#339.dst: Alors... s'il te plaît. Accepte la main qu'on te tend, OK? Viens avec nous parler au patron, et si ce qu'on a ne te suffit pas... personne ne te forcera à rester. Mais essaie, s'il te plaît?
Solidarity of Steel#339.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#341.src: Not to ruin the moment, Yuman, but we've got more soldiers coming our way! We've got to get moving soon!
Solidarity of Steel#341.dst: Désolé de gâcher le moment, Yuman, mais d'autres soldats arrivent! Faut qu'on bouge vite!
Solidarity of Steel#341.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#342.src: Damn... alright. Aihan, will you trust me?
Solidarity of Steel#342.dst: Mince... d'accord. Aihan, tu me fais confiance?
Solidarity of Steel#342.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#343.dst: Je... d'accord. Je vais... je vais essayer.
Solidarity of Steel#343.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#344.src: Okay... okay. Thank you. {u}, could you help her pack her stuff? Zeph, Jiro, help me prepare an escape route.
Solidarity of Steel#344.dst: OK... OK. Merci. {u}, tu peux l'aider à rassembler ses affaires? Zeph, Jiro, aidez-moi à préparer un itinéraire de fuite.
Solidarity of Steel#344.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#345.src: W-wait! I... I don't know what I'm packing!
Solidarity of Steel#345.dst: A-attends! Je... je ne sais pas quoi emporter!
Solidarity of Steel#345.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#346.src: Right. Uh... don't bring anything heavy. We have food and cookware where we're going...
Solidarity of Steel#346.dst: C'est vrai. Euh... rien de lourd. Là où on va, il y a de quoi manger et de quoi cuisiner...
Solidarity of Steel#346.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#347.src: Bring something to sleep with, something that reminds you of home... and maybe some form of entertainment, if you've got any.
Solidarity of Steel#347.dst: Prends de quoi dormir, quelque chose qui te rappelle ta maison... et peut-être de quoi te distraire, si t'as ça.
Solidarity of Steel#347.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#349.src: I... I can't think straight... this is all moving so fast... please- please, can you help me?
Solidarity of Steel#349.dst: Je... je n'arrive plus à réfléchir... tout va si vite... s'il te plaît- s'il te plaît, tu peux m'aider?
Solidarity of Steel#349.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#350.dst: Aidez Aihan à faire ses bagages en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#351.src: Grab that backpack and... pick whatever you think works...
Solidarity of Steel#351.dst: Prends ce sac à dos et... choisis ce qui te semble bien...
Solidarity of Steel#351.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#352.src: You've probably seen most of the station by now. Time to head back.
Solidarity of Steel#352.dst: Vous avez sans doute vu l'essentiel de la station. Il est temps de rentrer.

Solidarity of Steel#353.src: Grab that and... pick whatever you think works...
Solidarity of Steel#353.dst: Prends ça et... choisis ce qui te semble bien...
Solidarity of Steel#353.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#354.src: We have to hurry but I just can't think!
Solidarity of Steel#354.dst: Il faut se dépêcher mais je n'arrive pas à réfléchir!
Solidarity of Steel#354.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#355.src: Pack something to help Aihan sleep, some form of entertainment,  a piece of clothing, and something to remember.
Solidarity of Steel#355.dst: Emportez de quoi aider Aihan à dormir, de quoi la distraire, un vêtement et un souvenir.

Solidarity of Steel#356.src: {u}, h- h- hurry! We don't have m- mu- much time!
Solidarity of Steel#356.dst: {u}, d- d- dépêche-toi! On n'a pas b- b- beaucoup de temps!
Solidarity of Steel#356.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#357.dst: Halte! Vous êtes tous en état d'arrestation!
Solidarity of Steel#357.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#358.src: Where- where are you going? D-d-don't leave me here!
Solidarity of Steel#358.dst: Où- où tu vas? N-n-ne me laisse pas ici!
Solidarity of Steel#358.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#359.src: Did you get everything? Can we go?
Solidarity of Steel#359.dst: Tu as tout pris? On peut y aller?
Solidarity of Steel#359.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#362.src: Okay... No one's here yet. Let's go!
Solidarity of Steel#362.dst: D'accord... Personne n'est encore là. Allons-y!
Solidarity of Steel#362.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#364.src: We're out of time, we have to get moving! Come on, come on!
Solidarity of Steel#364.dst: On n'a plus le temps, faut bouger! Allez, allez!
Solidarity of Steel#364.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#365.src: Up the ladder, into the tunnel! Go, go, go!
Solidarity of Steel#365.dst: Montez l'échelle, dans le tunnel! Allez, allez, allez!
Solidarity of Steel#365.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#366.src: Yuman... c- co- come on. Let's go.
Solidarity of Steel#366.dst: Yuman... a- al- allez. On y va.
Solidarity of Steel#366.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#367.dst: Tu me donnes un coup de main?
Solidarity of Steel#367.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#369.src: Man... that was a really stupid thing for you to do. Like, astronomically stupid, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#369.dst: Mec... ce que t'as fait, c'était vraiment stupide. Genre, astronomiquement stupide, tu vois?
Solidarity of Steel#369.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#371.src: But I get it. I get it, y'know? If I didn't have to be a leader there, I'd've probably done the same thing!
Solidarity of Steel#371.dst: Mais je comprends. Je comprends, tu vois? Si j'avais pas dû jouer les chefs, j'aurais sûrement fait pareil!
Solidarity of Steel#371.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#372.src: Difference is, my bros can hold me back from that impulse. Guess I wasn't able to do that, here...
Solidarity of Steel#372.dst: La différence, c'est que mes frangins savent me retenir. J'ai pas réussi à faire pareil avec toi...
Solidarity of Steel#372.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#373.src: Hate to disappoint 'em, y'know? Bit late now, though. What's done is done, can't take it back.
Solidarity of Steel#373.dst: J'aime pas les décevoir, tu vois? Mais c'est trop tard. Ce qui est fait est fait, pas de retour en arrière.
Solidarity of Steel#373.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#374.src: It'll be alright. Worse things've happened. Aihan's safe, that's all that matters! We'll deal with the rest as it comes.
Solidarity of Steel#374.dst: Ça va aller. On a vu pire. Aihan est en sécurité, c'est tout ce qui compte! Le reste, on verra en temps voulu.
Solidarity of Steel#374.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#375.src: I- I should've... I should've l-lis- listened to you. But, s- s- seeing the way they- they were treating her... I was j- j- just so... angry. How dare th- they look down on p- p- people like that?!
Solidarity of Steel#375.dst: J- j'aurais dû... j'aurais dû t'é-écou- écouter. Mais, en v- v- voyant comment ils- ils la traitaient... j'étais t- t- tellement... en colère. Comment o- osent-ils mépriser les g- g- gens comme ça?!
Solidarity of Steel#375.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#376.src: Yeah... I hear you. Hear you loud and clear. It's not right, is it? But that's what we're working to fix down here, man. Gotta do what little you can, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#376.dst: Ouais... je comprends. Cinq sur cinq. C'est pas juste, hein? Mais c'est ce qu'on essaie de réparer ici, mec. Faut faire le peu qu'on peut, non?
Solidarity of Steel#376.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#377.src: Let's get going. They'll be expecting us. Wouldn't want to keep 'em waiting.
Solidarity of Steel#377.dst: Allons-y. Ils nous attendent. Faudrait pas les faire patienter.
Solidarity of Steel#377.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#378.src: ...We should f- f- follow them in.
Solidarity of Steel#378.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#379.src: Head back to the Steel Feather through the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#379.dst: Retournez à la Plume d'acier par le tunnel en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#380.src: Report what happened to The Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#380.dst: Racontez ce qui s'est passé à la Plume d'acier en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#382.src: Would- w- would it be weird to say it's a r- r- relief to find out he has a ser- a- a serious side to him?
Solidarity of Steel#382.dst: Ce s- s- serait bizarre de dire que c'est un s- s- soulagement de découvrir qu'il a un côté sé- s- sérieux?
Solidarity of Steel#382.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#383.src: Not- n- not that this is how I'd have w- w- wanted to find out...
Solidarity of Steel#383.dst: Pas- p- pas que j'aurais v- v- voulu le découvrir comme ça...
Solidarity of Steel#383.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#384.dst: Dis... o- où- où est Aihan?
Solidarity of Steel#384.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#385.src: Jiro and I got her settled. Quill's giving her the rundown as we speak.
Solidarity of Steel#385.dst: Jiro et moi, on l'a installée. Quill lui explique tout en ce moment même.
Solidarity of Steel#385.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#386.src: You should... probably avoid Jiro for now, yeah? He's not exactly... happy.
Solidarity of Steel#386.dst: Tu devrais... sans doute éviter Jiro pour l'instant, OK? Il est pas vraiment... ravi.
Solidarity of Steel#386.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#387.src: Right... Got it. So- s- so... how does it wor- work now? Should we re- record this mission s- somewhere?
Solidarity of Steel#387.dst: D'accord... Compris. A- a- alors... ça mar- marche comment, maintenant? On doit n- noter cette mission q- quelque part?
Solidarity of Steel#387.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#388.src: Yep, yep! Normally I'd go to Quill, but he's busy. Let's see if we can find Yusanu first- he'll... understand. Probably. More than Yulie, at least. I trust him to keep it quiet for now, at least... y'know?
Solidarity of Steel#388.dst: Ouais, ouais! D'habitude j'irais voir Quill, mais il est occupé. Cherchons d'abord Yusanu- il... comprendra. Sûrement. Mieux que Yulie, en tout cas. Je compte sur lui pour garder ça pour lui, au moins un temps... tu vois?
Solidarity of Steel#388.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#390.src: Yuman, I swear. Yusanu should know better than to let you take the lead on these sorts of things! What were you thinking?
Solidarity of Steel#390.dst: Yuman, je te jure. Yusanu devrait savoir qu'on ne te laisse pas diriger ce genre de choses! Tu pensais à quoi?
Solidarity of Steel#390.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#391.src: Woah, woah, woah! That's a lot of accusations out of nowhere, bro! What gives?
Solidarity of Steel#391.dst: Wow, wow, wow! Ça fait beaucoup d'accusations d'un coup, frérot! Qu'est-ce qui se passe?
Solidarity of Steel#391.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#392.src: What gives?! You know what gives- a whole squadron of housing enforcers turns up dead on the job, and you expect that to go over quietly?
Solidarity of Steel#392.dst: Ce qui se passe?! Tu le sais très bien- une escouade entière d'agents du logement retrouvée morte en service, et tu crois que ça va passer inaperçu?
Solidarity of Steel#392.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#393.src: Ahhh. That. Well, you know how it is. Things happen, right?
Solidarity of Steel#393.dst: Ahhh. Ça. Bah, tu sais ce que c'est. Ça arrive, non?
Solidarity of Steel#393.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#394.src: You-... at least pretend to take this seriously, would you? Of all people, you should know what this is going to lead to.
Solidarity of Steel#394.dst: Toi-... fais au moins semblant de prendre ça au sérieux, tu veux? Toi plus que quiconque, tu devrais savoir où ça va mener.
Solidarity of Steel#394.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#395.src: It- it was- was- it wasn't his f- f- fault, I-
Solidarity of Steel#395.dst: C- c'était- c'était- ce n'était pas sa f- f- faute, je-
Solidarity of Steel#395.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#396.src: Hey, princess, it's alright. Don't need you to cover for me, 'kay?
Solidarity of Steel#396.dst: Hé, princesse, c'est bon. T'as pas besoin de me couvrir, OK?
Solidarity of Steel#396.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#397.src: So what's the plan then, Yulie? Meeting to talk about it, as always?
Solidarity of Steel#397.dst: Alors, c'est quoi le plan, Yulie? Une réunion pour en parler, comme d'hab?
Solidarity of Steel#397.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#398.src: Sigh... as soon as Quill gets Aihan sorted, yes. It shouldn't take long, so everyone's gathered in advance.
Solidarity of Steel#398.dst: Soupir... dès que Quill en aura fini avec Aihan, oui. Ça ne devrait pas être long, alors tout le monde est déjà réuni.
Solidarity of Steel#398.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#400.src: Hey! What happened out there? Everyone's acting weird about it.
Solidarity of Steel#400.dst: Hé! Qu'est-ce qui s'est passé là-bas? Tout le monde est bizarre avec ça.
Solidarity of Steel#400.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#401.src: We ended up f- fight- fighting some soldiers to save the w- w- the woman we went there for...
Solidarity of Steel#401.dst: On a fini par c- com- combattre des soldats pour sauver la f- f- la femme qu'on était venus chercher...
Solidarity of Steel#401.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#402.src: Huh. Is that all? I thought it'd be way worse.
Solidarity of Steel#402.dst: Hein. C'est tout? Je pensais que ce serait bien pire.
Solidarity of Steel#402.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#403.src: Yeah... they- th- they're worried about it dr- draw- drawing attention...
Solidarity of Steel#403.dst: Ouais... ils- i- ils ont peur que ça at- atti- attire l'attention...
Solidarity of Steel#403.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#405.src: Still helping out in the kitchen, preparing for dinner! Worry not, I will catch her up once the meeting concludes.
Solidarity of Steel#405.dst: Toujours en cuisine, à aider pour le dîner! N'ayez crainte, je la mettrai au courant après la réunion.
Solidarity of Steel#405.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#406.src: Ah, hello everybody. Apologies for the delay.
Solidarity of Steel#406.dst: Ah, bonjour à tous. Pardon pour le retard.
Solidarity of Steel#406.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#408.src: She hasn't quite decided yet, but she has agreed to stay the night. She's in a bad state of mind, the poor woman. Some rest will do her good.
Solidarity of Steel#408.dst: Elle n'a pas encore tout à fait décidé, mais elle a accepté de rester pour la nuit. Elle n'a pas le moral, la pauvre. Un peu de repos lui fera du bien.
Solidarity of Steel#408.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#409.src: But that leads us well to the reason this meeting was called. The retrieval process went... poorly, I take it?
Solidarity of Steel#409.dst: Mais cela nous amène à la raison de cette réunion. Le sauvetage s'est... mal passé, si je comprends bien?
Solidarity of Steel#409.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#410.src: Poorly is an understatement. The military is on high alert now! Everyone entering or leaving {p} this evening was questioned- if I hadn't used our tunnel, I'd still be stuck in line there!
Solidarity of Steel#410.dst: Mal, c'est un euphémisme. L'armée est en état d'alerte maximale! Tous ceux qui entraient ou sortaient de {p} ce soir ont été interrogés- sans notre tunnel, je serais encore coincé dans la file!
Solidarity of Steel#410.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#411.src: This is an unmitigated disaster. Yuman, what do you have to say for yourself? You should know better by now, we need to-
Solidarity of Steel#411.dst: C'est un désastre complet. Yuman, qu'as-tu à dire pour ta défense? Tu devrais savoir, depuis le temps, qu'on doit-
Solidarity of Steel#411.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#412.src: H- hey! It- it- it's not- it's n- not his f- f- fault! I'm the- the one who-
Solidarity of Steel#412.dst: H- hé! C- c- ce n'est pas- ce n'est p- pas sa f- f- faute! C'est m- moi qui-
Solidarity of Steel#412.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#413.src: Nah, the blame falls on me. I was the leader, so anything that happened is my responsibility. I should've... been more firm about it.
Solidarity of Steel#413.dst: Non, c'est ma faute. J'étais le chef, donc tout ce qui s'est passé est sous ma responsabilité. J'aurais dû... être plus ferme.
Solidarity of Steel#413.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#414.src: None of this would have happened if I'd been there... damn it. The timing couldn't have been worse. This is all my-
Solidarity of Steel#414.dst: Rien de tout ça ne serait arrivé si j'avais été là... bon sang. Ça ne pouvait pas plus mal tomber. Tout est de ma-
Solidarity of Steel#414.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#415.src: Okay, that's enough. You're all acting stupid! Who cares whose fault it was? Either way, it already happened, so let's figure out what we're going to do about it.
Solidarity of Steel#415.dst: Bon, ça suffit. Vous êtes ridicules! On s'en fiche de savoir à qui la faute! C'est arrivé, alors voyons plutôt ce qu'on va faire.
Solidarity of Steel#415.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#417.src: And I'm not done! You're all acting like it's the end of the world that some soldiers are dead. So what? Soldiers die all the time.
Solidarity of Steel#417.dst: Et j'ai pas fini! Vous faites comme si quelques soldats morts, c'était la fin du monde. Et alors? Des soldats meurent tout le temps.
Solidarity of Steel#417.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#418.src: They don't die like this, though. We don't have the luxury of being able to wave off the crown's attention! If they find out what we're doing down here, we're done for.
Solidarity of Steel#418.dst: Pas comme ça. Nous ne pouvons pas nous permettre d'ignorer l'attention de la Couronne! S'ils découvrent ce qu'on fait ici, c'est fini pour nous.
Solidarity of Steel#418.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#419.src: But they haven't found out yet, have they? You have options still. For example- you're on the detective force! If suspicions arise, couldn't you just lead them elsewhere?
Solidarity of Steel#419.dst: Mais ils n'ont encore rien découvert, si? Vous avez encore des options. Par exemple- tu es détective! Si des soupçons apparaissent, tu ne pourrais pas les orienter ailleurs?
Solidarity of Steel#419.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#420.src: Besides. If staying hidden means having to look away as innocent people get harmed- what kind of a resistance does that make you? What's the point of any of it?
Solidarity of Steel#420.dst: Et puis. Si rester caché veut dire détourner les yeux pendant qu'on fait du mal à des innocents- quel genre de résistance êtes-vous? A quoi bon tout ça?
Solidarity of Steel#420.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#421.src: Rex... take care with your words. Don't say anything you'll-
Solidarity of Steel#421.dst: Rex... surveille tes paroles. Ne dis rien que tu-
Solidarity of Steel#421.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#422.src: What's the POINT?! The POINT is all the people we ALREADY have down here who we need to protect! Quill, please, back me up here.
Solidarity of Steel#422.dst: A QUOI BON?! Le BUT, ce sont tous ceux qu'on abrite ICI et qu'on doit protéger! Quill, je t'en prie, soutiens-moi.
Solidarity of Steel#422.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#423.src: ... No, Yulie, Rex has a point. Even if it was phrased harshly... we have been rather passive in our battle thus far. We've let people get hurt, even if only for the sake of our safety.
Solidarity of Steel#423.dst: ... Non, Yulie, Rex n'a pas tort. Même si c'est dit durement... nous avons été plutôt passifs jusqu'ici. Nous avons laissé des gens souffrir, même si c'était pour notre sécurité.
Solidarity of Steel#423.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#424.src: We have had our reasons... and we have done good work, to the best of our ability. But if we are afraid to act, how will anything ever change for the better?
Solidarity of Steel#424.dst: Nous avions nos raisons... et nous avons fait du bon travail, de notre mieux. Mais si nous avons peur d'agir, comment les choses pourraient-elles s'améliorer?
Solidarity of Steel#424.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#425.src: You are not wrong to feel frustration, Yulie. I, too, wish this had been handled with more care... but something like this was bound to happen eventually. We will survive this, as we have survived other hardships before.
Solidarity of Steel#425.dst: Ta frustration est légitime, Yulie. Moi aussi, j'aurais aimé qu'on agisse avec plus de prudence... mais ce genre de chose devait arriver tôt ou tard. Nous survivrons à ça, comme à d'autres épreuves avant.
Solidarity of Steel#425.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#427.src: ...But let's lighten the mood a little! Dinner should almost be ready. Yuman, you told me earlier today you were working on a new song. Would you still like to perform it tonight?
Solidarity of Steel#427.dst: ...Mais détendons un peu l'atmosphère! Le dîner est presque prêt. Yuman, tu m'as dit aujourd'hui que tu travaillais sur une nouvelle chanson. Tu veux toujours la jouer ce soir?
Solidarity of Steel#427.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#428.src: Huh? Oh, yeah, yeah man! I can do that, for sure.
Solidarity of Steel#428.dst: Hein? Oh, ouais, ouais, mec! Bien sûr que je peux.
Solidarity of Steel#428.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#429.src: Ahem. Before we depart, if I may- while we are all gathered here, I believe it could be beneficial to lay out some relevant information.
Solidarity of Steel#429.dst: Hum. Avant de nous séparer, si je puis me permettre- puisque nous sommes tous réunis, il serait utile de mettre en commun quelques informations.
Solidarity of Steel#429.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#430.src: Most of us are new to the Roughworks, so getting to know the lay of the land could help.
Solidarity of Steel#430.dst: La plupart d'entre nous découvrent Roughworks, connaître le terrain pourrait nous aider.
Solidarity of Steel#430.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#431.src: Right, of course. I'd been meaning to suggest something similar earlier, before... this situation came up.
Solidarity of Steel#431.dst: Oui, bien sûr. Je comptais proposer quelque chose de semblable, avant que... cette situation ne survienne.
Solidarity of Steel#431.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#432.src: Certainly, we could do that! What would you like to know?
Solidarity of Steel#432.dst: Bien sûr, faisons-le! Que voulez-vous savoir?
Solidarity of Steel#432.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#433.src: Ah, yes. Her name is Soosu. It's hard to say much about her... she's rather reclusive, staying cooped up in her mansion, working away.
Solidarity of Steel#433.dst: Ah, oui. Elle s'appelle Soosu. Difficile d'en dire beaucoup sur elle... elle vit plutôt recluse, enfermée dans son manoir à travailler.
Solidarity of Steel#433.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#434.src: She's the opposite of Zhiraok, in that way. Ideally, we'll avoid drawing her attention. We'll have plenty to worry about already without adding her to the list.
Solidarity of Steel#434.dst: En cela, elle est l'opposé de Zhiraok. Idéalement, on évitera d'attirer son attention. On aura déjà bien assez de soucis sans l'ajouter à la liste.
Solidarity of Steel#434.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#435.src: That'd be for the best, yeah. She's... kind of a genius. She singlehandedly brought forth the Industrial Age, over a century ago! Most of the machinery you see in Fruma probably traces its origin back to her in some way.
Solidarity of Steel#435.dst: Ce serait mieux, oui. C'est... une sorte de génie. Elle a lancé à elle seule l'Ère industrielle, il y a plus d'un siècle! La plupart des machines de Fruma lui doivent sûrement quelque chose.
Solidarity of Steel#435.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#436.src: Ha! Yeah, yeah, figures you'd know all that, bro. Nerd.
Solidarity of Steel#436.dst: Ha! Ouais, ouais, évidemment que tu sais tout ça, frérot. Intello.
Solidarity of Steel#436.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#437.src: Wh- that's just written history, Yuman. If you're going to make fun of me, at least do it right.
Solidarity of Steel#437.dst: Qu- c'est juste de l'histoire, Yuman. Si tu veux te moquer de moi, fais-le au moins correctement.
Solidarity of Steel#437.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#438.src: How about her blessing? If we do run into her, we'll want to know what to watch out for.
Solidarity of Steel#438.dst: Et sa bénédiction? Si on tombe sur elle, autant savoir à quoi s'attendre.
Solidarity of Steel#438.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#439.src: I don't know the specifics... but what I do know is that it allows her to mold matter at will. To what extent, or with what limits... hard to say. Still, that uncertainty is dangerous. Be careful.
Solidarity of Steel#439.dst: Je n'en connais pas les détails... mais je sais qu'elle lui permet de modeler la matière à volonté. Jusqu'où, avec quelles limites... difficile à dire. Cette incertitude est dangereuse. Soyez prudents.
Solidarity of Steel#439.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#440.src: Very well! Then let us adjourn for dinner.
Solidarity of Steel#440.dst: Très bien! Levons donc la séance pour le dîner.
Solidarity of Steel#440.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#441.src: Speak to Sui at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and watch Yuman's performance.
Solidarity of Steel#441.dst: Parlez à Sui en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] et assistez au spectacle de Yuman.

Solidarity of Steel#442.src: Yuman's performance is about to start. You should grab a bite from Sui!
Solidarity of Steel#442.dst: Le spectacle de Yuman va commencer. Va donc chercher à manger auprès de Sui!
Solidarity of Steel#442.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#443.src: Oh, {u}! I feel like I've barely seen you around here...
Solidarity of Steel#443.dst: Oh, {u}! J'ai l'impression qu'on ne s'est presque pas croisés...
Solidarity of Steel#443.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#444.src: I, um... Mora told me about what happened. On your mission. I'm... glad you were able to help that woman.
Solidarity of Steel#444.dst: Je, euh... Mora m'a raconté ce qui s'est passé. Pendant votre mission. Je suis... contente que vous ayez pu aider cette femme.
Solidarity of Steel#444.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#445.src: I, ha, kind of wish I could've been there, to help. Though, I don't... really know what I could have done, there.
Solidarity of Steel#445.dst: J'aurais, ha, un peu aimé être là, pour aider. Même si je ne... sais pas trop ce que j'aurais pu faire.
Solidarity of Steel#445.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#446.src: S-so maybe it's a good thing! That I've been, um, busy, cooking. For the Steel Feather. There's, ha, a lot of people here!
Solidarity of Steel#446.dst: A-alors c'est peut-être une bonne chose! Que j'aie été, euh, occupée, à cuisiner. Pour la Plume d'acier. Il y a, ha, beaucoup de monde ici!
Solidarity of Steel#446.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#447.src: But I've been learning new recipes, and getting to know new people! Oh, right, you're probably here for, um, the food. Here! Please have some.
Solidarity of Steel#447.dst: Mais j'apprends de nouvelles recettes, et je rencontre plein de gens! Oh, c'est vrai, tu viens sans doute pour, euh, manger. Tiens! Sers-toi.
Solidarity of Steel#447.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#448.src: ...oh, hi! Are you here for some food?
Solidarity of Steel#448.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#449.src: Ah, n-no, I- well, yes, I'd love some food, but I'm here to- to thank {u}.
Solidarity of Steel#449.dst: Ah, n-non, je- enfin, si, je mangerais bien quelque chose, mais je viens- je viens remercier {u}.
Solidarity of Steel#449.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#450.src: Don't- don't sell yourself short! I don't... f-fully understand yet, but, fighting the guards like... like that is dangerous, and- and I know why some people wouldn't want to...
Solidarity of Steel#450.dst: Ne- ne te sous-estime pas! Je ne... c-comprends pas encore tout, mais, affronter les gardes comme... comme ça, c'est dangereux, et- et je sais pourquoi certains ne voudraient pas...
Solidarity of Steel#450.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#451.src: We- no, no, no, this- this won't work, I can't- you need to pack different things, I can't go with- with this, pleas
Solidarity of Steel#451.dst: Non- non, non, non, ça- ça ne va pas, je ne peux pas- il faut emporter d'autres choses, je ne peux pas partir avec- avec ça, s'il te plaî

Solidarity of Steel#452.src: It's the poster you stuck on advertising the Pishlas Hot Springs.
Solidarity of Steel#452.dst: C'est l'affiche que tu as collée, une pub pour les sources chaudes de Pishlas.

Solidarity of Steel#453.src: But you did anyway, and- and- and it means a lot.
Solidarity of Steel#453.dst: Mais vous l'avez fait quand même, et- et- et ça compte beaucoup.
Solidarity of Steel#453.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#454.src: It, um, sounds like it was a really bad situation. So I'm glad you got out alright.
Solidarity of Steel#454.dst: C'était, euh, une sale situation, on dirait. Je suis contente que vous vous en soyez sortis.
Solidarity of Steel#454.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#455.src: H-ha... yes. They've been... p-pushy before, but they've never been this- this- this, ah, violent.
Solidarity of Steel#455.dst: H-ha... oui. Ils avaient déjà été... i-insistants, mais jamais aussi- aussi- aussi, ah, violents.
Solidarity of Steel#455.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#457.src: Y-yes, I am. It's... new, and- and different, but everyone here has been so kind, and...
Solidarity of Steel#457.dst: O-oui. C'est... nouveau, et- et différent, mais tout le monde ici a été si gentil, et...
Solidarity of Steel#457.speaker: Aihan
