Solidarity of Steel#458.src: It's a little- a little strange... It almost feels like- like- like I don't deserve it! Because, I- I- I haven't... w-worked for it.
Solidarity of Steel#458.dst: C'est un peu- un peu étrange... J'ai presque l'impression que- que- que je ne le mérite pas! Parce que, je- je- je n'ai pas... t-travaillé pour.
Solidarity of Steel#458.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#459.src: Um... I don't really, know, what it's like to live here... but where I'm from, people help each other. You shouldn't have to earn the right to live.
Solidarity of Steel#459.dst: Euh... je ne sais pas vraiment, comment, c'est de vivre ici... mais d'où je viens, les gens s'entraident. On ne devrait pas avoir à mériter le droit de vivre.
Solidarity of Steel#459.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#460.src: Y-you must be from a much n-nicer place than- than here.
Solidarity of Steel#460.dst: T-tu dois venir d'un endroit bien p-plus agréable qu'ici- qu'ici.
Solidarity of Steel#460.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#461.src: Ha... it's k-kind of ridiculous, looking back. Stupid- s-stupid quotas... ouch...
Solidarity of Steel#461.dst: Ha... c'est p-presque ridicule, avec le recul. Fichus- f-fichus quotas... aïe...
Solidarity of Steel#461.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#462.src: You want to know my story?

Solidarity of Steel#464.src: Oh, it- it's... nothing. Just, heavy m-machinery. Hurt my shoulder when- when I went in. It- it's r-really my fault, I, I, I sh-should have been m-more careful...
Solidarity of Steel#464.dst: Oh, c- ce n'est... rien. Juste, des m-machines lourdes. Je me suis fait mal à l'épaule en- en y allant. C- c'est v-vraiment ma faute, j'aurais, j'aurais, j'aurais d-dû faire p-plus attention...
Solidarity of Steel#464.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#465.src: Um... I- I can, ha, I can help you.
Solidarity of Steel#465.dst: Euh... je- je peux, ha, je peux t'aider.
Solidarity of Steel#465.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#467.src: Just... sigh. Follow me, and- and trust me.
Solidarity of Steel#467.dst: Juste... soupir. Suis-moi, et- et fais-moi confiance.
Solidarity of Steel#467.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#470.src: H-hey! I- I only have this shirt, I c- I can't- I-
Solidarity of Steel#470.dst: H-hé! Je- je n'ai que cette chemise, je ne p- je ne peux pas- je-
Solidarity of Steel#470.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#473.src: How did- how did you do that?
Solidarity of Steel#473.dst: Comment tu- comment tu as fait ça?
Solidarity of Steel#473.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#474.dst: Je suis... je suis maudite. Voilà comment.
Solidarity of Steel#474.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#476.src: I-... th-thank you. I didn't... I didn't know cursed ones could be- could be nice.
Solidarity of Steel#476.dst: Je-... m-merci. Je ne savais pas... je ne savais pas que les Maudits pouvaient être- être gentils.
Solidarity of Steel#476.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#477.src: Um... I sh-should go. Thank you for- for the food, and- and- and for... healing my shoulder. I- I really appreciate it.
Solidarity of Steel#477.dst: Euh... je d-dois y aller. Merci pour- pour le repas, et- et- et pour... avoir soigné mon épaule. Je- je t'en suis vraiment reconnaissante.
Solidarity of Steel#477.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#479.src: It's fine. It's what I expected. I'm... glad I could help.
Solidarity of Steel#479.dst: Ce n'est rien. Je m'y attendais. Je suis... contente d'avoir pu aider.
Solidarity of Steel#479.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#480.src: I- I guess so! Ha... at least she, um, wasn't scared. Just... nervous.
Solidarity of Steel#480.dst: J- je suppose! Ha... au moins, elle n'a, euh, pas eu peur. Elle était juste... nerveuse.
Solidarity of Steel#480.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#481.src: I'll, um, catch up with the rest of you, later.
Solidarity of Steel#481.dst: Je vous, euh, rejoins tous plus tard.
Solidarity of Steel#481.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#482.src: Go join the others. Uh, I'll join you in a bit.
Solidarity of Steel#482.dst: Va rejoindre les autres. Euh, j'arrive dans un moment.
Solidarity of Steel#482.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#483.src: {u}, it's nice of you to join us. Have you had dinner yet?
Solidarity of Steel#483.dst: {u}, c'est gentil de te joindre à nous. Tu as déjà dîné?
Solidarity of Steel#483.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#484.src: It's good, isn't it? Quill tells me she's managed to fit right in with the other cooks here.
Solidarity of Steel#484.dst: C'est bon, n'est-ce pas? Quill me dit qu'elle s'est parfaitement intégrée parmi les cuisiniers.
Solidarity of Steel#484.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#485.src: So, {u}, are you also w- wait- waiting for Yuman's performance?
Solidarity of Steel#485.dst: Alors, {u}, toi aussi tu a- att- attends le spectacle de Yuman?
Solidarity of Steel#485.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#486.src: I have heard great things about his musical talents! Though, ah, I have also heard this his variety, ah, leaves something to be desired.
Solidarity of Steel#486.dst: On m'a dit le plus grand bien de ses talents musicaux! Mais, ah, on m'a aussi dit que son répertoire, ah, laisse à désirer.
Solidarity of Steel#486.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#487.src: Then worry not, for you have been reminded just now, hoho!
Solidarity of Steel#487.dst: Alors ne t'en fais pas, on vient de te le rappeler, hoho!
Solidarity of Steel#487.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#488.src: Hey, maybe he's written a song about you, Zeph!
Solidarity of Steel#488.dst: Hé, il a peut-être écrit une chanson sur toi, Zeph!
Solidarity of Steel#488.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#489.src: Wh- wh- what?! R- Rex, no h- he-... that's n- not-... wh- why would he ev- even-
Solidarity of Steel#489.dst: Q- q- quoi?! R- Rex, non, i- il-... c'est p- pas-... p- pourquoi il irait m- même-
Solidarity of Steel#489.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#490.src: Ha! Relax, relax, I'm just teasing ya.
Solidarity of Steel#490.dst: Ha! Relax, relax, je te taquine.
Solidarity of Steel#490.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#491.src: Ahem... Attention, attention! Everyone, gather around!
Solidarity of Steel#491.dst: Hum... Votre attention, s'il vous plaît! Approchez, tout le monde!
Solidarity of Steel#491.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#492.src: I am heartened to see so many of you joining us for dinner today. It feels as though it has been a while since we've had such a large attendance!
Solidarity of Steel#492.dst: Ça me réchauffe le coeur de vous voir si nombreux à dîner ce soir. Il me semble que nous n'avions pas eu autant de monde depuis longtemps!
Solidarity of Steel#492.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#493.src: There is of course news to deliver... but first! We begin by thanking our cooks for the meal.
Solidarity of Steel#493.dst: Il y a bien sûr des nouvelles à annoncer... mais d'abord! Commençons par remercier nos cuisiniers pour ce repas.
Solidarity of Steel#493.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#494.src: We're all familiar with Fletch's talents, but dinner wouldn't have been possible without the help of one of our new arrivals: Sui!
Solidarity of Steel#494.dst: Nous connaissons tous le talent de Fletch, mais ce dîner n'aurait pas été possible sans l'aide d'une nouvelle venue: Sui!
Solidarity of Steel#494.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#495.src: Oh...! It, ha, it- um. It was nothing. T'was my pleasure! To- to help.
Solidarity of Steel#495.dst: Oh...! Ce, ha, ce- euh. Ce n'était rien. Ce fut un plaisir! D'ai- d'aider.
Solidarity of Steel#495.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#496.src: No need to be shy, my dear!
Solidarity of Steel#496.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#497.src: Dinner aside, let's get to the announcements!
Solidarity of Steel#497.dst: Assez parlé du dîner, passons aux annonces!
Solidarity of Steel#497.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#498.src: Today, we have had not one, but seven new arrivals! In addition to Sui, please welcome Aihan, Mora, Rex, Zeph, {u}, and Syndra!
Solidarity of Steel#498.dst: Aujourd'hui, nous avons accueilli non pas un, mais sept nouveaux venus! Avec Sui, souhaitez la bienvenue à Aihan, Mora, Rex, Zeph, {u} et Syndra!
Solidarity of Steel#498.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#499.src: Now, I'm certain news has spread of our... altercation, shall we say, with the crown's military. I assure you, all is under control! The Steel Feather remains secure and hidden.
Solidarity of Steel#499.dst: Bien, vous avez sûrement entendu parler de notre... altercation, disons, avec l'armée de la Couronne. Je vous assure que tout est sous contrôle! La Plume d'acier reste sûre et cachée.
Solidarity of Steel#499.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#500.src: It does mean expeditions out of the station will be at higher risk for a time. We will have updated guidelines available in the morning for those of you who volunteer.
Solidarity of Steel#500.dst: Cela veut dire que les sorties hors de la station seront plus risquées pendant un temps. De nouvelles consignes seront disponibles demain matin pour les volontaires.
Solidarity of Steel#500.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#501.src: But in lighter news, we have restocked candy bars and sodas at the ticket shops! Make sure to trade for some before they run out - remember the rules, one of each per person.
Solidarity of Steel#501.dst: Mais côté bonnes nouvelles, nous avons réapprovisionné les barres chocolatées et les sodas aux guichets! Échangez-en avant qu'il n'y en ait plus - rappelez-vous la règle, un de chaque par personne.
Solidarity of Steel#501.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#502.src: Well then! Barring any surprises at this very moment, that is all for today's report. As he has volunteered himself today, I will hand over the stage to Yuman.
Solidarity of Steel#502.dst: Eh bien! Sauf surprise de dernière minute, ce sera tout pour aujourd'hui. Puisqu'il s'est porté volontaire, je laisse la scène à Yuman.
Solidarity of Steel#502.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#503.src: Heeeeeelllllooooo people of the Steel Feather!
Solidarity of Steel#503.dst: Saluuuuuut, les gens de la Plume d'acier!
Solidarity of Steel#503.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#504.src: Good to see you all as always- ey, Taio, lookin' good! Mei, love what you've done with the hair! Jin, my man!
Solidarity of Steel#504.dst: Content de vous voir comme toujours- hé, Taio, t'as la classe! Mei, j'adore ta coiffure! Jin, mon pote!
Solidarity of Steel#504.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#505.src: Ah... I guess I can introduce my song. It's a new one! You guys won't be able to tease me for being an artist with only one song anymore, haha!
Solidarity of Steel#505.dst: Ah... je vais présenter ma chanson. C'en est une nouvelle! Vous pourrez plus me charrier parce que je n'ai qu'une seule chanson, haha!
Solidarity of Steel#505.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#506.src: I've been working on this one for a while. Never could find a way to end it, though... 'till now, that is. Finally managed to find some inspiration.
Solidarity of Steel#506.dst: Ça fait un moment que je bosse dessus. J'arrivais jamais à trouver la fin... jusqu'à maintenant. J'ai enfin trouvé l'inspiration.
Solidarity of Steel#506.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#507.src: Well, enough talking from me. Here it goes!
Solidarity of Steel#507.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#508.src: Hm hm hm! Look who it is!
Solidarity of Steel#508.dst: Hm hm hm! Regardez qui voilà!
Solidarity of Steel#508.speaker: ??? (Sovereign Soosu)

Solidarity of Steel#511.src: Happy to see you again, Flowers.
Solidarity of Steel#511.dst: Quel plaisir de te revoir, Flowers.
Solidarity of Steel#511.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solidarity of Steel#513.src: You need to subtract some of this security. It shouldn't need to take twenty minutes to get through just the gate. We need to talk, an hour ago.
Solidarity of Steel#513.dst: Tu dois soustraire une partie de cette sécurité. Il ne devrait pas falloir vingt minutes juste pour franchir le portail. Il fallait qu'on parle il y a une heure.
Solidarity of Steel#513.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solidarity of Steel#514.src: Wow, mister loudmouth, big words for someone who wasn't supposed to be here for a few more weeks! What gives?! You're interrupting my flow!
Solidarity of Steel#514.dst: Ouah, monsieur grande gueule, quels grands mots pour quelqu'un qui ne devait pas venir avant plusieurs semaines! C'est quoi, ce délire?! Tu casses mon rythme!
Solidarity of Steel#514.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Solidarity of Steel#515.src: Your sche- Are you taking lessons from Oru? This provincial emergency has a much greater value than your charter, Sovereign, so I'm summing to the equati- nnh.
Solidarity of Steel#515.dst: Ton plan- Tu prends des leçons avec Oru? Cette urgence provinciale a bien plus de valeur que ton tableau de marche, Souveraine, alors je m'ajoute à l'équati- nnh.
Solidarity of Steel#515.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solidarity of Steel#516.src: I've changed my schedule to come here early and track down a defector- Syndra, and her set of insurgents. You've heard the name, right?
Solidarity of Steel#516.dst: J'ai changé mon programme pour venir plus tôt et traquer une transfuge- Syndra, et son ensemble d'insurgés. Tu connais ce nom, non?
Solidarity of Steel#516.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solidarity of Steel#517.src:
Quill
Are either of you good with cooking?
Solidarity of Steel#517.dst:
Quill
L'un de vous deux sait-il cuisiner?
Solidarity of Steel#517.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#520.src: Sooo... fellow cursed one. How have you been treated around here.
Solidarity of Steel#520.dst: Alooors... collègue Maudit. Comment on te traite, par ici.
Solidarity of Steel#520.speaker: Jin

Solidarity of Steel#521.src: Don't look so surprised, haha! All kinds of outcasts are here, some of us are cursed.
Solidarity of Steel#521.dst: Fais pas cette tête, haha! Il y a toutes sortes de parias ici, et certains d'entre nous sont maudits.
Solidarity of Steel#521.speaker: Jin

Solidarity of Steel#522.src: We don't judge each other. We are all at risk here so why fight amongst each other. And if you ask me, curses aren't all bad.
Solidarity of Steel#522.dst: On ne se juge pas. On est tous en danger ici, alors pourquoi se battre entre nous. Et si tu veux mon avis, les malédictions n'ont pas que du mauvais.
Solidarity of Steel#522.speaker: Jin

Solidarity of Steel#523.src: I've found a use for my earth curse, I help build housing for people here!
Solidarity of Steel#523.dst: J'ai trouvé une utilité à ma malédiction de terre: j'aide à construire des logements pour les gens d'ici!
Solidarity of Steel#523.speaker: Jin

Solidarity of Steel#524.src: Hey, hey! Welcome to the Traincart!
Solidarity of Steel#524.speaker: Taio

Solidarity of Steel#525.src: Here to spend some food tickets, I take it? What can I get you?
Solidarity of Steel#525.dst: Tu viens dépenser des tickets repas, je suppose? Qu'est-ce que je te sers?
Solidarity of Steel#525.speaker: Taio

Solidarity of Steel#526.src: Oh, shoot, sorry. I didn't realize you were new! Typically Quill'd give you the rundown when you arrived, but with how hectic things are right now, it must've slipped his mind.
Solidarity of Steel#526.dst: Oh, zut, pardon. Je ne savais pas que tu venais d'arriver! D'habitude, Quill t'explique tout à ton arrivée, mais avec l'agitation du moment, ça a dû lui sortir de la tête.
Solidarity of Steel#526.speaker: Taio

Solidarity of Steel#527.src: Down here, we've got a system set up to ration out food and other items for anyone who needs it. You'll get a weekly allowance of tickets to spend on whatever you need, instead of paying emeralds.
Solidarity of Steel#527.dst: Ici, on a mis en place un système pour rationner la nourriture et d'autres articles pour ceux qui en ont besoin. Tu recevras chaque semaine des tickets à dépenser pour ce qu'il te faut, au lieu de payer en émeraudes.
Solidarity of Steel#527.speaker: Taio

Solidarity of Steel#528.src: System's worked well enough so far, ever since Quill devised it. We want everyone to have what they need to live, y'know?
Solidarity of Steel#528.dst: Le système marche plutôt bien depuis que Quill l'a imaginé. On veut que chacun ait de quoi vivre, tu vois?
Solidarity of Steel#528.speaker: Taio

Solidarity of Steel#529.src: Though... hey, if you're out of tickets, nobody'll stop you from getting food if you need it. System's there for convenience, not to enforce a new currency. So don't worry too much about it, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#529.dst: Cela dit... hé, si tu n'as plus de tickets, personne ne t'empêchera de manger si tu en as besoin. Le système est là pour simplifier, pas pour imposer une nouvelle monnaie. Alors t'en fais pas trop, OK?
Solidarity of Steel#529.speaker: Taio

Solidarity of Steel#530.src: Got it! I haven't seen your face around here yet, so I take it you're new?
Solidarity of Steel#530.dst: Compris! Ta tête ne me dit rien, alors je suppose que tu viens d'arriver?
Solidarity of Steel#530.speaker: Taio

Solidarity of Steel#531.src: Hey, feel free to take it easy a while. We all know it's a bit of an adjustment period, yeah? We'll have you back up on your feet in no time.
Solidarity of Steel#531.dst: Hé, prends ton temps. On sait tous qu'il faut une période d'adaptation, hein? On te remettra sur pied en un rien de temps.
Solidarity of Steel#531.speaker: Taio

Solidarity of Steel#532.src: Lots to do around here if you want to chip in. Ask Quill and he'll be able to sort you out.
Solidarity of Steel#532.dst: Il y a plein à faire ici si tu veux donner un coup de main. Demande à Quill, il te trouvera quelque chose.
Solidarity of Steel#532.speaker: Taio

Solidarity of Steel#533.src: Would this have been the main entrance to the station? If so, it looks to be blocked off.
Solidarity of Steel#533.dst: Était-ce l'entrée principale de la station? Si c'est le cas, elle semble condamnée.

Solidarity of Steel#534.src: If you need any clean clothes, water, utensils, even books, you heard that right. Let me know.
Solidarity of Steel#534.dst: S'il te faut des vêtements propres, de l'eau, des ustensiles, même des livres, oui, tu as bien entendu. Dis-moi.
Solidarity of Steel#534.speaker: Kaya

Solidarity of Steel#535.src: We take your spare tickets and trade them for quality items.
Solidarity of Steel#535.dst: On prend tes tickets en trop et on les échange contre des articles de qualité.
Solidarity of Steel#535.speaker: Kaya

Solidarity of Steel#536.src: The items are gathered from the outside and brought here fresh!
Solidarity of Steel#536.dst: Les articles sont récupérés dehors et arrivent ici tout frais!
Solidarity of Steel#536.speaker: Kaya

Solidarity of Steel#538.src: Don't think I've *cough* seen you before.
Solidarity of Steel#538.dst: Ta tête *tousse* ne me dit rien.
Solidarity of Steel#538.speaker: Hana

Solidarity of Steel#539.src: *cough* I was once a worker like everyone e-else but I fell ill.
Solidarity of Steel#539.dst: *tousse* Avant, je travaillais comme tout le m-monde, mais j'ai attrapé une maladie.
Solidarity of Steel#539.speaker: Hana

Solidarity of Steel#540.src: I wasn't contagious *cough* but I lost all strength and I could no longer do my work.
Solidarity of Steel#540.dst: Ce n'était pas contagieux *tousse* mais j'ai perdu toutes mes forces et je ne pouvais plus travailler.
Solidarity of Steel#540.speaker: Hana

Solidarity of Steel#541.src: A citizen of the Roughworks worst n-nightmare... If you can't *cough* work you can't afford housing.
Solidarity of Steel#541.dst: Le pire c-cauchemar d'un citoyen de Roughworks... Si tu ne peux pas *tousse* travailler, tu ne peux pas payer de logement.
Solidarity of Steel#541.speaker: Hana

Solidarity of Steel#542.src: I lived on the streets for a while and did things *cough* I wasn't proud of... But the brothers found me and took me here.
Solidarity of Steel#542.dst: J'ai vécu dans la rue un moment et j'ai fait des choses *tousse* pas très glorieuses... Mais les frères me sont venus en aide et voilà où je suis.
Solidarity of Steel#542.speaker: Hana

Solidarity of Steel#543.dst: Il pourrait y avoir des gardes dans le coin...

Solidarity of Steel#544.src: You're not sure if Zeph could take on three soldiers by himself. You should help him.
Solidarity of Steel#544.dst: Zeph pourrait-il affronter trois soldats seul? Rien n'est moins sûr. Vous devriez l'aider.

Solidarity of Steel#547.src: Alright, but hurry! Please! I can hear soldiers.
Solidarity of Steel#547.dst: D'accord, mais vite! S'il te plaît! J'entends des soldats.
Solidarity of Steel#547.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#548.src: Woah... wh-what did you pick into this? This- this is too heavy, I- I- I can't carry all of it!
Solidarity of Steel#548.dst: Ouah... q-qu'est-ce que tu as mis là-dedans? C'est- c'est trop lourd, je- je- je ne peux pas tout porter!
Solidarity of Steel#548.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#549.src: Why... did you take these? He- the young man said you had f-food, water, and cooking equipment, r-right?
Solidarity of Steel#549.dst: Pourquoi... tu as pris ça? Il- le jeune homme a dit que vous aviez à m-manger, de l'eau et de quoi cuisiner, n-non?
Solidarity of Steel#549.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#550.src: This... okay. Okay. This is enough. I can-... this will work. It has the- the important things. We can go, now.
Solidarity of Steel#550.dst: Ça... d'accord. D'accord. Ça suffit. Je peux-... ça ira. Il y a les- les choses importantes. On peut y aller, maintenant.
Solidarity of Steel#550.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#551.src: It's- fine. It's what I expected. I'm... glad I could help.
Solidarity of Steel#551.dst: Ce n'est- rien. Je m'y attendais. Je suis... contente d'avoir pu aider.
Solidarity of Steel#551.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#552.dst: Le spectacle de Yuman devrait bientôt commencer.

Solidarity of Steel#553.src: New Chapter Started: The Steel Feather

Solidarity of Steel#555.src: You- you didn't find any clothing? I can't leave with- with only one set of clothes! I know I have a shirt somewhere...
Solidarity of Steel#555.dst: Tu- tu n'as pas trouvé de vêtements? Je ne peux pas partir avec- avec une seule tenue! Je sais que j'ai une chemise quelque part...
Solidarity of Steel#555.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#556.src: There's... nothing to sleep with in- in here. You couldn't f-find a pillow or blanket? I'd e-even take a mattress...
Solidarity of Steel#556.dst: Il n'y a... rien pour dormir là- là-dedans. Tu n'as pas t-trouvé d'oreiller ou de couverture? Je p-prendrais même un matelas...
Solidarity of Steel#556.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#557.src: Oh... n-nothing to pass the time... I know I had a book and a deck of cards, I know I did...
Solidarity of Steel#557.dst: Oh... r-rien pour passer le temps... Je sais que j'avais un livre et un jeu de cartes, je le sais...
Solidarity of Steel#557.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#558.src: ...As much as this little place is- is run down, it's... it's home. I can't just leave- I can't. I can't go without... without something to remember it by. Please, please, find my ring or my photograph. Please.
Solidarity of Steel#558.dst: ...Aussi délabré que soit- que soit ce petit endroit, c'est... c'est chez moi. Je ne peux pas partir comme ça- je ne peux pas. Pas sans... sans un souvenir. S'il te plaît, s'il te plaît, trouve ma bague ou ma photo. S'il te plaît.
Solidarity of Steel#558.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#559.src: Well, there's no rush to be here. Quill's going to be a while still. Why don't you go talk to Sui and grab some food?
Solidarity of Steel#559.dst: Bon, rien ne presse. Quill en a encore pour un moment. Pourquoi ne pas aller parler à Sui et manger un morceau?
Solidarity of Steel#559.speaker: Syndra

Stable Story#000.src: Hey! Get out of here! Scram! Shoo!

Stable Story#001.src: Moo. Are you trying to run away, human? Moo. Only one of us can leave this place alive. Moo.
Stable Story#001.dst: Meuh. Tu essaies de t'enfuir, humain? Meuh. Un seul de nous deux sortira d'ici vivant. Meuh.

Stable Story#002.src: I see you don't have any grain on you. Here, take these [{~} Wheat Grains] and use them to feed your new buddy.
Stable Story#002.dst: Je vois que tu n'as pas de grain sur toi. Tiens, prends ces [{~} Wheat Grains] pour nourrir ton nouveau copain.

Stable Story#003.src: I wish you luck in the horse training career, young friend! Make me and Betty proud!
Stable Story#003.dst: Bonne chance dans le dressage de chevaux, mon jeune ami! Fais notre fierté, à Betty et moi!

Stable Story#004.src: Howdy! Lookin' to hitch a ride off to {p}? Well, lucky you! The wagon's been fixed up all nice and new!
Stable Story#004.dst: Salut! Tu cherches à te faire emmener à {p}? T'as de la chance! La charrette a été réparée, elle est comme neuve!

Stable Story#005.src: Just hop on aboard, and I'll get you to {p} in a jiffy!
Stable Story#005.dst: Grimpe donc, je t'emmène à {p} en un clin d'oeil!

Stable Story#006.src: Ain't far to {p} from here! We'll be there in a jiffy, just you wait.
Stable Story#006.dst: {p} n'est pas loin d'ici! On y sera en un clin d'oeil, tu verras.

Stable Story#007.src: Usually, I'd be charging a high price for these horses- Not to be rude, but one you couldn't afford.
Stable Story#007.dst: D'habitude, je vendrais ces chevaux à prix d'or- Sans vouloir te vexer, un prix que tu ne pourrais pas payer.
Stable Story#007.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#008.src: So, let's cut a deal- They stole my stable key. If you can go to my barn in {p}...
Stable Story#008.dst: Alors, marché conclu- On m'a volé la clé de l'écurie. Si tu peux aller à ma grange de {p}...
Stable Story#008.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#009.src: And return that key to me, I'll so charitably bestow upon you one of my horses. This deal is sweeter than you realize, too...
Stable Story#009.dst: Et me rapporter cette clé, je t'offrirai fort charitablement un de mes chevaux. Et ce marché est plus juteux que tu ne crois...
Stable Story#009.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#010.src: Hm. Cows, huh? Ah- who knows!? Life is full of mysteries, huh?
Stable Story#010.dst: Hm. Des vaches, hein? Ah- qui sait!? La vie est pleine de mystères, hein?
Stable Story#010.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#011.src: Either way. As the great bovine above is my witness if I see the smallest bruise on Betty I will-
Stable Story#011.dst: Peu importe. Le grand bovin céleste m'en soit témoin, si je vois le moindre bleu sur Betty, je-
Stable Story#011.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#012.src: Ah! I can't just hand you a horse without telling you how to care for that beautiful creature, can I?
Stable Story#012.dst: Ah! Je ne peux pas te confier un cheval sans t'expliquer comment soigner cette magnifique créature, pas vrai?

Stable Story#013.src: Those rich {p} folk have no respect for horses, let me tell you!
Stable Story#013.dst: Ces richards de {p} n'ont aucun respect pour les chevaux, crois-moi!

Stable Story#014.src: Now! Right Click the Feeder and place your [Horse Saddle] in there.
Stable Story#014.dst: Bon! Fais un clic droit sur la mangeoire et mets-y ta [Horse Saddle].

Stable Story#015.src: Use the [{~} Wheat Grains] I gave you earlier to feed your new friend.
Stable Story#015.dst: Utilise les [{~} Wheat Grains] que je t'ai donnés pour nourrir ton nouvel ami.

Stable Story#016.src: Just Right Click the Feeder again.
Stable Story#016.dst: Refais juste un clic droit sur la mangeoire.

Stable Story#017.src: Horses are sensitive creatures, you see. They don't grow strong over night, they require patience and a good stable diet.
Stable Story#017.dst: Les chevaux sont sensibles, vois-tu. Ils ne deviennent pas forts en une nuit: il faut de la patience et un régime stable.

Stable Story#018.src: However, you also need to take them out on walks so they get some well needed exercise, otherwise they will never reach their full potential.
Stable Story#018.dst: Mais il faut aussi les sortir en promenade pour qu'ils fassent l'exercice dont ils ont besoin, sinon ils n'atteindront jamais leur plein potentiel.

Stable Story#019.src: I almost forgot! If you really want to master the art of a horse trainer you can breed two horses using the Feeder.
Stable Story#019.dst: J'allais oublier! Si tu veux vraiment maîtriser l'art du dressage, tu peux faire reproduire deux chevaux avec la mangeoire.

Stable Story#020.src: Anyway! I wish you luck on your horse training career!
Stable Story#020.dst: Bref! Je te souhaite bonne chance dans ta carrière de dresseur de chevaux!

Stable Story#021.dst: Parlez à Enkser à l'extérieur de {p}, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Stable Story#022.src: Looking for able-bodied adventurers! Preferably with no friends or family, but I'm not picky!
Stable Story#022.dst: Je cherche des aventuriers robustes! De préférence sans amis ni famille, mais je ne suis pas difficile!
Stable Story#022.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#023.src: You see, I'm a horse merchant. Make my living selling these beauties to adventurers like you.
Stable Story#023.dst: Vois-tu, je suis marchand de chevaux. Je gagne ma vie en vendant ces beautés à des aventuriers comme toi.
Stable Story#023.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#024.src: I work at this barn, selling the horses I raise in {p} out here to rich {p} folk.
Stable Story#024.dst: Ici, je vends les chevaux que j'élève à {p} aux riches de {p}.
Stable Story#024.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#025.src: Until these rabble-rousing troublemakers blew a tunnel through my barn and smuggled MY horses out.
Stable Story#025.dst: Jusqu'à ce que ces voyous creusent un tunnel à l'explosif sous ma grange et volent MES chevaux.
Stable Story#025.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#026.src: Betty'll be there to help! Strong as she is, don't you DARE let them touch her!
Stable Story#026.dst: Betty sera là pour t'aider! Elle a beau être costaud, ne les laisse SURTOUT PAS la toucher!
Stable Story#026.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#027.src: I'll be making my way to {p} myself to ensure Betty's safety.
Stable Story#027.dst: Je vais moi-même me rendre à {p} pour veiller sur Betty.
Stable Story#027.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#028.src: Now, best be on your way. {p} is a fair bit down the {p} from here, off to the east.
Stable Story#028.dst: Allez, mets-toi en route. {p} est assez loin en descendant {p}, vers l'est.
Stable Story#028.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#029.src: Bring back [{~} Stable Key] to Enkser from the tunnel at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Stable Story#029.dst: Rapportez [{~} Stable Key] du tunnel à Enkser, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Stable Story#030.src: Hey, have you found my [{~} Stable Key] yet? It should be somewhere in {p} to the east.
Stable Story#030.dst: Hé, tu as trouvé ma [{~} Stable Key]? Elle devrait être quelque part à {p}, à l'est.
Stable Story#030.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#031.src: Looking for able-bodied adventurers, preferably with no friends or-
Stable Story#031.dst: Je cherche des aventuriers robustes, de préférence sans amis ni-
Stable Story#031.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#032.src: Hey, it's you! Got my barn key yet?
Stable Story#032.dst: Hé, c'est toi! Tu as ma clé de grange?
Stable Story#032.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#033.src: Ah, god bless. And I presume Betty did all the work while you just- lounged around.
Stable Story#033.dst: Ah, Dieu merci. Et je suppose que Betty a tout fait pendant que tu- te prélassais.
Stable Story#033.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#034.src: Ah, bless. And I presume Betty did all the work while you just- lounged around.
Stable Story#034.dst: Ah, bénie soit-elle. Et je suppose que Betty a tout fait pendant que tu- te prélassais.
Stable Story#034.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#036.src: Nevermind all that. A horse I promised, and a horse you shall have. Much thanks to you.
Stable Story#036.dst: Oublions tout ça. Un cheval je t'ai promis, un cheval tu auras. Merci mille fois.
Stable Story#036.speaker: Enkser

Star Thief#000.src: This pile of gravel appears to have blocked the entrance... Maybe there's a shovel nearby?
Star Thief#000.dst: Ce tas de gravier semble bloquer l'entrée... Il y a peut-être une pelle dans le coin?

Star Thief#001.src: [{~}/{~}] Thief: .... I can't control myself...fjfjfj This rock...
Star Thief#001.dst: [{~}/{~}] Voleur: .... Je ne peux pas me contrôler...fjfjfj Cette roche...

Star Thief#002.src: Look into the rumors of strange weather near the Imal Inn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Star Thief#002.dst: Enquêtez sur les rumeurs de temps étrange près de l'Imal Inn, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Star Thief#003.src: Find the meteor's crash site at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Star Thief#003.dst: Trouvez le lieu d'impact du météore, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Star Thief#004.src: Hey you! Human. What are you doing here?
Star Thief#004.dst: Hé, vous! Humain. Que faites-vous ici?
Star Thief#004.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#005.src: Under Villager law any extra terrestrial or extra voidal entities are prohibited and owned by the state.
Star Thief#005.dst: Selon la loi villageoise, toute entité extraterrestre ou venue du Vide est interdite et propriété de l'État.
Star Thief#005.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#006.src: Seeing as you are new to the land, I can't see you being prosecuted, especially a {p} Guard.
Star Thief#006.dst: Comme vous êtes nouveau dans la région, je doute qu'on vous poursuive, surtout un garde de {p}.
Star Thief#006.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#007.src: This meteor is different to what we've seen before. We suspect that direct contact with the meteor is dangerous.
Star Thief#007.dst: Ce météore est différent de ceux que nous avons vus. Nous pensons que tout contact direct avec lui est dangereux.
Star Thief#007.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#008.src: The magical radiation doesn't seem to be affecting you at all though. Do you not feel anything? Perhaps you could help me locate it.
Star Thief#008.dst: Pourtant, la radiation magique ne semble pas du tout vous affecter. Vous ne sentez rien? Vous pourriez m'aider à le localiser.
Star Thief#008.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#009.src: Explore the cave that the meteor crashed into.
Star Thief#009.dst: Explorez la grotte où le météore s'est écrasé.

Star Thief#011.dst: Échappez-vous de la grotte qui s'effondre.

Star Thief#012.src: Follow the trail leading off to the east from the cave.
Star Thief#012.dst: Suivez la piste qui part de la grotte vers l'est.

Star Thief#013.src: Explore the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and defeat the insane thief.
Star Thief#013.dst: Explorez la grotte en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] et battez le voleur dément.

Star Thief#014.src: .... I can't control myself...fjfjfj This rock...
Star Thief#014.dst: .... Je ne peux pas me contrôler...fjfjfj Cette roche...
Star Thief#014.speaker: Thief

Star Thief#015.src: What is... this feeling... No I won't listen..
Star Thief#015.dst: Qu'est-ce que... cette sensation... Non, je n'écouterai pas..
Star Thief#015.speaker: Thief

Star Thief#016.src: Bring back the piece of meteor to the secret agent at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Star Thief#016.dst: Rapportez le fragment de météore à l'agent secret, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Star Thief#017.src: Hello again. Did you find the meteor down there? Why on earth are you holding some?!
Star Thief#017.dst: Re-bonjour. Avez-vous trouvé le météore là-dessous? Pourquoi diable en tenez-vous un morceau?!
Star Thief#017.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#018.src: I see. This material is incredibly rare and magically powerful. Meteors fall all over Gavel and come in a variety of colours and potency.
Star Thief#018.dst: Je vois. Ce matériau est extrêmement rare et d'une grande puissance magique. Des météores tombent partout sur Gavel, de couleurs et de puissances variées.
Star Thief#018.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#019.src: We don't fully understand them, but we know they are dangerous. Every scientist who has studied them has lost their minds.
Star Thief#019.dst: Nous ne les comprenons pas entièrement, mais nous savons qu'ils sont dangereux. Tous les savants qui les ont étudiés ont perdu la raison.
Star Thief#019.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#020.src: The meteors hold many secrets and powers, maybe the ones we need to end your war. Thank you, here's a small reward for helping us.
Star Thief#020.dst: Les météores recèlent bien des secrets et pouvoirs, peut-être de quoi finir votre guerre. Merci, voici une petite récompense pour votre aide.
Star Thief#020.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#021.src: Hello again. Did you find the meteor down there? No? Maybe go back and try to find it?
Star Thief#021.dst: Re-bonjour. Vous avez trouvé le météore là-dessous? Non? Retournez donc le chercher?
Star Thief#021.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#022.src: Remember... Just follow the white trail leading to the cave!
Star Thief#022.dst: Rappelez-vous... Suivez simplement la piste blanche jusqu'à la grotte!
Star Thief#022.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#023.src: I can't... control... my mind... end me.
Star Thief#023.dst: Je ne peux pas... contrôler... mon esprit... achevez-moi.
Star Thief#023.speaker: Thief

Star Thief#026.src: What was that? It seems to have landed nearby, maybe you should go investigate.
Star Thief#026.dst: Qu'est-ce que c'était? On dirait que c'est tombé tout près, vous devriez peut-être aller voir.

Star Thief#027.src: It seems like the meteor crashed into a cave.
Star Thief#027.dst: On dirait que le météore s'est écrasé dans une grotte.

Star Thief#028.src: The meteor shard is radiating an odd and unfamiliar magical energy
Star Thief#028.dst: Le fragment de météore dégage une énergie magique étrange et inconnue

Star Thief#029.src: Thank you again for your help!
Star Thief#029.speaker: Agent

Supply and Delivery#000.src: Well? Did you buy the supply crate yet?
Supply and Delivery#000.dst: Alors? Tu as acheté la caisse de ravitaillement?
Supply and Delivery#000.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#001.src: All you need to do is go over to the Trade Market, and buy the supply crate for me. It's not that hard!
Supply and Delivery#001.dst: Tu n'as qu'à aller au Marché et m'acheter la caisse de ravitaillement. C'est pas si dur!
Supply and Delivery#001.speaker: Ope

similar.text: All you need to do is go over to the Trade Market, and buy the supply crate for me. Please?

Supply and Delivery#002.src: You bought the crate! Good, good. You still need to pick it up from the Trade Market, though!
Supply and Delivery#002.dst: Tu as acheté la caisse! Bien, bien. Mais il faut encore aller la récupérer au Marché!
Supply and Delivery#002.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#003.src: Hey! I- uh, I can't help but notice that. You're still here. With the crate. You need to bring it to {p}, remember?
Supply and Delivery#003.dst: Hé! Je- euh, j'ai remarqué que. Tu es toujours là. Avec la caisse. Faut l'apporter à {p}, tu te rappelles?

Supply and Delivery#004.src: What? Don't look at me like that! We had a perfectly fair interaction which we both benefited from. I got the plant, and you... well. You gained experience?
Supply and Delivery#004.dst: Quoi? Me regarde pas comme ça! On a fait un échange parfaitement équitable dont on a tous les deux profité. Moi j'ai eu la plante, et toi... bah. T'as gagné de l'expérience?
Supply and Delivery#004.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#005.src: So either you run the supplies to {p}... or we both run away and start new lives, and we avoid the consequences of our actions!
Supply and Delivery#005.dst: Donc soit tu livres les provisions à {p}... soit on s'enfuit tous les deux pour refaire notre vie, et on échappe aux conséquences de nos actes!
Supply and Delivery#005.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#006.src: Howdy! Lookin' to hitch a ride off to {p}? Sorry to say, but the wagon's broken down.
Supply and Delivery#006.dst: Salut! Tu cherches quelqu'un pour t'emmener à {p}? Désolé, mais la charrette est en panne.

Supply and Delivery#007.src: I reckon it won't be long 'till it's fixed up, but you'll have to make the journey yourself for now.
Supply and Delivery#007.dst: M'est avis qu'elle sera vite réparée, mais pour l'instant, tu vas devoir faire le trajet toi-même.

Supply and Delivery#008.src: This fast travel requires Supply and Delivery to use.
Supply and Delivery#008.dst: Ce voyage rapide exige d'avoir fini Approvisionnement et livraison.

Supply and Delivery#009.src: I hope these emeralds will suffice. Additionally... we have recently fixed up one of our broken carts, which makes the trip to {p} and back.
Supply and Delivery#009.dst: J'espère que ces émeraudes suffiront. Par ailleurs... nous avons récemment réparé une de nos charrettes, qui fait l'aller-retour jusqu'à {p}.
Supply and Delivery#009.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#011.src: Oh, man... What am I going to do now...
Supply and Delivery#011.dst: Oh là là... Qu'est-ce que je vais faire maintenant...
Supply and Delivery#011.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#012.src: O-oh! H-hello soldier! Wow, what a coincidence that we're both here... in {p}... today...
Supply and Delivery#012.dst: O-oh! B-bonjour, soldat! Ouah, quel hasard qu'on soit tous les deux ici... à {p}... aujourd'hui...
Supply and Delivery#012.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#013.src: Look, alright, I get it! But I can't pay you back either way. The mayor sent me here to pick up a crate of supplies for the village.
Supply and Delivery#013.dst: Écoute, d'accord, j'ai compris! Mais je peux pas te rembourser de toute façon. Le maire m'a envoyé chercher une caisse de provisions pour le village.
Supply and Delivery#013.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#014.src: The issue is... I've already run out of money on- uh, unrelated purchases. And even if I had the money, I couldn't buy the supply crate anyway...
Supply and Delivery#014.dst: Le problème, c'est que... j'ai déjà tout dépensé en- euh, achats sans rapport. Et même si j'avais l'argent, je pourrais pas acheter la caisse de toute façon...
Supply and Delivery#014.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#015.src: Those two over there who run the market banned me from ever using it after I tried to buy out the world's supplies of magical powders.
Supply and Delivery#015.dst: Les deux là-bas qui tiennent le Marché m'ont banni à vie après que j'ai essayé de racheter tout le stock mondial de poudres magiques.
Supply and Delivery#015.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#016.src: Look, it's not my fault I'm making big market moves. I'm just, you know- smarter than all these other folks!
Supply and Delivery#016.dst: Écoute, c'est pas ma faute si je fais des gros coups sur le marché. Je suis juste, tu sais- plus malin que tous ces gens!
Supply and Delivery#016.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#017.src: ... The point is. I could really use your help right now! I- I promise, I'll pay you back for it this time.
Supply and Delivery#017.dst: ... Bref. J'aurais vraiment besoin de ton aide, là! Je- je te promets, cette fois je te rembourserai.
Supply and Delivery#017.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#018.src: All you need to do is go over to the Trade Market, and buy the supply crate for me. Please?
Supply and Delivery#018.dst: Tu n'as qu'à aller au Marché et m'acheter la caisse de ravitaillement. S'il te plaît?
Supply and Delivery#018.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#019.src: ... What? They also banned you from the market?! Well, great. What are we supposed to do now?
Supply and Delivery#019.dst: ... Quoi? Toi aussi, ils t'ont banni du Marché?! Super. Qu'est-ce qu'on est censés faire maintenant?
Supply and Delivery#019.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#020.src: Well, do you have any other friends we could get involved? There was... that other soldier guy, right? His name was... Tim. Or something.
Supply and Delivery#020.dst: Bon, t'as d'autres amis qu'on pourrait mêler à ça? Il y avait... cet autre soldat, non? Il s'appelait... Tim. Ou un truc comme ça.
Supply and Delivery#020.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#021.src: Look- alright, I get it, I'm a jerk who doesn't remember peoples' names! Could you just ask him to buy the supplies for us?? He's our last hope... probably.
Supply and Delivery#021.dst: Bon- d'accord, j'ai compris, je suis un crétin qui oublie les noms! Tu peux juste lui demander de nous acheter les provisions?? C'est notre dernier espoir... sûrement.
Supply and Delivery#021.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#022.src: Purchase the supply crate from the Trade Market at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Supply and Delivery#022.dst: Achetez la caisse de ravitaillement au Marché, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Supply and Delivery#023.src: Hey, good work! Now you'll need to pick up the supply crate.
Supply and Delivery#023.dst: Hé, beau travail! Maintenant, il faut récupérer la caisse de ravitaillement.
Supply and Delivery#023.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#024.src: Find Tasim at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and convince him to buy the supply crate for you.
Supply and Delivery#024.dst: Trouvez Tasim en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] et convainquez-le de vous acheter la caisse de ravitaillement.

Supply and Delivery#025.src: Oh, hey {u}! Are you just here to hang out? Or- that look on your face tells me you're here for something else.
Supply and Delivery#025.dst: Oh, salut {u}! Tu viens juste traîner? Ou- vu ta tête, tu es là pour autre chose.
Supply and Delivery#025.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#026.src: [{~}] Can you buy something from the Trade Market for me?
Supply and Delivery#026.dst: [{~}] Tu peux m'acheter quelque chose au Marché?

Supply and Delivery#027.src: I... guess so? Is there a reason you can't do it yourself?
Supply and Delivery#027.dst: Je... suppose que oui? Il y a une raison pour que tu ne le fasses pas toi-même?
Supply and Delivery#027.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#028.src: ...You're banned from the market? How did you even manage that? We haven't even been in {p} for that long!
Supply and Delivery#028.dst: ...Tu es banni du Marché? Comment tu as fait ton compte? On n'est même pas à {p} depuis si longtemps!
Supply and Delivery#028.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#029.src: You- what!? Nevermind, I don't actually want to know. Come on, lead the way. I'll buy... whatever it is you need.
Supply and Delivery#029.dst: Tu- quoi!? Laisse tomber, je préfère ne pas savoir. Allez, passe devant. J'achèterai... ce dont tu as besoin.
Supply and Delivery#029.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#030.src: ...Oh. Well, that explains that. Though- is there a reason you can't get it yourself?
Supply and Delivery#030.dst: ...Oh. Bon, ça explique tout. Mais- il y a une raison pour que tu ne la récupères pas toi-même?
Supply and Delivery#030.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#031.src: You- what!? Nevermind, I don't actually want to know. Come on, lead the way. I'll buy whatever it is Ope needs.
Supply and Delivery#031.dst: Tu- quoi!? Laisse tomber, je préfère ne pas savoir. Allez, passe devant. J'achèterai ce dont Ope a besoin.
Supply and Delivery#031.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#032.src: Oh, hello . Are you here for training as well? Or- that look on your face tells me you're here for something else.
Supply and Delivery#032.dst: Oh, salut . Tu viens t'entraîner toi aussi? Ou- vu ta tête, tu es là pour autre chose.
Supply and Delivery#032.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#033.src: Bring Tasim to the Trade Market at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Supply and Delivery#034.src: Alright. So I'm just buying a supply crate...
Supply and Delivery#034.dst: Bon. Donc j'achète juste une caisse de ravitaillement...
Supply and Delivery#034.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#035.src: Here it is. I wish you luck with... whatever it is you're up to.
Supply and Delivery#035.dst: La voilà. Bonne chance avec... ce que tu mijotes.
Supply and Delivery#035.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#036.src: Return to Ope with the supply crate at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Supply and Delivery#036.dst: Retournez voir Ope avec la caisse de ravitaillement, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Supply and Delivery#037.src: Perfect! Now, quickly, come back over here, before those two realize you're working with me!
Supply and Delivery#037.dst: Parfait! Maintenant, vite, reviens par ici, avant que ces deux-là comprennent que tu bosses avec moi!
Supply and Delivery#037.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#038.src: You got the item? Good. Good, good good.
Supply and Delivery#038.dst: Tu as l'objet? Bien. Bien, bien bien.
Supply and Delivery#038.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#039.src: Okay! Now, we're onto step two. So, you see, this package still needs to make it to {p}...
Supply and Delivery#039.dst: OK! Maintenant, on passe à l'étape deux. Vois-tu, ce colis doit encore arriver à {p}...
Supply and Delivery#039.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#040.src: And. Well. You're the one holding the crate, not me! So... you know!
Supply and Delivery#040.dst: Et. Bon. C'est toi qui tiens la caisse, pas moi! Alors... tu vois!
Supply and Delivery#040.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#041.src: Fine, I'll take the crate to

Supply and Delivery#042.src: Great! You know the way by now, surely! No need for me to, uh, get in your way!
Supply and Delivery#042.dst: Super! Tu connais le chemin maintenant, sûrement! Pas besoin que je, euh, te gêne!
Supply and Delivery#042.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#043.src: Just take those supplies to {p}, and. Well. Things will work out.
Supply and Delivery#043.dst: Apporte juste ces provisions à {p}, et. Bon. Tout s'arrangera.
Supply and Delivery#043.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#044.src: Why can't you just take the
Supply and Delivery#044.dst: Pourquoi tu n'apportes pas toi-même la

Supply and Delivery#046.src: Well, you see. I really don't want to do it. And I'm not going to!
Supply and Delivery#046.dst: Eh bien, vois-tu. Je n'ai vraiment pas envie de le faire. Et je ne le ferai pas!
Supply and Delivery#046.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#047.src: ...no? No. Okay. Worth a shot. Well, you know the way by now! No need for me to, uh, get in your way! Heh...
Supply and Delivery#047.dst: ...non? Non. OK. Ça valait le coup. Bon, tu connais le chemin maintenant! Pas besoin que je, euh, te gêne! Hé hé...
Supply and Delivery#047.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#048.src: He bought you the item? Good. Good, good good. Okay! That was... harder than expected.
Supply and Delivery#048.dst: Il t'a acheté l'objet? Bien. Bien, bien bien. OK! C'était... plus dur que prévu.
Supply and Delivery#048.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#049.src: Bring the supply crate to Mayor Alvin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Supply and Delivery#049.dst: Apportez la caisse de ravitaillement au maire Alvin à {p}, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Supply and Delivery#050.src: Ah, hello! What can I do for you today?
Supply and Delivery#050.dst: Ah, bonjour! Que puis-je faire pour vous aujourd'hui?
Supply and Delivery#050.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#051.src: I have a supply crate from D
Supply and Delivery#051.dst: J'apporte une caisse de ravitaillement de D

Supply and Delivery#052.src: Ah... So you do. I thought I had sent Ope to pick that up...
Supply and Delivery#052.dst: Ah... En effet. Je croyais avoir envoyé Ope la chercher...
Supply and Delivery#052.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#053.src: More of his shenanigans, I suppose. I am sorry you have had to deal with him twice.
Supply and Delivery#053.dst: Encore une de ses manigances, je suppose. Désolé que vous ayez dû le supporter deux fois.
Supply and Delivery#053.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#054.src: When he returns to the village, I'm going to need to have a word with him... Ah, but of course, I should pay you for your troubles.
Supply and Delivery#054.dst: Quand il reviendra au village, il faudra que je lui parle... Ah, mais bien sûr, je dois vous dédommager pour votre peine.
Supply and Delivery#054.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#055.src: You may feel free to use it whenever you like! As thanks for all you have done for us.
Supply and Delivery#055.dst: Servez-vous-en quand vous voulez! Pour vous remercier de tout ce que vous avez fait pour nous.
Supply and Delivery#055.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#057.src: He's a good man, truly. I believe that with my whole heart. It's alright if you don't feel the same way, though. I will not force you to interact with him if you do not wish to.
Supply and Delivery#057.dst: C'est un homme bon, vraiment. J'en suis convaincu de tout mon coeur. Mais ce n'est pas grave si vous ne pensez pas de même. Je ne vous forcerai pas à le côtoyer si vous ne le souhaitez pas.
Supply and Delivery#057.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#058.src: Oh, dear... I suppose it must have been fifteen years ago that I took the position, when the old mayor stepped down.
Supply and Delivery#058.dst: Oh, mon Dieu... Ça doit faire quinze ans que j'ai pris ce poste, quand l'ancien maire s'est retiré.
Supply and Delivery#058.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#059.src: He was a kind man, always looking out for the townsfolk. Though, by the time he retired, it was clear he was growing restless in our little town.
Supply and Delivery#059.dst: C'était un homme bon, toujours attentif aux habitants. Mais quand il a pris sa retraite, il était clair qu'il s'ennuyait dans notre petit village.
Supply and Delivery#059.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#060.src: Well, as soon as he passed down the position to me, he immediately traveled to {p} and enlisted in their army! I hear he's in the business of training soldiers these days.
Supply and Delivery#060.dst: Eh bien, à peine m'avait-il cédé le poste qu'il est parti pour {p} s'engager dans leur armée! Il paraît qu'il entraîne des soldats, maintenant.
Supply and Delivery#060.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#061.src: Ah, but I've tried to live up to his legacy. I like to think I've done well in my time as mayor!
Supply and Delivery#061.dst: Ah, mais j'ai essayé d'être à la hauteur de son héritage. J'aime à penser que j'ai été un bon maire!
Supply and Delivery#061.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#062.src: A fine day for passing through! I hope you enjoy your stay.
Supply and Delivery#062.dst: Belle journée pour passer par ici! J'espère que vous apprécierez votre séjour.
Supply and Delivery#062.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Taking the Tower#000.src: You look like an adventurer in need of some work, pal. I have need of your services, but you'll need to be level {~} at least.
Taking the Tower#000.dst: Tu as tout l'air d'un aventurier en quête de travail, mon ami. J'ai besoin de tes services, mais il te faudra au moins le niveau {~}.
Taking the Tower#000.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#001.src: Tasim told me all about the corrupted force you took out. I wish I could have been here to help!
Taking the Tower#001.dst: Tasim m'a tout raconté sur la force corrompue que vous avez éliminée. J'aurais aimé être là pour aider!
Taking the Tower#001.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#002.src: We did it! Let's get back to Lieutenant Van and tell him the news.
Taking the Tower#002.dst: On a réussi! Retournons voir le lieutenant Van pour lui annoncer la nouvelle.

Taking the Tower#003.src: Oh, wait. There's a stop we've got to make first. Follow me to the Item Upgrader!
Taking the Tower#003.dst: Oh, attends. On doit d'abord faire un détour. Suis-moi jusqu'à l'Améliorateur d'objets!
Taking the Tower#003.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#004.src: Apparently, the big bad at the top of the tower is weak to  Water damage!
Taking the Tower#004.dst: Apparemment, le grand méchant au sommet de la tour craint les dégâts de type  Eau!

Taking the Tower#005.src: You can apply various elemental powders to your weapons, which lets them deal types of damage they might not have been able to before.
Taking the Tower#005.dst: Tu peux appliquer différentes poudres élémentaires à tes armes, ce qui leur permet d'infliger des types de dégâts dont elles étaient incapables avant.
Taking the Tower#005.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#006.src: In this case, you can apply a  Water powder, so that your weapon will be more effective against the corrupted enemies at the tower!
Taking the Tower#006.dst: Dans ce cas, tu peux appliquer une poudre de type  Eau, pour que ton arme soit plus efficace contre les ennemis corrompus de la tour!
Taking the Tower#006.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#007.src: ...The point is- here. Take this elemental powder and Hold the powder, then Right Click on your weapon. Let me know when you're done!
Taking the Tower#007.dst: ...Bref- tiens. Prends cette poudre élémentaire, tiens-la en main, puis fais un clic droit sur ton arme. Préviens-moi quand c'est fait!

Taking the Tower#009.src: You see this Item Upgrader? It can be used to upgrade powders to high tiers.
Taking the Tower#009.dst: Tu vois cet Améliorateur d'objets? Il sert à faire passer les poudres à des rangs supérieurs.

Taking the Tower#010.src: It can also remove powders from your items, if you need to- don't worry, you'll get your powders back!
Taking the Tower#010.dst: Il peut aussi retirer les poudres de tes objets, si besoin- ne t'inquiète pas, tu récupères tes poudres!

Taking the Tower#011.src: ...Anyway, Lieutenant Van and the others are by that bunch of houses in the {p}- you probably saw it on your way in.
Taking the Tower#011.dst: ...Bref, le lieutenant Van et les autres sont près de ce groupe de maisons de {p}- tu as dû les voir en arrivant.
Taking the Tower#011.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#012.src: It doesn't much matter who does the job, so long as it gets done. If you see an opportunity- go for it!
Taking the Tower#012.dst: Peu importe qui fait le travail, du moment qu'il est fait. Si vous voyez une occasion, foncez!
Taking the Tower#012.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#013.src: If you need to retreat, or the corrupteds are slain, regroup here! Understood?
Taking the Tower#013.dst: S'il faut battre en retraite, ou une fois les corrompus abattus, regroupez-vous ici! Compris?
Taking the Tower#013.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#014.src: Hey, {u}, there you are! Come on, let's climb that tower!
Taking the Tower#014.dst: Hé, {u}, te voilà! Allez, on grimpe à cette tour!

Taking the Tower#015.src: They have, lieutenant! {u} and I reached the top and defeated the corrupted.
Taking the Tower#015.dst: C'est fait, mon lieutenant! {u} et moi avons atteint le sommet et vaincu le corrompu.
Taking the Tower#015.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#016.src: Speak to Aledar in the {p} Barracks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Taking the Tower#016.dst: Parlez à Aledar à la caserne de {p}, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Taking the Tower#017.src: Oh, {u}! Hey! It's good to see you and Tasim again. Hope you didn't have too many adventures without me!
Taking the Tower#017.dst: Oh, {u}! Salut! Content de vous revoir, Tasim et toi. Pas trop d'aventures sans moi, j'espère!
Taking the Tower#017.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#018.src: Tasim's gone off to the training room, if you were looking for him. He's really jumping straight into it, which... is good! We all need to get stronger so we can defend the province.
Taking the Tower#018.dst: Tasim est parti à la salle d'entraînement, si tu le cherchais. Il s'y met à fond, ce qui... est une bonne chose! On doit tous devenir plus forts pour défendre la province.
Taking the Tower#018.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#019.src: ...Oh! Since you're here- I was about to head out to join Lieutenant Van's squad to take back a tower overtaken by corrupteds. You should come with us, too!
Taking the Tower#019.dst: ...Oh! Tant que tu es là- j'allais rejoindre l'escouade du lieutenant Van pour reprendre une tour tombée aux mains des corrompus. Tu devrais venir aussi!
Taking the Tower#019.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#020.src: Well? What do you think? Want to get some real combat experience? It shouldn't take long.
Taking the Tower#020.dst: Alors? Qu'en dis-tu? Envie d'un vrai baptême du feu? Ça ne devrait pas être long.
Taking the Tower#020.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#021.dst: Bien sûr, je viens avec toi.

Taking the Tower#022.src: Perfect. Well, no time better than the present! Let's get going.
Taking the Tower#022.dst: Parfait. Eh bien, pas de meilleur moment que maintenant! En route.
Taking the Tower#022.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#023.src: I've got something to do her
Taking the Tower#023.dst: J'ai quelque chose à faire ici

Taking the Tower#025.src: Well, I'll still be here for a while. If you change your mind, let me know!
Taking the Tower#025.dst: Bon, je reste encore un moment ici. Si tu changes d'avis, dis-le-moi!
Taking the Tower#025.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#026.src: Hey, you're back! Have you changed you mind? Want to join a raid on a corrupted tower?
Taking the Tower#026.dst: Hé, te revoilà! Tu as changé d'avis? Tu veux participer à l'assaut d'une tour corrompue?
Taking the Tower#026.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#027.src: Follow Aledar to the Powder Master at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Taking the Tower#027.dst: Suivez Aledar jusqu'au Maître des poudres, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Taking the Tower#028.src: Alright, so. There's something I've been told about the tower we're going to be attacking which we can prepare for!
Taking the Tower#028.dst: Bon, alors. On m'a parlé d'un truc sur la tour qu'on va attaquer, et on peut s'y préparer!
Taking the Tower#028.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#029.src: Apparently, the big bad at the top of the tower is weak to damage! And so, here we are at the Powder Master.
Taking the Tower#029.dst: Apparemment, le grand méchant au sommet de la tour craint les dégâts! Et donc, nous voilà chez le Maître des poudres.
Taking the Tower#029.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#030.src: I, uh... don't remember the whole elemental speech off the top of my head. If you want to know more about those, you'll have to talk to Captain Ragon in the barracks. He has a whole course about it!
Taking the Tower#030.dst: Je, euh... ne connais pas par coeur tout le discours sur les éléments. Si tu veux en savoir plus, va voir le capitaine Ragon à la caserne. Il a tout un cours là-dessus!
Taking the Tower#030.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#031.src: ...The point is- here. Take this elemental powder and talk to the Powder Master to apply it. Let me know when you're done!
Taking the Tower#031.dst: ...Bref- tiens. Prends cette poudre élémentaire et parle au Maître des poudres pour l'appliquer. Préviens-moi quand c'est fait!
Taking the Tower#031.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#032.src: Apply a Water Powder to your weapon, then let Aledar know at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Taking the Tower#032.dst: Appliquez une poudre d'Eau sur votre arme, puis prévenez Aledar en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Taking the Tower#033.src: Got the powder on your weapon? Good, that means we're ready.
Taking the Tower#033.dst: La poudre est sur ton arme? Bien, ça veut dire qu'on est prêts.
Taking the Tower#033.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#034.src: Lead the way! I'll be right behind you.
Taking the Tower#034.dst: Passe devant! Je te suis de près.
Taking the Tower#034.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#035.src: Meet up with Lieutenant Van's squad near the Raging Tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Taking the Tower#035.dst: Rejoignez l'escouade du lieutenant Van près de la Tour enragée, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Taking the Tower#036.src: Ah, Aledar! Good to see you here. Who's this with you?
Taking the Tower#036.dst: Ah, Aledar! Content de te voir. Qui est avec toi?
Taking the Tower#036.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#037.src: This is {u}, sir. They're here to join our assault, if you'll allow it.
Taking the Tower#037.dst: C'est {u}, mon lieutenant. Une recrue pour notre assaut, si vous le permettez.
Taking the Tower#037.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#038.src: Hm... Well, I don't see why not. The more the merrier, that's what I say.
Taking the Tower#038.dst: Hm... Ma foi, pourquoi pas. Plus on est de fous, plus on rit, comme je dis toujours.
Taking the Tower#038.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#039.src: If everyone's here, we can begin. Here's the plan! We'll need to fight off some of the forces near the base of the tower, so that someone can climb to the top.
Taking the Tower#039.dst: Si tout le monde est là, on peut commencer. Voici le plan! Il faudra repousser une partie des forces au pied de la tour pour que quelqu'un puisse grimper au sommet.
Taking the Tower#039.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#041.src: Good. Alright soldiers, let's take back that tower!
Taking the Tower#041.dst: Bien. Allez, soldats, reprenons cette tour!
Taking the Tower#041.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#042.src: Go on, head for the tower! If we're lucky, we'll be able to clear out the corrupteds who have taken over it.
Taking the Tower#042.dst: Allez, foncez vers la tour! Avec de la chance, on pourra la débarrasser des corrompus qui s'en sont emparés.
Taking the Tower#042.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#043.src: Assault the Raging Tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and defeat the monster at the top.
Taking the Tower#043.dst: Donnez l'assaut à la Tour enragée en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] et battez le monstre au sommet.

Taking the Tower#044.src: Alright. It's time to take on the tower! We've got this, {u}.
Taking the Tower#044.dst: Bien. C'est l'heure d'attaquer la tour! On va y arriver, {u}.
Taking the Tower#044.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#045.src: Report back to Lieutenant Van about your success at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Taking the Tower#045.dst: Annoncez votre réussite au lieutenant Van, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Taking the Tower#046.src: We did it, we killed the corrupted! Come on, let's get back to Lieutenant Van with the news!
Taking the Tower#046.dst: On a réussi, on a tué le corrompu! Allez, retournons voir le lieutenant Van avec la nouvelle!
Taking the Tower#046.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#047.src: It seems everyone has returned. Well? Have the corrupted forces been vanquished?
Taking the Tower#047.dst: On dirait que tout le monde est revenu. Alors? Les forces corrompues ont-elles été vaincues?
Taking the Tower#047.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#048.src: Fine work, soldiers! Another great victory for the {p} army. With the leader killed, it shouldn't be too difficult to clear out the rest of them.
Taking the Tower#048.dst: Beau travail, soldats! Encore une belle victoire pour l'armée de {p}. Leur chef tué, nettoyer le reste ne devrait pas être bien difficile.
Taking the Tower#048.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#049.src: I'll let the Admiral know of your victory today, soldiers. And- here, some payment for your work.
Taking the Tower#049.dst: J'informerai l'amiral de votre victoire du jour, soldats. Et- tenez, une paie pour votre travail.
Taking the Tower#049.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#050.src: The two of you have a promising future. I look forward to serving with you in the future!
Taking the Tower#050.dst: Vous deux avez un avenir prometteur. J'ai hâte de servir à nouveau à vos côtés!
Taking the Tower#050.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#052.src: We'll take care of the remaining stragglers, don't you worry. Thank you for your work today, soldier.
Taking the Tower#052.dst: On s'occupera des derniers traînards, ne vous en faites pas. Merci pour votre travail aujourd'hui, soldat.
Taking the Tower#052.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taproot#007.src: New Quest Started: Realm of Light II - Taproot
Taproot#007.dst: Nouvelle quête commencée: Royaume de la Lumière II - Le mal à la racine

similar.text: New Quest Started: Realm of Light V - The Realm of Light

Taproot#008.src: I have to follow the trail! I...I have to know what he's telling me!
Taproot#008.dst: Je dois suivre la piste! Je... je dois savoir ce qu'il essaie de me dire!

Taproot#009.src: {u}...please, can you investigate the doorway? There must be something wrong that I don't understand.
Taproot#009.dst: {u}... s'il te plaît, peux-tu examiner l'entrée? Il doit y avoir un problème que je ne comprends pas.
Taproot#009.speaker: Lari

similar.text: ...please, can you investigate the doorway? There must be something wrong that I don't understand.

Taproot#010.src: To end this "Mayor's" life... To snuff out one whose heart aches is painful.
Taproot#010.dst: Mettre fin à la vie de ce "maire"... Éteindre un coeur qui souffre est douloureux.

similar.text: The door has been opened...

Taproot#013.src: The cog is missing a piece...
Taproot#013.dst: Il manque une pièce à l'engrenage...

Taproot#014.src: Maybe there is something you can use around. Might be good to backtrack.
Taproot#014.dst: Il y a peut-être quelque chose d'utile par ici. Revenez peut-être sur vos pas.

Taproot#015.src: The piece of metal fit in the cog...
Taproot#015.dst: Le morceau de métal s'est emboîté dans l'engrenage...

Taproot#016.src: You should follow Lari. There has to be something you can do.
Taproot#016.dst: Vous devriez suivre Lari. Il doit y avoir quelque chose à faire.

Taproot#018.src: ...oh. {u}, you're back. Ehm...I have to say, I'm...rather busy at the moment.
Taproot#018.dst: ...oh. {u}, te revoilà. Euh... je dois dire que je suis... plutôt occupée en ce moment.
Taproot#018.speaker: Lari

Taproot#019.src: I have...important things to do. This accursed Decay...I have to end it. This all needs to stop.
Taproot#019.dst: J'ai... des choses importantes à faire. Cette maudite Décadence... je dois l'arrêter. Tout ça doit cesser.
Taproot#019.speaker: Lari

Taproot#020.src: I am thankful for your aid with the...the Grootslang, but I do not believe you will be able to help with this- Simply a matter of scale.
Taproot#020.dst: Je te suis reconnaissante pour ton aide avec le... le Grootslang, mais je ne crois pas que tu puisses m'aider ici- C'est une simple question d'échelle.
Taproot#020.speaker: Lari

Taproot#021.src: I apologize, but I need to focus on my task here. If, perhaps, you could come back another time? And, I do mean that sincerely...
Taproot#021.dst: Je suis désolée, mais je dois me concentrer sur ma tâche. Peut-être pourrais-tu revenir une autre fois? Et je le dis sincèrement...
Taproot#021.speaker: Lari

Taproot#022.src: I can't even recall how many attempts this will make...but all my knowledge has gone into this. This must work.
Taproot#022.dst: Je ne sais même plus combien de tentatives ça fait... mais j'y ai mis tout mon savoir. Ça doit marcher.
Taproot#022.speaker: Lari

Taproot#023.src: Follow Lari to the black spot next to her camp.
Taproot#023.dst: Suivez Lari jusqu'à la tache noire près de son campement.

Taproot#024.src: ...I suppose I can't fault you for being curious. You may have seen a large, dark-looking patch of ground on your way here- I am trying to tend to it once more.
Taproot#024.dst: ...Je suppose que je ne peux pas te reprocher ta curiosité. Tu as peut-être vu une grande parcelle de terre sombre en venant- J'essaie encore une fois de la soigner.
Taproot#024.speaker: Lari

Taproot#025.src: It is...the most obvious stain of the decay, and very intense...if I can scrub this out, the rest should follow.
Taproot#025.dst: C'est... la marque la plus visible de la Décadence, et très intense... si j'arrive à l'effacer, le reste devrait suivre.
Taproot#025.speaker: Lari

Taproot#026.src: This concoction of mine should...do the trick!
Taproot#026.speaker: Lari

Taproot#027.src: It...it's working!! I can feel it, the land is reacting positively!
Taproot#027.dst: Ça... ça marche!! Je le sens, la terre réagit bien!
Taproot#027.speaker: Lari

Taproot#028.src: I...I... It was...it was working, a-and... Agh, why can't I get this RIGHT?!
Taproot#028.dst: Je... je... Ça... ça marchait, e-et... Agh, pourquoi je n'y arrive PAS?!
Taproot#028.speaker: Lari

Taproot#029.src: How many decades have I been doing this? How much time have I wasted, just...flailing like this?!
Taproot#029.dst: Depuis combien de décennies je m'acharne? Combien de temps ai-je perdu, à... me débattre ainsi?!
Taproot#029.speaker: Lari

Taproot#030.src: Look, {u}, I...I don't know what you expect to do against this. The Wyrm was one thing, but...this is beyond your comprehension.
Taproot#030.dst: Écoute, {u}, je... je ne sais pas ce que tu comptes faire contre ça. Le Wyrm, c'était une chose, mais... ceci te dépasse.
Taproot#030.speaker: Lari

Taproot#031.src: I think you sh... Should...w-what is... Now, of all times? As I fail?!
Taproot#031.dst: Je crois que tu dev... Devrais... q-quoi... Là, maintenant? Quand j'échoue?!
Taproot#031.speaker: Lari

Taproot#032.src: The road, look! He's contacting me! A-are you finally giving me the answers I've asked for?
Taproot#032.dst: Le chemin, regarde! Il me contacte! T-tu me donnes enfin les réponses que je t'ai demandées?
Taproot#032.speaker: Lari

Taproot#033.src: Follow the trail of magic leading from the black spot.
Taproot#033.dst: Suivez la piste magique qui part de la tache noire.

Taproot#034.src: Talk to Lari outside the weird gate at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Taproot#034.dst: Parlez à Lari devant l'étrange porte, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Taproot#035.src: ...I followed you seeking answers...and here, I am presented with more questions. Why did he bring us here?
Taproot#035.dst: ...Je t'ai suivi en quête de réponses... et ici, on ne m'offre que d'autres questions. Pourquoi nous a-t-il amenés ici?
Taproot#035.speaker: Lari

Taproot#036.src: This gate has appeared, immovable and impassable, since the moment that...that everything started.
Taproot#036.dst: Cette porte est apparue, inamovible et infranchissable, dès l'instant où... où tout a commencé.
Taproot#036.speaker: Lari

Taproot#037.src: I don't...is he trying to remind me of what's at stake? Did he want to show y- No, that's...he wouldn't know you...but then, what IS this about?!
Taproot#037.dst: Je ne... essaie-t-il de me rappeler ce qui est en jeu? Voulait-il te montr- Non, c'est... il ne te connaîtrait pas... mais alors, de quoi S'AGIT-il?!
Taproot#037.speaker: Lari

Taproot#038.src: Rrgh... ANSWER ME! PLEASE! I've begged you for so long to answer!
Taproot#038.dst: Rrgh... RÉPONDS-MOI! PITIÉ! Je te supplie de répondre depuis si longtemps!
Taproot#038.speaker: Lari

Taproot#039.src: You gave me my task and your light but never told me what to DO! I've tried everything I can think of!!
Taproot#039.dst: Tu m'as donné ma tâche et ta lumière, sans jamais me dire quoi FAIRE! J'ai essayé tout ce que je pouvais!!
Taproot#039.speaker: Lari

Taproot#040.src: Tell me! Please, just t-tell me already!! I don't know how much longer I can stand this!!
Taproot#040.dst: Dis-le-moi! Pitié, d-dis-le-moi enfin!! Je ne sais pas combien de temps je vais tenir!!
Taproot#040.speaker: Lari

Taproot#041.src: I...a-another one? Where are you leading me now?
Taproot#041.dst: Je... e-encore une? Où me mènes-tu maintenant?
Taproot#041.speaker: Lari

Taproot#042.src: It...the gateway...? Are you...I can't understand! Why this, again?
Taproot#042.dst: C'est... le portail...? Est-ce que... Je ne comprends pas! Pourquoi ça, encore?
Taproot#042.speaker: Lari

Taproot#043.src: You showed me this before... At first, when you first contacted me. I made the choice...
Taproot#043.dst: Tu m'as déjà montré ça... Au début, la première fois que tu m'as contactée. J'ai fait le choix...
Taproot#043.speaker: Lari

Taproot#044.src: Must I make it again? Is that it, do I need to prove myself to you once more?
Taproot#044.dst: Dois-je le refaire? C'est ça, je dois encore une fois faire mes preuves auprès de toi?
Taproot#044.speaker: Lari

Taproot#045.src: I...what? You...you present me with this, but refuse to let me do what you want?
Taproot#045.dst: Je... quoi? Tu... tu me montres ça, mais tu refuses de me laisser faire ce que tu veux?
Taproot#045.speaker: Lari

Taproot#049.src: My pulse... Human. I must inquire to you. I present you a test. Guide your attention to those you see.
Taproot#049.dst: Mon pouls... Humain. Je dois t'interroger. Je te soumets une épreuve. Porte ton attention sur ceux que tu vois.

Taproot#050.src: I must see the rhythm your heart beats. Listen well.
Taproot#050.dst: Je dois voir le rythme que bat ton coeur. Écoute bien.

Taproot#051.src: This has gone far enough. I can't do this anymore! I can't give you any more and I refuse to apologize for it!
Taproot#051.dst: Ça a assez duré. Je n'en peux plus! Je ne peux plus rien vous donner et je refuse de m'en excuser!
Taproot#051.speaker: Mayor

Taproot#052.src: You know our deal. Remember what good you are doing by following the plans I've laid out for you.
Taproot#052.dst: Vous connaissez notre accord. Songez au bien que vous faites en suivant les plans que j'ai tracés pour vous.
Taproot#052.speaker: Dr. Urelix

Taproot#053.src: Are you going to let your emotions cloud your judgment? You're a smarter man than that, Mr. Mayor.
Taproot#053.dst: Allez-vous laisser vos émotions troubler votre jugement? Vous êtes plus malin que ça, monsieur le maire.
Taproot#053.speaker: Dr. Urelix

Taproot#054.src: You can't possibly believe that throwing away the lives of innocent people is right! I can't go on with this on my conscience!
Taproot#054.dst: Vous ne pouvez pas croire que sacrifier la vie d'innocents soit juste! Je ne peux pas continuer avec ça sur la conscience!
Taproot#054.speaker: Mayor

Taproot#055.src: Detective Hart WILL be hearing from me, and he'll be hearing everything. We can't keep sacrificing our own like this!
Taproot#055.dst: Le détective Hart VA avoir de mes nouvelles, et il saura tout. On ne peut pas continuer à sacrifier les nôtres ainsi!
Taproot#055.speaker: Mayor

Taproot#056.src: Our golems have single-handedly turned the tide of the Humans' corruption war. You would save ten here and sentence a thousand to die overseas?
Taproot#056.dst: Nos golems ont à eux seuls renversé le cours de la guerre des humains contre la Corruption. Vous en sauveriez dix ici pour en condamner mille outre-mer?
Taproot#056.speaker: Dr. Urelix

Taproot#057.src: You're a sick, twisted man, Urelix. I will not abide by this a moment longer.
Taproot#057.dst: Vous êtes un homme malade et tordu, Urelix. Je ne tolérerai pas ça un instant de plus.
Taproot#057.speaker: Mayor

Taproot#058.src: My pulse, you must decide. Three paths diverge upon your road.
Taproot#058.dst: Mon pouls, tu dois décider. Trois chemins s'ouvrent sur ta route.

Taproot#059.src: You may leave. The rays of fate will see to destiny unfolding.
Taproot#059.dst: Tu peux partir. Les rayons du sort veilleront à l'accomplissement du destin.

Taproot#060.src: You may end this "Mayor's" life. Blood upon your hands in many ways.
Taproot#060.dst: Tu peux mettre fin à la vie de ce "maire". Du sang sur tes mains, de bien des façons.

Taproot#062.src: You may end the life of Urelix. Heartbeats ceased by a bleeding heart.
Taproot#062.dst: Tu peux mettre fin à la vie d'Urelix. Des battements arrêtés par un coeur qui saigne.

Taproot#063.src: Which way does your heart beat? How will you cast your light? Can you see?
Taproot#063.dst: De quel côté bat ton coeur? Comment répandras-tu ta lumière? Vois-tu?

Taproot#065.src: My pulse... The blood of a bleeding heart has poisoned me. Even if you believe the sun should shine elsewhere, you must direct it yourself.
Taproot#065.dst: Mon pouls... Le sang d'un coeur qui saigne m'a empoisonné. Même si tu crois que le soleil devrait briller ailleurs, tu dois l'y diriger toi-même.

Taproot#066.src: You must realize what is needed. You must see light through my lens.
Taproot#066.dst: Tu dois comprendre ce qui est nécessaire. Tu dois voir la lumière à travers mon prisme.

Taproot#067.src: To leave... As destiny unfolds, the sun shall set.
Taproot#067.dst: Partir... Tandis que le destin s'accomplit, le soleil se couchera.

Taproot#068.src: To end the life of Urelix... The shadows of war shall engulf all.
Taproot#068.dst: Mettre fin à la vie d'Urelix... Les ombres de la guerre engloutiront tout.

Taproot#069.src: My pulse, there is only one choice. You must do what is required, I beg of you.
Taproot#069.dst: Mon pouls, il n'y a qu'un seul choix. Tu dois faire ce qui est requis, je t'en conjure.

Taproot#070.src: Ah, you recognize necessity. That couldn't have been pleasant...but what's needed isn't pleasant, in the end.
