The Cursed One#187.dst: Allez au grand arbre et trouvez Zeph en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#188.src: I suppose I should get around to firing up the forge... Sui, will you need me for anything?
The Cursed One#188.dst: Je suppose que je devrais aller allumer la forge... Sui, tu auras besoin de moi?
The Cursed One#188.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#189.src: Um... n-no, I don't think so.
The Cursed One#189.dst: Euh... n-non, je ne crois pas.
The Cursed One#189.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#190.src: He's taken to it remarkably well, hasn't he? Better than I could have hoped.
The Cursed One#190.dst: Il s'y est remarquablement bien fait, n'est-ce pas? Mieux que je ne l'espérais.
The Cursed One#190.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#191.src: {u}... you have opened a path for me that I never could have imagined. Thank you.
The Cursed One#191.dst: {u}... tu m'as ouvert une voie que je n'aurais jamais pu imaginer. Merci.
The Cursed One#191.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#195.src: Never in my life did I expect to have my whole world view challenged, hoh!
The Cursed One#195.dst: Jamais de ma vie je n'aurais cru voir toute ma vision du monde remise en question, ho!
The Cursed One#195.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#196.src: Admittedly, this information will take some time to progress...
The Cursed One#196.dst: Je l'avoue, il me faudra du temps pour digérer tout ça...
The Cursed One#196.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#197.src: I'll most likely seek you out later with some follow up questions.
The Cursed One#197.dst: Je viendrai sûrement te trouver plus tard avec d'autres questions.
The Cursed One#197.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#198.src: ...well, Synny, don't suppose any of this changes your usual approach?
The Cursed One#198.dst: ...alors, Synny, j'suppose que tout ça change rien à ta façon de faire?
The Cursed One#198.speaker: Kaio

The Cursed One#199.src: Sigh... You know it does, Kaio. If there's a possibility more of our members could wield magic, then...
The Cursed One#199.dst: Soupir... Tu sais bien que si, Kaio. S'il est possible que d'autres des nôtres manient la magie, alors...
The Cursed One#199.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#201.src: ... I don't know. I don't know if it'll work, yet.
The Cursed One#201.dst: ... Je ne sais pas. Je ne sais pas encore si ça marchera.
The Cursed One#201.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#204.src: Yes, well, I especially don't like this. Don't like the ideas you're gettin' all up there in your head. It's a risk.
The Cursed One#204.dst: Ouais, ben, ça, ça me plaît encore moins. J'aime pas les idées qui te trottent dans la tête. C'est un risque.
The Cursed One#204.speaker: Kaio

The Cursed One#205.src: Everything is a risk. But it doesn't matter yet. It'll depend on what Quill has to tell me during the festival.
The Cursed One#205.dst: Tout est un risque. Mais peu importe pour l'instant. Ça dépendra de ce que Quill aura à me dire pendant le festival.
The Cursed One#205.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#207.src: When I m- ma- when I make my weapon... do you think I'll be a- a- able to cast real spells? And not just... poofs of sp- s- sparkles?
The Cursed One#207.dst: Quand je f- fa- quand je ferai mon arme... tu crois que je p- p- pourrai lancer de vrais sorts? Et pas juste... des pouf d'é- é- étincelles?
The Cursed One#207.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#208.src: Having a weapon helps me cas
The Cursed One#208.dst: Avoir une arme m'aide à lan

The Cursed One#210.src: Sigh... I was h- h- hoping that- th- that I could do... I- I don't know! Something! A- any- anything to help. But... you're right.
The Cursed One#210.dst: Soupir... J'e- e- espérais que- que- que je pourrais faire... je- je sais pas! Quelque chose! N'im- n'importe quoi pour aider. Mais... tu as raison.
The Cursed One#210.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#211.src: Oh. O- okay! That means it- it m- might help me, too. Thank you.
The Cursed One#211.dst: Oh. D- d'accord! Alors ça- ça p- pourrait m'aider aussi. Merci.
The Cursed One#211.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#212.src: So, what are we doing here?

The Cursed One#213.src: Oh! R- ri- right! Well, Syndra said we sh- should find something magical, right? Well, I- I don't know for- f- for sure if it's magical or not, but...
The Cursed One#213.dst: Oh! C- c'e- c'est vrai! Syndra a dit qu'on d- devait trouver quelque chose de magique, non? Bon, je- je sais pas a- a- avec certitude si c'est magique ou pas, mais...
The Cursed One#213.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#214.src: A long, long time ago, th- this- this tree was more than just a stump! It had long arms st- str- stretching out over the whole forest, watching over th- the people and w- wi- wildlife.
The Cursed One#214.dst: Il y a très, très longtemps, c- cet- cet arbre était bien plus qu'une souche! Ses longs bras s'é- s'é- s'étendaient sur toute la forêt, veillant sur l- les gens et les a- ani- animaux.
The Cursed One#214.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#215.src: When anyone was hurt, o- or- or unwell, the tree would reach out with its br- branches and grow fruit- fruit that was said to he- h- heal all injuries and illnesses.
The Cursed One#215.dst: Quand quelqu'un était blessé, o- ou- ou malade, l'arbre tendait ses br- branches et donnait un fruit- un fruit qui, disait-on, gu- g- guérissait toutes les blessures et maladies.
The Cursed One#215.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#216.src: It took care of the people, and the p- people took care of the tree. But then- then the c- cur- curse took hold of the people.
The Cursed One#216.dst: Il prenait soin des gens, et les g- gens prenaient soin de l'arbre. Mais en- ensuite la m- mal- malédiction s'est emparée des gens.
The Cursed One#216.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#217.src: In the chaos and d- des- destruction caused by the cursed ones, the tree was hurt. It stopped gr- grow- growing its gifts, and went to sleep... f- forever.
The Cursed One#217.dst: Dans le chaos et la d- des- destruction causés par les Maudits, l'arbre a été blessé. Il a cessé de do- don- donner ses présents et s'est endormi... p- pour toujours.
The Cursed One#217.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#218.src: Even after the Queen arrived a- and blessed the people, the tree di- didn't- didn't wake up. Its trust had been broken...
The Cursed One#218.dst: Même après l'arrivée de la Reine, q- qui a béni les gens, l'arbre ne s'est p- pas- pas réveillé. Sa confiance avait été brisée...
The Cursed One#218.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#219.src: Ev- even though it's just a story... I hope s- some- someday the tree can trust us again. We could- c- could- we could really use its help, these days...
The Cursed One#219.dst: Mê- même si c'est juste une histoire... j'espère qu'un j- jour- un jour l'arbre nous refera confiance. On aurait- a- aurait- on aurait bien besoin de son aide, en ce moment...
The Cursed One#219.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#220.src: ... A- a- anyway! The cavern you met Syndra in is also said to be s- sa- sacred. And the feel of the crystals reminds me of h- how I feel there.
The Cursed One#220.dst: ... B- b- bref! La caverne où tu as rencontré Syndra serait aussi s- sa- sacrée. Et les cristaux me font le même effet que c- ce que je ressens là-bas.
The Cursed One#220.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#221.src: So- s- so if we can find our way into the tree... we co- could find some m- ma- s- some magical wood. Follow me!
The Cursed One#221.dst: Al- a- alors si on arrive à entrer dans l'arbre... on p- pourrait trouver du b- bo- d- du bois magique. Suis-moi!
The Cursed One#221.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#222.src: Head to the top of the giant tree at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Cursed One#222.dst: Montez au sommet de l'arbre géant en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#223.src: Hey! F- faster than last time! Keep up the im- im- improvement, and maybe soon I'll have to put in mo- more than {~}!
The Cursed One#223.dst: Hé! P- plus rapide que la dernière fois! Continue à pro- pro- progresser, et je devrai peut-être bientôt y mettre p- plus de {~}!
The Cursed One#223.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#224.src: Ha... yeah... Um, earlier you m- me- mentioned that magic can be found in- in everything.
The Cursed One#224.dst: Ha... ouais... Euh, tout à l'heure, tu as m- men- mentionné que la magie se trouve d- dans tout.
The Cursed One#224.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#225.src: So... so ma- maybe we didn't need to come to- to- to this old tree... But- b- but it feels right to me.
The Cursed One#225.dst: Alors... alors p- peut-être qu'on n'avait pas besoin de venir à- à- à ce vieil arbre... Mais- m- mais ça me semble juste.
The Cursed One#225.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#226.src: ... Thank you for c- c- coming along.
The Cursed One#226.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#227.src: It's a breath of fresh air, having someone n- n- new around! I don't know, having you around just f- fe- feels... good! Like- like anything is possible!
The Cursed One#227.dst: Ça fait un bol d'air frais, d'avoir quelqu'un de n- n- nouveau dans le coin! Je sais pas, t'avoir ici, ça- ç- ça fait... du bien! Comme- comme si tout était possible!
The Cursed One#227.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#228.src: ... Oh, I- I- I'm getting too sappy. Sorry, sorry!
The Cursed One#228.dst: ... Oh, je- je- je deviens trop sentimental. Pardon, pardon!
The Cursed One#228.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#229.src: Well... my h- h- my heart is telling me that this wood is what I w- w- what I want!
The Cursed One#229.dst: Bon... mon c- c- mon coeur me dit que ce bois, c'est ce que je v- v- ce que je veux!
The Cursed One#229.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#230.src: That old tale... it's one of the o- o- only things I still remember from my childhood.
The Cursed One#230.dst: Ce vieux conte... c'est l'une des s- s- seules choses dont je me souviens encore de mon enfance.
The Cursed One#230.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#231.src: So, s- so this is definitely what I want my w- we- weapon to be made out of.
The Cursed One#231.dst: A- alors c'est vraiment en ça que je veux mon a- ar- arme.
The Cursed One#231.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#232.src: We might as well just have g
The Cursed One#232.dst: On aurait pu prendre n'importe quel bois.

The Cursed One#233.src: Oh... y- y- yeah. Maybe you're right...
The Cursed One#233.dst: Oh... o- o- ouais. Tu as peut-être raison...
The Cursed One#233.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#234.src: I just thought... choosing s- some- something special to me would- would be b- best.
The Cursed One#234.dst: Je pensais juste... que choisir q- quel- quelque chose de spécial pour moi serait- serait le m- mieux.
The Cursed One#234.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#235.src: B- but we're here now any- a- anyway, aren't we? So we can just use the- the- the wood here...
The Cursed One#235.dst: M- mais on est là de toute f- f- façon, non? Alors on peut juste utiliser l- l- le bois d'ici...
The Cursed One#235.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#236.src: So, we've gotta find a way into the tr- the tree...
The Cursed One#236.dst: Bon, il faut trouver un moyen d'entrer dans l'a- l'arbre...
The Cursed One#236.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#237.src: Ha, I- I'm not exactly a wood- woodcutting expert... maybe it'd have been smart to ask Mora t- to- to join us?
The Cursed One#237.dst: Ha, je- je suis pas vraiment un expert en bû- bûcheronnage... ça aurait peut-être été malin de demander à Mora de v- ve- venir?
The Cursed One#237.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#238.src: ... Do- do you have any ideas? May- maybe you could break through with a sp- spe- spell?
The Cursed One#238.dst: ... T- tu as une idée? Peut- peut-être que tu pourrais percer avec un s- so- sort?
The Cursed One#238.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#239.src: Cast a spell ontop of the tree at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Cursed One#239.dst: Lancez un sort au sommet de l'arbre en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#240.src: Maybe you could break through with a sp- spe- spell?
The Cursed One#240.dst: Peut-être que tu pourrais percer avec un s- so- sort?
The Cursed One#240.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#241.dst: Ouah! Qu'est-ce qui vient de se passer?!
The Cursed One#241.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#242.src: ... Do- do you think the t- tr- the tree heard me earlier? Is it...
The Cursed One#242.dst: ... T- tu crois que l'a- ar- l'arbre m'a entendu tout à l'heure? Est-ce qu'il...
The Cursed One#242.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#243.src: This- th- this has to be a sign! Come on, let's go in!
The Cursed One#243.dst: C- c- ça doit être un signe! Allez, entrons!
The Cursed One#243.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#244.src: Find the wood Zeph wants at the end of the root system.
The Cursed One#244.dst: Trouvez le bois que Zeph veut au bout des racines.

The Cursed One#245.src: Th- th- there! That should- sh- should be a big enough chunk for Mora... right?
The Cursed One#245.dst: L- l- là! Ce morceau d- de- devrait suffire à Mora... non?
The Cursed One#245.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#246.src: A- and- you're still not fast enough to beat me to th- th- to the end!
The Cursed One#246.dst: E- et- tu n'es toujours pas assez rapide pour arriver au b- b- au bout avant moi!
The Cursed One#246.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#247.src: Okay, next... We- weapons are usually made of m- me- metal, right? That's why Mora has a f- fo- a forge.
The Cursed One#247.dst: Bon, ensuite... Les a- armes sont souvent en m- mé- métal, non? C'est pour ça que Mora a une f- fo- une forge.
The Cursed One#247.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#248.src: ...I have a- an- an idea! Let's meet up near {p}, wh- where we first met.
The Cursed One#248.dst: ...J'ai u- un- une idée! Retrouvons-nous près de {p}, l- là où on s'est rencontrés.
The Cursed One#248.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#250.src: O- okay, so. The crown usually uses t- ti- titanium for their equipment. Th- that's what Mora says, at least.
The Cursed One#250.dst: B- bon, alors. La Couronne utilise souvent du t- ti- titane pour son équipement. C- c'est ce que dit Mora, en tout cas.
The Cursed One#250.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#251.src: But- b- but, it can be hard to come by, b- be- because the crown keeps most of it for themselves.
The Cursed One#251.dst: Mais- m- mais c'est dur à trouver, p- par- parce que la Couronne en garde presque tout pour elle.
The Cursed One#251.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#252.src: Luckily, it's F- F- Festival time, so a bunch of m- merchants are in town! And they're fr- from all over the p- pr- province, not just here!
The Cursed One#252.dst: Par chance, c'est l'époque du F- F- Festival, alors plein de m- marchands sont en ville! Et ils viennent d- de toute la p- pro- province, pas seulement d'ici!
The Cursed One#252.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#253.src: So someone m- must have titanium, somewhere... we'll j- just- just have to look around.
The Cursed One#253.dst: Alors quelqu'un d- doit bien avoir du titane, quelque part... on va j- juste- juste devoir chercher.
The Cursed One#253.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#254.src: Ah! Th- that- that's the Sovereign!
The Cursed One#254.dst: Ah! C- c'est- c'est le Souverain!
The Cursed One#254.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#255.src: ...and alongside that, does she really think it's safe to hold the festival right now, sir? That opens up a really big risk!
The Cursed One#255.dst: ...et en plus, croit-elle vraiment qu'il est prudent d'organiser le festival maintenant, monsieur? Ça ouvre la porte à un risque énorme!
The Cursed One#255.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#256.src: What do you th- th- think they're t- talking about? Come on, let- l- let's shadow them.
The Cursed One#256.dst: De quoi tu c- c- crois qu'ils p- parlent? Allez, s- s- suivons-les.
The Cursed One#256.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#257.src: If the cursed thinks they can get past both myself and Her Majesty, they're out of their vector. You don't need to worry about the people.
The Cursed One#257.dst: Si le maudit croit pouvoir passer outre moi et Sa Majesté, il a perdu la raison... géométrique. Tu n'as pas à t'inquiéter pour le peuple.
The Cursed One#257.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#258.src: I was more worried about... ...um... W-well, never mind that! If you think we'll all be safe, sir, I'll take you at your word!
The Cursed One#258.dst: Je m'inquiétais plutôt pour... ...euh... B-bon, peu importe! Si vous pensez que nous serons tous en sécurité, monsieur, je vous crois sur parole!
The Cursed One#258.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#259.src: Let me rephrase- you don't need to worry about anyone. ...heh. Any- wait. What's that noise?
The Cursed One#259.dst: Je reformule- tu n'as à t'inquiéter pour personne. ...hé. Perso- attends. C'est quoi, ce bruit?
The Cursed One#259.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#260.src: Just someone out on a random walk? Back to the point- is everything for the festival shaping up according to schedule?
The Cursed One#260.dst: Quelqu'un en pleine marche aléatoire, sans doute? Revenons-en au fait- tout se met-il en place pour le festival selon le calendrier?
The Cursed One#260.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#261.src: Oh- yes! Yes it is, sir! The vendors have all been assigned, the game stands have all been constructed, we've commissioned a local band... The one you liked last year!
The Cursed One#261.dst: Oh- oui! Absolument, monsieur! Les marchands ont tous leur place, les stands de jeux sont tous montés, nous avons engagé un orchestre local... Celui que vous avez aimé l'an dernier!
The Cursed One#261.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#262.src: Golden. That rendition of "CHASE" is what really sold me on them.
The Cursed One#262.dst: Du nombre d'or. C'est leur version de "CHASE" qui m'a vraiment convaincu.
The Cursed One#262.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#263.src: That just leaves your speech, sir! Have you- Oh, who am I kidding, you already have it memorized.
The Cursed One#263.dst: Il ne reste que votre discours, monsieur! L'avez-vous- Oh, qui j'essaie de tromper, vous le connaissez déjà par coeur.
The Cursed One#263.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#264.src: Naturally, Xao. We have the whole festival set down to the last point, it looks like. Any more business to factor out?
The Cursed One#264.dst: Naturellement, Xao. On dirait que tout le festival est réglé jusqu'à la dernière décimale. D'autres affaires à mettre en facteur?
The Cursed One#264.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#265.src: Yes, sir! I've received word that Inquisitor Renn will be arriving tonight, as you sent me to request for!
The Cursed One#265.dst: Oui, monsieur! On m'a informé que l'Inquisiteur Renn arrivera ce soir, comme vous m'aviez chargé de le demander!
The Cursed One#265.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#266.src: Fantastic job. I have to remember that the Inquisitors aren't like me. When they're busy they can't just go triple-time... Still, good to have that problem solved.
The Cursed One#266.dst: Excellent travail. Je dois me rappeler que les Inquisiteurs ne sont pas comme moi. Occupés, ils ne peuvent pas passer au triple de la vitesse... Enfin, un problème de résolu.
The Cursed One#266.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#267.src: You know, they should check your work. This is proof positive they can keep pace with me like you can.
The Cursed One#267.dst: Tu sais, on devrait examiner ton travail. C'est la preuve par neuf qu'on peut suivre mon rythme, comme toi.
The Cursed One#267.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#268.src: Well! Sir! You know I've had to insist you stop and rest sometimes, and Inquisitors do serve the whole of the province, so...
The Cursed One#268.dst: Eh bien! Monsieur! Vous savez que j'ai parfois dû insister pour que vous vous reposiez, et les Inquisiteurs servent toute la province, alors...
The Cursed One#268.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#269.src: Hmm... ev- even with us r- r- raiding Nixeph, he isn't concerned...
The Cursed One#269.dst: Hmm... m- même avec notre a- a- attaque sur Nixeph, il ne s'inquiète pas...
The Cursed One#269.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#270.src: A- and- an Inquisitor! Th- that- that's not good. We need to tell the others to be c- ca- careful...
The Cursed One#270.dst: E- et- un Inquisiteur! C- ça- c'est pas bon. Il faut dire aux autres d'être p- pru- prudents...
The Cursed One#270.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#271.src: Oh! R- r- right! You're not from here. They're, uh, b- b- bad news. They're sent to d- d- deal with... um, c- cursed ones, and other s- si- similar stuff.
The Cursed One#271.dst: Oh! C- c- c'est vrai! Tu n'es pas d'ici. C'est, euh, de m- m- mauvais augure. On les envoie s'o- o- occuper des... euh, M- Maudits, et d'autres trucs s- sem- semblables.
The Cursed One#271.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#272.src: If one's a- around... we have to b- be careful. But, since w- we- since we're here, we should still find the t- ti- titanium.
The Cursed One#272.dst: S'il y en a un d- dans le coin... il faut faire a- attention. Mais, p- puis- puisqu'on est là, on devrait quand même trouver le t- ti- titane.
The Cursed One#272.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#273.src: There's a b- b- bazaar in the tunnel... if anyone wi- will have it, they'll be there.
The Cursed One#273.dst: Il y a un b- b- bazar dans le tunnel... si quelqu'un en a, c'est l- là-bas.
The Cursed One#273.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#274.dst: Trouvez le marchand de métaux en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#275.src: Fine quality metals, fine quality metals for- Ah, hello, hello! Might you be interested in my stock, friends?
The Cursed One#275.dst: Métaux de qualité, métaux de qualité pour- Ah, bonjour, bonjour! Mon stock vous intéresserait-il, mes amis?
The Cursed One#275.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#276.src: I've got all sorts for sale. Ingots, pre-made bangles and bracelets and trinkets- I've got hold of this lovely iron leaf, in fact. Quite fine decor, I might think!
The Cursed One#276.dst: J'ai de tout à vendre. Lingots, joncs et bracelets déjà faits, babioles- je me suis même procuré cette ravissante feuille de fer. Une bien belle décoration, je dirais!
The Cursed One#276.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#277.src: Hello! We're a- ac- actually looking for titanium! Would you h- ha- happen to have any in stock?
The Cursed One#277.dst: Bonjour! En f- fa- fait, on cherche du titane! Vous en au- au- auriez en stock, par hasard?
The Cursed One#277.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#278.src: Aha, you're in luck then! I've managed to obtain some from a passing {p} merchant! Straight from the {p}- and so I'm told, quite good quality!
The Cursed One#278.dst: Aha, vous avez de la chance, alors! J'en ai obtenu auprès d'un marchand de {p} de passage! Tout droit venu de {p}- et, à ce qu'on m'a dit, de très bonne qualité!
The Cursed One#278.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#279.src: I think the man was struck dumb by the offer of leaves I handed in return, he left with such a bewildered face- but I digress! Would you like ingots, or anything pre-hewn?
The Cursed One#279.dst: Je crois que l'homme est resté sans voix devant les feuilles que je lui ai offertes en échange, il est reparti si perplexe- mais je m'égare! Voulez-vous des lingots, ou quelque chose de déjà façonné?
The Cursed One#279.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#280.src: Uh... just- j- just some ingots would be fine.
The Cursed One#280.dst: Euh... juste- j- juste quelques lingots, ça ira.
The Cursed One#280.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#281.src: Indeed, then! It is always fine to see those interested in the crafting trades. For this, I might say ten Liff Leaves would be an agreeable price, yes?
The Cursed One#281.dst: Entendu, alors! C'est toujours un plaisir de voir des gens s'intéresser à l'artisanat. Pour ceci, je dirais que dix feuilles de Liff seraient un prix raisonnable, non?
The Cursed One#281.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#282.src: Ten!? Oh, f- fine... you said h- high- high quality? It's pr- probably worth the price. Here.
The Cursed One#282.dst: Dix!? Oh, b- bon... vous avez dit de h- hau- haute qualité? Ça vaut s- sûrement le prix. Tenez.
The Cursed One#282.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#283.src: Indeed, friend, so I have been assured! May you have fine fortune in your endeavors!
The Cursed One#283.dst: En effet, l'ami, c'est ce qu'on m'a assuré! Que la fortune sourie à vos entreprises!
The Cursed One#283.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#285.src: Hm... I d- don't- I don't think titanium is meant to have th- these purple streaks...
The Cursed One#285.dst: Hm... je c- crois- je crois pas que le titane soit censé avoir c- ces veines violettes...
The Cursed One#285.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#286.src: But I- I- I'm not the blacksmith, so... a- a- and it's not like anyone else is s- se- selling titanium, so.
The Cursed One#286.dst: Mais je- je- je suis pas le forgeron, alors... e- e- et c'est pas comme si quelqu'un d'autre v- ven- vendait du titane, alors.
The Cursed One#286.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#287.src: Huh? Oh, r- r- right, I keep forgetting you don't know e- ev- everything around here.
The Cursed One#287.dst: Hein? Oh, c- c- c'est vrai, j'oublie toujours que tu ne connais pas t- tou- tout par ici.
The Cursed One#287.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#288.src: The Auburn F- Fo- Forest may be a poorer area, so we d- do- don't have many emeralds...
The Cursed One#288.dst: La f- fo- forêt d'Auburn est peut-être une région pauvre, alors on n'a p- pa- pas beaucoup d'émeraudes...
The Cursed One#288.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#289.src: But we make up for it by u- u- using all the varied m- materials from the forest! People here v- val- value things from the wild more than e- em- emeralds.
The Cursed One#289.dst: Mais on compense en u- u- utilisant tous les m- matériaux de la forêt! Ici, les gens a- ac- accordent plus de valeur aux choses de la nature qu'aux é- é- émeraudes.
The Cursed One#289.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#290.src: Liff Leaves especially are in high d- d- demand due to their versatility.
The Cursed One#290.dst: Les feuilles de Liff surtout sont très d- d- demandées, car elles servent à tout.
The Cursed One#290.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#291.src: You don't need a- an- anything else? Then I'm r- ready to go.
The Cursed One#291.dst: Tu n'as besoin de r- ri- rien d'autre? Alors je suis p- prêt à partir.
The Cursed One#291.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#292.src: Want to tr- travel back with me?
The Cursed One#292.dst: Tu v- veux rentrer avec moi?
The Cursed One#292.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#295.src: Okay! I'll m- m- meet you later, then.
The Cursed One#295.dst: D'accord! On se r- r- retrouve plus tard, alors.
The Cursed One#295.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#297.src: Ah! Good, you're just in time.
The Cursed One#297.dst: Ah! Bien, vous arrivez juste à temps.
The Cursed One#297.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#298.src: Uh... in time for wh- what? A- and- and where is everybody?
The Cursed One#298.dst: Euh... à temps p- pour quoi? E- et- et où sont les autres?
The Cursed One#298.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#299.src: Have you forgotten? The Festival of the Queen is about to start!
The Cursed One#299.dst: Tu as oublié? Le Festival de la Reine va commencer!
The Cursed One#299.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#300.src: Wh- th- that was today?! Oh, man, I g- g- got so excited about the m- m- the ma- magic... I forgot!
The Cursed One#300.dst: Qu- c- c'était aujourd'hui?! Oh, la la, j'étais t- t- tellement excité par la m- m- la ma- magie... j'ai oublié!
The Cursed One#300.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#301.src: Wait... w- wait, before I go- Syndra, we o- ov- overheard something in town. The S- S- Sovereign said an In- Inquisitor would be arriving t- t- tonight!
The Cursed One#301.dst: Attends... a- attends, avant que j'y aille- Syndra, on a e- en- entendu quelque chose en ville. Le S- S- Souverain a dit qu'un In- Inquisiteur arriverait c- c- ce soir!
The Cursed One#301.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#302.src: ...ah. Well, that pushes ahead our timeline significantly...
The Cursed One#302.dst: ...ah. Eh bien, ça avance sérieusement notre calendrier...
The Cursed One#302.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#303.src: Hopefully, they're just here to clear out that cave you found the crystals in, but... better to be safe than sorry.
The Cursed One#303.dst: Avec un peu de chance, il vient juste nettoyer la grotte où vous avez trouvé les cristaux, mais... mieux vaut prévenir que guérir.
The Cursed One#303.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#304.src: That can wait until after the festival, though. You should go on ahead and enjoy yourself.
The Cursed One#304.dst: Mais ça peut attendre la fin du festival. Vas-y, va t'amuser.
The Cursed One#304.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#305.src: ...if you s- s- say so, Syndra. {u}, you should c- come to the festival too! See you there!
The Cursed One#305.dst: ...si tu le d- d- dis, Syndra. {u}, tu devrais v- venir au festival aussi! On se voit là-bas!
The Cursed One#305.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#306.src: Ah... there he goes. Well, what do you say? Will you join us for the festival?
The Cursed One#306.dst: Ah... le voilà parti. Alors, qu'en dis-tu? Tu te joins à nous pour le festival?
The Cursed One#306.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#307.src: It is a celebration of the crown... but you have a limited time here, and it is still a part of our culture. You wouldn't want to miss it.
The Cursed One#307.dst: C'est une célébration de la Couronne... mais ton temps ici est compté, et ça fait tout de même partie de notre culture. Tu ne voudrais pas manquer ça.
The Cursed One#307.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#308.src: It's a day for everyone to relax and enjoy themselves. The children certainly do... it's good for them, I think, to have some normalcy.
The Cursed One#308.dst: C'est un jour où chacun peut se détendre et s'amuser. Les enfants, en tout cas... ça leur fait du bien, je crois, un peu de normalité.
The Cursed One#308.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#309.src: I'll finish packing some things here, then I'll head on over. You should meet me there. If you head south, the river will lead you right to it.
The Cursed One#309.dst: Je finis d'emballer quelques affaires ici, puis j'arrive. Retrouve-moi là-bas. Si tu vas vers le sud, la rivière t'y mènera tout droit.
The Cursed One#309.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#310.src: Join Syndra at the festival at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#311.src: I'll head on over soon. I just need to take care of some things before I leave.
The Cursed One#311.dst: J'arrive bientôt. J'ai juste quelques affaires à régler avant de partir.
The Cursed One#311.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#312.src: You're here! Allow me to welcome you to the annual Festival of the Crown.
The Cursed One#312.dst: Te voilà! Permets-moi de t'accueillir au Festival annuel de la Couronne.
The Cursed One#312.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#313.src: I have some business to attend to, so Zeph, would you be able to show {u} around?
The Cursed One#313.dst: J'ai des affaires à régler, alors Zeph, tu pourrais faire visiter les lieux à {u}?
The Cursed One#313.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#315.src: So there's some g- games over there... and right here is the f- foo- food and beverages s- s- stand!
The Cursed One#315.dst: Alors il y a des j- jeux là-bas... et juste ici, c'est le stand de n- nou- nourriture et de b- b- boissons!
The Cursed One#315.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#316.src: They sell re- r- regional food and drinks. And, a- ac- according to Rex... they've even im- im- imported some fancy alcohol from the h- high- highlands!
The Cursed One#316.dst: Ils vendent des plats et des boissons de la r- r- région. Et, d- da- d'après Rex... ils ont même im- im- importé de l'alcool chic des H- Hau- Hautes-Terres!
The Cursed One#316.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#317.src: Here are some at- attractions, and an animal exhibit! I, uh, d- d- don't- I don't like the Mudkins game very much...
The Cursed One#317.dst: Ici, il y a des at- attractions, et une exposition d'animaux! Moi, euh, j- j- j'aime p- j'aime pas trop le jeu des Mudkins...
The Cursed One#317.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#318.src: I th- think I saw Sui back there, so... I'm gonna go h- ha- hang out with her. You sh- should check out some of the stalls!
The Cursed One#318.dst: Je c- crois que j'ai vu Sui là-bas, alors... je vais aller p- pa- passer un moment avec elle. Tu d- devrais aller voir les stands!
The Cursed One#318.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#320.src: ...thank you, Jiro. It's always good to hear from-
The Cursed One#320.dst: ...merci, Jiro. C'est toujours bon d'avoir des nouvelles de-
The Cursed One#320.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#322.src: Hm? Oh, that's just {u}- they're who I was hoping to write to Quill about. {u}, this is Jiro, my contact from the Roughworks.
The Cursed One#322.dst: Hm? Oh, c'est juste {u}- c'est justement à son sujet que je voulais écrire à Quill. {u}, voici Jiro, mon contact à Roughworks.
The Cursed One#322.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#323.src: Ah. Well, it's good to meet you then.
The Cursed One#323.speaker: Jiro

The Cursed One#324.src: Quill is... an old friend. It can be hard for us to stay in contact... discretely... so we often send messages this way.
The Cursed One#324.dst: Quill est... un vieil ami. Difficile pour nous de rester en contact... discrètement... alors on passe souvent par là pour nos messages.
The Cursed One#324.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#325.src: Wasn't going to use my yearly rail pass for anything anyway, so might as well.
The Cursed One#325.dst: J'allais pas utiliser mon pass ferroviaire annuel pour autre chose, de toute façon, alors autant.
The Cursed One#325.speaker: Jiro

The Cursed One#326.src: Well, it's more than I'm able to do, so I appreciate it. In any case, Quill runs his own... organization, shall we say.
The Cursed One#326.dst: Eh bien, c'est plus que je ne peux en faire, alors je te remercie. En tout cas, Quill dirige sa propre... organisation, disons.
The Cursed One#326.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#328.src: The Roughworks is the region directly to the south of here, just past the wall. Officially, it's known as the {p}.
The Cursed One#328.dst: Roughworks, c'est la région juste au sud d'ici, passé le mur. Officiellement, on l'appelle {p}.
The Cursed One#328.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#329.src: I can fill you in on it later. This isn't the place for it.
The Cursed One#329.dst: Je t'expliquerai plus tard. Ce n'est pas l'endroit.
The Cursed One#329.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#330.src: ...ahem. Should we get back to it then?
The Cursed One#330.speaker: Jiro

The Cursed One#331.src: We should. {u}, take a look around the stalls and come back later.
The Cursed One#331.dst: Oui. {u}, fais un tour des stands et reviens plus tard.
The Cursed One#331.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#332.src: {u}, take a look around the stalls and come back later.
The Cursed One#332.dst: {u}, fais un tour des stands et reviens plus tard.
The Cursed One#332.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#334.src: You're here visiting too I see!
The Cursed One#334.dst: Je vois que toi aussi, tu es là en visite!
The Cursed One#334.speaker: Highlands Tourist

The Cursed One#335.src: I plan on touring the whole festival this year around. Next up for me is the {p}!
The Cursed One#335.dst: Cette année, je compte faire toute la tournée du festival. Ma prochaine étape: {p}!
The Cursed One#335.speaker: Highlands Tourist

The Cursed One#336.src: But the Auburn festival is known for the best food and beverages around the province. Trust me! Those rumours are true.
The Cursed One#336.dst: Mais le festival d'Auburn est réputé pour avoir les meilleurs plats et boissons de la province. Crois-moi! Les rumeurs sont vraies.
The Cursed One#336.speaker: Highlands Tourist

The Cursed One#337.src: Will that be enough boar meat, ma'am?
The Cursed One#337.dst: Ça suffira, comme viande de sanglier, madame?
The Cursed One#337.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#338.src: Yes, dear. Thank you for always being so kind-hearted, helping us out each and every year.
The Cursed One#338.dst: Oui, ma chérie. Merci d'être toujours si gentille et de nous aider chaque année.
The Cursed One#338.speaker: Food Merchant

The Cursed One#339.src: No worries, Oya! Hope you sell-... oh. It's you.
The Cursed One#339.dst: De rien, Oya! J'espère que vous vendrez-... oh. C'est toi.
The Cursed One#339.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#342.src: Huh? I'm just here with a delivery. Nothing much.
The Cursed One#342.dst: Hein? Je fais juste une livraison. Rien de spécial.
The Cursed One#342.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#344.src: Just cause you've got everyone else wrapped around your finger, doesn't mean I have to be fine with you!
The Cursed One#344.dst: C'est pas parce que tu mènes tous les autres par le bout du nez que je dois t'accepter!
The Cursed One#344.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#345.src: Everything was fine until you showed up. I- I- I'd gotten over it! I made a home here, and now- and now, you-
The Cursed One#345.dst: Tout allait bien avant que tu débarques. Je- je- j'avais tourné la page! Je m'étais fait une place ici, et maintenant- et maintenant, toi-
The Cursed One#345.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#346.src: And- and sure, I'm happy for Zeph, but your- your- your everything, it's got Syndra plotting, and- and we were safe, and you've ruined that.
The Cursed One#346.dst: Et- et d'accord, je suis contente pour Zeph, mais ton- ton- tout ton truc, ça pousse Syndra à comploter, et- et on était en sécurité, et tu as tout gâché.
The Cursed One#346.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#347.src: So... so, no, I don't have to be okay with you. I don't trust you, I don't trust where you're from, and I definitely don't trust your... your c-
The Cursed One#347.dst: Alors... alors non, j'ai pas à t'accepter. J'ai pas confiance en toi, ni en ton pays, et j'ai encore moins confiance en ta... ta mal-
The Cursed One#347.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#350.src: Have you seen an- any- anyone else yet?
The Cursed One#350.dst: Tu as vu q- quel- quelqu'un d'autre?
The Cursed One#350.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#351.src: I was, um, looking for Mora... earlier. I, ah, didn't find him.
The Cursed One#351.dst: Je cherchais, euh, Mora... tout à l'heure. Je, ah, je l'ai pas trouvé.
The Cursed One#351.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#352.src: We, uh, s- saw Rex run past just a bit ago. Did s- so- something happen?
The Cursed One#352.dst: On a, euh, v- vu Rex passer en courant tout à l'heure. Il s'est p- pa- passé quelque chose?
The Cursed One#352.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#353.src: I can... um, take a guess.
The Cursed One#353.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#354.src: An- anyway, how are you liking the f- fes- festival?
The Cursed One#354.dst: B- bref, il te plaît, le f- fes- festival?
The Cursed One#354.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#355.src: Hey, th- that's good to hear!
The Cursed One#355.dst: Hé, c- ça fait plaisir à entendre!
The Cursed One#355.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#356.src: Have you, um, had the chance to, to taste any of the food? From the... food stall?
The Cursed One#356.dst: Tu as, euh, eu l'occasion de, de goûter la nourriture? Du... du stand de nourriture?
The Cursed One#356.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#357.src: Hahaha, as if th- th- there's any left after y- you- you ate so much!
The Cursed One#357.dst: Hahaha, comme s'il en r- r- restait après tout ce que t- tu- tu as mangé!
The Cursed One#357.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#358.src: Okay... well, I, I was hungry! That's... not my fault.
The Cursed One#358.dst: Bon... eh bien, j'avais, j'avais faim! C'est... pas ma faute.
The Cursed One#358.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#359.src: Oh... finally, someone else who, um, who gets it.
The Cursed One#359.dst: Oh... enfin, quelqu'un d'autre qui, euh, qui comprend.
The Cursed One#359.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#360.src: Wh- wh- what?! Sui, you don't like the f- fes- festival?
The Cursed One#360.dst: Qu- q- quoi?! Sui, tu n'aimes pas le f- fes- festival?
The Cursed One#360.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#361.src: I- I didn't, say that. It's just... a little boring. There's, um, not much to do.
The Cursed One#361.dst: J- j'ai pas, dit ça. C'est juste... un peu ennuyeux. Il y a, euh, pas grand-chose à faire.
The Cursed One#361.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#362.src: There's good f- food, fun rides a- and- and games... okay, m- maybe except the Mudkin g- game...
The Cursed One#362.dst: Il y a de la bonne n- nourriture, des manèges e- et- et des jeux... bon, p- peut-être pas le j- jeu des Mudkins...
The Cursed One#362.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#363.src: Why don't you, um, like the Mudkins? I... I think they're fun.
The Cursed One#363.dst: Pourquoi tu, euh, aimes pas les Mudkins? Moi... moi je les trouve amusants.
The Cursed One#363.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#364.src: They're s- s- so- there's no strategy! You j- just pick a random one, and- a- and sometimes you win!
The Cursed One#364.dst: Ils sont t- t- tell- il y a aucune stratégie! Tu en choisis j- juste un au hasard, et- e- et parfois tu gagnes!
The Cursed One#364.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#366.src: Unbelievable. {u}, a- a- are you hearing this?
The Cursed One#366.dst: Incroyable. {u}, t- t- tu entends ça?
The Cursed One#366.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#367.src: Okay, wh- whatever... Sui, let's go t- try out the zipline. I wonder if th- th- they changed it this year.
The Cursed One#367.dst: Bon, p- peu importe... Sui, allons e- essayer la tyrolienne. Je me demande s'ils l'ont c- c- changée cette année.
The Cursed One#367.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#368.src: ...could we, um, get food first? I'm hungry.
The Cursed One#368.dst: ...on pourrait, euh, manger d'abord? J'ai faim.
The Cursed One#368.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#369.src: A- ag- again?! No, we should do the z- z- zipline first. I don't want you th- thr- throwing up all over me.
The Cursed One#369.dst: En- en- encore?! Non, on fait la t- t- tyrolienne d'abord. Je veux pas que tu me v- vo- vomisses dessus.
The Cursed One#369.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#371.src: You kn- know I'm right! Oh, uh, {u}, you can j- j- join us if you want! It's fun, I pr- promise.
The Cursed One#371.dst: Tu s- sais que j'ai raison! Oh, euh, {u}, tu p- p- peux venir si tu veux! C'est amusant, je te le pr- promets.
The Cursed One#371.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#373.src: The {p} orchestra is definitely the best in all of Fruma! Well, not that I've heard any other orchestras.
The Cursed One#373.dst: L'orchestre de {p} est sans doute le meilleur de tout Fruma! Enfin, pas que j'en aie entendu d'autres.
The Cursed One#373.speaker: Festival Goer

The Cursed One#374.src: Aha! Hello there, {u}! Enjoying our festival, are you?
The Cursed One#374.dst: Aha! Bonjour, {u}! Tu profites de notre festival?
The Cursed One#374.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#375.src: I trust you and Zeph have acquired all the necessary materials in the time since we last spoke?
The Cursed One#375.dst: J'imagine que Zeph et toi avez réuni tous les matériaux nécessaires depuis notre dernière conversation?
The Cursed One#375.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#376.src: As soon as the festival concludes, I shall get right to smithing. I have a good feeling about this one!
The Cursed One#376.dst: Dès que le festival sera fini, je me mettrai à forger. J'ai un bon pressentiment pour celle-ci!
The Cursed One#376.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#377.src: I, ah... am still learning. But I have greatly improved since I started, worry not!
The Cursed One#377.dst: Je, ah... suis encore en apprentissage. Mais j'ai beaucoup progressé, sois sans crainte!
The Cursed One#377.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#378.src: ...ehm. I suppose I should return to my report...
The Cursed One#378.dst: ...hem. Je suppose que je devrais retourner à mon rapport...
The Cursed One#378.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#379.src: Hm? Ah, yes, I forget this is your first year. First week, even.
The Cursed One#379.dst: Hm? Ah, oui, j'oublie que c'est ta première année. Ta première semaine, même.
The Cursed One#379.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#380.src: I am... gathering data. Recording the changes since last year's festival- guard positioning and numbers, types of stands, amount of attendees- and so on.
The Cursed One#380.dst: Je... recueille des données. Je note les changements depuis le festival de l'an dernier- position et nombre des gardes, types de stands, nombre de visiteurs- et ainsi de suite.
The Cursed One#380.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#381.src: It is... perhaps unnecessarily thorough. Much of this data has not proven to be useful thus far... but it is something for me to do, and I do it well.
The Cursed One#381.dst: C'est... peut-être d'une minutie superflue. Une bonne partie de ces données ne s'est pas révélée utile jusqu'ici... mais c'est une tâche pour moi, et je la fais bien.
The Cursed One#381.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#382.src: These festivals... I suppose our discomfort is something Syndra and I share. It can be hard for us to enjoy ourselves, knowing what we do.
The Cursed One#382.dst: Ces festivals... je suppose que Syndra et moi partageons ce malaise. Difficile pour nous de nous amuser, sachant ce que nous savons.
The Cursed One#382.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#383.src: I am grateful that the younger Leaves can still find joy here. Perhaps you might as well, given your... relative lack of history.
The Cursed One#383.dst: Je suis reconnaissant que les jeunes Feuilles trouvent encore de la joie ici. Peut-être le pourras-tu aussi, vu ton... relatif manque de passé.
The Cursed One#383.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#384.src: Ah, but I am rambling. If you will excuse me, I need to get back to... counting all the new food items... hm.
The Cursed One#384.dst: Ah, mais je divague. Si tu veux bien m'excuser, je dois retourner... compter tous les nouveaux plats... hm.
The Cursed One#384.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#385.src: Welcome. Can I interest you in buying anything?
The Cursed One#385.dst: Bienvenue. Puis-je vous proposer quelque chose?
The Cursed One#385.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#386.src: Perhaps would you like to hear what we have to offer?
The Cursed One#386.dst: Peut-être aimeriez-vous entendre ce que nous proposons?
The Cursed One#386.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#388.src: We are selling both the raw ingredients and some freshly brewed tea.
The Cursed One#388.dst: Nous vendons les ingrédients bruts ainsi que du thé fraîchement infusé.
The Cursed One#388.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#389.src: Let me bring you on a history lesson to learn about the finest ingredients the forest has to offer.
The Cursed One#389.dst: Laissez-moi vous offrir une petite leçon d'histoire sur les meilleurs ingrédients que la forêt a à offrir.
The Cursed One#389.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#390.src: Tea is very popular in Auburn and the people have managed to make tea out of almost any plant you can find! Some are... more tasty than others.
The Cursed One#390.dst: Le thé est très populaire à Auburn, et les gens ont réussi à en faire avec presque toutes les plantes qu'on peut trouver! Certains sont... plus savoureux que d'autres.
The Cursed One#390.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#391.src: The Reishi Mushroom for example! Brewing tea of the mushroom alone often turns... bitter. With the help of herbs and spices it goes from bitter to a rich spicy flavour!
The Cursed One#391.dst: Le champignon Reishi, par exemple! Infusé seul, le thé devient souvent... amer. Avec des herbes et des épices, l'amertume laisse place à une saveur riche et épicée!
The Cursed One#391.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#392.src: The mushroom itself is said to help keep you healthy. It is also said to boost your resistances!
The Cursed One#392.dst: On dit que ce champignon aide à rester en bonne santé. On dit aussi qu'il renforce vos résistances!
The Cursed One#392.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#393.src: The Tea Tree Mushroom on the other hand is perfect for a good tea blend. The mushroom alone gives it a sweet and earthy flavour.
The Cursed One#393.dst: Le champignon d'arbre à thé, lui, est parfait pour un bon mélange. A lui seul, il donne une saveur douce et terreuse.
The Cursed One#393.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#394.src: This mushroom is also said to regenerate you back to health and alleviate the feeling of tiredness! How amazing.
The Cursed One#394.dst: On dit aussi que ce champignon vous rend la santé et soulage la fatigue! Quelle merveille.
The Cursed One#394.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#395.src: If you feel like buying something, please talk to my assistant.
The Cursed One#395.dst: Si vous souhaitez acheter quelque chose, adressez-vous à mon assistant, je vous prie.
The Cursed One#395.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#398.src: It's festival time! *hic* that means... drinking time!!!
The Cursed One#398.dst: C'est l'heure du festival! *hic* et ça veut dire... l'heure de boire!!!
The Cursed One#398.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#399.src: Inteeeerested in any of our mouth-watering beverages?
The Cursed One#399.dst: Intéééressé par l'une de nos boissons à tomber par terre?
The Cursed One#399.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#400.src: *Hic* Todaaaay, we have a couple of imported drinks as well as our classic Autumn Amaretto.
The Cursed One#400.dst: *Hic* Aujourd'huiii, on a quelques boissons importées et notre classique Autumn Amaretto.
The Cursed One#400.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#401.src: Seen them blue fruits in the trees around here? Most of 'em are inedible Liffberries, buuut, some of 'em are actually a more edible fruit called Autumn Fruit, which carry a high value!
The Cursed One#401.dst: T'as vu ces fruits bleus dans les arbres du coin? La plupart, c'est des Liffberries immangeables, maiiis certains sont en fait un fruit plus comestible appelé Autumn Fruit, et ça vaut cher!
The Cursed One#401.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#402.dst: C'est passsionnant, de faire de l'alcool *hic*!
The Cursed One#402.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#403.src: We have also imported the faaaamed Heather Beer from the rich highlands.
The Cursed One#403.dst: On a aussi importé la fameuuuse Heather Beer des riches Hautes-Terres.
The Cursed One#403.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#404.src: We also have an imported the faaaamed Heather Beer from the rich highlands.
The Cursed One#404.dst: On a aussi une importée, la fameuuuse Heather Beer des riches Hautes-Terres.
The Cursed One#404.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#405.src: A beer infused with the most beautiful heather grown across the highlands. *hic* You can almost taste the richness of the aristocrats.
The Cursed One#405.dst: Une bière infusée à la plus belle bruyère des Hautes-Terres. *hic* On sent presque le goût de la richesse des aristocrates.
The Cursed One#405.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#406.src: *hic* If I were you, I would deeefinitely try this drink. Stuff like this doesn't come to Auburn often.
The Cursed One#406.dst: *hic* A ta place, je goûterais caaarrément cette boisson. Des trucs comme ça, ça arrive pas souvent à Auburn.
The Cursed One#406.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#407.src: If you feel like blessing your taste buds, talk to my brother over there. *hic*
The Cursed One#407.dst: Si tu veux gâter tes papilles, va voir mon frère, là-bas. *hic*
The Cursed One#407.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#409.dst: Bonjour, mon petit. Un petit creux?
The Cursed One#409.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#410.src: We have freshly cooked and baked regional goods.
The Cursed One#410.dst: Des plats régionaux tout juste cuisinés et sortis du four.
The Cursed One#410.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#411.src: Would you like to hear about our menu, dear?
The Cursed One#411.dst: Tu veux que je te présente notre menu, mon petit?
The Cursed One#411.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#412.src: Just perfect! Auburn is famous for their bold, earthy and cosy flavours!
The Cursed One#412.dst: Parfait! Auburn est réputée pour ses saveurs franches, terreuses et réconfortantes!
The Cursed One#412.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#413.src: We also love to cook using our wild animals and resources, but I'm sure you already know all of this, haha.
The Cursed One#413.dst: On adore aussi cuisiner nos animaux sauvages et nos ressources, mais tu sais sûrement déjà tout ça, haha.
The Cursed One#413.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#414.src: Let me go over some of our special dishes for today, dear.
The Cursed One#414.dst: Laisse-moi te présenter quelques plats du jour, mon petit.
The Cursed One#414.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#415.src: The most important dish in Auburn, is of course the "Gift of the Forest". A wonderful meat and fruit mixture inside a steamed leaf wrap.
The Cursed One#415.dst: Le plat le plus important d'Auburn, c'est bien sûr le "Présent de la forêt". Un merveilleux mélange de viande et de fruits dans une feuille cuite à la vapeur.
The Cursed One#415.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#416.src: We have hand wrapped all of our gifts this morning and they are steamed to go!
The Cursed One#416.dst: On a emballé tous nos présents à la main ce matin, et ils sont cuits à la vapeur, prêts à emporter!
The Cursed One#416.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#417.src: If that doesn't interest you, we also have the classic "Forest Feast". A grilled piece of boar meat with a mud-kin salad.
The Cursed One#417.dst: Si ça ne te tente pas, on a aussi le classique "Festin de la forêt". Un morceau de sanglier grillé avec une salade de Mudkins.
The Cursed One#417.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#418.src: I'm afraid we have run out of ingredients at the moment. Please come back later!
The Cursed One#418.dst: J'ai bien peur qu'on n'ait plus d'ingrédients pour le moment. Reviens plus tard!
The Cursed One#418.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#420.src: Hey! You look like a tourist to me!
The Cursed One#420.dst: Hé! T'as tout l'air d'un touriste!
The Cursed One#420.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#421.src: I'm glad you decided to check out my little exhibition here.
The Cursed One#421.dst: Ravi que tu passes voir ma petite exposition.
The Cursed One#421.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#422.src: Is it your first time in this part of the region? Would you perhaps want to hear some fun facts about our animals?
The Cursed One#422.dst: C'est la première fois que tu viens dans ce coin de la région? Ça te dirait d'entendre quelques anecdotes sur nos animaux?
The Cursed One#422.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#424.src: First we have our Roly-bugs here! These little buggers are a pest to the people here.
The Cursed One#424.dst: D'abord, voici nos roly-bestioles! Ces petites bêtes sont un fléau pour les gens d'ici.
The Cursed One#424.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#425.src: They love gnawing on our houses. Luckily, we built most of our structures on stilts aaaand those bugs can't climb.
The Cursed One#425.dst: Elles adorent ronger nos maisons. Heureusement, on a construit presque tout sur pilotis eeeet ces bestioles ne savent pas grimper.
The Cursed One#425.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#426.src: Now! Frogs! The north-western bog is the best place for frog-watching. Just be careful of the bog monster.
The Cursed One#426.dst: Et maintenant! Les grenouilles! Le marais du nord-ouest est idéal pour les observer. Gare au monstre du marais.
The Cursed One#426.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#427.src: Frogs might be a good source of food but we like to see them more as... pets!
The Cursed One#427.dst: Les grenouilles se mangent, mais on préfère les voir comme... des animaux de compagnie!
The Cursed One#427.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#428.src: Lastly, we have foxes! These little cuties are very shy in nature. But beware, there are bigger versions of them, known as Foxhounds.
The Cursed One#428.dst: Enfin, les renards! Ces petits mignons sont très timides de nature. Mais attention, il en existe des versions plus grandes, les Foxhounds.
The Cursed One#428.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#429.src: Those are not as shy... or peaceful, as their smaller cousins. They are just as cute though!
The Cursed One#429.dst: Ceux-là sont moins timides... et moins paisibles que leurs petits cousins. Mais tout aussi mignons!
The Cursed One#429.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#430.src: Please have a looksie around! You can also pet them.
The Cursed One#430.dst: Jette donc un petit coup d'oeil! Tu peux aussi les caresser.
The Cursed One#430.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#432.src: Howdy and welcome to a mudkin farm!
The Cursed One#432.dst: B'jour et bienvenue dans une ferme à Mudkins!
The Cursed One#432.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#433.src: Mudkins are popular vegetables in food around here. They grow underground and you have to yoikn em' out!
The Cursed One#433.dst: Les Mudkins, c'est un légume ben populaire par ici. Ça pousse sous terre, et faut les arracher d'un coup sec!
The Cursed One#433.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#434.src: Are ya interested in a game of Mudkin Picking?
The Cursed One#434.dst: Ça te dirait, une partie de Cueillette de Mudkins?
The Cursed One#434.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#435.src: Basically, ye goal is to get as many points as possible before the time runs out.
The Cursed One#435.dst: En gros, ton but, c'est de marquer le plus de points possible avant la fin du temps.
The Cursed One#435.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#436.src: There are three sizes of Mudkins, each size gives a set of points. However! There are two ginger roots that give negative points.
The Cursed One#436.dst: Y a trois tailles de Mudkins, chaque taille rapporte des points. Mais attention! Y a deux racines de gingembre qui font perdre des points.
The Cursed One#436.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#437.src: Simply click on the dirt particles appearing in the field. There are five spots for ya to pick.
The Cursed One#437.dst: T'as qu'à cliquer sur les particules de terre qui apparaissent dans le champ. Y a cinq endroits où cueillir.
The Cursed One#437.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#440.src: Return to Syndra at or keep exploring the festival.
The Cursed One#440.dst: Retournez voir Syndra ou continuez à explorer le festival.

The Cursed One#441.src: Ah. There you are. Have you been enjoying yourself?
The Cursed One#441.dst: Ah. Te voilà. Tu t'es bien amusé?
The Cursed One#441.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#443.src: I hope your experience with the crown has not ruined your perception of our province... there are still many things to celebrate.
The Cursed One#443.dst: J'espère que ton expérience avec la Couronne n'a pas gâché ta vision de notre province... il y a encore bien des choses à célébrer.
The Cursed One#443.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#444.src: Sometimes, it can be nice to set aside your woes, and... take things as they are. Breathe, a little.
The Cursed One#444.dst: Parfois, ça fait du bien de mettre ses soucis de côté et de... prendre les choses comme elles viennent. Respirer un peu.
The Cursed One#444.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#445.dst: C'est mieux que rien, je suppose.
The Cursed One#445.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#446.src: It's hard to enjoy yourself with your experiences with the crown weighing you down, isn't it? I know the feeling.
The Cursed One#446.dst: Difficile de s'amuser quand ce qu'on a vécu avec la Couronne pèse sur nous, n'est-ce pas? Je connais ce sentiment.
The Cursed One#446.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#447.src: Mmn. I'd suggest to take what you can get. Happy moments like this can be fleeting, in my experience.
The Cursed One#447.dst: Mmn. Je te conseille de profiter de ce qui se présente. Ces moments de bonheur sont souvent fugaces, d'expérience.
The Cursed One#447.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#448.src: If there's even the smallest spark of joy... take hold of it before it's gone. Cherish it while you still can. Try not to grow old and jaded like I have, would you?
The Cursed One#448.dst: S'il y a ne serait-ce que la plus petite étincelle de joie... saisis-la avant qu'elle ne s'éteigne. Chéris-la tant que tu le peux. Essaie de ne pas devenir vieux et blasé comme moi, d'accord?
The Cursed One#448.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#449.src: Ha! It's alright. Neither have I.
The Cursed One#449.dst: Ha! Ce n'est rien. Moi non plus.
The Cursed One#449.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#450.src: Every year... every single year, the crown hosts these festivals. Starting here, and moving around in a ring around the province.
The Cursed One#450.dst: Chaque année... chaque année sans exception, la Couronne organise ces festivals. Ils commencent ici, puis font le tour de la province.
The Cursed One#450.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#451.src: The festival's a holiday, a day of rest, of celebration. What a gift it is, not needing to work for a time! How generous.
The Cursed One#451.dst: Le festival est un jour férié, un jour de repos, de fête. Quel cadeau, de ne pas avoir à travailler un moment! Quelle générosité.
The Cursed One#451.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#452.src: I can't stand it here... Every year, I convince myself I can bear it. The reminder it brings, of memories long passed. Every year, I'm proven wrong.
The Cursed One#452.dst: Je ne supporte pas d'être ici... Chaque année, je me persuade que je pourrai le supporter. Ce qu'il me rappelle, des souvenirs lointains. Et chaque année, j'ai tort.
The Cursed One#452.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#453.src: ...Ah. It's time. The main event is about to begin.
The Cursed One#453.dst: ...Ah. C'est l'heure. L'événement principal va commencer.
The Cursed One#453.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#455.src: Why, Her Majesty's annual speech, of course! It wouldn't be a Festival of the Crown if she didn't make an appearance, would it?
The Cursed One#455.dst: Eh bien, le discours annuel de Sa Majesté, bien sûr! Ce ne serait pas un Festival de la Couronne sans son apparition, n'est-ce pas?
The Cursed One#455.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#456.src: Ha! No, no. Of course not. It wouldn't be a Festival of the Crown without a speech from Her Majesty herself, would it?
The Cursed One#456.dst: Ha! Non, non. Bien sûr que non. Ce ne serait pas un Festival de la Couronne sans un discours de Sa Majesté en personne, n'est-ce pas?
The Cursed One#456.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#457.src: Now... observe. Behold our enemy, take note of how she presents herself, what she says, what she doesn't say.
The Cursed One#457.dst: Maintenant... observe. Regarde notre ennemie, note comment elle se présente, ce qu'elle dit, ce qu'elle tait.
The Cursed One#457.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#458.src: Ah... beloved people of the {p}! What a joy, what an honor it is to stand amongst you once again.
The Cursed One#458.dst: Ah... peuple bien-aimé de {p}! Quelle joie, quel honneur de me tenir de nouveau parmi vous.
The Cursed One#458.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#459.src: Some will claim the stunning {p} to be our most beautiful region, with its vibrant blossoming trees and grand historic castles...
The Cursed One#459.dst: Certains diront que {p}, splendide avec ses arbres en fleurs éclatants et ses grands châteaux historiques, est notre plus belle région...
The Cursed One#459.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#460.src: But I've always held a special regard for this place. The leaves and their warm shades, blowing in the soft breeze... all the woes of the world would be worth this sight.
The Cursed One#460.dst: Mais j'ai toujours eu une affection particulière pour ce lieu. Les feuilles aux teintes chaudes, portées par la douce brise... tous les maux du monde vaudraient ce spectacle.
The Cursed One#460.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#461.src: If I were able, perhaps I could stay here year-round! Ah, but alas... work in the Citadel keeps us all occupied!
The Cursed One#461.dst: Si je le pouvais, je resterais peut-être ici toute l'année! Ah, mais hélas... le travail à la Citadelle nous occupe tous!
The Cursed One#461.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#462.src: We have many plans for the coming year. Increased imports from the other regions, easier access to travel for all, and additional openings in military positions!
The Cursed One#462.dst: Nous avons de nombreux projets pour l'année à venir. Plus d'importations des autres régions, des voyages plus accessibles à tous, et de nouveaux postes dans l'armée!
The Cursed One#462.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#463.src: More will be revealed soon. Now, some words from your beloved Sovereign.
The Cursed One#463.dst: Vous en saurez plus bientôt. Et maintenant, quelques mots de votre Souverain bien-aimé.
The Cursed One#463.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#464.src: ...ah. The one thing I miscalculated. The mic height. Oh well- Testing, testing, one two three...
The Cursed One#464.dst: ...ah. La seule chose que j'ai mal calculée. La hauteur du micro. Tant pis- Un, deux, trois, test...
The Cursed One#464.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#465.src: Welcome one and all! I'm your Sovereign, Zhiraok. It's an honor to be here before you all again today.
The Cursed One#465.dst: Bienvenue à tous! Je suis votre Souverain, Zhiraok. C'est un honneur d'être de nouveau devant vous aujourd'hui.
The Cursed One#465.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#466.src: Two decades of work in the {p}. Twenty years. It feels like I've been here for so much longer- this place, these people, really have become my home.
The Cursed One#466.dst: Deux décennies de travail à {p}. Vingt ans. J'ai l'impression d'être ici depuis bien plus longtemps- cet endroit, ces gens, sont vraiment devenus mon foyer.
The Cursed One#466.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#467.src: My duty is not just to serve the Crown, but also to serve you. To make your lives better, to raise this region we live in to new heights.
The Cursed One#467.dst: Mon devoir n'est pas seulement de servir la Couronne, mais aussi de vous servir. De rendre vos vies meilleures, de hisser notre région vers de nouveaux sommets.
The Cursed One#467.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#468.src: Whether that's by increasing production of Liff Leaves to share our resources and knowledge the province over, which we owe to your hard work...
The Cursed One#468.dst: Que ce soit en augmentant la production de feuilles de Liff pour partager nos ressources et nos savoirs dans toute la province, ce que nous devons à votre dur labeur...
The Cursed One#468.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#469.src: ...or through sharpening our infrastructure to exponentiate your quality of life, in thanks for what you do!
The Cursed One#469.dst: ...ou en affûtant nos infrastructures pour élever votre qualité de vie à la puissance supérieure, pour vous remercier!
The Cursed One#469.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#470.src: I'd be here all day listing all the improvements over the last year, but I'll summarize- Multiple major road improvements, countless new job opportunities, multiplying guard patrols to keep you safe...
The Cursed One#470.dst: Je pourrais passer la journée à énumérer les progrès de l'année, mais je résume- de grands travaux sur plusieurs routes, d'innombrables nouveaux emplois, des patrouilles de gardes multipliées pour votre sécurité...
The Cursed One#470.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#471.src: The place we came from twenty years ago is unrecognizable now. My vow is that twenty years ahead, I can say the same thing for how much more we, together, improve our home.
The Cursed One#471.dst: L'endroit d'où nous sommes partis il y a vingt ans est méconnaissable aujourd'hui. Je fais le voeu de pouvoir dire la même chose dans vingt ans, tant nous aurons, ensemble, amélioré notre foyer.
The Cursed One#471.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#472.src: 'til the day we sum up to the grandeur of {p}- Thank you all! Enjoy the festivities!
The Cursed One#472.dst: Jusqu'au jour où notre somme égalera la grandeur de {p}- Merci à tous! Profitez des festivités!
The Cursed One#472.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#473.src: What fine work Sovereign Zhiraok has done for our province! Truly, there could have been no better choice to fill that role!
The Cursed One#473.dst: Quel beau travail le Souverain Zhiraok a accompli pour notre province! Vraiment, il n'y avait pas de meilleur choix pour ce rôle!
The Cursed One#473.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#474.src: The {p} flourishes under his governance, and I could not be more pleased by the progress he has made.
The Cursed One#474.dst: {p} s'épanouit sous sa gouvernance, et je ne pourrais être plus satisfaite des progrès qu'il a accomplis.
The Cursed One#474.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#475.src: One final message before we conclude. These past years, we have seen fewer and fewer reports of the cursed - a sign of our strength as a people.
The Cursed One#475.dst: Un dernier message avant de conclure. Ces dernières années, nous avons reçu de moins en moins de signalements de maudits - un signe de notre force en tant que peuple.
The Cursed One#475.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#476.src: And it is all thanks to you! Your diligent reporting of suspicious activity makes all the difference in keeping our province safe.
The Cursed One#476.dst: Et c'est grâce à vous! Vos signalements assidus d'activités suspectes font toute la différence pour la sécurité de notre province.
The Cursed One#476.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#477.src: We must stand strong, together! We will not allow this evil its victory, we will not let our province fall like so many others have beyond our walls!
The Cursed One#477.dst: Nous devons rester forts, ensemble! Nous ne laisserons pas ce mal triompher, nous ne laisserons pas notre province tomber comme tant d'autres au-delà de nos murs!
The Cursed One#477.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#478.src: With that, let the celebrations begin!
The Cursed One#478.dst: Sur ce, que les festivités commencent!
The Cursed One#478.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#480.src: Did anything stand out to you?
The Cursed One#480.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#481.src: Indeed, it is. It's quite puzzling, isn't it? It's a sort of reverence she never displays elsewhere.
The Cursed One#481.dst: En effet. C'est assez déroutant, n'est-ce pas? Une sorte de révérence qu'elle ne montre nulle part ailleurs.
The Cursed One#481.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#482.src: And if there is one thing I'm certain she's being truthful about, it's this. Which only makes it all the stranger.
The Cursed One#482.dst: Et s'il y a une chose sur laquelle je suis certaine qu'elle dit vrai, c'est celle-là. Ce qui la rend d'autant plus étrange.
The Cursed One#482.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#483.src: Yes, yes... improvements. Life has improved since he ascended to that position. I'll give him that. He's invested in Auburn.
The Cursed One#483.dst: Oui, oui... les progrès. La vie s'est améliorée depuis qu'il occupe ce poste. Je le lui accorde. Il s'investit pour Auburn.
The Cursed One#483.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#484.src: But he is still working under the crown. Don't forget that. For every improvement he has made, there's another he has left ignored.
The Cursed One#484.dst: Mais il travaille toujours pour la Couronne. Ne l'oublie pas. Pour chaque amélioration qu'il a apportée, il y en a une autre qu'il a ignorée.
The Cursed One#484.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#485.dst: Ils n'ont pas parlé de Torann.

The Cursed One#486.src: No, I suppose they wouldn't. Better to leave the public unaware of such failures.
The Cursed One#486.dst: Non, j'imagine qu'ils s'en garderaient. Mieux vaut que le peuple ignore de tels échecs.
The Cursed One#486.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#487.src: But rest assured that internally, they have not forgotten. They will keep searching for you.
The Cursed One#487.dst: Mais sois certain qu'en interne, ils n'ont pas oublié. Ils continueront à te chercher.
The Cursed One#487.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#488.src: Yes... the cursed. The crown needs to keep the people afraid. If there's another enemy out there that the crown supposedly protects them from...
The Cursed One#488.dst: Oui... les maudits. La Couronne a besoin d'entretenir la peur du peuple. S'il existe un autre ennemi dont la Couronne est censée le protéger...
The Cursed One#488.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#489.src: There's a reason they want people to believe the outside world is destroyed. Any contact could break the illusion.
The Cursed One#489.dst: Ce n'est pas pour rien qu'ils veulent faire croire que le monde extérieur est détruit. Le moindre contact pourrait briser l'illusion.
The Cursed One#489.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#490.src: They'll be closing out the festival soon... so, our work here is done. We should be leaving before the crowd thins enough for us to be spotted.
The Cursed One#490.dst: Ils vont bientôt clore le festival... notre travail ici est donc terminé. Partons avant que la foule ne se disperse assez pour qu'on nous repère.
The Cursed One#490.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#491.src: I've scheduled a meeting for tomorrow- I'd like for you to attend. It'll be about our next steps, now that the crown has moved on. I'll see you there.
The Cursed One#491.dst: J'ai prévu une réunion demain- j'aimerais que tu y assistes. On parlera de la suite, maintenant que la Couronne est repartie. On se voit là-bas.
The Cursed One#491.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#493.src: I think I've had just about enough of people sneaking into my office. Care to knock next time?
The Cursed One#493.dst: Je crois que j'en ai assez des gens qui se faufilent dans mon bureau. Tu pourrais frapper, la prochaine fois?
The Cursed One#493.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#494.src: Mmn. It's more interesting this way. I have news from the capital - your request for additional troops has been granted. Reassignments should come through by the end of the week.
The Cursed One#494.dst: Mmn. C'est plus intéressant ainsi. J'ai des nouvelles de la capitale - ta demande de troupes supplémentaires a été acceptée. Les mutations devraient arriver d'ici la fin de la semaine.

The Cursed One#495.src: Well, that'll solve some problems. But that's not the whole message, is it? What obtuse remark has he got for me this time?
The Cursed One#495.dst: Bon, ça réglera quelques problèmes. Mais ce n'est pas tout le message, hein? Quelle remarque obtuse m'a-t-il réservée cette fois?
The Cursed One#495.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#496.src: Merely a reminder to... ''get your act together,'' as it were.
The Cursed One#496.dst: Un simple rappel de... "te ressaisir", pour ainsi dire.

The Cursed One#497.src: Get my act toge- That floundering fractal's developed less in his quadrant in a hundred-fifty years than I've done in two, in the last ten!
The Cursed One#497.dst: Me ressai- Ce fractal à la dérive a moins développé son quadrant en cent cinquante ans que moi deux, ces dix dernières années!
The Cursed One#497.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#498.src: I- Ugh, focus, Z... He's not even here, don't let him get under your skin...
The Cursed One#498.dst: Je- Argh, concentre-toi, Z... Il n'est même pas là, ne le laisse pas te taper sur les nerfs...
The Cursed One#498.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#499.src: I'll get off that tangent. If that was all you had to say, it'd be a waste of your time. What do you need to say that a courier can't send in a letter?
The Cursed One#499.dst: Je sors de cette tangente. Si c'était tout ce que tu avais à dire, ce serait du temps perdu. Que dois-tu me dire qu'un coursier ne pourrait pas porter dans une lettre?
The Cursed One#499.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#500.src: The intruder. Does your administration believe it can get the situation under control?
The Cursed One#500.dst: L'intrus. Ton administration pense-t-elle pouvoir maîtriser la situation?

The Cursed One#501.src: There it is. Listen, I've got their number, alright? There's no way in or out of the district where they won't be detected. We'll track them down.
The Cursed One#501.dst: Nous y voilà. Écoute, je l'ai déjà mis en équation, d'accord? Impossible d'entrer ou de sortir du district sans être repéré. On le retrouvera.
The Cursed One#501.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#502.src: Though unlike some people, my ego isn't so massive I can't recognize when an ally can be of use. Your types have an expertise here, so if you could spare a set or two of eyes it'd be much appreciated.
The Cursed One#502.dst: Cela dit, contrairement à certains, mon ego n'est pas si énorme que je ne sache voir quand un allié peut servir. Les tiens sont experts, alors si tu pouvais me prêter une paire d'yeux ou deux, je t'en serais reconnaissant.
The Cursed One#502.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#503.src: I'll see what I can do. There happens to be an ongoing operation in the area already, we can discuss redirecting the agent once it's concluded.
The Cursed One#503.dst: Je verrai ce que je peux faire. Il se trouve qu'une opération est déjà en cours dans la zone, nous pourrons parler de réaffecter l'agent une fois qu'elle sera terminée.

The Cursed One#504.src: One last thing- the identity of the intruder has been made clear to you already, yes?
The Cursed One#504.dst: Une dernière chose- l'identité de l'intrus t'a déjà été clairement établie, n'est-ce pas?

The Cursed One#505.src: Mhm. Like I said, I've got their number.
The Cursed One#505.dst: Mhm. Comme je l'ai dit, je l'ai déjà mis en équation.
The Cursed One#505.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#506.src: Then you will understand Her Majesty's order not to speak of this ordeal to our newest. Ascension is a difficult process, and it would be... unwise to add additional distractions to it.
The Cursed One#506.dst: Alors tu comprendras l'ordre de Sa Majesté de ne pas parler de cette affaire à notre nouveau venu. L'ascension est un processus difficile, et il serait... imprudent d'y ajouter des distractions.

The Cursed One#507.src: Wouldn't want to distract a hard worker like him, right. But if that's everything, Spymaster? My to-do list is getting more added by the minute.
The Cursed One#507.dst: On ne voudrait pas distraire un travailleur aussi appliqué, bien sûr. Mais si c'est tout, Maîtresse des espions? Ma liste de tâches s'allonge à chaque minute.
The Cursed One#507.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#511.src: Let's get back to the others
The Cursed One#511.full: Let's get back to the others.

The Cursed One#515.src: Maybe it's time to find Syndra near the stage. But there is still time to check out the festival more too...
The Cursed One#515.dst: Il est peut-être temps de retrouver Syndra près de la scène. Mais il reste aussi le temps de découvrir encore le festival...
The Cursed One#515.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#518.dst: Sa façon de parler d'Auburn. C'est... différent.
The Cursed One#518.full: How she talks about Auburn. It's... different.

The Cursed One#520.src: The Fox seems to be fast asleep...
The Cursed One#520.dst: Le renard a l'air profondément endormi...

The Dark Descent#000.src: Hello there, chap! I must say, I didn't expect to see a part of the old {p} regiment over 'ere.
The Dark Descent#000.dst: Bien le bonjour, mon vieux! Je ne m'attendais pas à croiser quelqu'un du vieux régiment de {p} par ici.
The Dark Descent#000.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#001.src: I... there... too many... th-thousands, at... at least...
The Dark Descent#001.dst: Je... là-bas... trop... d-des milliers, au... au moins...
The Dark Descent#001.speaker: Scout

The Dark Descent#002.dst: Ça... ne sert à rien... on est... condamnés...

The Dark Descent#003.src: Please, stop this! Whoever you are, leave me and my family in peace!
The Dark Descent#003.dst: Je vous en prie, arrêtez! Qui que vous soyez, laissez-moi en paix, moi et ma famille!
