The Dark Descent#004.src: Ah, but if you had only said so sooner! I'm afraid they have already joined me, down below.
The Dark Descent#004.dst: Ah, si seulement tu l'avais dit plus tôt! Je crains qu'ils ne m'aient déjà rejoint, là-dessous.

The Dark Descent#005.src: Y-you... I thought they... oh, gods, no...
The Dark Descent#005.dst: V-vous... je croyais qu'ils... oh, par les dieux, non...
The Dark Descent#005.speaker: Lost Soul

The Dark Descent#006.src: Hush, now. You and your family will make fine additions to my legion.
The Dark Descent#006.dst: Chut, maintenant. Ta famille et toi ferez de belles recrues pour ma légion.

The Dark Descent#007.src: Wha... you mean... N-no, please! I don't want to hurt anyone!
The Dark Descent#007.dst: Quoi... vous voulez dire... N-non, pitié! Je ne veux faire de mal à personne!

The Dark Descent#008.src: How naive. Fear not. You will rise again, and then you will serve my purpose.
The Dark Descent#008.dst: Quelle naïveté. N'aie crainte. Tu te relèveras, et alors tu serviras mes desseins.

The Dark Descent#010.src: How easily this place fell? How quickly I became its master?
The Dark Descent#010.dst: Avec quelle facilité cet endroit est tombé? Comme j'en suis vite devenu le maître?

The Dark Descent#011.src: You can barely keep them at bay on the surface, and yet you think to enter my own domain, to challenge me in the Underworld?
The Dark Descent#011.dst: Vous arrivez à peine à les contenir à la surface, et tu crois pouvoir entrer dans mon domaine, me défier dans les Enfers?

The Dark Descent#012.src: So enter the mouth of my skull, soldier, make your way below the ground. I look forward to our next meeting, keheheh...
The Dark Descent#012.dst: Alors entre dans la gueule de mon crâne, soldat, descends sous terre. J'attends notre prochaine rencontre avec impatience, kéhéhé...

The Dark Descent#013.src: Looks like the only way to go is into the skull...
The Dark Descent#013.dst: On dirait que le seul chemin passe par le crâne...

The Dark Descent#014.src: You were stumbling about like a senile biddy, eyes blank as cream, and you kept muttering something about a Charon.
The Dark Descent#014.dst: Tu titubais comme une vieille gâteuse, les yeux vides comme de la crème, et tu marmonnais un truc sur un certain Charon.
The Dark Descent#014.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#015.src: I'm supposing he was the one who took you for a spin there? Well, you certainly haven't carked it, so I might call this operation a success!
The Dark Descent#015.dst: J'imagine que c'est lui qui t'a mené en balade? Enfin, tu n'as visiblement pas passé l'arme à gauche, alors je dirais que l'opération est un succès!
The Dark Descent#015.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#016.src: When you're ready, I'd be chuffed to have you along in the expedition down into the depths, old bean!
The Dark Descent#016.dst: Quand tu seras prêt, je serais ravi de t'avoir avec nous pour l'expédition dans les profondeurs, mon cher!
The Dark Descent#016.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#017.src: You've earned a lot of respect from the boys this fight, better than all of us I'd say. For this fight, I'll let you direct the army.
The Dark Descent#017.dst: Tu as gagné le respect des gars dans ce combat, plus que nous tous, je dirais. Pour cette bataille, je te laisse diriger l'armée.

The Dark Descent#018.src: I see you've brought aid, you aren't as foolish as I thought.
The Dark Descent#018.dst: Je vois que tu as amené du renfort, tu n'es pas aussi sot que je le pensais.

The Dark Descent#020.src: I am General Graken, leader of the {p} militia. Charmed to meet you!
The Dark Descent#020.dst: Je suis le général Graken, chef de la milice de {p}. Enchanté de faire ta connaissance!
The Dark Descent#020.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#021.src: You've seen all the bloody zombies faffing about everywhere, yes? They're all seeming to come from this massive skull.
The Dark Descent#021.dst: Tu as vu tous ces fichus zombies qui traînent partout, hein? Ils ont l'air de tous sortir de ce crâne gigantesque.
The Dark Descent#021.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#022.src: I'm putting together a crack team for an expedition inside, but we haven't got any bleedin' idea what's down there!
The Dark Descent#022.dst: Je monte une équipe d'élite pour une expédition à l'intérieur, mais on n'a pas la moindre fichue idée de ce qu'il y a en bas!
The Dark Descent#022.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#023.src: If you're up for it, chap, we could absolutely do with some recon 'round the old town, look for clues and the like.
The Dark Descent#023.dst: Si le coeur t'en dit, mon vieux, une petite reconnaissance dans le vieux village nous rendrait bien service, chercher des indices et tout.
The Dark Descent#023.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#024.src: I took a gander earlier, and one of the ol' houses caught my eye - it had a bloomin' great skull right over the door!
The Dark Descent#024.dst: J'ai jeté un oeil tout à l'heure, et une des vieilles maisons m'a tapé dans l'oeil - un sacré gros crâne au-dessus de la porte!
The Dark Descent#024.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#025.src: I didn't have time to look in proper, but I'd start the investigation there, chap.
The Dark Descent#025.dst: Je n'ai pas eu le temps de bien regarder, mais je commencerais l'enquête là-bas, mon vieux.
The Dark Descent#025.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#026.src: It's just south of here. The house still had solid wood boarding in it, despite the age, so look lively, chum!
The Dark Descent#026.dst: C'est juste au sud d'ici. La maison avait encore des planches solides malgré son âge, alors ouvre l'oeil, camarade!
The Dark Descent#026.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#028.src: Oh, sod it, I knew I was forgetting something! Steady there, chum! I'm on my way!
The Dark Descent#028.dst: Oh, sapristi, je savais que j'oubliais quelque chose! Tiens bon, camarade! J'arrive!
The Dark Descent#028.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#029.src: Drat! Too late, it seems. Yes, I forgot to mention the floor was in poor condition. Up here! You took quite the tumble, are you alright?
The Dark Descent#029.dst: Fichtre! Trop tard, on dirait. Oui, j'ai oublié de préciser que le plancher était en mauvais état. Ici, en haut! Quelle chute, tu vas bien?
The Dark Descent#029.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#030.src: Well, there's some good news, I suppose. Still though, seems I sent you a ticket to a bit of a sticky wicket! Do you see a way out anywhere down there?
The Dark Descent#030.dst: Bon, c'est déjà une bonne nouvelle, j'imagine. Mais il semble que je t'aie envoyé tout droit dans un beau pétrin! Tu vois une sortie, en bas?
The Dark Descent#030.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#031.src: There's a tunnel? Aha, spiffing! I suggest you take it immediately. I'll have to return to my post now, post-haste!
The Dark Descent#031.dst: Il y a un tunnel? Aha, épatant! Je te suggère de l'emprunter sur-le-champ. Je dois retourner à mon poste, et au pas de course!
The Dark Descent#031.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#032.src: Good luck, chum! Now, back, you cads! Back I say!
The Dark Descent#032.dst: Bonne chance, camarade! Et maintenant, arrière, canailles! Arrière, j'ai dit!
The Dark Descent#032.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#033.src: Keheh... Come further, little human... Step into the shadows...
The Dark Descent#033.dst: Kéhé... Approche encore, petit humain... Entre dans les ténèbres...

The Dark Descent#034.src: Explore the tunnel in the basement of the house.
The Dark Descent#034.dst: Explorez le tunnel au sous-sol de la maison.

The Dark Descent#037.src: Scout! Report your findings, immediately! How many corrupteds are coming?
The Dark Descent#037.dst: Éclaireur! Faites votre rapport, immédiatement! Combien de corrompus arrivent?
The Dark Descent#037.speaker: Soldier

The Dark Descent#038.src: Thousands...? This is far worse than I expected. Men! Prepare for-
The Dark Descent#038.dst: Des milliers...? C'est bien pire que je ne le pensais. Soldats! Préparez-vous à-
The Dark Descent#038.speaker: Soldier

The Dark Descent#039.dst: Ça ne sert à rien... on est... condamnés...
The Dark Descent#039.speaker: Scout

The Dark Descent#040.src: Wait, w-what's going on? What's happening to you?!
The Dark Descent#040.dst: Attends, q-qu'est-ce qui se passe? Qu'est-ce qui t'arrive?!
The Dark Descent#040.speaker: Soldier

The Dark Descent#041.src: Please, stop this! Whoever you are, leave me and my family in peace! What did we ever do to deserve this?!
The Dark Descent#041.dst: Je vous en prie, arrêtez! Qui que vous soyez, laissez-moi en paix, moi et ma famille! Qu'avons-nous fait pour mériter ça?!
The Dark Descent#041.speaker: Lost Soul

The Dark Descent#042.src: Ah, but if you had only said so sooner! They have already left this mortal coil...oh, what a shame.
The Dark Descent#042.dst: Ah, si seulement tu l'avais dit plus tôt! Ils ont déjà quitté ce monde mortel... oh, quel dommage.

The Dark Descent#043.src: Hush now. I will ensure that you and your family are reunited. You will even be able to partake in...keheh...family outings, under my watchful eye...
The Dark Descent#043.dst: Chut, maintenant. Je veillerai à ce que ta famille et toi soyez réunis. Vous pourrez même faire des... kéhé... sorties en famille, sous mon oeil attentif...

The Dark Descent#044.src: Wha...you mean... N-no, please! I don't want to hurt anyone! I don't want to die!!
The Dark Descent#044.dst: Quoi... vous voulez dire... N-non, pitié! Je ne veux faire de mal à personne! Je ne veux pas mourir!!
The Dark Descent#044.speaker: Lost Soul

The Dark Descent#045.src: Aha, naive girl. How cute, you believe you have a choice in the matter. What you want, is not what I need.
The Dark Descent#045.dst: Aha, petite naïve. Comme c'est mignon, tu crois avoir le choix. Ce que tu veux n'est pas ce dont j'ai besoin.

The Dark Descent#046.src: Do you see how easily this place fell? How quickly I became its master? And how I could simply dispose of you without a second thought?
The Dark Descent#046.dst: Tu vois avec quelle facilité cet endroit est tombé? Comme j'en suis vite devenu le maître? Et comme je pourrais me débarrasser de toi sans hésiter?

The Dark Descent#047.src: Hundreds slaughtered in mere moments... only to rise again as my soldiers in infinite amounts.
The Dark Descent#047.dst: Des centaines massacrés en quelques instants... pour se relever en soldats à mon service, en nombre infini.

The Dark Descent#048.src: You will fail, and I will be free to string your body up like a puppet and make you dance for me.
The Dark Descent#048.dst: Tu échoueras, et je pourrai alors suspendre ton corps comme une marionnette et te faire danser pour moi.

The Dark Descent#050.src: Return the ruby to Graken at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Dark Descent#050.dst: Rapportez le rubis à Graken en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Dark Descent#051.src: Return to your world, now. And if you still want to challenge me... I'll be waiting.
The Dark Descent#051.dst: Retourne dans ton monde, maintenant. Et si tu veux encore me défier... je t'attendrai.

The Dark Descent#052.src: Hey! Come on, come over here! Quit milling about with the zombies, chap!
The Dark Descent#052.dst: Hé! Allez, viens par ici! Arrête de traîner avec les zombies, mon vieux!
The Dark Descent#052.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#053.src: Oi! Hallo?! Chum? Why're you wandering round all bog-eyed? Come back to me now!
The Dark Descent#053.dst: Ohé! Allô?! Camarade? Pourquoi tu erres comme ça, l'oeil vitreux? Reviens à toi!
The Dark Descent#053.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#054.src: Come on, pip pip! Let's see a bit more colour in your eyes- There we are! Back now, chap?
The Dark Descent#054.dst: Allez, hop hop! Un peu plus de couleur dans ces yeux- Voilà! Tu es revenu, mon vieux?
The Dark Descent#054.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#055.src: Capital! You had me quite worried for a spot, there. Do bubble about just what went on down there, mm?
The Dark Descent#055.dst: Splendide! Tu m'as fait une sacrée frayeur, là. Raconte-moi donc ce qui s'est passé là-dessous, hm?
The Dark Descent#055.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#056.src: Your discoveries fit in jolly-well with what we already know - and I'm convinced. To stop all these bleedin' zombos, we're going to have to go down under.
The Dark Descent#056.dst: Tes découvertes collent à merveille avec ce qu'on sait déjà - et je suis convaincu. Pour arrêter tous ces fichus zombies, il va falloir descendre là-dessous.
The Dark Descent#056.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#057.src: Preliminary expeditions have brought back some real nasty bits, brains and such - but also some fancy-as-you-like jewellery!
The Dark Descent#057.dst: Les premières expéditions ont rapporté des trucs immondes, des cervelles et compagnie - mais aussi des bijoux on ne peut plus chics!
The Dark Descent#057.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#058.src: Take some with you, remind you what we're up against. But keep your eyes on the prize!
The Dark Descent#058.dst: Prends-en quelques-uns, ça te rappellera ce qu'on affronte. Mais ne perds pas l'objectif de vue!
The Dark Descent#058.speaker: General Graken

The Envoy Part I#000.src: It's an independant island to the west. In fact... If you want to go...
The Envoy Part I#000.dst: C'est une île indépendante à l'ouest. D'ailleurs... Si vous voulez y aller...
The Envoy Part I#000.speaker: Olivin

The Envoy Part I#001.src: The boat is down at the dock.
The Envoy Part I#001.dst: Le bateau est en bas, au quai.

The Envoy Part I#002.src: It's really hard to miss. Just hop on!
The Envoy Part I#002.dst: Impossible de le manquer. Montez à bord!

The Envoy Part I#003.src: And don't get me sterted on our architectur'!
The Envoy Part I#003.dst: Et me lance pas sur notre architectur'!
The Envoy Part I#003.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#004.src: Mo'in, Wynn traveller! Come speak to me.
The Envoy Part I#004.dst: Mo'in, voyageur de Wynn! Viens me parler.

The Envoy Part I#005.src: North, you can buy weapons and potions. If you continue through the gate you will find the native Avos.
The Envoy Part I#005.dst: Au nord, vous trouverez des armes et des potions. Si vous passez la porte, vous rencontrerez les Avos, le peuple natif.
The Envoy Part I#005.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#006.src: West, you can buy armour, and there is another entrance to the potion shop.
The Envoy Part I#006.dst: A l'ouest, vous trouverez des armures, et une autre entrée de la boutique de potions.
The Envoy Part I#006.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#007.src: Something is going on at the diner, you should hurry.
The Envoy Part I#007.dst: Il se passe quelque chose au restaurant, tu devrais te dépêcher.

The Envoy Part I#008.src: Psst! You! Over here, behind the logs!
The Envoy Part I#008.dst: Psst! Toi! Par ici, derrière les rondins!

The Envoy Part I#009.src: Mo'in, Wynnian. Thank goodness I stopped you!
The Envoy Part I#009.dst: Mo'in, Wynnien. Heureusement que je t'ai arrêté!
The Envoy Part I#009.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#010.src: The diner is being raided by mechs...
The Envoy Part I#010.dst: Le restaurant est attaqué par des mechs...
The Envoy Part I#010.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#011.src: You don't know, huh? Of course you don't. Let me explain.
The Envoy Part I#011.dst: Tu n'es pas au courant, hein? Évidemment que non. Je t'explique.

The Envoy Part I#012.src: The name's Maxie by the way. Nice to meet you.
The Envoy Part I#012.dst: Je m'appelle Maxie, au fait. Enchanté.
The Envoy Part I#012.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#013.src: This town is usually full of life...
The Envoy Part I#013.dst: Cette ville déborde de vie, d'habitude...
The Envoy Part I#013.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#014.src: Look... I know you're a stranger, but... If you want to help, talk to me.
The Envoy Part I#014.dst: Écoute... je sais que tu n'es pas d'ici, mais... Si tu veux aider, parle-moi.

The Envoy Part I#015.src: Alright, I'll open the door with electromagic...
The Envoy Part I#015.dst: Bon, je vais ouvrir la porte avec l'électromagie...
The Envoy Part I#015.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#018.src: Look, I-I'm sorry for slowing you down. It's just...
The Envoy Part I#018.dst: Écoute, d-désolé de te ralentir. C'est juste que...

The Envoy Part I#019.src: Oh, two paths. Well, I'm not sure which way it is, so let's split up. I'll go to the right.
The Envoy Part I#019.dst: Oh, deux chemins. Je ne sais pas lequel est le bon, alors séparons-nous. Je prends à droite.

The Envoy Part I#020.src: Mo'in. Sorry, had a problem with the-
The Envoy Part I#020.dst: Mo'in. Désolé, j'ai eu un problème avec le-
The Envoy Part I#020.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#022.src: Don't worry about the guards, they're disabled for now. Follow me!
The Envoy Part I#022.dst: Ne t'en fais pas pour les gardes, ils sont désactivés pour l'instant. Suis-moi!
The Envoy Part I#022.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#023.src: We saw a mech… A new mech! It looked different like it was made in-
The Envoy Part I#023.dst: On a vu un mech… Un nouveau mech! Il avait l'air différent, comme s'il avait été fabriqué à-
The Envoy Part I#023.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#024.src: Our guest... just killed several despermechs by themselves.
The Envoy Part I#024.dst: Notre invité... vient de détruire plusieurs despermechs à lui seul.
The Envoy Part I#024.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#025.src: Come to my house when you reach level {~}, here's a key so you get in. We must prepare to break into the factory.
The Envoy Part I#025.dst: Viens chez moi quand tu auras atteint le niveau {~}, voici une clé pour entrer. Nous devons préparer l'infiltration de l'Usine.
The Envoy Part I#025.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#031.src: I'm not from around here. In fact I am from Corkus.
The Envoy Part I#031.dst: Je ne suis pas d'ici. En fait, je viens de Corkus.
The Envoy Part I#031.speaker: Olivin

The Envoy Part I#033.src: We're looking for Wynn representatives. Head to the C.S.S Wavebreaker down at the dock if you want to experience Corkus. Enjoy Corkus if you go!
The Envoy Part I#033.dst: Nous cherchons des représentants de Wynn. Rendez-vous au C.S.S Wavebreaker, en bas au quai, si vous voulez découvrir Corkus. Profitez bien de Corkus si vous y allez!
The Envoy Part I#033.speaker: Olivin

The Envoy Part I#034.src: Speak to C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain at the {p} docks.
The Envoy Part I#034.dst: Parlez au capitaine du C.S.S Wavebreaker sur les quais de {p}.

The Envoy Part I#035.dst: Bienvenue, bienvenue à bord du C.S.S Wavebreaker!
The Envoy Part I#035.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#037.src: Just hop aboard and make yerself comfy.
The Envoy Part I#037.dst: Monte à bord et mets-toi à l'aise.
The Envoy Part I#037.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#038.dst: Montez à bord du C.S.S. Wavebreaker.

The Envoy Part I#039.src: Welcam aboard me ship, I'll bring ye directly to Corkus.
The Envoy Part I#039.dst: Bienv'nue à bord d'mon navire, j'te mène droit à Corkus.
The Envoy Part I#039.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#040.src: Trust me, it is fa' more amazin than Gavel and Wynn. We even 'ave machines!
The Envoy Part I#040.dst: Crois-moi, c'est bien plus épatant qu'Gavel et Wynn. On a même des machines!
The Envoy Part I#040.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#042.src: Trust me, you will enjoy yer stay.
The Envoy Part I#042.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#045.src: It's such an honour to have a Wynn soldier visit our island.
The Envoy Part I#045.dst: C'est un tel honneur d'accueillir un soldat de Wynn sur notre île.
The Envoy Part I#045.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#046.src: We were hoping for a true envoy, but you will do.
The Envoy Part I#046.dst: Nous espérions un véritable émissaire, mais vous ferez l'affaire.
The Envoy Part I#046.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#047.src: If you follow me, I'll give you a tour of the city.
The Envoy Part I#047.dst: Si vous me suivez, je vais vous faire visiter la ville.
The Envoy Part I#047.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#048.src: We first arrived on Corkus {~} years ago.
The Envoy Part I#048.dst: Nous sommes arrivés à Corkus il y a {~} ans.
The Envoy Part I#048.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#049.src: The Corkians, like you, are from Fruma originally...
The Envoy Part I#049.dst: Les Corkians, comme vous, viennent à l'origine de Fruma...
The Envoy Part I#049.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#051.src: Coming from Fruma, we of course knew no magic at all.
The Envoy Part I#051.dst: Venant de Fruma, nous ne connaissions bien sûr rien à la magie.
The Envoy Part I#051.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#052.src: We soon developed our own. The rare power of Electromagic.
The Envoy Part I#052.dst: Nous avons vite développé la nôtre. Le pouvoir rare de l'électromagie.
The Envoy Part I#052.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#053.src: It's a difficult modern branch of magic that allows us to create machines.
The Envoy Part I#053.dst: C'est une branche moderne et difficile de la magie, qui nous permet de créer des machines.
The Envoy Part I#053.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#054.src: Ah, here already. Welcome to {p}, Capital of our island.
The Envoy Part I#054.dst: Ah, déjà arrivés. Bienvenue à {p}, capitale de notre île.
The Envoy Part I#054.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#055.src: We've come a long way in a short time.
The Envoy Part I#055.dst: Nous avons fait beaucoup de chemin en peu de temps.
The Envoy Part I#055.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#056.src: Let me point out where the shops are.
The Envoy Part I#056.dst: Laissez-moi vous montrer où sont les boutiques.
The Envoy Part I#056.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#059.src: To the south is our bank, powder shop, scrolls, and our exclusive powder exchange!
The Envoy Part I#059.dst: Au sud: notre banque, la boutique de poudres, les parchemins, et notre échange de poudres exclusif!
The Envoy Part I#059.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#060.src: Oh! And speaking of the powder exchange, I'll start you off with some of these.
The Envoy Part I#060.dst: Oh! Et à propos de l'échange de poudres, je vais vous en offrir quelques-unes pour commencer.
The Envoy Part I#060.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#061.src: Moving on... The south gate leads to {p}. On your way there, you might pass by the-
The Envoy Part I#061.dst: Poursuivons... La porte sud mène à {p}. En chemin, vous passerez peut-être devant l'-
The Envoy Part I#061.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#062.src: Uhm, nevermind. In fact, we have a gift for you.
The Envoy Part I#062.dst: Euh, peu importe. D'ailleurs, nous avons un cadeau pour vous.
The Envoy Part I#062.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#063.src: The Five Gears Diner is hosting any guests of the island.
The Envoy Part I#063.dst: The Five Gears Diner accueille tous les visiteurs de l'île.
The Envoy Part I#063.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#064.src: Go through the western gate and head to the diner for your free feast. Enjoy!
The Envoy Part I#064.dst: Passez la porte ouest et rendez-vous au restaurant pour votre festin gratuit. Bon appétit!
The Envoy Part I#064.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#065.src: Walk towards The Five Gears Diner.
The Envoy Part I#065.dst: Dirigez-vous vers The Five Gears Diner.

The Envoy Part I#071.src: Before we do anything, I have to explain what's happening here...
The Envoy Part I#071.dst: Avant toute chose, je dois t'expliquer ce qui se passe ici...
The Envoy Part I#071.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#075.src: Our creations have rebelled against us.
The Envoy Part I#075.dst: Nos créations se sont rebellées contre nous.
The Envoy Part I#075.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#076.src: They now raid towns for parts.
The Envoy Part I#076.dst: Elles pillent les villes pour des pièces.
The Envoy Part I#076.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#077.src: Mechs are getting increasingly more desperate.
The Envoy Part I#077.dst: Les mechs sont de plus en plus désespérés.
The Envoy Part I#077.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#078.src: Even in rust, they are still powerful.
The Envoy Part I#078.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#079.src: We have tried to remove them but the factory always makes more.
The Envoy Part I#079.dst: On a essayé de les éliminer, mais l'Usine en fabrique toujours plus.
The Envoy Part I#079.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#080.src: It is Corkus' greatest failure. It must be stopped.
The Envoy Part I#080.dst: C'est le plus grand échec de Corkus. Il faut l'arrêter.
The Envoy Part I#080.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#082.src: I can try to open the vent to sneak in.
The Envoy Part I#082.dst: Je peux ouvrir la grille d'aération pour entrer.
The Envoy Part I#082.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#083.src: I know you are a stranger, but talk to me if you want to help.
The Envoy Part I#083.dst: Je sais que tu n'es pas d'ici, mais parle-moi si tu veux aider.
The Envoy Part I#083.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#088.src: Gah! I can't even do the most basic spell!
The Envoy Part I#088.dst: Argh! Je n'arrive même pas à lancer le sort le plus simple!
The Envoy Part I#088.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#091.src: I'm sorry for being useless in front of you...
The Envoy Part I#091.dst: Désolé d'être aussi inutile devant toi...
The Envoy Part I#091.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#092.src: Electromagic is different from your magic... And I'm not very good at it.
The Envoy Part I#092.dst: L'électromagie, ce n'est pas comme votre magie... Et je ne suis pas très doué.
The Envoy Part I#092.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#095.src: Open the door and exit the ducts.
The Envoy Part I#095.dst: Ouvrez la porte et sortez des conduits.

The Envoy Part I#101.src: ...What in the world is that mech on top of the pile of scrap over there?!
The Envoy Part I#101.dst: ...C'est quoi, ce mech là-bas, au sommet du tas de ferraille?!
The Envoy Part I#101.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#102.src: That is definitely not a regular despermech... It looks brand new!
The Envoy Part I#102.dst: Ce n'est sûrement pas un despermech ordinaire... Il a l'air flambant neuf!
The Envoy Part I#102.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#103.src: One of those hasn't been seen since the factory was running...
The Envoy Part I#103.dst: On n'en a pas vu un seul depuis que l'Usine tournait...
The Envoy Part I#103.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#104.src: We need to do something! I'll clear the path for you. That's the only thing I can do, I... hurt my... leg.
The Envoy Part I#104.dst: Il faut faire quelque chose! Je vais te dégager le passage. C'est tout ce que je peux faire, je... me suis blessé... à la jambe.
The Envoy Part I#104.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#108.src: Are you okay? Good. Meet me at the entrance where we met. We need to report to {p}!
The Envoy Part I#108.dst: Ça va? Bien. Retrouve-moi à l'entrée où on s'est rencontrés. Il faut prévenir {p}!
The Envoy Part I#108.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#109.src: Talk to Maxie at the entrance to The Five Gears Diner.
The Envoy Part I#109.dst: Parlez à Maxie devant l'entrée de The Five Gears Diner.

The Envoy Part I#111.src: I know a shortcut, we'll be in {p} in no time.
The Envoy Part I#111.dst: Je connais un raccourci, on sera à {p} en un rien de temps.
The Envoy Part I#111.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#112.src: Talk to Maxie and Corkus Delegate in {p}.
The Envoy Part I#112.dst: Parlez à Maxie et au délégué de Corkus à {p}.

The Envoy Part I#114.src: Beltrude, we have a problem! The factory is running!
The Envoy Part I#114.dst: Beltrude, on a un problème! L'Usine est en marche!
The Envoy Part I#114.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#116.src: What a load of scrap! You shouldn't talk about that in front of our guest!
The Envoy Part I#116.dst: Quel tas de ferraille! Tu ne devrais pas parler de ça devant notre invité!
The Envoy Part I#116.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#118.src: And why would we take the word of someone who can't do basic electromagic?
The Envoy Part I#118.dst: Et pourquoi croirions-nous quelqu'un qui ne maîtrise même pas l'électromagie de base?
The Envoy Part I#118.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#119.src: Don't listen to Maxie. Enjoy your stay.
The Envoy Part I#119.dst: N'écoutez pas Maxie. Profitez bien de votre séjour.
The Envoy Part I#119.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#120.src: They won't admit anything with you around. They want to become allies with Wynn.
The Envoy Part I#120.dst: Ils n'admettront rien tant que tu seras là. Ils veulent devenir les alliés de Wynn.
The Envoy Part I#120.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#000.src: Try following the trail outside the castle, it might lead you to the key.
The Envoy Part II#000.dst: Essaie de suivre la piste à l'extérieur du château, elle te mènera peut-être à la clé.

The Envoy Part II#001.src: Just follow the road to the north to find my friend. Watch out, she doesn't like humans much.
The Envoy Part II#001.dst: Suis la route vers le nord pour trouver mon amie. Attention, elle n'aime pas trop les humains.

The Envoy Part II#002.src: You need the key before you leave!
The Envoy Part II#002.dst: Il te faut la clé avant de partir!

The Envoy Part II#004.src: The idea was that both species had equal roles in the factory's operations.
The Envoy Part II#004.dst: L'idée était que les deux espèces aient un rôle égal dans le fonctionnement de l'Usine.
The Envoy Part II#004.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#005.src: We need those keys to get in and shut down the factory once more.
The Envoy Part II#005.dst: Il nous faut ces clés pour entrer et arrêter l'Usine une fois de plus.
The Envoy Part II#005.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#006.src: The Corkians won't give up their key very easily, so we should start with the Avos.
The Envoy Part II#006.dst: Les Corkians ne lâcheront pas leur clé si facilement, alors commençons par les Avos.
The Envoy Part II#006.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#007.src: Our best bet is to ask the chief, but... The border's closed due to tensions.
The Envoy Part II#007.dst: Le mieux, c'est de demander au chef, mais... la frontière est fermée à cause des tensions.

The Envoy Part II#008.src: Fortunately, there's a catapult that can help us in a village north-west of here. Let's meet there!
The Envoy Part II#008.dst: Heureusement, il y a une catapulte qui peut nous aider dans un village au nord-ouest d'ici. Rendez-vous là-bas!

The Envoy Part II#009.src: I knew it! There was something here we could use!
The Envoy Part II#009.dst: Je le savais! Il y avait bien quelque chose d'utile ici!
The Envoy Part II#009.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#010.src: I'll have to use electromagic to make it launch, so you'll have to go alone.
The Envoy Part II#010.dst: Je vais devoir la lancer avec l'électromagie, alors tu devras y aller sans moi.
The Envoy Part II#010.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#012.src: Locate the Avos Chief by asking the Avos citizens.
The Envoy Part II#012.dst: Trouvez le chef des Avos en interrogeant les habitants Avos.

The Envoy Part II#013.src: I'm so jealous of the chief, he gets to live in the fanciest house on the hill!
The Envoy Part II#013.dst: Je suis tellement jaloux du chef, il habite la maison la plus chic de la colline!

The Envoy Part II#014.src: Hmm, no gears or goggles... You are no Corkian Human.
The Envoy Part II#014.dst: Hmm, ni engrenages ni lunettes... Tu n'es pas un humain de Corkus.
The Envoy Part II#014.speaker: Avos Shaman

The Envoy Part II#015.src: We saw your battle with "Mech X" at the docks from above. I believe we can trust you.
The Envoy Part II#015.dst: Nous avons vu d'en haut ton combat contre "Méca X" sur les quais. Je crois qu'on peut te faire confiance.
The Envoy Part II#015.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#016.src: Can't you humans see I'm meditating?
The Envoy Part II#016.dst: Vous ne voyez pas que je médite, vous, les humains?

The Envoy Part II#017.src: I don't see why we're helping humans...
The Envoy Part II#017.dst: Je ne vois pas pourquoi on aide des humains...
The Envoy Part II#017.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#018.src: You should head back to Maxie with the key.
The Envoy Part II#018.dst: Tu devrais retourner voir Maxie avec la clé.

The Envoy Part II#019.src: Excellent! I'll hold onto that for now. Let's focus on getting the Corkian's Key.
The Envoy Part II#019.dst: Excellent! Je la garde pour l'instant. Concentrons-nous sur la clé des Corkians.
The Envoy Part II#019.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#020.src: They keep it in a vault inside the castle. I... I honestly don't know how to get in there.
The Envoy Part II#020.dst: Ils la gardent dans une chambre forte au château. Je... honnêtement, je ne sais pas comment y entrer.
The Envoy Part II#020.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#021.src: It's in the castle and to the right. There's {~} guards there at all times, you can't miss it.
The Envoy Part II#021.dst: C'est dans le château, sur la droite. Il y a toujours {~} gardes, impossible de la manquer.

The Envoy Part II#022.src: Something has happened in the vault.
The Envoy Part II#022.dst: Il s'est passé quelque chose dans la chambre forte.

The Envoy Part II#023.src: Don't go in there, it's under control.
The Envoy Part II#023.dst: N'entrez pas, la situation est sous contrôle.

The Envoy Part II#024.src: The mechs were covered in farm produce for some reason and left a convenient trail. If you are serious about fighting the factory, follow the trail.
The Envoy Part II#024.dst: Bizarrement, les mechs étaient couverts de légumes et ont laissé une piste bien pratique. Si vous tenez vraiment à combattre l'Usine, suivez la piste.
The Envoy Part II#024.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part II#025.src: Mo'in. See that guy up there? He hasn't moved an inch since I got here...
The Envoy Part II#025.dst: Mo'in. Tu vois le type là-haut? Il n'a pas bougé d'un pouce depuis que je suis arrivé...
The Envoy Part II#025.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#026.src: ...I don't think he's actually a farmer. Follow me.
The Envoy Part II#026.dst: ...Je ne crois pas que ce soit un vrai fermier. Suis-moi.
The Envoy Part II#026.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#028.src: That model was a S-{~}... It's warned the others. Let's go.
The Envoy Part II#028.dst: Ce modèle était un S-{~}... Il a prévenu les autres. Allons-y.

The Envoy Part II#029.dst: Tu vois? On est bloqués dehors.
The Envoy Part II#029.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#030.src: You did?! Great! Now we need to meet at the factory. The real hard part begins.
The Envoy Part II#030.dst: C'est vrai?! Génial! Maintenant, on doit se retrouver à l'Usine. Le plus dur commence.

The Envoy Part II#031.src: You hear a distant rumbling sound...

The Envoy Part II#032.src: An engraving on the pillar reads: Reunite three wise creatures to open the way.
The Envoy Part II#032.dst: Une inscription gravée sur le pilier dit: Réunis trois créatures sages pour ouvrir la voie.

The Envoy Part II#033.src: You dare intrude on me while I am sculpting?! You shall pay with your life!
The Envoy Part II#033.dst: Tu oses me déranger pendant que je sculpte?! Tu le paieras de ta vie!

The Envoy Part II#034.src: Another miserable whelp has come to steal my knowledge? I won't let you!
The Envoy Part II#034.dst: Encore un misérable morveux venu voler mon savoir? Je ne te laisserai pas faire!

The Envoy Part II#035.src: So... You've managed to make it past my family. Pathetic aren't they?
The Envoy Part II#035.dst: Alors... Tu as réussi à passer ma famille. Pathétiques, n'est-ce pas?

The Envoy Part II#036.src: Let me show you a real challenge!
The Envoy Part II#036.dst: Je vais te montrer un vrai défi!

The Envoy Part II#037.src: Use Maxie's house key to enter Maxie's house
The Envoy Part II#037.dst: Utilisez la clé de Maxie pour entrer chez lui

The Envoy Part II#039.src: Talk to Maxie on the first floor.
The Envoy Part II#039.dst: Parlez à Maxie au premier étage.

The Envoy Part II#040.src: To get in we need two keys. One from the Avos and one from Corkians.
The Envoy Part II#040.dst: Pour entrer, il faut deux clés. Celle des Avos et celle des Corkians.
The Envoy Part II#040.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#041.src: Our best bet is to ask the chief. However, because of tensions the border is closed.
The Envoy Part II#041.dst: Le mieux, c'est de demander au chef. Mais à cause des tensions, la frontière est fermée.
The Envoy Part II#041.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#042.src: Find the Avos chief. Ask for the factory key.
The Envoy Part II#042.dst: Trouve le chef des Avos. Demande-lui la clé de l'Usine.
The Envoy Part II#042.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#044.src: Press the button when you're ready.
The Envoy Part II#044.dst: Appuie sur le bouton quand tu es prêt.
The Envoy Part II#044.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#046.src: Locate the Avos Chief by asking the Avos citizens. Avos Chief is at -{~}, -{~}
The Envoy Part II#046.dst: Trouvez le chef des Avos en interrogeant les habitants Avos. Le chef des Avos se trouve en -{~}, -{~}

The Envoy Part II#047.src: The chief said your people are welcome here.
The Envoy Part II#047.dst: Le chef a dit que ton peuple est le bienvenu ici.
The Envoy Part II#047.speaker: Avos Shaman

The Envoy Part II#048.src: You must be here to see him.
The Envoy Part II#048.dst: Tu dois être là pour le voir.
The Envoy Part II#048.speaker: Avos Shaman

The Envoy Part II#049.dst: Il est juste en haut de ces escaliers.
The Envoy Part II#049.speaker: Avos Shaman

The Envoy Part II#050.src: Mo'in, soldier. I have been expecting you.
The Envoy Part II#050.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#051.src: You can't catapult yourself into a village full of bird people and not get noticed.
The Envoy Part II#051.dst: On ne se catapulte pas dans un village plein d'hommes-oiseaux sans se faire remarquer.
The Envoy Part II#051.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#052.src: We know what you are here for, however. The Avos factory key.
The Envoy Part II#052.dst: Nous savons cependant ce que tu cherches ici. La clé de l'Usine des Avos.
The Envoy Part II#052.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#053.src: The key you seek is hidden deep within our most protected temple.
The Envoy Part II#053.dst: La clé que tu cherches est cachée au plus profond de notre temple le mieux gardé.
The Envoy Part II#053.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#054.src: Follow the road north of here to reach the temple. Speak to the grandmaster and she will allow you entry.
The Envoy Part II#054.dst: Suis la route au nord d'ici pour atteindre le temple. Parle à la Grande Maîtresse, elle te laissera entrer.
The Envoy Part II#054.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#055.src: Talk to the chief's friend at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Envoy Part II#055.dst: Parlez à l'amie du chef en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Envoy Part II#056.src: Talk to the chief's friend at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Envoy Part II#056.dst: Parle à l'amie du chef en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Envoy Part II#057.src: Eh, It's the warrior. I have my orders, but still say this is a bad idea.
The Envoy Part II#057.dst: Tiens, le guerrier. J'ai mes ordres, mais je persiste à dire que c'est une mauvaise idée.
The Envoy Part II#057.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#058.src: We hid this key for the purpose that it would never be used again.
The Envoy Part II#058.dst: Nous avons caché cette clé pour qu'elle ne serve plus jamais.
The Envoy Part II#058.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#059.src: The creatures we summoned down there are hostile to all. Even Avos.
The Envoy Part II#059.dst: Les créatures que nous avons invoquées en bas sont hostiles envers tous. Même les Avos.
The Envoy Part II#059.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#060.src: I can't say I have high hopes for you.
The Envoy Part II#060.dst: Je ne peux pas dire que j'aie de grands espoirs pour toi.
The Envoy Part II#060.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#061.src: Meet me round the back of my house and I shall show you the way.
The Envoy Part II#061.dst: Retrouve-moi derrière ma maison, et je te montrerai le chemin.
The Envoy Part II#061.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#062.src: Meet the grandmaster behind her house and get over the gap and enter the temple.
The Envoy Part II#062.dst: Retrouvez la Grande Maîtresse derrière sa maison, franchissez le gouffre et entrez dans le temple.

The Envoy Part II#063.src: I'll make the bridge for you.
The Envoy Part II#063.dst: Je vais te faire un pont.
The Envoy Part II#063.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#064.src: You all act the same to me. Anyway, there you go.
The Envoy Part II#064.dst: Vous agissez tous pareil, à mes yeux. Bref, voilà.
The Envoy Part II#064.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#065.src: Find the key inside the temple.
The Envoy Part II#065.dst: Trouvez la clé dans le temple.

The Envoy Part II#066.src: You cannot have the key. Prepare for destruction.
The Envoy Part II#066.dst: Tu n'auras pas la clé. Prépare-toi à être détruit.
The Envoy Part II#066.speaker: Key Temple Dragon

The Envoy Part II#067.src: Return to Maxie in his house with the first key.
The Envoy Part II#067.dst: Retournez chez Maxie avec la première clé.

The Envoy Part II#068.src: You're back, and you have the key!
The Envoy Part II#068.dst: Tu es de retour, et tu as la clé!
The Envoy Part II#068.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#069.src: I think first we should just go and scout out the vault itself and work it out.
The Envoy Part II#069.dst: Je pense qu'on devrait d'abord aller repérer la chambre forte et voir sur place.
The Envoy Part II#069.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#070.dst: Trouvez la chambre forte de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Envoy Part II#071.dst: Trouve la chambre forte de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Envoy Part II#073.src: Uh- No need to worry! We accidentally...
The Envoy Part II#073.dst: Euh- Pas d'inquiétude! Nous avons accidentellement...
The Envoy Part II#073.speaker: Bertil

The Envoy Part II#074.src: Blew a hole in the wall! Yep!
The Envoy Part II#074.dst: Fait un trou dans le mur! Voilà!
The Envoy Part II#074.speaker: Reiva

The Envoy Part II#075.src: Stop. Maxie, was right. I'm sorry. Mech X pierced the vault like it was nothing and took the key.
The Envoy Part II#075.dst: Assez. Maxie avait raison. Pardon. Le Méca X a percé la chambre forte comme si de rien n'était et a pris la clé.
The Envoy Part II#075.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part II#076.src: Look for the hidden mech base.
The Envoy Part II#076.dst: Cherchez la base cachée des mechs.

The Envoy Part II#077.src: Psst! Over here, in the field!
The Envoy Part II#077.dst: Psst! Par ici, dans le champ!
The Envoy Part II#077.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#078.src: HELLO... I AM A... HUMAN... FARMER.
The Envoy Part II#078.dst: BONJOUR... JE SUIS UN... FERMIER... HUMAIN.
The Envoy Part II#078.speaker: Farmer

The Envoy Part II#079.src: DO YOU... HAVE... ANY BUSINESS... WITH ME?
The Envoy Part II#079.dst: AVEZ-VOUS... UNE AFFAIRE... A TRAITER... AVEC MOI?
The Envoy Part II#079.speaker: Farmer

The Envoy Part II#080.src: Nice try, mech! Not convincing enough for me!
The Envoy Part II#080.dst: Bien essayé, mech! Pas assez convaincant pour moi!
The Envoy Part II#080.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#081.src: REPORT... COVER HAS BEEN COMPROMISED... TWO UNAUTHORIZED INTRUDERS... OUTSIDE OF BASE.
The Envoy Part II#081.dst: RAPPORT... COUVERTURE COMPROMISE... DEUX INTRUS NON AUTORISÉS... HORS DE LA BASE.
The Envoy Part II#081.speaker: S-63 Mech

The Envoy Part II#083.dst: Oh que non, tu ne vas PAS faire ça!
The Envoy Part II#083.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#084.src: That model was a S-{~}, meaning it has warned the others. Follow me.
The Envoy Part II#084.dst: Ce modèle était un S-{~}, donc il a prévenu les autres. Suis-moi.
The Envoy Part II#084.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#085.src: Stand back, I'll open the door.
The Envoy Part II#085.dst: Recule, je vais ouvrir la porte.
The Envoy Part II#085.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#086.src: I think we can safely assume this is the right place.
The Envoy Part II#086.dst: Je crois qu'on peut affirmer sans risque que c'est le bon endroit.
The Envoy Part II#086.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#087.src: You storm in and find what we need. I'll cover you from out here.
The Envoy Part II#087.dst: Fonce à l'intérieur et trouve ce qu'il nous faut. Je te couvre d'ici.
The Envoy Part II#087.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#088.src: You need to find and destroy that new factory mech.
The Envoy Part II#088.dst: Tu dois trouver et détruire ce nouveau mech de l'Usine.
The Envoy Part II#088.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#089.src: Retrieve the key from the base.
The Envoy Part II#089.dst: Récupérez la clé dans la base.

The Envoy Part II#091.src: Corkus has to suffer... They shut down the Factory, locked us up in there. Once we have both keys we can open it and you are NOT getting this one.
The Envoy Part II#091.dst: Corkus doit souffrir... Ils ont fermé l'Usine et nous y ont enfermés. Avec les deux clés, nous pourrons l'ouvrir, et celle-ci, tu ne l'auras PAS.
The Envoy Part II#091.speaker: Mech X

The Envoy Part II#092.src: Find Maxie at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and give him the key.
The Envoy Part II#092.dst: Trouvez Maxie en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] et donnez-lui la clé.

The Envoy Part II#093.src: Mo'in. Did you get the key?
The Envoy Part II#093.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#094.src: Follow the northwestern road and enter the factory from the west side. I will meet you there.
The Envoy Part II#094.dst: Suis la route du nord-ouest et entre dans l'Usine par le côté ouest. Je t'y retrouverai.
The Envoy Part II#094.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#095.src: Find Maxie outside the Factory at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Envoy Part II#096.src: Mo'in. Are you sure you are ready?
The Envoy Part II#096.dst: Mo'in. Tu es sûr d'être prêt?
The Envoy Part II#096.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#097.src: This won't be your average fight. The factory is cutting edge. Run by a being of pure electromagic.
The Envoy Part II#097.dst: Ce ne sera pas un combat ordinaire. L'Usine est à la pointe. Elle est dirigée par un être de pure électromagie.
The Envoy Part II#097.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#098.src: The smartest man on Corkus, Cerid spent years making a being smarter even than he is...
The Envoy Part II#098.dst: Cerid, l'homme le plus brillant de Corkus, a passé des années à créer un être plus brillant encore que lui...
The Envoy Part II#098.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#099.src: Now it runs the factory with a twisted sense of morality. It's easy to see why it was shut down.
The Envoy Part II#099.dst: Aujourd'hui, il dirige l'Usine selon une morale tordue. On comprend pourquoi on l'a fermée.
The Envoy Part II#099.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#100.src: Also.. I- I made you these boots using my magic. It turns out I am pretty good at making stuff.
The Envoy Part II#100.dst: Aussi.. j- je t'ai fait ces bottes avec ma magie. En fait, je suis plutôt doué pour fabriquer des trucs.
The Envoy Part II#100.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#101.src: I just wanted to say thanks, too. I really feel like I made a difference fighting with you. When you are ready, just walk up to the factory doors.
The Envoy Part II#101.dst: Je voulais aussi te remercier. J'ai vraiment eu l'impression d'être utile en combattant avec toi. Quand tu seras prêt, avance jusqu'aux portes de l'Usine.
The Envoy Part II#101.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#103.src: Mo'in, {u}! I've been researching everything I can about the factory.
The Envoy Part II#103.dst: Mo'in, {u}! J'ai fait toutes les recherches possibles sur l'Usine.
The Envoy Part II#103.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#104.src: I have learned so much on our adventure. One day, if you ever need me, I will be there. You have an ally in this Corkian.
The Envoy Part II#104.dst: J'ai tant appris pendant notre aventure. Un jour, si tu as besoin de moi, je serai là. Tu as un allié en ce Corkian.

The Feathers Fly Part I#000.src: Visit the workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] (Requires completion of The Envoy Part II)
The Feathers Fly Part I#000.dst: Rendez-vous à l'atelier en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] (Nécessite d'avoir terminé L'émissaire, partie II)

The Feathers Fly Part I#001.src: Oh?! Hold on, is anyone there..!
The Feathers Fly Part I#001.dst: Oh?! Attends, il y a quelqu'un..!

The Feathers Fly Part I#002.src: Why hello there! Whatcha doin' here? I'm Ava!
The Feathers Fly Part I#002.dst: Eh bien, salut! Qu'est-ce que tu fabriques ici? Moi, c'est Ava!
The Feathers Fly Part I#002.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#003.src: Want a quick job? How 'bout helpin' me out?! That was perfect timing!
The Feathers Fly Part I#003.dst: Un petit boulot, ça te dit? Tu me donnes un coup de main?! Tu tombes à pic!
The Feathers Fly Part I#003.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#004.src: Y'see, while the other Avos hate it, I just find electromagic so fascinating!
The Feathers Fly Part I#004.dst: Tu vois, les autres Avos détestent ça, mais moi, je trouve l'électromagie tellement fascinante!
The Feathers Fly Part I#004.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#005.src: Look, I think I got a breakthrough invention. If it works... Oh man...
The Feathers Fly Part I#005.dst: Écoute, je crois que je tiens une invention révolutionnaire. Si ça marche... Oh là là...
The Feathers Fly Part I#005.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#006.src: I just need to harness some nature magic, and there's an amazing source in the chief's hut. Ya comin'?
The Feathers Fly Part I#006.dst: Il me faut juste capter un peu de magie de la nature, et il y a une source incroyable dans la hutte du chef. Tu viens?
The Feathers Fly Part I#006.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#007.src: Don't you worry about rewards! I got you! See ya' there!
The Feathers Fly Part I#007.dst: T'inquiète pas pour la récompense! Je m'occupe de toi! On se voit là-bas!
The Feathers Fly Part I#007.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#009.src: Hey! You showed up! Listen up, here's the plan...
The Feathers Fly Part I#009.dst: Hé! Tu es là! Écoute bien, voilà le plan...
The Feathers Fly Part I#009.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#010.src: There's a small museum inside the hut with all kinds of trophies.
The Feathers Fly Part I#010.dst: Il y a un petit musée dans la hutte, avec toutes sortes de trophées.
The Feathers Fly Part I#010.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#011.src: Our chief is quite the talkative fella, and I can guarantee he'd love to tell you stories.
The Feathers Fly Part I#011.dst: Notre chef est un sacré bavard, et je te garantis qu'il adorera te raconter des histoires.
The Feathers Fly Part I#011.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#012.src: That should keep him and his guards busy. And that's where I come in!
The Feathers Fly Part I#012.dst: Ça devrait l'occuper, lui et ses gardes. Et c'est là que j'interviens!
The Feathers Fly Part I#012.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#013.src: I'll take that chance to sneak behind the throne, where our sacred totem is. I'm not stealing it, don't worry!
The Feathers Fly Part I#013.dst: J'en profiterai pour me faufiler derrière le trône, où se trouve notre totem sacré. Je ne vais pas le voler, t'inquiète!
The Feathers Fly Part I#013.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#014.src: I'm a little clumsy, but I'm sure I can count on ya'! No matter what, keep the chief busy!
The Feathers Fly Part I#014.dst: Je suis un peu maladroite, mais je suis sûre de pouvoir compter sur toi! Quoi qu'il arrive, occupe le chef!
The Feathers Fly Part I#014.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#015.dst: Distrayez le chef des Avos en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#016.dst: Salutations, humain. Bon retour parmi nous.
The Feathers Fly Part I#016.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#017.src: So, what brings you here, hm?
The Feathers Fly Part I#017.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#018.src: Oh, you want to learn more about us... Of course, of course!
The Feathers Fly Part I#018.dst: Oh, tu veux en savoir plus sur nous... Bien sûr, bien sûr!
The Feathers Fly Part I#018.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#019.src: We have a room where I can show you some of our history.
The Feathers Fly Part I#019.dst: Nous avons une salle où je peux te montrer un peu de notre histoire.
The Feathers Fly Part I#019.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#020.src: You're in luck, I'm in a good mood. Follow me then.
The Feathers Fly Part I#020.dst: Tu as de la chance, je suis de bonne humeur. Suis-moi, alors.
The Feathers Fly Part I#020.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#022.src: It's alright, these books aren't important... Be careful though.
The Feathers Fly Part I#022.dst: Ce n'est rien, ces livres ne sont pas importants... Fais attention, tout de même.
The Feathers Fly Part I#022.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#024.src: It's one of a kind! We planted it eons ago. It has never ever grown an inch. Or moved.
The Feathers Fly Part I#024.dst: Elle est unique! Nous l'avons plantée il y a des éons. Elle n'a jamais grandi d'un pouce. Ni bougé.
The Feathers Fly Part I#024.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#025.src: Never died or anything either. For all we know, it might predate your corruption too!
The Feathers Fly Part I#025.dst: Elle n'est jamais morte non plus. Elle est peut-être même antérieure à votre Corruption!
The Feathers Fly Part I#025.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#026.src: Oh, this is quite the important tome.
The Feathers Fly Part I#026.dst: Oh, ce tome-ci est très important.
The Feathers Fly Part I#026.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#027.src: This book has a signature from all Avos chiefs ever since we discovered ink!
The Feathers Fly Part I#027.dst: Ce livre porte la signature de tous les chefs Avos depuis que nous avons découvert l'encre!
The Feathers Fly Part I#027.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#028.dst: Ah oui, la caisse à plumes!
The Feathers Fly Part I#028.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#029.src: It's a custom for every Avos chief to keep their feathers somewhere. I guess I left that here.
The Feathers Fly Part I#029.dst: Chaque chef Avos a coutume de garder ses plumes quelque part. J'ai dû laisser ça ici.
The Feathers Fly Part I#029.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#030.dst: Et voici un morceau d'histoire important!
The Feathers Fly Part I#030.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#031.src: Though, we don't really have the time to sit down and read all of it, do we?
The Feathers Fly Part I#031.dst: Mais nous n'avons pas vraiment le temps de nous asseoir pour tout lire, n'est-ce pas?
The Feathers Fly Part I#031.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#032.dst: Qu'est-ce que c'était?! Je vais voir.
The Feathers Fly Part I#032.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#033.src: Someone broke in? But why? Anyone can use our totem...
The Feathers Fly Part I#033.dst: Une effraction? Mais pourquoi? N'importe qui peut utiliser le totem...
The Feathers Fly Part I#033.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#034.src: I don't get it. They could've just asked...
The Feathers Fly Part I#034.dst: Je ne comprends pas. Il suffisait de demander...
The Feathers Fly Part I#034.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#035.src: Report back to Ava in the Workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part I#035.dst: Retournez voir Ava à l'atelier en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#036.src: Oh, hey! Thanks for earlier. You were a big help.
The Feathers Fly Part I#036.dst: Oh, salut! Merci pour tout à l'heure. Tu m'as beaucoup aidée.
The Feathers Fly Part I#036.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#037.src: Truth is, anyone can use that totem. They just don't like me very much.
The Feathers Fly Part I#037.dst: A vrai dire, n'importe qui peut utiliser ce totem. C'est juste qu'ils ne m'aiment pas beaucoup.
The Feathers Fly Part I#037.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#038.src: Anyway, we got what we needed, and it's promising! Now onto the next part...
The Feathers Fly Part I#038.dst: Bref, on a ce qu'il nous fallait, et c'est prometteur! Passons à la suite...
The Feathers Fly Part I#038.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#039.src: Y'see, I managed to bottle up some of our magic, but I still need corkian stuff.
The Feathers Fly Part I#039.dst: Tu vois, j'ai mis un peu de notre magie en bouteille, mais il me faut encore des trucs Corkian.
The Feathers Fly Part I#039.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#040.src: Fortunately for us, there's a shop outside the city. Though, things might get complicated...
The Feathers Fly Part I#040.dst: Heureusement pour nous, il y a une boutique à l'extérieur de la ville. Mais ça pourrait se compliquer...
The Feathers Fly Part I#040.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#041.src: A bunch of Corkians aren't too fond of... Us. I just think you should come along with me, y'know?
The Feathers Fly Part I#041.dst: Pas mal de Corkians n'aiment pas trop... les gens comme nous. Je pense juste que tu devrais venir avec moi, tu vois?
The Feathers Fly Part I#041.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#042.src: Here, I wrote the coords into that book of yours. It's a bit far, so come on out and I'll give you a lift!
The Feathers Fly Part I#042.dst: Tiens, j'ai noté les coordonnées dans ton livre. C'est un peu loin, alors sors et je t'emmène!
The Feathers Fly Part I#042.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#043.src: Meet Ava near the Corkian shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part I#043.dst: Retrouvez Ava près de la boutique Corkian en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#044.src: Alright, if you want a lift, tell me, or you could just walk!
The Feathers Fly Part I#044.dst: Bon, si tu veux que je t'emmène, dis-le-moi, sinon tu peux aussi y aller à pied!
The Feathers Fly Part I#044.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#045.src: Not sure why you'd do that when I'm right here though!
The Feathers Fly Part I#045.dst: Mais je ne vois pas pourquoi tu ferais ça, alors que je suis là!
The Feathers Fly Part I#045.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#046.src: Alright, buckle up, we're taking off!
The Feathers Fly Part I#046.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#047.src: Still holding on? We're almost there!
The Feathers Fly Part I#047.dst: Tu tiens toujours? On y est presque!
The Feathers Fly Part I#047.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#048.src: Here we are! Enjoyed the lift? I'm a great form of fast travel, right?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#048.dst: Nous y voilà! Le voyage t'a plu? Je suis un super moyen de voyage rapide, hein?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#048.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#049.src: Well, this was my first time using this magic magnet on people, but...
The Feathers Fly Part I#049.dst: Bon, c'était la première fois que j'utilisais cet aimant magique sur des gens, mais...
The Feathers Fly Part I#049.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#050.src: This is the shop! I think we can buy an Enhanced Potential Microchip here.
The Feathers Fly Part I#050.dst: C'est la boutique! Je crois qu'on peut acheter une Puce à potentiel amélioré ici.
The Feathers Fly Part I#050.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#051.src: I need you to accompany me.
The Feathers Fly Part I#051.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#052.src: If I'm with a human, surely they'll sell one, right?
The Feathers Fly Part I#052.dst: Si je suis avec un humain, ils m'en vendront sûrement une, non?
The Feathers Fly Part I#052.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#053.src: You go first, I'll follow you.
The Feathers Fly Part I#053.dst: Vas-y en premier, je te suis.
The Feathers Fly Part I#053.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#054.src: Or I guess you could just leave, that's cool too...
The Feathers Fly Part I#054.dst: Ou alors tu peux simplement partir, c'est cool aussi...
The Feathers Fly Part I#054.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#055.src: Ah, finally! I could've taken you there y'know!
The Feathers Fly Part I#055.dst: Ah, enfin! J'aurais pu t'y emmener, tu sais!
The Feathers Fly Part I#055.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#056.src: Honestly, I just wanted to test something on you... Oh well!
The Feathers Fly Part I#056.dst: Honnêtement, je voulais juste tester un truc sur toi... Tant pis!
The Feathers Fly Part I#056.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#057.src: This is the shop! I think we can buy an Enhanced Potential Microchip here.
The Feathers Fly Part I#057.dst: C'est la boutique! Je crois qu'on peut acheter une Puce à potentiel amélioré ici.
The Feathers Fly Part I#057.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#058.src: I need you to accompany me.
The Feathers Fly Part I#058.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#059.src: If I'm with a human, surely they'll sell one, right?
The Feathers Fly Part I#059.dst: Si je suis avec un humain, ils m'en vendront sûrement une, non?
The Feathers Fly Part I#059.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#060.src: You go first, I'll follow you.
The Feathers Fly Part I#060.dst: Vas-y en premier, je te suis.
The Feathers Fly Part I#060.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#061.src: Hmpf. What are you doing in here, Avo?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#061.dst: Hmpf. Qu'est-ce que tu fais ici, l'Avo?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#061.speaker: Shopkeeper

The Feathers Fly Part I#063.src: So-uh, I was, y'know, wonderin' if you had any-
The Feathers Fly Part I#063.dst: Donc-euh, je me demandais, tu vois, si vous aviez des-
The Feathers Fly Part I#063.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#066.src: There's NO WAY I'm selling anythin' to an Avo! Shoo! Get out!
The Feathers Fly Part I#066.dst: Il est HORS DE QUESTION que je vende quoi que ce soit à une Avo! Ouste! Dehors!
The Feathers Fly Part I#066.speaker: Shopkeeper

The Feathers Fly Part I#068.dst: Je... n'arrive pas à y croire.
The Feathers Fly Part I#068.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#069.src: I am NOT giving up! To hell with all this!
The Feathers Fly Part I#069.dst: Je n'abandonnerai PAS! Au diable tout ça!
The Feathers Fly Part I#069.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#070.src: Here, go in yourself and ask. I'll cover the cost later.
The Feathers Fly Part I#070.dst: Tiens, entre toi-même et demande. Je te rembourserai plus tard.
The Feathers Fly Part I#070.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#071.src: I'll stand back. CLEARLY this guy is too STUCK up to- Ugh, I'm getting angry! Just go in again.
The Feathers Fly Part I#071.dst: Je reste en retrait. Ce type est CLAIREMENT trop COINCÉ pour- Argh, je m'énerve! Retournes-y.
The Feathers Fly Part I#071.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#072.src: Ask for an Enhanced Microchip at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#073.src: Huh?! I made myself clear! You were with her!
The Feathers Fly Part I#073.dst: Hein?! J'ai été clair! Tu étais avec elle!
The Feathers Fly Part I#073.speaker: Shopkeeper

The Feathers Fly Part I#074.src: I'm closing for today, I cannot stand this! OUT!!
The Feathers Fly Part I#074.dst: Je ferme pour aujourd'hui, je n'en peux plus! DEHORS!!
The Feathers Fly Part I#074.speaker: Shopkeeper

The Feathers Fly Part I#075.src: Oh, and don't even think about even approaching MY shop!
The Feathers Fly Part I#075.dst: Oh, et ne pense même pas à t'approcher de MA boutique!
The Feathers Fly Part I#075.speaker: Shopkeeper

The Feathers Fly Part I#076.src: Find the control panel near the shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part I#076.dst: Trouvez le panneau de commande près de la boutique en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#077.src: So you did come back! Hang tight!
The Feathers Fly Part I#077.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#078.src: Look, we need a plan. Talk to me.
The Feathers Fly Part I#078.dst: Écoute, il nous faut un plan. Parle-moi.
The Feathers Fly Part I#078.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#079.dst: Argh, ce type est cinglé. Hmm...
The Feathers Fly Part I#079.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#080.src: I'm... surprised he kicked you out, too. Maybe he's a patriot?
The Feathers Fly Part I#080.dst: Je suis... surprise qu'il t'ait mis dehors, toi aussi. C'est peut-être un patriote?
The Feathers Fly Part I#080.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#081.src: Well, anyway, we need a plan. I don't wanna wait this out.
The Feathers Fly Part I#081.dst: Bon, bref, il nous faut un plan. J'ai pas envie d'attendre que ça passe.
The Feathers Fly Part I#081.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#082.src: Look, this guy has to have a control panel somewhere. Maybe we can neutralize the robots.
The Feathers Fly Part I#082.dst: Écoute, ce type doit avoir un panneau de commande quelque part. On pourrait neutraliser les robots.
The Feathers Fly Part I#082.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#083.src: That stuff hates water, y'know? So I'll go fetch some in the meantime.
The Feathers Fly Part I#083.dst: Ces machins détestent l'eau, tu vois? Alors je vais en chercher en attendant.
The Feathers Fly Part I#083.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#084.src: I'd like to NOT get zapped by a forcefield, so I'll sneak inside once we're done with that.
The Feathers Fly Part I#084.dst: J'aimerais NE PAS me faire griller par un champ de force, alors je me faufilerai dedans après ça.
The Feathers Fly Part I#084.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#085.src: Got it? Find the control panel. It should be somewhere around the house. Talk to me once you're ready.
The Feathers Fly Part I#085.dst: Compris? Trouve le panneau de commande. Il doit être quelque part autour de la maison. Parle-moi quand tu es prêt.
The Feathers Fly Part I#085.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#086.src: Good luck, then! I'll be back once you find the control panel and get inside!
The Feathers Fly Part I#086.dst: Bonne chance, alors! Je reviens dès que tu as trouvé le panneau et que tu es entré!
The Feathers Fly Part I#086.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#087.src: Here we are! Good job! Alright, let's see...
The Feathers Fly Part I#087.dst: Nous y voilà! Bon travail! Bon, voyons voir...
The Feathers Fly Part I#087.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#088.src: Wait... Why are there... Buttons... Everywhere??
The Feathers Fly Part I#088.dst: Attends... Pourquoi il y a... des boutons... partout??
The Feathers Fly Part I#088.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#089.src: I feel like soaking everything would be quite the mistake.
The Feathers Fly Part I#089.dst: J'ai l'impression que tout tremper serait une sacrée erreur.
The Feathers Fly Part I#089.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#090.src: And none of them are labelled! What is that?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#090.dst: Et aucun n'a d'étiquette! C'est quoi, ce truc?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#090.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#091.src: Look, your choice. What should we neutralize first?
The Feathers Fly Part I#091.dst: Écoute, c'est toi qui choisis. Qu'est-ce qu'on neutralise en premier?
The Feathers Fly Part I#091.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#092.src: Left, huh? Well, let's see how that goes.
The Feathers Fly Part I#092.dst: A gauche, hein? Bon, voyons ce que ça donne.
The Feathers Fly Part I#092.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#095.src: Center... I guess the most important stuff could be here. In theory. I wouldn't count on it.
The Feathers Fly Part I#095.dst: Au centre... J'imagine que le plus important pourrait être ici. En théorie. Je n'y compterais pas trop.
The Feathers Fly Part I#095.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#096.src: Huh! This wasn't that bad. And... I see something poking out, hold on...
The Feathers Fly Part I#096.dst: Tiens! C'était pas si mal. Et... je vois quelque chose qui dépasse, attends...
The Feathers Fly Part I#096.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#097.src: Haha!... Wait, that's not it. Urgh.
The Feathers Fly Part I#097.dst: Haha!... Attends, ce n'est pas ça. Argh.
The Feathers Fly Part I#097.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#098.src: Hey, I'll just give that to you. Though, you probably don't know how to use it, heh!
The Feathers Fly Part I#098.dst: Tiens, je te le donne. Mais tu ne sais sûrement pas t'en servir, hé!
The Feathers Fly Part I#098.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#099.src: Looks like we got another shot. I still have some water left.
The Feathers Fly Part I#099.dst: On dirait qu'on a une autre chance. Il me reste un peu d'eau.
The Feathers Fly Part I#099.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#100.src: Center... I guess the most important stuff could be here. In theory. I wouldn't count on it.
The Feathers Fly Part I#100.dst: Au centre... J'imagine que le plus important pourrait être ici. En théorie. Je n'y compterais pas trop.
The Feathers Fly Part I#100.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#101.src: Huh! This wasn't that bad. And... I see something poking out, hold on...
The Feathers Fly Part I#101.dst: Tiens! C'était pas si mal. Et... je vois quelque chose qui dépasse, attends...
The Feathers Fly Part I#101.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#102.src: Haha! I think that's what we're looking for!
The Feathers Fly Part I#102.dst: Haha! Je crois que c'est ce qu'on cherche!
The Feathers Fly Part I#102.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#103.src: Look, I still want to make it up to the guy. I really don't want to be the villain of his story.
The Feathers Fly Part I#103.dst: Écoute, je veux quand même me faire pardonner par ce type. Je ne veux pas être la méchante de son histoire.
The Feathers Fly Part I#103.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#104.src: I'll meet you back at the Workshop. You can go on ahead.
The Feathers Fly Part I#104.dst: On se retrouve à l'atelier. Tu peux partir devant.
The Feathers Fly Part I#104.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#105.src: Right, right. Stand back, just in case.
The Feathers Fly Part I#105.dst: D'accord, d'accord. Recule, au cas où.
The Feathers Fly Part I#105.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#106.src: Oh wow. You got the right one, first try! How'd you know?
The Feathers Fly Part I#106.dst: Oh, la vache. Le bon du premier coup! Comment tu savais?
The Feathers Fly Part I#106.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#107.src: Well, good job. I still want to make it up to the poor guy though.
The Feathers Fly Part I#107.dst: Bon, bien joué. Mais je veux quand même me faire pardonner auprès de ce pauvre type.
The Feathers Fly Part I#107.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#108.src: Just meet me back at the Workshop, I'll be there!
The Feathers Fly Part I#108.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#109.src: Fight your way out of the shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part I#109.dst: Frayez-vous un chemin hors de la boutique en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#110.src: Meet Ava in the workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#112.src: Sorry about all the trouble I caused... I hope this makes it up to you.
The Feathers Fly Part I#112.dst: Désolée pour tous les ennuis que j'ai causés... J'espère que ça compensera.
The Feathers Fly Part I#112.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#113.src: I hope that human's alright... I managed to find the microchip right away, after all.
The Feathers Fly Part I#113.dst: J'espère que cet humain va bien... Après tout, j'ai trouvé la puce tout de suite.
The Feathers Fly Part I#113.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#114.src: ...Alright. Time to go. I'll wait for them, I guess.
The Feathers Fly Part I#114.dst: ...Bon. Il est temps de partir. Je vais l'attendre, j'imagine.
The Feathers Fly Part I#114.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#116.src: Sorry about all the trouble I caused... I hope this makes it up to you.
The Feathers Fly Part I#116.dst: Désolée pour tous les ennuis que j'ai causés... J'espère que ça compensera.
The Feathers Fly Part I#116.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#118.src: Oh, there you are! I felt sad leaving you behind!
The Feathers Fly Part I#118.dst: Oh, te voilà! J'étais triste de te laisser derrière!
The Feathers Fly Part I#118.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#119.src: Say, if you need a lift, just tell me.
The Feathers Fly Part I#119.dst: Dis, si tu veux que je t'emmène, dis-le-moi.
The Feathers Fly Part I#119.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#121.src: Alright, I'm dropping you off! Stick the landing!
The Feathers Fly Part I#121.dst: Bon, je te dépose ici! Réussis ton atterrissage!
The Feathers Fly Part I#121.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#122.src: I can't believe it! It's working! Look! Look at it!
The Feathers Fly Part I#122.dst: Je n'arrive pas à y croire! Ça marche! Regarde! Regarde-moi ça!
The Feathers Fly Part I#122.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#123.src: A Growth Accelerator... Can you imagine the possibilities?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#123.dst: Un Accélérateur de croissance... Tu imagines les possibilités?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#123.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#124.src: We'll be able to... I don't know, help the poor, that's nice, right?
The Feathers Fly Part I#124.dst: On pourra... je sais pas, aider les pauvres, c'est bien, non?
The Feathers Fly Part I#124.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#125.src: But we're not done. Well, I'm not done. I'd still like your help.
The Feathers Fly Part I#125.dst: Mais on n'a pas fini. Enfin, moi, je n'ai pas fini. J'aimerais encore ton aide.
The Feathers Fly Part I#125.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#126.src: Look, let's try it out together, alright? Maybe I'll let you go afterwards?
The Feathers Fly Part I#126.dst: Écoute, essayons-le ensemble, d'accord? Et après, je te laisserai peut-être partir?
The Feathers Fly Part I#126.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#127.src: I'll join you outside. Once I'm sure this works, I'll be able to... Show it to them.
The Feathers Fly Part I#127.dst: Je te rejoins dehors. Une fois sûre que ça marche, je pourrai... le leur montrer.
The Feathers Fly Part I#127.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#128.src: In theory, it should be easy to operate... I'm trusting you. Again. Sorry 'bout that.
The Feathers Fly Part I#128.dst: En théorie, ça devrait être simple à utiliser... Je te fais confiance. Encore. Désolée pour ça.
The Feathers Fly Part I#128.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#129.src: Meet Ava outside of the Workshop and help her operate her machine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part I#129.dst: Retrouvez Ava devant l'atelier et aidez-la à faire fonctionner sa machine en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#130.src: Alright, it's just on the hill next to us, but I can bring you there if ya want!
The Feathers Fly Part I#130.dst: Bon, c'est juste sur la colline d'à côté, mais je peux t'y emmener si tu veux!
The Feathers Fly Part I#130.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#131.src: Just don't get too used to me, alright? Tell me when you're ready.
The Feathers Fly Part I#131.dst: Mais ne t'habitue pas trop à moi, d'accord? Dis-moi quand tu es prêt.
The Feathers Fly Part I#131.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#133.src: Or I guess you could just leave, that's cool too...
The Feathers Fly Part I#133.dst: Ou alors tu peux simplement partir, c'est cool aussi...
The Feathers Fly Part I#133.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#134.src: Alright, this should be good. Talk to me and I'll explain!
The Feathers Fly Part I#134.dst: Bon, ici, ça devrait aller. Parle-moi et je t'explique!
The Feathers Fly Part I#134.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#135.src: I'll do a quick rundown of how to operate this. It's not automatic yet.
The Feathers Fly Part I#135.dst: Je vais t'expliquer rapidement comment ça marche. Ce n'est pas encore automatique.
The Feathers Fly Part I#135.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#136.src: I'll give you a remote. You'll simply have to click in the right orders. You'll see!
The Feathers Fly Part I#136.dst: Je vais te donner une télécommande. Tu n'auras qu'à cliquer dans le bon ordre. Tu verras!
The Feathers Fly Part I#136.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#137.src: You have to be quick, though! You can't just take all the time you want.
The Feathers Fly Part I#137.dst: Mais il faut faire vite! Tu ne peux pas prendre tout ton temps.
The Feathers Fly Part I#137.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#138.src: I have no clue how stable all of this is, so we'll start slowly!
The Feathers Fly Part I#138.dst: Je n'ai aucune idée de la stabilité de tout ça, alors on commence doucement!
The Feathers Fly Part I#138.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#139.src: I know this sounds a li'l scary, but you've shown yourself being capable.
The Feathers Fly Part I#139.dst: Je sais que ça a l'air un peu effrayant, mais tu as montré de quoi tu es capable.
The Feathers Fly Part I#139.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#140.src: Tell me when you're ready, I'll give you the remote then start the machine!
The Feathers Fly Part I#140.dst: Dis-moi quand tu es prêt, je te donne la télécommande et je lance la machine!
The Feathers Fly Part I#140.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#142.src: Think of it like... Casting one of your spells. You're used to that, right?
The Feathers Fly Part I#142.dst: Vois ça comme... lancer un de tes sorts. Tu as l'habitude, non?
The Feathers Fly Part I#142.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#143.src: Let's start slowly! You have {~} seconds to fully charge it up!
The Feathers Fly Part I#143.dst: On commence doucement! Tu as {~} secondes pour le charger complètement!
The Feathers Fly Part I#143.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#145.dst: Oh là là... Je- C'est pas vrai...
The Feathers Fly Part I#145.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#146.src: Do you have ANY idea what it is we've just done?
The Feathers Fly Part I#146.dst: Tu as la MOINDRE idée de ce qu'on vient de faire?
The Feathers Fly Part I#146.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#147.src: I have to show that to the Chief. They WILL accept me! I cannot fail now!
The Feathers Fly Part I#147.dst: Je dois montrer ça au Chef. Ils VONT m'accepter! Je ne peux pas échouer maintenant!
The Feathers Fly Part I#147.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#148.src: Tell you what, let's meet up at the Chief's hut. If you want me to take you there right now, you can just go ahead and tell me!
The Feathers Fly Part I#148.dst: Écoute, retrouvons-nous à la hutte du Chef. Si tu veux que je t'y emmène tout de suite, tu n'as qu'à me le dire!
The Feathers Fly Part I#148.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#149.src: Operate the machine with Ava for the Avos Chief at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part I#149.dst: Faites fonctionner la machine avec Ava devant le chef des Avos en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#151.src: It really is convenient being with me, huh?
The Feathers Fly Part I#151.dst: C'est vraiment pratique d'être avec moi, hein?
The Feathers Fly Part I#151.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#152.src: On second thought... Isn't it too soon?
The Feathers Fly Part I#152.dst: Réflexion faite... C'est pas trop tôt?
The Feathers Fly Part I#152.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#153.src: I-I think I want to turn back... I...
The Feathers Fly Part I#153.dst: J-je crois que je veux faire demi-tour... Je...
The Feathers Fly Part I#153.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#154.src: You should approach the Chief first. It... won't work if I do it. I'll come by afterwards.
The Feathers Fly Part I#154.dst: Tu devrais aller voir le Chef en premier. Ça... ne marchera pas si c'est moi. Je viendrai après.
The Feathers Fly Part I#154.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#155.src: Ah, human! Welcome back. Good timing...
