The Feathers Fly Part I#155.dst: Ah, humain! Bon retour. Tu tombes bien...
The Feathers Fly Part I#155.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#156.src: Did you happen to see... An oddly dressed Avo around here recently?
The Feathers Fly Part I#156.dst: Aurais-tu vu par hasard... une Avo bizarrement vêtue dans les parages, récemment?
The Feathers Fly Part I#156.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#157.src: We kicked that girl from the tribe, and we do have our reasons.
The Feathers Fly Part I#157.dst: Nous avons chassé cette fille de la tribu, et nous avons nos raisons.
The Feathers Fly Part I#157.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#158.src: I've heard reports of her snooping around recently. With a human, even.
The Feathers Fly Part I#158.dst: On m'a rapporté qu'elle fouinait dans le coin, ces derniers temps. Avec un humain, qui plus est.
The Feathers Fly Part I#158.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#159.src: And I believe... That this is no coincidence you're here.
The Feathers Fly Part I#159.dst: Et je crois... que ce n'est pas un hasard si tu es ici.
The Feathers Fly Part I#159.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#160.src: I will be frank. You're with her, aren't you? I won't hurt you. I won't hurt her either.
The Feathers Fly Part I#160.dst: Je serai franc. Tu es avec elle, n'est-ce pas? Je ne te ferai pas de mal. A elle non plus.
The Feathers Fly Part I#160.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#161.src: She's not exactly welcome here. But she's never told you about that, did she?
The Feathers Fly Part I#161.dst: Elle n'est pas vraiment la bienvenue ici. Mais elle ne t'en a jamais parlé, hein?
The Feathers Fly Part I#161.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#162.src: And I have nothing to hide, Chief.
The Feathers Fly Part I#162.dst: Et je n'ai rien à cacher, Chef.
The Feathers Fly Part I#162.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#163.src: STOP IT, you two! Let her talk!
The Feathers Fly Part I#163.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#164.src: You're all scared of change, and that's all there is to it. Now...
The Feathers Fly Part I#164.dst: Vous avez tous peur du changement, voilà tout. Maintenant...
The Feathers Fly Part I#164.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#166.src: Hmpf. Let's see that broken atrocity of yours.
The Feathers Fly Part I#166.dst: Hmpf. Voyons cette horreur cassée qui est la tienne.
The Feathers Fly Part I#166.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#168.src: This is it. I can't fail now... I really hope I can trust you.
The Feathers Fly Part I#168.dst: C'est le moment. Je ne peux pas échouer... J'espère pouvoir te faire confiance.
The Feathers Fly Part I#168.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#169.src: You have no idea how important this is to me.
The Feathers Fly Part I#169.dst: Tu n'as aucune idée de l'importance que ça a pour moi.
The Feathers Fly Part I#169.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#170.src: It'll be slightly more difficult than last time, so get ready.
The Feathers Fly Part I#170.dst: Ce sera un peu plus difficile que la dernière fois, alors prépare-toi.
The Feathers Fly Part I#170.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#171.src: I'll give you the remote once you're ready!
The Feathers Fly Part I#171.dst: Je te donne la télécommande dès que tu es prêt!
The Feathers Fly Part I#171.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#172.src: Wait, are you sure this isn't dang-
The Feathers Fly Part I#172.dst: Attends, tu es sûre que ce n'est pas dang-
The Feathers Fly Part I#172.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#175.src: Let's just give her a chance for now.
The Feathers Fly Part I#175.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#176.src: Why is she getting away with using such magic?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#176.dst: Pourquoi a-t-elle le droit d'utiliser une telle magie?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#176.speaker: Avos Guard

The Feathers Fly Part I#177.src: Oh I'm gonna charge this sapling like crazy!
The Feathers Fly Part I#177.dst: Oh, je vais charger cette pousse à fond!
The Feathers Fly Part I#177.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#179.src: One last time soldier, and I'm counting on you to be quick!
The Feathers Fly Part I#179.dst: Une dernière fois, soldat, et je compte sur toi pour faire vite!
The Feathers Fly Part I#179.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#182.src: Wait... That's it?? No, this isn't right...
The Feathers Fly Part I#182.dst: Attends... C'est tout?? Non, ça ne va pas...
The Feathers Fly Part I#182.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#185.src: Chief! Have you seen what she just did?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#185.dst: Chef! Vous avez vu ce qu'elle vient de faire?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#185.speaker: Avos Guard

The Feathers Fly Part I#186.src: I-I didn't mean to! I told you to stand back!!
The Feathers Fly Part I#186.dst: J-je ne l'ai pas fait exprès! Je vous avais dit de reculer!!
The Feathers Fly Part I#186.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#187.src: Under normal circumstances, I'd have sent you down the pit after cutting off your feathers.
The Feathers Fly Part I#187.dst: En temps normal, je t'aurais coupé les plumes et jetée dans la fosse.
The Feathers Fly Part I#187.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#188.src: But these are not normal circumstances. Soldier, may you come over here as well?
The Feathers Fly Part I#188.dst: Mais ce n'est pas le cas. Soldat, peux-tu venir ici, toi aussi?
The Feathers Fly Part I#188.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#189.src: Talk to the Avos Chief with Ava at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part I#189.dst: Parlez au chef des Avos avec Ava en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#190.src: So you fused OUR magic... With electromagic?
The Feathers Fly Part I#190.dst: Alors tu as fusionné NOTRE magie... avec l'électromagie?
The Feathers Fly Part I#190.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#191.src: I recognized extracts from the totem too. You're the one who stole from us, right?
The Feathers Fly Part I#191.dst: J'ai aussi reconnu des extraits du totem. C'est toi qui nous as volés, n'est-ce pas?
The Feathers Fly Part I#191.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#192.dst: Il... se peut que ce soit moi.
The Feathers Fly Part I#192.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#193.src: And on top of that, you used the Wynn warrior to fool us?
The Feathers Fly Part I#193.dst: Et en plus, tu t'es servie du guerrier de Wynn pour nous duper?
The Feathers Fly Part I#193.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#194.src: And I'm sure you know why I did!
The Feathers Fly Part I#194.dst: Et je suis sûre que tu sais pourquoi!
The Feathers Fly Part I#194.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#195.src: Do you have any idea how unstable this wretched electromagic is?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#195.dst: As-tu la moindre idée de l'instabilité de cette maudite électromagie?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#195.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#197.src: And you should NOT! Don't you understand? This is too dangerous!
The Feathers Fly Part I#197.dst: Et tu ne DOIS PAS! Tu ne comprends pas? C'est trop dangereux!
The Feathers Fly Part I#197.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#198.src: Should we kill her on the spot?! We almost died!
The Feathers Fly Part I#198.dst: On la tue sur-le-champ?! On a failli mourir!
The Feathers Fly Part I#198.speaker: Avos Guard

The Feathers Fly Part I#199.src: No, don't kill her. I want her and the soldier in my hut, now.
The Feathers Fly Part I#199.dst: Non, ne la tuez pas. Je les veux, elle et le soldat, dans ma hutte. Tout de suite.
The Feathers Fly Part I#199.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#200.src: Ava. You can't keep going with this. Just stop. This is your final warning.
The Feathers Fly Part I#200.dst: Ava. Tu ne peux pas continuer comme ça. Arrête. C'est ton dernier avertissement.
The Feathers Fly Part I#200.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#201.src: What do you even hope to accomplish? You used to be such a brilliant kid.
The Feathers Fly Part I#201.dst: Qu'espères-tu accomplir, au juste? Tu étais une enfant si brillante.
The Feathers Fly Part I#201.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#202.src: I just... wanna help people. You know that, I'm sure you understand!
The Feathers Fly Part I#202.dst: Je veux juste... aider les gens. Tu le sais, je suis sûre que tu comprends!
The Feathers Fly Part I#202.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#203.src: Have you seen the Factory? They tried to help people, and instead they killed hundreds!
The Feathers Fly Part I#203.dst: Tu as vu l'Usine? Ils voulaient aider les gens, et au lieu de ça, ils en ont tué des centaines!
The Feathers Fly Part I#203.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#204.src: Do you think you're able change the world?! Well, you can't, Ava! This is beyond you!
The Feathers Fly Part I#204.dst: Tu crois pouvoir changer le monde?! Eh bien, non, Ava! Ça te dépasse!
The Feathers Fly Part I#204.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#205.src: So, for the last time. Stop all of this. I might reconsider your banishment then.
The Feathers Fly Part I#205.dst: Alors, pour la dernière fois. Arrête tout ça. Je pourrais alors reconsidérer ton bannissement.
The Feathers Fly Part I#205.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#206.src: You... You're really serious about that, huh? You'll NEVER change, will you?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#206.dst: Tu... Tu es vraiment sérieux, hein? Vous ne changerez JAMAIS, pas vrai?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#206.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#207.src: Do you guys have ANY idea how archaic you all are?! A "final warning"??
The Feathers Fly Part I#207.dst: Vous avez la MOINDRE idée d'à quel point vous êtes archaïques?! Un "dernier avertissement"??
The Feathers Fly Part I#207.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#208.src: I can't believe you worked with her, soldier. Well, now you know to avoid her.
The Feathers Fly Part I#208.dst: Je n'en reviens pas que tu aies aidé Ava, soldat. Enfin, maintenant, tu sais qu'il faut l'éviter.
The Feathers Fly Part I#208.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#209.src: ...It appears she left some device on the floor. You might as well take them, I sure don't want it. And here, take these. We haven't had the chance to thank you regarding the Factory.
The Feathers Fly Part I#209.dst: ...On dirait qu'elle a laissé un appareil par terre. Autant que tu le prennes, moi, je n'en veux certainement pas. Et tiens, prends ceci. Nous n'avons pas eu l'occasion de te remercier pour l'Usine.
The Feathers Fly Part I#209.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#211.src: Looks like Ava left. She probably went back to the Workshop.
The Feathers Fly Part I#211.dst: On dirait qu'Ava est partie. Elle est sûrement retournée à l'atelier.

The Feathers Fly Part I#213.dst: Tiens bon! Il est devenu fou!
The Feathers Fly Part I#213.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#215.src: Looks like Ava is waiting for you in the square south from here. Maybe she'll give you a lift?
The Feathers Fly Part I#215.dst: On dirait qu'Ava t'attend sur la place au sud d'ici. Elle t'emmènera peut-être?

The Feathers Fly Part I#216.src: (!) Don't aim directly at a block when Left-Clicking!
The Feathers Fly Part I#216.dst: (!) Ne visez pas directement un bloc en faisant un clic gauche!

The Feathers Fly Part I#217.src: Oh no, time's up! It was supposed to be easy... Hold on, I'm booting it up again.
The Feathers Fly Part I#217.dst: Oh non, le temps est écoulé! C'était censé être facile... Attends, je la relance.
The Feathers Fly Part I#217.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#218.src: Oh, you're back! Talk to me so we can get started!
The Feathers Fly Part I#218.dst: Oh, te revoilà! Parle-moi pour qu'on commence!
The Feathers Fly Part I#218.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#219.src: Hey, it happens to the best of us!
The Feathers Fly Part I#219.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#220.src: It's fine, the machine isn't at full power, it won't explode or anything.
The Feathers Fly Part I#220.dst: Pas de souci, la machine n'est pas à pleine puissance, elle ne va pas exploser ni rien.
The Feathers Fly Part I#220.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#221.src: Just tell me when you're ready!
The Feathers Fly Part I#221.dst: Dis-moi juste quand tu es prêt!
The Feathers Fly Part I#221.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#222.src: Gah! If I can't get myself to do it now, I'll never do it!
The Feathers Fly Part I#222.dst: Argh! Si je ne me force pas à le faire maintenant, je ne le ferai jamais!
The Feathers Fly Part I#222.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#225.src: To hell with this! I'll show everyone! I'll show how great we could be! You'll see, chief!
The Feathers Fly Part I#225.dst: Au diable tout ça! Je vais leur montrer! Je vais montrer à quel point on pourrait être grands! Tu verras, Chef!
The Feathers Fly Part I#225.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#226.src: New Questline Started: The Feathers Fly
The Feathers Fly Part I#226.dst: Nouvelle série de quêtes: Les plumes volent

The Feathers Fly Part I#229.dst: [!] Séquence de téléportation de secours activée!

The Feathers Fly Part I#230.src: Ava didn't get teleported with you! You're on your own!
The Feathers Fly Part I#230.dst: Ava n'a pas été téléportée avec toi! Tu dois te débrouiller sans elle!

The Feathers Fly Part I#231.src: Oh god, no- Let me boot up the machine again...
The Feathers Fly Part I#231.dst: Oh non, non- Je relance la machine...
The Feathers Fly Part I#231.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#233.src: We'll, uh, act as if nothing happened.
The Feathers Fly Part I#233.dst: On va, euh, faire comme si de rien n'était.
The Feathers Fly Part I#233.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#235.src: 't would've been too good to be true, right?
The Feathers Fly Part I#235.dst: Ç'aurait été trop beau pour être vrai, hein?
The Feathers Fly Part I#235.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#236.src: I hope you know what you're doing.
The Feathers Fly Part I#236.dst: J'espère que tu sais ce que tu fais.
The Feathers Fly Part I#236.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#237.src: For all we know, it might predate your corruption too!
The Feathers Fly Part I#237.dst: Pour ce qu'on en sait, elle est peut-être même antérieure à votre Corruption!
The Feathers Fly Part I#237.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part II#001.src: Oh... So you showed up! I'm glad, I really am!
The Feathers Fly Part II#001.dst: Oh... Alors tu es là! Je suis contente, vraiment!
The Feathers Fly Part II#001.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#002.src: It's time for me to show the Growth Accelerator to the Corkians.
The Feathers Fly Part II#002.dst: Il est temps pour moi de montrer l'Accélérateur de croissance aux Corkians.
The Feathers Fly Part II#002.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#003.src: Look, this time I'll really try and reward you well, alright?
The Feathers Fly Part II#003.dst: Écoute, cette fois, je vais vraiment essayer de bien te récompenser, d'accord?
The Feathers Fly Part II#003.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#004.src: Anyway! I have a plan. You see, I definitely can't easily get in the city.
The Feathers Fly Part II#004.dst: Bref! J'ai un plan. Tu vois, je ne peux vraiment pas entrer facilement dans la ville.
The Feathers Fly Part II#004.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#005.src: The Corkians have a council where they deal with their issues. We can try getting an audience.
The Feathers Fly Part II#005.dst: Les Corkians ont un Conseil qui règle leurs affaires. On peut essayer d'obtenir une audience.
The Feathers Fly Part II#005.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#006.src: I know a way for me to get in the city. That's where you come in! There are some sentries to take care of.
The Feathers Fly Part II#006.dst: Je connais un moyen d'entrer dans la ville. C'est là que tu interviens! Il y a des sentinelles à neutraliser.
The Feathers Fly Part II#006.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#007.src: They're really old models though, somehow. I'll give you a jammer I made for this. Right-Click a robot to use it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#007.dst: Ce sont de très vieux modèles, bizarrement. Je vais te donner un brouilleur que j'ai fabriqué. Clic droit sur un robot pour l'utiliser!
The Feathers Fly Part II#007.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#008.src: Once you jam one robot, you'll have to jam all others within {~} seconds! So try to plan ahead and locate them all before jamming one!
The Feathers Fly Part II#008.dst: Dès que tu brouilles un robot, tu dois brouiller tous les autres en {~} secondes! Alors repère-les tous avant d'en brouiller un!
The Feathers Fly Part II#008.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#009.src: Tell me once you're ready. I'll throw you in there. I'll join you afterwards. You'll see!
The Feathers Fly Part II#009.dst: Dis-moi quand tu es prêt. Je vais te lancer là-dedans. Je te rejoindrai après. Tu verras!
The Feathers Fly Part II#009.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#010.src: Well then, first off, take this!
The Feathers Fly Part II#010.dst: Bon, alors, pour commencer, prends ça!
The Feathers Fly Part II#010.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#011.src: Now, just stand still... I gotta try something on you...
The Feathers Fly Part II#011.dst: Maintenant, ne bouge plus... Je dois tester un truc sur toi...
The Feathers Fly Part II#011.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#012.src: Locate and jam all the robot sentries near the Corkus Clocktower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] within {~} seconds
The Feathers Fly Part II#012.dst: Repérez et brouillez toutes les sentinelles robots près de la tour de l'horloge de Corkus en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] en moins de {~} secondes

The Feathers Fly Part II#014.src: Thanks! These robots were harmless but hey, better safe than sorry right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#014.dst: Merci! Ces robots étaient inoffensifs, mais bon, mieux vaut prévenir que guérir, non?
The Feathers Fly Part II#014.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#015.src: Anyway, we need to get ready to meet the Corkian Council.
The Feathers Fly Part II#015.dst: Bref, il faut se préparer à rencontrer le Conseil Corkian.
The Feathers Fly Part II#015.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#016.src: And I think... I need a disguise. I don't like hiding myself, but I don't have a choice.
The Feathers Fly Part II#016.dst: Et je crois... qu'il me faut un déguisement. Je n'aime pas me cacher, mais je n'ai pas le choix.
The Feathers Fly Part II#016.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#017.src: Thanks to some plans I got, I know where to find some. Follow me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#017.dst: Grâce à des plans que j'ai récupérés, je sais où en trouver. Suis-moi!
The Feathers Fly Part II#017.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#018.src: Here we are! I'm pretty sure we can find some outfits in there.
The Feathers Fly Part II#018.dst: Nous y voilà! Je suis presque sûre qu'on trouvera des tenues là-dedans.
The Feathers Fly Part II#018.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#019.src: I'll stand here to quickly hide in case anyone comes.
The Feathers Fly Part II#019.dst: Je reste ici pour pouvoir me cacher vite si quelqu'un arrive.
The Feathers Fly Part II#019.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#020.src: Just look around, and come back with what you think looks better!
The Feathers Fly Part II#020.dst: Jette un oeil, et reviens avec ce qui te semble le mieux!
The Feathers Fly Part II#020.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#021.src: Yeah, I am letting you choose my outfit. Aren't you lucky? Go and get me the fanciest clothes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#021.dst: Eh oui, je te laisse choisir ma tenue. T'as de la chance, hein? Va me chercher les vêtements les plus chics!
The Feathers Fly Part II#021.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#022.src: Pick an outfit to fit in with the Corkians and bring it to Ava at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part II#022.dst: Choisissez une tenue pour passer inaperçu parmi les Corkians et apportez-la à Ava en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#023.src: I'm trusting you. We Avos aren't exactly into... Fashion. Then again, they're not into Electromagic either, so what do I know.
The Feathers Fly Part II#023.dst: Je te fais confiance. Nous, les Avos, on n'est pas trop... mode. Remarque, eux ne sont pas trop électromagie non plus, alors qu'est-ce que j'en sais.
The Feathers Fly Part II#023.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#026.src: I feel like... I'm about to go to work.
The Feathers Fly Part II#026.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#027.src: At the very least, I'll probably blend in very well!
The Feathers Fly Part II#027.dst: Au moins, je vais sûrement passer inaperçue!
The Feathers Fly Part II#027.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#028.src: Now, I'm gonna be completely honest about this, so don't panic, but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#028.dst: Bon, je vais être parfaitement honnête, alors ne panique pas, mais...
The Feathers Fly Part II#028.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#029.src: I have... absolutely NO idea how we could even get an audience.
The Feathers Fly Part II#029.dst: Je n'ai... absolument AUCUNE idée de comment obtenir une audience.
The Feathers Fly Part II#029.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#030.src: I think we need to split up and try to find out how to get one from the Council.
The Feathers Fly Part II#030.dst: Je pense qu'on doit se séparer et trouver comment en obtenir une auprès du Conseil.
The Feathers Fly Part II#030.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#031.src: I'll be around the town center if ya need me for anything! I'll ask around. You should too!
The Feathers Fly Part II#031.dst: Je serai vers le centre-ville si tu as besoin de moi! Je vais me renseigner. Tu devrais en faire autant!
The Feathers Fly Part II#031.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#032.src: One last thing, though... Sorry if that's a little weird but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#032.dst: Une dernière chose, quand même... Désolée si c'est un peu bizarre, mais...
The Feathers Fly Part II#032.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#034.src: {u}, huh? That's... A nice name. Well, good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#034.dst: {u}, hein? C'est... un joli nom. Bon, bonne chance!
The Feathers Fly Part II#034.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#037.src: I've already seen plenty of green in my lifetime, y'know.
The Feathers Fly Part II#037.dst: J'ai déjà vu bien assez de vert dans ma vie, tu sais.
The Feathers Fly Part II#037.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#038.src: Well, I know you folks sure do love money. Maybe we can get noticed with this...
The Feathers Fly Part II#038.dst: Bon, je sais que vous adorez l'argent, vous autres. Ça pourrait attirer l'attention...
The Feathers Fly Part II#038.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#039.src: Hmm... You know, this could actually work!
The Feathers Fly Part II#039.dst: Hmm... Tu sais, ça pourrait marcher!
The Feathers Fly Part II#039.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#040.src: I have no idea how this audience thing works, but I could try to get people to notice me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#040.dst: Je ne sais pas du tout comment marchent ces audiences, mais je pourrais essayer de me faire remarquer!
The Feathers Fly Part II#040.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#041.src: Well, we should split up and meet up later to see what information we have. Just ask around town!
The Feathers Fly Part II#041.dst: Bon, on devrait se séparer et se retrouver plus tard pour voir ce qu'on a appris. Renseigne-toi en ville!
The Feathers Fly Part II#041.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#042.src: I'll be around the town center if ya got any information!
The Feathers Fly Part II#042.dst: Je serai vers le centre-ville si tu as des infos!
The Feathers Fly Part II#042.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#043.src: One last thing, though... Sorry if thats a little weird but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#043.dst: Une dernière chose, quand même... Désolée si c'est un peu bizarre, mais...
The Feathers Fly Part II#043.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#048.src: Ya got good taste! I always wanted to explore the ocean, y'know?
The Feathers Fly Part II#048.dst: T'as bon goût! J'ai toujours voulu explorer l'océan, tu sais?
The Feathers Fly Part II#048.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#049.src: Hey, thanks for helping me out so much. You've been such a huge help!
The Feathers Fly Part II#049.dst: Hé, merci de m'aider autant. Tu m'as vraiment été d'une grande aide!
The Feathers Fly Part II#049.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#050.src: Well, this isn't over, of course. And to tell you the truth...
The Feathers Fly Part II#050.dst: Bon, ce n'est pas fini, bien sûr. Et à vrai dire...
The Feathers Fly Part II#050.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#051.src: I, uh, have no idea how to get an audience... Sorry?
The Feathers Fly Part II#051.dst: Je n'ai, euh, aucune idée de comment obtenir une audience... Désolée?
The Feathers Fly Part II#051.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#052.src: I think we need to split up and try to find out how to get one.
The Feathers Fly Part II#052.dst: Je pense qu'on doit se séparer et trouver comment en obtenir une.
The Feathers Fly Part II#052.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#053.src: I'll be around the town center if ya need me for anything!
The Feathers Fly Part II#053.dst: Je serai vers le centre-ville si tu as besoin de moi!
The Feathers Fly Part II#053.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#057.src: Oh, and check this mask out! Time to be Ava the human!
The Feathers Fly Part II#057.dst: Oh, et regarde ce masque! Place à Ava l'humaine!
The Feathers Fly Part II#057.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#059.src: I feel like... I'm not even supposed to be wearing this.
The Feathers Fly Part II#059.dst: J'ai l'impression... que je ne suis même pas censée porter ça.
The Feathers Fly Part II#059.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#060.src: This looks... Really, really cool though! ...Wait, where did you even find this?
The Feathers Fly Part II#060.dst: Mais ça a l'air... vraiment, vraiment cool! ...Attends, où est-ce que tu as trouvé ça?
The Feathers Fly Part II#060.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#061.src: I saw this dog, and... Well, that's besides the point. You'll tell me later!
The Feathers Fly Part II#061.dst: J'ai vu ce chien, et... Bon, là n'est pas la question. Tu me raconteras plus tard!
The Feathers Fly Part II#061.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#062.src: Look, this audience thing is foreign to me but I feel like it won't really be an issue with this... thing.
The Feathers Fly Part II#062.dst: Écoute, ces histoires d'audience, c'est du chinois pour moi, mais avec ce... truc, ça ne devrait pas poser problème.
The Feathers Fly Part II#062.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#063.src: Well, we still need information on who to even talk to for that stuff... I'll ask around.
The Feathers Fly Part II#063.dst: Bon, il faut encore savoir à qui parler pour ce genre de chose... Je vais me renseigner.
The Feathers Fly Part II#063.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#064.src: You should too! I'll be around the town center! Come by once you got enough information!
The Feathers Fly Part II#064.dst: Tu devrais en faire autant! Je serai vers le centre-ville! Passe me voir quand tu auras assez d'infos!
The Feathers Fly Part II#064.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#068.src: Ask around {p} for a way to get an audience with the Council. Ava is at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part II#068.dst: Renseignez-vous dans {p} pour obtenir une audience auprès du Conseil. Ava se trouve en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#069.dst: Oh, hé! J'ai trouvé quelque chose!!
The Feathers Fly Part II#069.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#070.src: Alright, so it's not really on the legal side of things, BUT apparently...
The Feathers Fly Part II#070.dst: Bon, ce n'est pas vraiment légal, MAIS apparemment...
The Feathers Fly Part II#070.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#071.src: There's some sort of... Shady dealer you can buy an audience invitation from?
The Feathers Fly Part II#071.dst: Il y a une sorte de... trafiquant louche qui vend des invitations à une audience?
The Feathers Fly Part II#071.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#072.src: I'm sure there are other ways, but the dude should be in the castle to the east, first door to the left.
The Feathers Fly Part II#072.dst: Il y a sûrement d'autres moyens, mais le type devrait être dans le château à l'est, première porte à gauche.
The Feathers Fly Part II#072.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#073.src: Do with that what you will. I guess I'll... Keep looking.
The Feathers Fly Part II#073.dst: Fais-en ce que tu veux. Moi, je vais... continuer à chercher, j'imagine.
The Feathers Fly Part II#073.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#074.src: An audience? Oh, you're one of those, I see...
The Feathers Fly Part II#074.dst: Une audience? Oh, tu es de ceux-là, je vois...
The Feathers Fly Part II#074.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#075.src: Yeah yeah, just go through the castle right there and you'll reach the receptionist.
The Feathers Fly Part II#075.dst: Ouais, ouais, traverse le château juste là et tu arriveras à la réceptionniste.
The Feathers Fly Part II#075.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#076.src: The chances you get one are really slim. You'd have more luck stealing the invitation from someone, heh!
The Feathers Fly Part II#076.dst: Tes chances d'en obtenir une sont vraiment minces. Tu aurais plus de chance en volant l'invitation de quelqu'un, hé!
The Feathers Fly Part II#076.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#077.src: Speaking of which... I think that actually just happened an hour ago on the opposite side of town.
The Feathers Fly Part II#077.dst: D'ailleurs... je crois que c'est justement arrivé il y a une heure, à l'autre bout de la ville.
The Feathers Fly Part II#077.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#078.src: Maybe you can help whoever lost their invitation. Maybe you can steal it. I'm not the boss of you! Now, shoo! Don't step on my plants!
The Feathers Fly Part II#078.dst: Tu pourrais aider celui qui a perdu son invitation. Ou la lui voler. Je ne suis pas ton patron! Allez, ouste! Ne marche pas sur mes plantes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#078.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#079.dst: ...Hein? Une audience? T'as perdu la tête?
The Feathers Fly Part II#079.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#080.src: I mean, yeah, anyone can try getting one...
The Feathers Fly Part II#080.dst: Enfin, ouais, n'importe qui peut essayer d'en obtenir une...
The Feathers Fly Part II#080.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#081.src: You have to be real impressive though. Like, I don't wanna be mean, but you ain't gonna cut it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#081.dst: Mais faut être vraiment impressionnant. Genre, je veux pas être méchant, mais t'as pas le niveau.
The Feathers Fly Part II#081.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#082.src: If you really want to, the receptionist is in the castle. Just go east and don't stop.
The Feathers Fly Part II#082.dst: Si tu y tiens vraiment, la réceptionniste est dans le château. Va vers l'est et ne t'arrête pas.
The Feathers Fly Part II#082.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#083.src: Lemme tell ya though, with all the crazy lads goin' in, she's never in a good mood.
The Feathers Fly Part II#083.dst: Mais j'te préviens, avec tous les cinglés qui entrent, elle est jamais de bonne humeur.
The Feathers Fly Part II#083.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#084.src: Oh, hi there. Whatcha lookin' for? ...An audience? What?
The Feathers Fly Part II#084.dst: Oh, salut. Tu cherches quoi? ...Une audience? Quoi?
The Feathers Fly Part II#084.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#085.src: Urgh... Let me guess what your machine is. Is it a weapon? What does it shoot? Sand?
The Feathers Fly Part II#085.dst: Pff... Laisse-moi deviner ce qu'est ta machine. C'est une arme? Elle tire quoi? Du sable?
The Feathers Fly Part II#085.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#086.src: Sorry, it's just a li'l annoying. If you really want an audience, there is a receptionist for that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#086.dst: Désolé, c'est juste un peu agaçant. Si tu veux vraiment une audience, il y a une réceptionniste pour ça.
The Feathers Fly Part II#086.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#087.src: Ask others. I ain't the one for that kind of stuff.
The Feathers Fly Part II#087.dst: Demande à d'autres. C'est pas moi qui m'occupe de ce genre de trucs.
The Feathers Fly Part II#087.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#088.src: Oh, are you interested in getting an audience too?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#088.dst: Oh, toi aussi, tu veux obtenir une audience?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#088.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#089.src: I've been forgin' away the greatest robotized swords the world shall ever see!
The Feathers Fly Part II#089.dst: J'ai forgé les plus grandes épées robotisées que le monde verra jamais!
The Feathers Fly Part II#089.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#090.src: Look, ya gotta go up to the receptionist and impress her like crazy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#090.dst: Écoute, faut que t'ailles voir la réceptionniste et que tu l'épates à fond!
The Feathers Fly Part II#090.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#091.src: It's great! Worst-case scenario, you die, but with enough luck only your arm gets broken!
The Feathers Fly Part II#091.dst: C'est génial! Au pire, tu meurs, mais avec un peu de chance, tu te casses juste le bras!
The Feathers Fly Part II#091.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#092.src: She's inside the castle to the east, just go through and keep walkin', you'll get there eventually!
The Feathers Fly Part II#092.dst: Elle est dans le château à l'est, traverse et continue à marcher, tu finiras par y arriver!
The Feathers Fly Part II#092.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#093.src: Hey, what's up? I do have somethin'!
The Feathers Fly Part II#093.dst: Hé, quoi de neuf? Moi, j'ai trouvé un truc!
The Feathers Fly Part II#093.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#094.src: Hmm... So we can go see a receptionist and they just might grant us an audience. Got it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#094.dst: Hmm... Donc on peut aller voir une réceptionniste, et elle pourrait nous accorder une audience. Compris!
The Feathers Fly Part II#094.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#095.src: So we go in, show her how cool we are, and I guess that'd work, huh?
The Feathers Fly Part II#095.dst: Alors on entre, on lui montre à quel point on est géniaux, et ça devrait marcher, hein?
The Feathers Fly Part II#095.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#096.src: That's fine, I'm sure you just have to show her your resolve or something.
The Feathers Fly Part II#096.dst: Pas grave, il suffit sûrement de lui montrer ta détermination ou un truc comme ça.
The Feathers Fly Part II#096.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#097.src: Oh, right, I had something too!
The Feathers Fly Part II#097.dst: Ah oui, moi aussi j'avais un truc!
The Feathers Fly Part II#097.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#098.src: There's apparently some sort of shady dude selling audience invitations!
The Feathers Fly Part II#098.dst: Il paraît qu'un type louche vend des invitations à des audiences!
The Feathers Fly Part II#098.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#099.src: I believe it's in the castle to the east, on the first left? Though...
The Feathers Fly Part II#099.dst: Je crois que c'est dans le château à l'est, première à gauche? Mais...
The Feathers Fly Part II#099.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#100.src: I'm sure there are other ways to go about this. Like that receptionist, for one! So she's in the last room of the castle, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#100.dst: Il y a sûrement d'autres moyens. Cette réceptionniste, par exemple! Elle est dans la dernière salle du château, c'est ça?
The Feathers Fly Part II#100.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#101.src: In fact, if you want me to follow you there, I can do that! Just tell me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#101.dst: D'ailleurs, si tu veux que je t'accompagne là-bas, je peux! Dis-le-moi!
The Feathers Fly Part II#101.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#102.dst: Bon, bonne chance pour tes recherches!
The Feathers Fly Part II#102.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#103.src: Hey kid. An audience, huh? Eheheh... I do have an idea...
The Feathers Fly Part II#103.dst: Hé, gamin. Une audience, hein? Héhéhé... J'ai bien une idée...
The Feathers Fly Part II#103.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#104.src: Y'know, it's hard to get one... Reeeaaal hard... But I know a way.
The Feathers Fly Part II#104.dst: Tu sais, c'est dur d'en avoir une... Vraaaiment dur... Mais je connais un moyen.
The Feathers Fly Part II#104.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#105.src: It's really, really simple... Ya just gotta hand me [{~} Emerald Blocks] and I'll work it out!
The Feathers Fly Part II#105.dst: C'est vraiment, vraiment simple... Tu me files [{~} blocs d'émeraude] et je m'occupe du reste!
The Feathers Fly Part II#105.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#106.src: ...eheheh... Well, you know where to find me if you're up to it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#106.dst: ...héhéhé... Bon, tu sais où me trouver si ça te tente!
The Feathers Fly Part II#106.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#107.src: So you found that weird dealer? Surely you're not thinking of...
The Feathers Fly Part II#107.dst: Alors tu as trouvé ce drôle de vendeur? Tu ne penses quand même pas à...
The Feathers Fly Part II#107.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#108.src: I mean... Actually, that'd be a way to get an audience, for sure. What does he want?
The Feathers Fly Part II#108.dst: Enfin... En vrai, ce serait un moyen d'avoir une audience, c'est sûr. Il veut quoi?
The Feathers Fly Part II#108.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#109.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks]? Is that a lot? I'm not human, y'know! Well, anyway!
The Feathers Fly Part II#109.dst: [{~} blocs d'émeraude]? C'est beaucoup? Je suis pas humaine, moi! Bref!
The Feathers Fly Part II#109.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#110.src: Buy that if you want, but I'm certain there are other ways to obtain an audience. You don't really have to buy that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#110.dst: Achète-le si tu veux, mais je suis sûre qu'il y a d'autres moyens d'avoir une audience. Pas besoin de payer.
The Feathers Fly Part II#110.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#111.src: Well, I'll just... Keep looking then.
The Feathers Fly Part II#111.dst: Bon, je vais... continuer à chercher.
The Feathers Fly Part II#111.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#112.src: Why thank you! 't was a pleasure doing business with you keheh... Good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#112.dst: Eh bien merci! Un plaisir de faire affaire avec toi, héhé... Bonne chance!
The Feathers Fly Part II#112.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#114.src: Seriously what is it with you people! Can't I be left alone for FIVE MINUTES?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#114.dst: Sérieux, qu'est-ce que vous avez tous?! On peut pas me laisser tranquille CINQ MINUTES?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#114.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#115.src: Oh excuuuuse me, did someone tell you to come here? Are you going to "impress" me?
The Feathers Fly Part II#115.dst: Oh, excuuuusez-moi, quelqu'un t'a dit de venir? Tu vas m'"impressionner"?
The Feathers Fly Part II#115.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#116.src: Well, let me tell ya', you FAILED.
The Feathers Fly Part II#116.dst: Eh bien, je vais te dire: tu as ÉCHOUÉ.
The Feathers Fly Part II#116.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#117.src: Come back when you actually have something of interest. Goodbye.
The Feathers Fly Part II#117.dst: Reviens quand tu auras vraiment quelque chose d'intéressant. Au revoir.
The Feathers Fly Part II#117.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#118.src: Oh? You found the dealer as well as one other way to get an audience?
The Feathers Fly Part II#118.dst: Oh? Tu as trouvé le vendeur et aussi un autre moyen d'avoir une audience?
The Feathers Fly Part II#118.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#119.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks], huh? No clue if that's a lot. I'd say we should try your other way! What is it?
The Feathers Fly Part II#119.dst: [{~} blocs d'émeraude], hein? Aucune idée si c'est beaucoup. Je dirais qu'on tente ton autre idée! C'est quoi?
The Feathers Fly Part II#119.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#120.src: There's a receptionist for audiences? How convenient! We should go talk to her then!
The Feathers Fly Part II#120.dst: Il y a une réceptionniste pour les audiences? Pratique! Allons lui parler!
The Feathers Fly Part II#120.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#121.src: It's... Apparently really hard? Oh... Well, that's not helpful. Maybe we can still give it a go?
The Feathers Fly Part II#121.dst: C'est... apparemment très difficile? Oh... Ça n'aide pas. On peut quand même tenter le coup?
The Feathers Fly Part II#121.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#122.src: Buy from that weird dealer if ya want, but we also should try to go see that receptionist. Tell me if you want me to follow you there.
The Feathers Fly Part II#122.dst: Achète au drôle de vendeur si tu veux, mais on devrait aussi aller voir la réceptionniste. Dis-moi si tu veux que je t'accompagne.
The Feathers Fly Part II#122.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#123.src: Alright, let's go then. I'd say we should avoid the dealer, I definitely don't want to get on the bad side of the law!
The Feathers Fly Part II#123.dst: Bon, allons-y. Je dirais qu'on évite le vendeur, je ne veux surtout pas d'ennuis avec la loi!
The Feathers Fly Part II#123.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#124.src: So, that dealer is in there, huh? Let's make sure to keep going. And avoid that place.
The Feathers Fly Part II#124.dst: Alors le vendeur est là-dedans, hein? Continuons. Et évitons cet endroit.
The Feathers Fly Part II#124.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#125.src: Wait wait wait what did I just tell yo- I'll just make myself small...
The Feathers Fly Part II#125.dst: Attends attends attends, je viens de te di- Je vais me faire toute petite...
The Feathers Fly Part II#125.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#126.src: 'ey, it's [{~} Emerald Blocks] or nothin'! Don't worry, I can get you two an audience! Your lady's quite shy I see! Believe me, I understand your struggle!
The Feathers Fly Part II#126.dst: Hé, c'est [{~} blocs d'émeraude] ou rien! T'inquiète, je peux vous avoir une audience à tous les deux! Ta dame est bien timide, je vois! Crois-moi, je comprends ta galère!
The Feathers Fly Part II#126.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#130.src: And just WHO are you two, busting here like that?
The Feathers Fly Part II#130.dst: Et QUI êtes-vous, tous les deux, pour débarquer comme ça?
The Feathers Fly Part II#130.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#131.src: Uh... Greetings... We've heard that we should come here for-
The Feathers Fly Part II#131.dst: Euh... Bonjour... On nous a dit de venir ici pour-
The Feathers Fly Part II#131.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#132.src: Do you have ANYTHING to show? Shouldn't you be working at that time?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#132.dst: Vous avez QUOI à montrer? Vous ne devriez pas être au boulot, à cette heure?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#132.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#133.src: No, it's just that I, well... Nevermind, I do have a thing to show, it's, uh...
The Feathers Fly Part II#133.dst: Non, c'est juste que, enfin... Laissez tomber, j'ai bien un truc à montrer, c'est, euh...
The Feathers Fly Part II#133.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#134.src: Not ANOTHER word! I've heard enough! You two clearly don't have anything worth my time!
The Feathers Fly Part II#134.dst: Pas UN mot de plus! J'en ai assez entendu! Vous n'avez clairement rien qui vaille mon temps!
The Feathers Fly Part II#134.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#135.src: Go back to your minimum wage job or something, but stay OUT of my room.
The Feathers Fly Part II#135.dst: Retournez à votre boulot au salaire minimum, mais restez HORS de ma salle.
The Feathers Fly Part II#135.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#136.src: The citizens said it was hard, huh? No kidding. Maybe we should've had something before strolling in.
The Feathers Fly Part II#136.dst: Les habitants disaient que c'était dur, hein? Tu m'étonnes. On aurait dû avoir quelque chose avant de débarquer.
The Feathers Fly Part II#136.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#137.src: Look, we'll figure out another approach. This can't end here! We need an audience invitation letter.
The Feathers Fly Part II#137.dst: Écoute, on trouvera une autre approche. Ça ne peut pas s'arrêter là! Il nous faut une lettre d'invitation à l'audience.
The Feathers Fly Part II#137.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#138.src: I'll head back to the town center, so if you want to talk I'll see ya there!
The Feathers Fly Part II#138.dst: Je retourne au centre-ville, si tu veux parler, on se voit là-bas!
The Feathers Fly Part II#138.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#139.src: That certainly didn't go well. But keep your head up! We got this!
The Feathers Fly Part II#139.dst: Ça ne s'est vraiment pas bien passé. Mais garde la tête haute! On va y arriver!
The Feathers Fly Part II#139.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#140.src: There was a normal way to get an audience which is via a competition. We... missed it. So that'll have to pass.
The Feathers Fly Part II#140.dst: Il y avait un moyen normal d'avoir une audience: un concours. On l'a... raté. Donc on oublie.
The Feathers Fly Part II#140.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#141.src: Now, for other... Unconventional ways... There was some panic by the Armour Merchant earlier today.
The Feathers Fly Part II#141.dst: Quant aux autres moyens... moins orthodoxes... Ça a paniqué près du marchand d'armures aujourd'hui.
The Feathers Fly Part II#141.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#142.src: Check it out if you want, I won't cause trouble. I'd rather be the friendly neighbourhood mechanic!
The Feathers Fly Part II#142.dst: Va voir si tu veux, moi je ne ferai pas d'histoires. Je préfère être la gentille mécano du quartier!
The Feathers Fly Part II#142.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#143.src: There is apparently a dealer in the castle the receptionist's in, first entrance to the left. However, he charges emeralds...
The Feathers Fly Part II#143.dst: Il y aurait un vendeur dans le château de la réceptionniste, première entrée à gauche. Mais il se fait payer en émeraudes...
The Feathers Fly Part II#143.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#144.src: I'm sure we can find a free alternative. I'm counting on ya! Just tell me if you want me to follow you!
The Feathers Fly Part II#144.dst: On trouvera sûrement une solution gratuite. Je compte sur toi! Dis-moi si tu veux que je t'accompagne!
The Feathers Fly Part II#144.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#145.src: Let's hope we get this right. You lead, I follow!
The Feathers Fly Part II#145.dst: Espérons qu'on y arrive. Tu mènes, je suis!
The Feathers Fly Part II#145.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#146.src: Oh, please don't mention the word "audience" to me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#146.dst: Oh, par pitié, ne me dites pas le mot "audience"!
The Feathers Fly Part II#146.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#147.src: I-I just got my invitation stolen! I can't believe this!
The Feathers Fly Part II#147.dst: On v-vient de me voler mon invitation! Je n'arrive pas à y croire!
The Feathers Fly Part II#147.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#148.src: I asked around, obviously no one knows anything! I'm trying to look for it...
The Feathers Fly Part II#148.dst: J'ai demandé partout, évidemment personne ne sait rien! J'essaie de la retrouver...
The Feathers Fly Part II#148.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#149.src: This inn has been under renovation for a while now... It's quite the spot to hide a stolen item, wouldn't you think?
The Feathers Fly Part II#149.dst: Cette auberge est en travaux depuis un moment... L'endroit idéal pour cacher un objet volé, vous ne trouvez pas?
The Feathers Fly Part II#149.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#150.src: But nooo, of course it's locked! Though it looks like we can access it from the back...
The Feathers Fly Part II#150.dst: Mais nooon, évidemment c'est fermé! On dirait pourtant qu'on peut y entrer par l'arrière...
The Feathers Fly Part II#150.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#151.src: It looks like there's some shady alleyway over there... Maybe...
The Feathers Fly Part II#151.dst: On dirait qu'il y a une ruelle louche là-bas... Peut-être...
The Feathers Fly Part II#151.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#152.src: Ugh, sorry for ranting so much. I don't even know you. I'm sure there's a passage over there...
The Feathers Fly Part II#152.dst: Pff, désolée de me plaindre autant. Je ne vous connais même pas. Il y a sûrement un passage par là...
The Feathers Fly Part II#152.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#153.src: Wait wait wait, I'm sure you're onto something but I'd rather not do anything fishy in town. Do what you wish, I'll hang around at the town center.
The Feathers Fly Part II#153.dst: Attends attends attends, tu tiens sûrement quelque chose, mais je préfère ne rien faire de louche en ville. Fais comme tu veux, je traîne au centre-ville.
The Feathers Fly Part II#153.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#161.src: Wait wait wait, I'm sure you're on to something but I'd rather not to anything fishy in town. Do what you wish, I'll hang around in the town center.
The Feathers Fly Part II#161.dst: Attends attends attends, tu tiens sûrement quelque chose, mais je préfère ne rien faire de louche en ville. Fais comme tu veux, je reste au centre-ville.
The Feathers Fly Part II#161.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#162.src: Let's hope we don't get rejected this time around.
The Feathers Fly Part II#162.dst: Espérons qu'on ne se fasse pas jeter cette fois.
The Feathers Fly Part II#162.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#164.src: Oh god, not another duo. What do you want?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#164.dst: Oh non, pas encore un duo. Vous voulez quoi?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#164.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#165.src: Oh, uh, greetings! We have something for you!
The Feathers Fly Part II#165.dst: Oh, euh, bonjour! On a quelque chose pour vous!
The Feathers Fly Part II#165.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#166.src: And what would a mechanic have for- Wait, is that an invitation letter..?
The Feathers Fly Part II#166.dst: Et qu'est-ce qu'une mécano aurait pou- Attendez, c'est une lettre d'invitation..?
The Feathers Fly Part II#166.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#167.src: That's... Unprecedented. Let me check when the council's available and book an audience...
The Feathers Fly Part II#167.dst: C'est... du jamais vu. Je vais voir quand le Conseil est disponible et vous réserver une audience...
The Feathers Fly Part II#167.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#168.src: You two are extremely lucky. I can barely believe it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#168.dst: Quelle chance vous avez, tous les deux. J'ai peine à y croire.
The Feathers Fly Part II#168.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#169.src: I hope tomorrow morning is good for you, because the Council's somehow available at that time.
The Feathers Fly Part II#169.dst: J'espère que demain matin vous convient, car le Conseil est miraculeusement libre à ce moment-là.
The Feathers Fly Part II#169.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#170.src: Sounds good? Hopefully it does, because you don't really have much of a choice. Well, you can leave now.
The Feathers Fly Part II#170.dst: Ça vous va? J'espère bien, vous n'avez pas vraiment le choix. Bon, vous pouvez partir.
The Feathers Fly Part II#170.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#171.src: I can't believe we're actually progressing! This is so exciting!
The Feathers Fly Part II#171.dst: Je n'arrive pas à croire qu'on avance enfin! C'est trop excitant!
The Feathers Fly Part II#171.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#172.src: Alright, we need to test the machine before the audience. I've made some tweaks!
The Feathers Fly Part II#172.dst: Bon, il faut tester la machine avant l'audience. J'ai fait quelques réglages!
The Feathers Fly Part II#172.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#173.src: Let's meet up near the northern entrance if ya want a lift. Alternatively, you can just meet me by the Workshop if you're into walking!
The Feathers Fly Part II#173.dst: Retrouvons-nous près de l'entrée nord si tu veux que je t'emmène. Sinon, rejoins-moi à l'Atelier si tu aimes marcher!
The Feathers Fly Part II#173.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#174.dst: Oh, euh, bonjour tout le monde! Désolée!
The Feathers Fly Part II#174.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#175.src: So, how do I find help...
The Feathers Fly Part II#175.dst: Bon, comment je trouve de l'aide...
The Feathers Fly Part II#175.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#176.src: I sure do love... Money. Totally!
The Feathers Fly Part II#176.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#229.src: It's difficult to get an audience? Well, it's worth a try, right? Maybe they'll see me as a wealthy lad!
The Feathers Fly Part II#229.dst: C'est difficile d'avoir une audience? Bah, ça vaut le coup d'essayer, non? Ils me prendront peut-être pour une richarde!
The Feathers Fly Part II#229.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#238.src: Why hello there! Greetings! Welcome! You are looking splendid, dear!
The Feathers Fly Part II#238.dst: Oh, bonjour! Salutations! Bienvenue! Vous êtes resplendissante, très chère!
The Feathers Fly Part II#238.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#239.src: Oh?! T-thank you... That's the first time someone told me such a thing!
The Feathers Fly Part II#239.dst: Oh?! M-merci... C'est la première fois qu'on me dit une chose pareille!
The Feathers Fly Part II#239.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#240.src: Don't be silly dear, you're beautiful! Say, you're looking to be an investor, am I right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#240.dst: Ne soyez pas sotte, très chère, vous êtes magnifique! Dites-moi, vous cherchez à investir, n'est-ce pas?
The Feathers Fly Part II#240.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#241.src: ...Will that grant me an audience with the Council?
The Feathers Fly Part II#241.dst: ...Est-ce que ça m'obtiendra une audience avec le Conseil?
The Feathers Fly Part II#241.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#242.src: Why of course! Is that other person your assistant? Great!
The Feathers Fly Part II#242.dst: Mais bien sûr! Cette autre personne est votre assistant? Parfait!
The Feathers Fly Part II#242.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#243.src: I'd like you to show me you have what it takes to be a great investor, yes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#243.dst: J'aimerais que vous me prouviez que vous avez l'étoffe d'une grande investisseuse, oui!
The Feathers Fly Part II#243.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#244.src: Just hand over a mere [{~} Liquified Emeralds] and it's settled!
The Feathers Fly Part II#244.dst: Remettez-moi simplement [{~} émeraudes liquides] et l'affaire est réglée!
The Feathers Fly Part II#244.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#245.src: I- We'll... see what we can do.
The Feathers Fly Part II#245.dst: Je- On va... voir ce qu'on peut faire.
The Feathers Fly Part II#245.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#246.src: Look, I'm not good at being a human but even I know this is an absurd amount of money!
The Feathers Fly Part II#246.dst: Écoute, je ne suis pas douée pour être humaine, mais même moi je sais que c'est une somme absurde!
The Feathers Fly Part II#246.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#247.src: Do you think she'd actually take it? I'm not sure. We might have to find another way...
The Feathers Fly Part II#247.dst: Tu crois qu'elle le prendrait vraiment? Je ne sais pas. On devra peut-être trouver un autre moyen...
The Feathers Fly Part II#247.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#248.src: I'll go back to the town center. It's up to you if you want to risk all that money, if you even have it! We'll figure something else out.
The Feathers Fly Part II#248.dst: Je retourne au centre-ville. A toi de voir si tu veux risquer tout cet argent, si tu l'as! On trouvera autre chose.
The Feathers Fly Part II#248.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#249.src: Oh, you're back! With the money I see! Surprising! I like you two!
The Feathers Fly Part II#249.dst: Oh, vous revoilà! Avec l'argent! Surprenant! Vous me plaisez, tous les deux!
The Feathers Fly Part II#249.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#250.src: What? Of course I'm not taking the money! I just wanted to know if you had what it takes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#250.dst: Quoi? Bien sûr que je ne prends pas l'argent! Je voulais juste savoir si vous aviez l'étoffe!
The Feathers Fly Part II#250.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#251.src: Now I'm sure you're not a scam. Let me see when the council's available...
The Feathers Fly Part II#251.dst: Bon, vous n'êtes pas des escrocs. Voyons quand le Conseil est libre...
The Feathers Fly Part II#251.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#252.src: Thanks! I'll try not to disappoint you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#252.dst: Merci! J'essaierai de ne pas vous décevoir.
The Feathers Fly Part II#252.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#253.src: You are two lucky people! We do have a free spot!
The Feathers Fly Part II#253.dst: Quelle chance, vous deux! Il nous reste une place!
The Feathers Fly Part II#253.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#254.src: I hope tomorrow morning is good for you! We'll see you there then!
The Feathers Fly Part II#254.dst: J'espère que demain matin vous convient! On se voit là-bas, alors!
The Feathers Fly Part II#254.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#256.src: That's crazy! [{~} Liquified Emeralds]? Is that how the world works?
The Feathers Fly Part II#256.dst: C'est dingue! [{~} émeraudes liquides]? C'est comme ça que le monde marche?
The Feathers Fly Part II#256.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#257.src: It's just... I honestly don't care about listening to the law anymore.
The Feathers Fly Part II#257.dst: C'est juste que... honnêtement, je me fiche de respecter la loi maintenant.
The Feathers Fly Part II#257.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#258.src: Let's just get that audience. For one, there's some girl panicking by the Armour Merchant! Maybe she could help?
The Feathers Fly Part II#258.dst: Allons chercher cette audience. Déjà, il y a une fille paniquée près du marchand d'armures! Elle pourrait peut-être aider?
The Feathers Fly Part II#258.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#259.src: As for another way, I don't know if you paid attention on our way to the receptionist, but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#259.dst: Pour un autre moyen, je ne sais pas si tu as fait attention en allant voir la réceptionniste, mais...
The Feathers Fly Part II#259.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#260.src: There is apparently a dealer in there. He does charge money too, though. But surely not as much as that... wretched... lady! ...Sorry.
The Feathers Fly Part II#260.dst: Il y aurait un vendeur là-dedans. Lui aussi se fait payer, cela dit. Mais sûrement pas autant que cette... maudite... bonne femme! ...Pardon.
The Feathers Fly Part II#260.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#280.src: Oh! Why hello there you two! How may I be of assistance?
The Feathers Fly Part II#280.dst: Oh! Bonjour à vous deux! Que puis-je faire pour vous?
The Feathers Fly Part II#280.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#282.src: You're looking splendid dear! Now, are you-- Wait, you have a letter?
The Feathers Fly Part II#282.dst: Resplendissante, très chère! Alors, vous êtes-- Attendez, vous avez une lettre?
The Feathers Fly Part II#282.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#286.src: You know miss, you look like you could've been a great investor. Oh well, good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#286.dst: Vous savez, mademoiselle, vous auriez fait une grande investisseuse. Tant pis, bonne chance!
The Feathers Fly Part II#286.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#287.src: If you want a tip, well... There's a new guy in the Council, so he might be easier to impress!
The Feathers Fly Part II#287.dst: Si vous voulez un conseil... Il y a un nouveau au Conseil, il sera peut-être plus facile à impressionner!
The Feathers Fly Part II#287.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#292.dst: Je fais que... marcher... tout bleu...
The Feathers Fly Part II#292.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#346.src: It's... Apparently really hard? Huh. Well, we should still give it a go? I look fancy, surely they'll listen!
The Feathers Fly Part II#346.dst: C'est... apparemment très dur? Tiens. On tente quand même? Je suis élégante, ils m'écouteront sûrement!
The Feathers Fly Part II#346.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#357.src: Do you have ANYTHING to show? I need more than fancy clothes.
The Feathers Fly Part II#357.dst: Vous avez QUOI à montrer? Il me faut plus que des beaux habits.
The Feathers Fly Part II#357.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#358.src: Oh, uh, we, well I actually made a, uh, what's it called, uh...
The Feathers Fly Part II#358.dst: Oh, euh, on, enfin j'ai fabriqué un, euh, comment ça s'appelle, euh...
The Feathers Fly Part II#358.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#359.src: Not Another word! I've heard enough! You two clearly don't have anything worth my time!
The Feathers Fly Part II#359.dst: Pas UN mot de plus! J'en ai assez entendu! Vous n'avez clairement rien qui vaille mon temps!
The Feathers Fly Part II#359.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#360.src: And what's up with your face, lady? I'd look into that if I were you! OUT!
The Feathers Fly Part II#360.dst: Et c'est quoi, ton visage, ma petite? Moi, je ferais vérifier ça! DEHORS!
The Feathers Fly Part II#360.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#367.src: Maybe that's our ticket? I don't know, I'm just a law-abiding citizen. Well, actually, about that...
The Feathers Fly Part II#367.dst: Et si c'était notre sésame? Je sais pas, moi je respecte la loi. Enfin, à ce propos...
The Feathers Fly Part II#367.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#379.src: Leaving town? I'll stick around, just come back eventually, alright?
The Feathers Fly Part II#379.dst: Tu quittes la ville? Je reste dans le coin, mais reviens à un moment, d'accord?
The Feathers Fly Part II#379.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#391.src: Why sure darling, you have {~} seconds to- Hold on, that letter...
The Feathers Fly Part II#391.dst: Bien sûr, ma chère, vous avez {~} secondes pour- Un instant, cette lettre...
The Feathers Fly Part II#391.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#393.src: You two are extremely luck. I can barely believe it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#393.dst: Quelle chance vous avez, tous les deux. J'ai peine à y croire.
The Feathers Fly Part II#393.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#395.src: Don't miss it. Oh, and miss, there's something really off about your face.
The Feathers Fly Part II#395.dst: Ne la ratez pas. Ah, et ma petite, ton visage a vraiment un truc bizarre.
The Feathers Fly Part II#395.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#396.src: Thank you so much! Sorry about my face, I'm... New in town. Bye!
The Feathers Fly Part II#396.dst: Merci beaucoup! Pardon pour mon visage, je suis... nouvelle en ville. Salut!
The Feathers Fly Part II#396.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#400.src: Urgh, what now? You better be quick.
The Feathers Fly Part II#400.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#401.src: Wait you... You actually have an invitation letter? ...How...
The Feathers Fly Part II#401.dst: Attends, toi... Tu as vraiment une lettre d'invitation? ...Comment...
The Feathers Fly Part II#401.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#402.src: Wait, WHY do you have TWO letters?? This doesn't make any sense?! Oh well, whatever I'm not paid enough to care.
The Feathers Fly Part II#402.dst: Attends, POURQUOI tu as DEUX lettres?? Ça n'a aucun sens?! Bon, peu importe, on ne me paie pas assez pour m'en soucier.
The Feathers Fly Part II#402.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#403.src: Oh, wow, you're not gonna believe this. You're a lucky one. Are you alone? No?
The Feathers Fly Part II#403.dst: Ouah, tu ne vas pas le croire. Quelle chance tu as. Tu es seul? Non?
The Feathers Fly Part II#403.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#404.src: Well, I hope tomorrow morning is good for you, because the Council's somehow available at that time
The Feathers Fly Part II#404.dst: Bon, j'espère que demain matin te convient, car le Conseil est miraculeusement libre à ce moment-là
The Feathers Fly Part II#404.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#405.src: Sounds good? Well, go tell your partner about this, you are two lucky Corkians!
The Feathers Fly Part II#405.dst: Ça te va? Alors va le dire à ton associé, vous êtes deux Corkians chanceux!
The Feathers Fly Part II#405.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#467.src: Wow. I cannot stop staring at you... Such magnificent armour.
The Feathers Fly Part II#467.dst: Ouah. Je ne peux pas vous quitter des yeux... Quelle armure magnifique.
The Feathers Fly Part II#467.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#468.src: Well sir, or miss, if you tried to impress me, you certainly succeeded.
The Feathers Fly Part II#468.dst: Eh bien monsieur, ou madame, si vous vouliez m'impressionner, c'est réussi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#468.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#469.src: Why thank you! I reckon you will search for an available time regarding an audience?
The Feathers Fly Part II#469.dst: Eh bien merci! Je suppose que vous allez chercher un créneau pour une audience?
The Feathers Fly Part II#469.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#470.src: Well, you two seem very lucky, there's an available slot soon!
The Feathers Fly Part II#470.dst: Eh bien, vous avez beaucoup de chance, il y a un créneau libre bientôt!
The Feathers Fly Part II#470.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#471.src: I hope tomorrow morning is good for you, because the Council's available at that time.
The Feathers Fly Part II#471.dst: J'espère que demain matin vous convient, car le Conseil est libre à ce moment-là.
The Feathers Fly Part II#471.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#472.dst: Ça vous va? C'est mérité, vous
The Feathers Fly Part II#472.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#486.src: Help Ava operate the machine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part II#486.dst: Aidez Ava à faire fonctionner la machine en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#487.src: Hey! I'm back in my original clothes. It feels so much better...
The Feathers Fly Part II#487.dst: Hé! J'ai remis mes vêtements habituels. Je me sens tellement mieux...
The Feathers Fly Part II#487.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#488.src: Remember that hill next to the Workshop? We'll work there again. Tell me when you're ready for the lift.
The Feathers Fly Part II#488.dst: Tu te souviens de la colline près de l'Atelier? On y retravaille. Dis-moi quand je peux t'emmener.
The Feathers Fly Part II#488.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#490.src: There we are! Talk to me and I'll tell you all about the changes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#490.dst: Nous y voilà! Parle-moi et je te raconte tous les changements!
The Feathers Fly Part II#490.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#491.src: Do you remember how it worked last time? Don't worry, it's still fairly similar.
The Feathers Fly Part II#491.dst: Tu te rappelles comment ça marchait la dernière fois? T'inquiète, c'est encore assez similaire.
The Feathers Fly Part II#491.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#492.src: Once again, you'll have a remote. Simply click in the right orders. However!
The Feathers Fly Part II#492.dst: Encore une fois, tu auras une télécommande. Clique dans le bon ordre. Mais attention!
The Feathers Fly Part II#492.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#493.src: Now, the machine requires a bit more... Dexterity.
The Feathers Fly Part II#493.dst: Maintenant, la machine demande un peu plus de... dextérité.
The Feathers Fly Part II#493.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#494.src: If you're really quick, the machine will charge up real fast!
The Feathers Fly Part II#494.dst: Si tu es très rapide, la machine se chargera super vite!
The Feathers Fly Part II#494.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#495.src: If you're too slow however, it'd take a bit of time to charge up...
The Feathers Fly Part II#495.dst: Mais si tu traînes trop, elle mettra un moment à se charger...
The Feathers Fly Part II#495.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#496.src: Time is still limited too. Don't worry, this is practice for the Council! Tell me once you're ready!
The Feathers Fly Part II#496.dst: Le temps est toujours limité. T'inquiète, c'est un entraînement pour le Conseil! Préviens-moi quand c'est bon!
The Feathers Fly Part II#496.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#503.src: You gotta admit, this has to be revolutionary!
The Feathers Fly Part II#503.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#504.src: The corkian council... I hope they're nice. I really do. And you're coming!
The Feathers Fly Part II#504.dst: Le Conseil Corkian... J'espère qu'ils sont gentils. Vraiment. Et tu viens!
The Feathers Fly Part II#504.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#505.src: Hey, let's meet up near the receptionist. Say, want another lift? I can't get you inside the city, though!
The Feathers Fly Part II#505.dst: Hé, retrouvons-nous près de la réceptionniste. Dis, je t'emmène encore? Par contre, je ne peux pas te faire entrer en ville!
The Feathers Fly Part II#505.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#506.src: Cool, let's go! I still have to change back and wear the outfit you got me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#506.dst: Cool, allons-y! Je dois encore me changer et mettre la tenue que tu m'as trouvée!
The Feathers Fly Part II#506.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#507.src: I'll drop you off around the city outskirts. See ya!
The Feathers Fly Part II#507.dst: Je te dépose aux abords de la ville. A plus!
The Feathers Fly Part II#507.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#509.src: Meet Ava to start the audience with the Corkian council at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part II#509.dst: Rejoignez Ava pour commencer l'audience avec le Conseil Corkian en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#510.src: This is it, then. {u}, I'm... scared.
The Feathers Fly Part II#510.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#511.src: I guess it's normal to be stressed before an important event...
The Feathers Fly Part II#511.dst: C'est sûrement normal d'être stressée avant un grand moment...
The Feathers Fly Part II#511.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#512.src: Look, once we go in there, I'm really counting on you to go all in with the machine.
The Feathers Fly Part II#512.dst: Écoute, une fois là-dedans, je compte vraiment sur toi pour tout donner avec la machine.
The Feathers Fly Part II#512.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#513.src: I don't want to stress you out, but... Please know this is important to me.
The Feathers Fly Part II#513.dst: Je ne veux pas te stresser, mais... sache que c'est important pour moi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#513.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#514.src: Alright, we should go now or else I'll just chicken out or somethin'.
The Feathers Fly Part II#514.dst: Bon, on devrait y aller, sinon je vais me dégonfler ou un truc du genre.
The Feathers Fly Part II#514.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#515.src: Just... tell me once you're ready, I guess.
The Feathers Fly Part II#515.dst: Dis-moi juste... quand c'est bon pour toi, j'imagine.
The Feathers Fly Part II#515.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#516.src: Stay close to me... Let's go.
The Feathers Fly Part II#516.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#518.src: This is the right place... I'm sure it is...
The Feathers Fly Part II#518.dst: C'est le bon endroit... J'en suis sûre...
The Feathers Fly Part II#518.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#519.dst: {u}... Tu sais ce qui se pa- Attends...
The Feathers Fly Part II#519.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#522.src: Nah, I saw him running around earlier. He's coming.

The Feathers Fly Part II#532.src: Of course you'd know them. I'm not surprised.
The Feathers Fly Part II#532.dst: Évidemment que tu le connais. Ça ne m'étonne pas.

The Feathers Fly Part II#534.dst: ...Alors c'est toi. J'imaginais quelqu'un de... plus imposant. Tiens.

The Feathers Fly Part II#537.dst: Ava, c'est ça? L'écriture est bizarre. Bon, bienvenue au... Conseil!

The Feathers Fly Part II#539.dst: *ahem* A toi de jouer, maintenant. Vas-y. Qu'est-ce que tu nous réserves?

The Feathers Fly Part II#540.dst: B-bonjour à tous. Je suis mécanicienne et j'ai quelque chose pour vous...

The Feathers Fly Part II#543.dst: ...J'ai fait un Accélérateur de croissance avec l'aide de .

The Feathers Fly Part II#544.src: It's- It- Uh, helps plants. Grow. Yeah.
The Feathers Fly Part II#544.dst: C'est- C'est- Euh, pour les plantes. Pousser. Voilà.

The Feathers Fly Part II#545.src: I'll just set it up super quickly!
The Feathers Fly Part II#545.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#561.src: I trust him. He's really been working hard as a new member.
The Feathers Fly Part II#561.dst: J'ai confiance en lui. Il a beaucoup bossé depuis son arrivée.
The Feathers Fly Part II#561.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#569.src: I can't believe you know them. They're out of your league, Maxie.
The Feathers Fly Part II#569.dst: Dingue que tu le connaisses. Il joue pas dans ta catégorie, Maxie.
The Feathers Fly Part II#569.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#577.src: Y'know, you really don't look like the "inventor" type.
The Feathers Fly Part II#577.dst: Tu sais, tu n'as vraiment pas le genre "inventrice".
The Feathers Fly Part II#577.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#578.src: I get that often, yeah. Green isn't really associated with money for me.
The Feathers Fly Part II#578.dst: On me le dit souvent, oui. Pour moi, le vert n'évoque pas vraiment l'argent.
The Feathers Fly Part II#578.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#579.src: I enjoy nature and all, right? Well, I present to you...
The Feathers Fly Part II#579.dst: J'aime la nature et tout ça, vous voyez? Eh bien, je vous présente...
The Feathers Fly Part II#579.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#582.src: As you should be! Let me quickly set the machine up.
The Feathers Fly Part II#582.dst: Il y a de quoi! Laissez-moi installer la machine en vitesse.
The Feathers Fly Part II#582.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#598.src: I don't think he'll skip this one. You look cute, Ava! That's your name, right? Handwriting's a little iffy.
The Feathers Fly Part II#598.dst: Je ne pense pas qu'il sèche celle-là. Tu es mignonne, Ava! C'est ton nom, hein? L'écriture est un peu douteuse.
The Feathers Fly Part II#598.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#606.src: And lo and behold, you know them. Of course.
The Feathers Fly Part II#606.dst: Et comme par hasard, tu le connais. Évidemment.
The Feathers Fly Part II#606.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#611.src: Right, right. Ava! Welcome to... the Council!
The Feathers Fly Part II#611.dst: Oui, oui. Ava! Bienvenue au... Conseil!
The Feathers Fly Part II#611.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#614.src: Hey, so... I'm here with to show you a little something!
The Feathers Fly Part II#614.dst: Salut, alors... Je suis venue avec pour vous montrer un petit truc!
The Feathers Fly Part II#614.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#615.src: It's actually quite revolutionary! It's a Growth Accelerator!
The Feathers Fly Part II#615.dst: C'est même assez révolutionnaire! C'est un Accélérateur de croissance!
The Feathers Fly Part II#615.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#617.src: That piqued your interest, right? Well get ready!
The Feathers Fly Part II#617.dst: Ça a piqué votre curiosité, hein? Alors préparez-vous!
The Feathers Fly Part II#617.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#618.src: It's better outdoors, but I believe I can make it work here.
The Feathers Fly Part II#618.dst: C'est mieux en extérieur, mais je pense pouvoir le faire marcher ici.
The Feathers Fly Part II#618.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#619.src: I'll set it up. Just sit back and watch!
The Feathers Fly Part II#619.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#652.dst: Je vois que tu maîtrises ton jouet!

The Feathers Fly Part II#653.src: Hey, look, I've only had it for a few- Nevermind. That's not what I'm here for.
The Feathers Fly Part II#653.dst: Hé, écoute, je ne l'ai que depuis quelques- Laisse tomber. Je ne suis pas là pour ça.
The Feathers Fly Part II#653.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#654.src: Wait, you brought such an armour and that's not what you're showcasing?
The Feathers Fly Part II#654.dst: Attends, tu viens avec une armure pareille et ce n'est pas ça que tu présentes?
The Feathers Fly Part II#654.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#655.src: You certainly caught our attention. Go on.
The Feathers Fly Part II#655.dst: Tu as clairement attiré notre attention. Continue.

The Feathers Fly Part II#656.src: Show the Corkians the Growth Accelerator with Ava at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part II#656.dst: Montrez l'Accélérateur de croissance aux Corkians avec Ava en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#657.src: This is really it, then. No backing down now.
The Feathers Fly Part II#657.dst: Cette fois, on y est. Plus moyen de reculer.
The Feathers Fly Part II#657.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#658.dst: J'essaierai juste de ne pas refaire mon erreur de l'époque avec les Avos.
The Feathers Fly Part II#658.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#659.src: It's time to show them. I don't really have anything extra to tell you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#659.dst: C'est le moment de leur montrer. Je n'ai rien de plus à te dire.

The Feathers Fly Part II#660.src: It's as the president just said, {u}. Do your thing.
The Feathers Fly Part II#660.dst: Comme l'a dit la présidente, {u}. Fais ton truc.
The Feathers Fly Part II#660.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#663.src: You certainly seem to have trained, young lady. I respect that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#663.dst: Vous vous êtes visiblement entraînée, jeune fille. Je respecte ça.
The Feathers Fly Part II#663.speaker: Nodise

The Feathers Fly Part II#664.src: This almost reminds me of, uuuh...
