The Feathers Fly Part II#666.dst: Ah oui, la magie des Avos! Pas vrai??
The Feathers Fly Part II#666.speaker: Dwice

The Feathers Fly Part II#668.src: I do believe this has potential. Let us see more of it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#668.dst: Je crois que ceci a du potentiel. Voyons-en davantage.
The Feathers Fly Part II#668.speaker: Nodise

The Feathers Fly Part II#672.src: I like the sounds, at least!
The Feathers Fly Part II#672.dst: J'aime bien les sons, au moins!
The Feathers Fly Part II#672.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#673.dst: Ouah, la machine est vraiment bien chaude cette fois.
The Feathers Fly Part II#673.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#674.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#676.dst: Hé, Carl! On t'a rien demandé!
The Feathers Fly Part II#676.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#678.src: This seems very propitious. Go on.
The Feathers Fly Part II#678.speaker: Nodise

The Feathers Fly Part II#681.dst: Alors {u} sait aussi manier les machines? Chouette!
The Feathers Fly Part II#681.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#682.dst: Vous n'êtes pas prêts pour ça!
The Feathers Fly Part II#682.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#765.dst: Regardez Ava présenter son Accélérateur de croissance

The Feathers Fly Part II#766.src: Oh my... Oh my grook. This is... Wow...

The Feathers Fly Part II#767.dst: C'est du sérieux. Cette fille a fait éclore une fleur en un instant.

The Feathers Fly Part II#768.dst: ...Ne nous regardez pas comme ça, je suis aussi surprise que vous.

The Feathers Fly Part II#769.dst: Eh bien, Ava... Tu m'as convaincue. Je suis impressionnée!
The Feathers Fly Part II#769.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#770.src: Hey, you alright? It's not often mechanics impress us. Good job.
The Feathers Fly Part II#770.dst: Hé, ça va? Ce n'est pas souvent qu'un mécano nous impressionne. Bon travail.
The Feathers Fly Part II#770.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#771.dst: Tout ça est très bien, mais... Comment ça marche?

The Feathers Fly Part II#772.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#773.dst: Personne à Corkus n'a jamais rien fait de tel. Tu as quelque chose à nous dire, ou à nous montrer?
The Feathers Fly Part II#773.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#776.src: I... How do I put this...

The Feathers Fly Part II#777.dst: Je ne suis pas vraiment comme vous.

The Feathers Fly Part II#778.dst: En fait, nous sommes très différents.

The Feathers Fly Part II#784.dst: C'est IMPOSSIBLE que ce soit vrai!

The Feathers Fly Part II#785.src: What should we do what should we-

The Feathers Fly Part II#794.dst: Je n'arrive pas à y croire!!
The Feathers Fly Part II#794.speaker: Clomius

The Feathers Fly Part II#795.src: Hmpf? Just take her on the spot!
The Feathers Fly Part II#795.speaker: Grant

The Feathers Fly Part II#796.src: We wouldn't have known with such an outfit.
The Feathers Fly Part II#796.dst: Avec une tenue pareille, impossible de savoir.
The Feathers Fly Part II#796.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#797.dst: Je ne veux savoir qu'une chose.
The Feathers Fly Part II#797.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#798.dst: Tu le savais, ou elle t'a dupé?

The Feathers Fly Part II#799.dst: Je jure que {u} ne savait pas! Croyez-moi!

The Feathers Fly Part II#800.dst: C'est ça, et ensuite? Vous espériez quoi?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#800.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#801.src: I'm unsure if I should be impressed, distressed or enraged. So I think I'll just be all three! Ava, congratulations.
The Feathers Fly Part II#801.dst: Je ne sais pas si je dois être impressionnée, affligée ou furieuse. Alors je vais être les trois! Ava, félicitations.
The Feathers Fly Part II#801.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#802.src: But... Why... I don't get it. I don't get the Avos. I don't get humans...
The Feathers Fly Part II#802.dst: Mais... Pourquoi... Je ne comprends pas. Ni les Avos. Ni les humains...
The Feathers Fly Part II#802.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#803.src: What's so wrong about me? Why shouldn't I do electromagic? Why??
The Feathers Fly Part II#803.dst: Qu'est-ce qui cloche chez moi? Pourquoi pas d'électromagie pour moi? Pourquoi??
The Feathers Fly Part II#803.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#804.src: Oh, darling. You impress then enrage me, and now you want me to pity you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#804.dst: Oh, ma chérie. Tu m'impressionnes, tu me mets en rage, et là tu veux ma pitié.
The Feathers Fly Part II#804.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#805.src: You know, your kind has always been...
The Feathers Fly Part II#805.dst: Tu sais, les tiens ont toujours été...
The Feathers Fly Part II#805.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#806.src: So archaic. Always with their spirituality, their flora, their beliefs, their traditions...
The Feathers Fly Part II#806.dst: Si archaïques. Toujours avec leur spiritualité, leur flore, leurs croyances, leurs traditions...
The Feathers Fly Part II#806.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#807.src: And you, you're fiddling not only with nature, but also with OUR things.
The Feathers Fly Part II#807.dst: Et toi, tu ne bricoles pas seulement avec la nature, mais aussi avec NOS affaires.
The Feathers Fly Part II#807.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#808.src: Somehow, you're able to control electromagic? I guess it's not exclusive to humans, then.
The Feathers Fly Part II#808.dst: Et tu arrives à contrôler l'électromagie? Faut croire qu'elle n'est pas réservée aux humains.
The Feathers Fly Part II#808.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#809.src: Even then, I see no reason as to why we should let you interact with us. You shouldn't be here.
The Feathers Fly Part II#809.dst: Même ainsi, je ne vois aucune raison de te laisser frayer avec nous. Tu n'as rien à faire ici.
The Feathers Fly Part II#809.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#810.src: I think... I finally get it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#810.dst: Je crois que... je comprends enfin.
The Feathers Fly Part II#810.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#811.src: I do, really. The truth is...
The Feathers Fly Part II#811.dst: Si, vraiment. La vérité, c'est que...
The Feathers Fly Part II#811.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#814.dst: Je vous apporte une avancée incroyable, et vous ne voyez pas plus loin que mes plumes.
The Feathers Fly Part II#814.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#815.src: Alright, I've heard enough. That's it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#815.dst: Bon, j'en ai assez entendu. Ça suffit.
The Feathers Fly Part II#815.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#817.src: Don't you dare touch- Gah! I'll show you. I'll show everyone what you're missing out on!
The Feathers Fly Part II#817.dst: N'ose même pas me touch- Argh! Je vais vous montrer. Je vais montrer à tout le monde ce que vous ratez!
The Feathers Fly Part II#817.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#818.src: What just... Everyone! Dismissed! What is that girl doing?! I'll go after her! Nodise, Maxie, you go and help Sybil!
The Feathers Fly Part II#818.dst: Qu'est-ce que... Tout le monde! La séance est levée! Qu'est-ce qu'elle fait?! Je la poursuis! Nodise, Maxie, allez aider Sybil!
The Feathers Fly Part II#818.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#823.src: You're crying?! Aw... There, there. It's alright, you made it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#823.dst: Tu pleures?! Oh... Là, là. Tout va bien, tu as réussi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#823.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#902.src: God, I hate to say it, but her mask was flawless.

The Feathers Fly Part II#902.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#903.src: Flawless?! More like flawful! This was so obvious!
The Feathers Fly Part II#903.dst: Impeccable?! Plutôt minable, oui! C'était tellement évident!
The Feathers Fly Part II#903.speaker: Dwice

The Feathers Fly Part II#904.src: And WHY didn't you say so??
The Feathers Fly Part II#904.dst: Et POURQUOI tu ne l'as pas dit??
The Feathers Fly Part II#904.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#905.src: I- uh, y'know, didn't want to assume...
The Feathers Fly Part II#905.dst: Je- euh, tu sais, je voulais pas présumer...
The Feathers Fly Part II#905.speaker: Dwice

The Feathers Fly Part II#906.src: Urgh. Look, there's only one think I want to know.
The Feathers Fly Part II#906.dst: Pff. Écoute, je ne veux savoir qu'une chose.
The Feathers Fly Part II#906.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#907.src: ... Did you know, or did she trick you? Be very careful about what you're about to say.
The Feathers Fly Part II#907.dst: ... Tu le savais, ou elle t'a dupé? Fais très attention à ce que tu vas dire.
The Feathers Fly Part II#907.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#932.src: I didn't really doubt you with your armour. We have a few questions though!
The Feathers Fly Part II#932.dst: Avec ton armure, je ne doutais pas trop de toi. On a quand même quelques questions!
The Feathers Fly Part II#932.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#979.src: Huh, that armour's actually powerful. Now, if you'll excuse me, I'll show everyone what I'm really capable of.
The Feathers Fly Part II#979.dst: Tiens, cette armure est vraiment puissante. Maintenant, si vous permettez, je vais montrer à tous ce dont je suis capable.
The Feathers Fly Part II#979.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#982.src: Well... Mo'in, {u}. I was thinking about catching up with you and all after the audience, but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#982.dst: Eh bien... Mo'in, {u}. Je comptais prendre de tes nouvelles après l'audience, mais...
The Feathers Fly Part II#982.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#983.src: I guess we don't really have time for that now, do we?
The Feathers Fly Part II#983.dst: J'imagine qu'on n'a pas vraiment le temps pour ça, hein?
The Feathers Fly Part II#983.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#984.src: Wow, Maxie, great time management you got there!
The Feathers Fly Part II#984.dst: Ouah, Maxie, quelle gestion du temps!
The Feathers Fly Part II#984.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#985.dst: Sybil... Ce n'est pas le moment de se disputer.
The Feathers Fly Part II#985.speaker: Nodise

The Feathers Fly Part II#986.src: Have you seen what just happened? I'm sure even now he'll keep defending the Avos!
The Feathers Fly Part II#986.dst: Tu as vu ce qui s'est passé? Je parie que même là, il va encore défendre les Avos!
The Feathers Fly Part II#986.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#987.src: Look, there's no time right now. I think {u} and I should go and help.
The Feathers Fly Part II#987.dst: Écoute, on n'a pas le temps. Je pense que {u} et moi devrions aller aider.
The Feathers Fly Part II#987.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#988.src: Nodise... You probably should stay here too. We-
The Feathers Fly Part II#988.dst: Nodise... Tu devrais sans doute rester ici aussi. On-
The Feathers Fly Part II#988.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#989.src: Wha-What's happening?! Oh dear, I'll just run there!
The Feathers Fly Part II#989.dst: Q-qu'est-ce qui se passe?! Oh là là, j'y cours!
The Feathers Fly Part II#989.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#990.src: Prevent Ava from making a mistake at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part II#990.dst: Empêchez Ava de commettre une erreur en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#991.src: Well look who decided to show up. I thought you would've fled by now.
The Feathers Fly Part II#991.dst: Tiens, regardez qui daigne se montrer. Je pensais que tu aurais déjà fui.
The Feathers Fly Part II#991.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#992.src: So what? Here to fix your mistakes? Help your insane bird friend?
The Feathers Fly Part II#992.dst: Et alors? Tu viens réparer tes erreurs? Aider ta copine l'oiseau cinglée?
The Feathers Fly Part II#992.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#993.src: For such a plant to grow in a few seconds... I can't believe this.
The Feathers Fly Part II#993.dst: Qu'une plante pareille pousse en quelques secondes... Je n'y crois pas.
The Feathers Fly Part II#993.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#994.src: Maxie's your friend, right? Well he's in there already. You should go, too.
The Feathers Fly Part II#994.dst: Maxie est ton ami, non? Il est déjà là-dedans. Tu devrais y aller aussi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#994.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#995.src: I think you gotta reach the top to take care of this. Maybe multiple times.
The Feathers Fly Part II#995.dst: Je crois qu'il faut atteindre le sommet pour régler ça. Peut-être plusieurs fois.
The Feathers Fly Part II#995.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#997.dst: Arrêtez Ava avant qu'elle ne ravage {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#998.src: {u}!! I'm sure Efena told you already, no time to talk!
The Feathers Fly Part II#998.dst: {u}!! Efena t'a sûrement déjà prévenu, pas le temps de parler!
The Feathers Fly Part II#998.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#999.src: Apparently, there's something up there! Try to reach the top! There are strange plants around, see if that helps!
The Feathers Fly Part II#999.dst: Il paraît qu'il y a quelque chose là-haut! Essaie d'atteindre le sommet! Il y a des plantes bizarres autour, vois si ça aide!
The Feathers Fly Part II#999.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1000.src: ...You're here. Here to fix my own mistakes, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1000.dst: ...Te voilà. Tu viens réparer mes erreurs, c'est ça?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1000.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1001.src: And then, here to take me, I suppose. Right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1001.dst: Et ensuite m'emmener, je suppose. Hein?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1001.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1002.src: Y'know, I noticed you always were one to follow orders. Well, what you're lookin' for is on top of the plant.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1002.dst: Tu sais, j'ai remarqué que tu obéissais toujours aux ordres. Bon, ce que tu cherches est au sommet de la plante.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1002.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1003.src: I... I'm not gonna fight back. There's no point. Just... Just go.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1003.dst: Je... Je ne vais pas me défendre. Ça ne sert à rien. Vas-y... Vas-y, c'est tout.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1003.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1004.src: Woah! You did something! You should try that again!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1004.dst: Ouah! Tu as fait quelque chose! Tu devrais recommencer!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1004.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1005.src: I - I really didn't want this. I wanted to help people, {u}! Not... not...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1005.dst: Je - Je ne voulais vraiment pas ça. Je voulais aider les gens, {u}! Pas... pas...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1005.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1006.src: I sure have impressed everyone. So I guess not all's lost, huh?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1006.dst: En tout cas, j'ai impressionné tout le monde. Donc tout n'est pas perdu, hein?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1006.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1007.src: I'll be the talk of an entire nation!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1007.dst: Toute une nation va parler de moi!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1007.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1008.src: Gosh, I really am going crazy aren't I?...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1008.dst: Bon sang, je deviens vraiment folle, pas vrai?...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1008.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1009.src: I just... I don't know what to do... I reached rock bottom...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1009.dst: C'est juste que... je ne sais pas quoi faire... J'ai touché le fond...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1009.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1010.src: I screwed up with my people, then with the humans, then...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1010.dst: J'ai tout gâché avec les miens, puis avec les humains, puis...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1010.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1013.src: Could you tell her something for me?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1013.dst: Tu pourrais lui dire quelque chose de ma part?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1013.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1014.src: Tell her that... I'm not that mad.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1014.dst: Dis-lui que... je ne suis pas si fâchée.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1014.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1015.src: This... While destructive, it's impressive, and...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1015.dst: Ceci... Bien que destructeur, c'est impressionnant, et...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1015.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1016.src: Whatever, just tell her! People will think I lost my mind, it's fine!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1016.dst: Peu importe, dis-le-lui! Les gens penseront que j'ai perdu la tête, tant pis!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1016.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1017.src: I'd like to talk to her. I assume she'll just flee, but... You should try!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1017.dst: J'aimerais lui parler. Je suppose qu'elle va juste s'enfuir, mais... Essaie!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1017.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1018.src: ...What? Do you have anythin' to tell me before I leave?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1018.dst: ...Quoi? Tu as quelque chose à me dire avant que je parte?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1018.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1019.src: Huh?! The president herself isn't too mad at me? What??
The Feathers Fly Part II#1019.dst: Hein?! La présidente elle-même ne m'en veut pas trop? Quoi??
The Feathers Fly Part II#1019.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1020.src: Are you trying to make me get down and get arrested? You know I... I can't believe you...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1020.dst: Tu essaies de me faire descendre pour qu'on m'arrête? Tu sais que je... Je n'arrive pas à croire que tu...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1020.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1021.src: I want to, but... Have you seen how she was during the audience?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1021.dst: J'aimerais bien, mais... Tu as vu comment elle était pendant l'audience?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1021.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1022.src: I can't trust you, {u}. There's no way.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1022.dst: Je ne peux pas te faire confiance, {u}. Impossible.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1022.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1023.src: I regret this... I shouldn't have acted this way, this wasn't supposed to happen, I...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1023.dst: Je regrette... Je n'aurais pas dû agir comme ça, ça n'aurait jamais dû arriver, je...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1023.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1024.src: I can't stay, {u}. The president's one thing, but the others...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1024.dst: Je ne peux pas rester, {u}. La présidente, c'est une chose, mais les autres...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1024.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1084.src: No point fighting back, even though I could totally manage. I feel bad for that other girl now. Go, then... Stop my machine.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1084.dst: Inutile de me défendre, même si j'en serais capable. J'ai de la peine pour l'autre fille, maintenant. Vas-y, alors... Arrête ma machine.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1084.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1108.src: Hmpf. Did {u} take that thing down?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1108.dst: Hmpf. C'est {u} qui a abattu ce truc?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1108.speaker: Grant

The Feathers Fly Part II#1111.src: Oh she better be around here!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1111.dst: Oh, elle a intérêt à être dans le coin!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1111.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1112.src: Wait, under the rubble, I see something!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1112.dst: Attendez, je vois quelque chose sous les décombres!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1112.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1116.src: Look, I'll give you a mission. Find Ava with {u}, and tell her this...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1116.dst: Écoute, je te confie une mission. Trouve Ava avec {u}, et dis-lui ceci...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1116.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1117.dst: {u}?! C'est toi? Je suis en bas!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1117.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1118.src: Mo'in, {u}! You're fine! I'm so glad!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1118.dst: Mo'in, {u}! Tu vas bien! Quel soulagement!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1118.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1119.src: You're something of a hero, y'know?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1119.dst: Tu es un vrai héros, tu sais?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1119.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1120.src: That was some really nice job back there! But now...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1120.dst: Super boulot, tout à l'heure! Mais maintenant...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1120.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1121.src: Well, the town's fine, but... I got tasked to find Ava.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1121.dst: Bon, la ville va bien, mais... on m'a chargé de retrouver Ava.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1121.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1122.src: From what I've gathered, you worked with her and know where to go, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1122.dst: D'après ce que j'ai compris, tu as travaillé avec elle et tu sais où aller, c'est ça?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1122.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1123.src: Oh, you told Ava about Efena? And she... she fled. Right. Well, I'm not surprised!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1123.dst: Oh, tu as parlé d'Efena à Ava? Et elle... elle s'est enfuie. Je vois. Bon, ça ne m'étonne pas!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1123.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1124.src: Trust me, we want to help that poor Avo. Let's just find her, alright?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1124.dst: Crois-moi, on veut aider cette pauvre Avo. Retrouvons-la, d'accord?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1124.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1125.src: Tell me whenever you're ready, and we'll go.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1125.dst: Dis-moi quand c'est bon, et on y va.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1125.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1128.src: Find Ava at the Workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#1130.src: The Avos chief did mention her once, but this place is crazy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1130.dst: Le chef des Avos l'a bien mentionnée une fois, mais cet endroit est dingue!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1130.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1131.src: You... I assume you're here to take me.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1131.dst: Vous... Je suppose que vous venez me chercher.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1131.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1132.src: Go ahead, then. Do it. I don't have anything to lose anymore. I've already lost everything.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1132.dst: Allez-y, alors. Faites-le. Je n'ai plus rien à perdre. J'ai déjà tout perdu.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1132.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1134.src: I don't want your pity. I have no one. You're making this harder for yourself.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1134.dst: Je ne veux pas de ta pitié. Je n'ai personne. Tu ne fais que te compliquer la vie.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1134.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1135.src: The president didn't sentence you to death or anything... Quite the opposite, actually.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1135.dst: La présidente ne t'a pas condamnée à mort ni rien... Bien au contraire, en fait.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1135.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1136.src: What do you mean? Why should I trust you?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1136.dst: Comment ça? Pourquoi je te ferais confiance?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1136.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1138.src: Don't bother, Maxie. I'll explain myself.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1139.src: Nice place. I can clearly see how our culture got to you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1139.dst: Joli endroit. Je vois bien à quel point notre culture t'a marquée.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1139.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1140.src: So you're here. Are you... Forgiving me?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1140.dst: Vous êtes venue. Vous allez... me pardonner?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1140.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1141.src: Oh, "forgive" is a really strong word, Ava. Look.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1141.dst: Oh, "pardonner" est un bien grand mot, Ava. Écoute.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1141.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1142.src: I do believe we can all learn a thing or two about this. Ava...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1142.dst: Je crois qu'on peut tous en tirer une leçon ou deux. Ava...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1142.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1143.src: You broke the law, and as such, you're not allowed in town. Ya understand?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1143.dst: Tu as enfreint la loi, et à ce titre, tu n'as plus le droit d'entrer en ville. Compris?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1143.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1144.src: First the Avos, then you, huh. So it's come full circle.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1144.dst: D'abord les Avos, puis vous, hein. La boucle est bouclée.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1144.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1145.src: Look, that machine of yours is impressive. I'm not lying. You're talented.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1145.dst: Écoute, ta machine est impressionnante. Je ne mens pas. Tu as du talent.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1145.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1146.src: But you've definitely made quite the mistake. I did too.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1146.dst: Mais tu as clairement commis une belle erreur. Moi aussi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1146.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1147.src: I guess you and I really learnt what "acting in the heat of the moment" means, huh.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1147.dst: Je crois que toi et moi, on a vraiment appris ce que veut dire "agir sous le coup de l'émotion", hein.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1147.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1148.src: I have some sort of... Compromise. For us. Maxie?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1148.dst: J'ai une sorte de... compromis. Pour nous deux. Maxie?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1148.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1149.src: Yeah, I'm... interested in working with you. Learning from you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1149.dst: Oui, ça m'... intéresse de travailler avec toi. D'apprendre de toi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1149.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1150.src: You're clearly better at Electromagic than I, so...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1150.dst: Tu maîtrises clairement mieux l'électromagie que moi, alors...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1150.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1151.src: I'm willing to provide you with what you need. Help you out from time to time.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1151.dst: Je suis prêt à te fournir ce dont tu as besoin. Te donner un coup de main de temps en temps.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1151.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1152.src: You've been alone for so long, Ava. I'm lending you Maxie!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1152.dst: Tu as été seule si longtemps, Ava. Je te prête Maxie!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1152.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1153.src: Hey, don't say it like that!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1153.dst: Hé, ne le dis pas comme ça!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1153.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1154.src: *chuckles* I'm kidding. The rest of the council isn't aware yet.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1154.dst: *rit* Je plaisante. Le reste du Conseil n'est pas encore au courant.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1154.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1155.src: They're not gonna like this, but I'll handle it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1155.dst: Ça ne va pas leur plaire, mais je m'en charge.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1155.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1156.src: You know I can't kill you. Can you imagine how the Avos would take it? Even though you're banished...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1156.dst: Tu sais que je ne peux pas te tuer. Tu imagines comment les Avos le prendraient? Même si tu es bannie...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1156.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1157.src: But I don't want to either. As for you, {u}...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1157.dst: Mais je ne le veux pas non plus. Quant à toi, {u}...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1157.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1158.src: I'll give you some stuff. I can't imagine how things would've gone if it weren't for you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1158.dst: Je vais te donner quelques trucs. Je n'ose imaginer comment ça aurait tourné sans toi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1158.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1159.src: Now, you're banished from everyone Ava. I know that's no happy ending.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1159.dst: Bref, tu es bannie de partout, Ava. Je sais que ce n'est pas une fin heureuse.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1159.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1160.src: But that would've been too easy, don't ya think?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1160.dst: Mais ça aurait été trop facile, tu ne crois pas?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1160.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1161.src: Maybe later, you'll get your happy ending. But you can settle with not being alone anymore, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1161.dst: Tu auras peut-être ta fin heureuse plus tard. Mais tu peux te contenter de ne plus être seule, non?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1161.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1162.src: Goodbye, Ava. Who knows, maybe I'll stop by sometimes.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1162.dst: Au revoir, Ava. Qui sait, je passerai peut-être de temps en temps.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1162.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1163.src: ...{u}? If you stop by the Workshop later, I'll set up something for you as well.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1163.dst: ...{u}? Si tu passes à l'Atelier plus tard, je te préparerai quelque chose à toi aussi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1163.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1234.src: Goodbye, Ava. Who knows, maybe I'll stop by sometimes. After all, you're very stylish!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1234.dst: Au revoir, Ava. Qui sait, je passerai peut-être de temps en temps. Après tout, tu as beaucoup de style!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1234.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1270.src: Goodbye, Ava. Who knows, I might stop by sometimes. Maybe you'll have figured out that armour of yours.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1270.dst: Au revoir, Ava. Qui sait, je passerai peut-être de temps en temps. D'ici là, tu auras peut-être percé le secret de ton armure.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1270.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1273.src: Please contact Cerid for more information about this model.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1273.dst: Pour plus d'informations sur ce modèle, veuillez contacter Cerid.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1273.speaker: Robot Sentry

The Feathers Fly Part II#1274.src: If you have any questions, know that I am definitely not the right machine to ask.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1274.dst: Pour toute question, sachez que je ne suis absolument pas la bonne machine à qui la poser.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1274.speaker: Robot Sentry

The Feathers Fly Part II#1276.src: Hey, it's alright. We'll be fine.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1276.dst: Hé, ça va aller. On s'en sortira.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1276.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.src: You know, that Workshop of yours is way nicer than I expected.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.dst: Tu sais, ton Atelier est bien plus sympa que je ne le pensais.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.src: {u}, thanks for the help. You've introduced me to quite the talent!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.dst: {u}, merci pour ton aide. Tu m'as fait rencontrer un sacré talent!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.src: Believe me, I know how rejection feels like. I guess everyone does, in their own ways.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.dst: Crois-moi, je sais ce que c'est d'être rejeté. Je crois que tout le monde le sait, à sa façon.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.src: Efena... She's nicer than Chief, that's for sure...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.dst: Efena... Elle est plus gentille que le chef, ça c'est sûr...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1283.src: This is all... Very hard to believe.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1283.dst: Tout ça est... très difficile à croire.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1283.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1285.src: {u}, once you come back here, you'll be able to get some of my gadgets.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1285.dst: {u}, quand tu reviendras ici, tu pourras récupérer quelques-uns de mes gadgets.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1285.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1356.dst: Alors, tu as trouvé quelque chose?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1356.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1357.src: We don't have that much time you know!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1357.dst: On n'a pas tant de temps que ça, hein!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1357.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1358.src: Looks like there's an outfit ready right here!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1358.dst: On dirait qu'il y a une tenue toute prête ici!

The Feathers Fly Part II#1360.src: You can give it to Ava, or you can look around the other rooms for more options.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1360.dst: Vous pouvez la donner à Ava, ou fouiller les autres pièces pour trouver d'autres options.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1361.src: There's some clothes here. They're dirty though.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1361.dst: Il y a des vêtements ici. Mais ils sont sales.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1363.src: There must be a way to wash those somewhere nearby.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1363.dst: Il doit bien y avoir un endroit pas loin pour les laver.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1364.dst: Vous commencez à laver les vêtements...

The Feathers Fly Part II#1366.src: Shoot, I think someone's coming!! Come back!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1366.dst: Mince, je crois que quelqu'un arrive!! Reviens!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1366.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1368.src: You take a look inside the drawer...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1368.dst: Vous jetez un oeil dans le tiroir...

The Feathers Fly Part II#1369.src: Lucky! There's a Mechanic Outfit in there.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1369.dst: Quelle chance! Il y a une tenue de mécanicien dedans.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1371.src: You pick up a particularly tasty-looking bone.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1371.dst: Vous ramassez un os particulièrement appétissant.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1373.src: There's some sort of armour in that chest. It looks flashy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1373.dst: Il y a une sorte d'armure dans ce coffre. Elle a l'air tape-à-l'oeil!

The Feathers Fly Part II#1378.src: It's... Quite hard to move around with that outfit, actually.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1378.dst: C'est... assez difficile de bouger avec cette tenue, en fait.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1378.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1379.src: ...Is that someone crying over there? Eh, I'm not sure my social skills can handle that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1379.dst: ...C'est quelqu'un qui pleure, là-bas? Euh, pas sûr que mes compétences sociales suffisent.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1379.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1380.dst: Je vais faire de mon mieux, {u}!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1380.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1383.src: Woah there, what's that letter? You actually got an invitation?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1383.dst: Ouh là, c'est quoi cette lettre? Tu as vraiment eu une invitation?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1383.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1384.src: I... Wow. Well I'm impressed! I really am!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1384.dst: Je... Ouah. Eh bien, je suis impressionnée! Vraiment!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1384.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1385.src: Did we even need a letter? That armour probably would've done the trick!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1385.dst: On avait même besoin d'une lettre? Cette armure aurait sûrement suffi!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1385.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1386.src: Well... If you want me to follow you, tell me. I've heard 'bout a receptionist in the far end of the castle, so maybe we should go there?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1386.dst: Bon... Si tu veux que je te suive, dis-le-moi. On parle d'une réceptionniste au fond du château, on devrait peut-être y aller?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1386.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1388.src: I heard there was a dealer around here but... We have the letter, so let's just keep goin'.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1388.dst: J'ai entendu dire qu'il y avait un vendeur par ici, mais... On a la lettre, alors continuons.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1388.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1389.src: Well, no matter! I'll just... See when the council's available and book a meeting...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1389.dst: Bon, peu importe! Je vais juste... voir quand le Conseil est disponible et réserver une réunion...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1389.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#1390.src: How peculiar. I wonder how they got that...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1390.dst: Comme c'est curieux. Je me demande d'où ça sort...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1390.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#1391.src: Hey! I saw you run towards the castle. What did you do?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1391.dst: Hé! Je t'ai vu courir vers le château. Qu'est-ce que tu as fait?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1391.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1392.src: ...Wait, what? You went to the receptionist alone, just like that?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1392.dst: ...Attends, quoi? Tu as filé chez la réceptionniste sans moi, comme ça?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1392.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1393.src: An audience is booked, and you didn't even give me the chance to show my cool armour!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1393.dst: Une audience est réservée, et tu ne m'as même pas laissé l'occasion de montrer ma super armure!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1393.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1394.src: I... I'm really grateful. What a relief. I did some tweaking regarding the machine, so you should come and test with me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1394.dst: Je... Je te suis vraiment reconnaissante. Quel soulagement. J'ai fait quelques réglages sur la machine, alors viens la tester avec moi!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1394.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1395.src: As I've said, this is only practice, don't worry.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1395.dst: Comme je l'ai dit, ce n'est qu'un entraînement, t'inquiète.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1395.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1396.src: Just tell me when you're up for another round!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1396.dst: Dis-moi quand tu veux refaire un tour!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1396.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1398.src: You probably should wait for Ava first.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1398.dst: Vous devriez sans doute attendre Ava d'abord.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1398.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1399.src: My guts are telling me this one's gonna be impressive. I hope he's there.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1399.dst: Mon instinct me dit que ça va être impressionnant. J'espère qu'il est là.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1399.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1401.dst: Tu as aidé à régler QUO-
The Feathers Fly Part II#1401.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1402.src: Looks like she's waiting for your signal.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1402.dst: On dirait qu'elle attend votre signal.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1404.dst: Même moi, je me prends au jeu!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1404.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1405.src: I still can't believe this isn't about your armour.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1405.dst: Je n'arrive toujours pas à croire que ce n'est pas pour ton armure.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1405.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#1406.src: No worries... Well, I'm worrying, but that doesn't mean you have to.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1406.dst: T'inquiète... Bon, moi je m'inquiète, mais toi, pas besoin.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1406.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1407.src: Alright guys, don't worry... We got this.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1407.dst: Bon, tout le monde, pas d'inquiétude... On gère.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1407.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1409.src: I'll just... wait for your signal, {u}.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1409.dst: Je vais juste... attendre ton signal, {u}.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1409.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1410.src: Hmpf. I certainly am curious now.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1410.dst: Hmpf. Là, je suis curieuse, c'est sûr.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1410.speaker: Grant

The Feathers Fly Part II#1411.src: She's glancing at you. Maybe she's waiting for your signal.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1411.dst: Elle vous jette un regard. Elle attend peut-être votre signal.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1413.src: EVERYONE! STOP! {u}, I want you to come here and answer something, immediately.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1413.dst: TOUT LE MONDE! STOP! {u}, viens ici et réponds-moi, immédiatement.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1413.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1414.src: You take a deep breath, and-
The Feathers Fly Part II#1414.dst: Vous prenez une grande inspiration, et-
The Feathers Fly Part II#1414.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1415.src: Looks like Maxie wants to speak to you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1415.dst: On dirait que Maxie veut vous parler.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1416.src: You're- *cough* so good at handling... priorities, Maxie.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1416.dst: Tu es- *tousse* si doué pour gérer... les priorités, Maxie.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1416.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#1417.src: Save your energy for later, Sybil.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1417.dst: Garde tes forces pour plus tard, Sybil.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1417.speaker: Nodise

The Feathers Fly Part II#1418.src: Even after... Even after this, I'm sure *cough* he'll keep defending them...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1418.dst: Même après... Même après ça, je suis sûre que *tousse* il va continuer à les défendre...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1418.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#1420.src: You've been... *cough* tricked by... Quite the individual, {u}. You better redeem yourself.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1420.dst: Tu t'es fait... *tousse* rouler par... un sacré personnage, {u}. Tu as intérêt à te racheter.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1420.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#1421.src: Efena doesn't seem very pleased to see you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1421.dst: Efena n'a pas l'air ravie de vous voir.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1423.src: No time to talk, {u}! Just go! There must be a core to hit at the top!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1423.dst: Pas le temps de parler, {u}! Vas-y! Il doit y avoir un noyau à frapper au sommet!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1423.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1424.src: Well, besides the citizens being afraid... I'd say the town's fine. However! I got tasked to find Ava.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1424.dst: Bon, à part les habitants qui ont peur... je dirais que la ville va bien. Par contre! On m'a chargé de retrouver Ava.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1424.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1425.src: Somehow... Efena ended up liking her.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1425.dst: Va savoir comment... Efena a fini par l'apprécier.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1425.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1426.src: I'm reading, but I'll be done soon!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1426.dst: Je lis, mais j'ai bientôt fini!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1426.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1427.src: Y-you!! I- oh no... I'm... It's over..!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1427.dst: T-toi!! Je- oh non... Je suis... C'est fini..!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1427.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1428.src: Hey, hey, calm down! I'm here to actually help you... in a way.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1428.dst: Hé, hé, calme-toi! Je suis là pour t'aider, vraiment... en quelque sorte.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1428.speaker: Efena

The Hero of Gavel#000.src: Find out what's happening in the center of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#000.dst: Découvrez ce qui se passe au centre de {p} en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#001.src: Hmm.. I might have just enough for one tier {~}... Why are you standing there?
The Hero of Gavel#001.dst: Hmm.. J'ai peut-être juste de quoi en avoir un de rang {~}... Pourquoi vous restez planté là?
The Hero of Gavel#001.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#002.src: What all these people are here for? Don't tell me you don't know about the Siegfried contest.
The Hero of Gavel#002.dst: Pourquoi tous ces gens sont là? Ne me dites pas que vous ne connaissez pas le concours de Siegfried.
The Hero of Gavel#002.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#003.src: Are you SERIOUS?! It's the biggest thing happening since the last contest last month!
The Hero of Gavel#003.dst: Vous êtes SÉRIEUX?! C'est le plus grand événement depuis le dernier concours, le mois dernier!
The Hero of Gavel#003.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#004.src: Whoever wins the big scavenger hunt gets to go on an adventure with Siegfried himself.
The Hero of Gavel#004.dst: Celui qui gagne la grande chasse au trésor part à l'aventure avec Siegfried en personne.
The Hero of Gavel#004.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#005.src: This year, I think I even have a good chance to win!
The Hero of Gavel#005.dst: Cette année, je crois même que j'ai mes chances!
The Hero of Gavel#005.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#006.src: Huh? Oh, you want this ticket? No way, this one's mine. Go get your own at that little shop.
The Hero of Gavel#006.dst: Hein? Oh, vous voulez ce ticket? Pas question, il est à moi. Allez acheter le vôtre à la petite boutique.
The Hero of Gavel#006.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#007.src: Hey, that's the mug I dropped!
The Hero of Gavel#007.dst: Hé, c'est la tasse que j'ai fait tomber!
The Hero of Gavel#007.speaker: Siegfried Fan 1

The Hero of Gavel#011.src: How can I win an adventure now?
The Hero of Gavel#011.speaker: Siegfried Fan 2

The Hero of Gavel#012.src: Get a Siegfried Scavenger Hunt ticket in the center of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#012.dst: Procurez-vous un ticket pour la chasse au trésor de Siegfried au centre de {p} en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#013.src: Tickets for sale! You! Would you like to join the great Siegfried Scavenger Hunt?
The Hero of Gavel#013.dst: Tickets en vente! Vous! Ça vous dit de participer à la grande chasse au trésor de Siegfried?
The Hero of Gavel#013.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#014.src: Entry is completely free, and if you win, you'll get to adventure with Siegfried himself!
The Hero of Gavel#014.dst: L'inscription est gratuite, et si vous gagnez, vous partirez à l'aventure avec Siegfried en personne!
The Hero of Gavel#014.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#015.src: You're interested? Great! Here, it's all quite simple.
The Hero of Gavel#015.dst: Ça vous intéresse? Parfait! Tenez, c'est très simple.
The Hero of Gavel#015.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#016.src: The ticket shows what items you need to find. It's split into three tiers.
The Hero of Gavel#016.dst: Le ticket indique les objets à trouver. Ils sont répartis en trois rangs.
The Hero of Gavel#016.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#017.src: The first two, they're for the common folk. But if you REALLY want to win, you need a tier {~} item.
The Hero of Gavel#017.dst: Les deux premiers, c'est pour le commun des mortels. Mais pour VRAIMENT gagner, il faut un objet de rang {~}.
The Hero of Gavel#017.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#018.src: Heh, you can even bring all three and you're practically guaranteed to win!
The Hero of Gavel#018.dst: Hé, vous pouvez même apporter les trois, et la victoire est presque assurée!
The Hero of Gavel#018.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#019.src: Here, take the ticket. Come back with your items and you'll be entered into the draw.
The Hero of Gavel#019.dst: Tenez, prenez le ticket. Revenez avec vos objets et je vous inscrirai au tirage.
The Hero of Gavel#019.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#020.src: Bring all three limited Siegfried Collection items to the merchant in {p} Center at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#020.dst: Apportez les trois objets limités de la Collection Siegfried au marchand du centre de {p} en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#021.src: You’re back! Let me see your items.
The Hero of Gavel#021.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#022.src: This… Wow, all of them? Let me take a look at these…
The Hero of Gavel#022.dst: Ça… Ouah, tous? Laissez-moi regarder ça…
The Hero of Gavel#022.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#023.src: They’re all authentic! You must be ri-I mean, you must be a huge fan of Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#023.dst: Ils sont tous authentiques! Vous devez être ri- Enfin, un grand fan de Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#023.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#025.src: Okay, I’ve entered you into the draw. The event’s taking place at the Golden Eagle Theatre.
The Hero of Gavel#025.dst: Bon, je vous ai inscrit au tirage. L'événement a lieu au Golden Eagle Theatre.
The Hero of Gavel#025.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#026.src: Just turn toward the bank and follow the signs, the winner will be selected when everyone gets there.
The Hero of Gavel#026.dst: Tournez vers la banque et suivez les panneaux, le gagnant sera désigné quand tout le monde sera arrivé.
The Hero of Gavel#026.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#027.src: Go to the Golden Eagle Theatre behind the Bank in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] for the winners to be announced.
The Hero of Gavel#027.dst: Allez au Golden Eagle Theatre derrière la banque de {p} en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] pour l'annonce des gagnants.

The Hero of Gavel#028.src: Welcome, welcome everyone! We’re only waiting on a few more people before we begin.
The Hero of Gavel#028.dst: Bienvenue, bienvenue à tous! On n'attend plus que quelques personnes avant de commencer.
The Hero of Gavel#028.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#029.src: Ah, there we go! I believe we’re all set now.
The Hero of Gavel#029.dst: Ah, les voilà! Je crois que nous sommes au complet.
The Hero of Gavel#029.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#030.src: Welcome everyone, to the monthly SIEGFRIED FESTIVAL SCAVENGER HUNT!
The Hero of Gavel#030.dst: Bienvenue à tous à la CHASSE AU TRÉSOR mensuelle du FESTIVAL SIEGFRIED!
The Hero of Gavel#030.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#031.src: Today, we are once again celebrating the heroic deeds of Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#031.dst: Aujourd'hui, nous célébrons une fois de plus les exploits héroïques de Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#031.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#032.src: All of you, my fellow gavellians, have adventured far and wide to gather rare items across the province.
The Hero of Gavel#032.dst: Vous tous, mes chers Gavelliens, avez parcouru toute la province pour réunir des objets rares.
The Hero of Gavel#032.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#033.src: And yet, I cannot announce the winner…
The Hero of Gavel#033.dst: Et pourtant, je ne peux pas annoncer le gagnant…
The Hero of Gavel#033.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#034.dst: CAR C'EST SIEGFRIED QUI LE FERA!
The Hero of Gavel#034.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#043.src: Thank you all for participating in this fantastic scavenger hunt around Gavel! Siegfried: The winner of this hunt will have the privilege of going on a once-in-a-lifetime, fully authentic, adventure with me!
The Hero of Gavel#043.dst: Merci à tous d'avoir participé à cette fantastique chasse au trésor à travers Gavel! Siegfried: Le gagnant aura le privilège de vivre avec moi une aventure unique, totalement authentique!
The Hero of Gavel#043.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#044.src: Now, without further ado: I shall announce the winner!
The Hero of Gavel#044.dst: Et maintenant, sans plus attendre: j'annonce le gagnant!
The Hero of Gavel#044.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#047.src: I better win, I bought his mug!
The Hero of Gavel#047.dst: J'ai intérêt à gagner, j'ai acheté sa tasse!
The Hero of Gavel#047.speaker: Siegfried Fan

The Hero of Gavel#048.dst: Je vais peut-être gagner, cette fois?
The Hero of Gavel#048.speaker: Siegfried Fan

The Hero of Gavel#051.src: {u}, please head to the backstage area to my right for your adventure. Thank you everyone!!
The Hero of Gavel#051.dst: {u}, rends-toi en coulisses, à ma droite, pour ton aventure. Merci à tous!!
The Hero of Gavel#051.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#052.src: Meet Siegfried backstage in the Golden Eagle Theatre to go on your adventure!
The Hero of Gavel#052.dst: Rejoignez Siegfried dans les coulisses du Golden Eagle Theatre pour partir à l'aventure!

The Hero of Gavel#053.src: Welcome {u}! Congratulations on winning the scavenger hunt!
The Hero of Gavel#053.dst: Bienvenue, {u}! Félicitations pour ta victoire à la chasse au trésor!
The Hero of Gavel#053.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#054.src: Today, you’ll be going with me on one of my glorious adventures.
The Hero of Gavel#054.dst: Aujourd'hui, tu m'accompagnes dans l'une de mes glorieuses aventures.
The Hero of Gavel#054.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#055.src: And to get there, we’ll ride in the great Siegfried Airship!
The Hero of Gavel#055.dst: Et pour y aller, nous prendrons le grand dirigeable de Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#055.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#056.src: It's up at the airship docks - I'll teleport us there!
The Hero of Gavel#056.dst: Il est aux quais des dirigeables - je vais nous y téléporter!
The Hero of Gavel#056.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#059.src: Travel with Siegfried on his airship at the {p} airship docks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#059.dst: Voyagez avec Siegfried à bord de son dirigeable depuis les quais de {p} en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#060.src: Here, follow me onto the airship!
The Hero of Gavel#060.dst: Viens, suis-moi à bord du dirigeable!
The Hero of Gavel#060.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#062.src: Impressed by my piloting skills? Dodging these islands isn’t a challenge at all for the mighty Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#062.dst: Mes talents de pilote t'impressionnent? Éviter ces îles n'est pas un défi pour le puissant Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#062.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#063.src: I rode an airship much like this one when I saved {p} from the dragon.
The Hero of Gavel#063.dst: J'ai piloté un dirigeable comme celui-ci quand j'ai sauvé {p} du dragon.
The Hero of Gavel#063.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#064.src: Right now we’re heading to a cave on the far east of the region.
The Hero of Gavel#064.dst: Nous allons vers une grotte à l'extrême est de la région.
The Hero of Gavel#064.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#065.src: We’ll have to navigate its treacherous corridors and defeat terrible beasts to get to the treasure at the end.
The Hero of Gavel#065.dst: Il faudra parcourir ses couloirs traîtres et vaincre de terribles bêtes pour atteindre le trésor au bout.
The Hero of Gavel#065.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#066.src: Why don’t you go get my map from the upper level of the airship, and we’ll get ready for our adventure.
The Hero of Gavel#066.dst: Va donc chercher ma carte au pont supérieur du dirigeable, et nous nous préparerons pour l'aventure.
The Hero of Gavel#066.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#067.src: How much lon- Oh, you brought the map! Thanks.
The Hero of Gavel#067.dst: Combien de temps encor- Oh, tu as apporté la carte! Merci.
The Hero of Gavel#067.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#068.src: We’ll need to use this map to navigate the dangerous cave we’re going to.
The Hero of Gavel#068.dst: Nous aurons besoin de cette carte pour nous repérer dans cette dangereuse grotte.
The Hero of Gavel#068.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#069.src: How did I get this? Well-er- I always prepare before my adventures!
The Hero of Gavel#069.dst: Comment je l'ai eue? Eh bien-euh- je me prépare toujours avant mes aventures!
The Hero of Gavel#069.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#070.src: Anyway, we're about to land now - be careful not to fall off!
The Hero of Gavel#070.dst: Bref, nous allons atterrir - attention à ne pas tomber!
The Hero of Gavel#070.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#071.src: Enter the perilous cave on the eastern edge of {p} with Siegfried at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#071.dst: Entrez avec Siegfried dans la périlleuse grotte à l'extrémité est de {p} en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#072.src: Here we are, the great Cave of Treasure-Hoarding Evil Creatures!
The Hero of Gavel#072.dst: Nous y voici, la grande Grotte des Créatures maléfiques amasseuses de trésors!
The Hero of Gavel#072.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#073.src: Speak to me when you’re fully prepared for this dangerous adventure.
The Hero of Gavel#073.dst: Parle-moi quand tout sera prêt pour cette dangereuse aventure.
The Hero of Gavel#073.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#074.src: This cave is exceedingly dangerous, so make sure to follow my instructions.
The Hero of Gavel#074.dst: Cette grotte est extrêmement dangereuse, alors suis bien mes instructions.
The Hero of Gavel#074.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#075.src: I’ve got decades of experience bravely adventuring in these caves, so I know what I’m doing.
The Hero of Gavel#075.dst: J'ai des décennies d'expérience à explorer bravement ces grottes, je sais ce que je fais.
The Hero of Gavel#075.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#076.dst: En avant! {u}, reste juste derrière moi!
The Hero of Gavel#076.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#077.src: Follow Siegfried through the cave on the eastern edge of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#077.dst: Suivez Siegfried à travers la grotte à l'extrémité est de {p} en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#078.src: You sure took your time getting here! No matter.
The Hero of Gavel#078.dst: Tu en as mis du temps pour arriver! Peu importe.
The Hero of Gavel#078.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#079.src: I adventure in caves such as these often to get rid of the evil beasts dwelling within.
The Hero of Gavel#079.dst: J'explore souvent des grottes comme celle-ci pour les débarrasser des bêtes maléfiques qui y vivent.
The Hero of Gavel#079.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#080.src: If it wasn’t for me defeating them before they could even--
The Hero of Gavel#080.dst: Si je ne les vainquais pas avant même qu'elles puissent--
The Hero of Gavel#080.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#081.src: Woah, stop! This might look like a harmless decoration, but it’s a trap!
The Hero of Gavel#081.dst: Ouah, stop! Ça a l'air d'une décoration inoffensive, mais c'est un piège!
The Hero of Gavel#081.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#082.src: Stay behind me, I'll open it with my magical spell. open!
The Hero of Gavel#082.dst: Reste derrière moi, je vais l'ouvrir avec mon sort magique. ouvre-toi!
The Hero of Gavel#082.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#083.src: Aha! I’ll protect you from the guardian, you deal with the rat!
The Hero of Gavel#083.dst: Aha! Je te protège du gardien, occupe-toi du rat!
The Hero of Gavel#083.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#085.src: Ow- I mean, hah! That was easier than swatting a fly for the mighty Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#085.dst: Aïe- Enfin, ha! C'était plus facile que d'écraser une mouche pour le puissant Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#085.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#086.src: Seems like we’re done here! That must have been a very difficult fight for you.
The Hero of Gavel#086.dst: On dirait qu'on en a fini ici! Ce combat a dû être très difficile pour toi.
The Hero of Gavel#086.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#087.src: The caves I adventure in are filled with terrifying beasts similar to those.
The Hero of Gavel#087.dst: Les grottes que j'explore sont pleines de bêtes terrifiantes comme celles-là.
The Hero of Gavel#087.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#088.src: WAIT! Don’t move, that boulder is about to fall!
The Hero of Gavel#088.dst: ATTENDS! Ne bouge pas, ce rocher va tomber!
The Hero of Gavel#088.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#089.src: Wow, that was close! Of course, I saw that coming and had no risk at all.
The Hero of Gavel#089.dst: Ouah, c'était moins une! Bien sûr, moi, je l'avais vu venir et je ne risquais rien.
The Hero of Gavel#089.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#090.src: You might say that we can’t go further, as it’s blocking our way. But I can fix that!
The Hero of Gavel#090.dst: Tu vas me dire qu'on ne peut plus avancer, puisqu'il bloque le passage. Mais j'ai la solution!
The Hero of Gavel#090.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#091.src: And no more boulder! Only one as powerful as I can do that.
The Hero of Gavel#091.dst: Et plus de rocher! Seul quelqu'un d'aussi puissant que moi peut faire ça.
The Hero of Gavel#091.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#092.src: All we must do now is cross a perilous bridge over the Endless Chasm.
The Hero of Gavel#092.dst: Il ne nous reste qu'à traverser un pont périlleux au-dessus de l'Endless Chasm.
The Hero of Gavel#092.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#093.src: Aa, why did- Woah, careful! It looks like the bridge fell.
The Hero of Gavel#093.dst: Ah, pourquoi- Ouah, attention! On dirait que le pont s'est effondré.
The Hero of Gavel#093.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#094.src: But this is not such an obstacle as you might think, for I can, uh, jump over this chasm!
The Hero of Gavel#094.dst: Mais ce n'est pas un obstacle aussi grand que tu crois, car je peux, euh, sauter par-dessus ce gouffre!
The Hero of Gavel#094.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#099.src: Jump after Siegfried into the pit at the end of the cave.
The Hero of Gavel#099.dst: Sautez à la suite de Siegfried dans le gouffre au fond de la grotte.

The Hero of Gavel#100.src: Find a way to wake Siegfried.
The Hero of Gavel#100.dst: Trouvez un moyen de réveiller Siegfried.

The Hero of Gavel#102.src: Aaaaggggh my LEGS MY LEGS AAAGGH SO COLD!
The Hero of Gavel#102.dst: Aaaaggggh mes JAMBES MES JAMBES AAAGGH QU'IL FAIT FROID!
The Hero of Gavel#102.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#104.src: Why couldn’t I THINK when I signed that STUPID CONTRACT that I’d end up here!?
The Hero of Gavel#104.dst: Pourquoi je n'ai pas PENSÉ, en signant ce CONTRAT STUPIDE, que je finirais ici!?
The Hero of Gavel#104.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#106.src: They aren’t gonna come rescue us, you know. We’re on our own.
The Hero of Gavel#106.dst: Ils ne viendront pas nous sauver, tu sais. On est seuls.
The Hero of Gavel#106.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#107.src: Why are you so calm? DON’T YOU SEE?!
The Hero of Gavel#107.dst: Pourquoi tu es si calme? TU NE VOIS PAS?!
The Hero of Gavel#107.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#108.src: WE'RE ON OUR OWN! This is REAL now! No coming back after 'dying', no more obvious traps, no more Siegfried! If I die here, I DIE! No coming back!
The Hero of Gavel#108.dst: ON EST SEULS! C'est RÉEL maintenant! Pas de retour après la 'mort', plus de pièges évidents, plus de Siegfried! Si je meurs ici, je MEURS! Pas de retour!
The Hero of Gavel#108.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#109.src: I.. I can’t do this. We’ll just starve here, in this cave… where nobody will ever find our bodies.
The Hero of Gavel#109.dst: Je.. Je ne peux pas. On va mourir de faim ici, dans cette grotte… où personne ne retrouvera jamais nos corps.
The Hero of Gavel#109.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#110.src: Stop looking at me! You figure out how to get us out of here, I’m just a worthless actor! Tell me if you find anything, I- I need a moment alone.
The Hero of Gavel#110.dst: Arrête de me regarder! Trouve comment nous sortir de là, moi je ne suis qu'un acteur bon à rien! Dis-moi si tu trouves quelque chose, j- j'ai besoin d'un moment seul.
The Hero of Gavel#110.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#111.src: You found something? Ok, I'll.. follow you then.
The Hero of Gavel#111.dst: Tu as trouvé quelque chose? D'accord, je.. te suis, alors.
The Hero of Gavel#111.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#112.src: WHAT WAS THAT SOUND?! A- are you sure we should go into there?
The Hero of Gavel#112.dst: C'ÉTAIT QUOI CE BRUIT?! T- tu crois vraiment qu'on doit entrer là-dedans?
The Hero of Gavel#112.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#113.src: MY ARM! IT HIT MY ARM!
The Hero of Gavel#113.dst: MON BRAS! ÇA M'A TOUCHÉ AU BRAS!
The Hero of Gavel#113.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#114.src: … I think I can manage.. OW!
The Hero of Gavel#114.dst: … Je crois que ça va aller.. AÏE!
The Hero of Gavel#114.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#115.src: Venture deeper into the cave with Siegfried.
The Hero of Gavel#115.dst: Enfoncez-vous plus loin dans la grotte avec Siegfried.

The Hero of Gavel#116.src: You.. You got us out of there!
The Hero of Gavel#116.dst: Tu.. Tu nous as sortis de là!
The Hero of Gavel#116.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#117.src: I didn’t think we’d ever find a way out of there…
The Hero of Gavel#117.dst: Je ne pensais pas qu'on trouverait un jour une sortie…
The Hero of Gavel#117.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#118.src: … Well, I guess we should keep going. M- Maybe there’s a way out?
The Hero of Gavel#118.dst: … Bon, je suppose qu'on doit continuer. P- Peut-être qu'il y a une sortie?
The Hero of Gavel#118.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#119.src: L- Look! There’s plants and light up ahead! A WAY OUT!
The Hero of Gavel#119.dst: R- Regarde! Il y a des plantes et de la lumière devant! UNE SORTIE!
The Hero of Gavel#119.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#122.src: Rescue Siegfried from the trap OR leave him there.
The Hero of Gavel#122.dst: Sauvez Siegfried du piège OU laissez-le là.

The Hero of Gavel#123.src: W- What just happened?! I’m trapped in here!
The Hero of Gavel#123.dst: Q- Que se passe-t-il?! Je suis piégé là-dedans!
The Hero of Gavel#123.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#124.src: … It’s… some sort of trap. I can feel the ground heating up!!
The Hero of Gavel#124.dst: … C'est… une sorte de piège. Je sens le sol chauffer!!
The Hero of Gavel#124.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#125.src: T-that was terrifying... Y-you saved my life. Thank you, {u}... I wasn't prepared for real danger like this.
The Hero of Gavel#125.dst: C-c'était terrifiant... T-tu m'as sauvé la vie. Merci, {u}... Je n'étais pas préparé à un vrai danger comme celui-là.
The Hero of Gavel#125.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#126.src: Rest before continuing through the cave.
The Hero of Gavel#126.dst: Reposez-vous avant de poursuivre dans la grotte.

The Hero of Gavel#127.src: …What? Houses, and a well? All the way down here?
The Hero of Gavel#127.dst: …Quoi? Des maisons, et un puits? Tout au fond, ici?
The Hero of Gavel#127.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#128.src: It’s… empty. And the houses sure don’t look like anyone’s lived here for.. centuries.
The Hero of Gavel#128.dst: C'est… vide. Et les maisons n'ont pas l'air habitées depuis.. des siècles.
The Hero of Gavel#128.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#129.src: OW! MY LEGS! And my arms, too! E- Everything hurts so much.. I need to sit down. I think I turned my arm the wrong way.
The Hero of Gavel#129.dst: AÏE! MES JAMBES! Et mes bras aussi! T- Tout me fait si mal.. Il faut que je m'asseye. Je crois que je me suis tordu le bras dans le mauvais sens.
The Hero of Gavel#129.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#130.src: I’ll just.. rest here a bit. W- would you mind taking a look around for something we can eat? I can.. hardly move.
The Hero of Gavel#130.dst: Je vais juste.. me reposer un peu ici. T- Tu veux bien chercher quelque chose à manger dans le coin? Je peux.. à peine bouger.
The Hero of Gavel#130.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#131.src: … Was this a sandwich at some point?
The Hero of Gavel#131.dst: … C'était un sandwich, à un moment?
The Hero of Gavel#131.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#132.src: It barely has any resemblance to one.
The Hero of Gavel#132.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#133.src: Well… I doubt there’s anything better around here. I- I’ll take it.
The Hero of Gavel#133.dst: Bon… Je doute qu'il y ait mieux par ici. J- Je le prends.
The Hero of Gavel#133.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#134.src: OW!! I think I broke my teeth! This is like eating stone!
The Hero of Gavel#134.dst: AÏE!! Je me suis cassé les dents! C'est comme mâcher de la pierre!
The Hero of Gavel#134.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#135.src: … I th-ow-ink I’m ready to- ow- move on. Let’s get go-oow-ing.
The Hero of Gavel#135.dst: … Je cr-aïe-ois que je suis prêt à- aïe- continuer. Al-aïe-lons-y.
The Hero of Gavel#135.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#136.src: ... Is this the food you found?
The Hero of Gavel#136.dst: ... C'est ça que tu as trouvé à manger?
The Hero of Gavel#136.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#137.src: I guess it's... the best that could be found here. You say you cooked it yourself?
The Hero of Gavel#137.dst: J'imagine que c'est... le mieux qu'on pouvait trouver ici. Tu dis que tu l'as cuisiné toi-même?
The Hero of Gavel#137.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#138.src: I'll give it a try, then. Doubt there's anything better around here.
The Hero of Gavel#138.dst: Je vais goûter, alors. Je doute qu'il y ait mieux par ici.
The Hero of Gavel#138.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#140.src: Thank you, {u}! I feel much better, I can head deeper as soon as you're ready.
The Hero of Gavel#140.dst: Merci, {u}! Je me sens beaucoup mieux, je peux descendre plus loin dès que tu veux.
The Hero of Gavel#140.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#142.src: I guess... I'll eat it, if it's the only food around.
The Hero of Gavel#142.dst: Bon... je vais le manger, si c'est tout ce qu'il y a.
The Hero of Gavel#142.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#143.src: Let's see... How do i even eat these?
The Hero of Gavel#143.dst: Voyons... Comment on mange ça, d'abord?
The Hero of Gavel#143.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#145.dst: Enfoncez-vous plus loin dans la grotte.

The Hero of Gavel#146.src: You know… my name is actually Gurix.
The Hero of Gavel#146.dst: Tu sais… en fait, je m'appelle Gurix.
The Hero of Gavel#146.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#147.src: Sounds extremely Corkian, I know. They made me use Siegfried because it sounds less foreign, I suppose.
The Hero of Gavel#147.dst: Ça fait très Corkian, je sais. On m'a fait prendre Siegfried parce que ça sonne moins étranger, je suppose.
The Hero of Gavel#147.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#149.src: OW! {u}, I think this web is poisoned! Quick, get me out with one of your spells!
The Hero of Gavel#149.dst: AÏE! {u}, je crois que cette toile est empoisonnée! Vite, sors-moi de là avec un de tes sorts!
The Hero of Gavel#149.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#150.src: Thank you, {u}. I'll.. I'll follow you from now on. Clearly you're more prepared than I am.
The Hero of Gavel#150.dst: Merci, {u}. Je vais.. Je vais te suivre, désormais. Tu t'y connais clairement mieux que moi.
The Hero of Gavel#150.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#151.src: Find your way through the spider burrows.
The Hero of Gavel#151.dst: Trouvez votre chemin à travers les terriers d'araignées.

The Hero of Gavel#152.src: {u}? I think that giant web there is being held up by the platforms on the walls.
The Hero of Gavel#152.dst: {u}? Je crois que cette toile géante est retenue par les plateformes sur les murs.
The Hero of Gavel#152.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#153.src: I think… Maybe you can cut them down? I’ll stay here, I think it’s the safest place. I’ll call for you if a spider webs me again.
The Hero of Gavel#153.dst: Je pense… Tu pourrais peut-être les abattre? Je reste ici, ça me semble le plus sûr. Je t'appellerai si une araignée m'emprisonne encore.
The Hero of Gavel#153.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#154.src: You did it! The web fell!
The Hero of Gavel#154.dst: Tu as réussi! La toile est tombée!
The Hero of Gavel#154.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#155.src: Let’s head onwards, I don’t want to deal with any more spiders.
The Hero of Gavel#155.dst: Continuons, je ne veux plus avoir affaire aux araignées.
The Hero of Gavel#155.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#157.src: Hey, wait up! Thanks for saving me there.
The Hero of Gavel#157.dst: Hé, attends-moi! Merci de m'avoir sauvé, là.
The Hero of Gavel#157.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#158.src: Woah... This is enormous! Who knows what this used to be?
The Hero of Gavel#158.dst: Ouah... C'est immense! Qui sait ce que c'était, avant?
The Hero of Gavel#158.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#159.src: The path seems to be across those yellow shards, maybe we can cross them?
The Hero of Gavel#159.dst: Le chemin semble passer par ces éclats jaunes, on peut peut-être les traverser?
The Hero of Gavel#159.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#160.src: Find a way to escape through the skylight at the end of the cave.
The Hero of Gavel#160.dst: Trouvez un moyen de vous échapper par la lucarne au fond de la grotte.

The Hero of Gavel#161.src: Another town? Or another part of the same one? I’m not sure..
The Hero of Gavel#161.dst: Un autre village? Ou une autre partie du même? Je ne suis pas sûr..
The Hero of Gavel#161.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#162.src: This one even seems to have a forge and a tailor.. It was a full, proper village!
The Hero of Gavel#162.dst: Celui-ci a même une forge et un tailleur.. C'était un vrai village, complet!
The Hero of Gavel#162.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#163.dst: Ça.. c'est la lumière du soleil?
The Hero of Gavel#163.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#164.src: {u}, look! I can see the sky from here! M- maybe there’s a way to get up!
The Hero of Gavel#164.dst: {u}, regarde! Je vois le ciel d'ici! P- peut-être qu'il y a un moyen de monter!
The Hero of Gavel#164.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#165.src: I think.. what if we can use this geyser somehow? It looks dormant, but I feel like we can activate it again.
The Hero of Gavel#165.dst: Je pense.. et si on pouvait se servir de ce geyser? Il a l'air endormi, mais j'ai l'impression qu'on peut le réactiver.
The Hero of Gavel#165.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#166.src: You take a look around, I’ll be resting a little. I don’t think I’ve ever walked this much in my life…
The Hero of Gavel#166.dst: Jette un oeil autour, moi je vais me reposer un peu. Je crois que je n'ai jamais autant marché de ma vie…
The Hero of Gavel#166.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#168.src: W-Wait.. that’ll be quite a long fall after we get launched up. Can you try making some safety equipment, like a parachute or some really soft boots?
The Hero of Gavel#168.dst: A-Attends.. ça va être une sacrée chute après le décollage. Tu peux essayer de fabriquer de l'équipement de sécurité, genre un parachute ou des bottes très souples?
The Hero of Gavel#168.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#169.src: You’ve already made something? Let me see.
The Hero of Gavel#169.dst: Tu as déjà fabriqué quelque chose? Fais voir.
The Hero of Gavel#169.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#170.src: This looks… usable? It’s something, at least.
The Hero of Gavel#170.dst: Ça a l'air… utilisable? C'est déjà ça.
The Hero of Gavel#170.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#171.src: Probably the best we’ll get down here. Are you sure you don’t need anything for yourself? No? Okay.
The Hero of Gavel#171.dst: Sans doute le mieux qu'on puisse trouver ici. Tu n'as vraiment besoin de rien pour toi? Non? D'accord.
The Hero of Gavel#171.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#172.src: I can’t wait to see the look on their faces when we get back. We’ve just saved the legacy of Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#172.dst: J'ai hâte de voir leurs têtes quand on reviendra. On vient de sauver l'héritage de Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#172.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#176.src: W-we made it? ...{u}, WE DID IT! WE'RE BACK! HAHAAA! I'M ALIVE!
The Hero of Gavel#176.dst: On s'en est s-sortis? ...{u}, ON A RÉUSSI! ON EST REVENUS! HAHAAA! JE VIS!
The Hero of Gavel#176.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#177.src: Hello there! It is I, Siegfried, and I just stopped the threat that was this cave!
The Hero of Gavel#177.dst: Bonjour à tous! C'est moi, Siegfried, et je viens de mettre fin à la menace de cette grotte!
The Hero of Gavel#177.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#178.src: Hah, that’s a great costume you have there! Looks just like me!
The Hero of Gavel#178.dst: Ha, joli costume que tu as là! On dirait moi!
The Hero of Gavel#178.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#179.dst: Quoi? On m'a- On m'a REMPLACÉ?
The Hero of Gavel#179.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#180.src: Hah, don't mind that jokester over there. He does have an impressive costume though!
The Hero of Gavel#180.dst: Ha, ne fais pas attention à ce plaisantin. Il a quand même un costume impressionnant!
The Hero of Gavel#180.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#181.src: W-what's going on here? You can't replace me!
The Hero of Gavel#181.dst: Q-qu'est-ce qui se passe? On ne peut pas me remplacer!
The Hero of Gavel#181.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#183.src: Look over there! Those must be fireworks to celebrate my victory!
The Hero of Gavel#183.dst: Regarde là-bas! Ce doivent être des feux d'artifice pour célébrer ma victoire!
The Hero of Gavel#183.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#185.src: Well, anyways! You had a really bad fall in that cave there. I carried you out myself, you must’ve had some wild hallucinations.
The Hero of Gavel#185.dst: Bref! Tu as fait une très mauvaise chute dans cette grotte. Je t'en ai sorti moi-même, tu as dû avoir de sacrées hallucinations.
The Hero of Gavel#185.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#186.src: Even though it was your own mistake, I’ll return you the emeralds you spent on the scavenger hunt.. and some more as compensation. That'll be.. [{~} Liquified Emeralds]!
The Hero of Gavel#186.dst: Même si c'était ta faute, je te rends les émeraudes dépensées pour la chasse au trésor.. et un peu plus en dédommagement. Ça fera.. [{~} émeraudes liquides]!
The Hero of Gavel#186.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#187.src: I must return to {p} for the celebration now. Perhaps we will meet again at the next scavenger hunt!
The Hero of Gavel#187.dst: Je dois retourner à {p} pour la fête. On se reverra peut-être à la prochaine chasse au trésor!
The Hero of Gavel#187.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#188.src: Hello there, human! It is I, Siegfried! You must have just missed how I expertly ended the threat of this monster-ridden cave!
The Hero of Gavel#188.dst: Bonjour, humain! C'est moi, Siegfried! Tu viens de rater de peu comment j'ai magistralement éliminé la menace de cette grotte infestée de monstres!
The Hero of Gavel#188.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#191.src: {u}, I'm glad to see you managed to get out alive. That must have been quite a fall into the chasm.
The Hero of Gavel#191.dst: {u}, content de te voir en vie. Ça a dû être une sacrée chute dans le gouffre.
The Hero of Gavel#191.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#192.src: Of course, I got out easily using my spells and great knowledge of caves! Well, I must be off now. Maybe we may meet again if you win the next scavenger hunt!
