The Mercenary#060.dst: On doit tous faire des sacrifices, Lanu.
The Mercenary#060.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#061.src: Hm. No, I don't think I do. Either way, that sounds like a plan. {u}, Linton, and I will break into the barracks then.
The Mercenary#061.dst: Hm. Moi, je ne crois pas. Bref, ça nous fait un plan. {u}, Linton et moi, on force l'entrée de la caserne.
The Mercenary#061.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#063.src: And Lanu and I can distract 'em while you do so. Sounds like a plan! Let's get goin'.
The Mercenary#063.dst: Et Lanu et moi, on les distrait pendant ce temps. Ça m'va! En route.
The Mercenary#063.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#065.src: Well, well. This looks like a good place to break our way in, wouldn't you say, Aledar?
The Mercenary#065.dst: Tiens, tiens. Voilà un bon endroit pour se frayer un chemin, tu ne trouves pas, Aledar?
The Mercenary#065.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#066.src: Yes, Linton, it looks fine. {u}, we'll be looking for Takan. I think the two of us could take him out.
The Mercenary#066.dst: Oui, Linton, ça ira. {u}, on cherche Takan. Je pense qu'à nous deux, on peut l'avoir.
The Mercenary#066.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#067.src: And I'll be looking for the captured soldiers! I stole a map of the barracks from Amerigo's desk, so I'll be able to find them easily enough!
The Mercenary#067.dst: Et moi, je cherche les soldats capturés! J'ai piqué un plan de la caserne sur le bureau d'Amerigo, alors je les trouverai sans peine!
The Mercenary#067.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#068.src: You-... nevermind, I don't care. Just do your job, please?
The Mercenary#068.dst: Tu-... laisse tomber, je m'en fiche. Fais juste ton travail, d'accord?
The Mercenary#068.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#070.src: See you two on the other side!
The Mercenary#070.dst: On se retrouve de l'autre côté!
The Mercenary#070.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#073.src: Damn it... damn it, damn it, damn it ALL! Couldn't give me a MOMENT of peace, could he, that rat Amerigo...
The Mercenary#073.dst: Bon sang... bon sang, bon sang, bon sang de BON SANG! Pas un INSTANT de paix, hein, ce rat d'Amerigo...
The Mercenary#073.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#074.src: ...do I really need to do everything myself?! It's almost as though-
The Mercenary#074.dst: ...dois-je vraiment tout faire moi-même?! C'est presque comme si-
The Mercenary#074.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#075.src: Oh, I see. I see what's going on. More of Amerigo's dogs, here to take care of his business, huh?! Get out here where I can see you.
The Mercenary#075.dst: Oh, je vois. Je vois ce qui se passe. Encore des chiens d'Amerigo venus faire son sale boulot, hein?! Sortez de là que je vous voie.
The Mercenary#075.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#076.src: You look new... haven't been around long enough to really see the face of War up close and personal yet, have you?
The Mercenary#076.dst: Vous avez l'air nouveaux... vous n'avez pas encore vu le visage de la Guerre de près, hein?
The Mercenary#076.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#077.src: You think this is right? You think it's right that those DAMNED admirals get all the wealth and fame, when WE'RE the ones out fighting in the trenches?!
The Mercenary#077.dst: Tu trouves ça juste? Tu trouves juste que ces MAUDITS amiraux récoltent richesse et gloire, alors que c'est NOUS qui nous battons dans les tranchées?!
The Mercenary#077.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#078.src: And these IDIOTS think they deserve their power? Their authority?!
The Mercenary#078.dst: Et ces IDIOTS pensent mériter leur pouvoir? Leur autorité?!
The Mercenary#078.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#079.src: ...You've killed dozens, and you're keeping dozens more captured.
The Mercenary#079.dst: ...Vous avez tué des dizaines de gens, et en retenez des dizaines d'autres.
The Mercenary#079.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#080.src: And I'd do all that and more, just to prove my point! They think they hold power?! I'll show them power...
The Mercenary#080.dst: Et je ferais tout ça et pire, rien que pour le prouver! Ils croient avoir le pouvoir?! Je vais leur en montrer, du pouvoir...
The Mercenary#080.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#081.src: Step aside, Shadow Spears. I'd like to deal with these dogs myself.
The Mercenary#081.dst: Écartez-vous, Shadow Spears. Ces chiens, je m'en occupe moi-même.
The Mercenary#081.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#082.src: ...We won't make it easy for you.
The Mercenary#082.dst: ...On ne vous facilitera pas la tâche.
The Mercenary#082.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#087.src: This tower can only go up... Come on, we need to chase after him! We can't let him get away!
The Mercenary#087.dst: Cette tour ne fait que monter... Allez, il faut le poursuivre! On ne peut pas le laisser filer!
The Mercenary#087.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#088.src: Continue up the stairs in the barracks.
The Mercenary#088.dst: Continuez à monter les escaliers de la caserne.

The Mercenary#091.src: Look, it's obvious we've lost here. Even if that idiot escapes, you military folk will find him.
The Mercenary#091.dst: Écoutez, c'est évident qu'on a perdu. Même si cet idiot s'échappe, vous, les militaires, vous le retrouverez.
The Mercenary#091.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#092.src: Here, take the key to the tower. A sign of good faith. Do what you will with him, I really don't care.
The Mercenary#092.dst: Tenez, la clé de la tour. Un gage de bonne foi. Faites de lui ce que vous voulez, ça m'est bien égal.
The Mercenary#092.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#093.src: I always preferred his brother anyway. Much quieter.
The Mercenary#093.dst: J'ai toujours préféré son frère. Bien plus discret.
The Mercenary#093.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#094.src: Ugh, more bandits... I'll hold them off here.
The Mercenary#094.dst: Pff, encore des bandits... Je les retiens ici.
The Mercenary#094.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#095.src: Keep going after Takan! I'll be fine!
The Mercenary#095.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#096.src: Head up the tower and take out Takan.
The Mercenary#096.dst: Montez en haut de la tour et éliminez Takan.

The Mercenary#097.src: Urgh... Why did I even come up here?! There's nowhere for me to-
The Mercenary#097.dst: Argh... Pourquoi suis-je monté ici?! Je n'ai nulle part où-
The Mercenary#097.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#098.src: ...Oh. L-listen. We can talk this out-
The Mercenary#098.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#101.src: ...and so then, I had to free them somehow! So I shouted at them to brace for it, and-
The Mercenary#101.dst: ...et du coup, il fallait que je les libère! Alors je leur ai crié de se préparer, et-
The Mercenary#101.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#102.src: {u}! There you are! I'm glad you made it out safely. It looks like the bandits are dispersing.
The Mercenary#102.dst: {u}! Te voilà! Ravi que tu aies pu sortir sans encombre. On dirait que les bandits se dispersent.
The Mercenary#102.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#103.src: And so is my train of thought for my story. So! Did you get him?
The Mercenary#103.dst: Tout comme le fil de mon histoire. Bref! Vous l'avez eu?
The Mercenary#103.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#104.src: He's dead. I have his badge.
The Mercenary#104.dst: Il est mort. J'ai son insigne.

The Mercenary#105.src: That's good to hear. At least something good came of this whole situation...
The Mercenary#105.dst: Bonne nouvelle. Au moins, il est sorti quelque chose de bon de toute cette histoire...
The Mercenary#105.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#106.src: Oh, not this again. You're still on that?
The Mercenary#106.dst: Oh non, pas encore ça. T'en es toujours là?
The Mercenary#106.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#107.src: I caught a few of the things he was shoutin' from outside. It didn't sound very pleasant.
The Mercenary#107.dst: J'ai entendu des trucs qu'il criait, depuis dehors. Ça avait pas l'air très plaisant.
The Mercenary#107.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#108.src:
Lanu:
Some of us care about history, Mel.
The Mercenary#108.dst:
Lanu:
Certains tiennent à l'histoire, Mel.
The Mercenary#108.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#109.src: Well, I didn't hear a thing. Probably on account of the ringing in my ears. It seems to me we're done here, though, right?
The Mercenary#109.dst: Moi, je n'ai rien entendu. Sûrement à cause de mes oreilles qui sifflent. Mais il me semble qu'on a fini ici, non?
The Mercenary#109.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#110.src: It looks like it, yes. I think I'll stay behind to help the soldiers clear out the remaining bandits.
The Mercenary#110.dst: On dirait, oui. Je crois que je vais rester aider les soldats à chasser les derniers bandits.
The Mercenary#110.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#111.src: I figure I'll stick around too. Don't got anythin' better to do right now, anyway!
The Mercenary#111.dst: J'crois que j'vais rester aussi. J'ai rien de mieux à faire pour l'instant, de toute façon!
The Mercenary#111.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#112.src: Well, I'm out of here. I've got places to be! Things to do! Explosives to return! Goodbye!
The Mercenary#112.dst: Bon, moi, je file. J'ai des endroits où aller! Des choses à faire! Des explosifs à rendre! Au revoir!
The Mercenary#112.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#113.src: {u}, I guess that leaves the two of us to return to {p} with the news! Let's get going.
The Mercenary#113.dst: {u}, il ne reste plus que nous deux pour rapporter la nouvelle à {p}! Allons-y.
The Mercenary#113.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#114.src: Bring Takan's badge to Amerigo at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Mercenary#114.dst: Apportez l'insigne de Takan à Amerigo en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Mercenary#115.src: Soldiers! Report! Don't tell me you're the only two survivors, damn it all...
The Mercenary#115.dst: Soldats! Votre rapport! Ne me dites pas que vous êtes les deux seuls survivants, bon sang...
The Mercenary#115.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#116.src: No, sir, the mission was a success. Takan is dead.
The Mercenary#116.dst: Non, amiral, la mission est un succès. Takan est mort.
The Mercenary#116.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#117.src: You're certain of this? You have his badge, surely...?
The Mercenary#117.dst: Vous en êtes certains? Vous avez son insigne, j'imagine...?
The Mercenary#117.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#118.src: I see... satisfactory work, soldiers. You two, and the others, have {p}'s gratitude.
The Mercenary#118.dst: Je vois... travail satisfaisant, soldats. Vous deux et les autres avez la gratitude de {p}.
The Mercenary#118.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#119.src: You will all be well-compensated for your work today. Now, run along. I have to collect my honorary badge for taking out Ex-Commander Takan.
The Mercenary#119.dst: Vous serez tous bien payés pour aujourd'hui. Allez, filez. Je dois récupérer mon insigne honorifique pour avoir éliminé l'ex-commandant Takan.
The Mercenary#119.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#120.src: I'm starting to see why Takan hated him so much.
The Mercenary#120.dst: Je commence à comprendre pourquoi Takan le détestait autant.
The Mercenary#120.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#121.src: I'll... probably try to speak to Admiral Aegis about that the next time I'm in {p}.
The Mercenary#121.dst: Je vais... sans doute essayer d'en parler à l'amiral Aegis la prochaine fois que je serai à {p}.
The Mercenary#121.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#122.src: Anyway! What an adventure, right? I can't wait to tell Tasim about it.
The Mercenary#122.dst: Bref! Quelle aventure, hein? J'ai hâte de raconter ça à Tasim.
The Mercenary#122.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#123.src: ...Speaking of. Have you heard from him recently? I can't seem to get ahold of him at all.
The Mercenary#123.dst: ...D'ailleurs. Tu as eu de ses nouvelles récemment? Impossible de le joindre.
The Mercenary#123.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#124.src: It's weird. Last I heard, he was at {p}, but he's not there anymore.
The Mercenary#124.dst: C'est bizarre. Aux dernières nouvelles, il était à {p}, mais il n'y est plus.
The Mercenary#124.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#125.src: He went off to Gavel, I thin
The Mercenary#125.dst: Il est parti à Gavel, je cro

The Mercenary#126.src: He- what? Really? And he didn't even tell me...
The Mercenary#126.dst: Il- quoi? Vraiment? Et il ne m'a même rien dit...
The Mercenary#126.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#127.src: ...I guess it must have slipped his mind. That's alright. We're all busy around here, right?
The Mercenary#127.dst: ...Ça a dû lui sortir de la tête. Ce n'est pas grave. On est tous occupés ici, pas vrai?
The Mercenary#127.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#128.src: Yeah, that makes two of us...
The Mercenary#128.dst: Oui, on est deux dans ce cas...
The Mercenary#128.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#129.src: Well, it's probably fine. I'm sure he'll pop up eventually! We just need to wait.
The Mercenary#129.dst: Bon, ce n'est sûrement rien. Je suis sûr qu'il finira par refaire surface! Il suffit d'attendre.
The Mercenary#129.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#130.src: I wonder where he's gone off to? Some kind of assignment in {p}, maybe? Or could he have gone off to Gavel...?
The Mercenary#130.dst: Je me demande où il est parti. Une mission à {p}, peut-être? Ou serait-il parti à Gavel...?
The Mercenary#130.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#131.src: Well, whatever. It was good to see you again! Even if... well. Even if it was strange.
The Mercenary#131.dst: Enfin, peu importe. Ça m'a fait plaisir de te revoir! Même si... enfin. Même si c'était étrange.
The Mercenary#131.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#133.src: Well, I guess I'm going to head off. I'll see you around, {u}!
The Mercenary#133.dst: Bon, je crois que je vais y aller. A la prochaine, {u}!
The Mercenary#133.speaker: Aledar

The Missing Piece#000.src: It says it's for 'the woman on the hill'.
The Missing Piece#000.dst: C'est pour 'la femme sur la colline'.

The Missing Piece#003.src: I have some letters that are addressed to you.
The Missing Piece#003.dst: J'ai des lettres qui vous sont adressées.

The Missing Piece#004.src: Move and rotate the selected beam using the directional buttons.
The Missing Piece#004.dst: Déplacez et pivotez la poutre choisie avec les boutons directionnels.

The Missing Piece#005.src: You could either confront them or talk to Elise about what to do.
The Missing Piece#005.dst: Vous pouvez les confronter ou demander à Elise ce qu'il faut faire.

The Missing Piece#007.src: It would be best to get the bread and get out of this place quickly.
The Missing Piece#007.dst: Mieux vaut prendre le pain et filer d'ici au plus vite.

The Missing Piece#008.src: You are already carrying a bottle.

The Missing Piece#009.src: The handwriting seems familiar. But, it doesn't say much...
The Missing Piece#009.dst: L'écriture vous dit quelque chose. Mais la lettre est brève...

The Missing Piece#010.src: Throw a Bottle by {#} RIGHT-CLICKING to aim and then {#} RIGHT-CLICKING again to throw.
The Missing Piece#010.dst: Lancez une bouteille: {#} CLIC DROIT pour viser, puis à nouveau {#} CLIC DROIT pour lancer.

The Missing Piece#012.src: After knocking them out,  RIGHT-CLICK to search workers.
The Missing Piece#012.dst: Une fois assommés,  CLIC DROIT pour fouiller les ouvriers.

The Missing Piece#013.src: Now, how to get up from here...

The Missing Piece#014.src: This must be the pipe Bush was talking about...
The Missing Piece#014.dst: Ce doit être le tuyau dont parlait Bush...

The Missing Piece#015.src: Hm... There's no sender... Are these all from the same person?
The Missing Piece#015.dst: Hm... Pas d'expéditeur... Elles viennent toutes de la même personne?

The Missing Piece#016.src: Pick up your post in the Post Office at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#016.dst: Récupérez votre courrier au bureau de poste en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#018.src: Don't you see I'm busy!? Take a ticket and wait in line as you're supposed to! I don't care if no one else is here, follow protocol!
The Missing Piece#018.dst: Vous voyez bien que je suis occupé!? Prenez un ticket et faites la queue comme il se doit! Même s'il n'y a personne, suivez le protocole!
The Missing Piece#018.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#019.src: You could get across this gap by arranging the suspended beams into a path.
The Missing Piece#019.dst: Vous pourriez franchir ce vide en alignant les poutres suspendues pour former un chemin.

The Missing Piece#020.src: Oh, yes! The letters. Silly me, I almost forgot.
The Missing Piece#020.dst: Ah, oui! Les lettres. Suis-je bête, j'allais oublier.

The Missing Piece#022.src: Take a ticket from the Ticket Machine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#022.dst: Prenez un ticket au distributeur de tickets en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#023.src: You have to take a ticket, just like everyone else!
The Missing Piece#023.dst: Vous devez prendre un ticket, comme tout le monde!
The Missing Piece#023.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#024.src: Return to the Post Office at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#024.dst: Retournez au bureau de poste en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#027.src: I'll be with you in one second! Gosh, so impatient these days...
The Missing Piece#027.dst: Je suis à vous dans une seconde! Ma parole, que les gens sont pressés...
The Missing Piece#027.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#028.src: Tired of waiting already? Well, someone decided to leave this place a mess for when I returned!
The Missing Piece#028.dst: Déjà las d'attendre? Eh bien, quelqu'un a décidé de me laisser cet endroit en pagaille pour mon retour!
The Missing Piece#028.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#029.src: I come back to the office yesterday from a well-deserved, brief, eighteen week, vacation. And this is how I'm thanked?!
The Missing Piece#029.dst: Je reviens hier au bureau après de courtes vacances bien méritées de dix-huit semaines. Et voilà comment on me remercie?!
The Missing Piece#029.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#030.src: Do you see the mess my substitute left this place in? And now I have to clean it up, or the Royal Inspector will have my head!
The Missing Piece#030.dst: Vous voyez le chantier que mon remplaçant m'a laissé? Et maintenant, c'est à moi de tout nettoyer, sinon l'Inspecteur royal aura ma tête!
The Missing Piece#030.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#031.src: I'll have you know I graduated with honours from the Royal University of Aelumia.
The Missing Piece#031.dst: Sachez que je suis diplômé avec mention de l'Université royale d'Aelumia.
The Missing Piece#031.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#032.src: Frankly, it's demeaning they stuck me out here with the... ugh... peasants! Oh, and don't even get me started on the smell!
The Missing Piece#032.dst: Franchement, c'est humiliant de m'avoir relégué ici avec les... beurk... paysans! Oh, et ne me lancez pas sur l'odeur!
The Missing Piece#032.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#033.src: But anyway, that is all besides the point. What did you want again?
The Missing Piece#033.dst: Bref, là n'est pas la question. Que vouliez-vous, déjà?
The Missing Piece#033.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#034.src: It's you! You're the one I left in charge over my vacation, you scoundrel!
The Missing Piece#034.dst: C'est vous! C'est à vous que j'ai confié le bureau pendant mes vacances, gredin!
The Missing Piece#034.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#036.src: I knew it! A university graduate like me couldn't possibly be wrong!
The Missing Piece#036.dst: Je le savais! Un diplômé de l'université comme moi ne peut pas se tromper!
The Missing Piece#036.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#038.src: Don't try to weasel your way out of it! A university graduate like me couldn't possibly be wrong!
The Missing Piece#038.dst: N'essayez pas de vous défiler! Un diplômé de l'université comme moi ne peut pas se tromper!
The Missing Piece#038.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#041.src: It's not just me who's going to be in trouble when the inspection comes, surely you realize that?
The Missing Piece#041.dst: Je ne serai pas le seul à avoir des ennuis lors de l'inspection, vous vous en rendez compte?
The Missing Piece#041.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#043.src: If you fix this mess you made... Then no one ever has to hear a word of what happened.
The Missing Piece#043.dst: Si vous réparez le gâchis que vous avez fait... Alors personne n'entendra jamais parler de tout ça.
The Missing Piece#043.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#044.src: You don't get in trouble, the Royal Inspector is happy, I'm happy. Everyone is happy!
The Missing Piece#044.dst: Vous n'avez pas d'ennuis, l'Inspecteur royal est content, je suis content. Tout le monde est content!
The Missing Piece#044.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#048.src: Then I'll have you sorting post like your life depends on it, scoundrel!
The Missing Piece#048.dst: Alors vous allez trier le courrier comme si votre vie en dépendait, gredin!
The Missing Piece#048.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#052.src: Sorting is so easy even someone like you should be able to do it.
The Missing Piece#052.dst: Trier, c'est si facile que même quelqu'un comme vous devrait y arriver.
The Missing Piece#052.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#053.src: All you do is take the packages from the conveyor over there.
The Missing Piece#053.dst: Il suffit de prendre les colis sur le tapis roulant, là-bas.
The Missing Piece#053.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#054.src: And put them where they're supposed to go over there.
The Missing Piece#054.dst: Et de les mettre là où ils doivent aller, là-bas.
The Missing Piece#054.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#055.src: {p} packages to the {p}, Auburn packages to the {p}, and so on.
The Missing Piece#055.dst: Les colis de {p} vers {p}, ceux d'Auburn vers {p}, et ainsi de suite.
The Missing Piece#055.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#057.src: Fantastic! Just don't make a mess of it, okay?
The Missing Piece#057.dst: Fantastique! Surtout, ne gâchez rien, d'accord?
The Missing Piece#057.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#061.src: Well, that was just the warmup! There's more to come, so don't go slacking off now!
The Missing Piece#061.dst: Eh bien, ce n'était que l'échauffement! Il y en a encore, alors ne vous relâchez pas!
The Missing Piece#061.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#062.src: Hmm... You did fine this time, but watch out, because these last packages come fast!
The Missing Piece#062.dst: Hmm... Pas mal cette fois, mais attention, ces derniers colis arrivent vite!
The Missing Piece#062.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#063.src: Don't think you're somebody just because you can sort some packages!
The Missing Piece#063.dst: Ne vous prenez pas pour quelqu'un juste parce que vous savez trier des colis!
The Missing Piece#063.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#064.src: What are you doing over there!?
The Missing Piece#064.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#065.src: Agh! Try again, but you better do it right this time!
The Missing Piece#065.dst: Agh! Recommencez, et cette fois, faites-le bien!
The Missing Piece#065.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#066.src: Don't bother me while I'm working! I didn't go to university just to slack off with people like you!
The Missing Piece#066.dst: Ne me dérangez pas quand je travaille! Je n'ai pas fait l'université pour lambiner avec des gens comme vous!
The Missing Piece#066.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#068.src: Ah, perfect! You sorted the packages!
The Missing Piece#068.dst: Ah, parfait! Vous avez trié les colis!
The Missing Piece#068.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#069.src: But wait, what's this then? Why are there so many packages to the {p}?
The Missing Piece#069.dst: Mais attendez, qu'est-ce que c'est que ça? Pourquoi y a-t-il autant de colis pour {p}?
The Missing Piece#069.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#070.src: Did you mess up the sorting, you fool!?
The Missing Piece#070.dst: Vous avez raté le tri, imbécile!?
The Missing Piece#070.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#071.src: What's up with these packages! They're filled with letters?
The Missing Piece#071.dst: Qu'est-ce qu'ils ont, ces colis! Ils sont remplis de lettres?
The Missing Piece#071.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#072.src: Hmph... all of them to the woman on the hill... Whatever that means!
The Missing Piece#072.dst: Hmph... toutes pour la femme sur la colline... Allez savoir ce que ça veut dire!
The Missing Piece#072.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#073.src: Hey you, scoundrel. This is part of your duty too, you know!
The Missing Piece#073.dst: Hé, vous, le gredin. Ça fait aussi partie de votre travail, vous savez!
The Missing Piece#073.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#074.src: Go deliver these letters! Or... or I'll tell the Royal Inspector about what you did! That's right, don't mess with me!
The Missing Piece#074.dst: Allez livrer ces lettres! Ou... ou je raconte à l'Inspecteur royal ce que vous avez fait! Parfaitement, on ne se moque pas de moi!
The Missing Piece#074.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#075.src: How should I know! That's your job to figure out. See, it says here 'to the woman on the hill', that should be enough shouldn't it?
The Missing Piece#075.dst: Comment voulez-vous que je le sache! C'est à vous de trouver. Regardez, c'est écrit 'pour la femme sur la colline', ça devrait suffire, non?
The Missing Piece#075.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#076.src: Oh, but you are! I have very many friends, in very high places! Met them in university, makes sure to remember that!
The Missing Piece#076.dst: Oh, que si! J'ai de très nombreux amis très haut placés! Rencontrés à l'université, ne l'oubliez pas!
The Missing Piece#076.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#077.src: Great! Now with that settled I can finally go back to my very important work.
The Missing Piece#077.dst: Parfait! Maintenant que c'est réglé, je peux enfin retourner à mon travail très important.
The Missing Piece#077.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#078.src: Oh, yes. Very important. University graduate, did I mention that?
The Missing Piece#078.dst: Oh, oui. Très important. Diplômé de l'université, je vous l'ai dit?
The Missing Piece#078.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#079.src: Now now, off you go. And don't come back crying if you can't find this mysterious woman!
The Missing Piece#079.dst: Allons, allons, filez. Et ne revenez pas en pleurant si vous ne trouvez pas cette mystérieuse femme!
The Missing Piece#079.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#080.src: But if you lose the letter I can always give you another, they seem to be practically infinite anyhow!
The Missing Piece#080.dst: Mais si vous perdez la lettre, je peux vous en redonner une, il y en a quasiment à l'infini, de toute façon!
The Missing Piece#080.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#081.src: Find out about the woman on the hill around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#081.dst: Renseignez-vous sur la femme sur la colline aux alentours de [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#082.src: Are you trying to slack off? You still have the letter on you, go deliver it!
The Missing Piece#082.dst: Vous essayez de tirer au flanc? Vous avez encore la lettre sur vous, allez la livrer!
The Missing Piece#082.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#083.src: Hmm, you lost the letter? Already!?
The Missing Piece#083.dst: Hmm, vous avez perdu la lettre? Déjà!?
The Missing Piece#083.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#084.src: Don't think you're getting out of this! I have spares!
The Missing Piece#084.dst: Ne croyez pas vous en tirer comme ça! J'en ai d'autres!
The Missing Piece#084.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#085.src: Now go on and sort this out for me, won't you? I have enough to worry about as is without you bungling about!
The Missing Piece#085.dst: Allez, réglez-moi ça, voulez-vous? J'ai assez de soucis comme ça sans que vous veniez tout gâcher!
The Missing Piece#085.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#087.src: Looking for someone, huh? 'round these parts it's usually the tin cans who do that.
The Missing Piece#087.dst: Tu cherches quelqu'un, hein? Dans le coin, c'est plutôt les boîtes de conserve qui font ça.
The Missing Piece#087.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#088.src: A visit from one of those and you get an all-expenses-paid vacation on the Crown, if you catch my drift.
The Missing Piece#088.dst: Une visite d'une de ces boîtes, et t'as des vacances tous frais payés par la Couronne, si tu vois le genre.
The Missing Piece#088.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#089.src: Safe to say, if it were Lars you were looking for I'd be happy to rat him out, but you haven't told me who it is yet.
The Missing Piece#089.dst: Pour être clair, si c'était Lars que tu cherchais, je le balancerais avec plaisir, mais tu m'as toujours pas dit qui c'est.
The Missing Piece#089.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#090.src: PLenty of hills 'round these parts, women too. But they're in the factories, slaving away, not on any hills 'sfar as I'm aware.
The Missing Piece#090.dst: Des collines, y en a plein dans le coin, des femmes aussi. Mais elles sont à l'usine, à trimer, pas sur des collines, pour autant que j'sache.
The Missing Piece#090.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#091.src: Sorry bud, don't think I can help you with this one. Try asking Lars, he's usually hogging the fire in the alley here behind me. Hate that guy...
The Missing Piece#091.dst: Désolé, mon pote, j'crois pas pouvoir t'aider sur ce coup. Demande à Lars, il monopolise toujours le feu dans la ruelle juste derrière moi. Je le déteste, ce type...
The Missing Piece#091.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#093.src: Already told you everythin', didn't I? Go harass Lars instead, I have nothing more to say.
The Missing Piece#093.dst: Je t'ai déjà tout dit, non? Va plutôt embêter Lars, j'ai rien d'autre à dire.
The Missing Piece#093.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#095.src: I'm looking for someone called 'the woman on the hill'. I have a letter I need to deliver to her.
The Missing Piece#095.dst: Je cherche quelqu'un qu'on appelle 'la femme sur la colline'. J'ai une lettre à lui remettre.
The Missing Piece#095.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#096.src: A letter? Don't know nuthin' about no woman on the hill, but maybe Bush over there would know.
The Missing Piece#096.dst: Une lettre? J'sais rien d'aucune femme sur la colline, mais Bush, là-bas, saurait peut-être.
The Missing Piece#096.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#097.src: He usually knows things... He's a knower.
The Missing Piece#097.dst: Il sait souvent des trucs... C'est un sachant.
The Missing Piece#097.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#098.src: Don't talk to him for too long though, or he'll start putting strange ideas in your head...
The Missing Piece#098.dst: Mais parle pas trop longtemps avec lui, ou il va te mettre des idées bizarres dans la tête...
The Missing Piece#098.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#100.src: Ask Bush. I told you I don't know nuthin'.
The Missing Piece#100.dst: Demande à Bush. J't'ai dit que j'sais rien.
The Missing Piece#100.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#101.src: I'm Bush, nice to meet you. Is there something you wish to know?
The Missing Piece#101.dst: Je suis Bush, enchanté. Y a-t-il quelque chose que tu désires savoir?
The Missing Piece#101.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#103.src: Oh, yes, her... This bush knows her all too well!
The Missing Piece#103.dst: Oh, oui, elle... Ce buisson ne la connaît que trop bien!
The Missing Piece#103.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#104.src: Without her this bush would wilt! Yes, a bush requires water to grow. I know, I know!
The Missing Piece#104.dst: Sans elle, ce buisson se fanerait! Oui, un buisson a besoin d'eau pour pousser. Je sais, je sais!
The Missing Piece#104.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#105.src: But first, I must know why you must know! Do you know?
The Missing Piece#105.dst: Mais d'abord, je dois savoir pourquoi tu dois savoir! Le sais-tu?
The Missing Piece#105.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#106.src: A letter! If only this Bush could know its contents... Alas, it would be rude to know...
The Missing Piece#106.dst: Une lettre! Si seulement ce Bush pouvait en savoir le contenu... Hélas, savoir serait impoli...
The Missing Piece#106.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#107.src: The mail-deliverer, truly a noble profession. I will share with you her location, but in exchange you must tell her: her friend is back in town.
The Missing Piece#107.dst: Facteur, quel noble métier. Je vais te dire où elle se trouve, mais en échange, tu dois lui dire ceci: son ami est de retour en ville.
The Missing Piece#107.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#108.src: Here, let me write it down for you!
The Missing Piece#108.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#109.src: Now you know! Now you know!
The Missing Piece#109.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#110.src: To know why I must know? Not even I know... All I know is that I must know!
The Missing Piece#110.dst: Pourquoi je dois savoir? Je l'ignore moi-même... Je sais juste que je dois savoir!
The Missing Piece#110.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#111.src: Again, tell me why you must know.
The Missing Piece#111.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#112.src: Nothing? That such people existed, I did not know! Now I know, now I know!
The Missing Piece#112.dst: Rien? Que de telles gens existaient, je l'ignorais! Maintenant je sais, je sais!
The Missing Piece#112.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#115.src: Post? You must be at the wrong house, dear.
The Missing Piece#115.dst: Du courrier? Tu dois te tromper de maison, mon chou.
The Missing Piece#115.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#116.src: No one is sending me any of that...
The Missing Piece#116.dst: Personne ne m'envoie ce genre de chose...
The Missing Piece#116.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#117.src: Well, if it says so on the letter...
The Missing Piece#117.dst: Eh bien, si c'est écrit sur la lettre...
The Missing Piece#117.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#118.src: Come in and we'll talk about it.
The Missing Piece#118.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#119.dst: Entrez dans la maison de la femme.

The Missing Piece#120.src: I don't usually get a lot of visitors up on the hill.
The Missing Piece#120.dst: Je n'ai pas souvent de visite, ici, sur la colline.
The Missing Piece#120.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#123.dst: Suivez la femme à l'intérieur jusqu'à [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#125.src: Place the letters on the table at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#125.dst: Posez les lettres sur la table en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#128.src: I think I'll need a closer look at this.
The Missing Piece#128.dst: Je dois regarder ça de plus près.
The Missing Piece#128.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#129.src: Please, have a seat. I'll make you something to drink.
The Missing Piece#129.dst: Je t'en prie, assieds-toi. Je te prépare de quoi boire.
The Missing Piece#129.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#131.src: You don't look like you're from around these parts, do you?
The Missing Piece#131.dst: Tu n'as pas l'air d'être du coin, hein?
The Missing Piece#131.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#132.src: Hmm? Well, I shouldn't pry into my guest's secrets. Better to let the unexplained rest, ha. Wouldn't you agree?
The Missing Piece#132.dst: Hmm? Enfin, je ne devrais pas fouiner dans les secrets de mes invités. Laissons l'inexpliqué en paix, ha. Tu ne crois pas?
The Missing Piece#132.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#133.src: Here in the Roughworks, we don't have any secrets. At least that's what Her Majesty wants to believe, ha.
The Missing Piece#133.dst: Ici, à Roughworks, nous n'avons pas de secrets. Du moins, c'est ce que Sa Majesté veut croire, ha.
The Missing Piece#133.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#134.src: That's why I chose to live here. In the neighborhoods, the walls are thinner than paper. Nothing goes unheard.
The Missing Piece#134.dst: C'est pour ça que j'ai choisi de vivre ici. Dans les quartiers, les murs sont plus fins que du papier. Rien n'échappe aux oreilles.
The Missing Piece#134.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#135.src: Up here on the hill, it's much more peaceful. As long as the Water Authority doesn't come knocking, ha.
The Missing Piece#135.dst: Ici, sur la colline, c'est bien plus paisible. Tant que l'Autorité de l'eau ne vient pas frapper à la porte, ha.
The Missing Piece#135.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#136.src: Well, if you're already here, why don't we have a little chat? Not a lot of people to talk to up here!
The Missing Piece#136.dst: Bon, puisque tu es là, pourquoi ne pas bavarder un peu? Il n'y a pas grand monde à qui parler, ici!
The Missing Piece#136.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#137.src: Pick up the Watering Can outside at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#138.src: The watering can is just outside in the garden. There are three plants inside and three plants outside.
The Missing Piece#138.dst: L'arrosoir est juste dehors, dans le jardin. Il y a trois plantes dedans et trois plantes dehors.
The Missing Piece#138.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#139.src: Water Elise's plants while she reads the letters.
The Missing Piece#139.dst: Arrosez les plantes d'Elise pendant qu'elle lit les lettres.

The Missing Piece#141.src: Oh, what a mess... trying to make sense of this is making my head hurt.
The Missing Piece#141.dst: Oh, quel fouillis... essayer d'y voir clair me donne mal à la tête.
The Missing Piece#141.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#142.src: So many letters, over so many years... who would possibly be so insistent on reaching me?
The Missing Piece#142.dst: Tant de lettres, sur tant d'années... qui pourrait bien tenir autant à me joindre?
The Missing Piece#142.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#143.src: Hm? Oh, you finished watering the plants already? That was quick!
The Missing Piece#143.dst: Hm? Oh, tu as déjà fini d'arroser les plantes? C'était rapide!
The Missing Piece#143.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#144.src: Well, I certainly won't make any progress like this, and it seems we both are in need of a break.
The Missing Piece#144.dst: Bon, je n'avancerai certainement pas comme ça, et on dirait qu'une pause nous ferait du bien, toi comme moi.
The Missing Piece#144.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#145.src: Oh, it's such a lovely day today... Why don't we go outside and enjoy the garden for a bit?
The Missing Piece#145.dst: Oh, il fait si beau aujourd'hui... Et si on sortait profiter un peu du jardin?
The Missing Piece#145.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#146.src: Follow Elise outside and take a seat at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#146.dst: Suivez Elise dehors et asseyez-vous en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#148.src: It really is beautiful today, isn't it?
The Missing Piece#148.dst: Il fait vraiment beau aujourd'hui, n'est-ce pas?
The Missing Piece#148.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#149.src: Ah... freshly watered flowers. Nothing beats that smell.
The Missing Piece#149.dst: Ah... des fleurs fraîchement arrosées. Rien ne vaut cette odeur.
The Missing Piece#149.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#150.src: Hm. Do you see that tree over there?
The Missing Piece#150.dst: Hm. Tu vois cet arbre, là-bas?
The Missing Piece#150.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#151.src: It's the only one of its kind in the whole of the Roughworks. Isn't it beautiful?
The Missing Piece#151.dst: C'est le seul de son espèce dans tout Roughworks. Il est beau, non?
The Missing Piece#151.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#152.src: It was a gift, but from who... It's another thing I've forgotten.
The Missing Piece#152.dst: C'était un cadeau, mais de qui... Encore une chose que j'ai oubliée.
The Missing Piece#152.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#153.src: It's frustrating, so frustrating... All these precious memories...
The Missing Piece#153.dst: C'est frustrant, tellement frustrant... Tous ces précieux souvenirs...
The Missing Piece#153.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#155.src: It isn't much now, that is for certain.
The Missing Piece#155.dst: Il ne paie pas de mine pour l'instant.

The Missing Piece#156.src: Well. It's beautiful already, don't you think?
The Missing Piece#156.dst: Eh bien. Il est déjà beau, tu ne trouves pas?
The Missing Piece#156.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#158.src: Ha! Of course it will, it's a tree!
The Missing Piece#158.dst: Ha! Bien sûr qu'il va grandir, c'est un arbre!
The Missing Piece#158.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#159.src: Oh, you know I didn't mean it like that.
The Missing Piece#159.dst: Oh, tu sais bien que je voulais dire autre chose.

The Missing Piece#160.src: For each year that passes... this tree will grow taller, and ever more beautiful.
The Missing Piece#160.dst: Chaque année qui passe... cet arbre grandira, toujours plus haut, toujours plus beau.

The Missing Piece#161.src: It'll have to weather many storms, and on some days it might even have to go without water. And still, it will continue growing.
The Missing Piece#161.dst: Il devra affronter bien des tempêtes, et certains jours, il devra même se passer d'eau. Et pourtant, il continuera de grandir.

The Missing Piece#163.src: And then in ten, fifteen, maybe even twenty-five years... we'll finally be able to rest in its shade.
The Missing Piece#163.dst: Et dans dix, quinze, peut-être même vingt-cinq ans... nous pourrons enfin nous reposer à son ombre.

The Missing Piece#164.src: Twenty-five years!? We'll be old by then!
The Missing Piece#164.dst: Vingt-cinq ans!? Nous serons vieilles d'ici là!
The Missing Piece#164.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#165.src: Oh, I know! We could have a picnic underneath its canopy. Doesn't that sound nice, {u}?
The Missing Piece#165.dst: Oh, je sais! On pourrait pique-niquer sous ses branches. Ça ne te dit pas, {u}?
The Missing Piece#165.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#166.src: ... It does. It does sound nice, Elise. Perhaps we could.
The Missing Piece#166.dst: ... Si. Ça me dit vraiment, Elise. Peut-être bien.

The Missing Piece#167.src: Go on, give it some more water. Or it'll never grow an inch!
The Missing Piece#167.dst: Allez, donne-lui encore un peu d'eau. Sinon il ne grandira jamais!

The Missing Piece#172.src: I was just thinking... If I were to die some day, I'd like to be buried here, under the tree.
The Missing Piece#172.dst: Je pensais juste... Si je venais à mourir un jour, j'aimerais être enterrée ici, sous l'arbre.

The Missing Piece#173.src: Huh? What could possibly make you think about such silly things? We still have a long life left ahead of us, don't we?
The Missing Piece#173.dst: Hein? Qu'est-ce qui peut bien te faire penser à des bêtises pareilles? Nous avons encore une longue vie devant nous, non?
The Missing Piece#173.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#174.src: Of course, you're right. I'm sorry, I'm just not used to this...
The Missing Piece#174.dst: Bien sûr, tu as raison. Pardon, c'est juste que je n'ai pas l'habitude...

The Missing Piece#177.src: Let's just enjoy the sun, for a bit. There's still work tomorrow.
The Missing Piece#177.dst: Profitons juste un peu du soleil. Demain, il y a encore le travail.
The Missing Piece#177.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#180.src: Hm. I shall leave the worrying for another day, I think. Today is a good day... not a day for worrying.
The Missing Piece#180.dst: Hm. Je garderai les soucis pour un autre jour, je crois. C'est une belle journée... pas un jour à s'inquiéter.
The Missing Piece#180.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#181.src: In fact, today is too nice a day to waste it... by not going anywhere, that is. Wouldn't you agree?
The Missing Piece#181.dst: En fait, il fait bien trop beau pour gâcher la journée... à rester ici, je veux dire. Tu ne crois pas?
The Missing Piece#181.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#182.src: Follow Elise to the roof at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#183.src: Ah... Do you see that factory off that way? I used to work there, back when I was younger...
The Missing Piece#183.dst: Ah... Tu vois l'usine, là-bas? J'y travaillais, quand j'étais plus jeune...
The Missing Piece#183.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#184.src: We mass-produced bread for the higher regions... Tedious work, and thankless too.
The Missing Piece#184.dst: On produisait du pain en masse pour les régions d'en haut... Un travail pénible, et ingrat.
The Missing Piece#184.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#185.src: I'm sure you have noticed, but things around here aren't too easy. Some people even go as far as stealing when times are tough...
The Missing Piece#185.dst: Tu l'as sûrement remarqué, mais la vie n'est pas facile par ici. Certains vont même jusqu'à voler quand les temps sont durs...
The Missing Piece#185.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#186.src: Fortunately... I never had to. They would let us take some home, every once in a while.
The Missing Piece#186.dst: Heureusement... je n'ai jamais eu à le faire. On pouvait en rapporter un peu chez soi, de temps en temps.
The Missing Piece#186.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#187.src: Those were good days. On those occasions, we'd go and have ourselves a picnic, me and- hm. Just me, I suppose.
The Missing Piece#187.dst: C'était le bon temps. Dans ces moments-là, on allait pique-niquer, moi et- hm. Juste moi, je suppose.
The Missing Piece#187.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#188.src: A shame it's so hard to come by... the thefts became a real problem, you know. The Crown ended up building a vault down under the factory to keep it all secure!
The Missing Piece#188.dst: Dommage qu'il soit si rare... les vols sont devenus un vrai problème, tu sais. La Couronne a fini par bâtir une chambre forte sous l'usine pour tout protéger!
The Missing Piece#188.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#189.src: A shame it's so hard to come by... the thefts became a real problem, you know. The Crown ended up building a vault down under the factory to keep it all secure.
The Missing Piece#189.dst: Dommage qu'il soit si rare... les vols sont devenus un vrai problème, tu sais. La Couronne a fini par bâtir une chambre forte sous l'usine pour tout protéger.
The Missing Piece#189.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#190.src: The door is locked. A note is plastered on the front.
The Missing Piece#190.dst: La porte est verrouillée. Une note est placardée dessus.

The Missing Piece#191.src: Now to find a way inside without being caught...
The Missing Piece#191.dst: Maintenant, entrer sans se faire prendre...

The Missing Piece#192.src: How long, since I last had some? Years, surely... not like any of that bread ever makes it to us poor folk, ha!
The Missing Piece#192.dst: Depuis combien de temps n'en ai-je pas mangé? Des années, sûrement... ce pain n'arrive jamais jusqu'à nous, les pauvres gens, ha!
The Missing Piece#192.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#193.src: But it'd be nice to have some again, I suppose... reminisce on old times.
The Missing Piece#193.dst: Mais ce serait bien d'en manger à nouveau, je suppose... se remémorer le bon vieux temps.
The Missing Piece#193.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#194.src: Well, if you're running errands for me already... mind seeing if you can get your hands on a loaf or two?
The Missing Piece#194.dst: Bon, puisque tu fais déjà des courses pour moi... ça t'ennuierait de voir si tu peux te procurer une miche ou deux?
The Missing Piece#194.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#195.src: It's expensive, but for the right price... I'm sure you could get ahold of some. You don't seem the sort to struggle with that kind of thing, do you, letter carrier?
The Missing Piece#195.dst: C'est cher, mais en y mettant le prix... je suis sûre que tu pourrais en trouver. Tu n'as pas l'air du genre à avoir du mal avec ça, hein, facteur?
The Missing Piece#195.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#196.src: Ha! Well, do your best, either way. Once you come back, I have a plan for what we can do today. How's that sound?
The Missing Piece#196.dst: Ha! Enfin, fais de ton mieux, de toute façon. A ton retour, j'ai un plan pour ce qu'on pourrait faire aujourd'hui. Qu'en dis-tu?
The Missing Piece#196.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#197.src: Try to enter the Bread Factory at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#197.dst: Essayez d'entrer dans l'usine de pain en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#198.src: Oh, no... You know! You know! Speak to that constable first, and perhaps, I'll tell you more.
The Missing Piece#198.dst: Oh, non... Tu sais! Tu sais! Parle d'abord à cet agent, et peut-être que je t'en dirai plus.
The Missing Piece#198.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#199.src: If you've come to beg, you might as well leave.
The Missing Piece#199.dst: Si tu viens mendier, autant repartir tout de suite.
The Missing Piece#199.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#201.src: Huh? Alright, bud. We all do.
The Missing Piece#201.dst: Hein? D'accord, mon pote. Nous aussi.
The Missing Piece#201.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#203.src: Do I look like a vending machine to you? Go find somewhere else. We just make the bread here, we don't sell it.
The Missing Piece#203.dst: J'ai l'air d'un distributeur automatique? Va voir ailleurs. Ici, on fabrique le pain, on ne le vend pas.
The Missing Piece#203.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#204.src: Get out of here pal, you shouldn't be loitering around under a Constable's watch.
The Missing Piece#204.dst: Dégage, mon pote, tu ne devrais pas traîner ici sous l'oeil d'un agent.
The Missing Piece#204.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#205.src: But, but, but! No buts. Don't make me have to do something! The paperwork is always such a hassle...
The Missing Piece#205.dst: Mais, mais, mais! Pas de mais. Ne m'oblige pas à sévir! La paperasse, c'est toujours une plaie...
The Missing Piece#205.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#207.src: Obviously not... We have enough problems as it is, what with that stolen barrel last week... And the production quotas...
The Missing Piece#207.dst: Évidemment que non... On a déjà assez de problèmes comme ça, avec ce tonneau volé la semaine dernière... Et les quotas de production...
The Missing Piece#207.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#208.src: Don't you have something better to do anyway?
The Missing Piece#208.dst: T'as rien de mieux à faire, de toute façon?
The Missing Piece#208.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#210.src: Over here, friend of a friend!

The Missing Piece#212.src: Did you know? Did you know? There is more than one way to enter any building.
The Missing Piece#212.dst: Tu savais? Tu savais? Il y a plus d'une façon d'entrer dans un bâtiment.
The Missing Piece#212.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#213.src: I'll tell you! But, stealing is unethical, you must know!
The Missing Piece#213.dst: Je vais te le dire! Mais voler, ce n'est pas éthique, sache-le!
The Missing Piece#213.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#214.src: As long as she doesn't know! She won't know! Do you understand?
The Missing Piece#214.dst: Tant qu'elle ne le sait pas! Elle ne saura rien! Tu comprends?
The Missing Piece#214.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#215.src: It's just around the corner, you see. A pipe! Now you know! Now you know!
The Missing Piece#215.dst: C'est juste au coin, tu vois. Un tuyau! Maintenant tu sais! Maintenant tu sais!
The Missing Piece#215.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#216.src: Enter the Bread Factory through the pipe at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#216.dst: Entrez dans l'usine de pain par le tuyau en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#217.dst: Retournez dans l'usine de pain en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#218.src: Find a way to enter the Bread Vault through the elevator at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#218.dst: Trouvez un moyen d'entrer dans la chambre forte du pain par l'ascenseur en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#220.src: Uhh? That's not an answer! Now, tell me who you are or I'll have a look for myself! And I never forget faces, keep that in mind!
The Missing Piece#220.dst: Hein? Ce n'est pas une réponse! Dis-moi qui tu es, ou je vais voir par moi-même! Et je n'oublie jamais un visage, retiens bien ça!
The Missing Piece#220.speaker: Supervisor

The Missing Piece#221.src: What's a worker doing in my office!? Now, tell me who you are or I'll have a look for myself! And I never forget faces, keep that in mind!
The Missing Piece#221.dst: Qu'est-ce qu'un ouvrier fait dans mon bureau!? Dis-moi qui tu es, ou je vais voir par moi-même! Et je n'oublie jamais un visage, retiens bien ça!
The Missing Piece#221.speaker: Supervisor

The Missing Piece#223.src: Well, thank you for bringing this to my attention! I will investigate the matter immediately!
The Missing Piece#223.dst: Eh bien, merci de me l'avoir signalé! Je vais enquêter immédiatement!
The Missing Piece#223.speaker: Supervisor

The Missing Piece#225.src: Make your way through the Bread Vault to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#225.dst: Traversez la chambre forte du pain jusqu'à [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#226.dst: Trouvez un moyen de monter jusqu'à [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#227.src: Hit the bottles at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with a Bottle.
The Missing Piece#227.dst: Touchez les bouteilles en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] avec une bouteille.

The Missing Piece#228.src: Continue through the Bread Vault to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#228.dst: Continuez à travers la chambre forte du pain jusqu'à [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#229.src: Use the beams to make it across to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#229.dst: Servez-vous des poutres pour traverser jusqu'à [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#231.src: ...and in accordance with our protocols, we will require a detailed record of this former employee. Years of employment, known associates, work performance... all of it.
The Missing Piece#231.dst: ...et conformément à nos protocoles, il nous faudra un dossier détaillé sur cette ancienne employée. Années de service, fréquentations connues, rendement... tout.
The Missing Piece#231.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#232.src: Naturally, I will comply to the best of my ability, blessed be Her Grace. But to think that the mere theft of one crate would reach this high a level...
The Missing Piece#232.dst: Naturellement, je m'y plierai de mon mieux, bénie soit Sa Grâce. Mais penser que le simple vol d'une caisse remonte aussi haut...
The Missing Piece#232.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#233.src: The crate is not relevant. It is the employee who is of interest. Further measures may be necessary, but the records will do well to begin with.
The Missing Piece#233.dst: La caisse n'a aucune importance. C'est l'employée qui nous intéresse. D'autres mesures pourraient être nécessaires, mais le dossier suffira pour commencer.
The Missing Piece#233.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#234.src: ...only the employee? Pardon my questions, but I do not understand why she is of interest to you.
The Missing Piece#234.dst: ...seulement l'employée? Pardonnez mes questions, mais je ne comprends pas en quoi elle vous intéresse.
The Missing Piece#234.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#235.src: That is for us to know, and for you to comply. But it pertains to a potential security breach which we are investigating.
The Missing Piece#235.dst: C'est à nous de savoir, et à vous d'obéir. Mais cela concerne une possible faille de sécurité sur laquelle nous enquêtons.
The Missing Piece#235.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#236.src: At my factory? What are you implying!?
The Missing Piece#236.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#237.src: I imply nothing. Must you be reminded of your position? It is by Her Majesty's will that I am here today. Do you truly wish to stand against it?
The Missing Piece#237.dst: Je n'insinue rien. Faut-il vous rappeler votre position? C'est par la volonté de Sa Majesté que je suis ici aujourd'hui. Souhaitez-vous vraiment vous y opposer?
The Missing Piece#237.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#238.src: I... I humbly apologize... I didn't mean-
The Missing Piece#238.dst: Je... Toutes mes excuses... Je ne voulais pas-
The Missing Piece#238.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#240.src: Y-yes, of course. But, still, I had thought that matter was settled years ago! What connection could it possibly have to-
The Missing Piece#240.dst: O-oui, bien sûr. Mais tout de même, je croyais l'affaire classée depuis des années! Quel rapport pourrait-elle avoir avec-
The Missing Piece#240.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#241.src: Enough aimless rambling. My time is limited. Pull up those records on this Elise, immediately.
The Missing Piece#241.dst: Assez de divagations. Mon temps est compté. Sortez-moi immédiatement le dossier de cette Elise.
The Missing Piece#241.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#242.src: U-understood, ma'am... I'll get them right away.
The Missing Piece#242.dst: C-compris, madame... Je vais le chercher tout de suite.
The Missing Piece#242.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#243.src: Acquire the bread from the barrel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#243.dst: Récupérez le pain dans le tonneau en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#244.src: Find the way out of the Bread Vault at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#244.dst: Trouvez la sortie de la chambre forte du pain en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#245.src: Well, well, well... it would seem the rats aren't the only plague to infest this place.
The Missing Piece#245.dst: Tiens, tiens, tiens... on dirait que les rats ne sont pas le seul fléau à infester cet endroit.
The Missing Piece#245.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#246.src: And here I had thought this particular lead was a dead end! Only years-old records which tell us nothing we did not already know... always a risk, but worth checking regardless.
The Missing Piece#246.dst: Et moi qui croyais que cette piste était une impasse! De vieux dossiers qui ne nous apprennent rien de neuf... toujours un risque, mais à vérifier malgré tout.
The Missing Piece#246.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#247.src: But here you are. One of the province's most wanted criminals. What a strange coincidence, finding you here.
The Missing Piece#247.dst: Mais vous voilà. L'un des criminels les plus recherchés de la province. Quelle étrange coïncidence de vous trouver ici.
The Missing Piece#247.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#248.src: I must wonder... for what reason are you here?
The Missing Piece#248.dst: Je me demande... pour quelle raison êtes-vous ici?
The Missing Piece#248.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#249.src: I know better than to expect an answer. But it does not matter, in the end. We will get it out of you eventually.
The Missing Piece#249.dst: Je sais qu'il ne faut pas attendre de réponse. Mais peu importe, au fond. Nous finirons par vous la faire cracher.
The Missing Piece#249.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#253.src: Return to the Roughworks through the pipe at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#253.dst: Retournez à Roughworks par le tuyau en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#254.src: Confront the inspection or talk to Elise at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#254.dst: Affrontez l'inspection ou parlez à Elise en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#255.src: Oh, it's the Water Authority! I don't know why they're here... but it can't be for any good reason.
The Missing Piece#255.dst: Oh, c'est l'Autorité de l'eau! Je ne sais pas ce qu'ils font là... mais ça ne présage rien de bon.
The Missing Piece#255.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#256.src: Open up already! We know you're in there!
The Missing Piece#256.dst: Ouvrez, enfin! Nous savons que vous êtes là!
The Missing Piece#256.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#257.src: Really, you should hide. It's okay, I've dealt with their type before. I'll send them away.
The Missing Piece#257.dst: Vraiment, tu devrais te cacher. Ne t'en fais pas, j'ai déjà eu affaire à ces gens-là. Je vais les renvoyer.
The Missing Piece#257.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#259.src: Good. Quick, find somewhere to hide!
The Missing Piece#259.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#260.src: Wait one second! I'll hide behind the plant!
The Missing Piece#260.dst: Une seconde! Je vais me cacher derrière la plante!
The Missing Piece#260.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#264.src: A friend, you say? Then you should be able to tell me why she's not answering the door!
The Missing Piece#264.dst: Un ami, dites-vous? Alors vous devriez pouvoir m'expliquer pourquoi elle n'ouvre pas la porte!
The Missing Piece#264.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#266.src: Someone like me!? What's that supposed to mean?
The Missing Piece#266.dst: Quelqu'un comme moi!? Qu'est-ce que ça veut dire?
The Missing Piece#266.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#267.src: Oh, you'll pay for this insult! We have authority to enforce our orders with force, you know! We can do anything we want!
The Missing Piece#267.dst: Oh, vous allez payer cette insulte! Nous pouvons imposer nos ordres par la force, vous savez! Nous faisons ce que nous voulons!
The Missing Piece#267.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#269.src: Not at home, you say? How convenient. Just as the inspection comes around they're not at home to greet us!
The Missing Piece#269.dst: Pas chez elle, dites-vous? Comme c'est commode. Pile au moment de l'inspection, elle n'est pas là pour nous accueillir!
The Missing Piece#269.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#270.src: It's almost like someone tipped them off, don't you think?
The Missing Piece#270.dst: C'est presque comme si quelqu'un l'avait prévenue, vous ne trouvez pas?
The Missing Piece#270.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#271.src: Say friend, did you tip off the subject that we were coming?
The Missing Piece#271.dst: Dites-moi, l'ami, c'est vous qui avez prévenu l'intéressée de notre venue?
The Missing Piece#271.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#272.src: Very well, then. But we will still need to get in to conduct the search.
The Missing Piece#272.dst: Très bien, alors. Mais il nous faudra tout de même entrer pour procéder à la fouille.
The Missing Piece#272.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#273.src: If you won't be of any use, then you better get out of our way!
The Missing Piece#273.dst: Si vous ne servez à rien, alors écartez-vous de notre chemin!
The Missing Piece#273.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#274.src: At the bread factory? That's none of our concern, we're the Water Authority, not the Bread Authority!
The Missing Piece#274.dst: A l'usine de pain? Ça ne nous concerne pas, nous sommes l'Autorité de l'eau, pas l'Autorité du pain!
The Missing Piece#274.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#275.src: A massive water spillage, you say!?
The Missing Piece#275.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#276.src: And you're not making this up? We don't take easily to liars, you should know.
The Missing Piece#276.dst: Et vous n'inventez rien? Nous n'aimons pas les menteurs, sachez-le.
The Missing Piece#276.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#277.src: Inspector, there seems to be some commotion coming from the Bread Factory.
The Missing Piece#277.dst: Inspectrice, il semble y avoir de l'agitation du côté de l'usine de pain.
The Missing Piece#277.speaker: Sentinel

The Missing Piece#278.src: Hmm... Well, in that case, we'll have to check it out. Thank you for the information, citizen.
The Missing Piece#278.dst: Hmm... Dans ce cas, nous allons devoir vérifier. Merci pour l'information.
The Missing Piece#278.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#279.src: Passing by! As if! Did you really think I would believe that story?
The Missing Piece#279.dst: De passage! Tu parles! Vous pensiez vraiment que j'allais avaler cette histoire?
The Missing Piece#279.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#280.src: We are here to execute a search. Your water usage levels have exceeded your authorized allotment.
The Missing Piece#280.dst: Nous sommes ici pour procéder à une fouille. Votre consommation d'eau a dépassé le quota autorisé.
The Missing Piece#280.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#283.src: Very well. We will now conduct an inspection of your property. Step out of the way, subject.
The Missing Piece#283.dst: Très bien. Nous allons maintenant inspecter votre propriété. Écartez-vous, sujette.
The Missing Piece#283.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#284.src: What's this? No wonder you're exceeding your water limit when you've been keeping illicit plants!
The Missing Piece#284.dst: Qu'est-ce que c'est? Pas étonnant que vous dépassiez votre limite d'eau, avec des plantes illicites!
The Missing Piece#284.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#285.src: Wait a second... There's someone hiding behind there! You said you were alone!
The Missing Piece#285.dst: Une seconde... Quelqu'un se cache là-derrière! Vous aviez dit que vous étiez seule!
The Missing Piece#285.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#288.src: Noooooooo, Alphonse! How... How could you do this!?
The Missing Piece#288.dst: Noooooooon, Alphonse! Comment... Comment avez-vous pu!?
The Missing Piece#288.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#289.src: You'll pay for this, you rat! In the name of Her Majesty!
The Missing Piece#289.dst: Vous allez payer pour ça, sale rat! Au nom de Sa Majesté!
The Missing Piece#289.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#290.src: Are you alright!? I heard a commotion, and-
The Missing Piece#290.dst: Ça va!? J'ai entendu du grabuge, et-
The Missing Piece#290.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#292.src: You may as well come inside, dearie.
The Missing Piece#292.dst: Autant que tu entres, mon chou.
The Missing Piece#292.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#294.src: But how strange... The authorities have never bothered me before... Oh, let's just get inside for now.
The Missing Piece#294.dst: Mais c'est étrange... Les autorités ne m'avaient jamais embêtée avant... Oh, rentrons pour l'instant.
The Missing Piece#294.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#295.src: Find somewhere to hide in Elise's house!
The Missing Piece#295.dst: Trouvez une cachette dans la maison d'Elise!

The Missing Piece#298.src: There you go. Now, what business could Her Majesty's authorities possibly have with little old me?
The Missing Piece#298.dst: Voilà. Alors, que peuvent bien vouloir les autorités de Sa Majesté à une petite vieille comme moi?
The Missing Piece#298.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#299.src: We are here to execute a search. You water usage levels have exceeded you authorized allotment.
The Missing Piece#299.dst: Nous sommes ici pour procéder à une fouille. Votre consommation d'eau a dépassé le quota autorisé.
The Missing Piece#299.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#300.dst: Eh bien, je ne vois pas-
The Missing Piece#300.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#303.src: We'll be done here after we've finished our inspection.
The Missing Piece#303.dst: Nous partirons une fois l'inspection terminée.
The Missing Piece#303.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#304.src: Say, would you prefer us searching the lower or upper floor first?
The Missing Piece#304.dst: Dites, on fouille d'abord le rez-de-chaussée ou l'étage?
The Missing Piece#304.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#305.src: How kind of you to ask... but as there is nothing of interest anywhere, I would suggest you start by finding a reason to get out of my home.
The Missing Piece#305.dst: Comme c'est aimable de demander... mais puisqu'il n'y a rien d'intéressant nulle part, je vous suggère de commencer par trouver une raison de quitter ma maison.
The Missing Piece#305.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#306.src: I wouldn't want to waste your time, is all.
The Missing Piece#306.dst: Je ne veux pas vous faire perdre de temps, voilà tout.
The Missing Piece#306.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#307.src: The lower floor then. Thank you for your cooperation.
The Missing Piece#307.dst: Le rez-de-chaussée, donc. Merci de votre coopération.
The Missing Piece#307.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#310.src: Oh what's the matter with you!?
The Missing Piece#310.dst: Oh, mais qu'est-ce qui vous prend!?
The Missing Piece#310.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#311.src: I've worked my whole life in the factories! Can't I have some flowers to keep me company in my old age?
The Missing Piece#311.dst: J'ai travaillé toute ma vie à l'usine! Je n'ai pas droit à quelques fleurs pour me tenir compagnie sur mes vieux jours?
The Missing Piece#311.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#312.src: Inspector. A message from the Authority.
The Missing Piece#312.speaker: Sentinel

The Missing Piece#314.src: How kind of you to ask... but as the upper floor is my bedroom, I would prefer it if you didn't inspect my bedsheets.
The Missing Piece#314.dst: Comme c'est aimable de demander... mais l'étage, c'est ma chambre, et je préférerais que vous n'inspectiez pas mes draps.
The Missing Piece#314.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#315.src: The upper floor then. Thank you for your cooperation.
The Missing Piece#315.dst: L'étage, donc. Merci de votre coopération.
The Missing Piece#315.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#316.src: How quaint. Doesn't it get lonely, living up here all by your lonesome?
The Missing Piece#316.dst: Comme c'est pittoresque. Vous ne vous sentez pas seule, à vivre là-haut sans personne?
The Missing Piece#316.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#318.src: Anyhow, I am required to inform you that you are in breach of the ordinance on water usage and will have to-
The Missing Piece#318.dst: Quoi qu'il en soit, je suis tenue de vous informer que vous enfreignez l'ordonnance sur l'usage de l'eau et que vous devrez-
The Missing Piece#318.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#320.src: Well, seems you're in luck this time, subject.
The Missing Piece#320.dst: Bon, on dirait que vous avez de la chance, sujette.
The Missing Piece#320.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#321.src: Some higher authority has overruled our command... we're being recalled.
The Missing Piece#321.dst: Une autorité supérieure a annulé notre ordre... on nous rappelle.
The Missing Piece#321.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#322.src: But don't be mistaken. We'll be back!
The Missing Piece#322.dst: Mais ne vous méprenez pas. Nous reviendrons!
The Missing Piece#322.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#323.src: Well, you won't be welcome next time!
The Missing Piece#323.dst: Eh bien, vous ne serez plus les bienvenus!
The Missing Piece#323.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#324.src: Nuisances, all of them... Well, it worked out in the end, didn't it?
The Missing Piece#324.dst: Des enquiquineurs, tous autant qu'ils sont... Enfin, ça s'est bien terminé, non?
The Missing Piece#324.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#325.src: They're gone, you can come out now.
The Missing Piece#325.dst: Ils sont partis, tu peux sortir maintenant.
The Missing Piece#325.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#326.src: Come, let's sit down and have a talk.
The Missing Piece#326.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#327.src: Right! The bread! So forgetful these days...
The Missing Piece#327.dst: C'est vrai! Le pain! Je suis si étourdie ces temps-ci...
The Missing Piece#327.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#328.src: Well? How did it go? Did you get any? I hope it wasn't too much trouble...
The Missing Piece#328.dst: Alors? Comment ça s'est passé? Tu en as eu? J'espère que ça n'a pas été trop compliqué...
The Missing Piece#328.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#329.src: Oh, wonderful. Thank you. That should be everything we need...
The Missing Piece#329.dst: Oh, merveilleux. Merci. Ça devrait être tout ce qu'il nous faut...
The Missing Piece#329.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#331.src: Well, if there was no other way... If the Authority is going to stomp in here looking for plants, taking a loaf of bread in return seems like a fair deal!
The Missing Piece#331.dst: Eh bien, s'il n'y avait pas d'autre moyen... Si l'Autorité peut débarquer ici chercher des plantes, prendre une miche de pain en retour me semble de bonne guerre!
The Missing Piece#331.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#333.src: Ah... How nostalgic. It really does bring me back to those good old days.
The Missing Piece#333.dst: Ah... Quelle nostalgie. Ça me ramène vraiment au bon vieux temps.
The Missing Piece#333.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#334.src: There was one time though... We... No, I bought it... Argh, why can't I remember!
The Missing Piece#334.dst: Il y a eu une fois, pourtant... Nous... Non, je l'ai acheté... Argh, ça ne me revient pas!
The Missing Piece#334.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#335.src: How strange... Again, this feeling... As if- as if there's something I should be remembering... but can't.
The Missing Piece#335.dst: Comme c'est étrange... Encore cette sensation... Comme si- comme s'il y avait une chose dont je devrais me souvenir... en vain.
The Missing Piece#335.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#337.src: Do you remember how we first met? All those years ago?
The Missing Piece#337.dst: Tu te souviens de notre rencontre? Il y a toutes ces années?

The Missing Piece#338.src: Of course I do! But... thinking about it now, maybe I was a bit... cold.
The Missing Piece#338.dst: Bien sûr! Mais... en y repensant, j'étais peut-être un peu... froide.
The Missing Piece#338.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#339.src: You were fine! You were the only one who...
The Missing Piece#339.dst: Tu étais très bien! Tu étais la seule qui...

The Missing Piece#341.src: You were the only one who even noticed I was there.
The Missing Piece#341.dst: Tu étais la seule à remarquer que j'étais là.

The Missing Piece#342.src: Ah- hello. I'm {u}, I'm new here. Nice to meet you.
The Missing Piece#342.dst: Ah- bonjour. Je suis {u}, je viens d'arriver. Enchantée.

The Missing Piece#343.src: The name's Elise, do a good job and I'm sure we'll get along.
The Missing Piece#343.dst: Moi, c'est Elise. Fais du bon travail, et on s'entendra bien.
The Missing Piece#343.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#344.src: Right, yes. Of course... I'll try my best!
The Missing Piece#344.dst: D'accord, oui. Bien sûr... Je ferai de mon mieux!

The Missing Piece#345.src: ... You know what, have this. It'll help you get through the day.
The Missing Piece#345.dst: ... Tu sais quoi, prends ça. Ça t'aidera à tenir la journée.
The Missing Piece#345.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#349.src: Really? I was only working there for a month!
The Missing Piece#349.dst: Vraiment? Je n'y ai travaillé qu'un mois!

The Missing Piece#350.src: Oh, sure... but it was a good month, wasn't it?
The Missing Piece#350.dst: Oh, bien sûr... mais c'était un bon mois, non?
The Missing Piece#350.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#351.src: And even after you were transferred away... I had something to look forward to at the end of my shifts.
The Missing Piece#351.dst: Et même après ta mutation... j'avais quelque chose à attendre à la fin de mes journées.
The Missing Piece#351.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#352.src: Ah... well... now you have something to look forward to when you come home, as well.
The Missing Piece#352.dst: Ah... eh bien... maintenant, tu as aussi quelque chose à attendre quand tu rentres à la maison.

The Missing Piece#353.src: Ha! I guess I do, don't I...
The Missing Piece#353.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#354.src: But it all seems so small from up here... doesn't it? Just look at the view!
The Missing Piece#354.dst: Mais tout paraît si petit, vu d'ici... n'est-ce pas? Regarde-moi cette vue!
The Missing Piece#354.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#355.src: It really is beautiful... up here, it's like nothing else matters except for us.
The Missing Piece#355.dst: C'est vraiment magnifique... ici, c'est comme si plus rien ne comptait, à part nous.

The Missing Piece#356.src: ...I wish we could stay like this forever...
The Missing Piece#356.dst: ...J'aimerais qu'on reste comme ça pour toujours...
The Missing Piece#356.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#357.src: ...oh. So do I, Elise... so do I...

The Missing Piece#358.src: Ha, but why do you sound so sad?
The Missing Piece#358.dst: Ha, mais pourquoi as-tu l'air si triste?
The Missing Piece#358.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#360.src: It's nothing... we'll stay like this... forever. I promise.
The Missing Piece#360.dst: Ce n'est rien... on restera comme ça... pour toujours. Je te le promets.

The Missing Piece#361.src: Her, again... Who is she? Why am I remembering these things?
The Missing Piece#361.dst: Elle, encore... Qui est-elle? Pourquoi ces souvenirs me reviennent?
The Missing Piece#361.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#363.src: Well, there's nothing that can be done about it now, is there? Say, why don't we head out?
The Missing Piece#363.dst: Enfin, on n'y peut plus rien, n'est-ce pas? Dis, et si on sortait?
The Missing Piece#363.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#364.src: Oh, dear. Did I forget to tell you? The bread is for a picnic!
The Missing Piece#364.dst: Oh, mon Dieu. J'ai oublié de te le dire? Le pain, c'est pour un pique-nique!
The Missing Piece#364.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#365.src: I know the perfect place... in fact, you reminded me of it. It has a view over the entire Roughworks, can you believe that?
The Missing Piece#365.dst: Je connais l'endroit parfait... d'ailleurs, c'est toi qui me l'as rappelé. On y voit tout Roughworks, tu te rends compte?
The Missing Piece#365.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#366.src: Although... Thinking about it, it's a bit far... I don't know if my old legs will carry me all the way there, ha!
The Missing Piece#366.dst: Quoique... En y pensant, c'est un peu loin... Je ne sais pas si mes vieilles jambes me porteront jusque-là, ha!
The Missing Piece#366.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#367.src: Someone around here has to have the code to this...
The Missing Piece#367.dst: Quelqu'un ici doit bien avoir le code...

The Missing Piece#368.src: Now all you have to do is get out of this place somehow...
The Missing Piece#368.dst: Il ne vous reste plus qu'à sortir d'ici, d'une manière ou d'une autre...

The Missing Piece#369.src: Maybe if you hit those bottles, it will move the beam.
The Missing Piece#369.dst: Peut-être qu'en touchant ces bouteilles, la poutre bougera.

The Missing Piece#373.src: Well, what do you say, then? Just talk to me when you want to head out.
The Missing Piece#373.dst: Alors, qu'en dis-tu? Parle-moi quand tu voudras partir.
The Missing Piece#373.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#374.src: Well, what do you say? Shall we head out?
The Missing Piece#374.dst: Alors, qu'en dis-tu? On y va?
The Missing Piece#374.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#377.src: Oh, you can really see a lot from up here... Let's go!
The Missing Piece#377.dst: Oh, on voit vraiment loin d'ici... Allons-y!
The Missing Piece#377.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#378.src: Where to? I know just the place for this! Let's see, it's...
The Missing Piece#378.dst: Par où? Je connais l'endroit idéal! Voyons, c'est...
The Missing Piece#378.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#379.src: Hm... I think... Forward! Yes, I think it was straight forward from here. Although, my memory might be a little hazy...
The Missing Piece#379.dst: Hm... Je crois... Tout droit! Oui, je crois que c'était tout droit d'ici. Quoique ma mémoire soit un peu floue...
The Missing Piece#379.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#380.src: Ah, hm... I think we turn left here...
The Missing Piece#380.dst: Ah, hm... Je crois qu'on tourne à gauche ici...
The Missing Piece#380.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#381.src: No, wait... It's right, we definitely have to turn right!
The Missing Piece#381.dst: Non, attends... C'est à droite, il faut tourner à droite, c'est sûr!
The Missing Piece#381.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#382.src: That house feels familiar... I think... yes, turn right here!
The Missing Piece#382.dst: Cette maison me dit quelque chose... Je crois... oui, à droite ici!
