The Missing Piece#382.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#383.src: Stop! Hmm... I don't think it's across this bridge, at least. Then that must mean...
The Missing Piece#383.dst: Stop! Hmm... En tout cas, je ne crois pas que ce soit de l'autre côté de ce pont. Ça veut donc dire...
The Missing Piece#383.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#384.src: Oh, what's the matter! We'll find it eventually, right? I'm pretty sure it's to the left!
The Missing Piece#384.dst: Oh, et alors! On finira bien par trouver, non? Je suis presque sûre que c'est à gauche!
The Missing Piece#384.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#385.src: Yes, this is it! It's just around this corner, I'm sure of it!
The Missing Piece#385.dst: Oui, c'est ça! C'est juste au coin, j'en suis sûre!
The Missing Piece#385.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#386.src: Here! I remember now... it's in here!
The Missing Piece#386.dst: Ici! Ça me revient... c'est là-dedans!
The Missing Piece#386.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#387.src: I don't remember it being so overgrown, though...
The Missing Piece#387.dst: Je ne me souvenais pas que c'était si envahi, pourtant...
The Missing Piece#387.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#388.src: How long has it been? I can't recall the last time I was here...
The Missing Piece#388.dst: Ça fait combien de temps? Je ne sais plus quand je suis venue ici...
The Missing Piece#388.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#390.src: Ah, it's blocked... Well. I didn't want to bring it up, but it seems we're out of options.
The Missing Piece#390.dst: Ah, c'est bloqué... Bon. Je ne voulais pas en parler, mais on dirait qu'on n'a plus le choix.
The Missing Piece#390.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#391.src: Oh, there's no need to pretend anymore. I know what you are. You're one of them, aren't you?
The Missing Piece#391.dst: Oh, inutile de faire semblant. Je sais ce que tu es. Tu es l'un d'eux, n'est-ce pas?
The Missing Piece#391.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#392.src: The cursed, as the Crown calls them. Not that I care!
The Missing Piece#392.dst: Les maudits, comme dit la Couronne. Ça m'est bien égal!
The Missing Piece#392.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#393.src: Why should I? I'm old! I have enough to worry about as is...
The Missing Piece#393.dst: Pourquoi pas? Je suis vieille! J'ai assez de soucis comme ça...
The Missing Piece#393.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#394.src: Besides, it's certainly useful in situations like this, isn't it? Be a dearie and do one of your little tricks, won't you?
The Missing Piece#394.dst: Et puis, c'est bien utile dans ce genre de situation, non? Sois un amour et fais un de tes petits tours, tu veux bien?
The Missing Piece#394.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#396.src: That's it... Let me down now, I can walk the rest of the way myself.
The Missing Piece#396.dst: C'est ça... Pose-moi maintenant, je peux faire le reste du chemin toute seule.
The Missing Piece#396.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#397.src: It's a little more... well, deserted, than I remember. But that's fine.
The Missing Piece#397.dst: C'est un peu plus... disons, désert que dans mon souvenir. Mais ce n'est pas grave.
The Missing Piece#397.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#398.src: We can take this elevator to the top. You'll have to find a way into the control room though... It shouldn't be too hard to reach!
The Missing Piece#398.dst: On peut prendre cet ascenseur jusqu'en haut. Mais il faudra que tu trouves un moyen d'entrer dans la salle de contrôle... Ça ne devrait pas être trop dur!
The Missing Piece#398.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#399.src: It's that thing up over there. The tunnel on the right will get you to it.
The Missing Piece#399.dst: C'est ce truc, là-haut. Le tunnel de droite t'y mènera.
The Missing Piece#399.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#402.dst: Atteignez le panneau de contrôle en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#403.src: Can you hear me? I'm down here!
The Missing Piece#403.dst: Tu m'entends? Je suis en bas!
The Missing Piece#403.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#404.src: Use the controls to get me up! You know how it works, right?
The Missing Piece#404.dst: Utilise les commandes pour me faire monter! Tu sais comment faire?
The Missing Piece#404.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#405.src: Use the controls at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to bring Elise up.
The Missing Piece#405.dst: Utilisez les commandes en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] pour faire monter Elise.

The Missing Piece#408.src: Maybe if... oh, I know. Put something on the up button, then you can clear the blockage... and we'll go up.
The Missing Piece#408.dst: Peut-être que si... oh, je sais. Pose un objet sur le bouton de montée, puis dégage ce qui bloque... et on montera.
The Missing Piece#408.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#409.src: Perfect! Now it will move, if only we can get it unstuck...
The Missing Piece#409.dst: Parfait! Maintenant, ça bougera, si on arrive à le débloquer...
The Missing Piece#409.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#410.src: If you could get up there, somehow...
The Missing Piece#410.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#412.src: Oh well, this place seems abandoned anyhow! Who cares about a little destruction?
The Missing Piece#412.dst: Oh, tant pis, cet endroit a l'air abandonné de toute façon! Qui se soucie d'un peu de casse?
The Missing Piece#412.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#413.src: Go up there and see if you can find a way to get this thing going again.
The Missing Piece#413.dst: Monte là-haut et vois si tu trouves un moyen de remettre ce truc en marche.
The Missing Piece#413.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#415.src: Throw a brick at the blockage at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#415.dst: Lancez une brique sur ce qui bloque en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#416.src: How's it going? Can you see anything?
The Missing Piece#416.dst: Alors, ça avance? Tu vois quelque chose?
The Missing Piece#416.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#421.src: Follow Elise to the cliff at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#421.dst: Suivez Elise jusqu'à la falaise en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#422.src: Ah, isn't this place nice. The breeze, the view, everything.
The Missing Piece#422.dst: Ah, comme c'est agréable ici. La brise, la vue, tout.
The Missing Piece#422.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#423.src: You can even see the trees of the {p} swaying from up here...
The Missing Piece#423.dst: On voit même les arbres de {p} se balancer, d'ici...
The Missing Piece#423.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#424.src: And finally! A place to sit! I'm sorely in need of some relaxation after this eventful day.
The Missing Piece#424.dst: Et enfin! Un endroit où s'asseoir! J'ai bien besoin de me détendre après une journée aussi mouvementée.
The Missing Piece#424.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#425.src: Please, let's sit down and enjoy the view for a bit.
The Missing Piece#425.dst: Je t'en prie, asseyons-nous et profitons un peu de la vue.
The Missing Piece#425.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#427.src: Hm. It's strange. All day, I've been... reminiscing, I suppose. And now, seeing this view... it fills me with that same, nostalgic feeling.
The Missing Piece#427.dst: Hm. C'est étrange. Toute la journée, je me suis... remémoré des choses, je suppose. Et maintenant, avec cette vue... je ressens cette même nostalgie.
The Missing Piece#427.speaker: Elise

similar.text: What are you doing?
... what's happening?

The Missing Piece#431.src: You should probably take your place at the front of the line.
The Missing Piece#431.dst: Vous devriez sans doute prendre votre place en tête de file.

The Missing Piece#432.src: All day, I've been having these... visions of the past. Of these things I can't recall ever happening.
The Missing Piece#432.dst: Toute la journée, j'ai eu ces... visions du passé. De choses dont je ne me rappelle pas qu'elles soient arrivées.
The Missing Piece#432.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#433.src: And I... well, truthfully, I'm not sure how to feel about it...
The Missing Piece#433.dst: Et je... eh bien, à vrai dire, je ne sais pas quoi en penser...
The Missing Piece#433.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#434.src: But I know- I know in my heart, that there's something missing... a piece that would make it all fit.
The Missing Piece#434.dst: Mais je sais- je sais au fond de mon coeur qu'il manque quelque chose... une pièce qui permettrait de tout assembler.
The Missing Piece#434.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#436.src: In every dream she's there beside me... but I don't even remember her name. I can't even recall her face...
The Missing Piece#436.dst: Dans chaque rêve, elle est à côté de moi... mais je ne me souviens même pas de son nom. Ni même de son visage...
The Missing Piece#436.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#437.src: If she was this important to me... then how could I forget?
The Missing Piece#437.dst: Si elle comptait autant pour moi... alors comment ai-je pu oublier?
The Missing Piece#437.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#440.src: Hurgh... hurgh... One second, I need to catch my breath.
The Missing Piece#440.dst: Heuf... heuf... Une seconde, je dois reprendre mon souffle.
The Missing Piece#440.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#441.src: Hm... Do you know this person? They're not an inspector... are they?
The Missing Piece#441.dst: Hm... Tu connais cette personne? Ce n'est pas un inspecteur... si?
The Missing Piece#441.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#442.src: So, as I was going to say—
The Missing Piece#442.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#443.src: Okay, fine! I'll get straight to the point.
The Missing Piece#443.dst: D'accord, très bien! J'en viens au fait.
The Missing Piece#443.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#444.src: I found more letters to deliver, and I was on my way to deliver them when I saw you two running out! Can you imagine how shocked I was?
The Missing Piece#444.dst: J'ai trouvé d'autres lettres à distribuer, et j'allais les livrer quand je vous ai vus sortir en courant, tous les deux! Imaginez ma stupeur!
The Missing Piece#444.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#445.src: That being that, I naturally decided to follow you, the good postmaster that I am. You sure didn't make it easy though! I barely managed to make it up here... It's a nice spot, by the way.
The Missing Piece#445.dst: Dès lors, j'ai naturellement décidé de vous suivre, en bon receveur que je suis. Vous ne m'avez pas facilité la tâche! J'ai eu du mal à monter jusqu'ici... C'est un joli coin, d'ailleurs.
The Missing Piece#445.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#446.src: But... how could you have possibly made it up here...?
The Missing Piece#446.dst: Mais... comment avez-vous bien pu monter jusqu'ici...?
The Missing Piece#446.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#447.src: Getting up here is nothing to a university graduate like me!
The Missing Piece#447.dst: Monter ici, ce n'est rien pour un diplômé de l'université comme moi!
The Missing Piece#447.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#450.src: Well, that was all that I came for I suppose. So...
The Missing Piece#450.dst: Bon, c'est tout ce pour quoi j'étais venu, je suppose. Alors...
The Missing Piece#450.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#451.src: You came all this way just for that!? At least have a piece of bread, or something...!
The Missing Piece#451.dst: Vous avez fait tout ce chemin juste pour ça!? Prenez au moins un morceau de pain, ou quelque chose...!
The Missing Piece#451.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#452.src: No, no. I couldn't possibly! Duty calls, the post isn't going to sort itself, and all that... Oh, by Her Majesty, the backlog...
The Missing Piece#452.dst: Non, non. Je ne saurais accepter! Le devoir m'appelle, le courrier ne va pas se trier tout seul, et ainsi de suite... Oh, par Sa Majesté, le retard...
The Missing Piece#452.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#453.src: Right! You! I hate to admit it, but it seems you've done your job well enough.
The Missing Piece#453.dst: Ah, oui! Vous! Ça me coûte de l'admettre, mais vous avez plutôt bien fait votre travail.
The Missing Piece#453.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#454.src: I happened to double check the records and it seems like my substitute, well, may have been someone else entirely!
The Missing Piece#454.dst: J'ai revérifié les registres, et il semblerait que mon remplaçant ait été, eh bien, quelqu'un d'autre!
The Missing Piece#454.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#455.src: No harm, no foul, right? The work's already done! No takesies-backsies! Okay?
The Missing Piece#455.dst: Pas de mal, pas de faute, hein? Le travail est fait! Donné, c'est donné! D'accord?
The Missing Piece#455.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#457.src: Huh, what was that? I couldn't hear you! Okay, bye!
The Missing Piece#457.dst: Hein, quoi? Je ne vous entends pas! Bon, au revoir!
The Missing Piece#457.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#459.src: But it was certainly nice of them to deliver this letter. Let me take a look.
The Missing Piece#459.dst: Mais c'était bien aimable de sa part d'apporter cette lettre. Voyons voir.
The Missing Piece#459.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#461.src: Oh, I don't understand... What would she have to apologize for?
The Missing Piece#461.dst: Oh, je ne comprends pas... De quoi aurait-elle à s'excuser?
The Missing Piece#461.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#462.src: Please... {u}, take a breath. You're shaking.
The Missing Piece#462.dst: Je t'en prie... {u}, respire. Tu trembles.
The Missing Piece#462.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#463.src: Getting caught in a storm like that... really, I could have waited a few hours! You didn't need to push yourself to get here.
The Missing Piece#463.dst: Te faire prendre dans une tempête pareille... vraiment, j'aurais pu attendre quelques heures! Tu n'avais pas besoin de te presser pour venir.
The Missing Piece#463.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#465.src: Yes, I know the weather's bad now... but eventually, it'll get better again. The clouds will clear and the sun will shine again. Right?
The Missing Piece#465.dst: Oui, je sais que le temps est mauvais en ce moment... mais ça finira par s'arranger. Les nuages partiront et le soleil brillera de nouveau. Pas vrai?
The Missing Piece#465.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#467.src: You know, it's not so bad with rain once in a while. Means we don't have to water the flowers, at least! And nothing beats the smell of wet grass after rain, don't you agree?
The Missing Piece#467.dst: Tu sais, un peu de pluie de temps en temps, ce n'est pas si mal. Au moins, on n'a pas à arroser les fleurs! Et rien ne vaut l'odeur de l'herbe mouillée après la pluie, tu ne trouves pas?
The Missing Piece#467.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#468.src: We could do something after it clears up. It's been a while since you visited, so why not go to our spot? I should still have some leftover bread lying around...
The Missing Piece#468.dst: On pourrait faire quelque chose quand ça se sera dégagé. Ça fait longtemps que tu n'es pas venue, alors pourquoi pas notre coin? Il doit me rester un peu de pain...
The Missing Piece#468.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#469.src: Elise. You're- please, forgive me- you're in danger. I-
The Missing Piece#469.dst: Elise. Tu es- je t'en prie, pardonne-moi- tu es en danger. Je-

The Missing Piece#470.src: I'm in danger? I'm just an ordinary worker, what reason would anyone have to harm me? I'll be fine.
The Missing Piece#470.dst: Moi, en danger? Je ne suis qu'une simple ouvrière, pourquoi voudrait-on me faire du mal? Tout ira bien.
The Missing Piece#470.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#471.src: {u}, you're the one pushing herself through this weather, clearly panicking...
The Missing Piece#471.dst: {u}, c'est toi qui t'épuises par ce temps, visiblement paniquée...
The Missing Piece#471.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#472.src: I barely get to see you anymore. And now, out of nowhere, you're here in this state... What's going on? Please, just talk to me.
The Missing Piece#472.dst: Je ne te vois presque plus. Et maintenant, sortie de nulle part, te voilà dans cet état... Qu'est-ce qui se passe? Je t'en prie, parle-moi.
The Missing Piece#472.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#473.src: ...ha. I- I haven't been truthful with you, Elise, and- I can explain later. We need to get out of here, before they-
The Missing Piece#473.dst: ...ha. Je- je n'ai pas été honnête avec toi, Elise, et- je t'expliquerai plus tard. Il faut qu'on parte d'ici, avant qu'ils-

The Missing Piece#476.src: Why would they... no, this doesn't make any sense...
The Missing Piece#476.dst: Pourquoi est-ce qu'ils... non, ça n'a aucun sens...

The Missing Piece#477.src: Hm. Well, then maybe it's nothing. I'll go see who it is.
The Missing Piece#477.dst: Hm. Bon, alors ce n'est peut-être rien. Je vais voir qui c'est.
The Missing Piece#477.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#478.src: As if one wasn't enough... who could possibly be foolish enough to brave a storm just to come visit this little place? Whatever it is, it can wait.
The Missing Piece#478.dst: Comme si une ne suffisait pas... qui pourrait être assez fou pour braver une tempête juste pour venir dans ce petit coin? Quoi que ce soit, ça peut attendre.
The Missing Piece#478.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#481.src: No... No... What are you... Why are you-
The Missing Piece#481.dst: Non... Non... Qu'est-ce que... Pourquoi vous-
The Missing Piece#481.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#482.src: Apologies for the disturbance, madam. But I'm afraid we have business to attend to.
The Missing Piece#482.dst: Pardonnez le dérangement, madame. Mais je crains que nous ayons une affaire à régler.
The Missing Piece#482.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#484.src: {u}, {u}, why are they here? Why... why won't you answer me...?
The Missing Piece#484.dst: {u}, {u}, pourquoi sont-ils là? Pourquoi... pourquoi tu ne me réponds pas...?
The Missing Piece#484.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#485.src: What have you done? I... Please, just explain... I- I...
The Missing Piece#485.dst: Qu'as-tu fait? Je... Je t'en prie, explique-moi... Je- je...
The Missing Piece#485.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#486.src: I... how did I overlook this...?
The Missing Piece#486.dst: Je... comment ai-je pu ne pas voir ça...?

The Missing Piece#487.src: Seems you're not quite the strategic mastermind you thought yourself, Lioness.
The Missing Piece#487.dst: On dirait que tu n'es pas la fine stratège que tu croyais être, Lionne.
The Missing Piece#487.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#488.src: Elise... if you... if you just cooperate...
The Missing Piece#488.dst: Elise... si tu... si tu coopères...

The Missing Piece#489.src: Then... everything will be fine. It... it will.
The Missing Piece#489.dst: Alors... tout ira bien. Ça... ça ira.

The Missing Piece#491.src: She... What did she do? Why did she wrap me up in it?
The Missing Piece#491.dst: Elle... Qu'a-t-elle fait? Pourquoi m'a-t-elle mêlée à ça?
The Missing Piece#491.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#492.src: Everything I remember... it just leaves me with more questions than answers. Why can't I remember her...? Why!?
The Missing Piece#492.dst: Tout ce dont je me souviens... ne me laisse que plus de questions que de réponses. Pourquoi je l'ai oubliée...? Pourquoi!?
The Missing Piece#492.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#493.src: I- I'm just an ordinary factory worker! I woke up early, worked late, slept late... then did it all over again the next day.
The Missing Piece#493.dst: Je- je ne suis qu'une simple ouvrière d'usine! Je me levais tôt, travaillais tard, me couchais tard... et je recommençais le lendemain.
The Missing Piece#493.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#494.src: I've never said a word about the Crown! Why would they possibly care about... me...?
The Missing Piece#494.dst: Je n'ai jamais dit un mot contre la Couronne! Pourquoi s'intéresseraient-ils à... moi...?
The Missing Piece#494.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#495.src: They... they took everything from me. My youth, my body, my time, and... and I never demanded anything in return.
The Missing Piece#495.dst: Ils... ils m'ont tout pris. Ma jeunesse, mon corps, mon temps, et... et je n'ai jamais rien exigé en retour.
The Missing Piece#495.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#496.src: So, why... why can't I just have this? This one, little thing? Why can't I remember her...?
The Missing Piece#496.dst: Alors pourquoi... pourquoi je ne peux pas avoir ça? Cette petite chose? Pourquoi je l'ai oubliée...?
The Missing Piece#496.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#497.src: ...oh, it might sound sad... but, looking back at it all like this...
The Missing Piece#497.dst: ...oh, ça peut paraître triste... mais en regardant tout ça avec du recul...
The Missing Piece#497.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#498.src: My life doesn't seem all that great, does it? Ha. Toiling away in a factory for someone else's bread...
The Missing Piece#498.dst: Ma vie n'a pas l'air bien brillante, n'est-ce pas? Ha. A trimer dans une usine pour le pain des autres...
The Missing Piece#498.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#499.src: But I can feel her. Even if... even if I can't remember her face, or her name, or her touch... I still feel her. Lingering in my heart. Shining.
The Missing Piece#499.dst: Mais je la sens. Même si... même si je ne me rappelle ni son visage, ni son nom, ni sa caresse... je la sens encore. Elle reste dans mon coeur. Elle brille.
The Missing Piece#499.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#500.src: ...it's all some sort of sick joke, isn't it?
The Missing Piece#500.dst: ...tout ça n'est qu'une farce cruelle, hein?
The Missing Piece#500.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#501.src: They weren't content with all I sacrificed... they had to take even my memories? Is that it...?
The Missing Piece#501.dst: Tout ce que j'ai sacrifié ne leur suffisait pas... il fallait qu'ils prennent mes souvenirs? C'est ça...?
The Missing Piece#501.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#502.src: Wherever you are now... whatever you did... whatever secrets you kept... I hope it was worth it.
The Missing Piece#502.dst: Où que tu sois... quoi que tu aies fait... quels que soient tes secrets... j'espère que ça en valait la peine.
The Missing Piece#502.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#503.src: I hope you burn this entire place to the ground.
The Missing Piece#503.dst: J'espère que tu réduiras tout cet endroit en cendres.
The Missing Piece#503.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#504.src: I just wish... we could have spent more time together.
The Missing Piece#504.dst: J'aurais seulement voulu... qu'on passe plus de temps ensemble.
The Missing Piece#504.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#505.src: For a long time, I went along the path that had been laid before me. I did what was right.
The Missing Piece#505.dst: Longtemps, j'ai suivi le chemin qu'on avait tracé pour moi. Je faisais ce qui était juste.

The Missing Piece#506.src: But then... I met you, Elise.
The Missing Piece#506.dst: Mais ensuite... je t'ai connue, Elise.

The Missing Piece#507.src: I... I don't know what to say, {u}...
The Missing Piece#507.dst: Je... Je ne sais pas quoi dire, {u}...
The Missing Piece#507.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#510.src: I see... a bird. A pigeon, it's old and gray. Its wings no longer work like they used to...
The Missing Piece#510.dst: Je vois... un oiseau. Un pigeon, vieux et gris. Ses ailes ne fonctionnent plus comme avant...
The Missing Piece#510.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#511.src: It wants to fly, but it can't... It's struggling...
The Missing Piece#511.dst: Il veut voler, mais il ne peut pas... Il se débat...
The Missing Piece#511.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#513.src: No, I can't! It's too sad...
The Missing Piece#513.dst: Non, je ne peux pas! C'est trop triste...
The Missing Piece#513.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#515.src: It's sitting beneath the shade of a canopy, singing. Like a cry, almost, mourning.
The Missing Piece#515.dst: Il est posé à l'ombre d'un feuillage, et il chante. Presque comme un cri, une plainte.
The Missing Piece#515.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#516.src: The clouds, dark clouds are gathering. A storm is coming. The bird is looking around, frantically searching. It's scared.
The Missing Piece#516.dst: Les nuages, des nuages sombres s'amoncellent. Une tempête approche. L'oiseau regarde autour de lui, il cherche, affolé. Il a peur.
The Missing Piece#516.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#517.src: It... It calls out, for something... or someone...
The Missing Piece#517.dst: Il... Il appelle quelque chose... ou quelqu'un...
The Missing Piece#517.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#518.src: Who is it calling for, Elise?

The Missing Piece#521.dst: Je... J-je ne me souviens pas!
The Missing Piece#521.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#523.src: I won't forget! I won't forget! I won't! I promised! I promised I'd never forget you!
The Missing Piece#523.dst: Je n'oublierai pas! Je n'oublierai pas! Jamais! J'ai promis! J'ai promis de ne jamais t'oublier!
The Missing Piece#523.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#526.src: You are an ordinary worker from the Roughworks. You work an ordinary job, and lead an ordinary but solitary life.
The Missing Piece#526.dst: Tu es une ouvrière ordinaire de Roughworks. Tu as un travail ordinaire, et tu mènes une vie ordinaire, mais solitaire.
The Missing Piece#526.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#527.dst: Je suis... Non, je suis moi!
The Missing Piece#527.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#528.src: She is nothing to you. You have never met her. You will never meet her.
The Missing Piece#528.dst: Elle n'est rien pour toi. Tu ne l'as jamais rencontrée. Tu ne la rencontreras jamais.
The Missing Piece#528.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#531.src: You are nothing to her! She is nothing to you! Soon you'll forget she ever existed.
The Missing Piece#531.dst: Tu n'es rien pour elle! Elle n'est rien pour toi! Bientôt, tu oublieras qu'elle a existé.
The Missing Piece#531.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#532.src: No, I will never forget! She was everything to me! She is everything to me! I will never forget her!
The Missing Piece#532.dst: Non, je n'oublierai jamais! Elle était tout pour moi! Elle est tout pour moi! Je ne l'oublierai jamais!
The Missing Piece#532.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#533.src: You do not know her face, nor her voice, nor her touch.
The Missing Piece#533.dst: Tu ne connais ni son visage, ni sa voix, ni sa caresse.
The Missing Piece#533.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#535.src: She is nothing to you. You have never met her. You will never meet her. You have always been ordinary, you will always be ordinary.
The Missing Piece#535.dst: Elle n'est rien pour toi. Tu ne l'as jamais rencontrée. Tu ne la rencontreras jamais. Tu as toujours été ordinaire, tu seras toujours ordinaire.
The Missing Piece#535.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#537.src: I will ask once more. Is your directive understood?
The Missing Piece#537.dst: Je le demande une dernière fois. Ta directive est-elle comprise?
The Missing Piece#537.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#546.dst: Je me suis souvenue que je t'aime.
The Missing Piece#546.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#547.src: And I'll never forget it, Elise.
The Missing Piece#547.dst: Et je ne l'oublierai jamais, Elise.
The Missing Piece#547.speaker: Syndra

The Missing Piece#548.src: My legs... feel funny... I think... I think I'm in need of some rest. A long, long rest... I deserve that... don't I?
The Missing Piece#548.dst: Mes jambes... sont toutes drôles... Je crois... je crois que j'ai besoin de repos. Un long, très long repos... Je l'ai bien mérité... non?
The Missing Piece#548.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#549.src: You'll take me home... won't you? I want to see it, at least once more... The tree.
The Missing Piece#549.dst: Tu me ramèneras à la maison... n'est-ce pas? Je veux le voir, au moins une dernière fois... L'arbre.
The Missing Piece#549.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#552.src: It's grown so tall... and so beautiful. Hasn't it, Syndra...?
The Missing Piece#552.dst: Il est devenu si grand... et si beau. N'est-ce pas, Syndra...?
The Missing Piece#552.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#553.src: If... If only... you could have seen it... like this...
The Missing Piece#553.dst: Si... Si seulement... tu avais pu le voir... comme ça...
The Missing Piece#553.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#554.src: Pick some of Elise's flowers around her house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#554.dst: Cueillez des fleurs d'Elise autour de sa maison en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#556.src: I'm searching for 'the woman on the hill'. Do you happen to know her?
The Missing Piece#556.dst: Je cherche 'la femme sur la colline'. Vous la connaissez, par hasard?
The Missing Piece#556.speaker: Player

The Missing Piece#558.src: Ha! But that's why I moved here!
The Missing Piece#558.dst: Ha! C'est pour ça que j'ai emménagé ici!
The Missing Piece#558.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#559.src: In the living blocks you can never be alone. No time to think, only to work. No dear, it's much better up here.
The Missing Piece#559.dst: Dans les blocs d'habitation, on n'est jamais seul. Pas le temps de penser, que de travailler. Non, mon chou, on est mieux ici.
The Missing Piece#559.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#560.src: Lived my whole childhood in one of the towers. I was born there. That was until... until... Well, I've forgotten the reason, ha!
The Missing Piece#560.dst: J'ai passé toute mon enfance dans une des tours. J'y suis née. Jusqu'à ce que... jusqu'à ce que... Bon, j'ai oublié pourquoi, ha!
The Missing Piece#560.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#561.src: My memory isn't so good these days. It must have been twenty-five or so years ago.
The Missing Piece#561.dst: Ma mémoire n'est plus ce qu'elle était. Ça devait être il y a vingt-cinq ans environ.
The Missing Piece#561.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#562.src: But I had a reason... a good one! Ha, it's funny isn't it? At the time it probably seemed like the most important thing in the world.
The Missing Piece#562.dst: Mais j'avais une raison... une bonne! Ha, c'est drôle, non? Sur le moment, ça devait sembler la chose la plus importante au monde.
The Missing Piece#562.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#563.src: But now, well, I've gone and forgotten the whole thing, haven't I?
The Missing Piece#563.dst: Mais maintenant, eh bien, j'ai tout oublié, pas vrai?
The Missing Piece#563.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#564.src: In the Roughworks? My whole life, ha. I'm only fifty... fifty-two, you know. Or maybe it was fifty-three.
The Missing Piece#564.dst: A Roughworks? Toute ma vie, ha. Je n'ai que cinquante... cinquante-deux ans, tu sais. Ou peut-être cinquante-trois.
The Missing Piece#564.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#565.src: ... Which year is it again? I seem to have lost track.
The Missing Piece#565.dst: ... On est en quelle année, déjà? J'ai perdu le fil.
The Missing Piece#565.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#566.src: So... goodness, longer than I expected. It must have been... Oh, by Her Grace! What does it matter, the years pass quicker for every one that goes.
The Missing Piece#566.dst: Alors... mon Dieu, plus longtemps que je ne le pensais. Ça doit faire... Oh, par Sa Grâce! Quelle importance, chaque année passe plus vite que la précédente.
The Missing Piece#566.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#567.src: How strange... I feel like I should know who this is from... and yet, I don't.
The Missing Piece#567.dst: Comme c'est étrange... Je devrais savoir de qui c'est... et pourtant, je l'ignore.
The Missing Piece#567.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#568.src: Hm. I said I wouldn't pry, but... You don't work for the post, do you? I know your type.
The Missing Piece#568.dst: Hm. J'ai dit que je ne fouinerais pas, mais... Tu ne bosses pas pour la poste, hein? Je connais ton genre.
The Missing Piece#568.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#570.src: But... you have piqued my curiosity with these letters...
The Missing Piece#570.dst: Mais... tu as piqué ma curiosité avec ces lettres...
The Missing Piece#570.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#571.src: Say, 'letter-carrier', won't you be a dearie and water my plants while I read the rest of these letters? Maybe there is something else I can glean from reading them.
The Missing Piece#571.dst: Dis, 'facteur', tu serais un amour d'arroser mes plantes pendant que je lis le reste de ces lettres? J'en apprendrai peut-être un peu plus en les lisant.
The Missing Piece#571.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#572.src: I have {~} plants outside and {~} pots inside. Just be sure not to overwater them! The watering can is just outside in the garden.
The Missing Piece#572.dst: J'ai {~} plantes dehors et {~} pots dedans. Fais juste attention à ne pas trop les arroser! L'arrosoir est juste dehors, dans le jardin.
The Missing Piece#572.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#573.src: Don't be afraid to ask if you're wondering anything! I don't bite, ha!
The Missing Piece#573.dst: N'aie pas peur de demander si tu te poses des questions! Je ne mords pas, ha!
The Missing Piece#573.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#575.src: Elise has probably finished reading those letters by now. You should return to her in the kitchen.
The Missing Piece#575.dst: Elise a sans doute fini de lire ces lettres. Vous devriez la rejoindre dans la cuisine.

The Missing Piece#577.src: Doesn't look like you're going to get anything out of this guy...
The Missing Piece#577.dst: On dirait que vous ne tirerez rien de ce type...

The Missing Piece#578.src: But my friend worked here, and...
The Missing Piece#578.dst: Mais une amie à moi travaillait ici, et...
The Missing Piece#578.speaker: Player

The Missing Piece#579.src: Can I at least get a look inside...?
The Missing Piece#579.dst: Je peux au moins jeter un oeil dedans...?
The Missing Piece#579.speaker: Player

The Missing Piece#580.src: In order to steal the bread, you must stay hidden.
The Missing Piece#580.dst: Pour voler le pain, vous devez rester hors de vue.

The Missing Piece#581.src: When close to workers, {#} SNEAK to remain hidden.
The Missing Piece#581.dst: Près des ouvriers, {#} ACCROUPISSEZ-VOUS pour rester caché.

The Missing Piece#582.src: You could knock out the workers with this...
The Missing Piece#582.dst: Vous pourriez assommer les ouvriers avec ça...

The Missing Piece#583.src: When close to workers, {#} LEFT-CLICK with Bottle to knock out.
The Missing Piece#583.dst: Près des ouvriers, {#} CLIC GAUCHE avec la bouteille pour les assommer.

The Missing Piece#584.src: {#} Left-Click with Bottle to Knock Out
The Missing Piece#584.dst: {#} Clic gauche avec la bouteille pour assommer

The Missing Piece#585.src: After knocking them out, {#} RIGHT-CLICK to search workers.
The Missing Piece#585.dst: Une fois assommés, {#} CLIC DROIT pour fouiller les ouvriers.

The Missing Piece#586.src: With this, you can open the grate to the pipe and progress.
The Missing Piece#586.dst: Avec ça, vous pouvez ouvrir la grille du tuyau et avancer.

The Missing Piece#588.src: To stay out of sight of workers, use Bottles to distract them.
The Missing Piece#588.dst: Pour échapper aux ouvriers, distrayez-les avec des bouteilles.

The Missing Piece#589.src: Activate EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN by inputting the activation code.
The Missing Piece#589.dst: Activez l'ARRÊT D'URGENCE en saisissant le code d'activation.

The Missing Piece#590.dst: Rien qui vaille la peine d'être pris.

The Missing Piece#591.src: The bottle is too high up to reach...
The Missing Piece#591.dst: La bouteille est trop haute pour l'atteindre...

The Missing Piece#592.src: That must be the way in to the vault Elise mentioned.
The Missing Piece#592.dst: Ce doit être l'entrée de la chambre forte dont parlait Elise.

The Missing Piece#593.src: Hey, I left the key in the break room if you need it. Be careful though! Get the Supervisor to disable the oven first, or you'll be toast!
The Missing Piece#593.dst: Hé, j'ai laissé la clé en salle de pause si besoin. Mais attention! Fais d'abord éteindre le four par le superviseur, ou tu vas griller!

The Missing Piece#594.src: A maintenance key. With this you could unlock the maintenace entrance to the oven.
The Missing Piece#594.dst: Une clé d'entretien. Avec ça, vous pourriez ouvrir l'accès d'entretien du four.

The Missing Piece#595.src: They really ought to improve their security around here...
The Missing Piece#595.dst: Ils devraient vraiment améliorer la sécurité, ici...

The Missing Piece#597.src: Now, to find the Maintenance Key...

The Missing Piece#598.src: EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN code successfully inputted. Press Activation Button to initiate.
The Missing Piece#598.dst: Code d'ARRÊT D'URGENCE saisi. Appuyez sur le bouton d'activation pour lancer la procédure.

The Missing Piece#599.src: After initiating emergency shutdown, you will have {~} seconds to make it to the vault. Do you want to press the button?
The Missing Piece#599.dst: Une fois l'arrêt d'urgence lancé, vous aurez {~} secondes pour atteindre la chambre forte. Appuyer sur le bouton?

The Missing Piece#600.src: Do you want to infiltrate the Bread Vault through this method?
The Missing Piece#600.dst: Voulez-vous infiltrer la chambre forte du pain par ce moyen?

The Missing Piece#602.src: This hallway looks heavily guarded. Maybe there's a different path you could take.
The Missing Piece#602.dst: Ce couloir a l'air très surveillé. Il existe peut-être un autre chemin.

The Missing Piece#603.src: There must be a way to get to that balcony above.
The Missing Piece#603.dst: Il doit y avoir un moyen d'atteindre ce balcon, là-haut.

The Missing Piece#604.src: Switch between selected beams using the switch button.
The Missing Piece#604.dst: Passez d'une poutre à l'autre avec le bouton de changement.

The Missing Piece#605.src: They're having a discussion you can just barely make out...
The Missing Piece#605.dst: Ils tiennent une discussion que vous parvenez à peine à saisir...

The Missing Piece#606.src: Finally... The bread you've been looking for.
The Missing Piece#606.dst: Enfin... Le pain que vous cherchiez.

The Missing Piece#613.dst: On dirait qu'Elise a de la visite...

The Missing Piece#615.src: Ha... Well, what's another crime added to the tally? It seems we've become real hardened bandits, haven't we?
The Missing Piece#615.dst: Ha... Bah, un crime de plus au tableau, qu'est-ce que ça change? On dirait qu'on est devenus de vrais bandits endurcis, hein?
The Missing Piece#615.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#617.src: That's what a life in the Roughworks does to you! Worked my whole life, I have. Ha, for no benefit either.
The Missing Piece#617.dst: Voilà ce que fait une vie à Roughworks! J'ai travaillé toute ma vie, moi. Ha, sans rien y gagner, en plus.
The Missing Piece#617.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#618.src: Still as poor as the day I was born! But I have a home... and sometimes even good company. That's enough for silly old me.
The Missing Piece#618.dst: Toujours aussi pauvre qu'à ma naissance! Mais j'ai un toit... et parfois de la bonne compagnie. Ça suffit à la vieille sotte que je suis.
The Missing Piece#618.speaker: Elise

The Olmic Rune#000.src: It has no fuel left, maybe you can start it again?
The Olmic Rune#000.dst: Elle n'a plus de carburant, vous pourriez la redémarrer?

The Olmic Rune#001.src: The crystalized magic on the floor seems unstable. Maybe something can shatter it...
The Olmic Rune#001.dst: La magie cristallisée au sol semble instable. Quelque chose pourrait peut-être la briser...

The Olmic Rune#003.src: The strange shard is reacting to the floor...

The Olmic Rune#005.src: Head back to the machine at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Olmic Rune#007.src: The loud noise is bound to attract creatures of the expanse.
The Olmic Rune#007.dst: Ce vacarme va forcément attirer les créatures de l'Expanse.

The Olmic Rune#008.src: It looks like the machine is about to break through!
The Olmic Rune#008.dst: On dirait que la machine est sur le point de percer!

The Olmic Rune#009.src: Find some sort of fuel in the Ruined City.
The Olmic Rune#009.dst: Trouvez une sorte de carburant dans Ruined City.

The Olmic Rune#010.src: Find some sort of fuel in the ruined city
The Olmic Rune#010.dst: Trouvez une sorte de carburant dans la cité en ruine

The Olmic Rune#011.src: Explore the cave for the fuel
The Olmic Rune#011.dst: Explorez la grotte à la recherche du carburant

The Olmic Rune#012.src: Collect [{~} Fuel Sprites] and bring it back to the machine.
The Olmic Rune#012.dst: Récupérez [{~} Esprits de carburant] et rapportez-les à la machine.

The Olmic Rune#013.src: Defend the machine from the incoming attackers.
The Olmic Rune#013.dst: Défendez la machine contre les assaillants.

The Olmic Rune#015.src: Now that you have enough fuel, you should return to the machine.
The Olmic Rune#015.dst: Maintenant que vous avez assez de carburant, retournez à la machine.

The Olmic Rune#016.src: It looks like a mining machine that's hundreds of years old. What was it mining though?
The Olmic Rune#016.dst: On dirait une machine minière vieille de plusieurs siècles. Mais qu'extrayait-elle?

The Olmic Rune#017.src: {#} You get the feeling you shouldn't be here...
The Olmic Rune#017.dst: {#} Vous sentez que vous ne devriez pas être ici...

The Olmic Rune#018.src: It's a strangely shaped keyhole. How cryptic.
The Olmic Rune#018.dst: Une serrure à la forme étrange. Comme c'est cryptique.

The Order of the Grook#000.src: Eager much? Keep yourself seated for now.
The Order of the Grook#000.dst: On s'impatiente? Garde ta place pour l'instant.
The Order of the Grook#000.speaker: Pensa

The Order of the Grook#001.src: Do you...not have any manners at all?! Just running into my parents' house like that! Jeez!
The Order of the Grook#001.dst: Tu... n'as donc aucune politesse?! Entrer comme ça chez mes parents! Non mais!
The Order of the Grook#001.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#003.src: Oh, I know! Here, go into my room real fast, and grab the letter in there.
The Order of the Grook#003.dst: Oh, je sais! Tiens, file vite dans ma chambre et prends la lettre qui s'y trouve.
The Order of the Grook#003.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#004.src: Bring it to me when you do, I wanna make sure it's the right one.
The Order of the Grook#004.dst: Apporte-la-moi quand tu l'as, je veux vérifier que c'est la bonne.
The Order of the Grook#004.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#005.src: Go look for my letter in my bedroom, pretty please.
The Order of the Grook#005.dst: Va chercher ma lettre dans ma chambre, steuplaît.

The Order of the Grook#006.src: My parents were super excited when that letter flew into my room, but magical school sounds so boring...
The Order of the Grook#006.dst: Mes parents étaient super contents quand la lettre est entrée dans ma chambre, mais l'école de magie, ça a l'air trop nul...
The Order of the Grook#006.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#007.src: The letter says to meet a boat captain on the broken docks next to the Seaskipper, and to "have faith". What does that mean?
The Order of the Grook#007.dst: La lettre dit de rejoindre un capitaine de bateau sur les quais en ruine à côté du Seaskipper, et d'"avoir la foi". Qu'est-ce que ça veut dire?

The Order of the Grook#008.src: This weird looking place is actually a magical transportation hub.
The Order of the Grook#008.dst: Cet endroit à l'allure bizarre est en fait un carrefour de transport magique.

The Order of the Grook#009.src: Each tunnel leads someplace else in the world, but the transportation portals aren't always, ehm...accurate? Let's leave it at that.
The Order of the Grook#009.dst: Chaque tunnel mène ailleurs dans le monde, mais les portails de transport ne sont pas toujours, euh... précis? Restons-en là.

The Order of the Grook#010.src: There are also some secret passages around, supposedly...
The Order of the Grook#010.dst: Il y aurait aussi des passages secrets par ici, à ce qu'on dit...

The Order of the Grook#011.src: Psst. Are you a student at Grookwarts?
The Order of the Grook#011.dst: Psst. Tu es élève à Grookwarts?

The Order of the Grook#012.src: This is the way in. Do you see that weird looking dirt wall?
The Order of the Grook#012.dst: C'est par ici. Tu vois ce mur de terre à l'allure bizarre?

The Order of the Grook#013.src: Just run straight through. Don't tell any non-wizard folks, though.
The Order of the Grook#013.dst: Fonce droit dedans. Mais n'en parle à aucun non-sorcier.

The Order of the Grook#015.src: So all of you will be getting two vouchers each, and with them you will need to buy one wand, and a book or tome.
The Order of the Grook#015.dst: Vous recevrez chacun deux bons, avec lesquels il vous faudra acheter une baguette, et un livre ou un tome.

The Order of the Grook#016.src: Students, please gather your school material and start your day! One wand and one tome.
The Order of the Grook#016.dst: Élèves, rassemblez votre matériel scolaire et commencez votre journée! Une baguette et un tome.

The Order of the Grook#017.src: Gosh, so many things, so little time!
The Order of the Grook#017.dst: Ouh là, tant de choses, si peu de temps!

The Order of the Grook#018.src: Have you picked out your wand and book yet? I chose an Avo Pheonix Wand.
The Order of the Grook#018.dst: Tu as déjà choisi ta baguette et ton livre? Moi, j'ai pris une Avo Pheonix Wand.

The Order of the Grook#019.src: Wait a minute, are you new here? You look really tall!
The Order of the Grook#019.dst: Attends une minute, tu viens d'arriver? Tu es d'une sacrée taille!

The Order of the Grook#021.src: Just fill in what subject you want to take and our guides will lead you to your classes.
The Order of the Grook#021.dst: Inscrivez simplement la matière que vous voulez suivre, et nos guides vous mèneront à vos cours.

The Order of the Grook#022.src: A true wizard after my own heart, seeking wisdom! Good choice. Now, choose a Practical Magic lesson.
The Order of the Grook#022.dst: Voilà un vrai mage comme je les aime, en quête de sagesse! Bon choix. Maintenant, choisissez un cours de magie pratique.

The Order of the Grook#023.src: Effects and materials are intertwined in function, but each has applications independent of one another. Now, choose a Magical Creatures class.
The Order of the Grook#023.dst: Effets et matériaux sont liés dans leur fonction, mais chacun a des applications indépendantes. Maintenant, choisissez un cours sur les créatures magiques.

The Order of the Grook#024.src: Ah, yes... As well-liked as that class is, those Wybels are more trouble than they're worth to keep sometimes. Lastly, you must choose a Magical Type class.
The Order of the Grook#024.dst: Ah, oui... Aussi populaire que soit ce cours, ces Wybels donnent parfois plus de mal qu'ils n'en valent. Enfin, vous devez choisir un cours sur les types de magie.

The Order of the Grook#025.src: What you take from the earth, you must give back.
The Order of the Grook#025.dst: Ce que tu prends à la terre, tu dois le lui rendre.

The Order of the Grook#027.src: It also is the element o-of knowledge, and pure magicality. Water i-is a sort of magical default, if you w-will. If it isn't focused on o-one element or another, magic ends up being water-based.
The Order of the Grook#027.dst: C'est aussi l'élément d-du savoir, et de la magicité pure. L'eau e-est un peu l'état magique par défaut, s-si vous voulez. Si elle n'est pas concentrée sur u-un élément ou un autre, la magie finit par être d'eau.
The Order of the Grook#027.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#028.src: Good w-work there! I h-hope I wasn't too boring with all my talking... You can go now.
The Order of the Grook#028.dst: B-bon travail! J'espère ne pas vous avoir t-trop ennuyés avec mes bavardages... Tu peux y aller.
The Order of the Grook#028.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#029.src: N-now, who's n-next? And...i-is it really cold in here for all of you, too? Or, is it j-just me...?
The Order of the Grook#029.dst: M-maintenant, qui est le s-suivant? Et... v-vous avez froid ici, vous aussi? Ou c'est j-juste moi...?

The Order of the Grook#030.src: If you've read my books, you know about Quartz, and how dangerous it can be if overcharged. So, of course, we have an overcharged sample here so you can feel the signs of it.
The Order of the Grook#030.dst: Si vous avez lu mes livres, vous connaissez le quartz, et son danger s'il est surchargé. Alors, bien sûr, voici un échantillon surchargé pour que vous en sentiez les signes.
The Order of the Grook#030.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#031.src: Depending on the formation, they can have natural effects as well. These crystals were found in Gavel's floating islands, and...well, let's say it's difficult to keep it in its case.
The Order of the Grook#031.dst: Selon leur formation, ils peuvent aussi avoir des effets naturels. Ces cristaux ont été trouvés sur les îles flottantes de Gavel, et... disons qu'il est difficile de les garder dans leur vitrine.
The Order of the Grook#031.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#032.src: Wybels! Pronounced like "nibble," they're a rather popular pet nowadays. But you all knew that, you want to know where they came from.
The Order of the Grook#032.dst: Les Wybels! Ça se prononce 'oui-belle', et ils sont plutôt populaires comme animaux de compagnie. Mais ça, vous le savez; vous voulez savoir d'où ils viennent.

The Order of the Grook#033.src: The explanation that we got was that they lived in the Ahms region, and when it split open, they eventually burrowed onto the surface of the {p}.
The Order of the Grook#033.dst: L'explication qu'on nous a donnée, c'est qu'ils vivaient dans la région d'Ahms, et quand elle s'est fendue, ils ont fini par creuser jusqu'à la surface de {p}.
The Order of the Grook#033.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#034.src: Oh, speaking of fluff. They wooly fur never actually stops growing, ever, and neither do their hooves, their horns, or their teeth. They shed often.
The Order of the Grook#034.dst: Oh, en parlant de duvet. Leur fourrure laineuse ne cesse jamais de pousser, jamais, et leurs sabots, leurs cornes et leurs dents non plus. Ils muent souvent.
The Order of the Grook#034.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#035.src: Wybel fluff is also able to be boiled, and it turns into a sticky molasses-like substance. It's used for candy, and it's very popular...but it's all POISON!!
The Order of the Grook#035.dst: Le duvet de Wybel peut aussi être bouilli, et il devient une substance collante semblable à de la mélasse. On en fait des bonbons, très populaires... mais c'est du POISON!!
The Order of the Grook#035.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#036.src: It's POISON, I tell you! Wybel meat is horrendously inedible! It'll give you the worst stomachache of your life! The candymakers are feeding us DEATH!
The Order of the Grook#036.dst: C'est du POISON, je vous dis! La viande de Wybel est horriblement immangeable! Elle vous donnera le pire mal de ventre de votre vie! Les confiseurs nous font manger la MORT!
The Order of the Grook#036.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#037.src: It's almost like they miss it, somehow. It's almost like they might be FROM outer space! It's ALMOST like they bring insanity-inducing things into our houses ON PURPOSE!
The Order of the Grook#037.dst: C'est presque comme si ça leur manquait, en quelque sorte. C'est presque comme s'ils venaient de l'espace! C'est PRESQUE comme s'ils apportaient EXPRÈS chez nous des choses qui rendent fou!
The Order of the Grook#037.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#038.src: Everyone says there's only nine, but WE know the truth! There's a tenth out there, an ultimately powerful one that wants us all gone. Pray you never see it, kids.
The Order of the Grook#038.dst: Tout le monde dit qu'il n'y en a que neuf, mais NOUS savons la vérité! Il y en a un dixième, tout-puissant, qui veut tous nous éliminer. Priez pour ne jamais le croiser, les enfants.
The Order of the Grook#038.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#039.src: Anyways, my lesson's safe from all that. All you have to do is re-order these plush Wybel toys on the stand. You'll figure it out once you're up here.
The Order of the Grook#039.dst: Bref, mon cours ne craint rien de tout ça. Vous n'avez qu'à remettre dans l'ordre ces Wybels en peluche sur le présentoir. Vous comprendrez une fois ici.
The Order of the Grook#039.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#040.src: Welcome in, guys and gals...we're learnin' about nature magic today!
The Order of the Grook#040.dst: Entrez, les gars et les filles... aujourd'hui, on apprend la magie de la nature!

The Order of the Grook#041.src: Druidic practices tend to deal with healing more, and nurturing. When life's created, it gives off energy...and Druids use that energy for their magic.
The Order of the Grook#041.dst: Les pratiques druidiques touchent plutôt au soin, et à prendre soin. Quand la vie est créée, elle dégage de l'énergie... et les druides utilisent cette énergie pour leur magie.

The Order of the Grook#042.src: Shamanic skills are a lot more direct, man. They take the life from other things and use that to do their stuff. It's way more varied than Druidic magic.
The Order of the Grook#042.dst: Les techniques chamaniques sont bien plus directes, mec. Elles prennent la vie d'autres choses et s'en servent pour leurs trucs. C'est bien plus varié que la magie druidique.
The Order of the Grook#042.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#043.src: Each has its ups and downs, man. Druidism is chill and helpful...but you can really expand your mind with Shamanism, buddies.
The Order of the Grook#043.dst: Chacune a ses hauts et ses bas, mec. Le druidisme, c'est cool et utile... mais le chamanisme peut vraiment vous ouvrir l'esprit, les potes.

The Order of the Grook#044.src: But, it's not picky about what life you take, man! A good shaman takes from plants and animals, not people!
The Order of the Grook#044.dst: Mais il ne fait pas le difficile sur la vie qu'on prend, mec! Un bon chaman prend aux plantes et aux animaux, pas aux gens!
The Order of the Grook#044.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#045.src: Don't be a Slykaar, kiddos. He asked for human sacrifices, but he lived in a jungle, man! Like, what the hey! He coulda done anything else!
The Order of the Grook#045.dst: Faites pas comme Slykaar, les enfants. Il voulait des sacrifices humains, alors qu'il vivait dans une jungle, mec! Non mais sérieux! Il avait plein d'autres options!
The Order of the Grook#045.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#046.src: Anyways. Our test today, little buds, is to practice some shamanic skills. We got a sick cow in the back, and you're gonna nurse it back to health.
The Order of the Grook#046.dst: Bref. Notre test d'aujourd'hui, mes petits bourgeons, c'est de pratiquer un peu le chamanisme. On a une vache malade au fond, et vous allez la remettre sur pied.

The Order of the Grook#047.src: When you think you have the right amount, activate the altar and see your results, man!
The Order of the Grook#047.dst: Quand tu penses avoir la bonne quantité, active l'autel et regarde le résultat, mec!

The Order of the Grook#049.src: You are about to enter the graduation room, there is no coming back after that. Are you sure?
The Order of the Grook#049.dst: Vous êtes sur le point d'entrer dans la salle de remise des diplômes, sans retour possible. Continuer?

The Order of the Grook#050.src: Let us start with {u}. Please come up to the stage!
The Order of the Grook#050.dst: Commençons par {u}. Montez sur l'estrade, je vous prie!

similar.text: Let us start with . Please come up to the stage!

The Order of the Grook#051.src: Oh, hey. You're that student from earlier.
The Order of the Grook#051.dst: Oh, salut. Tu es l'élève de tout à l'heure.

The Order of the Grook#052.src: Now that you've graduated you probably don't need to use the secret wall anymore.
The Order of the Grook#052.dst: Maintenant que tu as ton diplôme, tu n'as sans doute plus besoin du mur secret.

The Order of the Grook#053.src: Do you think we should make it something other than dirt? My robe gets dirty easily...
The Order of the Grook#053.dst: Tu crois qu'on devrait le faire dans autre chose que de la terre? Ma robe se salit facilement...

The Order of the Grook#054.src: Talk to Seasum in a tower on {p}.
The Order of the Grook#054.dst: Parlez à Seasum dans une tour de {p}.

The Order of the Grook#055.src: Ugh... I really, really, reeeeally don't want to go...
The Order of the Grook#055.dst: Pff... Je ne veux vraiment, vraiment, vraaaaiment pas y aller...
The Order of the Grook#055.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#057.src: Get the school invitation from Seasum room and bring it to Seasum.
The Order of the Grook#057.dst: Prenez l'invitation de l'école dans la chambre de Seasum et apportez-la à Seasum.

The Order of the Grook#058.src: Yep, that's the right letter. I hope you like school!
The Order of the Grook#058.dst: Ouais, c'est la bonne lettre. J'espère que tu vas aimer l'école!
The Order of the Grook#058.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#059.src: I don't even want to learn magic! I just want to write my stories and play games. You can go instead.
The Order of the Grook#059.dst: Je ne veux même pas apprendre la magie! Je veux juste écrire mes histoires et jouer. Vas-y à ma place.
The Order of the Grook#059.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#060.src: I know the picture on the letter is of me, but you can, um...
The Order of the Grook#060.dst: Je sais que la photo sur la lettre, c'est moi, mais tu peux, euh...
The Order of the Grook#060.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#061.src: You can say you had a growth spurt! Uh, that should work, i think!
The Order of the Grook#061.dst: Dis que tu as eu une poussée de croissance! Euh, ça devrait marcher, je crois!
The Order of the Grook#061.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#062.src: Now go on, you should get out before my parents see you. I don't want them to find out I gave that letter away...
The Order of the Grook#062.dst: Allez, file avant que mes parents te voient. Je ne veux pas qu'ils sachent que j'ai donné cette lettre...
The Order of the Grook#062.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#063.src: Talk to the School Ship Captain on the pier next to the Seaskipper Captain.
The Order of the Grook#063.dst: Parlez au capitaine du bateau de l'école sur la jetée, à côté du capitaine du Seaskipper.

The Order of the Grook#064.src: Hey! What are you doing all the way over here? This dock's broken.
The Order of the Grook#064.dst: Hé! Qu'est-ce que tu fais jusqu'ici? Ce quai est cassé.
The Order of the Grook#064.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#065.src: Oh, a student, you say. Aren't you a little old to be learning fundamental magical knowledge?
The Order of the Grook#065.dst: Oh, tu es élève, tu dis. Tu n'as pas un peu passé l'âge d'apprendre les bases de la magie?
The Order of the Grook#065.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#066.src: Well, if I could see your invitation letter, then?
The Order of the Grook#066.dst: Bon, je peux voir ta lettre d'invitation, alors?
The Order of the Grook#066.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#067.src: ...Hm. This...wow, you really look quite different than the picture. Did you get a new haircut?
The Order of the Grook#067.dst: ...Hm. Ça... eh ben, tu ne ressembles vraiment pas à la photo. Tu t'es fait couper les cheveux?
The Order of the Grook#067.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#068.src: Well, no judging from me! Keep walking to the end of the dock. Have faith!
The Order of the Grook#068.dst: Enfin, je ne juge personne! Avance jusqu'au bout du quai. Aie la foi!
The Order of the Grook#068.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#070.src: Alright everyone. Ready for a magical experience?
The Order of the Grook#070.dst: Bien, tout le monde. Prêts pour une expérience magique?
The Order of the Grook#070.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#071.src: We're headed to the Nexus. You've been told where to go. If you've forgotten, ask your fellow students!
The Order of the Grook#071.dst: Nous allons au Nexus. On vous a dit où aller. Si vous avez oublié, demandez à vos camarades!
The Order of the Grook#071.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#072.src: If you ever need to come back here, just walk out onto the dock again. Good luck, now!
The Order of the Grook#072.dst: Si jamais tu dois revenir ici, retourne simplement sur le quai. Bonne chance!
The Order of the Grook#072.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#073.src: Follow the children to the school.

The Order of the Grook#074.src: Through the wall, right? I hope my uniform doesn't get dirty.
The Order of the Grook#074.dst: A travers le mur, c'est ça? J'espère que mon uniforme ne va pas se salir.
The Order of the Grook#074.speaker: Student

The Order of the Grook#075.src: Talk to Cidre on the school island.
The Order of the Grook#075.dst: Parlez à Cidre sur l'île de l'école.

The Order of the Grook#076.src: Welcome to the island of Grookwarts! I will be guiding and helping all the new students.
The Order of the Grook#076.dst: Bienvenue sur l'île de Grookwarts! Je vais guider et aider tous les nouveaux élèves.
The Order of the Grook#076.speaker: Cidre

The Order of the Grook#077.src: You can find everything here around the docks. Choosing your materials is very important, so buy the ones that speak to you!
The Order of the Grook#077.dst: Vous trouverez tout ici, autour des quais. Choisir son matériel est très important, alors achetez ce qui vous parle!
The Order of the Grook#077.speaker: Cidre

The Order of the Grook#078.src: When you're done, meet with Miss Una at the front gates!
The Order of the Grook#078.dst: Quand vous aurez fini, retrouvez Mlle Una devant les grilles!
The Order of the Grook#078.speaker: Cidre

The Order of the Grook#079.src: Purchase a wand from the Wand Merchant and a book from the Magical Book Merchant, then talk to Una.
The Order of the Grook#079.dst: Achetez une baguette au marchand de baguettes et un livre au marchand de livres magiques, puis parlez à Una.

The Order of the Grook#081.src: Seems like you all have your materials in order. You are now free to enter Grookwarts and begin your lessons.
The Order of the Grook#081.dst: On dirait que vous avez tous votre matériel en ordre. Vous pouvez maintenant entrer à Grookwarts et commencer vos cours.
The Order of the Grook#081.speaker: Una

The Order of the Grook#082.src: The door is just behind me. Walk on in!
The Order of the Grook#082.dst: La porte est juste derrière moi. Entrez!
The Order of the Grook#082.speaker: Una

The Order of the Grook#083.src: Attend the welcoming dinner at Grookwarts.
The Order of the Grook#083.dst: Assistez au dîner de bienvenue de Grookwarts.

The Order of the Grook#084.src: Hush, hush! The speech will be soon!
The Order of the Grook#084.dst: Chut, chut! Le discours va bientôt commencer!
The Order of the Grook#084.speaker: Student

The Order of the Grook#085.src: Hurry, take a seat! The banquet will be starting any second now!
The Order of the Grook#085.dst: Vite, assieds-toi! Le banquet va commencer d'une seconde à l'autre!
The Order of the Grook#085.speaker: Student

The Order of the Grook#086.src: Magical children of Wynn and Gavel alike... We welcome you here, to our fair academy.
The Order of the Grook#086.dst: Enfants magiques de Wynn comme de Gavel... Nous vous souhaitons la bienvenue dans notre belle académie.

The Order of the Grook#087.src: Oh lordy, the headmaster! I didn't even see him come in!
The Order of the Grook#087.dst: Oh là là, le directeur! Je ne l'ai même pas vu entrer!
The Order of the Grook#087.speaker: Student

The Order of the Grook#088.src: Uhm... I don't see him at all, actually...
The Order of the Grook#088.dst: Euh... En fait, je ne le vois pas du tout...
The Order of the Grook#088.speaker: Student

The Order of the Grook#089.src: Well, I should hope you can see me now, all of you. Oh, what a splendid turnout this year!
The Order of the Grook#089.dst: Eh bien, j'espère que vous me voyez tous, maintenant. Oh, quelle splendide assistance cette année!
The Order of the Grook#089.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#090.src: Apologies, I simply can't resist a bit of theatrics. But now, it is time to listen and learn, fledgeling Grooks.
The Order of the Grook#090.dst: Pardonnez-moi, je ne résiste jamais à un peu de théâtre. Mais à présent, l'heure est venue d'écouter et d'apprendre, oisillons Grooks.
The Order of the Grook#090.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#091.src: We knowledged mages and scholars, the Order of the Grook, are pleased to see each of you here. Whether you be a young mind aching with curiosity...
The Order of the Grook#091.dst: Nous, mages et érudits de l'Ordre du Grook, sommes heureux de vous voir tous ici. Que vous soyez un jeune esprit brûlant de curiosité...
The Order of the Grook#091.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#092.src: ...or an old hat looking to refine their knowledge, all seeking to learn magic are welcomed here. We expect great things of you.
The Order of the Grook#092.dst: ...ou un vieux briscard voulant parfaire son savoir, quiconque veut apprendre la magie est le bienvenu ici. Nous attendons beaucoup de vous.
The Order of the Grook#092.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#093.src: Now, to business. You will write your schedules for the semester. Look down on your paper and write in what classes you wish to participate in.
The Order of the Grook#093.dst: Passons aux choses sérieuses. Vous allez établir votre emploi du temps du semestre. Regardez votre feuille et inscrivez les cours auxquels vous souhaitez participer.
The Order of the Grook#093.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#094.src: You will need to choose four classes, one from each category. The categories are: Elemental Magic, Practical Magic, Magical Creatures, and Types of magic.
The Order of the Grook#094.dst: Vous devrez choisir quatre cours, un dans chaque catégorie. Les catégories sont: Magie élémentaire, Magie pratique, Créatures magiques et Types de magie.
The Order of the Grook#094.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#095.src: The schedule book is at the end of the table. Worry not, there is no limit on class size. If you wish to take it, you may take it.
The Order of the Grook#095.dst: Le registre des horaires est au bout de la table. Soyez sans crainte, les places sont illimitées. Si vous voulez un cours, prenez-le.
The Order of the Grook#095.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#097.src: Talk to the Ghost Guide and attend your chosen classes (The Ghost Guide will lead you to each class):
The Order of the Grook#097.dst: Parlez au Guide fantôme et assistez aux cours choisis (le Guide fantôme vous mènera à chaque cours):

The Order of the Grook#098.src: I'll be leading you to your classes, everyone! Talk to me when you're ready to go.
The Order of the Grook#098.dst: C'est moi qui vous mènerai à vos cours, tout le monde! Parlez-moi quand vous serez prêts.
The Order of the Grook#098.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#099.src: Alright, fledgeling Grooks! Your first class is starting in just a minute. Follow me!
The Order of the Grook#099.dst: Bien, oisillons Grooks! Votre premier cours commence dans une minute. Suivez-moi!
The Order of the Grook#099.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#100.src: Here are the elemental classes. Step on in. Your magical journey truly begins here!
The Order of the Grook#100.dst: Voici les classes élémentaires. Entrez donc. Votre voyage magique commence vraiment ici!
The Order of the Grook#100.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#101.src: Now, all of you. Sit. Listen.
The Order of the Grook#101.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#102.src: Earth is an element of great power. Versatile and everpresent, nearly as the air.
The Order of the Grook#102.dst: La Terre est un élément très puissant. Polyvalente et omniprésente, presque autant que l'air.
The Order of the Grook#102.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#103.src: Thunder provides force... Earth provides sheer power. The difference... Force choose its own path. Power is force, directed.
The Order of the Grook#103.dst: La Foudre donne la force... La Terre donne la puissance brute. La différence... La force choisit son chemin. La puissance, c'est la force dirigée.
The Order of the Grook#103.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#104.src: Earth is also the earth itself. Stone, metal, trees and soil. Trees sway in the wind, but do not break. And the mountains do not crumble.
The Order of the Grook#104.dst: La Terre, c'est aussi la terre elle-même. Pierre, métal, arbres et sol. Les arbres ploient sous le vent, mais ne rompent pas. Et les montagnes ne croulent pas.
The Order of the Grook#104.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#105.src: The Touroto, stepped in earthly magic, are nearly invincible to all but themselves. It is proof of the earth's strength.
The Order of the Grook#105.dst: Les Touroto, imprégnés de magie tellurique, sont presque invincibles, sauf face à eux-mêmes. C'est la preuve de la force de la terre.
The Order of the Grook#105.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#106.src: The Doguns... They were masters of the earth, and fire alike, shaping caverns to their will... And now, nearly extinct. A terrible crime...
The Order of the Grook#106.dst: Les Doguns... Ils étaient maîtres de la terre comme du feu, façonnant les cavernes à leur guise... Et aujourd'hui, ils sont presque éteints. Un crime terrible...
The Order of the Grook#106.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#107.src: But we shall honor them, and move forwards. We shall strike the earth and claim it to be our own.
The Order of the Grook#107.dst: Mais nous les honorerons, et nous irons de l'avant. Nous frapperons la terre et la revendiquerons comme nôtre.
The Order of the Grook#107.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#108.src: The tome directs the earth's force. Take it and utilize it to shatter the stones I summon.
The Order of the Grook#108.dst: Le tome dirige la force de la terre. Prends-le et sers-t'en pour briser les pierres que j'invoque.
The Order of the Grook#108.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#109.src: The darkest parts of the stones are weak points. Find them, and learn the power of the earth.
The Order of the Grook#109.dst: Les parties sombres des pierres sont leurs points faibles. Trouve-les, et apprends la force de la terre.
The Order of the Grook#109.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#110.src: You know the earth's power, fledgeling. There is nothing more for you here. Go.
The Order of the Grook#110.dst: Tu connais la puissance de la terre, oisillon. Il n'y a plus rien pour toi ici. Va.
The Order of the Grook#110.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#111.src: Hee hee, take your seats, take your seats, TAKE. YOUR. SEATS. A marvelous batch of eager students today!!
The Order of the Grook#111.dst: Hi hi, asseyez-vous, asseyez-vous, AS. SEYEZ. VOUS. Quelle merveilleuse fournée d'élèves avides aujourd'hui!!
The Order of the Grook#111.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#112.src: Almost as marvelous as the powers of Thunder! Energy! Pure, unfocused energy! Devastation, desolation, industrialization all alike!
The Order of the Grook#112.dst: Presque aussi merveilleuse que les pouvoirs de la Foudre! L'énergie! L'énergie pure, brute! Dévastation, désolation, industrialisation, tout à la fois!
The Order of the Grook#112.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#113.src: Yes, yes! Thunder is technical and versatile! Unreliable to all those who don't know how to rely on it, to those dexterous of hand and mind!
The Order of the Grook#113.dst: Oui, oui! La Foudre est technique et polyvalente! Peu fiable pour qui ne sait pas s'y fier, fidèle aux mains et aux esprits adroits!
The Order of the Grook#113.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#114.src: But woe, woe, Thunder is reviled, reviled! Pure energy has no morality! If used for good, yes yes, ho hum, but if used for evil, oh, burn the witch! Burn, burn! Evil, they say! Pah!!
The Order of the Grook#114.dst: Mais hélas, hélas, la Foudre est honnie, honnie! L'énergie pure n'a pas de morale! Pour le bien, oui oui, bof, mais pour le mal, oh, au bûcher la sorcière! Brûlez-la, brûlez-la! Maléfique, qu'ils disent! Pfff!!
The Order of the Grook#114.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#115.src: All magicks are unaligned with silly concepts such as morality. They are pure chaos! But Thunder, the element of energy and force, it seems ever so EASY to use for evil...
The Order of the Grook#115.dst: Toutes les magies se moquent de concepts aussi ridicules que la morale. Elles sont chaos pur! Mais la Foudre, l'élément de l'énergie et de la force, semble si FACILE à utiliser pour le mal...
The Order of the Grook#115.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#116.src: And evil has found it, found it! CORRUPTION!! DEMONS!! Forces anathema to us, but knowleged in the ways of force and thus, thunder! So terrible, terrible, and thunder mages feared, feared...
The Order of the Grook#116.dst: Et le mal l'a trouvée, trouvée! LA CORRUPTION!! LES DÉMONS!! Des forces anathèmes, mais versées dans la force et donc la foudre! Si terrible, terrible, et les mages de la foudre craints, craints...
The Order of the Grook#116.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#117.src: And then, then! Joyous day, the Corkians arrived with their marvelous machines, and their electromagic! Thunder controlled, thunder tamed! The wonder of it all!
The Order of the Grook#117.dst: Et puis, et puis! Jour de joie, les Corkians sont arrivés avec leurs merveilleuses machines et leur électromagie! La foudre maîtrisée, la foudre domptée! Quelle merveille!
The Order of the Grook#117.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#118.src: Electromagic makes handles crank, gears spin, metal move, gives sheer stones the power to THINK, and to PLAN! A Corkian original, and a splendid, splendid development reintroduced!
The Order of the Grook#118.dst: L'électromagie tourne les manivelles et les engrenages, meut le métal, donne à de simples pierres le pouvoir de PENSER, et de PLANIFIER! Une invention des Corkians, un progrès splendide, splendide, retrouvé!
The Order of the Grook#118.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#119.src: And so, you shall see for yourselves! Electromagic at work! You will control thunder and electricity, and make the machines bend to your world today, today, this shocking day!
The Order of the Grook#119.dst: Et maintenant, vous allez voir par vous-mêmes! L'électromagie à l'oeuvre! Vous dompterez la foudre et l'électricité, et plierez les machines à votre volonté aujourd'hui, aujourd'hui, en ce jour électrisant!
The Order of the Grook#119.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#120.src: The mechanism is behind me now! Come up, come up! See the power of thunder, shackled by our whims, won't you, {u}?
The Order of the Grook#120.dst: Le mécanisme est derrière moi! Montez, montez! Contemple la puissance de la foudre, enchaînée à nos caprices, veux-tu, {u}?
The Order of the Grook#120.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#121.src: Whee hee hee! Thunder tamed, thunder shackled, and your magical wings unbound by such petty concepts, {u}! What a show!
The Order of the Grook#121.dst: Hi hi hi! La foudre domptée, la foudre enchaînée, et tes ailes magiques libérées de concepts aussi mesquins, {u}! Quel spectacle!
The Order of the Grook#121.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#122.src: Expand your knowledge ever further, further! Your task is complete, complete, and your next awaits!
The Order of the Grook#122.dst: Élargis ton savoir toujours plus loin, plus loin! Ta tâche est accomplie, accomplie, et la suivante t'attend!
The Order of the Grook#122.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#123.src: Aah, wow! Everyone s-sure got here quick...
The Order of the Grook#123.dst: Aah, ouah! Vous êtes t-tous arrivés vite...
The Order of the Grook#123.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#124.src: Welcome, w-welcome. The Water element class is...certainly an interesting one, I-I'd hope... Because water doesn't j-just pertain to, well, w-water...
The Order of the Grook#124.dst: Bienvenue, b-bienvenue. Le cours sur l'élément Eau est... certainement intéressant, j-j'espère... Parce que l'eau ne concerne pas s-seulement, eh bien, l'e-eau...
The Order of the Grook#124.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#125.src: Learning a-about the water element and e-expanding your horizons can allow you to cast spells easier... C-control the flow of magic better, you see.
The Order of the Grook#125.dst: Apprendre l'élément eau et é-élargir vos horizons peut vous permettre de lancer des sorts plus facilement... De m-mieux contrôler le flux de la magie, voyez-vous.
The Order of the Grook#125.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#126.src: Most aquatic creatures are t-tied to water, though creatures that live in icy or snowy environments are, t-too...often, they are also connected to air, but not always.
The Order of the Grook#126.dst: La plupart des créatures aquatiques sont l-liées à l'eau, mais celles des environnements glacés ou enneigés le sont a-aussi... souvent, elles sont aussi liées à l'air, mais pas toujours.
The Order of the Grook#126.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#127.src: In a-addition, many holy artifacts are enchanted with water magic... S-something about how it's a pure type of energy, I believe.
The Order of the Grook#127.dst: De p-plus, beaucoup d'artefacts sacrés sont enchantés par la magie de l'eau... Q-quelque chose à voir avec sa pureté, je crois.
The Order of the Grook#127.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#128.src: Lastly, healing abilities are b-bolstered by water magic. Just knowing magic well d-doesn't help, but actually having artifacts charged w-with water magic can increase healing capabilities.
The Order of the Grook#128.dst: Enfin, les capacités de soin sont r-renforcées par la magie de l'eau. Bien connaître la magie n'aide p-pas, mais porter des artefacts chargés d-de magie de l'eau peut augmenter les capacités de soin.
The Order of the Grook#128.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#129.src: N-now, for your test, I have...um, a...a test. Anyone who wants to try it f-first, just go up and start.
The Order of the Grook#129.dst: M-maintenant, pour votre examen, j'ai... euh, un... un examen. Que celui qui veut essayer en p-premier monte et commence.
The Order of the Grook#129.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#130.src: Good to see a decent turnout this year for my class. Too dangerous, pah! You can take this just fine.
The Order of the Grook#130.dst: Ça fait plaisir de voir du monde cette année dans mon cours. Trop dangereux, pff! Vous vous en sortirez très bien.
The Order of the Grook#130.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#131.src: Anyways. The Fire element class. Many misunderstand just what fire stands for...but after today, you will leave with courage in your hearts.
The Order of the Grook#131.dst: Bref. Le cours sur l'élément Feu. Beaucoup comprennent mal ce que représente le feu... mais après aujourd'hui, vous repartirez le coeur plein de courage.
The Order of the Grook#131.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#132.src: Fire is, of course, related to physical fire, magma, etcetera. A burning torch is a source of fire magic, but that is not the only source of it.
The Order of the Grook#132.dst: Le Feu est, bien sûr, lié au feu physique, au magma, et cetera. Une torche allumée est une source de magie du feu, mais ce n'est pas la seule.
The Order of the Grook#132.speaker: Teacher
