The Price of Ingenuity#102.dst: Le système de tickets sert à rationner la nourriture et d'autres articles pour ceux qui en ont besoin. En plus de cette somme de départ, vous recevrez chaque semaine des tickets à dépenser comme bon vous semble.
The Price of Ingenuity#102.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#103.src: Of course, basic amenities are free of charge if you're part of our community. Wouldn't want any of our members to sleep on the tracks, after all!
The Price of Ingenuity#103.dst: Bien sûr, les services de base sont gratuits si vous faites partie de notre communauté. On ne voudrait pas qu'un de nos membres dorme sur les voies!
The Price of Ingenuity#103.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#104.src: So... I baked bread for, um, no reason?
The Price of Ingenuity#104.dst: Alors... j'ai fait du pain pour, euh, rien?
The Price of Ingenuity#104.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#105.src: I fear so, haha! Do not worry, you will not be forced to do work here.
The Price of Ingenuity#105.dst: J'en ai bien peur, haha! Ne t'inquiète pas, personne ne te forcera à travailler ici.
The Price of Ingenuity#105.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#106.src: And, besides, if I wanted you to cook for us, I would have let you know well in advance.
The Price of Ingenuity#106.dst: Et puis, si je voulais que tu cuisines pour nous, je t'aurais prévenue longtemps à l'avance.
The Price of Ingenuity#106.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#107.src: I mean... I w-wouldn't mind some fr-fresh bread...
The Price of Ingenuity#107.dst: Enfin... moi, ça ne me d-dérangerait pas, un peu de pain f-frais...
The Price of Ingenuity#107.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#108.dst: Non! Il est tout à moi!
The Price of Ingenuity#108.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#109.src: Ah, one more thing. I wanted to point you all towards the training yard- Zeph, I believe you have been there already?
The Price of Ingenuity#109.dst: Ah, encore une chose. Je voulais vous indiquer la cour d'entraînement- Zeph, tu y es déjà allé, je crois?
The Price of Ingenuity#109.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#111.src: I believe the brothers should be there right now. If you're to be working with us, it would be best to get used to each other's fighting styles.
The Price of Ingenuity#111.dst: Les frères devraient y être en ce moment. Si vous devez travailler avec nous, mieux vaut vous habituer aux styles de combat de chacun.
The Price of Ingenuity#111.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#112.src: Why don't you go join them there, while Syndra and I discuss further matters?
The Price of Ingenuity#112.dst: Pourquoi n'iriez-vous pas les rejoindre là-bas, pendant que Syndra et moi discutons d'autres affaires?
The Price of Ingenuity#112.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#113.src: Find the brothers at the training yard at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#113.dst: Retrouvez les frères à la cour d'entraînement en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#114.src: ...do you really gotta head out there again?
The Price of Ingenuity#114.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#115.src: You know contracts are rare, man. I have to take what I can get.
The Price of Ingenuity#115.dst: Tu sais que les contrats sont rares, mec. Je dois prendre ce qui se présente.
The Price of Ingenuity#115.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#116.src: Why's it always gotta be you and Yus heading out?! For once- for once, man, take care of yourself!
The Price of Ingenuity#116.dst: Pourquoi c'est toujours toi et Yus qui partez?! Pour une fois- pour une fois, mec, prends soin de toi!
The Price of Ingenuity#116.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#120.src: No, this can wait. Did Quill send you over?
The Price of Ingenuity#120.dst: Non, ça peut attendre. C'est Quill qui vous envoie?
The Price of Ingenuity#120.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#121.src: Indeed he did. He suggested we get to know each other's fighting styles!
The Price of Ingenuity#121.dst: En effet. Il nous a suggéré d'apprendre à connaître les styles de combat de chacun!
The Price of Ingenuity#121.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#122.src: Not a bad idea. Yuman and I would be happy to show off what we can do, right?
The Price of Ingenuity#122.dst: Pas une mauvaise idée. Yuman et moi serons ravis de montrer ce qu'on sait faire, pas vrai?
The Price of Ingenuity#122.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#124.src: Well, Zeph, {u}, and I've already been through it! Some cool moves from you both! Man, getting to see a cursed one in action was awesome...
The Price of Ingenuity#124.dst: Bon, Zeph, {u} et moi, on l'a déjà fait! De sacrés mouvements, vous deux! Mec, voir un Maudit en action, c'était génial...
The Price of Ingenuity#124.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#126.src: Yeah! Like, I'd hear all the stories, and think... man, having those kinds of powers sounds so cool. Sometimes I wished I could have em! Without, uh, being evil, of course.
The Price of Ingenuity#126.dst: Ouais! Genre, j'entendais toutes ces histoires et je me disais... mec, avoir ce genre de pouvoirs, ça doit être trop cool. Des fois, j'aurais voulu les avoir! Sans, euh, être maléfique, bien sûr.
The Price of Ingenuity#126.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#127.src: You'd be even harder to deal with if you did, bro. But on that subject- Quill said something about you all practicing... what was the word he used... "magic?"
The Price of Ingenuity#127.dst: Tu serais encore plus pénible si c'était le cas, frérot. Mais à ce propos- Quill a dit que vous pratiquiez... c'était quoi le mot... la "magie"?
The Price of Ingenuity#127.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#128.src: What?! Ey, princess, why didn't you show anything off the other day?
The Price of Ingenuity#128.dst: Quoi?! Hé, princesse, pourquoi t'as rien montré l'autre jour?
The Price of Ingenuity#128.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#130.src: Don't be insensitive, Yuman. It isn't something people just... pick up.
The Price of Ingenuity#130.dst: Ne sois pas lourd, Yuman. Ce n'est pas un truc qu'on... apprend comme ça.
The Price of Ingenuity#130.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#131.src: From what little I've heard from Quill, it can take years of study to master a blessing... so I wouldn't be surprised if they couldn't even make a spark! Uh, no offense.
The Price of Ingenuity#131.dst: D'après le peu que m'en a dit Quill, maîtriser une bénédiction prend parfois des années... alors ça ne m'étonnerait pas qu'ils ne fassent même pas une étincelle! Euh, sans vouloir vexer.
The Price of Ingenuity#131.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#132.src: W- well... maybe we'll s- sur- surprise you!
The Price of Ingenuity#132.dst: B- bon... on va peut-être vous s- sur- surprendre!
The Price of Ingenuity#132.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#133.src: Ha, think you're the only ones with hidden talents? I've got a trick or two up my sleeve too!
The Price of Ingenuity#133.dst: Ha, vous croyez être les seuls à avoir des talents cachés? J'ai aussi un ou deux tours dans ma manche!
The Price of Ingenuity#133.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#135.src: It's an expression, dumbass. Like you're one to talk. Why are you half-naked?
The Price of Ingenuity#135.dst: C'est une expression, abruti. Tu peux parler. Pourquoi t'es à moitié à poil?
The Price of Ingenuity#135.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#136.src: To show off my abs? Obviously. Anyway, {u}, why don't you decide who goes first?
The Price of Ingenuity#136.dst: Pour montrer mes abdos? Évidemment. Bref, {u}, et si tu décidais qui commence?
The Price of Ingenuity#136.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#138.src: Who, me? Sorry, but I'll sit this one out until you're all done.
The Price of Ingenuity#138.dst: Qui, moi? Désolé, mais je passe mon tour jusqu'à ce que vous ayez tous fini.
The Price of Ingenuity#138.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#139.src: Got to save the best for last, right? Heh.
The Price of Ingenuity#139.dst: Faut garder le meilleur pour la fin, non? Hé.
The Price of Ingenuity#139.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#140.src: I'll have to add arrows until my bowstring runs out of space next time...
The Price of Ingenuity#140.dst: La prochaine fois, j'ajouterai des flèches jusqu'à ce qu'il n'y ait plus de place sur ma corde...
The Price of Ingenuity#140.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#141.src: I'll h-have to come back here a-again tonight!
The Price of Ingenuity#141.dst: Il f-faudra que je revienne ici e-encore ce soir!
The Price of Ingenuity#141.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#142.src: It's like there's ripples gently spreading within me...
The Price of Ingenuity#142.dst: C'est comme si des ondes se propageaient doucement en moi...
The Price of Ingenuity#142.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#143.src: To see my powers growing this clearly...
The Price of Ingenuity#143.dst: Voir mes pouvoirs grandir aussi nettement...
The Price of Ingenuity#143.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#145.src: Dang, I think I overloaded it. I'll have to put it through a charge cycle...
The Price of Ingenuity#145.dst: Mince, je crois que je l'ai surchargé. Il va falloir que je lui fasse un cycle de charge...
The Price of Ingenuity#145.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#147.src: So. Magic, curses, blessings... whatever you want to call it, it hasn't worked for me. It just doesn't... click.
The Price of Ingenuity#147.dst: Bon. Magie, malédictions, bénédictions... appelez ça comme vous voulez, ça n'a pas marché pour moi. Ça ne... prend pas, c'est tout.
The Price of Ingenuity#147.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#148.src: Ah, not to worry, Rex! Even without it, none in the province could match your accuracy with a bow.
The Price of Ingenuity#148.dst: Ah, ne t'en fais pas, Rex! Même sans cela, personne dans la province n'égale ta précision à l'arc.
The Price of Ingenuity#148.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#149.src: Y- yeah! And if you d- did get magic, it'd j- jus- just be unfair for the rest of us!
The Price of Ingenuity#149.dst: O- ouais! Et si tu a- avais de la magie, ce s- se- serait juste injuste pour nous autres!
The Price of Ingenuity#149.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#150.src: Yeah, yeah, sure. Either way, I've been practicing a new technique... let's see if I can pull it off.
The Price of Ingenuity#150.dst: Oui, oui, c'est ça. En tout cas, je m'entraîne à une nouvelle technique... voyons si j'y arrive.
The Price of Ingenuity#150.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#151.dst: ...tu es sûre que ce n'est pas de la magie?
The Price of Ingenuity#151.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#152.src: Yep! I just place every arrow on the string at once, which lets me shoot at a much larger area!
The Price of Ingenuity#152.dst: Ouaip! Je mets juste toutes les flèches sur la corde d'un coup, comme ça je couvre une zone bien plus grande!
The Price of Ingenuity#152.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#153.src: But... how'd you manage to hit each arrow right on target?! That's... insane!
The Price of Ingenuity#153.dst: Mais... comment tu as fait pour que chaque flèche touche sa cible?! C'est... dingue!
The Price of Ingenuity#153.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#154.src: Ha. Go on, keep praising my skill. That was actually the first time I tried that many arrows at once... glad it worked out!
The Price of Ingenuity#154.dst: Ha. Vas-y, continue de vanter mon talent. En fait, je n'avais jamais essayé avec autant de flèches... heureusement que ça a marché!
The Price of Ingenuity#154.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#155.src: The... first... You said you'd practiced it, man! What do you mean that was the first time?!
The Price of Ingenuity#155.dst: La... première... Tu as dit que tu t'étais entraînée! Comment ça, c'était la première fois?!
The Price of Ingenuity#155.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#156.src: Yeah? I practiced theoretically. In my head. Keep up, Yulie.
The Price of Ingenuity#156.dst: Oui? Je me suis entraînée en théorie. Dans ma tête. Suis un peu, Yulie.
The Price of Ingenuity#156.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#157.dst: Bon, alors, qui est le suivant?
The Price of Ingenuity#157.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#158.src: Couldn't even make a spark, eh?
The Price of Ingenuity#158.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#159.src: Alright, alright! I've been proven wrong.
The Price of Ingenuity#159.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#161.src: So... I w-want to first say that I've been c-coming here every night.
The Price of Ingenuity#161.dst: Alors... je v-veux d'abord dire que je suis v-venu ici toutes les nuits.
The Price of Ingenuity#161.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#162.src: I was e-embarrassed that I just didn't g-get it.
The Price of Ingenuity#162.dst: J'avais h-honte de ne pas y a-arriver.
The Price of Ingenuity#162.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#163.src: I mean, j-just look at how fast your m-magic developed, Mora!
The Price of Ingenuity#163.dst: Je veux dire, r-regarde à quelle vitesse ta m-magie s'est développée, Mora!
The Price of Ingenuity#163.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#164.src: And you, S-sui! You are a natural, a-after all.
The Price of Ingenuity#164.dst: Et toi, S-sui! Tu es douée de nature, a-après tout.
The Price of Ingenuity#164.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#165.src: I still don't know any form of magic. Why feel so embarrassed?
The Price of Ingenuity#165.dst: Moi, je ne connais toujours aucune forme de magie. Pourquoi avoir honte?
The Price of Ingenuity#165.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#166.src: Rex, you don't even n-need magic to be a valuable asset! You're the best archer in the w-world!
The Price of Ingenuity#166.dst: Rex, tu n'as même pas b-besoin de magie pour être précieuse! Tu es la meilleure archère du m-monde!
The Price of Ingenuity#166.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#167.src: I don't h-have that skill! My blade skills a-aren't good enough! You've h-had to save me time and time a-again.
The Price of Ingenuity#167.dst: Moi, je n'ai pas ce t-talent! Je ne manie pas assez b-bien la lame! Tu as d-dû me sauver encore et e-encore.
The Price of Ingenuity#167.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#168.src: And {u}, I felt like I had l-let you down after all the k-knowledge you had given me.
The Price of Ingenuity#168.dst: Et {u}, j'avais l'impression de t'avoir d-déçu après tout le s-savoir que tu m'as transmis.
The Price of Ingenuity#168.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#169.src: I may not have talked to you a lot, Zeph. But from what I know of the science behind magic, you don't have to blame yourself for not getting it.
The Price of Ingenuity#169.dst: On n'a peut-être pas beaucoup parlé, Zeph. Mais d'après ce que je sais de la science derrière la magie, tu n'as pas à t'en vouloir de ne pas y arriver.
The Price of Ingenuity#169.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#170.src: A lot of people study magic their whole lives. I'm sure you'll get there eventually.
The Price of Ingenuity#170.dst: Plein de gens étudient la magie toute leur vie. Je suis sûr que tu finiras par y arriver.
The Price of Ingenuity#170.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#171.src: Thank y-you, Yusanu. However, I think I f-finally figured it out...
The Price of Ingenuity#171.dst: M-merci, Yusanu. Mais je crois que j'ai e-enfin compris...
The Price of Ingenuity#171.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#173.src: I think I'm finally g-getting this magic thing somewhat down!
The Price of Ingenuity#173.dst: Je crois que je c-commence enfin à maîtriser ce truc de la magie!
The Price of Ingenuity#173.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#174.src: I will n-not stop practicing! N-not until I can m-m-match you all!
The Price of Ingenuity#174.dst: Je ne v-vais pas arrêter de m'entraîner! P-pas avant de pouvoir t-t-tous vous égaler!
The Price of Ingenuity#174.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#176.src: Come on, man! Show us what you've got!
The Price of Ingenuity#176.dst: Allez, vas-y! Montre-nous ce que t'as dans le ventre!
The Price of Ingenuity#176.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#177.src: ...okay. I've tried to, um, practice a bit, now that I'm... yeah.
The Price of Ingenuity#177.dst: ...d'accord. J'ai essayé de, euh, m'entraîner un peu, maintenant que je suis... ouais.
The Price of Ingenuity#177.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#178.src: I haven't fully developed it, but, I have this new skill...
The Price of Ingenuity#178.dst: Je ne l'ai pas complètement développé, mais j'ai ce nouveau talent...
The Price of Ingenuity#178.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#179.src: Okay! I'm going to try it!
The Price of Ingenuity#179.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#180.src: W- woah! It's like you ma- made that out of n- n- nothing!
The Price of Ingenuity#180.dst: W- waouh! C'est comme si tu l'avais f- fait à partir de r- r- rien!
The Price of Ingenuity#180.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#181.src: ...ugh! It takes so much concentration... even a word makes me fail...
The Price of Ingenuity#181.dst: ...pff! Ça demande tellement de concentration... un seul mot et je rate...
The Price of Ingenuity#181.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#182.src: Also. It's not, um, out of nothing.
The Price of Ingenuity#182.dst: Et puis. Ce n'est pas, euh, à partir de rien.
The Price of Ingenuity#182.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#183.src: It's like... there's an ocean of swirling energy, all around me. If I can get a bit, in, like... a bucket, I can use it. But... I don't know how to get it without, um, falling into it and getting overwhelmed.
The Price of Ingenuity#183.dst: C'est comme... s'il y avait un océan d'énergie tourbillonnante tout autour de moi. Si j'en attrape un peu, genre... dans un seau, je peux l'utiliser. Mais... je ne sais pas comment la prendre sans, euh, tomber dedans et être submergée.
The Price of Ingenuity#183.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#184.dst: ...est-ce que, euh, ça a du sens?
The Price of Ingenuity#184.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#185.src: Uh... n- not- not really, but-
The Price of Ingenuity#185.dst: Euh... p- pas- pas vraiment, mais-
The Price of Ingenuity#185.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#190.src: I... I'm fine. No, even... more than that...
The Price of Ingenuity#190.dst: Je... je vais bien. Non, même... mieux que ça...
The Price of Ingenuity#190.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#191.src: It's like... I finally felt this power's ebb and flow, not just... it pouring out, I...
The Price of Ingenuity#191.dst: C'est comme si... je sentais enfin le flux et reflux de ce pouvoir, pas juste... qu'il déborde, je...
The Price of Ingenuity#191.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#192.src: ...ah! Is everyone fine? You... you all seem fine. Okay...
The Price of Ingenuity#192.dst: ...ah! Tout le monde va bien? Vous... vous avez l'air d'aller bien. D'accord...
The Price of Ingenuity#192.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#193.src: I think... I think that's all from me.
The Price of Ingenuity#193.dst: Je crois... je crois que c'est tout pour moi.
The Price of Ingenuity#193.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#194.src: Very well! This is as good an opportunity as any to show off my progress!
The Price of Ingenuity#194.dst: Très bien! Voilà une occasion idéale de montrer mes progrès!
The Price of Ingenuity#194.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#195.src: Although I am proficient in combat with my hammer, that is... standard. So, allow me to show my magic instead, as that is what I have been training!
The Price of Ingenuity#195.dst: Bien que je manie le marteau avec aisance au combat, c'est... ordinaire. Permettez-moi plutôt de vous montrer ma magie, car c'est elle que j'entraîne!
The Price of Ingenuity#195.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#196.src: ...oh, dear. I did not expect it to have become so powerful! It seems I must still master control over it...
The Price of Ingenuity#196.dst: ...oh, mon Dieu. Je ne la pensais pas devenue si puissante! Il semble que je doive encore apprendre à la maîtriser...
The Price of Ingenuity#196.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#197.src: I apologize for the damage I have caused. If you would ask for compensation, I would gladly provide it.
The Price of Ingenuity#197.dst: Je vous prie d'excuser les dégâts que j'ai causés. Si vous demandez réparation, je vous l'accorderai volontiers.
The Price of Ingenuity#197.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#198.src: Eh, don't worry about it. It's just a training room. Besides, all this junk in here doesn't even work anymore.
The Price of Ingenuity#198.dst: Bah, t'en fais pas. C'est qu'une salle d'entraînement. Et puis, toute cette ferraille ici ne marche même plus.
The Price of Ingenuity#198.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#200.src: Yo, that was badass, man! Your curse is awesome.
The Price of Ingenuity#200.dst: Ho, c'était trop stylé, mec! Ta malédiction est géniale.
The Price of Ingenuity#200.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#201.src: Is it! I suppose it is, haha! I am glad to have had the opportunity to learn to use it.
The Price of Ingenuity#201.dst: Vraiment! Je suppose que oui, haha! Je suis heureux d'avoir eu l'occasion d'apprendre à m'en servir.
The Price of Ingenuity#201.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#202.src: That is all, then. Who will go next?
The Price of Ingenuity#202.dst: Ce sera tout, alors. Qui passe ensuite?
The Price of Ingenuity#202.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#203.src: Lemme show you just what I can really do, man.
The Price of Ingenuity#203.dst: Laisse-moi te montrer ce que je sais vraiment faire, mec.
The Price of Ingenuity#203.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#204.src: Watch and learn, princess. Not every day you get to see me shred.
The Price of Ingenuity#204.dst: Regarde et apprends, princesse. C'est pas tous les jours que tu me vois envoyer du lourd.
The Price of Ingenuity#204.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#205.dst: Allez, c'est parti pour le rock!
The Price of Ingenuity#205.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#207.src: My Sonic Boomer can help out with defense too! I'm no one trick pony - I can cover every genre of combat!
The Price of Ingenuity#207.dst: Mon Bang Sonique aide aussi en défense! Je suis pas l'artiste d'un seul tube: je joue tous les styles de combat!
The Price of Ingenuity#207.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#208.src: And bam! That's it from me and Sonic Boomer for today.
The Price of Ingenuity#208.dst: Et bam! C'est tout pour aujourd'hui, de ma part et de celle du Bang Sonique.
The Price of Ingenuity#208.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#210.dst: Je suppose que c'est mon tour.
The Price of Ingenuity#210.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#211.src: I'll say, I'm not as... direct... as Yuman. But I can hold my own in a fight.
The Price of Ingenuity#211.dst: Je l'avoue, je ne suis pas aussi... direct... que Yuman. Mais je sais me défendre.
The Price of Ingenuity#211.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#213.src: I mean... yeah? Yusanu made this thing for me, and he calls it the Electric Blaster.
The Price of Ingenuity#213.dst: Euh... ben oui? C'est Yusanu qui me l'a fabriqué, il l'appelle le Blaster électrique.
The Price of Ingenuity#213.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#214.src: It's also able to fire a much larger blast with way more power, but that does make it less... precise.
The Price of Ingenuity#214.dst: Il peut aussi tirer une décharge bien plus grosse et puissante, mais ça le rend moins... précis.
The Price of Ingenuity#214.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#215.src: That's all from me. Next one!
The Price of Ingenuity#215.dst: C'est tout pour moi. Au suivant!
The Price of Ingenuity#215.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#216.src: Alrighty! Let's see... where to start...
The Price of Ingenuity#216.dst: C'est parti! Voyons... par où commencer...
The Price of Ingenuity#216.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#217.src: Oh, you have gotta be... again?! Really?! Ugh!
The Price of Ingenuity#217.dst: Oh, c'est pas vrai... encore?! Sérieux?! Pff!
The Price of Ingenuity#217.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#218.src: Yulie, Yuman, can you check the tunnels for any intruders?
The Price of Ingenuity#218.dst: Yulie, Yuman, vous pouvez vérifier les tunnels au cas où il y aurait des intrus?
The Price of Ingenuity#218.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#219.src: If you need us to. Keep us updated, would you?
The Price of Ingenuity#219.dst: Si tu as besoin de nous. Tiens-nous au courant, d'accord?
The Price of Ingenuity#219.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#220.src: Sure. Get the others to help you, I gotta run and check on things!
The Price of Ingenuity#220.dst: Bien sûr. Faites-vous aider par les autres, je dois filer vérifier un truc!
The Price of Ingenuity#220.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#221.src: Of course we can help, just tell us what to do!
The Price of Ingenuity#221.dst: Bien sûr que nous pouvons aider, dis-nous simplement quoi faire!
The Price of Ingenuity#221.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#222.src: {u} and I actually have some important tasks Syndra needed done!! Will you be okay without us?
The Price of Ingenuity#222.dst: {u} et moi, on a des tâches importantes que Syndra nous a confiées!! Vous vous en sortirez sans nous?
The Price of Ingenuity#222.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#223.src: We will. It shouldn't be too hard for us, anyway- just routine check ups.
The Price of Ingenuity#223.dst: Oui. Ça ne devrait pas être bien difficile pour nous, de toute façon- juste des vérifications de routine.
The Price of Ingenuity#223.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#224.src: Yep, yep! Alright guys, follow papa!
The Price of Ingenuity#224.dst: Ouais, ouais! Allez, les gars, suivez papa!
The Price of Ingenuity#224.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#225.src: Wh- what? Ugh... put some c- cl- clothes on, a- at- at least.
The Price of Ingenuity#225.dst: Q- quoi? Pff... mets au m- moins des v- vê- vêtements.
The Price of Ingenuity#225.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#229.src: I needed a way to get everyone else out of here so we could talk!
The Price of Ingenuity#229.dst: Il me fallait un moyen de faire sortir tout le monde pour qu'on puisse parler!
The Price of Ingenuity#229.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#230.src: Yeah, obviously! It was the best excuse I could come up with in the moment.
The Price of Ingenuity#230.dst: Ben oui, évidemment! C'était la meilleure excuse qui m'est venue sur le moment.
The Price of Ingenuity#230.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#231.src: So, look. Yusanu's been really hard to get a read of! He's barely ever around- I'm honestly surprised he even showed up today!
The Price of Ingenuity#231.dst: Bon, écoute. Yusanu est vraiment difficile à cerner! Il n'est presque jamais là- franchement, ça m'étonne qu'il soit venu aujourd'hui!
The Price of Ingenuity#231.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#232.src: But anyway, when you and Zeph headed out with Yuman during the last alarm, I wanted to check in with Yusanu and see what he was up to.
The Price of Ingenuity#232.dst: Bref, quand toi et Zeph êtes partis avec Yuman pendant la dernière alerte, j'ai voulu passer voir Yusanu pour savoir ce qu'il fabriquait.
The Price of Ingenuity#232.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#233.src: But guess what? He was gone! Walked into his workshop and never walked out. Isn't that weird?
The Price of Ingenuity#233.dst: Et devine quoi? Il avait disparu! Entré dans son atelier, jamais ressorti. C'est bizarre, non?
The Price of Ingenuity#233.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#234.src: I don't know what it means, and I don't know if he's a risk to us or not. But what I do know is that he's suspicious!
The Price of Ingenuity#234.dst: Je ne sais pas ce que ça veut dire, ni s'il représente un danger pour nous. Mais ce que je sais, c'est qu'il est louche!
The Price of Ingenuity#234.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#235.src: Because they'd all probably tell me not to do anything impulsive right now. Which isn't even true, I've thought this plan out extensively!
The Price of Ingenuity#235.dst: Parce qu'ils me diraient sûrement de ne rien faire d'impulsif en ce moment. Ce qui est même pas vrai, j'ai longuement réfléchi à ce plan!
The Price of Ingenuity#235.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#236.src: Come on, meet me outside his workshop! I just want to look. If it's nothing, then it's nothing! But I don't think it's nothing.
The Price of Ingenuity#236.dst: Allez, retrouve-moi devant son atelier! Je veux juste jeter un oeil. Si c'est rien, c'est rien! Mais je crois pas que ce soit rien.
The Price of Ingenuity#236.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#238.src: I'll meet up with you at the workshop.
The Price of Ingenuity#238.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#241.src: See? I told you! He's just... gone.
The Price of Ingenuity#241.dst: Tu vois? Je te l'avais dit! Il a juste... disparu.
The Price of Ingenuity#241.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#242.src: Not even a trace... Seems like I wasn't distrustful for nothing. But how?
The Price of Ingenuity#242.dst: Pas la moindre trace... On dirait que je ne me méfiais pas pour rien. Mais comment?
The Price of Ingenuity#242.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#243.src: He has to have gone somewhere! He couldn't have just... vanished.
The Price of Ingenuity#243.dst: Il a bien dû aller quelque part! Il ne peut pas s'être... volatilisé.
The Price of Ingenuity#243.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#244.src: There has to be something else going on here! Do you see why I suspect him now?
The Price of Ingenuity#244.dst: Il se passe forcément autre chose ici! Tu comprends pourquoi je le soupçonne, maintenant?
The Price of Ingenuity#244.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#245.src: Let's snoop around a bit and make sure he's not posing a threat to us.
The Price of Ingenuity#245.dst: Fouinons un peu et assurons-nous qu'il ne représente pas une menace pour nous.
The Price of Ingenuity#245.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#246.dst: Oui, il y a un truc qui cloche.

The Price of Ingenuity#247.src: I'm glad you feel that way. Makes me feel less... horrible... about it.
The Price of Ingenuity#247.dst: Je suis contente que tu le voies comme ça. Je me sens moins... horrible... de faire ça.
The Price of Ingenuity#247.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#248.src: I guess we can be horrible people together, then.
The Price of Ingenuity#248.dst: Alors on n'a qu'à être horribles ensemble.
The Price of Ingenuity#248.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#249.src: I get it, trust me. They've taken us in and given us a place to stay, and now...
The Price of Ingenuity#249.dst: Je comprends, crois-moi. Ils nous ont accueillis et donné un toit, et maintenant...
The Price of Ingenuity#249.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#250.src: If we're wrong, if I'm wrong, then we both might get thrown out.
The Price of Ingenuity#250.dst: Si on se trompe, si je me trompe, on risque de se faire mettre dehors tous les deux.
The Price of Ingenuity#250.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#251.src: The blame will land squarely on us both. I really hope that even if we are kicked out, the rest can still stay here...
The Price of Ingenuity#251.dst: On portera tout le blâme tous les deux. J'espère vraiment que, même si on nous chasse, les autres pourront rester...
The Price of Ingenuity#251.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#252.src: ...no time to dwell on that. He must have left the workshop through an exit somewhere. Let's look around and see what we can find.
The Price of Ingenuity#252.dst: ...pas le temps de ruminer. Il a dû quitter l'atelier par une sortie quelque part. Fouillons les lieux pour voir ce qu'on trouve.
The Price of Ingenuity#252.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#253.src: Try and find Yusanu in his workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#253.dst: Essayez de trouver Yusanu dans son atelier en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#254.src: Aha! And you thought I was just being paranoid.
The Price of Ingenuity#254.dst: Ah ha! Et toi qui pensais que j'étais juste paranoïaque.
The Price of Ingenuity#254.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#255.src: But you were thinking it, I could tell!
The Price of Ingenuity#255.dst: Mais tu le pensais, je l'ai bien vu!
The Price of Ingenuity#255.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#256.src: Okay, fine, maybe a little. But I was right to be!
The Price of Ingenuity#256.dst: Bon, d'accord, peut-être un peu. Mais j'avais raison de l'être!
The Price of Ingenuity#256.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#257.src: That's confirmation. Though, not like we needed it...
The Price of Ingenuity#257.dst: Voilà la confirmation. Même si on n'en avait pas vraiment besoin...
The Price of Ingenuity#257.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#260.src: Yusanu's really pulling out all the stops to make sure nobody follows him!
The Price of Ingenuity#260.dst: Yusanu ne recule devant rien pour que personne ne le suive!
The Price of Ingenuity#260.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#261.src: Too bad we're persistent, though. There's got to be some way to open it, we just need to find it!
The Price of Ingenuity#261.dst: Dommage pour lui, on est tenaces. Il doit y avoir un moyen de l'ouvrir, il suffit de le trouver!
The Price of Ingenuity#261.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#262.src: Whatever you did seems to have worked, the door's open!
The Price of Ingenuity#262.dst: Ce que tu as fait a l'air d'avoir marché, la porte est ouverte!
The Price of Ingenuity#262.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#264.src: Dead end? No, I see something on the other side...
The Price of Ingenuity#264.dst: Un cul-de-sac? Non, je vois quelque chose de l'autre côté...
The Price of Ingenuity#264.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#265.src: How do we get across? I guess you could try to use your magic... but I don't want you to put yourself at risk just cause I dragged you along for this.
The Price of Ingenuity#265.dst: Comment on traverse? Tu pourrais essayer ta magie... mais je ne veux pas que tu prennes des risques juste parce que je t'ai entraîné là-dedans.
The Price of Ingenuity#265.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#267.src: Oh! Yusanu has to have taken this way, there aren't any other options. So, there's a trick to it...
The Price of Ingenuity#267.dst: Oh! Yusanu a forcément pris ce chemin, il n'y a pas d'autre option. Donc, il y a une astuce...
The Price of Ingenuity#267.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#268.src: Look, over there! Do you see the button on the other side? I bet he uses it to close off this path whenever he takes it.
The Price of Ingenuity#268.dst: Regarde, là-bas! Tu vois le bouton de l'autre côté? Je parie qu'il s'en sert pour fermer ce passage chaque fois qu'il l'emprunte.
The Price of Ingenuity#268.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#269.src: It's a good thing you have the best sharpshooter in all of Fruma on your side! A shot like that is nothing to me.
The Price of Ingenuity#269.dst: Heureusement que tu as la meilleure tireuse d'élite de tout Fruma avec toi! Un tir comme ça, c'est rien pour moi.
The Price of Ingenuity#269.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#270.src: Just a moment... need to line it up... just right...
The Price of Ingenuity#270.dst: Un instant... il faut que je vise... pile comme il faut...
The Price of Ingenuity#270.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#271.src: Got it! Oh, that's more precarious than I expected. Be careful!
The Price of Ingenuity#271.dst: Touché! Oh, c'est plus instable que prévu. Fais attention!
The Price of Ingenuity#271.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#273.src: ...okay, why are we right outside the Sovereign's mansion?!
The Price of Ingenuity#273.dst: ...bon, pourquoi on est juste devant le manoir de la Souveraine?!
The Price of Ingenuity#273.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#274.src: This place is so heavily guarded, and he just has a secret tunnel directly to the front door?!
The Price of Ingenuity#274.dst: Cet endroit est hyper gardé, et lui, il a un tunnel secret qui mène droit à la porte d'entrée?!
The Price of Ingenuity#274.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#275.dst: Bon... bon, bon, bon. Du calme.
The Price of Ingenuity#275.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#276.src: We can't just leave it here, obviously, but we're definitely not getting through the front door...
The Price of Ingenuity#276.dst: On ne peut évidemment pas en rester là, mais on ne passera sûrement pas par la porte d'entrée...
The Price of Ingenuity#276.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#277.src: Look, up there. The arch connects to the main structure, and probably has a way inside.
The Price of Ingenuity#277.dst: Regarde, là-haut. L'arche rejoint le bâtiment principal, il y a sûrement un moyen d'entrer.
The Price of Ingenuity#277.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#278.src: Maybe we can get up by climbing up this building over here!
The Price of Ingenuity#278.dst: On pourrait peut-être monter en escaladant ce bâtiment-là!
The Price of Ingenuity#278.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#279.src: Travel up the nearby building at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and enter Soosu's mansion.
The Price of Ingenuity#279.dst: Montez sur le bâtiment voisin en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] et entrez dans le manoir de Soosu.

The Price of Ingenuity#280.src: Sneak through Soosu's mansion looking for Yusanu at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#280.dst: Faufilez-vous dans le manoir de Soosu à la recherche de Yusanu en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#281.src: ... Hey, stay on your guard. We don't want to get caught in here.
The Price of Ingenuity#281.dst: ... Hé, reste sur tes gardes. Il ne faut pas qu'on se fasse prendre ici.
The Price of Ingenuity#281.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#282.src: Though... it's kind of quiet in here. Weird.
The Price of Ingenuity#282.dst: Quoique... c'est plutôt calme ici. Bizarre.
The Price of Ingenuity#282.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#283.src: Okay. Okay okay. That's a lot of buttons.
The Price of Ingenuity#283.dst: Bon. Bon, bon. Ça fait beaucoup de boutons.
The Price of Ingenuity#283.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#284.src: So these two say up and down... over here it looks like a list...? Office, Workshop, Quarters, Workshop {~}, Roof Workshop... And why is there a lever? It's not even labeled.
The Price of Ingenuity#284.dst: Alors ces deux-là disent haut et bas... ici, on dirait une liste...? Bureau, Atelier, Quartiers, Atelier {~}, Atelier du toit... Et pourquoi il y a un levier? Il n'a même pas d'étiquette.
The Price of Ingenuity#284.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#285.src: Ugh, I can never figure out Roughworks machines. Always overly complicated...
The Price of Ingenuity#285.dst: Pff, je n'arrive jamais à comprendre les machines de Roughworks. Toujours trop compliquées...
The Price of Ingenuity#285.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#286.src: Well, what about you? Any thoughts?
The Price of Ingenuity#286.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#287.src: Okay. Sure! As good a suggestion as any.
The Price of Ingenuity#287.dst: D'accord. Pourquoi pas! Une suggestion qui en vaut une autre.
The Price of Ingenuity#287.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#288.src: ...so, which one of these is up?
The Price of Ingenuity#288.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#290.src: Okay. Thanks for the input. I'm... not going to do that! That sounds like an awful idea- has Zeph been rubbing off on you?
The Price of Ingenuity#290.dst: D'accord. Merci de ta contribution. Je... ne vais pas faire ça! Ça a l'air d'une idée affreuse- Zeph déteint sur toi ou quoi?
The Price of Ingenuity#290.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#291.src: And I thought one of him was bad enough...
The Price of Ingenuity#291.dst: Et moi qui pensais qu'un seul comme lui, c'était déjà trop...
The Price of Ingenuity#291.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#292.src: Oh, whatever! Let's just try something.
The Price of Ingenuity#292.dst: Oh, et puis zut! Essayons quelque chose.
The Price of Ingenuity#292.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#295.src: That was... I don't want to talk about it.
The Price of Ingenuity#295.dst: C'était... Je ne veux pas en parler.
The Price of Ingenuity#295.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#296.src: Wait! {u}, quietly, come look at this.
The Price of Ingenuity#296.dst: Attends! {u}, sans bruit, viens voir ça.
The Price of Ingenuity#296.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#297.src: Shoot, they're coming this way! Follow me!
The Price of Ingenuity#297.dst: Mince, ils viennent par ici! Suis-moi!
The Price of Ingenuity#297.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#299.src: Approximately {~} of the input fuel energy is lost as heat. This results in a poor overall performance.
The Price of Ingenuity#299.dst: Environ {~} de l'énergie du combustible est perdue sous forme de chaleur. Il en résulte un rendement global médiocre.

The Price of Ingenuity#304.src: N-O-O-O!!! Mother w-o-o-o-ould know what to do!
The Price of Ingenuity#304.speaker: Glitter

The Price of Ingenuity#306.src: Those "guards" don't seem very normal, do they? Isn't this supposed to be the Sovereign's mansion?
The Price of Ingenuity#306.dst: Ces "gardes" n'ont pas l'air très normaux, hein? C'est pas censé être le manoir de la Souveraine?
The Price of Ingenuity#306.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#307.src: They didn't even see us... oh, whatever. Let's keep moving.
The Price of Ingenuity#307.dst: Ils ne nous ont même pas vus... bah, peu importe. Continuons.
The Price of Ingenuity#307.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#309.src: Why did you call me here again so soon? I was just here yesterday.
The Price of Ingenuity#309.dst: Pourquoi tu m'as encore appelé si tôt? J'étais déjà là hier.
The Price of Ingenuity#309.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#310.src: Oh, don't play dumb! Dead soldiers! Killed on the job! Sound familiar??
The Price of Ingenuity#310.dst: Oh, ne fais pas l'innocent! Des soldats morts! Tués en service! Ça te dit quelque chose??
The Price of Ingenuity#310.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#312.src: Well, it better! Again - dead soldiers!! We had an agreement, Yus, and you've clearly gone and broken it!
The Price of Ingenuity#312.dst: Ça a intérêt! Je répète - des soldats morts!! On avait un accord, Yus, et tu l'as clairement rompu!
The Price of Ingenuity#312.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#313.src: I- I know. And I'm sorry that it happened. But- it happened while I was here, working! What do you expect me to have done about it?!
The Price of Ingenuity#313.dst: J- je sais. Et je suis désolé que ce soit arrivé. Mais- c'est arrivé pendant que j'étais ici, à travailler! Qu'est-ce que tu voulais que j'y fasse?!
The Price of Ingenuity#313.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#314.src: Hmph! You're smart, aren't you? Smart enough to be able to grasp the fundamentals of conductivity and electrical currents! You could have found a way.
The Price of Ingenuity#314.dst: Hmpf! Tu es intelligent, non? Assez intelligent pour saisir les principes de la conductivité et des courants électriques! Tu aurais pu trouver un moyen.
The Price of Ingenuity#314.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#315.src: It's such a shame... you were one of my favorites, Yus. And now you've really let me down.
The Price of Ingenuity#315.dst: C'est tellement dommage... tu étais l'un de mes préférés, Yus. Et là, tu m'as vraiment déçue.
The Price of Ingenuity#315.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#316.src: ...I know. I- I'll find a way to fix it. Tell me what to do, and- and I can. Whatever I need to- so I can keep them safe- I'll, I'll do it.
The Price of Ingenuity#316.dst: ...je sais. J- je trouverai un moyen d'arranger ça. Dis-moi quoi faire, et- et je le ferai. Tout ce qu'il faudra- pour les protéger- je, je le ferai.
The Price of Ingenuity#316.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#317.src: Oh, Yus, you're so silly. There's nothing you can do to fix this now. The damage is done, and nobody around here will shut! Up! About it!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#317.dst: Oh, Yus, que tu es bête. Tu ne peux plus rien faire pour arranger ça. Le mal est fait, et personne ici ne veut se! Taire! Là-dessus!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#317.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#318.src: I let you live in that abandoned trainyard because I thought you'd be quiet. But this isn't quiet! I can't focus now that everyone is-
The Price of Ingenuity#318.dst: Je t'ai laissé ce vieux dépôt de trains pour que tu restes discret. Mais là, c'est tout sauf discret! Je ne peux plus me concentrer, tout le monde-
The Price of Ingenuity#318.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#320.src: A GHO-O-O-OST! SPARKLES HEARD A GHO-O-O-O-OST! WHAT DO WE-E-E-E DO???
The Price of Ingenuity#320.dst: UN FANTÔ-Ô-Ô-ÔME! SPARKLES A ENTENDU UN FANTÔ-Ô-Ô-Ô-ÔME! QU'EST-CE QU'ON FA-A-A-AIT???
The Price of Ingenuity#320.speaker: Glitter

The Price of Ingenuity#321.src: Ugh! Not now!! Can't you see mommy's busy?!
The Price of Ingenuity#321.dst: Pff! Pas maintenant!! Vous ne voyez pas que maman est occupée?!
The Price of Ingenuity#321.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#322.dst: ...Oh. Je les aimais bien, ces deux-là...
The Price of Ingenuity#322.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#323.src: ...They'll be fine. I'll just bring them back later!
The Price of Ingenuity#323.dst: ...Ils s'en remettront. Je les ramènerai plus tard, voilà tout!
The Price of Ingenuity#323.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#324.src: You know, they've been getting better and better at replicating human behavior! My latest constructs were at an estimated {~} accuracy-
The Price of Ingenuity#324.dst: Tu sais, ils imitent de mieux en mieux le comportement humain! Mes dernières créations atteignaient une précision estimée de {~}-
The Price of Ingenuity#324.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#326.src: Right! Here's what you can do for me, Yus. This isn't going to go away. I need someone to pin this on, so they'll all shut up and move on from it!
The Price of Ingenuity#326.dst: Ah oui! Voilà ce que tu peux faire pour moi, Yus. Cette affaire ne va pas s'évaporer. Il me faut un coupable, pour qu'ils se taisent tous et passent à autre chose!
The Price of Ingenuity#326.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#327.src: Especially that loudmouth from the north! Would it kill him to leave me alone and stop meddling in my business??
The Price of Ingenuity#327.dst: Surtout cette grande gueule du nord! Ça le tuerait de me laisser tranquille et d'arrêter de se mêler de mes affaires??
The Price of Ingenuity#327.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#328.src: Don't answer that. Look, this is the only way. You need to hand over whoever is responsible for this whole thing. That's the only way we can keep our peace and keep being friends.
The Price of Ingenuity#328.dst: Ne réponds pas. Écoute, c'est la seule solution. Tu dois livrer le responsable de toute cette histoire. C'est le seul moyen de préserver la paix et de rester amis.
The Price of Ingenuity#328.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#329.src: Wh- you can't be serious! I can't do that, Soosu! You- you really expect me to give up one of my friends or family?!
The Price of Ingenuity#329.dst: Qu- tu plaisantes! Je ne peux pas, Soosu! Tu- tu veux vraiment que je livre un de mes amis ou un membre de ma famille?!
The Price of Ingenuity#329.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#330.src: No, Yus, what I expected from you was to keep your "friends and family" quiet! But we're past that point now. Something needs to happen.
The Price of Ingenuity#330.dst: Non, Yus, ce que j'attendais de toi, c'était que tu fasses taire tes "amis et ta famille"! Mais on n'en est plus là. Il faut que quelque chose se passe.
The Price of Ingenuity#330.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#331.src: I-... I understand. I need to think. I'll... I'll let you know soon.
The Price of Ingenuity#331.dst: Je-... je comprends. J'ai besoin de réfléchir. Je... je te tiendrai au courant bientôt.
The Price of Ingenuity#331.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#332.src: What is he doing?! Sneaking around, meeting with the Sovereign?!
The Price of Ingenuity#332.dst: Qu'est-ce qu'il fabrique?! Il se faufile en douce pour voir la Souveraine?!
The Price of Ingenuity#332.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#333.src: We need to cut him off. I'm not letting him get away with this. Follow me, quickly!
The Price of Ingenuity#333.dst: Il faut lui couper la route. Je ne vais pas le laisser s'en tirer comme ça. Suis-moi, vite!
The Price of Ingenuity#333.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#334.src: Come on! Let's see if we can cut him off before he enters the tunnel!
The Price of Ingenuity#334.dst: Allez! Voyons si on peut lui couper la route avant qu'il entre dans le tunnel!
The Price of Ingenuity#334.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#335.dst: Attendez le retour de Yusanu en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#336.src: Okay. This is as good a place as any to hide out and wait...
The Price of Ingenuity#336.dst: Bon. Cet endroit en vaut un autre pour se cacher et attendre...
The Price of Ingenuity#336.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#337.src: I can't believe this! I can't believe him! How long has he been doing this?
The Price of Ingenuity#337.dst: J'arrive pas à y croire! Venant de lui! Depuis combien de temps il fait ça?
The Price of Ingenuity#337.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#338.src: I... uh, I'll see you guys later, I... guess.
The Price of Ingenuity#338.dst: Je... euh, à plus tard, les gars, je... suppose.
The Price of Ingenuity#338.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#342.src: Not a word, Yusanu. You are in no position to be asking questions!
The Price of Ingenuity#342.dst: Pas un mot, Yusanu. Tu n'es pas en position de poser des questions!
The Price of Ingenuity#342.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#343.src: Secretly meeting with the Sovereign? Really? Are you insane?!
The Price of Ingenuity#343.dst: Des rencontres secrètes avec la Souveraine? Sérieusement? T'es fou?!
The Price of Ingenuity#343.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#344.src: You- you... followed me... oh, no... no no no, no... you weren't seen, were you? You're going to ruin ev-
The Price of Ingenuity#344.dst: Vous- vous... m'avez suivi... oh, non... non non non, non... personne ne vous a vus, hein? Vous allez tout gâch-
The Price of Ingenuity#344.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#345.src: We're going to ruin everything?! And not you, the guy always sneaking off to meet the Sovereign?!
The Price of Ingenuity#345.dst: C'est NOUS qui allons tout gâcher?! Et pas toi, le type qui file en douce voir la Souveraine?!
The Price of Ingenuity#345.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#346.src: You don't understand! The only reason we're safe down there is BECAUSE I struck a deal with her!!
The Price of Ingenuity#346.dst: Vous ne comprenez pas! Si on est en sécurité là-dessous, c'est PARCE QUE j'ai passé un marché avec elle!!
The Price of Ingenuity#346.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#348.src: I work as her assistant in her workshop, help her with whatever projects she's working on, and in exchange she allows us to live in the station!
The Price of Ingenuity#348.dst: Je travaille comme assistant dans son atelier, je l'aide sur ses projets en cours, et en échange elle nous laisse vivre dans la station!
The Price of Ingenuity#348.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#349.src: As long as we don't cause any trouble with soldiers, at least- which, might I remind you, you people caused? So don't- don't act like...
The Price of Ingenuity#349.dst: Tant qu'on ne cause pas d'ennuis aux soldats, du moins- ce que, je vous le rappelle, vous avez fait, vous? Alors ne- ne faites pas comme si...
The Price of Ingenuity#349.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#350.src: Oh my god, you idiot. How long were you planning to keep this a secret? Were you ever going to tell anyone?
The Price of Ingenuity#350.dst: Mon Dieu, espèce d'idiot. Combien de temps tu comptais garder ça secret? Tu comptais le dire à quelqu'un, un jour?
The Price of Ingenuity#350.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#351.src: You were just gonna let it sit until, inevitably , someone was going to piss off the soldiers? Because, trust me, that would have happened eventually. With or without us.
The Price of Ingenuity#351.dst: Tu allais laisser traîner jusqu'à ce que, inévitablement,quelqu'un mette les soldats en rogne? Parce que, crois-moi, ça serait arrivé tôt ou tard. Avec ou sans nous.
The Price of Ingenuity#351.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#352.src: Status: On Hold. She needs my attention elsewhere.
The Price of Ingenuity#352.dst: Statut: En pause. Elle a besoin de moi ailleurs.

The Price of Ingenuity#354.src: Ack! You- you heard that part too?
The Price of Ingenuity#354.dst: Aïe! Vous- vous avez entendu ça aussi?
The Price of Ingenuity#354.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#356.src: Ughhh.... I don't know! I don't know. I don't want to, obviously! You're all good people, and it'd break every single one of our guidelines to throw someone out like that!
The Price of Ingenuity#356.dst: Rhhh.... Je ne sais pas! Je ne sais pas. Je ne veux pas, évidemment! Vous êtes tous des gens bien, et livrer quelqu'un comme ça violerait toutes nos règles!
The Price of Ingenuity#356.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#357.src: But... I don't think I have a choice. The Steel Feather's safety is on the line, and I could fix it by just- just- handing someone over, but- I- I can't. I can't do that.
The Price of Ingenuity#357.dst: Mais... je crois que je n'ai pas le choix. La sécurité de la Plume d'acier est en jeu, et je pourrais tout régler en- en- livrant quelqu'un, mais- je- je ne peux pas. Je ne peux pas faire ça.
The Price of Ingenuity#357.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#358.src: Okay. You were doing what you thought was right. I can understand that. But this - keeping secrets, following their rules - it was never going to end well!
The Price of Ingenuity#358.dst: D'accord. Tu faisais ce qui te semblait juste. Je peux le comprendre. Mais ça - garder des secrets, suivre leurs règles - ça ne pouvait que mal finir!
The Price of Ingenuity#358.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#359.src: We can get past this choice by doing what we were already doing - trying to take down the crown! If we succeed, there won't be any more risk for you all.
The Price of Ingenuity#359.dst: On peut éviter ce choix en faisant ce qu'on faisait déjà - essayer de renverser la Couronne! Si on réussit, vous ne courrez plus aucun risque.
The Price of Ingenuity#359.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#361.src: This is your chance to make it right, Yusanu! You have information. Tell us what you and the Sovereign were working on. Is it important?
The Price of Ingenuity#361.dst: C'est ta chance de te racheter, Yusanu! Tu as des informations. Dis-nous sur quoi vous travailliez, toi et la Souveraine. C'est important?
The Price of Ingenuity#361.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#362.src: ...I don't know much about... what it is. I know it's not a weapon, at least- Soosu was clear on that. It's... an important assignment from the Queen.
The Price of Ingenuity#362.dst: ...je ne sais pas grand-chose sur... ce que c'est. Ce n'est pas une arme, au moins- Soosu a été claire. C'est... une mission importante de la Reine.
The Price of Ingenuity#362.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#363.src: It's- it's strange. Very, very strange. It uses science that sounds... impossible. I think we're building over an existing device, something the Queen already had.
The Price of Ingenuity#363.dst: C'est- c'est étrange. Très, très étrange. Ça repose sur une science qui semble... impossible. Je crois qu'on construit sur un appareil que la Reine possédait déjà.
The Price of Ingenuity#363.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#364.src: Soosu... she's stressed about the project. She needs to get it done, but it- it seems like an impossible task. There's something on the line for her.
The Price of Ingenuity#364.dst: Soosu... ce projet la stresse. Elle doit le terminer, mais ça- ça semble impossible. Elle a quelque chose en jeu.
The Price of Ingenuity#364.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#365.src: ...mysterious device, important to the crown... got it. {u}, Yusanu- we need to steal it. If it's important to the crown... whatever it does, it's better if they don't have it.
The Price of Ingenuity#365.dst: ...appareil mystérieux, important pour la Couronne... compris. {u}, Yusanu- il faut le voler. S'il est important pour la Couronne... quoi qu'il fasse, mieux vaut qu'elle ne l'ait pas.
The Price of Ingenuity#365.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#366.src: Wh- what?! You can't be serious! We can't just-
The Price of Ingenuity#366.dst: Q- quoi?! Tu ne peux pas être sérieuse! On ne peut pas juste-
The Price of Ingenuity#366.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#367.src: We can, and we should! The Sovereigns aren't your friends, Yusanu, they're complicit in and responsible for everything wrong with Fruma!!
The Price of Ingenuity#367.dst: On peut, et on doit! Les Souverains ne sont pas tes amis, Yusanu, ils sont complices et responsables de tout ce qui va mal à Fruma!!
The Price of Ingenuity#367.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#368.src: If we can hurt them, then we can hurt the crown. And if we can hurt the crown... we might actually stand a chance.
The Price of Ingenuity#368.dst: Si on peut leur nuire, on peut nuire à la Couronne. Et si on peut nuire à la Couronne... on a peut-être vraiment une chance.
The Price of Ingenuity#368.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#369.src: ...okay. Okay, fine! You're right. You're... right.
The Price of Ingenuity#369.dst: ...d'accord. D'accord, très bien! Tu as raison. Tu as... raison.
The Price of Ingenuity#369.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#370.src: I can get you to it. Uh... how did you get in, anyway?
The Price of Ingenuity#370.dst: Je peux vous y conduire. Euh... au fait, comment vous êtes entrés?
The Price of Ingenuity#370.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#371.src: We'll show you. Come on, back in we go.
The Price of Ingenuity#371.dst: On va te montrer. Allez, on y retourne.
The Price of Ingenuity#371.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#372.dst: Entrez à nouveau dans le manoir en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#373.dst: ...ça a intérêt à valoir le coup.
The Price of Ingenuity#373.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#374.dst: Suivez Yusanu jusqu'à l'atelier de Soosu.

The Price of Ingenuity#375.src: Right, we'll need to be fast. Soosu tends to spend most of her time in the workshops...
The Price of Ingenuity#375.dst: Bon, il va falloir faire vite. Soosu passe le plus clair de son temps dans les ateliers...
The Price of Ingenuity#375.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#377.src: I... would probably be fine. But if she sees you two, then...
The Price of Ingenuity#377.dst: Moi... ça irait sans doute. Mais si elle vous voit, vous deux, alors...
The Price of Ingenuity#377.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#378.src: So don't get caught, got it. I'm guessing we wouldn't stand a chance fighting her?
The Price of Ingenuity#378.dst: Donc on ne se fait pas prendre, compris. J'imagine qu'on n'aurait aucune chance contre elle?
The Price of Ingenuity#378.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#379.src: No!! No, no, absolutely not. Her blessing... I haven't seen her use it in combat, but knowing what it can do...
The Price of Ingenuity#379.dst: Non!! Non, non, absolument pas. Sa bénédiction... je ne l'ai jamais vue s'en servir au combat, mais vu ce qu'elle permet...
The Price of Ingenuity#379.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#380.src: Being able to mold matter... it means more than just putting together machines. So...
The Price of Ingenuity#380.dst: Pouvoir modeler la matière... ça va bien au-delà d'assembler des machines. Alors...
The Price of Ingenuity#380.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#381.src: It won't come to that. Come on, let's get going.
The Price of Ingenuity#381.dst: On n'en arrivera pas là. Allez, en route.
The Price of Ingenuity#381.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#382.src: The door to the workshop has already been unlocked...
The Price of Ingenuity#382.dst: La porte de l'atelier est déjà déverrouillée...

The Price of Ingenuity#385.dst: Module de déplacement quantique - Notes de recherche

The Price of Ingenuity#386.src: Alright, before we descend - Soosu has a bunch of golems walking around her workshop.
The Price of Ingenuity#386.dst: Bon, avant de descendre - Soosu a tout un tas de golems qui patrouillent dans son atelier.
The Price of Ingenuity#386.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#387.src: They're more... uh, advanced than Sparkles and Glitter. If they see us, they'll sound the alarms. So don't get caught!
The Price of Ingenuity#387.dst: Ils sont plus... euh, perfectionnés que Sparkles et Glitter. S'ils nous voient, ils donneront l'alerte. Alors ne vous faites pas prendre!
The Price of Ingenuity#387.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#388.src: How did you two even manage to find me?
The Price of Ingenuity#388.dst: Comment vous avez fait pour me trouver, d'ailleurs?
The Price of Ingenuity#388.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#389.src: Really? I'm... surprised the system held together long enough for that.
The Price of Ingenuity#389.dst: Vraiment? Je suis... étonné que le système ait tenu le coup assez longtemps.
The Price of Ingenuity#389.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#390.src: Look, it's not our fault this... thing doesn't come with an instruction manual!
The Price of Ingenuity#390.dst: Écoute, c'est pas notre faute si ce... truc n'a pas de mode d'emploi!
The Price of Ingenuity#390.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#391.src: Ha! Okay, it's a little hard to figure out. You have to pick the destination, then hit up or down, and then pull the lever to turn it on! Simple.
The Price of Ingenuity#391.dst: Ha! D'accord, c'est un peu dur à comprendre. Il faut choisir la destination, appuyer sur haut ou bas, puis tirer le levier pour l'allumer! Simple.
The Price of Ingenuity#391.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#392.src: That... sounds right, but the way you say that is concerning. What actually happened?
The Price of Ingenuity#392.dst: Ça... semble juste, mais ta façon de le dire m'inquiète. Que s'est-il vraiment passé?
The Price of Ingenuity#392.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#393.src: Ugh, it doesn't matter what happened. What matters is this stupid box is overly complicated and annoying!
The Price of Ingenuity#393.dst: Pff, peu importe ce qui s'est passé. Ce qui compte, c'est que cette boîte idiote est trop compliquée et agaçante!
The Price of Ingenuity#393.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#394.src: Okay, okay! It is... a little hard to figure out. You have to pick the destination, then hit up or down, and then pull the lever to turn it on! Simple.
The Price of Ingenuity#394.dst: D'accord, d'accord! C'est... un peu dur à comprendre. Il faut choisir la destination, appuyer sur haut ou bas, puis tirer le levier pour l'allumer! Simple.
The Price of Ingenuity#394.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#395.src: ...I chose the music, by the way.
The Price of Ingenuity#395.dst: ...c'est moi qui ai choisi la musique, au fait.
The Price of Ingenuity#395.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#397.src: Oh... I forgot how much of a mess it was down here.
The Price of Ingenuity#397.dst: Oh... j'avais oublié quel bazar c'était, ici en bas.
The Price of Ingenuity#397.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#398.src: Sneak through the mansion avoiding the guards.
The Price of Ingenuity#398.dst: Faufilez-vous dans le manoir en évitant les gardes.

The Price of Ingenuity#399.src: Alright! That's our goal, over there.
The Price of Ingenuity#399.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#400.src: It's the most important sector of Soosu's workshop.
The Price of Ingenuity#400.dst: C'est le secteur le plus important de l'atelier de Soosu.
The Price of Ingenuity#400.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#401.src: Look around Soosu's workshop for the device.
The Price of Ingenuity#401.dst: Cherchez l'appareil dans l'atelier de Soosu.

The Price of Ingenuity#402.src: And you're sure she won't be coming down here?
The Price of Ingenuity#402.dst: Et tu es sûr qu'elle ne descendra pas ici?
The Price of Ingenuity#402.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#403.src: Uh... mostly. {~} sure. We should be fine today, if we move quickly.
The Price of Ingenuity#403.dst: Euh... à peu près. Sûr à {~}. Ça devrait aller aujourd'hui, si on fait vite.
The Price of Ingenuity#403.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#405.src: The festival's coming up, so she has a lot to handle. She'll be busy cleaning up the other workshops, building whatever contraptions she needs for this year's festival... that sort of stuff.
The Price of Ingenuity#405.dst: Le festival approche, elle a beaucoup à gérer. Elle sera occupée à ranger les autres ateliers, à construire les engins dont elle a besoin pour le festival de cette année... ce genre de choses.
The Price of Ingenuity#405.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#406.src: She only comes down here for the big projects. Well, or when she needs to let out some steam. But she doesn't have anything going on today, so... we're safe.
The Price of Ingenuity#406.dst: Elle ne descend ici que pour les grands projets. Enfin, ou quand elle a besoin de se défouler. Mais elle n'a rien de prévu aujourd'hui, alors... on ne risque rien.
The Price of Ingenuity#406.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#407.src: ...if you say so, Yusanu. Still, I'd rather be out of here quickly.
The Price of Ingenuity#407.dst: ...si tu le dis, Yusanu. Je préfère quand même filer d'ici au plus vite.
The Price of Ingenuity#407.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#408.src: Yeah... same. Let's take the device and go.
The Price of Ingenuity#408.dst: Ouais... moi aussi. Prenons l'appareil et partons.
The Price of Ingenuity#408.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#409.src: This is Soosu's favorite room in the workshop. Her golem creation room.
The Price of Ingenuity#409.dst: C'est la pièce préférée de Soosu dans l'atelier. Sa salle de création de golems.
The Price of Ingenuity#409.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#410.src: She... told me once that she likes working with plants. It's why a lot of her golems are built off of flower pots and soil.
The Price of Ingenuity#410.dst: Elle... m'a dit un jour qu'elle aimait travailler avec les plantes. D'où tous ces golems faits de pots de fleurs et de terreau.
The Price of Ingenuity#410.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#411.src: Hm. Well, good thing she's using her blessing on this, and not... I don't know. Reshaping the whole world?
The Price of Ingenuity#411.dst: Hm. Eh bien, heureusement qu'elle utilise sa bénédiction pour ça, et pas pour... je ne sais pas. Remodeler le monde entier?
The Price of Ingenuity#411.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#412.src: A-another golem? Should we turn back?
The Price of Ingenuity#412.dst: U-un autre golem? On fait demi-tour?
The Price of Ingenuity#412.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#413.src: Oh, hey, it's Flowers! That's Soosu's favourite golem! Wonder why he's sleeping here and not on his Flowersbed, though. ... I wasn't the one that named that.
The Price of Ingenuity#413.dst: Oh, tiens, c'est Flowers! Le golem préféré de Soosu! Je me demande pourquoi il dort ici et pas dans son lit-parterre, par contre. ... C'est pas moi qui ai trouvé ce nom.
The Price of Ingenuity#413.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#414.src: Finally!!! He said yes!!! Uncle T finally let me visit his workshop, I'm so excited!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#414.dst: Enfin!!! Il a dit oui!!! Tonton T me laisse enfin visiter son atelier, je suis trop contente!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#414.speaker: 125 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#415.src: He's real!! Flowers is REAL NOW!!!! I showed Ma my drawing, and she helped me sew him together!! Now I can match with Fiona! She has Daruma, and I have... Flowers!
The Price of Ingenuity#415.dst: Il est vrai!! Flowers est VRAI MAINTENANT!!!! J'ai montré mon dessin à maman, et elle m'a aidée à le coudre!! Maintenant je suis assortie avec Fiona! Elle a Daruma, et moi j'ai... Flowers!
The Price of Ingenuity#415.speaker: 125 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#416.src: Hmph. Hmph!!!!!!! Fiona's old enough now, she's gotta work too... she's always so tired now, she won't play with me anymore!!!! This sucks. This sucks!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#416.dst: Hmpf. Hmpf!!!!!!! Fiona est assez grande maintenant, elle doit travailler aussi... elle est toujours si fatiguée, elle veut plus jouer avec moi!!!! C'est nul. C'est trop nul!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#416.speaker: 126 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#417.src: Uncle T agreed to help me make the super ultra cow milker o-matic!!
The Price of Ingenuity#417.dst: Tonton T a accepté de m'aider à fabriquer la super-ultra-trayeuse-o-matic!!
The Price of Ingenuity#417.speaker: 126 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#419.src: Grrrrrr............ I haven't written in AGES......... and it's because I gotta WORK!!!! In the FIELDS!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#419.dst: Grrrrrr............ J'ai pas écrit depuis DES SIÈCLES......... et c'est parce que je dois TRAVAILLER!!!! Dans les CHAMPS!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#419.speaker: 127 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#420.src: I've been READING!! Reading so so many books... about FARMING!
The Price of Ingenuity#420.dst: J'ai LU!! Lu plein plein de livres... sur l'AGRICULTURE!
The Price of Ingenuity#420.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#421.src: It's that time of year again!! The FESTIVAL OF THE CROWN!!! Just a week away!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#421.dst: C'est de nouveau cette période de l'année!! Le FESTIVAL DE LA COURONNE!!! Plus qu'une semaine!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#421.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#422.src: Weird thing happened today. Uncle T came home with a strange man from the military, big ol fancy uniform and all!
The Price of Ingenuity#422.dst: Truc bizarre aujourd'hui. Tonton T est rentré avec un drôle de monsieur de l'armée, grand uniforme chic et tout!
The Price of Ingenuity#422.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#423.src: It turns out, the Crown really liked my super duper farmer!! Cause it makes it easier to harvest crops and stuff, they want us to make more of them, so everyone can do their work faster!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#423.dst: En fait, la Couronne a vraiment aimé mon super-méga-fermier!! Comme il aide à récolter et tout ça, ils veulent qu'on en fabrique d'autres, pour que tout le monde travaille plus vite!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#423.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#424.src: Ugh...... ughhhhhhhh......... UGHHHHHHH...... I'm so TIRED!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#424.dst: Pff...... pfffffff......... PFFFFFFF...... Je suis trop FATIGUÉE!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#424.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#425.src: Uncle T got really hurt today. Really, really, really hurt.
The Price of Ingenuity#425.dst: Tonton T s'est fait très mal aujourd'hui. Très, très, très mal.
The Price of Ingenuity#425.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#426.src: Ma says Uncle T's gonna be okay. He will.
The Price of Ingenuity#426.dst: Maman dit que Tonton T va s'en remettre. Il va s'en remettre.
The Price of Ingenuity#426.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#427.dst: En fait, les délais, c'est peut-être facile?
The Price of Ingenuity#427.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#428.dst: OK. Il se passe des GRANDES choses!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#428.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#429.src: The Citadel was AWESOME!!! I've always dreamed of going up there, someday... and now I HAVE!!
The Price of Ingenuity#429.dst: La Citadelle, c'était GÉNIAL!!! J'ai toujours rêvé d'y monter un jour... et maintenant J'Y SUIS ALLÉE!!
The Price of Ingenuity#429.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#430.src: Work on project E-lec-tricity is ongoing (yes, the name changed... the Sovereign didn't like what I called it before...... bleh.), and it's going really well!!
The Price of Ingenuity#430.dst: Le projet É-lec-tricité avance (oui, le nom a changé... le Souverain n'aimait pas celui que j'avais choisi...... beurk.), et ça se passe super bien!!
The Price of Ingenuity#430.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#431.src: OKAY!!! DO NOT PANIC!!!! BUT THINGS! ARE! HAPPENING!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#431.dst: OKAY!!! PAS DE PANIQUE!!!! MAIS IL! SE! PASSE! DES CHOSES!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#431.speaker: 130 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#433.src: Looking back at these entries, I... I feel hollow.
The Price of Ingenuity#433.dst: En relisant ces pages, je... je me sens vide.
The Price of Ingenuity#433.speaker: 3 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#434.src: Mother passed away from her illness, a few days ago. They knew it was coming for a while, apparently, but... it was still a shock.
The Price of Ingenuity#434.dst: Mère est morte de sa maladie, il y a quelques jours. Ils le savaient depuis un moment, apparemment, mais... ça a quand même été un choc.
The Price of Ingenuity#434.speaker: 4 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#435.src: What's the point in writing these, anymore? I don't know what to say. I could talk about my projects, about all the progress I've been making, but it all feels so hollow.
The Price of Ingenuity#435.dst: A quoi bon écrire tout ça, désormais? Je ne sais pas quoi dire. Je pourrais parler de mes projets, de tous mes progrès, mais tout semble si creux.
The Price of Ingenuity#435.speaker: 10 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#436.src: How many years has it been? I can check the dates, but... I don't want to.
The Price of Ingenuity#436.dst: Combien d'années se sont écoulées? Je peux vérifier les dates, mais... je ne veux pas.
The Price of Ingenuity#436.speaker: 40 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#437.src: Never forget, never stop creating, never give in!
The Price of Ingenuity#437.dst: Ne jamais oublier, ne jamais cesser de créer, ne jamais céder!
The Price of Ingenuity#437.speaker: 45 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#438.src: And there it is... looking at it like this, it really is impressive.
The Price of Ingenuity#438.dst: Et le voilà... vu comme ça, c'est vraiment impressionnant.
The Price of Ingenuity#438.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#439.src: Again, you really don't know what this is for? And more importantly, which of us will carry it out?
The Price of Ingenuity#439.dst: Je répète: tu ne sais vraiment pas à quoi ça sert? Et surtout, lequel de nous va le porter?
The Price of Ingenuity#439.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#440.src: I'd say until we're in the clear, {u} should carry it. And no... I really, absolutely do not. Every time I've asked Soosu to elaborate, she's just blown me off.
The Price of Ingenuity#440.dst: Je dirais que {u} le porte jusqu'à ce qu'on soit tirés d'affaire. Et non... je n'en ai absolument aucune idée. Chaque fois que j'ai demandé à Soosu, elle m'a envoyé promener.
The Price of Ingenuity#440.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#441.src: Well. Whatever this is, it can't be any good if the Crown wants it. {u}, are you ready?
The Price of Ingenuity#441.dst: Bon. Quoi que ce soit, ça ne peut rien avoir de bon si la Couronne le veut. {u}, tu es prêt?
The Price of Ingenuity#441.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#442.src: Wait. Do you also hear that sound? Are those footsteps?
The Price of Ingenuity#442.dst: Attendez. Vous entendez ce bruit, vous aussi? C'est des pas?
The Price of Ingenuity#442.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#443.src: Can't be anything else - and there's two pairs of them. So Soosu is here, but with whom...?
The Price of Ingenuity#443.dst: Ça ne peut être que ça - et il y en a deux paires. Donc Soosu est là, mais avec qui...?
The Price of Ingenuity#443.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#444.src: ...are you sure this is the best idea? Dividing your attention between the discussion, and your...projects... It hasn't worked out in the past.
The Price of Ingenuity#444.dst: ...tu es sûre que c'est la meilleure idée? Partager ton attention entre la discussion et tes... projets... Ça n'a jamais bien fonctionné.
The Price of Ingenuity#444.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#445.src: Well, you know, Zhiraok, not eeeveryone seems to have the time to drop everything and leave their region. Sometimes, we have a job to do.
The Price of Ingenuity#445.dst: Eh bien, tu sais, Zhiraok, tout le mooonde n'a pas le temps de tout lâcher pour quitter sa région. Parfois, on a un travail à faire.
The Price of Ingenuity#445.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#446.src: Ah, there you are, Flowers! Wakey wakey, sleepyhead - you've got some guarding to get back to!
The Price of Ingenuity#446.dst: Ah, te voilà, Flowers! Debout, gros dormeur - tu as une garde à reprendre!
The Price of Ingenuity#446.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#448.src: Awareness, Soosu! A bit of warning before you stop like that?
The Price of Ingenuity#448.dst: Vigilance, Soosu! Un petit avertissement avant de t'arrêter comme ça?
The Price of Ingenuity#448.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#449.src: Hm? Ah, sorry, sorry, but an unexpected run-in with a close friend is just sooo nice! Surely there's space somewhere in your mind to know that, hmm?
The Price of Ingenuity#449.dst: Hm? Ah, pardon, pardon, mais tomber à l'improviste sur un ami proche, c'est teeellement agréable! Il doit bien y avoir une place dans ta tête pour savoir ça, hmm?
The Price of Ingenuity#449.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#450.src: Soosu... This is a solved problem! How many times have I told you that? ...Alright, look, that's a tangent. What I really need to tell you-
The Price of Ingenuity#450.dst: Soosu... C'est un problème résolu! Combien de fois devrai-je te le dire? ...Bon, écoute, je pars sur une tangente. Ce que je dois vraiment te dire-
The Price of Ingenuity#450.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#451.src: Escape the workshop without being spotted.
The Price of Ingenuity#451.dst: Échappez-vous de l'atelier sans vous faire repérer.

The Price of Ingenuity#452.src: Soosu's here? And with Zhiraok, of all people?! We have to get out, now!
The Price of Ingenuity#452.dst: Soosu est là? Et avec Zhiraok, rien que ça?! Il faut sortir, tout de suite!
The Price of Ingenuity#452.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#453.src: Yeah, but I bet Soosu's got Flowers on high alert! Don't use your magic, and whatever you do, don't get spotted!
The Price of Ingenuity#453.dst: Ouais, mais Soosu a sûrement mis Flowers en alerte maximale! Pas de magie et, quoi qu'il arrive, ne te fais pas repérer!
The Price of Ingenuity#453.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#454.src: Wait- What's that, Flowers? Intruders?! Right by the device room?!
The Price of Ingenuity#454.dst: Attends- Qu'est-ce que tu dis, Flowers? Des intrus?! Juste à côté de la salle de l'appareil?!
The Price of Ingenuity#454.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#455.src: ...!! The Cursed!! You're not laying one digit on her, you hear me?!
The Price of Ingenuity#455.dst: ...!! Le maudit!! Tu ne la toucheras pas, pas même d'une décimale, tu m'entends?!
The Price of Ingenuity#455.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#456.src: Wh-what the helix- Infiltrators! You aren't getting away this time!
The Price of Ingenuity#456.dst: Qu-quoi, nom d'une hélice- Des infiltrés! Vous ne vous échapperez pas cette fois!
The Price of Ingenuity#456.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#457.src: Yusanu?! Who is that with you? Wait, are you trying to steal the device?!
The Price of Ingenuity#457.dst: Yusanu?! Qui est avec toi? Attends, vous essayez de voler l'appareil?!
