The Worm Holes#073.src: You would wound and consume everything in your rage? Even knowing the consequences?
The Worm Holes#073.dst: Tu blesserais et dévorerais tout dans ta rage? Même en connaissant les conséquences?
The Worm Holes#073.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#074.src: Your hunger cannot be sated with this fruitless destruction! I beg of you, let them out!
The Worm Holes#074.dst: Cette destruction vaine n'apaisera pas ta faim! Je t'en supplie, laisse-les sortir!
The Worm Holes#074.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#075.src: You know th- W-wait...where did you... AAAH!
The Worm Holes#075.dst: Tu sais qu- A-attends... d'où est-ce que tu... AAAH!
The Worm Holes#075.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#076.src: I tried...w-why does no one listen to me? Why won't a-anything change for me?
The Worm Holes#076.dst: J'ai essayé... p-pourquoi personne ne m'écoute? Pourquoi rien ne c-change jamais pour moi?
The Worm Holes#076.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#077.src: She...she's been eating dark parasites. They're wracking her insides and h-hurting her head...
The Worm Holes#077.dst: Elle... elle a mangé des parasites obscurs. Ils lui ravagent les entrailles et lui f-font mal à la tête...
The Worm Holes#077.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#078.src: I...i-it's so d-dark... I c-can't breathe... This...th-this can't be the end...
The Worm Holes#078.dst: Je... t-tout est si s-sombre... Je ne p-peux plus respirer... Ce n-ne peut pas être la fin...
The Worm Holes#078.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#079.src: I...n-no, I can't die in here... I-I'm needed still... You're n-needed still! I... I...
The Worm Holes#079.dst: Je... n-non, je ne peux pas mourir ici... On a b-besoin de moi... On a b-besoin de toi! Je... Je...
The Worm Holes#079.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#080.src: I n-need... Or... O-Or... C-Concentrate, Lari... You can do this...
The Worm Holes#080.dst: J'ai b-besoin... Ou... O-Ou... C-concentre-toi, Lari... Tu peux y arriver...
The Worm Holes#080.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#082.src: LET US OUT! LET US OUT OF HERE! DON'T LET US DIE LIKE THIS! I'M BEGGING YOU, PLEASE!!
The Worm Holes#082.dst: LAISSE-NOUS SORTIR! LAISSE-NOUS SORTIR D'ICI! NE NOUS LAISSE PAS MOURIR COMME ÇA! JE T'EN SUPPLIE!!
The Worm Holes#082.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#083.src: ...I...oh no... It's...d-d... I... I j-just... I just w-wanted out... Ohhh...n-no...
The Worm Holes#083.dst: ...Je... oh non... Elle est... m-m... Je v-voulais juste... juste s-sortir... Ohhh... n-non...
The Worm Holes#083.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#084.src: ...w-we're...leaving. I...I c-can't look at this any more...
The Worm Holes#084.dst: ...n-nous... partons. Je... je ne p-peux plus regarder ça...
The Worm Holes#084.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#086.src: I'm...I'm so sorry, {u}. If I'd...I don't... I don't even know what else I could have d-done...
The Worm Holes#086.dst: Je suis... tellement désolée, {u}. Si j'avais... je ne... Je ne sais même pas ce que j'aurais pu f-faire...
The Worm Holes#086.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#087.src: There...it didn’t feel like there was...anything left to it... But, if I’d just been quicker, then... Would it...would it even have made a difference?
The Worm Holes#087.dst: Là-bas... on aurait dit qu'il ne restait... plus rien d'elle... Mais si j'avais été plus rapide... Est-ce que... est-ce que ça aurait changé quoi que ce soit?
The Worm Holes#087.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#088.src: ...some savior I am... I need to be better, but what else even is there that...ugh, I'm going in circles...
The Worm Holes#088.dst: ...belle sauveuse que je fais... Je dois faire mieux, mais que reste-t-il qui... pff, je tourne en rond...
The Worm Holes#088.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#090.src: ...I...I can't believe this. This is...does destiny just hate me? What have I done to deserve this?!
The Worm Holes#090.dst: ...Je... je n'arrive pas à y croire. C'est... le destin me déteste-t-il? Qu'ai-je fait pour mériter ça?!
The Worm Holes#090.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#091.src: The Mother Wyrm laid eggs... Eggs infested with parasites! Every single one is going to be born berserk!!
The Worm Holes#091.dst: La mère Wyrm avait pondu des oeufs... Des oeufs infestés de parasites! Ils vont tous naître enragés!!
The Worm Holes#091.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#092.src: You saw how strong the mother was...an infestation like this could cause the entire region of Gavel to collapse in a quake...
The Worm Holes#092.dst: Tu as vu la force de la mère... une infestation pareille pourrait faire s'effondrer toute la région de Gavel dans un séisme...
The Worm Holes#092.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#093.src: They...they need to be stopped, but...I can't do it. I c-can't kill... I'm sorry, I just can't!
The Worm Holes#093.dst: Il... il faut les arrêter, mais... je ne peux pas. Je n-ne peux pas tuer... Pardon, je ne peux pas!
The Worm Holes#093.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#094.src: Bring a group... Even Whelps can be a terror if they're enraged. Just...p-please, take care of this quickly.
The Worm Holes#094.dst: Viens en groupe... Même les petits peuvent être terribles s'ils sont enragés. Je t'en p-prie, règle ça vite.
The Worm Holes#094.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#095.src: You deserve the best... But that's more than I can give...so here. Take these. I'll move along.
The Worm Holes#095.dst: Tu mérites le meilleur... Mais je ne peux pas te l'offrir... alors tiens. Prends ça. Je m'en vais.
The Worm Holes#095.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#096.src: beathach mor solais! dean ion an anam tuirseach seo!
The Worm Holes#096.dst: beathach mor solais! dean ion an anam tuirseach seo!

Through the Pipes#001.src: You're a lifesaver, {u}. I cannot thank you enough!
Through the Pipes#001.dst: Tu m'as sauvé la vie, {u}. Je ne te remercierai jamais assez!

Through the Pipes#002.src: WAIT! MY ART BAG IS MISSING! Did I accidentally drop it somewhere?
Through the Pipes#002.dst: ATTENDS! MON SAC D'ARTISTE A DISPARU! Je l'ai fait tomber quelque part?

Through the Pipes#003.src: Do you want us to sink?!

similar.text: So you want us to sneak in?

Through the Pipes#004.src: What's your name... {u}? Great, I will resume searching for that fool as well. Best of luck to you!
Through the Pipes#004.dst: Comment t'appelles-tu... {u}? Super, je reprends mes recherches pour retrouver cet idiot. Bonne chance!

Through the Pipes#006.src: Maybe it's best to continue forward...
Through the Pipes#006.dst: Mieux vaut peut-être continuer tout droit...

Through the Pipes#008.src: You hear someone in the distance.

Through the Pipes#009.src: I'm so glad you found it! I don't know what I would do if I lost Soosu's gift and my bag!
Through the Pipes#009.dst: Ouf, tu l'as trouvé! Perdre le cadeau de Soosu et mon sac, je ne m'en serais pas remis!

Through the Pipes#010.src: You are? Excellent! Let's see what you've created.
Through the Pipes#010.dst: Ah oui? Excellent! Voyons ce que tu as créé.

Through the Pipes#012.src: Are you sure you want to leave the dock?

Through the Pipes#014.dst: Le générateur se met à ronronner.

Through the Pipes#015.src: You pull the hook off of the grapple. It might be useful later.
Through the Pipes#015.dst: Vous détachez le crochet du grappin. Il pourrait servir plus tard.

Through the Pipes#017.src: You must be on your raft to use this.
Through the Pipes#017.dst: Vous devez être sur votre radeau pour utiliser ceci.

Through the Pipes#018.src: Find a way to open that gate. I don't want to be on this raft for any longer!
Through the Pipes#018.dst: Ouvre cette grille d'une façon ou d'une autre. Je ne veux plus rester sur ce radeau!

Through the Pipes#020.src: Huh, this isn't- really what I expected.
Through the Pipes#020.dst: Hein, ce n'est pas- vraiment ce que j'attendais.

Through the Pipes#021.src: Are you sure you want to reset your raft?

Through the Pipes#022.src: Maybe there's something you could build to get across...
Through the Pipes#022.dst: Vous pourriez peut-être construire quelque chose pour traverser...

Through the Pipes#023.src: That looks like enough leaf litter. You should return to the generator to fuel it now.
Through the Pipes#023.dst: Ça semble assez de feuilles mortes. Retournez au générateur pour l'alimenter.

Through the Pipes#025.src: Especially considering how rarely Soosu shows up in public, this festival might be my only opportunity this year...
Through the Pipes#025.dst: Surtout que Soosu se montre rarement en public; ce festival est peut-être ma seule occasion cette année...

Through the Pipes#026.src: You should let Fichu know you're done.
Through the Pipes#026.dst: Vous devriez prévenir Fichu que vous avez terminé.

Through the Pipes#027.src: The board crumbles under your step. Maybe there's another way to the other side.
Through the Pipes#027.dst: La planche s'effrite sous votre pas. Il y a peut-être un autre chemin vers l'autre côté.

Through the Pipes#028.src: Talk with the citizen in despair at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Through the Pipes#029.src: H-Hey, you! Have you seen a raccoon anywhere?
Through the Pipes#029.dst: H-hé, toi! Tu n'aurais pas vu un raton laveur?
Through the Pipes#029.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#030.src: I spent all my free time making a gift for Soosu, and that devil snatched it from me! It would be a shame if I never got the chance to give it to her...
Through the Pipes#030.dst: J'ai passé tout mon temps libre à faire un cadeau pour Soosu, et ce démon me l'a arraché! Ce serait dommage de ne jamais pouvoir le lui offrir...
Through the Pipes#030.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#031.src: Say, this might be a big ask, but- do you think you could help me?
Through the Pipes#031.dst: Dis, c'est peut-être beaucoup demander, mais- tu pourrais m'aider?
Through the Pipes#031.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#032.src: Y-You will? I knew there was some good left in this world!
Through the Pipes#032.dst: T-tu veux bien? Je savais qu'il restait un peu de bonté en ce monde!
Through the Pipes#032.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#033.src: Right! Last time I saw that raccoon, it was running into an alleyway south of the town center. It can't have gone too far!
Through the Pipes#033.dst: Parfait! La dernière fois que j'ai vu ce raton laveur, il filait dans une ruelle au sud du centre-ville. Il ne peut pas être allé bien loin!
Through the Pipes#033.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#034.src: I will resume searching for that fool as well. Best of luck to you!
Through the Pipes#034.dst: Je reprends aussi mes recherches pour retrouver cet idiot. Bonne chance!
Through the Pipes#034.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#035.src: ...I get it. If you change your mind, come and talk with me again.
Through the Pipes#035.dst: ...Je comprends. Si tu changes d'avis, reviens me parler.
Through the Pipes#035.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#036.src: Yes! A raccoon! You've seen them before- surely? They're rampant around here!
Through the Pipes#036.dst: Oui! Un raton laveur! Tu en as déjà vu- forcément? Il y en a partout par ici!
Through the Pipes#036.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#038.src: You know, those furry gray creatures with the weird striped tails?
Through the Pipes#038.dst: Tu sais, ces bestioles grises et poilues avec une drôle de queue rayée?
Through the Pipes#038.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#039.src: ...I hope you know what a raccoon is.
Through the Pipes#039.dst: ...J'espère que tu sais ce qu'est un raton laveur.
Through the Pipes#039.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#041.src: Oh- you're back! Are you able to help me now?
Through the Pipes#041.dst: Oh- te revoilà! Tu peux m'aider maintenant?
Through the Pipes#041.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#043.src: I really think it would be better if we split up to search, don't you agree?
Through the Pipes#043.dst: Je pense vraiment qu'il vaut mieux se séparer pour chercher, tu ne trouves pas?
Through the Pipes#043.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#044.src: If you forgot, you should try searching south of the town center. But you do you, I suppose...
Through the Pipes#044.dst: Au cas où tu aurais oublié, cherche au sud du centre-ville. Mais fais comme tu veux, je suppose...
Through the Pipes#044.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#046.dst: Entrez dans le trou d'évacuation en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Through the Pipes#047.src: Enter the drainage hole at to continue the search.
Through the Pipes#047.dst: Entrez dans le trou d'évacuation pour poursuivre les recherches.

Through the Pipes#048.src: Dive deeper into the sewer network.

Through the Pipes#050.src: Find a way to get across the flooded section of the sewer.
Through the Pipes#050.dst: Trouvez un moyen de traverser la partie inondée des égouts.

Through the Pipes#051.src: Huh, is there someone down there?
Through the Pipes#051.dst: Hein, il y a quelqu'un en bas?

Through the Pipes#053.src: Continue chasing the raccoon through the sewers.
Through the Pipes#053.dst: Continuez de poursuivre le raton laveur dans les égouts.

Through the Pipes#054.src: You aren't getting away from me now!
Through the Pipes#054.dst: Tu ne m'échapperas pas cette fois!

Through the Pipes#055.src: Encounter a familiar face in the sewers.
Through the Pipes#055.dst: Croisez un visage familier dans les égouts.

Through the Pipes#056.src: Ah ha! I've got you now, thief!
Through the Pipes#056.dst: Ah ah! Je te tiens, voleur!

Through the Pipes#060.src: {u}! You're here! I was wondering where you went!
Through the Pipes#060.dst: {u}! Te voilà! Je me demandais où tu étais passé!
Through the Pipes#060.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#061.src: I've been chasing that raccoon the whole time! What in the world have you been up to?
Through the Pipes#061.dst: Moi, ça fait tout ce temps que je poursuis ce raton laveur! Mais qu'est-ce que tu fabriquais?
Through the Pipes#061.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#062.src: Whatever. I'm struggling to keep up the chase at this rate. But fortunately, I have just the thing that'll help you!
Through the Pipes#062.dst: Peu importe. A ce rythme, j'ai du mal à suivre. Mais heureusement, j'ai exactement ce qu'il te faut!
Through the Pipes#062.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#064.src: It's broken! How will I ever catch up with that crook at this rate?
Through the Pipes#064.dst: Il est cassé! Comment je vais rattraper cette fripouille, maintenant?
Through the Pipes#064.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#065.src: ...Maybe this is all a lost cause. You can try fixing it, I guess, but it's not worth it.
Through the Pipes#065.dst: ...C'est peut-être peine perdue. Tu peux essayer de le réparer, j'imagine, mais ça n'en vaut pas la peine.
Through the Pipes#065.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#066.src: I'm going that direction to see if I can catch that pest. You go the other way, we'll meet again soon.
Through the Pipes#066.dst: Je vais par là, voir si j'attrape cette peste. Toi, va de l'autre côté, on se retrouve bientôt.
Through the Pipes#066.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#067.src: Encounter the stranger in the sewers.

Through the Pipes#073.src: Who are you? What are you doing here?
Through the Pipes#073.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#074.src: Ah, exploring the sewers? That's fun! I've basically been to every corner of {p}'s sewers.
Through the Pipes#074.dst: Ah, tu explores les égouts? C'est amusant! J'ai fait à peu près tous les recoins des égouts de {p}.
Through the Pipes#074.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#075.src: Say, is there any chance you stumbled upon that raccoon earlier? That pest snatched something of value from me!
Through the Pipes#075.dst: Dis, tu n'aurais pas croisé un raton laveur tout à l'heure? Cette peste m'a volé quelque chose de précieux!
Through the Pipes#075.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#076.src: I was making a gift for Sovereign Soosu, but then that fiend just ran off with it! Horrible, isn't it?
Through the Pipes#076.dst: Je préparais un cadeau pour la Souveraine Soosu, et ce scélérat est parti avec! Horrible, non?
Through the Pipes#076.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#077.src: Especially with how soon the festival is... I wouldn't want to miss my only opportunity this year!
Through the Pipes#077.dst: Surtout que le festival approche... Je ne voudrais pas rater ma seule occasion de l'année!
Through the Pipes#077.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#078.src: I could really use your help, and hey- I have just the tool you'll want for exploring the sewers!
Through the Pipes#078.dst: Ton aide me serait précieuse, et tiens- j'ai justement l'outil idéal pour explorer les égouts!
Through the Pipes#078.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#082.src: I'm going that direction to see if I can catch that pest. What's your name... {u}? You go the other way, we'll meet again soon.
Through the Pipes#082.dst: Je vais par là, voir si j'attrape cette peste. Comment t'appelles-tu... {u}? Toi, va de l'autre côté, on se retrouve bientôt.
Through the Pipes#082.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#083.src: Find a safe way past the flooded rail tunnels.
Through the Pipes#083.dst: Trouvez un passage sûr à travers les tunnels ferroviaires inondés.

Through the Pipes#084.src: Whew! I didn't mean to let go-
Through the Pipes#084.dst: Ouf! Je ne voulais pas lâcher prise-
Through the Pipes#084.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#086.src: Perfect, I know where we are, and there isn't much further that foolish raccoon can run. We could corner it!
Through the Pipes#086.dst: Parfait, je sais où on est, et ce raton laveur idiot n'a plus beaucoup d'endroits où fuir. On pourrait le coincer!
Through the Pipes#086.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#087.src: Now, the problem is, I have no idea how to traverse this next area. It's heavily flooded if I can recall.
Through the Pipes#087.dst: Le problème, c'est que je ne sais pas comment traverser la zone suivante. Elle est très inondée, il me semble.
Through the Pipes#087.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#088.src: {u}! OH NO! I didn't mean to drop that on you-
Through the Pipes#088.dst: {u}! OH NON! Je ne voulais pas te faire tomber ça dessus-
Through the Pipes#088.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#089.src: W-why were you standing there? Out of all places?
Through the Pipes#089.dst: P-pourquoi tu étais là? De tous les endroits possibles?
Through the Pipes#089.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#090.src: ...Okay. You seem to be alright. Sorry, I didn't realize you were standing right there!
Through the Pipes#090.dst: ...Bon. Tu as l'air d'aller bien. Désolé, je n'avais pas vu que tu étais juste là!
Through the Pipes#090.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#091.src: Alright, at least we're regrouped now. Try not to stand under any more heavy objects, alright?
Through the Pipes#091.dst: Bon, au moins on est de nouveau réunis. Évite de te mettre sous d'autres objets lourds, d'accord?
Through the Pipes#091.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#092.src: Moving forward, the problem is, I have no idea how to traverse this next area. It's heavily flooded if I can recall.
Through the Pipes#092.dst: Pour la suite, le problème, c'est que je ne sais pas comment traverser la zone suivante. Elle est très inondée, si je me souviens bien.
Through the Pipes#092.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#093.src: You'll need to find some way for us to cross. Too many people have gotten the worst of diseases by wading through that water- eugh.
Through the Pipes#093.dst: Il faudra que tu trouves un moyen de nous faire traverser. Trop de gens ont attrapé des maladies horribles en pataugeant dans cette eau- beurk.
Through the Pipes#093.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#094.src: Right! Let me know when you figure something out. I'll scout around, never had an excuse to explore this area before!
Through the Pipes#094.dst: Parfait! Préviens-moi quand tu as une idée. Je vais faire un tour, je n'avais jamais eu d'excuse pour explorer ce coin!
Through the Pipes#094.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#095.src: Huh? What's all this stuff? Did someone forget their construction equipment?
Through the Pipes#095.dst: Hein? C'est quoi tout ce bazar? Quelqu'un a oublié son matériel de chantier?
Through the Pipes#095.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#096.src: I guess the maintenance crews never bother to pack up their equipment. Maybe you can use this stuff for something.
Through the Pipes#096.dst: J'imagine que les équipes d'entretien ne rangent jamais leur matériel. Tu pourrais peut-être t'en servir.
Through the Pipes#096.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#097.src: Check back in with me when you're done!
Through the Pipes#097.dst: Reviens me voir quand tu as fini!
Through the Pipes#097.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#098.src: Navigate through the end of the sewer network with Fichu.
Through the Pipes#098.dst: Traversez la fin du réseau d'égouts avec Fichu.

Through the Pipes#099.dst: Salut! Tu as trouvé quelque chose?
Through the Pipes#099.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#101.src: I'd appreciate it if you added a seat for me.
Through the Pipes#101.dst: J'apprécierais que tu m'ajoutes un siège.
Through the Pipes#101.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#104.dst: Je me demande où ça mène...
Through the Pipes#104.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#105.src: Bet no one's been here for a while.
Through the Pipes#105.dst: Personne n'est venu ici depuis un moment, je parie.
Through the Pipes#105.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#106.src: Wonder where that raccoon is now...
Through the Pipes#106.dst: Je me demande où est ce raton laveur maintenant...
Through the Pipes#106.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#107.src: Soosu needs to see that state of this place...
Through the Pipes#107.dst: Soosu devrait voir l'état de cet endroit...
Through the Pipes#107.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#109.src: What else do you think we'll find?
Through the Pipes#109.dst: Qu'est-ce qu'on va trouver d'autre, à ton avis?
Through the Pipes#109.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#110.src: I've heard a few stories about this place. Mostly bad ones...
Through the Pipes#110.dst: J'ai entendu quelques histoires sur cet endroit. Surtout des mauvaises...
Through the Pipes#110.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#111.src: I hope that raccoon hasn't gone too far...
Through the Pipes#111.dst: J'espère que ce raton laveur n'est pas allé trop loin...
Through the Pipes#111.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#114.src: This raft looks fragile, be careful!
Through the Pipes#114.dst: Ce radeau a l'air fragile, fais attention!
Through the Pipes#114.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#116.dst: Je crois que tu as heurté quelque chose.
Through the Pipes#116.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#119.src: You know what you're doing, right?
Through the Pipes#119.dst: Tu sais ce que tu fais, hein?
Through the Pipes#119.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#121.src: Ah! I almost fell out of my seat.
Through the Pipes#121.dst: Ah! J'ai failli tomber de mon siège.
Through the Pipes#121.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#123.src: Are you even capable of not hitting something?
Through the Pipes#123.dst: Tu es seulement capable de ne rien heurter?
Through the Pipes#123.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#124.src: One more hit and I'm taking over!
Through the Pipes#124.dst: Encore un choc et je prends les commandes!
Through the Pipes#124.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#125.src: I don't trust you sailing this thing!
Through the Pipes#125.dst: Je ne te fais pas confiance pour piloter ce truc!
Through the Pipes#125.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#127.src: It can't possibly be that hard!
Through the Pipes#127.dst: Ça ne peut pas être si difficile!
Through the Pipes#127.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#128.src: Make sure to be careful, okay?
Through the Pipes#128.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#129.src: No wonder everyone avoids this place...
Through the Pipes#129.dst: Pas étonnant que tout le monde évite cet endroit...
Through the Pipes#129.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#131.src: You know where you're going, right?
Through the Pipes#131.dst: Tu sais où tu vas, hein?
Through the Pipes#131.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#132.src: When I get that raccoon, oh man...
Through the Pipes#132.dst: Quand je vais attraper ce raton laveur, oh là là...
Through the Pipes#132.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#133.src: How long have I even spent chasing that fool...
Through the Pipes#133.dst: Depuis combien de temps je poursuis cet idiot...
Through the Pipes#133.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#135.src: Keep an eye out for dangers!
Through the Pipes#135.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#136.src: Make sure we're staying on track.
Through the Pipes#136.dst: Assure-toi qu'on reste sur la bonne voie.
Through the Pipes#136.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#137.src: Maybe rats are better than raccoons after all.
Through the Pipes#137.dst: Finalement, les rats valent peut-être mieux que les ratons laveurs.
Through the Pipes#137.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#138.src: I regret getting on this raft.
Through the Pipes#138.dst: Je regrette d'être monté sur ce radeau.
Through the Pipes#138.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#139.dst: S'il te plaît, ne fais pas de bêtise...
Through the Pipes#139.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#142.src: I cannot wait to get off...
Through the Pipes#142.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#144.src: I really don't want to insult you, but-
Through the Pipes#144.dst: Je ne veux vraiment pas te vexer, mais-
Through the Pipes#144.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#150.src: Ah! What will we do now?!
Through the Pipes#150.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#152.src: Hmm, is the raft broken? We haven't moved for a while.
Through the Pipes#152.dst: Hmm, le radeau est cassé? On n'a pas bougé depuis un moment.
Through the Pipes#152.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#153.src: Are you... going to have us move?
Through the Pipes#153.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#155.dst: On peut y aller, s'il te plaît?
Through the Pipes#155.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#156.src: I'm not sure why you think this place is interesting enough to stop at.
Through the Pipes#156.dst: Je ne vois pas ce que cet endroit a d'assez intéressant pour qu'on s'y arrête.
Through the Pipes#156.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#160.src: The raccoon is probably long gone at this point, thanks to your delay.
Through the Pipes#160.dst: Le raton laveur doit être loin maintenant, grâce à ton retard.
Through the Pipes#160.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#163.src: How long were we waiting for?
Through the Pipes#163.dst: On a attendu combien de temps?
Through the Pipes#163.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#164.src: Huh? What are you doing with that?!
Through the Pipes#164.dst: Hein? Qu'est-ce que tu fais avec ça?!
Through the Pipes#164.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#165.src: You're going to sink us with that!
Through the Pipes#165.dst: Tu vas nous faire couler avec ça!
Through the Pipes#165.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#167.src: IS THAT AN EXPLOSIVE?! ARE YOU MAD!
Through the Pipes#167.dst: C'EST UN EXPLOSIF?! TU ES FOU!
Through the Pipes#167.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#168.src: HELP US! WE'RE GOING TO DROWN!
Through the Pipes#168.dst: AU SECOURS! ON VA SE NOYER!
Through the Pipes#168.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#169.src: OH NO! GET ME OFF OF HERE!
Through the Pipes#169.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#172.src: Why did you think this was a good idea?!
Through the Pipes#172.dst: Pourquoi tu as cru que c'était une bonne idée?!
Through the Pipes#172.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#173.src: I gotta get off of this thing!
Through the Pipes#173.dst: Il faut que je descende de ce truc!
Through the Pipes#173.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#174.src: That's the exit! Go past this gate, then I never want to board anything sailed by you again!
Through the Pipes#174.dst: C'est la sortie! Passe cette grille, et après je ne monte plus jamais sur un truc que tu pilotes!

Through the Pipes#175.src: I gotta get off this thing!
Through the Pipes#175.dst: Faut que je descende de ce truc!
Through the Pipes#175.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#176.src: Hey- maybe we should've been a bit further away from that train?
Through the Pipes#176.dst: Hé- on aurait peut-être dû s'éloigner un peu plus de ce train?
Through the Pipes#176.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#177.dst: Un peu trop près à mon goût...
Through the Pipes#177.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#179.src: Agh! Sorry, just got scared by that.
Through the Pipes#179.dst: Agh! Désolé, ça m'a fait peur.
Through the Pipes#179.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#180.src: AHHHHH! THIS WAS A HORRIBLE IDEA!
Through the Pipes#180.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#181.src: OUT OF ALL ROUTES YOU TOOK, ONE OF THEM INCLUDED A TRAIN!
Through the Pipes#181.dst: DE TOUS LES CHEMINS POSSIBLES, TU AS PRIS CELUI AVEC UN TRAIN!
Through the Pipes#181.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#183.src: Huh? AH! THERE'S A TRAIN! GET OUT OF HERE!
Through the Pipes#183.dst: Hein? AH! IL Y A UN TRAIN! SORS D'ICI!
Through the Pipes#183.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#186.src: YOU REALLY THINK THIS FLIMSY RAFT IS GOING TO SURVIVE A TRAIN?!
Through the Pipes#186.dst: TU CROIS VRAIMENT QUE CE RADEAU MINABLE VA RÉSISTER AU TRAIN?!
Through the Pipes#186.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#187.src: YOU FOOL! We barely missed being hit!
Through the Pipes#187.dst: ESPÈCE D'IDIOT! On a failli se faire percuter!
Through the Pipes#187.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#188.src: Oh my- we survived! YOU ARE AN IDIOT! DON'T DO THAT AGAIN!
Through the Pipes#188.dst: Oh là- on a survécu! TU ES UN IDIOT! NE REFAIS PAS ÇA!
Through the Pipes#188.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#189.src: This looks like the halfway point!
Through the Pipes#189.dst: On dirait qu'on est à mi-chemin!
Through the Pipes#189.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#190.src: You'll need to find a way to open that gate, since I don't see any other way past.
Through the Pipes#190.dst: Il va falloir trouver comment ouvrir cette grille, je ne vois pas d'autre passage.
Through the Pipes#190.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#191.src: If I'm remembering correctly, just past this gate should be our destination!
Through the Pipes#191.dst: Si je me souviens bien, notre destination devrait être juste après cette grille!
Through the Pipes#191.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#192.src: Phew, we survived. That was a bit rough, but at least we made it.
Through the Pipes#192.dst: Ouf, on a survécu. C'était un peu mouvementé, mais au moins on y est.
Through the Pipes#192.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#193.src: However, I think I'll definitely be avoiding boats for now...
Through the Pipes#193.dst: Cela dit, je crois que je vais éviter les bateaux pendant un moment...
Through the Pipes#193.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#194.src: We made it! You did a pretty good job navigating, I knew I could trust you!
Through the Pipes#194.dst: On y est! Tu as plutôt bien piloté, je savais que je pouvais compter sur toi!
Through the Pipes#194.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#195.src: Alright, let's chase down that raccoon once and for all!
Through the Pipes#195.dst: Allez, attrapons ce raton laveur une bonne fois pour toutes!
Through the Pipes#195.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#196.src: I hope my prediction is right, and there really is no further it can run from here.
Through the Pipes#196.dst: J'espère avoir vu juste, et qu'il ne peut vraiment plus fuir plus loin.
Through the Pipes#196.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#198.src: Huh?! LOOK! It's the raccoon, that's it!
Through the Pipes#198.dst: Hein?! REGARDE! C'est le raton laveur, c'est lui!
Through the Pipes#198.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#201.src: Ah ha! Now you're cornered, you little imp!
Through the Pipes#201.dst: Ah ah! Te voilà coincé, petit diablotin!
Through the Pipes#201.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#202.src: Before you do anything, we need a way to take the gift back!
Through the Pipes#202.dst: Avant tout, il faut trouver comment récupérer le cadeau!
Through the Pipes#202.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#204.src: And look! We finally got the gift back! I knew we could do it.
Through the Pipes#204.dst: Et regarde! On a enfin récupéré le cadeau! Je savais qu'on y arriverait.
Through the Pipes#204.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#205.src: Hopefully this is still intact after all of that...
Through the Pipes#205.dst: Pourvu qu'il soit encore intact après tout ça...
Through the Pipes#205.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#206.src: It survived! Thank the queen! I don't know what I would do otherwise...
Through the Pipes#206.dst: Il a survécu! Merci la reine! Je ne sais pas ce que j'aurais fait sinon...
Through the Pipes#206.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#207.src: {u}, from the very start, you have been a massive help. I cannot thank you enough for your efforts!
Through the Pipes#207.dst: {u}, depuis le tout début, tu m'as énormément aidé. Je ne te remercierai jamais assez pour tes efforts!
Through the Pipes#207.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#208.src: ...You don't think that was a little too brutal, do you?
Through the Pipes#208.dst: ...Tu ne trouves pas que c'était un peu trop brutal?

Through the Pipes#209.src: {u}, from the very start, you were a massive help. I cannot thank you enough for your efforts!
Through the Pipes#209.dst: {u}, dès le début, tu m'as été d'une aide immense. Je ne te remercierai jamais assez pour tes efforts!
Through the Pipes#209.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#210.src: Without your help, I don't even know if I could have caught that raccoon on my own!
Through the Pipes#210.dst: Sans ton aide, je ne sais même pas si j'aurais pu attraper ce raton laveur tout seul!
Through the Pipes#210.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#211.src: As a reward, I have an extra gift just for you! Thank you again for your incredible help!
Through the Pipes#211.dst: En récompense, j'ai un cadeau rien que pour toi! Merci encore pour ton aide incroyable!
Through the Pipes#211.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#216.src: Not only did you safely get us through a flooded tunnel with- that creation of yours, but you came more prepared than I could have expected!
Through the Pipes#216.dst: Non seulement tu nous as fait traverser un tunnel inondé sains et saufs avec- ta création, mais en plus tu étais mieux préparé que je ne l'aurais cru!
Through the Pipes#216.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#217.src: A cage... a ring to use as a distraction... and even a firecracker. Where did you even find all this stuff?
Through the Pipes#217.dst: Une cage... une bague pour faire diversion... et même un pétard. Où as-tu trouvé tout ça?
Through the Pipes#217.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#218.src: And on top of all of that, you found my art supplies bag! That bag itself is more important to me than the gift we were chasing after!
Through the Pipes#218.dst: Et en plus de tout ça, tu as retrouvé mon sac de matériel de dessin! Ce sac compte plus pour moi que le cadeau qu'on pourchassait!
Through the Pipes#218.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#219.src: Speaking of that, I would like to give you Soosu's gift as a token of appreciation. I believe you're more deserving of it.
Through the Pipes#219.dst: D'ailleurs, j'aimerais t'offrir le cadeau de Soosu en signe de reconnaissance. Je crois que tu le mérites davantage.
Through the Pipes#219.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#220.src: Don't worry, I've already brainstormed a better design. I think Soosu will like this next one even more!
Through the Pipes#220.dst: Ne t'inquiète pas, j'ai déjà imaginé un meilleur modèle. Je crois que Soosu aimera encore plus le prochain!
Through the Pipes#220.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#221.src: Don't go so close! You might scare it off again!
Through the Pipes#221.dst: Ne t'approche pas autant! Tu pourrais encore le faire fuir!
Through the Pipes#221.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#222.src: Thank you again for the help! I couldn't have done it without you.
Through the Pipes#222.dst: Merci encore pour ton aide! Je n'y serais pas arrivé sans toi.
Through the Pipes#222.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#224.src:
If I see that raccoon...
Fichu
Through the Pipes#224.dst:
Si je revois ce raton laveur...
Fichu
Through the Pipes#224.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#225.src: I'm rushing to finish a gift I made for Sovereign Soosu! The festival's gonna be this week, and I can't miss my opportunity to give it to her!
Through the Pipes#225.dst: Je me dépêche de finir un cadeau pour la Souveraine Soosu! Le festival a lieu cette semaine, et je ne peux pas rater l'occasion de le lui offrir!
Through the Pipes#225.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#226.src: Just as I was about to add the finishing details, a raccoon snuck up on me and snatched it from my bag! Can you believe it?
Through the Pipes#226.dst: Juste au moment où j'allais ajouter les finitions, un raton laveur s'est faufilé et l'a chipé dans mon sac! Tu te rends compte?
Through the Pipes#226.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#228.src: Oh, you're wondering what the gift is? Well, that's a surprise!
Through the Pipes#228.dst: Oh, tu te demandes ce qu'est ce cadeau? Eh bien, c'est une surprise!
Through the Pipes#228.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#229.src: It might be the best thing I've made all year. I really think Soosu would love it, especially for all of the work she's done for our district!
Through the Pipes#229.dst: C'est peut-être ce que j'ai fait de mieux cette année. Je crois vraiment que Soosu l'adorerait, surtout pour tout ce qu'elle a fait pour notre district!
Through the Pipes#229.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#230.src: If you want to see it, you'll have to help me find it. How does that sound?
Through the Pipes#230.dst: Si tu veux le voir, tu devras m'aider à le retrouver. Qu'en dis-tu?
Through the Pipes#230.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#231.src: The water seems to have cleared the debris.
Through the Pipes#231.dst: L'eau semble avoir dégagé les débris.

Through the Pipes#232.src: It looks like a valve handle could fit into this slot.
Through the Pipes#232.dst: On dirait qu'un {c2}volant de vanne{/} pourrait s'insérer dans cette fente.

Through the Pipes#233.src:
{#} to add fuel to
 the generator
[{~}/{~}]

Through the Pipes#227.src: This water looks too dangerous to swim in.
Through the Pipes#227.dst: Cette eau semble trop dangereuse pour y nager.

Through the Pipes#234.src: Different materials around the room can be used as raft parts.
Through the Pipes#234.dst: Divers matériaux dans la salle peuvent servir de {c2}pièces de radeau{/}.

Through the Pipes#235.src:

Through the Pipes#236.src: Some raft parts may have unique functions.
Through the Pipes#236.dst: Certaines pièces de radeau peuvent avoir des {c2}fonctions uniques{/}.

Through the Pipes#237.src: Place the raft parts on the building mat to construct your raft.
Through the Pipes#237.dst: Posez les pièces sur le {c2}tapis de montage{c1} pour construire votre radeau.

Through the Pipes#238.dst: Il n'y a... pas d'hélices ici?

Through the Pipes#239.src: Maybe you need to find a different method of propulsion.
Through the Pipes#239.dst: Il vous faut peut-être trouver {c2}un autre moyen de propulsion{c1}.

Through the Pipes#240.src: You must have a fully constructed raft to set sail.
Through the Pipes#240.dst: Il vous faut un {c2}radeau entièrement construit{/} pour lever l'ancre.

Through the Pipes#241.src: The lever appears to be jammed. Maybe it needs power?
Through the Pipes#241.dst: Le levier semble coincé. Il lui faut peut-être {c2}du courant{/}?

Through the Pipes#242.src: It looks like this station hasn't been powered in a very long time.
Through the Pipes#242.dst: On dirait que cette station n'a pas été alimentée depuis très longtemps.

Through the Pipes#243.src: Fortunately, it still seems to be accepting power.
Through the Pipes#243.dst: Heureusement, elle semble encore accepter le courant.

Through the Pipes#244.src: You could fit this with a grappling hook.

Through the Pipes#245.src: You seem to have gone off track. Sadly, your raft isn't able to survive this far.
Through the Pipes#245.dst: Vous semblez être sorti du parcours. Hélas, votre radeau ne tient pas aussi loin.

Through the Pipes#246.src: Your raft seems to have vanished into thin air. (Unknown error occured!)
Through the Pipes#246.dst: Votre radeau semble s'être volatilisé. {c2}(Une erreur inconnue s'est produite!)

Through the Pipes#247.src: You shouldn't open this just yet.
Through the Pipes#247.dst: Vous ne devriez pas ouvrir ceci tout de suite.

Through the Pipes#250.src:
But I would never steal, right?
Fichu
Through the Pipes#250.dst:
Mais je ne volerais jamais, hein?
Fichu
Through the Pipes#250.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#251.src:
No wonder the water tastes so weird...
Fichu
Through the Pipes#251.dst:
Pas étonnant que l'eau ait un goût si bizarre...
Fichu
Through the Pipes#251.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#255.src:
This workbench is quite convenient.
Fichu
Through the Pipes#255.dst:
Cet établi est bien pratique.
Fichu
Through the Pipes#255.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#256.src: Oh, don't mind me. I'm just seeing if there's anything interesting here.
Through the Pipes#256.dst: Oh, ne fais pas attention à moi. Je cherche juste un truc intéressant par ici.
Through the Pipes#256.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#257.src: Usually there's cool things to, well- steal, but this place seems to be a bust.
Through the Pipes#257.dst: D'habitude il y a des trucs sympas à, eh bien- voler, mais ici, c'est un fiasco.
Through the Pipes#257.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#258.src: There sure is a lot hidden underground, you wouldn't believe some of the things I've seen!
Through the Pipes#258.dst: Il y en a, des choses cachées sous terre, tu ne croirais pas certaines choses que j'ai vues!
Through the Pipes#258.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#259.src: They seem to be busy with something. You should check in later.
Through the Pipes#259.dst: Cette personne semble occupée. Vous devriez revenir plus tard.

Through the Pipes#260.src: That's great to hear! I haven't found anything useful unfortunately.
Through the Pipes#260.dst: Ravi de l'entendre! Malheureusement, je n'ai rien trouvé d'utile.
Through the Pipes#260.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#261.src: I'm quite interested to see what you come up with, return to me when you're done!
Through the Pipes#261.dst: J'ai hâte de voir ce que tu vas inventer, {c2}reviens me voir quand tu as fini{/}!
Through the Pipes#261.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#262.src: You know what, not a bad idea! Let's give it a try!
Through the Pipes#262.dst: Tu sais quoi, pas bête! Essayons!
Through the Pipes#262.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#264.src: Trains are cool... not when they're speeding right next to you.
Through the Pipes#264.dst: Les trains, c'est cool... sauf quand ils foncent juste à côté de toi.
Through the Pipes#264.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#265.src: Oh, thank the Queen! It's the halfway point.
Through the Pipes#265.dst: Oh, merci la Reine! On est à mi-chemin.
Through the Pipes#265.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#266.src: Woah, that looks like an expensive ring! You really think the raccoon will take it?
Through the Pipes#266.dst: Ouah, cette bague a l'air de valoir cher! Tu crois vraiment que le raton laveur va la prendre?
Through the Pipes#266.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#267.src: Hold on, where did you even get that- nevermind, I won't ask any questions. Give it a try!
Through the Pipes#267.dst: Attends, où as-tu bien pu trouver ça- non, laisse, je ne pose pas de questions. Essaie!
Through the Pipes#267.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#270.src: I hope no one cared about that ring, because they sure aren't getting it back...
Through the Pipes#270.dst: J'espère que personne ne tenait à cette bague, parce qu'on ne la reverra pas...
Through the Pipes#270.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#271.src: Great work! After all of that, we've finally gotten the gift back! I knew we could do it.
Through the Pipes#271.dst: Beau travail! Après tout ça, on a enfin récupéré le cadeau! Je savais qu'on y arriverait.
Through the Pipes#271.speaker: Fichu

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#002.src: I challenge you to reach the final floor!
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#002.dst: Je te mets au défi d'atteindre le dernier étage!
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#002.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#003.src: Have you got what it takes to conquer it?
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#003.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#004.src: Perhaps you would like to know the layout of the tower first? Hehehehe...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#004.dst: Peut-être voudrais-tu d'abord connaître l'agencement de la tour? Héhéhéhé...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#004.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#005.src: There are {~} floors in this tower, each with ten levels.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#005.dst: Cette tour compte {~} étages, chacun avec dix niveaux.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#005.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#006.src: Each floor has nine regular levels and one boss level.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#006.dst: Chaque étage a neuf niveaux normaux et un niveau de boss.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#006.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#007.src: To pass a regular level, you must collect five tokens from the challenge on that level, and one token from boss levels.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#007.dst: Pour passer un niveau normal, tu dois récupérer cinq jetons dans l'épreuve de ce niveau, et un seul pour les niveaux de boss.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#007.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#008.src: After you beat a whole floor, you will return here and you can begin the next one...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#008.dst: Après avoir battu un étage entier, tu reviendras ici et tu pourras commencer le suivant...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#008.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#009.src: So, what do you say? Hehehe...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#009.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#010.src: Turn left and head to the first floor...if you dare...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#010.dst: Tourne à gauche et rends-toi au premier étage... si tu l'oses...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#010.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#011.src: Well done, adventurer, you have successfully completed this floor! You may proceed.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#011.dst: Bien joué, aventurier, tu as terminé cet étage! Tu peux continuer.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#011.speaker: Floormaster

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#012.src: You have completed my tower, I see...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#012.dst: Tu as terminé ma tour, je vois...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#012.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#013.src: Did you enjoy Death? Many challengers certainly did. Her power is... unmatched, hehehe...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#013.dst: As-tu apprécié la Mort? Bien des prétendants, assurément. Son pouvoir est... sans égal, héhéhé...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#013.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#014.src: A tower of madness, fueled by Death herself... Quite a challenge, yes?
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#014.dst: Une tour de folie, alimentée par la Mort elle-même... Tout un défi, n'est-ce pas?
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#014.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#015.src: You have joined us now, champion... Few can claim this victory as their own. Fewer still have held their mind.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#015.dst: Tu es des nôtres, champion... Rares sont ceux qui peuvent revendiquer cette victoire. Plus rares ceux qui ont gardé la raison.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#015.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#016.src: For this honor... A reward, for you. You have truly earned it... Hehehehe...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#016.dst: Pour cet honneur... Une récompense, pour toi. Tu l'as vraiment méritée... Héhéhéhé...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#016.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#018.src: I need five tokens from the enemies in this room as evidence that you are strong enough to ascend.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#018.dst: Il me faut cinq jetons des ennemis de cette salle pour prouver que tu es assez fort pour monter.

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#019.src: And you... You are unlike them all, yes? Few have managed to ascend these floors.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#019.dst: Et toi... Tu n'es pas comme eux tous, n'est-ce pas? Peu ont réussi à gravir ces étages.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#019.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#020.src: I need one token from the boss in this room a

Tribal Aggression#000.src: Not only did the {p} steal our totem but also stole one of our Idol's eyes!
Tribal Aggression#000.dst: Non seulement {p} nous a volé notre totem, mais aussi un des yeux de notre Idole!
Tribal Aggression#000.speaker: Eagle Tribesman

Tribal Aggression#001.src: The totems hold great protective magical power. Without all the parts, it can not function.
Tribal Aggression#001.dst: Les totems renferment une grande magie protectrice. Sans toutes ses pièces, il ne fonctionne pas.
Tribal Aggression#001.speaker: Eagle Tribesman

Tribal Aggression#002.src: It is probably hiding away somewhere at the {p}. Maybe if there's peace we can return it.
Tribal Aggression#002.dst: Il doit être caché quelque part dans {p}. Si la paix revient, peut-être pourrons-nous le récupérer.
Tribal Aggression#002.speaker: Eagle Tribesman

Tribal Aggression#003.src: You may go now traveler, farewell.
Tribal Aggression#003.dst: Vous pouvez partir maintenant, voyageur. Adieu.

Tribal Aggression#004.src: My tribe worries our own business, stranger.
Tribal Aggression#004.dst: Ma tribu s'occupe de ses propres affaires, étranger.
Tribal Aggression#004.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#005.src: I'm sure they hid the totem, but if you are able to find it, I await your return!
Tribal Aggression#005.dst: Ils ont sûrement caché le totem, mais si vous parvenez à le trouver, j'attendrai votre retour!
Tribal Aggression#005.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#006.src: Hopefully, we two camps will never set foot on another's land in an attempt to steal back the totems, and live in peace.
Tribal Aggression#006.dst: Espérons que nos deux camps ne mettront plus jamais le pied sur les terres de l'autre pour reprendre les totems, et vivront en paix.
Tribal Aggression#006.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#007.src: I-Is that, the totem? My, it has been a long time since the owl has been with me. Though I wonder if the Eagle and Owl totem possess the same mystic powers.
Tribal Aggression#007.dst: C-c'est le totem? Ma foi, cela faisait longtemps que le hibou n'était plus à mes côtés. Je me demande toutefois si les totems de l'Aigle et du Hibou ont les mêmes pouvoirs mystiques.
Tribal Aggression#007.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#008.src: Have you gotten our totem back yet? The Eagle camp is across the river, on the other side of the canyon.
Tribal Aggression#008.dst: Avez-vous récupéré notre totem? Le camp de l'Aigle est de l'autre côté de la rivière, au-delà du canyon.

Tribal Aggression#010.src: Oh, my apologies, I did not realize you are a warrior of the province! We would be grateful of your help.
Tribal Aggression#010.dst: Oh, pardonnez-moi, je ne savais pas que vous étiez un guerrier de la Province! Votre aide nous serait précieuse.
Tribal Aggression#010.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#011.src: Our sacred owl totem that we worship was stolen by the cunning Eagle Tribe many years ago. Its magical properties used to bring prosperity to our camp.
Tribal Aggression#011.dst: Notre totem sacré du hibou, que nous vénérons, nous a été volé par la rusée tribu de l'Aigle il y a bien des années. Sa magie apportait la prospérité à notre camp.
Tribal Aggression#011.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#012.src: However, the Eagle tribe are not victorious, we possess their mystic eagle totem, but alas, I do not know who was the original thief.
Tribal Aggression#012.dst: Mais la tribu de l'Aigle n'a pas gagné pour autant: nous détenons leur totem mystique de l'aigle, même si, hélas, j'ignore qui fut le premier voleur.
Tribal Aggression#012.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#013.src: We have been at war for years now, despite being neighbors. Without our totem, our rivalry will continue for ages and peace will never again be felt in our hearts.
Tribal Aggression#013.dst: Nous sommes en guerre depuis des années, bien que voisins. Sans notre totem, notre rivalité durera des siècles et nos coeurs ne connaîtront plus jamais la paix.
Tribal Aggression#013.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#014.src: Retrieve our totem, and the blessing of the Owl spirit will be with you.
Tribal Aggression#014.dst: Récupérez notre totem, et la bénédiction de l'esprit du Hibou vous accompagnera.
Tribal Aggression#014.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#015.src: Now, enter the Eagle Camp across the river, you may have to search the camp, I'm sure they have hidden our totem!
Tribal Aggression#015.dst: Entrez dans le camp de l'Aigle, de l'autre côté de la rivière; fouillez-le, ils ont sûrement caché notre totem!
Tribal Aggression#015.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#016.src: Enter the Eagle Camp and talk to Favian
Tribal Aggression#016.dst: Entrez dans le camp de l'Aigle et parlez à Favian

Tribal Aggression#017.src: Greetings, what brings you to the noble Eagle tribe?
Tribal Aggression#017.dst: Salutations, qu'est-ce qui vous amène chez la noble tribu de l'Aigle?
Tribal Aggression#017.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#018.src: You seek the Owl totem? The cursed Owl tribe trying to retain their lost dignity again.
Tribal Aggression#018.dst: Le totem du hibou? Ces maudits Hiboux tentent encore de retrouver leur dignité perdue.
Tribal Aggression#018.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#019.src: Why should we give you their totem back? They stole our source of enlightenment all those years ago.
Tribal Aggression#019.dst: Pourquoi vous rendrions-nous leur totem? Ils nous ont volé notre source d'illumination il y a des années.
Tribal Aggression#019.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#020.src: Tell you what, if you can retrieve our Eagle Totem, I will allow you to go return the Owl totem.
Tribal Aggression#020.dst: Je vous propose ceci: rapportez notre totem de l'aigle, et je vous laisserai rendre celui du hibou.
Tribal Aggression#020.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#021.src: Bring back the Eagle Totem from the Owl Camp
Tribal Aggression#021.dst: Rapportez le totem de l'aigle depuis le camp du Hibou

Tribal Aggression#022.src: Wonderful! You may now enter the cave to retrieve the blasted Owl totem.
Tribal Aggression#022.dst: Magnifique! Entrez donc dans la grotte récupérer ce maudit totem du hibou.
Tribal Aggression#022.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#023.src: Be careful, there are Eagle guardians in the cave, be prepared traveller.
Tribal Aggression#023.dst: Prudence, des gardiens aigles occupent la grotte, soyez prêt, voyageur.
Tribal Aggression#023.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#024.src: Once you get the totem, you may return it to its original tribe.
Tribal Aggression#024.dst: Une fois le totem en main, vous pourrez le rendre à sa tribu d'origine.
Tribal Aggression#024.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#025.src: Anyways, hurry up, even the thought of the two totems sharing the same space makes me sick.
Tribal Aggression#025.dst: Bref, dépêchez-vous, rien que d'imaginer les deux totems au même endroit me rend malade.
Tribal Aggression#025.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#026.src: Retrieve the Owl Totem and return it to the Owl Camp
Tribal Aggression#026.dst: Récupérez le totem du hibou et rapportez-le au camp du Hibou

Tribal Aggression#027.src: To think, such a long war could end so quickly and by the help of a single person.
Tribal Aggression#027.dst: Qui l'eût cru: une guerre si longue, terminée si vite, grâce à une seule personne.
Tribal Aggression#027.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#028.src: Many thanks to you! I shall keep my promise, please accept this reward, and may the Owl be forever with you.
Tribal Aggression#028.dst: Merci infiniment! Je tiendrai ma promesse, acceptez cette récompense, et que le Hibou soit toujours avec vous.
Tribal Aggression#028.speaker: Caras

Troubled Tribesmen#000.src: Fa yna tuusat! Dra sykel uv drec cylnat dnaa ryc paah lunnibdat.
Troubled Tribesmen#000.dst: Fa yna tuusat! Dra sykel uv drec cylnat dnaa ryc paah lunnibdat.
Troubled Tribesmen#000.speaker: Ka L'argwit

Troubled Tribesmen#001.src: Oui tuh'd ihtancdyht y funt E ys cyoehk. Dryd kio Krattson ybbaync du cbayg ouin myhkiyka.
Troubled Tribesmen#001.dst: Oui tuh'd ihtancdyht y funt E ys cyoehk. Dryd kio Krattson ybbaync du cbayg ouin myhkiyka.
Troubled Tribesmen#001.speaker: Ka L'argwit

Troubled Tribesmen#002.src: But despite my efforts, he just sat in silence with his eyes closed. He must've known I wasn't a threat because he was totally exposed. He had no interest in speaking with me, though.
Troubled Tribesmen#002.dst: Mais malgré mes efforts, il est resté assis en silence, les yeux fermés. Il devait savoir que je n'étais pas une menace, car il était totalement à découvert. Mais il n'avait aucune envie de me parler.
Troubled Tribesmen#002.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#003.src: Oui ryja y bufanvim vaam ypuid oui, cdnyhkan. So baubma yna eh tyhkan. Bmayca, dyga drec yht ramb dras.
Troubled Tribesmen#003.dst: Oui ryja y bufanvim vaam ypuid oui, cdnyhkan. So baubma yna eh tyhkan. Bmayca, dyga drec yht ramb dras.
Troubled Tribesmen#003.speaker: Shaman Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#004.src: What did Ka L'argwit have to say? ...I see... please go and speak with him as soon as possible.
Troubled Tribesmen#004.dst: Qu'avait à dire Ka L'argwit? ...Je vois... je vous en prie, allez lui parler au plus vite.

Troubled Tribesmen#005.src: For as long as I am able to recall upon, my people have called this tree our guardian. She shares her magic with those who respect her and keep her healthy.
Troubled Tribesmen#005.dst: D'aussi loin que je me souvienne, mon peuple a appelé cet arbre notre gardienne. Elle partage sa magie avec ceux qui la respectent et la gardent en bonne santé.

Troubled Tribesmen#006.src: Or so, she did. A few sunrises ago, an outlandish creature cascaded through the tree's magic barrier as if it was made of cotton!
Troubled Tribesmen#006.dst: Du moins, autrefois. Il y a quelques levers de soleil, une étrange créature a traversé la barrière magique de l'arbre comme du coton!

Troubled Tribesmen#007.src: It burrowed deep within the roots, and unleashed huge egg pods. They're filled with disgusting insects that are draining her of protective magic.
Troubled Tribesmen#007.dst: Elle s'est enfouie au plus profond des racines et a libéré d'énormes cocons d'oeufs. Ils sont remplis d'insectes répugnants qui lui drainent sa magie protectrice.

Troubled Tribesmen#008.src: And to make matters worse.. they must be replacing the magic with corruption. Just look at her, she's obviously very sick!
Troubled Tribesmen#008.dst: Et pour ne rien arranger... ils doivent remplacer cette magie par de la corruption. Regardez-la, elle est manifestement très malade!

Troubled Tribesmen#009.src: Even some of our own people have lost their minds and have become very dangerous. It just crushes my soul to see this happening before my eyes.
Troubled Tribesmen#009.dst: Même certains des nôtres ont perdu la raison et sont devenus très dangereux. Voir cela se produire sous mes yeux me brise l'âme.

Troubled Tribesmen#010.src: Our protective magic is extremely weak right now. If I try to stop the creature myself I will surely be vanquished. You on the other hand, look most protected.
Troubled Tribesmen#010.dst: Notre magie protectrice est extrêmement faible en ce moment. Si j'essaie d'arrêter la créature moi-même, je serai sûrement vaincu. Vous, en revanche, semblez fort bien protégé.

Troubled Tribesmen#011.src: It benefits us both if the creature is stopped. You will have a safer time traversing the jungle and our people will be saved.
Troubled Tribesmen#011.dst: Il est dans notre intérêt à tous deux que la créature soit arrêtée. Vous traverserez la jungle plus sereinement et notre peuple sera sauvé.

Troubled Tribesmen#012.src: Simply follow the path of destruction. It started at the roots, so you should make your way in from there. Be cautious, and may Entamis guide you.
Troubled Tribesmen#012.dst: Suivez simplement la trace de destruction. Elle a commencé aux racines, vous devriez donc entrer par là. Soyez prudent, et qu'Entamis vous guide.

Troubled Tribesmen#013.src: Enter the base of the trunk, and Entamis will guide you to the creature.
Troubled Tribesmen#013.dst: Entrez par la base du tronc, et Entamis vous guidera jusqu'à la créature.

Troubled Tribesmen#014.src: Hello again. I am grateful you have returned safely. You don't need to say anything, though. I no longer can sense Entamis. I know she has died...
Troubled Tribesmen#014.dst: Rebonjour. Je vous suis reconnaissant d'être revenu sain et sauf. Mais inutile de dire quoi que ce soit. Je ne sens plus Entamis. Je sais qu'elle est morte...
Troubled Tribesmen#014.speaker: Shaman Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#015.src: You still managed to prevent her corrupted magic to spread any further. And for that, my people are forever in your debt.
Troubled Tribesmen#015.dst: Vous avez tout de même empêché sa magie corrompue de se propager davantage. Pour cela, mon peuple vous sera à jamais redevable.
Troubled Tribesmen#015.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#016.src: Please take this. It is but a small gift. Your currency is meaningless to us. In times of peril, few step forward and risk their lives to save those they do not know.
Troubled Tribesmen#016.dst: Prenez ceci, je vous prie. Ce n'est qu'un modeste présent. Votre monnaie n'a aucune valeur pour nous. En temps de péril, rares sont ceux qui risquent leur vie pour sauver des inconnus.
Troubled Tribesmen#016.speaker: Shaman Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#019.src: Hey! Aren't these people fascinating? They sure smell bad, though! What? That Tribesman said my name?! Amazing! I've been trying to communicate with them for weeks.
Troubled Tribesmen#019.dst: Hé! Ces gens sont fascinants, non? Ils sentent sacrément mauvais, cela dit! Quoi? Ce membre de la tribu a dit mon nom?! Incroyable! Ça fait des semaines que j'essaie de communiquer avec eux.
Troubled Tribesmen#019.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#020.src: He sure seems like a distressed little fellow. He keeps pointing to that huge tree right there. A {p} keeper once told me it's possible to speak with them.
Troubled Tribesmen#020.dst: Il a l'air d'un petit bonhomme bien angoissé. Il n'arrête pas de montrer cet arbre immense, là. Un gardien de {p} m'a dit un jour qu'il est possible de leur parler.
Troubled Tribesmen#020.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#021.src: He told me that within the woods there is a Shaman who will grant certain people permission to speak their language. I did some traveling through the jungle and actually found him!
Troubled Tribesmen#021.dst: Il m'a dit que dans les bois vit un chaman qui accorde à certaines personnes le droit de parler leur langue. J'ai un peu parcouru la jungle et je l'ai vraiment trouvé!
Troubled Tribesmen#021.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#023.src: Say, who knows, maybe the Shaman will talk to you. It would greatly assist my research if you could help me talk to them. So why don't you give it a shot?
Troubled Tribesmen#023.dst: Dis, qui sait, le chaman te parlera peut-être. Ça aiderait beaucoup mes recherches si tu m'aidais à leur parler. Alors pourquoi ne pas tenter le coup?
Troubled Tribesmen#023.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#024.src: Follow this path to the north. Keep going past the pond and the path will split to the West and to the East. Take the West path, and you will see the Shaman.
Troubled Tribesmen#024.dst: Suis ce chemin vers le nord. Passe l'étang et le chemin se sépare vers l'ouest et l'est. Prends celui de l'ouest, et tu verras le chaman.
Troubled Tribesmen#024.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#027.src: I have cast a spell on you. If you can understand me, you are pure of heart.
Troubled Tribesmen#027.dst: Je vous ai jeté un sort. Si vous me comprenez, c'est que votre coeur est pur.
Troubled Tribesmen#027.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#028.src: This spell will allow those of true spirit to speak and comprehend our language. I have entrusted you with this because of my connection with our sacred tree, who we call Entamis.
Troubled Tribesmen#028.dst: Ce sort permet à ceux dont l'esprit est sincère de parler et de comprendre notre langue. Je vous l'ai confié grâce à mon lien avec notre arbre sacré, que nous appelons Entamis.
Troubled Tribesmen#028.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#029.src: I am the shaman of my tribe. I sit here every day with my eyes closed and carefully monitor Entamis' wavelengths. She has not been responding to my calls as of late...
Troubled Tribesmen#029.dst: Je suis le chaman de ma tribu. Je m'assieds ici chaque jour, les yeux fermés, et surveille attentivement les ondes d'Entamis. Elle ne répond plus à mes appels, ces derniers temps...
Troubled Tribesmen#029.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#030.src: Dear human, your presence emits warmth and trust. Please go speak with my apprentice, Ka L'argwit. He is to take my place as shaman when I pass from this life.
Troubled Tribesmen#030.dst: Cher humain, votre présence dégage chaleur et confiance. Allez parler à mon apprenti, Ka L'argwit. Il prendra ma place de chaman quand je quitterai cette vie.
Troubled Tribesmen#030.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#031.src: He would know if anything is causing our beautiful tree discomfort. The spell I have cast on you will allow you to speak with him.
Troubled Tribesmen#031.dst: Il saurait si quelque chose fait souffrir notre bel arbre. Le sort que je vous ai jeté vous permettra de lui parler.
Troubled Tribesmen#031.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#032.src: Now, please go seek out Ka L'argwit.
Troubled Tribesmen#032.dst: Maintenant, allez trouver Ka L'argwit, je vous prie.
Troubled Tribesmen#032.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#035.src: Thank you for coming. We haven't but moments. The monster's name is Aenara. He's a fiendish monster of corruption.
Troubled Tribesmen#035.dst: Merci d'être venu. Il ne nous reste que quelques instants. Le monstre s'appelle Aenara. C'est un monstre diabolique de la Corruption.
Troubled Tribesmen#035.speaker: Entamis

Troubled Tribesmen#036.src: He unleashed egg pods that host a variety of magic draining insects. They are eating me alive and replacing my magic with evil magic. Soon I will die.
Troubled Tribesmen#036.dst: Il a libéré des cocons d'oeufs pleins d'insectes qui drainent la magie. Ils me dévorent vivante et changent ma magie en magie maléfique. Je vais bientôt mourir.
Troubled Tribesmen#036.speaker: Entamis

Troubled Tribesmen#037.src: You mustn't let me be reborn a creature of evil...
Troubled Tribesmen#037.dst: Ne me laissez pas renaître en créature du mal...
Troubled Tribesmen#037.speaker: Entamis

Troubled Tribesmen#038.src: Kill Aenara and bring an Insect of Corruption to Shaman Inrekei.
Troubled Tribesmen#038.dst: Tuez Aenara et apportez un Insecte de la Corruption au chaman Inrekei.

Troubled Tribesmen#041.src: This insect appears to be the queen. I'll need to perform a ritual to kill it permanently. But never mind that, I can do that in my own time.
Troubled Tribesmen#041.dst: Cet insecte semble être la reine. Je devrai accomplir un rituel pour la tuer définitivement. Mais peu importe, je m'en chargerai en temps voulu.
Troubled Tribesmen#041.speaker: Inrekei

True Colours#000.dst: - Sujet #{~}. A volé de la nourriture à la cantine.

True Colours#001.src: - Subjects require sustenance based on the form they are currently using.
True Colours#001.dst: - Les sujets ont besoin d'une alimentation adaptée à la forme qu'ils utilisent.

True Colours#002.src: - Leave no gaps in the cell. Subjects may transform into small creatures in order to escape.
True Colours#002.dst: - Aucun interstice dans la cellule. Les sujets peuvent se changer en petites créatures pour s'évader.

True Colours#005.src: The cabinet is locked. A label reads: Project Hallowground.
True Colours#005.dst: L'armoire est verrouillée. Une étiquette indique: Projet Hallowground.

True Colours#009.src: Feel free to take the zipline up to the canopy.
True Colours#009.dst: N'hésitez pas à prendre la tyrolienne pour monter jusqu'aux cimes.

True Colours#011.dst: Il y a beaucoup d'autres étapes...

True Colours#012.src: Alright, enough games. Now, dance for me! Hehehahehah!
True Colours#012.dst: Bon, assez joué. Maintenant, danse pour moi! Héhéhahéhah!

True Colours#014.src: Changelings are a great asset to any army. They are proven excellent spies.
True Colours#014.dst: Les changelins sont un atout pour toute armée. Ce sont des espions éprouvés.

True Colours#015.src: - Provide subjects with daily stimulus. Enquire with instructors on current curriculum.
True Colours#015.dst: - Stimuler les sujets chaque jour. Voir le programme actuel avec les instructeurs.

True Colours#017.src: - Yusanu. Wanted. Will be held until Sovereign Majin arrives.
True Colours#017.dst: - Yusanu. Recherché. Sera détenu jusqu'à l'arrivée du Souverain Majin.

True Colours#018.src: ...and she needed help. Needed someone powerful - someone from Fruma, but who had also seen... well, all of it. The world, and their impact on it.
True Colours#018.dst: ...et elle avait besoin d'aide. Il lui fallait quelqu'un de puissant - quelqu'un de Fruma, mais qui avait aussi vu... enfin, tout. Le monde, et l'effet qu'ils ont sur lui.

True Colours#020.src: Their biology makes them easily adaptable to any situation, they can easily become heat resistant or cold resistant.
True Colours#020.dst: Leur biologie les rend très adaptables à toute situation, ils peuvent facilement devenir résistants à la chaleur ou au froid.

True Colours#022.src: ...there has to be a key around here somewhere.
True Colours#022.dst: ...il doit bien y avoir une clé quelque part par ici.

True Colours#023.src: Meet up with The Canopy at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#024.src: {u}! Did you hear? They- they finished, um, sorting through the reports!
True Colours#024.dst: {u}! Tu as entendu? Ils- ils ont fini, euh, de trier les rapports!
True Colours#024.speaker: Sui

True Colours#025.src: Azael says he has news about everyone from the Roughworks!
True Colours#025.dst: Azael dit qu'il a des nouvelles de tous ceux de Roughworks!
True Colours#025.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#026.src: Indeed... indeed. Ehm... where to begin...
True Colours#026.dst: En effet... en effet. Hum... par où commencer...
True Colours#026.speaker: Azael

True Colours#027.src: Outsiders, I would... temper your expectations.
True Colours#027.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#029.src: I am afraid we are sorely lacking in good news. The Owls have returned with reports of a rather sudden influx of prisoners taken to Deraj Prison following the festival.
True Colours#029.dst: Je crains que les bonnes nouvelles se fassent rares. Les Hiboux rapportent un afflux soudain de prisonniers envoyés à la prison de Deraj après le festival.
True Colours#029.speaker: Azael

True Colours#030.dst: D... Deraj? Vous... vous en êtes sûr?
True Colours#030.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#031.src: No... no, no, it- it can't be, there- there has to be another explanation...
True Colours#031.dst: Non... non, non, c- c'est impossible, il- il doit y avoir une autre explication...
True Colours#031.speaker: Sui

True Colours#032.src: Ah, Gravity's Monolith... it truly is a sight to behold, dark carved stone and burning crimson lights shining deep in the southern wastes...
True Colours#032.dst: Ah, le Monolithe de la Gravité... un spectacle à voir, de la pierre sombre sculptée et des lumières cramoisies brûlant au fin fond des terres désolées du sud...
True Colours#032.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#033.src: A shame it's inescapable, or I'd love to pay a visit. It's true, what they say- there is no escaping its pull once it gets a hold of you!
True Colours#033.dst: Dommage qu'on n'en sorte pas, j'adorerais le visiter. Ce qu'on dit est vrai- une fois qu'il vous tient, son attraction ne vous lâche plus!
True Colours#033.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#034.src: I... I've, I've heard the rumors... are- are they really true?
True Colours#034.dst: J'ai... j'ai, j'ai entendu les rumeurs... elles- elles sont vraies?
True Colours#034.speaker: Sui

True Colours#035.src: As far as we can tell. We don't have a single record of a successful escape attempt. Supposedly, the Warden's blessing keeps the prisoners in line.
True Colours#035.dst: Pour autant qu'on sache. Nous n'avons aucune trace d'une seule évasion réussie. Il paraît que la bénédiction du directeur maintient les prisonniers dans le rang.
True Colours#035.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#037.src: Cileon, goodness! There's no need for the dramatics! What they mean to say, dear friends, is that none who enter are ever heard from again!
True Colours#037.dst: Cileon, enfin! Pas besoin de tant de drame! Ce qu'il veut dire, chers amis, c'est qu'on n'a plus jamais de nouvelles de ceux qui y entrent!
True Colours#037.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#038.src: Gravity's Monolith, they call it... an inescapable pull, drawing you deeper and deeper into its clutches the more you try to break free!
True Colours#038.dst: Le Monolithe de la Gravité, dit-on... une attraction inéluctable, qui vous enfonce dans ses griffes à mesure que vous luttez!
True Colours#038.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#039.src: Oh, you're one to talk about dramatics. But he's right. I wouldn't get your hopes up.
True Colours#039.dst: Oh, tu es mal placé pour parler de drame. Mais il a raison. Je ne me ferais pas trop d'espoirs.
True Colours#039.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#040.src: Unfortunately, it would seem we also lack the details on who specifically has been sent there.
True Colours#040.dst: Malheureusement, il semble que nous ignorions aussi qui, précisément, y a été envoyé.
True Colours#040.speaker: Azael

True Colours#041.src: Sigh. Azael, sir, it's cruel to leave them in the dark. You need to tell them.
True Colours#041.dst: Pff. Azael, monsieur, c'est cruel de les laisser dans le flou. Vous devez leur dire.
True Colours#041.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#043.src: I suppose you are right, captain. It is regarding the older woman among your party... Syndra, was it?
True Colours#043.dst: Je suppose que tu as raison, capitaine. Cela concerne la femme plus âgée de votre groupe... Syndra, c'est bien cela?
True Colours#043.speaker: Azael

True Colours#044.src: It would seem that Her Majesty has made her into a statement.
True Colours#044.dst: Il semble que Sa Majesté ait fait d'elle un exemple.
True Colours#044.speaker: Azael

True Colours#046.src: She was publicly executed during the festival, as a way to send a message.
True Colours#046.dst: Elle a été exécutée publiquement pendant le festival, pour faire passer un message.
True Colours#046.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#047.src: Subtle as a brick, aren't you?
True Colours#047.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#048.src: I apologize. This must be a shock. It is my understanding she was something of a leader to you all.
True Colours#048.dst: Je vous présente mes excuses. Ce doit être un choc. Si j'ai bien compris, elle était un peu votre cheffe à tous.
True Colours#048.speaker: Azael

True Colours#049.src: So it would seem. My, it has been an age since Her Majesty last performed such an act... how interesting, that she would deem it necessary.
True Colours#049.dst: On dirait bien. Ma foi, cela faisait une éternité que Sa Majesté n'avait pas fait une chose pareille... intéressant, qu'elle l'ait jugé nécessaire.
True Colours#049.speaker: Azael

True Colours#050.src: But rest assured that her death will not be for nought. She fought like a true warrior, to the bitter end.
True Colours#050.dst: Mais soyez assurés que sa mort ne sera pas vaine. Elle s'est battue comme une vraie guerrière, jusqu'au bout.
True Colours#050.speaker: Azael

True Colours#051.dst: Je....... n- non, je.... elle... elle ne p- peut pas.... je.... je-
True Colours#051.speaker: Sui

True Colours#053.src: Yes, a fine idea, Cileon. Space - that we certainly can provide!
True Colours#053.dst: Oui, bonne idée, Cileon. De l'espace - ça, nous pouvons en donner!
True Colours#053.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#054.src: Ugh. Fine. Captains, let's talk plans. Come on.
True Colours#054.dst: Pff. Bon. Capitaines, parlons stratégie. Venez.
True Colours#054.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#055.src: Talk to Sui and Yusanu at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#055.dst: Parlez à Sui et Yusanu en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#057.src: I... I didn't think she could... how...?
True Colours#057.dst: Je... je ne pensais pas qu'elle pouvait... comment...?
True Colours#057.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#058.src: She... she d-died, and we... w-we all got separated. She died and... she's d-dead. D-dead dead... dead. She's... dead.
True Colours#058.dst: Elle... elle est m-morte, et on a t-tous été séparés. Elle est morte et... elle est m-morte. M-morte morte... morte. Elle est... morte.
True Colours#058.speaker: Sui

True Colours#059.src: And the others... to Deraj? What... what are we going to do now?
True Colours#059.dst: Et les autres... à Deraj? Qu'est-ce... qu'est-ce qu'on va faire maintenant?
True Colours#059.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#060.src: N-no, we... we can't. You... you heard Rurie. There's no escaping once they take you there...
True Colours#060.dst: N-non, on... on ne peut pas. Tu... tu as entendu Rurie. On ne s'échappe pas une fois qu'ils t'y emmènent...
True Colours#060.speaker: Sui

True Colours#061.src: I... I've lost too many people to th-that place. So many friends, c-captured and... and taken...
True Colours#061.dst: J'ai... j'ai perdu trop de gens à c-cause de cet endroit. Tant d'amis, c-capturés et... emmenés...
True Colours#061.speaker: Sui

True Colours#063.src: {u}, are you really considering this?! You can't just- just- throw yourself into a suicide mission!
True Colours#063.dst: {u}, tu y penses vraiment?! Tu ne peux pas- pas- te jeter dans une mission suicide!
True Colours#063.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#064.src: ...fine. Fine! Just... make sure you c-come back. The three of us, we... we're all that's, ha, left.
True Colours#064.dst: ...d'accord. D'accord! Mais... arrange-toi pour r-revenir. Nous trois, on... on est tout ce qui, ha, reste.
True Colours#064.speaker: Sui

True Colours#065.src: I need to get back to work. Keep trying to align the resonances... maybe if I get it to work, it'll actually help us...
True Colours#065.dst: Je dois retourner au travail. Continuer à aligner les résonances... si j'y arrive, ça nous aidera peut-être vraiment...
True Colours#065.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#066.src: ...{u}, um. You should... tell Master Azael what you're doing. Before you... go.
True Colours#066.dst: ...{u}, euh. Tu devrais... dire à maître Azael ce que tu fais. Avant de... partir.
True Colours#066.speaker: Sui

True Colours#067.src: Say good bye to Master Azael before heading to the Deraj Prison at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#067.dst: Faites vos adieux à maître Azael avant de vous rendre à la prison de Deraj en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#068.src: Stupid... resonance core. Pink, green, blue, white, gold... what am I supposed to even do with this?!
True Colours#068.dst: Stupide... noyau de résonance. Rose, vert, bleu, blanc, or... qu'est-ce que je suis censé faire de ça?!
True Colours#068.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#070.src: I must apologize once more for being so blunt with the news. I am often told I am lacking in that kind of sensitivity.
True Colours#070.dst: Je dois encore m'excuser d'avoir annoncé la nouvelle si brutalement. On me reproche souvent de manquer de ce genre de tact.
True Colours#070.speaker: Azael

True Colours#071.src: Worry not, that is what you have us captains for! In addition to all the, ah, other stuff we do!
